english_meaning: original appearance; original state
explanation_mandarin: 指事物最初或未改變之前的樣子。
explanation_english: Refers to the original appearance or state of something before it has been changed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度嘅建築物盡可能保留咗佢哋嘅原貌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 ge3 gin3 zuk1 mat6 zeon6 ho2 nang4 bo2 lau4 zo2 keoi5 dei6 ge3 jyun4 maau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的建筑物尽可能保留了它们原来的面貌。
examples.english_sentence: The buildings here have been preserved in their original state as much as possible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過咁多年，條村都仲大致保持住原貌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 gam3 do1 nin4, tiu4 cyun1 dou1 zung6 daai6 zai3 bo2 chi4 zyu6 jyun4 maau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过这么多年，这条村都还大致保持着原来的面貌。
examples.english_sentence: After so many years, this village has still largely retained its original appearance.

english_meaning: First wife; legal wife; original spouse (referring to a woman)
explanation_mandarin: 指第一个妻子，通常指法律上的妻子，多用于已婚男性对妻子的称呼，尤其是在有妾或情妇的情况下。
explanation_english: Refers to the first wife, usually the legally recognized wife. Often used by married men to refer to their wife, especially in situations involving concubines or mistresses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋以前係一夫多妻制，所以先有原配呢個講法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ji5 cin4 hai6 jat1 fu1 do1 cai1 zai3, so2 ji5 sin1 jau5 jyun4 pui3 ne1 go3 gong2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们以前是一夫多妻制，所以才有原配这种说法。
examples.english_sentence: They used to have polygamy, so there was this term 'first wife'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢雖然有錢咗，但都冇諗過要飛咗佢原配。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seoi1 jin4 jau5 cin2 zo2, daan6 dou1 mou5 nim2 gwo3 jiu3 fei1 zo2 keoi5 jyun4 pui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他虽然有钱了，但也没想过要抛弃他的原配。
examples.english_sentence: Although he became rich, he never thought about abandoning his first wife.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺舊時嘅社會，原配嘅地位係非常重要嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gau6 si4 ge3 se5 wui2, jyun4 pui3 ge3 dei6 wai2 hai6 fei1 soeng4 zung6 jiu3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在旧时的社会，原配的地位是非常重要的。
examples.english_sentence: In the old society, the position of the first wife was very important.

english_meaning: field; open country; wilderness
explanation_mandarin: 指广阔的田野；未开垦或少开垦的土地。
explanation_english: A wide open area of land; open country, especially when wild or uncultivated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成群牛羊喺原野上面食草。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seng4 kwan4 ngau4 joeng4 hai2 jyun4 je5 soeng6 min6 sik6 cou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 成群的牛羊在原野上吃草。
examples.english_sentence: Herds of cattle and sheep are grazing in the fields.

english_meaning: toilet, restroom, lavatory
explanation_mandarin: 指供人排泄大小便的场所。
explanation_english: A room or building containing a toilet and usually a sink.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該，我想問下邊度有厠所啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1, ngo5 soeng2 man6 haa5 bin1 dou6 jau5 ci3 so2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请问一下，我想问一下哪里有厕所？
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, I would like to ask where the toilet is?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間厠所好污糟，冇人清潔咁嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 ci3 so2 hou2 wu1 zou1, mou5 jan4 cing1 git3 gam2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个厕所很脏，好像没人清洁。
examples.english_sentence: This toilet is very dirty, it seems like no one has cleaned it.

english_meaning: to faint, to lose consciousness, to pass out
explanation_mandarin: 指因脑部供血不足而突然失去知觉。
explanation_english: Refers to a sudden loss of consciousness due to insufficient blood supply to the brain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到血就厥咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou2 hyut3 zau6 kyut3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到血就昏过去了。
examples.english_sentence: He fainted when he saw blood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢可能係低血糖，所以先至會厥嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ho2 nang4 hai6 dai1 hyut3 tong4, so2 ji5 sin1 zi3 wui5 kyut3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他可能是低血糖，所以才会昏厥的。
examples.english_sentence: He probably has low blood sugar, that's why he fainted.

english_meaning: to dislike, to be tired of, to be sick of, to loathe
explanation_mandarin: 表示对某事物感到厌恶，不再喜欢或愿意继续接触。
explanation_english: Expresses dislike, boredom, or weariness towards something, indicating a desire to avoid further contact or experience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好厭呢份工呀，日日都做埋啲無聊嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 jim3 ni1 fan6 gung1 aa3, jat1 jat1 dou1 zou6 maai4 di1 mou4 liu4 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我好讨厌这份工作啊，每天都做一些无聊的事情。
examples.english_sentence: I really dislike this job, I'm doing boring things every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁厭食啦，食多啲菜先至健康㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 jim3 sik6 laa1, sik6 do1 di1 coi3 sin1 zi3 gin6 hong1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么挑食，多吃点蔬菜才健康。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so picky about food, eat more vegetables to be healthy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經厭到痺，唔想再聽佢嘅藉口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 jim3 dou3 bei3, m4 soeng2 zoi3 teng1 keoi5 ge3 zik1 hau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已经厌烦到麻木了，不想再听他的借口。
examples.english_sentence: I'm so fed up that I don't want to hear his excuses anymore.

english_meaning: pessimistic; world-weary; nihilistic
explanation_mandarin: 对世界感到厌倦，觉得人生没有意义或价值，带有消极情绪。
explanation_english: Feeling tired of the world and life; expressing a pessimistic or nihilistic view, feeling that life is meaningless or worthless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都話好厭世，唔知諗乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 waa6 hou2 yim3 sai3, m4 zi1 nam2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说很厌世，不知道在想什么。
examples.english_sentence: He always says he's world-weary; I wonder what he's thinking about.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁厭世啦，世界仲有好多美好嘅嘢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 yim3 sai3 laa1, sai3 gaai3 zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 mei5 hou2 ge3 je5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么厌世啦，世界还有很多美好的东西。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so pessimistic, there are still many good things in the world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近發生咁多事，難怪佢會覺得厭世。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 faat3 sang1 gam3 do1 si6, naan4 gwaai3 keoi5 wui5 gok3 dak1 yim3 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近发生这么多事，难怪他会觉得厌世。
examples.english_sentence: With so many things happening recently, it's no wonder he feels world-weary.

english_meaning: tired of; weary of; bored with
explanation_mandarin: 对某种事物失去兴趣，感到疲惫或不耐烦。
explanation_english: Feeling tired of or weary with something after having too much of it; losing interest in something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對而家份工感到厭倦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 ji4 gaa1 fan6 gung1 gam2 dou3 jim3 gyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对现在的工作感到厌倦。
examples.english_sentence: I am tired of my current job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 日日都係咁，我都覺得有啲厭倦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat6 jat6 dou1 hai6 gam2, ngo5 dou1 gok3 dak1 jau5 di1 jim3 gyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每天都这样，我都觉得有点厌倦。
examples.english_sentence: It's like this every day, I feel a bit bored with it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢已經厭倦咗咁樣嘅生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 ging1 jim3 gyun6 zo2 gam2 joeng2 ge3 sang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他已经厌倦了这样的生活。
examples.english_sentence: He is already tired of this kind of life.

english_meaning: disgust, aversion, to detest, to loathe
explanation_mandarin: 指对某事物或某人非常不喜欢，甚至感到恶心。
explanation_english: To feel disgust or aversion towards something or someone; to dislike intensely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好厭惡佢嘅行為，真係好乞人憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 yim3 ok3 keoi5 ge3 hang4 wai4, zan1 hai6 hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我非常厌恶他的行为，真的很令人讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: I really detest his behavior, it's truly repulsive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對賭博好厭惡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 dou2 bok3 hou2 yim3 ok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他非常厌恶赌博。
examples.english_sentence: He has a strong aversion to gambling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅臭脾氣真係令人厭惡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 chau3 pei4 hei3 zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 yim3 ok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的坏脾气真的很令人厌恶。
examples.english_sentence: His bad temper is really disgusting.

mandarin_meaning: 令人厌恶的行业；令人反感的行业
english_meaning: Unsavory industry; Undesirable industry; Industry generally considered unpleasant or distasteful
explanation_mandarin: 指那些因为其工作性质、社会观感或潜在风险而令人感到厌恶或不喜欢的行业。这些行业通常涉及处理脏、臭、危险或不道德的事情。
explanation_english: Refers to industries that are generally considered unpleasant or undesirable due to the nature of the work, social perception, or potential risks involved. These industries often involve dealing with dirty, smelly, dangerous, or morally questionable activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 清潔工都算係厭惡性行業，雖然佢哋對社會好重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing1 git3 gung1 dou1 syun3 hai6 yim3 ok3 sing3 hang4 jip6, seui1 jin4 keoi5 dei6 deoi3 se5 wui2 hou2 cung5 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 清洁工也算是令人厌恶的行业，虽然他们对社会很重要。
examples.english_sentence: Cleaning workers are considered an unsavory industry, although they are very important to society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多人唔想做殯儀業，覺得係厭惡性行業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 jan4 m4 soeng2 zou6 ban3 ji4 jip6, gok3 dak1 hai6 yim3 ok3 sing3 hang4 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多人不想从事殡仪业，觉得是令人厌恶的行业。
examples.english_sentence: Many people don't want to work in the funeral industry because they think it's an undesirable industry.

english_meaning: feeling of disgust, aversion, repugnance
explanation_mandarin: 指因某种事物或行为而产生的强烈反感和厌弃的感觉。
explanation_english: A feeling of intense dislike, aversion, or repugnance towards something or someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對佢嘅行為感到好大嘅厭惡感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 keoi5 ge3 hang4 wai4 gam2 dou3 hou2 daai6 ge3 yim3 ngok3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对他的行为感到非常大的厌恶感。
examples.english_sentence: I feel a great sense of disgust towards his behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事令我產生咗厭惡感，唔想再接觸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ling6 ngo5 chan2 sang1 zo2 yim3 ngok3 gam2, m4 soeng2 zoi3 zip3 cuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事让我产生了厌恶感，不想再接触。
examples.english_sentence: This incident gave me a feeling of aversion, and I don't want to be involved anymore.

english_meaning: to detest; to despise; to loathe; to reject
explanation_mandarin: 表示不喜欢或厌恶，因而排斥、丢弃。
explanation_english: To feel disgust or dislike towards someone or something, leading to rejection or abandonment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為我窮就厭棄我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai4 ngo5 kung4 zau6 yim3 hei3 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为我穷就嫌弃我。
examples.english_sentence: He despised me because I was poor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好因為佢嘅外表而厭棄佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 jan1 wai4 keoi5 ge3 ngoi6 biu2 ji4 yim3 hei3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要因为他的外表而嫌弃他。
examples.english_sentence: Don't despise him because of his appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份工太辛苦，所以厭棄咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 taai3 san1 fu2, so2 ji5 yim3 hei3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工作太辛苦了，所以嫌弃了。
examples.english_sentence: His job was too tiring, so he quit/despised it.

english_meaning: Anorexia; loss of appetite; aversion to food
explanation_mandarin: 指对食物失去兴趣或食欲，有时特指神经性厌食症。
explanation_english: Refers to a loss of appetite or interest in food, sometimes specifically referring to anorexia nervosa.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近唔知點解突然間厭食，乜嘢都唔想食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 m4 zi1 dim2 gaai2 dat6 jin4 gaan1 yim3 sik6, mat1 je5 dou1 m4 soeng2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近不知道为什么突然厌食，什么都不想吃。
examples.english_sentence: He suddenly has anorexia recently for some reason and doesn't want to eat anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果小朋友長期厭食，最好帶佢去睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 siu2 pang4 jau5 coeng4 kei4 yim3 sik6, zeoi3 hou2 daai3 keoi5 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果小朋友长期厌食，最好带他去看医生。
examples.english_sentence: If children have a long-term loss of appetite, it's best to take them to see a doctor.

english_meaning: Awesome, amazing, formidable, severe, terrible
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度很高，很强，很厉害。
explanation_english: Indicates a high degree, strength, or awesomeness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試攞到第一名，真係好厲害。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 lo2 dou3 dai6 jat1 ming4, zan1 hai6 hou2 lai6 hai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试得了第一名，真的很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: He got first place in the exam, he's really awesome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排啲風都好厲，要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 di1 fung1 dou1 hou2 lai6, jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近的风很大，要小心一点。
examples.english_sentence: The wind has been strong lately, be careful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢功夫好厲害，好多人都打唔過佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gung1 fu1 hou2 lai6 hai6, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 daa2 m4 gwo3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他功夫很厉害，很多人都打不过他。
examples.english_sentence: His Kung Fu is formidable, many people can't beat him.

english_meaning: To hold on tightly, to grip firmly, to cling to
explanation_mandarin: 表示緊緊抓住某物不放手，通常用於形容情況危急或非常重視某事物。
explanation_english: Means to hold onto something tightly, not letting go. Usually used to describe a situation where someone is in a precarious situation or highly values something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺巴士上面，一定要厲住扶手呀，費事跌親。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 baa1 si2 soeng6 min6, jat1 ding6 jiu3 lai6 zyu6 fu4 sau2 aa3, fai3 si2 dit3 can1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在巴士上，一定要抓住扶手啊，免得摔倒。
examples.english_sentence: On the bus, you must hold onto the handrail tightly, in case you fall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢厲住份工唔放，因為經濟唔好，好難搵到第二份。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lai6 zyu6 fan6 gung1 m4 fong3, jan1 wai6 ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, hou2 naan4 wan2 dou3 dai6 ji6 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他紧紧抓住这份工作不放，因为经济不好，很难找到第二份。
examples.english_sentence: He's clinging to this job because the economy is bad and it's hard to find another one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢厲住我隻手，驚我走失。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lai6 zyu6 ngo5 zek3 sau2, geng1 ngo5 zau2 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他紧紧抓住我的手，怕我走丢。
examples.english_sentence: He held onto my hand tightly, afraid I would get lost.

english_meaning: awesome; formidable; serious; severe; skillful
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人或某事物程度很深，超出一般水平。也可表示情况严重。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone that is impressive, skillful, powerful, or serious, exceeding the ordinary level. Can also indicate a serious situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲功夫好厲害㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 gung1 fu1 hou2 lai6 hoi6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的功夫很厉害的。
examples.english_sentence: His Kung Fu is very impressive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次感冒好厲害，睇醫生啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 gam2 mou6 hou2 lai6 hoi6, tai2 ji1 sang1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次感冒很厉害，去看医生吧。
examples.english_sentence: This cold is really bad, go see a doctor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁後生就做咗經理，真係好厲害！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 hau6 saang1 zau6 zou6 zo2 ging1 lei5, zan1 hai6 hou2 lai6 hoi6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么年轻就当了经理，真厉害！
examples.english_sentence: You became a manager at such a young age, you're really awesome!

english_meaning: Malevolent ghost; vengeful spirit; fierce ghost
explanation_mandarin: 指非常凶恶，带有强烈怨恨，具有强大力量的鬼。
explanation_english: Refers to a ghost that is extremely fierce, filled with intense resentment, and possesses great power. Often associated with tragic deaths or unresolved grievances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話呢間屋以前死過人，所以有厲鬼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 ni1 gaan1 uk1 ji5 cin4 sei2 gwo3 jan4, so2 ji5 jau5 lai6 gwai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说这间屋子以前死过人，所以有厉鬼。
examples.english_sentence: He said that someone died in this house before, so there's a malevolent ghost.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講佢死得好慘，變成咗一隻厲鬼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 keoi5 sei2 dak1 hou2 caam2, bin3 sing4 zo2 jat1 zek3 lai6 gwai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说他死得很惨，变成了一只厉鬼。
examples.english_sentence: It's said that he died tragically and turned into a vengeful spirit.

english_meaning: cheek, gill cover (of a fish)
explanation_mandarin: 指面颊，也指鱼的鳃盖。
explanation_english: Refers to the cheek or the gill cover of a fish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢塊厴紅卜卜咁，好得意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faai3 jim2 hung4 buk1 buk1 gam2, hou2 dak1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的脸颊红扑扑的，很可爱。
examples.english_sentence: His cheeks are rosy and cute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條魚個厴郁下郁下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 yu2 go3 jim2 juk1 haa5 juk1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那条鱼的鳃盖动个不停。
examples.english_sentence: The fish's gill cover is moving up and down.

english_meaning: miser, stingy person, skinflint
explanation_mandarin: 比喻非常吝啬、小气的人。因为螃蟹的腹部有壳（厴仔），就像把钱藏起来一样。
explanation_english: A metaphor for a very stingy person. It's derived from the crab's belly which has a shell (厴仔) that is similar to someone hiding money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係隻厴仔蟹嚟㗎，一蚊都唔捨得用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 zek3 jim2 zai2 haai5 lai4 gaa3, jat1 man1 dou1 m4 se2 dak1 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是个吝啬鬼，一毛钱都舍不得花。
examples.english_sentence: He's really a miser, he can't bear to spend even a cent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做厴仔蟹啦，請大家飲杯嘢啫！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 jim2 zai2 haai5 laa1, cheng2 daai6 gaa1 jam2 bui1 ye5 ze1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别做个小气鬼了，请大家喝一杯东西而已嘛！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a skinflint, just treat everyone to a drink!

mandarin_meaning: 色狼; 花痴 (形容男性)
english_meaning: lecherous man; wolf; horndog
explanation_mandarin: 形容男性非常饥渴，见到女性就想靠近或占便宜，行为令人厌恶。带有贬义。
explanation_english: Describes a man who is very eager and desperate for female attention, often in a lecherous or inappropriate way. It implies a strong, almost animalistic, desire and is generally considered derogatory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條友成日喺街度望住啲女仔，真係厹到爆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 jau2 seng4 jat6 hai2 gaai1 dou6 mong6 zyu6 di1 neoi5 zai2, zan1 hai6 gau1 dou3 baau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个人整天在街上看著那些女孩，真是色狼到了极点。
examples.english_sentence: That guy is always staring at girls on the street, he's such a horndog.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁厹啦，人哋會唔舒服㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 gau1 laa1, jan4 dei6 wui5 m4 syu1 fuk6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么色狼啦，别人会不舒服的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be such a lecher, it makes people uncomfortable.

english_meaning: to go
explanation_mandarin: 表示从一个地方移动到另一个地方。
explanation_english: To move from one place to another; to go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要去香港。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 hoeng1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要去香港。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Hong Kong tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你去邊呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 heoi3 bin1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要去哪里呀？
examples.english_sentence: Where are you going?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想去飲茶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 jam2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想去喝茶。
examples.english_sentence: I want to go to have dim sum.

english_meaning: To go on holiday; to take a vacation
explanation_mandarin: “去P”是香港常用的粤语口语，其中“P”是英文单词“Party”的缩写，但在这种语境下并非指参加派对，而是指请假或者度假。这是一个比较轻松幽默的说法。
explanation_english: "去P" is a common Cantonese colloquialism in Hong Kong. "P" is an abbreviation of the English word "Party", but in this context, it doesn't mean attending a party. Instead, it means taking leave or going on vacation. It's a relatively lighthearted and humorous way of saying it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月想去P一個禮拜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 soeng2 heoi3 pi1 jat1 go3 lai5 baai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月想去度假一个星期。
examples.english_sentence: I want to go on holiday for a week next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都話要去P，唔知佢邊度嚟咁多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 waa6 jiu3 heoi3 pi1, m4 zi1 keoi5 bin1 dou6 lai4 gam3 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天都说要去度假，不知道他从哪里来这么多钱。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps saying he wants to go on vacation, I don't know where he gets so much money from.

english_meaning: to pass away; to die
explanation_mandarin: 较委婉的说法，指人死去。
explanation_english: A more euphemistic way of saying that someone has died; to pass away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我爺爺舊年去世喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 je4 je2 gau6 nin4 heoi3 sai3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我爷爷去年去世了。
examples.english_sentence: My grandfather passed away last year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢去世之後，留低咗好多嘢俾佢啲仔女。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 heoi3 sai3 zi1 hau6, lau4 dai1 zo2 hou2 do1 je5 bei2 keoi5 di1 zai2 neoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他去世之后，留下了很多东西给他的孩子们。
examples.english_sentence: After he passed away, he left a lot of things to his children.

mandarin_meaning: 去香港浸会大学或香港城市大学上学/去九龙塘一带购物或休闲
english_meaning: To go to Kowloon Tong (often implies going to Hong Kong Baptist University or City University of Hong Kong, or going there for shopping/leisure)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是“去九龍塘”，九龍塘是香港的一个地区，因香港浸会大学和香港城市大学位于该区，所以也常指去这两所大学上学。此外，九龍塘又一城是著名的购物中心，所以也可能指去该区购物或休闲。
explanation_english: Literally means "to go to Kowloon Tong". Kowloon Tong is a district in Hong Kong where Hong Kong Baptist University and City University of Hong Kong are located. Therefore, it can also mean going to these two universities to study. Additionally, Kowloon Tong's Festival Walk is a well-known shopping mall, so it can also refer to going to the area for shopping or leisure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要去九龍塘返學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 gau2 lung4 tong4 faan1 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要去九龙塘上学。
examples.english_sentence: I need to go to Kowloon Tong for school tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不如我哋去九龍塘又一城行街啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 gau2 lung4 tong4 jau6 jat1 sing4 haang4 gaai1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不如我们去九龙塘又一城逛街吧。
examples.english_sentence: How about we go shopping at Festival Walk in Kowloon Tong?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日去九龍塘溝女。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 heoi3 gau2 lung4 tong4 kau1 neoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常去九龙塘泡妞。
examples.english_sentence: He often goes to Kowloon Tong to pick up girls (implying around the university area).

english_meaning: to write a letter
explanation_mandarin: 书写并寄送信件。
explanation_english: To write and send a letter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日會去信俾你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 wui5 heoi3 seon3 bei2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天会给你写信。
examples.english_sentence: I will write a letter to you tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好少人去信，大家都用email多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 siu2 jan4 heoi3 seon3, daai6 ga1 dou1 jung6 email do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很少人写信，大家都用电子邮件多。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, few people write letters; everyone uses email more.

english_meaning: To steal and rob; to resort to theft and robbery
explanation_mandarin: 形容人走投无路，被迫去做偷窃和抢劫的事情。通常指在极端困境下，不得已而为之的行为，带有无奈和绝望的意味。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone is driven to steal and rob, often indicating a desperate act born out of extreme hardship and leaving no other option.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冇錢開飯，唔通真係要我去偷去搶咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou5 cin2 hoi1 faan6, m4 tung1 zan1 hai6 jiu3 ngo5 heoi3 tau1 heoi3 coeng2 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没钱吃饭，难道真的要我去偷去抢吗？
examples.english_sentence: I have no money for food, do you really expect me to steal and rob?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟咁差，好多人失業，逼住去偷去搶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 zai3 gam3 caa1, hou2 do1 jan4 sat1 jip6, bik1 zyu6 heoi3 tau1 heoi3 coeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济这么差，很多人失业，被迫去偷去抢。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is so bad, many people are unemployed and forced to steal and rob.

mandarin_meaning: 做到极致 / 做到最好 / 不遗余力
english_meaning: To go all out / To go to the extreme / To give it your all / To push something to the limit
explanation_mandarin: 形容做事全力以赴，做到最好，毫不保留。也可以指将某事物推到极限。
explanation_english: Describes putting in maximum effort to achieve the best possible result, holding nothing back. Can also refer to pushing something to its limit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試我要去到盡，攞個A返嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ngo5 jiu3 heoi3 dou3 zeon6, lo2 go3 ei1 faan1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我要全力以赴，拿个A回来。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to give it my all in this exam and get an A.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好去到盡，唔會hea做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 heoi3 dou3 zeon6, m4 wui5 hea1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作非常认真，不会敷衍了事。
examples.english_sentence: He goes all out when he works and doesn't slack off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你部車已經去到盡，唔好再踩啦，會整壞㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bou6 ce1 ji5 ging1 heoi3 dou3 zeon6, m4 hou2 zoi3 caai2 laa1, wui2 zing2 waai6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的车已经开到极限了，不要再踩油门了，会坏的。
examples.english_sentence: Your car is already at its limit, don't push it any further, it will break down.

mandarin_meaning: 阉割, 势颓, 失去影响力
english_meaning: castration, to castrate, to lose influence, to be on the decline
explanation_mandarin: 原指动物或人的阉割，引申为失去权势或影响力，走向衰败。
explanation_english: Originally refers to the castration of animals or people. By extension, it means losing power or influence, or heading towards decline.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司嘅權力已經俾人去勢咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 ge3 kuen4 lik6 ji5 ging1 bei2 jan4 heoi3 sai3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司的权力已经被架空了。
examples.english_sentence: His power in the company has already been stripped away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔俾啲後生仔上位，呢間公司早晚都會被去勢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 bei2 di1 hau6 saang1 zai2 soeng5 wai2, ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zou2 maan5 dou1 wui5 bei2 heoi3 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不让年轻人上位，这家公司迟早会被削弱。
examples.english_sentence: If the younger generation isn't given opportunities, this company will be weakened sooner or later.

english_meaning: direction; whereabouts; destination; course
explanation_mandarin: 指人或事物离去后所前往的地方或方向。
explanation_english: Refers to the place or direction where a person or thing goes after leaving.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔知佢嘅去向。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zi1 keoi5 ge3 heoi3 hoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不知道他的去向。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know his whereabouts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢班資金嘅去向令人關注。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baan1 zi1 gam1 ge3 heoi3 hoeng3 ling6 jan4 gwaan1 zyu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这笔资金的去向令人关注。
examples.english_sentence: The destination of this fund is a cause for concern.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方正調查失蹤人士嘅去向。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 zing3 diu6 caa4 sat1 zung1 jan4 si6 ge3 heoi3 hoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方正在调查失踪人士的去向。
examples.english_sentence: The police are investigating the whereabouts of the missing person.

english_meaning: to go to a place; to go somewhere
explanation_mandarin: 去某个地方。埞指地方。
explanation_english: To go to a certain place. '埞' refers to a place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去埞食飯？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 heoi3 deng6 sik6 faan6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚去哪儿吃饭？
examples.english_sentence: Where shall we go for dinner tonight?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都唔知去咗邊埞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 m4 zi1 heoi3 zo2 bin1 deng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是不知道去了哪里。
examples.english_sentence: He always disappears and no one knows where he's gone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想去邊埞旅行啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 heoi3 bin1 deng6 leoi5 hang4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想去哪里旅行啊？
examples.english_sentence: Where do you want to travel to?

english_meaning: To go to a night market / To go out at night
explanation_mandarin: 在晚上去逛街，通常指去夜市或者晚上比较热闹的街道。
explanation_english: To go out and wander around at night, usually referring to visiting night markets or streets that are lively at night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚想去夜街，你有冇興趣啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 soeng2 heoi3 je6 gaai1, nei5 jau5 mou5 hing3 ceoi3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚想逛夜市，你有兴趣吗？
examples.english_sentence: I want to go to the night market tonight, are you interested?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅夜街好熱鬧，好多嘢食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 je6 gaai1 hou2 jit6 naau6, hou2 do1 je5 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的夜市很热闹，有很多东西吃。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's night markets are very lively, with lots of food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日去夜街，通常都好晏先返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 heoi3 je6 gaai1, tung1 soeng4 dou1 hou2 aan3 sin1 faan1 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们经常逛夜市，通常都很晚才回家。
examples.english_sentence: They often go out at night and usually return home very late.

mandarin_meaning: 炫耀, 摆阔, 显摆
english_meaning: to show off, to brag, to flaunt
explanation_mandarin: 指为了引人注目或获得赞赏而故意展示自己的财富、权力或成就。
explanation_english: To show off, brag, or flaunt, usually to gain attention or admiration by displaying one's wealth, power, or achievements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢發咗達之後成日去威，買晒名牌嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faat3 zo2 daat6 zi1 hau6 seng4 jat6 heoi3 wai1, maai5 saai3 ming4 paai4 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他发财之后整天炫耀，买的全是名牌。
examples.english_sentence: After he became rich, he showed off all the time, buying all branded goods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日去威啦，低調啲好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 heoi3 wai1 laa1, dai1 diu6 di1 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是炫耀了，低调一点好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always show off, it's better to be more low-key.

english_meaning: definitely going
explanation_mandarin: 表示一定、肯定会去的意思。
explanation_english: Indicates a definite intention to go; certainly going.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日去定㗎啦，唔使再問我！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 heoi3 ding6 gaa3 laa1, m4 sai2 zoi3 man6 ngo5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天肯定会去的，不用再问我了！
examples.english_sentence: I'm definitely going tomorrow, no need to ask me again!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話去定，你就放心啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 heoi3 ding6, nei5 zau6 fong3 sam1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说肯定会去，你就放心吧。
examples.english_sentence: He said he's definitely going, so just relax.

english_meaning: last year
explanation_mandarin: 刚刚过去的一年。
explanation_english: The year immediately preceding the current year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我去年去咗日本旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 heoi3 nin4 heoi3 zo2 jat6 bun2 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我去年去了日本旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I went to Japan on a trip last year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢去年畢業之後就開始做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 heoi3 nin4 bat1 jip6 zi1 hau6 zau6 hoi1 chi2 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他去年毕业之后就开始工作了。
examples.english_sentence: He started working after graduating last year.

english_meaning: to remove, to get rid of, to eliminate
explanation_mandarin: 表示移除、取消或减少某物。
explanation_english: Indicates the action of removing, cancelling, or reducing something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 將啲唔要嘅嘢去掉佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 di1 m4 jiu3 ge3 je5 heoi3 diu6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把一些不要的东西去掉。
examples.english_sentence: Remove the things that you don't need.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要去掉啲負擔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 heoi3 diu6 di1 fu6 daam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要去掉一些负担。
examples.english_sentence: We need to get rid of some burdens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將個污糟嘅地方去掉咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 go3 wu1 zou3 ge3 dei6 fong1 heoi3 diu6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把脏的地方去掉了。
examples.english_sentence: He removed the dirty part.

english_meaning: to go and provoke, to go and tease, to go and flirt
explanation_mandarin: 指故意去找麻烦，或挑逗别人，引起对方的注意或反应。通常带有轻微的负面含义，表示不应该这样做。
explanation_english: Refers to intentionally going to cause trouble, tease someone, or provoke them to get their attention or reaction. It usually carries a slightly negative connotation, suggesting that it shouldn't be done.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好去撩佢啦，佢今日心情唔好㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 heoi3 liu1 keoi5 laa1, keoi5 gam1 jat6 sam1 cing4 m4 hou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好别去招惹他了，他今天心情不好。
examples.english_sentence: You better not go and provoke him, he's in a bad mood today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日去撩啲女仔，真係好花心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 heoi3 liu1 di1 neoi5 zai2, zan1 hai6 hou2 faa1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是去撩女孩子，真是很花心。
examples.english_sentence: He always goes around flirting with girls, he's really a flirt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔係想去撩事鬥非，但係我只係想講出真相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 hai6 soeng2 heoi3 liu1 si6 dau3 fei1, daan6 hai6 ngo5 zi2 hai6 soeng2 gong2 ceot1 zan1 soeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不是想去挑起事端，我只是想说出真相。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not trying to stir up trouble, I just want to tell the truth.

english_meaning: to pass away, to die
explanation_mandarin: 委婉的说法，指人去世。
explanation_english: A euphemism for someone's death; to pass away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿爺琴日去咗歸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3 je4 kam4 jat6 heoi3 zo2 gwai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他爷爷昨天去世了。
examples.english_sentence: His grandfather passed away yesterday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到呢個消息，我覺得好難過，因為我地嘅老朋友去咗歸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou2 ni1 go3 siu1 sik1, ngo5 gok3 dak1 hou2 naan4 gwo3, jan1 wai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 lou5 pang4 jau5 heoi3 zo2 gwai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到这个消息，我觉得很难过，因为我们的老朋友去世了。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing this news, I feel very sad because our old friend has passed away.

english_meaning: Go to hell; Drop dead; Get lost
explanation_mandarin: 表达强烈的厌恶、愤怒或不耐烦的情绪，常带有诅咒的意味，希望对方消失或受到惩罚。
explanation_english: Expresses strong disgust, anger, or impatience. It's often a curse-like expression wishing someone would disappear or be punished.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁衰，去死啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 seoi1, heoi3 sei2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么坏，去死吧！
examples.english_sentence: You're so awful, go to hell!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想再聽你廢話，去死啦你！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 zoi3 teng1 nei5 fai3 waa2, heoi3 sei2 laa1 nei5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想再听你废话，你去死吧你！
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to hear your nonsense anymore, drop dead!

english_meaning: to remove dirt; to clean; to get rid of dirt
explanation_mandarin: 清理掉污垢，使之干净。
explanation_english: To remove dirt or grime from something, making it clean.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件衫咁污糟，快啲去污糟佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 saam1 gam3 wu1 zou1, faai3 di1 heoi3 wu1 zou1 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服这么脏，快点把它弄干净吧。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is so dirty, clean it up quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張枱面好耐冇抹，去污糟佢先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 toi4 min6 hou2 noi6 mou5 mut3, heoi3 wu1 zou1 keoi5 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张桌面很久没擦了，先把它清洁一下。
examples.english_sentence: This table hasn't been wiped for a long time, let's clean it first.

english_meaning: to remove dirt/stains; to decontaminate
explanation_mandarin: 指去除物体表面的污垢、污渍。
explanation_english: Refers to removing dirt, stains, or contaminants from the surface of an object.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫有啲污漬，要攞去洗衣鋪去污。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 jau5 di1 wu1 zi3, jiu3 lo2 heoi3 sai2 ji1 pou3 heoi3 wu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服有些污渍，要拿到洗衣店去污。
examples.english_sentence: This piece of clothing has some stains; I need to take it to the laundry shop to remove them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要一齊努力，去污名化呢個行業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jat1 cai4 nou5 lik6, heoi3 wu1 ming4 faa3 ni1 go3 hang4 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要一起努力，去除这个行业的污名。
examples.english_sentence: We need to work together to de-stigmatize this industry.

english_meaning: to go for a stroll; to go for a walk; to go wander around
explanation_mandarin: 指出去走走，随便逛逛，没有特别的目的。
explanation_english: Refers to going out for a walk or a stroll, wandering around without a specific purpose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋晏晝去溜吓街啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 aan3 zau3 heoi3 liu6 haa5 gaai1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们下午去逛逛街吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go for a stroll in the afternoon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食完飯不如去溜吓公園啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 jyun4 faan6 bat1 jyu4 heoi3 liu6 haa5 gung1 jyun2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃完饭不如去公园溜达一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: After dinner, why don't we go for a walk in the park?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意得閒就去溜吓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 dak1 haan4 zau6 heoi3 liu6 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喜欢有空就去溜达溜达。
examples.english_sentence: He likes to go for a walk whenever he is free.

english_meaning: to dispel dampness, to reduce internal dampness (in traditional Chinese medicine)
explanation_mandarin: 中医指通过药物或食疗等方法，去除体内过多的湿气。
explanation_english: In traditional Chinese medicine (TCM), it refers to the process of removing excess dampness from the body through methods such as herbal medicine or dietary therapy. Dampness is considered a pathogenic factor that can cause various health problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近天氣潮濕，飲啲薏米水去濕啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 tin1 hei3 ciu4 sap1, yam2 di1 ji3 mai5 seoi2 heoi3 sap1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近天气潮湿，喝点薏米水祛湿吧。
examples.english_sentence: The weather has been humid lately, drink some barley water to dispel dampness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日覺得個人好重，可能要睇下中醫去濕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gok3 dak1 go3 jan4 hou2 cung5, ho2 nang4 jiu3 tai2 haa5 zung1 ji1 heoi3 sap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是觉得身体很沉重，可能要看看中医祛湿。
examples.english_sentence: He always feels heavy, maybe he needs to see a Chinese medicine practitioner to dispel dampness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食多啲紅豆湯可以幫助去濕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 do1 di1 hung4 dau2 tong1 ho2 ji5 bong1 zo6 heoi3 sap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 多吃一些红豆汤可以帮助祛湿。
examples.english_sentence: Eating more red bean soup can help to dispel dampness.

english_meaning: Play the video; Roll the tape; Let's watch the clip
explanation_mandarin: 播放视频片段。在香港电视节目或网络视频中常用，表示即将播放一段预先录制好的视频。
explanation_english: To play a video clip. Commonly used in Hong Kong television programs or online videos to indicate that a pre-recorded video segment is about to be played.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家去片，睇下佢當時點樣講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 heoi3 pin3, tai2 haa5 keoi5 dong1 si4 dim2 joeng2 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在播放视频，看看他当时是怎么说的。
examples.english_sentence: Let's play the video now and see what he said at that time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好，去片！等我哋睇吓佢有幾咁叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2, heoi3 pin3! dang2 ngo5 dei6 tai2 haa5 keoi5 jau5 gei2 gam2 lek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 好，播放视频！让我们看看他有多厉害。
examples.english_sentence: Okay, let's play the clip! Let's see how capable he is.

english_meaning: to stay or leave; to remain or depart; a decision on whether to stay or leave
explanation_mandarin: 指决定去还是留的状态或决定。
explanation_english: Refers to the state or decision of choosing to stay or leave.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋仲討論緊去留嘅問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zung6 tou2 leon6 gan2 heoi3 lau4 ge3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们还在讨论去留的问题。
examples.english_sentence: We are still discussing the matter of whether to stay or leave.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對公司嘅去留，仲未有決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 gung1 si1 ge3 heoi3 lau4, zung6 mei6 jau5 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对公司的去留，还没有决定。
examples.english_sentence: He hasn't decided whether to stay with the company or leave.

mandarin_meaning: 做到极致; 完全彻底
english_meaning: To go all out; To push to the limit; To go the whole nine yards; To give it your all
explanation_mandarin: 表示做到最极限，毫不保留。指在做某件事时竭尽全力，毫无保留地发挥或付出。
explanation_english: Means to go to the extreme limit, without holding back. Refers to exerting oneself to the fullest and giving it your all when doing something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試我要去盡，攞個好成績。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ngo5 jiu3 heoi3 zeon6, lo2 go3 hou2 sing4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我要全力以赴，取得好成绩。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to go all out for this exam and get good grades.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗幫你，我已經去盡㗎啦，冇辦法再做多啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai4 zo2 bong1 nei5, ngo5 ji5 ging1 heoi3 zeon6 gaa3 laa3, mou5 baan6 faat3 zoi3 zou6 do1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了帮你，我已经尽力了，没办法再做更多了。
examples.english_sentence: I've already gone all out to help you. There's nothing more I can do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要喺呢個項目上邊去盡佢，務求達到最佳效果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hai2 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 soeng6 bin1 heoi3 zeon6 keoi5, mou6 kau4 daat6 dou3 zeoi3 gaai1 haau6 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们必须在这个项目上全力以赴，力求达到最佳效果。
examples.english_sentence: We need to go all out on this project in order to achieve the best results.

synonyms: 盡力而為 (zeon6 lik6 ji4 wai4)
全力以赴 (cyun4 lik6 ji5 fu6)

english_meaning: Falling tone (one of the six tones in Cantonese; one of the four tones in Mandarin)
explanation_mandarin: 粤语六个声调之一（阴去），或者普通话四个声调之一（第四声）。
explanation_english: The falling tone, one of the six tones in Cantonese (specifically, the "upper departing" tone - 陰去), or one of the four tones in Mandarin (the fourth tone).  Refers to the tone that descends in pitch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「去」呢個字係去聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: "heoi3" ni1 go3 zi6 hai6 heoi3 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: “去”这个字是去声。
examples.english_sentence: The word "去" is in the falling tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學粵語要留意聲調，唔係好易讀錯，尤其係去聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 jyut6 jyu5 jiu3 lau4 yi3 seng1 diu6, m4 hai6 hou2 yi6 duk6 co3, jau4 kei4 hai6 heoi3 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学粤语要注意声调，不然很容易读错，尤其是去声。
examples.english_sentence: When learning Cantonese, you need to pay attention to the tones, or you'll easily mispronounce words, especially those in the falling tone.

mandarin_meaning: 离职; 辞职; 免职
english_meaning: to leave a post; to resign; to be dismissed; to be relieved of one's duties
explanation_mandarin: 离开原来的工作职位。可以是主动辞职，也可以是被动被解雇。
explanation_english: To leave one's original work position. This can be either resigning voluntarily or being dismissed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為身體唔好，所以決定去職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 san1 tai2 m4 hou2, so2 ji5 kyut3 ding6 heoi3 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为身体不好，所以决定离职。
examples.english_sentence: He decided to resign because he was not feeling well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司因為財政問題，炒咗好多人，搞到佢都去職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 jan1 wai6 coi4 zing3 man6 tai4, caau2 zo2 hou2 do1 jan4, gaau2 dou3 keoi5 dou1 heoi3 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司因为财政问题，炒了很多人，结果他也离职了。
examples.english_sentence: The company fired a lot of people due to financial problems, which resulted in him also leaving his job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人揭發咗貪污，最後被迫去職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 kit3 faat3 zo2 taam1 wu1, zeoi3 hau6 bei1 bik1 heoi3 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人揭发了贪污，最后被迫离职。
examples.english_sentence: He was exposed for corruption and was eventually forced to resign.

english_meaning: Out with the old, in with the new; to bid farewell to the old year and welcome the new year
explanation_mandarin: 去除旧的，迎接新的。常用于新年之际，表示告别过去，迎接新的开始。
explanation_english: To get rid of the old and welcome the new. It is often used around the New Year to express saying goodbye to the past and welcoming a new beginning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每年農曆新年，我哋都會去舊迎新，希望新一年會更好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 nin4 nung4 lik6 san1 nin4, ngo5 dei6 dou1 wui5 heoi3 gau6 jing4 san1, hei1 mong6 san1 jat1 nin4 wui5 gang3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每年农历新年，我们都会辞旧迎新，希望新的一年会更好。
examples.english_sentence: Every Lunar New Year, we get rid of the old and welcome the new, hoping the new year will be even better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年新氣象，去舊迎新，買啲新衫慶祝下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 san1 hei3 zoeng6, heoi3 gau6 jing4 san1, maai5 di1 san1 saam1 hing3 zuk1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年新气象，辞旧迎新，买些新衣服庆祝一下。
examples.english_sentence: New year, new atmosphere, out with the old, in with the new, let's buy some new clothes to celebrate.

english_meaning: to die, to pass away (euphemism)
explanation_mandarin: 委婉地说“死亡”。因为“荷兰”的粤语发音“ho4 laan1”与“好难”谐音，表示事情很难办，最终导致死亡，所以用“去荷兰”来代替“死亡”。
explanation_english: A euphemism for death or passing away. The Cantonese pronunciation of "Netherlands" (荷蘭, ho4 laan1) sounds similar to "very difficult" (好難, hou2 naan4), implying that the situation is too difficult to overcome, ultimately leading to death.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴日去咗荷蘭，好可惜啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 heoi3 zo2 ho4 laan1, hou2 ho2 sik1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天去世了，真可惜。
examples.english_sentence: He passed away yesterday, it's a pity.

english_meaning: to go clubbing; to go out and have fun (usually at night); to go night-lifing
explanation_mandarin: 指到酒吧、夜店等场所玩乐，享受夜生活。
explanation_english: Refers to going to bars, nightclubs, and other places to have fun and enjoy the nightlife. It generally implies going out at night for entertainment and socializing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋去蒲啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 pou4 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们去玩吧！
examples.english_sentence: Let's go clubbing tonight!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都去蒲，唔怪得咁夜瞓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 heoi3 pou4, m4 gwaai3 dak1 gam3 je6 fan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常去夜店玩，怪不得这么晚睡。
examples.english_sentence: He often goes out to nightclubs, no wonder he sleeps so late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講蘭桂坊好多人去蒲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 laan4 gwai3 fong1 hou2 do1 jan4 heoi3 pou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说兰桂坊很多人去玩乐。
examples.english_sentence: I heard that many people go out for nightlife in Lan Kwai Fong.

english_meaning: to remove the dross and select the essential; to weed out the bad and retain the good; to separate the wheat from the chaff
explanation_mandarin: 去除粗糙、无用的部分，保留精华。
explanation_english: To remove the unwanted or inferior parts, and retain the valuable or essential elements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告好長，我哋要幫佢去蕪存菁，抽啲重點出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 hou2 coeng4, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 bong1 keoi5 heoi3 wu4 cyun4 cing1, cau1 di1 zung2 dim2 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告很长，我们要帮他去伪存真，提取一些重点出来。
examples.english_sentence: This report is very long. We need to extract the essential parts and remove the unnecessary details.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過多年嘅研究，佢哋終於去蕪存菁，搵到最有效嘅治療方法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 do1 nin4 ge3 jin4 gau3, keoi5 dei6 zung1 jyu1 heoi3 wu4 cyun4 cing1, wan2 dou2 zeoi3 jau5 haau6 ge3 zi6 liu4 fong1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过多年的研究，他们终于去粗取精，找到了最有效的治疗方法。
examples.english_sentence: After many years of research, they finally weeded out the less effective methods and found the most effective treatment.

english_meaning: to go out; to go shopping; to go for a stroll
explanation_mandarin: 指出去逛街、散步、购物等活动。
explanation_english: Refers to going out for a stroll, shopping, or other similar activities outside.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去街好唔好啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan1 heoi3 gaai1 hou2 m4 hou2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚去逛街好不好啊？
examples.english_sentence: Shall we go out tonight?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都鍾意去街買嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 zung1 ji3 heoi3 gaai1 maai5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是喜欢去逛街买东西。
examples.english_sentence: She always likes to go shopping.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放工之後，我想去街鬆吓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 gung1 zi1 hau6, ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 gaai1 sung1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下班之后，我想去逛街放松一下。
examples.english_sentence: After work, I want to go for a walk to relax.

jyutping: heoi3 gaai1 si5 maai5 sung3 jau5 gaa3 gong2 aa3
mandarin_meaning: 去菜市场买菜可以讲价啊
english_meaning: You can bargain when buying groceries at the wet market.
explanation_mandarin: 表示去街市（菜市场）买菜时，可以尝试和摊主讲价，希望能够以更低的价格购买。这在香港的街市是很常见的现象。
explanation_english: This phrase means that when you go to the wet market (traditional market) to buy groceries, you can try to bargain with the vendors to get a lower price. This is a very common practice in Hong Kong wet markets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得去街市買餸有價講呀，唔好怕醜！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 heoi3 gaai1 si5 maai5 sung3 jau5 gaa3 gong2 aa3, m4 hou2 paa3 cau2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记得去菜市场买菜可以讲价啊，不要害羞！
examples.english_sentence: Remember you can bargain when buying groceries at the wet market, don't be shy!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 去街市買餸有價講呀，可以慳返唔少錢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: heoi3 gaai1 si5 maai5 sung3 jau5 gaa3 gong2 aa3, ho2 ji5 haan1 faan1 m4 siu2 cin2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去菜市场买菜可以讲价啊，可以省下不少钱的。
examples.english_sentence: You can bargain when buying groceries at the wet market, you can save quite a bit of money.

english_meaning: way out; escape route; prospect; future
explanation_mandarin: 指离开的道路，也指未来的发展方向或出路。
explanation_english: Refers to a way out, escape route, or future prospects. It can also refer to one's future path or development.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 差佬嚟緊，我哋要諗定去路啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: caa1 lou2 lai4 gan2, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 nam2 ding6 heoi3 lou6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察要来了，我们要想好逃跑的路线啊！
examples.english_sentence: The police are coming, we need to figure out an escape route!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家經濟咁差，搵食都好難，真係唔知有咩去路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ging1 zai3 gam3 caa1, wan2 sik6 dou1 hou2 naan4, zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 jau5 me1 heoi3 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在经济这么差，找工作很难，真的不知道有什么出路。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is so bad now, it's hard to find work, I really don't know what prospects there are.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做生意失敗咗，但係佢仲喺度諗緊其他去路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 seng1 ji3 sat1 baai6 zo2, daan6 hai6 keoi5 zung6 hai2 dou6 nam2 gan2 kei4 taa1 heoi3 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做生意失败了，但是他还在想着其他的出路。
examples.english_sentence: He failed in business, but he is still thinking about other ways to make a living.

jyutping: heoi3 jim4 lo4 wong4 cyu3 bou3 dou3
english_meaning: To report to the King of Hell; to die
explanation_mandarin: 指人死亡，到阴间报到。
explanation_english: A euphemism for death, referring to the act of reporting to the King of Hell in the underworld.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁後生就去咗閻羅王處報到，真係可惜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 hau6 saang1 zau6 heoi3 zo2 jim4 lo4 wong4 cyu3 bou3 dou3, zan1 hai6 ho2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么年轻就去世了，真是可惜。
examples.english_sentence: It's such a pity that he died so young.

english_meaning: to remove, to get rid of, to eliminate
explanation_mandarin: 去掉；消除。把不需要的东西去掉。
explanation_english: To remove, eliminate, or get rid of something unwanted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要去除所有嘅障礙，先可以成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 keoi5 ceoi4 so2 jau5 ge3 zoeng3 ngoi6, sin1 ho2 ji5 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要去除所有的障碍，才可以成功。
examples.english_sentence: We need to remove all obstacles in order to succeed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 用激光去除面上嘅斑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jung6 gwong1 bou1 keoi5 ceoi4 min6 soeng6 ge3 baan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 用激光去除脸上的斑。
examples.english_sentence: To remove the spots on the face with laser.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你點樣去除衫上面嘅污漬啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dim2 joeng2 keoi5 ceoi4 saam1 soeng6 min6 ge3 wu1 zi3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你怎么样去除衣服上的污渍啊？
examples.english_sentence: How do you remove the stain on the shirt?

english_meaning: to attend a wedding banquet, to attend a formal dinner party
explanation_mandarin: 参加婚宴或正式的宴会。通常指比较正式的、喜庆的场合，比如婚礼。
explanation_english: To attend a wedding banquet or a formal dinner party. Usually refers to formal and celebratory occasions like weddings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月要去飲我表哥嘅婚禮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 jiu3 heoi3 jam2 ngo5 biu2 go1 ge3 fan1 lai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月要去参加我表哥的婚礼。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to attend my cousin's wedding next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋去咗飲，所以今晚唔會返嚟食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 heoi3 zo2 jam2, so2 ji5 gam1 maan1 m4 wui5 faan1 lei4 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们去参加婚宴了，所以今晚不会回来吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: They went to a wedding banquet, so they won't be back for dinner tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 开始行动；出发；采取行动
english_meaning: To start; to begin action; to set off; to take action; to get going
explanation_mandarin: 指开始行动，出发，或采取行动。常用于鼓励或催促他人开始做某事。
explanation_english: Refers to starting to act, setting off, or taking action. Often used to encourage or urge others to start doing something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好啦，唔好再諗咁多啦，去馬啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 laa1, m4 hou2 zoi3 lam2 gam2 do1 laa1, heoi3 maa5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 好了，不要再想那么多了，开始行动吧！
examples.english_sentence: Okay, stop thinking so much, let's get going!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 時間唔等人，我哋要快啲去馬至得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si4 gaan3 m4 dang2 jan4, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 faai3 di1 heoi3 maa5 zi3 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 时间不等人，我们得快点行动才行。
examples.english_sentence: Time waits for no one, we have to get going quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 既然決定咗，就去馬啦，唔好拖泥帶水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 jin4 kyut3 ding6 zo2, zau6 heoi3 maa5 laa1, m4 hou2 to1 nei4 daai3 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 既然决定了，就开始行动吧，不要拖泥带水。
examples.english_sentence: Now that it's decided, let's get started, don't drag your feet.

english_meaning: to poke, to stab, to prod
explanation_mandarin: 用尖锐的物体去刺、戳。
explanation_english: To poke or stab with a sharp object.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好用筷子厾人呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 yung6 faai3 zi2 duk1 yan4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要用筷子戳人啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't poke people with chopsticks!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用手指厾我膊頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 sau2 zi2 duk1 ngo5 bok3 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用手指戳我的肩膀。
examples.english_sentence: He poked my shoulder with his finger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好攞枝筆嚟厾我！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lo2 ji1 zi1 bat1 lai4 duk1 ngo5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要拿笔来戳我！
examples.english_sentence: Don't use that pen to poke me!

english_meaning: three
explanation_mandarin: 数字，表示数量是三。
explanation_english: The number three.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋有叁個仔女。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jau5 saam1 go3 zai2 neoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们有三个孩子。
examples.english_sentence: They have three children.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗叁公斤蘋果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 saam1 gung1 gan1 ping4 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了三公斤苹果。
examples.english_sentence: I bought three kilograms of apples.

english_meaning: to participate; to join; to attend
explanation_mandarin: 参与，加入某项活动或组织。
explanation_english: To take part in; to join; to attend an activity or organization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今晚有冇参啲活動啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 maan1 jau5 mou5 caam1 di1 wut6 dung6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今晚有没有参加一些活动啊？
examples.english_sentence: Are you participating in any activities tonight?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我打算参个義工隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daa2 syun3 caam1 go3 ji6 gung1 deoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打算参加一个义工队。
examples.english_sentence: I plan to join a volunteer team.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢冇参今次嘅會議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mou5 caam1 gam1 ci3 ge3 wui6 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他没参加这次的会议。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't attend the meeting this time.

mandarin_meaning: 加入; 参与; 拜访
english_meaning: to participate; to join; to attend; to visit; ginseng (depending on context)
explanation_mandarin: 有多重含义，主要指加入、参与、参观访问等动作。也指人参这种药材，但通常会搭配其他字一起使用，例如“人參”。
explanation_english: Has multiple meanings, primarily referring to actions like joining, participating, or visiting. Can also refer to ginseng, but it's usually used in conjunction with other characters, such as "人參" (yan4 sam1 - ginseng).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一齊參觀博物館啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 caam1 guan1 bok3 mat6 guan2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一起参观博物馆吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's visit the museum together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢冇參加上次嘅會議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mou5 caam1 gaa1 soeng6 ci3 ge3 wui6 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他没有参加上次的会议。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't attend the last meeting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今晚有冇興趣參一腳？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 maan1 jau5 mou5 hing3 ceoi3 caam1 jat1 goek3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今晚有没有兴趣参与一下？
examples.english_sentence: Are you interested in joining tonight?

english_meaning: to participate, to join, to take part in
explanation_mandarin: 加入某个活动或团体。
explanation_english: To take part in an activity or to join an organization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日會參加遊行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 wui5 caam1 gaa1 jau4 haang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天会参加游行。
examples.english_sentence: We will participate in the parade tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇興趣參加我個生日派對呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 hing3 ceoi3 caam1 gaa1 ngo5 go3 saang1 jat6 paai3 deoi2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有没有兴趣参加我的生日派对？
examples.english_sentence: Are you interested in joining my birthday party?

english_meaning: half and half; fifty-fifty
explanation_mandarin: 表示一半一半的情况，不完全是其中任何一方。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where something is half and half, not entirely one thing or the other; fifty-fifty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試嘅合格機會參半啦，我仲未溫晒啲書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 ge3 hap6 gaak3 gei1 wui6 caam1 bun3 laa1, ngo5 zung6 mei6 wan1 saai3 di1 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试及格的机会一半一半吧，我还没复习完所有的书。
examples.english_sentence: The chances of passing this exam are fifty-fifty, I haven't finished revising all the books.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對呢件事嘅興趣參半，唔係好積極。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 hing3 ceoi3 caam1 bun3, m4 hai6 hou2 zik1 gik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对这件事的兴趣一半一半，不是很积极。
examples.english_sentence: His interest in this matter is fifty-fifty; he's not very enthusiastic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事嘅成功率參半，要睇多啲情況先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 ge3 sing4 gung1 leut2 caam1 bun3, jiu3 tai2 do1 di1 cing4 fong3 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事的成功率一半一半，要多看看情况才行。
examples.english_sentence: The success rate of this matter is fifty-fifty; we need to see more of the situation first.

english_meaning: to participate in an exhibition; to exhibit
explanation_mandarin: 参加展览会，作为展出方。
explanation_english: To participate in an exhibition, typically as an exhibitor showing goods or services.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司今年會參展香港貿易發展局舉辦嘅展覽會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 gam1 nin4 wui5 caam1 zin2 Hoeng1 Gong2 mau6 jik6 faat3 zyun2 guk6 ge3 zin2 laam5 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司今年会参加香港贸易发展局举办的展览会。
examples.english_sentence: Our company will participate in the exhibition organized by the Hong Kong Trade Development Council this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次參展，我哋想推廣我哋公司嘅新產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 caam1 zin2, ngo5 dei6 soeng2 teoi1 gwong2 ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 san1 caan2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次参展，我们想推广我们公司的新产品。
examples.english_sentence: This time exhibiting, we want to promote our company's new products.

english_meaning: uneven; irregular; varied; not uniform
explanation_mandarin: 形容不整齐，高低长短不一。也可用来比喻水平或质量不一致。
explanation_english: Describing something that is uneven, irregular, or varied; not uniform in height, length, quality, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲牙仔生得參差，要箍牙先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 ngaa4 zai2 saang1 dak1 caam1 ci1, jiu3 ku1 ngaa4 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 牙齿长得不整齐，需要矫正牙齿。
examples.english_sentence: The teeth are growing unevenly; they need to be straightened with braces.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司啲員工質素參差，有啲好叻，有啲就麻麻地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 di1 waan4 gung1 zat1 so3 caam1 ci1, jau5 di1 hou2 lek1, jau5 di1 zau6 maa4 maa4 dei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的员工素质参差不齐，有些很厉害，有些就很一般。
examples.english_sentence: The quality of the employees at this company is uneven; some are very capable, while others are just so-so.

english_meaning: uneven; irregular; of varying quality
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物高低长短、好坏不一，不整齐。
explanation_english: Describes something that is uneven, irregular, or of varying quality; not uniform or consistent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲學生嘅成績參差不齊，有啲好好，有啲就好差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 hok6 sang1 ge3 sing1 zik1 caam1 ci1 bat1 cai4, jau5 di1 hou2 hou2, jau5 di1 zau6 hou2 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学生的成绩参差不齐，有些很好，有些很差。
examples.english_sentence: The students' grades are uneven; some are very good, and some are very bad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條馬路啲石屎參差不齊，行起上嚟好唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 maa5 lou6 di1 sek6 sai2 caam1 ci1 bat1 cai4, haang4 hei2 soeng5 lai4 hou2 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条马路的水泥路面参差不齐，走起来很不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: The concrete pavement of this road is uneven, making it uncomfortable to walk on.

mandarin_meaning: 领悟, 体悟, 参透
english_meaning: to comprehend, to grasp, to understand thoroughly, to realize (a profound truth)
explanation_mandarin: 通过思考、体验等方式，深刻地理解和领会某种道理或事物。
explanation_english: To deeply understand and comprehend a principle or thing through thinking, experience, and other methods. Often implies a profound or insightful understanding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢花咗好多年時間先至參悟到人生嘅意義。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faa1 zo2 hou2 do1 nin4 si4 gaan3 sin1 zi3 caam1 ng6 dou3 jan4 sang1 ge3 ji3 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他花了很多年时间才领悟到人生的意义。
examples.english_sentence: It took him many years to realize the meaning of life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇完呢本書，我參悟到好多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 jyun4 ni1 bun2 syu1, ngo5 caam1 ng6 dou3 hou2 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看完这本书，我领悟了很多东西。
examples.english_sentence: After reading this book, I grasped a lot of things.

english_meaning: to participate in a battle/war; to join a fight/conflict; to join a competition
explanation_mandarin: 字面意义为参加战争，也引申为参与竞争、争斗等活动。
explanation_english: Literally means to participate in a battle or war. Figuratively, it can also mean to participate in a competition, fight, or conflict.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日我哋籃球隊要參戰啦，希望可以贏到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 ngo5 dei6 laam4 kau4 deui2 jiu3 caam1 zin3 laa1, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 wing4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天我们篮球队要参战了，希望可以赢。
examples.english_sentence: Our basketball team will be competing tomorrow. Hope we can win.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單project咁重要，我都想參戰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 project gam3 zung6 jiu3, ngo5 dou1 soeng2 caam1 zin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目这么重要，我也想参与。
examples.english_sentence: This project is so important, I also want to participate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個為咗爭女朋友，搞到好似打仗咁，佢都想參戰埋一份。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 wai6 zo2 zaang1 neoi5 pang4 jau5, gaau2 dou3 hou2 ci5 daa2 zoeng3 gam2, keoi5 dou1 soeng2 caam1 zin3 maai4 jat1 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个为了争女朋友，搞得像打仗一样，他也想参与一份。
examples.english_sentence: Those two are fighting over a girlfriend, like a war, and he also wants to join in.

english_meaning: to worship; to pay homage
explanation_mandarin: 指拜见神佛或祖先，表示敬意。
explanation_english: To worship deities or ancestors, expressing respect and reverence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年嗰陣，我哋會去廟入面參拜神明。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 go2 zan6, ngo5 dei6 wui5 heoi3 miu2 jap6 min6 caam1 baai3 san4 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年的时候，我们会去庙里参拜神明。
examples.english_sentence: During the New Year, we will go to the temple to worship the deities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 清明節嘅時候，我哋一家人會去拜山參拜祖先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing1 ming4 zit3 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 wui5 heoi3 baai3 saan1 caam1 baai3 zou2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 清明节的时候，我们一家人会去扫墓参拜祖先。
examples.english_sentence: During Qingming Festival, our whole family will go to the cemetery to pay respects to our ancestors.

english_meaning: to participate in politics, to take part in government
explanation_mandarin: 参与政府管理或政治活动。
explanation_english: To participate in government administration or political activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對參政好有興趣，諗住第時選議員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 caam1 zing3 hou2 jau5 hing3 ceoi3, lam2 zyu6 dai6 si4 syun2 ji5 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对参政很有兴趣，打算以后选议员。
examples.english_sentence: He is very interested in participating in politics and plans to run for councillor in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家越來越多年輕人關心社會，積極參政。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 jyut6 lai5 jyut6 do1 nin4 hing1 jan4 gwaan1 sam1 se5 wui2, zik1 gik1 caam1 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在越来越多的年轻人关心社会，积极参政。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, more and more young people are concerned about society and are actively participating in politics.

english_meaning: parameter; argument
explanation_mandarin: 在数学、计算机科学等领域指可变因素或数值，用于决定系统的特性或行为。
explanation_english: A variable or factor that can be given a particular value and that is used to define the conditions of a system or process, especially in mathematics or computer science.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個方程式嘅參數好複雜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fong1 cing1 sik1 ge3 caam1 sou3 hou2 fuk1 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个方程式的参数很复杂。
examples.english_sentence: The parameters of this equation are very complicated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要調整啲參數嚟提升系統嘅效能。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 tiu4 jing2 di1 caam1 sou3 lai4 tai4 sing1 hai6 tung2 ge3 haau6 nang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要调整一些参数来提升系统的性能。
examples.english_sentence: We need to adjust some parameters to improve the performance of the system.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺編寫程式嘅時候，要小心設定每一個參數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 pin1 se2 cing4 sik1 ge3 si4 hau6, jiu3 siu2 sam1 sat3 ding6 mui5 jat1 go3 caam1 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在编写程序的时候，要小心设定每一个参数。
examples.english_sentence: When writing a program, be careful to set each parameter.

english_meaning: to participate in a performance; to act in; to star in
explanation_mandarin: 参与演出，担任演员。
explanation_english: To participate in a performance, usually acting in a role.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺套戲入面參演一個重要嘅角色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 tou3 hei3 jap6 min6 caam1 jin2 jat1 go3 zung6 jiu3 ge3 gok3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在电影里饰演一个重要的角色。
examples.english_sentence: He is playing an important role in the movie.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多明星都有份參演呢個慈善演唱會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 ming4 sing1 dou1 jau5 fan6 caam1 jin2 ni1 go3 ci4 sin6 jin2 cheung3 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多明星都参与了这个慈善演唱会。
examples.english_sentence: Many stars are participating in this charity concert.

english_meaning: to refer to; to consult; reference
explanation_mandarin: 以某事物为依据或比照。
explanation_english: To use something as a basis or reference point; to take something into consideration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以參照呢份報告嘅數據嚟做分析。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 caam1 ziu3 ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ge3 sou3 geoi3 lai4 zou6 fan1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以参考这份报告的数据来进行分析。
examples.english_sentence: You can refer to the data in this report to do the analysis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 設計個陣，要參照返相關嘅建築法例。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 gai3 go3陣, jiu3 caam1 ziu3 faan1 soeng1 gwaan1 ge3 gin3 zuk1 faat3 leoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 设计的时候，要参考相关的建筑法规。
examples.english_sentence: When designing, you need to refer back to the relevant building regulations.

english_meaning: to refer to; to consult; see also
explanation_mandarin: 查阅并参考。
explanation_english: To look at and consult; to refer to something for more information or guidance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 詳情可以參看說明書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 cing4 ho2 ji5 caam1 hon3 syut1 ming4 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 详情可以参考说明书。
examples.english_sentence: For details, please refer to the instruction manual.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以參看下佢哋嘅網站。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 caam1 hon3 haa5 keoi5 dei6 ge3 mong5 zaam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以参考一下他们的网站。
examples.english_sentence: You can refer to their website.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 想知多啲資料，參看附錄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng2 zi1 do1 di1 zi1 liu2, caam1 hon3 fu6 luk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 想了解更多信息，请参考附录。
examples.english_sentence: To learn more, see the appendix.

english_meaning: to refer to; to consult; reference
explanation_mandarin: 查阅资料，借鉴
explanation_english: To look at or consult (something) in order to inform oneself or to gain information; a person or thing referred to, especially in a written work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以參考下呢本書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 caam1 kaau2 haa5 ni1 bun2 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以参考一下这本书。
examples.english_sentence: You can refer to this book.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告好多資料都係參考網上嘅。
