examples.english_sentence: They fell out over money issues and haven't contacted each other since.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想同佢反面，所以咩都忍住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 tung4 keoi5 faan2 min6, so2 ji5 me1 dou1 jan2 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想和他翻脸，所以什么都忍着。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to fall out with him, so I'm enduring everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗呢啲小事反面，真係唔值得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 ni1 di1 siu2 si6 faan2 min6, zan1 hai6 m4 dak1 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了这些小事翻脸，真的不值得。
examples.english_sentence: It's really not worth falling out over these small matters.

english_meaning: negative example, object lesson (of something bad)
explanation_mandarin: 指用反面的例子作为教育的材料，用来警示人们不要犯同样的错误。
explanation_english: Refers to a negative example or case study used as teaching material to warn people against making the same mistakes. An object lesson in what not to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅失敗經驗就係一個好好嘅反面敎材，提醒我哋要更加小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 si1 baai6 ging1 jim6 zau6 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 hou2 ge3 faan2 min6 gaau3 coi4, tai4 sing2 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gang3 gaa1 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的失败经验是一个很好的反面教材，提醒我们要更加小心。
examples.english_sentence: His failure is a good negative example, reminding us to be more careful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個貪污案係一個重要嘅反面敎材，要警惕其他官員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 taam1 wu1 on3 hai6 jat1 go3 zung6 jiu3 ge3 faan2 min6 gaau3 coi4, jiu3 ging2 tik1 kei4 taa1 gun1 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个贪污案是一个重要的反面教材，要警惕其他官员。
examples.english_sentence: This corruption case is an important negative example, warning other officials.

english_meaning: negative example; cautionary tale; bad example
explanation_mandarin: 指用坏人坏事作为例子，以此警戒人们，使人们从中吸取教训。
explanation_english: Refers to using bad people or bad deeds as examples to warn people and enable them to learn from them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅失敗經驗就係一個好好嘅反面教材，我哋要從中吸取教訓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sat1 baai6 ging1 jim6 zau6 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 hou2 ge3 faan2 min6 gaau3 coi4, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 cung4 zung1 kap1 cheoi2 gaau3 fan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的失败经验就是一个很好的反面教材，我们要从中吸取教训。
examples.english_sentence: His failure is a good negative example, we should learn from it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅行為簡直係反面教材，大家千祈唔好學佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hang4 wai4 gaan2 zik6 hai6 faan2 min6 gaau3 coi4, daai6 ga1 chin1 kei4 m4 hou2 hok6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的行为简直是反面教材，大家千万不要学他。
examples.english_sentence: His behavior is simply a bad example, everyone should never learn from him.

english_meaning: response, repercussion, reaction
explanation_mandarin: 指事情发生后引起的反应或影响。
explanation_english: Refers to the response or impact resulting from an event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 套戲上映之後反應好好，觀眾嘅反響好熱烈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou3 hei3 soeng5 jing2 zi1 hau6 faan2 ying3 hou2 hou2, gun1 zung3 ge3 faan2 hoeng2 hou2 jit6 lit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影上映之后反响很好，观众的反响很热烈。
examples.english_sentence: The movie received a very good response after its release; the audience's reaction was very enthusiastic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個政策引起咗社會好大嘅反響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zing3 caak3 ging2 hei2 zo2 se5 wui2 hou2 daai6 ge3 faan2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个政策引起了社会很大的反响。
examples.english_sentence: This policy caused a big reaction in society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅演講得到熱烈嘅反響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jin2 gong2 dak1 dou3 jit6 lit6 ge3 faan2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的演讲得到了热烈的反响。
examples.english_sentence: His speech received a warm response.

english_meaning: turn-down collar, to turn up the collar (as a style or to protect the neck)
explanation_mandarin: 指衣服的翻折领子。也可以指将领子翻起来的动作。
explanation_english: Refers to a turn-down collar on clothing. It can also refer to the action of turning up the collar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫個反領幾靚喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 go3 faan2 ling5 gei2 leng3 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服的翻领挺好看的。
examples.english_sentence: The turn-down collar of this shirt is quite nice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 凍到反領都唔掂，要帶埋頸巾先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dung3 dou3 faan2 ling5 dou1 m4 dim6, jiu3 daai3 maai4 geng2 gan1 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 冷得把领子都翻起来也不行，还得带上围巾才行。
examples.english_sentence: It's so cold that turning up my collar isn't enough, I need to bring a scarf.

english_meaning: feedback
explanation_mandarin: 指将结果或意见传达回去，以便改进或调整。
explanation_english: The process of providing information about the results of a process or activity back to the source, typically to improve or adjust it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋好重視你嘅反饋意見，希望你多啲俾意見我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hou2 zung6 si6 nei5 ge3 faan2 gwai3 ji3 gin3, hei1 mong6 nei5 do1 di1 bei2 ji3 gin3 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们很重视你的反馈意见，希望你多给我们提意见。
examples.english_sentence: We value your feedback and hope you can give us more suggestions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽完講座之後，我哋會俾份問卷你填，收集下你嘅反饋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jyun4 gong2 zo3 zi1 hau6, ngo5 dei6 wui2 bei2 fan6 man6 gyun2 nei5 tin4, sau1 gaap3 haa5 nei5 ge3 faan2 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听完讲座之后，我们会给你一份问卷填写，收集一下你的反馈。
examples.english_sentence: After the lecture, we'll give you a questionnaire to fill out to collect your feedback.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個系統暫時未有即時反饋功能。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 tung2 zaam6 si4 mei6 jau5 zik1 si4 faan2 gwai3 gung1 nang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个系统暂时没有即时反馈功能。
examples.english_sentence: This system does not yet have an instant feedback function.

english_meaning: to retort, to refute, to rebut, to argue back
explanation_mandarin: 针对别人的观点或说法提出反对的理由或论据。
explanation_english: To argue against a statement or viewpoint by presenting counter-arguments or evidence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢根本冇道理，我一定要反駁佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 gan1 bun2 mou5 dou6 lei5, ngo5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 faan2 bok3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话根本没有道理，我一定要反驳他。
examples.english_sentence: What he said makes no sense at all, I must refute him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁快反駁我，聽埋我講埋先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 faai3 faan2 bok3 ngo5, teng1 maai4 ngo5 gong2 maai4 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么快反驳我，先听我说完吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't refute me so quickly, let me finish speaking first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅論點好難反駁，因為佢證據充足。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 leon6 dim2 hou2 naan4 faan2 bok3, jan1 wai6 keoi5 zing3 geoi3 cung1 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的论点很难反驳，因为他证据充足。
examples.english_sentence: His argument is difficult to refute because he has sufficient evidence.

english_meaning: treacherous; disloyal; ungrateful; having a rebellious spirit
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人背叛他人，不忠诚，忘恩负义。也指具有叛逆的精神。
explanation_english: Describes a person who betrays others, is disloyal, ungrateful, or has a rebellious spirit. It implies a lack of loyalty and a tendency to go against established norms or authority.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁反骨，邊個敢信佢啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 faan2 gwat1, bin1 go3 gam2 seon3 keoi5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么叛逆，谁敢相信他啊？
examples.english_sentence: He's so treacherous, who would dare to trust him?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁反骨啦，人哋對你咁好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 faan2 gwat1 laa1, yan4 dei6 deoi3 nei5 gam3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么忘恩负义，别人对你那么好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so ungrateful, people are so good to you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人天生就係反骨，唔聽人講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 yan4 tin1 sang1 zau6 hai6 faan2 gwat1, m4 ting1 yan4 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人天生就是叛逆，不听人说。
examples.english_sentence: Some people are born rebellious and don't listen to others.

english_meaning: traitor; turncoat; someone who betrays their own group or cause
explanation_mandarin: 指背叛自己所属团体、组织或国家的人。带有强烈的贬义。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who betrays their own group, organization, or country. It carries a strong negative connotation, implying disloyalty and treachery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢竟然做咗反骨仔，幫人搞自己公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging2 jin4 zou6 zo2 faan2 gwat1 zai2, bong1 jan4 gaau2 zi6 gei2 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他竟然当了叛徒，帮别人搞自己的公司。
examples.english_sentence: He actually became a traitor and helped others sabotage his own company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好做反骨仔啊，到時無人幫你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 faan2 gwat1 zai2 aa3, dou3 si4 mou5 jan4 bong1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要当叛徒啊，到时候没有人会帮你。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a traitor, or no one will help you later.

mandarin_meaning: 扫兴；大失所望；事与愿违
english_meaning: anticlimactic; letdown; damp squib; a disappointment
explanation_mandarin: 指事情发展的结果与之前期望或营造的气氛截然相反，令人感到失望和扫兴。
explanation_english: Refers to a situation where the outcome is the opposite of what was expected or what the atmosphere suggested, leading to disappointment and frustration. It suggests a disappointing or underwhelming climax.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我以為套戲會好好睇，點知睇完覺得好反高潮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 wai4 to3 hei3 wui5 hou2 hou2 tai2, dim2 zi1 tai2 jyun4 gok3 dak1 hou2 faan2 gou1 ciu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我以为这部电影会很好看，结果看完觉得很扫兴。
examples.english_sentence: I thought the movie would be great, but after watching it, I felt it was really anticlimactic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋本來諗住開個盛大嘅派對，但係最後得幾個人嚟，真係好反高潮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 bun2 loi4 nam2 zyu6 hoi1 go3 sing6 daai6 ge3 paai3 deoi3, daan6 hai6 zeoi3 hau6 dak1 gei2 go3 jan4 lai4, zan1 hai6 hou2 faan2 gou1 ciu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们本来想开一个盛大的派对，但是最后只有几个人来，真是很扫兴。
examples.english_sentence: They originally planned to throw a big party, but in the end only a few people came, it was a real letdown.

english_meaning: Anti-Triad Squad
explanation_mandarin: 香港警务处刑事侦缉部门专门负责打击黑社会犯罪的部门。
explanation_english: A specialized unit within the Hong Kong Police Force's Criminal Investigation Department responsible for combating triad-related crimes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗警察之後就加入咗反黑組，專門對付啲黑社會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 ging2 caat3 zi1 hau6 zau6 gaa1 jap6 zo2 faan2 hak1 zou2, zyun1 mun4 deoi3 fu6 di1 hak1 se6 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他当了警察之后就加入了反黑组，专门对付黑社会。
examples.english_sentence: After becoming a police officer, he joined the Anti-Triad Squad, specializing in dealing with triads.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 琴日新聞報導話反黑組拉咗幾個黑社會頭目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kam4 jat6 san1 man4 bou3 dou6 waa6 faan2 hak1 zou2 laai1 zo2 gei2 go3 hak1 se6 wui2 tau4 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天新闻报道说反黑组抓了几个黑社会头目。
examples.english_sentence: Yesterday's news reported that the Anti-Triad Squad arrested several triad leaders.

english_meaning: to become rich, to get rich, to make a fortune; to issue, to send out; to happen, to occur; to develop, to expand
explanation_mandarin: 本意是发出，发展。在粤语中，常指发财，变得富有，也指发生，产生等。
explanation_english: Originally means to issue, to develop. In Cantonese, it often refers to getting rich, becoming wealthy. It can also mean to happen, to occur, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祝你新年发大财!
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk1 nei5 san1 nin4 faat3 daai6 coi4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 祝你新年发大财!
examples.english_sentence: Wish you a fortune in the New Year!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢炒股票发咗达啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 caau2 gu2 piu3 faat3 zo2 daat6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他炒股票发财了。
examples.english_sentence: He made a fortune by speculating on stocks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好乱咁发脾气。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 faat3 pei4 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱发脾气。
examples.english_sentence: Don't lose your temper randomly.

english_meaning: uncle (father's younger brother); a polite term to address a man of one's father's age or slightly older
explanation_mandarin: 父亲的弟弟；对与父亲年龄相仿或稍长的男子的尊称。
explanation_english: Father's younger brother; a polite form of address for a man of one's father's age or slightly older, even if they are not related.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個叔好錫我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 suk1 hou2 sek3 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的叔叔很疼我们。
examples.english_sentence: My uncle loves us very much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 叔，唔該幫我攞個麵包。
examples.jyutping_sentence: suk1, m4 goi1 bong1 ngo5 lo2 go3 min6 baau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 叔叔，请帮我拿个面包。
examples.english_sentence: Uncle, please help me get a bread.

english_meaning: Husband's younger brother
explanation_mandarin: 指丈夫的弟弟。
explanation_english: Refers to the younger brother of one's husband.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個叔仔好後生，啱啱大學畢業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 suk1 zai2 hou2 hau6 saang1, ngaam1 ngaam1 daai6 hok6 bat1 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的小叔子很年轻，刚大学毕业。
examples.english_sentence: My husband's younger brother is very young and just graduated from university.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日同奶奶一齊去飲茶，順便識吓啲叔仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 tung4 naa4 naai4 jat1 cai4 heoi3 jam2 caa4, seon6 bin2 sik1 haa5 di1 suk1 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天和婆婆一起去喝茶，顺便认识一下小叔子们。
examples.english_sentence: Tomorrow, I'm going to have tea with my mother-in-law and will get to know my husband's younger brothers at the same time.

mandarin_meaning: 叔叔伯伯; 长辈亲戚
english_meaning: uncles and elders (referring to male relatives of the same generation as one's father or older)
explanation_mandarin: 泛指比父亲年长的男性亲戚或长辈，包括叔叔和伯伯。有时也用来尊称年长的男性。
explanation_english: A general term referring to male relatives or elders who are older than one's father, including uncles (both paternal uncles younger than the father and paternal uncles older than the father). It can also be used as a respectful term for older men.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 過年嘅時候，我哋要去拜年，同啲叔伯拜個年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwo3 nin4 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 heoi3 baai3 nin4, tung4 di1 suk1 baak3 baai3 go3 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 过年的时候，我们要去拜年，和叔叔伯伯们拜个年。
examples.english_sentence: During the Lunar New Year, we need to pay New Year's visits and greet our uncles and elders.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好尊重佢啲叔伯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zyun1 zung6 keoi5 di1 suk1 baak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很尊重他的叔叔伯伯。
examples.english_sentence: He respects his uncles and elders a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 叔伯，飲杯茶先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: suk1 baak3, yam2 bui1 caa4 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 叔叔伯伯，先喝杯茶吧。
examples.english_sentence: Uncles, please have a cup of tea first.

english_meaning: Great-uncle (father's uncle)
explanation_mandarin: 父亲的叔叔，即祖父的弟弟。
explanation_english: The brother of one's paternal grandfather; a great-uncle (on the father's side).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日我哋要去拜年，記得叫叔公啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 heoi3 baai3 nin4, gei3 dak1 giu3 suk1 gung1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天我们要去拜年，记得叫叔祖父啊。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to pay a New Year visit tomorrow, remember to call him great-uncle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嗰陣成日去叔公屋企玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 heoi3 suk1 gung1 uk1 kei2 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候经常去叔祖父家玩。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, I often went to my great-uncle's house to play.

english_meaning: uncle (father's younger brother)
explanation_mandarin: 称谓，称呼父亲的弟弟。也可用作对与父母年龄相仿的男性的尊称。
explanation_english: Term of address for father's younger brother. Also used as a polite form of address for a man of one's parents' generation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 叔叔，我想買支雪糕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: suk1 suk1, ngo5 soeng2 maai5 zi1 syut3 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 叔叔，我想买一个冰淇淋。
examples.english_sentence: Uncle, I want to buy an ice cream.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿叔喺英國做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 suk1 hai2 jing1 gwok3 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我叔叔在英国工作。
examples.english_sentence: My uncle works in the UK.

english_meaning: comfortable; cozy; feeling good
explanation_mandarin: 形容身体或心理上感到轻松愉快，没有压力。
explanation_english: Describes a feeling of physical or mental ease and relaxation, without any stress or discomfort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日放假，喺屋企瞓晏覺，真係好叔台呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 fong3 gaa3, hai2 uk1 kei2 fan3 aan3 gaau3, zan1 hai6 hou2 suk1 toi4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天放假，在家睡午觉，真舒服啊！
examples.english_sentence: It's a holiday today, taking a nap at home, it's so comfortable!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 沖完涼飲杯凍嘢，即刻覺得成個人都叔台晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: chung1 jyun4 loeng4 jam2 bui1 dung3 je5, zik1 hak1 gok3 dak1 sing4 go3 jan4 dou1 suk1 toi4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 洗完澡喝一杯冰饮料，立刻感觉整个人都舒服了。
examples.english_sentence: After taking a shower and drinking a cold drink, I immediately feel so comfortable.

english_meaning: great aunt (father's uncle's wife)
explanation_mandarin: 父亲的伯父或叔父的妻子。
explanation_english: Wife of one's father's elder or younger uncle. In English terms, this is a 'great aunt' on one's father's side.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋過年會去拜年，見吓啲親戚，包括我叔婆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gwo3 nin4 wui5 heoi3 baai3 nin4, gin3 haa5 di1 can1 cik1, baau1 kwut3 ngo5 suk1 po4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们过年的时候会去拜年，见一下亲戚，包括我的叔祖母。
examples.english_sentence: During Chinese New Year, we will visit relatives, including my great aunt.

english_meaning: uncle (father's younger brother)
explanation_mandarin: 称呼父亲的弟弟。比父亲年轻的男性亲属。
explanation_english: A term of address for one's father's younger brother. A younger male relative on the father's side.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嘅時候成日去叔父屋企玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 seng4 jat6 heoi3 suk1 fu6 uk1 kei2 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候经常去叔叔家玩。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a kid, I often went to my uncle's house to play.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 叔父，飲杯茶先啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: suk1 fu6, jam2 bui1 caa4 sin1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 叔叔，先喝杯茶吧！
examples.english_sentence: Uncle, have a cup of tea first!

english_meaning: Uncle (respectful term for an older male, often used for taxi drivers, waiters, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 对年龄稍长男性的尊称，不一定有亲属关系。常用于称呼出租车司机、餐厅服务员等。
explanation_english: A respectful term for addressing older men who are not necessarily related to the speaker. It's commonly used when addressing taxi drivers, restaurant waiters, or other service providers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 叔臺，唔該你車我去旺角呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: suk1 toi2, m4 goi1 nei5 ce1 ngo5 heoi3 wong6 gok3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 师傅，请你载我去旺角。
examples.english_sentence: Uncle, please take me to Mong Kok.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，叔臺，呢度啲嘢幾錢啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, suk1 toi2, ni1 dou6 di1 je5 gei2 cin2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，叔叔，这里的东西多少钱啊？
examples.english_sentence: Hey, uncle, how much are these things here?

mandarin_meaning: 老牌店铺；有历史的店铺
english_meaning: An old, established shop; a shop with a long history.
explanation_mandarin: 指一些经营历史悠久、有口碑的老店铺。通常是街坊邻居熟悉和信赖的店家。
explanation_english: Refers to old, well-established shops with a good reputation. These are usually shops that are familiar and trusted by the local community.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間叔記茶餐廳，啲嘢食真係好有風味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 suk1 gei2 caa4 caan1 teng1, di1 je5 sik6 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 fung1 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家老字号茶餐厅，食物真的很有风味。
examples.english_sentence: This old-school 'suk gei' (established) cha chaan teng, the food is really flavorful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嘅時候就成日嚟呢間叔記士多買嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 zau6 seng4 jat6 lai4 ni1 gaan1 suk1 gei2 si6 do1 maaai5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候就经常来这家老字号士多店买东西。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a child, I often came to this old 'suk gei' (established) store to buy things.

english_meaning: to take, to get, to obtain
explanation_mandarin: 表示拿走，获得，选取等意思。
explanation_english: Indicates the action of taking, getting, or obtaining something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我晏啲去銀行取錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aan3 di1 heoi3 ngan4 hong4 ceoi2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我晚点去银行取钱。
examples.english_sentence: I'll go to the bank to withdraw money later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺比賽度攞咗冠軍，取咗第一名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 bei2 coi3 dou6 lo2 zo2 gun3 gwan1, ceoi2 zo2 dai6 jat1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在比赛中获得了冠军，取得了第一名。
examples.english_sentence: He won the championship in the competition, taking first place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你取啲紙巾畀我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ceoi2 di1 zi2 gan1 bei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你拿一些纸巾给我。
examples.english_sentence: Take some tissues and give them to me.

english_meaning: to replace, to supersede, to substitute
explanation_mandarin: 用别的事物代替原来的事物。
explanation_english: To take the place of; to replace something or someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新嘅技術好快會取代舊嘅技術。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 ge3 gei6 seot6 hou2 faai3 wui5 ceoi2 dai6 gau6 ge3 gei6 seot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新的技术很快会取代旧的技术。
examples.english_sentence: New technology will quickly replace the old technology.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個app最終取代咗舊有嘅網站。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 app zeoi3 chung1 ceoi2 dai6 zo2 gau6 jau5 ge3 mong5 zaam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个app最终取代了旧有的网站。
examples.english_sentence: This app eventually replaced the old website.

english_meaning: to win, to triumph, to gain victory
explanation_mandarin: 获得胜利。 在竞争、比赛或冲突中战胜对手。
explanation_english: To win or triumph over an opponent in a competition, match, or conflict.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋隊波今次比賽一定會取勝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 deoi2 bo1 gam1 ci3 bei2 coi3 jat1 ding6 wui5 ceoi2 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的球队这次比赛一定会取胜。
examples.english_sentence: Their team will definitely win this competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要喺呢場比賽取勝，一定要有策略。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 hai2 ni1 coeng4 bei2 coi3 ceoi2 sing3, jat1 ding6 jiu3 jau5 cak1 loek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要想在这场比赛中取胜，一定要有策略。
examples.english_sentence: To win this competition, you must have a strategy.

english_meaning: to name; to give a name
explanation_mandarin: 给某人或某物起名字。
explanation_english: To give a name to someone or something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要幫個仔取名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 bong1 go3 zai2 ceoi2 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要给儿子取名字。
examples.english_sentence: We need to name our son.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間鋪頭取名做「好運來」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou1 tau2 ceoi2 ming4 zou6 "hou2 wan6 loi4".
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家商店起名叫“好运来”。
examples.english_sentence: This shop is named "Good Luck Comes".

english_meaning: orientation, preference, inclination
explanation_mandarin: 方向或志趣的倾向；通常指性取向。
explanation_english: A direction or inclination of interest; often refers to sexual orientation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅性取向係同性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing3 ceoi2 hoeng3 hai6 tung4 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的性取向是同性恋。
examples.english_sentence: His sexual orientation is homosexual.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對呢方面嘅研究有啲取向。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 fong1 min6 ge3 jin4 gau3 jau5 di1 ceoi2 hoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对这方面的研究有些倾向。
examples.english_sentence: I have some inclination towards this area of research.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司嘅市場取向改變咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 si5 coeng4 ceoi2 hoeng3 goi2 bin3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的市场取向改变了。
examples.english_sentence: The company's market orientation has changed.

english_meaning: to try to gain advantage by trickery, to cut corners, to seek personal gain through clever tricks, to be opportunistic
explanation_mandarin: 指用不正当的手段或投机的方法来获取利益或达到目的，通常带有贬义。
explanation_english: To use improper methods or opportunistic ways to gain benefits or achieve a goal. Usually carries a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日諗住取巧啦，要腳踏實地先得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 nam2 zyu6 ceoi2 haau2 laa1, jiu3 goek3 daap6 sat6 dei6 sin1 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是想着投机取巧，要脚踏实地才行。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always think about cutting corners, you have to be down-to-earth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份功課咁快就交咗，一定係取巧㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 fo3 gam3 faai3 zau6 gaau1 zo2, jat1 ding6 hai6 ceoi2 haau2 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的作业这么快就交了，肯定是投机取巧的。
examples.english_sentence: He handed in his homework so quickly; he must have cut corners.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做人唔應該諗住取巧，應該誠實做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jan4 m4 jing1 goi1 nam2 zyu6 ceoi2 haau2, jing1 goi1 sing4 sat6 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做人不应该想着投机取巧，应该诚实做事。
examples.english_sentence: A person shouldn't be thinking about cutting corners, they should do things honestly.

english_meaning: to obtain, to acquire, to gain, to achieve
explanation_mandarin: 表示经过努力或某种方式得到想要的东西。
explanation_english: To get, acquire, or obtain something through effort or a particular method.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好努力讀書，終於取得好成績。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 nou5 lik6 duk6 syu1, chung1 yu1 cheui2 dak1 hou2 sing4 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很努力学习，终于取得了好成绩。
examples.english_sentence: He studied very hard and finally achieved good grades.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要努力工作，先可以取得成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 nou5 lik6 gung1 jok3, sin1 ho2 ji5 cheui2 dak1 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要努力工作，才可以取得成功。
examples.english_sentence: We need to work hard in order to achieve success.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司成功取得咗新嘅合約。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 sing4 gung1 cheui2 dak1 zo2 san1 ge3 hap6 yeuk3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司成功取得了新的合同。
examples.english_sentence: This company successfully obtained a new contract.

english_meaning: to please; to ingratiate oneself with; to curry favour with
explanation_mandarin: 使别人高兴，迎合别人的心意。
explanation_english: To make someone happy; to try to please someone, often to gain favor or advantage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都想取悅老細。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 soeng2 ceoi2 jyut6 lou5 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想取悦老板。
examples.english_sentence: He always tries to please the boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使刻意取悅任何人，做自己就得啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 hak1 ji3 ceoi2 jyut6 jam6 ho4 jan4, zou6 zi6 gei2 zau6 dak1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不必刻意取悦任何人，做自己就好。
examples.english_sentence: There's no need to deliberately please anyone, just be yourself.

english_meaning: to please, to flatter, to ingratiate oneself with
explanation_mandarin: 为了获得好感或利益而迎合对方，使其高兴。
explanation_english: To try to please someone, often in order to gain favour or advantage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都諗住點樣取悅佢老細。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 nam2 zoek3 dim2 joeng2 ceoi2 yut6 keoi5 lou5 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想着怎样取悦他的老板。
examples.english_sentence: He's always thinking about how to please his boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想靠取悅人嚟得到我想要嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 kaau3 ceoi2 yut6 jan4 lai4 dak1 dou3 ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想靠取悦别人来得到我想要的东西。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to get what I want by pleasing people.

english_meaning: to please, to ingratiate oneself with, to curry favour with
explanation_mandarin: 使人高兴，迎合别人。
explanation_english: To try to please someone in order to gain their favour or approval.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都諗住點樣取悦老闆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 nam2 zyu6 dim2 joeng2 ceoi2 jyut6 lou5 baan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想着如何取悦老板。
examples.english_sentence: He's always thinking about how to please the boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想為咗升職而去取悦任何人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 wai6 zo2 sing1 zik1 heoi3 ceoi2 jyut6 jam6 ho4 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想为了升职而去取悦任何人。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to please anyone just to get a promotion.

english_meaning: stance, attitude, position
explanation_mandarin: 指在特定问题或事件上的立场、态度或观点。
explanation_english: Refers to the stance, attitude, or viewpoint on a particular issue or event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府喺呢件事上面嘅取態好唔清晰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 hai2 ni1 gin6 si6 zeon2 mian6 ge3 ceoi2 taai3 hou2 m4 cing1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府在这件事上的态度很不清晰。
examples.english_sentence: The government's stance on this matter is very unclear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你對呢個問題嘅取態係點呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 deoi3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4 ge3 ceoi2 taai3 hai6 dim2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你对这个问题的立场是什么？
examples.english_sentence: What is your stance on this issue?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司嘅取態係唔鼓勵員工超時工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ge3 ceoi2 taai3 hai6 m4 gu2 lai6 wun4 gung1 ciu1 si4 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的态度是不鼓励员工加班。
examples.english_sentence: The company's position is to discourage employees from working overtime.

english_meaning: to choose what to keep and what to discard; to make a choice; to select
explanation_mandarin: 指选取和舍弃，做出选择。强调在多个选项中选择需要的，放弃不需要的。
explanation_english: To choose what to keep and what to discard; to make a choice between alternatives, keeping some and discarding others. It emphasizes the process of selection and rejection based on needs and priorities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做嘢嘅時候，要識得取捨，唔好乜都攬上身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 je5 ge3 si4 hau6, jiu3 sik1 dak1 ceoi2 se2, m4 hou2 mat1 dou1 laam5 soeng5 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工作的时候，要懂得取舍，不要什么都揽在身上。
examples.english_sentence: When working, you need to know how to make choices, don't take on everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺人生嘅道路上，我哋要學識取捨，先可以活得更加輕鬆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 jan4 sang1 ge3 dou6 lou6 soeng6, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hok6 sik1 ceoi2 se2, sin1 ho2 ji5 wut6 dak1 gang3 gaa1 hing1 sung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在人生的道路上，我们要学会取舍，才可以活得更加轻松。
examples.english_sentence: On the path of life, we must learn to make choices in order to live more easily.

english_meaning: to scout locations (for filming); to choose a scene; framing (photography)
explanation_mandarin: 指在拍摄电影、电视或其他影像作品时，选择合适的场景或地点进行拍摄；也指摄影或摄像中对画面进行构图和调整。
explanation_english: Refers to the process of selecting appropriate scenes or locations for filming movies, television shows, or other visual works. It also refers to the composition and adjustment of the image in photography or videography.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今日要去西貢取景。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 sai1 gung3 ceoi2 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今天要去西贡取景。
examples.english_sentence: We are going to Sai Kung for location scouting today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度嘅風景好靚，好啱攞嚟取景。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 ge3 fung1 ging2 hou2 leng3, hou2 ngaam1 lo2 lai4 ceoi2 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的风景很美，很适合用来取景。
examples.english_sentence: The scenery here is very beautiful, very suitable for filming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用咗好多時間嚟取景，務求拍出最好嘅效果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 zo2 hou2 do1 si4 gaan3 lai4 ceoi2 ging2, mou6 kau4 paak3 ceot1 zeoi3 hou2 ge3 haau6 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他花了很多时间来取景，务求拍出最好的效果。
examples.english_sentence: He spent a lot of time scouting locations, striving to capture the best possible effect.

english_meaning: to keep warm; to warm oneself
explanation_mandarin: 使自己变暖和；通常指通过靠近热源或互相靠近来获取温暖。
explanation_english: To warm oneself; typically refers to getting warm by being near a heat source or by huddling together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冬天咁凍，我哋圍埋一齊取暖啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dung1 tin1 gam3 dung3, ngo5 dei6 wai4 maai4 jat1 cai4 ceoi2 nyun5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 冬天这么冷，我们围在一起取暖吧。
examples.english_sentence: It's so cold in winter, let's huddle together to keep warm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺個火爐前面取暖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 go3 fo2 lou4 cin4 min6 ceoi2 nyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在火炉前面取暖。
examples.english_sentence: He is warming himself in front of the stove.

english_meaning: to replace, to substitute
explanation_mandarin: 以某事物代替另一事物。更换。
explanation_english: To replace one thing with another. To substitute or exchange.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 壞咗嘅燈膽要取替。
examples.jyutping_sentence: waai6 zo2 ge3 dang1 daam2 jiu3 ceoi2 tai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 坏了的灯泡要更换。
examples.english_sentence: The broken lightbulb needs to be replaced.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔舒服，我要取替佢開會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 syu1 fuk6, ngo5 jiu3 ceoi2 tai3 keoi5 hoi1 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不舒服，我要代替他开会。
examples.english_sentence: He is not feeling well, so I need to substitute for him in the meeting.

english_meaning: to gather material, to collect data, to draw material from
explanation_mandarin: 搜集写作或创作的素材。
explanation_english: To gather material or data for writing or creating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢套戲嘅靈感係取材自真人真事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tou3 hei3 ge3 ling4 gam2 hai6 ceoi2 coi4 zi6 zan1 jan4 zan1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这部电影的灵感是取材于真人真事。
examples.english_sentence: The inspiration for his movie is drawn from real events.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書取材廣泛，包羅萬有。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 ceoi2 coi4 gwong2 faan6, baau1 lo4 maan6 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书取材广泛，包罗万象。
examples.english_sentence: This book draws material from a wide range of sources, encompassing everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記者要四處取材，先可以寫出一篇好嘅報道。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 ze2 jiu3 sei3 cyu3 ceoi2 coi4, sin1 ho2 ji5 se2 ceot1 jat1 pin1 hou2 ge3 bou3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记者要四处搜集资料，才可以写出一篇好的报道。
examples.english_sentence: A reporter needs to gather information from all over the place in order to write a good report.

synonyms: 收集資料 (sau1 zaap6 zi1 liu2)

english_meaning: to make fun of; to find amusement in; to amuse oneself with; to have fun (at someone's expense)
explanation_mandarin: 以某事或某人为乐，有时含有嘲弄或戏弄的意味。
explanation_english: To derive amusement or pleasure from something or someone, often with a hint of mockery or teasing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日攞我嚟取樂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 lo2 ngo5 lai4 ceoi2 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们总是拿我寻开心。
examples.english_sentence: They always make fun of me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好攞人哋嘅缺陷嚟取樂啦，咁樣好無品㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lo2 jan4 dei2 ge3 kyut3 ham6 lai4 ceoi2 lok6 laa1, gam2 joeng2 hou2 mou5 ban2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要拿别人的缺陷来取乐，这样很没有品德。
examples.english_sentence: Don't make fun of other people's shortcomings, it's very rude.

synonyms: 搵嘢嚟搞 (wan2 je5 lai4 gaau2)

english_meaning: to depend on, to hinge on, to be determined by
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事由另一件事决定。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is determined by something else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最後嘅結果取決於你嘅努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 hau6 ge3 git3 gwo2 ceoi2 kyut3 jyu1 nei5 ge3 nou5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最终的结果取决于你的努力。
examples.english_sentence: The final result depends on your effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成功與否取決於團隊嘅合作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 gung1 jyu5 fau2 ceoi2 kyut3 jyu1 tyun4 deoi2 ge3 hap6 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 成功与否取决于团队的合作。
examples.english_sentence: Success or failure depends on the team's cooperation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個比賽嘅日子取決於天氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 bei2 coi3 ge3 jat6 zi2 ceoi2 kyut3 jyu1 tin1 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 比赛的日子取决于天气。
examples.english_sentence: The date of the competition depends on the weather.

english_meaning: to cancel; cancellation
explanation_mandarin: 停止或废止已安排或计划好的事情。
explanation_english: To decide that an arranged event will not take place; to nullify or revoke something that has been planned or scheduled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要取消個會議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 ceoi2 siu1 go3 wui6 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要取消那个会议。
examples.english_sentence: We have to cancel the meeting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 由於天氣唔好，所以演唱會取消咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau4 jyu1 tin1 hei3 m4 hou2, so2 ji5 jin2 coeng3 wui2 ceoi2 siu1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 由于天气不好，所以演唱会取消了。
examples.english_sentence: Due to the bad weather, the concert was cancelled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢臨時取消咗同我嘅約會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lam4 si4 ceoi2 siu1 zo2 tung4 ngo5 ge3 joek3 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他临时取消了和我的约会。
examples.english_sentence: He cancelled his appointment with me at the last minute.

english_meaning: Cancel culture
explanation_mandarin: 指一种社会现象，通常发生在互联网上，某人因发表或做出了被认为冒犯性、不恰当或有争议的言论或行为后，受到公众的抵制和谴责，导致其职业、声誉和社会地位受到损害。
explanation_english: Refers to a social phenomenon, often occurring on the internet, where a person is publicly boycotted and condemned for expressing or doing something considered offensive, inappropriate, or controversial, leading to damage to their career, reputation, and social standing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲人好易因為少少嘢就搞取消文化，好恐怖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 yan4 hou2 yi6 wai4 zo6 siu2 siu2 ye5 zau6 gaau2 ceoi2 siu1 man4 faa3, hou2 hung2 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的人很容易因为一点小事就搞取消文化，很恐怖。
examples.english_sentence: People nowadays easily engage in cancel culture over trivial matters, it's terrifying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為講錯嘢，搞到俾人取消文化，好慘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yan1 wai4 gong2 co3 ye5, gaau2 dou3 bei2 yan4 ceoi2 siu1 man4 faa3, hou2 caam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为说错话，导致被人取消文化，很惨。
examples.english_sentence: He was subjected to cancel culture for saying the wrong thing, it's terrible.

english_meaning: to light a fire; to get fire
explanation_mandarin: 点燃火源，获得火。
explanation_english: To start a fire; to obtain fire (e.g., using a lighter or matches).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 野外露營嘅時候，我哋要學識點樣取火。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je5 ngoi6 lou6 jing4 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hok6 sik1 dim2 joeng2 ceoi2 fo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在野外露营的时候，我们要学会怎样取火。
examples.english_sentence: When camping in the wild, we need to learn how to start a fire.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢袋入面有打火機，可以攞嚟取火。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 doi6 jap6 min6 jau5 daa2 fo2 gei1, ho2 ji5 lo2 lai4 ceoi2 fo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他口袋里有打火机，可以用来点火。
examples.english_sentence: He has a lighter in his pocket, which can be used to light a fire.

english_meaning: to use, to make use of
explanation_mandarin: 使用。多用于比较正式的场合或书面语。
explanation_english: To use; to make use of. Often used in formal situations or written language.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以隨便取用啲茶點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 ceoi4 bin2 ceoi2 jung6 di1 caa4 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以随便使用一些茶点。
examples.english_sentence: You can freely take and use some refreshments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度嘅資源可以俾大家取用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 ge3 zi1 jyun4 ho2 ji5 bei2 daai6 gaa1 ceoi2 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的资源可以供大家使用。
examples.english_sentence: The resources here are available for everyone to use.

english_meaning: to make fun of, to tease, to ridicule
explanation_mandarin: 嘲弄，开玩笑地批评或贬低。
explanation_english: To make fun of someone or something, often in a playful or unkind way; to tease or ridicule.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好取笑人哋喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 ceoi2 siu3 jan4 dei6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要取笑别人了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't make fun of others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都取笑我啲廣東話唔正。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 ceoi2 siu3 ngo5 di1 gwong2 dung1 waa2 m4 zeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是取笑我的广东话不标准。
examples.english_sentence: He always makes fun of my Cantonese pronunciation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔鍾意人哋取笑我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 jan4 dei6 ceoi2 siu3 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不喜欢别人取笑我。
examples.english_sentence: I don't like people making fun of me.

english_meaning: to learn from experience; to seek advice and experience; to learn from the source (like Tripitaka in Journey to the West); to draw lessons from others' experience
explanation_mandarin: 本意指去西方（印度）获取佛教经典，比喻学习他人的长处，借鉴他人的经验。
explanation_english: Originally referring to Tripitaka's journey to the West (India) to obtain Buddhist scriptures, it's now used metaphorically to describe learning from others' strengths and drawing lessons from their experiences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要向成功嘅企業家取經，學習佢哋嘅經營之道。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hoeng3 sing4 gung1 ge3 kei5 jip6 gaa1 ceoi2 ging1, hok6 zaap6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 ging1 jing4 zi1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要向成功的企业家取经，学习他们的经营之道。
examples.english_sentence: We need to learn from successful entrepreneurs and study their business strategies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次失敗咗，下次要汲取教訓，向人哋取經。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 sat1 baai6 zo2, haa6 ci3 jiu3 kap1 ceoi2 gaau3 fan3, hoeng3 jan4 dei6 ceoi2 ging1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次失败了，下次要汲取教训，向别人取经。
examples.english_sentence: We failed this time. Next time we need to learn from our mistakes and seek advice from others.

english_meaning: to ban; to suppress; to outlaw; to prohibit
explanation_mandarin: 指政府或有关部门明令禁止，取消某种机构或活动的合法地位。
explanation_english: To officially ban or suppress something, such as an organization or activity, by declaring it illegal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府決定取締所有非法賭檔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 kyut3 ding6 cheui2 dai2 so2 jau5 fei1 faat3 dou2 dong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府决定取缔所有非法赌博场所。
examples.english_sentence: The government decided to ban all illegal gambling dens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方取締咗一間無牌酒吧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 cheui2 dai2 zo2 jat1 gaan1 mou4 paai3 jau5 baa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方取缔了一家无牌酒吧。
examples.english_sentence: The police shut down an unlicensed bar.

english_meaning: to replace; to supplant; to supersede
explanation_mandarin: 夺取原来的位置，由自己代替。
explanation_english: To take the place of; to replace someone or something, often through competition or by force.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果佢唔努力，好快就會俾其他人取而代之啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 keoi5 m4 nou5 lik6, hou2 faai3 zau6 wui5 bei2 kei4 taa1 jan4 ceoi2 ji4 doi6 zi1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果他不努力，很快就会被其他人取代。
examples.english_sentence: If he doesn't work hard, he will soon be replaced by others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新嘅科技好快就會取而代之舊嘅科技。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 ge3 fo2 gei6 hou2 faai3 zau6 wui5 ceoi2 ji4 doi6 zi1 gau6 ge3 fo2 gei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新的科技很快就会取代旧的科技。
examples.english_sentence: New technology will soon replace old technology.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢表現得咁差，俾人取而代之都係遲早嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 biu2 hin3 dak1 gam3 caa1, bei2 jan4 ceoi2 ji4 doi6 zi1 dou1 hai6 ci4 zou2 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他表现得那么差，被人取代是迟早的事情。
examples.english_sentence: He performed so poorly, it was only a matter of time before he was replaced.

english_meaning: to take a route; to go via
explanation_mandarin: 选择经过某条道路或路线。
explanation_english: To choose and take a particular road or route; to go via a specific place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋可以取道紅磡海底隧道過海。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 ceoi2 dou6 hung4 ham3 hoi2 dai2 seoi6 dou6 gwo3 hoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们可以取道红磡海底隧道过海。
examples.english_sentence: We can take the Cross-Harbour Tunnel via Hung Hom to cross the harbor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋取道深圳返大陸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ceoi2 dou6 sam1 zan3 faan1 daai6 luk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们取道深圳返回大陆。
examples.english_sentence: They are taking the route through Shenzhen to return to the mainland.

english_meaning: to admit; to accept (application, student, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 接受申请、录取（例如：录取学生）。
explanation_english: To admit or accept, especially in the context of applications or selections, such as admitting a student to a school or accepting a job application.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間大學取錄咗我啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 daai6 hok6 ceoi2 luk6 zo2 ngo5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那所大学录取我了！
examples.english_sentence: That university has admitted me!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次招聘競爭好激烈，唔知會取錄幾多人呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ziu1 ping3 ging6 zang1 hou2 gik1 lit6, m4 zi1 wui5 ceoi2 luk6 gei2 do1 jan4 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次招聘竞争很激烈，不知道会录取多少人呢？
examples.english_sentence: The competition for this recruitment is very fierce. I wonder how many people will be accepted?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅成績好好，一定會俾大學取錄嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing1 zik1 hou2 hou2, jat1 ding6 wui5 bei2 daai6 hok6 ceoi2 luk6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的成绩很好，肯定会被大学录取的。
examples.english_sentence: His grades are very good, he will definitely be accepted by the university.

english_meaning: to frame (a shot); to compose (a picture)
explanation_mandarin: 在摄影或摄像中，为了达到最佳的视觉效果而选择合适的角度和范围，进行构图。
explanation_english: In photography or videography, to select the appropriate angle and range to achieve the best visual effect and compose the shot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 導演喺度取緊鏡，唔好行埋去阻住佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daam2 jin2 hai2 dou6 ceoi2 gan2 geng3, m4 hou2 hang4 maai4 heoi3 zo2 zyu6 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 导演正在取景，不要走过去打扰他。
examples.english_sentence: The director is framing the shot, don't go over there and disturb him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個位取鏡一流，影出嚟嘅相一定好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 wai2 ceoi2 geng3 jat1 lau4, ying2 chut1 lai4 ge3 soeng2 jat1 ding6 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个位置取景一流，拍出来的照片一定很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: This is a great spot for framing a shot, the pictures taken will definitely be beautiful.

english_meaning: to learn from each other's strengths and make up for each other's weaknesses
explanation_mandarin: 吸取别人的长处，弥补自己的短处。
explanation_english: To learn from others' strengths and compensate for one's own weaknesses; to make up for shortcomings by drawing on strengths.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋兩個可以取長補短，一齊合作做好呢個project。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 leong5 go3 ho2 ji5 ceoi2 coeng4 bou2 dyun2, jat1 cai4 hap6 zok3 zou2 hou2 ni1 go3 project.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们两个可以取长补短，一起合作做好这个项目。
examples.english_sentence: The two of us can learn from each other's strengths and make up for each other's weaknesses. Let's work together to complete this project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 團隊合作最緊要係取長補短，發揮各自嘅優勢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tyun4 deoi2 hap6 zok3 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hai6 ceoi2 coeng4 bou2 dyun2, faat3 fai1 gok3 zi6 ge3 jau1 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 团队合作最重要的是取长补短，发挥各自的优势。
examples.english_sentence: The most important thing in teamwork is to learn from each other's strengths and make the best use of everyone's advantages.

english_meaning: to receive; to suffer; to bear; to stand; to endure
explanation_mandarin: 接受；承受；遭受。
explanation_english: To receive; to accept; to bear; to suffer; to endure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我受唔住咁大嘅壓力啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sau6 m4 zyu6 gam3 daai6 ge3 aat3 lik6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我受不了这么大的压力啊！
examples.english_sentence: I can't stand such great pressure!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我受咗傷，要睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sau6 zo2 soeng1, jiu3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我受伤了，要看医生。
examples.english_sentence: I got injured, I need to see a doctor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢受咗好多委屈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sau6 zo2 hou2 do1 wai2 kuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他受到了很多委屈。
examples.english_sentence: He has suffered a lot of grievances.

english_meaning: cannot bear, cannot stand, intolerable, unbearable
explanation_mandarin: 表示无法忍受或承受某种情况或事物。
explanation_english: Expresses the inability to tolerate or endure a certain situation or thing. It indicates that something is too much to handle or accept.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 熱到我受不了啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: jit6 dou3 ngo5 sau6 bat1 liu5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 热得我都受不了了！
examples.english_sentence: It's so hot that I can't stand it!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺度嘈，我真係受不了佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 cou4, ngo5 zan1 hai6 sau6 bat1 liu5 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天在这里吵闹，我真受不了他。
examples.english_sentence: He's always making noise here, I really can't stand him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份工壓力咁大，我都嚟緊受不了。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 gung1 aat3 lik6 gam3 daai6, ngo5 dou1 lai4 gan2 sau6 bat1 liu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作压力这么大，我都快受不了了。
examples.english_sentence: The pressure of this job is so high, I'm almost at my breaking point.

mandarin_meaning: 受人恩惠; 接受别人的好处
english_meaning: To be indebted to someone; to be under obligation to someone; to receive benefits from someone.
explanation_mandarin: 表示接受了别人的帮助或好处，因此欠了别人人情，需要回报。
explanation_english: Indicates that one has received help or benefits from someone, and is therefore indebted to them and needs to reciprocate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次多得你幫手，我真係受人二分四啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 do1 dak1 nei5 bong1 sau2, ngo5 zan1 hai6 sau6 jan4 ji6 fan1 sei3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次多亏你帮忙，我真是受你恩惠了。
examples.english_sentence: Thanks to your help this time, I am truly indebted to you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日受人二分四，遲早都要還㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 sau6 jan4 ji6 fan1 sei3, ci4 zou2 dou1 jiu3 waan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是接受别人的好处，迟早都要还的。
examples.english_sentence: He always receives benefits from others, sooner or later he will have to repay them.

jyutping: sau6 jan4 cin4 coi4, tai3 jan4 siu1 zoi1
english_meaning: He who takes money must ward off calamity for others.
explanation_mandarin: 收了别人的钱，就应该替别人解决问题，摆平麻烦。
explanation_english: This idiom means that if you accept money from someone, you are obligated to resolve their problems and avert misfortune for them. It implies a sense of responsibility or even a slightly dubious agreement to handle a difficult situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋收咗佢咁多錢，梗係要幫佢搞掂件事啦，受人錢財，替人消災嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sau1 zo2 keoi5 gam3 do1 cin2, gang2 hai6 jiu3 bong1 keoi5 gaau2 dim6 gin6 si6 laa1, sau6 jan4 cin4 coi4, tai3 jan4 siu1 zoi1 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们收了他这么多钱，当然要帮他把事情办好，拿人钱财，替人消灾嘛。
examples.english_sentence: We've received so much money from him, of course we have to help him get this done, he who takes money must ward off calamity for others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋肯幫我解決問題，都係因為我俾咗好多錢佢哋啫，真係受人錢財，替人消災。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hang2 bong1 ngo5 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4, dou1 hai6 jan1 wai6 ngo5 bei2 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2 keoi5 dei6 ze1, zan1 hai6 sau6 jan4 cin4 coi4, tai3 jan4 siu1 zoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们肯帮我解决问题，都是因为我给了他们很多钱，真是拿人钱财，替人消灾。
examples.english_sentence: They are willing to help me solve the problem because I gave them a lot of money. Truly, he who takes money must ward off calamity for others.

english_meaning: to be injured; to sustain an injury
explanation_mandarin: 身体受到损伤，如跌倒、碰撞等造成的伤害。
explanation_english: To sustain physical damage to the body, such as injuries caused by falls, collisions, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢踢波嘅時候受傷，要睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tek3 bo1 ge3 si4 hau6 sau6 soeng1, jiu3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他踢足球的时候受伤了，要看医生。
examples.english_sentence: He got injured while playing football and needs to see a doctor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小心啲，唔好整親受傷啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 sam1 di1, m4 hou2 zing2 can1 sau6 soeng1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心一点，不要不小心受伤了！
examples.english_sentence: Be careful, don't accidentally get injured!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次意外好多人受傷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 ji3 ngoi6 hou2 do1 jan4 sau6 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次意外很多人受伤。
examples.english_sentence: Many people were injured in this accident.

synonyms: 損手爛腳 (syun2 sau2 laan6 goek3)

english_meaning: to be employed; to be hired
explanation_mandarin: 被雇佣；接受雇佣。
explanation_english: To be employed by someone; to be hired for a job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺一間大公司受僱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jat1 gaan1 daai6 gung1 si1 sau6 gu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在一家大公司受雇。
examples.english_sentence: He is employed by a large company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋受僱於政府。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sau6 gu3 jyu1 zing3 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们受雇于政府。
examples.english_sentence: They are employed by the government.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你間公司請幾多個受僱人士啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gaan1 gung1 si1 ceng2 gei2 do1 go3 sau6 gu3 jan4 si6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的公司聘请了多少雇员啊？
examples.english_sentence: How many employees does your company hire?

english_meaning: to receive; to be subjected to; to suffer
explanation_mandarin: 表示接受，遭受某种待遇、影响或冲击。
explanation_english: Indicates receiving, being subjected to a certain treatment, influence, or impact.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢受到好多人嘅支持。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sau6 dou2 hou2 do1 jan4 ge3 zi1 chi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他受到了很多人的支持。
examples.english_sentence: He received a lot of support from people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司受到經濟衰退嘅影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 sau6 dou2 ging1 zai3 seoi1 teoi3 ge3 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司受到了经济衰退的影响。
examples.english_sentence: The company was affected by the economic recession.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢受到批評，覺得好唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sau6 dou2 pai1 ping1, gok3 dak1 hou2 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他受到了批评，觉得很不开心。
examples.english_sentence: He was criticized and felt very unhappy.

english_meaning: to be controlled, to be restricted, to be subject to control
explanation_mandarin: 指受到某种力量或条件的限制和控制，无法自由行动或发展。
explanation_english: Refers to being restricted or controlled by some force or condition, making it impossible to act or develop freely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅行動受到好多限制，成日受制於人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 hang4 dung6 sau6 dou2 hou2 do1 haan6 zai3, sing4 jat6 sau6 zai3 jyu1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的行动受到很多限制，总是受制于人。
examples.english_sentence: Their actions are very restricted, and they are always subject to others' control.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔想受制於人，就要努力啲增強自己嘅實力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 soeng2 sau6 zai3 jyu1 jan4, zau6 jiu3 nou5 lik6 di1 zang1 koeng4 zi6 gei2 ge3 sat6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不想受制于人，就要努力增强自己的实力。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't want to be controlled by others, you need to work harder to strengthen your own strength.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司受制於資金問題，好多計劃都唔能夠順利進行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 sau6 zai3 jyu1 zi1 gam1 man6 tai4, hou2 do1 gai3 waak6 dou1 m4 nang4 gau3 seon6 lei6 zeon3 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司受制于资金问题，很多计划都不能顺利进行。
examples.english_sentence: The company is restricted by financial problems, and many plans cannot be carried out smoothly.

english_meaning: to suffer injury; to be traumatized; to be hit hard (e.g., by a financial crisis)
explanation_mandarin: 指受到伤害，可以是身体上的损伤，也可以是精神上的打击。形容遭受了某种程度的损失或伤害。
explanation_english: Refers to suffering injury or harm. Can refer to physical damage or emotional trauma. Describes experiencing some degree of loss or damage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺車禍入邊受創好嚴重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ce1 wo6 jap6 bin1 sau6 cong3 hou2 jim4 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在车祸中受伤很严重。
examples.english_sentence: He was severely injured in the car accident.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司因為經濟衰退受創好深。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 jan1 wai6 ging1 zai3 seoi1 teoi3 sau6 cong3 hou2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司因为经济衰退受到很深的打击。
examples.english_sentence: The company was hit hard by the economic recession.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢失戀之後，心靈受創，好耐都走唔出陰影。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sat1 lyun2 zi1 hau6, sam1 ling4 sau6 cong3, hou2 noi6 dou1 zau2 m4 ceot1 jam1 ying2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他失恋之后，心灵受到创伤，很久都走不出阴影。
examples.english_sentence: After breaking up, his spirit was traumatized, and it took him a long time to get out of the shadow.

english_meaning: to suffer, to endure hardship, to have a hard time
explanation_mandarin: 指承受痛苦、折磨或困境。通常用于形容境遇艰难，日子不好过。
explanation_english: Refers to enduring pain, torment, or hardship. Usually used to describe difficult situations and having a hard time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 近排經濟唔好，好多人都受力呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan6 paai2 ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 sau6 lik6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近经济不好，很多人都受罪啊。
examples.english_sentence: Recently, the economy has been bad, and many people are having a hard time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一個人湊住兩個細路，真係好受力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 go3 jan4 cou3 zyu6 loeng5 go3 sai3 lou6, zan1 hai6 hou2 sau6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她一个人带着两个小孩，真的很受罪。
examples.english_sentence: She is taking care of two children alone, it's really hard on her.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁擔心，捱過咗呢段時間就唔使再受力啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 daam1 sam1, ngaai4 gwo3 zo2 ni1 dyun6 si4 gaan3 zau6 m4 sai2 zoi3 sau6 lik6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要太担心，熬过这段时间就不用再受罪了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry too much, once you get through this period, you won't have to suffer anymore.

english_meaning: to be awarded a medal (or honor)
explanation_mandarin: 接受勋章或荣誉。
explanation_english: To receive a medal or honor, typically awarded by a government or organization for distinguished service or achievement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今年受勛，真係好叻仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 nin4 sau6 fan1, zan1 hai6 hou2 lek1 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今年受勋了，真的很棒。
examples.english_sentence: He was awarded a medal this year, he's really amazing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為對社會嘅貢獻，所以受到政府受勛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 deoi3 se5 wui2 ge3 gung3 hiến3, so2 ji5 sau6 dou3 zing3 fu2 sau6 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为他对社会的贡献，所以受到政府受勋。
examples.english_sentence: Because of his contributions to society, he was awarded a medal by the government.

english_meaning: to be awarded a medal (of honour); to receive a knighthood (or other honour)
explanation_mandarin: 接受勋章，指因功绩或贡献而被授予荣誉称号或奖章。
explanation_english: To receive an honour or award, often a medal, knighthood, or other prestigious recognition for merit or service.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為對社會嘅貢獻而受勳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 deoi3 se5 wui2 ge3 gung3 hiun3 ji4 sau6 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为对社会的贡献而受勋。
examples.english_sentence: He was awarded a medal for his contribution to society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年有幾位傑出人士會受勳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 jau5 gei2 wai2 git6 cheut1 yan4 si6 wui5 sau6 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年有几位杰出人士会受勋。
examples.english_sentence: Several outstanding individuals will be honored with awards this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅爸爸係一位受勳嘅警務人員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 baa4 baa1 hai6 jat1 wai2 sau6 fan1 ge3 ging2 mou6 yan4 yun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的爸爸是一位受勋的警务人员。
examples.english_sentence: His father is an honoured police officer.

english_meaning: can't stand it; can't bear it; unable to endure
explanation_mandarin: 表示无法承受、忍受，达到忍耐的极限。
explanation_english: Expresses the inability to bear or endure something, reaching the limit of tolerance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日咁熱，真係受唔住呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 gam3 jit6, zan1 hai6 sau6 m4 zyu6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天这么热，真是受不了啊！
examples.english_sentence: It's so hot today, I really can't stand it!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都咁樣嘈，我已經受唔住喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 gam2 joeng2 caau4, ngo5 ji5 ging1 sau6 m4 zyu6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都这么吵，我已经受不了了。
examples.english_sentence: He's so noisy every day, I can't take it anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份工壓力太大，我受唔住想辭職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 gung1 aat3 lik6 taai3 daai6, ngo5 sau6 m4 zyu6 soeng2 ci4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作压力太大，我受不了想辞职。
examples.english_sentence: The pressure of this job is too much, I can't bear it and want to resign.

english_meaning: Cannot afford (literally or figuratively); cannot bear; cannot cope with
explanation_mandarin: 表示无法承受某种事物或情况，可能是经济上的负担，也可能是精神上的压力或某种行为的后果。
explanation_english: Indicates an inability to afford something, either literally (financially) or figuratively (unable to bear the burden, stress, or consequences of something).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個手袋咁貴，我受唔起呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sau2 doi2 gam3 gwai3, ngo5 sau6 m4 hei2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个手提包这么贵，我承受不起啊！
examples.english_sentence: This handbag is so expensive, I can't afford it!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日發脾氣，我都受唔起佢喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 faat3 pei4 hei3, ngo5 dou1 sau6 m4 hei2 keoi5 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天发脾气，我都受不了他了。
examples.english_sentence: He throws tantrums all the time, I can't bear him anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做咁多嘢，我真係受唔起呀，要抖下先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 gam3 do1 je5, ngo5 zan1 hai6 sau6 m4 hei2 aa3, jiu3 tau2 haa5 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做这么多事情，我真是吃不消啊，要休息一下才行。
examples.english_sentence: Doing so much work, I really can't cope, I need to rest for a while.

english_meaning: to be trapped; to be stranded; to be in distress
explanation_mandarin: 指被某种情况或环境限制，无法自由行动或摆脱困境。
explanation_english: Refers to being restricted by a certain situation or environment, unable to move freely or escape from difficulties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺升降機入面受困咗成個鐘頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 sing1 gong3 gei1 jap6 min6 sau6 kwan3 zo2 seng4 go3 zung1 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们被困在电梯里一个小时。
examples.english_sentence: They were trapped in the elevator for an hour.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為落大雨，好多人受困喺機場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 lok6 daai6 jyu5, hou2 do1 jan4 sau6 kwan3 hai2 gei1 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为下大雨，很多人被困在机场。
examples.english_sentence: Because of the heavy rain, many people were stranded at the airport.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 疫情期間，好多人受困喺屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jik6 cing4 gei1 gaan1, hou2 do1 jan4 sau6 kwan3 hai2 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 疫情期间，很多人被困在家里。
examples.english_sentence: During the pandemic, many people were trapped at home.

english_meaning: To be pursued (romantically); to be hit on
explanation_mandarin: 指被人追求，受到异性的追求。
explanation_english: Refers to being pursued romantically, being the target of someone's romantic advances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁靚女，梗係好多人受媾啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 leng3 neoi5, gang2 hai6 hou2 do1 jan4 sau6 gau3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她那么漂亮，肯定很多人追求她。
examples.english_sentence: She's so pretty, of course many people are pursuing her.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔鍾意成日喺酒吧度受媾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 seng4 jat6 hai2 jau5 baa1 dou6 sau6 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不喜欢总是再酒吧里被人搭讪。
examples.english_sentence: I don't like being hit on in bars all the time.

english_meaning: to suffer harm; to be victimized; to be harmed; victim
explanation_mandarin: 受到损害，遭受伤害。
explanation_english: To suffer harm or damage; to be victimized; also refers to a victim.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係呢單詐騙案嘅受害人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ni1 daan1 zaa3 pin3 on3 ge3 sau6 hoi6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是这起诈骗案的受害者。
examples.english_sentence: He is a victim of this fraud case.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多人喺呢場風災入面受害。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 jan4 hai2 ni1 coeng4 fung1 zoi1 jap6 min6 sau6 hoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多人在这场台风中受害。
examples.english_sentence: Many people suffered in this typhoon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再做受害人喇，企起身反抗啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 zou6 sau6 hoi6 jan4 laa3, kei5 hei2 san1 faan2 kong3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再当受害者了，站起来反抗吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a victim anymore, stand up and resist!

english_meaning: victim
explanation_mandarin: 遭受损害或伤害的人。
explanation_english: A person who has suffered harm or injury.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係呢單騙案嘅受害人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ni1 daan1 pin3 on3 ge3 sau6 hoi6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是这起诈骗案的受害人。
examples.english_sentence: He is a victim of this fraud case.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要幫助所有嘅受害人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 bong1 zo6 so2 jau5 ge3 sau6 hoi6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要帮助所有的受害人。
examples.english_sentence: We need to help all the victims.

english_meaning: victim
explanation_mandarin: 遭受损害的人。
explanation_english: A person who has suffered harm or loss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係呢單交通意外嘅受害者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ni1 daan1 gaau1 tung1 ji3 ngoi6 ge3 sau6 hoi6 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是这起交通事故的受害者。
examples.english_sentence: He is a victim of this traffic accident.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想成為網絡欺凌嘅受害者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 sing4 wai4 mong5 lok6 hei1 ling4 ge3 sau6 hoi6 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想成为网络欺凌的受害者。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to be a victim of cyberbullying.

english_meaning: to be on trial, to stand trial, to be tried
explanation_mandarin: 接受审判，接受法院的审理。
explanation_english: To undergo a trial; to be subjected to judicial examination in a court of law.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為涉嫌詐騙而要受審。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 sip3 jim4 zaa3 pin3 ji4 jiu3 sau6 sam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为涉嫌诈骗而要受审。
examples.english_sentence: He has to stand trial for alleged fraud.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 被告人喺法庭上面受審。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei6 gou3 jan4 hai2 faat3 ting4 soeng6 min6 sau6 sam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 被告人在法庭上受审。
examples.english_sentence: The defendant is standing trial in court.

mandarin_meaning: 受宠若惊 (shòu chǒng ruò jīng)
english_meaning: to feel overwhelmed by an unexpected favour, to feel deeply grateful and apprehensive
explanation_mandarin: 形容受到意想不到的恩宠而感到非常惊喜和不安。
explanation_english: Describes the feeling of being extremely surprised and uneasy at receiving an unexpected favour or honor. It implies a feeling of unworthiness and a fear of not being able to reciprocate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細突然間升我做經理，我真係受寵若驚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 dat6 jin4 gaan1 sing1 ngo5 zou6 ging1 lei5, ngo5 zan1 hai6 sau6 cung2 joek6 ging1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板突然升我做经理，我真是受宠若惊。
examples.english_sentence: My boss suddenly promoted me to manager, I'm really overwhelmed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢竟然送咗隻咁貴嘅錶俾我，我受寵若驚呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging2 jin4 sung3 zo2 zek3 gam3 gwai3 ge3 biu1 bei2 ngo5, ngo5 sau6 cung2 joek6 ging1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他竟然送了我这么贵的手表，我受宠若惊啊！
examples.english_sentence: He actually gave me such an expensive watch, I'm overwhelmed!

english_meaning: to be wronged; to be subjected to injustice; to feel aggrieved
explanation_mandarin: 受到不公正的待遇，感到委屈。
explanation_english: To be treated unfairly or unjustly; to feel aggrieved or wronged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得自己好受屈啊，明明唔係我做嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 hou2 sau6 wat1 aa3, ming4 ming4 m4 hai6 ngo5 zou6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得自己很委屈，明明不是我做的。
examples.english_sentence: I feel so wronged, it wasn't me who did it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾老細鬧咗一鑊，覺得好受屈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 lou5 sai3 naau6 zo2 jat1 wok6, gok3 dak1 hou2 sau6 wat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被老板骂了一顿，觉得很委屈。
examples.english_sentence: He was scolded by his boss and felt very wronged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁受屈啦，有咩事講出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 sau6 wat1 laa1, jau5 me1 si6 gong2 chut1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么委屈了，有什么事说出来。
examples.english_sentence: Don't feel so wronged, tell me what's wrong.

english_meaning: to benefit from; to receive benefit
explanation_mandarin: 得到好处或利益。
explanation_english: To receive benefit or advantages; to be a beneficiary of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋受惠於政府嘅教育政策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sau6 wai6 jyu1 zing3 fu2 ge3 gaau3 juk6 zing3 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们受益于政府的教育政策。
examples.english_sentence: We benefit from the government's education policies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 市民受惠於新嘅醫療改革。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si5 man4 sau6 wai6 jyu1 san1 ge3 ji1 liu4 goi2 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 市民受益于新的医疗改革。
examples.english_sentence: The citizens benefit from the new healthcare reform.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你嘅幫忙，令我哋受惠良多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 ge3 bong1 mong4, ling6 ngo5 dei6 sau6 wai6 loeng4 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢你的帮忙，让我们受益良多。
examples.english_sentence: Thank you for your help, we have benefited a lot from it.

english_meaning: to receive and maintain; to accept and uphold (often in a religious context, particularly Buddhism)
explanation_mandarin: 接受并保持，通常指接受佛教教义并依照奉行。
explanation_english: To receive and maintain, often referring to accepting Buddhist teachings and practicing accordingly. It implies a commitment to upholding and following something received.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢信咗佛之後，每日都受持經文。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seon3 zo2 fat6 zi1 hau6, mui5 jat6 dou1 sau6 ci4 ging1 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他信佛之后，每天都信受奉行经文。
examples.english_sentence: After he became a Buddhist, he accepts and upholds the scriptures every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該受持正確嘅價值觀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jing1 goi1 sau6 ci4 zing3 kok3 ge3 gaa3 zik6 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该接受并保持正确的价值观。
examples.english_sentence: We should accept and uphold correct values.

english_meaning: to suffer setbacks; to be frustrated; to be discouraged
explanation_mandarin: 指受到阻碍或失败，士气受打击。
explanation_english: To experience obstacles or failure, leading to a loss of morale or discouragement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次考試考得唔好，覺得好受挫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 haau2 dak1 m4 hou2, gok3 dak1 hou2 sau6 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次考试考得不好，觉得很受挫。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't do well on the exam this time and feels very frustrated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然計劃受挫，但我哋唔會放棄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 gai3 waak6 sau6 co3, daan6 ngo5 dei6 m4 wui5 fong3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然计划受挫，但是我们不会放弃。
examples.english_sentence: Although the plan has suffered a setback, we won't give up.

english_meaning: under control; controlled
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物或情况受到控制，可以被管理或约束。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is under control, can be managed or restrained.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部機器嘅運作受到嚴格控制。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 gei1 hei3 ge3 wan6 zok3 sau6 dou3 jim4 gaak3 hung3 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台机器的运作受到严格控制。
examples.english_sentence: The operation of this machine is under strict control.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢情緒好容易受到影響，好難受控。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cing4 seoi5 hou2 jung4 ji6 sau6 dou3 jing2 hoeng2, hou2 naan4 sau6 hung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的情绪很容易受到影响，很难控制。
examples.english_sentence: His emotions are easily affected, making them hard to control.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要確保情況受到控制，唔好俾佢失控。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 kok3 bou2 cing4 fong3 sau6 dou3 hung3 zai3, m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 sat1 hung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要确保情况受到控制，不要让它失控。
examples.english_sentence: We need to ensure the situation is under control, don't let it get out of hand.

english_meaning: damaged; impaired; harmed
explanation_mandarin: 受到损伤或损害。
explanation_english: To suffer damage or impairment. Can be used as a verb or adjective.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電話跌咗落地，個屏幕受損咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 waa2 dit3 zo2 lok6 dei6, go3 ping4 mok6 sau6 syun2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 手机掉在地上了，屏幕受损了。
examples.english_sentence: The phone fell on the ground and the screen got damaged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢架車喺交通意外度受損好嚴重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaa3 ce1 hai2 gaau1 tung1 ji3 ngoi6 dou6 sau6 syun2 hou2 gim2 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的车在交通事故中受损很严重。
examples.english_sentence: His car was severely damaged in the traffic accident.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 場大火令到好多建築物受損。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 daai6 fo2 ling6 dou3 hou2 do1 gin3 zuk1 mat6 sau6 syun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这场大火令许多建筑物受损。
examples.english_sentence: The big fire caused damage to many buildings.

english_meaning: to be enlightened; to have learned something; I stand corrected; I am enlightened; to receive instruction
explanation_mandarin: 表示接受教诲或指正，从中获益。有时也用于表示赞同对方的观点或对对方的能力表示钦佩。也可表示确实领教了对方的厉害。
explanation_english: Indicates acceptance of instruction or correction and benefit from it. It can also be used to express agreement with the other party's point of view or admiration for their ability. It can also mean that one has truly learned of the other party's power or skill.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽完你咁樣分析，真係受教喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jyun4 nei5 gam3 joeng2 fan1 sik1, zan1 hai6 sau6 gaau3 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听完你这样分析，真是受益匪浅！
examples.english_sentence: After listening to your analysis, I've really learned a lot!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次真係受教，下次唔敢再犯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 sau6 gaau3, haa6 ci3 m4 gam2 zoi3 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次真是领教了，下次不敢再犯。
examples.english_sentence: I truly stand corrected this time. I won't make the same mistake again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 講得啱，受教受教。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong2 dak1 aam1, sau6 gaau3 sau6 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 说得对，学习了学习了。
examples.english_sentence: You're right, I am enlightened, I am enlightened.

english_meaning: popular, well-received, sought-after
explanation_mandarin: 表示人或事物很受大家的喜爱和欢迎。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something that is liked and well-received by many people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺學校好受歡迎㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 hok6 haau6 hou2 sau6 fun1 jing4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在学校很受欢迎的。
examples.english_sentence: He is very popular in school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅點心好受歡迎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 dim2 sam1 hou2 sau6 fun1 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的点心很受欢迎。
examples.english_sentence: The dim sum in this restaurant is very popular.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲好受歡迎，好多人排隊買飛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 hou2 sau6 fun1 jing4, hou2 do1 jan4 paai4 deoi2 maai5 fei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影很受欢迎，很多人排队买票。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is very popular; many people are lining up to buy tickets.

synonyms: 受人喜爱 (sau6 jan4 hei2 oi3)

english_meaning: to be bullied, to be pushed around, to be subjected to ill-treatment, to be in the receiving end of anger/bad temper
explanation_mandarin: 承受别人的怒气，受到不公平的待遇。
explanation_english: To endure someone else's anger or bad temper; to be subjected to unfair treatment or bullying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺公司日日受氣，真係好辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gung1 si1 jat6 jat6 sau6 hei3, zan1 hai6 hou2 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在公司每天受气，真的很辛苦。
examples.english_sentence: I get bullied at work every day, it's really tough.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁受氣啦，有咩同我講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 sau6 hei3 laa1, jau5 me1 tung4 ngo5 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么受委屈了，有什么跟我说。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so bullied, tell me what's going on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日俾佢老婆受氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 bei2 keoi5 lou5 po2 sau6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是被他老婆欺负/受他老婆的气。
examples.english_sentence: He's always being bullied by his wife.

english_meaning: to be baptized
explanation_mandarin: 指接受基督教或天主教的洗礼仪式，成为教徒。
explanation_english: To receive the sacrament of baptism, a ritual act signifying acceptance into the Christian faith.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺教堂受洗，正式成為咗基督徒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gaau3 tong4 sau6 sai2, zing3 sik1 sing4 wai4 zo2 gei1 duk1 tou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在教堂受洗，正式成为了基督徒。
examples.english_sentence: He was baptized in the church and officially became a Christian.

english_meaning: to be baptized
explanation_mandarin: 接受基督教的洗礼。
explanation_english: To undergo baptism, a Christian sacrament symbolizing purification or regeneration and admission into the Christian Church.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋全家都喺教堂受浸㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 cyun4 gaa1 dou1 hai2 gaau3 tong4 sau6 zam3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们全家都在教堂受洗了。
examples.english_sentence: Their whole family was baptized in church.

english_meaning: to be accepted, to be understood and listened to
explanation_mandarin: 指意见或建议被他人接受和采纳，或者指个人被他人理解和接纳。
explanation_english: Refers to an idea or suggestion being accepted and adopted by others, or a person being understood and accepted by others. It implies having influence or being listened to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅建議喺會議上面好受溝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gin3 ji5 hai2 wui6 ji5 soeng6 min6 hou2 sau6 kau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的建议在会议上很受重视（被采纳）。
examples.english_sentence: His suggestion was well received (and accepted) at the meeting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好想喺公司入面受溝，所以好努力表現自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 soeng2 hai2 gung1 si1 jap6 min6 sau6 kau1, so2 ji5 hou2 nou5 lik6 biu2 hin6 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很想在公司里被认可，所以很努力地表现自己。
examples.english_sentence: He really wants to be accepted in the company, so he tries very hard to show himself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你想你嘅意見受溝，就要講得有理有據。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 soeng2 nei5 ge3 ji3 gin3 sau6 kau1, zau6 jiu3 gong2 dak1 jau5 lei5 jau5 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你想你的意见被采纳，就要说得有理有据。
examples.english_sentence: If you want your opinions to be accepted, you need to speak logically and with evidence.

english_meaning: to become damp; to be affected by moisture; to get mildewed
explanation_mandarin: 指物品因吸收空气中的水分而变得潮湿。
explanation_english: Refers to an object becoming damp due to absorbing moisture from the air.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲餅乾受潮，唔好食喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 beng2 gon1 sau6 ciu4, m4 hou2 sik6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 饼干受潮了，不好吃了。
examples.english_sentence: The biscuits have become damp and are not good to eat anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件衫擺咗好耐，有啲受潮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 saam1 baai2 zo2 hou2 noi6, jau5 di1 sau6 ciu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服放了很久，有点受潮。
examples.english_sentence: This piece of clothing has been left for a long time and is a bit damp.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部相機受潮壞咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 soeng3 gei1 sau6 ciu4 waai6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 相机受潮坏了。
examples.english_sentence: The camera broke down because it got damp.

mandarin_meaning: 遭受灾害; 遭受灾难
english_meaning: to suffer from a disaster; to be hit by a calamity; to be affected by a natural disaster
explanation_mandarin: 指遭受灾害，如自然灾害（地震、洪水、台风等）或人为灾害，导致损失或破坏。
explanation_english: To suffer from a disaster, such as a natural disaster (earthquake, flood, typhoon, etc.) or a man-made disaster, resulting in loss or damage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上次個風好勁，好多地方都受災。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng6 ci3 go3 fung1 hou2 ging6, hou2 do1 dei6 fong1 dou1 sau6 zoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上次那个台风很厉害，很多地方都受灾了。
examples.english_sentence: The last typhoon was very strong, and many places were affected by the disaster.
