examples.cantonese_sentence: 地震之後，災民生活好艱苦，需要各界嘅支援。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dei6 zan3 zi1 hau6, zoi1 man4 sang1 wut6 hou2 gaan1 fu2, seoi1 jiu3 gok3 gaai3 ge3 zi1 wun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 地震之后，灾民生活很艰苦，需要各界的支援。
examples.english_sentence: After the earthquake, the lives of the disaster victims are very difficult and require support from all sectors.

english_meaning: to be heated; to be subjected to heat; to heat up
explanation_mandarin: 指物体或人感受到热力，或者指被加热的过程。
explanation_english: Refers to the state of an object or person experiencing heat, or the process of being heated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個餸受熱唔均勻，有啲位仲係凍嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sung3 sau6 jit6 m4 gwan1 wan4, jau5 di1 wai2 zung6 hai6 dung3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这道菜受热不均匀，有些地方还是冷的。
examples.english_sentence: This dish is not heated evenly, some parts are still cold.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 太陽曬到佢受熱到差啲中暑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taai3 joeng4 saai3 dou3 keoi5 sau6 jit6 dou3 caa1 di1 zung3 syu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 太阳晒得他受热差点中暑。
examples.english_sentence: The sun heated him up so much that he almost got heatstroke.

english_meaning: to accept (an application, case, etc.); to take (something) into consideration; to handle
explanation_mandarin: 接受并处理（案件、申请等）。
explanation_english: To accept and handle (a case, application, etc.). It implies officially accepting something for processing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋收到你嘅申請，會盡快受理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sau1 dou2 nei5 ge3 san1 ching2, wui5 zeon6 faai3 sau6 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们收到了您的申请，会尽快受理。
examples.english_sentence: We have received your application and will process it as soon as possible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個部門專門受理市民嘅投訴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 bou6 mun4 zyun1 mun4 sau6 lei5 si5 man4 ge3 tau4 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个部门专门受理市民的投诉。
examples.english_sentence: This department specializes in handling complaints from citizens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方已經受理咗呢單案件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 ji5 ging1 sau6 lei5 zo2 ni1 daan1 on3 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方已经受理了这起案件。
examples.english_sentence: The police have already accepted this case.

mandarin_meaning: 享受; 感到舒服; 得益
english_meaning: to enjoy; to benefit; to feel comfortable; to find something useful or agreeable
explanation_mandarin: 表示接受并享用，或者感到舒服、得益。既可以指物质上的享受，也可以指精神上的受益。
explanation_english: Indicates receiving and enjoying something, or feeling comfortable and benefiting from it. It can refer to material enjoyment or spiritual benefit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張床好舒服，瞓得好受用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 chong4 hou2 syu1 fuk6, fan3 dak1 hou2 sau6 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张床很舒服，睡得很享受。
examples.english_sentence: This bed is very comfortable, I enjoyed sleeping in it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅建議對我好受用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gin3 ji5 deoi3 ngo5 hou2 sau6 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的建议对我有很大帮助。
examples.english_sentence: His advice was very helpful to me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽完佢講嘅嘢，我獲益良多，真係好受用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 yun4 keoi5 gong2 ge3 ye5, ngo5 wok6 yik1 loeng4 do1, zan1 hai6 hou2 sau6 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听完他讲的话，我获益良多，真是受益匪浅。
examples.english_sentence: After listening to what he said, I benefited a lot. It was really helpful.

english_meaning: to benefit; to profit
explanation_mandarin: 得到好处; 获得利益
explanation_english: To receive benefits; to profit from something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢參加咗個培訓課程，受益良多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 caam1 gaa1 zo2 go3 pui4 fan3 fo3 cing4, sau1 jik1 loeng4 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他参加了一个培训课程，受益很多。
examples.english_sentence: He participated in a training course and benefited a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個政策會令到好多市民受益。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zing3 caak3 wui5 ling6 dou3 hou2 do1 si5 man4 sau1 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个政策会让很多市民受益。
examples.english_sentence: This policy will benefit many citizens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 從你嘅經驗分享度，我受益匪淺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cung4 nei5 ge3 ging1 jim6 fan1 hoeng2 dou6, ngo5 sau1 jik1 fei2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 从你的经验分享中，我受益匪浅。
examples.english_sentence: I have benefited greatly from your experience sharing.

english_meaning: beneficiary
explanation_mandarin: 指因他人行为或事件而得到好处的人。通常指保险、信托等法律文件中指定的人。
explanation_english: A person who derives advantage from something, especially a trust, will,, or life insurance policy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係呢份保單嘅唯一受益人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ni1 fan6 bou2 daan1 ge3 wai4 jat1 sau1 jik1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是这份保单的唯一受益人。
examples.english_sentence: He is the sole beneficiary of this insurance policy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗我嘅仔會係我嘅退休金嘅受益人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 ngo5 ge3 zai2 wui5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 teoi3 jau1 gam1 ge3 sau1 jik1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想我的儿子会是我的退休金的受益人。
examples.english_sentence: I think my son will be the beneficiary of my retirement fund.

english_meaning: audience
explanation_mandarin: 接受信息的一群人，例如广播节目的听众或观众，文章的读者等。
explanation_english: The group of people that receives information, such as the audience of a broadcast program or the readers of an article.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個節目嘅受眾主要係年輕人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zit3 muk6 ge3 sau6 zung3 zyu2 jiu3 hai6 nin4 hing1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个节目的受众主要是年轻人。
examples.english_sentence: The audience of this program is mainly young people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要了解受眾嘅需求，先至可以製作出受歡迎嘅內容。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 liu2 gaai2 sau6 zung3 ge3 seoi1 kau4, sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 zai3 zok3 ceot1 sau6 fun1 ying4 ge3 noi6 yung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要了解受众的需求，才能制作出受欢迎的内容。
examples.english_sentence: We need to understand the needs of the audience to create popular content.

english_meaning: fertilization, fecundation
explanation_mandarin: 指生物的精子与卵子结合形成受精卵的过程。
explanation_english: The process of sperm and egg fusing to form a zygote.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢好難自然受精，可能要做試管嬰兒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yi1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 hou2 naan4 zi6 jin4 sau6 zing1, ho2 nang4 jiu3 zou6 si3 gun2 ying1 yi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说她很难自然受精，可能要做试管婴儿。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said she has difficulty conceiving naturally and may need to do IVF.

english_meaning: fertilized egg; zygote
explanation_mandarin: 指精子和卵子结合后形成的细胞，是生物个体发育的起点。
explanation_english: The cell formed by the union of a sperm and an egg, representing the initial stage of development of an individual organism; a zygote.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話胚胎即係受精卵嘅早期階段。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 pui1 toi1 jik1 hai6 sau6 zing1 loeng2 ge3 zou2 kei4 gaai1 dyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说胚胎就是受精卵的早期阶段。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said that the embryo is the early stage of a fertilized egg.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 受精卵會分裂成好多細胞，然後發育成一個完整嘅生物體。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau6 zing1 loeng2 wui5 fan1 lit6 sing4 hou2 do1 sai3 baau1, jin4 hau6 faat3 juk6 sing4 jat1 go3 wan4 zing2 ge3 sang1 mat6 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 受精卵会分裂成许多细胞，然后发育成一个完整的生物体。
examples.english_sentence: The fertilized egg divides into many cells and then develops into a complete organism.

english_meaning: to accept; to adopt; to take in
explanation_mandarin: 接受，采纳，容纳的意思。
explanation_english: To accept, adopt, or take in something. It implies actively receiving something and agreeing to it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋受納咗佢嘅建議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sau6 naap6 zo2 keoi5 ge3 gin3 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们采纳了他的建议。
examples.english_sentence: We accepted his suggestion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間機構唔受納任何政治捐款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gei1 kau3 m4 sau6 naap6 jam6 ho4 zing3 zi6 gyun1 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个机构不接受任何政治捐款。
examples.english_sentence: This organization does not accept any political donations.

mandarin_meaning: 连累; 拖累; 麻烦
english_meaning: to be burdened; to be inconvenienced; to cause trouble (for someone)
explanation_mandarin: 指因某人的行为或情况而给他人带来不便或负担。
explanation_english: Indicates causing inconvenience or burden to someone due to someone's actions or situation. Often used as a polite expression to acknowledge the trouble caused to others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，咁夜仲要受累你送我返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 ho2 ji3 si1, gam3 je2 zung1 jiu3 sau6 leoi6 nei5 sung3 ngo5 faan1 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，这么晚还要麻烦你送我回家。
examples.english_sentence: I'm sorry for troubling you to take me home so late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次真係受累你幫我咁多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 sau6 leoi6 nei5 bong1 ngo5 gam3 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次真是麻烦你帮我这么多。
examples.english_sentence: I'm really sorry for troubling you to help me so much this time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想受累其他人，自己搞掂佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 sau6 leoi6 kei4 taat3 jan4, zi6 gei2 gaau2 dim6 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想连累其他人，自己搞定它吧。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to burden others, I'll take care of it myself.

english_meaning: to suffer; to endure hardship; to have a rough time
explanation_mandarin: 指遭受痛苦、折磨或困境。
explanation_english: Refers to experiencing pain, suffering, torment, or hardship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先睇牙醫真係受罪呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 tai2 ngaa4 yi1 zan1 hai6 sau6 zeoi6 aa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才看牙医真是受罪啊！
examples.english_sentence: Seeing the dentist just now was really suffering!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁熱嘅天氣喺街度做嘢真係好受罪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam3 jit6 ge3 tin1 hei3 hai2 gaai1 dou6 zou6 je5 zan1 hai6 hou2 sau6 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这么热的天气在街上工作真是很受罪。
examples.english_sentence: Working on the street in such hot weather is really suffering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成日返夜班真係好受罪，搞到個人都顛顛地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seng4 jat6 faan1 je6 baan1 zan1 hai6 hou2 sau6 zeoi6, gaau2 dou3 go3 jan4 dou1 din1 din1 dei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 总是上夜班真是很受罪，搞得人都颠颠的。
examples.english_sentence: Always working the night shift is really tough, it's making me feel all loopy.

english_meaning: to be punished, to receive punishment
explanation_mandarin: 接受惩罚。因为做错事或违反规定而受到相应的惩处。
explanation_english: To receive punishment; to be penalized for doing something wrong or violating rules.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為遲到成日受罰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 ci4 dou3 seng4 jat6 sau6 fat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为迟到总是受到惩罚。
examples.english_sentence: He is always being punished because he is often late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你唔交功課，就會受罰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 m4 gaau1 gung1 fo3, zau6 wui5 sau6 fat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不交作业，就会受到惩罚。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't hand in your homework, you will be punished.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友唔聽話，有時會受罰企喺度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 m4 teng1 waa6, jau5 si4 wui5 sau6 fat6 kei5 hai2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子不听话，有时候会被惩罚站着。
examples.english_sentence: If children are disobedient, they will sometimes be punished by being made to stand.

english_meaning: to be employed; to be hired; to be recruited
explanation_mandarin: 接受聘请，被聘用。
explanation_english: To be hired or employed by someone. To accept a job offer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近受聘喺一間大公司做經理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 sau6 ping3 hai2 jat1 gaan1 daai6 gung1 si1 zou6 ging1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近被一家大公司聘用当经理。
examples.english_sentence: He was recently hired as a manager at a large company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好高興可以受聘加入呢個團隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 gou1 hing3 ho2 ji5 sau6 ping3 gaa1 jap6 ni1 go3 teoi1 deoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很高兴能被聘用加入这个团队。
examples.english_sentence: I'm very happy to be hired to join this team.

english_meaning: to suffer hardship; to undergo suffering
explanation_mandarin: 经历痛苦和艰难。
explanation_english: To experience pain, hardship, or adversity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嗰陣時受咗好多苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 si4 sau6 zo2 hou2 do1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候受了很多苦。
examples.english_sentence: He suffered a lot when he was young.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想再受苦啦，我想開心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 zoi3 sau6 fu2 laa1, ngo5 soeng2 hoi1 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想再受苦了，我想开心点。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to suffer anymore, I want to be happier.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗成功，中間可能會受好多苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 sing4 gung1, zung1 gaan1 ho2 nang4 wui5 sau6 hou2 do1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了成功，中间可能会受很多苦。
examples.english_sentence: In order to succeed, you may have to suffer a lot in the process.

english_meaning: To receive the tea ceremony; to be formally introduced to the family and blessed by the elders (typically during a wedding)
explanation_mandarin: 传统婚礼仪式中，新娘向男方长辈敬茶，接受祝福和红包。表示正式成为家庭的一员。
explanation_english: In traditional wedding ceremonies, the bride serves tea to the groom's elders, receiving blessings and red envelopes. This signifies her formal acceptance into the family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋聽日就擺酒，晏晝會喺屋企受茶禮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ting1 jat6 zau6 baai2 zau2, aan3 zau3 wui5 hai2 uk1 kei2 sau6 caa4 lai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们明天就要摆婚宴了，下午会在家里进行敬茶仪式。
examples.english_sentence: They are having their wedding banquet tomorrow. In the afternoon, they will have the tea ceremony at home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 結婚嗰日，新人要受茶禮，接受長輩嘅祝福。
examples.jyutping_sentence: git3 fan1 go2 jat6, san1 jan4 jiu3 sau6 caa4 lai5, zip3 sau6 zoeng2 bui3 ge3 zuk1 fuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 结婚那天，新人要接受敬茶仪式，接受长辈的祝福。
examples.english_sentence: On the wedding day, the bride and groom have to undergo the tea ceremony and receive blessings from the elders.

english_meaning: to be well-received; to be accepted; to take to something; to buy it
explanation_mandarin: 指某事物或某人受到欢迎，被人接受或认可。也指某人对某事物买账，愿意接受。
explanation_english: Refers to something or someone being popular and accepted or recognized. It can also mean someone 'buys it' (accepts something), and is willing to accept it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲橋喺公司好受落㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei1 kiu2 hai2 gung1 si1 hou2 sau6 lok6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的主意在公司很受欢迎。
examples.english_sentence: His ideas are very well-received in the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢種風格而家啲後生仔好受落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zung2 fung1 gaak3 ji4 gaa1 di1 hau6 saang1 zai2 hou2 sau6 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种风格现在年轻人很喜欢。
examples.english_sentence: This style is very popular with young people nowadays.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢講道理，點知佢唔受落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 gong2 dou6 lei5, dim2 zi1 keoi5 m4 sau6 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他讲道理，结果他不接受。
examples.english_sentence: I tried to reason with him, but he wouldn't listen.

english_meaning: salaried; to receive a salary; employed
explanation_mandarin: 指领取薪水，通常指有固定工资的职位或状态。
explanation_english: Refers to receiving a salary, usually indicating a position or status with a fixed wage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個受薪嘅員工，每個月都有固定嘅收入。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 sau6 san1 ge3 jyun4 gung1, mui5 go3 jyut6 dou1 jau5 gu2 ding6 ge3 sau1 jap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一个受薪的员工，每个月都有固定的收入。
examples.english_sentence: He is a salaried employee and has a fixed income every month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司請緊一位受薪嘅會計師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ceng2 gan2 jat1 wai2 sau6 san1 ge3 wui6 gai3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司正在招聘一位受薪的会计师。
examples.english_sentence: Our company is hiring a salaried accountant.

english_meaning: masochist
explanation_mandarin: 指从受虐待中得到快感的人。在心理学上，指具有受虐癖的人。
explanation_english: A person who derives pleasure, especially sexual gratification, from their own pain or humiliation. Psychologically, referring to someone with masochism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁鍾意畀人鬧，係咪受虐狂嚟㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 zung1 ji3 bei2 jan4 naau6, hai6 mai6 sau6 ngok6 kwong4 lai4 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么喜欢被人骂，是受虐狂吗？
examples.english_sentence: You enjoy being scolded so much, are you a masochist?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人喺愛情關係入面，會唔自觉噉扮演受虐狂嘅角色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 hai2 oi3 cing4 gwaan1 hai6 jap6 min6, wui5 m4 zi3 gok3 gam2 baan1 jin2 sau6 ngok6 kwong4 ge3 gok3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人在恋爱关系中，会不自觉地扮演受虐狂的角色。
examples.english_sentence: Some people unconsciously play the role of a masochist in romantic relationships.

english_meaning: audience, readership, viewership
explanation_mandarin: 指信息传播的对象，例如听众、读者、观众等。
explanation_english: Refers to the target group of information dissemination, such as listeners, readers, and viewers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個節目嘅受衆主要係年輕人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zit3 muk6 ge3 sau6 zung3 zyu2 jiu3 hai6 nin4 ging1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个节目的受众主要是年轻人。
examples.english_sentence: The audience for this program is mainly young people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要了解我哋嘅受衆先可以制定有效嘅宣傳策略。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 liu2 gaai2 ngo5 dei6 ge3 sau6 zung3 sin1 ho2 ji5 zai3 ding6 jau5 haau6 ge3 syun1 cyun4 caak3 loek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要了解我们的受众才可以制定有效的宣传策略。
examples.english_sentence: We need to understand our audience in order to develop effective promotional strategies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 網絡資訊嘅普及令到受衆嘅選擇多咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mong5 lok6 zi1 seon3 ge3 pou2 kap1 ling6 dou3 sau6 zung3 ge3 syun2 zaak6 do1 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 网络资讯的普及使得受众的选择多了很多。
examples.english_sentence: The widespread availability of online information has greatly increased the choices available to the audience.

english_meaning: audience, target audience
explanation_mandarin: 指信息传播所针对的人群，接受信息的一群人。
explanation_english: The group of people that a message is intended for; the audience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個節目嘅受衆主要係年輕人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zit3 muk6 ge3 sau6 zung3 zyu2 jiu3 hai6 nin4 hing1 yan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个节目的受众主要是年轻人。
examples.english_sentence: The target audience of this program is mainly young people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要了解清楚受衆嘅喜好先可以設計出啱佢哋嘅產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 liu2 gaai2 cing1 chu2 sau6 zung3 ge3 hei2 hou3 sin1 ho2 ji5 sat3 gai3 chut1 ngaam1 keoi5 dei6 ge3 caan2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要了解清楚受众的喜好才能设计出适合他们的产品。
examples.english_sentence: We need to clearly understand the audience's preferences before we can design products that suit them.

synonyms: 目標群體 (muk6 biu1 kwan4 tai2)

english_meaning: to receive training, to undergo training
explanation_mandarin: 接受训练，接受培训。
explanation_english: To receive formal instruction or practical experience in a particular skill or field.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋啱啱畢業就要去警校受訓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 aam1 aam1 bat1 jip6 zau6 jiu3 heoi3 ging2 haau6 sau6 fan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们刚毕业就要去警校受训。
examples.english_sentence: They have just graduated and are going to the police academy for training.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我公司會安排我哋去香港受訓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gung1 si1 wui5 on1 paai4 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 hoeng1 gong2 sau6 fan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司会安排我们去香港受训。
examples.english_sentence: Our company will arrange for us to go to Hong Kong for training.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我受訓嗰陣時學到好多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sau6 fan3 go2 zan6 si4 hok6 dou2 ho2 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我受训的时候学到很多东西。
examples.english_sentence: I learned a lot of things during my training.

english_meaning: to be entrusted; to be commissioned; to be asked to do something on behalf of someone else
explanation_mandarin: 接受别人的委托，代表别人处理事务。
explanation_english: To be entrusted or commissioned by someone to handle matters on their behalf.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我受託幫佢睇住間屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sau6 tok3 bong1 keoi5 tai2 zyu6 gaan1 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我受托帮他看房子。
examples.english_sentence: I'm entrusted to look after his house for him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢受託處理公司嘅財務問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sau6 tok3 cyu5 lei5 gung1 si1 ge3 coi4 mou6 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他受托处理公司的财务问题。
examples.english_sentence: He is commissioned to handle the company's financial problems.

english_meaning: to be interviewed
explanation_mandarin: 接受采访，成为被访者。
explanation_english: To be interviewed, to be the interviewee.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢尋日受訪嗰陣講咗好多內幕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cam4 jat6 sau6 fong2 go2 zan6 gong2 zo2 hou2 do1 noi6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天接受采访的时候讲了很多内幕。
examples.english_sentence: He revealed a lot of inside information during the interview yesterday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多藝人都唔鍾意俾記者受訪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 ngai6 jan4 dou1 m4 zung1 ji3 bei2 gei3 ze2 sau6 fong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多艺人都不喜欢被记者采访。
examples.english_sentence: Many artists don't like being interviewed by reporters.

english_meaning: to accept bribes; to take bribes
explanation_mandarin: 指接受贿赂，利用职权谋取不正当利益。
explanation_english: To accept a bribe, to take a bribe, usually referring to someone abusing their power to gain unfair advantages by receiving illicit payments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為受賄俾人拉咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 sau6 wai2 bei2 jan4 laai1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为受贿被人抓走了。
examples.english_sentence: He was arrested for accepting bribes.

english_meaning: Only responds to gentle persuasion, not to force or threats.
explanation_mandarin: 指某人只接受柔和的劝说或方法，不接受强硬的手段或威胁。
explanation_english: Describes someone who responds well to gentle persuasion or soft approaches but rebels against force, threats, or harsh methods. They are receptive to kindness and logic, but resistant to demands and pressure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢呢個人受軟唔受硬㗎，你同佢傾嘅時候要溫柔啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ni1 go3 jan4 sau6 jyun5 m4 sau6 ngaang6 gaa3, nei5 tung4 keoi5 king1 ge3 si4 hau6 jiu3 wan1 jau4 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个人吃软不吃硬，你和他谈的时候要温柔一些。
examples.english_sentence: This person only responds to gentle persuasion, so you need to be gentler when talking to him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 對住啲小朋友唔可以太硬，要受軟唔受硬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: deoi3 zyu6 di1 siu2 pang4 jau5 m4 ho2 ji5 taai3 ngaang6, jiu3 sau6 jyun5 m4 sau6 ngaang6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 对待小孩子不可以太强硬，要吃软不吃硬。
examples.english_sentence: You can't be too strict with children, you need to take a gentle approach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆受軟唔受硬，你直接同佢講道理可能會有用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 sau6 jyun5 m4 sau6 ngaang6, nei5 zik6 zip3 tung4 keoi5 gong2 dou6 lei5 ho2 nang4 wui5 jau5 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板吃软不吃硬，你直接和他讲道理可能会有用。
examples.english_sentence: The boss only responds to gentle persuasion; reasoning with him directly might work.

synonyms: 吃軟唔吃硬 (hek3 jyun5 m4 hek3 ngaang6)
食軟唔食硬 (sik6 jyun5 m4 sik6 ngaang6)

english_meaning: to be humiliated, to be insulted, to suffer indignity
explanation_mandarin: 受到侮辱，蒙受耻辱。
explanation_english: To experience humiliation or insult; to be treated with indignity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公開場合俾人鬧，真係好受辱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 hoi1 coeng4 bei2 jan4 naau6, zan1 hai6 hou2 sau6 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公开场合被人骂，真的很受侮辱。
examples.english_sentence: He was scolded in public, it was truly humiliating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔可以俾自己受辱，我要反抗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 ho2 ji5 bei2 zi6 gei2 sau6 juk6, ngo5 jiu3 faan2 kong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不能让自己受侮辱，我要反抗。
examples.english_sentence: I cannot allow myself to be humiliated, I must resist.

english_meaning: obstructed, hindered, impeded, blocked
explanation_mandarin: 受到阻碍，前进困难。
explanation_english: To be obstructed, hindered, impeded, or blocked, making progress difficult.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為落大雨，交通受阻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yan1 wai6 lok6 daai6 yu5, gaau1 tung1 sau6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为下大雨，交通受阻。
examples.english_sentence: Because of the heavy rain, the traffic is obstructed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅計劃因為資金不足而受阻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gai3 waak6 yan1 wai6 zi1 gam1 bat1 zuk1 ji4 sau6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的计划因为资金不足而受阻。
examples.english_sentence: His plan was hindered due to insufficient funding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 工程進度受到好多因素影響而受阻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 ching4 zeon3 dou6 sau6 dou3 hou2 do1 yin1 sou3 ying2 hoeng2 ji4 sau6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工程进度受到很多因素影响而受阻。
examples.english_sentence: The progress of the project has been obstructed due to the influence of many factors.

english_meaning: to be employed; to be hired
explanation_mandarin: 接受雇佣，被雇请。
explanation_english: To be employed by someone; to be hired for a job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司請咗好多人，個個都係受雇員工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 ceng2 zo2 hou2 do1 jan4, go3 go3 dou1 hai6 sau6 gu3 jyun4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司聘请了很多人，个个都是受雇员工。
examples.english_sentence: Their company hired a lot of people, everyone is an employed staff.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢受雇於一間跨國公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sau6 gu3 jyu1 jat1 gaan1 kwaa3 gwok3 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他受雇于一家跨国公司。
examples.english_sentence: He is employed by a multinational corporation.

english_meaning: to suffer hardship; to undergo suffering; ordeal; passion (religious)
explanation_mandarin: 经历痛苦和困难；也指耶稣基督受难。
explanation_english: To experience pain and hardship; also refers to the Passion of Christ.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋經歷咗好多受難，先至可以成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ging1 lik6 zo2 hou2 do1 sau6 naan6, sin1 zai3 ho2 ji5 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们经历了很多苦难，才能够成功。
examples.english_sentence: They went through a lot of hardship before they could succeed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 耶穌嘅受難係基督教信仰嘅重要部份。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je4 sou1 ge3 sau6 naan6 hai6 gei1 duk1 gaau3 seon3 joeng5 ge3 zung6 jiu3 bou6 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 耶稣的受难是基督教信仰的重要部分。
examples.english_sentence: The Passion of Jesus is an important part of the Christian faith.

english_meaning: To be the target of criticism; to be made a scapegoat; to take the flak
explanation_mandarin: 比喻成为众人批评或攻击的目标，承担责任或罪责。
explanation_english: To be the target of criticism or attack, often unfairly. It can also refer to taking responsibility or blame for something, whether deserved or not. Often implies being unfairly singled out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次單嘢咁大鑊，佢梗係要受靶㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 daan1 je5 gam3 daai6 wok6, keoi5 gang2 hai6 jiu3 sau6 baa2 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的事情这么严重，他肯定要成为替罪羊了。
examples.english_sentence: This incident is so serious, he's definitely going to be the scapegoat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿頭做錯嘢，但係最尾都係我哋啲細嘅受靶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 tau4 zou6 co3 je5, daan6 hai6 zeoi3 mei5 dou1 hai6 ngo5 dei6 di1 sai3 ge3 sau6 baa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 领导做错了事，但最后还是我们这些下属承担责任。
examples.english_sentence: The boss made a mistake, but in the end, us subordinates are the ones taking the flak.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂講嘢，小心俾人攞嚟受靶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 gong2 je5, siu2 sam1 bei2 jan4 lo2 lai4 sau6 baa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱说话，小心被人拿来当替罪羊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk nonsense, be careful or you'll be used as a scapegoat.

english_meaning: to be deceived; to be cheated; to be fooled
explanation_mandarin: 指受到欺骗，被蒙蔽。
explanation_english: To be deceived or cheated, to be tricked into believing something that is not true.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾個騙徒受騙咗，損失咗好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 go3 pin3 tou4 sau6 pin3 zo2, sun2 sat1 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被骗子骗了，损失了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: He was deceived by a con artist and lost a lot of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁容易受騙呀，呢啲網上嘅嘢好多都係假嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 jung4 ji6 sau6 pin3 aa3, ni1 di1 mong5 soeng5 ge3 je5 hou2 do1 dou1 hai6 gaa2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么容易受骗啊，这些网上的东西很多都是假的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so easily deceived, a lot of things online are fake.

english_meaning: to be frightened; to be startled; to be alarmed
explanation_mandarin: 受到惊吓，感到害怕。
explanation_english: To be frightened, startled, or alarmed by something. It implies a sudden and often unexpected feeling of fear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先嗰架車差啲撞到你，有冇受驚啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 go2 ga1 ce1 caa1 di1 zong6 dou3 nei5, jau5 mou5 sau6 ging1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才那辆车差点撞到你，有没有吓到啊？
examples.english_sentence: That car almost hit you just now, were you frightened?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇完恐怖片之後，佢受咗好多驚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 jyun4 hung2 bou3 pin2 zi1 hau6, keoi5 sau6 zo2 hou2 do1 ging1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看完恐怖片之后，他受到了很多惊吓。
examples.english_sentence: After watching the horror movie, he was very frightened.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻貓突然跳出嚟，嚇到我受驚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 maau1 dat6 jin4 tiu3 chut1 lei4, haak3 dou3 ngo5 sau6 ging1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 猫突然跳出来，吓到我了。
examples.english_sentence: The cat suddenly jumped out and startled me.

english_meaning: to relate; to narrate; to chat; to reminisce
explanation_mandarin: 叙述，描述； 叙旧，谈论往事。
explanation_english: To narrate or describe; to reminisce or chat about past events.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等陣同你慢慢叙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 zan6 tung4 nei5 maan6 maan6 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 等一会儿慢慢地跟你聊。
examples.english_sentence: I'll chat with you slowly later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不如我哋一齊叙下舊啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 zeoi6 haa5 gau6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不如我们一起叙叙旧吧。
examples.english_sentence: Why don't we reminisce together?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將件事嘅來龍去脉都详细噉叙述出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 gin6 si6 ge3 loi4 lung4 heoi3 mak6 dou1 soeng4 sai3 gam2 zeoi6 seot6 ceot1 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他将事情的来龙去脉都详细地叙述出来。
examples.english_sentence: He narrated the entire story with all the details.

english_meaning: to rebel; to betray; to revolt; rebellious; traitorous
explanation_mandarin: 指背离原来的阵营、组织、国家或信仰；也指违背常理或伦理规范。
explanation_english: To betray or rebel against one's original allegiance, organization, country, or belief; to violate common sense or ethical norms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋班友仔叛咗變節，走咗去幫對家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 baan1 jau5 zai2 bun6 zo2 bin3 zit3, zau2 zo2 heoi3 bong1 deoi3 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们那帮人叛变了，跑去帮对手了。
examples.english_sentence: That group of theirs betrayed us and went to help the opposition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔唔好咁叛逆，聽下阿爸阿媽講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 m4 hou2 gam3 bun6 jik6, ting1 haa5 aa3 baa4 aa3 maa1 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子不要这么叛逆，听听爸爸妈妈的话。
examples.english_sentence: Children shouldn't be so rebellious, listen to your parents.

english_meaning: rebellion; revolt; insurgency
explanation_mandarin: 指武装暴动，反抗政府或权威。
explanation_english: An act of open resistance to an established government or ruler, often involving violence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 果次叛亂好快就俾政府平息咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwo2 ci3 bun6 lyun6 hou2 faai3 zau6 bei2 zing3 fu2 ping4 sik1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那次叛乱很快就被政府平息了。
examples.english_sentence: That rebellion was quickly suppressed by the government.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋發動叛亂，想推翻現有政權。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 faat3 dung6 bun6 lyun6, soeng2 teoi1 faan1 hin6 jau5 zing3 kyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们发动叛乱，想推翻现有政权。
examples.english_sentence: They launched a rebellion, wanting to overthrow the current regime.

english_meaning: treason, betray one's country
explanation_mandarin: 背叛自己的国家。
explanation_english: To betray one's own country; an act of betraying one's country.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人指控叛國，但係佢堅稱自己係清白嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 zi2 gung3 bun6 gwok3, daan6 hai6 keoi5 gin1 ching1 zi6 gei2 hai6 ching1 baak6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人指控叛国，但是他坚称自己是清白的。
examples.english_sentence: He was accused of treason, but he insists on his innocence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 叛國罪係非常嚴重嘅罪行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun6 gwok3 zeoi6 hai6 fei1 soeng4 jim4 zung6 ge3 zeoi6 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 叛国罪是非常严重的罪行。
examples.english_sentence: Treason is a very serious crime.

english_meaning: traitor; traitor to one's country
explanation_mandarin: 背叛国家的人。
explanation_english: A person who betrays their country.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人叫做叛國賊，但係佢話佢只係為咗人民嘅利益。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 giu3 zou6 bun6 gwok3 caak6, daan6 hai6 keoi5 waa6 keoi5 zi2 hai6 wai6 zo2 jan4 man4 ge3 lei6 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人叫做叛国者，但是他说他只是为了人民的利益。
examples.english_sentence: He was called a traitor, but he said he was only acting in the interests of the people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 歷史會證明佢係英雄定係叛國賊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lik6 si2 wui5 zing3 ming4 keoi5 hai6 jing1 hung4 ding6 hai6 bun6 gwok3 caak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 历史会证明他是英雄还是叛国者。
examples.english_sentence: History will prove whether he is a hero or a traitor.

english_meaning: traitor, betrayer, turncoat
explanation_mandarin: 背叛自己的团体、国家或信仰的人。
explanation_english: A person who betrays their group, country, or beliefs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人叫做叛徒，因為佢將公司嘅秘密賣俾競爭對手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 giu3 zou6 bun6 tou4, jan1 wai6 keoi5 zoeng1 gung1 si1 ge3 bei3 mat6 maai6 bei2 ging6 zang1 deoi3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人叫做叛徒，因为他将公司的秘密卖给了竞争对手。
examples.english_sentence: He was called a traitor because he sold the company's secrets to a competitor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做一個叛徒，要忠於自己嘅信念。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 jat1 go3 bun6 tou4, jiu3 zung1 jyu1 zi6 gei2 ge3 seon3 nim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要做一个叛徒，要忠于自己的信念。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a traitor, be loyal to your beliefs.

english_meaning: apostasy; defection from a religion; to abandon one's religion
explanation_mandarin: 指放弃或背叛自己原先信仰的宗教。
explanation_english: The act of abandoning or renouncing a religious belief or faith.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為娶咗個異教徒而畀人話叛敎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yan1 wai6 cheui2 zo2 go3 yi6 gaau3 tou4 yi4 bei2 yan4 wa6 bun6 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为娶了一个异教徒而被说成是叛教。
examples.english_sentence: He was accused of apostasy for marrying a non-believer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 叛敎嘅後果好嚴重，會畀其他教徒排斥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun6 gaau3 ge3 hau6 gwo2 hou2 yim4 zhung6, wui5 bei2 kei4 taa1 gaau3 tou4 paai4 chik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 叛教的后果很严重，会被其他教徒排斥。
examples.english_sentence: The consequences of apostasy are severe, and you will be ostracized by other believers.

english_meaning: apostasy, defection from a religion
explanation_mandarin: 指背叛自己原本信仰的宗教，脫離宗教組織。
explanation_english: The abandonment or renunciation of a religious belief.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為結咗婚之後改信咗老婆嘅宗教，所以俾人話佢叛教。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yan1 wai6 git3 zo2 fan1 zi1 hau6 gai2 seon3 zo2 lou5 po4 ge3 zung1 gaau3, so2 yi5 bei2 yan4 waa6 keoi5 bun6 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为他结婚后改信了妻子的宗教，所以被人说他叛教。
examples.english_sentence: Because he converted to his wife's religion after marriage, he was accused of apostasy.

english_meaning: Apostate, one who abandons their religion or faith
explanation_mandarin: 指背叛自己宗教信仰的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who abandons or renounces their religious faith or beliefs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為放棄咗佢嘅信仰，所以俾人叫做叛教者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 fong3 hei3 zo2 keoi5 ge3 seon3 joeng5, so2 ji5 bei2 jan4 giu3 zou6 bun6 gaau3 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为他放弃了他的信仰，所以被人叫做叛教者。
examples.english_sentence: Because he abandoned his faith, he is called an apostate.

english_meaning: rebellion, revolt, mutiny, defection, to betray
explanation_mandarin: 背叛原来的组织、团体、国家等。
explanation_english: To rebel, revolt, or mutiny; to betray one's allegiance to an organization, group, or country.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋發動咗一場叛變。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 faat3 dung6 zo2 jat1 coeng4 bun6 bin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们发动了一场叛变。
examples.english_sentence: They launched a rebellion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為叛變而被捕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 bun6 bin3 ji4 bei6 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为叛变而被捕。
examples.english_sentence: He was arrested for treason.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔可以容忍任何形式嘅叛變行為。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 ho2 ji5 jung4 jan2 jam6 ho4 hang4 sik1 ge3 bun6 bin3 hang4 wai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不能容忍任何形式的叛变行为。
examples.english_sentence: No form of rebellious behavior can be tolerated.

english_meaning: rebel army, insurgent army
explanation_mandarin: 指反叛政府或当权者的军队。
explanation_english: An army that rebels against the government or ruling power.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰班叛軍佔領咗成個城市。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 baan1 bun6 gwan1 zim3 ling5 zo2 sing4 go3 sing4 si5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那群叛军占领了整个城市。
examples.english_sentence: That rebel army occupied the entire city.

english_meaning: to defect, to desert and flee
explanation_mandarin: 指背叛自己的國家、組織或信仰而逃亡。
explanation_english: To abandon one's country, organization, or faith and flee; to defect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為唔滿意政府嘅政策而叛逃咗去外國。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 m4 mun5 ji3 zing3 fu2 ge3 zing3 caak3 ji4 bun6 tou4 zo2 heoi3 ngoi6 gwok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为不满意政府的政策而叛逃去了外国。
examples.english_sentence: He defected to a foreign country because he was dissatisfied with the government's policies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋懷疑佢想叛逃，所以一路監視住佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 waai4 ji4 keoi5 soeng2 bun6 tou4, so2 ji5 jat1 lou6 gaam1 si6 zyu6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们怀疑他想叛逃，所以一直在监视着他。
examples.english_sentence: They suspected he was planning to defect, so they kept him under surveillance.

english_meaning: rebellious; rebelliousness
explanation_mandarin: 指不服从管教、反抗传统或权威的行为或态度。
explanation_english: Refers to behavior or attitude of disobedience, resistance to tradition, or authority.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢後生嗰陣好叛逆，成日同屋企人嘈交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau6 saang1 go2 zan6 hou2 bun6 jik6, seng4 jat6 tung4 uk1 kei2 jan4 cou4 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他年轻的时候很叛逆，总是和家人吵架。
examples.english_sentence: He was very rebellious when he was young, always arguing with his family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁叛逆啦，聽下阿爸阿媽講嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 bun6 jik6 laa1, teng1 haa5 aa3 baa1 aa3 maa1 gong2嘢 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么叛逆了，听听爸爸妈妈说的话吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so rebellious, listen to what your parents say.

english_meaning: old man, elderly gentleman
explanation_mandarin: 指年老的男人。
explanation_english: Refers to an elderly man; an old gentleman.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個公園坐咗好多老叟喺度傾偈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 gung1 yun2 co5 zo2 hou2 do1 lou5 sau2 hai2 dou6 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公园里坐着很多老头在聊天。
examples.english_sentence: There are many old men sitting in the park chatting.

mandarin_meaning: 叠; 重叠; 量词（用于堆叠的东西）
english_meaning: to fold; to pile up; to stack; to repeat; to overlap; (measure word for things in a pile or stack)
explanation_mandarin: 动词：将东西重叠放置；量词：用于堆叠的东西。
explanation_english: Verb: To fold, pile up, or stack items on top of each other. Measure word: Used for things that are stacked or piled up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 將啲衫叠好佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 di1 saam1 dip6 hou2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把衣服叠好。
examples.english_sentence: Fold the clothes neatly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢叠文件好重啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dip6 man4 gin2 hou2 cung5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这叠文件很重啊！
examples.english_sentence: This stack of documents is very heavy!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋叠埋心水去做呢件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 dip6 maai4 sam1 seoi2 heoi3 zou6 ni1 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们同心协力去做这件事。
examples.english_sentence: Let's put our minds together and do this.

english_meaning: Drug buddy, fellow drug user
explanation_mandarin: 指一起吸毒的朋友。这是一个贬义词，通常用于描述吸毒群体。
explanation_english: Refers to a friend with whom one uses drugs together. This is a derogatory term, usually used to describe a group of drug users.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好同啲叠友鬼混，對你冇好處嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tung4 di1 dip6 jau5 gwai2 wan6, deoi3 nei5 mou5 hou2 cyu3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要和那些毒友混在一起，对你没有好处的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't hang out with those drug buddies, it won't do you any good.

english_meaning: to make up one's mind; to be determined; to decide
explanation_mandarin: 指经过考虑后，最终下定决心、做好决定。形容一个人已经打定主意。
explanation_english: Refers to making a final decision after consideration; to be determined. Describes a person who has already made up their mind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢叠埋心水，決定辭職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dip6 maai4 sam1 seoi2, kyut3 ding6 ci4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他下定决心，决定辞职。
examples.english_sentence: He made up his mind and decided to resign.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經叠埋心水買呢間屋啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 dip6 maai4 sam1 seoi2 maai5 ni1 gaan1 uk1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已经决定买这间房子了。
examples.english_sentence: I've already made up my mind to buy this house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 既然你叠埋心水要走，我就唔阻你啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 jin4 nei5 dip6 maai4 sam1 seoi2 jiu3 zau2, ngo5 zau6 m4 zo2 nei5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 既然你已经决定要走了，我就不拦着你了。
examples.english_sentence: Since you've made up your mind to leave, I won't stop you.

mandarin_meaning: 堆积如山，崩塌；比喻事情累积过多，超出承受能力而崩溃
english_meaning: To collapse due to being piled too high; to crumble under pressure due to being overloaded
explanation_mandarin: 形容东西堆积过多，导致崩塌；也比喻压力或工作任务累积过多，超出承受能力而最终崩溃、失败。
explanation_english: Describes something collapsing due to being piled too high. It's also a metaphor for being overwhelmed by accumulated pressure, tasks, or problems, leading to a breakdown or failure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲嘢叠到叠崩咁滯，小心冧落嚟呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 je5 dip6 dou3 dip6 bang1 gam3 zai6, siu2 sam1 lam1 lok6 lai4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 东西都堆得要塌下来了，小心掉下来！
examples.english_sentence: The things are piled so high they're about to collapse, be careful they don't fall!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日做到冇停手，疊崩嘅時候都唔知點算。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 zou6 dou3 mou5 ting4 sau2, dip6 bang1 ge3 si4 hau6 dou1 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天工作不停歇，真不知道事情累积崩溃的时候该怎么办。
examples.english_sentence: He works non-stop every day, I don't know what he'll do when things pile up and he breaks down.

mandarin_meaning: 赌博中介人，叠码仔; 筹码
english_meaning: junket operator; rolling chips (in gambling)
explanation_mandarin: 在赌场中，指一种特殊的职业，通常被称为“叠码仔”。他们负责招揽赌客，并提供信贷等服务，从中赚取佣金。也指賭場中用來賭博的籌碼。
explanation_english: In casinos, it refers to a special profession, often called "junket operators." They are responsible for attracting gamblers and providing credit services, earning commissions from it. It can also refer to gambling chips in casinos.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺澳門做叠碼，搵好多錢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ou3 mun2 zou6 dip6 maa5, wan2 hou2 do1 cin2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在澳门做叠码仔，赚很多钱的。
examples.english_sentence: He works as a junket operator in Macau and makes a lot of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 拎啲叠碼出嚟，準備賭錢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ling1 di1 dip6 maa5 ceot1 lei4, zeon2 bei6 dou2 cin2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 拿出一些筹码来，准备赌钱了。
examples.english_sentence: Take out some rolling chips, get ready to gamble.

english_meaning: junket operator, commission agent in casinos
explanation_mandarin: 指在赌场里专门拉拢赌客，并从中抽取佣金的人。他们通常负责为赌客提供交通、住宿等服务，并帮助赌客兑换筹码。叠码仔的主要收入来源是赌客的赌资，他们会从赌客的输赢中抽取一定比例的佣金。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who specializes in attracting gamblers to casinos and receives commissions for doing so. They typically provide services such as transportation, accommodation, and currency exchange for gamblers. Their main source of income is the gamblers' wagering money, from which they take a percentage of the winnings or losses as commission.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢靠做叠碼仔搵食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kaau3 zou6 dip6 maa5 zai2 wan2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他靠做叠码仔谋生。
examples.english_sentence: He makes a living as a junket operator.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多叠碼仔都喺澳門做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 dip6 maa5 zai2 dou1 hai2 Ou3 Mun2 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多叠码仔都在澳门工作。
examples.english_sentence: Many junket operators work in Macau.

english_meaning: human pyramid
explanation_mandarin: 指几个人叠在一起，形成金字塔形状的人体造型。
explanation_english: A human pyramid is an acrobatic formation in which people stack themselves on top of each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺沙灘度玩叠羅漢，玩得好開心呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 saa1 taan1 dou6 waan2 dip6 lo4 hon3, waan2 dak1 hou2 hoi1 sam1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在沙滩上玩叠罗汉，玩得很开心啊。
examples.english_sentence: They were playing human pyramid on the beach, having a lot of fun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 表演嘅時候，佢哋表演咗一個叠羅漢，好精彩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: biu2 jin2 ge3 si4 hau6, keoi5 dei6 biu2 jin2 zo2 jat1 go3 dip6 lo4 hon3, hou2 zing1 coi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 表演的时候，他们表演了一个叠罗汉，很精彩。
examples.english_sentence: During the performance, they performed a human pyramid, it was amazing.

english_meaning: To gather reinforcements; to call for backup; to amass troops (for a confrontation)
explanation_mandarin: 指召集更多人手或势力以增强实力，通常用于对抗或冲突场合。
explanation_english: Refers to gathering more people or forces to strengthen one's position, usually in situations involving confrontation or conflict. It implies calling for reinforcements or backup.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嗌交嗌到咁僵，聽講雙方都叠晒馬準備開拖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 aai3 gaau1 aai3 dou3 gam3 goeng1, ting1 gong2 soeng1 fong1 dou1 dip6 saai3 maa5 zyun2 bei6 hoi1 to1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们吵架吵得这么僵，听说双方都叫了人准备打架。
examples.english_sentence: They argued so fiercely that I heard both sides have called for reinforcements and are ready to fight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次件事咁大鑊，我哋一定要叠馬先得，唔係實輸硬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 gin6 si6 gam3 daai6 wok6, ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 dip6 maa5 sin1 dak1, m4 hai6 sat6 syu1 ngaang6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的事情这么严重，我们一定要聚集人手才行，不然肯定输定了。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is so serious, we must call for backup, otherwise we're sure to lose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好亂嚟，我識好多人，分分鐘叠馬搞掂你！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lyun6 lai4, ngo5 sik1 hou2 do1 jan4, fan1 min1 zung1 dip6 maa5 gaau2 dim6 nei5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别乱来，我认识很多人，随时都能叫人来搞定你！
examples.english_sentence: Don't mess with me, I know a lot of people, I can call for backup and settle you anytime!

english_meaning: clump, thicket, collection, crowd
explanation_mandarin: 指聚集在一起的草木或其他东西。
explanation_english: Refers to a group of plants or other things clustered together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢匿喺草叢入面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nik1 hai2 cou2 cung4 jap6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他躲在草丛里。
examples.english_sentence: He is hiding in the bushes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度有好多蚊，都係因為附近有草叢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 jau5 hou2 do1 man1, dou1 hai6 jan1 wai6 fan6 gan6 jau5 cou2 cung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里有很多蚊子，都是因为附近有草丛。
examples.english_sentence: There are many mosquitoes here, all because there are bushes nearby.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋圍埋一叢傾偈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 wai4 maai4 jat1 cung4 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们聚在一起聊天。
examples.english_sentence: They gathered together to chat.

english_meaning: series of books; collection of books
explanation_mandarin: 指一系列有关联的书籍，通常由同一出版社或编辑者出版，主题或风格具有一致性。
explanation_english: A series of books, often published by the same publisher or editor, with a common theme or style.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間出版社出咗好多套唔同主題嘅叢書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 ceot1 baan2 se5 ceot1 zo2 hou2 do1 tou3 m4 tung4 zyu2 tai4 ge3 cung4 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家出版社出版了很多套不同主题的丛书。
examples.english_sentence: This publishing house has published many series of books with different themes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗一套關於香港歷史嘅叢書，想了解多啲本土文化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 tou3 gwaan1 jyu1 hoeng1 gong2 lik6 si2 ge3 cung4 syu1, soeng2 liu2 gaai2 do1 di1 bun2 tou2 man4 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一套关于香港历史的丛书，想了解更多本土文化。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a series of books about the history of Hong Kong, I want to learn more about the local culture.

english_meaning: jungle; forest
explanation_mandarin: 树木、草丛等密集生长的地方。
explanation_english: A dense growth of trees, vines, and other vegetation; a jungle or forest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去咗亞馬遜嘅叢林探險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 zo2 aa3 maa5 seon3 ge3 cung4 lam4 taam3 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们去了亚马逊丛林探险。
examples.english_sentence: We went to explore the Amazon jungle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺叢林入面迷路，好彩最後搵返出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 cung4 lam4 jap6 min6 mai4 lou6, hou2 coi2 zeoi3 hau6 wan2 faan1 cheot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在丛林里迷路了，幸好最后找回来了。
examples.english_sentence: He got lost in the jungle, but luckily he was found in the end.

english_meaning: Law of the jungle
explanation_mandarin: 指自然界生物竞争中，适者生存，弱者淘汰的规律。也比喻人类社会中残酷的竞争。
explanation_english: Refers to the natural law of survival of the fittest and elimination of the weak in the biological world. It also metaphorically describes the ruthless competition in human society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢個社會，好多時候都係叢林法則，弱肉強食㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 go3 se5 wui2, hou2 do1 si4 hau6 dou1 hai6 cung4 lam4 faat3 zak1, joek6 yuk6 keung4 sik6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这个社会，很多时候都是丛林法则，弱肉强食的。
examples.english_sentence: In this society, it's often the law of the jungle, survival of the fittest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司競爭好激烈，根本就係叢林法則，唔夠勁好快俾人淘汰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 ging6 zang1 hou2 gik1 lit6, gan1 bun2 jau6 hai6 cung4 lam4 faat3 zak1, m4 gau3 ging6 hou2 faai3 bei2 jan4 tau4 tai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司竞争很激烈，根本就是丛林法则，不够厉害很快会被淘汰。
examples.english_sentence: The competition in their company is very fierce; it's basically the law of the jungle. If you're not strong enough, you'll be eliminated quickly.

synonyms: 弱肉強食 (joek6 yuk6 keung4 sik6)
優勝劣汰 (jau1 sing3 lyut6 taai3)

english_meaning: to grow thickly; to spring up in profusion; growing densely
explanation_mandarin: 指植物密集地生长。
explanation_english: Describes plants growing thickly and densely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲雜草喺花園度叢生，好難清理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 zaap6 cou2 hai2 faa1 jyun4 dou6 cung4 sang1, hou2 naan4 cing1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 花园里杂草丛生，很难清理。
examples.english_sentence: The weeds are growing thickly in the garden, making them hard to clean up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過幾年無人打理，啲植物已經叢生到遮住晒間屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 gei2 nin4 mou4 jan4 daa2 lei5, di1 zik6 mat6 ji5 ging1 cung4 sang1 dou3 ze1 zyu6 saai3 gaan1 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过几年无人打理，植物已经丛生到遮住了整间房子。
examples.english_sentence: After years of neglect, the plants have grown so thickly that they've covered the whole house.

english_meaning: mouth; opening; classifier for people, families, and livestock
explanation_mandarin: 口指嘴巴，是人或动物进食、说话的器官。也可用作量词，表示人口或牲畜的数量。
explanation_english: "Mouth" refers to the organ of a person or animal used for eating and speaking. It can also be used as a classifier, indicating the number of people or livestock.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢把口好叻講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baa2 hau2 hou2 lek1 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他嘴巴很会说话。
examples.english_sentence: He is very good at speaking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屋企有五口人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 uk1 kei5 jau5 ng5 hau2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我家有五口人。
examples.english_sentence: There are five people in my family.

english_meaning: Dumbfounded, speechless, at a loss for words, appearing foolish
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人因为惊讶、尴尬或其他原因而说不出话，或者看起来很傻的样子。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is speechless or at a loss for words, often due to surprise, embarrassment, or confusion, and as a result, appears foolish or stunned.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人問到口up up，乜都講唔出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 man6 dou3 hau2 ap1 ap1, mat1 dou1 gong2 m4 chut1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人问得哑口无言，什么都说不出来。
examples.english_sentence: He was questioned to the point of being dumbfounded, unable to say anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到佢攞咗冠軍，我哋個個都口up up咁望住佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou2 keoi5 lo2 zo2 gun3 gwan1, ngo5 dei6 go3 go3 dou1 hau2 ap1 ap1 gam2 mong6 zyu6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到他拿了冠军，我们个个都目瞪口呆地望着他。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing that he won the championship, we were all dumbfounded, staring at him.

english_meaning: Saying one thing but meaning another; saying the opposite of what one thinks; insincere
explanation_mandarin: 指嘴里说的和心里想的不一样。形容人虚伪，言不由衷。
explanation_english: Describes someone who says one thing but means another; insincere; their words don't match their thoughts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話唔想去，但係我睇佢個樣就知佢口不對心啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 m4 soeng2 heoi3, daan6 hai6 ngo5 tai2 keoi5 go3 joeng2 zau6 zi1 keoi5 hau2 bat1 deoi3 sam1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说不想去，但是我看他的样子就知道他口是心非了。
examples.english_sentence: He said he didn't want to go, but I could tell from his expression that he was just saying that; he didn't mean it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁口不對心啦，想幫手咪出聲囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 hau2 bat1 deoi3 sam1 laa1, soeng2 bong1 sau2 mai5 ceot1 seng1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么口是心非了，想帮忙就说出来啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so insincere, if you want to help, just say so.

english_meaning: to speak rashly; to speak without thinking; to blurt things out
explanation_mandarin: 说话不加选择，指说话轻率，想什么就说什么。
explanation_english: To speak without choosing words, implying that someone speaks rashly and says whatever comes to mind without thinking about the consequences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嬲到口不擇言，乜嘢難聽嘅說話都講得出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nau1 dou3 hau2 bat1 zaak6 jin4, mat1 je5 naan4 ting1 ge3 syut3 waa2 dou1 gong2 dak1 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他气得口不择言，什么难听的话都说得出来。
examples.english_sentence: He was so angry that he spoke rashly, saying all sorts of nasty things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好口不擇言呀，小心得罪人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hau2 bat1 zaak6 jin4 aa3, siu2 sam1 dak1 zeoi6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要口不择言呀，小心得罪人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't speak without thinking, you might offend people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我知道你而家好唔開心，但係都唔可以口不擇言。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi1 dou3 nei5 ji4 gaa1 hou2 m4 hoi1 sam1, daan6 hai6 dou1 m4 ho2 ji5 hau2 bat1 zaak6 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我知道你现在很不开心，但是也不能口不择言。
examples.english_sentence: I know you're upset right now, but you still shouldn't speak without thinking.

english_meaning: corner of the mouth
explanation_mandarin: 指嘴巴的两侧，即嘴角。
explanation_english: Refers to the corners of the mouth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢笑到見牙唔見眼，連口丫角都向上翹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 siu3 dou3 gin3 ngaa4 m4 gin3 ngaan5, lin4 hau2 ngaa1 gok3 dou1 hoeng3 soeng6 kiu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他笑得眼睛都眯成一条缝了，连嘴角都向上翘。
examples.english_sentence: He smiled so much that his eyes narrowed, and even the corners of his mouth turned upwards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你口丫角有啲飯跡，抹咗佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hau2 ngaa1 gok3 jau5 di1 faan6 zik1, maat3 zo2 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的嘴角有些饭粒，擦掉它吧。
examples.english_sentence: There's some rice on the corner of your mouth, wipe it off.

english_meaning: well-behaved verbally; sweet-talking; good at saying pleasing things; obedient
explanation_mandarin: 形容人很会说话，嘴巴很甜，经常说一些讨人喜欢的话；有时候也指听话，顺从。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is good at saying pleasing things; sweet-talking; verbally obedient; good at saying what people want to hear. Can also imply someone is simply obedient and does as they are told.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好口乖，成日讚啲老人家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 hau2 gwaai1, seng4 jat6 zaan3 di1 lou5 jan4 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的很会说话，总是称赞老人们。
examples.english_sentence: He's really sweet-talking; he always compliments the elderly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁口乖啦，唔係乜都應承人哋㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 hau2 gwaai1 laa1, m4 hai6 mat1 dou1 jing3 sing4 jan4 dei6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么嘴甜了，不是什么都答应别人的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so sweet-talking; don't agree to everything people ask of you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個細路好口乖，叫佢做咩佢都做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sai3 lou6 hou2 hau2 gwaai1, giu3 keoi5 zou6 me1 keoi5 dou1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个小孩很听话，叫他做什么他都做。
examples.english_sentence: This child is very obedient; he does everything he's asked to do.

english_meaning: thirsty, dry mouth
explanation_mandarin: 指口腔感觉干燥，想喝水。
explanation_english: Refers to the feeling of dryness in the mouth, indicating a need to drink water; thirsty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我講咗好多嘢，口乾晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gong2 zo2 hou2 do1 je5, hau2 gon1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我说了很多话，口都干了。
examples.english_sentence: I've been talking a lot, my mouth is completely dry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飲杯水先啦，睇你口乾咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yam2 bui1 seoi2 sin1 laa1, tai2 nei5 hau2 gon1 gam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 先喝杯水吧，看你这么口渴。
examples.english_sentence: Have a glass of water first, you look so thirsty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食咗咁多薯片，梗係口乾啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 zo2 gam3 do1 syu4 pin2, gang2 hai6 hau2 gon1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃了这么多薯片，当然口渴了。
examples.english_sentence: After eating so many potato chips, of course you're thirsty.

english_meaning: Oral sex, fellatio (for men), cunnilingus (for women)
explanation_mandarin: 指用口唇舔舐或吸吮对方生殖器的性行为。
explanation_english: Sexual activity involving oral stimulation of the genitals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋拍拖冇耐就開始咗口交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 paak3 to1 mou5 noi6 zau6 hoi1 chi2 zo2 hau2 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们交往没多久就开始口交了。
examples.english_sentence: They started oral sex soon after they started dating.

english_meaning: testimony, statement (to police), confession
explanation_mandarin: 向警方或法庭提供的供词，通常指犯罪嫌疑人的陈述。
explanation_english: A statement given to the police or court, usually referring to the statement of a criminal suspect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋逼佢落口供。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 bik1 keoi5 lok6 hau2 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们逼他作供。
examples.english_sentence: They forced him to give a statement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份口供有好多矛盾嘅地方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 hau2 gung1 jau5 hou2 do1 maau4 teon5 ge3 dei6 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份口供有很多矛盾的地方。
examples.english_sentence: There are many contradictions in the statement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份口供同佢之前講嘅唔一樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 hau2 gung1 tung4 keoi5 zi1 cin4 gong2 ge3 m4 jat1 joeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的供词和他之前说的不一样。
examples.english_sentence: His statement is different from what he said before.

english_meaning: verbal message; oral message; word of mouth
explanation_mandarin: 通过口头传递的信息。
explanation_english: A message conveyed orally; word-of-mouth communication.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我叫佢帶個口信俾你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 giu3 keoi5 daai3 go3 hau2 seon3 bei2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我让他给你带个口信儿。
examples.english_sentence: I asked him to bring you a message.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你記住幫我帶個口信返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gei3 zyu6 bong1 ngo5 daai3 go3 hau2 seon3 faan1 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你记得帮我带个口信回家。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to take a message home for me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該你帶個口信俾阿媽，話我今晚唔返嚟食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 nei5 daai3 go3 hau2 seon3 bei2 aa3 maa1, waa6 ngo5 gam1 maan1 m4 faan1 lai4 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦你给妈妈带个口信，说我今晚不回来吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: Please give my mom a message, telling her that I won't be home for dinner tonight.

english_meaning: To make wild or boastful statements; to talk big; to brag.
explanation_mandarin: 指说话狂妄自大，说超出实际能力的大话。
explanation_english: Refers to making arrogant and boastful statements that exceed one's actual abilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日口出狂言，話自己乜都識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hau2 ceot1 kwong4 jin4, waa6 zi6 gei2 mat1 dou1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是口出狂言，说自己什么都懂。
examples.english_sentence: He always talks big, saying he knows everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好口出狂言喇，做到先講啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hau2 ceot1 kwong4 jin4 laa3, zou6 dou2 sin1 gong2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别说大话了，先做到再说吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk big, do it first before you speak.

english_meaning: Constantly saying; always claiming; professing repeatedly; paying lip service.
explanation_mandarin: 形容人总是重复地说某件事情，但可能实际上并没有去做，或者言行不一致。
explanation_english: Describes someone who repeatedly says something, but may not actually do it, or whose words and actions are inconsistent. Often implies insincerity or hypocrisy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢口口聲聲話自己好忙，但係成日見佢喺度打機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau2 hau2 seng1 seng1 waa6 zi6 gei2 hou2 mong4, daan6 hai6 seng4 jat6 gin3 keoi5 hai2 dou6 daa2 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说自己很忙，但是经常看见他在打游戏。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps saying he's very busy, but I often see him playing video games.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你口口聲聲話會幫我，結果咩都冇做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hau2 hau2 seng1 seng1 waa6 wui5 bong1 ngo5, git3 gwo2 me1 dou1 mou5 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你总是说会帮我，结果什么都没做。
examples.english_sentence: You kept saying you would help me, but you didn't do anything.

english_meaning: To stammer, to stutter, to hesitate while speaking
explanation_mandarin: 形容说话不流畅，说话的时候会重复或停顿。类似于吞吞吐吐。
explanation_english: Describes someone who speaks haltingly and unfluently, often repeating sounds or pausing frequently. Similar to stammering or stuttering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好緊張，講嘢都口吃吃噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 gan2 zoeng1, gong2 je5 dou1 hau2 hek3 hek3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很紧张，说话都吞吞吐吐的。
examples.english_sentence: He's so nervous that he's stuttering when he speaks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，我口吃吃，講得唔清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 hau2 hek3 hek3, gong2 dak1 m4 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我有点口吃，说得不太清楚。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I'm stuttering a bit, I'm not speaking very clearly.

synonyms: 吞吞吐吐 (tan1 tan1 tu3 tu3)
窒吓窒吓 (zat1 haa2 zat1 haa2)

english_meaning: To be at odds; to have conflicting opinions; to contradict each other; lit. mouth agrees but nose turns away.
explanation_mandarin: 形容表面上一致，实际上各有各的打算和主张，意见不合。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where people appear to be in agreement, but in reality, they have different plans and opinions, and thus contradict each other. It implies insincerity or hidden disagreement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩姊妹成日口同鼻拗，一時又話好friend，一時又嘈交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 zi2 mui2 seng4 jat6 hau2 tung4 bei6 aau3, jat1 si4 jau6 waa6 hou2 friend, jat1 si4 jau6 cou4 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她们两姐妹经常意见不合，一会儿说关系很好，一会儿又吵架。
examples.english_sentence: Those two sisters are often at odds. One moment they say they are good friends, the next moment they are arguing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開會嘅時候個個都話支持，但係私底下就口同鼻拗，根本冇人想跟住做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 wui2 ge3 si4 hau6 go3 go3 dou1 waa6 zi1 chi4, daan6 hai6 si1 dai2 haa6 zau6 hau2 tung4 bei6 aau3, gan1 bun2 mou5 jan4 soeng2 gan1 zeoi3 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开会的时候每个人都说支持，但是私底下就意见不合，根本没人想跟着做。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone said they supported it in the meeting, but behind the scenes, they have conflicting opinions, and nobody wants to follow through.

english_meaning: stammering, stuttering; hesitant in speech
explanation_mandarin: 形容说话不流利，吞吞吐吐的样子。
explanation_english: Describes someone who stammers, stutters, or hesitates when speaking, often due to nervousness or difficulty finding the right words.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好怕醜，喺台上講嘢口吶吶咁，唔知講乜好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 paa3 cau2, hai2 toi4 soeng6 gong2 je5 hau2 naap6 naap6 gam2, m4 zi1 gong2 mat1 ho2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很害羞，在台上说话吞吞吐吐的，不知道说什么好。
examples.english_sentence: He's very shy, he was stammering on stage, unsure of what to say.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個男仔見到心儀嘅女仔，即刻口吶吶，唔敢同佢講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 naam4 zai2 gin3 dou2 sam1 ji4 ge3 neoi5 zai2, zik1刻 hau2 naap6 naap6, m4 gam2 tung4 keoi5 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个男孩看到心仪的女孩，立刻吞吞吐吐，不敢和她说话。
examples.english_sentence: The boy saw his crush and immediately started stammering, not daring to talk to her.

english_meaning: tone of voice; manner of speaking
explanation_mandarin: 说话时的语气、腔调。
explanation_english: The tone of voice or manner of speaking one uses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你用咩口吻同阿媽講嘢㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 yung6 me1 hau2 man5 tung4 a3 maa1 gong2嘢 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你用什么口气跟妈妈说话的？
examples.english_sentence: What tone of voice are you using when talking to your mom?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅口吻好似喺度責備我噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hau2 man5 hou2 ci5 hai2 dou6 zaak3 bei6 ngo5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的口气好像在责备我。
examples.english_sentence: His tone of voice sounds like he's blaming me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽佢嘅口吻，佢好唔滿意呢件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 keoi5 ge3 hau2 man5, keoi5 hou2 m4 mun5 yi3 ni1 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听他的口气，他很不满意这件事。
examples.english_sentence: Judging by his tone, he's very dissatisfied with this matter.

english_meaning: taste; flavour; preference; inclination
explanation_mandarin: 指食物的味道；也指对食物、艺术等的爱好或偏好。
explanation_english: Refers to the taste or flavour of food; also refers to preferences or inclinations towards food, art, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意食辣嘅口味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 laat6 ge3 hau2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢吃辣的口味。
examples.english_sentence: I like spicy flavours.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅口味好特別，乜嘢都食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hau2 mei6 hou2 dak6 bit6, mat1 je5 dou1 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的口味很特别，什么都吃。
examples.english_sentence: His taste is very special, he eats everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食好啱我口味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 hou2 ngaam1 ngo5 hau2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物很合我的口味。
examples.english_sentence: The food in this restaurant suits my taste.

english_meaning: whistle
explanation_mandarin: 用嘴吹气发出的声音。也指用嘴吹气发出声音的动作。
explanation_english: A whistling sound made by blowing air through the lips or between the teeth. Also refers to the act of making such a sound.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢識得用手指吹口哨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sik1 dak1 yung6 sau2 ji2 cheoi1 hau2 saau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他会用手指吹口哨。
examples.english_sentence: He knows how to whistle with his fingers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢吹咗個口哨，叫隻狗過嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cheoi1 zo2 go3 hau2 saau3, giu3 jek3 gau2 gwo3 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他吹了个口哨，叫那只狗过来。
examples.english_sentence: He whistled to call the dog over.

english_meaning: lips
explanation_mandarin: 嘴的外缘部分，为口部的组成部分。
explanation_english: The outer edge of the mouth, forming part of the oral region; lips.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢搽咗紅色嘅唇膏，令到佢嘅口唇睇起嚟好性感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 caa4 zo2 hung4 sik1 ge3 seon4 gou1, ling6 dou3 keoi5 ge3 hau2 seon4 tai2 hei2 lai4 hou2 sing3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她涂了红色的口红，使她的嘴唇看起来很性感。
examples.english_sentence: She applied red lipstick, making her lips look very sexy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 凍到我啲口唇都裂開曬啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dung3 dou3 ngo5 di1 hau2 seon4 dou1 lit6 hoi1 saai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 冷得我的嘴唇都裂开了。
examples.english_sentence: It's so cold that my lips are all chapped.

english_meaning: Saying one thing but meaning another; saying the opposite of what one feels or thinks; hypocritical.
explanation_mandarin: 指嘴里说的一套，心里想的又是一套，言语和心意不一致。
explanation_english: Describes someone who says one thing but means another. Their words do not reflect their true feelings or intentions. It often implies dishonesty or insincerity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都口唔對心，你唔好咁認真聽佢講嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 hau2 m4 deoi3 sam1, nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 jing6 zan1 ting1 keoi5 gong2 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是口是心非，你别太认真听他说话。
examples.english_sentence: He's always saying one thing and meaning another, don't take him too seriously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明明好開心，但係就口唔對心咁話自己唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 ming4 hou2 hoi1 sam1, daan6 hai6 zau6 hau2 m4 deoi3 sam1 gam2 waa6 zi6 gei2 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明明很高兴，却口是心非地说自己不开心。
examples.english_sentence: He's clearly very happy, but he's saying he's not happy, being hypocritical.

mandarin_meaning: 哑口无言, 说不出话
english_meaning: speechless, unable to speak, rendered mute
explanation_mandarin: 形容因为惊讶、害怕、羞愧等原因而说不出话的状态。
explanation_english: Describes a state of being speechless or unable to speak due to surprise, fear, shame, or other strong emotions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽到個消息，嚇到口啞啞，一句嘢都講唔出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ting1 dou2 go3 siu1 sik1, haak3 dou3 hau2 ngaa2 ngaa2, jat1 geoi3 je5 dou1 gong2 m4 chut1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他听到这个消息，吓得哑口无言，一句话都说不出来。
examples.english_sentence: When he heard the news, he was so shocked that he was speechless and couldn't say a word.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆唔識講普通話，佢問佢嘢，佢都口啞啞噉唔知點答。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 m4 sik1 gong2 pou2 tung1 waa2, keoi5 man6 keoi5 je5, keoi5 dou1 hau2 ngaa2 ngaa2 gam2 m4 zi1 dim2 daap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶不会说普通话，你问她事情，她也哑口无言不知道怎么回答。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma doesn't know how to speak Mandarin. If you ask her something, she's speechless and doesn't know how to answer.

english_meaning: to mutter; to mumble; to talk to oneself in a low voice; to grumble under one's breath
explanation_mandarin: 形容人小声嘀咕，嘟囔自语，通常带有不满或抱怨的语气。
explanation_english: Describes someone muttering, mumbling to themselves, often with a tone of dissatisfaction or complaint.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一路行一路口噏噏，唔知講乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 lou6 haang4 jat1 lou6 hau2 ngap1 ngap1, m4 zi1 gong2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一路走一路嘟囔着，不知道在说什么。
examples.english_sentence: He was muttering to himself as he walked, I don't know what he was saying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺度口噏噏啦，有乜嘢就直接講出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 hau2 ngap1 ngap1 laa1, jau5 mat1 je5 zau6 zik6 tip3 gong2 chut1 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要在这里嘟囔了，有什么就直接说出来。
examples.english_sentence: Don't mutter there, just say what you have to say directly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆成日口噏噏，好似有好多嘢唔滿意噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 seng4 jat6 hau2 ngap1 ngap1, hou2 ci5 jau5 hou2 do1 je5 m4 mun5 ji3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老奶奶总是嘟囔，好像有很多事情不满意似的。
examples.english_sentence: The old lady is always muttering, as if she's dissatisfied with many things.

english_meaning: dry mouth and dry tongue; feeling thirsty and parched
explanation_mandarin: 形容口部干燥，舌头感觉粗糙，通常表示非常口渴或者身体缺水。
explanation_english: Describes a dry mouth and tongue, usually indicating extreme thirst or dehydration. The 'digging' sensation emphasizes the feeling of roughness and discomfort on the tongue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 跑完步之後，我口嚡脷掘，即刻飲咗一大樽水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: paau2 jyun4 bou6 zi1 hau6, ngo5 hau2 haai4 lei6 gwat6, zik1刻飲咗一大樽水。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 跑完步之后，我口干舌燥，立刻喝了一大瓶水。
examples.english_sentence: After running, I had a dry mouth and dry tongue, so I immediately drank a whole bottle of water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋晚飲咗好多酒，第二朝起身口嚡脷掘，好唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 maan1 jam2 zo2 hou2 do1 zau2, dai2 ji6 zaau1 hei2 san1 hau2 haai4 lei6 gwat6, hou2 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨晚喝了很多酒，第二天早上起来口干舌燥，很不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: I drank a lot of alcohol last night, and this morning I woke up with a dry mouth and dry tongue, feeling very uncomfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 連續講咗幾個鐘頭嘅嘢，講到我口嚡脷掘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lin4 zuk6 gong2 zo2 gei2 go3 zung1 tau4 ge3 je5, gong2 dou3 ngo5 hau2 haai4 lei6 gwat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 连续讲了几个小时的话，说得我口干舌燥。
examples.english_sentence: I've been talking for several hours continuously, and it's made my mouth and tongue feel dry.

english_meaning: dry mouth and tongue; feeling parched
explanation_mandarin: 形容口和舌头感觉干燥，通常是由于缺水或上火引起的。
explanation_english: Describes the feeling of dryness in the mouth and on the tongue, usually caused by dehydration or excessive heat in the body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋日冇飲夠水，搞到我而家口嚡脷素。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 jat6 mou5 jam2 gau3 seoi2, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 ji4 gaa1 hau2 haai4 lei6 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天没喝够水，搞得我现在口干舌燥。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't drink enough water yesterday, which caused my mouth and tongue to feel dry now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食咗咁多煎炸嘢，梗係口嚡脷素啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 zo2 gam3 do1 zin1 zaa3 je5, gang2 hai6 hau2 haai4 lei6 sou3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃了这么多油炸的东西，肯定口干舌燥啦。
examples.english_sentence: You ate so much fried food, of course you'll have a dry mouth and tongue.

mandarin_meaning: 不说话，沉默不语; 默不作声
english_meaning: To keep quiet; to remain silent; to shut one's mouth
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人保持沉默，不发表意见。类似于“闭嘴”、“不说话”的意思，有时也表示无奈或屈服。
explanation_english: Describes someone who remains silent and does not express opinions. Similar to "shut up" or "not speak," sometimes expressing helplessness or submission.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾老細鬧完之後，咪口在路邊囉，仲可以點啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 lou5 sai3 naau6 jyun4 zi1 hau6, mai6 hau2 zoi6 lou6 bin1 lo1, zung6 ho2 ji5 dim2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被老板骂完之后，只能不说话了，还能怎么样呢？
examples.english_sentence: After being scolded by the boss, he just kept quiet, what else could he do?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔知頭唔知路，最好口在路邊，唔好亂講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 zi1 tau4 m4 zi1 lou6, zeoi3 hou2 hau2 zoi6 lou6 bin1, m4 hou2 lyun6 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你一无所知，最好闭嘴，不要乱说话。
examples.english_sentence: You don't know anything about it, so you better keep your mouth shut and don't talk nonsense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 既然大家都唔支持，我都係口在路邊算啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 jin4 daai6 ga1 dou1 m4 zi1 chi4, ngo5 dou1 hai6 hau2 zoi6 lou6 bin1 syun3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 既然大家都不支持，我还是保持沉默算了。
examples.english_sentence: Since everyone doesn't support it, I guess I'll just keep quiet.

synonyms: 閂埋把口 (saan1 maai4 baa2 hau2)

english_meaning: talkative; gossipy; meddlesome; prone to saying unnecessary or unwanted things
explanation_mandarin: 形容人喜欢多说话，管闲事，或者说一些不该说的话。
explanation_english: Describes someone who talks too much, interferes in other people's business, or says things they shouldn't.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你口多多，唔該你收聲啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hau2 do1 do1, m4 goi1 nei5 sau1 seng1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你太多嘴了，请你安静点！
examples.english_sentence: You're being too talkative, please be quiet!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好口多多問人哋嘅私事啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hau2 do1 do1 man6 yan4 dei6 ge3 si1 si6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要多嘴问别人的私事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so nosy asking about other people's private matters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日口多多，所以好多人唔鍾意佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hau2 do1 do1, so2 ji5 hou2 do1 yan4 m4 zung1 yi3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是多嘴多舌，所以很多人不喜欢他。
examples.english_sentence: He's always being talkative and meddlesome, so many people don't like him.

english_meaning: Talkative and meddlesome, leading to trouble; being a busybody and suffering the consequences.
explanation_mandarin: 形容人喜欢多嘴多舌，干涉与自己无关的事情，最终给自己带来麻烦或不好的结果。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is overly talkative and meddlesome, interfering in matters that don't concern them, and ultimately suffering negative consequences as a result.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁口多身賤啦，人哋嘅家事唔關你事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 hau2 do1 san1 zin6 laa1, jan4 dei6 ge3 gaa1 si6 m4 gwaan1 nei5 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别那么多嘴多舌的，人家的家事不关你的事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so meddlesome. Their family matters are none of your business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日口多身賤，所以先惹咁多麻煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hau2 do1 san1 zin6, so2 ji5 sin1 je5 gam3 do1 maa4 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是多嘴多舌的，所以才会惹这么多麻烦。
examples.english_sentence: He's always meddling, that's why he gets into so much trouble.

synonyms: 多管閒事 (do1 gun2 haan4 si6)

english_meaning: tight-lipped; discreet; good at keeping secrets
explanation_mandarin: 形容人嘴巴严实，不会轻易泄露秘密。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is good at keeping secrets and doesn't easily reveal them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人口密，同佢講秘密唔使驚俾人知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hau2 mat6, tung4 keoi5 gong2 bei3 mat6 m4 sai2 geng1 bei2 jan4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人嘴很严，跟他讲秘密不用担心被人知道。
examples.english_sentence: He is very discreet, you don't have to worry about your secrets being leaked if you tell him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿強口密到死，問極都唔肯講發生咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 koeng4 hau2 mat6 dou3 sei2, man6 gik1 dou1 m4 hang2 gong2 faat3 sang1 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿强嘴巴紧闭，怎么问都不肯说发生什么事。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Keung is so tight-lipped, he refuses to say what happened no matter how much I ask.

synonyms: 守口如瓶 (sau2 hau2 jyu4 ping2)

english_meaning: tasteless, bland (food); having a bland taste in the mouth; lacking appetite
explanation_mandarin: 形容食物味道清淡，或者形容因为生病、心情不好等原因导致味觉迟钝，感觉嘴里没有味道。
explanation_english: Describes food that is bland or tasteless. It can also describe a situation where someone has a dull sense of taste due to illness, bad mood, or other reasons, resulting in a lack of flavor in the mouth or lack of appetite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 病咗之後，食咩都覺得口寡寡噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: beng6 zo2 zi1 hau6, sik6 me1 dou1 gok3 dak1 hau2 gwaa2 gwaa2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 生病之后，吃什么都觉得嘴里淡淡的。
examples.english_sentence: After getting sick, everything I eat tastes bland.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢碗粥煮得太淡啦，有啲口寡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wun2 zuk1 zyu2 dak1 taai3 daam6 laa1, jau5 di1 hau2 gwaa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这碗粥煮得太淡了，有点没味道。
examples.english_sentence: This porridge is too bland; it's a little tasteless.

synonyms: 淡而無味 (daam6 ji4 mou4 mei6)

mandarin_meaning: 嘴里没味儿, 淡而无味
english_meaning: Mouth feeling bland, tasteless, a lack of taste in the mouth; feeling the need for something flavorful to eat or drink.
explanation_mandarin: 形容嘴里感觉没有味道，想吃点有味道的东西。
