examples.english_sentence: You seem to have bad breath, have some chewing gum.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔刷牙，所以成日都有口臭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 caat3 ngaa4, so2 ji5 seng4 jat6 dou1 jau5 hau2 cau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不刷牙，所以总是口臭。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't brush his teeth, so he always has bad breath.

mandarin_meaning: 争论不休；口头上的争执
english_meaning: verbal dispute; argument; war of words
explanation_mandarin: 指没有实际意义的，仅仅停留在口头上的争论。
explanation_english: Refers to a dispute or argument that is limited to words and has no practical consequences or resolution. It emphasizes the pointlessness of arguing without action or results.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋兩個唔好再搞口舌之爭啦，不如做啲實事好過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 loeng5 go3 m4 hou2 zoi3 gaau2 hau2舌zi1 zaang1 laa1, bat1 jyu4 zou6 di1 sat6 si6 hou2 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们两个别再进行口舌之争了，不如做些实际的事情更好。
examples.english_sentence: You two, stop having a verbal dispute. It's better to do something practical.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗啲雞毛蒜皮嘅事搞口舌之爭，真係冇意思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai4 zo2 di1 gai1 mou1 syun3 pei4 ge3 si6 gaau2 hau2舌zi1 zaang1, zan1 hai6 mou5 ji3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了那些鸡毛蒜皮的小事进行口舌之争，真是没有意义。
examples.english_sentence: It's really meaningless to have a war of words over trivial matters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢場口舌之爭，最終都冇人贏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 coeng4 hau2舌zi1 zaang1, zeoi3 zung1 dou1 mou5 jan4 wing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这场口头争论，最终都没有人赢。
examples.english_sentence: In this verbal dispute, no one won in the end.

english_meaning: glib-tongued; smooth-talking; flirtatious (in speech)
explanation_mandarin: 形容人说话轻浮，不诚实，常带调戏或奉承的意味。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is glib-tongued, speaks frivolously, insincerely, often with a flirtatious or flattering tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條仔成日口花花，信唔過㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 zai2 sing4 jat6 hau2 faa1 faa1, seon3 m4 gwo3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个男孩子总是油嘴滑舌的，不可靠。
examples.english_sentence: That guy is always smooth-talking, he's not trustworthy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁口花花啦，我唔鍾意聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 hau2 faa1 faa1 laa1, ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么油嘴滑舌的，我不喜欢听。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so smooth-talking, I don't like listening to it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢口花花咁追女仔，好快就追到啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau2 faa1 faa1 gam2 zeoi1 neoi5 zai2, hou2 faai3 zau6 zeoi1 dou2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用油嘴滑舌的方式追女孩子，很快就能追到了。
examples.english_sentence: He uses smooth-talking to pursue girls, he'll get one quickly.

english_meaning: eloquent; speaking fluently and incessantly (as if a river were hanging upside down)
explanation_mandarin: 形容说话像瀑布一样连续不断，比喻能言善辩，说话滔滔不绝。
explanation_english: Describes someone who speaks fluently and eloquently, as if a river were hanging upside down, pouring out an endless stream of words. It's used to describe someone who is very articulate and speaks without pause.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢口若懸河，成日都講到人哋冇聲出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 hau2 joek6 hyun4 ho4, seng4 jat6 dou1 gong2 dou3 jan4 dei6 mou5 seng1 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话滔滔不绝，总是说到别人无话可说。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks so eloquently that he always leaves others speechless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個律師口若懸河，辯護得好好，最後贏咗單官司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 leot6 si1 hau2 joek6 hyun4 ho4, bin6 wu6 dak1 hou2 hou2, zeoi3 hau6 wing4 zo2 daan1 gun1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个律师滔滔不绝，辩护得很好，最后赢了官司。
examples.english_sentence: The lawyer spoke eloquently, defended the case well, and ultimately won the lawsuit.

english_meaning: bitter taste in the mouth
explanation_mandarin: 指嘴巴里感到苦涩的味道。
explanation_english: Having a bitter taste in one's mouth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 琴日唔夠瞓，搞到今日朝早起身覺得口苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kam4 jat6 m4 gau3 fan3, gaau2 dou3 gam1 jat6 ziu1 zou2 hei2 san1 gok3 dak1 hau2 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天没睡够，导致今天早上起床觉得口苦。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't sleep enough yesterday, which caused me to feel a bitter taste in my mouth when I woke up this morning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食完啲藥，成日都覺得口苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 jyun4 di1 joek6, seng4 jat6 dou1 gok3 dak1 hau2 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃完那些药，总是觉得口苦。
examples.english_sentence: After taking those medicines, I always feel a bitter taste in my mouth.

english_meaning: slogan, motto
explanation_mandarin: 为宣传某种主张而提出的简短而有力的语句。
explanation_english: A short and striking or memorable phrase used in advertising or political campaigns.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一路遊行一路嗌住口號。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 lou6 jau4 hang4 jat1 lou6 aai3 zoek3 hau2 hou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一路游行一路喊着口号。
examples.english_sentence: They were shouting slogans as they marched.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個口號聽落好響亮，但係實際意義唔大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hau2 hou6 teng1 lok6 hou2 hoeng2 loeng6, daan6 hai6 sat6 zai3 ji3 jik1 m4 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个口号听起来很响亮，但是实际意义不大。
examples.english_sentence: This slogan sounds powerful, but it doesn't have much practical meaning.

english_meaning: honey-mouthed and dagger-hearted; a wolf in sheep's clothing; someone who is outwardly friendly but inwardly malicious.
explanation_mandarin: 形容人口头上说得好听，心里却盘算着害人的阴谋。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is outwardly friendly and speaks sweetly, but harbors malicious intentions and plots against others secretly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日笑咪咪咁，但係啲手段好陰濕，真係口蜜腹劍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 siu3 mi1 mi1 gam2, daan6 hai6 di1 sau2 dyun6 hou2 jam1 sap1, zan1 hai6 hau2 mat6 fuk1 gim3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是笑眯眯的，但是手段很阴险，真是口蜜腹剑。
examples.english_sentence: He always smiles, but his methods are very insidious. He's truly honey-mouthed and dagger-hearted.

synonyms: 笑裡藏刀 (siu3 lei5 cong4 dou1)

mandarin_meaning: 口头说说；光说不做；说说而已
english_meaning: All talk and no action; empty promises; just saying it but not doing it.
explanation_mandarin: 指只会口头上说说，实际行动却跟不上。形容人说话不兑现承诺，只说不做。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who only talks about doing something but never actually does it. It describes someone who doesn't keep their promises and only talks the talk but doesn't walk the walk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好口行行啦，講咗咁耐都冇見你做過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hau2 hang4 hang4 laa1, gong2 zo2 gam3 noi6 dou1 mou5 gin3 nei5 zou6 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要光说不做，说了这么久都没见你做过。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just talk the talk, you've been saying it for so long and I haven't seen you do anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日口行行，信唔過㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hau2 hang4 hang4, seon3 m4 gwo3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天说说而已，不可信的。
examples.english_sentence: He's always just saying things but never doing them. He's not trustworthy.

english_meaning: Foul-mouthed; To have a sharp tongue; To be verbally abusive; To speak rudely or critically.
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人说话不客气，尖酸刻薄，喜欢说一些难听的话。
explanation_english: Describes a person who speaks rudely, critically, and often says unpleasant things. Implies a lack of tact and consideration for others' feelings when speaking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人口衰到死，成日都講啲嘢嚟hurt人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hau2 seoi1 dou3 sei2, seng4 jat6 dou1 gong2 di1 je5 lai4 hurt jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人嘴巴毒得要命，总是说一些话来伤害人。
examples.english_sentence: He's so foul-mouthed, he always says things to hurt people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁口衰啦，講嘢要留返啲口德。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 hau2 seoi1 laa1, gong2 je5 jiu3 lau4 faan1 di1 hau2 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么嘴损了，说话要积点口德。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so foul-mouthed, you should think about the impact of your words.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁口衰，好易得罪人㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 hau2 seoi1, hou2 ji6 dak1 zeoi6 jan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么嘴损，很容易得罪人的。
examples.english_sentence: You're so foul-mouthed, it's easy for you to offend people.

english_meaning: pocket
explanation_mandarin: 放置物品的小袋子，缝在衣服上。
explanation_english: A small bag sewn into clothing, used for carrying items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我將鎖匙放喺口袋度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zoeng1 so2 si4 fong3 hai2 hau2 doi2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我把钥匙放在口袋里。
examples.english_sentence: I put the keys in my pocket.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫冇口袋嘅？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 mou5 hau2 doi2 ge3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服没有口袋吗？
examples.english_sentence: Does this shirt not have any pockets?

english_meaning: Saying one thing but meaning another; Saying no but meaning yes (often in a coy or flirtatious way)
explanation_mandarin: 指嘴上说不要，心里却想要。常用于男女之间的玩笑，表示拒绝的同时也带着期待。
explanation_english: Refers to saying "no" verbally, but secretly wanting something. Often used in a joking or flirtatious way between men and women, indicating rejection while also hinting at anticipation or desire.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁靚仔請我睇戲，我口裏說不，但係心裏面好想去㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 leng3 zai2 ceng2 ngo5 tai2 hei3, ngo5 hau2 leoi5 syut3 bat1, daan6 hai6 sam1 leoi5 min6 hou2 soeng2 heoi3 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么帅的男生请我看电影，我口头上说不要，但是心里很想去啊！
examples.english_sentence: You're such a handsome guy asking me to the movies. I might say no, but I really want to go!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢口裏說不，但佢都幫我搞掂咗件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 hau2 leoi5 syut3 bat1, daan6 keoi5 dou1 bong1 ngo5 gaau2 ding6 zo2 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他口头说不要，但他还是帮我搞定了这件事。
examples.english_sentence: Even though he said he wouldn't, he still helped me to get this done.

english_meaning: Saying no with one's mouth but meaning yes in one's heart; saying the opposite of what one thinks.
explanation_mandarin: 指嘴上说不要，心里却很想要。形容口头拒绝，内心却渴望或同意。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone says 'no' but actually means 'yes'. It indicates a verbal refusal while inwardly desiring or agreeing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢口裏説不，但係我睇得出佢好想去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau2 leoi5 syut3 bat1, daan6 hai6 ngo5 tai2 dak1 ceot1 keoi5 hou2 soeng2 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他口里说不要，但是我看得出来他很想去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: He says he doesn't want to go, but I can tell he really wants to go on a trip.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好信佢口裏説不，俾多啲時間氹下佢就得啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 hau2 leoi5 syut3 bat1, bei2 do1 di1 si4 gaan3 tam5 haa5 keoi5 zau6 dak1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要相信他的口是心非，多花点时间哄哄他就行了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't believe him saying 'no', just spend more time coaxing him and it'll be fine.

english_meaning: Saying one thing but meaning another; saying no but meaning yes (often used in a flirtatious way).
explanation_mandarin: 指嘴上说不要，心里却很想要。常用于表示欲拒还迎的情境，带有一些撒娇的意味。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where someone verbally refuses something but actually desires it. It often implies a coyness or reluctance that is not entirely genuine, sometimes in a flirtatious context. It's like saying 'no' while secretly hoping for a 'yes'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢口裡說不，但係我睇得出佢好想去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau2 leoi5 syut3 bat1, daan6 hai6 ngo5 tai2 dak1 ceot1 keoi5 hou2 soeng2 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她嘴上说不要，但是我看出来她很想去。
examples.english_sentence: She says she doesn't want to go, but I can tell she really does.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好信佢口裡說不，女仔通常都係咁㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 hau2 leoi5 syut3 bat1, neoi5 zai2 tung1 soeng4 dou1 hai6 gam2 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要相信她嘴上说不要，女孩子通常都是这样的啦。
examples.english_sentence: Don't believe her when she says she doesn't want it; girls are usually like that.

english_meaning: Saying no but meaning yes; saying one thing but meaning another; lip service
explanation_mandarin: 嘴上說不要，心裡卻是想要的，表達一種口是心非的狀態。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone says 'no' or something contradictory to what they actually want or mean. It's often used playfully or to indicate a shy or reluctant acceptance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢口裡說不，但係咪仲係幫你手？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau2 lei5 syut3 bat1, daan6 hai6 mai1 zung6 hai6 bong1 nei5 sau2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他嘴上说不要，但是不是还在帮你？
examples.english_sentence: He said he didn't want to, but isn't he still helping you?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好聽佢口裡說不，佢好想去㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 teng1 keoi5 hau2 lei5 syut3 bat1, keoi5 hou2 soeng2 heoi3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要听他嘴上说不要，他很想去的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't listen to him saying he doesn't want to go, he really wants to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你口裡說不，其實好想收呢份禮物，係咪？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hau2 lei5 syut3 bat1, kei4 sat6 hou2 soeng2 sau1 ni1 fan6 lai5 mat6, hai6 mai1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你嘴上说不要，其实很想收到这份礼物，是吗？
examples.english_sentence: You're saying you don't want it, but you really want to receive this gift, right?

english_meaning: quarrel, squabble, argument, verbal dispute
explanation_mandarin: 指因意见不合而发生的争吵或口头冲突。
explanation_english: Refers to a quarrel or verbal conflict that arises due to a disagreement in opinions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日為咗啲小事而口角。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 jat6 wai6 zo2 di1 siu2 si6 ji4 hau2 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们经常为了一些小事而争吵。
examples.english_sentence: They often quarrel over trivial matters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好因為少少嘢就同人哋口角啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 jan1 wai6 siu2 siu2 je5 zau6 tung4 jan4 dei6 hau2 gok3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要因为一点小事就和别人争吵。
examples.english_sentence: Don't argue with others over small things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔想同你口角，只係想解決問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 soeng2 tung4 nei5 hau2 gok3, zi2 hai6 soeng2 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不想和你争吵，只是想解决问题。
examples.english_sentence: We don't want to argue with you, we just want to solve the problem.

english_meaning: message (oral or recorded), voicemail
explanation_mandarin: 通过口头方式传递的信息，也指电话留言。
explanation_english: A message relayed verbally, or a voicemail message.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺你電話度留咗個口訊，你有冇聽到呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 nei5 din6 waa2 dou6 lau4 zo2 go3 hau2 seon3, nei5 jau5 mou5 ting1 dou2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在你电话里留了个口信，你听到了吗？
examples.english_sentence: I left a voicemail on your phone, did you hear it?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢叫我帶個口訊俾你，話聽日唔使返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 giu3 ngo5 daai3 go3 hau2 seon3 bei2 nei5, waa6 ting1 jat6 m4 sai2 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他让我给你带个口信，说明天不用上班。
examples.english_sentence: He asked me to give you a message, saying you don't need to go to work tomorrow.

english_meaning: mnemonic device; key to success; formula; trick; rhyme
explanation_mandarin: 为了方便记忆而编成的顺口溜或诗歌。也指某种特殊技能或方法的核心要点。
explanation_english: A mnemonic rhyme or formula used to aid memory; also refers to the key to a skill or method.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢教我哋背生字嘅口訣，好易記。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaau3 ngo5 dei6 bui6 sang1 zi6 ge3 hau2 kyut3, hou2 ji6 gei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他教我们背生字的口诀，很容易记。
examples.english_sentence: He taught us a mnemonic rhyme for memorizing new words, it's easy to remember.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 練太極拳都有啲口訣要記住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lin6 taai3 gik6 kyun4 dou1 jau5 di1 hau2 kyut3 jiu3 gei3 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 练习太极拳也有一些口诀要记住。
examples.english_sentence: There are some mnemonics to remember when practicing Tai Chi.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學車都有啲口訣可以幫助記住步驟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 ce1 dou1 jau5 di1 hau2 kyut3 ho2 ji5 bong1 zo6 gei3 zyu6 bou6 zau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学车也有一些口诀可以帮助记住步骤。
examples.english_sentence: There are some mnemonics to help remember the steps when learning to drive.

english_meaning: oral exam, oral test
explanation_mandarin: 一种考试形式，通过口头问答来评估学生的知识或能力。
explanation_english: A form of examination where a student's knowledge or ability is assessed through verbal questioning and answers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日我哋要考英文口試呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 haau2 jing1 man2 hau2 si5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天我们要考英语口试啊。
examples.english_sentence: We have an English oral exam tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴日嘅口試表現好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 ge3 hau2 si5 biu2 hin3 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天的口试表现很好。
examples.english_sentence: His performance in the oral exam yesterday was very good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你口試準備成點呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hau2 si5 zeon2 bei6 sing4 dim2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你口试准备得怎么样了？
examples.english_sentence: How is your preparation for the oral exam going?

english_meaning: to condemn in speech and writing; to attack someone verbally and in writing; to denounce
explanation_mandarin: 用言语和文字进行讨伐和谴责。
explanation_english: To condemn someone using both spoken and written words; to subject someone to severe criticism and denunciation in both speech and writing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘅嘢咁離譜，俾人口誅筆伐都係抵佢死啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 ge3 je5 gam3 lei4 pou2, bei2 jan4 hau2 zyu1 bat1 fat6 dou1 hai6 dai2 keoi5 sei2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做的事情这么离谱，被人口诛笔伐也是他活该。
examples.english_sentence: What he did was so outrageous that it's only right he's being condemned in speech and writing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事引起咗社會各界嘅口誅筆伐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 yan5 hei2 zo2 se5 wui2 gok3 gaai3 ge3 hau2 zyu1 bat1 fat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事引起了社会各界的口诛笔伐。
examples.english_sentence: This matter has provoked condemnation from all sectors of society.

english_meaning: colloquial speech, spoken language
explanation_mandarin: 日常生活中使用的、非正式的书面语的口头表达方式。
explanation_english: The spoken language used in everyday conversation, as opposed to formal written language.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇嘢用咗好多口語，唔似正式文章。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 je5 yung6 zo2 ho2 do1 hau2 jyu5, m4 ci5 zing3 sik1 man4 jeung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这篇文章用了许多口语，不像正式文章。
examples.english_sentence: This article uses a lot of colloquial language; it doesn't look like a formal piece of writing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘢唔好咁口語啦，聽落唔夠專業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 je5 m4 hou2 gam3 hau2 jyu5 laa1, ting1 lok6 m4 gau3 zyun1 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说话不要那么口语化，听起来不够专业。
examples.english_sentence: Don't speak so colloquially; it doesn't sound professional.

english_meaning: slip of the tongue, Freudian slip, misstatement
explanation_mandarin: 说话时无意中说错话，犯了错误。
explanation_english: An unintentional mistake or error in speech; a slip of the tongue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先講嘢係口誤，唔好意思啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 gong2 je5 hai6 hau2 ng6, m4 hou2 ji3 si1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才说话是口误，不好意思啊！
examples.english_sentence: That was a slip of the tongue just now, sorry!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁認真啦，佢只係口誤啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 jing6 zan1 laa1, keoi5 zi2 hai6 hau2 ng6 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么认真了，他只是口误而已。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so serious, it was just a slip of the tongue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅口誤引嚟全場大笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hau2 ng6 jan5 lei4 cyun4 coeng4 daai6 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的口误引来了全场大笑。
examples.english_sentence: His slip of the tongue caused everyone to burst into laughter.

english_meaning: Empty promises; all talk and no action; lip service; to promise something but not deliver.
explanation_mandarin: 形容人只是口头上说说，却没有实际行动，承诺不会兑现。
explanation_english: Describes someone who only makes verbal promises but takes no actual action, and their promises are not fulfilled. It implies insincerity and unreliability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日口講口賠，你唔好信佢咁多啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hau2 gong2 hau2 pui4, nei5 m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 gam3 do1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说说而已，不要太相信他了。
examples.english_sentence: He's always making empty promises, don't trust him too much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆口講口賠話會加人工，到依家都冇影。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 hau2 gong2 hau2 pui4 waa6 wui5 gaa1 jan4 gung1, dou3 ji1 gaa1 dou1 mou5 jeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板只是口头上说说会加薪，到现在都没兑现。
examples.english_sentence: The boss only paid lip service to giving us a raise, and nothing has happened yet.

english_meaning: Words are not enough to prove anything; oral evidence is not reliable; verbal promises are unreliable.
explanation_mandarin: 只靠口头说是没有凭据的，不能作为证据。
explanation_english: This idiom means that words alone are not sufficient proof or evidence. It suggests that something more tangible or documented is required to establish the truth or validity of a claim.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 口講無憑，你都要簽份合約，咁先有保障㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hau2 gong2 mou4 pang4, nei5 dou1 jiu3 cim1 fan6 hap6 joek3, gam2 sin1 jau5 bou2 zoeng3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 口说无凭，你还是要签一份合同，这样才有保障。
examples.english_sentence: Words aren't enough to prove it, you still need to sign a contract to ensure protection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好淨係口講無憑，攞啲證據出嚟啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 hau2 gong2 mou4 pang4, lo2 di1 zing3 geoi3 chut1 lai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要只是口说无凭，拿出一些证据来吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just say it without proof, show some evidence.

synonyms: 空口無憑 (hung1 hau2 mou4 pang4)

english_meaning: oral interpretation, interpreting
explanation_mandarin: 指在不同语言的人之间进行即时口头翻译。
explanation_english: Referring to the act of interpreting orally between people who speak different languages, providing real-time translation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做緊聯合國嘅口譯員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 gan2 lyun4 hap6 gwok3 ge3 hau2 jik6 yun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他正在做联合国的口译员。
examples.english_sentence: He is working as an interpreter for the United Nations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我需要一個口譯員幫我同個法國人溝通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seoi1 jiu3 jat1 go3 hau2 jik6 yun4 bong1 ngo5 tung4 go3 faat3 gwok3 yan4 gau1 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我需要一个口译员帮我和那个法国人沟通。
examples.english_sentence: I need an interpreter to help me communicate with that French person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次會議嘅口譯做得好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 wui5 ji5 ge3 hau2 jik6 zou6 dak1 ho2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次会议的口译做得很好。
examples.english_sentence: The interpreting for this meeting was done very well.

english_meaning: having a sharp and malicious tongue; saying mean or hurtful things; sarcastic and offensive
explanation_mandarin: 指说话尖酸刻薄，喜欢说一些伤人的话，令人不快。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is verbally sharp, malicious, and likes to say hurtful or offensive things, making others feel unpleasant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁口賤啦，人哋會唔開心㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 hau2 zin6 laa1, jan4 dei6 wui5 m4 hoi1 sam1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么嘴贱了，别人会不开心的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so mean, people will be upset.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人就係咁口賤，你唔好咁在意佢講嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 zau6 hai6 gam2 hau2 zin6, nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 zoi6 ji3 keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人就是这么嘴贱，你不要太在意他说的话。
examples.english_sentence: He's just a mean-mouthed person, don't take what he says too seriously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日口賤得罪人，都唔知點解冇人打佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hau2 zin6 dak1 zeoi2 jan4, dou1 m4 zi1 dim2 gaai2 mou5 jan4 daa2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是嘴贱得罪人，都不知道为什么没人打他。
examples.english_sentence: He always offends people with his sharp tongue, I don't know why no one beats him up.

synonyms: 尖酸刻薄 (zim1 syun1 hak1 bok6)

english_meaning: stuttering, stammering, hesitating in speech
explanation_mandarin: 形容说话不流畅，结结巴巴的样子。
explanation_english: Describes someone who stutters, stammers, or hesitates when speaking. It implies a lack of fluency and difficulty articulating words.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好緊張，講嘢口趌趌噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 gan2 zoeng1, gong2 je5 hau2 gat6 gat6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很紧张，说话结结巴巴的。
examples.english_sentence: He's very nervous, he's stuttering when he speaks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，我第一次上台報告，有啲口趌趌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 dai6 jat1 ci3 soeng5 toi4 bou3 gou3, jau5 di1 hau2 gat6 gat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我第一次上台报告，有点结巴。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, it's my first time giving a presentation on stage, I'm a bit stammering.

mandarin_meaning: 说话不谨慎; 随便承诺; 说话没分量
english_meaning: Careless with words; quick to make promises (and potentially break them); lacking weight or credibility in one's speech.
explanation_mandarin: 指说话随便，不经过大脑，容易承诺但做不到；或者指说的话没有分量，不被重视。
explanation_english: Describes someone who speaks carelessly, without thinking, and easily makes promises they might not keep. It can also mean someone whose words lack weight or are not taken seriously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好口輕㗎，千祈唔好信佢講嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 hau2 hing1 gaa3, cin1 mai5 m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人说话很不靠谱，千万不要相信他说的话。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very unreliable person; don't believe what he says.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁口輕啦，應承咗人就要做到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 hau2 hing1 laa1, jing1 sing4 zo2 jan4 zau6 jiu3 zou6 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么随便承诺了，答应了别人就要做到。
examples.english_sentence: Don't make promises so easily; if you promise someone, you have to deliver.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢冇人信，因為佢平時太口輕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 mou5 jan4 seon3, jan1 wai6 keoi5 ping4 si4 taai3 hau2 hing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话没人相信，因为他平时说话太没分量了。
examples.english_sentence: No one believes what he says, because he's usually too careless with his words.

english_meaning: To talk carelessly; to make promises easily without intention to keep them; frivolous in speech; to be a blabbermouth
explanation_mandarin: 形容人说话随便、不经大脑，容易承诺或泄露秘密。
explanation_english: Describes someone who speaks casually and thoughtlessly, easily making promises or revealing secrets without considering the consequences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢口輕輕，乜嘢都同人講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau2 hing1 hing1, mat1 je5 dou1 tung4 jan4 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话轻率，什么都跟别人说。
examples.english_sentence: He's a blabbermouth, he tells everything to others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁口輕輕，應承咗人又做唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 hau2 hing1 hing1, jing3 sing4 zo2 jan4 jau6 zou6 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么轻易地答应，答应了别人又做不到。
examples.english_sentence: Don't make promises so easily if you can't keep them.

english_meaning: to narrate orally; to dictate; oral description
explanation_mandarin: 用口头叙述或讲述的方式表达。
explanation_english: To express or narrate something orally; to dictate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢口述咗成件事嘅經過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau2 seot6 zo2 sing4 gin6 si6 ge3 ging1 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他口述了整件事情的经过。
examples.english_sentence: He narrated the whole incident orally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 律師幫佢記錄佢口述嘅遺囑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: leot6 si1 bong1 keoi5 gei3 luk6 keoi5 hau2 seot6 ge3 wai4 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 律师帮他记录他口述的遗嘱。
examples.english_sentence: The lawyer helped him record his dictated will.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份報告係我口述，秘書幫我寫嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 bou3 gou3 hai6 ngo5 hau2 seot6, bei3 syu1 bong1 ngo5 se2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告是我口述，秘书帮我写的。
examples.english_sentence: I dictated the report, and my secretary helped me write it.

english_meaning: Trembling lips (due to fear, cold, excitement, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 形容因为害怕、寒冷、激动等原因导致嘴唇颤抖的样子。
explanation_english: Describes the appearance of lips trembling due to fear, cold, excitement, nervousness, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢驚到口震震，一句嘢都講唔出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging1 dou3 hau2 zan3 zan3, jat1 geoi3 je5 dou1 gong2 m4 chut1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他吓得嘴唇哆嗦，一句话都说不出来。
examples.english_sentence: He was so scared that his lips were trembling, and he couldn't say a word.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 凍到我口震震，快啲入屋啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dung3 dou3 ngo5 hau2 zan3 zan3, faai3 di1 jap6 uk1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 冷得我嘴唇哆嗦，快点进屋吧。
examples.english_sentence: I'm so cold my lips are trembling, let's go inside quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到佢嘅表白，佢興奮到口震震。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou2 keoi5 ge3 biu2 baak6, keoi5 hing3 fan5 dou3 hau2 zan3 zan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到他的表白，她兴奋得嘴唇哆嗦。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing his confession, she was so excited that her lips were trembling.

english_meaning: Two-faced; hypocritical; saying one thing to someone's face and another behind their back.
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人当面一套，背后一套，虚伪。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is two-faced, saying one thing to someone's face and something completely different behind their back; hypocritical.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好口面㗎，你小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 hau2 min6 gaa3, nei5 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很虚伪，你小心点。
examples.english_sentence: He's very two-faced, be careful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁口面啦，做人真誠啲好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 hau2 min6 laa1, zou6 jan4 zan1 sing4 di1 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么虚伪了，做人真诚点比较好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so two-faced, it's better to be sincere as a person.

english_meaning: accent
explanation_mandarin: 说话时带有的地方语音特点。
explanation_english: A distinctive mode of pronunciation of a language, especially one associated with a particular nation, locality, or social class.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅口音好重，一聽就知佢係鄉下嚟嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hau2 jam1 hou2 zung5, jat1 teng1 zau6 zi1 keoi5 hai6 hoeng1 haa6 lai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的口音很重，一听就知道他是乡下来的。
examples.english_sentence: His accent is very strong. You can tell he's from the countryside as soon as you hear him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽唔慣佢哋嘅口音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 teng1 m4 gwaan3 keoi5 dei6 ge3 hau2 jam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不习惯他们的口音。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not used to their accent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好努力咁想改甩自己嘅口音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 nou5 lik6 gam2 soeng2 gaai2 lat1 zi6 gei2 ge3 hau2 jam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很努力地想改掉自己的口音。
examples.english_sentence: He is trying very hard to get rid of his accent.

english_meaning: all talk and no action; empty boast; to talk big
explanation_mandarin: 形容人只会夸夸其谈，没有实际行动。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is all talk and no action; someone who makes empty boasts or promises without following through.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日口響話會幫手，但係到最後都冇做到嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hau2 hoeng2 waa6 wui5 bong1 sau2, daan6 hai6 dou3 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 mou5 zou6 dou2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天光说会帮忙，但最后什么都没做。
examples.english_sentence: He always talks big about helping, but in the end, he doesn't do anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁口響啦，做啲嘢出嚟先講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 hau2 hoeng2 laa1, zou6 di1 je5 chut1 lai4 sin1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别光说不做，先做点事情再说话。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just talk the talk, do something first before you speak.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人就係咁口響，唔使咁認真聽佢講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 zau6 hai6 gam2 hau2 hoeng2, m4 sai2 gam3 jing6 zan1 teng1 keoi5 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他就是那么爱吹牛，不用太认真听他说话。
examples.english_sentence: That's just how he is, all talk, you don't have to take him seriously.

english_meaning: oral; verbal; spoken; by word of mouth
explanation_mandarin: 指用口说的，而非书面的；也指口语。
explanation_english: Refers to something spoken rather than written; also refers to spoken language.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢淨係口頭應承，唔知會唔會做到呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zing6 hai6 hau2 tau4 ying3 sing4, m4 zi1 wui5 m4 wui5 zou6 dou2 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只是口头答应，不知道会不会做到呢？
examples.english_sentence: He only promised verbally, I don't know if he'll actually do it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個協議只係口頭嘅，未簽正式文件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hip3 yi5 zi2 hai6 hau2 tau4 ge3, mei6 cim1 zing3 sik1 man4 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个协议只是口头上的，还没签正式文件。
examples.english_sentence: This agreement is only verbal, the official documents haven't been signed yet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅英文口頭能力好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ying1 man2 hau2 tau4 nang4 lik6 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的英语口语能力很好。
examples.english_sentence: His spoken English ability is very good.

english_meaning: catchphrase, cliché; words or phrases habitually used without much thought
explanation_mandarin: 指经常挂在嘴边的，不经思考的口头用语。
explanation_english: A catchphrase or cliché, often a word or phrase that someone uses repeatedly without much thought or meaning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都講「冇計啦」，真係佢嘅口頭禪嚟嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 gong2 "mou5 gai3 laa1", zan1 hai6 keoi5 ge3 hau2 tau4 sim4 lai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说“没办法啦”，真是他的口头禅。
examples.english_sentence: He always says "There's no other way," it's really his catchphrase.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「盡力而為」已經變咗我阿媽嘅口頭禪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeon6 lik6 ji4 wai4 ji5 ging1 bin3 zo2 ngo5 aa3 maa1 ge3 hau2 tau4 sim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: “尽力而为”已经变成我妈妈的口头禅。
examples.english_sentence: "Do your best" has become my mom's catchphrase.

mandarin_meaning: 口气; 语气; 说法
english_meaning: tone of voice; wording; hint; indication; change of attitude; change of opinion
explanation_mandarin: 指说话的口气、语气、态度，也指透露出的信息或意向。有时也指改变了原来的态度或意见。
explanation_english: Refers to the tone of voice, wording, or attitude used when speaking. It can also refer to the information or intention revealed. Sometimes it also refers to a change in one's original attitude or opinion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽佢嘅口風，好似唔係好想幫我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 keoi5 ge3 hau2 fung1, hou2 ci5 m4 hai6 hou2 soeng2 bong1 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听他的口风，好像不太想帮我们。
examples.english_sentence: Judging from his tone, it seems he's not very willing to help us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅口風轉得好快，尋日先話支持我，今日又唔同講法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hau2 fung1 zyun2 dak1 hou2 faai3, cam4 jat6 sin1 waa6 zi1 chi4 ngo5, gam1 jat6 jau6 m4 tung4 gong2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的口风变得很快，昨天才说支持我，今天又换了说法。
examples.english_sentence: He changed his tune very quickly. He said he supported me yesterday, but he's saying something different today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆嘅口風好硬，睇嚟唔會加人工啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 ge3 hau2 fung1 hou2 ngaang6, tai2 lai4 m4 wui5 gaa1 jan4 gung1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板的口风很硬，看来不会加薪了。
examples.english_sentence: The boss's tone is very firm, it seems like we won't be getting a raise.

english_meaning: harmonica
explanation_mandarin: 一种乐器，通过口吹或吸气使簧片振动发声。
explanation_english: A musical instrument in which sound is produced by blowing air through reeds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣時，我學過吓口風琴㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 si4, ngo5 hok6 gwo3 haa5 hau2 fung1 kam4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候，我学过口风琴。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a kid, I learned the harmonica a bit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞住支口風琴，喺街頭表演。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 zyu6 zi1 hau2 fung1 kam4, hai2 gaai1 tau4 biu2 jin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿着口风琴，在街头表演。
examples.english_sentence: He's holding a harmonica and performing on the street.

english_meaning: Chewing gum
explanation_mandarin: 一种用来咀嚼的糖，通常含有糖或其他甜味剂和香料。
explanation_english: A flavored gum for chewing, typically containing sugar or other sweeteners and flavorings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想買包口香糖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 baau1 hau2 hoeng1 tong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想买一包口香糖。
examples.english_sentence: I want to buy a pack of chewing gum.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食完飯之後，我鍾意食粒口香糖清新下口氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 jyun4 faan6 zi1 hau6, ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 lap1 hau2 hoeng1 tong2 cing1 san1 haa5 hau2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃完饭之后，我喜欢嚼一块口香糖清新一下口气。
examples.english_sentence: After eating, I like to chew a piece of gum to freshen my breath.

english_meaning: Having a dark (angry/unhappy) look; looking very displeased; scowling
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人因为生气、不高兴或其他原因而脸色发黑，表情非常难看。
explanation_english: Describes someone having a dark or gloomy expression, usually due to anger, displeasure, or other negative emotions. It implies a visible and unpleasant expression on their face.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你遲到成個鐘，老細梗係口黑面黑啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ci4 dou3 sing4 go3 zung1, lou5 sai3 gang2 hai6 hau2 hak1 min6 hak1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你迟到了一个小时，老板肯定脸色铁青了。
examples.english_sentence: You were an hour late, the boss is definitely scowling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試唔合格，返到屋企梗係口黑面黑啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 m4 hap6 gaak3, faan1 dou3 uk1 kei2 gang2 hai6 hau2 hak1 min6 hak1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试不及格，回到家肯定脸色很难看。
examples.english_sentence: He failed the exam, he must be looking very displeased when he gets home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽見到我整爛咗佢個花樽，即刻口黑面黑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 gin3 dou2 ngo5 zing2 laan6 zo2 keoi5 go3 faa1 zeon3, zik1 hak1 hau2 hak1 min6 hak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈看到我弄坏了她的花瓶，立刻脸色铁青。
examples.english_sentence: Mom saw that I broke her vase, and she immediately scowled.

english_meaning: eloquence; speaking ability; articulation
explanation_mandarin: 指说话的技巧和表达能力。形容人说话清晰流畅，能言善辩。
explanation_english: Refers to the skill and ability to speak. It describes someone who speaks clearly, fluently, and is eloquent and articulate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢口齒伶俐，好啱做銷售。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau2 chi2 ling4 lei6, hou2 ngaam1 zou6 siu1 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他口齿伶俐，很适合做销售。
examples.english_sentence: He is eloquent and articulate, very suitable for sales.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢口齒唔好，講嘢唔係好清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau2 chi2 m4 hou2, gong2 je5 m4 hai6 hou2 ching1 chu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他口才不好，说话不是很清楚。
examples.english_sentence: His articulation isn't good; he doesn't speak very clearly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個律師口齒便給，辯護技巧一流。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 leot6 si1 hau2 chi2 bin6 gap3, bin6 wu6 gei6 haau2 jat1 lau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个律师口齿伶俐，辩护技巧一流。
examples.english_sentence: This lawyer is eloquent and has first-class advocacy skills.

english_meaning: unclear speech; inarticulate; to mumble; to have a speech impediment
explanation_mandarin: 形容说话不清楚，发音含糊。
explanation_english: Describes speech that is unclear, mumbled, or difficult to understand due to poor articulation or a speech impediment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢飲醉咗，講嘢口齒不清。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yam2 zeoi3 zo2, gong2嘢 hau2 chi2 bat1 ching1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喝醉了，说话口齿不清。
examples.english_sentence: He's drunk and his speech is slurred.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為中咗風，搞到口齒不清。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yan1 wai4 zung3 zo2 fung1, gaau2 dou3 hau2 chi2 bat1 ching1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为中风了，导致口齿不清。
examples.english_sentence: He had a stroke which resulted in slurred speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友啱啱學講嘢，口齒不清都好正常嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 ngaam1 ngaam1 hok6 gong2嘢, hau2 chi2 bat1 ching1 dou1 hou2 jing4 seung4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友刚开始学说话，口齿不清是很正常的。
examples.english_sentence: It's normal for young children to have unclear speech when they are just learning to talk.

english_meaning: Mouth watering, drooling, craving something (especially food)
explanation_mandarin: 形容想吃东西，口水都快要流下来了。 比喻非常渴望得到某样东西。
explanation_english: Describes a craving for something, usually food, to the point of drooling. Figuratively, it can mean being extremely eager or desirous for something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到舊嘢咁好食，我口𣲷溼晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 gau6 je5 gam3 hou2 sik6, ngo5 hau2 nap1 sap1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到这东西这么好吃，我都馋得流口水了。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing that food looks so delicious, my mouth is watering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對部新車口𣲷溼，日日都唸住買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 bou6 san1 ce1 hau2 nap1 sap1, jat1 jat1 dou1 nim6 zyu6 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对那辆新车垂涎三尺，每天都想着买。
examples.english_sentence: He's drooling over that new car, thinking about buying it every day.

mandarin_meaning: 馋, 想吃东西, 嘴馋
english_meaning: mouth is watering; eager to eat; greedy for food; having a craving
explanation_mandarin: 形容想吃东西的样子，馋得流口水。
explanation_english: Describes a state of wanting to eat something, often to the point of salivating. It implies a strong craving for food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇到啲蛋糕咁靚，我已經口𣲷濕晒喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 dou2 di1 daan6 gou1 gam3 leng3, ngo5 ji5 ging1 hau2 nap1 sap1 saai3 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到那些蛋糕这么漂亮，我已经馋得流口水了！
examples.english_sentence: Seeing those cakes looking so beautiful, my mouth is already watering!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聞到陣香味，搞到我口𣲷濕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: man4 dou2 zan6 hoeng1 mei6, gaau2 dou2 ngo5 hau2 nap1 sap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 闻到香味，弄得我嘴馋。
examples.english_sentence: Smelling the aroma made my mouth water.

english_meaning: old, ancient, outdated
explanation_mandarin: 指时间久远的，不合时宜的。
explanation_english: Refers to something old, ancient, or outdated; not in line with current trends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫好古喎，你仲著？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 hou2 gu2 wo3, nei5 zung6 zoek3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服很旧了，你还穿？
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is so old-fashioned, are you still wearing it?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲諗法好古，跟唔上時代。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 nam2 faat3 hou2 gu2, gan1 m4 soeng5 si4 doi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的想法很老旧，跟不上时代。
examples.english_sentence: His ideas are very outdated and he can't keep up with the times.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅裝修好古，不過都幾有特色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 zong1 sau1 hou2 gu2, bat1 gwo3 dou1 gei2 jau5 dak6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的装修很古老，不过也挺有特色的。
examples.english_sentence: The decoration of this restaurant is very old, but it is quite unique.

english_meaning: ancient people; people of the past; deceased person (euphemism)
explanation_mandarin: 1. 指古代的人。2. （委婉语）指去世的人。
explanation_english: 1. Refers to people from ancient times. 2. (Euphemism) Refers to a deceased person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古人嘅智慧真係好勁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 jan4 ge3 ji3 wai3 zan1 hai6 hou2 ging6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古代人的智慧真的很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: The wisdom of the ancients is really amazing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆成日話要落去陪古人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 seng4 jat6 waa6 jiu3 lok6 heoi3 pui4 gu2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶总是说要下去陪已故的人。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma always says she wants to go down and accompany the deceased.

english_meaning: past and present; from ancient times to the present
explanation_mandarin: 指从古代到现在的一段时间。强调时间跨度长，包含过去和现在。
explanation_english: Refers to a period from ancient times to the present. It emphasizes a long time span, including the past and the present.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間博物館展出咗好多古今中外嘅藝術品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 bok3 mat6 gun2 zin2 ceot1 zo2 hou2 do1 gu2 gam1 zung1 ngoi6 ge3 ngai6 seot6 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家博物馆展出了很多古今中外的艺术品。
examples.english_sentence: This museum exhibits many works of art from past and present, both Chinese and foreign.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古今中外，無論邊個民族都重視家庭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 gam1 zung1 ngoi6, mou4 leon6 bin1 go3 man4 zuk6 dou1 zung6 si6 gaa1 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古往今来，无论哪个民族都重视家庭。
examples.english_sentence: Throughout history, all cultures value family.

english_meaning: throughout the ages and across the world; ancient and modern, Chinese and foreign
explanation_mandarin: 指从古到今，中国和外国。形容范围极广，时间极长。
explanation_english: Refers to all times (ancient and modern) and all places (China and abroad).  Describes a very broad scope in both time and space.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個問題古今中外都存在。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 man6 tai4 gu2 gam1 zung1 ngoi6 dou1 cyun4 zoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个问题古今中外都存在。
examples.english_sentence: This problem exists throughout the ages and across the world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古今中外嘅文學作品，佢都好鍾意睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 gam1 zung1 ngoi6 ge3 man4 hok6 zuk1 ban2, keoi5 dou1 hou2 zung1 ji3 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古今中外的文学作品，他都很喜欢看。
examples.english_sentence: He loves to read literary works from ancient and modern times, both Chinese and foreign.

english_meaning: Story, tale
explanation_mandarin: 故事，指的是虚构或真实的事情的叙述。
explanation_english: A story or tale, often fictional but can also be based on real events.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣時，阿嫲成日講古仔俾我哋聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 si4, aa3 maa4 seng4 jat6 gong2 gu2 zai2 bei2 ngo5 dei6 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候，奶奶经常讲故事给我们听。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a kid, my grandma often told us stories.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最叻就係作古仔呃人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 lek1 zau6 hai6 zok3 gu2 zai2 aak1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最擅长就是编故事骗人。
examples.english_sentence: He is best at making up stories to deceive people.

english_meaning: ancient times; antiquity
explanation_mandarin: 指遥远的过去；古时候。
explanation_english: Refers to the distant past; ancient times.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古代嘅人冇咁多科技產品用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 doi6 ge3 jan4 mou5 gam3 do1 fo1 gei6 caan2 ban2 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古代的人没有那么多科技产品用。
examples.english_sentence: People in ancient times didn't have so many technological products to use.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對古代歷史好有興趣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 gu2 doi6 lik6 si2 hou2 jau5 hing3 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对古代历史很感兴趣。
examples.english_sentence: I am very interested in ancient history.

english_meaning: classical, classic
explanation_mandarin: 指具有传统、规范、典范意义的艺术或文化形式。也指传统的、正式的。
explanation_english: Refers to art or cultural forms that are traditional, standard, and exemplary. Also refers to things that are traditional and formal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意聽古典音樂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 teng1 gu2 din2 jam1 ngok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我非常喜欢听古典音乐。
examples.english_sentence: I really like listening to classical music.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅裝修好古典。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 zong1 sau1 hou2 gu2 din2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的装修很古典。
examples.english_sentence: The decoration of this restaurant is very classic.

english_meaning: Classical Mechanics
explanation_mandarin: 研究宏观物体运动规律的物理学分支，以牛顿力学为基础。
explanation_english: A branch of physics that studies the laws of motion of macroscopic objects, based on Newtonian mechanics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢讀緊大學，主修物理，專攻古典力學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 duk6 ging2 daai6 hok6, zyu2 sau1 mat6 lei5, zyun1 gung1 gu2 din2 lik6 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他正在读大学，主修物理，专攻古典力学。
examples.english_sentence: He is studying at university, majoring in physics and specializing in classical mechanics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古典力學解釋咗好多日常嘅現象，例如蘋果點解會跌落地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 din2 lik6 hok6 gaai2 sik1 zo2 hou2 do1 jat1 seong4 ge3 hin3 zoeng6, leoi5 jyu4 ping4 gwo2 dim2 gaai2 wui5 dit3 lok6 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古典力学解释了很多日常的现象，例如苹果为什么会掉在地上。
examples.english_sentence: Classical mechanics explains many everyday phenomena, such as why apples fall to the ground.

english_meaning: classical music
explanation_mandarin: 指主要产生于西方，以书面音乐传统为基础的音乐。通常指巴洛克时期、古典主义时期和浪漫主义时期的音乐。
explanation_english: Music composed largely in the Western art music tradition, often referring specifically to the period from the Baroque era through the Romantic era.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意聽古典音樂，特別係莫扎特嘅作品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 teng1 gu2 din2 jam1 ngok6, dak6 bit1 hai6 mok6 zaat3 dak6 ge3 zok3 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我非常喜欢听古典音乐，特别是莫扎特的作品。
examples.english_sentence: I really like listening to classical music, especially Mozart's works.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個就開始學鋼琴，所以對古典音樂好有認識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 zau6 hoi1 chi2 hok6 gong3 kam4, so2 ji5 deoi3 gu2 din2 jam1 ngok6 hou2 jau5 jing6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他从小就开始学钢琴，所以对古典音乐很有认识。
examples.english_sentence: He started learning piano when he was young, so he has a good understanding of classical music.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋去睇古典音樂會啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 tai2 gu2 din2 jam1 ngok6 wui2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们去看古典音乐会吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to a classical music concert tonight.

english_meaning: ancient city
explanation_mandarin: 历史悠久的城市。
explanation_english: A city with a long history.

examples.jyutping_sentence: sai1 on1 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 cheut1 ming4 ge3 gu2 sing4.

english_meaning: castle, old fortress
explanation_mandarin: 指历史悠久的城堡。
explanation_english: Refers to a castle with a long history; an old fortress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個古堡好有歷史價值㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 gu2 bou2 hou2 jau5 lik6 si2 gaa3 zik6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个古城堡很有历史价值。
examples.english_sentence: That castle has a lot of historical value.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去歐洲旅行，一定要參觀下嗰啲古堡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 au1 zau1 leoi5 hang4, jat1 ding6 jiu3 caam1 guan1 haa5 go2 di1 gu2 bou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们去欧洲旅行，一定要参观一下那些古城堡。
examples.english_sentence: When we travel to Europe, we must visit those castles.

english_meaning: ancient tomb; old tomb
explanation_mandarin: 年代久远的坟墓。
explanation_english: An ancient tomb; a tomb from a long time ago.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺古墓入面搵到好多寶藏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 gu2 mu6 jap6 min6 wan2 dou2 ho2 do1 bou2 zong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在古墓里找到了很多宝藏。
examples.english_sentence: They found many treasures inside the ancient tomb.

english_meaning: Cuba (country)
explanation_mandarin: 中美洲加勒比海的一个岛国，名为古巴。
explanation_english: An island country in the Caribbean, Central America, called Cuba.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一直都好想去古巴旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 zik6 dou1 hou2 soeng2 heoi3 gu2 baa1 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一直都很想去古巴旅行。

english_meaning: from ancient times to the present
explanation_mandarin: 指从古代到现代，涵盖了所有时间。
explanation_english: Refers to all of time, from ancient times to the present day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古往今來，香港都係一個充滿活力嘅城市。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 wong5 gam1 loi4, hoeng1 gong2 dou1 hai6 jat1 go3 cung1 mun5 wut6 lik6 ge3 sing4 si5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 从古至今，香港都是一个充满活力的城市。
examples.english_sentence: From ancient times to the present, Hong Kong has always been a vibrant city.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古往今來，好多人都為咗夢想而努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 wong5 gam1 loi4, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 wai6 zo2 mung6 soeng2 ji4 nu5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自古以来，很多人都为了梦想而努力。
examples.english_sentence: Throughout history, many people have strived for their dreams.

english_meaning: strange, weird, odd, eccentric, peculiar
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或事物异于常人或常理，让人觉得不寻常。
explanation_english: Describing a person or thing as being different from the norm or common sense, making it feel unusual.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅性格好古怪，成日都唔知佢諗緊咩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing3 gaak3 hou2 gu2 gwaai3, seng4 jat6 dou1 m4 zi1 keoi5 lam2 gan2 me1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的性格很奇怪，总是不知道他在想什么。
examples.english_sentence: His personality is very strange; you never know what he's thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢间餐厅嘅装修好古怪，好似唔系好搭噉。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天穿的衣服好奇怪啊！
examples.english_sentence: The clothes you're wearing today are very strange!

english_meaning: crafty, sly, cunning, mischievous, tricky, scheming
explanation_mandarin: 形容人狡猾，不老实，爱耍手段。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is crafty, sly, cunning, mischievous, or uses tricks and schemes to achieve their goals. It often carries a slightly negative connotation, suggesting a lack of trustworthiness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好古惑㗎，小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 gu2 waak6 gaa3, siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很狡猾，小心点。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very cunning person, be careful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好信佢呀，佢份人好古惑嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 aa3, keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 gu2 waak6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要相信他，他这人很狡猾的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust him, he's a very sly person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲古惑招數都唔好用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 gu2 waak6 ziu1 sou3 dou1 m4 hou2 yung6.

examples.english_sentence: Don't use these tricky methods.

english_meaning: Young gangster; hoodlum; delinquent
explanation_mandarin: 指年轻的、经常惹事生非的流氓或不良少年。多指加入黑社会组织，以暴力手段解决问题的人。
explanation_english: Refers to young, often trouble-making hooligans or delinquents. Often refers to people who join triad societies and use violence to solve problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嘅時候成日同啲古惑仔喺街度遊蕩。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候经常和一些小流氓在街上游荡。
examples.english_sentence: When he was young, he often hung out on the streets with some young gangsters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為做古惑仔好威，其實好容易惹禍上身㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 zou6 gu2 waak6 zai2 hou2 wai1, kei4 sat6 hou2 jung4 ji6 je5 wo6 soeng5 san1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为当小流氓很威风，其实很容易惹祸上身。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think being a young gangster is cool, it's actually very easy to get into trouble.

mandarin_meaning: 叛逆少女, 不良少女
english_meaning: Rebellious girl, delinquent girl, 'bad girl'
explanation_mandarin: 指行为叛逆，穿着打扮前卫，经常出入不良场所的年轻女性。带有一定的贬义。
explanation_english: Refers to a young woman who is rebellious in behavior, dresses in an avant-garde style, and frequently frequents undesirable places. Carries a certain degree of negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日同埋班古惑仔一齊，都變咗個古惑女咁啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 tung4 maai4 baan1 gu2 waak6 zai2 jat1 cai4, dou1 bin3 zo2 go3 gu2 waak6 neoi5 gam2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她整天和一群小混混在一起，都变成一个不良少女了。
examples.english_sentence: She's always with a group of gangsters, she's become a rebellious girl.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪學埋晒啲古惑女咁，染曬啲頭髮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 hok6 maai4 saai3 di1 gu2 waak6 neoi5 gam2, jim5 saai3 di1 tau4 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别学那些不良少女那样，把头发都染了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't imitate those rebellious girls by dyeing all your hair.

english_meaning: classical Chinese; literary Chinese
explanation_mandarin: 指古代的书面语言，有别于现代白话文。
explanation_english: Refers to classical written Chinese, distinct from modern vernacular Chinese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我讀唔明啲古文，太深奧喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 duk6 m4 ming4 di1 gu2 man4, taai3 sam1 ou3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我读不懂那些古文，太深奥了。
examples.english_sentence: I can't understand the classical Chinese, it's too profound.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對古文好有研究，成日睇古書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 gu2 man4 hou2 jau5 jin4 gau3, seng4 jat6 tai2 gu2 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对古文很有研究，经常看古书。
examples.english_sentence: He has done a lot of research on classical Chinese, and often reads old books.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家嘅教科書好少用古文。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ge3 gaau3 fo3 syu1 hou2 siu2 yung6 gu2 man4.
