explanation_mandarin: 指语言中词语组成句子的规则和结构。
explanation_english: Refers to the rules and structure governing how words are arranged to form sentences in a language.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個句子嘅句法有啲奇怪，好似唔係咁通順。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 geoi3 zi2 ge3 geoi3 faat3 jau5 di1 kei4 gwaai3, hou2 ci5 m4 hai6 gam2 tung1 seon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个句子的句法有点奇怪，好像不太通顺。
examples.english_sentence: The syntax of this sentence is a bit strange; it doesn't seem very smooth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要學好一門語言，除咗詞彙，仲要掌握佢嘅句法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 hok6 hou2 jat1 mun4 jyu5 jin4, ceoi4 zo2 ci4 wui6, zung6 jiu3 zo2ng2 aak1 keoi5 ge3 geoi3 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要学好一门语言，除了词汇，还要掌握它的句法。
examples.english_sentence: To learn a language well, you need to master its syntax in addition to its vocabulary.

english_meaning: period, full stop
explanation_mandarin: 标点符号，表示一句话的结束。
explanation_english: A punctuation mark ( . ) used to mark the end of a sentence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢句嘢嘅後面應該加個句號。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 geoi3 je5 ge3 hau6 min6 jing1 goi1 gaa1 go3 geoi3 hou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这句话的后面应该加个句号。
examples.english_sentence: A period should be added after this sentence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅戀情終於畫上咗句號。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 lyun2 cing4 zung1 jyu1 waak6 soeng5 zo2 geoi3 hou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的恋情终于画上了句号。
examples.english_sentence: Their romance finally came to an end.

english_meaning: hour
explanation_mandarin: 表示一小时的时间单位。
explanation_english: A unit of time equal to 60 minutes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我等咗你成句鐘喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dang2 zo2 nei5 seng4 geoi3 zung1 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我等了你整整一个小时了！
examples.english_sentence: I've been waiting for you for a whole hour!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 套戲有兩句鐘咁長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou3 hei3 jau5 loeng5 geoi3 zung1 gam3 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影有两个小时那么长。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is two hours long.

english_meaning: another, other, separate
explanation_mandarin: 表示在某个事物之外再加一个。也表示不相同。
explanation_english: Indicates something in addition to something else. Also indicates something different.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想要另一個橙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 ling6 jat1 go3 caang2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想要另外一个橙子。
examples.english_sentence: I want another orange.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有無另一個選擇？
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 mou5 ling6 jat1 go3 syun2 zaak6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有没有另外一个选择？
examples.english_sentence: Is there another option?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋另日再傾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ling6 jat6 zoi3 king1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们改天再聊。
examples.english_sentence: Let's talk another day.

english_meaning: another, other
explanation_mandarin: 表示另外一个，与目前所指的不同。
explanation_english: Refers to another one, different from the one currently mentioned.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想買另一部電話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 ling6 jat1 bou6 din6 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想买另一部电话。
examples.english_sentence: I want to buy another phone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋去咗另一間餐廳食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 heoi3 zo2 ling6 jat1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们去了另一家餐厅吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: They went to another restaurant to have a meal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我需要另一種解決方法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seoi1 jiu3 ling6 jat1 zung2 gaai2 kyut3 fong1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我需要另一种解决方法。
examples.english_sentence: I need another solution.

english_meaning: other half; spouse; partner
explanation_mandarin: 指配偶，伴侣，或者指整体中的另一部分。
explanation_english: Refers to one's spouse, partner, or the other half of a whole.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嘅另一半好支持我嘅事業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ge3 ling6 jat1 bun3 hou2 zi1 chi4 ngo5 ge3 si6 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的另一半很支持我的事业。
examples.english_sentence: My other half is very supportive of my career.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搵到啱嘅另一半真係唔容易。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wan2 dou2 ngaam1 ge3 ling6 jat1 bun3 zan1 hai6 m4 jung4 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 找到合适的另一半真不容易。
examples.english_sentence: It's really not easy to find the right other half.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係天生一對，真係另一半嘅最佳典範。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 tin1 sang1 jat1 deoi3, zan1 hai6 ling6 jat1 bun3 ge3 zeoi3 gaai1 din2 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是天生一对，真是另一半的最佳典范。
examples.english_sentence: They are a match made in heaven, truly the best example of other halves.

english_meaning: on the other hand; on the other aspect
explanation_mandarin: 表示从另一个角度来看待问题。
explanation_english: Used to introduce a different perspective or aspect of a situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好聰明，但係另一方面，佢都幾懶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 cung1 ming4, daan6 hai6 ling6 jat1 fong1 min6, keoi5 dou1 gei2 laan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很聪明，但是另一方面，他也挺懒的。
examples.english_sentence: He is very smart, but on the other hand, he is also quite lazy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學嘢要勤力，另一方面，都要用啱方法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 je5 jiu3 kan4 lik6, ling6 jat1 fong1 min6, dou1 jiu3 yung6 ngaam1 fong1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学习要努力，另一方面，也要用对方法。
examples.english_sentence: You need to work hard to learn, but on the other hand, you also need to use the right methods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工人工高，另一方面，壓力都好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 yan4 gung1 gou1, ling6 jat1 fong1 min6, aat3 lik6 dou1 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作工资高，另一方面，压力也很大。
examples.english_sentence: This job has a high salary, but on the other hand, the pressure is also very high.

english_meaning: on the other hand; on the other side; in contrast
explanation_mandarin: 表示与前面所说的事情形成对比或补充说明的另一种情况。
explanation_english: Indicates a different situation that contrasts with or complements what was said before.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿哥掛住打機，另一邊廂，阿妹就努力讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 go1 gwaa3 zyu6 daa2 gei1, ling6 jat1 bin1 soeng1, aa3 mui2 zau6 nou5 lik6 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哥哥沉迷于玩游戏，另一方面，妹妹努力学习。
examples.english_sentence: The elder brother is absorbed in playing games; on the other hand, the younger sister is studying hard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港樓價好貴，另一邊廂，好多人搵唔到工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 lau2 gaa3 hou2 gwai3, ling6 jat1 bin1 soeng1, hou2 do1 jan4 wan2 m4 dou2 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的房价很贵，另一方面，很多人找不到工作。
examples.english_sentence: Housing prices are very expensive in Hong Kong; on the other hand, many people can't find jobs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好勤力咁做嘢，另一邊廂，佢又好識得享受生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 kan4 lik6 gam2 zou6 je5, ling6 jat1 bin1 soeng1, keoi5 jau6 hou2 sik1 dak1 hoeng2 sau6 sang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很努力地工作，另一方面，他也懂得享受生活。
examples.english_sentence: He works very hard; on the other hand, he also knows how to enjoy life.

english_meaning: to make other plans; to consider alternatives; to deal with (a matter) separately
explanation_mandarin: 另外考虑，另做打算。指原来的计划或方案不可行，需要重新考虑或另外寻找解决办法。
explanation_english: To make other plans; to consider alternatives. It indicates that the original plan or scheme is not feasible and needs to be reconsidered or another solution needs to be found.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個計劃行唔通，我哋要另作打算喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 gai3 waak6 hang4 m4 tung1, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 ling6 zok3 daa2 syun3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划行不通，我们得另作打算了。
examples.english_sentence: This plan won't work; we need to make other plans.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事要另作處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 jiu3 ling6 zok3 cyu2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事需要另行处理。
examples.english_sentence: This matter needs to be dealt with separately.

english_meaning: to be treated as a separate case; to be considered separately; different circumstances apply
explanation_mandarin: 指另外做出不同的考虑和处理。表示某种情况特殊，不能一概而论。
explanation_english: Refers to handling a situation differently after separate consideration. It indicates that a certain situation is special and cannot be treated in the same way as others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個價錢包晒所有嘢，但係如果要做特別訂製嘅話，就另作別論啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gaa3 cin4 baau1晒 so2 jau5 je5, daan6 hai6 jyu4 gwo2 jiu3 zou6 dak6 bit6 ding3 zai3 ge3 waa2, zau6 ling6 zok3 bit6 leon6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个价钱包括所有东西，但是如果要特别定制的话，就另当别论了。
examples.english_sentence: This price includes everything, but if you want a special custom order, that's a different story.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 正常情況我哋唔會咁做，但係特殊情況就要另作別論。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 soeng4 cing4 fong3 ngo5 dei6 m4 wui5 gam2 zou6, daan6 hai6 dak6 syu4 cing4 fong3 zau6 jiu3 ling6 zok3 bit6 leon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 正常情况下我们不会这样做，但是特殊情况就要另当别论。
examples.english_sentence: Under normal circumstances we wouldn't do this, but special circumstances call for separate consideration.

english_meaning: additionally; plus; in addition to
explanation_mandarin: 在原有的基础上，另外增加。
explanation_english: To add something extra to the existing amount or cost.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個價錢係基本嘅， 另加服務費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gaa3 cin4 hai6 gei1 bun2 ge3, ling6 gaa1 fuk6 mou6 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个价格是基本的，另外加服务费。
examples.english_sentence: This price is the basic price, plus a service fee.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 埋單總共五百蚊， 另加一服務費就五百五十蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai4 daan1 zung2 gung1 ng5 baak3 man1, ling6 gaa1 jat1 cheng1 fuk6 mou6 fai3 zau6 ng5 baak3 ng5 sap6 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 结账一共五百元，另外加一成服务费就五百五十元。
examples.english_sentence: The total bill is five hundred dollars, and with an additional 10% service charge, it's five hundred and fifty dollars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果要快遞， 另加五十蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yu4 gwo2 jiu3 faai3 dai6, ling6 gaa1 ng5 sap6 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果需要快递，另外加五十元。
examples.english_sentence: If you need express delivery, it's an additional fifty dollars.

english_meaning: in addition, furthermore, besides, other, another
explanation_mandarin: 表示在原来之外再加上一个或一些。
explanation_english: Indicates adding one or more to the original.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住買呢件衫，另外仲要買條褲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 zyu6 maai5 ni1 gin6 saam1, ling6 ngoi6 zung6 jiu3 maai5 tiu4 fu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打算买这件衣服，另外还要买一条裤子。
examples.english_sentence: I plan to buy this shirt, and I also need to buy a pair of pants.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇另外嘅意見啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 ling6 ngoi6 ge3 ji3 gin3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有没有其他的意见啊？
examples.english_sentence: Do you have any other opinions?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 除咗佢之外，另外重有邊個嚟？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceoi4 zo2 keoi5 zi1 ngoi6, ling6 ngoi6 zung6 jau5 bin1 go3 lai4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 除了他之外，还有谁来？
examples.english_sentence: Besides him, who else is coming?

english_meaning: there is something else; additionally; furthermore
explanation_mandarin: 表示除了目前所说的，还存在其他的可能性、项目或内容。
explanation_english: Indicates that in addition to what has been mentioned, there is something else, other possibilities, items, or content.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個只係其中一個選擇，我哋另有其他計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zi2 hai6 kei4 zung1 jat1 go3 syun2 zaak6, ngo5 dei6 ling6 jau5 kei4 taa1 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这只是其中一个选择，我们另外有其他计划。
examples.english_sentence: This is just one option, we have other plans as well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢已經食咗飯，但係我想佢另有原因。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 ji5 ging1 sik6 zo2 faan6, daan6 hai6 ngo5 soeng2 keoi5 ling6 jau5 jyun4 yan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他已经吃饭了，但是我觉得他另有原因。
examples.english_sentence: He said he had already eaten, but I think he has another reason.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳已經冇位，不過我哋另有辦法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 ji5 ging1 mou5 wai2, bat1 gwo3 ngo5 dei6 ling6 jau5 baan6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 餐厅已经没有位置了，不过我们另有办法。
examples.english_sentence: The restaurant is already full, but we have another way.

mandarin_meaning: 另作别论 / 另外考虑
english_meaning: to be considered separately / to be another matter
explanation_mandarin: 表示在某种情况下，某件事要单独考虑，不能一概而论。
explanation_english: Indicates that something needs to be considered separately in a specific situation and cannot be generalized.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 平時返工遲到要罰錢，但係如果因為交通意外遲到就另當別論啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ping4 si4 faan1 gung1 ci4 dou3 jiu3 fat6 cin2, daan6 hai6 jyu4 gwo2 jan1 wai6 gaau1 tung1 ji3 ngoi6 ci4 dou3 zau6 ling6 dong3 bit6 leon6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 平时上班迟到要罚钱，但是如果因为交通事故迟到就要另作别论了。
examples.english_sentence: Normally, being late for work results in a fine, but if you're late due to a traffic accident, that's another matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋鋪頭啲嘢唔講價，但係熟客就另當別論。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 pou1 tau2 di1 je5 m4 gong2 gaa3, daan6 hai6 suk6 haak3 zau6 ling6 dong3 bit6 leon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们店里的东西不讲价，但是熟客就要另作别论了。
examples.english_sentence: We don't bargain at our shop, but loyal customers are another story.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對其他人好嚴格，但係對佢嘅仔女就另當別論。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 kei4 taa1 jan4 hou2 jim4 gaak3, daan6 hai6 deoi3 keoi5 ge3 zai2 neoi5 zau6 ling6 dong3 bit6 leon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对其他人很严格，但是对他的子女就要另作别论了。
examples.english_sentence: He is very strict with others, but his children are another matter.

english_meaning: to treat someone with special respect; to look at someone in a new light; to think more highly of someone
explanation_mandarin: 用不同于以往的眼光来看待。表示重视或刮目相看。
explanation_english: To view someone or something differently, usually with greater respect or admiration than before. It implies a change in perception and a higher opinion of the person or thing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從佢喺比賽攞咗冠軍之後，大家都對佢另眼相看。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 keoi5 hai2 bei2 coi3 lo2 zo2 gun3 gwan1 zi1 hau6, daai6 gaa1 dou1 deoi3 keoi5 ling6 ngaan5 soeng1 hon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从他在比赛中获得了冠军之后，大家都对他另眼相看。
examples.english_sentence: Since he won the championship in the competition, everyone treats him with special respect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你真係有實力，老闆自然會另眼相看。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 zan1 hai6 jau5 sat6 lik6, lou5 baan2 zi6 jin4 wui5 ling6 ngaan5 soeng1 hon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你真的有实力，老板自然会对你另眼相看。
examples.english_sentence: If you really have the ability, the boss will naturally treat you with special respect.

english_meaning: to find a new love; to move on to someone else (romantically)
explanation_mandarin: 指放弃旧的恋情，转而开始新的恋情。表示结束一段关系并寻找新的伴侣。
explanation_english: To abandon a previous romantic relationship and start a new one. It implies ending one relationship to find a new partner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢同條女分手之後，好快就另結新歡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tung4 tiu4 neoi2 fan1 sau2 zi1 hau6, hou2 faai3 zau6 ling6 git3 san1 fun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他和那个女朋友分手后，很快就另寻新欢了。
examples.english_sentence: After breaking up with that girlfriend, he quickly found a new love.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁傷心啦，天涯何處無芳草，咪另結新歡囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 soeng1 sam1 laa1, tin1 ngaai4 ho4 chu3 mou4 fong1 cou2, mai1 ling6 git3 san1 fun1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么伤心了，天涯何处无芳草，那就另寻新欢吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so sad, there are plenty of fish in the sea, just find a new love.

english_meaning: separately; on one's own; independently
explanation_mandarin: 表示独立地、分开地做某事。
explanation_english: Indicates doing something independently or separately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋另自搞掂佢啦，唔使煩你哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ling6 zi6 gaau2 dim6 keoi5 laa1, m4 sai2 faan4 nei5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们自己想办法搞定它吧，不用麻烦你们。
examples.english_sentence: We'll sort it out ourselves, no need to trouble you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢想另自發展事業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 soeng2 ling6 zi6 faat3 zin2 si6 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他想独自发展事业。
examples.english_sentence: He said he wants to develop his career independently.

english_meaning: separately; additionally; another time; separately organized
explanation_mandarin: 表示在其他时间或以其他方式进行。
explanation_english: Indicates something will be done at another time or in a separate manner. Often used to postpone or announce further arrangements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 詳情會另行通知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 cing4 wui5 ling6 hang4 tung1 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 详情会另行通知。
examples.english_sentence: Details will be notified separately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果情況有變，我哋會另行安排。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 cing4 fong3 jau5 bin3, ngo5 dei6 wui5 ling6 hang4 on1 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果情况有变，我们会另行安排。
examples.english_sentence: If the situation changes, we will make separate arrangements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 活動嘅取消，會另行公告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wut6 dung6 ge3 chui1 siu1, wui5 ling6 hang4 gung1 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 活动的取消，会另行公告。
examples.english_sentence: The cancellation of the event will be announced separately.

english_meaning: to seek elsewhere, to find another, to look for alternative options
explanation_mandarin: 重新寻找其他选择或方案。
explanation_english: To look for other choices, options, or solutions; to seek something elsewhere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份工唔啱做咪另覓囉，唔使咁愁嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 gung1 m4 ngaam1 zou6 mai1 ling6 mik6 lo1, m4 sai2 gam3 sau4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果工作不合适，那就另找一个吧，不用那么愁。
examples.english_sentence: If the job isn't suitable, just look for another one. There's no need to be so worried.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳嘅嘢食唔好食，我哋另覓地方食飯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 je5 sik6 m4 hou2 sik6, ngo5 dei6 ling6 mik6 dei6 fong1 sik6 faan6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西不好吃，我们另找地方吃饭吧。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant isn't good, let's find another place to eat.

english_meaning: calculated separately; extra charge
explanation_mandarin: 表示费用或者数量不包含在之前的总数中，需要单独计算。
explanation_english: Indicates that a cost or quantity is not included in the previous total and needs to be calculated separately; an extra charge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個價錢包唔包運費㗎？如果唔包嘅話，運費另計呀嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gaa3 cin2 baau1 m4 baau1 wan6 fai3 gaa3? jyu4 gwo2 m4 baau1 ge3 waa2, wan6 fai3 ling6 gai3 aa3 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个价格包含运费吗？如果不包含的话，运费是另算的吧。
examples.english_sentence: Does this price include shipping? If not, the shipping will be charged separately, right?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 套餐嘅嘢飲係跟餐嘅，但係甜品就要另計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou3 caan1 ge3 je5 yam2 hai6 gan1 caan1 ge3, daan6 hai6 tim4 ban2 zau6 jiu3 ling6 gai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 套餐里的饮料是包含在套餐里的，但是甜点就要另外算钱。
examples.english_sentence: The drinks in the set meal are included, but desserts are charged separately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 演唱會門票嘅價錢淨係包入場費，週邊商品就要另計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin2 coeng3 wui2 mun4 piu3 ge3 gaa3 cin2 zing6 hai6 baau1 jap6 coeng4 fai3, zau1 bin1 soeng1 ban2 zau6 jiu3 ling6 gai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演唱会门票的价格只包含入场费，周边商品需要另行计算。
examples.english_sentence: The price of the concert ticket only includes the admission fee, souvenirs are charged separately.

english_meaning: Find someone better/more qualified
explanation_mandarin: 婉拒某事，表示自己能力不足，建议对方寻找更适合的人选。
explanation_english: A polite way of declining to do something, indicating that you are not qualified or capable and suggesting that they find someone more suitable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個Project實在太複雜，我都係另請高明啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 Project sat6 zai6 taai3 fuk1 zaap6, ngo5 dou1 hai6 ling6 cing2 gou1 ming4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目实在太复杂了，我还是另请高明吧。
examples.english_sentence: This project is too complicated; I'd better suggest you find someone more capable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你問我搞掂佢，我都係另請高明啦，我唔識整電腦㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 man6 ngo5 gaau2 dim6 keoi5, ngo5 dou1 hai6 ling6 cing2 gou1 ming4 laa1, ngo5 m4 sik1 zeng2 din6 nou5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你问我搞定它，我还是另请高明吧，我不懂修理电脑啊。
examples.english_sentence: You're asking me to fix it? I'd better suggest you find someone more capable; I don't know how to repair computers.

mandarin_meaning: 另找出路; 另作打算
english_meaning: to find another way out; to seek alternative avenues; to look for another way
explanation_mandarin: 指在原有的道路或方法行不通的情况下，寻找新的出路或解决办法。
explanation_english: Refers to finding a new way out or solution when the original path or method is no longer viable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司執笠喇，我哋要另謀出路至得喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 zap1 lap1 laa3, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 ling6 mau4 ceot1 lou6 zi3 dak1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司倒闭了，我们得另找出路才行了。
examples.english_sentence: The company went bankrupt, we have to find another way out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條舊橋爛咗，我哋要另謀出路過河啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 gau6 kiu2 laan6 zo2, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 ling6 mau4 ceot1 lou6 gwo3 ho4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 旧桥坏了，我们得另找一条路过河了。
examples.english_sentence: The old bridge is broken, we need to find another way to cross the river.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢覺得喺呢度發展唔到，所以想另謀出路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gok3 dak1 hai2 ni1 dou6 faat3 zin2 m4 dou2, so2 ji5 soeng2 ling6 mau4 ceot1 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他觉得在这里发展不了，所以想另找出路。
examples.english_sentence: He feels he can't develop here, so he wants to find another way.

english_meaning: to seek a better position; to find a job with better prospects; to look for greener pastures
explanation_mandarin: 指离开原来的职位，去寻找更高、更好的工作机会。表示一种积极的跳槽行为。
explanation_english: Refers to leaving one's current position to seek a higher or better job opportunity. It indicates a proactive career move.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢覺得喺呢間公司冇乜發展機會，所以諗住另謀高就。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gok3 dak1 hai2 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 mou5 mat1 faat3 zin2 gei1 wui6, so2 ji5 lam2 zyu6 ling6 mau4 gou1 zau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他觉得在这家公司没什么发展机会，所以打算另谋高就。
examples.english_sentence: He feels there are not many development opportunities in this company, so he plans to seek a better position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆知道佢有能力，都預咗佢遲早會另謀高就。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 zi1 dou3 keoi5 jau5 nang4 lik6, dou1 jyu6 zo2 keoi5 chi4 zou2 wui5 ling6 mau4 gou1 zau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板知道他有能力，也预料到他迟早会另谋高就。
examples.english_sentence: The boss knows he is capable and anticipated that he would eventually seek a better position.

synonyms: [另起爐灶 (ling6 hei2 lou4 zou3) - start a new stove/business from scratch]

mandarin_meaning: 另立门户, 从头开始
english_meaning: to start afresh; to set up one's own shop; to strike out on one's own
explanation_mandarin: 比喻脱离原来的单位或集体，另外建立一套班子，重新开始。也指放弃原来的做法，另想办法。
explanation_english: An idiom that figuratively means to leave the original organization or group and establish a new team or system to start over. It also refers to abandoning the original method and thinking of another way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔撈呢份工喇，決定另起爐灶，自己開公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 lou1 ni1 fan6 gung1 laa3, kyut3 ding6 ling6 hei2 lou4 zou3, zi6 gei2 hoi1 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不干这份工作了，决定另起炉灶，自己开公司。
examples.english_sentence: He's not doing this job anymore. He's decided to start afresh and open his own company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳生意唔好，佢哋決定另起爐灶，轉做另一種菜式。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 saang1 ji3 m4 hou2, keoi5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 ling6 hei2 lou4 zou3, zyun2 zou6 ling6 jat1 zung2 coi3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅生意不好，他们决定另起炉灶，改做另一种菜式。
examples.english_sentence: The restaurant's business is not good, they decided to start afresh and switch to another type of cuisine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 既然舊嘅系統唔work，不如另起爐灶，重新開發一個新嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 jin4 gu6 ge3 hai6 tung2 m4 wok1, bat1 jyu4 ling6 hei2 lou4 zou3, cung4 san1 hoi1 faat3 jat1 go3 san1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 既然旧的系统不行，不如另起炉灶，重新开发一个新的。
examples.english_sentence: Since the old system doesn't work, why not start afresh and develop a new one.

synonyms: 重新開始 (cung4 san1 hoi1 ci2)
另立门户 (ling6 laap6 mun4 wu6)

mandarin_meaning: 另辟蹊径 (lìng pì xī jìng)
english_meaning: To blaze a new trail; to find a new way; to adopt an unconventional approach; to seek a different path
explanation_mandarin: 指另外开辟一条新路。比喻另找一种解决问题的方法。
explanation_english: To find a new solution or method to a problem; to explore an alternative route; to take an unconventional approach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果條舊路行唔通，不如我哋另闢蹊徑，諗下其他方法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 tiu4 gau6 lou6 hang4 m4 tung1, bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 ling6 pik1 hei1 ging3, lam2 haa5 kei4 taa1 fong1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果这条旧路行不通，不如我们另辟蹊径，想想其他方法。
examples.english_sentence: If the old path doesn't work, why don't we blaze a new trail and think of other methods?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗可以成功，佢決定另闢蹊徑，唔跟其他人嘅做法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 ho2 ji5 sing4 gung1, keoi5 kyut3 ding6 ling6 pik1 hei1 ging3, m4 gan1 kei4 taa1 jan4 ge3 zou6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了可以成功，他决定另辟蹊径，不跟其他人的做法。
examples.english_sentence: In order to succeed, he decided to blaze a new trail and not follow the methods of others.

synonyms: 另起爐灶 (ling6 hei2 lou4 zou3)

english_meaning: alternative, unconventional, different, eccentric
explanation_mandarin: 指不同于一般的、非主流的、独特的。
explanation_english: Refers to something that is different from the norm, non-mainstream, unique, or eccentric.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅打扮好另類，成日染埋啲鮮色嘅頭髮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 daa2 bun6 hou2 ling6 leoi6, seng4 jat6 jim5 maai4 di1 sin1 sik1 ge3 tau4 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的打扮很另类，经常染一些鲜艳颜色的头发。
examples.english_sentence: His style is very alternative; he always dyes his hair in bright colours.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅諗法好另類，成日都有啲古靈精怪嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 nam2 faat3 hou2 ling6 leoi6, seng4 jat6 dou1 jau5 di1 gu2 ling4 zing1 gwaai3 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的想法很另类，总是有些古灵精怪的东西。
examples.english_sentence: His thinking is very unconventional; he always has some quirky ideas.

english_meaning: to nag, to be garrulous, talkative, long-winded
explanation_mandarin: 指不停地说话，说个不停，令人厌烦。多用于形容人说话啰嗦。
explanation_english: To talk on and on, often annoyingly or tediously. Usually used to describe someone being long-winded or garrulous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再喺度叨啦，好煩啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 hai2 dou6 dou1 laa1, hou2 faan4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再在这里唠叨了，很烦啊！
examples.english_sentence: Stop nagging, it's annoying!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆成日都喺度叨，都唔知佢講乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai2 dou6 dou1, dou1 m4 zi1 keoi5 gong2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶总是唠叨个不停，都不知道她在说什么。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma is always nagging, I don't even know what she's saying.

english_meaning: To benefit from someone else's influence, to be favored, to bask in someone's glory; Thanks to you (formal)
explanation_mandarin: 表示因别人的恩惠或光荣而得到好处。比较客气的说法。
explanation_english: A polite expression used to express gratitude for being favored or benefiting from someone else's influence or glory. It often implies that one is benefiting from the other person's position, connections, or actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次能夠參與呢個項目，全靠你叨光啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 nang4 gau3 caam1 jyu5 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6, cyun4 kaau3 nei5 dou1 gwong1 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次能够参与这个项目，全靠你沾光了。
examples.english_sentence: I was able to participate in this project all thanks to you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 叨光晒，今晚餐飯食得好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dou1 gwong1 saai3, gam1 maan5 caan1 faan6 sik6 dak1 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 托福了，今晚这顿饭吃得很开心。
examples.english_sentence: Thanks to you, I really enjoyed dinner tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你咁照顧我，叨光晒!
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 gam3 ziu3 gu3 ngo5, dou1 gwong1 saai3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢你这么照顾我，托您的福了！
examples.english_sentence: Thank you for taking care of me so much, I am truly grateful!

english_meaning: to knock; to kowtow; to rap
explanation_mandarin: 敲打；磕头；（粤语中也指）轻微地打，敲。
explanation_english: To knock; to kowtow (kneel and touch the forehead to the ground as a sign of respect); (in Cantonese) to lightly hit or knock.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 叩門之前記得撳定門鐘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kau3 mun4 zi1 cin4 gei3 dak1 gam6 ding6 mun4 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 敲门之前记得先按门铃。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to ring the doorbell before knocking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年嘅時候，佢哋會去祠堂叩頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 ge3 si4 hau6, keoi5 dei6 wui5 heoi3 ci4 tong4 kau3 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年的时候，他们会去祠堂磕头。
examples.english_sentence: During the New Year, they will go to the ancestral hall to kowtow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔小心叩親咗個頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 siu2 sam1 kau3 can1 zo2 go3 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不小心碰到了头。
examples.english_sentence: I accidentally bumped my head.

english_meaning: to kowtow and express thanks, to express deep gratitude
explanation_mandarin: 表示非常感谢，通常带有比较正式或恭敬的意味。在古代，叩谢通常指磕头感谢。
explanation_english: To express deep gratitude, often with a formal or respectful tone. Historically, it referred to kowtowing to express thanks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你咁幫我，真係要叩謝你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 gam3 bong1 ngo5, zan1 hai6 jiu3 kau3 ze6 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 非常感谢你这样帮助我，真的要叩谢你。
examples.english_sentence: Thank you so much for helping me, I really need to express my deep gratitude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢收到獎學金之後，即刻返去叩謝父母。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sau1 dou2 zoeng2 hok6 gam1 zi1 hau6, zik1 hak1 faan1 heoi3 kau3 ze6 fu6 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他收到奖学金之后，立刻回去叩谢父母。
examples.english_sentence: After receiving the scholarship, he immediately went back to express his deep gratitude to his parents.

english_meaning: To knock on a door; By extension, to apply for a school place when the regular admission period is over.
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是敲门。在香港教育语境下，通常指在统一派位结束后，家长直接向学校递交申请，希望学校能额外录取自己的孩子。类似于补录或自主招生。
explanation_english: Literally means 'to knock on a door.' In the context of Hong Kong education, it usually refers to parents submitting applications directly to schools after the central allocation (uniform application) process, hoping the school will offer their child a place. Similar to late application or discretionary places.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年太多人叩門喇，學校都唔知點揀好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 taai3 do1 jan4 kau3 mun4 laa3, hok6 haau6 dou1 m4 zi1 dim2 gaan2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年太多人敲门了，学校都不知道怎么选才好。
examples.english_sentence: Too many people are applying directly to the schools this year. The schools don't know how to choose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個仔考得唔好，佢諗住叩門試下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 zai2 haau2 dak1 m4 hou2, keoi5 lam2 zyu6 kau3 mun4 si3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他儿子考得不好，他打算去敲门试试。
examples.english_sentence: His son didn't do well in the exam, he plans to try applying to schools directly (after the allocation).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 叩門位通常都好搶手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kau3 mun4 wai2 tung1 soeng4 dou1 hou2 coeng2 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 叩门的位置通常都很抢手。
examples.english_sentence: Discretionary places are usually very competitive.

english_meaning: to kowtow, to prostrate oneself (as a sign of respect or submission)
explanation_mandarin: 磕头，跪拜并以头触地，表示尊敬、感谢或顺从。
explanation_english: To kowtow is to kneel and bow one's head to the ground, especially as an act of deep respect, gratitude, or submission. It is a traditional gesture of reverence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊時啲人見到皇帝要叩頭㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 si4 di1 jan4 gin3 dou2 wong4 dai3 jiu3 kau3 tau4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古代的人见到皇帝要磕头的。
examples.english_sentence: In the old days, people had to kowtow when they saw the emperor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗求佢原諒，跪喺度不斷叩頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 kau4 keoi5 jyun4 loeng6, gwai6 hai2 dou6 bat1 dyun6 kau3 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了求他原谅，他跪在那里不停地磕头。
examples.english_sentence: In order to beg for his forgiveness, he knelt there and kept kowtowing.

english_meaning: only; just; measure word for certain objects
explanation_mandarin: 作为副词，表示仅仅，只有。作为量词，用于某些成对或单个的物体。
explanation_english: As an adverb, it means only, just. As a measure word, it's used for certain objects that come in pairs or are singular in nature.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我只係想幫你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi2 hai6 soeng2 bong1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是想帮你。
examples.english_sentence: I just want to help you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我得返一隻錶咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dak1 faan1 jat1 zek3 biu2 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只剩下一只手表了。
examples.english_sentence: I only have one watch left.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我淨係得一隻手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zing6 hai6 dak1 jat1 zek3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只有一只手。
examples.english_sentence: I only have one hand.

english_meaning: merely, only, just, simply
explanation_mandarin: 表示转折或补充说明，语气较轻。
explanation_english: Indicates a slight change of subject or a supplemental explanation; the tone is relatively light. It emphasizes that something is the only or main factor in a situation, often used to downplay the significance of something else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我只不過想幫吓你啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi2 bat1 gwo3 soeng2 bong1 haa5 nei5 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只不过想帮你一下而已。
examples.english_sentence: I just wanted to help you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢只不過係細路仔，唔好咁計較啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi2 bat1 gwo3 hai6 sai3 lou6 zai2, m4 hou2 gam2 gai3 gaau3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只不过是个小孩子，别太计较了。
examples.english_sentence: He's just a kid, don't be so fussy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我只不過係問吓啫，唔使咁緊張嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi2 bat1 gwo3 hai6 man6 haa5 ze1, m4 sai2 gam2 gan2 zoeng1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只不过是问一下而已，不用那么紧张。
examples.english_sentence: I was just asking, you don't need to be so nervous.

english_meaning: only; just; merely
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度轻微，相当于“只是”、“仅仅”。
explanation_english: Indicates a small degree or limitation, equivalent to "only," "just," or "merely."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我只係想幫你啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi2 hai6 soeng2 bong1 nei5 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是想帮你而已。
examples.english_sentence: I just wanted to help you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我只係問吓啫，唔使咁緊張嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi2 hai6 man6 haa5 ze1, m4 sai2 gam3 gan2 zoeng1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是问问而已，不用这么紧张。
examples.english_sentence: I'm just asking, no need to be so nervous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢只係細路仔，唔好咁計較啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi2 hai6 sai3 lou2 zai2, m4 hou2 gam3 gai3 gaau3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只是个小孩子，别太计较了。
examples.english_sentence: He's just a kid, don't be so serious about it.

english_meaning: have to; be forced to; have no choice but to
explanation_mandarin: 表示没有更好的办法，只能这样做了。
explanation_english: Indicates that there is no better option and one has to do it this way; have no alternative but to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 巴士冇車，我哋只好搭的士返屋企啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baa1 si2 mou5 ce1, ngo5 dei6 zi2 hou2 daap3 dik1 si2 faan1 uk1 kei2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没有巴士了，我们只好坐出租车回家了。
examples.english_sentence: There are no buses. We'll have to take a taxi home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 功課咁多，只好捱夜做喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 fo3 gam3 do1, zi2 hou2 ngaai4 je6 zou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 作业这么多，只好熬夜做了。
examples.english_sentence: There's so much homework, I have no choice but to stay up late to do it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔聽你講，你只好由得佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 ting1 nei5 gong2, nei5 zi2 hou2 jau4 dak1 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不听你的话，你只好随他去了。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't listen to you, you just have to leave him alone.

english_meaning: only have; merely; just
explanation_mandarin: 表示数量或范围的限定，相当于“只有”、“仅有”。
explanation_english: Indicates a limitation in quantity or scope, equivalent to "only have", "merely", or "just".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我只得十蚊咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zek3 dak1 sap6 man1 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只有十块钱而已。
examples.english_sentence: I only have ten dollars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢只得一個細佬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zek3 dak1 jat1 go3 sai3 lou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只有一个弟弟。
examples.english_sentence: He only has one younger brother.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋只得一個鐘頭時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zek3 dak1 jat1 go3 zung1 tau4 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们只有一个小时的时间。
examples.english_sentence: We only have one hour.

english_meaning: I'm afraid that; I fear that; probably
explanation_mandarin: 表示一种担忧或估计，意思是“恐怕”。
explanation_english: Expresses a worry or estimation, meaning 'I'm afraid that', 'I fear that', or 'probably'. It indicates a degree of uncertainty and potential negative outcome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日會落雨，只怕我哋去唔到行山咯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5, zi2 paa3 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 m4 dou2 haang4 saan1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天会下雨，恐怕我们去不了爬山了。
examples.english_sentence: It's going to rain tomorrow, I'm afraid we won't be able to go hiking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁夜都未返嚟，只怕有啲咩事發生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 je6 dou1 mei6 faan1 lai4, zi2 paa3 jau5 di1 me1 si6 faat3 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么晚都没回来，恐怕发生了什么事。
examples.english_sentence: He hasn't come back so late, I'm afraid something might have happened.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 只怕今次考試佢都唔合格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi2 paa3 gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 keoi5 dou1 m4 hap6 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 恐怕这次考试他也不及格。
examples.english_sentence: I fear that he will fail this exam again.

english_meaning: only, merely, just, simply, but
explanation_mandarin: 仅仅，不过，表示程度轻微或范围狭小；也表示转折。
explanation_english: Indicates a limited scope or degree; can also indicate a contrast or transition, similar to 'but'. It expresses 'only', 'merely', 'just', or 'simply'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我只是想幫吓手啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi2 si6 soeng2 bong1 haa5 sau2 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是想帮帮忙而已。
examples.english_sentence: I just want to lend a hand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢只是唔想去啫，唔係唔得閒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi2 si6 m4 soeng2 heoi3 ze1, m4 hai6 m4 dak1 haan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只是不想去而已，不是没空。
examples.english_sentence: He just doesn't want to go, it's not that he's not free.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我只是問吓，唔使咁緊張嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi2 si6 man6 haa5, m4 sai2 gam3 gan2 zoeng1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是问问而已，不用那么紧张。
examples.english_sentence: I'm just asking, no need to be so nervous.

english_meaning: only know how to; only able to; can only; will only
explanation_mandarin: 表示只会做某件事情，或者只会发生某种情况。
explanation_english: Indicates that someone only knows how to do something, or that only a certain situation will occur.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢只會打機，咩都唔識做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi2 wui5 daa2 gei1, me1 dou1 m4 sik1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只会打游戏，什么都不会做。
examples.english_sentence: He only knows how to play video games, he can't do anything else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你只會埋怨，有咩用啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zi2 wui5 maai4 jyun3, jau5 me1 yung6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你只会抱怨，有什么用啊？
examples.english_sentence: You only know how to complain, what's the point?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我只會講廣東話，唔識講普通話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi2 wui5 gong2 gwong2 dung1 waa2, m4 sik1 gong2 pou2 tung1 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只会说广东话，不会说普通话。
examples.english_sentence: I only know how to speak Cantonese, I don't know how to speak Mandarin.

english_meaning: only; only have
explanation_mandarin: 表示单一条件或结果，限定范围。
explanation_english: Indicates a single condition or result, limiting the scope.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我只有十蚊咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi2 jau5 sap6 man1 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只有十块钱而已。
examples.english_sentence: I only have ten dollars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢只有一個細佬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi2 jau5 jat1 go3 sai3 lou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只有一个弟弟。
examples.english_sentence: He only has one younger brother.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 只有努力先可以成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi2 jau5 nou5 lik6 sin1 ho2 ji5 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 只有努力才可以成功。
examples.english_sentence: Only through hard work can you succeed.

english_meaning: only ask for; only want; just hoping for
explanation_mandarin: 表示唯一的请求或愿望，强调期望不高，只要达到某个目标即可。
explanation_english: Expresses the only request or wish, emphasizing that expectations are not high, only needing to achieve a certain goal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我只求考試合格就得㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi2 kau4 haau2 si5 hap6 gaak3 zau6 dak1 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只求考试及格就行了。
examples.english_sentence: I only ask to pass the exam, and that's enough.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋只求平平安安噉過日子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zi2 kau4 ping4 ping4 on1 on1 gam2 gwo3 jat6 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们只求平平安安地过日子。
examples.english_sentence: We just hope to live peacefully and safely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家嘅樓價咁貴，我只求買到間細細哋嘅屋就夠晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ge3 lau2 gaa3 gam3 gwai3, ngo5 zi2 kau4 maai5 dou2 gaan1 sai3 sai3 dei2 ge3 uk1 zau6 gau3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的房价这么贵，我只求买到一间小小的房子就够了。
examples.english_sentence: House prices are so expensive now, I only hope to buy a small apartment and that will be enough.

english_meaning: only care about, only look after, just (do something)
explanation_mandarin: 表示专注于做某事，不用管其他；只顾着；只理会。
explanation_english: Indicates focusing on doing something without worrying about other things; only caring about; only looking after.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你只管做好你嘅嘢就得啦，其他嘢唔使理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zi2 gun2 zou2 hou2 nei5 ge3 je5 zau6 dak1 laa1, kei4 taa1 je5 m4 sai2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你只管做好你的事情就行了，其他的事情不用管。
examples.english_sentence: You just focus on doing your job well, and you don't need to worry about other things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我只管食嘢，其他嘢唔關我事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi2 gun2 sik6 je5, kei4 taa1 je5 m4 gwaan1 ngo5 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只管吃东西，其他的事情不关我的事。
examples.english_sentence: I only care about eating, other things are none of my business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢只管自己嘅利益，完全唔理人哋嘅感受。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi2 gun2 zi6 gei2 ge3 lei6 jik1, jyun4 cyun4 m4 lei5 jan4 dei6 ge3 gam2 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只顾自己的利益，完全不理别人的感受。
examples.english_sentence: He only cares about his own interests, completely disregarding other people's feelings.

jyutping: zi2 sin6 jyun1 joeng1 bat1 sin6 sin1
mandarin_meaning: 只羡慕恩爱夫妻，不羡慕神仙
english_meaning: To envy a loving couple more than immortals; To value earthly love over heavenly immortality.
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常羡慕恩爱夫妻的生活，认为能拥有美满的爱情胜过长生不老的神仙。
explanation_english: Describes the state of envying a loving couple, valuing their blissful relationship more than the immortality enjoyed by deities. It emphasizes the importance and beauty of earthly love and companionship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋咁恩愛，真係令人只羨鴛鴦不羨仙啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gam3 jan1 oi3, zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 zi2 sin6 jyun1 joeng1 bat1 sin6 sin1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们这么恩爱，真是让人只羡慕恩爱夫妻，不羡慕神仙啊。
examples.english_sentence: They are so loving, it really makes one envy a loving couple more than immortals.

mandarin_meaning: 光说不做; 雷声大雨点小
english_meaning: All talk and no action; much ado about nothing; a lot of noise but little substance.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻只有声势而没有实际行动或结果。
explanation_english: Metaphorically refers to a situation where there's a lot of hype, announcements, or preparation but ultimately little or no tangible result or action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋間公司話要搞個大project，但係到依家都只聞樓梯響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaan1 gung1 si1 waa6 jiu3 gaau2 go3 daai6 project, daan6 hai6 dou3 ji1 gaa1 dou1 zi2 man4 lau4 tai1 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司说要做一个大项目，但是到现在都只是只闻楼梯响。
examples.english_sentence: Their company said they were going to start a big project, but until now, it's just been all talk and no action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府話要解決房屋問題，但係講咗好多年，都係只聞樓梯響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 waa6 jiu3 gaai2 kyut3 fong4 uk1 man6 tai4, daan6 hai6 gong2 zo2 hou2 do1 nin4, dou1 hai6 zi2 man4 lau4 tai1 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府说要解决住房问题，但是说了好多年，都还是只闻楼梯响。
examples.english_sentence: The government said it would solve the housing problem, but after talking about it for many years, it's still all talk and no action.

english_meaning: can only; can but; have to
explanation_mandarin: 表示唯一的选择或条件。
explanation_english: Indicates the only choice or condition; can only do something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我只能盡力試下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi2 nang4 zeon6 lik6 si3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只能尽力试一下。
examples.english_sentence: I can only try my best.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日咁晏，我哋只能搭的士返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 gam3 aan3, ngo5 dei6 zi2 nang4 daap3 dik1 si2 faan1 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天这么晚，我们只能打车回家。
examples.english_sentence: It's so late today, we can only take a taxi home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 時間唔夠，我只能夠揀一份禮物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si4 gaan3 m4 gau3, ngo5 zi2 nang4 gau3 gaan2 jat1 fan6 lai5 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 时间不够，我只能选一份礼物。
examples.english_sentence: Not enough time, I can only choose one gift.

english_meaning: as long as; provided that; if only
explanation_mandarin: 表示条件，相当于“如果…就…”。
explanation_english: Indicates a condition; equivalent to "if... then...". Expresses that a certain result will follow if a certain condition is met.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 只要你肯努力，就一定會成功嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi2 jiu3 nei5 hang2 nou5 lik6, zau6 jat1 ding6 wui5 sing4 gung1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 只要你肯努力，就一定会成功的。
examples.english_sentence: As long as you are willing to work hard, you will definitely succeed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 只要有錢，乜嘢都買到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi2 jiu3 jau5 cin2, mat1 je5 dou1 maai5 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 只要有钱，什么都买得到。
examples.english_sentence: As long as you have money, you can buy anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 只要你鍾意，我就陪你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi2 jiu3 nei5 zung1 ji3, ngo5 zau6 pui4 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 只要你喜欢，我就陪你。
examples.english_sentence: As long as you like it, I will accompany you.

cantonese: 只要有恆心，鐵杵磨成針
jyutping: zi2 jiu3 jau5 hang4 sam1, tit3 cyu5 mo4 sing4 zam1
mandarin_meaning: 只要有恒心，铁杵磨成针
english_meaning: If you have perseverance, even an iron pestle can be ground into a needle.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻只要有决心和毅力，再难的事情也能成功。
explanation_english: This idiom means that with determination and perseverance, even the most difficult tasks can be accomplished.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做人千祈唔好咁易放棄，只要有恆心，鐵杵磨成針㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jan4 cin1 kei4 m4 hou2 gam3 ji6 fong3 hei3, zi2 jiu3 jau5 hang4 sam1, tit3 cyu5 mo4 sing4 zam1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做人千万不要轻易放弃，只要有恒心，铁杵磨成针啊。
examples.english_sentence: You should never give up easily in life. With perseverance, even an iron pestle can be ground into a needle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 讀書唔叻唔緊要，只要有恆心，鐵杵磨成針，總有一日會成功嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: duk6 syu1 m4 lek1 m4 gan2 jiu3, zi2 jiu3 jau5 hang4 sam1, tit3 cyu5 mo4 sing4 zam1, zung2 jau5 jat1 jat6 wui sing4 gung1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学习不好没关系，只要有恒心，铁杵磨成针，总有一天会成功的。
examples.english_sentence: It doesn't matter if you're not good at studying, with perseverance, even an iron pestle can be ground into a needle. You'll succeed one day.

cantonese: 只許州官放火，不准百姓點燈
jyutping: zi2 heoi2 zau1 gun1 fong3 fo2, bat1 zeon2 baak3 sing3 dim2 dang1
mandarin_meaning: 只许州官放火，不许百姓点灯
english_meaning: The magistrate is allowed to burn down the city, while the common people aren't even allowed to light a lamp.
explanation_mandarin: 形容统治者为所欲为，老百姓却连正当的权利都没有。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where those in power are allowed to do whatever they want, while the common people are denied even the most basic rights.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司啲政策都係只許州官放火，唔准百姓點燈，經理做錯嘢就冇事，我哋做錯少少嘢就俾人鬧到狗血淋頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 di1 zing3 caak3 dou1 hai6 zi2 heoi2 zau1 gun1 fong3 fo2, m4 zeon2 baak3 sing3 dim2 dang1, ging1 lei5 zou6 co3 je5 zau6 mou5 si6, ngo5 dei6 zou6 co3 siu2 siu2 je5 zau6 bei2 jan4 naau6 dou3 gau2 hyut3 lam4 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的政策都是只许州官放火，不许百姓点灯，经理做错事就没事，我们做错一点点事就被骂得狗血淋头。
examples.english_sentence: The company's policies are a case of 'the magistrate is allowed to burn down the city, while the common people aren't even allowed to light a lamp'. If the manager makes a mistake, nothing happens, but if we make a small mistake, we get severely scolded.

english_meaning: only need; only require
explanation_mandarin: 表示只需要某种条件或事物就足够了。
explanation_english: Indicates that only a certain condition or thing is necessary or sufficient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你只需簽個名就得啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zi2 seoi1 cim1 go3 meng2 zau6 dak1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你只需要签个名就可以了。
examples.english_sentence: You only need to sign your name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 只需一分鐘，我就搞掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi2 seoi1 jat1 fan1 zung1, ngo5 zau6 gaau2 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 只需要一分钟，我就搞定。
examples.english_sentence: It only takes one minute, and I'll finish it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我只需休息一下，就會好返。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi2 seoi1 hiu1 sik1 jat1 haa5, zau6 wui5 hou2 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只需要休息一下，就会好起来。
examples.english_sentence: I only need to rest for a while, and I'll be better.

english_meaning: only need to, just need to, only have to
explanation_mandarin: 表示只需要某种条件就能达到某种结果。
explanation_english: Indicates that a certain result can be achieved with just a certain condition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你只須要俾錢就可以買到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zi2 seoi1 jiu3 bei2 cin2 zau6 ho2 ji5 maai5 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你只要给钱就可以买到。
examples.english_sentence: You only need to pay to buy it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 只須要你肯努力，就一定會成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi2 seoi1 jiu3 nei5 hang2 nou5 lik6, zau6 jat1 ding6 wui5 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 只要你肯努力，就一定会成功。
examples.english_sentence: You only need to be willing to work hard, and you will definitely succeed.

english_meaning: to call; to shout; to order; to be called
explanation_mandarin: 发出声音，喊；称呼；命令；使唤。
explanation_english: To utter a sound; to shout; to call; to name; to order; to tell someone to do something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我叫咗外賣，就快到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 giu3 zo2 ngoi6 maai6, zau6 faai3 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我叫了外卖，快到了。
examples.english_sentence: I ordered takeout, it will arrive soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢大聲咁叫救命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daai6 seng1 gam2 giu3 gau3 ming6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他大声地喊救命。
examples.english_sentence: He shouted for help loudly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你叫咩名啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 giu3 me1 meng2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你叫什么名字啊？
examples.english_sentence: What's your name?

english_meaning: To make people (feel), to cause people (to do something), to be...
explanation_mandarin: 表示使人产生某种感觉或状态。常用在形容词前，表示强调该形容词的程度。例如：叫人伤心、叫人难忘。
explanation_english: Indicates causing people to have a certain feeling or state. Often used before an adjective to emphasize the degree of that adjective. For example, '叫人傷心' means 'making people sad,' and '叫人難忘' means 'unforgettable, making people not forget'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 套戲真係叫人感動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou3 hei3 zan1 hai6 giu3 jan4 gam2 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影真令人感动。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is really touching.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅行為叫人失望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hang4 wai4 giu3 jan4 sat1 mong6.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他吓得大叫一声，发出凄厉的叫声。
examples.english_sentence: He was so scared that he screamed loudly, letting out a shrill cry.

english_meaning: beggar
explanation_mandarin: 指以乞讨为生的人。多为贬义词。
explanation_english: A person who lives by begging; a beggar. Often used in a derogatory way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺街邊扮叫花，呃人嘅錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 gaai1 bin1 baan6 giu3 faa1, aak1 jan4 ge3 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天在街边装乞丐，骗人的钱。
examples.english_sentence: He pretends to be a beggar on the street all day long, tricking people out of their money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好信佢，佢扮可憐，其實佢係個叫花。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5, keoi5 baan6 ho2 lin4, kei4 sat6 keoi5 hai6 go3 giu3 faa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要相信他，他装可怜，其实他是个乞丐。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust him, he pretends to be pitiful, but he's actually a beggar.

english_meaning: to complain bitterly; to cry out in distress; to complain incessantly
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常痛苦，不停地叫苦。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone is in great pain or distress and is constantly complaining about it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試考得唔好，佢就叫苦連天，好似世界末日咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si5 haau2 dak1 m4 hou2, keoi5 zau6 giu3 fu2 lin4 tin1, hou2 ci5 sai3 gaai3 mut6 jat6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试没考好，他就叫苦不迭，好像世界末日一样。
examples.english_sentence: He complained bitterly about failing the exam, as if it were the end of the world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搬屋真係好辛苦，執嘢執到我叫苦連天。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun1 uk1 zan1 hai6 hou2 san1 fu2, zap1 je5 zap1 dou3 ngo5 giu3 fu2 lin4 tin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 搬家真的很辛苦，收拾东西收拾到我叫苦不迭。
examples.english_sentence: Moving house is really hard work, packing everything made me complain incessantly.

english_meaning: to peddle; to hawk; to sell by shouting
explanation_mandarin: 大声叫喊着售卖商品。
explanation_english: To sell goods by shouting or calling out to attract customers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺街邊叫賣魚蛋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gaai1 bin1 giu3 maai6 jyu2 daan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在街边叫卖鱼蛋。
examples.english_sentence: He is peddling fish balls on the street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲人會喺屋邨入面叫賣雪條。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 jan4 wui2 hai2 uk1 chyun1 jap6 min6 giu3 maai6 syut3 tiu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的人会在住宅区里面叫卖冰棒。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, people would hawk popsicles inside housing estates.

english_meaning: to wake up (someone); to call someone to get up
explanation_mandarin: 叫醒某人，使之起床。
explanation_english: To wake someone up; to cause someone to get out of bed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽朝朝都叫起我返學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 ziu1 ziu1 dou1 giu3 hei2 ngo5 faan1 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈每天早上都叫我起床上学。
examples.english_sentence: My mother wakes me up every morning to go to school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好叫起我呀，我想瞓多陣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 giu3 hei2 ngo5 aa3, ngo5 soeng2 fan3 do1 zan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要叫醒我，我想再睡一会儿。
examples.english_sentence: Don't wake me up, I want to sleep a little longer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鬧鐘壞咗，你聽日可唔可以叫起我呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 naau6 zung1 waai6 zo2, nei5 ting1 jat6 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 giu3 hei2 ngo5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的闹钟坏了，你明天可不可以叫醒我？
examples.english_sentence: My alarm clock is broken, can you wake me up tomorrow?

english_meaning: to start; to begin; to get going; to get cracking
explanation_mandarin: 表示开始做某事，开始行动或变得起劲。有催促或鼓励的意味。
explanation_english: Indicates the commencement of an action, starting a task, or becoming enthusiastic. Often implies encouragement or a prompt to begin something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 時間唔多喇，叫起手做嘢啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: si4 gaan3 m4 do1 laa3, giu3 hei2 sau2 zou6 je5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 时间不多了，开始工作吧！
examples.english_sentence: There's not much time left, let's get started on the work!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一聽到呢首歌就叫起手跳舞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 teng1 dou2 ni1 sau2 go1 zau6 giu3 hei2 sau2 tiu3 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一听到这首歌就开始跳舞。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as they heard this song, they started dancing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好啦，叫起手溫書啦，聽日考試呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 laa1, giu3 hei2 sau2 wan1 syu1 laa1, ting1 jat6 haau2 si3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 好了，开始复习吧，明天考试啊。
examples.english_sentence: Alright, let's start studying, there's an exam tomorrow.

english_meaning: to call a taxi/car; to book a ride
explanation_mandarin: 指通过电话、网络或其他方式预约出租车或网约车。
explanation_english: To call or book a taxi or ride-hailing service, usually by phone, app, or other means.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我趕時間，幫我叫車啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gon2 si4 gaan3, bong1 ngo5 giu3 ce1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我赶时间，帮我叫车吧。
examples.english_sentence: I'm in a hurry, please help me call a taxi.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家用App 叫車好方便嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 yung6 App giu3 ce1 hou2 fong1 bin6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在用App 叫车很方便的。
examples.english_sentence: It's very convenient to book a ride using an App nowadays.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺機場叫車返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 gei1 coeng4 giu3 ce1 faan1 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们从机场叫车回家。
examples.english_sentence: We called a taxi from the airport to go home.

english_meaning: to wake up (someone)
explanation_mandarin: 使某人从睡眠状态中醒来。
explanation_english: To rouse someone from sleep; to awaken someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該你聽朝七點叫醒我啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 nei5 ting1 ziu1 cat1 dim2 giu3 sing2 ngo5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请你明天早上七点叫醒我。
examples.english_sentence: Please wake me up at 7 a.m. tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽每日都叫醒我返學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 mui5 jat6 dou1 giu3 sing2 ngo5 faan1 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈每天都叫醒我上学。
examples.english_sentence: My mom wakes me up for school every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鬧鐘唔響，好彩我老婆叫醒我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 naau6 zung1 m4 hoeng2, hou2 coi2 ngo5 lo2 po4 giu3 sing2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的闹钟没响，幸好我老婆叫醒我。
examples.english_sentence: My alarm clock didn't ring, luckily my wife woke me up.

english_meaning: Since you're calling, call (someone else) as well; Call (someone) while you're at it.
explanation_mandarin: 在已经联系某个人的情况下，顺便也联系另外一个人。
explanation_english: To call someone else while already in contact with someone else; To invite someone else along while already making arrangements with someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去飲嘢，你叫開啊明，叫埋啊輝啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan1 heoi3 yam2 je5, nei5 giu3 hoi1 aa3 ming4, giu3 maai4 aa3 fai1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚去喝酒，你如果叫阿明的话，也顺便叫上阿辉吧。
examples.english_sentence: We're going for drinks tonight. If you're calling Ah Ming, call Ah Fai as well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你聽日約咗佢食飯，叫開叫埋佢啲朋友啦，熱鬧啲嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ting1 jat6 joek3 zo2 keoi5 sik6 faan6, giu3 hoi1 giu3 maai4 keoi5 di1 pang4 jau5 laa1, jit6 naau6 di1 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你明天约了他吃饭，顺便把他的朋友也叫上吧，热闹一点嘛。
examples.english_sentence: You've arranged to have dinner with him tomorrow, why don't you call his friends as well, it'll be more lively.

english_meaning: to challenge; to provoke; to call out (someone for a fight or competition); to dare someone to a duel
explanation_mandarin: 指在争斗或竞争前，向对方发出挑战或挑衅，通常带有强烈的敌意或竞争意识。
explanation_english: To issue a challenge or provocation to an opponent before a fight or competition. It often carries a strong sense of hostility or competitiveness. Originates from martial arts contexts where fighters would formally announce their challenge before engaging.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都嚟叫陣，煩都煩死人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 lai4 giu3 zan6, faan4 dou1 faan4 sei2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都来挑战，烦都烦死了。
examples.english_sentence: He comes to challenge us every day, it's so annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁衝動，叫陣唔係解決問題嘅方法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 cung1 dung6, giu3 zan6 m4 hai6 gai2 kyut3 man6 tai4 ge3 fong1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么冲动，挑战不是解决问题的方法。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so impulsive, challenging is not a way to solve problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩間公司成日叫陣，競爭好激烈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gaan1 gung1 si1 seng4 jat6 giu3 zan6, ging6 zang1 hou2 gik1 lit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两家公司经常挑战对方，竞争很激烈。
examples.english_sentence: The two companies often challenge each other, the competition is fierce.

english_meaning: to solicit prostitutes, to hire a prostitute
explanation_mandarin: 指男性花钱与妓女进行性交易。
explanation_english: Refers to a man paying money for sexual services with a prostitute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日北上叫雞，真係冇眼睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 bak1 soeng5 giu3 gai1, zan1 hai6 mou5 ngaan5 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常去北方嫖妓，真是看不下去。
examples.english_sentence: He often goes to the north to solicit prostitutes, it's really unbearable to watch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為有錢就可以亂咁叫雞。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为有钱就可以随便嫖妓。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think that just because you have money you can casually hire prostitutes.

english_meaning: To hire a male prostitute; to call for a male escort.
explanation_mandarin: 在娱乐场所或通过中介，付费聘请男性提供性服务。
explanation_english: To hire a male prostitute, typically in an entertainment venue or through an agency, for sexual services. The term '鴨 (aap3)' refers to a male prostitute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋去咗夜總會，仲叫埋鴨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 heoi3 zo2 je6 zung2 wui2, zung6 giu3 maai4 aap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们去了夜总会，还叫了男妓。
examples.english_sentence: They went to the nightclub and even hired male prostitutes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲人真係乜都做得出，連叫鴨都咁光明正大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 jan4 zan1 hai6 mat1 dou1 zou6 dak1 ceot1, lin4 giu3 aap3 dou1 gam3 gwong1 ming4 zing3 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的人真是什么都做得出来，连叫男妓都这么光明正大。
examples.english_sentence: People nowadays are really capable of anything; they even hire male prostitutes so openly.

english_meaning: to solicit a prostitute, to call for a prostitute
explanation_mandarin: 指花钱找妓女进行性交易的行为。这是一个贬义词，通常用于描述不道德的行为。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of paying for sexual services from a prostitute. It's a derogatory term used to describe immoral behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講佢成日去深圳叫鷄，真係唔要面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 keoi5 seng4 jat6 heoi3 sam1 zan3 giu3 gai1, zan1 hai6 m4 jiu3 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说他经常去深圳嫖娼，真不要脸。
examples.english_sentence: I heard he often goes to Shenzhen to solicit prostitutes, he's really shameless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度嘅治安唔好，夜晚好容易遇到有人叫鷄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 ge3 zi6 on1 m4 hou2, je6 maan5 hou2 jung4 ji6 jyu6 dou2 jau5 jan4 giu3 gai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的治安不好，晚上很容易遇到有人招嫖。
examples.english_sentence: The security here isn't good, it's easy to encounter people soliciting prostitutes at night.

english_meaning: to summon; to call; to convene
explanation_mandarin: 呼唤，召唤。指命令或请求某人前来。
explanation_english: To summon, to call. To order or request someone to come.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀老細召咗上辦公室。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 lou5 sai3 ziu6 zo2 soeng5 bun6 gung1 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被老板叫到办公室去了。
examples.english_sentence: He was summoned to the boss's office.

english_meaning: to summon; to call upon (esp. spirits, deities, etc.); to invoke
explanation_mandarin: 呼唤；召唤；多用于呼唤神灵或虚拟角色。
explanation_english: To summon or call upon something, often used to refer to spirits, deities, or virtual characters. It can also be used figuratively to mean to invoke or bring about something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺度召喚惡魔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 dou6 ziu6 wun6 ok3 mo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在召唤恶魔。
examples.english_sentence: They are summoning demons.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂咁召喚佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 ziu6 wun6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱召唤他。
examples.english_sentence: Don't summon him carelessly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個法術可以召喚出元素精靈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 faat3 seot6 ho2 ji5 ziu6 wun6 ceot1 jyun4 sou3 zing1 ling4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个法术可以召唤出元素精灵。
examples.english_sentence: This spell can summon elemental spirits.

english_meaning: to recall, to retract, to withdraw (a product or statement)
explanation_mandarin: 指收回已经发出或售出的东西，如产品、言论等。
explanation_english: To take back or withdraw something that has been issued or sold, such as a product or a statement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司因為發現產品有問題，決定召回所有貨品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 jan1 wai6 faat3 hin2 caan2 ban2 jau5 man6 tai4, kyut3 ding6 siu6 wui4 so2 jau5 fo3 pan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司因为发现产品有问题，决定召回所有货物。
examples.english_sentence: The company decided to recall all the goods because they found problems with the product.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢覺得之前講嘅嘢唔啱，所以想召回嗰句說話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gok3 dak1 zi1 cin4 gong2 ge3 je5 m4 ngaam1, so2 ji5 soeng2 siu6 wui4 go2 geoi3 syut3 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他觉得之前说的话不对，所以想收回那句话。
examples.english_sentence: He felt that what he said before was wrong, so he wanted to retract that statement.

english_meaning: to solicit prostitutes, to engage in prostitution
explanation_mandarin: 指男性为了性需求而花钱找妓女进行性交易。
explanation_english: Refers to a man paying a prostitute for sexual services.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日去蒲，仲會召妓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 heoi3 pou4, zung6 wui5 ziu6 gei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常去夜店玩，还会嫖妓。
examples.english_sentence: He often goes clubbing and also solicits prostitutes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 召妓係犯法嘅，唔好搞咁多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ziu6 gei6 hai6 faan2 faat3 ge3, m4 hou2 gaau2 gam3 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 嫖妓是犯法的，别搞那么多事。
examples.english_sentence: Soliciting prostitutes is illegal, don't make so much trouble.

english_meaning: to summon for an audience; to grant an audience
explanation_mandarin: 指上级或君主召唤下属或臣民前来觐见。
explanation_english: To summon someone, especially a subordinate, to appear before a superior or a monarch for an audience or meeting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾國王召見咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 gwok3 wong4 siu6 gin3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被国王召见了。
examples.english_sentence: He was summoned by the king.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日老細要召見我哋開會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 lou5 sai3 jiu3 siu6 gin3 ngo5 dei6 hoi1 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天老板要召见我们开会。
examples.english_sentence: The boss will summon us for a meeting tomorrow.

english_meaning: to convene; to convoke; to summon; to hold (a meeting)
explanation_mandarin: 指聚集众人举行会议或活动。
explanation_english: To convene a meeting, conference, or event; to gather people together for a specific purpose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下個禮拜會召開一次會議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 wui5 siu6 hoi1 jat1 ci3 wui6 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们下个星期会召开一次会议。
examples.english_sentence: We will hold a meeting next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司決定召開緊急會議，討論呢個問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 kyut3 ding6 siu6 hoi1 gan2 gap1 wui6 ji5, dou2 leon6 ni1 go3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司决定召开紧急会议，讨论这个问题。
examples.english_sentence: The company decided to convene an emergency meeting to discuss this issue.

english_meaning: to convene; to summon; to gather; to assemble
explanation_mandarin: 聚集人群或事物；把人召集起来。
explanation_english: To gather people or things together; to summon or assemble people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要召集所有嘅員工開會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 ziu6 zaap6 so2 jau5 ge3 wun4 gung1 hoi1 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要召集所有的员工开会。
examples.english_sentence: We need to convene all the employees for a meeting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢緊急召集晒啲朋友出嚟幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gan2 gap1 ziu6 zaap6 saai3 di1 pang4 jau5 ceot1 lai4 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他紧急召集所有的朋友出来帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: He urgently summoned all his friends to come out and help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 班長召集大家聽日去郊遊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baan1 zoeng2 ziu6 zaap6 daai6 gaa1 ting1 jat6 heoi3 gaau1 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 班长召集大家明天去郊游。
examples.english_sentence: The class monitor is gathering everyone to go on a picnic tomorrow.

english_meaning: Convener, Convenor, Organizer
explanation_mandarin: 指被指定或选举出来，负责召集会议、活动或组织的人。
explanation_english: A person who is designated or elected to be responsible for convening meetings, activities, or organizations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係今次籌款活動嘅召集人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 gam1 ci3 cau4 fun2 wut6 dung6 ge3 ziu6 zaap6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是这次筹款活动的召集人。
examples.english_sentence: He is the convener of this fundraising event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要搵返個召集人搞掂呢件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 wan2 faan1 go3 ziu6 zaap6 jan4 gaau2 dim6 ni1 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要找一个召集人来处理这件事。
examples.english_sentence: We need to find a convener to handle this matter.

mandarin_meaning: 张开（嘴巴）, 喊叫, 吸（烟）
english_meaning: to open (mouth), to shout, to puff (on a cigarette), to toot (a horn)
explanation_mandarin: 1. 张开嘴巴。 2. 大声喊叫。3. 吸（烟）。 4. 喇叭发出声音，鸣笛。
explanation_english: 1. To open one's mouth wide. 2. To shout loudly. 3. To puff (on a cigarette). 4. To toot a horn; the sound a horn makes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢忍唔住叭一聲大叫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan2 m4 zyu6 baa1 jat1 seng1 daai6 giu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他忍不住大叫一声。
examples.english_sentence: He couldn't help but shout loudly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺度叭煙啦，臭死人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 baa1 jin1 laa1, cau3 sei2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在这里抽烟了，臭死了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't smoke here, it stinks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車喺度叭叭叭，唔知做乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 hai2 dou6 baa1 baa1 baa1, m4 zi1 zou6 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车一直在叭叭叭地响，不知道在干什么。
examples.english_sentence: The car is tooting its horn repeatedly, I don't know what's happening.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日擘大個口得得叭，好似唔夠瞓噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 maak3 daai6 go3 hau2 dak1 dak1 baa1, hou2 ci5 m4 gau3 fan3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是张大嘴巴，好像没睡够一样。
examples.english_sentence: He always yawns with his mouth wide open, as if he didn't get enough sleep.

english_meaning: making a lot of noise; loud and noisy; to nag persistently
explanation_mandarin: 形容声音嘈杂，或者指人不停地抱怨、唠叨。
explanation_english: Describes a situation with a lot of noise, or someone who is constantly complaining or nagging.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部冷氣機成日叭叭聲，嘈到瞓唔著。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 laang5 hei3 gei1 sing4 jat6 baa1 baa1 seng1, cou4 dou3 fan3 m4 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台空调一直发出很大的噪音，吵得我睡不着。
examples.english_sentence: This air conditioner is always making a lot of noise, I can't sleep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺度叭叭聲，真係好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 baa1 baa1 seng1, zan1 hai6 hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天在那里唠叨，真让人烦。
examples.english_sentence: He's always nagging, it's really annoying.

english_meaning: ding (sound); ring; to ding; to remind (electronically)
explanation_mandarin: 模拟金属碰撞或电子设备发出的短促响亮的声音。也指用电子设备提醒。
explanation_english: Onomatopoeia for a short, sharp ringing sound, like that of a bell or electronic device. Also, to remind someone electronically, often through a notification.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電話叮咗一聲，睇嚟有人send咗訊息俾我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 waa2 ding1 zo2 jat1 seng1, tai2 lai4 jau5 jan4 send2 zo2 seon3 sik1 bei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电话响了一声，看来有人给我发了信息。
examples.english_sentence: The phone dinged once, it seems someone sent me a message.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我Set咗個鬧鐘，到時會叮醒我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 set3 zo2 go3 naau6 zung1, dou3 si4 wui5 ding1 sing2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我设置了闹钟，到时候会叮醒我。
examples.english_sentence: I set an alarm, it will ring and wake me up then.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 微波爐叮咗一聲，啲嘢食熱好啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mei1 bo1 lou4 ding1 zo2 jat1 seng1, di1 je5 sik6 jit6 hou2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 微波炉响了一声，食物热好了。
examples.english_sentence: The microwave dinged, the food is heated up.

english_meaning: Ding Ding (Hong Kong Tram); Tram
explanation_mandarin: 香港电车的俗称，因行驶时发出的“叮叮”声而得名。
explanation_english: A colloquial name for the Hong Kong Tram, so called because of the 'ding ding' sound it makes while running.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋搭叮叮去中環啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 daap3 ding1 ding1 heoi3 zung1 waan4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们坐叮叮车去中环吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's take the tram to Central.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你鍾唔鍾意搭叮叮啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung1 m4 zung1 ji3 daap3 ding1 ding1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你喜欢坐叮叮车吗？
examples.english_sentence: Do you like riding the tram?

mandarin_meaning: 糊里糊涂, 马马虎虎
english_meaning: Muddle-headed, scatterbrained, careless, doing things sloppily
explanation_mandarin: 形容人做事不认真、不细心，迷迷糊糊，马虎了事。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is careless, not detail-oriented, muddle-headed, and does things sloppily or half-heartedly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢唔好咁叮叮DumDum啦，會出事㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 m4 hou2 gam3 ding1 ding1 dum1 dum1 laa1, wui5 chut1 si6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做事不要这么糊里糊涂的，会出事的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so careless when you do things, it'll lead to problems!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人成日都叮叮DumDum，所以老闆唔畀佢做重要嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 sing4 jat6 dou1 ding1 ding1 dum1 dum1, so2 ji5 lou5 baan2 m4 bei2 keoi5 zou6 zung6 jiu3 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人总是糊里糊涂的，所以老板不让他做重要的事。
examples.english_sentence: He's always muddle-headed, so the boss doesn't let him do important things.

mandarin_meaning: 形容做事不靠谱，马马虎虎，敷衍了事。
english_meaning: Careless, sloppy, haphazard, perfunctory.
explanation_mandarin: 形容做事不认真，态度随便，草率了事的样子。带有轻微的贬义。
explanation_english: Describes something done carelessly, sloppily, or in a perfunctory manner. It implies a lack of seriousness and attention to detail, often with a slightly negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢唔好咁叮叮凳凳啦，咁樣好容易出錯㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 m4 hou2 gam3 ding1 ding1 dang3 dang3 laa1, gam2 joeng2 hou2 jung5 ji6 cheut1 cho3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做事不要这么马马虎虎，这样很容易出错的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so careless with your work, you're easily going to make mistakes like that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份功課叮叮凳凳，畀老師鬧咗一鑊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 fo3 ding1 ding1 dang3 dang3, bei2 lou5 si1 naau6 zo2 jat1 wok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的作业很马虎，被老师骂了一顿。
examples.english_sentence: His homework was done sloppily, and he was scolded by the teacher.

english_meaning: Ding Ding Candy (a type of traditional hard candy)
explanation_mandarin: 一种传统硬糖，通过敲击使其碎裂成小块食用。以前卖糖的人会用锤子敲打，发出“叮叮”的声音，因此得名。
explanation_english: A type of traditional hard candy, broken into smaller pieces for consumption by tapping it with a tool. The name comes from the 'ding ding' sound made by the vendor when tapping the candy with a hammer to break it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣成日喺街邊買叮叮糖食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 hai2 gaai1 bin1 maai5 ding1 ding1 tong2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候经常在街边买叮叮糖吃。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, I often bought Ding Ding candy to eat on the street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好少見到有人賣叮叮糖喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 siu2 gin3 dou2 jau5 jan4 maai6 ding1 ding1 tong2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很少见到有人卖叮叮糖了。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, it's rare to see people selling Ding Ding candy.

english_meaning: Dangling, swaying, loose and floppy; unsteady, uncertain
explanation_mandarin: 形容物体悬挂着，并且摇晃不稳，或者比喻人心神不定，拿不定主意。
explanation_english: Describes something hanging and swaying loosely, or metaphorically describes someone who is hesitant and indecisive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條裙條帶叮叮髧髧咁，好似就嚟甩咁款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 kwan4 tiu4 daai2 ding1 ding1 daam6 daam6 gam2, hou2 ci5 zau6 lai4 lat1 gam2 kwan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 裙子的带子摇摇晃晃的，好像要掉下来一样。
examples.english_sentence: The strap of the skirt is dangling, it looks like it's about to fall off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人叮叮髧髧咁，做嘢都唔靠得住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 ding1 ding1 daam6 daam6 gam2, zou6 je5 dou1 m4 kaau3 dak1 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人摇摆不定，做事都不靠谱。
examples.english_sentence: He is an unsteady person, you can't rely on him to get things done.

mandarin_meaning: 铃铛声; 比喻很棒、非常好
english_meaning: tinkle, jingle; great, excellent, fantastic
explanation_mandarin:
1. 描述铃铛发出的声音。
2. (香港俚语) 形容某事物非常棒、非常好，令人满意。
explanation_english:
1. Onomatopoeia for the sound of a bell. Tinkle, jingle.
2. (Hong Kong Slang) Used to describe something as great, excellent, fantastic, or satisfactory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽到門口嘅叮噹聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 dou2 mun4 hau2 ge3 ding1 dong1 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我听到门口的铃铛声。
examples.english_sentence: I heard the jingle of the bell at the door.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅表演真係叮噹，全場觀眾都拍爛手掌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 biu2 jin2 zan1 hai6 ding1 dong1, cyun4 coeng4 gun1 zung3 dou1 paak3 laan6 sau2 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的表演真是太棒了，全场观众都鼓掌。
examples.english_sentence: His performance was fantastic; the whole audience applauded wildly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅服務叮噹，下次一定會再嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 fuk6 mou6 ding1 dong1, haa6 ci3 jat1 ding6 wui5 zoi3 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的服务非常好，下次一定会再来。
examples.english_sentence: The service in this restaurant is excellent, I will definitely come again next time.

english_meaning: Immediately; right after; almost; nearly; neck and neck
explanation_mandarin: 形容时间、地点或事物非常接近，紧随其后。也形容竞争非常激烈，不分上下。
explanation_english: Describes something that is very close in time, location, or performance. Can also describe intense competition where participants are neck and neck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個跑得叮噹馬頭，真係唔知邊個贏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 paau2 dak1 ding1 dong1 maa5 tau4, zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 bin1 go3 wing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个跑得不分上下，真的不知道谁会赢。
examples.english_sentence: The two of them are running neck and neck, it's really hard to tell who will win.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車叮噹馬頭噉嚟到，差啲撞到我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 ding1 dong1 maa5 tau4 gam2 lai4 dou3, caa1 di1 zong6 dou2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那辆车紧接着就开来了，差点撞到我。
examples.english_sentence: The car came immediately after, almost hitting me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅銷售額叮噹馬頭，要再努力啲先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 siu1 sau3 ngaak6 ding1 dong1 maa5 tau4, jiu3 zoi3 nou5 lik6 di1 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的销售额差不多，需要再努力一些才行。
