examples.english_sentence: Our sales figures are almost the same, we need to work harder.

english_meaning: to urge; to exhort; to remind repeatedly; to warn earnestly
explanation_mandarin: 反复地嘱咐，提醒，使对方注意。
explanation_english: To urge or exhort someone repeatedly and carefully, reminding them to pay attention to something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽出門口之前，叮囑我記得閂好門窗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 ceot1 mun4 hau2 zi1 cin4, ding1 zuk1 ngo5 gei3 dak1 saan1 hou2 mun4 coeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈出门前，叮嘱我记得关好门窗。
examples.english_sentence: Before leaving, my mother urged me to remember to close the doors and windows properly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生叮囑佢要定時食藥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 ding1 zuk1 keoi5 jiu3 ding6 si4 sik6 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生叮嘱他要定时吃药。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor urged him to take his medicine regularly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 臨走嘅時候，佢不斷叮囑我哋要小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lam4 zau2 ge3 si4 hau2, keoi5 bat1 dyun6 ding1 zuk1 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 临走的时候，他不断叮嘱我们要小心。
examples.english_sentence: When leaving, he repeatedly reminded us to be careful.

english_meaning: rigid, inflexible, stiff, by the book
explanation_mandarin: 形容人做事或处理事情非常死板，不灵活，缺乏变通。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is rigid, inflexible, and follows rules strictly without considering the specific circumstances. Implies a lack of adaptability and creativity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好叮板，唔識變通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6嘢 hou2 ding1 baan2, m4 sik1 bin3 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很死板，不懂得变通。
examples.english_sentence: He's very rigid in his work, he doesn't know how to be flexible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁叮板啦，試下用新方法啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 ding1 baan2 laa1, si3 haa5 yung6 san1 fong1 faat3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么死板，试试用新方法吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so rigid, try using a new method.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條例就係咁寫，唔可以咁叮板㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 lai6 zau6 hai6 gam2 se2, m4 ho2 ji5 gam3 ding1 baan2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 条例是这样写的，但是不能这么死板啊。
examples.english_sentence: The rules are written like this, but you can't be so rigid about it.

english_meaning: to microwave (food); to heat up in a microwave
explanation_mandarin: 使用微波炉加热食物。
explanation_english: To heat up food using a microwave oven.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不如我哋叮熱啲餸食啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 ding1 jit6 di1 sung3 sik6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不如我们用微波炉加热一下菜吃吧。
examples.english_sentence: Why don't we microwave the dishes and eat?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個飯盒叮熱三分鐘就食得㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 faan6 hap6 ding1 jit6 saam1 fan1 zung1 zau6 sik6 dak1 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个饭盒用微波炉加热三分钟就可以吃了。
examples.english_sentence: You can eat this lunchbox after microwaving it for three minutes.

english_meaning: to get rid of (someone); to send (someone) away; to dismiss
explanation_mandarin: 指用一种不太客气的方式把人打发走或者赶走，含有不耐烦或轻视的意味。
explanation_english: To dismiss or send someone away in an impolite or dismissive manner. It carries a sense of impatience or contempt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都喺度嘈，經理頂唔順，咪叮走咗佢囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai2 dou6 cou4, ging1 lei5 ding2 m4 seon6, mai1 ding1 zau2 zo2 keoi5 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天都在这里吵闹，经理受不了，就把他给打发走了。
examples.english_sentence: He was always making noise here, the manager couldn't stand it, so he got rid of him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲乞兒咁煩，快啲叮走佢哋啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 hat1 ji4 gam3 faan4, faai3 di1 ding1 zau2 keoi5 dei6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些乞丐真烦人，快点把他们赶走吧！
examples.english_sentence: These beggars are so annoying, quickly get rid of them!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆唔鍾意佢，所以咪叮走咗佢囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 m4 zung1 ji3 keoi5, so2 ji5 mai1 ding1 zau2 zo2 keoi5 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板不喜欢他，所以就把他解雇了。
examples.english_sentence: The boss didn't like him, so he dismissed him.

mandarin_meaning: 可以; 能够; 值得
english_meaning: can; may; able to; worth; but; indeed
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 助动词; 副词; 形容词
explanation_mandarin: 表示许可、能够、值得等意义。也可表示转折、强调等语气。
explanation_english: Expresses permission, ability, worthiness, etc. It can also indicate a change of subject or emphasis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以幫我手？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 sau2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以帮我一下忙吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can you give me a hand?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書都可讀嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 dou1 ho2 duk6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书还是值得读的。
examples.english_sentence: This book is worth reading.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唱歌可好聽㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 coeng3 go1 ho2 hou2 teng1 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他唱歌可是很好听的！
examples.english_sentence: He sings really well!

english_meaning: Exactly; That's right; Indeed; You're right
explanation_mandarin: 表示赞同或肯定对方的说法，相当于“可不是吗”、“正是”。
explanation_english: Expresses agreement or affirmation with the other person's statement. It's equivalent to 'That's right', 'Exactly', or 'Indeed'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日真係好熱啊！可不是，熱到人都暈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 zan1 hai6 hou2 jit6 aa3! ho2 bat1 si6, jit6 dou3 jan4 dou1 wan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天真热啊！可不是，热得人都晕了。
examples.english_sentence: It's really hot today! Exactly, it's so hot it makes you dizzy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部戲真係好好睇喎！可不是，我睇咗三次啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 hei3 zan1 hai6 hou2 hou2 tai2 wo3! ho2 bat1 si6, ngo5 tai2 zo2 saam1 ci3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影真好看啊！可不是，我已经看了三次了！
examples.english_sentence: This movie is really good! That's right, I've already watched it three times!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港啲樓真係好貴啊！可不是，普通人都買唔起。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 di1 lau2 zan1 hai6 hou2 gwai3 aa3! ho2 bat1 si6, pou2 tung1 jan4 dou1 maai5 m4 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的房子真贵啊！可不是，普通人都买不起。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's apartments are really expensive! Indeed, ordinary people can't afford them.

english_meaning: lovable, charming, endearing, pleasing
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或事物可爱、讨人喜欢。
explanation_english: Describes a person or thing that is lovable, charming, and pleasing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個細路女真係好可人啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sai3 lou6 neoi2 zan1 hai6 hou2 ho2 jan4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个小女孩真是太可爱了。
examples.english_sentence: This little girl is so lovely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好可人，所以好多人鍾意佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 ho2 jan4, so2 ji5 hou2 do1 jan4 zung1 ji3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她这个人很讨人喜欢，所以很多人喜欢她。
examples.english_sentence: She is a very likeable person, so many people like her.

english_meaning: can; may; able to; permissible; okay; all right
explanation_mandarin: 表示许可，可能，能够，还可以表示好，行，没问题。
explanation_english: Indicates permission, possibility, ability, or acceptance. Can also mean 'okay' or 'all right'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我可唔可以去廁所呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 heoi3 ci3 so2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我可以去洗手间吗？
examples.english_sentence: May I go to the toilet?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁樣可以㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam2 joeng2 ho2 ji5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这样可以的。
examples.english_sentence: That's okay.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以幫我手呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 sau2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以帮我一下吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can you give me a hand?

english_meaning: It can be said that; One could say; In a way; Arguably
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 副词 (fùcí - adverb); 动词短语 (dòngcí duǎnyǔ - verb phrase)
explanation_mandarin: 表示在某种程度上可以这样说，表示语气缓和或不太确定。
explanation_english: Indicates that something can be said in a certain way, often used to soften the tone or express uncertainty. Used to introduce an opinion or statement that is not entirely definitive but still valid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個價錢可以話係幾抵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gaa3 cin2 ho2 ji5 waa6 hai6 gei2 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个价钱可以说很划算。
examples.english_sentence: It can be said that this price is quite a bargain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅成功，可以話係靠晒努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing4 gung1, ho2 ji5 waa6 hai6 kaau3 saai3 nu5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的成功，可以说完全是靠努力。
examples.english_sentence: One could say that his success is entirely due to hard work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳，可以話係全港最好食嘅一間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1, ho2 ji5 waa6 hai6 cyun4 gong2 zeoi3 hou2 sik6 ge3 jat1 gaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅，可以说是在全香港最好吃的一家。
examples.english_sentence: Arguably, this restaurant is one of the best in Hong Kong.

synonyms: 可以咁講 (ho2 ji5 gam2 gong2)

english_meaning: trustworthy; credible; believable
explanation_mandarin: 值得相信的；可以相信的。
explanation_english: Worthy of trust; able to be believed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢唔係好可信，你要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 m4 hai6 hou2 ho2 seon3, nei5 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话不太可信，你要小心点。
examples.english_sentence: What he says is not very trustworthy, you need to be careful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告嘅數據好可信，可以參考。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ge3 sou3 geoi3 hou2 ho2 seon3, ho2 ji5 caam1 haau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告的数据很可信，可以参考。
examples.english_sentence: The data in this report is very credible, you can use it as a reference.

english_meaning: avoid if possible; can be avoided, then avoid it
explanation_mandarin: 如果可以避免，就尽量避免。表示一种避免麻烦或者不必要的行为的态度。
explanation_english: If something can be avoided, then avoid it. It expresses an attitude of avoiding trouble or unnecessary actions. Suggests a preference for minimizing involvement or effort where feasible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果可以自己煮飯，可免則免出去食啦，而家啲嘢咁貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ho2 ji5 zi6 gei2 zyu2 faan6, ho2 min5 zak1 min5 cheot1 heoi3 sik6 laa1, ji4 gaa1 di1 je5 gam3 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果可以自己做饭，能免则免出去吃吧，现在东西这么贵。
examples.english_sentence: If you can cook yourself, avoid eating out if possible. Things are so expensive these days.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲應酬可免則免啦，咁攰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 ying1 chau4 ho2 min5 zak1 min5 laa1, gam3 leoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些应酬能免则免吧，这么累。
examples.english_sentence: Avoid these social gatherings if possible, I'm so tired.

english_meaning: cocaine
explanation_mandarin: 一种强烈的兴奋剂，从古柯叶中提取。
explanation_english: A strong stimulant most often used as a recreational drug. It is commonly snorted, inhaled as smoke, or as a solution injected into a vein.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為吸食可卡因而俾差人捉咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 kap1 sik6 ho2 kaa1 jan1 ji4 bei2 caai1 jan2 zuk1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为吸食可卡因而被警察抓了。
examples.english_sentence: He was arrested by the police for taking cocaine.

english_meaning: desirable; commendable; worth adopting; advisable
explanation_mandarin: 值得采取或学习的；值得赞许的。
explanation_english: Worth adopting or learning; commendable; referring to something that is worthy of praise, adoption or learning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個方法都幾可取嘅，不妨試吓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fong1 faat3 dou1 gei2 ho2 ceoi2 ge3, bat1 fong4 si3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个方法还挺可取的，不妨试试。
examples.english_sentence: This method is quite commendable, why not give it a try?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅意見都幾可取，可以考慮下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ji3 gin3 dou1 gei2 ho2 ceoi2, ho2 ji5 haam3 leuk6 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的意见也挺可取的，可以考虑一下。
examples.english_sentence: His opinion is quite desirable, it's worth considering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅福利都幾可取。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 fuk1 lei6 dou1 gei2 ho2 ceoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的福利还挺值得称赞的。
examples.english_sentence: The benefits of this company are quite desirable.

synonyms: 值得參考 (zik6 dak1 caam1 kaau2)

english_meaning: delicious; tasty; palatable
explanation_mandarin: 形容食物味道好，令人想吃。
explanation_english: Describes food that tastes good and makes one want to eat it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅點心好可口，我成日嚟食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 dim2 sam1 hou2 ho2 hau2, ngo5 seng4 jat6 lai4 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的点心很可口，我经常来吃。
examples.english_sentence: The dim sum at this restaurant is very delicious, I come here to eat often.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個湯好可口，飲多碗啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 tong1 hou2 ho2 hau2, jam2 do1 wun2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个汤很好喝，多喝一碗吧。
examples.english_sentence: This soup is very tasty, have another bowl.

english_meaning: Coca-Cola
explanation_mandarin: 一种受欢迎的碳酸饮料，品牌名为“可口可乐”。
explanation_english: A popular carbonated beverage, brand name Coca-Cola.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想飲罐可口可樂呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 jam2 gun3 ho2 hau2 ho2 lok6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想喝一罐可口可乐呀。
examples.english_sentence: I want to drink a can of Coca-Cola.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日好熱呀，飲杯可口可樂應該好正。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 hou2 jit6 aa3, jam2 bui1 ho2 hau2 ho2 lok6 jing1 goi1 hou2 zeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天好热啊，喝杯可口可乐应该很棒。
examples.english_sentence: It's so hot today, drinking a cup of Coca-Cola should be great.

english_meaning: Cocoa; chocolate
explanation_mandarin: 指巧克力或者可可豆，也可以指用可可粉制成的饮品。
explanation_english: Refers to cocoa, chocolate, or a drink made from cocoa powder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意飲熱可可啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 yam2 jit6 ho2 ho2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我非常喜欢喝热可可。
examples.english_sentence: I really like drinking hot cocoa.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個蛋糕有可可味，好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 daan6 gou1 jau5 ho2 ho2 mei6, hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个蛋糕有巧克力味，很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: This cake has a chocolate flavor, it's very delicious.

english_meaning: cocoa powder
explanation_mandarin: 可可豆研磨成的粉末，常用于制作巧克力、甜点和饮料。
explanation_english: Cocoa powder is a powder made from roasted cocoa beans, often used in making chocolate, desserts, and beverages.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想用可可粉整朱古力蛋糕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 yung6 ho2 ho2 fan2 zing2 zyu1 gu2 lik6 daan6 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想用可可粉做巧克力蛋糕。
examples.english_sentence: I want to use cocoa powder to make a chocolate cake.

english_meaning: cocoa bean
explanation_mandarin: 指可可树的种子，是制作巧克力和可可粉的主要原料。
explanation_english: The seed of the cacao tree, the primary raw material used in making chocolate and cocoa powder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲可可豆係嚟自南美洲嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 ho2 ho2 dau6 hai6 lai4 zi6 naam4 mei5 zau1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些可可豆来自南美洲。
examples.english_sentence: These cocoa beans come from South America.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想買啲可可豆返屋企整朱古力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 di1 ho2 ho2 dau6 faan1 uk1 kei2 zing2 zyu1 gu1 lik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想买些可可豆回家做巧克力。
examples.english_sentence: I want to buy some cocoa beans to make chocolate at home.

english_meaning: May I?; Is it possible?; Whether or not; can or cannot
explanation_mandarin: 表示询问或征求意见，相当于“是否”、“可以不可以”。
explanation_english: Used to ask for permission or opinion, equivalent to 'may I?', 'is it possible?', or 'can or cannot'. Indicates a question regarding the possibility of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我可否借用你部電腦呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ho2 fau2 ze3 jung6 nei5 bou6 din6 nou5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我可以借用你的电脑吗？
examples.english_sentence: May I borrow your computer?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可否幫我個忙呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 fau2 bong1 ngo5 go3 mong4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以帮我一个忙吗？
examples.english_sentence: Could you do me a favor?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 可否詳細啲解釋下呢個情況？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 fau2 coeng4 sai3 di1 gai2 sik1 haa5 ni1 go3 cing4 fong3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 可以更详细地解释一下这个情况吗？
examples.english_sentence: Could you explain this situation in more detail?

english_meaning: gratifying; delightful; pleasing
explanation_mandarin: 令人高兴的；值得庆幸的。
explanation_english: Deserving of joy or happiness; something that brings pleasure or satisfaction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到佢升職嘅消息，真係一件可喜嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou2 keoi5 sing1 zik1 ge3 siu1 sik1, zan1 hai6 jat1 gin6 ho2 hei2 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到他升职的消息，真是一件可喜的事。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing the news of his promotion is truly a gratifying thing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過多年嘅努力，佢終於成功咗，真係可喜可賀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 do1 nin4 ge3 nu5 lik6, keoi5 zung1 jyu1 sing4 gung1 zo2, zan1 hai6 ho2 hei2 ho2 ho6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过多年的努力，他终于成功了，真是可喜可贺。
examples.english_sentence: After years of effort, he finally succeeded, it's truly gratifying and congratulatory.

english_meaning: Congratulations!
explanation_mandarin: 表示值得高兴和祝贺的事情。
explanation_english: Expressing something is worth celebrating and congratulating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 恭喜你升職，真係可喜可賀啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 hei2 nei5 sing1 zik1, zan1 hai6 ho2 hei2 ho2 ho6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 恭喜你升职，真是可喜可贺啊！
examples.english_sentence: Congratulations on your promotion, it's really something to celebrate!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿仔考到大學，可喜可賀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 zai2 haau2 dou2 daai6 hok6, ho2 hei2 ho2 ho6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 儿子考上大学了，可喜可贺！
examples.english_sentence: My son got into university, congratulations!

english_meaning: commendable, praiseworthy, laudable
explanation_mandarin: 值得赞扬和嘉奖的。形容行为、品质等表现出色。
explanation_english: Worthy of praise and commendation; describing behavior, qualities, etc., that are outstanding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅精神好可嘉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zing1 san4 hou2 ho2 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的精神很可嘉。
examples.english_sentence: His spirit is very commendable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你能夠喺咁困難嘅情況下堅持落去，真係好可嘉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 nang4 gau3 hai2 gam3 kwan3 naan4 ge3 cing4 kwong3 haa6 gin1 ci4 lok6 heoi3, zan1 hai6 hou2 ho2 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你能够在这么困难的情况下坚持下去，真是很可嘉。
examples.english_sentence: It's truly commendable that you were able to persevere in such a difficult situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗保護環境所做嘅努力，十分可嘉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 bou2 wu6 waan4 ging2 so2 zou6 ge3 nou5 lik6, sap6 fan1 ho2 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为了保护环境所做的努力，十分可嘉。
examples.english_sentence: His efforts to protect the environment are very commendable.

english_meaning: commendable; having both strengths and weaknesses; having aspects worthy of praise
explanation_mandarin: 指有值得赞赏和改进的地方，并非完美但总体来说还不错。
explanation_english: Used to describe something that has both good and bad points, or areas where it can be improved. It's not perfect, but generally acceptable and has merits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次考試嘅成績可圈可點，有啲嘢做得好，有啲嘢仲要努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ge3 sing4 zik1 ho2 hyun1 ho2 dim2, jau5 di1 je5 zou6 dak1 hou2, jau5 di1 je5 zung6 jiu3 nou5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次考试的成绩可圈可点，有些地方做得好，有些地方还要努力。
examples.english_sentence: His exam results this time are commendable, some things were done well, but there are still areas he needs to work harder on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢齣戲可圈可點，演員嘅表現唔錯，但係劇情有啲老套。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ceot1 hei3 ho2 hyun1 ho2 dim2, jin2 jyun4 ge3 biu2 hin3 m4 co3, daan6 hai6 kek6 cing4 jau5 di1 lou5 tou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部戏可圈可点，演员的表演不错，但是剧情有些老套。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is commendable, the actors' performances are good, but the plot is a bit cliché.

english_meaning: plasticity, malleability, adaptability
explanation_mandarin: 指物体受外力作用后，能改变形状而不发生断裂的性质，也指人或事物具有改变和发展的潜力。
explanation_english: The quality of being easily shaped or molded; the ability to change or be changed easily to suit different conditions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個年輕人嘅可塑性好高，學嘢好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 nin4 hing1 jan4 ge3 ho2 sok3 sing3 hou2 gou1, hok6 je5 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个年轻人可塑性很高，学东西很快。
examples.english_sentence: This young person has high plasticity; he learns things quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 黏土嘅可塑性好強，好容易整成唔同嘅形狀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nim1 tou2 ge3 ho2 sok3 sing3 hou2 koeng4, hou2 jung4 yi6 zing2 sing4 m4 tung4 ge3 ying4 zong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 黏土的可塑性很强，很容易做成不同的形状。
examples.english_sentence: Clay has strong plasticity and is easily shaped into different forms.

english_meaning: Can be big or small; can be a big deal or a small deal; can be serious or not serious.
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情的严重程度或影响可以很大也可以很小，视情况而定。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where the seriousness or impact can vary greatly, depending on the circumstances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事可大可小，睇吓點處理囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ho2 daai6 ho2 siu2, tai2 haa5 dim2 cyu2 lei5 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事可大可小，看看怎么处理吧。
examples.english_sentence: This matter can be a big deal or a small deal, depending on how it's handled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘅嘢可大可小，要小心啲啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 ge3 je5 ho2 daai6 ho2 siu2, jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说的东西可大可小，要小心点啊。
examples.english_sentence: What you're saying could be a big deal or a small deal, so be careful.

mandarin_meaning: 太可恶了; 真是可气
english_meaning: How outrageous!; It's infuriating!
explanation_mandarin: 表示一种强烈的愤慨、不满或愤怒的情绪。
explanation_english: Expresses a strong feeling of indignation, dissatisfaction, or anger. Often used to emphasize the speaker's frustration or outrage at a situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢呃我錢，可怒也！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aak1 ngo5 cin2, ho2 nou6 jaa5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他骗我的钱，真是可气！
examples.english_sentence: He scammed me out of my money, how outrageous!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲老細成日OT，可怒也！
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 lou5 sai3 sing4 jat6 OT, ho2 nou6 jaa5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板们总是让加班，真是可气！
examples.english_sentence: The bosses always make us work overtime, it's infuriating!

english_meaning: terrible, dreadful, awful, frightening, scary
explanation_mandarin: 形容令人感到害怕、恐怖或厌恶。
explanation_english: Describes something that is frightening, scary, terrible, or inspires fear or disgust.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲好可怕，睇到我驚都驚死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 hou2 ho2 paai3, tai2 dou3 ngo5 geng1 dou1 geng1 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影很可怕，我看得害怕死了。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is so scary, I was scared to death watching it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個車禍現場好可怕，周圍都係血。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 che1 wo6 jin6 cheung2 hou2 ho2 paai3, zau1 wai4 dou1 hai6 hyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个车祸现场很可怕，到处都是血。
examples.english_sentence: The car accident scene was terrible, there was blood everywhere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好可怕，成日都鬧人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 yan4 hou2 ho2 paai3, seng4 yat6 dou1 naau6 yan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很可怕，总是骂人。
examples.english_sentence: He is a terrible person, always scolding people.

english_meaning: terrifying; horrible; dreadful; frightening
explanation_mandarin: 令人害怕，引起恐惧的。
explanation_english: Something that is terrifying or horrible, causing fear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個故事嘅情節好可怖，聽到我都起雞皮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 gu3 si6 ge3 cing4 zit3 hou2 ho2 bou3, teng1 dou3 ngo5 dou1 hei2 gai1 pei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 故事的情节很可怕，听得我都起鸡皮疙瘩。
examples.english_sentence: The plot of the story is so terrifying, it gave me goosebumps.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間屋咁黑咁靜，真係可怖到令人唔敢入去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 uk1 gam3 hak1 gam3 zing6, zan1 hai6 ho2 bou3 dou3 ling6 jan4 m4 gam2 jap6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间屋子这么黑这么安静，真是可怕得让人不敢进去。
examples.english_sentence: This house is so dark and quiet, it's truly terrifying that people don't dare to go in.

english_meaning: shameful, disgraceful, despicable
explanation_mandarin: 表示令人感到羞耻，不光彩，不道德。
explanation_english: Describes something that is shameful, disgraceful, or despicable, causing a feeling of dishonor or moral repugnance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢呃人錢，真係可恥！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaak1 jan4 cin2, zan1 hai6 ho2 ci2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他骗别人的钱，真是可耻！
examples.english_sentence: He cheated people out of their money, it's truly shameful!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁樣做對唔住自己嘅良心，好可恥㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam2 joeng2 zou6 deoi3 m4 zyu6 zi6 gei2 ge3 loeng4 sam1, hou2 ho2 ci2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这样做对不起自己的良心，是很可耻的。
examples.english_sentence: Doing that is against your conscience, it's very shameful.

english_meaning: hateful, detestable, abominable
explanation_mandarin: 令人憎恨，非常讨厌。
explanation_english: Deserving of hatred; extremely unpleasant or detestable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個衰人真係可恨！
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 seoi1 jan4 zan1 hai6 ho2 han6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个坏人真是可恨！
examples.english_sentence: That bad person is really hateful!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅行為非常可恨，唔值得原諒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hang4 wai4 fei1 soeng4 ho2 han6, m4 zik6 dak1 jyun4 loeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的行为非常可恨，不值得原谅。
examples.english_sentence: His behavior is extremely hateful and not worthy of forgiveness.

english_meaning: pathetic, lamentable, sad, deplorable
explanation_mandarin: 指令人感到悲哀、可怜的情形。
explanation_english: Describes a situation that is sad, pitiful, or deserving of lament.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅遭遇真係好可悲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zou1 geoi1 zan1 hai6 hou2 ho2 bei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的遭遇真是很可悲。
examples.english_sentence: His situation is truly pathetic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個世界有咁多可悲嘅事發生，我哋應該多啲關心社會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sai3 gaai3 jau5 gam3 do1 ho2 bei1 ge3 si6 faat3 sang1, ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 do1 di1 gwaan1 sam1 se5 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个世界有很多可悲的事情发生，我们应该多关心社会。
examples.english_sentence: So many lamentable things happen in this world, we should care more about society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁後生就病逝，真係可悲可歎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 hau6 saang1 zau6 beng6 sai3, zan1 hai6 ho2 bei1 ho2 taan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么年轻就病逝了，真是可悲可叹。
examples.english_sentence: It's truly sad and regrettable that he passed away so young.

english_meaning: It's a pity; what a shame; regrettable
explanation_mandarin: 表示惋惜，觉得某件事情不尽如人意，令人遗憾。
explanation_english: Expressing regret or pity about something that is undesirable or disappointing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁後生就走咗，真係可惜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 hau6 saang1 zau6 zau2 zo2, zan1 hai6 ho2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么年轻就去世了，真是可惜。
examples.english_sentence: It's such a pity that he passed away so young.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 差少少就贏咗，可惜呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: caa1 siu2 siu2 zau6 wing4 zo2, ho2 sik1 aa!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 差一点就赢了，真可惜啊！
examples.english_sentence: We were so close to winning, what a shame!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳執咗笠，啲嘢食咁好味，真係可惜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 zap1 zo2 lap1, di1 je5 sik6 gam3 hou2 mei6, zan1 hai6 ho2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅倒闭了，食物那么好吃，真可惜。
examples.english_sentence: The restaurant closed down, the food was so delicious, it's a real shame.

english_meaning: despicable, detestable, hateful, abominable
explanation_mandarin: 形容令人厌恶、憎恨的，非常坏。
explanation_english: Describes something that is detestable, hateful, or extremely bad; deserving of scorn.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個騙子真係可惡，呃咗我好多錢！
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 pin3 zi2 zan1 hai6 ho2 wu3, aak1 zo2 ngo5 ho2 do1 cin2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个骗子真可恶，骗了我好多钱！
examples.english_sentence: That swindler is truly despicable, he cheated me out of a lot of money!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲地產商咁抬高樓價，真係好可惡！
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 dei6 caan2 soeng1 gam3 toi4 gou1 lau4 gaa3, zan1 hai6 hou2 ho2 wu3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些房地产商这样抬高房价，真是太可恶了！
examples.english_sentence: Those property developers are raising housing prices like this, it's really despicable!

english_meaning: How annoying!
explanation_mandarin: 表示恼怒、生气的语气助词，相当于“可恼啊”的意思。
explanation_english: An interjection expressing annoyance or frustration. Equivalent to 'How annoying!'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唉吔，架車又壞咗，可惱也！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ai1 jaa1, gaa3 ce1 jau6 waai6 zo2, ho2 nou5 jaa5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哎呀，车又坏了，可恼啊！
examples.english_sentence: Oh dear, the car broke down again, how annoying!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試又唔合格，真係可惱也！
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 jau6 m4 hap6 gaak3, zan1 hai6 ho2 nou5 jaa5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试又不及格，真是可恼啊！
examples.english_sentence: Failed the exam again, how annoying!

english_meaning: it is conceivable; it's easy to imagine; it stands to reason; predictably
explanation_mandarin: 可以想象得到。形容事情是很容易理解的，结果是显而易见的。
explanation_english: Used to describe something that is easily imaginable or predictable; the outcome is obvious or easy to understand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁懶，可想而知考試一定唔合格啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 laan5, ho2 soeng2 ji1 zi1 haau2 si5 jat1 ding6 m4 gok3 gaak3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么懒，可想而知考试肯定不合格。
examples.english_sentence: He's so lazy, it's easy to imagine that he will fail the exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳咁出名，可想而知一定好多人排隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 gam3 ceot1 ming4, ho2 soeng2 ji1 zi1 jat1 ding6 hou2 do1 jan4 paai4 deoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅这么出名，可想而知一定很多人排队。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant is so famous, it's easy to imagine there will be a long queue.

english_meaning: cute; lovable; adorable
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或事物令人喜爱。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something that is endearing and lovable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個BB真係好可愛呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 bi1 bi1 zan1 hai6 hou2 ho2 ngo3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个宝宝真是太可爱了！
examples.english_sentence: This baby is so cute!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你件衫好可愛呀！邊度買㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gin6 saam1 hou2 ho2 ngo3 aa3! bin1 dou6 maai5 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的衣服好可爱啊！在哪儿买的？
examples.english_sentence: Your clothes are so cute! Where did you buy them?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個拍拖好可愛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 paak3 to1 hou2 ho2 ngo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个谈恋爱很可爱。
examples.english_sentence: They are a cute couple.

english_meaning: pitiful; pathetic; to pity; to feel sorry for
explanation_mandarin: 表示值得同情或怜悯；也可以表示使人感到可悲的。
explanation_english: Deserving or arousing pity or compassion; also used to describe someone or something that is pathetic or miserable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁細個就冇咗阿爸阿媽，真係好可憐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 sai3 go3 zau6 mou5 zo2 aa3 baa4 aa3 maa1, zan1 hai6 hou2 ho2 lin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么小就失去了父母，真是很可怜。
examples.english_sentence: It's so pitiful that he lost his parents at such a young age.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好可憐我，我會自己搞掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ho2 lin4 ngo5, ngo5 wui5 zi6 gei2 gaau2 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要可怜我，我会自己搞定的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't pity me, I'll handle it myself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋份糧咁低，真係可憐，點樣養家呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 fan6 leong4 gam3 dai1, zan1 hai6 ho2 lin4, dim2 joeng2 joeng5 gaa1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的工资这么低，真是可怜，怎么养家啊？
examples.english_sentence: Their salary is so low, it's really pitiful, how can they support their family?

jyutping: ho2 lin4 tin1 haa6 fu6 mou5 sam1
english_meaning: It is pitiable, the hearts of parents all over the world (expressing empathy for parents' sacrifices and worries)
explanation_mandarin: 形容父母对子女无私奉献和担忧的感情是普遍存在的，值得同情和理解。
explanation_english: This idiom describes the universal and selfless love, sacrifices, and worries that parents have for their children. It expresses empathy and understanding for these parental feelings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁辛苦都係為咗仔女啫，真係可憐天下父母心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 san1 fu2 dou1 hai6 wai6 zo2 zai2 neoi5 ze1, zan1 hai6 ho2 lin4 tin1 haa6 fu6 mou5 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么辛苦都是为了孩子，真是可怜天下父母心。
examples.english_sentence: He works so hard all for his children, it's truly pitiable, the hearts of parents all over the world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽成日擔心我，我知佢係可憐天下父母心啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 seng4 jat6 daam1 sam1 ngo5, ngo5 zi1 keoi5 hai6 ho2 lin4 tin1 haa6 fu6 mou5 sam1 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈总是担心我，我知道她是可怜天下父母心。
examples.english_sentence: My mother always worries about me; I know it's just the heart of a parent.

english_meaning: poor thing; pitiable creature; wretch
explanation_mandarin: 指值得同情或轻视的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who is deserving of pity or scorn.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁睇唔起人啦，個個都有難處㗎，唔好成日當人係可憐蟲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 tai2 m4 hei2 jan4 laa1, go3 go3 dou1 jau5 naan6 chu3 gaa3, m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 dong3 jan4 hai6 ho2 lin4 cung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么看不起人，每个人都有难处，不要总是把人当成可怜虫。
examples.english_sentence: Don't look down on people like that. Everyone has difficulties. Don't always treat them like a pitiable creature.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢失業之後成日飲酒，搞到自己好似隻可憐蟲噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sat1 jip6 zi1 hau6 seng4 jat6 jam2 zau2, gaau2 dou3 zi6 gei2 hou2 ci5 zek3 ho2 lin4 cung4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他失业之后整天喝酒，把自己搞得像个可怜虫一样。
examples.english_sentence: After losing his job, he drinks all the time, making himself look like a pitiable creature.

english_meaning: Can I/we?
explanation_mandarin: “可摸以”是粤语中“可以吗”的谐音，常用于口语中，表示询问是否可以做某事。 属于一种网络用语或者说谐音梗。
explanation_english: "可摸以" (ho2 mo1 ji5) is a Cantonese slang term which is a phonetic approximation of "我可以嗎？" (ho2 ji5 maa3?), meaning "Can I/we?" or "Is it okay?". It's often used in informal conversations and online contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我可摸以借你枝筆呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ho2 mo1 ji5 ze3 nei5 zi1 bat1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我可以借你的笔吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can I borrow your pen?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 可摸以幫我手呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 mo1 ji5 bong1 ngo5 sau2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 可以帮我一下忙吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can you give me a hand?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家可摸以走呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ho2 mo1 ji5 zau2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在可以走了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can I leave now?

synonyms: 得唔得呀 (dak1 m4 dak1 aa3)

english_meaning: May I? Can I? Is it okay?
explanation_mandarin: 询问对方是否可以做某事，语气比较轻松随意，通常用于朋友或熟人之间。
explanation_english: A Cantonese phrase used to ask for permission or to inquire if something is okay. It's generally used in casual settings with friends or acquaintances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 可摸耳借你枝筆嚟用吓？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 mo1 ji5 ze3 nei5 zi1 bat1 lai4 yung6 haa5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我可以借你的笔用一下吗？
examples.english_sentence: May I borrow your pen for a moment?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 可摸耳同你一齊食lunch呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 mo1 ji5 tung4 nei5 jat1 cai4 sik6 lunch aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我可以和你一起吃午饭吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can I have lunch with you?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 可摸耳影張相呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 mo1 ji5 ying2 zoeng1 soeng2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我可以拍张照片吗？
examples.english_sentence: May I take a photo?

english_meaning: respectable; admirable; worthy of respect
explanation_mandarin: 值得尊敬，令人敬佩。
explanation_english: Worthy of respect; admirable; deserving of reverence or high regard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗社會付出咁多，真係好可敬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 se5 wui2 fu6 ceot1 gam3 do1, zan1 hai6 hou2 ho2 ging3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为了社会付出了这么多，真的很可敬。
examples.english_sentence: He has contributed so much to society, he is truly respectable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅毅力同埋決心都好可敬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ngai6 lik6 tung4 ma4 kyut3 sam1 dou1 hou2 ho2 ging3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的毅力和决心都很可敬。
examples.english_sentence: His perseverance and determination are very admirable.

english_meaning: but; however; yet
explanation_mandarin: 表示转折关系，相当于“但是”、“不过”。
explanation_english: Expressing a contrasting relationship, equivalent to "but" or "however".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好想去旅行，可是冇錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 soeng2 heoi3 leoi5 hang4, ho2 si6 mou5 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很想去旅行，可是没钱。
examples.english_sentence: I really want to travel, but I don't have money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好叻，可是有啲懶惰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 lek1, ho2 si6 jau5 di1 laan5 do6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很聪明，可是有点懒惰。
examples.english_sentence: He's very smart, but he's a bit lazy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同意你嘅觀點，可是仲有啲嘢需要考慮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung3 ji3 nei5 ge3 gun1 dim2, ho2 si6 zung6 jau5 di1 je5 seoi1 jiu3 haau2 leoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我同意你的观点，可是还有一些东西需要考虑。
examples.english_sentence: I agree with your point of view, but there are still some things to consider.

english_meaning: dispensable; optional; not essential; neither necessary nor unnecessary
explanation_mandarin: 指有也好，没有也好，无关紧要，形容事物存在与否都不会有太大影响。
explanation_english: Describes something that is not essential; its presence or absence makes little difference.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個功能可有可無啫，冇咗都唔會影響用家體驗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gung1 nang4 ho2 jau5 ho2 mou4 ze1, mou5 zo2 dou1 m4 wui5 jing2 hoeng2 yung6 gaa1 tai1 jim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个功能可有可无，没有了也不会影响用户体验。
examples.english_sentence: This function is dispensable; removing it won't affect the user experience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 對於佢嚟講，我只不過係個可有可無嘅朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: deoi3 jyu1 keoi5 lei4 gong2, ngo5 zi2 bat1 gwo3 hai6 go3 ho2 jau5 ho2 mou4 ge3 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 对他来说，我只不过是个可有可无的朋友。
examples.english_sentence: To him, I'm just a dispensable friend.

english_meaning: promising; hopeful; can be expected
explanation_mandarin: 值得期望；有希望实现。
explanation_english: Deserving of anticipation or expectation; having a reasonable chance of success or fulfillment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今年考到大學嘅機會都幾可望喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 nin4 haau2 dou3 daai6 hok6 ge3 gei1 wui2 dou1 gei2 ho2 mong6 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今年考上大学的机会还是很有希望的。
examples.english_sentence: He has a pretty good chance of getting into university this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目前景可望，值得投資。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 cin4 ging2 ho2 mong6, zik6 dak1 tau4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目前景可期，值得投资。
examples.english_sentence: This project has a promising outlook and is worth investing in.

english_meaning: desirable but unattainable; within sight but beyond reach
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物看起来很美好，很吸引人，但实际上却无法得到或实现。
explanation_english: Describes something that seems desirable and attractive, but is actually impossible to obtain or achieve.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個明星靚到呢，簡直係可望不可即嘅存在。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 ming4 sing1 leng3 dou3 ne1, gaan2 zik6 hai6 ho2 mong6 bat1 ho2 zik1 ge3 cyun4 zoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个明星长得太漂亮了，简直是可望而不可及的存在。
examples.english_sentence: That star is so beautiful, she's simply an unattainable being.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然我好想買層樓，但而家啲樓價咁貴，真係可望不可即。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 ngo5 hou2 soeng2 maai5 cang4 lau2, daan6 ji4 gaa1 di1 lau2 gaa3 gam3 gwai3, zan1 hai6 ho2 mong6 bat1 ho2 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然我很想买一套房子，但是现在房价这么贵，真是可望而不可及。
examples.english_sentence: Although I really want to buy an apartment, the current property prices are so high, it's truly unattainable.

jyutping: ho2 mong6 ji4 bat1 ho2 zik1
english_meaning: Desirable but unattainable; within sight but out of reach
explanation_mandarin: 虽然能够看到，但是无法达到或得到。形容看起来很好，很想要，但实际上却难以实现。
explanation_english: Describes something that is desirable and within sight, but practically impossible to obtain or achieve. It suggests a sense of yearning for something that remains elusive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人工實在太高，對我嚟講真係可望而不可即呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 gung1 sat6 zoi6 taai3 gou1, deoi3 ngo5 lai4 gong2 zan1 hai6 ho2 mong6 ji4 bat1 ho2 zik1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工资实在太高了，对我来说真是可望而不可及啊。
examples.english_sentence: His salary is way too high. It's really desirable but unattainable for me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 攞諾貝爾獎對大部分科學家嚟講都係可望而不可即嘅目標。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lo2 nok6 bei3 ji5 o2 zoeng2 deoi3 daai6 bou6 fan6 fo1 hok6 gaa1 lai4 gong2 dou1 hai6 ho2 mong6 ji4 bat1 ho2 zik1 ge3 muk6 biu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 获得诺贝尔奖对大部分科学家来说都是可望而不可及的目标。
examples.english_sentence: Winning the Nobel Prize is a desirable but unattainable goal for most scientists.

english_meaning: cola
explanation_mandarin: 一种碳酸饮料，通常指可口可乐或百事可乐。
explanation_english: A carbonated soft drink, usually referring to Coca-Cola or Pepsi.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想飲罐可樂呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 jam2 gun3 ho2 lok6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想喝一罐可乐啊。
examples.english_sentence: I want to drink a can of cola.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日天氣好熱，飲杯凍可樂就好爽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 tin1 hei3 hou2 jit6, jam2 bui1 dung3 ho2 lok6 zau6 hou2 song2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天天气很热，喝一杯冰可乐就很爽。
examples.english_sentence: It's very hot today, drinking a glass of iced cola is so refreshing.

english_meaning: worthy of song and tears; deeply moving; inspiring
explanation_mandarin: 形容事迹非常感人，值得歌颂和悲泣。
explanation_english: Describes a deed or event that is extremely touching and moving, worthy of being sung and wept over.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅一生真係可歌可泣，為咗理想奮鬥到最後一刻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jat1 sang1 zan1 hai6 ho2 go1 ho2 nap1, wai6 zo2 lei5 soeng2 fan5 dau3 dou3 zeoi3 hau6 jat1 hak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的一生真是可歌可泣，为了理想奋斗到最后一刻。
examples.english_sentence: His life was truly inspiring and moving, fighting for his ideals until his very last moment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個抗疫故事真係可歌可泣，好多醫護人員都好偉大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 kong3 jik6 gu2 si6 zan1 hai6 ho2 go1 ho2 nap1, hou2 do1 ji1 wu6 jan4 jyun4 dou1 hou2 wai5 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个抗疫故事真是可歌可泣，很多医护人员都很伟大。
examples.english_sentence: This anti-epidemic story is truly inspiring and moving, many medical staff are very great.

english_meaning: comparable; comparable to; the same as; analogy; comparison
explanation_mandarin: 表示可以进行比较；具有可以比较的性质。
explanation_english: Expresses the ability to be compared; having the quality of being comparable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個人嘅成績可比性好高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 jan4 ge3 sing1 zik1 ho2 bei2 sing3 hou2 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个人的成绩可比性很高。
examples.english_sentence: The academic results of these two people are very comparable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好攞我同佢可比啦，我冇佢咁叻㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lo2 ngo5 tung4 keoi5 ho2 bei2 laa1, ngo5 mou5 keoi5 gam3 lek1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要拿我和他比较了，我没有他那么厉害。
examples.english_sentence: Don't compare me to him, I'm not as capable as he is.

english_meaning: Khan (historical title); (slang) extremely capable person, master, king
explanation_mandarin: （历史）古代北方民族对君主的称谓。 （俚语）比喻非常厉害的人，大神，大佬。
explanation_english: (Historical) Khan, a title of rulers in ancient northern nomadic tribes. (Slang) Used to describe someone who is extremely capable, a master, a big shot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺遊戲界簡直係可汗級嘅人物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jau4 hei3 gaai3 gaan2 zik6 hai6 ho2 hon4 kap1 ge3 yan4 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在游戏界简直是可汗级别的人物。
examples.english_sentence: He's practically a Khan-level figure in the gaming world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁叻，直頭係寫程式界嘅可汗啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 lek1, zik6 tau4 hai6 se2 cing4 sik1 gaai3 ge3 ho2 hon4 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么厉害，简直是编程界的可汗了！
examples.english_sentence: You're so good, you're practically the Khan of the programming world!

english_meaning: suspicious, dubious
explanation_mandarin: 指某事或某人令人怀疑，觉得不正常或不可信。
explanation_english: Describing something or someone that causes suspicion, feeling abnormal or untrustworthy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅行為好可疑，我哋要留意下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hang4 wai4 hou2 ho2 ji4, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 lau4 yi3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的行为很可疑，我们要留意一下。
examples.english_sentence: His behavior is very suspicious, we need to pay attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事嘅細節有啲可疑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 sai3 zit3 jau5 di1 ho2 ji4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事的细节有些可疑。
examples.english_sentence: The details of this matter are a bit suspicious.

english_meaning: laughable; ridiculous; absurd
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情荒谬、滑稽，令人觉得好笑。
explanation_english: Describes something ridiculous, absurd, or funny, causing amusement or ridicule.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅諗法真係好可笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 nam2 faat3 zan1 hai6 hou2 ho2 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的想法真可笑。
examples.english_sentence: His idea is really ridiculous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事嘅結果好可笑，完全唔合邏輯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 git3 gwo2 hou2 ho2 siu3, wun4 cyun4 m4 hap6 lo4 gap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事的结果很可笑，完全不合逻辑。
examples.english_sentence: The outcome of this event is laughable, completely illogical.

english_meaning: possible, maybe, probably
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情有实现的希望，但不能确定。也可以表示推测。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is possible or probable, but not certain. Can also express speculation or conjecture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日可能落雨，記得帶遮啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 ho2 nang4 lok6 jyu5, gei3 dak1 daai3 ze1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天可能下雨，记得带伞啊。
examples.english_sentence: It might rain tomorrow, remember to bring an umbrella.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢可能唔會嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ho2 nang4 m4 wui5 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他可能不会来。
examples.english_sentence: He probably won't come.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 可能係咁嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 nang4 hai6 gam2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 可能是这样的。
examples.english_sentence: That's possible.

english_meaning: possibility, probability
explanation_mandarin: 指事情发生的可能性或成为现实的程度。
explanation_english: The degree to which something is possible or likely to happen or be true.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事嘅可能性好低。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 ho2 nang4 sing3 hou2 dai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事的可能性很低。
examples.english_sentence: The possibility of this happening is very low.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔排除任何可能性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 paai3 ceoi4 jam6 ho4 ho2 nang4 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不排除任何可能性。
examples.english_sentence: I don't rule out any possibilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成功嘅可能性唔大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 gung1 ge3 ho2 nang4 sing3 m4 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他成功的可能性不大。
examples.english_sentence: The possibility of him succeeding is not high.

english_meaning: Quran, Koran
explanation_mandarin: 伊斯兰教的经典。
explanation_english: The central religious text of Islam, believed by Muslims to be the word of God (Allah).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢每日都會讀可蘭經。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mui5 jat6 dou1 wui5 duk6 ho2 laan4 ging1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都会读古兰经。
examples.english_sentence: He reads the Quran every day.

english_meaning: feasible; viable; practicable; workable
explanation_mandarin: 表示某种方法或计划能够被实行或实现，具有现实的可能性。
explanation_english: Describes a method, plan, or idea that can be implemented or achieved, possessing practical possibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個方案睇落好似唔係幾可行噉喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fong1 on3 tai2 lok6 hou2 ci5 m4 hai6 gei2 ho2 hang4 gam2 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个方案看起来好像不太可行啊。
examples.english_sentence: This plan doesn't seem very feasible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要搵一個可行嘅解決辦法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 wan2 jat1 go3 ho2 hang4 ge3 gaai2 kyut3 baan6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要找到一个可行的解决方法。
examples.english_sentence: We need to find a viable solution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嘅提議聽落好可行，但係實際操作可能會有困難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ge3 tai4 ji5 teng1 lok6 hou2 ho2 hang4, daan6 hai6 sat6 zai3 cau1 zok3 ho2 nang4 wui5 jau5 kwan3 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的建议听起来很可行，但是实际操作可能会有困难。
examples.english_sentence: Your suggestion sounds workable, but there might be difficulties in actual implementation.

english_meaning: it can be seen, it is evident, obviously, from this it can be seen
explanation_mandarin: 表示由前面的情况可以看出后面的结论或道理。
explanation_english: Indicates that a conclusion or principle can be seen from the preceding situation. Used to introduce a conclusion or statement based on evidence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁勤力，可見佢好想成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 kan4 lik6, ho2 gin3 keoi5 hou2 soeng2 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么努力，可见他很想成功。
examples.english_sentence: He works so hard, it's evident that he really wants to succeed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度嘅樓價升得咁快，可見香港嘅經濟幾咁好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 ge3 lau2 gaa3 sing1 dak1 gam3 faai3, ho2 gin3 Hoeng1 Gong2 ge3 ging1 zai3 gei2 gam3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的房价涨得这么快，可见香港的经济有多好。
examples.english_sentence: The property prices here are rising so fast, it shows how good Hong Kong's economy is.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一啲都唔講嘢，可見佢心情唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 di1 dou1 m4 gong2 je5, ho2 gin3 keoi5 sam1 cing4 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一句话都不说，可见他心情不好。
examples.english_sentence: He's not saying a word, it's obvious that he's in a bad mood.

english_meaning: to see a leopard through its spots; to get a glimpse of the whole picture from a part; a glimpse of the whole
explanation_mandarin: 比喻见到事物的一小部分也能推知事物的整体。
explanation_english: This idiom means that by seeing a small part of something, you can infer the whole picture or the true nature of the situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅作品雖然只係得幾篇，但都可見一斑，知道佢嘅才華橫溢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jok3 pan2 seoi1 jin4 zi2 hai6 dak1 gei2 pin1, daan6 dou1 ho2 gin3 jat1 baan1, zi1 dou3 keoi5 ge3 coi4 waa4 waang4 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他的作品只有几篇，但也能从中略见一斑，知道他的才华横溢。
examples.english_sentence: Although he only has a few pieces of work, you can still get a glimpse of his immense talent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇佢咁樣處理呢件事，就可見一斑，知道佢做嘢幾咁求其。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 keoi5 gam2 joeng2 cyu2 lei5 ni1 gin6 si6, zau6 ho2 gin3 jat1 baan1, zi1 dou3 keoi5 zou6 je5 gei2 gam2 kau4 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看他这样处理这件事，就能看出端倪，知道他做事多么马虎。
examples.english_sentence: Looking at how he handled this matter, you can get a glimpse and know how careless he is at work.

english_meaning: visible light
explanation_mandarin: 指人眼可以感知的电磁波谱范围内的光线。
explanation_english: Visible light is the portion of the electromagnetic spectrum that is visible to the human eye.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 太陽放出嚟嘅可見光令到我哋可以睇到嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taai3 joeng4 fong3 chut1 lai4 ge3 ho2 gin3 gwong1 ling6 dou3 ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 tai2 dou3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 太阳发出的可见光让我们能够看到东西。
examples.english_sentence: The visible light emitted by the sun allows us to see things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 紫外線同紅外線都唔係可見光，我哋睇唔到㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi2 ngoi6 sin3 tung4 hung4 ngoi6 sin3 dou1 m4 hai6 ho2 gin3 gwong1, ngo5 dei6 tai2 m4 dou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 紫外线和红外线都不是可见光，我们看不到的。
examples.english_sentence: Ultraviolet and infrared light are not visible light, we can't see them.

english_meaning: approachable; amiable; affable; friendly; kind and easy to get along with
explanation_mandarin: 形容人态度和蔼，容易接近。
explanation_english: Describing a person's demeanor as amiable, approachable, and easy to get along with.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好可親，所以好多人都鍾意同佢傾偈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 ho2 can1, so2 ji5 hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 zung1 ji3 tung4 keoi5 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很和蔼可亲，所以很多人都喜欢和他聊天。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very approachable person, so many people like to chat with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間鋪頭嘅老闆娘好可親，成日同啲街坊吹水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau2 ge3 lou5 baan2 noeng2 hou2 ho2 can1, seng4 jat6 tung4 di1 gaai1 fong1 cheui1 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店的老板娘很和蔼可亲，经常和街坊们聊天。
examples.english_sentence: The owner of this shop is very approachable and often chats with the neighbors.

english_meaning: considerable; impressive; significant; worth seeing
explanation_mandarin: 形容数量、价值或程度较大，值得重视或欣赏。
explanation_english: Describing something that is considerable in quantity, value, or degree; worthy of attention or appreciation; impressive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年間公司嘅盈利好可觀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 ying4 lei6 hou2 ho2 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年公司的盈利非常可观。
examples.english_sentence: This year, the company's profits are very considerable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲嘅票房收入非常可觀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 ge3 piu3 fong2 sau1 jap6 fei1 soeng4 ho2 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影的票房收入非常可观。
examples.english_sentence: The box office revenue for this movie is very impressive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅中文進步好可觀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zung1 man2 zeon3 bou6 hou2 ho2 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的中文进步很可观。
examples.english_sentence: His Chinese has improved significantly.

english_meaning: it can be said (that); one might say; so to speak
explanation_mandarin: 表示某种程度上可以这样说，带有一定的评价或总结意味。
explanation_english: Indicates that something can be said to be true to a certain extent, often implying a form of evaluation or summary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁後生就做咗經理，可謂少年得志。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 hau6 saang1 zau6 zou6 zo2 ging1 lei5, ho2 wai6 siu3 nin4 dak1 zi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么年轻就当了经理，可以说是少年得志。
examples.english_sentence: He became a manager at such a young age, one might say he achieved success early in life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目嘅成功，可謂係團隊合作嘅最佳例子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 ge3 sing4 gung1, ho2 wai6 hai6 teoi1 deoi2 hap6 zok3 ge3 zeoi3 gaai1 lai6 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目的成功，可以说是团队合作的最佳例子。
examples.english_sentence: The success of this project can be said to be the best example of teamwork.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次比賽佢表現咁出色，可謂係超常發揮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 bei2 coi3 keoi5 biu2 hin3 gam3 ceot1 sik1, ho2 wai6 hai6 ciu1 soeng4 faat3 fai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次比赛他表现这么出色，可以说是超常发挥。
examples.english_sentence: His outstanding performance in this competition can be said to be an exceptional display.

english_meaning: valuable; precious; commendable; worthy
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物具有很高价值或品质，值得珍惜和重视。
explanation_english: Describing something that has high value or quality and is worth cherishing and paying attention to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個機會好可貴，你要好好把握呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gei1 wui2 hou2 ho2 gwai3, nei5 jiu3 hou2 hou2 baa2 ak1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个机会非常可贵，你要好好把握啊。
examples.english_sentence: This opportunity is very valuable, you should seize it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅毅力好可貴，值得我哋學習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ngai6 lik6 hou2 ho2 gwai3, zik6 dak1 ngo5 dei6 hok6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的毅力非常可贵，值得我们学习。
examples.english_sentence: His perseverance is very commendable and worth learning from.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 和平係好可貴嘅，我哋應該珍惜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wo4 ping4 hai6 hou2 ho2 gwai3 ge3, ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 zan1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 和平是非常可贵的，我们应该珍惜。
examples.english_sentence: Peace is very precious, we should cherish it.

english_meaning: promising material, a promising talent, someone with potential
explanation_mandarin: 指可以培养、有发展前途的人才。
explanation_english: Refers to someone with the potential to be cultivated and developed into a valuable asset.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁醒目，真係可造之材。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 seng2 muk6, zan1 hai6 ho2 zou6 zi1 caai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么聪明，真是可造之材。
examples.english_sentence: He's so smart; he's really promising material.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個細路好勤力，睇嚟會係可造之材。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sai3 lou2 hou2 kan4 lik6, tai2 lai4 wui5 hai6 ho2 zou6 zi1 caai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个小孩很勤奋，看来会是可造之材。
examples.english_sentence: This kid is very diligent; it seems like he'll be a promising talent.

english_meaning: Something that is desirable but cannot be obtained through effort alone; Something that can only be encountered by chance and cannot be deliberately sought.
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物非常难得，只能凭借机遇才能遇到，即使努力追求也未必能得到。
explanation_english: Describes something rare and precious that can only be encountered by chance. Effort or deliberate seeking may not guarantee obtaining it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工真係可遇不可求㗎，你要好好珍惜呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 zan1 hai6 ho2 jyu6 bat1 ho2 kau4 gaa3, nei5 jiu3 hou2 hou2 zan1 sik1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作真是可遇不可求的，你要好好珍惜啊！
examples.english_sentence: This job is truly a blessing; it's not something you can easily find. You should cherish it!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 真正嘅愛情係可遇不可求嘅，唔好強求。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zan1 zing3 ge3 oi3 ching4 hai6 ho2 jyu6 bat1 ho2 kau4 ge3, m4 hou2 koeng5 kau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 真正的爱情是可遇不可求的，不要强求。
examples.english_sentence: True love is something you encounter by chance, not something you can force.

synonyms: 千載難逢 (chin1 zoi2 naan4 fung4)
機緣巧合 (gei1 jyun4 kiu2 hap6)

english_meaning: despicable; contemptible; base
explanation_mandarin: 指行为、品格等卑劣，令人鄙视。
explanation_english: Describing behavior, character, etc., as despicable and worthy of contempt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅行為真係好可鄙，竟然偷人哋啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hang4 wai4 zan1 hai6 hou2 ho2 pei2, ging2 jin4 tau1 jan4 dei6 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的行为真的很可鄙，竟然偷别人的钱。
examples.english_sentence: His behavior is truly despicable, he actually stole other people's money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢種為咗自己嘅利益而出賣朋友嘅行為，實在係可鄙至極。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zung2 wai6 zo2 zi6 gei2 ge3 lei6 jik1 ji4 ceot1 maai6 pang4 jau5 ge3 hang4 wai4, sat6 zoi6 hai6 ho2 pei2 zi3 gik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种为了自己的利益而背叛朋友的行为，实在是可鄙至极。
examples.english_sentence: This kind of behavior of betraying friends for one's own benefit is extremely despicable.

english_meaning: reliable, dependable, trustworthy
explanation_mandarin: 值得信任和依靠的；可信賴的。
explanation_english: Worthy of trust and reliance; dependable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好可靠，交畀佢做就放心喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6嘢 hou2 ho2 kaau3, gaau1 bei2 keoi5 zou6 zau6 fong3 sam1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很可靠，交给他做就放心了。
examples.english_sentence: He's very reliable at work, you can relax if you leave it to him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅信譽好可靠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 seon3 jyu6 hou2 ho2 kaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的信誉很可靠。
examples.english_sentence: This company's reputation is very reliable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要搵一個可靠嘅朋友幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 wan2 jat1 go3 ho2 kaau3 ge3 pang4 jau5 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要找一个可靠的朋友帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: You need to find a reliable friend to help.

english_meaning: Maybe; possibly; perhaps
explanation_mandarin: 表示可能性，相当于普通话的“可能”、“也许”。语气比较口语化，通常用于非正式场合。
explanation_english: Expressing possibility; equivalent to 'maybe', 'possibly', or 'perhaps' in Mandarin. It's a colloquial expression typically used in informal settings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 可馬陶聽日會落雨喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 maa1 tou4 ting1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 也许明天会下雨啊。
examples.english_sentence: Maybe it will rain tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢可馬陶唔會嚟啦，佢話佢好忙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ho2 maa1 tou4 m4 wui5 lai4 laa1, keoi5 waa6 keoi5 hou2 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他可能不会来了，他说他很忙。
examples.english_sentence: He probably won't come; he said he's very busy.

mandarin_meaning: 平台; 台子; 台湾
english_meaning: platform; stage; stand; Taiwan
explanation_mandarin: 1. 比地面高而平的建筑物或构筑物。2. 舞台。3. 台湾。
explanation_english: 1. A raised, flat surface. 2. A stage. 3. Taiwan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺台上唱歌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 toi4 soeng6 coeng3 go1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在台上唱歌。
examples.english_sentence: He is singing on the stage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個台好穩陣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 toi4 hou2 wan2 zan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个台子很稳固。
examples.english_sentence: This platform is very stable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋計劃去台灣旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gai3 waak6 heoi3 toi4 waan1 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们计划去台湾旅行。
examples.english_sentence: We are planning to travel to Taiwan.

cantonese: 台上一分鐘，台下十年功
jyutping: toi4 soeng6 jat1 fan1 zung1, toi5 haa6 sap6 nin4 gung1
mandarin_meaning: 台上十分钟，台下十年功
english_meaning: One minute on stage, ten years of practice off stage; what appears easy on the surface requires painstaking effort behind the scenes.
explanation_mandarin: 形容台上的短暂表演或成功需要台下长时间的刻苦练习和准备。强调成功来之不易，需要付出巨大的努力。
explanation_english: This idiom describes how a brief performance or success on stage requires many years of hard work and preparation behind the scenes. It emphasizes that success doesn't come easily and requires immense effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺奧運會攞到金牌，真係台上一分鐘，台下十年功啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ou3 wan6 wui2 lo2 dou2 gam1 paai4, zan1 hai6 toi4 soeng6 jat1 fan1 zung1, toi5 haa6 sap6 nin4 gung1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在奥运会上拿到金牌，真是台上十分钟，台下十年功啊。
examples.english_sentence: He won a gold medal at the Olympics, it's truly one minute on stage, ten years of practice off stage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要煮出一碗好食嘅雲吞麵，都係台上一分鐘，台下十年功㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 zyu2 ceot1 jat1 wun2 hou2 sik6 ge3 wan4 tan1 min6, dou1 hai6 toi4 soeng6 jat1 fan1 zung1, toi5 haa6 sap6 nin4 gung1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要煮出一碗好吃的云吞面，也是台上十分钟，台下十年功的。
examples.english_sentence: Even cooking a delicious bowl of wonton noodles is one minute on stage, ten years of practice off stage.

cantonese: 台上三分鐘，台下十年功
jyutping: toi4 soeng6 saam1 fan1 zung1, toi5 haa6 sap6 nin4 gung1
mandarin_meaning: 台上一分钟，台下十年功
english_meaning: Three minutes on stage, ten years of practice off stage.
explanation_mandarin: 形容台前短暂的精彩表现，需要台下长时间的刻苦努力。
explanation_english: This idiom describes how a brilliant performance on stage, no matter how brief, is only possible with years of dedicated hard work and practice behind the scenes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺鋼琴比賽攞到冠軍，真係台上三分鐘，台下十年功啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gong3 kam4 bei2 coi3 lo2 dou3 gun3 gwan1, zan1 hai6 toi4 soeng6 saam1 fan1 zung1, toi5 haa6 sap6 nin4 gung1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在钢琴比赛中获得冠军，真是台上一分钟，台下十年功啊！
examples.english_sentence: He won the championship in the piano competition, it's really three minutes on stage, ten years of practice off stage!

english_meaning: Taichung (city in Taiwan)
explanation_mandarin: 台湾西部的城市，是台湾的直辖市之一。
explanation_english: A city in western Taiwan, and one of Taiwan's special municipalities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月要去台中旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 jiu3 heoi3 toi4 zung1 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月要去台中旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to travel to Taichung next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋去過台中未呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 heoi3 gwo3 toi4 zung1 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们去过台中吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you guys been to Taichung before?

mandarin_meaning: 台湾男生；台湾人（带有轻微贬义）
english_meaning: Taiwanese guy; a Taiwanese person (often with a slightly derogatory or teasing connotation)
explanation_mandarin: 指来自台湾的年轻男性。有时也泛指台湾人，但带有轻微的轻蔑或调侃意味。
explanation_english: Refers to a young man from Taiwan. Sometimes refers to Taiwanese people in general, but with a slightly derogatory or teasing tone. The exact connotation depends heavily on the context and the speaker's intention. It can range from playful teasing to mild disapproval.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個男朋友係個台仔，講嘢都好溫柔㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 naam4 pang4 jau5 hai6 go3 toi4 zai2, gong2 je5 dou1 hou2 wan1 jau4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的男朋友是台湾人，说话都很温柔。
examples.english_sentence: Her boyfriend is Taiwanese, and he speaks very gently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日叫人台仔啦，好無禮貌㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 giu3 jan4 toi4 zai2 laa1, hou2 mou4 lai5 maau6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是叫别人台湾人，很没礼貌的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always call people 'Taiwanese guy,' it's very rude.

synonyms: 台灣人 (taai4 waan1 jan4) - Taiwanese person (more neutral)

english_meaning: front stage and backstage; on and behind the scenes; all aspects of a production (including performers and staff)
explanation_mandarin: 比喻在公开场合和私下里；也指从事某项工作的所有人员，包括台前的表演者和幕后的工作人员。
explanation_english: Refers to both the public and private aspects of something; also refers to all the people involved in a project, including those who are visible on stage and those who work behind the scenes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 套戲嘅成功，唔少得台前幕後嘅努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou3 hei3 ge3 sing4 gung1, m4 siu2 dak1 toi4 cin4 mok6 hau6 ge3 nu5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部戏的成功离不开台前幕后的努力。
examples.english_sentence: The success of this movie is inseparable from the efforts of everyone both on and behind the scenes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋台前幕後合作得好好，所以表演好成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 toi4 cin4 mok6 hau6 hap6 zok3 dak1 hou2 hou2, so2 ji5 biu2 jin2 hou2 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们台前幕后合作得很好，所以表演很成功。
examples.english_sentence: They cooperated very well, both on and behind the scenes, so the performance was very successful.

english_meaning: Taipei
explanation_mandarin: 台湾省的首都。
explanation_english: The capital city of Taiwan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個禮拜要去台北旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 lai5 baai1 jiu3 heoi3 toi4 bak1 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个星期要去台北旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Taipei for a trip next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 台北啲嘢食好好味㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: toi4 bak1 di1 je5 sik6 hou2 hou2 mei6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 台北的东西很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The food in Taipei is very delicious.

english_meaning: Tainan (city in Taiwan)
explanation_mandarin: 台湾省台南市
explanation_english: Tainan, a city in Taiwan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽講台南好多嘢食㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 gong2 toi4 naam4 hou2 do1 je5 sik6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我听说台南有很多好吃的东西。
examples.english_sentence: I heard that Tainan has a lot of good food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢下個月要去台南旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haa6 go3 jyut6 jiu3 heoi3 toi4 naam4 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他下个月要去台南旅行。
examples.english_sentence: He's going to travel to Tainan next month.

mandarin_meaning: 有气派；有风度; 架势
english_meaning: stylish; has presence; imposing; charismatic; having a good stage presence (originally, but extended to everyday situations)
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人很有气场、有风度，通常指外表和举止让人觉得很自信、很吸引人。最初指演员在舞台上的表现很有魅力，后来延伸到日常生活中。
explanation_english: Describes a person who has a strong presence, is stylish, or carries themselves with confidence and charisma. It originates from describing an actor who has good stage presence and is captivating on stage, but has extended to describe individuals in everyday situations who possess similar qualities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日著得好台型喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 dak1 hou2 toi4 jing4 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天穿得很时尚有型。
examples.english_sentence: He's dressed really stylishly today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺台上表演得好有台型。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 toi4 soeng6 biu2 jin2 dak1 hou2 jau5 toi4 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在台上表演得很有气场。
examples.english_sentence: He performed on stage with great stage presence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好擺咁多台型啦，快啲幫手啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 baai2 gam3 do1 toi4 jing4 laa1, faai3 di1 bong1 sau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要摆架子了，快点帮忙吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't put on airs, come and help!

mandarin_meaning: 台湾女孩, 带有刻板印象的台湾女孩
english_meaning: Taiwanese girl (often used stereotypically)
explanation_mandarin: 指来自台湾的年轻女性。在香港语境中，有时带有刻板印象，指穿着打扮比较甜美可爱，说话带台湾口音，行为举止比较娇柔的台湾女性。
explanation_english: Refers to a young woman from Taiwan. In the context of Hong Kong Cantonese, it sometimes carries a stereotype, referring to Taiwanese women who dress in a sweet and cute style, speak with a Taiwanese accent, and have a delicate and gentle demeanor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日扮台妹，啲衫都係粉紅色嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 baan6 toi4 mui1, di1 saam1 dou1 hai6 fan2 hung4 sik1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是打扮成台妹，衣服都是粉红色的。
examples.english_sentence: She always dresses like a Taiwanese girl; her clothes are all pink.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去台灣旅行嗰陣，見到好多打扮好可愛嘅台妹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 toi4 waan1 leoi5 hang4 go2 zan2, gin3 dou2 ho2 do1 daa2 bun6 hou2 ho2 oi3 ge3 toi4 mui1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们去台湾旅行的时候，看到了很多打扮很可爱的台湾女孩。
examples.english_sentence: When we travelled to Taiwan, we saw many Taiwanese girls who dressed very cute.

mandarin_meaning: 舞厅小姐; 公关小姐
english_meaning: Hostess; dance hall girl; public relations girl (often with connotations of working in nightlife establishments, sometimes suggestive of sex work but not always explicit)
explanation_mandarin: 指在夜总会、舞厅等场所工作的女性，通常负责陪客人聊天、喝酒、跳舞等。带有一定程度的贬义，有时暗示着与性服务有关，但并非总是如此。
explanation_english: Refers to women who work in nightclubs, dance halls, or similar establishments, typically responsible for entertaining guests by chatting, drinking, and dancing. It carries a slightly derogatory connotation and sometimes implies involvement with sex work, although not always explicitly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份工係喺夜總會做台姐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 hai6 hai2 je6 zung2 wui2 zou6 toi4 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的工作是在夜总会做舞厅小姐。
examples.english_sentence: Her job is working as a hostess in a nightclub.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好睇少啲台姐，佢哋都好辛苦㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 tai2 siu2 di1 toi4 ze2, keoi5 dei6 dou1 hou2 san1 fu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要小看那些舞厅小姐，她们也很辛苦的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't look down on those hostesses, they work very hard.

mandarin_meaning: 台山 (地名); 形容人土气，没见过世面
english_meaning: Toisan (place name); unsophisticated, countrified, provincial, unworldly
explanation_mandarin: 台山是广东省的一个地级市，也指来自台山的人。作为形容词，有时用来形容人比较土气，没见过世面，不时髦。
explanation_english: Toisan is a city in Guangdong province, China. It can also refer to people from Toisan. As an adjective, it sometimes describes someone who is unsophisticated, countrified, or not worldly wise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱由台山嚟，好多嘢都唔識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaam1 ngaam1 jau4 toi4 saan1 lai4, ho2 do1 je5 dou1 m4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他刚从台山来，很多东西都不懂。
examples.english_sentence: He just came from Toisan and doesn't know many things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁講人哋啦，可能佢細個喺台山長大啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 gong2 jan4 dei6 laa1, ho2 nang4 keoi5 sai3 go3 hai2 toi4 saan1 zoeng2 daai6 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那样说人家啦，可能他小时候在台山长大而已。
examples.english_sentence: Don't say that about him, maybe he just grew up in Toisan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲衣着真係好台山，成日都係咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 ji1 zoek3 zan1 hai6 hou2 toi4 saan1, seng4 jat6 dou1 hai6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的穿着真的很土气，总是这样。
examples.english_sentence: Her clothes are really unsophisticated, always like that.

english_meaning: New Taiwan Dollar (NTD)
explanation_mandarin: 台灣使用的貨幣，正式名稱為新台幣。
explanation_english: The currency used in Taiwan, officially known as the New Taiwan Dollar (NTD).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個手袋要幾多台幣啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sau2 doi2 jiu3 gei2 do1 toi4 bai6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个手提包要多少台币啊？
examples.english_sentence: How much does this handbag cost in New Taiwan Dollars?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺台灣旅行嗰陣用咗好多台幣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 toi4 waan1 leoi5 hang4 go2 zan6 yung6 zo2 hou2 do1 toi4 bai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在台湾旅行的时候花了很多台币。
examples.english_sentence: I spent a lot of New Taiwan Dollars when I traveled in Taiwan.

english_meaning: TV station anniversary celebration
explanation_mandarin: 香港电视台（特别是无线电视TVB）每年举行的周年庆典活动，通常包括大型的电视节目、表演和抽奖等，以庆祝电视台成立周年。
explanation_english: Anniversary celebration of a Hong Kong television station (especially TVB - Television Broadcasts Limited), usually involving large-scale TV programs, performances, and lucky draws to celebrate the station's anniversary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅台慶節目好精彩，好多明星都有份表演。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ge3 toi4 hing3 zit3 muk6 hou2 zing1 coi2, hou2 do1 ming4 sing1 dou1 jau5 fan6 biu2 jin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的电视台周年庆典节目很精彩，很多明星都有参与表演。
examples.english_sentence: This year's TV station anniversary program is very exciting, with many celebrities participating in the performance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好想喺台慶抽中大獎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 soeng2 hai2 toi4 hing3 cau1 zung3 daai6 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很想在电视台周年庆典抽中大奖。
examples.english_sentence: He really wants to win the grand prize in the TV station's anniversary lucky draw.

english_meaning: a show; a performance; a drama; a scene (often in a negative or sarcastic sense)
explanation_mandarin: 指一场表演或戏剧，也可以指某种带有戏剧性的事件或场面，通常带有负面或讽刺的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to a performance or a play. It can also refer to a dramatic event or scene, often with a negative or sarcastic connotation. It implies the situation is often exaggerated or unnecessary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搞咁大龍鳳，都係得啖笑，真係一場台戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau2 gam3 daai6 lung4 fung6, dou1 hai6 dak1 daam6 siu3, zan1 hai6 jat1 coeng4 toi4 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 搞得这么大阵仗，结果只是个笑话，真是一场戏。
examples.english_sentence: Making such a big fuss, and it's all just a joke. It's really a show.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再喺度做戲啦，我知道你係扮嘢，唔係真心嘅，真係一場台戲咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 hai2 dou6 zou6 hei3 laa1, ngo5 zi1 dou3 nei5 hai6 baan6 je5, m4 hai6 zan1 sam1 ge3, zan1 hai6 jat1 coeng4 toi4 hei3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再在这里演戏了，我知道你是装的，不是真心的，真是一场戏。
examples.english_sentence: Stop acting here. I know you're pretending, not being genuine. It's really a show.

english_meaning: to support (someone); to back up (someone); to attend an event to show support
explanation_mandarin: 指通过出席活动或提供支持来支持某人或某事。通常带有捧场或撑场面的意味。
explanation_english: To support someone or something by attending an event or providing support. Often implies showing support or backing up someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢開鋪頭，我一定要去台東佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hoi1 pou3 tau4, ngo5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 heoi3 toi4 dung1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他开店，我一定要去捧场。
examples.english_sentence: He's opening a shop, I must go to support him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚個演唱會，好多明星都會去台東。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 go3 jin2 coeng3 wui2, hou2 do1 ming4 sing1 dou1 wui2 heoi3 toi4 dung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚的演唱会，很多明星都会去捧场。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight's concert, many celebrities will go to show their support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該你嚟台東我一下，我驚一個人搞唔掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 nei5 lai4 toi4 dung1 ngo5 jat1 haa5, ngo5 ging1 jat1 go3 jan4 gaau2 m4 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦你来支持我一下，我怕一个人搞不定。
examples.english_sentence: Please come and back me up, I'm afraid I can't handle it alone.

english_meaning: pillar; mainstay; leading actor or actress of a performance troupe; key figure in an organization
explanation_mandarin: 指剧团、公司等组织中起关键作用、具有代表性的人物；也指戏曲表演中的主要演员。
explanation_english: Refers to a key and representative figure in an organization such as a performance troupe or company. It can also refer to the leading actor or actress in a theatrical performance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係劇團嘅台柱，冇咗佢唔掂㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 kek6 tyun4 ge3 toi4 cyu5, mou5 zo2 keoi5 m4 dim6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是剧团的台柱，没有了他不行啊。
examples.english_sentence: He is the mainstay of the troupe; we can't do without him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅台柱就係佢哋班工程師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 toi4 cyu5 zau6 hai6 keoi5 dei6 baan1 gung1 cing4 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的台柱就是他们这批工程师。
examples.english_sentence: The key figures in this company are their team of engineers.

english_meaning: Taiwan
explanation_mandarin: 指台湾岛及其周边岛屿组成的地区，是中华民国实际控制的区域。
explanation_english: Refers to Taiwan and its surrounding islands, the area under the de facto control of the Republic of China (ROC).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月要去台灣旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 jiu3 heoi3 toi4 waan1 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月要去台湾旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to travel to Taiwan next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 台灣嘅嘢食好出名㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: toi4 waan1 ge3 je5 sik6 hou2 cheut1 ming4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 台湾的食物很有名。
examples.english_sentence: Taiwan's food is very famous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺台灣讀大學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 toi4 waan1 duk6 daai6 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在台湾读大学。
examples.english_sentence: He studies at a university in Taiwan.

mandarin_meaning: 台湾品牌; 台湾制造; 假冒产品 (带贬义)
english_meaning: Taiwan brand; Made in Taiwan; counterfeit product (with derogatory connotation)
explanation_mandarin: 原指台湾制造的产品或品牌。在香港，有时带有贬义，指质量差的假冒产品或劣质品，尤其指电子产品或玩具。
explanation_english: Originally refers to products or brands made in Taiwan. In Hong Kong, it sometimes has a derogatory connotation, referring to low-quality counterfeit products or inferior goods, especially electronics or toys.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲電子嘢好多都係台灣牌嚟㗎，買嘅時候要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 din6 zi2 je5 hou2 do1 dou1 hai6 toi4 waan1 paai4 lai4 gaa3, maai5 ge3 si4 hau6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些电子产品很多都是台湾品牌来的，买的时候要小心一些。
examples.english_sentence: Many of these electronic products are 'Taiwan brand', so be careful when buying them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為平就係好，好多都係台灣牌，用唔耐嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 peng4 zau6 hai6 hou2, hou2 do1 dou1 hai6 toi4 waan1 paai4, yung6 m4 noi6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为便宜就是好，很多都是台湾牌，用不长久的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think that cheap means good; many are 'Taiwan brand' and won't last long.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢隻錶係瑞士錶，但我覺得係台灣牌嚟嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 zek3 biu1 hai6 seoi6 si6 biu1, daan6 ngo5 gok3 dak1 hai6 toi4 waan1 paai4 lai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他的手表是瑞士表，但我觉得是台湾牌来的。
examples.english_sentence: He said his watch is a Swiss watch, but I think it's a 'Taiwan brand'.

english_meaning: Taiwan compatriot, Taiwanese compatriot
explanation_mandarin: 指来自台湾的同胞，是大陆地区对台湾人的称呼。
explanation_english: Refers to compatriots from Taiwan. It is a term used in mainland China to refer to Taiwanese people.
