examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多台胞都鍾意嚟香港玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 toi4 baau1 dou1 zung1 ji3 lei4 hoeng1 gong2 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多台湾同胞都喜欢来香港玩。
examples.english_sentence: Many Taiwanese compatriots like to come to Hong Kong for fun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 台胞證係台胞嚟大陸用嘅證件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: toi4 baau1 zing3 hai6 toi4 baau1 lei4 daai6 luk6 yung6 ge3 zing3 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 台胞证是台湾同胞来大陆使用的证件。
examples.english_sentence: The Taiwan Compatriot Permit is a document used by Taiwanese compatriots to enter mainland China.

english_meaning: lines (in a play or film); script
explanation_mandarin: 指剧本、电影等中角色所说的对白。
explanation_english: The lines spoken by actors in a play, film, or other performance; script.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢背台詞背得好熟練呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bui3 toi4 ci4 bui3 dak1 hou2 suk6 lin6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他背台词背得很熟练啊。
examples.english_sentence: He memorized the lines very fluently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢場戲嘅台詞好感人，睇到我眼濕濕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 coeng4 hei3 ge3 toi4 ci4 hou2 gam2 jan4, tai2 dou3 ngo5 ngaan5 sip1 sip1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这场戏的台词很感人，看到我眼眶湿润。
examples.english_sentence: The lines in this scene are very touching; they brought tears to my eyes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢臨場爆肚，加咗啲台詞落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lam4 coeng4 baau3 tou5, gaa1 zo2 di1 toi4 ci4 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他即兴发挥，加了一些台词进去。
examples.english_sentence: He improvised and added some lines on the spot.

english_meaning: Taiwanese language; Minnan language
explanation_mandarin: 指台湾地区通行的闽南语，也常被称作台湾话。
explanation_english: Refers to the Minnan language spoken in Taiwan, often also called Taiwanese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢識講台語，好叻㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sik1 gong2 toi4 jyu5, hou2 lek1 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他会说台湾话，很厉害！
examples.english_sentence: He can speak Taiwanese, he's very good at it!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我學緊啲台語歌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hok6 gan2 di1 toi4 jyu5 go1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我正在学一些台湾话歌曲。
examples.english_sentence: I'm learning some Taiwanese songs.

english_meaning: Table charge; Cover charge; Service charge (specifically at establishments like hostess bars or karaoke lounges)
explanation_mandarin: 通常指在某些娱乐场所，例如卡拉OK、夜总会等，客人需要支付的，除了酒水饮料之外，占用座位或包厢的费用。 也可泛指一般的服务费，但较常用于娱乐场所。
explanation_english: Refers to a charge levied at entertainment venues, such as karaoke lounges or hostess bars, in addition to the cost of drinks, to cover the use of a table or private room. It can also broadly refer to a service charge, but is more commonly used in the context of entertainment venues.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚去唱K，台費都幾貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 heoi3 cheung3 kei1, toi4 fai3 dou1 gei2 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚去唱卡拉OK，包厢费挺贵的。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to karaoke tonight, the table charge is quite expensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間酒吧嘅台費包埋啲小食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 jau5 baa1 ge3 toi4 fai3 baau1 maai4 di1 siu2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家酒吧的台费包括一些小吃。
examples.english_sentence: The table charge at this bar includes some snacks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話唔想俾台費，所以企喺吧枱飲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 m4 seung2 bei2 toi4 fai3, so2 ji5 kei5 hai2 baa1 toi2 yam2 ye5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说不想付包厢费，所以站在吧台喝酒。
examples.english_sentence: He said he didn't want to pay the table charge, so he stood at the bar to drink.

mandarin_meaning: 钧鉴; 惠鉴; 尊鉴
english_meaning: Esteemed sir/madam (formal opening for letters, implying respect and asking for review)
explanation_mandarin: 一种书信用语，用于书信开头，表示尊敬，请对方审阅。多用于下级对上级、晚辈对长辈。
explanation_english: A formal salutation used at the beginning of a letter, expressing respect and requesting the recipient's perusal. Commonly used by subordinates to superiors, or juniors to seniors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 李生台鑒：近來工作繁忙，未能抽空拜訪，望請見諒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lei5 saang1 toi4 gaam3: gan6 loi4 gung1 zok3 bun1 mong4, mei6 nang4 cau1 hung3 baai3 fong2, mong6 cing2 gin3 loeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 李先生钧鉴：近来工作繁忙，未能抽空拜访，望请见谅。
examples.english_sentence: Esteemed Mr. Li: I have been busy with work lately and unable to visit. I hope you will understand.

english_meaning: steps, stairs; fig. a way out of an awkward situation; a way to save face; an excuse
explanation_mandarin: 字面意义是楼梯的台阶。比喻意义是给人一个体面的借口或机会来摆脱尴尬的局面。
explanation_english: Literally means steps or stairs. Figuratively, it refers to a way out of an embarrassing situation, a chance to save face, or an excuse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 俾個台階佢落啦，唔好再逼佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 go3 toi4 gaai1 keoi5 lok6 laa1, m4 hou2 zoi3 bik1 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 给他个台阶下吧，不要再逼他了。
examples.english_sentence: Give him a way out, don't push him anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢自己唔識搵台階落，盞搞到自己咁尷尬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi6 gei2 m4 sik1 wan2 toi4 gaai1 lok6, zaan2 gaau2 dou3 zi6 gei2 gam3 gaam3 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他自己不知道找个台阶下，只会让自己这么尴尬。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't know how to find a way to save face, which only makes himself so embarrassed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落雨，小心啲行台階呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 jyu5, siu2 sam1 di1 haang4 toi4 gaai1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下雨了，小心点走台阶啊。
examples.english_sentence: It's raining, be careful when walking on the steps.

english_meaning: to scold, to reprimand, to rebuke
explanation_mandarin: 大声责备。 用严厉的语言批评或责怪。
explanation_english: To scold or reprimand loudly. To criticize or blame with harsh language.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀老細叱到狗血淋頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 lou5 sai3 cik1 dou3 gau2 hyut3 lam4 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被老板骂得狗血淋头。
examples.english_sentence: He was scolded by the boss severely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽叱佢唔好咁唔生性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 cik1 keoi5 m4 hou2 gam3 m4 sang1 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈骂他不要这么不争气。
examples.english_sentence: Mom scolded him not to be so hopeless.

english_meaning: to dominate; to rule the roost; to be a powerful figure; to command the elements; to be influential and powerful
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人或势力非常强大，能够影响局势，具有支配能力。
explanation_english: Describes a person or organization that is powerful and influential, capable of dominating a situation and wielding considerable influence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺商界叱吒風雲，冇人夠佢鬥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 soeng1 gaai3 cik1 zaa3 fung1 wan4, mou5 jan4 gau3 keoi5 dau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在商界呼风唤雨，没有人能和他竞争。
examples.english_sentence: He dominates the business world; no one can compete with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電影講嘅係一個黑幫大佬叱吒風雲嘅一生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 ying2 gong2 ge3 hai6 jat1 go3 hak1 bong1 daai6 lou2 cik1 zaa3 fung1 wan4 ge3 jat1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影讲述了一个黑帮老大气势逼人的一生。
examples.english_sentence: This movie tells the story of a powerful gangster's dominating life.

english_meaning: to dominate, to command, to rule, to be powerful and influential
explanation_mandarin: 形容声势威力很大，能左右局势。也可以形容人很厉害，很有影响力。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something powerful and influential, capable of dominating and controlling a situation. Can also describe a person who is very capable and influential.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺商界叱咤風雲，好多人都好敬佩佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 soeng1 gaai3 cik1 zaa3 fung1 wan4, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 hou2 ging3 pui3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在商界叱吒风云，很多人都很敬佩他。
examples.english_sentence: He dominates the business world, and many people admire him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個就好想可以喺舞台上面叱咤一時。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 zau6 hou2 soeng2 ho2 ji5 hai2 mou5 toi4 soeng6 min6 cik1 zaa3 jat1 si4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候就想在舞台上叱咤一时。
examples.english_sentence: Since he was young, he wanted to dominate the stage for a period of time.

english_meaning: to dominate; to be powerful and influential; to rule the roost; to have great power and influence; to storm the world
explanation_mandarin: 形容声势威力极大，可以左右局势。比喻有巨大影响力的人物或事物。
explanation_english: Describes someone with immense power and influence, capable of controlling or significantly affecting a situation. It refers to a person or entity with great power and influence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺商界叱咤風雲咗好多年啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 soeng1 gaai3 cik1 zaa3 fung1 wan4 zo2 hou2 do1 nin4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在商界叱咤风云很多年了。
examples.english_sentence: He has been a dominant figure in the business world for many years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲講述一個小人物點樣一步一步咁叱咤風雲嘅故事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 gong2 suk6 jat1 go3 siu2 jan4 mat6 dim2 joeng2 jat1 bou6 jat1 bou6 gam2 cik1 zaa3 fung1 wan4 ge3 gu3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影讲述了一个小人物如何一步一步叱咤风云的故事。
examples.english_sentence: This movie tells the story of how a small person step by step becomes a dominant force.

english_meaning: to scold, to reprimand, to berate
explanation_mandarin: 大声责骂。以严厉的言辞责备。
explanation_english: To scold loudly and severely. To reprimand with harsh words.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個老細成日都叱喝啲員工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 lou5 sai3 seng4 jat6 dou1 cik1 hot3 di1 jyun4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个老板总是斥责员工。
examples.english_sentence: That boss always scolds the employees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好用呢種態度叱喝我，我唔係你嘅下屬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 yung6 ni1 zung2 taai3 dou6 cik1 hot3 ngo5, ngo5 m4 hai6 nei5 ge3 haa6 suk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要用这种态度斥责我，我不是你的下属。
examples.english_sentence: Don't use that tone to scold me, I'm not your subordinate.

english_meaning: to scold, to reprimand, to berate
explanation_mandarin: 指严厉地责备，用严厉的言语批评。
explanation_english: To scold or reprimand severely, usually with harsh words.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為做錯嘢畀老細叱罵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 zou6 co3 je5 bei2 lou5 sai3 cik1 maa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为做错事被老板斥责了。
examples.english_sentence: He was scolded by the boss for doing something wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽成日叱罵啲細路唔聽話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 seng4 jat6 cik1 maa6 di1 sai3 lou6 m4 ting1 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈总是责骂孩子们不听话。
examples.english_sentence: Mom always scolds the kids for not listening.

english_meaning: to scold, to reprimand, to berate
explanation_mandarin: 严厉地责备、斥责。
explanation_english: To scold or reprimand someone severely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為遲到成日俾老細叱駡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 ci4 dou3 seng4 jat6 bei2 lou5 sai3 cik1 maa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为迟到总是被老板斥责。
examples.english_sentence: He is always scolded by his boss for being late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁容易叱駡啲細路，佢哋會唔開心㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 jung4 ji6 cik1 maa6 di1 sai3 lou2, keoi5 dei6 wui5 m4 hoi1 sam1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么容易斥责小孩子，他们会不开心的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't scold the children so easily; they will be unhappy.

english_meaning: shit; excrement; feces
explanation_mandarin: 粤语中“史”是“屎”的口语说法，指粪便。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "史" (si2) is the colloquial term for "屎" (si2), meaning excrement or feces.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好踩到啲史啊，好臭㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 caai2 dou2 di1 si2 aa3, hou2 cau3 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别踩到那些屎啊，很臭的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't step on that shit, it's really smelly!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻狗疴咗督史喺地下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 gau2 o1 zo2 duk1 si2 hai2 dei6 haa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那只狗在地上拉了一坨屎。
examples.english_sentence: That dog took a dump on the floor.

english_meaning: historically; in history; the most... in history
explanation_mandarin: 指在历史上，通常用来表示程度上的最高级，类似于“有史以来”。
explanation_english: Refers to something in history. It is usually used to express the highest degree, similar to "ever in history" or "of all time".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲係史上最賣座嘅港產片。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 hai6 si2 soeng6 zeoi3 maai6 zo6 ge3 gong2 caan2 pin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影是历史上最卖座的香港电影。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is the highest-grossing Hong Kong movie in history.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅氣溫係史上最高嘅一年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ge3 hei3 wan1 hai6 si2 soeng6 zeoi3 gou1 ge3 jat1 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的气温是历史上最高的一年。
examples.english_sentence: This year's temperature is the highest in history.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅服務態度係史上最差嘅！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 fuk6 mou6 taai3 dou6 hai6 si2 soeng6 zeoi3 caa1 ge3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的服务态度是历史上最差的！
examples.english_sentence: The service attitude of this restaurant is the worst in history!

english_meaning: prehistoric; extremely outdated
explanation_mandarin: 本意指人类有文字记录之前的时期。也可引申为非常古老，非常过时，落后于时代。
explanation_english: Literally refers to the period before written history. Can also be used figuratively to describe something extremely old, outdated, or behind the times.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你部電話咁史前，都唔知點解仲用緊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bou6 din6 waa2 gam3 si2 cin4, dou1 m4 zi1 dim2 gaai2 zung6 yung6 gan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的手机这么古老，真不知道你为什么还在用。
examples.english_sentence: Your phone is so prehistoric, I don't know why you're still using it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個電腦程式好史前，根本冇人識用。

explanation_english: Describes someone with right-wing political leanings who is perceived as naive, idealistic, and lacking the toughness or pragmatism expected of a 'true' right-winger. It is often used pejoratively to criticize their perceived lack of decisiveness, impracticality, or even betrayal of right-wing principles. The term '膠' (gaau1) implies being 'soft' or easily manipulated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講啲唔切實際嘅嘢，真係右膠嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gong2 di1 m4 cit3 sat6 zai3 ge3 je5, zan1 hai6 jau6 gaau1 lei4 ge3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说一些不切实际的事情，真是个右翼幼稚派。
examples.english_sentence: He always says impractical things; he's such a right-wing softie.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁右膠啦，政治唔係咁簡單嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 jau6 gaau1 laa1, zing3 zi6 m4 hai6 gam3 gaan2 daan1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么天真了，政治不是这么简单的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so naive; politics isn't that simple.

english_meaning: Hard to handle; difficult to control; steering to the right (literally right rudder)
explanation_mandarin: 比喻难以驾驭，不容易控制。字面意思是向右打舵。
explanation_english: Figuratively describes something or someone difficult to manage or control. Literally means steering to the right using the rudder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個細路好右舦，成日搞搞震。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sai3 lou2 hou2 jau6 tai5, seng4 jat6 gaau2 gaau2 zan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个小孩很难管教，整天捣蛋。
examples.english_sentence: This kid is very hard to handle, always causing trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司自從換咗老闆之後，就右舦咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 zi6 cung4 wun6 zo2 lou5 baan2 zi1 hau6, zau6 jau6 tai5 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从公司换了老板之后，就变得很难控制了。
examples.english_sentence: Since the company changed its boss, it has become very difficult to control.

english_meaning: Right-hand drive
explanation_mandarin: 指车辆的方向盘在右侧，驾驶员坐在车辆右边。
explanation_english: Refers to a vehicle with the steering wheel on the right-hand side, where the driver sits on the right side of the vehicle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港啲車全部都係右軚㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 di1 ce1 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 jau6 taai1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的车都是右舵的。
examples.english_sentence: All the cars in Hong Kong are right-hand drive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 揸慣咗左軚車，初初揸右軚車有啲唔慣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zaa1 gwaan3 zo2 zo2 taai1 ce1, co1 co1 zaa1 jau6 taai1 ce1 jau5 di1 m4 gwaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 习惯了开左舵车，刚开始开右舵车有点不习惯。
examples.english_sentence: Being used to driving left-hand drive cars, I'm a little unaccustomed to driving right-hand drive cars at first.

english_meaning: Right-hand drive car
explanation_mandarin: 指驾驶座位在车辆右侧的汽车。
explanation_english: Refers to a car with the steering wheel located on the right side of the vehicle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港都係行右軚車嘅，同英國一樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 dou1 hai6 hang4 jau6 taai3 ce1 ge3, tung4 jing1 gwok3 jat1 joeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港也是行驶右舵车的，和英国一样。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong also drives right-hand drive cars, like the UK.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺香港揸左軚車要攞特別許可證㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 hoeng1 gong2 zaa1 zo2 taai3 ce1 jiu3 lo2 dak6 bit1 heoi2 ho2 zing3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在香港开左舵车需要获得特别许可证的。
examples.english_sentence: You need a special permit to drive a left-hand drive car in Hong Kong.

english_meaning: right side; to the right of
explanation_mandarin: 指方向或位置，表示在右侧。
explanation_english: Refers to the direction or position on the right side.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳喺你嘅右邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 hai2 nei5 ge3 jau6 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 餐厅在你右边。
examples.english_sentence: The restaurant is on your right.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行右邊條路就會到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 jau6 bin1 tiu4 lou6 zau6 wui5 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 走右边的路就会到。
examples.english_sentence: You will arrive if you take the road on the right.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請你企喺我嘅右邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 nei5 kei5 hai2 ngo5 ge3 jau6 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请你站在我的右边。
examples.english_sentence: Please stand to my right.

english_meaning: right side; right
explanation_mandarin: 指方向的右边。
explanation_english: Refers to the right side as a direction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間銀行喺你嘅右面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 ngan4 hong4 hai2 nei5 ge3 jau6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 银行在你右边。
examples.english_sentence: The bank is on your right.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢企喺我嘅右面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kei5 hai2 ngo5 ge3 jau6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他站在我的右边。
examples.english_sentence: He is standing on my right.

english_meaning: not permissible; cannot; surmise; to guess
explanation_mandarin: 表示不可以，不能。也指猜测，揣测。
explanation_english: Indicates 'not permissible', 'cannot'. Also refers to guessing or surmising.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 居心叵測。
examples.jyutping_sentence: geoi1 sam1 po2 cak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 居心叵测。
examples.english_sentence: To have sinister motives; of dubious character.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅行為真係令人叵測。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hang4 wai4 zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 po2 cak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的行为真是令人难以揣测。
examples.english_sentence: His behavior is really unpredictable.

english_meaning: page
explanation_mandarin: 用于书、文件等。相当于“页”。
explanation_english: Measure word for pages in a book, document, etc. Equivalent to 'page'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 本書有三百叶紙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun2 syu1 jau5 saam1 baak3 jip6 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书有三百页纸。
examples.english_sentence: This book has three hundred pages.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告有十幾叶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 jau5 sap6 gei2 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告有十几页。
examples.english_sentence: This report has more than ten pages.

english_meaning: homophone; to sound like
explanation_mandarin: 指两个或多个字词发音相似或相同。
explanation_english: Refers to two or more words that sound similar or identical (homophones).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日用叶音嚟讲笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 yung6 hip3 jam1 lai4 gong2 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常用谐音来开玩笑。
examples.english_sentence: He often uses homophones to make jokes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢个名嘅叶音唔系几好听。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 meng2 ge3 hip3 jam1 m4 hai6 gei2 hou2 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个名字的谐音不太好听。
examples.english_sentence: The homophone of this name doesn't sound very good.

mandarin_meaning: 号码; 日; 记号; 命令
english_meaning: number; date; mark; order, command
explanation_mandarin: 1. 数字的排列。2. 日期。3. 标志、记号。4. 命令、下令。
explanation_english: 1. Number. 2. Date. 3. Mark, sign. 4. Order, command.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你電話號碼係幾多號呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 din6 waa2 hou6 maa5 hai6 gei2 do1 hou6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的电话号码是多少？
examples.english_sentence: What is your phone number?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日幾多号呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 gei2 do1 hou6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天几号？
examples.english_sentence: What's the date today?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 收到老細嘅命令，要加班。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau1 dou2 lou5 sai3 ge3 ming6 ling6, jiu3 gaa1 baan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 收到老板的命令，要加班。
examples.english_sentence: Received the boss's order, need to work overtime.

mandarin_meaning: 管理机构; 部门; 公司
english_meaning: office; department; company; to control; to take charge of
explanation_mandarin: 机构或部门的名称；主管，管理。
explanation_english: A name for an institution or department; to manage; to be in charge of.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺一間大公司做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jat1 gaan1 daai6 gung1 si1 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在一家大公司工作。
examples.english_sentence: He works at a big company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個部門由佢嚟司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 bou6 mun4 jau4 keoi5 lai4 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个部门由他来主管。
examples.english_sentence: This department is managed by him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係呢間律師樓嘅老闆，即係佢司晒成間嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ni1 gaan1 leot6 si1 lau2 ge3 lou5 baan2, zik1 hai6 keoi5 si1 saai3 seng4 gaan1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是这家律师事务所的老板，也就是说他掌管整个事务所。
examples.english_sentence: He is the boss of this law firm, which means he is in charge of the whole firm.

english_meaning: Commander; Person in charge; To give orders
explanation_mandarin: 名词：指军队的指挥官。动词：指发号施令，主导事务。
explanation_english: Noun: Commander, specifically referring to the military. Verb: To command, to be in charge and giving orders.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺間公司入邊好似個司令噉，乜都佢話事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gaan1 gung1 si1 jap6 bin1 hou2 ci5 go3 si1 ling6-2 gam2, mat1 dou1 keoi5 waa6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在那间公司里好像个司令一样，什么都他说了算。
examples.english_sentence: He's like a commander in that company, he makes all the decisions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺度司令啦，人哋唔會聽你講㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 si1 ling6-2 laa1, jan4 dei6 m4 wui5 ting1 nei5 gong2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在这里发号施令了，别人不会听你的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't give orders here, people won't listen to you.

english_meaning: Headquarters; Command Post
explanation_mandarin: 军队或武装力量的指挥机关所在地。
explanation_english: The headquarters of an army or armed force; the command post.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋個司令部搬咗去新嘅位置啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 go3 si1 ling6 bou6 bun1 zo2 heoi3 san1 ge3 wai6 zi3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的司令部搬到了新的位置了。
examples.english_sentence: Their headquarters has moved to a new location.

english_meaning: Master of ceremonies (MC), host
explanation_mandarin: 主持仪式或节目的主持人。
explanation_english: A person who hosts and guides an event, ceremony, or program; a master of ceremonies (MC).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚個婚禮嘅司儀好識搞氣氛，大家都好開心。

examples.english_sentence: The MC of the wedding tonight is very good at creating a lively atmosphere, everyone is very happy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做司儀經驗豐富，應付突發情況都好淡定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 si1 ji4 ging1 jim6 fung1 fu3, jing3 fui6 dat6 faat3 cing4 kwong3 dou1 hou2 daam6 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做主持经验丰富，应对突发情况都很冷静。
examples.english_sentence: He is very experienced as an MC, and he is very calm when dealing with unexpected situations.

english_meaning: Snickers (a chocolate bar)
explanation_mandarin: 香港对美国巧克力棒Snickers的音译名称。
explanation_english: A transliteration of the American chocolate bar Snickers into Cantonese.

examples.english_sentence: I want to buy a Snickers bar, thank you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣成日食司力架，好甜㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 sik6 si1 lik6 gaa1, hou2 tim4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候经常吃士力架，很甜的。
examples.english_sentence: I often ate Snickers when I was young, it's very sweet.

mandarin_meaning: 司徒 (古代官名); 姓氏
english_meaning: Situ (ancient official title); a surname
explanation_mandarin: 司徒是古代的一种官职，负责管理土地和人民。现在也用作姓氏。
explanation_english: Situ was an ancient official title responsible for managing land and the people. It is now also used as a surname.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢姓司徒。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他姓司徒。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 司徒这个姓很少见。
examples.english_sentence: The surname Situ is quite rare.

english_meaning: driver
explanation_mandarin: 驾驶车辆的人。
explanation_english: A person who drives a vehicle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要搵個司機車我哋去機場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 wan2 go3 si1 gei1 ce1 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 gei1 coeng4.

examples.english_sentence: His job is a taxi driver.

english_meaning: Judiciary; justice
explanation_mandarin: 指国家审判机关及其进行的活动，包括法院的设立、审判制度、诉讼程序等。
explanation_english: Refers to the judicial organs of a state and their activities, including the establishment of courts, judicial system, litigation procedures, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單案件交咗畀司法機構處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 on3 gin2 gaau1 zo2 bei2 si1 faat3 gei1 kau3 cyu5 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这起案件已经交给司法机构处理。
examples.english_sentence: This case has been handed over to the judiciary for processing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅司法制度相當獨立。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 si1 faat3 zai3 dou6 soeng1 daang1 duk6 lap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的司法制度相当独立。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's judicial system is quite independent.

english_meaning: Judicial Review
explanation_mandarin: 一种法律程序，指个人或团体对政府或公共机构的决定提出质疑，请求法院审查该决定是否合法、合理。
explanation_english: A legal process by which an individual or group challenges a decision made by a government or public body, asking a court to review the legality and reasonableness of the decision.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋就政府嘅決定提出咗司法覆核。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zau6 zing3 fu2 ge3 kyut3 ding6 tai4 ceot1 zo2 si1 faat3 fuk1 hak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们就政府的决定提出了司法复核。
examples.english_sentence: They filed a judicial review against the government's decision.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 法官駁回咗佢哋嘅司法覆核申請。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 guan1 bok3 wui4 zo2 keoi5 dei6 ge3 si1 faat3 fuk1 hak6 san1 cing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 法官驳回了他们的司法复核申请。
examples.english_sentence: The judge rejected their application for judicial review.

english_meaning: manager
explanation_mandarin: 旧时对经理的称呼，现在较少使用。
explanation_english: An old-fashioned term for 'manager', now rarely used.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前嘅舖頭興叫老細做司理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 ge3 pou3 tau2 hing3 giu3 lou5 sai3 zou6 si1 lei5.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺間公司做司理好多年喇。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在那家公司当经理很多年了。
examples.english_sentence: He has been a manager in that company for many years.

english_meaning: Pianist, accompanist, keyboard player
explanation_mandarin: 指负责弹奏钢琴的人，常用于宗教场所或合唱团中。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who plays the piano, often used in religious settings or choirs; a pianist or accompanist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 教會個司琴彈得好好聽呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau2 wui2 go3 si1 kam4 taan4 dak1 hou2 hou2 teng1 aa3.

examples.english_sentence: The pianist in the church plays very beautifully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係合唱團嘅司琴。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是合唱团的钢琴伴奏者。
examples.english_sentence: He is the pianist for the choir.

english_meaning: Master of ceremonies; MC; to host; to emcee
explanation_mandarin: 指在婚礼、宴会等场合主持仪式的人，也指主持仪式这个动作。
explanation_english: Refers to the person who hosts a ceremony (like a wedding or banquet), or the act of hosting the ceremony itself. Equivalent to 'Master of Ceremonies' or 'MC'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺婚禮上面做司祝，搞得好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 fan1 lai5 soeng6 min6 zou6 si1 zuk1, gaau2 dak1 hou2 hou2.

examples.english_sentence: Who is the MC for the party tonight?

english_meaning: to turn a blind eye; to ignore; to be indifferent to
explanation_mandarin: 对常见的事物或不好的现象，见惯不怪，不加以注意或过问。
explanation_english: To turn a blind eye to something that is common or bad, to become accustomed to it and not pay attention to it or get involved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日遲到，老細都司空見慣啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 seng4 jat6 ci4 dou3, lou5 sai3 dou1 si1 hung1 gin3 gwaan3 laa1.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 jan4 deoi3 taam1 wu1 ge3 je5 dou1 si1 hung1 gin3 gwaan3, mou5 saai3 gam2 gok3.

english_meaning: a common sight; nothing new; commonplace
explanation_mandarin: 指某事物常见，不足为奇。
explanation_english: Describes something that is so common that it's no longer surprising or remarkable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲新聞成日都係講呢啲嘢，真係司空見慣喇。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的新闻总是说这些事，真是司空见惯了。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, the news is always talking about these things, it's really commonplace.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺香港，咁多人搭地鐵，迫到沙甸魚咁，都司空見慣嘅事嚟㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 hoeng1 gong2, gam3 do1 jan4 daap3 dei6 tit3, bik1 dou3 saa1 din1 jyu2 gam3, dou1 si1 hung1 gin3 gwaan3 ge3 si6 lai4 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在香港，那么多人坐地铁，挤得像沙丁鱼一样，这都是司空见惯的事情了。
examples.english_sentence: In Hong Kong, so many people take the subway, packed like sardines, it's all commonplace.

english_meaning: to be in charge of, to hold a post, to be responsible for a specific duty or role
explanation_mandarin: 担任某个特定的职务或职责。指一个人在工作或组织中负责的岗位。
explanation_english: To be in charge of or responsible for a specific duty, role, or position. It refers to the post a person holds within a job or organization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺間公司司職市場推廣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gaan1 gung1 si1 si1 zik1 si5 coeng4 tui1 gwong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在那家公司负责市场推广。
examples.english_sentence: He is in charge of marketing in that company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋部門司職處理所有嘅投訴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 bou6 mun4 si1 zik1 cyu5 lei5 so2 jau5 ge3 tau4 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们部门负责处理所有的投诉。
examples.english_sentence: Our department is responsible for handling all complaints.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢司職保安，所以要成日巡邏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 si1 zik1 bou2 on1, so2 ji5 jiu3 seng4 jat6 cheun4 lo4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他担任保安的职务，所以要经常巡逻。
examples.english_sentence: He is responsible for security, so he has to patrol frequently.

mandarin_meaning: 热狗肠；男性生殖器 (粗俗语)
english_meaning: Hot dog sausage; penis (vulgar)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是“史华力肠”，香港口语中常用来指热狗肠。同时，也被用作对男性生殖器的粗俗称呼。
explanation_english: Literally means "Sih Wah Lik Sausage". In Hong Kong colloquial speech, it is commonly used to refer to a hot dog sausage. It is also used as a vulgar term for the male genitalia.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日晏晝食咗條司華力腸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 aan3 zau3 sik6 zo2 tiu4 si1 waa4 lik6 cheung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天中午吃了一根热狗肠。
examples.english_sentence: I ate a hot dog sausage for lunch today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪咁無禮貌，唔好講啲咁嘅嘢，咩司華力腸啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 gam3 mou4 lai5 maau6, m4 hou2 gong2 di1 gam3 ge3 je5, me1 si1 waa4 lik6 cheung2 aa!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么没礼貌，不要说这些东西，什么“司华力肠”啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so rude, don't say such things, what "Sih Wah Lik Sausage"!

english_meaning: Judicial Police
explanation_mandarin: 指澳门特别行政区的司法警察，负责刑事侦查和维护社会治安。
explanation_english: Refers to the Judiciary Police of the Macao Special Administrative Region, responsible for criminal investigation and maintaining social order.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 澳門嘅司警權力都幾大㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ou3 mun2 ge3 si1 ging2 kyuen4 lik6 dou1 gei2 daai6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 澳门的司法警察权力挺大的。
examples.english_sentence: The powers of the Judiciary Police in Macau are quite significant.

english_meaning: priest (Catholic)
explanation_mandarin: 天主教的神职人员，神父。
explanation_english: A priest in the Catholic Church.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個司鐸好有愛心，成日幫啲窮人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 si1 dok6 hou2 jau5 oi3 sam1, seng4 jat6 bong1 di1 kung4 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个神父很有爱心，经常帮助穷人。
examples.english_sentence: That priest is very compassionate and always helps the poor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嘅時候想做司鐸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 soeng2 zou6 si1 dok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候想当神父。
examples.english_sentence: He wanted to become a priest when he was a child.

english_meaning: Secretary (of a government bureau in Hong Kong)
explanation_mandarin: 香港政府部门的首长，通常负责一个决策局。
explanation_english: The head of a government bureau in Hong Kong, usually responsible for a policy bureau.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 財政司司長負責制定香港嘅財政預算。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coi4 zing3 si1 si1 zoeng2 fu3 zaak3 zai3 ding6 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 coi4 zing3 jyu6 syun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 财政司司长负责制定香港的财政预算。
examples.english_sentence: The Financial Secretary is responsible for formulating Hong Kong's budget.

english_meaning: to fire, to sack, to dismiss (from employment)
explanation_mandarin: 香港俚语，指解雇某人，即开除。
explanation_english: Hong Kong slang meaning to fire someone, to dismiss someone from their job. The origin of the term is unknown, but it's speculated to be related to the surname Sima (司馬) somehow. It's considered quite colloquial.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日遲到，好快會俾老細司馬㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 ci4 dou3, hou2 faai3 wui5 bei2 lou5 sai3 si1 maa5 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是迟到，很快会被老板开除的。
examples.english_sentence: He's always late; he'll be fired by the boss soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好以為咁hea都得呀，分分鐘俾人司馬你都唔知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 gam3 hea1 dou1 dak1 aa3, fan1 fan1 zung1 bei2 jan4 si1 maa5 nei5 dou1 m4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要以为这样混日子也可以，说不定什么时候就被炒鱿鱼了你都不知道。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can slack off like this. You might get fired without even knowing it.

english_meaning: so-so, mediocre, just passable
explanation_mandarin: 形容质量或水平一般，不太好也不太坏，介于好与坏之间。
explanation_english: Describes something as being so-so, mediocre, or just passable. It's neither particularly good nor particularly bad, but somewhere in between.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試我考得司馬両啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ngo5 haau2 dak1 si1 maa5 loeng2 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我考得马马虎虎。
examples.english_sentence: I did so-so in this exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食司馬両啦，唔算好好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 si1 maa5 loeng2 laa1, m4 syun3 hou2 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物一般般，不算很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is so-so, not particularly delicious.

english_meaning: So-so; Not good, not bad; Perfunctory; Mediocre
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情做得一般般，不太好也不太坏，或者敷衍了事。 多用于评价事情的质量或态度。
explanation_english: Describes something done in a mediocre way, neither good nor bad, or done perfunctorily. Often used to evaluate the quality of something or someone's attitude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲功課做得司馬兩，都唔用心機嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 gung1 fo3 zou6 dak1 si1 maa5 loeng5, dou1 m4 jung6 sam1 gei1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做的功课马马虎虎，都没用心思。
examples.english_sentence: He does his homework so-so, he doesn't put in effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食都係司馬兩啫，冇咩特別。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 dou1 hai6 si1 maa5 loeng5 ze1, mou5 me1 dak6 bit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物也就那样，没什么特别的。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is just so-so, nothing special.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告寫得司馬兩，要改改佢先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dak1 si1 maa5 loeng5, jiu3 goi2 goi2 keoi5 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告写得马马虎虎，要修改一下才行。
examples.english_sentence: This report is written so-so, it needs to be revised.

english_meaning: slow; slow-witted; dull; clumsy
explanation_mandarin: 形容人反应迟钝，或者动作笨手笨脚。
explanation_english: Describes someone as being slow-witted, dull, or having clumsy movements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢咁司馬斤，幾時先做得完啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 gam3 si1 maa5 gan1, gei2 si4 sin1 zou6 dak1 jyun4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做事这么慢，什么时候才能做完啊？
examples.english_sentence: You're so slow at working, when will you ever finish?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁司馬斤啦，快啲啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 si1 maa5 gan1 laa1, faai3 di1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么迟钝了，快点啦！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so slow, hurry up!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個腦好似有啲司馬斤咁，反應好慢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 nou5 hou2 ci5 jau5 di1 si1 maa5 gan1 gam3, faan2 jing3 hou2 maan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的脑子好像有点迟钝，反应很慢。
examples.english_sentence: His brain seems a bit slow, his reaction is very slow.

english_meaning: Sima Zhao's heart is known to all; Sima Zhao's intention is obvious to everyone.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻野心非常明显，人人都知道。
explanation_english: This idiom refers to Sima Zhao, a powerful figure in the Three Kingdoms period of Chinese history, whose ambition to usurp the throne was well known. It means someone's ambition or ulterior motive is so obvious that everyone is aware of it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺老細面前表現自己，司馬昭之心，人人都知佢想升職啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 lou5 sai3 min6 cin4 biu2 hin6 zi6 gei2, si1 maa5 ziu1 zi1 sam1, jan4 jan4 dou1 zi1 keoi5 soeng2 sing1 zik1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天在老板面前表现自己，司马昭之心，人人都知道他想升职了。
examples.english_sentence: He's always trying to show off in front of the boss. Sima Zhao's heart is obvious; everyone knows he wants a promotion.

mandarin_meaning: 不准確的秤；不公平的評判
english_meaning: Inaccurate scale; unfair judgment; biased assessment
explanation_mandarin: 一種不準確的傳統杆秤，比喻不公正、不公平的評判或待遇。
explanation_english: A traditional steelyard balance that is inaccurate, used metaphorically to describe an unfair judgment or treatment, a biased assessment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你用司馬秤度人，梗係唔公平啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 yung6 si1 maa5 cing3 dok6 yan4, gang2 hai6 m4 gung1 ping4 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你用不公平的标准衡量别人，当然不公平了！
examples.english_sentence: You're judging people with an unfair standard, of course it's unfair!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個考試好似用司馬秤咁，明顯偏袒啲有錢學生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 haau2 si3 hou2 ci5 yung6 si1 maa5 cing3 gam2, ming4 hin2 pin1 taan2 di1 yau5 chin2 hok6 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试好像用不公平的标准，明显偏袒有钱的学生。
examples.english_sentence: This exam seems to use an unfair standard, clearly favoring the wealthy students.

english_meaning: to sigh; to enjoy leisurely; to take pleasure in; to savour
explanation_mandarin: 享受、悠闲地享受。也可以表示叹气。
explanation_english: To enjoy something leisurely and comfortably. It can also mean to sigh, but in this context, it more commonly means 'to enjoy'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 得閒嘅時候，我最鍾意去飲杯咖啡，叹下世界。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dak1 haan4 ge3 si4 hau2, ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 heoi3 jam2 bui1 gaa3 fe1, taan3 haa5 sai3 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 空闲的时候，我最喜欢去喝一杯咖啡，享受一下。
examples.english_sentence: When I'm free, I like to grab a coffee and enjoy myself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴日去咗按摩，叹咗成个晏昼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 heoi3 zo2 on3 mo1, taan3 zo2 seng4 go3 aan3 zau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天去按摩了，享受了一个下午。
examples.english_sentence: He went for a massage yesterday and enjoyed the whole afternoon.

english_meaning: smart, capable, clever, competent
explanation_mandarin: 形容人聪明能干，有能力。通常用于口语。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is smart, capable, clever, and competent. Commonly used in spoken Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好叻㗎，乜嘢都識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 lek1 gaa3, mat1 je5 dou1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很聪明能干，什么都知道。
examples.english_sentence: He is very clever and capable; he knows everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁叻，一定搞得掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 lek1, jat1 ding6 gaau2 dak1 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么聪明，一定能搞定的。
examples.english_sentence: You're so smart; you'll definitely be able to handle it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁叻啦，謙虛啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 lek1 laa1, him1 heoi1 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么自作聪明了，谦虚一点吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so cocky; be more humble.

mandarin_meaning: 很棒的, 很厉害的, 厉害的
english_meaning: Awesome, great, capable, talented, skillful (usually used with a tone of approval and sometimes admiration)
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人很棒、很厉害，具有某种才能或技能，通常带有赞赏的语气。
explanation_english: Indicates that someone is awesome, great, or skillful, possessing a certain talent or ability. It is usually used with a tone of approval and sometimes admiration.  The '㗎' is a sentence-final particle that adds emphasis and a sense of affirmation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畫畫叻㗎，細細個就開始學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa2 waa2 lek1 gaa3, sai3 sai3 go3 zau6 hoi1 chi2 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他画画很厉害，从小就开始学。
examples.english_sentence: He's great at painting. He started learning since he was little.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁快就搞掂曬？真係叻㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 faai3 zau6 gaau2 dim6 saai3? zan1 hai6 lek1 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么快就完成了？ 真的很厉害！
examples.english_sentence: You finished so quickly? You're really awesome!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個廚師整嘢食好叻㗎，好多人都嚟幫襯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 cyu4 si1 zing2 je5 sik6 hou2 lek1 gaa3, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 lei4 bong1 can3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个厨师做菜很厉害，很多人都来光顾。
examples.english_sentence: This chef is very skillful at cooking. Many people come to patronize him.

mandarin_meaning: 聪明的小伙子；能干的人
english_meaning: clever boy; capable person; smart guy
explanation_mandarin: 通常用来称赞年轻男性聪明、能干。也可用作形容词，表示某人很厉害。
explanation_english: Usually used to praise a young man for being clever and capable. Can also be used as an adjective to describe someone as being very capable or impressive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個後生仔好叻仔，咁快就升咗職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hau6 sang1 zai2 hou2 lek1 zai2, gam3 faai3 zau6 sing1 zo2 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个年轻人很能干，这么快就升职了。
examples.english_sentence: This young man is very capable, he got promoted so quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細細個就已經係個叻仔，學咩都好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 sai3 go3 zau6 ji5 ging1 hai6 go3 lek1 zai2, hok6 me1 dou1 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他从小就是一个聪明的孩子，学什么都很快。
examples.english_sentence: He has been a smart boy since he was young, he learns everything quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你真係叻仔，咁難嘅嘢都搞得掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zan1 hai6 lek1 zai2, gam3 naan4 ge3 ye5 dou1 gaau2 dak1 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你真厉害，这么难的事情都搞定了。
examples.english_sentence: You are really something, you managed to handle such a difficult thing.

mandarin_meaning: 聪明过头；聪明反被聪明误
english_meaning: Too clever by half; oversmart; so clever it's annoying or counterproductive
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常聪明，但有时候过于自作聪明，反而弄巧成拙，甚至让人反感。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is very clever, but sometimes too clever for their own good, leading to unintended consequences or being annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢叻到舋，成日想出啲古靈精怪嘅橋，結果次次都搞砸晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lek1 dou3 sek3, seng4 jat6 soeng2 ceot1 di1 gu2 ling4 zing1 gwaai3 ge3 kiu2, git3 gwo2 ci3 ci3 dou1 gaau2 zaap3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他太聪明了，老是想出一些稀奇古怪的主意，结果每次都搞砸了。
examples.english_sentence: He's too clever by half, always trying to come up with weird ideas, and it always ends up making a mess.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁叻到舋啦，簡單啲咪算囉，搞到咁複雜做咩啫？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 lek1 dou3 sek3 laa1, gaan2 daan1 di1 mai1 syun3 lo1, gaau2 dou3 gam3 fuk1 zaap6 zou6 me1 ze1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要太自作聪明了，简单点不就好了吗，搞得这么复杂干什么呢？
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so clever by half, just keep it simple, why make it so complicated?

english_meaning: Clever piggy, smartie, good job (used to praise children)
explanation_mandarin: 形容小孩子很聪明，做得很好，常带宠溺的语气。
explanation_english: Used to praise a child for being clever, smart, or doing a good job. Often used affectionately or playfully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日自己識著衫，真係叻叻豬！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 zi6 gei2 sik1 zoek3 saam1, zan1 hai6 lek1 lek1 zyu1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天自己会穿衣服了，真是聪明宝宝！
examples.english_sentence: You can dress yourself today, what a clever piggy!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 叻叻豬，食晒啲飯飯啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: lek1 lek1 zyu1, sik6 saai3 di1 faan6 faan2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 真棒，把饭都吃完吧！
examples.english_sentence: Good job, eat all your rice!

mandarin_meaning: 太聪明/过分自负/自作聪明
english_meaning: Too clever for one's own good; Overly confident and often making mistakes as a result; Acting smart but actually foolish.
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人过于自信和自作聪明，以至于经常犯错误或做出愚蠢的举动。带有贬义。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is overly confident and acts too clever, often leading to mistakes or foolish actions. It has a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都叻唔切咁，結果搞衰曬啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 lek1 m4 cit3 gam2, git3 gwo2 gaau2 sai2晒啲嘢.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是自作聪明，结果把事情都搞砸了。
examples.english_sentence: He always acts too smart for his own good, and ends up messing everything up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁叻唔切啦，聽吓人哋嘅意見啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 lek1 m4 cit3 laa1, teng1 haa5 yan4 dei6 ge3 yi3 gin3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别那么自作聪明了，听听别人的意见吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so overly confident, listen to other people's opinions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有時謙虛啲好，唔好成日以為自己叻唔切。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 si4 him1 heoi1 di1 hou2, m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 ji5 wai4 zi6 gei2 lek1 m4 cit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有时候谦虚一点好，不要总是以为自己很聪明。
examples.english_sentence: Sometimes it's better to be humble, don't always think you're too clever for your own good.

english_meaning: A place known for producing talented people; A town of talents
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个地方有很多有才能、聪明的人才。
explanation_english: Describes a place that produces many talented and intelligent people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港真係一個叻埠，好多出色嘅人才都喺度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 lek1 fau6, hou2 do1 ceot1 sik1 ge3 jan4 coi4 dou1 hai2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港真是一个人才辈出的地方，很多出色的人才都在这里。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong is truly a town of talents, with many outstanding people here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋間學校出名係叻埠，教出好多狀元。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaan1 hok6 haau6 ceot1 ming4 hai6 lek1 fau6, gaau3 ceot1 hou2 do1 zong6 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的学校出名是能人辈出的地方，培养出很多高考状元。
examples.english_sentence: Their school is known as a place of talents, producing many top scorers in the university entrance exams.

english_meaning: smart girl, bright girl, capable girl
explanation_mandarin: 形容女孩聪明伶俐，能干。也可用作称呼，表示对女孩的赞赏。
explanation_english: Describes a girl as being smart, intelligent, and capable. It can also be used as a term of endearment or to show appreciation for a girl.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係一個叻女，咁細個就識得煮飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 lek1 neoi5, gam3 sai3 go3 zau6 sik1 dak1 zyu2 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她真是一个聪明的女孩，这么小就懂得做饭。
examples.english_sentence: She's really a smart girl, she knows how to cook at such a young age.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁叻女，一定可以考到好成績。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 lek1 neoi5, jat1 ding6 ho2 ji5 haau2 dou3 hou2 sing1 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么聪明，一定可以考到好成绩。
examples.english_sentence: You're so smart, you'll definitely get good grades.

english_meaning: A clever, capable, or skillful person (often sarcastic or playful)
explanation_mandarin: “叻”在粤语中是“聪明、能干”的意思。“叻幣”常用于称赞或者略带讽刺地形容某人非常聪明，能干，但也可能暗示这个人有点自以为是。
explanation_english: "Lek" in Cantonese means "clever" or "capable." "Lek bai" is used to describe someone who is very clever or capable, often with a playful or slightly sarcastic tone. It can also imply that the person is a bit self-important or thinks they are too smart.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係叻幣，乜嘢都識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 lek1 bai6, mat1 je5 dou1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是个聪明人，什么都知道。
examples.english_sentence: He's really a clever guy; he knows everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁自以為是啦，叻幣！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 zi6 ji5 wai4 si6 laa1, lek1 bai6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么自以为是啦，聪明人！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so full of yourself, smarty!

english_meaning: Clever; capable; competent; a smart person
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人聪明、能干、有能力。也可以直接指聪明能干的人。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is clever, capable, and competent. It can also directly refer to a smart and capable person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好叻架，咩都識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 lek1 gaa3, me1 dou1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的很厉害，什么都会。
examples.english_sentence: He's really clever, he knows everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明係公司嘅叻架，老闆好信任佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 hai6 gung1 si1 ge3 lek1 gaa3, lou5 baan2 hou2 seon3 jam6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明是公司的能干的人，老板很信任他。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ming is a competent person in the company, the boss trusts him a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好睇佢細細個，佢好叻架！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tai2 keoi5 sai3 sai3 go3, keoi5 hou2 lek1 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要看他年纪小，他很厉害的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't underestimate him because he's young, he's very capable!

mandarin_meaning: 叻沙 (一种东南亚风味的面食)
english_meaning: Laksa (a spicy Southeast Asian noodle soup)
explanation_mandarin: 叻沙是一种在东南亚地区流行的面食，通常是浓郁的椰奶汤底，加入辣椒、香料、豆腐、虾、鱼饼等食材。
explanation_english: Laksa is a popular noodle soup dish in Southeast Asia, typically featuring a rich coconut milk-based broth, flavored with chili, spices, tofu, shrimp, fish cake, and other ingredients.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意食叻沙呀，夠曬惹味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 sik6 lak1 saa1 aa3, gau3 saai3 je5 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我非常喜欢吃叻沙，足够入味。
examples.english_sentence: I really like eating Laksa, it's very flavorful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅叻沙做得好正宗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 lak1 saa1 zou6 dak1 hou2 zing3 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的叻沙做得非常正宗。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant's Laksa is very authentic.

mandarin_meaning: 聪明笨蛋; 自作聪明
english_meaning: Smart idiot; acting smart but actually foolish; clever pig
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人自以为很聪明，实际上却做了蠢事或说了蠢话。是一种带有调侃意味的说法，表示对方聪明反被聪明误。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who thinks they are very clever, but actually does something foolish or says something stupid. It's a teasing way of saying that someone's cleverness has backfired.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日以為自己好叻，點知今次瀨晒嘢，真係叻豬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ji5 wai4 zi6 gei2 hou2 lek1, dim2 zi1 gam1 ci3 laai6 saai3 je5, zan1 hai6 lek1 zyu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是以为自己很聪明，结果这次搞砸了，真是个聪明笨蛋。
examples.english_sentence: He always thinks he's smart, but he messed up this time. What a smart idiot!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁叻豬啦，明明唔識就扮識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 lek1 zyu1 laa1, ming4 ming4 m4 sik1 zau6 ban3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别那么自作聪明了，明明不懂就装懂。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be such a smart idiot, pretending you know when you clearly don't.

synonyms: 醒目仔 (sing2 muk6 zai2, but with a negative connotation)

mandarin_meaning: 叼 (diāo); 叼着 (diāozhe); 贬义：厉害，了不起 (lìhai, liǎobuqǐ)
english_meaning: To hold in the mouth; to carry in the beak or mouth; (slang/vulgar) awesome, impressive, to brag, to be arrogant.
explanation_mandarin: 原意指用嘴叼住东西。在粤语中，此字用作动词时，意思与普通话相同。作为粤语俚语使用时，带有贬义，指人很厉害、了不起，或者指人吹牛、自大。
explanation_english: Originally means to hold something in the mouth. In Cantonese, as a verb, it carries the same meaning as in Mandarin. As a Cantonese slang term, it has a negative connotation, referring to someone who is awesome, impressive (often sarcastically), or to brag or be arrogant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻狗叼住條骨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 gau2 diu2 zyu6 tiu4 gwat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 狗叼着一根骨头。
examples.english_sentence: The dog is holding a bone in its mouth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鬼叼，成日話自己幾叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 gwai2 diu2, seng4 jat6 waa6 zi6 gei2 gei2 lek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他太厉害了，总是说自己多厉害。
examples.english_sentence: He's too arrogant, always talking about how great he is.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁叼啦，謙虛啲好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 diu2 laa1, him1 heoi1 di1 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么得意洋洋的，谦虚一点比较好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so cocky, it's better to be more humble.

english_meaning: to suck; to kiss (often with the sound of sucking)
explanation_mandarin: 指用嘴唇和舌头吸取液体或亲吻时发出声响。
explanation_english: To suck liquid with the lips and tongue or to kiss making a sucking sound.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢叾咗啖汽水，好開心噉樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 duk1 zo2 daam6 hei3 seoi2, hou2 hoi1 sam1 gam2 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喝了一口汽水，看起来很高兴。
examples.english_sentence: He sucked on a sip of soda, looking very happy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個BB仔不停噉叾住奶嘴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 be1 be1 zai2 bat1 ting4 gam2 duk1 zyu6 naai5 zeoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个婴儿不停地吮吸着奶嘴。
examples.english_sentence: That baby keeps sucking on the pacifier.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺街度叾嘴，好鬼肉麻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 gaai1 dou6 duk1 zeoi2, hou2 gwai2 juk6 maa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在街上接吻，很令人肉麻。
examples.english_sentence: They were kissing in the street, which was very cheesy.

english_meaning: to exhale; to blow gently; to sigh
explanation_mandarin: 本义是慢慢地吐气，也指轻轻地吹气。在粤语中，也常用作语气词，表示轻微的不满或无奈。
explanation_english: Originally means to exhale slowly, or to blow gently. In Cantonese, it's also often used as an interjection to express slight dissatisfaction or helplessness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 吁，真係好鬼熱呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: heoi1, zan1 hai6 hou2 gwai2 jit6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 唉，真的好热啊！
examples.english_sentence: Ugh, it's really so hot!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢吁咗一口气，好似放松咗咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 heoi1 zo2 jat1 hau2 hei3, hou2 ci5 fong3 sung1 zo2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他叹了一口气，好像放松了似的。
examples.english_sentence: He sighed, as if he had relaxed.

english_meaning: not yet; not yet done; hasn't; haven't
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情尚未发生或完成。相当于普通话的“没有”。
explanation_english: Indicates that something has not yet happened or been completed. Equivalent to "not yet" or "hasn't/haven't" in English.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我吂食飯呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mong4 sik6 faan6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我还没吃饭呢。
examples.english_sentence: I haven't eaten yet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你吂做完功課呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 mong4 zou6 jyun4 gung1 fo3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你还没做完作业吗？
examples.english_sentence: Haven't you finished your homework yet?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢吂返嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mong4 faan1 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他还没回来。
examples.english_sentence: He hasn't come back yet.

english_meaning: to eat
explanation_mandarin: 指将食物放入口中咀嚼并吞咽。
explanation_english: To eat; to consume food by putting it in the mouth, chewing, and swallowing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你食咗飯未呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sik6 zo2 faan6 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你吃饭了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you eaten yet?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想吃點心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 hek3 dim2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想吃点心。
examples.english_sentence: I want to eat dim sum.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好食咁多垃圾食物啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hek3 gam3 do1 laap1 saap3 sik6 mat6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要吃那么多垃圾食品了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't eat so much junk food.

english_meaning: cannot take it, cannot bear it, cannot cope with, be overwhelmed
explanation_mandarin: 表示承受不了某种情况或负担，无法忍受。
explanation_english: Expressing inability to bear or cope with a situation, burden, or workload; to be overwhelmed or unable to handle something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份工咁辛苦，我真係吃不消。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 gung1 gam3 san1 fu2, ngo5 zan1 hai6 hek3 bat1 siu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作这么辛苦，我真的受不了。
examples.english_sentence: This job is so hard, I really can't take it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都OT到咁夜，邊個吃得消啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 OT dou3 gam3 je2, bin1 go3 hek3 dak1 siu1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都加班到这么晚，谁受得了啊？
examples.english_sentence: He's working overtime until so late every day, who can bear it?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再飲咁多酒喇，我驚你身體吃不消。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 jam2 gam3 do1 zau2 laa1, ngo5 ging1 nei5 san1 tai2 hek3 bat1 siu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再喝那么多酒了，我怕你身体受不了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't drink so much alcohol anymore, I'm afraid your body can't handle it.

english_meaning: strenuous; laborious; strenuous; toilsome; taxing; hard; difficult; to strain
explanation_mandarin: 指做某事感到困难，需要花费很大的力气。
explanation_english: Describes something that is difficult to do and requires a lot of effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工好吃力㗎，你要有心理准备。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 hou2 hek3 lik6 gaa3, nei5 jiu3 jau5 sam1 lei5 zeon2 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作很费力的，你要有心理准备。
examples.english_sentence: This job is very strenuous, you have to be prepared.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢搬嗰啲嘢好重，睇佢搬到好吃力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bun1 go2 di1 je5 hou2 cung5, tai2 keoi5 bun1 dou3 hou2 hek3 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他搬的那些东西很重，看他搬得很吃力。
examples.english_sentence: The things he is carrying are very heavy, it looks like he is struggling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 爬山好吃力，但系风景好靓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: paa4 saan1 hou2 hek3 lik6, daan6 hai6 fung1 ging2 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爬山很费力，但是风景很美。
examples.english_sentence: Hiking is strenuous, but the scenery is beautiful.

english_meaning: efforts not appreciated; a thankless task; to exert oneself but gain no credit
explanation_mandarin: 形容花费了很大的力气，却没有得到好的结果或赞赏。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where one puts in a lot of effort but receives no appreciation or positive results.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幫佢哋搬屋真係吃力不討好，搞到腰痠背痛，佢哋都冇句多謝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bong1 keoi5 dei6 bun1 uk1 zan1 hai6 hek3 lik6 bat1 tou2 hou2, gaau2 dou3 jiu1 syun1 bui3 tung3, keoi5 dei6 dou1 mou5 geoi3 do1 ze6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 帮他们搬家真是费力不讨好，弄得我腰酸背痛，他们连一句谢谢都没有。
examples.english_sentence: Helping them move house was truly a thankless task; it left me with back pain and they didn't even say thank you.

synonyms: 徒勞無功 (tou4 lou4 mou4 gung1)

english_meaning: to take a bite; to have a mouthful
explanation_mandarin: 指吃一小口食物。
explanation_english: Refers to taking a small bite of food; to have a mouthful of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你試吓食口啦，好好味㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 si3 haa5 hek3 hau2 laa1, hou2 hou2 mei6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你试一下吃一口吧，很好吃的！
examples.english_sentence: Try taking a bite, it's very delicious!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔係好肚餓，淨係想食口嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 hai6 hou2 tou5 ngo6, zing6 hai6 soeng2 hek3 hau2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不是特别饿，只想吃一口东西。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not very hungry, I just want to have a mouthful of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: BB瞓緊，你唔好整醒佢，俾佢食口奶就算啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bi1 bi1 fan3 gan2, nei5 m4 hou2 zing2 sing2 keoi5, bei2 keoi5 hek3 hau2 naai5 zau6 syun3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 宝宝在睡觉，你不要弄醒他，让他吃一口奶就算了。
examples.english_sentence: The baby is sleeping, don't wake him up, just let him have a mouthful of milk.

english_meaning: to stutter, to stammer
explanation_mandarin: 形容说话不流畅，结结巴巴。
explanation_english: Describes someone who speaks in a halting or stammering manner; to stutter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢緊張到吃口吃舌，一句嘢都講唔出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gan2 zoeng1 dou3 hek3 hau2 hek3 sit3, jat1 geoi3 je5 dou1 gong2 m4 chut1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他紧张得结结巴巴，一句话都说不出来。
examples.english_sentence: He was so nervous that he stuttered and couldn't say a word.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明喺台上吃口吃舌，好尷尬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 hai2 toi4 soeng5 hek3 hau2 hek3 sit3, hou2 gaam3 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明在台上结结巴巴的，很尴尬。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ming was stuttering on stage, it was very embarrassing.

english_meaning: eating, drinking, and merrymaking; to indulge in pleasure
explanation_mandarin: 指享受生活，沉迷于吃、喝、玩、乐。形容生活奢靡，只顾享乐。
explanation_english: Refers to enjoying life by indulging in eating, drinking, having fun, and pleasure. Describes a luxurious and hedonistic lifestyle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都淨係識得吃喝玩樂，唔諗住做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 zing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 hek3 hot3 waan2 lok6, m4 nam2 zyu6 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天就知道吃喝玩乐，不想着工作。
examples.english_sentence: He only knows how to eat, drink, and be merry every day, and doesn't think about working.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試完咗，咪俾自己放鬆下，吃喝玩樂下囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si5 jyun4 zo2, mai1 bei2 zi6 gei2 fong3 sung1 haa5, hek3 hot3 waan2 lok6 haa5 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试完了，就让自己放松一下，吃喝玩乐一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: Now that the exam is over, let yourself relax and enjoy some eating, drinking, and fun.

synonyms: 花天酒地 (faa1 tin1 zau2 dei6)

cantonese: 吃得苦中苦，方為人上人
jyutping: hek3 dak1 fu2 zung1 fu2, fong1 wai4 jan4 soeng6 jan4
mandarin_meaning: 吃得苦中苦，方为人上人
english_meaning: No pain, no gain; One must endure the hardest of hardships to become a person above others; Through hardship to the stars.
explanation_mandarin: 只有经历过极大的苦难，才能成为人上人，获得成功。
explanation_english: This proverb emphasizes that one must endure hardship and overcome difficulties in order to achieve success and rise above others. It highlights the importance of perseverance and hard work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿哥日日做到三更半夜，都係想第時可以威返次，真係吃得苦中苦，方為人上人啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 go1 jat6 jat6 zou6 dou3 saam1 gang1 bun3 je6, dou1 hai6 soeng2 dai6 si4 ho2 ji5 wai1 faan1 ci3, zan1 hai6 hek3 dak1 fu2 zung1 fu2, fong1 wai4 jan4 soeng6 jan4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哥哥每天工作到深夜，都是想将来能风光一次，真是吃得苦中苦，方为人上人啊。
examples.english_sentence: My brother works until late every night, all because he wants to be successful in the future. It really is 'no pain, no gain'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我知道依家好辛苦，但係你要記住吃得苦中苦，方為人上人，唔好放棄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi1 dou3 ji1 gaa1 hou2 san1 fu2, daan6 hai6 nei5 jiu3 gei3 zyu6 hek3 dak1 fu2 zung1 fu2, fong1 wai4 jan4 soeng6 jan4, m4 hou2 fong3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我知道现在很辛苦，但是你要记住吃得苦中苦，方为人上人，不要放弃。
examples.english_sentence: I know it's hard now, but you have to remember 'no pain, no gain', don't give up.

synonyms: [有志者事竟成 (jau5 zi3 ze2 si6 ging2 sing4 - Those who have a will, succeed)
梅花香自苦寒来 (mui4 faa1 hoeng1 zi6 fu2 hon4 loi4 - Plum blossom's fragrance comes from the bitter cold)

cantonese: 吃得苦中苦，方爲人上人
jyutping: hek3 dak1 fu2 zung1 fu2, fong1 wai4 jan4 soeng6 jan4
mandarin_meaning: 吃得苦中苦，方为人上人
english_meaning: No pain, no gain; One must endure hardship to rise above others.
explanation_mandarin: 指只有经历过艰难困苦，才能取得成功，成为杰出的人。
explanation_english: This idiom emphasizes that enduring hardship and overcoming difficulties are essential for achieving success and excelling in life. It suggests that only those who persevere through tough times can rise above the ordinary and become outstanding individuals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你而家咁辛苦讀書，都要記住「吃得苦中苦，方為人上人」呢句嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ji4 gaa1 gam3 san1 fu2 duk6 syu1, dou1 jiu3 gei3 zyu6 "hek3 dak1 fu2 zung1 fu2, fong1 wai4 jan4 soeng6 jan4" ni1 geoi3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你现在这么辛苦读书，都要记住“吃得苦中苦，方为人上人”这句话。
examples.english_sentence: You're studying so hard now, you must remember the saying, "No pain, no gain."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 創業初期一定好艱難，但係要記住，吃得苦中苦，方為人上人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cong3 jip6 co1 kei4 jat1 ding6 hou2 gaan1 naan4, daan6 hai6 jiu3 gei3 zyu6, hek3 dak1 fu2 zung1 fu2, fong1 wai4 jan4 soeng6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 创业初期一定很艰难，但是要记住，吃得苦中苦，方为人上人。
examples.english_sentence: The initial stage of starting a business will definitely be tough, but remember, no pain, no gain.

synonyms: 梅花香自苦寒来 (mui4 faa1 hoeng1 zi6 fu2 hon4 loi4)

english_meaning: draft (of a ship); draught (of a ship)
explanation_mandarin: 指船舶浸入水中的深度，从船底到水面的垂直距离。
explanation_english: The depth to which a ship is immersed in water, measured from the bottom of the hull to the waterline.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻船吃水幾深啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 syun4 hek3 seoi2 gei2 sam1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这艘船吃水有多深啊？
examples.english_sentence: How deep is the draft of this ship?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為 loaded 左好多貨，所以隻船吃水深咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 loaded zo2 hou2 do1 fo3, so2 ji5 zek3 syun4 hek3 seoi2 sam1 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为装载了很多货物，所以船的吃水深了很多。
examples.english_sentence: Because it's loaded with a lot of cargo, the ship's draft is much deeper.

english_meaning: to bear hardships; to suffer; to go through difficulties
explanation_mandarin: 经历困苦、艰难的事情；忍受痛苦。
explanation_english: To experience hardship, difficulties, or suffering; to endure pain and adversity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 後生仔唔好怕吃苦，第日咪有成就囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hau6 sang1 zai2 m4 hou2 paa3 hek3 fu2, dai6 jat6 mai1 jau5 sing4 zau6 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 年轻人不要怕吃苦，以后才能有成就。
examples.english_sentence: Young people shouldn't be afraid of hardships, that's how you achieve success in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嘅時候吃咗好多苦，所以而家好珍惜眼前嘅生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 hek3 zo2 hou2 do1 fu2, so2 ji5 ji4 gaa1 hou2 zan1 sik1 ngaan5 cin4 ge3 sang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候吃了很多苦，所以现在很珍惜眼前的生活。
examples.english_sentence: He suffered a lot when he was young, so he cherishes his current life.

english_meaning: to suffer losses, to come to grief, to be at a disadvantage, to get the worst of it
explanation_mandarin: 指受到损害或损失，处于不利的地位。
explanation_english: To suffer a loss, be at a disadvantage, or come to grief. It implies experiencing some form of negative consequence, whether financial, social, or physical.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔聽我講，遲早會吃虧㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 ting1 ngo5 gong2, chi4 zou2 wui5 hek3 kwai1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不听我的话，迟早会吃亏的。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't listen to me, sooner or later you will suffer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做生意唔小心，好容易會吃虧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 seng1 yi3 m4 siu2 sam1, hou2 yung4 yi6 wui5 hek3 kwai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做生意不小心，很容易会吃亏。
examples.english_sentence: If you are not careful in business, it is easy to suffer losses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁老實，好容易俾人呃，吃虧都唔知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 lou5 sat6, hou2 yung4 yi6 bei2 yan4 aak1, hek3 kwai1 dou1 m4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么老实，很容易被人骗，吃亏了都不知道。
examples.english_sentence: He is so honest, it's easy for people to cheat him, and he wouldn't even know he's suffered a loss.

english_meaning: to be jealous (in love); to be envious
explanation_mandarin: 因为喜欢的人对别人好而感到不高兴或不舒服；因为别人有自己没有的东西而感到羡慕或不快。
explanation_english: To be jealous, especially in a romantic context, feeling resentment or unhappiness because one's partner shows interest in someone else. Also, to be envious, feeling resentment because someone else possesses something desirable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到男朋友同其他女仔傾偈，即刻吃醋喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou2 naam4 pang4 jau5 tung4 kei4 taa1 neoi5 zai2 king1 gai2, zik1 hak1 hek3 cou3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她看到男朋友和其他女孩聊天，立刻就吃醋了。
examples.english_sentence: She saw her boyfriend chatting with other girls and immediately became jealous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁小器啦，人哋讚你同事叻啲啫，使唔使吃醋呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 siu2 hei3 laa1, yan4 dei6 zaan3 nei5 tung4 si6 lek1 di1 ze1, sai2 m4 sai2 hek3 cou3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么小气啦，人家只是夸你同事更聪明一点而已，需要吃醋吗？
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so petty. People just praised your colleague as being a bit smarter, do you need to be jealous?

english_meaning: demanding; strenuous; taxing; heavy (workload)
explanation_mandarin: 指工作或任务繁重，费力。
explanation_english: Refers to a workload or task that is heavy, demanding, and requires a lot of effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工好食重㗎，你要有心理準備啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 hou2 hek3 zung6 gaa3, nei5 jiu3 jau5 sam1 lei5 zeon2 bei6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作很吃力，你要有心理准备啊。
examples.english_sentence: This job is very demanding, you need to be mentally prepared.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一個人做晒咁多嘢，真係好食重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 go3 jan4 zou6 saai3 gam3 do1 je5, zan1 hai6 hou2 hek3 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一个人做这么多事情，真的很吃力。
examples.english_sentence: He's doing so much by himself, it's really demanding.

english_meaning: to eat a meal
explanation_mandarin: 指吃食物，通常指吃正餐。
explanation_english: To eat a meal, usually referring to a main meal such as lunch or dinner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚出去吃飯啦，你想食啲乜嘢啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan1 cheot1 heoi3 sik6 faan6 laa1, nei5 seung2 sik6 di1 mat1 je5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚出去吃饭吧，你想吃点什么？
examples.english_sentence: Let's go out for dinner tonight, what do you want to eat?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你食咗飯未啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sik6 zo2 faan6 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你吃饭了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you eaten yet?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好肚餓，想快啲吃飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 tou5 ngo6, seung2 faai3 di1 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我好饿，想快点吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: I'm very hungry, I want to eat soon.

english_meaning: to be popular, to be in demand, to be well-received
explanation_mandarin: 指某人或某事物很受欢迎，很吃得开，受到大家的喜爱和追捧。也指某种技能或职业前景良好，有发展潜力。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something as being popular, in demand, well-received, and liked by many. It can also refer to a skill or profession that has good prospects and development potential.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家做IT呢行好食香㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 zou6 IT ni1 hong4 hou2 hek3 hoeng1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在做IT这个行业很受欢迎。
examples.english_sentence: The IT industry is very popular now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司好食香，個個都鍾意佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 hou2 hek3 hoeng1, go3 go3 dou1 zung1 ji3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司很受欢迎，每个人都喜欢他。
examples.english_sentence: He is very popular in the company, everyone likes him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家識英文好食香。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 sik1 ying1 man2 hou2 hek3 hoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在懂英语很受欢迎。
examples.english_sentence: Being able to speak English is very advantageous now.

english_meaning: to be startled; to be shocked; to be surprised
explanation_mandarin: 表示因意外的事情而感到惊讶或震惊。
explanation_english: To express surprise or shock due to an unexpected event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到佢哋結婚嘅消息，我真係好食驚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou2 keoi5 dei6 git3 fan1 ge3 siu1 sik1, ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 hek3 ging1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到他们结婚的消息，我真是很惊讶。
examples.english_sentence: I was really surprised to hear the news of their marriage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先差啲撞車，嚇到我食咗一驚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 caa1 di1 zong6 ce1, hak1 dou3 ngo5 hek3 zo2 jat1 ging1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才差点撞车，吓了我一跳。
examples.english_sentence: I almost had a car accident just now, it gave me a fright.

english_meaning: each, every, various
explanation_mandarin: 每个、各自。表示不同的个体或方面。
explanation_english: Each, every, various. Indicates different individuals or aspects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋各有各嘅意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gok3 jau5 gok3 ge3 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们各有各的意见。
examples.english_sentence: They each have their own opinions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 各人自掃門前雪，莫管他人瓦上霜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gok3 jan4 zi6 sou3 mun4 cin4 syut3, mok6 gun2 taa1 jan4 ngaa5 soeng5 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 各人自扫门前雪，莫管他人瓦上霜。
examples.english_sentence: Every man sweeps the snow from his own doorstep; let him not worry about the frost on another's roof. (Mind your own business)

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺各方面都需要努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 gok3 fong1 min6 dou1 seoi1 jiu3 nou5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在各方面都需要努力。
examples.english_sentence: We need to work hard in every aspect.

english_meaning: unwilling to yield to each other; refusing to budge; locked in a standoff
explanation_mandarin: 指双方都不肯退让，互相争执。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where two or more parties are unwilling to compromise or concede ground to each other, resulting in a deadlock or intense competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋為咗層樓爭到各不相讓，搞到關係好僵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 wai6 zo2 cang4 lau2 zaang1 dou3 gok3 bat1 soeng1 joeng6, gaau2 dou3 gwaan1 hai6 hou2 goeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们为了房子争得互不相让，导致关系很僵硬。
examples.english_sentence: They argued fiercely over the apartment, refusing to yield to each other, which strained their relationship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺球場上面，兩隊波各不相讓，打到最後一分鐘都仲係打和。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 kau4 coeng4 soeng6 min6, loeng5 deoi2 bo1 gok3 bat1 soeng1 joeng6, daa2 dou3 zeoi3 hau6 jat1 fan1 zung1 dou1 zung6 hai6 daa2 wo4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在球场上，两队互不相让，打到最后一分钟还是平局。
examples.english_sentence: On the field, both teams were unwilling to yield, resulting in a tie until the very last minute.

english_meaning: everyone; ladies and gentlemen; everybody
explanation_mandarin: 指在场的每一个人，表示对听众或读者的尊称。
explanation_english: Refers to everyone present, used as a respectful form of address to the audience or readers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 各位早晨！歡迎嚟到我哋嘅公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gok3 wai2 zou2 san4! waan1 jing4 lai4 dou3 ngo5 dei6 ge3 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 各位早上好！欢迎来到我们公司。
examples.english_sentence: Good morning, everyone! Welcome to our company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 各位觀眾，我哋而家開始抽獎啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gok3 wai2 gun1 zung3, ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 hoi1 ci2 cau1 zoeng2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 各位观众，我们现在开始抽奖啦！
examples.english_sentence: Ladies and gentlemen, we are now starting the lottery!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 各位同事，請大家合作完成呢個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gok3 wai2 tung4 si6, cing2 daai6 gaa1 hap6 jok3 waan4 sing4 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 各位同事，请大家合作完成这个项目。
examples.english_sentence: Colleagues, please cooperate to complete this project.

english_meaning: to each according to their needs
explanation_mandarin: 每个人拿取自己需要的东西。表示分配或给予时，按照个人的需求分配。
explanation_english: Everyone takes what they need. It means distributing or giving according to individual needs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 噉嘅話，大家就各取所需啦，唔使客氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam2 ge3 waa2, daai6 gaa1 zau6 gok3 ceoi2 so2 seoi1 laa1, m4 sai2 haak3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这样的话，大家就各取所需吧，不用客气。
examples.english_sentence: In that case, everyone just take what they need, don't be polite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自助餐嘅好處就係各取所需，鍾意食咩就攞咩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 zo6 caan1 ge3 hou2 cyu3 zau6 hai6 gok3 ceoi2 so2 seoi1, zung1 ji3 sik6 me1 zau6 lo2 me1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自助餐的好处就是各取所需，喜欢吃什么就拿什么。
examples.english_sentence: The advantage of a buffet is that everyone takes what they need, take whatever you like to eat.

english_meaning: each performs his/her own duties; everyone does their job
explanation_mandarin: 每个人做好自己的工作，负责自己的职责。
explanation_english: Everyone performs their own duties and is responsible for their own job. It emphasizes the importance of individuals focusing on their specific tasks within a larger system or organization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司入邊要各司其職，先可以運作得好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jap6 bin1 jiu3 gok3 si1 kei4 zik1, sin1 ho2 ji5 wan6 zok3 dak1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司里面要各司其职，才可以运作得好。
examples.english_sentence: In a company, everyone needs to do their job properly in order for it to operate well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺一隊籃球隊入面，每個球員都要各司其職，咁樣先至可以贏波㗎嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 jat1 deui2 laam4 kau4 deui2 jap6 min6, mui5 go3 kau4 jyun4 dou1 jiu3 gok3 si1 kei4 zik1, gam2 joeng2 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 wing4 bo1 gaa3 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在一个篮球队里，每个球员都要各司其职，这样才能赢得比赛嘛。
examples.english_sentence: In a basketball team, each player needs to perform their own duties, that's how you win the game.

english_meaning: various places; everywhere; all over
explanation_mandarin: 各个地方；不同的地方。
explanation_english: Various places; different locations; all over.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司喺各地都有分公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 hai2 gok3 dei6 dou1 jau5 fan1 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司在各地都有分公司。
examples.english_sentence: Our company has branch offices in various places.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 各地嘅風俗習慣都唔同。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gok3 dei6 ge3 fung1 suk6 zaap6 gwaan3 dou1 m4 tung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 各地的风俗习惯都不同。
examples.english_sentence: The customs and habits are different in various places.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢周遊各地，見識好多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zau1 jau4 gok3 dei6, gin3 sik1 hou2 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他周游各地，见识了很多东西。
examples.english_sentence: He traveled all over and saw a lot.

english_meaning: Each sticks to his own story; conflicting accounts; different versions of the story; each maintains their own version
explanation_mandarin: 指双方或多方各坚持自己的说法，意见不一致。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where multiple parties each insist on their own version of events or have conflicting opinions and cannot agree.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 單嘢嘅真相得佢哋兩個人先知，而家佢哋又各執一詞，根本唔知信邊個好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daan1 je5 ge3 zan1 soeng2 dak1 keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 jan4 sin1 zi1, ji4 gaa1 keoi5 dei6 jau6 gok3 zap1 jat1 ci4, gan1 bun2 m4 zi1 seon3 bin1 go3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事的真相只有他们两个人知道，现在他们又各执己见，根本不知道该相信谁好。
examples.english_sentence: Only those two people know the truth of this matter, but now they're each sticking to their own story, and I don't know who to believe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩兄妹為咗啲遺產問題各執一詞，搞到家庭關係好差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 hing1 mui2 wai4 zo2 di1 wai4 caan2 man6 tai4 gok3 zap1 jat1 ci4, gaau2 dou3 gaa1 ting4 gwaan1 hai6 hou2 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们兄妹俩为了遗产问题各持己见，导致家庭关系很差。
examples.english_sentence: The two siblings are sticking to their own versions regarding the inheritance issue, causing a very bad family relationship.

english_meaning: each insists on their own opinion; each holds their own view; to disagree
explanation_mandarin: 形容各自坚持自己的看法，互不相让。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where everyone sticks to their own views and refuses to yield to others' opinions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開會嘅時候，大家各執己見，傾咗好耐都冇共識。
