examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 wui2 ge3 si4 hau6, daai6 gaa1 gok3 zap1 gei2 gin3, king1 zo2 hou2 noi6 dou1 mou5 gung6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开会的时候，大家各持己见，讨论了很久都没有达成共识。
examples.english_sentence: During the meeting, everyone insisted on their own opinion, and no consensus was reached after a long discussion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為件事太複雜，佢哋兩個各執己見，搞到成件事停咗喺度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 gin6 si4 taai3 fuk1 zaap6, keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 gok3 zap1 gei2 gin3, gaau2 dou3 sing4 gin6 si4 ting4 zo2 hai2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为这件事太复杂，他们两个各持己见，导致整件事情停滞不前。
examples.english_sentence: Because the matter is too complicated, the two of them each insisted on their own opinion, causing the whole thing to stall.

synonyms: 針鋒相對 (zam1 fung1 soeng1 deoi3)
寸步不讓 (cyun3 bou6 bat1 joeng6)

jyutping: gok3 gaa1 zi6 sou3 mun4 cin4 syut3
mandarin_meaning: 各人自扫门前雪，莫管他人瓦上霜
english_meaning: Everyone sweeps the snow from their own doorstep, and doesn't care about the frost on other people's roofs.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻只管自己，不管别人的事。形容自私自利，不关心他人。
explanation_english: An idiom describing a self-centered attitude where people only care about their own business and don't care about others' well-being or problems. It implies selfishness and a lack of compassion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲人真係各家自掃門前雪，邊個得閒理你死活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 jan4 zan1 hai6 gok3 gaa1 zi6 sou3 mun4 cin4 syut3, bin1 go3 dak1 haan4 lei5 nei5 sei2 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的人真是各人自扫门前雪，谁有空管你的死活。
examples.english_sentence: People nowadays really only care about themselves. Who has the time to care about your life or death?

english_meaning: Everybody take your places; On your marks, get set
explanation_mandarin: 指每个人按照指定的位置或职责做好准备。常用于体育比赛开始前，或者团队行动开始前的指令。
explanation_english: Refers to everyone taking their designated places or positions and getting ready. Commonly used as a command before the start of a sports competition or a team action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好喇，各就各位，準備開始喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 laa3, gok3 zau6 gok3 wai2, zeon2 bei6 hoi1 ci2 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 好了，各就各位，准备开始了！
examples.english_sentence: Alright, everyone take your places, get ready to start!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日要拍戲喇，今日大家要各就各位，準備好自己嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 jiu3 paak3 hei3 laa3, gam1 jat6 daai6 gaa1 jiu3 gok3 zau6 gok3 wai2, zeon2 bei6 hou2 zi6 gei2 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天要拍戏了，今天大家要各就各位，准备好自己的东西。
examples.english_sentence: We're filming tomorrow, everyone needs to be in their places and ready with their things today.

english_meaning: Each uses their own method; to each their own; different strokes for different folks
explanation_mandarin: 指每个人采取不同的方法或手段来达到同样的目的。
explanation_english: This idiom means that everyone adopts different methods or means to achieve the same goal. It implies that there's no single right way to do something and that various approaches can be effective.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 解決呢個問題，大家都各師各法，睇下邊個方法work啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaai2 kyut3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4, daai6 gaa1 dou1 gok3 si1 gok3 faat3, tai2 haa5 bin1 go3 fong1 faat3 wok1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 解决这个问题，大家都各施各法，看看哪个方法更有效。
examples.english_sentence: To solve this problem, everyone is using their own method to see which one works better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 教小朋友讀書，唔可以一概而論，要各師各法，因材施教。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau3 sai3 peng4 jau5 duk6 syu1, m4 ho2 ji5 jat1 koi3 ji4 leon6, jiu3 gok3 si1 gok3 faat3, yan1 coi4 si1 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 教育孩子读书，不能一概而论，要各施各法，因材施教。
examples.english_sentence: When teaching children to read, you can't generalize. You need to use different methods tailored to each individual's abilities.

english_meaning: various kinds; all sorts of
explanation_mandarin: 各种各样的，不同种类的。
explanation_english: Describing things that are of various kinds or types; all sorts of.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間鋪頭賣各式各樣嘅衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou1 tau2 maai6 gok3 sik1 gok3 joeng6 ge3 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家商店卖各式各样的衣服。
examples.english_sentence: This shop sells clothes of all kinds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意嘗試各式各樣嘅嘢食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 soeng4 si3 gok3 sik1 gok3 joeng6 ge3 je5 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢尝试各种各样的食物。
examples.english_sentence: I like to try all sorts of food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個博物館展覽各式各樣嘅藝術品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 bok3 mat6 gun2 zin2 laam5 gok3 sik1 gok3 joeng6 ge3 ngai6 seot1 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个博物馆展览各种各样的艺术品。
examples.english_sentence: This museum exhibits various kinds of artwork.

english_meaning: all kinds of; various; diverse
explanation_mandarin: 指种类繁多，具有不同的样式和特点。
explanation_english: Describes a wide variety of things, having different styles and characteristics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舖頭賣各式各樣嘅衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau2 maai6 gok3 sik1 gok3 joeng6 ge3 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家商店卖各种各样的衣服。
examples.english_sentence: This shop sells all kinds of clothes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港有各式各樣嘅美食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 jau5 gok3 sik1 gok3 joeng6 ge3 mei5 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港有各种各样的美食。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong has all kinds of delicious food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個博物館入邊有各式各樣嘅藝術品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 bok3 mat6 gun2 jap6 bin1 jau5 gok3 sik1 gok3 joeng6 ge3 ngai6 seot1 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 博物馆里面有各式各样的艺术品。
examples.english_sentence: There are all kinds of artworks in the museum.

english_meaning: everyone/everything in its proper place; each gets what he/she deserves; everyone finds his/her proper place
explanation_mandarin: 每个人或事物都得到合适的安置或待遇。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where everyone or everything is in its proper place or receives the appropriate treatment. It implies order, fairness, and efficiency.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過一番努力，啲資源終於可以各得其所。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 jat1 faan1 nou5 lik6, di1 zi1 jyun4 zung1 jyu1 ho2 ji5 gok3 dak1 kei4 so2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过一番努力，这些资源终于可以各得其所了。
examples.english_sentence: After much effort, these resources can finally be allocated to their appropriate uses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺一個理想嘅社會，每個人都應該可以各得其所。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 jat1 go3 lei5 soeng2 ge3 se5 wui2, mui5 go3 jan4 dou1 jing1 goi1 ho2 ji5 gok3 dak1 kei4 so2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在一个理想的社会，每个人都应该可以各得其所。
examples.english_sentence: In an ideal society, everyone should be able to find their proper place.

mandarin_meaning: 各怀鬼胎 (gè huái guǐ tāi)
english_meaning: to have ulterior motives; to have one's own axe to grind; each having his own scheme
explanation_mandarin: 比喻各有各的算盘，隐藏着各自不可告人的目的。
explanation_english: An idiom used to describe a situation where everyone involved has their own hidden agenda or ulterior motives. It implies a lack of trust and potential conflict of interest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋表面上合作，但係其實個個都各懷鬼胎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 biu2 min6 soeng6 hap6 zok3, daan6 hai6 kei4 sat6 go3 go3 dou1 gok3 waai4 gwai2 toi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们表面上合作，但实际上每个人都各怀鬼胎。
examples.english_sentence: They are cooperating on the surface, but in reality, everyone has their own hidden agenda.

english_meaning: To each be equally at fault; to be equally responsible; to split the blame equally; to call it a draw.
explanation_mandarin: 指双方都有过错，责任均等，各承受相同的惩罚。类似于“一个巴掌拍不响”。
explanation_english: This idiom means that both parties are at fault and equally responsible for a situation, each bearing the same degree of blame or consequences. Similar to the English idiom "It takes two to tango". It can also mean that the results are equal, calling it a draw.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個打交，其實兩邊都唔啱，咪各打五十囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 daa2 gaau1, kei4 sat6 loeng5 bin1 dou1 m4 ngaam1, mai1 gok3 daa2 ng5 sap6 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个打架，其实两边都不对，就各打五十大板吧。
examples.english_sentence: They were fighting, but actually, both sides were wrong, so let's say they are equally at fault.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次嘅比賽，兩隊實力差唔多，最後各打五十，打成平手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ge3 bei2 coi3, loeng5 deoi2 sat6 lik6 caa1 m4 do1, zeoi3 hau6 gok3 daa2 ng5 sap6, daa2 sing4 ping4 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的比赛，两队实力差不多，最后打成平手。
examples.english_sentence: In this competition, the two teams were of similar strength, so in the end, they drew.

synonyms: 兩邊都唔啱 (loeng5 bin1 dou1 m4 ngaam1)

jyutping: gok3 daa2 ng5 sap6 daai6 baan2
english_meaning: to punish both sides equally (regardless of the degree of fault); to give both sides the same treatment (usually when resolving a dispute)
explanation_mandarin: 比喻不问情由，对双方各打一顿，一样惩罚。形容处理事情不分青红皂白，一律看待。
explanation_english: This idiom means to punish both sides equally, regardless of the actual fault or circumstances. It's used to describe a situation where someone treats everyone involved the same way, without considering the nuances of the situation or who is more at fault.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋鬧交，阿媽唔理三七廿一，各打五十大板。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 naau6 gaau1, aa3 maa1 m4 lei5 saam1 cat1 jaa6 jat1, gok3 daa2 ng5 sap6 daai6 baan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们吵架，妈妈不分青红皂白，各打五十大板。
examples.english_sentence: They were arguing, and their mother didn't care about the details, she just punished both of them equally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細覺得佢哋兩個都有錯，所以就各打五十大板，扣佢哋人工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 gok3 dak1 keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 dou1 jau5 co3, so2 ji5 zau6 gok3 daa2 ng5 sap6 daai6 baan2, kau3 keoi5 dei6 jan4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板觉得他们两个都有错，所以就各打五十大板，扣了他们工资。
examples.english_sentence: The boss thought they were both at fault, so he punished both of them equally by deducting their wages.

english_meaning: Each holds their own opinion; everyone has their own point of view.
explanation_mandarin: 指每个人都坚持自己的看法，不肯让步。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where everyone sticks to their own opinion and refuses to compromise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開會嘅時候，佢哋各持己見，傾咗好耐都冇結論。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 wui2 ge3 si4 hau6, keoi5 dei6 gok3 ci4 gei2 gin3, king1 zo2 hou2 noi6 dou1 mou5 git3 leon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开会的时候，他们各持己见，谈了很久都没有结论。
examples.english_sentence: During the meeting, they each held their own opinions and talked for a long time without reaching a conclusion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋對呢件事各持己見，可能要再討論下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 deoi3 ni1 gin6 si6 gok3 ci4 gei2 gin3, ho2 nang4 jiu3 zoi3 to2 leon6 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们对这件事各持己见，可能要再讨论一下。
examples.english_sentence: We each hold our own opinion on this matter; we may need to discuss it further.

english_meaning: to go separate ways; to scatter in all directions
explanation_mandarin: 比喻各人朝不同的方向离去，多指分散、分手。
explanation_english: An idiom describing a situation where people or groups separate and head in different directions, often after a period of togetherness. It implies dispersal and departure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋畢業之後，大家都各散東西，好少再見面啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 bat1 jip6 zi1 hau6, daai6 gaa1 dou1 gok3 saan3 dung1 sai1, hou2 siu2 zoi3 gin3 min6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们毕业之后，大家都各奔东西，很少再见面了。
examples.english_sentence: After we graduated, everyone went their separate ways and we rarely see each other anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司執笠之後，啲員工都各散東西。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 zap1 laap1 zi1 hau6, di1 jyun4 gung1 dou1 gok3 saan3 dung1 sai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司倒闭之后，员工们都各奔东西。
examples.english_sentence: After the company closed down, the employees all went their separate ways.

english_meaning: everyone uses their own methods; each to their own (method); everyone does it their own way
explanation_mandarin: 每个人都用自己的方法来解决问题或达成目标。
explanation_english: Each person employs their own unique method or approach to solve a problem or achieve a goal. It implies a variety of strategies being used independently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次嘅比賽冇乜規矩，大家可以各施各法去完成任務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ge3 bei2 coi3 mou5 mat1 gwai1 juk1, daai6 gaa1 ho2 ji5 gok3 si1 gok3 faat3 heoi3 waan4 sing4 jam6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次比赛没有什么规则，大家可以各显神通去完成任务。
examples.english_sentence: There aren't many rules in this competition, so everyone can use their own methods to complete the task.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要搞掂呢件事，我哋可以各施各法，睇下邊個嘅方法最有效。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 gaau2 dim6 ni1 gin6 si6, ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 gok3 si1 gok3 faat3, tai2 haa5 bin1 go3 ge3 fong1 faat3 zeoi3 jau5 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要解决这件事，我们可以各显神通，看看谁的方法最有效。
examples.english_sentence: To handle this matter, we can each use our own methods and see whose approach is the most effective.

jyutping: gok3 jau5 cin4 jan1 mok6 sin6 jan4
mandarin_meaning: 每个人都有自己的因果，不要羡慕别人
english_meaning: Everyone has their own karma; don't envy others.
explanation_mandarin: 意思是每个人今天的境遇都是由过去种下的因决定的，所以不要羡慕别人，要专注于自身。
explanation_english: This idiom means that everyone's current situation is determined by the causes they planted in the past. Therefore, don't envy others, but focus on yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁後生就咁成功，但係你都要記住各有前因莫羨人呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 hau6 saang1 zau6 gam3 sing4 gung1, daan6 hai6 nei5 dou1 jiu3 gei3 zyu6 gok3 jau5 cin4 jan1 mok6 sin6 jan4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么年轻就这么成功，但是你也要记住每个人都有自己的因果，不要羡慕别人啊。
examples.english_sentence: He's so successful at such a young age, but you have to remember that everyone has their own karma; don't envy others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到人哋咁風光，唔好唔開心，各有前因莫羨人，做好自己就得啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 jan4 dei6 gam3 fung1 gwong1, m4 hou2 m4 hoi1 sam1, gok3 jau5 cin4 jan1 mok6 sin6 jan4, zou6 hou2 zi6 gei2 zau6 dak1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到别人这么风光，不要不开心，每个人都有自己的因果，不要羡慕别人，做好自己就可以了。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing other people so successful, don't be unhappy. Everyone has their own karma; don't envy others. Just do your best.

english_meaning: Each has its own merits; each has its own strong points; to each their own.
explanation_mandarin: 形容每个人或事物都有自己的优点和特点，不能简单地比较和评价高低优劣。
explanation_english: Describes that each person or thing has its own advantages and characteristics, and it is not possible to simply compare and evaluate them as being superior or inferior. It implies that they are different but valuable in their own way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢兩個都好叻，真係各有千秋，好難講邊個好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 loeng5 go3 dou1 hou2 lek1, zan1 hai6 gok3 jau5 cin1 cau1, hou2 naan4 gong2 bin1 go3 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个都很厉害，真是各有千秋，很难说哪个更好。
examples.english_sentence: They are both very capable; they really each have their own strengths, it's hard to say which one is better.

english_meaning: each has their own; everyone has their own
explanation_mandarin: 指每个人或事物都有自己独特的方式、特点或情况。
explanation_english: Indicates that each person or thing has their own unique way, characteristics, or circumstances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋各有各嘅諗法，好難達成共識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gok3 jau5 gok3 ge3 lam2 faat3, hou2 naan4 daat6 sing4 gung6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们各有各的想法，很难达成共识。
examples.english_sentence: They each have their own ideas, it's difficult to reach a consensus.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每個人嘅興趣都唔同，真係各有各。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 go3 jan4 ge3 hing3 ceoi3 dou1 m4 tung4, zan1 hai6 gok3 jau5 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每个人的兴趣都不一样，真是各有各的。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone has different interests; truly, each has their own.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩姊妹各有各嘅性格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 zi2 mui2 gok3 jau5 gok3 ge3 sing3 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她们两姐妹各有各的性格。
examples.english_sentence: The two sisters each have their own personality.

english_meaning: To each their own; Everyone has their own preferences.
explanation_mandarin: 每个人都有自己不同的爱好和喜好。
explanation_english: This idiom means that everyone has their own individual tastes, preferences, and interests.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好迫佢食啲佢唔鍾意嘅嘢啦，各有所好啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 ho2 bik1 keoi5 sik6 di1 keoi5 m4 zung1 ji3 ge3 je5 laa1, gok3 jau5 so2 hou3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要强迫他吃他不喜欢的东西了，各有所好嘛。
examples.english_sentence: Don't force him to eat things he doesn't like. To each their own.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人鍾意睇戲，有啲人鍾意睇書，各有所好，冇話邊樣好啲嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 zung1 ji3 tai2 hei3, jau5 di1 jan4 zung1 ji3 tai2 syu1, gok3 jau5 so2 hou3, mou5 waa6 bin1 joeng2 hou2 di1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人喜欢看电影，有些人喜欢看书，各有所好，没有说哪个更好。
examples.english_sentence: Some people like watching movies, some like reading books. To each their own. There's no saying which is better.

english_meaning: various, all sorts of, every kind of
explanation_mandarin: 表示种类很多，各式各样的。
explanation_english: Describes a variety of things; all kinds of.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度有各樣嘅玩具，你鍾意邊樣啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 jau5 gok3 joeng6 ge3 wun6 geoi6, nei5 zung1 ji3 bin1 joeng6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里有各种各样的玩具，你喜欢哪个？
examples.english_sentence: There are all kinds of toys here, which one do you like?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢賣各樣嘅嘢，由衫褲到電器都有。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai6 gok3 joeng6 ge3 je5, jau4 saam1 fu3 dou3 din6 hei3 dou1 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他卖各种各样的东西，从衣服到电器都有。
examples.english_sentence: He sells all sorts of things, from clothes to electrical appliances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳提供各樣嘅菜式。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 tai4 cung4 gok3 joeng6 ge3 coi3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅提供各种各样的菜肴。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant offers various dishes.

english_meaning: Each works for their own master; everyone serves their own boss.
explanation_mandarin: 指各人效忠于自己的主人或代表的利益。
explanation_english: Refers to each person being loyal to their own master or representing their own interests. It often implies that people have conflicting loyalties and therefore opposing stances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 始終大家各為其主，立場唔同。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ci2 chung1 daai6 gaa1 gok3 wai4 kei4 zyu2, lap6 cheung4 m4 tung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 毕竟大家各为其主，立场不同。
examples.english_sentence: After all, everyone works for their own master, so their positions are different.

english_meaning: Each serves his own master; each acts in the interest of their own party; everyone has their own allegiance.
explanation_mandarin: 各自为自己效力的对象或利益着想。多用于说明立场不同。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where individuals or groups act according to their own interests or the interests of their respective masters or organizations. Often used to explain conflicting positions or loyalties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 傾生意係噉㗎啦，各爲其主，都係想幫自己公司攞到最大嘅利益。
examples.jyutping_sentence: king1 seng1 ji3 hai6 gam2 gaa3 laa1, gok3 wai4 kei4 zyu2, dou1 hai6 soeng2 bong1 zi6 gei2 gung1 si1 lo2 dou2 zeoi3 daai6 ge3 lei6 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做生意就是这样，各为其主，都是想帮自己的公司拿到最大的利益。
examples.english_sentence: That's how business works, each serves their own master, everyone wants to get the maximum benefit for their own company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋立場唔同，各爲其主，所以先會咁多爭拗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 lip6 coeng4 m4 tung4, gok3 wai4 kei4 zyu2, so2 ji5 sin1 wui5 gam3 do1 zaang1 ngaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的立场不同，各为其主，所以才会这么多争执。
examples.english_sentence: Their positions are different, each serves their own master, that's why there are so many disputes.

english_meaning: different; distinct; each having its own characteristics
explanation_mandarin: 指彼此之間不相同，各有各的特點。
explanation_english: Refers to differences between things, each having its own distinct characteristics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個嘅興趣各異。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 ge3 hing3 ceoi3 gok3 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个的兴趣各不相同。
examples.english_sentence: Their interests are different.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每個國家嘅文化都各異。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 go3 gwok3 gaa1 ge3 man4 faa3 dou1 gok3 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每个国家的文化都各不相同。
examples.english_sentence: Each country's culture is different.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢班學生嘅學習進度各異。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baan1 hok6 sang1 ge3 hok6 zaap6 zeon3 dou6 gok3 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这班学生的学习进度各不相同。
examples.english_sentence: The learning progress of these students is different.

english_meaning: various, all kinds of, a variety of
explanation_mandarin: 表示不同的类别或种类。
explanation_english: Indicates different categories or types.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 超級市場入面有各種唔同嘅水果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ciu1 kap1 si5 coeng4 jap6 min6 jau5 gok3 zung2 m4 tung4 ge3 sui2 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 超市里面有各种不同的水果。
examples.english_sentence: There are various kinds of fruits in the supermarket.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅興趣各種各樣，包括畫畫、唱歌同埋跳舞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hing3 ceoi3 gok3 zung2 gok3 joeng6, baau1 kut3 waa2 waa2, coeng3 go1 tung4 maai4 tiu3 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的兴趣各种各样，包括画画、唱歌和跳舞。
examples.english_sentence: His interests are various, including painting, singing, and dancing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳提供各種亞洲菜式。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 tai4 cung1 gok3 zung2 aa3 zau1 coi3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅提供各种亚洲菜肴。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant offers various Asian dishes.

synonyms: 各式各樣 (gok3 sik1 gok3 joeng6)

english_meaning: various, all kinds of, a variety of
explanation_mandarin: 形容种类繁多，式样不同。
explanation_english: Describes a wide variety of types and styles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間鋪頭賣各種各樣嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau2 maai6 gok3 zung2 gok3 joeng2 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店卖各种各样的东西。
examples.english_sentence: This shop sells all kinds of things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意食各種各樣嘅零食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 sik6 gok3 zung2 gok3 joeng2 ge3 ling4 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喜欢吃各种各样的零食。
examples.english_sentence: He likes to eat all sorts of snacks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港有各種各樣嘅文化活動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 jau5 gok3 zung2 gok3 joeng2 ge3 man4 faa3 wut6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港有各种各样的文化活动。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong has a variety of cultural activities.

english_meaning: each; respective; individually
explanation_mandarin: 表示每个人或每个事物分别地、各自地。
explanation_english: Indicates that each person or thing does something separately or individually.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋各自帶啲嘢食去野餐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gok3 zi6 daai3 di1 je5 sik6 heoi3 je5 caan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们各自带一些食物去野餐。
examples.english_sentence: Let's each bring some food for the picnic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋各自返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gok3 zi6 faan1 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们各自回家。
examples.english_sentence: They each went home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋各自負責唔同嘅部分。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gok3 zi6 fu6 zaak3 m4 tung4 ge3 bou6 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们各自负责不同的部分。
examples.english_sentence: We are each responsible for different parts.

english_meaning: Each to their own; everyone does their own thing; separate ways
explanation_mandarin: 指每个人都按照自己的方式或计划行事，互不干涉。
explanation_english: Refers to each person acting according to their own way or plan, without interfering with others. Emphasizes individuality and separation in action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋各自各做功課啦，唔好抄對方㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gok3 zi6 gok3 zou6 gung1 fo3 laa1, m4 hou2 caau1 deoi3 fong1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们各自做作业吧，不要抄袭对方的。
examples.english_sentence: Let's each do our own homework, don't copy each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋結婚之後，生活各自各精彩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 git3 fan1 zi1 hau6, sang1 wut6 gok3 zi6 gok3 zing1 coi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们结婚之后，生活各自精彩。
examples.english_sentence: After they got married, they each lived their own wonderful lives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次旅行我哋各自各 plan 行程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 leoi5 hang4 ngo5 dei6 gok3 zi6 gok3 plan hang4 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次旅行我们各自计划行程。
examples.english_sentence: For this trip, we'll each plan our own itinerary.

synonyms: 各自分開 (gok3 zi6 fan1 hoi1)
分道揚鑣 (fan1 dou6 joeng4 biu1)

english_meaning: Each acts on their own; each does things their own way; to act independently and without coordination
explanation_mandarin: 比喻各人按自己的主张办事，不互相配合，或者不听统一指挥。
explanation_english: A metaphor for each person acting according to their own ideas and plans, without mutual cooperation or listening to unified command.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司啲部門各自為政，搞到效率好低。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 di1 bou6 mun4 gok3 zi6 wai4 zing3, gaau2 dou3 haau2 leot2 hou2 dai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的部门各自为政，导致效率很低。
examples.english_sentence: The departments in the company act on their own, resulting in very low efficiency.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果大家各自為政，呢件事好難成功㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 daai6 gaa1 gok3 zi6 wai4 zing3, ni1 gin6 si6 hou2 naan4 sing4 gung1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果大家各自为政，这件事很难成功的。
examples.english_sentence: If everyone acts on their own, this matter will be difficult to succeed.

english_meaning: each acts on his own; each does things his own way; independent operations; disunity
explanation_mandarin: 比喻各人按照自己的主張辦事，不互相配合，或不聽從統一指揮。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where everyone acts according to their own ideas and plans, without cooperation or unified direction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司啲部門各自為政，搞到效率好低。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 di1 bou6 mun4 gok3 zi6 wai4 zing3, gaau2 dou3 haau2 leot2 hou2 dai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的部门各自为政，导致效率很低。
examples.english_sentence: The departments in the company act independently, leading to very low efficiency.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府部門唔可以各自為政，要合作先至可以解決到問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 bou6 mun4 m4 ho2 ji5 gok3 zi6 wai4 zing3, jiu3 hap6 zok3 sin1 zai3 ho2 ji5 gaai2 kyut3 dou2 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府部门不可以各自为政，要合作才可以解决问题。
examples.english_sentence: Government departments cannot act independently; they need to cooperate to solve problems.

mandarin_meaning: 萝卜青菜，各有所爱 (luóbo qīngcài, gè yǒu suǒ ài)
english_meaning: Beauty is in the eye of the beholder; Different strokes for different folks; To each their own.
explanation_mandarin: 每个人对于美的看法和喜爱的事物都不同，所以不要强求别人的喜好和自己一样。
explanation_english: This idiom means that everyone has different tastes and preferences, especially regarding beauty and what they find appealing. It emphasizes that there's no universal standard of beauty or preference.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢覺得嗰條裙好靚，但我唔係咁睇，真係各花入各眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gok3 dak1 go2 tiu4 kwan4 hou2 leng3, daan6 ngo5 m4 hai6 gam2 tai2, zan1 hai6 gok3 faa1 jap6 gok3 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她觉得那条裙子很漂亮，但我不太这样认为，真是萝卜青菜，各有所爱。
examples.english_sentence: She thinks that dress is beautiful, but I don't really think so. Beauty is in the eye of the beholder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔鍾意佢啲歌唔出奇，各花入各眼啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 zung1 ji3 keoi5 di1 go1 m4 ceot1 kei4, gok3 faa1 jap6 gok3 ngaan5 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不喜欢他的歌不奇怪，萝卜青菜，各有所爱嘛。
examples.english_sentence: It's not surprising that you don't like his songs. To each their own.

synonyms: 情人眼裏出西施 (cing4 jan4 ngaan5 leoi5 ceot1 sai1 si1)

jyutping: gok3 cyu3 hoeng1 cyun1 gok3 cyu3 lai6
mandarin_meaning: 各地有各地的规矩/风俗
english_meaning: Every village has its own customs; different places, different rules.
explanation_mandarin: 指不同的地方有不同的规矩、习俗，不能一概而论。强调要因地制宜。
explanation_english: This idiom means that different places have different rules and customs. It emphasizes that one should adapt to local conditions and not apply the same standards everywhere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好將你嗰套擺喺呢度，各處鄉村各處例，呢度有呢度嘅規矩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoeng1 nei5 go2 tou3 baai2 hai2 ni1 dou6, gok3 cyu3 hoeng1 cyun1 gok3 cyu3 lai6, ni1 dou6 jau5 ni1 dou6 ge3 kwai1 geoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要把你那一套放在这里，各地有各地的规矩，这里有这里的规矩。
examples.english_sentence: Don't bring your own methods here. Every village has its own customs, this place has its own rules.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 移民去外國就要遵守當地嘅法律，唔好諗住可以好似喺香港咁，各處鄉村各處例嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 man4 heoi3 ngoi6 gwok3 zau6 jiu3 zeon1 sau2 dong1 dei6 ge3 faat3 leot6, m4 hou2 nam2 zoek3 ho2 ji5 hou2 ci5 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 gam2, gok3 cyu3 hoeng1 cyun1 gok3 cyu3 lai6 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 移民去国外就要遵守当地的法律，不要以为可以像在香港一样，各地有各地的规矩嘛。
examples.english_sentence: When you immigrate to a foreign country, you need to abide by local laws. Don't think you can do things as you did in Hong Kong, every village has its own customs.

english_meaning: all walks of life; all trades and professions
explanation_mandarin: 指各种不同的行业和职业。
explanation_english: Refers to all different kinds of trades, professions, and industries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港係一個國際城市，所以有嚟自各行各業嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 hai6 jat1 go3 gwok3 zai3 sing4 si5, so2 ji5 jau5 lai4 zi6 gok3 hong4 gok3 yip6 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港是一个国际城市，所以有来自各行各业的人。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong is an international city, so there are people from all walks of life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟唔好，各行各業都受到影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gai3 m4 hou2, gok3 hong4 gok3 yip6 dou1 sau6 dou3 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济不好，各行各业都受到影响。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is bad, and all industries are affected.

english_meaning: Each goes their own way; to each their own
explanation_mandarin: 比喻人们各自有不同的道路和选择，互不干涉。
explanation_english: This idiom means that people each have their own path and choices in life and should not interfere with each other. It signifies independence and separation of ways.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個意見唔夾，咪各行各路囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 ji3 gin3 m4 gaap3, mai1 gok3 hong4 gok3 lou6 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的两个意见不合，那就各走各的路呗。
examples.english_sentence: Their opinions don't match, so they'll just go their separate ways.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 既然大家嘅目標唔同，不如各行各路算數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 jin4 daai6 ga1 ge3 muk6 biu1 m4 tung4, bat1 jyu4 gok3 hong4 gok3 lou6 syun3 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 既然大家的目标不同，不如各走各的路算了。
examples.english_sentence: Since everyone has different goals, it's better for us to go our separate ways.

english_meaning: Everyone finds their proper place; To each their own; Whatever suits each person.
explanation_mandarin: 指每个人都能找到适合自己的位置或方式。强调个体差异，尊重每个人的选择。
explanation_english: Refers to everyone being able to find a suitable place or method for themselves. Emphasizes individual differences and respects everyone's choices.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 揀工呢啲嘢吖，各適其適啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan2 gung1 ne1 di1 je5 aa1, gok3 sik1 kei4 sik1 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 选择工作这种事啊，都是各得其所罢了。
examples.english_sentence: When it comes to choosing jobs, it's just to each their own.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你鍾意住邊度咪住邊度囉，各適其適啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung1 ji3 zyu6 bin1 dou6 mai1 zyu6 bin1 dou6 lo1, gok3 sik1 kei4 sik1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你喜欢住哪里就住哪里咯，各得其所啦。
examples.english_sentence: Live wherever you like, to each their own.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好逼人哋做唔鍾意嘅嘢啦，應該俾佢哋各適其適。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 ho2 bik1 jan4 dei6 zou6 m4 zung1 ji3 ge3 je5 laa1, ying1 goi1 bei2 keoi5 dei6 gok3 sik1 kei4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要强迫别人做不喜欢的事情啦，应该让他们各得其所。
examples.english_sentence: Don't force people to do things they don't like, they should be allowed to find what suits them best.

english_meaning: Each pays their own (share); go Dutch
explanation_mandarin: 指在消费时，每个人支付自己的那份。一般用于朋友或同事之间聚餐、娱乐等场合，避免互相欠账。
explanation_english: Refers to each person paying for their own portion of the bill, typically used in casual settings like meals or entertainment among friends or colleagues to avoid owing each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚食飯各還各啦，唔好爭住俾錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 sik6 faan6 gok3 waan4 gok3 laa1, m4 hou2 zaang1 zyu6 bei2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚吃饭各付各的吧，别争着付钱。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go Dutch tonight for dinner, don't fight over paying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去唱K，各還各就最公平。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 coeng3 kei1, gok3 waan4 gok3 zau6 zeoi3 gung1 ping4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们去唱K，各付各的就是最公平的。
examples.english_sentence: It's fairest if we go Dutch when we go to karaoke.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上次睇戲條數，我仲未還返俾你，不如今次各還各?
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng6 ci3 tai2 hei3 tiu4 sou3, ngo5 zung6 mei6 waan4 faan1 bei2 nei5, bat1 jyu4 gam1 ci3 gok3 waan4 gok3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上次看电影的账，我还没还给你，不如这次各付各的？
examples.english_sentence: I haven't paid you back for the movies last time, how about we go Dutch this time?

english_meaning: Each for himself/herself; Every man for himself/herself; To each their own; Everyone looking out for their own interests
explanation_mandarin: 形容每个人只照顾自己的利益，不关心他人。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where everyone only looks after their own interests and doesn't care about others. It implies a lack of cooperation or teamwork and a focus on individual survival or gain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟唔好，大家都各顧各啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gai3 m4 hou2, daai6 gaa1 dou1 gok3 gu3 gok3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济不好，大家都各管各的了。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is bad, everyone is looking out for themselves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢個殘酷嘅世界，好多時都要各顧各。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 go3 caan4 huk6 ge3 sai3 gaai3, hou2 do1 si4 hau6 dou1 jiu3 gok3 gu3 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这个残酷的世界，很多时候都要各管各的。
examples.english_sentence: In this cruel world, many times you have to fend for yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從公司裁員之後，同事之間就變得各顧各，好少合作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 gung1 si1 coi4 jyun4 zi1 hau6, tung4 si6 zi1 gaan1 zau6 bin3 dak1 gok3 gu3 gok3, hou2 siu2 hap6 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从公司裁员之后，同事之间就变得各管各的，很少合作。
examples.english_sentence: Since the company laid off employees, colleagues have become more self-centered and there is little cooperation.

mandarin_meaning: 邀请; 呼唤; 吆喝
english_meaning: to invite; to call out; to shout (to attract attention)
explanation_mandarin: 表示邀请或呼唤的行为。通常带有口头叫喊的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of inviting or calling out. Often implies a verbal shout or call to attract attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺街邊吆人嚟買嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 gaai1 bin1 jiu1 jan4 lai4 maai5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常在街边吆喝着叫人来买东西。
examples.english_sentence: He often shouts on the street to attract people to buy things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好大聲吆，會嘈親人哋㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 daai6 seng1 jiu1, wui5 cou4 can1 jan4 dei6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要大声吆喝，会吵到别人的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't shout so loudly, it will disturb others.

mandarin_meaning: 适合; 合适; 合作; 闭合
english_meaning: to close; to join; to fit; suitable; appropriate; to cooperate; to suit; to tally
explanation_mandarin: 1. 闭合，关合。2. 适合，合适。3. 合作，共同。
explanation_english: 1. To close, to shut. 2. Suitable, appropriate. 3. To cooperate, to collaborate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫好合你著啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 hou2 hap6 nei5 zoek3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服很适合你穿啊！
examples.english_sentence: This shirt suits you very well!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一齐合力完成呢个项目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 hap6 lik6 waan4 sing4 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们几个合伙开了一家餐厅。
examples.english_sentence: They partnered up and opened a restaurant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋想搵人合夥做生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 soeng2 wan2 jan4 hap6 fo2 zou6 saang1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们想找人合伙做生意。
examples.english_sentence: We want to find someone to partner with to do business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 合夥關係最緊要係互相信任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hap6 fo2 gwaan1 hai6 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hai6 wu6 soeng1 seon3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 合伙关系最重要的是互相信任。
examples.english_sentence: Mutual trust is the most important thing in a partnership.

english_meaning: partner (in business)
explanation_mandarin: 共同出资经营生意的人。
explanation_english: A person who invests money and effort into a business with another person, sharing the profits and losses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個係生意上嘅合夥人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hai6 saang1 ji3 soeng6 ge3 hap6 fo2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个是生意上的合伙人。
examples.english_sentence: They are business partners.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋想搵多個合夥人一齊做呢盤生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 soeng2 wan2 do1 go3 hap6 fo2 jan4 jat1 cai4 zou6 ni1 pun4 saang1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们想找多一个合伙人一起做这盘生意。
examples.english_sentence: We want to find another partner to do this business together.

english_meaning: Happy family; family-friendly; family fun
explanation_mandarin: 形容适合全家人一起观看、参与或享受的活动、电影、节目等，气氛欢乐祥和。
explanation_english: Describes something suitable for the whole family to watch, participate in, or enjoy, with a happy and harmonious atmosphere. Often used to describe movies, TV shows, or events.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年新年我哋一家人一齊睇咗套合家歡嘅賀歲片。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 san1 nin4 ngo5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 jat1 cai4 tai2 zo2 tou3 hap6 gaa1 fun1 ge3 ho6 seoi3 pin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年新年我们一家人一起看了一部阖家欢乐的贺岁片。
examples.english_sentence: This Chinese New Year, our family watched a family-friendly New Year's movie together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅氣氛好適合一家大細嚟食飯，真係合家歡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 hei3 fan1 hou2 sik1 hap6 jat1 gaa1 daai6 sai2 lai4 sik6 faan6, zan1 hai6 hap6 gaa1 fun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的气氛很适合一家老小来吃饭，真是阖家欢乐。
examples.english_sentence: The atmosphere of this restaurant is very suitable for families to come and eat, it's truly family fun.

english_meaning: to get along well, to be compatible, to click
explanation_mandarin: 形容人与人之间性格、想法等很合得来，容易相处，配合默契。
explanation_english: Describes people who are compatible, get along well, and have good chemistry. They are easy to get along with and have a good understanding of each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋两个好合尺，成日一齐玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hou2 hap6 cek3, seng4 jat6 jat1 cai4 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个人很合得来，经常一起玩。
examples.english_sentence: Those two get along very well, they always play together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢唔系好合尺，讲几句就嗌交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 m4 hai6 hou2 hap6 cek3, gong2 gei2 geoi3 zau6 aai3 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他不太合得来，说几句话就吵架。
examples.english_sentence: I don't get along with him very well, we argue after saying a few words.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋个team好合尺，所以做嘢好顺利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 go3 team1 hou2 hap6 cek3, so2 ji5 zou6 je5 hou2 seon6 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们这个团队很合拍，所以工作很顺利。
examples.english_sentence: Our team is very compatible, so the work goes smoothly.

english_meaning: to get along (well); compatible
explanation_mandarin: 形容人和人之间关系融洽，性格或兴趣相投。
explanation_english: Describes a harmonious relationship between people, where they are compatible in personality or interests and get along well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋两个好合得嚟，成日一齐玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hou2 hap6 dak1 lai4, seng4 jat6 jat1 cai4 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个很合得来，经常一起玩。
examples.english_sentence: Those two get along really well, they always play together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢好唔合得嚟，倾两句就嘈交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 hou2 m4 hap6 dak1 lai4, king1 loeng5 geoi3 zau6 cou4 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他很不合得来，说两句话就吵架。
examples.english_sentence: I don't get along with him at all, we start arguing after just a few words.

english_meaning: to one's liking; to be to one's taste; to be suitable
explanation_mandarin: 符合自己的心意，喜欢。
explanation_english: To be agreeable to one's wishes; to be to one's liking or taste; suitable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食好合我心水，下次再嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 hou2 hap6 ngo5 sam1 seoi2, haa6 ci3 zoi3 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西很合我的心意，下次再来。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is very much to my liking, I'll come again next time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電話嘅功能好合心水，我決定買啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 waa2 ge3 gung1 nang4 hou2 hap6 sam1 seoi2, ngo5 kyut3 ding6 maai5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部手机的功能很合我的心意，我决定买了。
examples.english_sentence: The functions of this phone are to my liking, I've decided to buy it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢介紹嗰份工唔係好合我心水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaai3 siu6 go2 fan6 gung1 m4 hai6 hou2 hap6 ngo5 sam1 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他介绍的那份工作不太合我的心意。
examples.english_sentence: The job he introduced wasn't really to my liking.

english_meaning: logical and reasonable; justifiable
explanation_mandarin: 指事情符合情理，可以接受。
explanation_english: Describes something that is in accordance with reason and common sense, therefore acceptable and justifiable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做都算係合情合理嘅，冇人會怪你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 dou1 syun3 hai6 hap6 cing4 hap6 lei5 ge3, mou5 jan4 wui5 gwaai3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做也算是合情合理的，没有人会怪你。
examples.english_sentence: What you did is considered logical and reasonable, no one will blame you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個判決合情合理，大家都覺得公平。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 pun3 gyut3 hap6 cing4 hap6 lei5, daai6 gaa1 dou1 gok3 dak1 gung1 ping4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个判决合情合理，大家都觉得公平。
examples.english_sentence: The verdict was logical and reasonable, and everyone felt it was fair.

english_meaning: satisfactory, to one's liking, pleasing, agreeable
explanation_mandarin: 表示符合心意，令人感到满意。
explanation_english: Describes something that meets one's expectations or desires, making one feel satisfied.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工嘅人工都幾合意㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 ge3 yan4 gung1 dou1 gei2 hap6 ji3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作的人工还挺满意的。
examples.english_sentence: The salary of this job is quite satisfactory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅嘢食都幾合意，下次可以再嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 ye5 sik6 dou1 gei2 hap6 ji3, haa6 ci3 ho2 ji5 zoi3 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物还挺合意的，下次可以再来。
examples.english_sentence: The food in this restaurant is quite to my liking; I can come again next time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫嘅款式幾合意，我買咗佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 ge3 kwan2 sik1 gei2 hap6 ji3, ngo5 maai5 zo2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服的款式挺合意的，我买了它。
examples.english_sentence: The style of this shirt is quite pleasing; I bought it.

english_meaning: constitutional
explanation_mandarin: 指符合宪法的规定，不违反宪法的原则和精神。
explanation_english: Referring to something that complies with the constitution, not violating its principles and spirit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條法例俾人質疑合唔合憲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 faat3 leoi6 bei2 jan4 zat1 ji4 hap6 m4 hap6 hin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条法律被人质疑是否合宪。
examples.english_sentence: This law is being questioned for its constitutionality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 法院需要判斷呢個決定係咪合憲嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 jyun2 seoi1 jiu3 pun3 dyun3 ni1 go3 kyut3 ding6 hai6 mai1 hap6 hin3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 法院需要判断这个决定是否合宪。
examples.english_sentence: The court needs to determine whether this decision is constitutional.

english_meaning: synthetic; composite; to synthesize; to compound; to put together; combined; to merge
explanation_mandarin: 指将不同的东西结合成一个整体。可以是化学上的合成，也可以是图像、声音等的合成。
explanation_english: To combine different things into a single whole. It can refer to chemical synthesis, or the synthesis of images, sounds, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲相係用電腦合成嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 soeng3 hai6 yung6 din6 nou5 hap6 sing4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些照片是用电脑合成的。
examples.english_sentence: These photos were synthesized using a computer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻藥係化學合成嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 joek6 hai6 faa3 hok6 hap6 sing4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种药是化学合成的。
examples.english_sentence: This medicine is chemically synthesized.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個嘅樣合成埋一齊會係點㗎呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 ge3 joeng2 hap6 sing4 maai4 yat1 cai4 wui5 hai6 dim2 gaa3 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个的脸合成在一起会是什么样子呢？
examples.english_sentence: What would it look like if their faces were merged together?

english_meaning: Composite number
explanation_mandarin: 指大于1且不是质数的整数。即除了1和本身以外，还有其他因数的整数。
explanation_english: A composite number is a positive integer that can be formed by multiplying two smaller positive integers. Equivalently, it is a positive integer that has at least one divisor other than 1 and itself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 四、六、八、九都係合成數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sei3 luk6 baat3 gau2 dou1 hai6 hap6 sing4 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 四、六、八、九都是合数。
examples.english_sentence: Four, six, eight, and nine are all composite numbers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要識得分咩係質數，咩係合成數呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 sik1 dak1 fan1 me1 je5 hai6 zat1 sou3, me1 je5 hai6 hap6 sing4 sou3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要知道什么是质数，什么是合数。
examples.english_sentence: You need to know the difference between a prime number and a composite number.

mandarin_meaning: 顺手, 合用, 称手
english_meaning: Handy, suitable to handle, easy to use, fitting the hand
explanation_mandarin: 指物品使用起来很顺手，大小或设计适合手握。
explanation_english: Describes something that is handy, easy to use, and fits comfortably in the hand. Can also imply that something is well-suited for its intended purpose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢把刀好合手，用嚟切嘢好方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baa2 dou1 hou2 hap6 sau2, yung6 lai4 cit3 ye5 hou2 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这把刀很顺手，用来切东西很方便。
examples.english_sentence: This knife is very handy, it's very convenient to use for cutting things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電話個size啱啱好，好合手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 waa2 go3 size ngaam1 ngaam1 hou2, hou2 hap6 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电话的尺寸刚刚好，很称手。
examples.english_sentence: This phone is just the right size, it fits the hand perfectly.

english_meaning: compatible, get along well, in sync
explanation_mandarin: 指两人或多人性格、做事方式等方面很合得来，彼此配合默契。
explanation_english: Describes two or more people who are compatible in terms of personality, way of doing things, etc., and who work well together with mutual understanding and tacit agreement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋兩個好合拍，一齊做嘢好順利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hou2 hap6 paak3, jat1 cai4 zou6 je5 hou2 seon6 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们俩很合得来，一起工作很顺利。
examples.english_sentence: We are very compatible, and working together is very smooth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個好唔合拍，成日鬧交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hou2 m4 hap6 paak3, seng4 jat6 naau6 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们俩很不合得来，经常吵架。
examples.english_sentence: They are very incompatible and argue all the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隊波嘅隊員好合拍，合作得好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 deoi2 bo1 ge3 deoi6 jyun4 hou2 hap6 paak3, hap6 zok3 dak1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这支球队的队员很合得来，合作得很好。
examples.english_sentence: The team members of this team are very compatible and work well together.

english_meaning: co-production film
explanation_mandarin: 指由中国大陆（包括香港、澳门）与其他国家或地区合作拍摄的电影。
explanation_english: A film that is co-produced between mainland China (including Hong Kong and Macau) and other countries or regions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 近幾年多咗好多合拍片。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan6 gei2 nin4 do1 zo2 hou2 do1 hap6 paak3 pin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 近几年多了很多合拍电影。
examples.english_sentence: There have been many co-production films in recent years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲係香港同韓國嘅合拍片。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 hai6 hoeng1 gong2 tung4 hon4 gwok3 ge3 hap6 paak3 pin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影是香港和韩国的合拍电影。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is a co-production between Hong Kong and South Korea.

english_meaning: Chayote
explanation_mandarin: 一种葫芦科蔬菜，果实梨形，表面有纵向的皱纹。也叫佛手瓜。
explanation_english: A pear-shaped vegetable belonging to the gourd family, characterized by longitudinal wrinkles on its surface. Also known as chayote.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日買咗個合掌瓜，今晚煲湯飲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 maai5 zo2 go3 hap6 zoeng2 gwaa1, gam1 maan5 bou1 tong1 jam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天买了一个佛手瓜，今晚煲汤喝。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a chayote today, I'll make soup tonight.

english_meaning: seasonable; timely; in season; appropriate for the time
explanation_mandarin: 符合当时的时节或潮流。指某事物出现的时间或方式是恰当的，符合当前的需求或趋势。
explanation_english: Meeting the needs or trends of the time; being appropriate and timely for the current situation or season.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫而家著啱啱合時。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 ji4 gaa1 zoek3 ngaam1 ngaam1 hap6 si4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在穿这件衣服正合时宜。
examples.english_sentence: Wearing this outfit now is just right for the season.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年流行呢種款式，好合時㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 lau4 hang4 ni1 zung2 kwan2 sik1, hou2 hap6 si4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年流行这种款式，很合时宜。
examples.english_sentence: This style is trendy this year, it's very fashionable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅回應好合時，啱啱解決咗個問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 wui4 ying3 hou2 hap6 si4, ngaam1 ngaam1 gaai2 kyut3 zo2 go3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的回应很及时，正好解决了那个问题。
examples.english_sentence: His response was very timely, solving the problem just at the right moment.

mandarin_meaning: 完全符合; 非常合适
english_meaning: Perfectly matched; a perfect fit; just right
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物之间非常吻合，完全符合要求。也可以指某件事或某人非常适合某种情况或工作。
explanation_english: Describes something that is perfectly matched or fits requirements exactly. It can also refer to someone or something being very suitable for a particular situation or job. The '尺' (cek3) here originally refers to a tailor's ruler, implying precise measurement and fit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫合晒合尺你著。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 hap6 saai3 hap6 cek3 nei5 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服你穿正合适。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt fits you perfectly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做呢份工合晒合尺，簡直係為佢度身訂造嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 ni1 fan6 gung1 hap6 saai3 hap6 cek3, gaan2 zik6 hai6 wai4 keoi5 dou6 san1 ding3 zou6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做这份工作非常合适，简直是为他量身定做的。
examples.english_sentence: He is perfectly suited for this job; it's tailor-made for him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個性格合晒合尺，好襯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 sing3 gaak3 hap6 saai3 hap6 cek3, hou2 can3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个性格非常合拍，很般配。
examples.english_sentence: Their personalities are a perfect match, they are well-suited for each other.

english_meaning: qualified, up to standard, pass (an exam/test)
explanation_mandarin: 符合标准；通过（考试、测试等）。
explanation_english: Meeting the required standard; passing (an exam, test, etc.).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今次考試合格喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 haap6 gaak3 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我这次考试合格了！
examples.english_sentence: I passed the exam this time!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件貨品質素唔合格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 fo3 pin2 zat1 m4 haap6 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件货品的质量不合格。
examples.english_sentence: The quality of this product is not up to standard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅表現唔合格，需要改善。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 biu2 hin3 m4 haap6 gaak3, seoi1 jiu3 goi2 sin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的表现不合格，需要改善。
examples.english_sentence: His performance is not satisfactory and needs improvement.

english_meaning: walnut
explanation_mandarin: 一种坚果，果仁可以食用。
explanation_english: A type of nut whose kernel can be eaten.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意食合桃酥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 sik6 hap6 tou4 sou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢吃核桃酥。
examples.english_sentence: I like to eat walnut cookies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲合桃好香脆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 hap6 tou4 hou2 hoeng1 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些核桃很香脆。
examples.english_sentence: These walnuts are very fragrant and crispy.

english_meaning: Walnut cookie
explanation_mandarin: 一种酥脆的传统中式点心，主要成分包括面粉、猪油（或植物油）、糖和核桃。
explanation_english: A crumbly and crisp traditional Chinese cookie made primarily with flour, lard (or vegetable oil), sugar, and walnuts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嘅時候好鍾意食合桃酥，阿嫲成日買俾我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 hou2 zung1 ji3 sik6 hap6 tou4 sou1, aa3 maa4 sing4 jat6 maai5 bei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候很喜欢吃核桃酥，奶奶总是买给我。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, I really liked eating walnut cookies. My grandma always bought them for me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餅店嘅合桃酥特別鬆化，好香口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 beng2 dim3 ge3 hap6 tou4 sou1 dak6 bit6 sung1 faa3, hou2 hoeng1 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家饼店的核桃酥特别酥脆，很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The walnut cookies from this bakery are especially crumbly and delicious.

english_meaning: walnut sweet soup
explanation_mandarin: 一种用核桃磨成粉后煮成的甜品。是香港常见的甜品之一。
explanation_english: A sweet dessert made from ground walnuts boiled into a soup. It is a common dessert in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想飲碗熱嘅合桃露啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 jam2 wun2 jit6 ge3 hap6 tou4 lou6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想喝一碗热的核桃露。
examples.english_sentence: I want to drink a bowl of hot walnut sweet soup.

english_meaning: to partner, to collaborate, to work together
explanation_mandarin: 指一起合作做生意或完成某项任务。
explanation_english: Refers to working together, often in business or on a task. Implies a partnership or collaborative effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋兩個諗住合檔搞間餐廳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 loeng5 go3 nam2 zyu6 hap6 dong3 gaau2 gaan1 caan1 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们俩打算合伙开一家餐厅。
examples.english_sentence: The two of us are thinking of partnering up to open a restaurant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋合檔做緊一個新嘅項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hap6 dong3 zou6 gan2 jat1 go3 san1 ge3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们正在合作做一个新的项目。
examples.english_sentence: They are collaborating on a new project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不如我哋合檔一齊應付佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 hap6 dong3 jat1 cai4 jing3 fu6 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不如我们合作一起对付他吧。
examples.english_sentence: Why don't we partner up to deal with him together?

english_meaning: Mimosa tree flower (Albizia julibrissin); also used colloquially to refer to a happy, easy-going person.
explanation_mandarin: 1. 指植物合欢树的花。2. (口语) 形容一个人性格开朗，乐观，容易相处。
explanation_english: 1. Refers to the flower of the Mimosa tree (Albizia julibrissin). 2. (Colloquial) Describes a person with a cheerful, optimistic, and easy-going personality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好似合歡花咁，成日笑咪咪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 ci5 hap6 fun1 faa1 gam2, seng4 jat6 siu3 mi1 mi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人像合欢花一样，整天笑眯眯的。
examples.english_sentence: He's like a Mimosa flower, always smiling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢棵合歡花開得好靚啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ko1 hap6 fun1 faa1 hoi1 dak1 hou2 leng3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这棵合欢花开得很漂亮啊！
examples.english_sentence: This Mimosa tree flower is blooming beautifully!

english_meaning: legal, lawful, legitimate
explanation_mandarin: 符合法律规定的，法律允许的。
explanation_english: Conforming to the law; permitted by law.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司係合法嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 hai6 hap6 faat3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司是合法的。
examples.english_sentence: This company is legal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅婚姻係合法嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 fan1 yan1 hai6 hap6 faat3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的婚姻是合法的。
examples.english_sentence: Their marriage is legal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你噉樣做唔合法㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 m4 hap6 faat3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做是不合法的。
examples.english_sentence: What you are doing is not legal.

english_meaning: legalize, legitimize
explanation_mandarin: 使...合法，使...合乎法律规定。
explanation_english: To make something legal or legitimate; to give legal status to something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府考慮緊將大麻合法化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 hau2 leoi5 gan2 zoeng1 daai6 maa4 hap6 faat3 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府正在考虑将大麻合法化。
examples.english_sentence: The government is considering legalizing marijuana.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要反對賭博合法化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 faan2 doi3 dou2 bok3 hap6 faat3 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要反对赌博合法化。
examples.english_sentence: We must oppose the legalization of gambling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個行為唔可以合法化，係錯嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hang4 wai4 m4 ho2 ji5 hap6 faat3 faa3, hai6 co3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种行为不能合法化，是错误的。
examples.english_sentence: This behavior cannot be legalized, it's wrong.

english_meaning: to converge; to join streams; to merge
explanation_mandarin: 指多条河流或水流汇聚到一起。也比喻不同的力量或团体汇集到一起。
explanation_english: Refers to multiple rivers or streams converging into one. It also figuratively means different forces or groups coming together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幾條溪喺山腳合流，形成咗一條大河。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei2 tiu4 kai1 hai2 saan1 goek3 hap6 lau4, ying4 sing4 zo2 jat1 tiu4 daai6 ho4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 几条小溪在山脚下汇合，形成了一条大河。
examples.english_sentence: Several streams converged at the foot of the mountain, forming a large river.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅意見最終都係合流咗，決定咗採取同一個方案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 yi3 gin3 zeoi3 chung1 dou1 hai6 hap6 lau4 zo2, kyut3 ding6 zo2 coi2 ceoi2 tung4 jat1 go3 fong1 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的意见最终还是汇合了，决定采取同一个方案。
examples.english_sentence: Their opinions eventually converged, and they decided to adopt the same plan.

english_meaning: to co-star, to perform together
explanation_mandarin: 共同演出，一起表演（戏剧、电影等）。
explanation_english: To perform together; to co-star in a play, movie, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個喺套戲入面合演情侶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hai2 tou3 hei3 jap6 min6 hap6 jin2 cing4 leoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个在那部电影里合作演出情侣。
examples.english_sentence: They co-starred as a couple in that movie.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺台上合演咗一齣經典粵劇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 toi4 soeng6 hap6 jin2 zo2 jat1 ceot1 ging1 din2 jyut6 kek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在台上合作演出了一出经典粤剧。
examples.english_sentence: They performed a classic Cantonese opera together on stage.

english_meaning: group photo; to take a group photo
explanation_mandarin: 一起拍照，多人一起拍摄的照片。
explanation_english: A photo taken with multiple people together; to take such a photo.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一齊合照啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 hap6 ziu3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一起合影吧！
examples.english_sentence: Let's take a group photo!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 畢業嗰陣，我同啲同學仔合照咗好多相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jip6 go2 zan6, ngo5 tung4 di1 tung4 hok6 zai2 hap6 ziu3 zo2 hou2 do1 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 毕业的时候，我和同学们合影了很多照片。
examples.english_sentence: During graduation, I took many group photos with my classmates.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想同你合照。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 tung4 nei5 hap6 ziu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想和你合影。
examples.english_sentence: I want to take a group photo with you.

english_meaning: joint venture; co-management; co-operation
explanation_mandarin: 指两个或多个企业或个人共同投资、经营和分享利润或承担风险的一种合作方式。
explanation_english: Refers to a cooperative arrangement where two or more companies or individuals invest, operate, and share profits or bear risks together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋兩間公司諗住搞個合營企業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 loeng5 gaan1 gung1 si1 lam2 jyu6 gaau2 go3 hap6 ying4 kei5 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们两家公司打算成立一家合营企业。
examples.english_sentence: Our two companies are planning to set up a joint venture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目係我哋同外國公司嘅合營計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 hai6 ngo5 dei6 tung4 ngoi6 gwok3 gung1 si1 ge3 hap6 ying4 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目是我们和外国公司的合营计划。
examples.english_sentence: This project is a joint venture between us and a foreign company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 合營嘅風險比較分散。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hap6 ying4 ge3 fung1 him2 bei2 gaau3 fan1 saan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 合营的风险比较分散。
examples.english_sentence: The risks of a joint venture are more diversified.

english_meaning: to get along with; to be compatible; to be to one's taste
explanation_mandarin: 指在口味、性格等方面相互契合，能融洽相处。也指食物符合自己的口味。
explanation_english: Refers to being compatible in terms of taste, personality, etc., and being able to get along well. It can also mean that food suits one's taste.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅嘢食好合牙，我成日嚟食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 je5 sik6 hou2 hap6 ngaa4, ngo5 seng4 jat6 lai4 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物很合我的口味，我经常来吃。
examples.english_sentence: The food in this restaurant is to my taste, I come here often.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢好合牙，乜嘢都傾得埋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 hou2 hap6 ngaa4, mat1 je5 dou1 king1 dak1 maai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他很合得来，什么都能聊。
examples.english_sentence: I get along well with him, we can talk about anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔係好合牙呢種口味嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 hai6 hou2 hap6 ngaa4 ni1 zung2 hau2 mei6 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不太喜欢这种口味的东西。
examples.english_sentence: I don't really like this kind of flavor.

english_meaning: Rugby / American Football
explanation_mandarin: 指橄榄球运动，包括英式橄榄球（Rugby）和美式橄榄球（American Football）。
explanation_english: Refers to the sport of rugby or American football.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日想去睇人哋打合球。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 soeng2 heoi3 tai2 jan4 dei6 daa2 hap6 kau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天想去看别人打橄榄球。
examples.english_sentence: I want to go watch people play rugby tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意睇合球比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 tai2 hap6 kau4 bei2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很喜欢看橄榄球比赛。
examples.english_sentence: He really likes watching rugby matches.

english_meaning: reasonable; rational; justifiable; fair
explanation_mandarin: 指符合逻辑、情理，公正、没有偏袒。
explanation_english: Describes something that is logical, reasonable, justifiable, and fair; without bias or partiality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得佢嘅要求都幾合理喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 keoi5 ge3 jiu1 kau4 dou1 gei2 ho4 lei5 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得他的要求还挺合理的。
examples.english_sentence: I think his request is quite reasonable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個價錢都算合理，可以接受。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gaa3 cin2 dou1 syun3 ho4 lei5, ho2 ji5 zip3 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个价格还算合理，可以接受。
examples.english_sentence: This price is considered reasonable, acceptable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅解釋都幾合理，我信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gaai2 sik1 dou1 gei2 ho4 lei5, ngo5 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的解释挺合理的，我信他。
examples.english_sentence: His explanation is quite reasonable; I believe him.

english_meaning: rationalize, justification
explanation_mandarin: 使某事变得合乎逻辑或情理，找到看似合理的理由来解释或辩护。
explanation_english: To make something seem logical or reasonable; to find or create seemingly logical reasons to justify or explain something, often something questionable or undesirable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日幫自己嘅錯誤合理化啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 bong1 zi6 gei2 ge3 co3 ng6 hap6 lei5 faa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是为自己的错误合理化。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always rationalize your mistakes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想將佢嘅行為合理化，但係冇人信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 zoeng1 keoi5 ge3 hang4 wai4 hap6 lei5 faa3, daan6 hai6 mou5 jan4 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想合理化他的行为，但是没有人相信他。
examples.english_sentence: He tried to rationalize his behavior, but no one believed him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司試圖合理化裁員嘅決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 si3 tou4 hap6 lei5 faa3 caai4 jyun4 ge3 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司试图合理化裁员的决定。
examples.english_sentence: The company tried to rationalize the decision to lay off employees.

english_meaning: suitable; fit for purpose; appropriate; compatible
explanation_mandarin: 指某事物或方法适合使用，符合特定要求或目的。
explanation_english: Refers to something being suitable for use, meeting specific requirements or purposes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電腦啱曬我哋公司用，好合用㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 nou5 ngaam1 saai3 ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 yung6, hou2 hap6 yung6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台电脑非常适合我们公司用，很合适。
examples.english_sentence: This computer is perfect for our company, it's very suitable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個方法唔合用，要諗過第二個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fong1 faat3 m4 hap6 yung6, yiu3 nam2 gwo3 dai6 ji6 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个方法不适用，需要考虑另一个。
examples.english_sentence: This method is not suitable, we need to consider another one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個software同我部機唔合用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 software tung4 ngo5 bou6 gei1 m4 hap6 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个软件和我的电脑不兼容。
examples.english_sentence: This software is not compatible with my computer.

english_meaning: Cost-effective, a good deal, bargain
explanation_mandarin: 指商品或服务的价格非常划算，性价比高。
explanation_english: Refers to a product or service being very cost-effective and a good value for money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅午餐真係好合皮，又抵食又好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 ng5 caan1 zan1 hai6 hou2 gaap3 pei4, jau6 dai2 sik6 jau6 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的午餐真的很划算，又便宜又好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The lunch at this restaurant is really a good deal, it's cheap and delicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 趁佢哋做緊promotion，買啲合皮嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: can3 keoi5 dei6 zou6 gan2 promotion, maai5 di1 gaap3 pei4 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 趁他们做促销，买些划算的东西吧。
examples.english_sentence: Take advantage of their promotion and buy some good deals.

english_meaning: Close eyes; Go to sleep; Sleep
explanation_mandarin: 闭上眼睛；睡觉。
explanation_english: To close one's eyes; to go to sleep; to be asleep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好眼瞓，合埋眼瞓陣先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 ngaan5 fan3, hap6 mai4 ngaan5 fan3 zan6 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我好困，闭上眼睛睡一会儿。
examples.english_sentence: I'm very sleepy, I'll close my eyes and sleep for a while.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一上車就合眼瞓覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 soeng5 ce1 zau6 hap6 ngaan5 fan3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一上车就闭上眼睛睡觉。
examples.english_sentence: He closes his eyes and sleeps as soon as he gets on the car.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好講嘢喇，俾阿婆合眼休息吓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gong2 je5 laa1, bei2 aa3 po4 hap6 ngaan5 jau1 sik1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要说话了，让奶奶闭眼休息一下。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk, let Grandma close her eyes and rest for a while.

mandarin_meaning: 投缘; 顺眼; 对眼
english_meaning: pleasing to the eye; to have a good feeling about someone at first sight; to be compatible; to be to one's liking
explanation_mandarin: 指第一眼看上去感觉不错，觉得这个人或者事物让人感到舒服，有缘分的感觉。也形容对某人或某事物的喜爱或好感。
explanation_english: Refers to having a good feeling or impression about someone or something at first sight. It suggests compatibility or a sense of liking towards the person or thing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋兩個好似好合眼緣咁，傾咗好多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hou2 ci5 hou2 hap6 ngaan5 jyun4 gam2, king1 zo2 hou2 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们俩好像很投缘，聊了很多东西。
examples.english_sentence: It seems like we two have a good connection. We talked about a lot of things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫我一睇就覺得好合眼緣，所以買咗佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 ngo5 jat1 tai2 zau6 gok3 dak1 hou2 hap6 ngaan5 jyun4, so2 ji5 maai5 zo2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服我一看就觉得很顺眼，所以买了它。
examples.english_sentence: I thought this piece of clothing was pleasing to the eye at first glance, so I bought it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個唔合眼緣，成日都嘈交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 m4 hap6 ngaan5 jyun4, sing4 jat6 dou1 cou4 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个不投缘，整天都吵架。
examples.english_sentence: Those two don't get along; they argue all the time.

english_meaning: collectively called; jointly known as; commonly referred to as
explanation_mandarin: 将几个事物总括地称为一个名称。
explanation_english: To refer to several things collectively by one name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 港澳地區經常合稱「港澳」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong2 ou3 dei6 keoi1 ging1 seung4 hap6 cing1 "gong2 ou3".
examples.mandarin_sentence: 港澳地区经常合称“港澳”。
examples.english_sentence: The Hong Kong and Macau areas are often collectively called "Hong Kong and Macau".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋三個合稱「三劍俠」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 saam1 go3 hap6 cing1 "saam1 gim3 hap6".
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们三个合称“三剑侠”。
examples.english_sentence: The three of them are collectively known as "Three Musketeers".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢兩種藥可以合稱做消炎藥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 leung5 zung2 yoek6 ho2 ji5 hap6 cing1 zou6 siu1 yim4 yoek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这两种药可以合称做消炎药。
examples.english_sentence: These two kinds of medicine can be collectively called anti-inflammatory drugs.

english_meaning: contract
explanation_mandarin: 一种法律文件，规定双方或多方的权利和义务。
explanation_english: A legally binding agreement between two or more parties that outlines the rights and obligations of each party.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要簽份合約先可以開始呢個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 cim1 fan6 hap6 joek3 sin1 ho2 ji5 hoi1 chi2 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要签一份合同才能开始这个项目。
examples.english_sentence: We need to sign a contract before we can start this project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇清楚份合約嘅條款未啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 ching1 chu2 fan6 hap6 joek3 ge3 tiu4 fun2 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看清楚合同的条款了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you read the terms of the contract carefully?

english_meaning: contractual spirit; spirit of contract
explanation_mandarin: 指遵守合同条款、尊重合同义务的精神。
explanation_english: Refers to the spirit of adhering to the terms of a contract and respecting contractual obligations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做生意最緊要嘅就係要有合約精神，簽咗約就要跟足嚟做。

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「嬲」呢個字係一個合體字，由三個「男」字組成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nau1 ni1 go3 zi6 hai6 jat1 go3 hap6 tai2 zi6, jau4 saam1 go3 naam4 zi6 zou2 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: “嬲”这个字是一个合体字，由三个“男”字组成。
examples.english_sentence: The character "嬲" (nau1) is a compound character formed by three "男" (naam4) characters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲合體字嘅意思好直接，例如「好」字就係「女」同「子」嘅組合。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 hap6 tai2 zi6 ge3 ji3 si1 hou2 zik6 zip3, lai4 jyu4 "hou2" zi6 zau6 hai6 "neoi5" tung4 "zi2" ge3 zou2 hap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些合体字的意思很直接，例如“好”字就是“女”和“子”的组合。
examples.english_sentence: Some compound characters have very direct meanings, for example, the character "好" (hou2) is a combination of "女" (neoi5, woman) and "子" (zi2, child).

english_meaning: lucky; auspicious; empty
explanation_mandarin: 表示吉祥、顺利；也指空的，没有东西。
explanation_english: Indicates luck, auspiciousness, and good fortune; also refers to being empty or without contents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年快樂，萬事大吉！
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 faai3 lok6, maan6 si6 daai6 gat1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年快乐，万事大吉！
examples.english_sentence: Happy New Year, everything will be auspicious!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日間舖頭執笠，吉咗啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 gaan1 pou3 tau4 zap1 laap1, gat1 zo2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天这家店铺倒闭了，空了。
examples.english_sentence: This shop closed down today, it's empty now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，張枱吉嘅，你可以坐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, zoeng1 toi2 gat1 ge3, nei5 ho2 ji5 co5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，这张桌子是空的，你可以坐。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, this table is empty, you can sit here.

english_meaning: JUSCO / AEON (Japanese department store chain)
explanation_mandarin: 吉之岛是日本永旺集团 (AEON) 旗下的一家百货公司品牌。在香港，吉之岛曾经是AEON的主要品牌名称，后来逐渐统一为AEON。
explanation_english: JUSCO (now AEON) is a department store brand under the AEON Group, a Japanese retail company. In Hong Kong, JUSCO was the main brand name of AEON before it was gradually unified to AEON.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日去吉之島買嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 heoi3 gat1 zi1 dou2 maai5 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天去吉之岛买东西吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to JUSCO/AEON to buy things tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前細個成日同屋企人去吉之島行街嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 sai3 go3 seng4 jat6 tung4 uk1 kei2 jan4 heoi3 gat1 zi1 dou2 haang4 gaai1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前小时候经常和家人去吉之岛逛街。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, I often went shopping at JUSCO/AEON with my family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然依家間間都轉咗名叫AEON，但我都係鍾意叫佢做吉之島。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 ji1 ga1 gaan1 gaan1 dou1 zyun2 zo2 ming4 giu3 AEON, daan6 ngo5 dou1 hai6 zung1 ji3 giu3 keoi5 zou6 gat1 zi1 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然现在都改名叫AEON了，但我还是喜欢叫它吉之岛。
examples.english_sentence: Although they've all changed their name to AEON now, I still prefer to call it JUSCO.

english_meaning: The virtuous are always protected by Heaven; Fortune favors the good; Good people are blessed by Heaven.
explanation_mandarin: 指善良、有德行的人自然会得到上天的庇佑，逢凶化吉。
explanation_english: This idiom refers to the belief that virtuous and kind people are naturally protected by Heaven and will turn bad luck into good fortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁好心，就算遇到咩麻煩都吉人天相嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 hou2 sam1, zau6 syun3 jyu6 dou2 me1 maa4 faan4 dou1 gat1 jan4 tin1 soeng3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么善良，就算遇到什么麻烦也会吉人天相的。
examples.english_sentence: He is so kind-hearted that even if he encounters any trouble, fortune will favor the good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次咁危險，好彩吉人天相，先可以平安返嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 gam3 ngai4 him2, hou2 coi3 gat1 jan4 tin1 soeng3, sin1 ho2 ji5 ping4 on1 faan1 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次这么危险，幸好吉人天相，才可以平安回来。
examples.english_sentence: It was so dangerous this time, but fortunately, the virtuous are always protected by Heaven, so he could return safely.

jyutping: gat1 jan4 zi6 jau5 tin1 soeng3
english_meaning: Good people are always protected by Heaven; Good people will naturally be blessed.
explanation_mandarin: 指善良、正直的人，自然会得到上天的庇佑，逢凶化吉。
explanation_english: It means that good and upright people will naturally be protected by Heaven and will turn bad luck into good fortune. It suggests that virtuous individuals are destined to receive divine assistance in times of adversity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使咁擔心，佢咁好人，吉人自有天相嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 gam3 daam1 sam1, keoi5 gam3 hou2 jan4, gat1 jan4 zi6 jau5 tin1 soeng3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用那么担心，他那么好的人，好人自有天助的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry so much; he's such a good person. Good people are always protected by Heaven.

english_meaning: funeral gift bag
explanation_mandarin: 在葬礼结束后，丧家会派发给前来致祭的亲友的回礼，通常包含白毛巾、糖果或硬币等，以示答谢并冲淡丧家的哀伤。
explanation_english: A gift bag given out by the bereaved family to guests attending a funeral after the ceremony, typically containing items like a white towel, candy, and coins. It's a gesture of gratitude and meant to ward off bad luck for the guests and alleviate the family's grief.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 去完喪禮之後，記得攞返份吉儀啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: heoi3 jyun4 song1 lai5 zi1 hau6, gei3 dak1 lo2 faan1 fan6 gat1 ji4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 参加完葬礼之后，记得拿一份丧礼回礼啊。
examples.english_sentence: After attending the funeral, remember to take a funeral gift bag.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲吉儀入面通常有毛巾同埋糖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 gat1 ji4 jap6 min6 tung1 soeng4 jau5 mou4 gan1 tung4 mai4 tong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 丧礼回礼里面通常有毛巾和糖。
examples.english_sentence: There are usually towels and candy in the funeral gift bags.

english_meaning: Auspicious omen, good omen
explanation_mandarin: 指吉祥的预兆，预示着好运或成功。
explanation_english: Refers to an auspicious omen, foreshadowing good luck or success.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到隻喜鵲喺窗邊叫，覺得係個吉兆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou2 zek3 hei2 zoek3 hai2 cung1 bin1 giu3, gok3 dak1 hai6 go3 gat1 siu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到一只喜鹊在窗边叫，觉得是个吉兆。
examples.english_sentence: He saw a magpie calling by the window and felt it was a good omen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司生意好咗咁多，相信係個吉兆，下年會更好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 saang1 ji3 hou2 zo2 gam3 do1, soeng1 seon3 hai6 go3 gat1 siu6, haa6 nin4 wui5 gang3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司生意好了这么多，相信是个吉兆，明年会更好。
examples.english_sentence: The company's business has improved so much; I believe it's a good omen, and next year will be even better.

english_meaning: deep-fried (cutlet, usually breaded)
explanation_mandarin: 指将食物（通常是肉或海鲜）裹上面包糠后油炸的一种烹饪方式。
explanation_english: Describing a method of cooking where food (usually meat or seafood) is coated in breadcrumbs and then deep-fried.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想食吉列豬扒飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 sik6 gat1 lit6 zyu1 paa2 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想吃炸猪排饭。
examples.english_sentence: I want to eat deep-fried pork cutlet rice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅吉列魚柳做得好好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 gat1 lit6 jyu2 lau2 zou6 dak1 hou2 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的炸鱼柳做得很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The deep-fried fish fillet in this restaurant is very delicious.

english_meaning: lucky, auspicious
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物象征着好运、顺利。
explanation_english: Describing something that symbolizes good luck and success; auspicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年講啲吉利嘢啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 gong2 di1 gat1 lei6 je5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年说一些吉祥话吧！
examples.english_sentence: Say some lucky things for the New Year!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個號碼幾吉利㗎，好多人都想揀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hou6 maa5 gei2 gat1 lei6 gaa3, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 soeng2 gaan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个号码很吉祥，很多人都想选。
examples.english_sentence: This number is very lucky, many people want to choose it.

english_meaning: Gypsy, Romani people
explanation_mandarin: 指罗姆人，一个起源于印度的游牧民族。
explanation_english: Refers to the Romani people, a nomadic ethnic group originating from India.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日喺唔同嘅地方搬嚟搬去，好似啲吉卜賽人噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 jat6 hai2 m4 tung4 ge3 dei6 fong1 bun1 lai4 bun1 heoi3, hou2 ci5 di1 gat1 bok3 sai3 jan4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们总是搬来搬去到不同的地方，就像吉普赛人一样。
examples.english_sentence: They are always moving from place to place, just like Gypsies.

english_meaning: custard
explanation_mandarin: 西式甜点，一种用牛奶、鸡蛋和糖做成的奶油状甜点。
