explanation_english: A person with whom one works, typically in a profession or business; a colleague.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢係同僚，成日一齊食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 hai6 tung4 liu4, sing4 jat6 jat1 cai4 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他是同事，经常一起吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: He and I are colleagues, we often eat together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我嘅同僚，喺同一間公司做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 tung4 liu4, hai2 tung4 jat1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我的同事，在同一家公司工作。
examples.english_sentence: He is my colleague, working in the same company.

mandarin_meaning: 同伴; 同行; 同辈
english_meaning: peer; fellow; colleague
explanation_mandarin: 指在年龄、地位、兴趣等方面相近的人。
explanation_english: Refers to people of similar age, status, interests, etc. Often used in an academic or professional context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺大學入面，我哋好受同儕影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 daai6 hok6 jap6 min6, ngo5 dei6 hou2 sau6 tung4 caai4 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在大学里，我们很容易受到同伴的影响。
examples.english_sentence: In university, we are easily influenced by our peers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好重視同儕嘅評價。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung6 si6 tung4 caai4 ge3 ping3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很重视同行的评价。
examples.english_sentence: He values the opinions of his colleagues very much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要獲得成功，除咗自己嘅努力之外，仲要同同儕互相合作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 wok6 dak1 sing4 gung1, ceoi4 zo2 zi6 gei2 ge3 nou5 lik6 zi1 ngoi6, zung6 jiu3 tung4 tung4 caai4 wu6 seong1 hap6 jok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要获得成功，除了自己的努力之外，还要和同伴互相合作。
examples.english_sentence: To achieve success, in addition to your own efforts, you also need to cooperate with your peers.

english_meaning: identical; exactly the same; cut from the same cloth
explanation_mandarin: 形容兩件事或兩個人的做法、想法等完全相同。
explanation_english: Describes two things or two people's methods, ideas, etc., being exactly the same.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩兄妹嘅性格同出一轍，都咁硬頸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 hing1 mui6 ge3 sing3 gaak3 tung4 ceot1 jat1 cit3, dou1 gam3 ngaang6 geng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们兄妹俩的性格如出一辙，都这么固执。
examples.english_sentence: The personalities of the two siblings are identical; they're both so stubborn.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢兩間公司嘅市場策略同出一轍，都係靠減價吸引顧客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 loeng5 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 si5 coeng4 caak3 leuk6 tung4 ceot1 jat1 cit3, dou1 hai6 kaau3 gaam2 gaa3 kap1 yan5 gu3 hak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这两家公司的市场策略如出一辙，都是靠降价吸引顾客。
examples.english_sentence: The market strategies of these two companies are exactly the same; they both rely on lowering prices to attract customers.

english_meaning: assimilation, acculturation
explanation_mandarin: 指个人或群体接受并融入另一种文化、社会或群体之中，使其变得相似或相同。
explanation_english: The process of an individual or group absorbing and integrating into another culture, society, or group, becoming similar or identical to it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋移民咗去外國，好努力噉想同化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ji4 man4 zo2 heoi3 ngoi6 gwok3, hou2 nou5 lik6 gam2 soeng2 tung4 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们移民去了外国，很努力地想被同化。
examples.english_sentence: They immigrated to a foreign country and are working hard to assimilate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔應該強迫少數族裔去同化主流文化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 jing1 goi1 koeng5 bik1 siu2 sou3 zuk6 jeui6 heoi3 tung4 faa3 zyu2 lau4 man4 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不应该强迫少数族裔去同化主流文化。
examples.english_sentence: Minorities should not be forced to assimilate into the mainstream culture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間學校嘅教育制度傾向同化學生嘅思想。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 hok6 haau6 ge3 gaau3 juk6 zai3 dou6 king1 hoeng3 tung4 faa3 hok6 sang1 ge3 si1 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这所学校的教育制度倾向于同化学生的思想。
examples.english_sentence: The education system of this school tends to assimilate the students' thinking.

english_meaning: Identical twins (monozygotic twins)
explanation_mandarin: 指由同一个受精卵分裂而成的双胞胎，基因完全相同，外貌非常相似。
explanation_english: Refers to twins that develop from a single zygote (fertilized egg) and are therefore genetically identical and very similar in appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個同卵雙生，真係好難分得清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 tung4 leon2 soeng1 sang1, zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4 fan1 dak1 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个是同卵双胞胎，真的很难分辨清楚。
examples.english_sentence: They are identical twins, it's really hard to tell them apart.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 同卵雙生嘅兄弟姊妹，性格都會有唔同。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tung4 leon2 soeng1 sang1 ge3 hing1 dai6 zi2 mui6, sing3 gaak3 dou1 wui jau5 m4 tung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 同卵双胞胎的兄弟姐妹，性格也会有不同。
examples.english_sentence: Even identical twins can have different personalities.

english_meaning: Same question; following
explanation_mandarin: 表示有相同的问题，希望得到解答。通常在网络论坛或社交媒体上使用，表示自己也有同样的疑问，希望有人能提供答案。
explanation_english: Expresses having the same question and wanting an answer. Typically used in online forums or social media to indicate that one also has the same question and hopes someone can provide an answer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 點解個wifi咁慢嘅？同問！
examples.jyutping_sentence: dim2 gaai2 go3 wifi gam3 maan6 ge3? tung4 man6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为什么这个无线网这么慢？同问！
examples.english_sentence: Why is this Wi-Fi so slow? Same question!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 邊度有好食嘅點心？同問！
examples.jyutping_sentence: bin1 dou6 jau5 hou2 sik6 ge3 dim2 sam1? tung4 man6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哪里有好吃的点心？同问！
examples.english_sentence: Where is there delicious dim sum? Following!

english_meaning: and, also, as well as
explanation_mandarin: 连接两个或多个并列的词语或短语，表示附加关系。
explanation_english: Connects two or more words or phrases of equal importance, indicating an additive relationship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想飲咖啡，同埋食件蛋糕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 jam2 gaa3 fe1, tung4 maai4 sik6 gin6 daan6 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想喝咖啡，以及吃一块蛋糕。
examples.english_sentence: I want to drink coffee and eat a piece of cake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢識講廣東話，同埋英文。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sik1 gong2 gwong2 dung1 waa2, tung4 maai4 jing1 man2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他会说广东话，以及英文。
examples.english_sentence: He can speak Cantonese and English.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我帶咗本書，同埋遮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daai3 zo2 bun2 syu1, tung4 maai4 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我带了一本书，和一把伞。
examples.english_sentence: I brought a book and an umbrella.

english_meaning: together, and together, and with each other
explanation_mandarin: “同埋”表示“和，与，以及”，“一齐”表示“一起，一同”。连用时强调一起、一同的意思，也可以用于连接两个并列的成分，强调一起做某事。
explanation_english: "同埋" (tung4 maai4) means "and, with, along with," and "一齊" (jat1 cai4) means "together, at the same time." When used together, it emphasizes the meaning of "together, at the same time," and can also be used to connect two parallel components, emphasizing doing something together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日同埋一齊去行山啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 tung4 maai4 jat1 cai4 heoi3 haang4 saan1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天一起去爬山吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go hiking together tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩姊妹成日都同埋一齊玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 zi2 mui2 sing4 jat6 dou1 tung4 maai4 jat1 cai4 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她们两姐妹总是经常一起玩。
examples.english_sentence: Those two sisters always play together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想同你同埋你屋企人一齊食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 tung4 nei5 tung4 maai4 nei5 uk1 kei5 jan4 jat1 cai4 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想和你以及你的家人一起吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: I want to have a meal with you and your family together.

mandarin_meaning: 同乐; 一起; 同聚一堂
english_meaning: Together; in the same hall; to be together (usually referring to family gatherings or events)
explanation_mandarin: 指家人、朋友等共同聚在一起，特别是欢庆节日或举行活动时。
explanation_english: Refers to family members, friends, etc., gathering together, especially when celebrating festivals or holding events. It emphasizes the sense of togetherness and shared joy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年嘅時候，我哋一家人會同堂食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 wui5 tung4 tong4 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年的时候，我们一家人会聚在一起吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: During Chinese New Year, our whole family will gather together to have dinner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一家人好重視中秋節，一定會同堂賞月。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 hou2 zung6 si6 zung1 cau1 zit3, jat1 ding6 wui5 tung4 tong4 soeng2 jyut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一家人很重视中秋节，一定会一起赏月。
examples.english_sentence: Their family values the Mid-Autumn Festival a lot, and they will definitely gather together to admire the moon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望可以快啲同屋企人同堂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 faai3 di1 tung4 uk1 kei2 jan4 tung4 tong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望可以快点和家人团聚。
examples.english_sentence: I hope to be able to get together with my family soon.

english_meaning: Bonus feature; additional performance; encore
explanation_mandarin: 原指电影院在放映正片后，额外加放一部短片或花絮。 现在常用来比喻在主要活动或事件之后，额外增加一些内容或表演。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a cinema showing an additional short film or behind-the-scenes footage after the main feature. Now, it is often used metaphorically to describe adding extra content or performances after a main event or activity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 演唱會反應咁熱烈，不如我哋同場加映多兩首歌啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: yin2 cheung3 wui2 faan2 ying3 gam3 jit6 lit6, bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 tung4 coeng4 gaa1 ying2 do1 leung5 sau2 go1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演唱会反响这么热烈，不如我们加演两首歌吧！
examples.english_sentence: The concert has such a great response, how about we do an encore and sing two more songs!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買一送一，仲同場加映送多個環保袋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 yat1 sung3 yat1, zung6 tung4 coeng4 gaa1 ying2 sung3 do1 go3 waan4 bou2 doi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 买一送一，还额外赠送一个环保袋。
examples.english_sentence: Buy one get one free, plus we're throwing in an extra free reusable bag as a bonus!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 節目完咗之後，我哋同場加映幕後花絮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jit3 muk6 yun4 zo2 ji1 hau6, ngo5 dei6 tung4 coeng4 gaa1 ying2 muk6 hau6 faa1 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 节目结束后，我们加映幕后花絮。
examples.english_sentence: After the program ends, we will be showing behind-the-scenes footage as a bonus feature.

english_meaning: person with the same hobby or interest; fellow enthusiast
explanation_mandarin: 指有相同爱好或兴趣的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who shares the same hobby, interest, or passion as another.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我響呢個興趣班識到好多同好啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hoeng2 ni1 go3 hing3 ceoi3 baan1 sik1 dou2 ho2 do1 tung4 hou3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在这个兴趣班认识了很多同好。
examples.english_sentence: I met a lot of fellow enthusiasts in this interest class.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 難得遇到啲同好，真係好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: naan4 dak1 jyu6 dou2 di1 tung4 hou3, zan1 hai6 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很难得遇到一些同好，真的很开心。
examples.english_sentence: It's rare to meet some fellow enthusiasts, I'm really happy.

english_meaning: same surname; having the same last name
explanation_mandarin: 指具有相同的姓氏；用于描述两个人或多人姓氏相同的情况。
explanation_english: Refers to having the same surname. Used to describe the situation where two or more people share the same family name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個都係姓陳，係同姓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 dou1 hai6 sing3 can4, hai6 tung4 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个都姓陈，是同姓。
examples.english_sentence: They both have the surname Chan, they have the same surname.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前嘅傳統，同姓唔可以結婚㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 ge3 cyun4 tung2, tung4 sing3 m4 ho2 ji5 git3 fan1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的传统，同姓不可以结婚的。
examples.english_sentence: In the old traditions, people with the same surname were not allowed to marry.

english_meaning: People with the same surname share a partial kinship (literally: people with the same surname are three-tenths family)
explanation_mandarin: 表示同姓的人之间有一定的亲近关系，即使素不相识也会感到亲切。强调血缘关系对人际关系的影响。
explanation_english: This idiom means that people who share the same surname have a certain degree of kinship, even if they are strangers. It emphasizes the influence of blood relations on interpersonal relationships. The 'three-tenths' represents a partial, or diluted, sense of family connection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺香港機場撞到，發現大家同姓陳，真係同姓三分親，傾得好投契！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 gei1 coeng4 zong6 dou2, faat3 jin6 daai6 gaa1 tung4 sing3 can4, zan1 hai6 tung4 sing3 saam1 fan6 can1, king1 dak1 hou2 tau4 kei3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在香港机场碰到，发现大家同姓陈，真是同姓三分亲，聊得很投缘！
examples.english_sentence: We ran into each other at Hong Kong Airport and found out we shared the same surname, Chan. It's true, people with the same surname share a partial kinship. We got along really well!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢係我哋公司嘅新同事，但係我哋同姓，所以覺得特別親切，真係同姓三分親。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 hai6 ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 san1 tung4 si6, daan6 hai6 ngo5 dei6 tung4 sing3, so2 ji5 gok3 dak1 dak6 bit3 can1 cit3, zan1 hai6 tung4 sing3 saam1 fan6 can1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他是我们公司的新同事，但是我们同姓，所以觉得特别亲切，真是同姓三分亲。
examples.english_sentence: Although he is a new colleague in our company, we share the same surname, so I feel particularly close to him. It's true, people with the same surname share a partial kinship.

english_meaning: classmate; schoolmate
explanation_mandarin: 在同一学校或班级学习的人。
explanation_english: A person who studies in the same school or class.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我中學嘅同學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 zung1 hok6 ge3 tung4 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我中学的同学。
examples.english_sentence: He is my classmate from secondary school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同個同學一齊做功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 go3 tung4 hok6 jat1 cai4 zou6 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和我的同学一起做功课。
examples.english_sentence: I do homework together with my classmate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個係大學同學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hai6 daai6 hok6 tung4 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个是大学同学。
examples.english_sentence: They are university classmates.

english_meaning: fratricidal strife; internal conflict; infighting
explanation_mandarin: 比喻兄弟或内部自相残杀或争斗。
explanation_english: Metaphorically refers to infighting or internal conflict, like brothers turning against each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋兩兄弟唔好同室操戈啦，一家人有咩解決唔到啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 loeng5 hing1 dai6 m4 hou2 tung4 sat1 cou1 go1 laa1, jat1 gaa1 jan4 jau5 me1 gaai2 kyut3 m4 dou2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们两兄弟不要同室操戈了，一家人有什么解决不了的吗？
examples.english_sentence: You two brothers shouldn't be fighting amongst yourselves. Is there anything a family can't resolve?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司成日同室操戈，難怪做唔起。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 seng4 jat6 tung4 sat1 cou1 go1, naan4 gwaai3 zou6 m4 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司总是内部斗争，难怪做不起来。
examples.english_sentence: The company is always engaging in internal conflicts, no wonder it can't succeed.

english_meaning: colleague; fellow worker
explanation_mandarin: 指在同一部门或同一单位工作的人，通常带有较为正式或文雅的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to people working in the same department or unit, usually with a more formal or elegant connotation. It is a more traditional term for colleagues.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司嘅同寅都好幫得手㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 tung4 jan4 dou1 hou2 bong1 dak1 sau2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司的同事都很乐于助人。
examples.english_sentence: My colleagues in the company are very helpful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢同我係同寅，日日都一齊食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tung4 ngo5 hai6 tung4 jan4, jat1 jat1 dou1 jat1 cai4 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她和我同事，每天都一起吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is my colleague, and we eat together every day.

english_meaning: to live together; cohabitation
explanation_mandarin: 指男女双方在没有结婚的情况下，像夫妻一样共同生活。
explanation_english: Refers to a couple living together as husband and wife without being married.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋同居咗三年先結婚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 tung4 geoi1 zo2 saam1 nin4 sin1 git3 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们同居了三年才结婚。
examples.english_sentence: They lived together for three years before getting married.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多後生仔都選擇同居。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 hau6 saang1 zai2 dou1 syun2 zaak6 tung4 geoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多年轻人都会选择同居。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, many young people choose to live together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋打算同居試下係咪真係啱key。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 daa2 syun3 tung4 geoi1 si3 haa5 hai6 mai6 zan1 hai6 ngaam1 key1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们打算同居试试是否真的合适。
examples.english_sentence: They plan to live together to see if they are really compatible.

english_meaning: roommate, housemate
explanation_mandarin: 一起住在同一个房子里的人，通常指合租者。
explanation_english: A person who shares a house or apartment with someone else; a roommate or housemate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同屋好嘈，成日都好夜先瞓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 uk1 hou2 cou4, seng4 jat6 dou1 hou2 je6 sin1 fan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的室友很吵，经常很晚才睡。
examples.english_sentence: My roommate is very noisy and always goes to bed late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想搵個同屋夾租。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 wan2 go3 tung4 uk1 gaap3 zou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想找个室友一起合租。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to find a roommate to share the rent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同屋係我大學同學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 uk1 hai6 ngo5 daai6 hok6 tung4 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的室友是我的大学同学。
examples.english_sentence: My roommate is my university classmate.

english_meaning: roommate
explanation_mandarin: 共同租住或拥有一间房屋的人。
explanation_english: A person with whom one shares a room or house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嘅同屋主好嘈，成日都搞到我瞓唔著。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ge3 tung4 uk1 zyu2 hou2 cou4, seng4 jat6 dou1 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 fan3 m4 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的室友很吵，总是吵得我睡不着。
examples.english_sentence: My roommate is very noisy and always keeps me from falling asleep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同我嘅同屋主一齊夾錢買咗部雪櫃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 ngo5 ge3 tung4 uk1 zyu2 jat1 cai4 gaap3 cin2 maai5 zo2 bou6 syut3 gwai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和我的室友一起凑钱买了台冰箱。
examples.english_sentence: My roommate and I chipped in to buy a refrigerator.

english_meaning: to live together, to share a house
explanation_mandarin: 指住在同一个房子里，共同生活。
explanation_english: Refers to living in the same house, sharing a living space.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同我嘅朋友同屋住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 ngo5 ge3 pang4 jau5 tung4 uk1 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和我的朋友住在一起。
examples.english_sentence: I live with my friend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋幾時開始同屋住㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 gei2 si4 hoi1 chi2 tung4 uk1 zyu6 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们什么时候开始住在一起的？
examples.english_sentence: When did you guys start living together?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗慳錢，好多學生都會同屋住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 haan1 cin2, hou2 do1 hok6 sang1 dou1 wui5 tung4 uk1 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了省钱，很多学生都会住在一起。
examples.english_sentence: To save money, many students live together.

english_meaning: to belong to the same (category, group, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 表示属于同一个类别、团体或组织。
explanation_english: Indicates belonging to the same category, group, or organization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個都同屬一間公司嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 dou1 tung4 suk6 jat1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个都同属于一家公司。
examples.english_sentence: They both belong to the same company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢兩種動物都同屬哺乳類。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 leung5 zung2 dung6 mat6 dou1 tung4 suk6 bou2 jyu5 leoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这两种动物都同属于哺乳类。
examples.english_sentence: These two animals both belong to the mammal class.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢都同屬一個興趣班。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 dou1 tung4 suk6 jat1 go3 hing3 ceoi3 baan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他都同属于一个兴趣班。
examples.english_sentence: He and I both belong to the same interest group.

english_meaning: same job; equal work; equal pay for equal work
explanation_mandarin: 指做同样的工作；也指同工同酬，即做同样的工作应该得到相同的报酬。
explanation_english: Refers to doing the same job. It also refers to equal pay for equal work, meaning that the same job should receive the same compensation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋做緊同工，但係人工差好遠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zou6 gan2 tung4 gung1, daan6 hai6 yan4 gung1 chaa1 hou2 yuen5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们做着同样的工作，但是工资差很远。
examples.english_sentence: They are doing the same job, but their salaries are very different.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該要爭取同工同酬嘅權利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 yiu3 jaang1 cheui2 tung4 gung1 tung4 chau4 ge3 kuen4 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该争取同工同酬的权利。
examples.english_sentence: We should fight for the right to equal pay for equal work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢間公司，男女員工都係同工同酬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1, naam4 neui5 yun4 gung1 dou1 hai6 tung4 gung1 tung4 chau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这家公司，男女员工都是同工同酬。
examples.english_sentence: In this company, male and female employees receive equal pay for equal work.

english_meaning: Equal pay for equal work
explanation_mandarin: 指从事相同工作的人应该得到相同的报酬，不论性别、种族、年龄等。
explanation_english: Refers to the principle that people who perform the same work should receive the same pay, regardless of gender, race, age, or other factors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司堅持同工同酬，唔會因為性別而有差別。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 gin1 ci4 tung4 gung1 tung4 cau4, m4 wui5 yan1 wai4 sing3 bit6 yi4 yau5 caa1 bit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司坚持同工同酬，不会因为性别而有差别。
examples.english_sentence: Our company insists on equal pay for equal work and will not discriminate based on gender.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該立法保障同工同酬嘅權利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ying1 goi1 lap6 faat3 bou2 zoeng3 tung4 gung1 tung4 cau4 ge3 kuen4 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府应该立法保障同工同酬的权利。
examples.english_sentence: The government should legislate to protect the right to equal pay for equal work.

english_meaning: Different tunes played with equal skill; different approaches achieving the same result; accomplishing the same thing in different ways.
explanation_mandarin: 虽然做法不同，但结果或效果是一样的。
explanation_english: Although the methods are different, the result or effect is the same.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個解決問題嘅方法雖然唔同，但係同工異曲，都做到一樣嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4 ge3 fong1 faat3 seoi1 jin4 m4 tung4, daan6 hai6 tung4 gung1 ji6 kuk1, dou1 zou6 dou3 jat1 joeng6 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个解决问题的方法虽然不同，但是异曲同工，都做到了同样的事情。
examples.english_sentence: Although their methods for solving the problem are different, they achieve the same result; they are doing the same thing in different ways.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢兩間餐廳煮同樣嘅菜，但係風格唔同，可以話係同工異曲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 loeng5 gaan1 caan1 teng1 zyu2 tung4 joeng6 ge3 coi3, daan6 hai6 fung1 gaak3 m4 tung4, ho2 ji5 waa6 hai6 tung4 gung1 ji6 kuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这两家餐厅煮同样的菜，但是风格不同，可以说是异曲同工。
examples.english_sentence: These two restaurants cook the same dishes, but in different styles; you could say it's different tunes played with equal skill.

english_meaning: same year; of the same year
explanation_mandarin: 指同一年。
explanation_english: Refers to the same year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋係同年出世嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai6 tung4 nin4 ceot1 sai3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们是同年出生的。
examples.english_sentence: We were born in the same year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋同年結婚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 tung4 nin4 git3 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们同年结婚。
examples.english_sentence: They got married in the same year.

mandarin_meaning: 同床异梦 (tóng chuáng yì mèng)
english_meaning: Sleeping in the same bed, dreaming different dreams; outwardly together but inwardly divided; united in appearance but divided in spirit.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻同在一起生活或共事的人，虽然表面一致，但各有各的打算。
explanation_english: A metaphor for people who live or work together, appearing united but having their own different plans and intentions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩公婆雖然結咗婚好多年，但係一直都係同床異夢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gung1 po4 seoi1 jin4 git3 zo2 fan1 hou2 do1 nin4, daan6 hai6 jat1 zik6 dou1 hai6 tung4 cong4 ji6 mung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们夫妻虽然结婚很多年，但是一直都是同床异梦。
examples.english_sentence: Although the couple has been married for many years, they have always been sleeping in the same bed, dreaming different dreams.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅管理層同員工根本就係同床異夢，大家目標都唔一致。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 gun2 lei5 cang4 tung4 jyun4 gung1 gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 tung4 cong4 ji6 mung6, daai6 gaa1 muk6 biu1 dou1 m4 jat1 zi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的管理层和员工根本就是同床异梦，大家的目标都不一致。
examples.english_sentence: The management and employees of this company are fundamentally sleeping in the same bed, dreaming different dreams; their goals are not aligned at all.

english_meaning: Sleeping in the same bed, dreaming different dreams; outwardly together but inwardly at odds; having different aims or goals despite appearing to be united.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻共同生活或一起做事的人，各有各的打算。表面上一致，實際上想法和做法各不相同。
explanation_english: A metaphor for people living together or working together who have their own separate plans and intentions. Outwardly they appear to be in agreement, but in reality, their thoughts and actions differ.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩公婆表面好似好恩愛咁，但係其實同床異夢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gung1 po4 biu2 min6 hou2 ci5 hou2 jan1 oi3 gam2, daan6 hai6 kei4 sat6 tung4 cong4 ji6 mung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们夫妻表面上看起来很恩爱，但实际上同床异梦。
examples.english_sentence: They appear to be a loving couple on the surface, but in reality, they are sleeping in the same bed but dreaming different dreams.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司嘅管理層同員工之間同床異夢，好難有發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 gun2 lei5 cang4 tung4 jyun4 gung1 zi1 gaan1 tung4 cong4 ji6 mung6, hou2 naan4 jau5 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司管理层和员工之间同床异梦，很难有发展。
examples.english_sentence: The management and employees of the company are working towards different goals, so it's difficult for the company to develop.

english_meaning: to work together with one heart; to be of one mind and one heart; united effort
explanation_mandarin: 形容大家一条心，共同努力。
explanation_english: Describes people working together with one mind and making concerted efforts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 只要我哋同心協力，一定可以解決呢個問題嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi2 jiu3 ngo5 dei6 tung4 sam1 hip3 lik6, jat1 ding6 ho2 ji5 gaai2 kyut3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 只要我们同心协力，一定可以解决这个问题。
examples.english_sentence: As long as we work together, we can definitely solve this problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗重建家園，村民同心協力，互相幫忙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 cung4 gin3 gaa1 jyun4, cyun1 man4 tung4 sam1 hip3 lik6, wu6 soeng1 bong1 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了重建家园，村民们同心协力，互相帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: In order to rebuild their homes, the villagers worked together and helped each other.

synonyms: 齊心合力 (cai4 sam1 hap6 lik6)

english_meaning: to work together with one heart; united in purpose and effort
explanation_mandarin: 形容大家一条心，共同努力。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where everyone is of one mind and works together towards a common goal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 只要我哋同心合力，一定可以克服任何困難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi2 jiu3 ngo5 dei6 tung4 sam1 hap6 lik6, jat1 ding6 ho2 ji5 hak1 fuk6 jam6 ho4 kwan3 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 只要我们同心协力，一定可以克服任何困难。
examples.english_sentence: As long as we work together with one heart, we will definitely overcome any difficulty.

synonyms: 齊心協力 (cai4 sam1 hip3 lik6)

english_meaning: Comrade; Homosexual (gay, lesbian, bisexual)
explanation_mandarin: 原指志同道合的人，后来在中国大陆共产党内用来指称同事或同伴。在香港和台湾，主要指同性恋者。
explanation_english: Originally meant 'comrade' or 'someone with the same aspirations.' In mainland China, it was used to refer to colleagues or companions, especially within the Communist Party. In Hong Kong and Taiwan, it primarily refers to homosexual people (gay, lesbian, bisexual).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢公開承認自己係同志。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gung1 hoi1 sing4 jing6 zi6 gei2 hai6 tung4 zi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他公开承认自己是同性恋。
examples.english_sentence: He publicly admitted that he is homosexual.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司對同志員工都好平等。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 deoi3 tung4 zi3 wun4 gung1 dou1 hou2 ping4 dang2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司对同性恋员工都很平等。
examples.english_sentence: Our company treats homosexual employees very equally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊時啲人會叫同事做「同志」，依家就好少聽到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 si4 di1 jan4 wui5 giu3 tung4 si6 zou6 "tung4 zi3", ji1 gaa1 zau6 hou2 siu2 teng1 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的人会叫同事做“同志”，现在很少听到了。
examples.english_sentence: People used to call their colleagues "comrade", but now it's rarely heard.

english_meaning: same sex; homosexual
explanation_mandarin: 指具有相同性别的人；也可指同性恋的。
explanation_english: Refers to people of the same sex; can also refer to homosexuality/homosexual.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢同性婚姻合法化嘅支持者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tung4 sing3 fan1 yan1 hap6 faat3 faa3 ge3 zi1 chi4 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是同性婚姻合法化的支持者。
examples.english_sentence: He is a supporter of same-sex marriage legalization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你對同性戀有咩睇法呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 deoi3 tung4 sing3 lyun2 jau5 me1 tai2 faat3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你对同性恋有什么看法？
examples.english_sentence: What are your views on homosexuality?

english_meaning: homosexuality, homosexual
explanation_mandarin: 指对同性产生性吸引力或恋爱关系的状态或行为。
explanation_english: The state or behavior of being sexually attracted to or in love with people of the same sex.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個都係同性戀者，一齊好多年喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 dou1 hai6 tung4 sing3 lyun2 ze2, jat1 cai4 hou2 do1 nin4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个都是同性恋者，在一起很多年了。
examples.english_sentence: They are both homosexual and have been together for many years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家社會對同性戀嘅接受程度高咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 se5 wui2 deoi3 tung4 sing3 lyun2 ge3 zip3 sau6 cing4 dou6 gou1 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在社会对同性恋的接受程度高了很多。
examples.english_sentence: Society's acceptance of homosexuality is much higher now.

synonyms: 基佬 (gei1 lou1) - for gay men, less formal
女同志 (neoi5 tung4 zi3) - for lesbians

english_meaning: sympathy, compassion, pity
explanation_mandarin: 对别人的不幸遭遇表示怜悯和关怀。
explanation_english: To feel or express sympathy or compassion for someone's suffering or misfortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得好同情佢，咁後生就冇咗父母。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 hou2 tung4 cing4 keoi5, gam3 hau6 saang1 zau6 mou5 zo2 fu2 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得很同情他，这么年轻就失去了父母。
examples.english_sentence: I feel so sorry for him, losing his parents at such a young age.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔需要你嘅同情，佢只需要你嘅幫助。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 seoi1 jiu3 nei5 ge3 tung4 cing4, keoi5 zi2 seoi1 jiu3 nei5 ge3 bong1 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不需要你的同情，他只需要你的帮助。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't need your sympathy, he just needs your help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對佢嘅遭遇深表同情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 keoi5 ge3 zou1 geoi6 sam1 biu2 tung4 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对他的遭遇深表同情。
examples.english_sentence: I deeply sympathize with his situation.

english_meaning: sympathy, compassion
explanation_mandarin: 对别人的不幸遭遇表示理解和关心的情感。
explanation_english: A feeling of pity and sorrow for someone else's misfortune; compassion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好有同情心，成日幫啲冇錢嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 jau5 tung4 cing4 sam1, seng4 jat6 bong1 di1 mou5 cin2 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很有同情心，经常帮助那些没钱的人。
examples.english_sentence: He is very sympathetic and often helps people who have no money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你應該對佢哋有啲同情心，佢哋都唔想咁樣嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ying1 goi1 deoi3 keoi5 dei6 jau5 di1 tung4 cing4 sam1, keoi5 dei6 dou1 m4 soeng2 gam2 joeng2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你应该对他们有点同情心，他们也不想这样的。
examples.english_sentence: You should have some sympathy for them; they don't want it to be like this either.

english_meaning: agree, consent, approve
explanation_mandarin: 赞成，允许，许可。
explanation_english: To agree with, consent to, or approve of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你同唔同意我嘅睇法呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tung4 m4 tung4 ji3 ngo5 ge3 tai2 faat3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你同意我的看法吗？
examples.english_sentence: Do you agree with my point of view?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細唔同意我哋加人工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 m4 tung4 ji3 ngo5 dei6 gaa1 yan4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板不同意我们加薪。
examples.english_sentence: The boss doesn't agree to give us a pay raise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要得到你嘅同意先可以做呢件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 yiu3 dak1 dou3 nei5 ge3 tung4 ji3 sin1 ho2 yi5 zou6 ni1 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要得到你的同意才可以做这件事。
examples.english_sentence: We need to get your consent before we can do this.

english_meaning: consent form; letter of consent
explanation_mandarin: 书面的同意文件，用于表明某人同意进行某事，例如医疗程序或参与研究。
explanation_english: A written document indicating that someone consents to something, such as a medical procedure or participation in a study.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺做手術之前，你要簽返份同意書㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 zou6 sau2 seot6 zi1 cin4, nei5 jiu3 cim1 faan1 fan6 tung4 ji3 syu1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在做手术之前，你需要签一份同意书。
examples.english_sentence: Before the surgery, you need to sign a consent form.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要家長嘅同意書先可以帶啲細路去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gaa1 zoeng2 ge3 tung4 ji3 syu1 sin1 ho2 ji5 daai3 di1 sai3 lou2 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要家长的同意书才能带孩子们去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: We need the parents' consent forms before we can take the children on a trip.

english_meaning: Same feeling; I feel the same; I share your sentiment
explanation_mandarin: 表示有相同的感受或想法。
explanation_english: Expressing that one has the same feeling or thought as someone else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁講我都好同感啊，返工真係好辛苦㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 gong2 ngo5 dou1 hou2 tung4 gam2 aa3, faan1 gung1 zan1 hai6 hou2 san1 fu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么说我也很有同感，上班真的很辛苦。
examples.english_sentence: I totally feel the same way you do; working is really tiring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽你咁講，我真係好同感，呢個問題真係好難搞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 nei5 gam2 gong2, ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 tung4 gam2, ni1 go3 man6 tai4 zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4 gaau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听你这么说，我真的很有同感，这个问题真的很难解决。
examples.english_sentence: Listening to you, I really feel the same way; this problem is really difficult to deal with.

mandarin_meaning: 同住一间房间; 发生性关系
english_meaning: to share a room; to sleep with someone; to have sexual relations
explanation_mandarin: 1. 指共同住在同一间房间。2. 指发生性关系，一般为委婉的说法。
explanation_english: 1. To share a room with someone. 2. A euphemism for having sexual relations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋兩個今晚要同房啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 loeng5 go3 gam1 maan1 jiu3 tung4 fong2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们两个今晚要住同一个房间啊。
examples.english_sentence: The two of us will be sharing a room tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講佢哋結婚之前已經同房喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 keoi5 dei6 git3 fan1 zi1 cin4 ji5 ging1 tung4 fong2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说他们结婚之前就已经发生性关系了。
examples.english_sentence: I heard they slept together before they got married.

synonyms: [上床 (seung5 cong4) - to go to bed (with someone, euphemism for sex)]

english_meaning: To work together, to live together; in the same boat; to share the same fate
explanation_mandarin: 形容一起工作，一起生活，共同面对困难和分享成果。 捞：在水里捞东西，引申为谋生。煲：烹煮，引申为生活。
explanation_english: This idiom describes people who work and live together, facing difficulties and sharing the results together. 撈 (lou1) means 'to scoop' or 'to retrieve from water,' implying making a living. 煲 (bou1) means 'to cook' or 'to boil,' implying life and sustenance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋成班同事日日都同撈同煲，感情好深厚㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seng4 baan1 tung4 si6 jat6 jat6 dou1 tung4 lou1 tung4 bou1, gam2 ching4 hou2 sam1 hau5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们这群同事每天都一起工作一起生活，感情很深厚。
examples.english_sentence: We, this group of colleagues, work and live together every day, and our relationship is very deep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺香港打拼，大家都係同撈同煲，互相幫忙啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 hoeng1 gong2 daa2 ping3, daai6 ga1 dou1 hai6 tung4 lou1 tung4 bou1, wu6 seung1 bong1 mong4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在香港打拼，大家都是一起工作一起生活，互相帮助吧。
examples.english_sentence: Working hard in Hong Kong, everyone is in the same boat, let's help each other.

english_meaning: same day
explanation_mandarin: 指同一天，指同一日期。
explanation_english: Refers to the same day, the same date.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋係同日生日㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai6 tung4 jat6 saang1 jat6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们是同一天生日的。
examples.english_sentence: We have the same birthday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋同日結婚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 tung4 jat6 git3 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们同一天结婚。
examples.english_sentence: They got married on the same day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋同日開始返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 tung4 jat6 hoi1 chi2 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们同一天开始上班。
examples.english_sentence: We started working on the same day.

jyutping: tung4 si6 tin1 ngaai4 leon4 lok6 jan4
mandarin_meaning: 同是天涯沦落人 (tóng shì tiān yá lún luò rén)
english_meaning: Fellow sufferers from different places; We are all in the same boat; Misery loves company
explanation_mandarin: 指来自不同地方，有着相似不幸遭遇的人。形容境遇相同的人互相怜悯。
explanation_english: Describes people from different places who share similar unfortunate experiences. It implies mutual sympathy between those in similar situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋兩個都失咗業，真係同是天涯淪落人呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 loeng5 go3 dou1 sat1 zo2 jip6, zan1 hai6 tung4 si6 tin1 ngaai4 leon4 lok6 jan4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们两个都失业了，真是同是天涯沦落人啊。
examples.english_sentence: We both lost our jobs, we are truly fellow sufferers from different places.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢個咁艱難嘅時候，大家同是天涯淪落人，應該互相幫助。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 go3 gam3 gaan1 naan4 ge3 si4 hau6, daai6 gaa1 tung4 si6 tin1 ngaai4 leon4 lok6 jan4, ying1 goi1 wu6 seong1 bong1 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这个这么艰难的时候，大家同是天涯沦落人，应该互相帮助。
examples.english_sentence: In this difficult time, we are all in the same boat, we should help each other.

synonyms: 難兄難弟 (naan6 hing1 naan6 dai6)
患難之交 (waan6 naan6 zi1 gaau1)

english_meaning: at the same time; simultaneously
explanation_mandarin: 表示两个或多个动作、事情在同一时间发生。
explanation_english: Refers to two or more actions or events happening at the same time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋同時開始做呢個 project。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 tung4 si4 hoi1 chi2 zou6 ni1 go3 project.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们同时开始做这个项目。
examples.english_sentence: We started working on this project at the same time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢同時做緊兩份工，好辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tung4 si4 zou6 gan2 loeng5 fan6 gung1, hou2 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他同时做着两份工作，很辛苦。
examples.english_sentence: He's working two jobs at the same time, it's very tiring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個課程同時包含理論同實踐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fo3 ching4 tung4 si4 baau1 ham4 lei5 leon6 tung4 sat6 jian5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个课程同时包含理论和实践。
examples.english_sentence: This course includes both theory and practice at the same time.

english_meaning: same period; of the same term/class/intake
explanation_mandarin: 指同一时期，同一届，或同一批的人或事物。
explanation_english: Refers to the same period, the same term/class/intake of people or things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋係同期入職嘅同事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai6 tung4 kei4 jap6 zik1 ge3 tung4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们是同一批入职的同事。
examples.english_sentence: We are colleagues who joined the company in the same intake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個係大學嘅同期同學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hai6 daai6 hok6 ge3 tung4 kei4 tung4 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个是大学的同届同学。
examples.english_sentence: They are classmates from the same year at university.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年好多同期嘅樓盤都減價。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ho2 do1 tung4 kei4 ge3 lau4 pun4 dou1 gaam2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年很多同期的楼盘都降价了。
examples.english_sentence: This year, many properties launched in the same period have reduced their prices.

english_meaning: concurrent execution, simultaneous implementation
explanation_mandarin: 指在同一时期或时间段内执行或实施某事。
explanation_english: Refers to executing or implementing something within the same period or time frame.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要同期執行呢兩個項目，時間好趕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 tung4 kei4 zap1 hang4 ni1 leong5 go3 hong6 muk6, si4 gaan3 hou2 gan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要同步执行这两个项目，时间很赶。
examples.english_sentence: We need to execute these two projects concurrently, and we are running out of time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司決定同期執行幾個市場推廣計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 kyut3 ding6 tung4 kei4 zap1 hang4 gei2 go3 si5 cheung4 tui1 gwong2 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司决定同步执行几个市场推广计划。
examples.english_sentence: The company decided to implement several marketing campaigns simultaneously.

jyutping: tung4 toi4 sik6 faan6, gok3 zi6 sau1 hang4
mandarin_meaning: 各人自扫门前雪，莫管他人瓦上霜
english_meaning: Eat at the same table, but each practices their own cultivation; Mind your own business.
explanation_mandarin: 表面上大家在一起，实际上各顾各的，互不干涉。比喻表面上合作或共处，但实际上每个人都有自己的打算或追求，互不影响。
explanation_english: Literally means "eating at the same table, but each person practices their own cultivation." It implies that although people may be in the same situation or group, they are focused on their own individual goals and concerns, and are not necessarily collaborating or interfering with each other. Similar to "mind your own business."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩公婆雖然住埋一齊，但係同枱食飯，各自修行，好少溝通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gung1 po4 seoi1 jin4 zyu6 maai4 jat1 cai4, daan6 hai6 tung4 toi4 sik6 faan6, gok3 zi6 sau1 hang4, hou2 siu2 gau1 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们夫妻俩虽然住在一起，但是各过各的，很少沟通。
examples.english_sentence: Although the husband and wife live together, they mind their own business and rarely communicate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢間公司做嘢，大家都係同枱食飯，各自修行，冇乜團隊精神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zou6 je5, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hai6 tung4 toi4 sik6 faan6, gok3 zi6 sau1 hang4, mou5 mat1 tyun4 deoi2 zing1 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这家公司工作，大家都是各顾各的，没什么团队精神。
examples.english_sentence: Working in this company, everyone minds their own business, there is not much team spirit.

english_meaning: schoolmate; from the same school
explanation_mandarin: 在同一所学校就读的人；属于同一所学校的。
explanation_english: People who attend the same school; belonging to the same school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋係同校嘅，不過唔同班。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai6 tung4 haau6 ge3, bat1 gwo3 m4 tung4 baan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们是同校的，不过不同班。
examples.english_sentence: We are schoolmates, but we are not in the same class.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我同校師妹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 tung4 haau6 si1 mui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她是我同校的师妹。
examples.english_sentence: She is my junior schoolmate.

english_meaning: colleague in the same industry; people in the same trade; fellow professional
explanation_mandarin: 指在同一行業工作的人。
explanation_english: Refers to people working in the same industry or trade.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司同好多同業都有合作關係㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 tung4 hou2 do1 tung4 jip6 dou1 jau5 hap6 zok3 gwaan1 hai6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司和很多同行都有合作关系。
examples.english_sentence: Our company has cooperative relationships with many colleagues in the same industry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對咁多同業嘅競爭，我哋一定要努力啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 gam3 do1 tung4 jip6 ge3 ging6 zang1, ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 nu5 lik6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面对这么多同行的竞争，我们一定要更努力。
examples.english_sentence: Facing such fierce competition from so many fellow professionals, we must work harder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺呢行都做咗好耐，識好多同業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ni1 hang4 dou1 zou6 zo2 hou2 noi6, sik1 hou2 do1 tung4 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在这行做了很久，认识很多同行。
examples.english_sentence: He's been working in this industry for a long time and knows many fellow professionals.

english_meaning: Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate (HIBOR)
explanation_mandarin: 香港银行同业之间的短期贷款利率，是香港金融市场的重要参考指标之一。
explanation_english: Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate (HIBOR). The interest rate at which banks in Hong Kong lend funds to one another on a short-term basis. It is an important benchmark for the Hong Kong financial market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近嘅同業拆息升得好快，對樓市可能有影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 ge3 tung4 jip6 caak3 sik1 sing1 dak1 hou2 faai3, deoi3 lau4 si5 ho2 nang4 jau5 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近的香港银行同业拆借利率升得很快，对房地产市场可能有影响。
examples.english_sentence: The HIBOR has been rising rapidly recently, which may affect the property market.

english_meaning: Fun Day, Family Fun Day, Community Fun Day
explanation_mandarin: 通常指为社区或特定人群组织的，以娱乐、游戏和庆祝为主题的活动日。
explanation_english: Usually refers to a day of activities, games, and celebrations organized for a community or specific group of people, designed for fun and enjoyment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋學校下個禮拜搞同樂日，到時會有好多遊戲玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hok6 haau6 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 gaau2 tung4 lok6 jat6, dou3 si4 wui5 jau5 hou2 do1 jau4 hei3 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们学校下个星期举办同乐日，到时会有很多游戏玩。
examples.english_sentence: Our school is holding a Fun Day next week, there will be lots of games to play.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年屋邨嘅同樂日，節目豐富，好好玩㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 uk1 cyun1 ge3 tung4 lok6 jat6, zit3 muk6 fung1 fu3, hou2 hou2 waan2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年屋邨的同乐日，节目丰富，很好玩啊。
examples.english_sentence: This year's Fun Day at the housing estate has a rich variety of programs and is a lot of fun.

english_meaning: same; identical; alike; equally
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物在性质、状态或程度等方面没有差异或非常相似。
explanation_english: Used to indicate that things are the same, identical, or alike in nature, state, or degree.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋兩個都係同樣嘅年紀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 loeng5 go3 dou1 hai6 tung4 joeng6 ge3 nin4 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们两个都是同样的年纪。
examples.english_sentence: We are both the same age.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢同佢做嘅嘢唔同樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 tung4 keoi5 zou6 ge3 je5 m4 tung4 joeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的和做的不一样。
examples.english_sentence: What he says is not the same as what he does.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢兩件衫嘅顏色同樣咁靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 loeng5 gin6 saam1 ge3 ngaan4 sik1 tung4 joeng6 gam3 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这两件衣服的颜色同样那么漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: These two pieces of clothing are equally beautiful in color.

jyutping: tung4 toi2 sik6 faan6, gok3 zi6 sau1 hang4
english_meaning: Eating at the same table, practicing one's own cultivation (spiritually/morally). Everyone minds their own business even when together.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻即使在一起，也各有各的想法和做法，互不干涉。每个人专注于自己的事情。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where people are physically together but each person is focused on their own goals, thoughts, or actions, and do not interfere with each other. It implies a lack of genuine connection or collaboration despite being in the same environment. It highlights individualism and a 'live and let live' attitude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 宜家啲同事就係咁，同檯食飯，各自修行，冇乜交流嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 tung4 si6 zau6 hai6 gam2, tung4 toi2 sik6 faan6, gok3 zi6 sau1 hang4, mou5 mat1 gaau1 lau4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的同事就是这样，同桌吃饭，各自修行，没有什么交流的。
examples.english_sentence: The colleagues nowadays are like this, eating at the same table, practicing their own cultivation, there's not much communication.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然我哋一家人住埋一齊，但係都好似同檯食飯，各自修行咁，好少傾偈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 ngo5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 zyu6 maai4 jat1 cai4, daan6 hai6 dou1 hou2 ci5 tung4 toi2 sik6 faan6, gok3 zi6 sau1 hang4 gam2, hou2 siu2 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然我们一家人住在一起，但是都好像同桌吃饭，各自修行一样，很少聊天。
examples.english_sentence: Although my family lives together, it's like we're eating at the same table, practicing our own cultivation, we rarely chat.

synonyms: 各有各做 (gok3 jau5 gok3 zou6)

english_meaning: synchronize, synchronous
explanation_mandarin: 同时进行，协调一致。
explanation_english: To occur at the same time; to synchronize; to be in sync.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要同步資料先，唔係就會出錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 tung4 bou6 zi1 liu2 sin1, m4 hai6 zau6 wui5 ceot1 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要先同步资料，不然就会出错。
examples.english_sentence: We need to synchronize the data first, otherwise there will be errors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 演唱會用咗好多同步嘅燈光效果，好震撼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin2 coeng3 wui2 yung6 zo2 hou2 do1 tung4 bou6 ge3 dang1 gwong1 haau6 gwo2, hou2 zan3 ham6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演唱会用了许多同步的灯光效果，非常震撼。
examples.english_sentence: The concert used a lot of synchronized lighting effects, it was very impressive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個嘅諗法好同步，成日都諗埋一齊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 ge3 lam2 faat3 hou2 tung4 bou6, seng4 jat6 dou1 lam2 maai4 jat1 cai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个的想法很同步，经常都想到一起。
examples.english_sentence: Their thoughts are very synchronized, they often think of the same thing.

english_meaning: to perish together; to destroy oneself along with the enemy; mutual destruction; to fight to the bitter end
explanation_mandarin: 一同走向死亡，多指与敌人拼死搏斗，同归于尽。
explanation_english: To perish together; to die together. Often refers to fighting to the death with an enemy, resulting in mutual destruction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個都咁激，再嘈落去實會同歸於盡㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 dou1 gam3 gik1, zoi3 cou4 lok6 heoi3 sat6 wui5 tung4 gwai1 jyu1 zeon6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个都很激动，再吵下去肯定会同归于尽的。
examples.english_sentence: They are both so agitated; if they keep arguing, they will definitely end up destroying each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 與其俾佢哋攞到啲嘢，不如同佢哋同歸於盡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu5 keoi5 bei2 keoi5 dei6 lo2 dou2 di1 je5, bat1 jyu4 tung4 keoi5 dei6 tung4 gwai1 jyu1 zeon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 与其让他们得到东西，不如和他们同归于尽。
examples.english_sentence: Rather than let them get their hands on something, it's better to perish together with them.

english_meaning: of the same stock; closely related (like branches growing from the same tree); sharing the same fate
explanation_mandarin: 比喻兄弟姐妹或情谊深厚的人关系密切，命运相连。也指地理位置相近，命运休戚相关的地方。
explanation_english: An idiom used to describe a close relationship between siblings or close friends, sharing the same fate. It can also refer to places that are geographically close and whose fates are intertwined.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋兩兄弟同氣連枝，一定會互相扶持。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 loeng5 hing1 dai6 tung4 hei3 lin4 zi1, jat1 ding6 wui5 wu6 seung1 fu4 chi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们两兄弟同气连枝，一定会互相扶持。
examples.english_sentence: We are brothers of the same stock and will definitely support each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢兩間公司同氣連枝，一間有事，另一間都唔會好過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 loeng5 gaan1 gung1 si1 tung4 hei3 lin4 zi1, jat1 gaan1 jau5 si6, ling6 jat1 gaan1 dou1 m4 wui5 hou2 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这两间公司同气连枝，一间出事，另一间也不会好过。
examples.english_sentence: These two companies are closely related; if one has problems, the other won't be doing well either.

english_meaning: to wallow in the mire with others, to join the wicked, to go with the flow and become corrupt, to associate with bad company
explanation_mandarin: 指跟坏人一起做坏事。形容人放弃原则，与坏人坏事同流合污。
explanation_english: To join in the bad deeds of others; to compromise one's principles and associate with corrupt or immoral people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗升職，竟然同流合汙，幫老細做啲唔見得光嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai4 zo2 sing1 zik1, ging2 jin4 tung4 lau4 hap6 wu1, bong1 lou5 sai3 zou6 di1 m4 gin3 dak1 gwong1 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了升职，他竟然同流合污，帮老板做一些见不得光的事。
examples.english_sentence: In order to get promoted, he actually stooped to joining the wicked and helped his boss do some shady things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想同佢哋同流合汙，所以辭咗份工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 tung4 keoi5 dei6 tung4 lau4 hap6 wu1, so2 ji5 ci4 zo2 fan6 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想和他们同流合污，所以辞了工作。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't want to associate with their corruption, so I resigned from my job.

english_meaning: to wallow in the mire with others; to join the bad elements; to follow the bad example of others; to become corrupt
explanation_mandarin: 比喻跟壞人一起做壞事。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to associate with evil people and do evil deeds; to go along with the tide of corruption.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗升職，竟然同啲貪官同流合污。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 sing1 jik1, ging2 jin4 tung4 di1 taam1 gun1 tung4 lau4 hap6 wu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了升职，他竟然和那些贪官同流合污。
examples.english_sentence: In order to get promoted, he actually joined the corrupt officials and did dirty deeds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想同佢哋同流合污，所以辭咗份工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 tung4 keoi5 dei6 tung4 lau4 hap6 wu1, so2 ji5 ci4 zo2 fan6 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想和他们同流合污，所以辞掉了工作。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't want to wallow in the mire with them, so I resigned from my job.

english_meaning: comfort zone; echo chamber
explanation_mandarin: 比喻只与自己意见相近的人交流，接收到的信息都是类似的，从而强化自身的观点，形成一个舒适区，难以接受不同的意见。
explanation_english: Metaphorically refers to a situation where people only interact with others who share similar opinions and beliefs. This creates an echo chamber that reinforces their existing viewpoints and makes it difficult to accept dissenting opinions. Similar to the concept of a comfort zone, but specifically regarding opinions and information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺自己嘅同温层入面好舒服嘅，但係会限制咗你嘅视野。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 zi6 gei2 ge3 tung4 wan1 cang4 jap6 min6 hou2 syu1 fuk6 ge3, daan6 hai6 wui5 haan6 zai3 zo2 nei5 ge3 si6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在自己的同温层里很舒服，但是会限制你的视野。
examples.english_sentence: It's comfortable being in your own comfort zone/echo chamber, but it limits your perspective.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都喺自己嘅同温层入面，听唔到其他人嘅意见。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai2 zi6 gei2 ge3 tung4 wan1 cang4 jap6 min6, teng1 m4 dou2 kei4 taa1 jan4 ge3 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是待在自己的同温层里，听不到其他人的意见。
examples.english_sentence: He's always in his own echo chamber and can't hear other people's opinions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要努力跳出自己嘅同温层，接触唔同嘅人同埋文化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 nu5 lik6 tiu3 chut1 zi6 gei2 ge3 tung4 wan1 cang4, zip3 cuk1 m4 tung4 ge3 jan4 tung4 ma4 man4 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要努力跳出自己的同温层，接触不同的人和文化。
examples.english_sentence: We need to try hard to step out of our comfort zone/echo chamber and expose ourselves to different people and cultures.

english_meaning: echo chamber, filter bubble
explanation_mandarin: 指在一个相对封闭的环境中，人们只接触与自己观点相似的信息，从而加深对原有观点的认同，并可能变得更加极端。
explanation_english: Refers to a situation where individuals are primarily exposed to information and opinions that reinforce their existing beliefs, creating a bubble where dissenting viewpoints are rarely encountered.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺網上成日睇埋啲同自己一樣諗法嘅嘢，好容易困喺同溫層度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 mong5 soeng5 seng4 jat6 tai2 maai4 di1 tung4 zi6 gei2 jat1 joeng6 nam2 faat3 ge3 je5, hou2 jung4 ji6 kwan3 hai2 tung4 wan1 cang4 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在网上总是看那些和自己想法一样的东西，很容易困在同温层里。
examples.english_sentence: On the internet, if you always look at things that align with your own opinions, it's easy to get trapped in an echo chamber.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要跳出同溫層，先可以聽到唔同嘅聲音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 tiu3 chut1 tung4 wan1 cang4, sin1 ho2 ji5 ting1 dou3 m4 tung4 ge3 seng1 yam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要跳出同温层，才可以听到不同的声音。
examples.english_sentence: We need to step outside our echo chamber to hear different voices.

english_meaning: Echo chamber; Filter bubble; Comfortable sphere; Homogeneous social circle
explanation_mandarin: 指人们只接触到与自己观点相似的信息和人群，导致观点越来越固化，难以接触到不同意见的情况。也指一个让人感到舒适的环境，里面的人往往有类似的背景或看法。
explanation_english: Refers to a situation where people are only exposed to information and people that share similar viewpoints, leading to the solidification of opinions and difficulty in encountering different perspectives. It can also refer to a comfortable environment where people tend to have similar backgrounds or viewpoints.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日淨係睇啲同你立場一樣嘅嘢，咁樣咪即係喺同溫層囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sing4 jat6 zing6 hai6 tai2 di1 tung4 nei5 lip6 coeng4 jat1 joeng6 ge3 je5, gam2 joeng2 mai1 zik1 hai6 hai2 tung4 wan1 cang4 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你总是只看和你立场一样的东西，这样不就是在同温层里吗？
examples.english_sentence: You always only look at things that align with your views, isn't that just being in an echo chamber?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋間公司文化好似同溫層咁，個個都諗法一樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaan1 gung1 si1 man4 faa3 hou2 ci5 tung4 wan1 cang4 gam2, go3 go3 dou1 nam2 faat3 jat1 joeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司的文化好像同温层一样，每个人想法都一样。
examples.english_sentence: Their company culture is like an echo chamber, everyone thinks the same.

mandarin_meaning: 同床异梦 (tóng chuáng yì mèng)
english_meaning: Sleeping in the same bed, dreaming different dreams; to share a bed but have different aims; outwardly together but inwardly divided.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻同在一起生活或共事，但各有各的打算。表面上一致，实际上有不同的想法或目的。
explanation_english: A metaphor for people living or working together but having different plans or goals. Outwardly united but with different ideas or aims.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩公婆雖然住埋一齊，但係就同牀異夢，根本冇乜交流。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gung1 po4 seui1 jin4 zyu6 maai4 jat1 cai4, daan6 hai6 zau6 tung4 cong4 ji6 mung6, gan1 bun2 mou5 mat1 gaau1 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们夫妻虽然住在一起，但是同床异梦，根本没什么交流。
examples.english_sentence: Although the couple lives together, they are sleeping in the same bed, dreaming different dreams, and have virtually no communication.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司表面上好團結，但其實個個都同牀異夢，諗住點樣跳槽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 biu2 min6 soeng6 hou2 tyun4 git3, daan6 kei4 sat6 go3 go3 dou1 tung4 cong4 ji6 mung6, nam2 zyu2 dim2 joeng2 tiu3 cou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司表面上很团结，但实际上每个人都同床异梦，想着怎么跳槽。
examples.english_sentence: The company appears united on the surface, but in reality, everyone is sleeping in the same bed, dreaming different dreams, thinking about how to jump to another company.

english_meaning: in the same class; classmates
explanation_mandarin: 名词：指在同一个班级的人。形容词：表示在同一个班级的。
explanation_english: Noun: People in the same class. Adjective: Being in the same class.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋中學嘅時候係同班同學嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zung1 hok6 ge3 si4 hau6 hai6 tung4 baan1 tung4 hok6 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们中学的时候是同班同学。
examples.english_sentence: We were classmates in secondary school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢同我細個嗰陣係同班，所以好熟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tung4 ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 hai6 tung4 baan1, so2 ji5 hou2 suk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他和我小时候是同班，所以很熟。
examples.english_sentence: He and I were in the same class when we were young, so we're very familiar with each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個仔今年升上一年班，同班有三十個學生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 zai2 gam1 nin4 sing1 soeng5 jat1 nin4 baan1, tung4 baan1 jau5 saam1 sap6 go3 hok6 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我儿子今年升上一年级，同班有三十个学生。
examples.english_sentence: My son is going to grade one this year, there are thirty students in his class.

english_meaning: by the same logic; similarly; in the same vein; same reasoning
explanation_mandarin: 表示根据同样的道理或逻辑。
explanation_english: Indicates that the same reasoning or logic applies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁樣對你，同理，佢都會咁樣對其他人㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 joeng2 deoi3 nei5, tung4 lei5, keoi5 dou1 wui5 gam2 joeng2 deoi3 kei4 taa1 jan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这样对你，同样的道理，他也会这样对其他人。
examples.english_sentence: He treats you this way, and by the same logic, he will treat others this way too.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔想做，同理，我都唔想做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 soeng2 zou6, tung4 lei5, ngo5 dou1 m4 soeng2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不想做，同样的道理，我也不想做。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't want to do it, and by the same token, I don't want to do it either.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果佢可以咁做，同理，我哋都可以。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 keoi5 ho2 ji5 gam2 zou6, tung4 lei5, ngo5 dei6 dou1 ho2 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果他可以这样做，同样的道理，我们也可以。
examples.english_sentence: If he can do that, then by the same reasoning, we can too.

english_meaning: empathy
explanation_mandarin: 理解和感受他人情绪的能力，能够站在对方的立场思考问题。
explanation_english: The ability to understand and share the feelings of another; the ability to put yourself in someone else's shoes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有同理心嘅人通常都比較容易同其他人建立良好關係。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 tung4 lei5 sam1 ge3 jan4 tung1 soeng4 dou1 bei2 gaau3 jung4 ji6 tung4 kei4 taa1 jan4 gin3 lap6 loeng4 hou2 gwaan1 hai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有同理心的人通常更容易与他人建立良好的关系。
examples.english_sentence: People with empathy usually find it easier to build good relationships with others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 作為一個社工，你一定要有同理心去了解服務對象嘅需要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zok3 wai4 jat1 go3 se5 gung1, nei5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 jau5 tung4 lei5 sam1 heoi3 liu4 gaai2 fuk6 mou6 deoi3 zoeng6 ge3 seoi1 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 作为一个社工，你一定要有同理心去了解服务对象的需求。
examples.english_sentence: As a social worker, you must have empathy to understand the needs of your clients.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢缺乏同理心，所以唔明點解人哋會唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kyut3 fat6 tung4 lei5 sam1, so2 ji5 m4 ming4 dim2 gaai2 jan4 dei6 wui5 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他缺乏同理心，所以不明白为什么别人会不开心。
examples.english_sentence: He lacks empathy, so he doesn't understand why others are unhappy.

english_meaning: To share joys and sorrows; to stick together through thick and thin; to share weal and woe.
explanation_mandarin: 一同享受幸福，共同承担苦难。形容关系非常密切，感情深厚。
explanation_english: To share both the sweet and bitter experiences of life. It describes a relationship where people share both happiness and hardship together, indicating a strong and close bond.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋兩兄弟由細到大都同甘共苦，感情好好㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 loeng5 hing1 dai6 jau4 sai3 dou3 daai6 dou1 tung4 gam1 gung6 fu2, gam2 cing4 hou2 hou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们两兄弟从小到大都同甘共苦，感情很好。
examples.english_sentence: My brother and I have shared joys and sorrows since we were young, our relationship is very good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩公婆一齊創業，一路都同甘共苦，終於成功咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gung1 po4 jat1 cai4 cong3 jip6, jat1 lou6 dou1 tung4 gam1 gung6 fu2, zung1 jyu1 sing4 gung1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两夫妻一起创业，一路都同甘共苦，终于成功了。
examples.english_sentence: The couple started a business together, sharing joys and sorrows along the way, and finally succeeded.

synonyms: 患難與共 (waan6 naan6 jyu5 gung6)

english_meaning: To live and die together; to share life and death; bound by fate
explanation_mandarin: 形容关系非常密切，生死与共，不离不弃。
explanation_english: Describes a very close relationship where people share life and death, never abandoning each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩兄弟情同手足，話過要同生共死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 hing1 dai6 cing4 tung4 sau2 zuk1, waa6 gwo3 jiu3 tung4 sang1 gung6 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两兄弟情同手足，说过要同生共死。
examples.english_sentence: The two brothers are as close as siblings; they said they would live and die together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一齊打天下，就算有咩事都一定會同生共死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 daa2 tin1 haa5, zau6 syun3 jau5 me1 si6 dou1 jat1 ding6 wui5 tung4 sang1 gung6 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一起打天下，就算有什么事也一定会同生共死。
examples.english_sentence: We fought for the world together, and even if something happens, we will definitely live and die together.

english_meaning: Birds of a feather flock together; Misery loves company; fellow sufferers empathize with each other
explanation_mandarin: 比喻遭遇同样不幸的人互相怜悯，互相安慰。
explanation_english: Describes the feeling of empathy and understanding between people who share a similar hardship or misfortune. It implies that those who have experienced similar suffering can better relate to and support one another.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋都係俾公司炒咗，咪同病相憐囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 dou1 hai6 bei2 gung1 si1 caau2 zo2, mai1 tung4 beng6 soeng1 lin4 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们都被公司炒了，这就是同病相怜。
examples.english_sentence: They were both fired by the company, so they empathize with each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 兩個都係單親家庭長大，自然同病相憐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: loeng5 go3 dou1 hai6 daan1 can1 gaa1 ting4 zoeng2 daai6, zi6 jin4 tung4 beng6 soeng1 lin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 两个人都是单亲家庭长大的，自然同病相怜。
examples.english_sentence: Both of them grew up in single-parent families, so naturally they empathize with each other.

english_meaning: alliance; league; coalition
explanation_mandarin: 为了共同的目的而结成的联盟。
explanation_english: An alliance or league formed for a common purpose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個國家組成咗一個同盟，共同對抗敵人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 gwok3 gaa1 zo2 sing4 zo2 jat1 go3 tung4 mang4, gung6 tung4 deoi3 kong3 dik6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个国家组成了一个同盟，共同对抗敌人。
examples.english_sentence: The two countries formed an alliance to jointly fight against the enemy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要組成同盟，一齊爭取我哋嘅權益。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zo2 sing4 tung4 mang4, jat1 cai4 zaang1 ceoi2 ngo5 dei6 ge3 kuen4 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要组成同盟，一起争取我们的权益。
examples.english_sentence: We need to form an alliance to fight for our rights together.

english_meaning: Allied powers
explanation_mandarin: 指在战争或冲突中结成联盟的国家或政权。
explanation_english: Refers to countries or regimes that form an alliance during a war or conflict.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 第二次世界大戰嘅時候，同盟國打贏咗軸心國。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dai6 ji6 ci3 sai3 gaai3 daai6 zin3 ge3 si4 hau6, tung4 mang4 gwok3 daa2 wing4 zo2 zuk6 sam1 gwok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在第二次世界大战的时候，同盟国战胜了轴心国。
examples.english_sentence: During World War II, the Allied powers defeated the Axis powers.

english_meaning: Same type; of the same kind; same species
explanation_mandarin: 指属于同一类别、同一性质或同一物种。
explanation_english: Refers to being of the same category, nature, or species.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩間公司賣緊同種嘅產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gaan1 gung1 si1 maai6 gan2 tung4 zung2 ge3 caan2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两家公司卖的是同一种产品。
examples.english_sentence: The two companies are selling the same type of product.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋都係同種人，應該互相幫助。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 dou1 hai6 tung4 zung2 jan4, ying1 goi1 wu6 seong1 bong1 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们都是同一类人，应该互相帮助。
examples.english_sentence: We are all of the same kind, we should help each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好同唔同種嘅動物放埋一齊，可能會打交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tung4 m4 tung4 zung2 ge3 dung6 mat6 fong3 maai4 yat1 cai4, ho2 nang4 wui5 daa2 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把不同种类的动物放在一起，可能会打架。
examples.english_sentence: Don't put animals of different species together, they might fight.

english_meaning: schoolmate; classmate
explanation_mandarin: 指在同一所学校或同一个班级学习的人。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who studies at the same school or in the same class.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢係小學嘅同窗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 hai6 siu2 hok6 ge3 tung4 coeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他是小学同学。
examples.english_sentence: He and I were schoolmates in primary school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 畢業咁多年，我哋仲keep住同啲同窗聯絡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jip6 gam3 do1 nin4, ngo5 dei6 zung6 keep1 zyu6 tung4 di1 tung4 coeng1 lyun4 lok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 毕业这么多年，我们还和一些同学保持联系。
examples.english_sentence: It's been so many years since graduation, but we still keep in touch with some of our classmates.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 難得可以同啲舊同窗聚一聚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: naan4 dak1 ho2 ji5 tung4 di1 gau6 tung4 coeng1 zeoi6 jat1 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很难得可以和老同学们聚一聚。
examples.english_sentence: It's rare to have a chance to get together with old classmates.

english_meaning: equal, equivalent, of the same rank
explanation_mandarin: 表示在价值、数量、地位等方面相同或相当。
explanation_english: Indicates being the same or equivalent in value, quantity, status, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該畀所有小朋友同等嘅機會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 bei2 so2 jau5 siu2 peng4 jau5 tung4 dang2 ge3 gei1 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该给所有小朋友同等的机会。
examples.english_sentence: We should give all children equal opportunities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔理咩人，法律面前人人同等。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 lei5 me1 yan4, faat3 leot6 min6 cin4 yan4 yan4 tung4 dang2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不论什么人，法律面前人人平等。
examples.english_sentence: No matter who, everyone is equal before the law.

english_meaning: synonym
explanation_mandarin: 意义相同或相近的词语。
explanation_english: A word or phrase that means exactly or nearly the same as another word or phrase in the same language.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「靚」同「靚女」都係同義詞，都係用嚟讚人樣貌好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: leung1 tung4 leung1 neui5 dou1 hai6 tung4 ji6 ci4, dou1 hai6 yung6 lai4 zaan3 yan4 yeung6 maau6 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: “靓”和“靓女”都是同义词，都是用来赞美人长得漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: "Leung1" and "leung1 neui5" are synonyms, both used to praise someone's appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺寫作文嘅時候，可以多啲用同義詞，避免重複。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 se2 jok3 man4 ge3 si4 hau6, ho2 yi5 do1 di1 yung6 tung4 ji6 ci4, bei2 min5 chung5 fuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在写作文的时候，可以多用一些同义词，避免重复。
examples.english_sentence: When writing compositions, you can use more synonyms to avoid repetition.

english_meaning: in unison; with one voice; to echo; to agree with
explanation_mandarin: 一起发出声音；比喻附和别人。
explanation_english: To make a sound together; to express agreement with someone else's opinion or statement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋同聲咁話好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 tung4 sing1 gam2 waa6 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们异口同声地说好。
examples.english_sentence: They all said 'okay' in unison.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 全公司都同聲支持佢嘅建議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyun4 gung1 si1 dou1 tung4 sing1 zi1 chi4 keoi5 ge3 gin3 yi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 全公司都一致支持他的建议。
examples.english_sentence: The whole company unanimously supports his proposal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係識得同聲，要有自己嘅諗法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 tung4 sing1, jiu3 jau5 zi6 gei2 ge3 nam2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只会附和，要有自己的想法。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just echo others; you need to have your own thoughts.

english_meaning: Simultaneous interpreting
explanation_mandarin: 在会议或演讲进行的同时，口译员通过耳机收听发言人的讲话，并通过麦克风几乎同步地用另一种语言进行翻译，让听众可以通过耳机即时收听翻译的内容。
explanation_english: The practice of interpreting speech simultaneously, typically in a conference setting, where an interpreter listens to the speaker through headphones and translates into another language in real-time via a microphone, allowing listeners to hear the translated version through headphones.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次國際研討會需要大量嘅同聲傳譯員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 gwok3 zai3 jin4 tou2 wui2 seoi1 jiu3 daai6 loeng6 ge3 tung4 sing1 cyun4 jik6 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次国际研讨会需要大量的同声传译员。
examples.english_sentence: This international seminar requires a large number of simultaneous interpreters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅同聲傳譯技巧好純熟，啲客都讚佢做得好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 tung4 sing1 cyun4 jik6 gei2 haau2 hou2 seon4 suk6, di1 haak3 dou1 zaan3 keoi5 zou6 dak1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的同声传译技巧很熟练，客人都夸他做得好。
examples.english_sentence: His simultaneous interpreting skills are very proficient, and the clients praised him for doing a good job.

english_meaning: To share the same voice and spirit; to share a common cause; solidarity
explanation_mandarin: 形容彼此志同道合，互相支持。多用于形容有共同的背景、经历或追求的人之间的团结和互相支持。
explanation_english: Describes people who share the same aspirations and support each other. Often used to describe the unity and mutual support between people who share a common background, experience, or pursuit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺外國讀書嘅香港學生，都好同聲同氣，會互相幫忙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 ngoi6 gwok3 duk6 syu1 ge3 hoeng1 gong2 hok6 sang1, dou1 hou2 tung4 sing1 tung4 hei3, wui5 wu6 seong1 bong1 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们这些在国外留学的香港学生，都非常同声同气，会互相帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: We Hong Kong students studying abroad are very much of the same mind and spirit, and we help each other out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港人喺困難嘅時候，總係會同聲同氣，互相支持。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 jan4 hai2 kwan3 naan4 ge3 si4 hau6, zung2 hai6 wui5 tung4 sing1 tung4 hei3, wu6 seong1 zi1 chi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港人在困难的时候，总是会同声同气，互相支持。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong people always stand in solidarity and support each other in times of difficulty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個都係鄉下出嚟嘅，所以特別同聲同氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 dou1 hai6 hoeng1 haa6 cheut1 lai4 ge3, so2 ji5 dak6 bit1 tung4 sing1 tung4 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个都是从乡下来的，所以特别同声同气。
examples.english_sentence: They are both from the countryside, so they have a special sense of solidarity.

english_meaning: compatriot; fellow countryman; fellow citizen
explanation_mandarin: 指同一国家或民族的人民。
explanation_english: Refers to people of the same country or nation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋都係中國嘅同胞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 dou1 hai6 zung1 gwok3 ge3 tung4 baau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们都是中国的同胞。
examples.english_sentence: We are all compatriots of China.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 作為香港同胞，我哋應該互相支持。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zok3 wai4 hoeng1 gong2 tung4 baau1, ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 wu6 seung1 zi1 chi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 作为香港同胞，我们应该互相支持。
examples.english_sentence: As Hong Kong compatriots, we should support each other.

mandarin_meaning: 同舟共济 (tóng zhōu gòng jì)
english_meaning: To cross a river in the same boat; to cooperate and work together to overcome difficulties; to be in the same boat.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻利害一致，同心協力，共同渡过难关。源自《孙子·九地》。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to be in the same boat, and to cooperate and work together to overcome difficulties. It emphasizes the importance of unity and mutual help when facing a challenge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋依家好似同舟共濟咁，一定要互相支持先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji1 gaa1 hou2 ci5 tung4 zau1 gung6 zai3 gam2, jat1 ding6 jiu3 wu6 soeng1 zi1 chi4 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们现在就像同舟共济一样，一定要互相支持才行。
examples.english_sentence: We are like we're in the same boat now, we must support each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對經濟唔景氣，公司上下都要同舟共濟，先可以渡過難關。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 ging1 zai3 m4 ging2 hei3, gung1 si1 soeng6 haa6 dou1 jiu3 tung4 zau1 gung6 zai3, sin1 ho2 ji5 dou6 gwo3 naan4 gwaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面对经济不景气，公司上下都要同舟共济，才可以渡过难关。
examples.english_sentence: Faced with the economic downturn, everyone in the company must work together to overcome the difficulties.

synonyms: 守望相助 (sau2 mong6 soeng1 zo6)
休戚與共 (jau1 cik1 jyu5 gung6)

english_meaning: straight flush (poker)
explanation_mandarin: 扑克牌中的一种牌型，由五张同一花色且顺序相连的牌组成。是扑克游戏中非常强的牌型。
explanation_english: In poker, a straight flush is a hand containing five cards of sequential rank, all of the same suit. It is a very strong hand in most poker games.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嗰手牌竟然係同花順，真係好彩!
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go2 sau2 paai4 ging2 jin4 hai6 tung4 faa1 seon6, zan1 hai6 hou2 coi2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的那手牌竟然是同花顺，真是幸运！
examples.english_sentence: His hand was actually a straight flush, so lucky!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 除非你拎到同花順，如果唔係都贏唔到我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceoi4 fei1 nei5 ling1 dou2 tung4 faa1 seon6, jyu4 gwo2 m4 hai6 dou1 jeng4 m4 dou2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 除非你拿到同花顺，不然都赢不了我。
examples.english_sentence: Unless you get a straight flush, you won't beat me.

english_meaning: same trade/industry; companion; to walk together
explanation_mandarin: 名词：指从事相同行业的人或公司。动词：指一起行走，也可引申为合作。
explanation_english: Noun: People or companies in the same trade or industry. Verb: To walk together; can also be extended to mean cooperation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個都係做地產嘅，所以咪係同行囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 dou1 hai6 zou6 dei6 caan2 ge3, so2 ji5 mai1 hai6 tung4 haang4 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个都是做房地产的，所以就是同行了。
examples.english_sentence: They both work in real estate, so they're in the same trade.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一齊去迪士尼，你有個伴同行都好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 heoi3 dik1 si6 nei4, nei5 jau5 go3 bun6 tung4 haang4 dou1 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一起去迪士尼，你有个伴一起去也好一些。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to Disneyland together, it's better to have a companion to go with.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望同你嘅公司可以同行，一齊發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 tung4 nei5 ge3 gung1 si1 ho2 ji5 tung4 haang4, jat1 cai4 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望和你的公司可以合作，一起发展。
examples.english_sentence: I hope to cooperate with your company and develop together.

english_meaning: Competition among people in the same trade is fierce, like enemies.
explanation_mandarin: 形容同一行业的竞争非常激烈，如同敌对的国家一样。
explanation_english: This idiom describes the intense competition that exists between people working in the same industry or profession. It suggests that the rivalry is so strong that they treat each other as enemies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做生意就係咁㗎啦，同行如敵國，唔可以太老實。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 seng1 ji3 zau6 hai6 gam2 gaa3 laa1, tung4 hong4 jyu4 dik6 gwok3, m4 ho2 ji5 taai3 lou5 sat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做生意就是这样的，同行是冤家，不可以太老实。
examples.english_sentence: That's how business is, competitors are like enemies, you can't be too honest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺地產界，同行如敵國，搶客搶到出晒面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 dei6 caan2 gaai3, tung4 hong4 jyu4 dik6 gwok3, coeng2 haak3 coeng2 dou3 ceot1晒 min6.
