examples.mandarin_sentence: 在房地产行业，同行是冤家，抢客户抢得很明显。
examples.english_sentence: In the real estate industry, competitors are like enemies, they openly compete for clients.

synonyms: 商場如戰場 (seung1 coeng4 jyu4 zin3 coeng4)

mandarin_meaning: 同僚; 同伴; 战友
english_meaning: fellow soldiers; comrades; colleagues; people who share a common purpose or profession
explanation_mandarin: 本指同一部队或从事同一行业的人。引申为有共同目标或职业的人。
explanation_english: Originally referred to people in the same army or profession. It has been extended to refer to people who share a common goal or profession.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋係同一間公司嘅同袍，應該互相幫助。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai6 tung4 jat1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 tung4 pou4, jing1 goi1 wu6 soeng1 bong1 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们是同一家公司的同事，应该互相帮助。
examples.english_sentence: We are colleagues in the same company and should help each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係戰場上嘅同袍，感情好深厚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 zin3 coeng4 soeng6 ge3 tung4 pou4, gam2 ching4 hou2 sam1 hau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是战场上的战友，感情很深厚。
examples.english_sentence: They are comrades on the battlefield and have a deep relationship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 作為醫護同袍，我哋要盡力救助病人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zok3 wai4 ji1 wu6 tung4 pou4, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zeon6 lik6 gau3 zo6 beng6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 作为医护人员，我们要尽力救助病人。
examples.english_sentence: As fellow healthcare workers, we must do our best to help patients.

english_meaning: accomplice, conspirator, to conspire, to be an accomplice
explanation_mandarin: 共同策划，参与某种非法或不道德的活动。
explanation_english: A person who helps another commit a crime or immoral act; to conspire or be an accomplice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個係同謀，一齊呃人錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hai6 tung4 mau4, jat1 cai4 aak1 jan4 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个是同谋，一起骗别人的钱。
examples.english_sentence: They are accomplices, cheating people out of their money together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好做佢嘅同謀呀，咁樣會害死你㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 keoi5 ge3 tung4 mau4 aa3, gam2 joeng2 wui5 hoi6 sei2 nei5 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要做他的同谋啊，这样会害死你的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be his accomplice, it will kill you!

english_meaning: To share weal and woe; to bear the yoke together; to go through thick and thin together.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻共同承担艰巨的任务或命运。源自圣经，指两头牛套在同一副轭下一起耕地。
explanation_english: An idiom that describes sharing both joys and hardships, and bearing burdens or fate together. Originates from the Bible, referring to two oxen yoked together to plough the field.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋兩兄弟以後就要同負一軛，一齊打拼喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 loeng5 hing1 dai6 ji5 hau6 zau6 jiu3 tung4 fu6 jat1 aak3, jat1 cai4 daa2 ping3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们两兄弟以后就要同甘共苦，一起奋斗了。
examples.english_sentence: From now on, we two brothers will share weal and woe, and strive together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩公婆一直都同負一軛，無論遇到幾大困難都唔放棄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gung1 po4 jat1 zik6 dou1 tung4 fu6 jat1 aak3, mou4 leon6 jyu6 dou2 gei2 daai6 kwan3 naan4 dou1 m4 fong3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们夫妻俩一直都同甘共苦，无论遇到多大的困难都不放弃。
examples.english_sentence: The couple has always shared thick and thin, never giving up no matter how big the difficulties they face.

english_meaning: fellow traveler, someone with similar goals or ideals, kindred spirit
explanation_mandarin: 指有共同目标或理想的人。
explanation_english: Refers to people who share the same goals, ideals, or beliefs; someone who is on the same path as another.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋都係為咗香港嘅民主自由，所以係同路人嚟嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 dou1 hai6 wai6 zo2 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 man4 zyu2 zi6 jau4, so2 ji5 hai6 tung4 lou6 jan4 lai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们都是为了香港的民主自由，所以是同路人。
examples.english_sentence: We are all for democracy and freedom in Hong Kong, so we are fellow travelers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢個社會，搵到個同路人唔容易㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 go3 se5 wui2, wan2 dou2 go3 tung4 lou6 jan4 m4 jung4 ji6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这个社会，找到一个同路人不容易的。
examples.english_sentence: In this society, it's not easy to find a kindred spirit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個對藝術嘅睇法好相似，所以覺得對方係同路人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 deoi3 ngai6 seot1 ge3 tai2 faat3 hou2 soeng1 ci5, so2 ji5 gok3 dak1 deoi3 fong1 hai6 tung4 lou6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个对艺术的看法很相似，所以觉得对方是同路人。
examples.english_sentence: The two of them have similar views on art, so they feel that each other is a kindred spirit.

english_meaning: peers; people of the same generation
explanation_mandarin: 指年龄、辈分相近的人。
explanation_english: Refers to people who are of similar age or generation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺同輩入面算係好叻㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 tung4 bui3 jap6 min6 syun3 hai6 hou2 lek1 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在同辈中算是很厉害的了。
examples.english_sentence: He is considered very capable among his peers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋係同輩，所以好多嘢都好傾得埋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai6 tung4 bui3, so2 ji5 hou2 do1 je5 dou1 hou2 king1 dak1 maai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们是同辈，所以很多事情都能聊得来。
examples.english_sentence: We are peers, so we can talk about many things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想得到同輩嘅認同。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 dak1 dou3 tung4 bui3 ge3 jing6 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想得到同辈的认可。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to gain recognition from his peers.

english_meaning: like-minded people, people who share the same ideals/interests
explanation_mandarin: 指志同道合的人，有着共同的理想、兴趣或目标的人。
explanation_english: Refers to people who share the same ideals, interests, or goals; like-minded individuals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋都鍾意睇粵劇，真係同道中人呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 dou1 zung1 ji3 tai2 jyut6 kek6, zan1 hai6 tung4 dou6 zung1 jan4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们都喜欢看粤剧，真是同道中人啊！
examples.english_sentence: We both like watching Cantonese opera, we are truly like-minded people!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢個行業，搵到同道中人真係好難得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 go3 hang4 jip6, wan2 dou2 tung4 dou6 zung1 jan4 zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这个行业，找到同路人真的很难得。
examples.english_sentence: In this industry, it's really rare to find like-minded people.

english_meaning: fellow townsman/villager; someone from the same hometown
explanation_mandarin: 指来自同一个家乡的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who comes from the same hometown or village as another person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺香港遇到好多同鄉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 jyu6 dou2 ho2 do1 tung4 hoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在香港遇到很多同乡。
examples.english_sentence: I met many fellow townsmen in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好照顧啲同鄉，成日幫佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 ziu3 gu3 di1 tung4 hoeng1, seng4 jat6 bong1 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很照顾那些同乡，经常帮助他们。
examples.english_sentence: He takes good care of his fellow townsmen, often helping them.

english_meaning: Fellow natives association, hometown association
explanation_mandarin: 由来自同一个地方的人组成的社团，通常是为了联络感情，互相帮助。
explanation_english: An association formed by people who come from the same hometown, often for the purpose of connecting with each other and providing mutual assistance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多移民去咗外國嘅人都會參加當地嘅同鄉會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 yi4 man4 heoi3 zo2 ngoi6 gwok3 ge3 yan4 dou1 wui5 caam1 gaa1 dong1 dei6 ge3 tung4 hoeng1 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多移民去国外的人都会参加当地的同乡会。
examples.english_sentence: Many immigrants who have gone abroad will join the local fellow natives association.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋個同鄉會每年都會搞新春聯歡晚會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 go3 tung4 hoeng1 wui2 mui5 nin4 dou1 wui5 gaau2 san1 ceon1 lyun4 fun1 maan5 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的同乡会每年都会举办新春联欢晚会。
examples.english_sentence: Our hometown association organizes a Chinese New Year's Eve gala every year.

english_meaning: to be at odds with money; to be deliberately losing money; to not know how to handle money
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人故意或因为无能而失去赚钱的机会，或者不会理财，导致经济损失。
explanation_english: Describes someone who deliberately or due to incompetence misses opportunities to make money, or doesn't know how to manage money, leading to financial losses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日投資啲唔靠譜嘅嘢，真係同錢作對。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 tau4 zi1 di1 m4 kaau3 pou5 ge3 je5, zan1 hai6 tung4 cin2 zok3 deoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是投资一些不靠谱的东西，真是跟钱过不去。
examples.english_sentence: He always invests in unreliable things, he's really at odds with money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做生意法，遲早同錢作對㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 seng1 ji3 faat3, ci4 zou2 tung4 cin2 zok3 deoi3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样经营生意，迟早会赔钱的。
examples.english_sentence: The way you do business, you'll be losing money sooner or later.

synonyms: 倒錢落海 (dou2 cin2 lok6 hoi2)

english_meaning: To have a vendetta against money; to be bad at handling money; to be reckless with money; to not value money
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人不善于理财，不懂得珍惜金钱，或者总是遇到财务上的问题。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is bad at managing money, doesn't appreciate the value of money, or constantly encounters financial problems. It implies a person is either wasteful, unlucky with money, or actively sabotaging their financial well-being.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日亂咁洗錢，真係同錢有仇咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 lyun6 gam2 sai2 cin2, zan1 hai6 tung4 cin2 jau5 sau4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是乱花钱，真是跟钱过不去。
examples.english_sentence: He always spends money recklessly, it's like he has a vendetta against money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明好似同錢有仇，次次投資都蝕錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 hou2 ci5 tung4 cin2 jau5 sau4, ci3 ci3 tau4 zi1 dou1 sit3 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明好像跟钱过不去，每次投资都赔钱。
examples.english_sentence: It seems like Ah Ming has a vendetta against money; he loses money every time he invests.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做生意，唔執笠至奇啦，簡直係同錢有仇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 sang1 ji3, m4 zap1 lap1 zi3 kei4 laa1, gaan2 zik6 hai6 tung4 cin2 jau5 sau4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做生意，不倒闭才奇怪呢，简直是和钱过不去！
examples.english_sentence: The way you're running your business, it'd be a miracle if it doesn't go bankrupt, it's like you're at war with money!

synonyms: 唔識慳錢 (m4 sik1 haan1 cin2)

english_meaning: same school; fellow disciple; alumni of the same school
explanation_mandarin: 指同一师门或同一学校出身的人。
explanation_english: Refers to people who have the same teacher or graduated from the same school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢係同門師兄弟嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 hai6 tung4 mun4 si1 hing1 dai6 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他是同门师兄弟。
examples.english_sentence: He and I are fellow disciples from the same school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋兩個係大學同門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hai6 daai6 hok6 tung4 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们两个是大学同门。
examples.english_sentence: The two of us are alumni of the same university.

english_meaning: of the same kind; like; similar; fellow
explanation_mandarin: 指同一类型或性质的事物或人。
explanation_english: Refers to things or people of the same type or nature.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋好似唔係同類人，性格差好遠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hou2 ci5 m4 hai6 tung4 leoi6 jan4, sing3 gaak3 caa1 hou2 jyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们好像不是同类人，性格差很远。
examples.english_sentence: They don't seem to be of the same kind; their personalities are very different.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意同啲同類傾偈，感覺有共鳴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 tung4 di1 tung4 leoi6 king1 gai2, gam2 gaak3 jau5 gung6 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢和一些同类聊天，感觉有共鸣。
examples.english_sentence: I like chatting with people of the same kind because I feel a sense of resonance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢兩隻動物係同類嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 loeng5 zek3 dung6 mat6 hai6 tung4 leoi6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这两种动物是同类的。
examples.english_sentence: These two animals are of the same kind.

english_meaning: accomplice; cohort; partner in crime
explanation_mandarin: 指一同参与不法活动的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who participates in illegal activities together with others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係一班賊嘅同黨，專門打劫遊客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 jat1 baan1 caak6 ge3 tung4 dong2, zyun1 mun4 daa2 gip3 jau4 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是一伙贼的同伙，专门抢劫游客。
examples.english_sentence: They are accomplices of a group of thieves, specializing in robbing tourists.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好同佢哋做埋同一黨啦，會出事㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 tung4 keoi5 dei6 zou6 maai4 tung4 jat1 dong2 laa1, wui5 chut1 si6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要和他们混在一起了，会出事的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't get involved with them, something bad will happen!

english_meaning: of the same age; contemporary
explanation_mandarin: 指年龄相同或相近的人。
explanation_english: Refers to people who are of the same or similar age.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋兩個係同齡嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hai6 tung4 ling4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们两个是同龄的。
examples.english_sentence: We are the same age.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅同齡朋友都已經結婚生仔啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 tung4 ling4 pang4 jau5 dou1 ji5 ging1 git3 fan1 sang1 zai2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的同龄朋友都已经结婚生子了。
examples.english_sentence: His friends of the same age are already married and have children.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家啲同齡小朋友好叻仔㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 di1 tung4 ling4 siu2 pang4 jau5 hou2 lek1 zai2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的同龄小朋友很厉害的。
examples.english_sentence: Children of the same age are very clever nowadays.

mandarin_meaning: 名字; 名声; 有名的
english_meaning: name; reputation; famous
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人的名字，也可以指名声、名誉，还可以形容某事物很有名。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's name; can also refer to reputation or fame; can also describe something as famous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你叫咩名啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 giu3 me1 ming4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你叫什么名字啊？
examples.english_sentence: What's your name?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅名好響㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ming4 hou2 hoeng2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的名声很响亮的。
examples.english_sentence: He has a very good reputation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳好出名㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 hou2 ceot1 ming4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅很有名。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant is very famous.

english_meaning: under (someone's) name, in the name of
explanation_mandarin: 指登记在某人名下的财产或事物。
explanation_english: Refers to property or things registered under someone's name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間屋喺我阿媽名下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 uk1 hai2 ngo5 aa3 maa1 ming4 haa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间房子在我妈妈名下。
examples.english_sentence: This house is under my mom's name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司有兩部車喺佢名下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 jau5 loeng5 bou6 ce1 hai2 keoi5 ming4 haa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司有两辆车在他名下。
examples.english_sentence: The company has two cars under his name.

english_meaning: The name does not match the reality; not living up to the name; overrated
explanation_mandarin: 名称与实际不相符合。指徒有虚名，没有实际内容。
explanation_english: The reputation doesn't match the reality. It means that something or someone is overrated or doesn't live up to the expectations set by its name or reputation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳睇落好靚，但啲嘢食名不副實，唔好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 lok6 hou2 leng3, daan6 di1 je5 sik6 ming4 bat1 fu3 sat6, m4 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅看起来很漂亮，但是食物名不符实，不好吃。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant looks beautiful, but the food is overrated and not tasty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅演技名不副實，攞咗獎都覺得唔值。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jin2 gei6 ming4 bat1 fu3 sat6, lo2 zo2 zoeng2 dou1 gok3 dak1 m4 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的演技名不副实，拿了奖都觉得不值。
examples.english_sentence: His acting skills are overrated; even though he won an award, I don't think he deserves it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間大學嘅名氣好大，但係實際上資源唔夠，真係名不副實。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 daai6 hok6 ge3 ming4 hei3 hou2 daai6, daan6 hai6 sat6 zeong6 so1 jyun4 m4 gau3, zan1 hai6 ming4 bat1 fu3 sat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这所大学的名气很大，但是实际上资源不够，真是名不副实。
examples.english_sentence: This university has a big reputation, but in reality, the resources are not enough. It's truly overrated.

english_meaning: unknown, obscure, insignificant
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或事物不出名，不为人所知。多指人或事物原来没有名气。
explanation_english: Describes a person or thing that is not well-known or insignificant; often refers to someone or something that was previously unknown or obscure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以前只係一個名不經傳嘅小演員，而家已經係一位巨星。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 cin4 zi2 hai6 jat1 go3 ming4 bat1 ging1 cyun4 ge3 siu2 jin2 jyun4, ji4 gaa1 ji5 ging1 hai6 jat1 wai2 geoi6 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以前只是一个默默无闻的小演员，现在已经是一位巨星了。
examples.english_sentence: He used to be an unknown small actor, but now he is a superstar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳以前都名不經傳，但係最近啲嘢食好出名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ji5 cin4 dou1 ming4 bat1 ging1 cyun4, daan6 hai6 zeoi3 gan6 deoi1 je5 sik6 hou2 ceot1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅以前默默无闻，但是最近的食物很有名。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant used to be obscure, but recently its food has become very famous.

english_meaning: to deserve one's reputation; to live up to one's name; to be worthy of the name
explanation_mandarin: 形容名声与实际相符，不是虚假的。
explanation_english: This idiom describes something or someone that lives up to its reputation or lives up to its name, proving that the reputation is well-deserved and not exaggerated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳啲點心真係名不虛傳，好好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 dim2 sam1 zan1 hai6 ming4 bat1 heoi1 cyun4, hou2 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的点心真是名不虚传，非常好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The dim sum at this restaurant truly lives up to its reputation; it's very delicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅功夫咁犀利，真係名不虛傳啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gung1 fu1 gam3 sai1 lei6, zan1 hai6 ming4 bat1 heoi1 cyun4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的功夫这么厉害，真是名不虚传啊。
examples.english_sentence: His Kung Fu is so impressive; he truly lives up to his reputation!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲咁多人讚好睇，睇完之後我覺得真係名不虛傳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 gam3 do1 jan4 zaan3 hou2 tai2, tai2 jyun4 zi1 hau6 ngo5 gok3 dak1 zan1 hai6 ming4 bat1 heoi1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影这么多人称赞好看，看完之后我觉得真是名不虚传。
examples.english_sentence: So many people praised this movie as good, after watching it, I feel it really lives up to its name.

synonyms: 實至名歸 (sat6 zi3 ming4 gwai1)

english_meaning: Celebrity, Famous person
explanation_mandarin: 指有名气、受人关注的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who is famous and attracts public attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢依家係個好出名嘅名人，成日喺電視見到佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji1 gaa1 hai6 go3 hou2 ceot1 ming4 ge3 ming4 jan4, seng4 jat6 hai2 din6 si6 gin3 dou2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在是个很有名的名人，经常在电视上看到他。
examples.english_sentence: He is now a very famous celebrity, I see him on TV all the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想好似啲名人咁，著啲名牌衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 hou2 ci5 di1 ming4 jan4 gam2, zoek3 di1 ming4 paai4 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她想像那些名人一样，穿名牌衣服。
examples.english_sentence: She wants to be like those celebrities, wearing designer clothes.

english_meaning: status; position; legitimate status; formal designation; recognition
explanation_mandarin: 指在社会、组织或家庭中，某人所享有的正式身份、地位或权利，通常带有合法性和被认可的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to the formal status, position, or rights that someone enjoys in society, an organization, or a family, usually implying legitimacy and recognition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅關係一直都冇個名份，好似偷偷摸摸咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 jat1 zik6 dou1 mou5 go3 ming4 fan6, hou2 ci5 tau1 tau1 muk1 muk1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的关系一直没有一个正式的名分，好像偷偷摸摸一样。
examples.english_sentence: Their relationship has never had a formal status, it's like they're doing it secretly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋結婚之後，佢先至算有咗個正式嘅名份。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 git3 fan1 zi1 hau6, keoi5 sin1 zi3 syun3 jau5 zo2 go3 zing3 sik1 ge3 ming4 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们结婚之后，她才算有了一个正式的名分。
examples.english_sentence: Only after we got married, she finally had a formal status.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺公司入面，要爭取到個好嘅名份，先至可以升職加薪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gung1 si1 jap6 min6, jiu3 zaang1 ceoi2 dou2 go3 hou2 ge3 ming4 fan6, sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 sing1 zik1 gaa1 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在公司里面，要争取到一个好的名分，才可以升职加薪。
examples.english_sentence: Within the company, you need to fight for a good status in order to get promoted and a raise.

english_meaning: Masterpiece
explanation_mandarin: 指著名的作品，通常指艺术、文学等方面的杰出作品。
explanation_english: Refers to a famous work, usually referring to outstanding works in art, literature, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電影真係名作嚟㗎，一定要睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 ying2 zan1 hai6 ming4 zok3 lai4 gaa3, jat1 ding6 jiu3 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影真是名作，一定要看。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is a real masterpiece, you must watch it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅畫作而家已經俾人視為名作啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 waa2 zok3 ji4 gaa1 ji5 ging1 bei2 jan4 si6 wai4 ming4 zok3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的画作现在已经被人们视为名作了。
examples.english_sentence: His paintings are now considered masterpieces.

english_meaning: list (of names); register; roll
explanation_mandarin: 记录姓名的册子；花名册。
explanation_english: A list or register of names, often used for official purposes or record-keeping.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要整一份出席名冊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zeng2 jat1 fan6 ceot1 sik1 ming4 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要制作一份出席名单。
examples.english_sentence: We need to create an attendance list.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請喺名冊上面簽個名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 hai2 ming4 caak3 soeng6 min6 cim1 go3 ming2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请在名单上签个名。
examples.english_sentence: Please sign your name on the list.

english_meaning: roster, list, register
explanation_mandarin: 记录人名或事物名称的册子。
explanation_english: A list or register containing names of people or things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅名冊上面冇你個名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 ming4 caak3 soeng6 min6 mou5 nei5 go3 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的名单上没有你的名字。
examples.english_sentence: Your name isn't on their roster.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要更新學生嘅名冊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gang1 san1 hok6 sang1 ge3 ming4 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要更新学生的名单。
examples.english_sentence: We need to update the student register.

english_meaning: status; legitimacy; justification; title; reason; pretext
explanation_mandarin: 指名义、身份或理由。
explanation_english: Refers to name, status, or reason. Often implies a formal or socially recognized justification for something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一齊咗好耐，但係都冇名分。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 cai4 zo2 hou2 noi6, daan6 hai6 dou1 mou5 ming4 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在一起很久了，但是还没有名分。
examples.english_sentence: They have been together for a long time, but they are not officially recognized (as a couple).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁做係冇名分㗎，根本冇理由。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 zou6 hai6 mou5 ming4 fan6 gaa3, gan1 bun2 mou5 lei5 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这样做是没有名义的，根本没有理由。
examples.english_sentence: There's no justification for him doing that; there's simply no reason.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你俾佢有咗，佢就會俾返個名分你㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bei2 keoi5 jau5 zo2, keoi5 zau6 wui5 bei2 faan1 go3 ming4 fan6 nei5 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你如果让他有了孩子，他就会给你一个名分了。
examples.english_sentence: If you get him pregnant, he will give you the title (of wife).

english_meaning: to be among the best, to be at the top of the list, to be a high achiever
explanation_mandarin: 比喻名次排在前面，成绩优秀。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to be among the best or at the top of the list, indicating high achievement or superior performance, especially in rankings or scores.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺班入面成日都名列前茅㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 baan1 jap6 min6 seng4 jat6 dou1 ming4 lit6 cin4 maau4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在班里总是名列前茅的。
examples.english_sentence: He is always among the best in the class.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要考到好成績，就要努力，目標係名列前茅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 haau2 dou3 hou2 sing1 zik1, zau6 jiu3 nu5 lik6, muk6 biu1 hai6 ming4 lit6 cin4 maau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 想要考到好成绩，就要努力，目标是名列前茅。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to get good grades, you need to work hard, with the goal of being at the top.

synonyms: 數一數二 (sou3 jat1 sou3 ji6)

english_meaning: fame and wealth; reputation and gain; worldly success
explanation_mandarin: 名声和利益。指在社会上获得的好的名誉和物质上的好处。
explanation_english: Fame and wealth; refers to good reputation and material benefits acquired in society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好重視名利，乜嘢都為咗出名同賺錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung6 si6 ming4 lei6, mat1 je5 dou1 wai6 zo2 ceot1 ming4 tung4 zaan6 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很看重名利，什么都为了出名和赚钱。
examples.english_sentence: He values fame and wealth a lot; everything he does is for becoming famous and making money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好俾名利蒙蔽雙眼，重要嘅係做好自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 ming4 lei6 mung4 bai3 soeng1 ngaan5, zung6 jiu3 ge3 hai6 zou2 hou2 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要被名利蒙蔽双眼，重要的是做好自己。
examples.english_sentence: Don't let fame and wealth cloud your judgment; what's important is to be yourself and do your best.

mandarin_meaning: 名利双收 (míng lì shuāng shōu)
english_meaning: to gain both fame and wealth; to achieve both success and fortune
explanation_mandarin: 同时获得名誉和利益。形容事业非常成功，既有名声又有财富。
explanation_english: To achieve both fame and fortune, indicating a highly successful career with both recognition and wealth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢套戲咁賣座，真係名利雙收啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tou3 hei3 gam3 maai6 zo6, zan1 hai6 ming4 lei6 soeng1 sau1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的电影这么卖座，真是名利双收了。
examples.english_sentence: His movie is such a box office success, he has truly gained both fame and wealth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我可以喺呢個比賽攞到冠軍，就名利雙收喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 ho2 ji5 hai2 ni1 go3 bei2 coi3 lo2 dou2 gun1 gwan3, zau6 ming4 lei6 soeng1 sau1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我可以在这个比赛中获得冠军，就名利双收了。
examples.english_sentence: If I can win the championship in this competition, I will gain both fame and fortune.

english_meaning: Worthy of the name; true to its name; living up to its reputation
explanation_mandarin: 名称或名声与实际相符，不是徒有虚名。
explanation_english: The name or reputation matches the reality; not just an empty name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳啲嘢食真係名副其實咁好味呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 zan1 hai6 ming4 fu3 kei4 sat6 gam3 hou2 mei6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家餐厅的食物真是名副其实地好吃啊！
examples.english_sentence: The food at that restaurant is truly worthy of its reputation for being delicious!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅演技真係名副其實，攞獎都係實至名歸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 yin2 gei6 zan1 hai6 ming4 fu3 kei4 sat6, lo2 zoeng2 dou1 hai6 sat6 zi3 ming4 gwai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的演技真是名副其实，得奖也是实至名归。
examples.english_sentence: His acting skills are truly worthy of the name, and winning the award is well deserved.

english_meaning: scenic spot; place of interest
explanation_mandarin: 风景优美、有文物古迹而著名的地点。
explanation_english: A scenic spot or place of interest that is famous for its beautiful scenery, historical sites, or cultural significance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港有好多出名嘅名勝古蹟，吸引咗好多遊客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 jau5 hou2 do1 ceot1 ming4 ge3 ming4 sing3 gu2 zik1, kap1 jan5 zo2 hou2 do1 jau4 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港有很多著名的名胜古迹，吸引了很多游客。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong has many famous scenic spots and historical sites, attracting many tourists.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去旅行嘅時候，一定要去啲名勝地方睇下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 leoi5 haang4 ge3 si4 hau6, jat1 ding6 jiu3 heoi3 di1 ming4 sing3 dei6 fong1 tai2 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们去旅行的时候，一定要去一些名胜地方看看。
examples.english_sentence: When we go traveling, we must visit some scenic spots.

english_meaning: Scenic spots and historical sites
explanation_mandarin: 著名的风景优美的地方和有历史价值的遗迹。
explanation_english: Famous scenic spots and historical sites; places of interest and historical landmarks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港有好多名勝古跡，好似黃大仙廟咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 jau5 hou2 do1 ming4 sing3 gu2 zik1, hou2 ci5 wong4 daai6 sin1 miu2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港有很多名胜古迹，比如黄大仙庙。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong has many scenic spots and historical sites, such as the Wong Tai Sin Temple.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今個禮拜去睇啲名勝古跡啦，好唔好？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 go3 lai5 baai3 heoi3 tai2 di1 ming4 sing3 gu2 zik1 laa1, hou2 m4 hou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们这个星期去看一些名胜古迹吧，好不好？
examples.english_sentence: Shall we go see some scenic spots and historical sites this week, okay?

english_meaning: Nagoya (city in Japan)
explanation_mandarin: 日本中部城市名古屋
explanation_english: Nagoya is a major city in central Japan, known for its industry and history.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個禮拜去名古屋旅行啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 heoi3 ming5 gu2 wu1 leoi5 hang4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个星期要去名古屋旅行啊。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Nagoya for a trip next week.

english_meaning: to be called, to be named
explanation_mandarin: 表示名称或称呼。
explanation_english: Indicates a name or title; to be called.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢名叫李小明。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming5 giu3 lei5 siu2 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他叫李小明。
examples.english_sentence: He is called Li Xiaoming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳名叫「好味」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ming5 giu3 「hou2 mei6」.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅叫做“好味”。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant is called 'Delicious'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻狗名叫Lucky。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 gau2 ming5 giu3 Lucky.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那只狗叫Lucky。
examples.english_sentence: That dog is called Lucky.

english_meaning: list; roster; register
explanation_mandarin: 列有姓名、项目等的单子。
explanation_english: A list containing names, items, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張名單有好多人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 ming4 daan1 jau5 hou2 do1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张名单上有很多个人。
examples.english_sentence: There are a lot of people on this list.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你喺名單上面嘅邊個位呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai2 ming4 daan1 soeng6 min6 ge3 bin1 go3 wai2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在名单上的哪个位置啊？
examples.english_sentence: What position are you on the list?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個名冇喺份名單上面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 meng2 mou5 hai2 fan6 ming4 daan1 soeng6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的名字没有在名单上。
examples.english_sentence: His name is not on the list.

english_meaning: well-known eloquent speaker; talking head; pundit
explanation_mandarin: 指口才很好，很有名气的评论员、主持人、演说家等。
explanation_english: Refers to a well-known and eloquent speaker, commentator, host, or orator, often with a reputation for insightful or entertaining commentary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個電視節目嘅名嘴，講嘢好風趣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 din6 si6 zit3 muk6 ge3 ming4 zeoi2, gong2 je5 hou2 fung1 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是电视节目的名嘴，说话很风趣。
examples.english_sentence: He's a well-known pundit on a TV show, and he speaks very humorously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多人都鐘意聽佢哋啲名嘴講波，好鬼過癮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 zung1 ji3 teng1 keoi5 dei6 dik1 ming4 zeoi2 gong2 bo1, hou2 gwai2 gwo3 jan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多人都喜欢听他们的名嘴解说球赛，非常过瘾。
examples.english_sentence: Many people enjoy listening to those well-known commentators talk about the game, it's very exciting.

english_meaning: A woman with exceptional sexual skills or physical attributes; figuratively, a high-quality sexual partner (female).
explanation_mandarin: 本义为名贵的器具，但在粤语中多指性能力极佳或身体特征优异的女性，含贬义色彩。
explanation_english: Originally meaning a famous or valuable instrument, but in Cantonese slang, it usually refers to a woman with exceptional sexual abilities or physical attributes, often with a negative connotation. It objectifies women.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條仔成日喺度曬佢條女，話佢係名器。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 zai2 seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 saai3 keoi5 tiu4 neoi2, waa6 keoi5 hai6 ming4 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个男的总是炫耀他的女朋友，说她是个极品性伴侣。
examples.english_sentence: That guy is always showing off his girlfriend, saying she's a top-tier sex partner.

english_meaning: to be a sensation for a time; to create a temporary stir; to be briefly famous
explanation_mandarin: 指名声在短时间内传遍各地，轰动一时。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something that becomes famous or well-known very quickly, but the fame is usually short-lived.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嗰時出咗一首歌，即刻名噪一時。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go2 si4 ceot1 zo2 jat1 sau2 go1, zik1 hak1 ming4 cou3 jat1 si4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他当时出了一首歌，立刻轰动一时。
examples.english_sentence: He released a song at that time and immediately became a sensation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電影上映嘅時候，都算係名噪一時。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 ying2 soeng5 ying2 ge3 si4 hau2, dou1 syun3 hai6 ming4 cou3 jat1 si4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影上映的时候，也算是轰动一时。
examples.english_sentence: This movie was quite a sensation when it was released.

mandarin_meaning: 名目, 花样, 原因, 门道
english_meaning: name; style; variety; trick; reason; something special or interesting
explanation_mandarin: 指名称、名目；花样、种类；原因、理由；门道、诀窍。也指与众不同的地方或噱头。
explanation_english: Refers to a name or title; variety or type; reason or justification; the knack or know-how. Also refers to something special, interesting, or a trick.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢搞咁多名堂，都係想吸引人注意啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaau2 gam3 do1 ming4 tong4, dou1 hai6 soeng2 kap1 jan4 zyu2 ji3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他搞这么多花样，都是想吸引人注意而已。
examples.english_sentence: He's doing so many things (tricks/varieties) just to attract attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅菜式好多名堂，味道又唔錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 coi3 sik1 hou2 do1 ming4 tong4, mei6 dou6 jau6 m4 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的菜式有很多花样，味道也不错。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant has many varieties of dishes, and the taste is not bad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁做一定有啲名堂嘅，唔係唔會咁樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 zou6 jat1 ding6 jau5 di1 ming4 tong4 ge3, m4 hai6 m4 wui5 gam2 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这样做肯定是有原因的，不然不会这样。
examples.english_sentence: There must be a reason why he's doing this; otherwise, he wouldn't be doing it like this.

english_meaning: Socialite, debutante, woman of high society
explanation_mandarin: 指在社会上享有较高声誉和地位的女性，通常出身于富裕家庭，受过良好教育，并且经常参与社交活动。
explanation_english: Refers to women of high social standing and reputation, typically from wealthy families, well-educated, and frequently involved in social events.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係城中嘅名媛，成日出席唔同嘅慈善活動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 sing4 zung1 ge3 ming4 jyun4, sing4 jat6 cheut1 sik1 m4 tung4 ge3 ci4 sin6 wut6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她是城中的名媛，经常出席不同的慈善活动。
examples.english_sentence: She is a socialite in the city and often attends various charity events.

english_meaning: name
explanation_mandarin: 人或事物的称谓。
explanation_english: The designation of a person or thing; a name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你叫咩名字啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 giu3 me1 ming4 zi2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你叫什么名字啊？
examples.english_sentence: What's your name?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個名字好特別。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 ming4 zi2 hou2 dak6 bit1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的名字很特别。
examples.english_sentence: His name is very special.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔記得佢個名字喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 gei3 dak1 keoi5 go3 ming4 zi2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 忘记了他的名字了。
examples.english_sentence: I forgot his name.

mandarin_meaning: 名存实亡 (míng cún shí wáng)
english_meaning: Nominal existence; existing in name only; a mere shell; defunct.
explanation_mandarin: 指空有虚名，实际上已经不存在或起不了作用。
explanation_english: Describes something that exists in name only, but has lost its power, function, or effectiveness; it is practically dead or useless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司雖然仲掛住個牌，但其實已經名存實亡啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 seui1 jin4 zung6 gwaa3 zyu6 go3 paai4, daan6 kei4 sat6 ji5 ging1 ming4 cyun4 sat6 mong4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家公司虽然还挂着牌子，但其实已经名存实亡了。
examples.english_sentence: Although the company still has its nameplate hanging, it's actually defunct.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個組織已經名存實亡，冇人再聽佢哋指揮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zo2 zik1 ji5 ging1 ming4 cyun4 sat6 mong4, mou5 jan4 zoi3 teng1 keoi5 dei6 zi2 fai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个组织已经名存实亡，没有人再听他们的指挥。
examples.english_sentence: This organization exists in name only; no one listens to their commands anymore.

synonyms: 徒有虛名 (tou4 jau5 heoi1 ming4)

english_meaning: Famous person; expert; master (of a field); well-known family
explanation_mandarin: 指在某一领域享有盛名，具有权威性的专家或学者；也可以指声名显赫的家族。
explanation_english: Refers to a renowned and authoritative expert or scholar in a particular field. Can also refer to a prominent or well-known family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係烹飪界嘅名家，好多人都好欣賞佢嘅手藝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 paang1 jam6 gaai3 ge3 ming4 gaa1, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 hou2 jan1 seong2 keoi5 ge3 sau2 ngai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是烹饪界的专家，很多人都很欣赏他的手艺。
examples.english_sentence: He is a master in the culinary world, and many people admire his skills.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 李家喺香港係名家望族，有好多社會地位高嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lei5 gaa1 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 hai6 ming4 gaa1 mong6 zuk6, jau5 hou2 do1 se5 wui2 dei6 wai2 gou1 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 李家在香港是名门望族，有很多社会地位高的人。
examples.english_sentence: The Li family is a prominent and influential family in Hong Kong, with many people of high social status.

english_meaning: Legend, former star player, prominent former figure
explanation_mandarin: 指曾经在某个领域做出过杰出贡献，现已退役或退休，但仍享有盛名的人士，通常用于体育界。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who has made outstanding contributions in a particular field and has now retired or retired, but still enjoys a great reputation. It is often used in the sports world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢位籃球名宿嘅球技真係好犀利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wai2 laam4 kau4 ming4 suk1 ge3 kau4 gei6 zan1 hai6 hou2 sai1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这位篮球名宿的球技真的很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: This legendary basketball player's skills are really amazing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多球迷都好尊重呢位足球名宿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 do1 kau4 mei5 dou1 hou2 zyun1 zung6 ni1 wai2 zuk1 kau4 ming4 suk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多球迷都很尊重这位足球名宿。
examples.english_sentence: Many fans respect this legendary football player.

english_meaning: The name matches the reality; to live up to one's name; to be worthy of the name.
explanation_mandarin: 名称与实际相符合，指实际情况与名声一致。
explanation_english: The name and the reality are in accordance, referring to the actual situation matching the reputation. It means someone or something is as good as its reputation suggests.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳啲嘢食真係名實相符，好好味㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 zan1 hai6 ming4 sat6 soeng1 fu4, hou2 hou2 mei6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物真是名副其实，非常好吃！
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant really lives up to its name, it's so delicious!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅演技真係名實相符，攞獎攞到手軟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jin2 gei6 zan1 hai6 ming4 sat6 soeng1 fu4, lo2 zoeng2 lo2 dou3 sau2 jyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的演技真是名副其实，拿奖拿到手软。
examples.english_sentence: His acting really lives up to its name, he wins awards constantly.

english_meaning: Famous general, renowned commander
explanation_mandarin: 指著名的将领，以军事才能著称的将领。
explanation_english: Refers to a famous and highly skilled military general or commander, known for their strategic abilities and leadership.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一位好出名嘅名將，打過好多勝仗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 wai2 hou2 ceot1 ming4 ge3 ming4 zeung3, daa2 gwo3 hou2 do1 sing3 zoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一位很有名的名将，打过很多胜仗。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very famous general who has won many battles.

english_meaning: famous teacher; renowned instructor
explanation_mandarin: 指有名气的，教学水平很高的老师。
explanation_english: Refers to a famous and highly skilled teacher.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係補習界嘅名師，好多學生爭住報佢嘅班。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 bou2 sik1 gaai3 ge3 ming4 si1, hou2 do1 hok6 sang1 zaang1 zyu6 bou3 keoi5 ge3 baan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是补习界的名师，很多学生争着报名他的班。
examples.english_sentence: He is a famous tutor in the tutoring industry, and many students are vying to enroll in his classes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 想學好廣東話，最好搵個名師指導下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng2 hok6 hou2 gwong2 dung1 waa2, zeoi3 hou2 wan2 go3 ming4 si1 zi2 dou6 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 想要学好广东话，最好找个名师指导一下。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to learn Cantonese well, it's best to find a renowned teacher to guide you.

synonyms: 著名導師 (zyu3 ming4 dou6 si1)
資深導師 (zi1 san1 dou6 si1)

english_meaning: Famous shop, brand-name store, luxury store
explanation_mandarin: 指售卖知名品牌或高档商品的商店。
explanation_english: Refers to a shop or store that sells well-known brands or luxury goods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日去名店買嘢，真係好捨得洗錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 heoi3 ming4 dim3 maai5 je5, zan1 hai6 hou2 se2 dak1 sai2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是去名牌店买东西，真舍得花钱。
examples.english_sentence: She always goes to luxury stores to buy things, she's really willing to spend money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間名店嘅手袋好出名，好多人都排隊買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 ming4 dim3 ge3 sau2 doi2 hou2 ceot1 ming4, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 paai4 deoi2 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家名牌店的手提包很有名，很多人都排队买。
examples.english_sentence: This brand-name store's handbags are very famous, many people queue up to buy them.

english_meaning: Famous brand (manufacturer); reputable company; established brand
explanation_mandarin: 指知名度高、声誉好的公司或品牌。
explanation_english: Refers to a well-known and reputable company or brand, especially a manufacturer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部車係名廠出㗎，品質有保證。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 che1 hai6 ming4 chong2 cheut1 gaa3, ban2 chat1 yau5 bou2 zheng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车是名牌厂家生产的，质量有保证。
examples.english_sentence: This car is made by a famous brand, so the quality is guaranteed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢淨係著名廠衫，好講究。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zing6 hai6 jeuk3 ming4 chong2 saam1, hou2 gong2 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只穿名牌衣服，很讲究。
examples.english_sentence: He only wears clothes from famous brands, he's very particular.

english_meaning: to achieve fame and fortune; to be successful in one's career
explanation_mandarin: 指事业成功，名声和利益都得到。
explanation_english: Describes the state of achieving both fame and financial success in one's career or life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢讀書好叻，第日一定名成利就。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 duk6 syu1 hou2 lek1, dai6 jat6 ding6 hai6 ming4 sing4 lei6 zau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他读书很聪明，将来一定功成名就。
examples.english_sentence: He is very smart in his studies, he will definitely achieve fame and fortune in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要名成利就唔係咁容易嘅，要付出好多努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yiu3 ming4 sing4 lei6 zau6 m4 hai6 gam3 yung4 yi6 ge3, yiu3 fu6 ceot1 hou2 do1 nu5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要功成名就不是那么容易的，要付出很多努力。
examples.english_sentence: It's not that easy to achieve fame and fortune, you have to put in a lot of effort.

english_meaning: reputation, prestige, renown
explanation_mandarin: 声誉，名气，因好行为或品质而赢得的尊重。
explanation_english: Reputation, prestige, renown; the respect or admiration that someone or something receives because of good qualities or actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺醫學界好有名望㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 yi1 hok6 gaai3 hou2 jau5 ming4 mong6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在医学界很有名望的。
examples.english_sentence: He has a very good reputation in the medical field.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間大學歷史悠久，名望都好高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 dai6 hok6 lik6 si2 jau4 gau2, ming4 mong6 dou1 hou2 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这所大学历史悠久，名望也很高。
examples.english_sentence: This university has a long history and a very high reputation.

english_meaning: Prestigious school, top school, renowned school
explanation_mandarin: 指在学术声誉、师资力量、硬件设施等方面都非常优秀的学校，通常入学竞争激烈。
explanation_english: Refers to a school that is highly regarded for its academic reputation, faculty, facilities, and other qualities, and usually has a high level of competition for admission.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好叻㗎，入咗間名校讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 lek1 gaa3, jap6 zo2 gaan1 ming4 haau6 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很厉害，进了一所名校读书。
examples.english_sentence: He's very smart, he got into a prestigious school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗入名校，啲家長都好落力幫仔女報興趣班。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 jap6 ming4 haau6, di1 gaa1 zoeng2 dou1 hou2 lok6 lik6 bong1 zai2 neoi5 bou3 hing3 ceoi3 baan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了进名校，家长们都很努力地帮子女们报名兴趣班。
examples.english_sentence: In order to get into a prestigious school, parents put a lot of effort into enrolling their children in extracurricular classes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間名校嘅畢業生好多都好有成就。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 ming4 haau6 ge3 bat1 jip6 sang1 hou2 do1 dou1 hou2 jau5 sing4 zau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这所名校的毕业生很多都很有成就。
examples.english_sentence: Many graduates from this prestigious school are very successful.

english_meaning: supermodel, famous model
explanation_mandarin: 指非常出名的模特兒。
explanation_english: Refers to a very famous model.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係香港最出名嘅名模之一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 hoeng1 gong2 zeoi3 ceot1 ming4 ge3 ming4 mou4-1 zi1 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她是香港最出名的名模之一。
examples.english_sentence: She is one of the most famous supermodels in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢夢想成為一個國際名模。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mung6 soeng2 sing4 wai4 jat1 go3 gwok3 zai3 ming4 mou4-1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她梦想成为一个国际名模。
examples.english_sentence: She dreams of becoming an international supermodel.

english_meaning: ranking, place (in a competition)
explanation_mandarin: 指在比赛、考试等活动中所获得的排名或位置。
explanation_english: Refers to the rank or position obtained in activities such as competitions or exams.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次考試攞到第一名次呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 lo2 dou3 dai6 jat1 ming4 ci3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次考试考了第一名啊！
examples.english_sentence: He got first place in the exam this time!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你喺比賽入面攞到咩名次呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai2 bei2 coi3 jap6 min6 lo2 dou3 me1 ming4 ci3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在比赛中得到了什么名次啊？
examples.english_sentence: What place did you get in the competition?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅名次跌咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ming4 ci3 dit3 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的名次下降了很多。
examples.english_sentence: His ranking has dropped a lot.

english_meaning: legitimate and justified; perfectly logical and reasonable; with proper authority
explanation_mandarin: 指名义正当，道理也顺畅。形容做事情理由充分，合情合理。
explanation_english: Describes something that is perfectly legitimate and justifiable, with a proper and logical reason. It suggests that an action is done with the appropriate authority and that there is no doubt about its correctness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞到獎學金，升大學咪名正言順囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 dou2 zoeng2 hok6 gam1, sing1 daai6 hok6 mai1 ming4 zing3 yan4 seon6 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿到奖学金，升大学就名正言顺了。
examples.english_sentence: Now that he's got the scholarship, it's perfectly legitimate for him to go to university.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你俾咗錢，咪名正言順用呢啲設施囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bei2 zo2 cin2, mai1 ming4 zing3 yan4 seon6 yung6 ni1 di1 si1 si3 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你付了钱，就可以名正言顺地使用这些设施了。
examples.english_sentence: Since you paid the money, you are legitimately entitled to use these facilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有晒證據，佢就名正言順咁贏咗呢場官司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 saai3 zing3 geoi3, keoi5 zau6 ming4 zing3 yan4 seon6 gam2 wing4 zo2 ni1 coeng4 gun1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有了所有证据，他就名正言顺地赢了这场官司。
examples.english_sentence: With all the evidence, he legitimately won the lawsuit.

english_meaning: reputation, fame, renown
explanation_mandarin: 指在社会上获得的声誉和知名度。
explanation_english: Refers to the reputation and recognition gained in society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺娛樂圈好有名氣㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jyu4 lok6 hyun1 hou2 jau5 ming4 hei3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在娱乐圈里很有名气。
examples.english_sentence: He has a great reputation in the entertainment industry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅名氣都幾大，好多人都嚟幫襯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 ming4 hei3 dou1 gei2 daai6, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 lai4 bong1 can3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的名气挺大的，很多人都来光顾。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant has quite a big reputation, many people come to patronize it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅學術名氣好高，好多人都尊重佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hok6 seot6 ming4 hei3 hou2 gou1, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 zyun1 zung6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的学术名气很高，很多人都尊重他。
examples.english_sentence: His academic reputation is very high, many people respect him.

english_meaning: celebrity; personage; VIP; influential person
explanation_mandarin: 指社会上有声望和地位的人。
explanation_english: Refers to people who are well-known and influential in society; celebrities or important figures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個都係上流社會嘅名流。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 dou1 hai6 soeng6 lau4 se5 wui2 ge3 ming4 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个都是上流社会的知名人士。
examples.english_sentence: They are both celebrities in high society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚個慈善晚宴好多名流都會出席。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 go3 ci4 sin6 maan5 jin3 hou2 do1 ming4 lau4 dou1 wui5 ceot1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚的慈善晚宴会有很多名流出席。
examples.english_sentence: Many celebrities will attend tonight's charity gala.

english_meaning: named; called; to be known as
explanation_mandarin: 表示被命名或被称为某种名称。
explanation_english: Indicates being named or referred to by a certain name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間鋪頭名為「好運茶餐廳」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 pou3 tau2 ming4 wai4 「hou2 wan6 caa4 caan1 teng1」.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店铺名为“好运茶餐厅”。
examples.english_sentence: This shop is named 'Good Luck Cafe'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃名為「明日之星」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 ming4 wai4 「ming4 jat6 zi1 sing1」.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划名为“明日之星”。
examples.english_sentence: This project is named 'Rising Star'.

english_meaning: named, called, known as
explanation_mandarin: 称作，叫做，以...为名
explanation_english: To be named, to be called, to be known as. Expresses the name or title given to something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳名爲「香港仔」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ming4 wai4 "Hoeng1 Gong2 Zai2".
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅名为“香港仔”。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant is named "Hong Kong Boy".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋搞咗個慈善活動，名爲「關愛長者」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaau2 zo2 go3 ci4 sin6 wut6 dung6, ming4 wai4 "Gwaan1 Oi3 Cheung2 Ze2".
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们搞了一个慈善活动，名为“关爱长者”。
examples.english_sentence: They organized a charity event, named "Care for the Elderly".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃名爲「綠色香港」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 ming4 wai4 "Luk6 Sik1 Hoeng1 Gong2".
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划名为“绿色香港”。
examples.english_sentence: This project is called "Green Hong Kong".

english_meaning: business card
explanation_mandarin: 用于商业或社交场合，上面印有个人姓名、职务、联系方式等信息的卡片。
explanation_english: A small card bearing a person's name, occupation, contact information, etc., typically presented during business or social interactions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該畀張名片我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 bei2 zoeng1 ming4 pin3 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请给我一张名片。
examples.english_sentence: Please give me a business card.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張係我嘅名片，有咩事可以聯絡我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 hai6 ngo5 ge3 ming4 pin3, jau5 me1 si6 ho2 ji5 lyun4 lok3 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这是我的名片，有事可以联系我。
examples.english_sentence: This is my business card, you can contact me if you need anything.

english_meaning: brand name, designer label, luxury brand
explanation_mandarin: 指知名品牌的商品，通常价格较高，质量较好，代表一种身份或品味。
explanation_english: Refers to products from well-known brands, usually expensive and of high quality, often representing status or taste.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意買名牌嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 maai5 ming4 paai4 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她很喜欢买名牌的东西。
examples.english_sentence: She really likes buying brand-name stuff.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個手袋係名牌嚟㗎，好貴㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sau2 doi2 hai6 ming4 paai4 lei4 gaa3, hou2 gwai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个手提包是名牌的，很贵的。
examples.english_sentence: This handbag is a designer brand, it's very expensive.

english_meaning: To have one's name recorded in history (for good); to achieve lasting fame; to be remembered forever
explanation_mandarin: 指好名声载入史册，永久流传。形容功业伟大，永远为人所纪念。
explanation_english: Refers to having one's good name recorded in history and passed down forever. Describes great achievements and being remembered forever.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗香港嘅民主自由奮鬥一生，一定會名留青史㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 Hoeng1 Gong2 ge3 man4 zyu2 zi6 jau4 fan5 dau3 jat1 sang1, jat1 ding6 wui5 ming4 lau4 cing1 si2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为了香港的民主自由奋斗一生，一定会名垂青史的。
examples.english_sentence: He fought for Hong Kong's democracy and freedom his whole life and will definitely be remembered in history.

english_meaning: item; heading; category; nominal purpose
explanation_mandarin: 指名称或名义；也指列出的项目或类别。
explanation_english: Refers to a name or title; also refers to listed items or categories.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋用唔同嘅名目嚟收錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 yung6 m4 tung4 ge3 ming4 muk6 lai4 sau1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们用不同的名义来收费。
examples.english_sentence: They charge fees under different categories.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司有好多古怪嘅名目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 jau5 hou2 do1 gu2 gwaai3 ge3 ming4 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司有很多奇怪的项目。
examples.english_sentence: This company has a lot of strange items.

english_meaning: Purebred, Pedigree
explanation_mandarin: 指具有优秀血统或品种的动植物。
explanation_english: Refers to an animal or plant of pure or superior breed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻貓係名種嚟㗎，好貴㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 maau1 hai6 ming4 zung2 lei4 gaa3, hou2 gwai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这只猫是名种的，很贵的。
examples.english_sentence: This cat is a purebred, it's very expensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢屋企養咗好多名種狗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 uk1 kei2 joeng5 zo2 hou2 do1 ming4 zung2 gau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他家里养了很多名种狗。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps a lot of pedigree dogs at home.

english_meaning: name; designation; title
explanation_mandarin: 指事物所使用的名字。
explanation_english: Refers to the name used for a thing or object; designation or title.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅名稱好易記。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 ming4 cing1 hou2 ji6 gei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的名称很容易记。
examples.english_sentence: This company's name is easy to remember.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請你喺表格上面填寫你嘅名稱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 nei5 hai2 biu2 gaak3 soeng6 min6 tin4 se2 nei5 ge3 ming4 cing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请你在表格上面填写你的名字。
examples.english_sentence: Please fill in your name on the form.

english_meaning: to live up to one's name; worthy of the name; true to its reputation
explanation_mandarin: 名称或名声与实际情况相符合。
explanation_english: The name or reputation is in accordance with the actual situation.  The reality matches the reputation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅廚藝真係名符其實，煮乜嘢都咁好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 chu4 ngai6 zan1 hai6 ming4 fu4 kei4 sat6, zyu2 mat1 je5 dou1 gam3 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的厨艺真是名副其实，做什么都那么好吃。
examples.english_sentence: His cooking skills are truly worthy of the name; everything he cooks is so delicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間酒店嘅服務名符其實，住得好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 zau2 dim3 ge3 fuk6 mou6 ming4 fu4 kei4 sat6, zyu6 dak1 hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家酒店的服务名副其实，住得很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: The service at this hotel truly lives up to its reputation; it's very comfortable to stay in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅「鋼琴王子」嘅名號，真係名符其實。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 "gong3 kam4 wong4 zi2" ge3 ming4 hou6, zan1 hai6 ming4 fu4 kei4 sat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他“钢琴王子”的称号，真是名副其实。
examples.english_sentence: His title of 'Piano Prince' is truly worthy of the name.

english_meaning: reputation; moral integrity; honor
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人的名誉和节操。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's reputation and moral integrity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好睇重自己嘅名節，唔會做啲唔見得光嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 tai2 zung6 zi6 gei2 ge3 ming4 zit3, m4 wui5 zou6 di1 m4 gin3 dak1 gwong1 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很看重自己的名节，不会做一些见不得光的事情。
examples.english_sentence: He values his reputation and moral integrity and wouldn't do anything shameful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗保住名節，寧願辭職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 bou2 zyu6 ming4 zit3, ning4 jyun2 ci4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了保住名节，他宁愿辞职。
examples.english_sentence: To protect his reputation, he would rather resign.

english_meaning: name; in name; nominally; pretext
explanation_mandarin: 表面上的名称、理由或身份。
explanation_english: The stated or supposed reason or purpose; nominal capacity or title.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以公司嘅名義捐錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 gung1 si1 ge3 ming4 ji6 gyun1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以公司的名义捐钱。
examples.english_sentence: He donated money in the name of the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋以環保嘅名義嚟破壞生態。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ji5 waan4 bou2 ge3 ming4 ji6 lai4 po3 waai6 sang1 taai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们以环保的名义来破坏生态。
examples.english_sentence: They are destroying the ecology under the pretext of environmental protection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我只係掛個名義，實際唔負責任何嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi2 hai6 gwaa3 go3 ming4 ji6, sat6 zai3 m4 fu6 zaak3 jam6 ho4 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是挂个名义，实际不负责任何事。
examples.english_sentence: I'm just a figurehead; I'm not actually responsible for anything.

english_meaning: Famous veteran TCM practitioner
explanation_mandarin: 指医术精湛，经验丰富，享有盛誉的老年中医医生。
explanation_english: Refers to an elderly Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) practitioner who is highly skilled, experienced, and enjoys a great reputation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 婆婆睇咗好多個西醫都唔好，最後睇個名老中醫，食咗幾劑藥就好返晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: po4 po4 tai2 zo2 hou2 do1 go3 sai1 ji1 dou1 m4 hou2, zeoi3 hau6 tai2 go3 ming4 lou5 zung1 ji1, sik6 zo2 gei2 zai1 joek6 zau6 hou2 faan1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶看了很多西医都没好，最后看了个名老中医，吃了几个疗程的药就好了。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma didn't get better after seeing many Western doctors. In the end, she saw a famous veteran TCM practitioner, and she recovered completely after taking a few doses of medicine.

english_meaning: world-renowned; famous far and wide; widely known
explanation_mandarin: 形容名声很大，远近都知道。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something that is famous and well-known in distant places; having a widespread reputation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間餐廳嘅點心名聞遐邇，好多人都慕名而嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 dim2 sam1 ming4 man4 haa4 nei5, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 mou6 ming4 ji4 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的餐厅的点心闻名遐迩，很多人都慕名而来。
examples.english_sentence: The dim sum at his restaurant is world-renowned, and many people come especially for it.

english_meaning: reputation, fame, name, standing
explanation_mandarin: 指在社会上的名誉和声望。
explanation_english: Refers to one's reputation and standing in society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅名聲好好，好多人都信得過佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ming4 sing1 hou2 hou2, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 seon3 dak1 gwo3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的名声很好，很多人都信任他。
examples.english_sentence: His reputation is very good; many people trust him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗啲衰嘢，搞到名聲臭晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 di1 seoi1 je5, gaau2 dou3 ming4 sing1 cau3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了一些坏事，搞得名声都臭了。
examples.english_sentence: He did some bad things, ruining his reputation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司嘅名聲越嚟越差，好難再吸引到新客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 ming4 sing1 yut6 lai4 yut6 caa1, hou2 naan4 zoi3 kap1 yan5 dou2 san1 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的名声越来越差，很难再吸引到新客户。
examples.english_sentence: The company's reputation is getting worse and worse; it's hard to attract new customers.

english_meaning: A beautiful flower already has an owner (already taken, in a relationship)
explanation_mandarin: 比喻美好的女子已经有了归属，或指美好的事物已被占有。
explanation_english: A metaphor for a beautiful woman who is already in a relationship or engaged. It can also be used to describe something desirable that is already owned by someone else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使諗啦，佢咁靚女，一定名花有主㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 nam2 laa1, keoi5 gam3 leng3 neoi2, jat1 ding6 ming4 faa1 jau5 zyu2 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用想了，她这么漂亮，一定已经有男朋友了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't even bother, she's so pretty, she must already have a boyfriend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 哎吔，睇嚟呢架車都名花有主喇，貼咗售出標籤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ai1 jaa1, tai2 lai4 ne1 gaa3 ce1 dou1 ming4 faa1 jau5 zyu2 laa3, tip3 zo2 sau6 ceot1 biu1籤.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哎呀，看来这辆车已经卖出去了，贴了售出标签。
examples.english_sentence: Oh dear, it seems this car is already sold, it has a 'sold' tag on it.

english_meaning: to fail in an examination; to be unsuccessful in a competition
explanation_mandarin: 比喻没有考中或选拔没有被录取。孙山是宋朝的一个有名的才子，他参加科举考试，榜发后，孙山的名字在榜单的最后一名。他回家后，乡邻问他儿子是否考取，孙山说：“榜上最后一名是孙山，我的儿子落在孙山之后。”
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to fail an exam or not be selected in a competition. The origin of the idiom comes from a story about Sun Shan, a talented scholar in the Song Dynasty, who came last in the imperial examination. When his neighbor asked if his son passed, Sun Shan replied, "The last name on the list is Sun Shan, and my son is after Sun Shan," meaning his son failed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試又名落孫山，都唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 jau6 ming4 lok6 syun1 saan1, dou1 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试又没考上，真不知道怎么办才好。
examples.english_sentence: He failed the exam again, I don't know what to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次比賽咁多人參加，我驚自己會名落孫山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 bei2 coi3 gam3 do1 jan4 caam1 gaa1, ngo5 ging1 zi6 gei2 wui5 ming4 lok6 syun1 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次比赛这么多人参加，我怕自己会落选。
examples.english_sentence: There are so many participants in this competition, I'm afraid I'll fail.

english_meaning: famous work; classic
explanation_mandarin: 著名的作品，通常指文学、艺术或学术方面的经典之作。
explanation_english: A famous work, usually referring to a classic piece of literature, art, or academic work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意睇啲世界名著㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 tai2 di1 sai3 gaai3 ming4 zoek3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很喜欢看世界名著。
examples.english_sentence: He really likes reading world classics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 紅樓夢係中國文學嘅名著。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hung4 lau4 mung6 hai6 zung1 gwok3 man4 hok6 ge3 ming4 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 红楼梦是中国文学的名著。
examples.english_sentence: Dream of the Red Chamber is a classic of Chinese literature.

english_meaning: famous saying; adage; maxim; quote
explanation_mandarin: 著名的言论；富有哲理的话。
explanation_english: A famous saying or quote, often containing wisdom or profound meaning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日引用啲名人嘅名言嚟鼓勵自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 yin5 yung6 di1 ming4 jan4 ge3 ming4 jin4 lai4 gu2 lai6 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是引用名人的名言来鼓励自己。
examples.english_sentence: He always quotes famous sayings of celebrities to encourage himself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢句名言真係講得好好，好有道理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 geoi3 ming4 jin4 zan1 hai6 gong2 dak1 hou2 hou2, hou2 jau5 dou6 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这句名言说得真好，很有道理。
examples.english_sentence: This famous saying is really well said, it's very reasonable.

english_meaning: noun
explanation_mandarin: 表示人、事物、地点或抽象概念的词语。
explanation_english: A word (other than a pronoun) used to identify any of a class of people, places, or things (common noun), or to name a particular one of these (proper noun).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「快樂」係一個抽象名詞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: “faai3 lok6” hai6 jat1 go3 chou1 jeung6 ming4 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: “快乐”是一个抽象名词。
examples.english_sentence: "Happiness" is an abstract noun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢課書教緊唔同種類嘅名詞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fo3 syu1 gaau3 gan2 m4 tung4 zung2 leoi6 ge3 ming4 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这节课教的是不同种类的名词。
examples.english_sentence: This lesson teaches different types of nouns.

english_meaning: reputation; fame; honour
explanation_mandarin: 指在社会上获得的好的评价和声望。
explanation_english: Good reputation or fame that someone or something has earned; honour.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好重視自己嘅名譽，所以做嘢好小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung6 si6 zi6 gei2 ge3 ming4 jyu6, so2 ji5 zou6 je5 hou2 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很重视自己的名誉，所以做事很小心。
examples.english_sentence: He values his reputation very much, so he is very careful in his work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅行為損害咗公司嘅名譽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hang4 wai4 syun2 hoi6 zo2 gung1 si1 ge3 ming4 jyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的行为损害了公司的名誉。
examples.english_sentence: His behaviour damaged the company's reputation.

english_meaning: to lose all reputation; to be completely discredited; to be utterly disgraced
explanation_mandarin: 形容名声、信誉完全丧失，降到极低点。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where one's reputation and credibility are completely lost, reaching a very low point.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為貪污俾人拉咗，而家名譽掃地啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 taam1 wu1 bei2 jan4 laai1 zo2, ji4 gaa1 ming4 jyu6 sou3 dei6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为贪污被人抓了，现在名誉扫地了。
examples.english_sentence: He was arrested for corruption, and now his reputation is completely ruined.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司賣假貨，搞到名譽掃地，執埋都似。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 maai6 gaa2 fo3, gaau2 dou3 ming4 jyu6 sou3 dei6, zaap1 maai4 dou1 ci5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那间公司卖假货，导致名誉扫地，恐怕要倒闭了。
examples.english_sentence: That company sold counterfeit goods, causing them to lose all credibility, they will probably shut down.

english_meaning: valuable, precious, expensive, exquisite
explanation_mandarin: 形容物品因品质优良或稀有而价格很高。
explanation_english: Describing an object that is expensive due to its high quality or rarity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻手錶好名貴㗎，唔好整爛佢呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 sau2 biu1 hou2 ming4 gwai3 gaa3, m4 hou2 zing2 laan6 keoi5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这只手表很名贵，不要弄坏它。
examples.english_sentence: This watch is very valuable, don't break it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢戴住條好名貴嘅鑽石頸鏈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daai3 zyu6 tiu4 hou2 ming4 gwai3 ge3 zyun3 sek6 geng2 lin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她戴着一条很名贵的钻石项链。
examples.english_sentence: She's wearing a very expensive diamond necklace.

english_meaning: More in name than in reality; overrated; living on reputation
explanation_mandarin: 指名声超过实际情况，实际不如名声大。
explanation_english: Describes something whose reputation or name is greater than its actual substance or quality; overrated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳啲嘢食名過其實，唔好去試啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 ming4 gwo3 kei4 sat6, m4 hou2 heoi3 si3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西名不副实，别去试了。
examples.english_sentence: The food at that restaurant is overrated, don't bother trying it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅演技名過其實，攞獎都唔係實至名歸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 yin2 gei6 ming4 gwo3 kei4 sat6, lo2 zoeng2 dou1 m4 hai6 sat6 zi3 ming4 gwai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的演技名不副实，得奖也不是实至名归。
examples.english_sentence: His acting is overrated, the award he got wasn't really deserved.

english_meaning: Title, designation, rank, appellation
explanation_mandarin: 指个人在社会或组织中拥有的正式称谓或职务。
explanation_english: Refers to a formal title or designation that a person holds in society or an organization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢升咗職，個名銜都唔同晒啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing1 zo2 zik1, go3 ming4 haam4 dou1 m4 tung4 saai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他升职了，头衔都不一样了。
examples.english_sentence: He got promoted, his title is completely different now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞咗好多名銜，好叻㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 zo2 hou2 do1 ming4 haam4, hou2 lek1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他获得了很多头衔，很厉害的。
examples.english_sentence: He has acquired many titles, he is very capable.

english_meaning: directory, list, register
explanation_mandarin: 按一定规则编排的人名或事物名称的记录。
explanation_english: A record of names or things arranged according to certain rules.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋間公司嘅客戶名錄好長㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 haak3 wu6 ming4 luk6 hou2 coeng4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司的客户名录很长。
examples.english_sentence: Our company's client directory is very long.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個名錄嘅資料過時喇，要更新一下先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ming4 luk6 ge3 zi1 liu2 gwo3 si4 laa3, jiu3 gang1 san1 jat1 haa5 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个名录的资料过时了，需要更新一下才行。
examples.english_sentence: The information in this directory is outdated and needs to be updated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請喺名錄上面搵下佢嘅電話號碼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 hai2 ming4 luk6 soeng6 min6 wan2 haa5 keoi5 ge3 din6 waa2 hou6 maa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请在名录上找一下他的电话号码。
examples.english_sentence: Please find his phone number in the directory.

english_meaning: noble family; prominent family; prestigious family
explanation_mandarin: 指有名望和地位的家族。
explanation_english: Refers to a family with fame and status.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢出自名門，細個就已經學好多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ceot1 zi6 ming4 mun4, sai3 go3 zau6 ji5 ging1 hok6 hou2 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他出身名门，从小就学了很多东西。
examples.english_sentence: He comes from a prominent family and has learned a lot since childhood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋個家族喺香港係名門望族。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 go3 ga1 zuk6 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 hai6 ming4 mun4 mong6 zuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的家族在香港是名门望族。
examples.english_sentence: Their family is a prominent and respected family in Hong Kong.

english_meaning: prominent and respected family; noble family; family of high standing
explanation_mandarin: 指世代显贵、声名显赫的家族。
explanation_english: Refers to a family that is prominent, respected, and has a long history of high social standing and influence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係本地嘅名門望族，好多人都識佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 bun2 dei6 ge3 ming4 mun4 mong6 zuk6, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 sik1 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是本地的名门望族，很多人都认识他们。
examples.english_sentence: They are a prominent family in the local area; many people know them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嫁咗入名門望族，生活一定好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaa3 zo2 jap6 ming4 mun4 mong6 zuk6, sang1 wut6 jat1 ding6 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她嫁入了名门望族，生活肯定很好。
examples.english_sentence: She married into a prominent family, her life must be very good.

english_meaning: orthodox school; prestigious sect; a person of noble birth and correct principles
explanation_mandarin: 指正统的、有声望的门派或家族；也指行为端正、光明磊落的人。
explanation_english: Refers to an orthodox and prestigious school or family; also refers to a person of upright conduct and integrity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋屋企係名門正派，家教好嚴嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 uk1 kei5 hai6 ming4 mun4 zing3 paai3, gaa1 gaau3 hou2 jim4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们家是名门正派，家教很严的。
examples.english_sentence: Their family is a prestigious sect, and their family education is very strict.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一路以嚟都想加入武林嘅名門正派。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 lou6 ji5 lai4 dou1 soeng2 gaa1 jap6 mou5 lam4 ge3 ming4 mun4 zing3 paai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一直以来都想加入武林中的名门正派。
examples.english_sentence: He has always wanted to join a prestigious sect in the martial arts world.

english_meaning: quota; place; slot; allocation
explanation_mandarin: 限定的数量或席位，通常指分配给特定人群或机构的配额。
explanation_english: A limited number of positions, places, or slots, usually allocated to a specific group or institution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年大學嘅學位名額好似少咗好多喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 daai6 hok6 ge3 hok6 wai2 ming4 ngaak6 hou2 ci5 siu2 zo2 hou2 do1 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年大学的学位名额好像少了很多啊。
examples.english_sentence: It seems like the number of university places is much less this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司嘅培訓計劃得十個名額，好難爭㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 pui4 fan3 gai3 waak6 dak1 sap6 go3 ming4 ngaak6, hou2 naan4 zaang1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司的培训计划只有十个名额，很难竞争啊。
examples.english_sentence: Their company's training program only has ten places, it's hard to compete for them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次演唱會嘅飛得返少量名額，要搶就快啲啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 jin2 coeng3 wui2 ge3 fei1 dak1 faan1 siu2 loeng6 ming4 ngaak6, jiu3 coeng2 zau6 faai3 di1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次演唱会的票只剩下少量名额了，要抢就快点吧！
examples.english_sentence: There are only a few remaining tickets (places) for the concert this time, grab them quickly if you want them!

english_meaning: after; behind; queen (in chess)
explanation_mandarin: 在时间或位置上较晚或靠后的。在象棋中，指皇后。
explanation_english: Refers to something that is later in time or located behind. In chess, it refers to the queen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 之后我哋再去食饭啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi1 hau6 ngo5 dei6 zoi3 heoi3 sik6 faan6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 之后我们再去吃饭吧。
examples.english_sentence: Afterwards, let's go eat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 排隊嘅時候，唔好逼埋去前面，企后啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: paai4 deoi2 ge3 si4 hau6, m4 hou2 bik1 maai4 heoi3 cin4 min6, kei5 hau6 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 排队的时候，不要挤到前面，站后面一点吧。
examples.english_sentence: When queuing, don't squeeze to the front, stand a little behind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺国际象棋入面，后嘅威力最大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gwok3 zai3 seung3 kei2 jap6 min6, hau6 ge3 wai1 lik6 zeoi3 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在国际象棋里面，后的威力最大。
examples.english_sentence: In chess, the queen is the most powerful piece.

english_meaning: tiara; crown
explanation_mandarin: 皇后或王后所戴的冠冕。
explanation_english: A jeweled crown worn by a queen or empress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢戴住后冠，真係好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daai3 zyu6 hau6 gun3, zan1 hai6 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她戴着后冠，真的很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: She's wearing the tiara, she's really beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 選美冠軍會得到后冠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syun2 mei5 gwun3 gwan1 wui5 dak1 dou2 hau6 gun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 选美冠军会得到后冠。
examples.english_sentence: The beauty pageant champion will receive the tiara.

english_meaning: Goddess of the Earth
explanation_mandarin: 中国神话中的大地之神，主管土地。
explanation_english: The Goddess of the Earth in Chinese mythology, in charge of the land and soil.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺古代嘅中國，好多人都會拜后土祈求豐收。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gu2 doi6 ge3 zung1 gwok3, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 wui5 baai3 hau6 tou2 kei4 kau4 fung1 sau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在古代中国，很多人都会拜后土祈求丰收。
examples.english_sentence: In ancient China, many people would worship the Goddess of the Earth to pray for a good harvest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 后土娘娘係中國傳統文化重要嘅神祇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hau6 tou2 noeng4 noeng2 hai6 zung1 gwok3 tyun4 tung2 man4 faa3 zung6 jiu3 ge3 san4 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 后土娘娘是中国传统文化重要的神祇。
examples.english_sentence: The Goddess of the Earth is an important deity in traditional Chinese culture.

english_meaning: Deep Bay (Shenzhen Bay)
explanation_mandarin: 位于香港新界西北部和深圳之间的海湾，也称深圳湾。
explanation_english: A bay located between the northwestern New Territories of Hong Kong and Shenzhen, also known as Shenzhen Bay.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日諗住去后海灣睇雀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 lam2 zyu6 heoi3 hau6 hoi2 waan1 tai2 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天打算去后海湾看鸟。
examples.english_sentence: We are planning to go to Deep Bay tomorrow to watch birds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 后海灣嗰邊嘅生態環境保護得好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hau6 hoi2 waan1 go2 bin1 ge3 saang1 taai3 waan4 ging2 bou2 wu6 dak1 ho2 hou2.

explanation_mandarin: 中国古代神话人物，传说尧帝时期，天上出现十个太阳，危害人民，后羿射下九个太阳，并杀死各种妖魔，为民除害。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的吏治真的很差，贪污腐败的情况也挺严重的。
examples.english_sentence: The government administration nowadays is really bad, and the corruption is quite serious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要改善吏治，首先要加強監管。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 goi2 sin6 lei6 zi6, sau2 sin1 jiu3 gaa1 keung4 gaam1 gun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要改善吏治，首先要加强监管。
examples.english_sentence: To improve governance, the first thing is to strengthen supervision.

english_meaning: to vomit, to throw up; to spit (out)
explanation_mandarin: 指把胃里的东西通过嘴巴排出来。 也指吐出（如唾沫）。
explanation_english: To eject the contents of the stomach through the mouth; to vomit. Also, to spit (out).
