examples.jyutping_sentence: jo1, nei5 dou1 gam3 daai6 go3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哟，你都这么大了！
examples.english_sentence: Oh, you've grown so big!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 哟，原來你喺度啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: jo1, jyun4 lai4 nei5 hai2 dou6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哟，原来你在这里啊！

examples.cantonese_sentence: 哟，我諗住你唔嚟添。

examples.english_sentence: Oh, I thought you weren't coming.

english_meaning: member, person (in a role), employee
explanation_mandarin: 表示人员，通常指集体中的个体，或者担任某种职务的人。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 警员在这里维持秩序。
examples.english_sentence: Police officers are maintaining order here.

english_meaning: rank and file; junior police officers
explanation_mandarin: 香港警队对初级警务人员的称谓，通常指警员、警长等。
explanation_english: In the Hong Kong Police Force, refers to the junior ranks, typically including constables and sergeants.

examples.english_sentence: Many citizens strongly support the frontline rank and file police officers.

english_meaning: employee; staff; personnel
explanation_mandarin: 受雇于企业或组织的人员。
explanation_english: A person employed by a company or organization.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 jau5 hou2 do1 jyun4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司有很多员工。

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係呢間舖頭嘅員工。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司派了一些员工去海外受训。
examples.english_sentence: The company sent some employees to overseas training.

english_meaning: to be in a daze; to be stunned; absent-minded
explanation_mandarin: 形容人精神恍惚，发愣的状态。
explanation_english: Describes a state of mental blankness or absent-mindedness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都喺度哣哣吓，唔知諗緊乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai2 dou6 tau5 tau5 haa5, m4 zi1 naam2 gan2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是发呆，不知道在想什么。
examples.english_sentence: He's always in a daze, I don't know what he's thinking about.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺度哣，做嘢啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 tau5, zou6 je5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别发呆了，工作吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be in a daze, get to work!

english_meaning: elder brother; (polite address to a male slightly older than oneself)
explanation_mandarin: 称谓，指哥哥；也可用于称呼年龄稍大的男性，表示亲切和尊敬。
explanation_english: Term of address for one's elder brother; can also be used to address a male slightly older than oneself, expressing friendliness and respect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿哥好錫我㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 go1 hou2 sek3 ngo5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我哥哥很疼我的。
examples.english_sentence: My elder brother loves me very much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 哥，唔該幫我拎埋啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go1, m4 goi1 bong1 ngo5 ling1 maai4 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哥，麻烦帮我拿一下东西。
examples.english_sentence: Brother, please help me carry these things.

english_meaning: young man; brother (younger than the speaker, used informally)
explanation_mandarin: 称呼年轻的男性，也可用作兄弟之间的称呼（弟弟称哥哥）。
explanation_english: A term of address for a young man. Can also be used as a term of address between brothers (younger brother addressing older brother). Generally used informally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，哥仔，借問聲，地鐵站喺邊啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, go1 zai2, ze3 man6 seng1, dei6 tit3 zaam6 hai2 bin1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，小伙子，请问一下，地铁站在哪里？
examples.english_sentence: Hey, young man, excuse me, where is the subway station?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿哥，你個仔幾大個啦？
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 go1, nei5 go3 zai2 gei2 daai6 go3 laa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哥哥，你的儿子多大了？
examples.english_sentence: Brother, how old is your son?

english_meaning: Colombia (country)
explanation_mandarin: 南美洲国家哥伦比亚的音译。
explanation_english: Transliteration of the South American country Colombia.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下年諗住去哥倫比亞旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 nin4 lam2 zyu6 heoi3 go1 leon4 bei2 aa3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明年打算去哥伦比亚旅行。
examples.english_sentence: We are planning to travel to Colombia next year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 哥倫比亞嘅咖啡好出名㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go1 leon4 bei2 aa3 ge3 gaa3 fe1 hou2 ceot1 ming4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哥伦比亚的咖啡很有名。
examples.english_sentence: Colombian coffee is very famous.

english_meaning: elder brother
explanation_mandarin: 指比自己年长的男性同胞。
explanation_english: Refers to a male sibling who is older than oneself; elder brother.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個哥哥好叻仔㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 go1 hou2 lek1 zai2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我哥哥很能干的。
examples.english_sentence: My elder brother is very capable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日跟住佢哥哥後面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gan1 zoek6 keoi5 go1 go1 hau6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是跟在他哥哥后面。
examples.english_sentence: He always follows behind his elder brother.

english_meaning: Young man; (affectionate term for) young man; young brother
explanation_mandarin: 指年轻男子，常带有一种亲切、友好的语气。也可单纯指哥哥的小名或昵称。
explanation_english: Refers to a young man, often used in a friendly and affectionate tone. Can also be a diminutive or affectionate term for one's older brother.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個哥哥仔好鬼靚仔呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 go1 go1 zai2 hou2 gwai2 leng3 zai2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个小伙子真帅啊！
examples.english_sentence: That young man is so handsome!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 哥哥仔，幫我攞個箱得唔得呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: go1 go1 zai2, bong1 ngo5 lo2 go3 soeng1 dak1 m4 dak1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小伙子，帮我拿个箱子行不行啊？
examples.english_sentence: Young man, could you help me get that box?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣成日叫我阿哥做哥哥仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 giu3 ngo5 aa3 go1 zou6 go1 go1 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候经常叫我哥哥做哥哥仔。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, I often called my older brother 'Go Go Zai'.

english_meaning: Glue
explanation_mandarin: 一种用于粘合物体的物质，通常呈液态或半液态。
explanation_english: An adhesive substance used for sticking objects or materials together, usually in liquid or semi-liquid form.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我整親啲嘢，要用哥啦黐返埋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zing2 can1 di1 je5, jiu3 yung6 go1 laa1 chi1 faan1 maai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我弄坏了一些东西，要用胶水粘起来。
examples.english_sentence: I broke something and need to use glue to stick it back together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲報告全部都係哥啦作文，抄人哋嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 bou3 gou3 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 go1 laa1 zok3 man2, caau1 yan4 dei6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的报告全部都是用胶水粘起来的作文，抄别人的。
examples.english_sentence: His reports are all plagiarized, just glued together from other people's work.

english_meaning: Corgi
explanation_mandarin: 一种腿短、身长的犬种，原产于威尔士。
explanation_english: A breed of dog characterized by its short legs and long body, originating from Wales.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意哥基，佢哋好得意㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 go1 gei1, keoi5 dei6 hou2 dak1 ji3 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我非常喜欢柯基，它们很可爱！
examples.english_sentence: I really like Corgis, they are so cute!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屋企養咗兩隻哥基。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 uk1 kei2 joeng5 zo2 loeng5 zek3 go1 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我家里养了两只柯基。
examples.english_sentence: I have two Corgis at home.

english_meaning: expensive, high-end, fancy
explanation_mandarin: 形容某事物价格高昂、质量上乘，通常带有炫耀或讽刺意味。
explanation_english: Describes something as expensive and high-quality, often with a sense of showing off or irony. It implies that the item is luxurious or exclusive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日着啲哥士的衫，好似好巴閉噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zoek3 di1 go1 si6 dik1 saam1, hou2 ci5 hou2 baa1 bai1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是穿那些昂贵的衣服，好像很了不起似的。
examples.english_sentence: He always wears those expensive clothes, as if he's very important.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢好哥士的，唔係人人食得起。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 hou2 go1 si6 dik1, m4 hai6 jan4 jan4 sik6 dak1 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西很贵，不是每个人都吃得起。
examples.english_sentence: The food in this restaurant is very expensive; not everyone can afford it.

english_meaning: Costa Rica
explanation_mandarin: 中美洲国家哥斯达黎加的粤语音译。
explanation_english: Cantonese transliteration of Costa Rica, a country in Central America.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽講哥斯達黎加啲咖啡好出名㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 teng1 gong2 go1 si1 daat6 lai4 ga1 di1 gaa3 fe1 hou2 ceot1 ming4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我听说哥斯达黎加的咖啡很有名。
examples.english_sentence: I heard that Costa Rican coffee is very famous.

english_meaning: golf
explanation_mandarin: 一项体育运动，指在高尔夫球场上，用各种球杆将高尔夫球打入球洞的运动。
explanation_english: A sport in which players use various clubs to hit balls into a series of holes on a course.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋星期六一齊去打哥爾夫好唔好啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sing1 kei4 luk6 jat1 cai4 heoi3 daa2 go1 ji5 fu1 hou2 m4 hou2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们星期六一起去打高尔夫好不好？
examples.english_sentence: How about we go play golf together on Saturday?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哥爾夫打得好好㗎，成日攞獎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go1 ji5 fu1 daa2 dak1 hou2 hou2 gaa3, seng4 jat6 lo2 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他高尔夫打得很好，经常得奖。
examples.english_sentence: He plays golf very well, he wins prizes often.

english_meaning: Golf
explanation_mandarin: 一种运动，参加者用不同的球杆将球打入球场上一系列的洞中。
explanation_english: A sport in which players use different clubs to hit a ball into a series of holes on a course.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意打哥爾夫球，每個禮拜都去打。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 daa2 go1 ji5 fu1 kau4, mui5 go3 lai5 baai1 dou1 heoi3 daa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很喜欢打高尔夫球，每个星期都去打。
examples.english_sentence: He likes playing golf very much, he goes every week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打哥爾夫球要好多耐性㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 go1 ji5 fu1 kau4 jiu3 hou2 do1 noi6 sing3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 打高尔夫球需要很多耐心的。
examples.english_sentence: Playing golf requires a lot of patience.

english_meaning: Chloroform
explanation_mandarin: 一种有机化合物，化学式为CHCl₃，曾用作麻醉剂。
explanation_english: An organic compound with the formula CHCl₃, formerly used as an anesthetic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電影成日都話用哥羅芳嚟迷暈人嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 ying2 sing4 jat6 dou1 waa6 yung6 go1 lo4 fong1 lai4 mai4 wan4 yan4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电影里经常说用氯仿来迷晕人的。
examples.english_sentence: Movies often say that chloroform is used to knock people unconscious.

english_meaning: Police officer, cop (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 香港俗语，指警察。
explanation_english: Hong Kong slang term for a police officer, especially uniformed police.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 前面有哥記查緊牌呀，小心啲揸車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin4 min6 jau5 go1 gei2 caa4 gan2 paai4 aa3, siu2 sam1 di1 zaa1 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 前面有警察在查驾照，小心开车。
examples.english_sentence: There are cops checking licenses ahead, drive carefully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為自己好醒目，哥記一嚟你就知驚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 zi6 gei2 hou2 sing2 muk6, go1 gei2 jat1 lai4 nei5 zau6 zi1 geng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为自己很聪明，警察一来你就害怕了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you are so smart, you'll be scared when the cops come.

english_meaning: Oh, I see; indicates understanding or realization; a response word
explanation_mandarin: 表示明白了，知道了，或者表示回应。语气较为平淡，有时也略带敷衍。
explanation_english: Indicates understanding, acknowledgement, or realization. The tone is generally neutral and can sometimes imply a lack of deep interest or perfunctory agreement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 哦，原來係咁嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: o1, jyun4 loi4 hai6 gam2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哦，原来是这样的。
examples.english_sentence: Oh, so that's how it is.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘅嘢我都聽唔明，哦，而家明啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 ge3 je5 ngo5 dou1 teng1 m4 ming4, o1, ji4 gaa1 ming4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说的东西我都听不明白，哦，现在明白了。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't understand what you were saying, oh, I get it now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 哦，好呀，得閒再傾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: o1, hou2 aa3, dak1 haan4 zoi3 king1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哦，好的，有空再聊。
examples.english_sentence: Oh, okay, let's chat again when we have time.

english_meaning: to scold, to reprimand, to rebuke
explanation_mandarin: 表示责备，带有训斥的意味。
explanation_english: To scold, reprimand, or rebuke someone, often with a sharp tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽成日都哧我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 seng4 jat6 dou1 cik1 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈总是责备我。
examples.english_sentence: My mom always scolds me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日哧啲細路啦，佢哋都唔係故意㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 cik1 di1 sai3 lou6 laa1, keoi5 dei6 dou1 m4 hai6 gu3 ji3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是责备小孩子了，他们都不是故意的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always scold the kids, they didn't do it on purpose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 俾老細哧完，心情真係好差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 lou5 sai3 cik1 jyun4, sam1 ching4 zan1 hai6 hou2 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 被老板责备完，心情真的很差。
examples.english_sentence: After being scolded by the boss, my mood is really bad.

english_meaning: sentry; to stand guard; whistle; to whistle
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语中，“哨”有站岗、放哨的意思，也指哨兵或哨岗。此外，也可以指哨子。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "哨" means to stand guard, to be on sentry duty, or a sentry post. It can also refer to a whistle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺門口度放緊哨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 mun4 hau2 dou6 fong3 gan2 saau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在门口站岗。
examples.english_sentence: He is standing guard at the door.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 吹個哨示意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cheoi1 go3 saau3 si3 yi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吹一声哨子示意。
examples.english_sentence: Blow a whistle to signal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個哨兵企得好直。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 saau3 bing1 kei5 dak1 hou2 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个哨兵站得很直。
examples.english_sentence: That sentry is standing very straight.

english_meaning: Sentry, guard, sentinel
explanation_mandarin: 担任警戒任务的士兵，通常站在特定的岗位上监视周围情况。
explanation_english: A soldier stationed to keep watch and guard an area, typically observing the surroundings from a fixed position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你望住班哨兵啊，佢哋成日都喺度hea。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 mong6 zyu6 baan1 saau3 bing1 aa3, keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai2 dou6 hea1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看着那些哨兵啊，他们总是很闲。
examples.english_sentence: Look at those sentries, they are always slacking off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 企哨兵好悶㗎，又唔郁得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kei5 saau3 bing1 hou2 mun6 gaa3, jau6 m4 juk1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 站岗当哨兵很闷的，又不能动。
examples.english_sentence: Standing guard as a sentry is very boring, and you can't move.

english_meaning: whistle
explanation_mandarin: 一种通过气流发声的器具。
explanation_english: A small device that produces a loud, high-pitched sound when air is blown through it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個阿sir吹緊哨子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 aa3 sir1 cheui1 gan2 saau3 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个警察在吹哨子。
examples.english_sentence: That police officer is blowing a whistle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 球證吹咗一下哨子，比賽就開始喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kau4 jing3 cheui1 zo2 jat1 haa5 saau3 zi2, bei2 choi3 zau6 hoi1 chi2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 裁判吹了一声哨子，比赛就开始了。
examples.english_sentence: The referee blew the whistle, and the game started.

english_meaning: buck teeth, overbite
explanation_mandarin: 指上颌牙齿明显突出于下颌牙齿。
explanation_english: Refers to a condition where the upper teeth protrude significantly beyond the lower teeth, causing an overbite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嗰陣成日吮手指，搞到而家有啲哨牙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 suk1 sau2 zi2, gaau2 dou3 ji4 gaa1 jau5 di1 saau3 ngaa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候经常吮手指，导致现在有点暴牙。
examples.english_sentence: He used to suck his thumb a lot when he was a child, which caused him to have a bit of an overbite now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我打算箍牙，因為我覺得自己有啲哨牙，唔係咁好睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daa2 syun3 ku1 ngaa4, yan1 wai6 ngo5 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 jau5 di1 saau3 ngaa4, m4 hai6 gam3 hou2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打算做牙齿矫正，因为我觉得自己有点暴牙，不是很好看。
examples.english_sentence: I plan to get braces because I think I have a bit of an overbite, and it doesn't look very good.

english_meaning: Buck-toothed person, Bugs Bunny
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人牙齿突出，尤其是上排牙齿特别明显。也常用来开玩笑地称呼有兔牙的人。
explanation_english: A descriptive term for someone with prominent buck teeth, particularly the upper teeth. It's often used playfully or jokingly to refer to someone with prominent front teeth (like a rabbit). It's sometimes used as a nickname.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個樣幾得意，有啲似哨牙蘇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 joeng2 gei2 dak1 ji3, jau5 di1 ci5 saau3 ngaa4 sou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他长得挺可爱的，有点像龅牙苏。
examples.english_sentence: He looks quite cute, a bit like Bugs Bunny.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好叫我哨牙蘇啦，我唔鍾意！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 giu3 ngo5 saau3 ngaa4 sou1 laa1, ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要叫我龅牙苏了，我不喜欢！
examples.english_sentence: Don't call me Buck-toothed person, I don't like it!

english_meaning: sentry post, outpost, guard post
explanation_mandarin: 指军事上或安保方面设置的用于警戒、观察、防御的据点或岗位。
explanation_english: A sentry post is a station where a guard is posted to keep watch and maintain security, often in a military or security context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺邊境設立咗好多個哨站，防止非法入境。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 bin1 ging2 sat6 laap6 zo2 ho2 do1 go3 saau3 zaam6, fong2 zi2 fei1 faat3 yap6 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在边境设立了很多个哨所，防止非法入境。
examples.english_sentence: They set up many sentry posts along the border to prevent illegal immigration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個哨站嘅阿兵哥日夜輪班守衛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 saau3 zaam6 ge3 aa3 bing1 go1 jat6 je6 leon4 baan1 sau2 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哨所里的士兵日夜轮班守卫。
examples.english_sentence: The soldiers at the sentry post guard day and night in shifts.

english_meaning: to stroll around the streets; to wander aimlessly; to window shop
explanation_mandarin: 指在街上随意走动、游逛，通常没有明确的目的，可能只是为了消遣或看看有什么新鲜事物。
explanation_english: To stroll around the streets aimlessly, usually without a specific purpose, perhaps just to relax or see what's new.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日冇嘢做，不如我哋去哨街啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 mou5 je5 zou6, bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 saau3 gaai1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天没事做，不如我们去逛街吧。
examples.english_sentence: I have nothing to do today, why don't we go for a stroll?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放工之后，我钟意喺附近哨街，睇下有咩新嘢食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 gung1 zi1 hau6, ngo5 zung1 ji3 hai2 fu6 gan6 saau3 gaai1, tai2 haa5 jau5 me1 san1 je5 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下班之后，我喜欢在附近逛街，看看有什么新东西吃。
examples.english_sentence: After work, I like to stroll around the neighborhood and see if there are any new things to eat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日喺旺角哨街，买啲无谓嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 hai2 wong6 gok3 saau3 gaai1, maai5 di1 mou4 wai6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们整天在旺角逛街，买一些没用的东西。
examples.english_sentence: They stroll around Mong Kok all day, buying useless things.

mandarin_meaning: 闲逛的人；到处游荡的人
english_meaning: Loafer; street wanderer; someone who aimlessly wanders around the streets
explanation_mandarin: 形容在街上无所事事，到处游荡的人，通常带有贬义。
explanation_english: Describes someone who aimlessly wanders around the streets, usually with a negative connotation. They have nothing to do and are just killing time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好日日做哨街豬啦，搵份工做下好過啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 jat6 jat6 zou6 saau3 gaai1 zyu1 laa1, wan2 fan6 gung1 zou6 haa5 hou2 gwo3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要每天当个闲逛的人了，找份工作做比较好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a loafer every day; it's better to find a job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 班學生放學之後，就變成哨街豬，喺商場周圍行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baan1 hok6 sang1 fong3 hok6 zi1 hau6, zau6 bin3 sing4 saau3 gaai1 zyu1, hai2 soeng1 coeng4 zau1 wai4 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些学生放学后，就变成了到处游荡的人，在商场周围走。
examples.english_sentence: After school, those students turned into street wanderers, walking around the shopping mall.

english_meaning: this, here
explanation_mandarin: 指示代词，指较近的地方。
explanation_english: Demonstrative pronoun, referring to a place that is relatively close.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 哩度有位㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: li1 dou6 jau5 wai2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里有位置的。
examples.english_sentence: There's a seat here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你喺哩邊做嘢呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai2 li1 bin1 zou6 je5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在这里工作吗？
examples.english_sentence: Do you work here?

english_meaning: Fragmentary, incomplete, scattered, rambling, nonsensical (often describing speech or actions)
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物零散、不完整，也用来形容说话含糊不清、东拉西扯，或做事拖拉。
explanation_english: Describes something fragmentary, incomplete, or scattered. It can also describe speech that is rambling, nonsensical, or unclear, or actions that are slow and inefficient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢哩哩啦啦，完全唔知佢想表達啲咩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 li1 li1 laa1 laa1, jyun4 cyun4 m4 zi1 keoi5 soeng2 biu2 daat6 di1 me1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话零零碎碎的，完全不知道他想表达什么。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks in a rambling, incoherent way, and I have no idea what he's trying to say.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份報告寫到哩哩啦啦，要重新整理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dou3 li1 li1 laa1 laa1, jiu3 cung4 san1 zeng2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告写得零零散散的，需要重新整理。
examples.english_sentence: The report is written in a fragmentary and disorganized way; it needs to be reorganized.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好哩哩啦啦，快啲做完佢啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 li1 li1 laa1 laa1, faai3 di1 zou6 jyun4 keoi5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要磨蹭了，快点做完它吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't dawdle; finish it quickly!

synonyms: 亂七八糟 (luan6 cat1 baat3 zou1)
拖拖拉拉 (to1 to1 laai1 laai1)

english_meaning: coffee
explanation_mandarin: 指咖啡，是英文“coffee”的粤语音译。
explanation_english: Refers to coffee. It's a Cantonese transliteration of the English word "coffee."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想飲杯哩啡，提下神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 jam2 bui1 li1 fe1, tai4 haa5 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想喝杯咖啡，提提神。
examples.english_sentence: I want to drink a cup of coffee to refresh myself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢每日朝早都一定要飲杯熱哩啡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mui5 jat6 ziu1 zou2 dou1 jat1 ding6 jiu3 jam2 bui1 jit6 li1 fe1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天早上都一定要喝杯热咖啡。
examples.english_sentence: He must drink a cup of hot coffee every morning.

mandarin_meaning: 形容词：邋遢, 不整洁,马虎
english_meaning: sloppy; messy; untidy; careless
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或事物不整洁、不干净，马马虎虎，不认真。
explanation_english: Describes a person or thing that is untidy, messy, or careless. It implies a lack of attention to detail and a generally sloppy appearance or manner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間房哩啦到死，執執佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 fong2 li1 laa1 dou3 sei2, zap1 zap1 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房间邋遢死了，收拾一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: The room is so messy, tidy it up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好哩啦，成日都出錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 li1 laa1, seng4 jat6 dou1 ceot1 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很马虎，经常出错。
examples.english_sentence: He's very careless in his work, he makes mistakes all the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁哩啦啦啦啦啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 li1 laa1 laa1 laa1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么邋遢。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so sloppy.

english_meaning: mileage; odometer reading
explanation_mandarin: 指车辆行驶的里程数。也泛指数量或绩效。
explanation_english: Refers to the number of miles a vehicle has traveled (odometer reading). Also used more broadly to refer to quantity or performance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車嘅哩數好多喎，都行咗十幾萬公里。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 ge3 li1 sou3 hou2 do1 wo3, dou1 haang4 zo2 sap6 gei2 maan6 gung1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车的里程数好多啊，都走了十几万公里了。
examples.english_sentence: This car has a lot of mileage; it's already driven over a hundred thousand kilometers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今個月嘅哩數唔錯，跑夠數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 go3 jyut6 ge3 li1 sou3 m4 co3, paau2 gau3 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个月的业绩不错，完成了目标。
examples.english_sentence: His performance this month is not bad; he met the target.

english_meaning: which
explanation_mandarin: 疑问代词，表示询问选择哪个。
explanation_english: Interrogative pronoun, used to ask about which one is being selected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想去邊度旅行呀？香港定係澳門？邊哪？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 heoi3 bin1 dou6 leoi5 hang4 aa3? hoeng1 gong2 ding6 hai6 ou3 mun4? bin1 naa1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想去哪里旅行？香港还是澳门？哪儿？
examples.english_sentence: Where do you want to travel? Hong Kong or Macau? Which one?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想飲咩嘢呀？咖啡哪？定係茶呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 jam2 me1 je5 aa3? gaa3 fe1 naa1? ding6 hai6 caa4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想喝什么？咖啡吗？还是茶？
examples.english_sentence: What do you want to drink? Coffee? Or tea?

english_meaning: which; what; some
explanation_mandarin: 表示询问或指示不确定的几个或一些。
explanation_english: Used to ask about or indicate an uncertain number or some items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想買哪些嘢呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 maai5 naa5 se1 je5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想买哪些东西啊？
examples.english_sentence: What things do you want to buy?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 哪些人會嚟參加派對？
examples.jyutping_sentence: naa5 se1 jan4 wui5 lai4 caam1 gaa1 paai3 deoi2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哪些人会来参加派对？
examples.english_sentence: Which people will come to the party?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔知佢會揀哪些款色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zi1 keoi5 wui2 gaan2 naa5 se1 fun2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不知道他会选哪些款式。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know which styles he will choose.

english_meaning: which; which one
explanation_mandarin: 表示疑问，询问在若干人或事物中指定的一个。
explanation_english: Indicates a question, asking to specify one among several people or things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你鍾意邊個？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung1 ji3 bin1 go3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你喜欢哪个？
examples.english_sentence: Which one do you like?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 邊個係你嘅仔？
examples.jyutping_sentence: bin1 go3 hai6 nei5 ge3 zai2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哪个是你儿子？
examples.english_sentence: Which one is your son?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想知邊個贏咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 zi1 bin1 go3 wing4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想知道哪个赢了。
examples.english_sentence: I want to know which one won.

english_meaning: where; which place
explanation_mandarin: 表示疑问的处所。相当于“哪里”。
explanation_english: Indicates an interrogative place. Equivalent to "where".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想去哪兒啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 heoi3 naa1 ji4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想去哪里啊？
examples.english_sentence: Where do you want to go?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你住喺邊度㗎？唔通住喺火星嗰哪兒咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zyu6 hai2 bin1 dou6 gaa3? m4 tung1 zyu6 hai2 fo2 sing1 go2 naa1 ji4 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你住在哪里啊？难道住在火星的哪里吗？
examples.english_sentence: Where do you live? Don't tell me you live somewhere on Mars?

english_meaning: Nezha, a Chinese deity; sometimes used as a nickname for someone who is rebellious, mischievous or energetic (especially children)
explanation_mandarin: 中国神话人物，又称哪吒三太子。有时用作昵称，形容淘气、叛逆或精力充沛的人（特别是小孩）。
explanation_english: Nezha is a Chinese deity primarily known as a protection god. He is often portrayed as a young boy who is rebellious, mischievous, and energetic. In Cantonese, the name can be used as a nickname for someone who displays these characteristics, particularly children.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個細路仔真係好似哪吒咁，成日搞搞震。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sai3 lou2 zai2 zan1 hai6 hou2 ci5 naa1 zaa1 gam2, seng4 jat6 gaau2 gaau2 zan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个小孩子真像哪吒一样，整天捣蛋。
examples.english_sentence: That kid is really like Nezha, always causing trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嘅時候成日俾人叫做哪吒，因為佢實在太百厭喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 seng4 jat6 bei2 jan4 giu3 zou6 naa1 zaa1, jan1 wai6 keoi5 sat6 zoi6 taai3 baak3 jim3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候经常被人叫做哪吒，因为他实在太调皮了。
examples.english_sentence: He was often called Nezha when he was young because he was so mischievous.

english_meaning: even if, even though, no matter how
explanation_mandarin: 表示假设的让步，相当于“即使”，“就算”。
explanation_english: Expresses a hypothetical concession, equivalent to "even if" or "even though". It indicates that something will happen regardless of the condition that follows.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 哪怕落狗屎，我都要去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: naa5 paa3 lok6 gau2 si2, ngo5 dou1 jiu3 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 即使下大雨，我也要去。
examples.english_sentence: Even if it rains cats and dogs, I still have to go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 哪怕你唔幫手，我都會自己搞掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: naa5 paa3 nei5 m4 bong1 sau2, ngo5 dou1 wui5 zi6 gei2 gaau2 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 即使你不帮忙，我也会自己搞定。
examples.english_sentence: Even if you don't help, I'll manage it myself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 哪怕佢幾叻，都唔可以驕傲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: naa5 paa3 keoi5 gei2 lek1, dou1 m4 ho2 ji5 giu1 ngou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哪怕他有多厉害，都不能骄傲。
examples.english_sentence: No matter how capable he is, he shouldn't be arrogant.

english_meaning: which kind; what kind; what sort
explanation_mandarin: 表示询问事物的种类、性质、状态等。
explanation_english: Used to ask about the type, nature, or state of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想飲邊樣嘢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 jam2 bin1 joeng2 je5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想喝哪种东西？
examples.english_sentence: What kind of drink do you want?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你鍾意邊樣顏色啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung1 ji3 bin1 joeng2 ngaan4 sik1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你喜欢哪种颜色啊？
examples.english_sentence: Which color do you like?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔知應該揀邊樣好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 zi1 jing1 goi1 gaan2 bin1 joeng2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不知道应该选哪种好。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't know which one to choose.

english_meaning: where; what place; not at all; don't mention it (response to thanks)
explanation_mandarin: 用作疑问代词，表示地方；用作谦辞，表示不敢当，相当于“哪里哪里”。
explanation_english: As a pronoun, it indicates a place (where). As a modest expression, it means 'not at all' or 'don't mention it,' used as a polite response to thanks or compliments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你住喺邊度呀？我住喺香港呀，咁你呢，你住喺邊度呀？ 我住喺九龍呀。 邊度呀？ 邊度呀？ 邊度呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zyu6 hai2 bin1 dou6 aa3? ngo5 zyu6 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 aa3, gam2 nei5 ne1, nei5 zyu6 hai2 bin1 dou6 aa3? ngo5 zyu6 hai2 gau2 lung4 aa3. bin1 dou6 aa3? bin1 dou6 aa3? bin1 dou6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你住在哪里呀？我住在香港呀，那你呢，你住在哪里呀？ 我住在九龙呀。哪里呀？哪里呀？哪里呀？
examples.english_sentence: Where do you live? I live in Hong Kong, and you, where do you live? I live in Kowloon. Where? Where? Where?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你幫我呀！ 哪裏哪裏，唔使客氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 bong1 ngo5 aa3! naa1 lei5 naa1 lei5, m4 sai2 hak3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢你帮我！哪里哪里，不用客气。
examples.english_sentence: Thank you for helping me! Not at all, you're welcome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你廣東話講得好好喎！哪裏哪裏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gwong2 dung1 waa2 gong2 dak1 hou2 hou2 wo3! naa1 lei5 naa1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你广东话说得很好啊！哪里哪里。
examples.english_sentence: Your Cantonese is very good! Not at all (I'm flattered).

english_meaning: where; how (expressing politeness or denial)
explanation_mandarin: 用作疑问代词，表示地点。 也常用作客套话，表示谦虚或否定。
explanation_english: As an interrogative pronoun, it indicates location. Also commonly used as a polite expression to express modesty or denial.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你去邊度呀？ 我去邊度都唔關你事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 heoi3 bin1 dou6 aa3? ngo5 heoi3 bin1 dou6 dou1 m4 gwaan1 nei5 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你去哪里啊？我去哪里都不关你的事。
examples.english_sentence: Where are you going? It's none of your business where I go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘢咁叻， 邊度邊度，都係學人咋嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 je5 gam3 lek1, bin1 dou6 bin1 dou6, dou1 hai6 hok6 yan4 zaa3 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说话这么厉害，哪里哪里，都是学别人而已。
examples.english_sentence: You speak so well! Not at all, I'm just learning from others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔係呀， 邊度有咁嘅事？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hai6 aa3, bin1 dou6 jau5 gam3 ge3 si6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不是吧，哪里有这样的事？
examples.english_sentence: No way, where did such a thing happen?

english_meaning: where*
explanation_mandarin: 表示疑问或者不确定的地点。
explanation_english: Indicates an interrogative or indefinite location; where.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想去邊度啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 heoi3 bin1 dou6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想去哪里啊？
examples.english_sentence: Where do you want to go?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廁所喺邊度啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ci3 so2 hai2 bin1 dou6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 厕所在哪里啊？
examples.english_sentence: Where is the restroom?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔知佢去咗邊度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 zi1 keoi5 heoi3 zo2 bin1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不知道他去了哪里。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know where he went.

mandarin_meaning: 语气词，表示惊讶或疑问
english_meaning: interjection expressing surprise, doubt, or agreement
explanation_mandarin: 表示轻微的惊讶，疑问，或带有一种不屑的肯定。语气较轻。
explanation_english: An interjection used to express slight surprise, doubt, or a somewhat dismissive agreement. The tone is generally light.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 哬，係咁嘅咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho1, hai6 gam2 ge3 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哦，是这样的吗？
examples.english_sentence: Oh, is that how it is?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 哬，噉樣都得？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho1, gam2 joeng2 dou1 dak1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哦，那样也行？
examples.english_sentence: Oh, that works too?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 哬，你話嘅都啱啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho1, nei5 waa6 ge3 dou1 ngaam1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哦，你说的都对啦。（不屑）
examples.english_sentence: Oh, whatever you say is right. (dismissive)

english_meaning: Where, Where is it?
explanation_mandarin: 表示询问地方的词语，语气较轻。 相当于“哪里呀”。
explanation_english: A word used to ask about a place, with a lighter tone. Equivalent to 'Where is it?' or 'Where are you talking about?'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話佢住邊度呀？哬哚呀？我唔知喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 keoi5 zyu6 bin1 dou6 aa3? ho4 do1 aa3? ngo5 m4 zi1 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说他住哪里呀？哪里呀？我不知道诶。
examples.english_sentence: You said where he lives? Where is it? I don't know.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢喺香港有個單位，哬哚呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 jau5 go3 daan1 wai2, ho4 do1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他在香港有个公寓，哪里呀？
examples.english_sentence: He said he has an apartment in Hong Kong, where is it?

english_meaning: to cry, to weep
explanation_mandarin: 指发出声音或不出声地流眼泪。
explanation_english: To shed tears, often accompanied by sounds of distress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個成日扭計喊，依家大個咗就少咗喊喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 seng4 jat6 nau2 gai2 haam3, ji1 gaa1 daai6 go3 zo2 zau6 siu2 zo2 haam3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候经常撒娇哭闹，现在长大了就很少哭了。
examples.english_sentence: He used to cry a lot as a child when he threw tantrums, but now that he's grown up, he cries less.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喊啦，冇事㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 haam3 laa1, mou5 si6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别哭了，没事儿的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't cry, it's okay.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喊到好傷心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haam3 dou3 hou2 soeng1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他哭得很伤心。
examples.english_sentence: He cried very sadly.

english_meaning: to weep and wail; to cry and whine incessantly
explanation_mandarin: 形容不停地哭泣，哭个没完。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is crying and whining incessantly and uncontrollably.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喊啦，再喊都冇用㗎，唔好哭哭啼啼啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 haam3 laa1, zoi3 haam3 dou1 mou5 jung6 gaa3, m4 hou2 huk1 huk1 tai4 tai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别哭了，再哭也没用，不要哭哭啼啼了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't cry anymore, it's useless to cry, don't weep and wail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都為咗啲小事喺度哭哭啼啼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 wai6 zo2 di1 siu2 si6 hai2 dou6 huk1 huk1 tai4 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是为了小事哭哭啼啼。
examples.english_sentence: She always cries and whines about small things.

english_meaning: to mourn at a funeral; to perform mourning rites; (figurative) to complain incessantly, to be a downer
explanation_mandarin: 原本指在丧礼上哭泣，表达哀悼。引申义指持续抱怨、垂头丧气，让人感到压抑。
explanation_english: Originally refers to weeping at a funeral to express mourning. The extended meaning refers to complaining incessantly, being downcast, and making others feel depressed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都喺度哭喪，真係好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai2 dou6 huk1 song3, zan1 hai6 hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天都在那里哭丧着脸，真烦人。
examples.english_sentence: He's always moping around, it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日哭喪口面啦，開心啲啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 huk1 song3 hau2 min6 laa1, hoi1 sam1 di1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是哭丧着脸，开心点吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't always have such a long face, cheer up!

synonyms: 怨天尤人 (jyun3 tin1 jau4 jan4)

english_meaning: to weep; to cry
explanation_mandarin: 指发出声音地哭；流着眼泪哭。
explanation_english: To weep; to cry while making sound; to cry with tears.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為聽唔到父母嘅死訊而哭泣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yan1 wai6 teng1 m4 dou2 fu6 mou5 ge3 sei2 seon3 yi4 huk1 jap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为听到父母的死讯而哭泣。
examples.english_sentence: He wept upon hearing the news of his parents' death.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再哭泣啦，冇用㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 huk1 jap1 laa1, mou5 yung6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再哭泣了，没用的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't cry anymore, it's no use.

english_meaning: to find something both ridiculous and annoying; to not know whether to laugh or cry; to be in a dilemma
explanation_mandarin: 形容处境尴尬，不知该哭还是该笑。表示一种非常无奈的感受，不知道如何反应。
explanation_english: Describes a situation that is both frustrating and humorous, leaving one unsure whether to laugh or cry. It expresses a feeling of helplessness and not knowing how to react to a particular situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我份功課交遲咗，個老師話要我罰抄，但係佢寫錯晒啲字，真係搞到我哭笑不得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 fan6 gung1 fo3 gaau1 ci4 zo2, go3 lou5 si1 waa6 jiu3 ngo5 fat6 caau1, daan6 hai6 keoi5 se2 co3 saai3 di1 zi6, zan1 hai6 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 huk1 siu3 bat1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我作业交晚了，老师说要我罚抄，但是他写错了所有的字，真是让我哭笑不得。
examples.english_sentence: I handed in my homework late, and the teacher said I had to copy it as punishment, but he wrote all the characters wrong. It really made me not know whether to laugh or cry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講埋啲爛gag，雖然好無聊，但係有時又幾搞笑，真係令人哭笑不得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gong2 maai4 di1 laan6 gag1, seoi1 jin4 hou2 mou4 liu2, daan6 hai6 jau5 si4 jau6 gei2 gau2 siu3, zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 huk1 siu3 bat1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是讲一些很烂的笑话，虽然很无聊，但是有时候又挺搞笑的，真是令人哭笑不得。
examples.english_sentence: He always tells corny jokes. Although they are boring, sometimes they're quite funny, which makes me not know whether to laugh or cry.

english_meaning: whimpering tone; tearful tone of voice
explanation_mandarin: 指说话时带有的哭泣的声音或者腔调。
explanation_english: Refers to a tone of voice that sounds like one is about to cry, or is already crying; a whimpering or tearful tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好用哭腔同我講嘢，有咩事慢慢講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 yung6 huk1 hong1 tung4 ngo5 gong2嘢, yau5 me1 si6 maan6 maan2 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要用哭腔跟我说话，有什么事慢慢说。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk to me in a tearful tone, tell me slowly what's wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一聽到個壞消息就忍唔住用哭腔講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yat1 ting1 dou2 go3 waai6 siu1 sik1 jau6 yan2 m4 jyu6 jyu5 yung6 huk1 hong1 gong2嘢.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一听到这个坏消息就忍不住用哭腔说话。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as he heard the bad news, he couldn't help but speak in a whimpering tone.

english_meaning: to weep and complain; to pour out one's grievances; to plead tearfully
explanation_mandarin: 哭着诉说（自己的冤屈或痛苦）。
explanation_english: To weep and complain; to express one's grievances or sufferings through crying and talking. Often implies a sense of injustice or mistreatment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺法官面前哭訴自己嘅遭遇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 faat3 gun1 min6 cin4 huk1 sou3 zi6 gei2 ge3 zao1 geoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在法官面前哭诉自己的遭遇。
examples.english_sentence: She tearfully pleaded her situation to the judge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢受咗委屈，返到屋企就向阿媽哭訴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sau6 zo2 wai2 kwik1, faan1 dou3 uk1 kei2 zau6 hoeng3 aa3 maa1 huk1 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他受了委屈，回到家就向妈妈哭诉。
examples.english_sentence: After being wronged, he went home and tearfully complained to his mother.

english_meaning: asthma, to wheeze
explanation_mandarin: 哮喘；喘息。
explanation_english: Asthma; to wheeze or breathe noisily, especially due to asthma.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嗰陣成日都哮嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 dou1 haau1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候经常哮喘。
examples.english_sentence: He used to have asthma a lot when he was little.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一轉天氣佢就哮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 zyun2 tin1 hei3 keoi5 zau6 haau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一变天就哮喘。
examples.english_sentence: He gets asthma whenever the weather changes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺佢面前食煙，佢會哮嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 keoi5 min6 cin4 sik6 jin1, keoi5 wui5 haau1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在他面前吸烟，他会哮喘的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't smoke in front of him, he'll have an asthma attack.

english_meaning: asthma
explanation_mandarin: 一种呼吸道疾病，特征是气道狭窄、炎症和产生过多的黏液，导致呼吸困难、喘息、咳嗽和胸闷。
explanation_english: A chronic respiratory disease characterized by inflammation and narrowing of the airways, leading to difficulty breathing, wheezing, coughing, and chest tightness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嘅時候就有哮喘，成日要睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 zau6 jau5 haau1 cyun2, seng4 jat6 jiu3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候就有哮喘，经常要看医生。
examples.english_sentence: He had asthma since he was a child and had to see the doctor often.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 吸煙會令哮喘嘅病情惡化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kap1 jin1 wui5 ling6 haau1 cyun2 ge3 bing6 ching4 ok3 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吸烟会使哮喘的病情恶化。
examples.english_sentence: Smoking will worsen the symptoms of asthma.

english_meaning: wise; sagacious; clever
explanation_mandarin: 指人有智慧，聪明，善于思考。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who is wise, intelligent, and good at thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好哲㗎，乜嘢都識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zit3 gaa3, mat1 je5 dou1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很聪明，什么都知道。
examples.english_sentence: He's very clever; he knows everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁哲，一定諗到辦法㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 zit3, jat1 ding6 nim2 dou2 baan6 faat3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么聪明，一定能想到办法的。
examples.english_sentence: You are so wise, you must be able to think of a solution.

english_meaning: philosophy
explanation_mandarin: 对事物根本规律的探讨，包括存在、知识、价值、理性、心灵和语言等方面的研究。
explanation_english: the study of the fundamental nature of knowledge, reality, and existence, especially when considered as an academic discipline.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意睇哲學書，成日諗埋晒啲好深嘅問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 tai2 zit3 hok6 syu1, seng4 jat6 nam2 maai4 saai3 di1 hou2 sam1 ge3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很喜欢看哲学书，总是想一些很深奥的问题。
examples.english_sentence: He likes to read philosophy books and is always thinking about very profound questions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人生嘅意義係乜嘢？呢個係哲學嘅一個基本問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 sang1 ge3 ji3 ngai6 hai6 mat1 je5? ni1 go3 hai6 zit3 hok6 ge3 jat1 go3 gei1 bun2 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人生的意义是什么？这是哲学的一个基本问题。
examples.english_sentence: What is the meaning of life? This is a fundamental question in philosophy.

english_meaning: philosopher
explanation_mandarin: 指研究哲学的人，从事哲学研究或精通哲学的人。
explanation_english: A person who studies or teaches philosophy, or one who is versed in philosophy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅夢想係成為一位哲學家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 mung6 soeng2 hai6 sing4 wai4 jat1 wai2 zit3 hok6 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的梦想是成为一位哲学家。
examples.english_sentence: His dream is to become a philosopher.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 蘇格拉底係一位著名嘅古希臘哲學家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sou1 gaak3 laai1 dai2 hai6 jat1 wai2 zoeng1 ming4 ge3 gu2 hei1 laap6 zit3 hok6 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 苏格拉底是一位著名的古希腊哲学家。
examples.english_sentence: Socrates was a famous ancient Greek philosopher.

english_meaning: philosophy, philosophical principle
explanation_mandarin: 关于宇宙和人生的根本原理、智慧。
explanation_english: Fundamental principles and wisdom concerning the universe and human life; philosophy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢好有哲理㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 jau5 zit3 lei5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话很有哲理的。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks very philosophically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書充滿人生哲理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 cung1 mun5 jan4 sang1 zit3 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书充满了人生哲理。
examples.english_sentence: This book is full of life philosophies.

mandarin_meaning: 模仿液体或食物被吞咽的声音
english_meaning: Sound of gulping or slurping; to gulp; to slurp
explanation_mandarin: 形容喝东西或吃东西时发出的声音，通常指大口吞咽液体或吸食流质食物的声音。
explanation_english: Describes the sound made when drinking or eating, typically referring to the sound of gulping down liquid or slurping liquid food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一口氣將碗湯「哴」一聲飲晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 hau2 hei3 zoeng1 wun2 tong1 "loeng1" jat1 seng1 jam2 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一口气把碗里的汤「哴」的一声喝完了。
examples.english_sentence: He gulped down the entire bowl of soup in one go with a "loeng" sound.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好「哴哴」聲咁大聲，好冇禮貌嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 "loeng1 loeng1" seng1 gam3 daai6 seng1, hou2 mou5 lai5 maau6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要「哴哴」作响这么大声，很没礼貌的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't slurp so loudly, it's very impolite.

english_meaning: to breastfeed; to suckle
explanation_mandarin: 喂奶，特指用乳房喂养婴儿。
explanation_english: To feed a baby with breast milk; to suckle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽喺度哺緊BB。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 hai2 dou6 bou6 gan2 bi1 bi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈正在给宝宝喂奶。
examples.english_sentence: Mom is breastfeeding the baby.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢覺得喺公眾場所哺母乳冇問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gok3 dak1 hai2 gung1 zung2 coeng4 so2 bou6 mou5 jyu5 mou5 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她觉得在公共场所哺乳没问题。
examples.english_sentence: She doesn't think it's a problem to breastfeed in public.

english_meaning: breastfeeding, lactation
explanation_mandarin: 指用乳房喂养婴儿的行为。
explanation_english: The act of feeding a baby with milk from the breast.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽喺房入面哺乳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 hai2 fong2 jap6 min6 bou2 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈在房间里哺乳。
examples.english_sentence: The mother is breastfeeding in the room.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢選擇咗用人奶哺乳，唔想用奶粉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 syun2 zaak6 zo2 yung6 jan4 naai5 bou2 jyu5, m4 soeng2 yung6 naai5 fan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她选择了用母乳哺乳，不想用奶粉。
examples.english_sentence: She chose to breastfeed instead of using formula.

english_meaning: mammal
explanation_mandarin: 指脊椎动物亚门哺乳纲的动物，其主要特征是母体通过乳腺分泌乳汁来哺育幼仔。
explanation_english: Mammals are a class of vertebrate animals whose main characteristic is that the mother nourishes her young with milk secreted from mammary glands.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 鯨魚都係哺乳類動物嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kwing4 jyu4 dou1 hai6 bou2 jyu5 leoi6 dung6 mat6 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 鲸鱼也是哺乳动物。
examples.english_sentence: Whales are also mammals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人類都係哺乳類動物嘅一種。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 leoi6 dou1 hai6 bou2 jyu5 leoi6 dung6 mat6 ge3 jat1 zung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人类也是哺乳动物的一种。
examples.english_sentence: Humans are also a type of mammal.

mandarin_meaning: 巢穴, 窝, 避风港
english_meaning: nest, den, hideout, a safe place; (slang) home, residence
explanation_mandarin: 原指鸟兽的巢穴，引申为安全舒适的场所，亦可指住所或常去的地方。
explanation_english: Originally refers to the nest of birds and animals, extended to mean a safe and comfortable place, also can refer to a residence or a frequently visited place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日匿喺屋企，當咗屋企係佢嘅哺竇噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 nik1 hai2 uk1 kei2, dong3 zo2 uk1 kei2 hai6 keoi5 ge3 bou6 dau2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天躲在家里，把家当成了他的巢穴。
examples.english_sentence: He hides at home all day, treating his home like his nest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放工之後，我最想返屋企呢個哺竇休息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 gung1 zi1 hau6, ngo5 zeoi3 soeng2 faan1 uk1 kei2 ni1 go3 bou6 dau2 jau1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下班之后，我最想回家这个避风港休息。
examples.english_sentence: After work, I want to return to my home, this safe haven, to rest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間酒吧係我哋班friend嘅哺竇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 baa1 geoi2 hai6 ngo5 dei6 baan1 friend ge3 bou6 dau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家酒吧是我们这群朋友的常聚地。
examples.english_sentence: This bar is the hangout spot for our group of friends.

english_meaning: to boast; to brag; to exaggerate
explanation_mandarin: 指誇大其詞，吹牛，說話不實在。
explanation_english: Refers to exaggerating, boasting, or speaking untruthfully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都喺度哺蛋，話自己幾叻幾叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 hai2 dou6 bou6 daan2, waa6 zi6 gei2 gei2 lek1 gei2 lek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在这里吹牛，说自己多么厉害。
examples.english_sentence: He's always boasting here, saying how capable he is.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好信佢講嘅嘢，佢鍾意哺蛋㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5, keoi5 zung1 ji3 bou6 daan2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要相信他说的话，他喜欢吹牛的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't believe what he says, he likes to boast.

english_meaning: Humph; to grunt; to express dissatisfaction or disapproval
explanation_mandarin: 表示轻蔑、不满、不相信等语气；也可以表示无意义的发出声音。
explanation_english: Expresses contempt, dissatisfaction, disbelief, or a feeling of being unimpressed. Can also simply be a meaningless sound made in the throat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 哼！我唔信佢講嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hang1! ngo5 m4 seon3 keoi5 gong2 ge3嘢.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哼！我不相信他说的话。
examples.english_sentence: Humph! I don't believe what he said.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哼乜啊？唔同意咪出聲囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hang1 mat1 aa3? m4 tung1 yi3 mai5 chut1 seng1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你哼什么？不同意就出声啊。
examples.english_sentence: What are you 'humphing' for? If you disagree, just speak up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哼咗一聲，表示唔高興。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hang1 zo2 jat1 seng1, biu2 si6 m4 gou1 hing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他哼了一声，表示不高兴。
examples.english_sentence: He grunted, showing his displeasure.

english_meaning: to extort; to blackmail
explanation_mandarin: 指以威胁、恐吓等手段，强行索取财物。
explanation_english: To extort money or goods through threats or intimidation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日諗住哼哈勒榨人哋啲錢啦，靠自己先至係正途。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 lam2 zyu6 hang1 haa1 lak6 jaa3 jan4 dei6 di1 cin2 laa1, kaau3 zi6 gei2 sin1 zi3 hai6 zeng3 tou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是想着敲诈勒索别人的钱，靠自己才是正道。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always think about extorting money from others. Relying on yourself is the right path.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺條街度哼哈勒榨啲細路仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 tiu4 gaai1 dou6 hang1 haa1 lak6 jaa3 di1 sai3 lou2 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常在街上敲诈勒索那些小孩子。
examples.english_sentence: He often extorts money from those kids on the street.

english_meaning: to choke with emotion; to sob; to have a lump in one's throat
explanation_mandarin: 形容因为悲伤、激动等情绪而呼吸受阻，说不出话或声音颤抖。
explanation_english: Describes the sensation of having difficulty speaking due to strong emotions, often sadness or excitement, resulting in a constricted throat and trembling voice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽到阿婆過身嘅消息，哽到講唔出嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ting1 dou2 aa3 po4 gwo3 san1 ge3 siu1 sik1, gang2 dou3 gong2 m4 chut1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她听到奶奶去世的消息，哽咽得说不出话。
examples.english_sentence: When she heard the news of her grandmother's death, she was so choked up that she couldn't speak.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇到佢攞獎，我感動到哽住哽住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 dou2 keoi5 lo2 zoeng2, ngo5 gam2 dung6 dou3 gang2 zyu6 gang2 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到他得奖，我感动得哽咽不已。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing him win the award, I was so moved that I kept sobbing.

english_meaning: stuttering; stammering; hesitant speech; intermittent
explanation_mandarin: 形容说话不流畅，断断续续，像被东西哽住一样。
explanation_english: Describes speech that is not fluent, interrupted, as if something is stuck in the throat. Can also describe something that occurs intermittently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好緊張，講嘢哽住哽住，唔知佢想表達啲乜嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 gan2 zoeng1, gong2 je5 gang2 zyu6 gang2 zyu6, m4 zi1 keoi5 soeng2 biu2 daat6 di1 mat1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很紧张，说话结结巴巴的，不知道他想表达什么。
examples.english_sentence: He's very nervous, speaking with stutters, I don't know what he wants to express.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車啲引擎哽住哽住，好似就嚟死火咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 di1 jing5 ching4 gang2 zyu6 gang2 zyu6, hou2 ci5 zau6 lai4 si2 fo2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车的引擎断断续续的，好像要熄火一样。
examples.english_sentence: The car's engine is intermittent, like it's about to stall.

english_meaning: to choke with emotion; to sob; to speak with a lump in one's throat
explanation_mandarin: 因悲伤或激动而声音嘶哑、阻塞。
explanation_english: To choke with emotion, usually sadness or strong feelings, causing the voice to become hoarse or obstructed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢睇完封信之後，忍唔住哽咽咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tai2 jyun4 fung1 seon3 zi1 hau6, yan2 m4 jyu6 gang2 jit3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看完信之后，忍不住哽咽了。
examples.english_sentence: After reading the letter, he couldn't help but choke up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 講起阿婆，佢哽咽到講唔出聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong2 hei2 aa3 po4, keoi5 gang2 jit3 dou3 gong2 m4 chut1 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 提到奶奶，他哽咽得说不出话来。
examples.english_sentence: When talking about his grandmother, he choked up and couldn't speak.

english_meaning: sobbing, with a choked voice; stuttering due to emotion; a voice breaking with emotion
explanation_mandarin: 形容说话时因为情绪激动而声音阻塞，带有哽咽的声音。也形容勉强说话。
explanation_english: Describes a voice that is choked with emotion, usually because of sadness or crying. It can also describe someone speaking with difficulty because of strong feelings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講起過身嘅嫲嫲，哽哽聲噉話好掛住佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 hei2 gwo3 san1 ge3 maa4 maa4, gang2 gang2 seng1 gam2 waa6 hou2 gwaa3 zyu6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他提起去世的奶奶，哽咽地说很想她。
examples.english_sentence: When he talked about his deceased grandmother, his voice was choked with emotion, and he said he missed her a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喊到哽哽聲，乜嘢都講唔清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haam3 dou3 gang2 gang2 seng1, mat1 je5 dou1 gong2 m4 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她哭得哽咽，什么都说不清楚。
examples.english_sentence: She was sobbing and couldn't say anything clearly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哽哽聲噉解釋，睇得出佢好委屈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gang2 gang2 seng1 gam2 gaai2 sik1, tai2 dak1 chut1 keoi5 hou2 wai2 kwik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他哽咽着解释，看得出他很委屈。
examples.english_sentence: He explained with a choked voice, and you could tell he felt very wronged.

mandarin_meaning: 难以下咽; 难以接受
english_meaning: Unable to swallow (literally or figuratively); Unable to accept
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是指食物或液体很难吞咽下去。比喻意义是指某件事情让人难以接受、无法容忍。
explanation_english: Literally means unable to swallow food or liquid. Figuratively, it means something is unacceptable, unbearable, or difficult to stomach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲咁嘅嘢，我真係哽唔落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 gam3 ge3 je5, ngo5 zan1 hai6 gang2 m4 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些东西，我真的咽不下去。
examples.english_sentence: This kind of stuff, I really can't swallow it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗咁多衰嘢，我真係哽唔落條氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 gam3 do1 seoi1 je5, ngo5 zan1 hai6 gang2 m4 lok6 tiu4 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了这么多坏事，我真的无法接受。
examples.english_sentence: He's done so many bad things, I really can't swallow it (can't stand it).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到佢咁樣講，我哽唔落飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou2 keoi5 gam2 joeng2 gong2, ngo5 gang2 m4 lok6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到他那样说，我吃不下饭。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing him say that, I couldn't swallow my food.

mandarin_meaning: 咽不下去；过不去；无法接受
english_meaning: Cannot swallow (literally or figuratively); cannot accept; cannot get over (something); unacceptable.
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是指东西哽在喉咙里咽不下去。引申意义是指某件事情让人无法接受、无法释怀、难以忍受。
explanation_english: Literally means something is stuck in the throat and cannot be swallowed. Figuratively, it means something is unacceptable, unbearable, or difficult to come to terms with.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁樣對你，真係哽唔過頭喎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 joeng2 deoi3 nei5, zan1 hai6 gang2 m4 gwo3 tau4 wo3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这样对你，真是让人无法接受啊！
examples.english_sentence: The way he treated you is really unacceptable!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到佢走咗嘅消息，我哽唔過頭，成晚都瞓唔著。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou2 keoi5 zau2 zo2 ge3 siu1 sik1, ngo5 gang2 m4 gwo3 tau4, sing4 ngaan1 dou1 fan3 m4 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到他去世的消息，我无法接受，整晚都睡不着。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing the news of his passing, I couldn't get over it, and I couldn't sleep all night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試考得咁差，我真係哽唔過頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 haau2 dak1 gam3 caa1, ngo5 zan1 hai6 gang2 m4 gwo3 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试考得这么差，我真的无法接受。
examples.english_sentence: I did so badly on the exam this time, I really can't get over it.

english_meaning: heartwarming, touching; to feel choked up (with emotion)
explanation_mandarin: 形容令人感动、感到温暖，有时也指让人感到堵心、难受。
explanation_english: Describes a feeling of being touched, moved, and warmed by something. It can also mean feeling choked up with emotion, either positive or negative.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁樣做，真係好哽心啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 joeng2 zou6, zan1 hai6 hou2 gang2 sam1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这样做，真的很窝心啊。
examples.english_sentence: The way he did that is really heartwarming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到佢嘅遭遇，我都覺得有啲哽心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou2 keoi5 ge3 zou1 geoi6, ngo5 dou1 gok3 dak1 jau5 di1 gang2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到他的遭遇，我也觉得有点堵心。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing about his experiences, I also felt a bit choked up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲嘅結局好哽心，睇到我眼濕濕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 ge3 git3 guk1 hou2 gang2 sam1, tai2 dou3 ngo5 ngaan5 sip1 sip1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影的结局很感人，看得我眼眶湿润。
examples.english_sentence: The ending of this movie is very touching, it made my eyes watery.

mandarin_meaning: 非常难受；心里非常不舒服
english_meaning: Extremely uncomfortable; feeling a deep, suffocating pain in one's heart; feeling extremely distressed or upset.
explanation_mandarin: 形容内心极度难受，仿佛有什么东西哽在心和肺里，难以言喻的痛苦。
explanation_english: Describes a feeling of extreme emotional distress, as if something is stuck in one's heart and lungs, causing a deep, almost suffocating pain that is difficult to express.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇到佢咁慘，真係哽心哽肺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 dou2 keoi5 gam3 caam2, zan1 hai6 gang2 sam1 gang2 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到他这么惨，真是让人心里非常难受。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing him in such a miserable state really makes my heart ache.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 諗起細個嘅事，我而家都仲係覺得哽心哽肺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nam2 hei2 sai3 go3 ge3 si6, ngo5 ji4 gaa1 dou1 zung1 hai6 gok3 dak1 gang2 sam1 gang2 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 想起小时候的事，我现在都还是觉得很难受。
examples.english_sentence: Thinking about things that happened when I was a child, I still feel deeply distressed.

english_meaning: jarring; grating (sound); harsh on the ears; cacophonous
explanation_mandarin: 形容声音难听、刺耳。
explanation_english: Describes a sound that is unpleasant, jarring, or harsh to the ears.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部鬧鐘啲聲好哽耳，一聽就醒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 naau6 zung1 di1 seng1 hou2 gang2 ji5, jat1 teng1 zau6 sing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个闹钟的声音很刺耳，一听就醒了。
examples.english_sentence: The sound of this alarm clock is very jarring; you wake up as soon as you hear it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個男人把聲好哽耳，聽得我好唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 naam4 jan2 baa2 seng1 hou2 gang2 ji5, teng1 dak1 ngo5 hou2 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个男人的声音很刺耳，听得我很不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: That man's voice is very grating; it makes me feel uncomfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唱歌走晒音，真係哽耳到爆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 coeng3 go1 zau2 saai3 jam1, zan1 hai6 gang2 ji5 dou3 baau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他唱歌完全跑调了，真是刺耳极了。
examples.english_sentence: He sang completely off-key; it was extremely grating.

english_meaning: to choke; to get stuck in the throat; to be unable to swallow properly
explanation_mandarin: 指食物或异物卡在喉咙里，难以吞咽。
explanation_english: Refers to food or a foreign object being stuck in the throat, making it difficult to swallow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食飯唔好咁快，小心哽頸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 faan6 m4 hou2 gam3 faai3, siu2 sam1 gang2 geng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃饭不要这么快，小心噎着。
examples.english_sentence: Don't eat so fast, be careful of choking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢食魚哽親頸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sik6 jyu2 gang2 can1 geng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他吃鱼卡住了喉咙。
examples.english_sentence: He choked on a fish bone.

english_meaning: Stubborn, obstinate, inflexible, pig-headed
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常固执，听不进别人的意见，一意孤行。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is extremely stubborn and refuses to listen to others' opinions, insisting on having their own way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你真係哽頸四，叫你唔好咁做，你偏要做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zan1 hai6 gang2 geng2 sei3, giu3 nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 zou6, nei5 pin1 jiu3 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你真是太固执了，叫你不要这么做，你偏要做。
examples.english_sentence: You are so stubborn. I told you not to do it, but you insisted on doing it anyway.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁哽頸四啦，聽下人哋嘅意見啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 gang2 geng2 sei3 laa1, ting1 haa5 jan4 dei6 ge3 ji3 gin3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么固执了，听一下别人的意见吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stubborn, listen to other people's opinions.

english_meaning: good; fine; well (usually archaic or literary)
explanation_mandarin: 表示好的，不错的。常见于古文或一些成语、人名中。
explanation_english: Indicates something good or not bad. Commonly found in classical Chinese or in some idioms and given names. It is rarely used in modern spoken Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個名有個「哿」字。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 meng2 jau5 go3 "go2" zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的名字里有个“哿”字。
examples.english_sentence: His name has the character "哿" in it.

english_meaning: to express condolences; to condole
explanation_mandarin: 对遭遇丧事的人家表示慰问。 通常用于书面语。
explanation_english: To express sympathy or condolences to someone who has suffered a bereavement. Usually used in formal writing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋派人去佢屋企唁喪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 paai3 jan4 heoi3 keoi5 uk1 kei2 jin6 song3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们派人去他家吊唁。
examples.english_sentence: They sent someone to his home to offer condolences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我寫咗封信去唁佢嘅喪事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 se2 zo2 fung1 seon3 heoi3 jin6 keoi5 ge3 song1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我写了一封信去慰问他的丧事。
examples.english_sentence: I wrote a letter to express my condolences to him on his bereavement.

english_meaning: Cocoa powder; Chocolate (drink)
explanation_mandarin: 指可可粉或者用可可粉冲调的饮料，有时也直接指巧克力。
explanation_english: Refers to cocoa powder or a drink made with cocoa powder, sometimes referring directly to chocolate (drink).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飲杯熱唂先啦，暖下身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yam2 bui1 jit6 guk1 sin1 laa1, nün5 haa5 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 先喝一杯热可可吧，暖暖身子。
examples.english_sentence: Have a cup of hot cocoa first to warm up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意飲唂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 yam2 guk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很喜欢喝巧克力（饮品）。
examples.english_sentence: I really like drinking chocolate (drink).

english_meaning: Cocoa, chocolate
explanation_mandarin: 指可可粉或用可可粉制成的饮料或食品，通常指巧克力。
explanation_english: Refers to cocoa powder, or drinks or food made with cocoa powder, usually referring to chocolate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想飲杯熱唂咕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 yam2 bui1 jit6 guk1 gu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想喝一杯热可可。
examples.english_sentence: I want to drink a cup of hot cocoa.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲唂咕餅好好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 guk1 gu1 beng2 hou2 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些巧克力饼干很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: These chocolate cookies are very delicious.

english_meaning: courage; guts; nerve; boldness
explanation_mandarin: 指做某事或面对困难时所需的勇气和胆量。
explanation_english: Refers to the courage, guts or nerve needed to do something, especially something difficult or risky.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁都敢做，真係夠嗮唂氣！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 dou1 gam2 zou6, zan1 hai6 gau3 saai3 guk1 hei3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他连这个都敢做，真是太有勇气了！
examples.english_sentence: He even dares to do that, he really has guts!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冇啲唂氣都唔敢喺呢度投資㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou5 di1 guk1 hei3 dou1 m4 gam2 hai2 ni1 dou6 tau4 zi1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没有一点胆量都不敢在这里投资的。
examples.english_sentence: You wouldn't dare invest here without some courage.

english_meaning: to hold in the mouth, to contain, to include
explanation_mandarin: 指东西放在嘴里不咽下，也指包含，含有。
explanation_english: Refers to holding something in the mouth without swallowing, also means to contain, to include.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好唅住啲嘢食，快啲吞落去啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 haam4 zyu6 di1 je5 sik6, faai3 di1 tan1 lok6 heoi3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要含着食物，快点吞下去吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't hold the food in your mouth, swallow it quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢把聲好似唅住舊嘢咁，聽唔清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baa2 seng1 hou2 ci5 haam4 zyu6 gau6 je5 gam2, teng1 m4 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的声音好像含着东西一样，听不清楚。
examples.english_sentence: His voice sounds like he's holding something in his mouth, it's hard to hear clearly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個產品唅有豐富嘅維他命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 caan2 ban2 haam4 jau5 fung1 fu3 ge3 wai4 taa1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个产品含有丰富的维生素。
examples.english_sentence: This product contains abundant vitamins.

english_meaning: stingy, miserly, tight-fisted
explanation_mandarin: 形容人非常吝啬，舍不得花钱。通常指在不必要的地方节省开支，甚至到了抠门的程度。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is extremely stingy and unwilling to spend money. Usually refers to saving expenses in unnecessary areas, even to the point of being miserly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好唅沈，請佢飲杯嘢都唔肯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 ham4 sam4, ceng2 keoi5 yam2 bui1 ye5 dou1 m4 hang2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的很吝啬，请他喝一杯东西都不愿意。
examples.english_sentence: He is really stingy; he's not even willing to buy you a drink.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁唅沈啦，間唔中都要對自己好啲嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 ham4 sam4 laa1, gaan1 m4 zung1 dou1 jiu3 deoi3 zi6 gei2 hou2 di1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么吝啬啦，偶尔也要对自己好一点。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stingy, you should treat yourself well once in a while.

english_meaning: to instigate, to incite, to egg on, to tempt
explanation_mandarin: 指怂恿、挑唆别人做坏事。
explanation_english: To instigate, incite, or egg someone on to do something bad or undesirable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪唆我做啲衰嘢啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 so1 ngo5 zou6 di1 seoi1 je5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要怂恿我做坏事了！
examples.english_sentence: Don't instigate me to do bad things!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日唆人打交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 so1 jan4 daa2 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是怂恿别人打架。
examples.english_sentence: He always incites people to fight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好聽佢唆擺，佢想害你㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 teng1 keoi5 so1 baai2, keoi5 soeng2 hoi6 nei5 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要听他唆使，他想害你啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't listen to his instigation, he wants to harm you!

english_meaning: to instigate, to incite, to egg on
explanation_mandarin: 指背后怂恿、指使他人去做不好的事情。
explanation_english: To instigate or incite someone to do something bad or undesirable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日唆使我唔好做功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 so1 sai2 ngo5 m4 hou2 zou6 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是怂恿我不要做作业。
examples.english_sentence: He always instigates me not to do my homework.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好俾佢唆使你做啲犯法嘅嘢呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 so1 sai2 nei5 zou6 di1 faan6 faat3 ge3 je5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要让他怂恿你做违法的事情啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't let him instigate you to do illegal things!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾朋友唆使去偷嘢，而家後悔都冇用啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 pang4 jau5 so1 sai2 heoi3 tau1 je5, ji4 gaa1 hau6 fui3 dou1 mou5 jung6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被朋友怂恿去偷东西，现在后悔也没用了。
examples.english_sentence: He was instigated by his friend to steal things, and now it's no use regretting it.

english_meaning: to instigate, to incite, to egg on, to coax into doing something
explanation_mandarin: 怂恿别人做坏事或者不好的事情。
explanation_english: To encourage or persuade someone to do something bad or undesirable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好唆擺我做啲我唔想做嘅嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 so1 baai2 ngo5 zou6 di1 ngo5 m4 soeng2 zou6 ge3 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要怂恿我做一些我不想做的事情。
examples.english_sentence: Don't instigate me to do things I don't want to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日唆擺人哋去搞事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 so1 baai2 jan4 dei6 heoi3 gaau2 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是怂恿别人去闹事。
examples.english_sentence: He always eggs people on to make trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好信佢呀，佢成日唆擺人㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 aa3, keoi5 seng4 jat6 so1 baai2 jan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要相信他，他总是怂恿别人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust him, he always instigates people.

english_meaning: lip
explanation_mandarin: 嘴巴的外部边缘部分，主要用于说话、吃东西、亲吻等。
explanation_english: Either of the two fleshy parts forming the edge of the mouth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅嘴唇好紅潤呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zeoi2 seon4 hou2 hung4 jeon6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的嘴唇很红润啊！
examples.english_sentence: Her lips are so red and plump!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咀唇裂咗，搽啲潤唇膏啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zeoi2 seon4 lit6 zo2, caa1 di1 jeon6 seon4 gou1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的嘴唇裂了，涂点润唇膏吧。
examples.english_sentence: Your lips are chapped, put on some lip balm.

english_meaning: If the lips are gone, the teeth will be cold; intimately interdependent; sharing a common fate.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻关系密切，利害相关。一方受损，另一方也要受损。
explanation_english: A metaphor describing a close, interdependent relationship where one side's misfortune will inevitably affect the other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋兩間公司嘅合作關係係唇亡齒寒，一間執笠，另一間都好難維持落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 loeng5 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 hap6 jok3 gwaan1 hai6 hai6 seon4 mong4 ci2 hon4, jat1 gaan1 zap1 laap1, loeng5 jat1 gaan1 dou1 hou2 naan4 wai4 ci4 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们两家公司的合作关系是唇亡齿寒，一家倒闭，另一家也很难维持下去。
examples.english_sentence: The cooperative relationship between our two companies is like lips and teeth, one collapses, and the other will find it hard to continue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港同中國大陸嘅經濟，某程度上都係唇亡齒寒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 tung4 zung1 gwok3 daai6 luk6 ge3 ging1 zai3, mau5 sing4 dou6 soeng5 dou1 hai6 seon4 mong4 ci2 hon4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港和中国大陆的经济，某种程度上都是唇亡齿寒。
examples.english_sentence: To some extent, the economies of Hong Kong and mainland China are interdependent.

english_meaning: lip print, lipstick mark
explanation_mandarin: 嘴唇印在物体上的痕迹，通常指涂了口红的嘴唇留下的印记。
explanation_english: The mark left by lips on a surface, usually referring to a mark left by lipstick-covered lips.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢塊面有幾個唇印，唔知邊個嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faai3 min6 jau5 gei2 go3 seon4 jan3, m4 zi1 bin1 go3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他脸上有好几个唇印，不知道是谁的。
examples.english_sentence: There are several lip prints on his face, I don't know whose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我係佢杯度見到個唇印，即刻知道佢偷食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai6 keoi5 bui1 dou6 gin3 dou2 go3 seon4 jan3, zik1 hak1 zi1 dou3 keoi5 tau1 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在他的杯子上看到了一个唇印，立刻知道他偷吃了。
examples.english_sentence: I saw a lipstick mark on his cup and immediately knew he was cheating.

english_meaning: lip gloss
explanation_mandarin: 一种涂在嘴唇上以增加光泽的化妆品。
explanation_english: A cosmetic product applied to the lips to add shine and sometimes a hint of color.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日搽咗隻好靚嘅唇彩，成個人精神曬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 caa4 zo2 zek3 hou2 leng3 ge3 seon4 coi2, sing4 go3 jan4 zing1 san4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今天涂了很漂亮的唇彩，整个人精神多了。
examples.english_sentence: She wore a very pretty lip gloss today, and it made her look so much more energetic.

synonyms: 唇膏 (seon4 gou1) - lipstick (generally more pigment and less shine)

english_meaning: verbal jousting, heated debate, fierce argument
explanation_mandarin: 形容辩论激烈，针锋相对，像用唇作枪，舌作剑一样。
explanation_english: Describes a fierce debate or argument where the participants engage in sharp, pointed exchanges, using words as weapons (spears and swords).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個為咗呢個問題，喺會議上面唇槍舌劍，嘈得好犀利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 wai6 zo2 ni1 go3 man6 tai4, hai2 wui6 ji5 soeng6 min6 seon4 coeng1 sit3 gim3, cou4 dak1 hou2 sai1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个为了这个问题，在会议上唇枪舌剑，吵得很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: The two of them engaged in a heated debate about this problem at the meeting, arguing fiercely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢場辯論比賽，兩隊嘅代表都唇槍舌劍，互不相讓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 coeng4 bin6 leon6 bei2 coi3, loeng5 deoi2 ge3 doi6 biu2 dou1 seon4 coeng1 sit3 gim3, wu6 bat1 soeng1 joeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这场辩论比赛中，两队的代表都唇枪舌剑，互不相让。
examples.english_sentence: In this debate competition, the representatives of both teams engaged in fierce verbal jousting, neither giving way.

synonyms: 針鋒相對 (zam1 fung1 soeng1 deoi3)

english_meaning: lip liner
explanation_mandarin: 一种化妆品，用于描绘嘴唇轮廓，使唇妆更精致持久。
explanation_english: A cosmetic product used to outline the lips, making lipstick application more precise and long-lasting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我用唇筆描個靚啲嘅唇形。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 yung6 seon4 bat1 miu4 go3 leng3 di1 ge3 seon4 ying4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我用唇线笔描一个更好看的唇形。
examples.english_sentence: I'm using lip liner to draw a more beautiful lip shape.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢支唇筆嘅顏色同我枝唇膏好襯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zi1 seon4 bat1 ge3 ngaan4 sik1 tung4 ngo5 zi1 seon4 gou1 hou2 can3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这支唇线笔的颜色和我的口红很配。
examples.english_sentence: The color of this lip liner matches my lipstick very well.

english_meaning: Lipstick
explanation_mandarin: 一种涂在嘴唇上，使嘴唇颜色鲜艳的化妆品。
explanation_english: A cosmetic product applied to the lips to add color and shine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日搽咗支紅色嘅唇膏，好靚呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 caa4 zo2 zi1 hung4 sik1 ge3 seon4 gou1, hou2 leng3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今天涂了支红色的口红，很漂亮啊！
examples.english_sentence: She put on a red lipstick today, it's very beautiful!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我支唇膏用晒啦，聽日要買返支先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi1 seon4 gou1 jung6 saai3 laa1, ting1 jat6 jiu3 maai5 faan1 zi1 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的口红用完了，明天要买一支才行。
examples.english_sentence: My lipstick is all used up, I have to buy a new one tomorrow.

english_meaning: as close as lips and teeth; interdependent; mutually dependent; closely related
explanation_mandarin: 形容关系密切，互相依存，谁也离不开谁。像嘴唇和牙齿那样互相依靠。比喻互相辅助，互相依存。
explanation_english: Describes a close and interdependent relationship where one cannot exist without the other, like lips and teeth relying on each other. It is an idiom referring to mutual assistance and interdependence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋兩個公司唇齒相依，如果其中一間執咗笠，另一間都好難生存落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 loeng5 go3 gung1 si1 seon4 ci2 soeng1 ji1, jyu4 gwo2 kei4 zung1 jat1 gaan1 zaap1 zo2 lap1, loeng5 jat1 gaan1 dou1 hou2 naan4 sang1 cyun4 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们两家公司唇齿相依，如果其中一家倒闭了，另一家也很难生存下去。
examples.english_sentence: Our two companies are interdependent; if one of them goes bankrupt, the other will also find it difficult to survive.

english_meaning: Sigh; alas; to express regret, disappointment, or resignation
explanation_mandarin: 表示叹息、惋惜、无奈、不满等情绪的语气词。
explanation_english: An interjection used to express a range of emotions including sighing, regret, disappointment, resignation, or mild complaint.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唉，今次考試又肥佬喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ai1, gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 jau6 fei4 lou2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 唉，这次考试又不及格了。
examples.english_sentence: Alas, I failed the exam again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唉，冇計啦，都係咁樣㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ai1, mou5 gai3 laa1, dou1 hai6 gam2 joeng2 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 唉，没办法，就是这样的了。
examples.english_sentence: Sigh, there's nothing I can do, that's just how it is.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唉，遲咗起身，趕唔切返工喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ai1, ci4 zo2 hei2 san1, gon2 m4 cit3 faan1 gung1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 唉，起晚了，赶不上上班了。
examples.english_sentence: Alas, I woke up late, I'm going to be late for work.

english_meaning: Ouch; Oh no!; Oops!
explanation_mandarin: 表示惊讶、疼痛、后悔、失望等情绪的感叹词，语气较轻。
explanation_english: An interjection expressing surprise, pain, regret, disappointment, or other mild emotions. Similar to 'ouch,' 'oh no,' or 'oops' in English.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唉吔！撞到個頭喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ai1 jaa1! zong6 dou2 go3 tau4 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哎呀！撞到头了！
examples.english_sentence: Ouch! I bumped my head!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唉吔！唔記得帶銀包！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ai1 jaa1! m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 ngan4 baau1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哎呀！忘记带钱包了！
examples.english_sentence: Oh no! I forgot to bring my wallet!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唉吔，唔小心整跌咗隻杯！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ai1 jaa1, m4 siu2 sam1 zing2 dit3 zo2 zek3 bui1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哎呀，不小心把杯子打掉了！
