examples.english_sentence: Oops, I accidentally dropped the cup!

english_meaning: Oh damn it!/Damn it!
explanation_mandarin: 表达一种失望、沮丧、生气等负面情绪的感叹词，带有粗俗的语气。“唉”表示叹息或惊讶，“屌”是粗俗的表示不满或愤怒的用语，类似于普通话的“操”。
explanation_english: An interjection expressing disappointment, frustration, anger, or other negative emotions. It's a vulgar expression. "唉 (ai1)" indicates a sigh or surprise. "屌 (diu2)" is a vulgar term expressing dissatisfaction or anger, similar to "操 (cāo)" in Mandarin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唉屌！又唔記得帶銀包！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ai1 diu2! jau6 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 ngan4 baau1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哎呀！操！又忘了带钱包！
examples.english_sentence: Damn it! I forgot to bring my wallet again!

english_meaning: to sigh and groan, to moan and groan, to lament, to complain frequently
explanation_mandarin: 形容因伤感、烦恼等原因而发出叹息的声音。表示情绪低落，抱怨或不满。
explanation_english: Describes the act of sighing and groaning due to sadness, annoyance, or other reasons. It indicates a low mood, complaining, or dissatisfaction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日唉聲嘆氣啦，試下解決問題好過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 ai1 seng1 taan3 hei3 laa1, si3 haa5 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4 hou2 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是唉声叹气了，试着解决问题更好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always moan and groan, it's better to try and solve the problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考得唔好，日日都唉聲嘆氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 dak1 m4 hou2, jat6 jat6 dou1 ai1 seng1 taan3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考得不好，每天都唉声叹气。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't do well in the exam, so he's been sighing and groaning every day.

synonyms: 怨天尤人 (jyun3 tin1 jau4 jan4)
愁眉苦臉 (sau4 mei4 fu2 lim5)

english_meaning: used in slang or dialect; usually with a negative connotation; often added to foreign words or concepts to make them sound negative or less desirable; sometimes used as a meaningless syllable
explanation_mandarin: 粤语口语中，常带贬义或轻蔑语气，有时无实际意义，常用于外来语的音译，使其听起来不那么好。
explanation_english: In Cantonese slang, often carries a negative or contemptuous tone. Sometimes it has no actual meaning. It is often used in the transliteration of foreign words to make them sound less desirable or negative.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日著啲老唎茄衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zoek3 di1 lou5 li1 ke2 saa1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是穿一些老土的茄色衣服。
examples.english_sentence: He always wears some old-fashioned, purplish-red clothes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲人話香港電影越來越老唎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jan4 waa6 hoeng1 gong2 din6 ying2 jyut6 lai5 jyut6 lou5 li1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人们说香港电影越来越老套。
examples.english_sentence: People say Hong Kong movies are becoming more and more outdated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁唎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 li1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么土气啦。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so unstylish/uncool.

mandarin_meaning: 表示轻微的叹息或不屑
english_meaning: sigh, express mild disdain or disappointment
explanation_mandarin: 表示轻微的叹息、失望、不屑等情绪。有时也用作语气助词，表示语气缓和。
explanation_english: Used to express a slight sigh, disappointment, mild disdain, or a gentle tone. Sometimes it's used as a particle to soften the tone of a sentence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唏，又係咁嘅結果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1, jau6 hai6 gam2 ge3 git3 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 唉，又是这样的结果。
examples.english_sentence: Sigh, it's the same result again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唏，算啦，下次再努力啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1, syun3 laa1, haa6 ci3 zoi3 nu5 lik6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 唉，算了，下次再努力吧。
examples.english_sentence: Oh well, never mind, let's try harder next time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做，唏，真係唔啱嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6, hei1, zan1 hai6 m4 ngaam1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做，唉，真是不对的。
examples.english_sentence: The way you do it, sigh, is really not right.

english_meaning: to sigh; to lament; to heave a sigh (of regret, sadness, etc.); to express regret or sadness
explanation_mandarin: 表示叹息、感慨，常用于表达对事物变迁、时间流逝等的感叹。
explanation_english: Expressing a sigh or lament, often used to express emotions about the passage of time, changes in things, or past events.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 諗返起以前啲嘢，真係令人唏噓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nam2 faan1 hei2 ji5 cin4 di1 je5, zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 hei1 heoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 回想起以前的事情，真是令人唏嘘。
examples.english_sentence: Thinking back to the past, it really makes one sigh.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅遭遇令人覺得好唏噓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ziu1 geoi6 ling6 jan4 gok3 dak1 hou2 hei1 heoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的遭遇让人觉得很唏嘘。
examples.english_sentence: His experiences make people feel very sad and regretful.

english_meaning: stupid, foolish, dumb
explanation_mandarin: 形容人愚笨，反应迟钝。在粤语口语中，常用于骂人。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone as stupid, foolish, or slow-witted. In Cantonese colloquial speech, it is often used as an insult.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁唐嘅？呢啲嘢都唔識做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 tong4 ge3? ni1 di1 je5 dou1 m4 sik1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么笨？这些东西都不会做。
examples.english_sentence: Are you that stupid? You can't even do these things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁唐啦，醒醒定定啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 tong4 laa1, sing2 sing2 ding6 ding6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么蠢了，清醒一点！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so dumb, wake up and be alert!

english_meaning: Chinese person (especially referring to overseas Chinese)
explanation_mandarin: 指海外的华人或中国人，尤其是在海外定居的华人。有时也泛指中国人。
explanation_english: Refers to overseas Chinese, especially those who have settled abroad. Sometimes it also refers to Chinese people in general.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊金山嘅唐人街好出名㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 gam1 saan1 ge3 tong4 yan4 gaai1 hou2 ceot1 ming4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 旧金山的唐人街很有名。
examples.english_sentence: Chinatown in San Francisco is very famous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個喺美國出世嘅唐人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 hai2 mei5 gwok3 ceot1 sai3 ge3 tong4 yan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一个在美国出生的华人。
examples.english_sentence: He is a Chinese person born in America.

english_meaning: Chinatown
explanation_mandarin: 指海外华人聚居的地区，通常有中国餐馆、商店等。
explanation_english: A district in a non-Chinese city, inhabited predominantly by people of Chinese origin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去唐人街食飯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan1 heoi3 tong4 yan4 gaai1 sik6 faan6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚去唐人街吃饭吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to Chinatown for dinner tonight.

english_meaning: person with Down syndrome
explanation_mandarin: 指患有唐氏综合征的人。
explanation_english: A term referring to a person with Down syndrome. This term is considered outdated and potentially offensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲人會叫佢哋做唐仔，但係依家通常會用「唐氏綜合症患者」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 jan4 wui5 giu3 keoi5 dei6 zou6 tong4 zai2, daan6 hai6 ji1 gaa1 tung1 soeng4 wui5 jung6 "tong4 si6 zung1 hap6 zing3 waan6 ze2".
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前人们会叫他们唐仔，但是现在通常会用“唐氏综合征患者”。
examples.english_sentence: People used to call them 'Tong Zai', but nowadays they usually use 'person with Down syndrome'.

english_meaning: Mainland China
explanation_mandarin: 指中国大陆，尤其是在香港的语境下。在早期香港，很多移民来自中国大陆，所以用“唐山”代指中国大陆。
explanation_english: Refers to Mainland China, especially in the context of Hong Kong. In early Hong Kong, many immigrants came from Mainland China, so '唐山' is used as a synonym for Mainland China.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿爺係唐山落嚟嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 je4 hai6 tong4 saan1 lok6 lai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我爷爷是从中国大陆来的。
examples.english_sentence: My grandfather came from Mainland China.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都話唐山啲嘢平啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 waa6 tong4 saan1 di1 je5 peng4 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说中国大陆的东西便宜一些。
examples.english_sentence: He always says things in Mainland China are cheaper.

english_meaning: Old-style Chinese tenement building
explanation_mandarin: 指香港、澳门等地在二战前后建造的，一般为多层、没有电梯的旧式楼房，通常具有骑楼等建筑特色。
explanation_english: Refers to old-style tenement buildings, typically multi-story and without elevators, built in Hong Kong, Macau, and other places before and after World War II. They often feature architectural characteristics such as shophouses (骑楼).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣我住喺油麻地嘅一間唐樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2陣ngo5 zyu6 hai2 jau4 maa4 dei2 ge3 jat1 gaan1 tong4 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候我住在油麻地的一栋唐楼里。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, I lived in a Tang Lau (old-style tenement building) in Yau Ma Tei.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多唐樓都冇電梯，行樓梯好辛苦㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 tong4 lau2 dou1 mou5 din6 tai3, haang4 lau2 tai1 hou2 san1 fu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多唐楼都没有电梯，走楼梯很辛苦的。
examples.english_sentence: Many Tang Lau buildings don't have elevators, climbing the stairs is very tiring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唐樓嘅騎樓好有特色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tong4 lau2 ge3 kei4 lau2 hou2 jau5 dak6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 唐楼的骑楼很有特色。
examples.english_sentence: The shophouses of Tang Lau buildings are very distinctive.

mandarin_meaning: 唐氏综合征，也称21三体综合征
english_meaning: Down syndrome, also known as Trisomy 21
explanation_mandarin: 唐氏综合征，一种由第21号染色体异常引起先天性疾病，导致智力发育迟缓和一些身体特征。
explanation_english: Down syndrome, a genetic disorder caused by the presence of all or part of a third copy of chromosome 21, resulting in intellectual disability and characteristic physical features.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢哋個BB有機會係唐氏綜合症。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yi1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 dei6 go3 bi1 bi1 jau5 gei1 wui2 hai6 tong4 si6 zung1 hap6 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说他们的宝宝有可能患有唐氏综合征。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said there is a chance that their baby has Down syndrome.

english_meaning: Mongrel dog; mixed-breed dog; stray dog; (sometimes derogatory) native dog
explanation_mandarin: 指血统不纯正的狗，通常指本地的、混血的土狗。在香港，也常指被遗弃的流浪狗。有时带有贬义。
explanation_english: Refers to a dog of mixed or unknown parentage; a mongrel. It often refers to local or mixed-breed dogs, especially in Hong Kong. It can also refer to stray or abandoned dogs. Sometimes used in a derogatory way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢屋企養咗隻唐狗，好乖㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 uk1 kei5 joeng5 zo2 zek3 tong4 gau2, hou2 gwaai1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他家养了一只土狗，很乖的。
examples.english_sentence: They have a mongrel dog at home, it's very well-behaved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好歧視唐狗，佢哋一樣可以好忠心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 kei4 si6 tong4 gau2, keoi5 dei6 jat1 joeng2 ho2 ji5 hou2 zung1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要歧视土狗，它们一样可以很忠诚。
examples.english_sentence: Don't discriminate against mongrels, they can be just as loyal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多唐狗都喺街邊流浪，好慘㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 tong4 gau2 dou1 hai2 gaai1 bin1 lau4 long6, hou2 caam2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多土狗都在街边流浪，很可怜的。
examples.english_sentence: Many mongrel dogs are wandering on the streets, it's so pitiful.

english_meaning: Chinese lettuce, Celtuce, Stem lettuce
explanation_mandarin: 一种蔬菜，茎可食用，叶子也可食用，味道清淡。
explanation_english: A type of lettuce with a thick edible stem and leaves. It has a mild flavour.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日落街買咗棵唐生菜，今晚炒嚟食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 lok6 gaai1 maai5 zo2 po1 tong4 sang1 coi3, gam1 maan1 caau2 lai4 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天下楼买了棵莴笋，今晚炒来吃。
examples.english_sentence: I went downstairs to buy a Celtuce today. I'll stir-fry it for dinner tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意食唐生菜，貪佢夠爽脆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 tong4 sang1 coi3, taam1 keoi5 gau3 song2 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢吃莴笋，因为很爽脆。
examples.english_sentence: I like eating Celtuce because it's crunchy.

english_meaning: abrupt; tactless; rude; sudden; impolite
explanation_mandarin: 指言语或行为不顾及场合或对象，显得鲁莽、冒失。
explanation_english: Describes speech or behavior that disregards the occasion or the person being addressed, appearing rash, impudent, or sudden and unexpected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣問人屋企啲嘢，好唐突㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 man6 jan4 uk1 kei2 di1 je5, hou2 tong4 dat6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样问别人家里的事情，很冒昧的。
examples.english_sentence: It's very rude of you to ask about someone's family affairs like that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔熟，你問我幾多歲，好唐突喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 suk6, nei5 man6 ngo5 gei2 do1 seoi3, hou2 tong4 dat6 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不熟，你问我几岁，很冒昧。
examples.english_sentence: We're not close, it's quite abrupt to ask me how old I am.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唐突噉衝入嚟，嚇咗我一跳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tong4 dat6 gam2 cung1 jap6 lai4, haak3 zo2 ngo5 jat1 tiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他突然地冲进来，吓了我一跳。
examples.english_sentence: He rushed in abruptly and startled me.

english_meaning: Chinese celery
explanation_mandarin: 一种芹菜，与西芹相比，茎较细，叶子较多，味道也更浓郁。
explanation_english: A type of celery with thinner stalks, more leaves, and a stronger flavor compared to Western celery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意用唐芹炒牛肉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 yung6 tong4 kan4 caau2 ngau4 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢用芹菜炒牛肉。
examples.english_sentence: I like to stir-fry beef with Chinese celery.

english_meaning: Chinese tea
explanation_mandarin: 指中国出产的茶叶，区别于外国或其他地方的茶叶。
explanation_english: Chinese tea, referring to tea that originates from China, distinguishing it from tea from other countries or regions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飲啖唐茶，潤下喉嚨先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yam2 daam6 tong4 caa4, jeon6 haa5 hau4 lung4 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喝一口中国茶，先润润嗓子。
examples.english_sentence: Have a sip of Chinese tea, to moisten the throat first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間酒樓嘅唐茶幾好飲㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 zau2 lau4 ge3 tong4 caa4 gei2 hou2 yam2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家酒楼的中国茶很好喝。
examples.english_sentence: The Chinese tea in this restaurant is quite delicious.

english_meaning: Tang suit, Chinese jacket
explanation_mandarin: 指具有中国传统风格的服装，通常为对襟立领的上衣或套装。
explanation_english: Refers to Chinese traditional style clothing, usually a jacket or a suit with a mandarin collar and a front opening.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年嗰陣，好多人都會着唐衫拜年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 go2 zan6, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 wui5 zoek3 tong4 saam1 baai3 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年的时候，很多人都会穿唐装拜年。
examples.english_sentence: During Chinese New Year, many people wear Tang suits to pay New Year visits.

english_meaning: Tang suit, Chinese suit
explanation_mandarin: 一种具有中国传统风格的服装，通常指清朝时期改良后的款式，具有立领、对襟等特点。
explanation_english: A traditional Chinese style of clothing, typically referring to the modified version from the Qing dynasty, characterized by a mandarin collar and a front closure with toggles or buttons.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年嘅時候，好多人都會著唐裝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 ge3 si4 hau6, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 wui5 zoek3 tong4 zong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年的时候，很多人都会穿唐装。
examples.english_sentence: During the Lunar New Year, many people wear Tang suits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嗰套唐裝好靚啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go2 tou3 tong4 zong1 hou2 leng3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的那套唐装很漂亮啊。
examples.english_sentence: His Tang suit is very beautiful.

english_meaning: Tang poetry (poetry of the Tang Dynasty)
explanation_mandarin: 指唐朝（公元618年－907年）创作的诗歌。唐诗是中国古典诗歌的巅峰之一，涌现了许多著名的诗人，如李白、杜甫、王维等。
explanation_english: Refers to the poetry created during the Tang Dynasty (618-907 AD). Tang poetry is one of the peaks of classical Chinese poetry and produced many famous poets, such as Li Bai, Du Fu, and Wang Wei.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣阿媽成日教我背唐詩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 aa3 maa1 seng4 jat6 gaau3 ngo5 bui6 tong4 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候妈妈经常教我背唐诗。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, my mother often taught me to recite Tang poems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最鍾意李白嘅唐詩，覺得佢嘅詩好有氣勢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 lei5 baak6 ge3 tong4 si1, gok3 dak1 keoi5 ge3 si1 hou2 jau5 hei3 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最喜欢李白的唐诗，觉得他的诗很有气势。
examples.english_sentence: I like Li Bai's Tang poetry the most, I think his poems are very imposing.

english_meaning: Cantonese
explanation_mandarin: “唐話”是舊時對粵語的一種稱呼。在現代，通常是指廣東話，主要在香港、澳門、廣東省和海外華人社區中使用。
explanation_english: "Tang waa" is an old term for Cantonese. Nowadays, it generally refers to Cantonese, a Chinese language mainly spoken in Hong Kong, Macau, Guangdong Province, and overseas Chinese communities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你識唔識講唐話呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sik1 m4 sik1 gong2 tong4 waa2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你会不会说粤语啊？
examples.english_sentence: Do you know how to speak Cantonese?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅唐話好流利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 tong4 waa2 hou2 lau4 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的粤语很流利。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks Cantonese fluently.

english_meaning: Mixed-breed cat, stray cat, tabby cat (often refers to non-pedigree domestic cats)
explanation_mandarin: 指非纯种的，血统不纯正的猫，通常是流浪猫或家养的土猫。在香港，也常指身上有虎斑花纹的猫。
explanation_english: Refers to a non-purebred cat, a cat of mixed lineage, often a stray or a common domestic cat. In Hong Kong, it often refers to tabby cats (cats with stripe patterns).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺街執咗隻唐貓返嚟養。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 gaai1 zap1 zo2 zek3 tong4 maau1 faan1 lai4 joeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在街上捡了一只土猫回来养。
examples.english_sentence: I picked up a stray cat on the street and brought it home to raise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢屋企養咗好多隻唐貓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 uk1 kei5 joeng5 zo2 hou2 do1 zek3 tong4 maau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他家里养了很多只土猫。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps a lot of mixed-breed cats at home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲唐貓好得意㗎，性格又溫馴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 tong4 maau1 hou2 dak1 ji3 gaa3, sing3 gaak3 jau6 wan1 seon4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 土猫很可爱的，性格又温顺。
examples.english_sentence: Mixed-breed cats are very cute and have gentle personalities.

english_meaning: General store selling Chinese goods; Store selling mainland Chinese products
explanation_mandarin: 指售卖来自中国大陆（唐山）的货物的商店。旧时香港多见，现今逐渐减少，多指售卖传统日用品、食品的店铺。
explanation_english: Refers to a store selling goods from mainland China (Tangshan is often used as a general term for China). Common in old Hong Kong, but gradually decreasing in number. Now often refers to shops selling traditional daily necessities and food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前屋企附近有好多唐貨舖，乜嘢都有得賣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 uk1 kei2 fan6 gan6 jau5 hou2 do1 tong4 fo3 pou2, mat1 je5 dou1 jau5 dak1 maai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前我家附近有很多国货商店，什么都有卖。
examples.english_sentence: There used to be many general stores selling Chinese goods near my house, they sold everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好少見到唐貨舖喇，啲超級市場乜都有。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 siu2 gin3 dou2 tong4 fo3 pou2 laa1, di1 ciu1 kap1 si5 coeng4 mat1 je5 dou1 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很少见到国货商店了，超市里什么都有。
examples.english_sentence: Now it's rare to see general stores selling Chinese goods, supermarkets have everything.

english_meaning: Chinese food; Chinese cuisine
explanation_mandarin: 指中国菜肴。
explanation_english: Refers to Chinese cuisine or dishes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚食唐餐好唔好？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 sik6 tong4 caan1 hou2 m4 hou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚吃中餐好不好？
examples.english_sentence: Shall we have Chinese food tonight?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間唐餐館啲點心好好食㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 tong4 caan1 gun2 di1 dim2 sam1 hou2 hou2 sik6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家中餐馆的点心很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The dim sum at this Chinese restaurant is very delicious.

english_meaning: Tchaw! (sound of dismissal, disbelief, or contempt)
explanation_mandarin: 表示不屑、怀疑或轻蔑的语气词，常带有一种不相信或不认同的情绪。
explanation_english: An interjection expressing disbelief, skepticism, or contempt. It often implies a feeling of not believing or disagreeing with what someone has said.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話自己好有錢，唓！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 zi6 gei2 hou2 jau5 cin2, ce1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说自己很有钱，切！
examples.english_sentence: He says he's very rich, Tchaw!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唓，你又識啲乜嘢呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ce1, nei5 jau6 sik1 di1 mat1 je5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 切，你又懂什么呀？
examples.english_sentence: Tchaw, what do you know anyway?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唓！信你一成雙目失明啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ce1! seon3 nei5 jat1 sing4 soeng1 muk6 sat1 ming4 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 切！相信你一成，两只眼睛都要瞎了！
examples.english_sentence: Tchaw! If I believed even 10% of what you say, I'd go blind!

english_meaning: not
explanation_mandarin: 否定副词，表示否定，相当于普通话的“不”。
explanation_english: Negative adverb, expressing negation, equivalent to 'not' in English.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔知啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zi1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不知道啊。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔喺度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 hai2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不在。
examples.english_sentence: He is not here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該晒！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1晒！
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢你！
examples.english_sentence: Thank you very much!

mandarin_meaning: 不做； 不想做； 不参与
english_meaning: Not to do; Don't want to do; Opt out; Not participating
explanation_mandarin: 「唔do」是一个粤语口语，直接从英语「do」音译而来。表示「不做」、「不想做」、「不参与」等含义，通常用于表达拒绝或不情愿。
explanation_english: "唔do" is a Cantonese slang term directly transliterated from the English word "do". It means "not to do", "don't want to do", "opt out", or "not participating". It's commonly used to express refusal or unwillingness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚要OT，我唔do呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 jiu3 OT, ngo5 m4 dou1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚要加班，我不做！
examples.english_sentence: I have to work overtime tonight, I'm not doing it!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲咁cheap嘅嘢，我唔do嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 gam3 cheap ge3 je5, ngo5 m4 dou1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些这么廉价的东西，我不做的。
examples.english_sentence: I won't do these cheap things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋搞埋啲咁嘅嘢，我唔do㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaau2 maai4 di1 gam2 ge3 je5, ngo5 m4 dou1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们搞那些事情，我不参与的。
examples.english_sentence: I won't participate in what they're doing.

mandarin_meaning: 不舒服, 不适应, 不喜欢
english_meaning: uncomfortable, awkward, uneasy, to not sit well (with someone), to feel out of place, to dislike (something or someone)
explanation_mandarin: 指感觉不舒服、不自在、不适应，或者对某人某事感到不喜欢、反感。
explanation_english: Refers to a feeling of discomfort, awkwardness, or uneasiness; it can also describe a feeling of dislike or aversion towards something or someone. The feeling can be due to the environment, the person, or the situation itself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺佢哋面前覺得好唔gur。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 keoi5 dei6 min6 cin4 gok3 dak1 hou2 m4 gu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在他们面前觉得很不自在。
examples.english_sentence: I feel very uncomfortable in front of them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間房咁細，住得好唔gur。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 fong2 gam3 sai3, zyu6 dak1 hou2 m4 gu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房间这么小，住得很不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: This room is so small, it's very uncomfortable to live in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好假，我好唔gur佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 yan4 hou2 gaa2, ngo5 hou2 m4 gu1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他人很虚伪，我很不喜欢他。
examples.english_sentence: He's very fake, I really dislike him.

mandarin_meaning: 不行/不可以 (不能直接翻译，需要根据语境)
english_meaning: Not allowed/Not possible/Cannot (depending on context, used to indicate impossibility or prohibition)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 副词/助词 (根据具体情况)
explanation_mandarin: 表示否定，强调某件事是不行、不允许或不可能实现的。中间的省略号表示需要根据具体语境来补充，可以是动词、形容词或其他成分，以表达完整的否定意义。
explanation_english: Used to express negation, emphasizing that something is not allowed, impossible, or not feasible. The ellipsis indicates that the expression needs to be completed with a verb, adjective, or other element depending on the specific context to convey the complete negative meaning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔掂得！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 dim1 dak1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不行！
examples.english_sentence: No way!/Not allowed!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔瞓覺得㗎，聽日要返工㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 fan3 gaau3 dak1 gaa3, ting1 jat6 jiu3 faan1 gung1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不睡觉不行啊，明天要上班的。
examples.english_sentence: I can't not sleep, I have to go to work tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔可以唔嚟得㗎，個個都嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 ho2 ji5 m4 lai4 dak1 gaa3, go3 go3 dou1 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不可以不来啊，每个人都来的。
examples.english_sentence: You can't not come, everyone is coming.

english_meaning: Even if not... still already...
explanation_mandarin: 表示一种即使没有达到某种预期的情况，结果也已经发生了。强调事情已经发生，结果已经产生，即使条件不完全满足。
explanation_english: Indicates that even if a certain expected situation hasn't been fully achieved, the result has already occurred. It emphasizes that the event has already happened and the result has already been produced, even if the conditions are not completely met.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔溫書都合格咗，真係好好彩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 wan1 syu1 dou1 hap6 gaak3 zo2, zan1 hai6 hou2 hou2 coi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 即使不复习都及格了，真是太幸运了。
examples.english_sentence: Even if I didn't study, I still passed. I'm so lucky!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔落雨都濕晒，天氣真係好鬼熱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 lok6 jyu5 dou1 sap1晒, tin1 hei3 zan1 hai6 hou2 gwai2 jit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 即使不下雨也湿透了，天气真是太热了。
examples.english_sentence: Even if it doesn't rain, I'm already soaked. The weather is really hot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使佢幫手，我都搞掂咗啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 keoi5 bong1 sau2, ngo5 dou1 gaau2 dim6 zo2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 即使不需要他帮忙，我也已经搞定了。
examples.english_sentence: Even if I didn't need his help, I've already finished it.

mandarin_meaning: 不正经，不伦不类，不像样
english_meaning: neither one thing nor another; neither fish nor fowl; improper; indecent; not proper; out of line; borderline
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人或事物不正经，不伦不类，不合规范或标准。多用于批评人的行为举止不端庄或不规范。
explanation_english: Describes a person or thing that is improper, out of line, or does not conform to standards. It is often used to criticize a person's behavior or mannerisms as being undignified or not conforming to standards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日着啲唔三唔四嘅衫去返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zoek3 di1 m4 saam1 m4 sei3 ge3 saam1 heoi3 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是穿一些不正经的衣服去上班。
examples.english_sentence: He always wears improper clothes to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘢唔好咁唔三唔四啦，正經啲得唔得啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 je5 m4 hou2 gam3 m4 saam1 m4 sei3 laa1, zing3 ging1 di1 dak1 m4 dak1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说话不要这么不正经，正经点行不行啊？
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk so improperly, can you be more serious?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢齣戲嘅劇情有啲唔三唔四，唔知想表達啲乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 cheut1 hei3 ge3 kek6 ching4 jau5 di1 m4 saam1 m4 sei3, m4 zhi1 dou3 soeng2 biu2 daat6 di1 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部戏的剧情有点不伦不类，不知道想表达些什么。
examples.english_sentence: The plot of this drama is a bit neither here nor there, I don't know what it wants to express.

synonyms: 吊兒郎當 (diu3 ji4 long4 dong3)

english_meaning: neither up nor down; stuck in between; in a limbo
explanation_mandarin: 形容处在一个进退两难、不上不下的状态。多指情况、心情、处境等。
explanation_english: Describes a state of being neither up nor down, in a limbo, or stuck in between. It often refers to situations, moods, or circumstances where progress is difficult or impossible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家個市況唔上唔落，真係唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 go3 si5 fong3 m4 soeng5 m4 lok6, zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的市场不上不下，真不知道怎么办才好。
examples.english_sentence: The market is neither up nor down right now, I really don't know what to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份工做得唔上唔落，好冇癮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 zou6 dak1 m4 soeng5 m4 lok6, hou2 mou5 jan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工作做得不上不下，很没意思。
examples.english_sentence: His job is neither progressing nor getting worse, it's very boring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事搞到唔上唔落，唔知點收科。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 gaau2 dou3 m4 soeng5 m4 lok6, m4 zi1 dim2 sau1 fo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 事情搞得不上不下，不知道怎么收场。
examples.english_sentence: The matter has been handled in a way that it's stuck in limbo, I don't know how to finish it.

english_meaning: useless; no good; ineffective; incompetent
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人或某事物没有用处，达不到预期效果。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something that is useless, ineffective, or fails to achieve the desired result.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電腦舊到已經唔中用㗎啦，換過部新嘅啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 nou5 gau6 dou3 ji5 ging1 m4 zung3 yung6 gaa3 laa1, wun6 gwo3 bou6 san1 ge3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台电脑太旧了，已经没用了，换一台新的吧。
examples.english_sentence: This computer is too old and useless. Let's get a new one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好懶，做嘢又唔上心，真係唔中用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 yan4 hou2 laan5, zou6嘢 jau6 m4 soeng5 sam1, zan1 hai6 m4 zung3 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很懒，工作又不认真，真没用。
examples.english_sentence: He's a lazy person and doesn't take his work seriously. He's really useless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲方法已經唔中用，試下其他嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 fong1 faat3 ji5 ging1 m4 zung3 yung6, si3 haa5 kei4 taa1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些方法已经没用了，试试其他的。
examples.english_sentence: These methods are no longer effective. Try some other ones.

english_meaning: unlike; not like; doesn't resemble; unlikely; improbable
explanation_mandarin: 表示不像，不相似；也指不像樣，不可能。
explanation_english: Indicates a lack of resemblance or similarity; can also mean unlikely or improbable. It expresses that something does not resemble something else or that an event is unlikely to happen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個樣唔似佢阿爸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 joeng2 m4 ci5 keoi5 aa3 baa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他长得不像他爸爸。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't look like his father.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚落雨嘅機會唔似好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 lok6 jyu5 ge3 gei1 wui2 m4 ci5 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚下雨的可能性不大。
examples.english_sentence: It's unlikely to rain tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘅嘢唔似真嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 ge3 je5 m4 ci5 zan1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说的东西不太像真的。
examples.english_sentence: What you said doesn't seem true.

english_meaning: not like; not as good as; incomparable (often used negatively, implying someone or something is inferior)
explanation_mandarin: 表示与某事物或某人相比，显得不如；也用于表示不像样，不好。
explanation_english: Expressing that someone or something is inferior or not as good as another. Also used to describe something that is not up to par or undesirable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢讀書唔似得佢家姐咁叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 duk6 syu1 m4 ci5 dak1 keoi5 gaa1 ze1 gam3 lek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他读书不如他姐姐那么聪明。
examples.english_sentence: He's not as smart at studying as his older sister.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲貨嘅質素唔似得以前咁好啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 fo3 ge3 zat1 so3 m4 ci5 dak1 ji5 cin4 gam3 hou2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些货品的质量不如以前那么好了。
examples.english_sentence: The quality of these goods is not as good as it used to be.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢唔似得人哋咁積極嘅？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 m4 ci5 dak1 jan4 dei6 gam3 zik1 gik1 ge3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你工作不像别人那么积极吗？
examples.english_sentence: Aren't you as proactive as others at work?

english_meaning: unpresentable; disgraceful; shameful; awful; not looking good; in a bad state
explanation_mandarin: 指某事物或某人表现得不好，令人不满意，丢脸。形容状态很差，或者行为不端庄。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone that is unpresentable, disgraceful, shameful, awful, or in a bad state. It implies that the appearance or behavior is not satisfactory and is embarrassing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇下你，成身污糟邋遢，真係唔似樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 haa5 nei5, seng4 san1 wu1 zou1 laat6 taat3, zan1 hai6 m4 ci5 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看看你，全身脏兮兮的，真是不像样。
examples.english_sentence: Look at you, you're all dirty and scruffy, it's really unpresentable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公眾地方咁大聲講電話，真係唔似樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 zung3 dei6 fong1 gam3 daai6 seng1 gong2 din6 waa2, zan1 hai6 m4 ci5 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公共场合那么大声打电话，真是不像样。
examples.english_sentence: He's talking on the phone so loudly in a public place, it's really disgraceful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋咁亂，唔執拾下，都唔似樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 gam3 lyun6, m4 zap1 sap6 haa5, dou1 m4 ci5 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间屋子这么乱，不收拾一下，都不像样。
examples.english_sentence: This house is so messy, if you don't tidy it up, it's unpresentable.

synonyms: 唔見得人 (m4 gin3 dak1 jan4)

english_meaning: no need; not necessary; don't have to
explanation_mandarin: 表示不需要，不必。
explanation_english: Expresses the absence of need or obligation; not necessary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使客氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 haak3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用客气。
examples.english_sentence: You're welcome; Don't mention it; No need to be polite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔使嚟咁早嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 sai2 lai4 gam3 zou2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不用来这么早的。
examples.english_sentence: You don't need to come so early.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔使幫手，我自己搞得掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 sai2 bong1 sau2, ngo5 zi6 gei2 gaau2 dak1 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不需要帮忙，我自己能搞定。
examples.english_sentence: I don't need help, I can handle it myself.

english_meaning: You're welcome; No problem; Don't mention it.
explanation_mandarin: 表示不用客气，相当于“不用谢”或者“没关系”。在对方表达感谢时使用，回应客套。
explanation_english: Used as a polite response after someone thanks you for something. Similar to "You're welcome" or "Don't mention it." Expresses that no further thanks are necessary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你幫我攞埋啲嘢啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 bong1 ngo5 lo2 maai4 di1 je5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢你帮我拿了东西！
examples.english_sentence: Thank you for helping me carry the stuff!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使唔該，舉手之勞啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 m4 goi1, geoi2 sau2 zi1 lou4 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用谢，举手之劳而已。
examples.english_sentence: You're welcome, it was nothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使唔該，我哋係朋友嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 m4 goi1, ngo5 dei6 hai6 pang4 jau5 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用谢，我们是朋友嘛。
examples.english_sentence: You're welcome, we're friends.

synonyms: 唔使客氣 (m4 sai2 haak3 hei3)

english_meaning: It's obvious; it goes without saying; no need to ask.
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情非常明显，不需要再询问或讨论。
explanation_english: Used to describe something that is extremely obvious, so there's no need to ask or discuss it further. It emphasizes the clarity and certainty of a situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇佢個樣都知佢唔開心啦，唔使問阿桂㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 keoi5 go3 joeng2 dou1 zi1 keoi5 m4 hoi1 sam1 laa1, m4 sai2 man6 aa3 gwai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看他的样子就知道他不开心了，这还用问吗？
examples.english_sentence: Just looking at him, you can tell he's not happy. It's obvious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁鍾意打機，贏咗比賽都唔使問阿桂啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 zung1 ji3 daa2 gei1, wing4 zo2 bei2 coi3 dou1 m4 sai2 man6 aa3 gwai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那么喜欢玩游戏，赢了比赛是理所当然的。
examples.english_sentence: He loves playing video games so much. It's obvious he'd win the competition.

english_meaning: It goes without saying; it's obvious; it's self-evident
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情非常明显，不需要询问或怀疑。
explanation_english: This idiom means that something is very obvious and requires no further questioning or doubt. It's akin to saying something is a given or a foregone conclusion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁錫你，實會幫你㗎啦，唔使問阿貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 sek3 nei5, sat1 wui5 bong1 nei5 gaa3 laa1, m4 sai2 man6 aa3 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那么疼你，肯定会帮你的，不用问。
examples.english_sentence: He loves you so much; he'll definitely help you. It goes without saying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都嚟探你，擺明鍾意你啦，唔使問阿貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 lai4 taam3 nei5, baai2 ming4 zung1 ji3 nei5 laa1, m4 sai2 man6 aa3 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都来看你，明显是喜欢你，不用问。
examples.english_sentence: He visits you every day. It's obvious that he likes you. It goes without saying.

english_meaning: No need to come; don't bother coming
explanation_mandarin: 表示不需要对方过来，通常带有婉拒或取消约定的意味。
explanation_english: Expresses that there's no need for someone to come. It often implies a polite refusal or cancellation of an arrangement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日落大雨，你唔使嚟幫手啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 lok6 daai6 jyu5, nei5 m4 sai2 lai4 bong1 sau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天下大雨，你不用来帮忙了。
examples.english_sentence: It's raining heavily tomorrow, no need for you to come help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我搞得掂，你唔使嚟啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gaau2 dak1 dim6, nei5 m4 sai2 lai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我能搞定，你不用来了。
examples.english_sentence: I can handle it, no need for you to come.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經搞掂咗，你唔使嚟接我啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 gaau2 dim6 zo2, nei5 m4 sai2 lai4 zip3 ngo5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已经搞定了，你不用来接我了。
examples.english_sentence: I've already finished, no need for you to come pick me up.

english_meaning: You're welcome; Don't mention it; No problem
explanation_mandarin: 表示不用客气，是回应感谢的常用语。
explanation_english: A common phrase used as a polite response to someone thanking you. It expresses that no gratitude is necessary or that the speaker was happy to help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你幫我搬嘢呀！ 唔使客氣！
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 bong1 ngo5 bun1 je5 aa3! m4 sai2 haak3 hei3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢你帮我搬东西！ 不用客气！
examples.english_sentence: Thank you for helping me move things! You're welcome!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該晒！ 唔使客氣，舉手之勞啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 saai3! m4 sai2 haak3 hei3, geoi2 sau2 zi1 lou4 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 非常感谢！ 不用客气，只是举手之劳而已。
examples.english_sentence: Thank you so much! Don't mention it, it was just a small favor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 真係唔該你！ 唔使客氣啦，下次有咩幫到你儘管出聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zan1 hai6 m4 goi1 nei5! m4 sai2 haak3 hei3 laa1, haa6 ci3 jau5 me1 bong1 dou2 nei5 zeon2 gun2 ceot1 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 真的谢谢你！ 不用客气啦，下次有什么能帮到你的尽管说。
examples.english_sentence: Really thank you! You're welcome, just let me know next time if there's anything I can help you with.

mandarin_meaning: 不用审问；没问题；绝对没问题
english_meaning: No need to interrogate; no problem; absolutely no problem; a done deal; you can count on it
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情确定无疑，不需要进一步询问或调查；形容绝对没有问题，可以放心。
explanation_english: It indicates that something is certain and does not require further questioning or investigation. It describes that there is absolutely no problem and you can rest assured.  It can also mean 'a done deal' or 'you can count on it'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我搞掂曬啦，唔使審！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gaau2 dim6 saai3 laa3, m4 sai2 sam2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已经全部搞定了，没问题！
examples.english_sentence: I've already handled everything, no problem!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你放心啦，呢件事交俾我，唔使審！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 fong3 sam1 laa1, ni1 gin6 si6 gaau1 bei2 ngo5, m4 sai2 sam2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你放心吧，这件事交给我，绝对没问题！
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry, leave this matter to me, you can count on it!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢，唔使審，肯定係真嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5, m4 sai2 sam2, hang2 ding6 hai6 zan1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话，不用审问，肯定是真的。
examples.english_sentence: What he said, no need to interrogate, it's definitely true.

mandarin_meaning: 不用羡慕; 没必要羡慕
english_meaning: No need to envy; No need to be jealous
explanation_mandarin: 表示没有必要羡慕或嫉妒某人或某事。通常用于安慰或劝说别人，说明情况并没有看起来那么好，或者自己也有别人没有的优点。
explanation_english: Indicates that there's no need to envy or be jealous of someone or something. It's often used to comfort or persuade someone, explaining that the situation isn't as good as it seems, or that they themselves have advantages that others don't.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人哋揸靚車，你唔使恨嘅，你都有樓收租。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 dei6 zaa1 leng1 ce1, nei5 m4 sai2 han6 ge3, nei5 dou1 jau5 lau2 sau1 zu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别人开好车，你不用羡慕，你也有楼收租。
examples.english_sentence: Someone else drives a fancy car, but you don't need to be jealous, you have properties to collect rent from.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢入咗名牌大學，你唔使恨佢，你都好叻，只係唔鍾意讀書啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jap6 zo2 ming4 paai4 daai6 hok6, nei5 m4 sai2 han6 keoi5, nei5 dou1 hou2 lek1, zi2 hai6 m4 zung1 ji3 duk6 syu1 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他进了名牌大学，你不用羡慕他，你也很棒，只是不喜欢读书而已。
examples.english_sentence: He got into a prestigious university, you don't need to envy him, you're also very capable, you just don't like studying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔使恨佢咁瘦，佢日日keep fit好辛苦㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 sai2 han6 keoi5 gam3 sau3, keoi5 jat1 jat1 keep fit hou2 san1 fu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不用羡慕她那么瘦，她每天健身很辛苦的。
examples.english_sentence: You don't need to envy her being so slim, she works very hard to keep fit every day.

english_meaning: Don't panic; No need to worry
explanation_mandarin: 表示不需要慌张，不必担心害怕。用来安慰别人，让其冷静。
explanation_english: Expresses that there's no need to panic or be afraid. Used to reassure someone and tell them to calm down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 跌咗啲錢啫，唔使慌嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dit3 zo2 di1 cin2 ze1, m4 sai2 fong1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 只是掉了点钱而已，不用慌张的。
examples.english_sentence: You just dropped some money. There's no need to panic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試唔合格都唔使慌，下次再努力就得啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si5 m4 gok3 gaak3 dou1 m4 sai2 fong1, haa6 ci3 zoi3 nu5 lik6 zau6 dak1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试不及格也不用慌张，下次再努力就行了。
examples.english_sentence: Even if you fail the exam, there's no need to panic. Just work harder next time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使慌，我會幫你搞掂佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 fong1, ngo5 wui5 bong1 nei5 gaau2 dim6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用慌张，我会帮你搞定它的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't panic, I will help you sort it out.

synonyms: 唔使用怕 (m4 sai2 dung2 paa3)

english_meaning: Don't worry
explanation_mandarin: 表示不需要担心，放心
explanation_english: Expresses that there is no need to worry; a reassurance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試唔使憂，你平時咁努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si5 m4 sai2 yau1, nei5 ping4 si4 gam3 nou5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试不用担心，你平时这么努力。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry about the exam, you work so hard usually.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日落雨唔使憂，我哋有帶遮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 lok6 jyu5 m4 sai2 yau1, ngo5 dei6 jau5 daai3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天下雨不用担心，我们有带伞。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry about it raining tomorrow, we brought umbrellas.

synonyms: 唔使擔心 (m4 sai2 daam1 sam1)

english_meaning: Don't count on it; No way; Don't even think about it
explanation_mandarin: 表示某件事完全不可能实现，不要期望或期待。
explanation_english: Expresses that something is completely impossible and should not be expected or anticipated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想我幫你做功課？唔使指意啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 ngo5 bong1 nei5 zou6 gung1 fo3? m4 sai2 zi2 ji3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想我帮你做功课？别指望了！
examples.english_sentence: You want me to help you with your homework? Don't even think about it!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁懶，你仲想佢升職？唔使指意啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 laan5, nei5 zung6 soeng2 keoi5 sing1 zik1? m4 sai2 zi2 ji3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那么懒，你还想他升职？别指望了。
examples.english_sentence: He's so lazy, you still expect him to get promoted? Don't count on it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試咁難，你想攞A？唔使指意！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 gam3 naan4, nei5 soeng2 lo2 ei1? m4 sai2 zi2 ji3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试这么难，你想拿A？ 没希望！
examples.english_sentence: This exam is so difficult, you want to get an A? No way!

english_meaning: No need to point out; It's obvious; No need to tell me
explanation_mandarin: 表示情况很明显，不需要特别指出或提醒。
explanation_english: Indicates that the situation is very obvious and does not require special pointing out or reminding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事咁明顯，都唔使指擬㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 gam3 ming4 hin2, dou1 m4 sai2 zi2 ngai4 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事这么明显，不用特意指出来了吧。
examples.english_sentence: The matter is so obvious, there's no need to point it out, right?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁醒目，你都唔使指擬點做嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 sing2 muk6, nei5 dou1 m4 sai2 zi2 ngai4 dim2 zou6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么聪明，你都不用告诉他怎么做。
examples.english_sentence: He's so smart, you don't need to tell him how to do it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁叻， 唔使指擬都識做啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 lek1, m4 sai2 zi2 ngai4 dou1 sik1 zou6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么厉害，不用指点也知道怎么做啦！
examples.english_sentence: You are so capable, you know how to do it without me telling you!

english_meaning: No need to pick an auspicious date; no need to wait for a better time.
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情非常顺利，立即就可以做，不需要挑选黄道吉日。也表示事情进展顺利，时机已经成熟。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where things are so favorable that there's no need to consult an almanac or wait for an auspicious date to proceed. It implies that the timing is perfect and the task can be undertaken immediately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家個市咁好，唔使擇日啦，即刻買樓啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 go3 si5 gam3 hou2, m4 sai2 zaak6 jat6 laa1, zik1 hak1 maai5 lau2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在市场这么好，不用择日了，立刻买房吧！
examples.english_sentence: The market is so good right now, no need to wait for a good day, buy the apartment immediately!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 既然大家同意，又準備好曬，咁就唔使擇日啦，聽日開始做啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 jin4 daai6 gaa1 tung3 ji3, jau6 zeon2 bei6 hou2 saai3, gam2 zau6 m4 sai2 zaak6 jat6 laa1, ting1 jat6 hoi1 chi2 zou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 既然大家都同意，又准备好了，那么就不用择日了，明天开始做吧。
examples.english_sentence: Since everyone agrees and everything is ready, there's no need to pick a date, let's start tomorrow.

english_meaning: No need to worry; it's okay; don't bother
explanation_mandarin: 表示不需要担心或操心，事情并不严重，或者可以处理。
explanation_english: Indicates that there's no need to worry or bother. The situation is not serious, or it can be handled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 跌咗少少嘢啫，唔使方啦，我執返佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dit3 zo2 siu2 siu2 je5 ze1, m4 sai2 fong1 laa1, ngo5 zap1 faan1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 只是掉了点东西而已，不用担心，我捡回来。
examples.english_sentence: It's just a few things that fell, don't worry, I'll pick them up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使方，我識搞掂佢嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 fong1, ngo5 sik1 gaau2 dim6 keoi5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用担心，我知道怎么处理它。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry, I know how to handle it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使方，呢啲小事嚟㗎啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 fong1, ni1 di1 siu2 si6 lai4 gaa3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用担心，这只是小事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry, this is just a small matter.

english_meaning: Don't even think about it; Forget about it; There's no way
explanation_mandarin: 表示绝对不可能或者希望渺茫，劝人不要抱有幻想。
explanation_english: Expresses absolute impossibility or a very slim chance. It advises someone not to have any illusions or hopes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔使旨意我可以借錢畀你，我已經冇錢喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 sai2 zi2 ji3 ngo5 ho2 ji5 ze3 cin2 bei2 nei5, ngo5 ji5 ging1 mou5 cin2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别指望我可以借钱给你，我已经没钱了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't even think about me lending you money, I have no money left.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁嘅表現，唔使旨意升職啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 ge3 biu2 hin3, m4 sai2 zi2 ji3 sing1 zik1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样的表现，别指望升职了。
examples.english_sentence: With your performance like this, there's no way you'll get promoted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢都走咗咁耐，你唔使旨意佢會返嚟啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou1 zau2 zo2 gam3 noi6, nei5 m4 sai2 zi2 ji3 keoi5 wui5 faan1 lei4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他都走了这么久，你别指望他会回来了。
examples.english_sentence: He's been gone for so long, don't even think about him coming back.

english_meaning: No investment required; free; to get something for nothing; to gain without any input
explanation_mandarin: 不需要任何成本；形容无需投入资本就能获取利益，或者可以免费得到的东西。
explanation_english: Describes something that requires no investment or cost. It means to gain a profit or something of value without putting in any capital or effort. It can also mean something is free.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都諗住唔使本就發達。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 nam2 zyu6 m4 sai2 bun2 zau6 faat3 daat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天都想着不劳而获。
examples.english_sentence: He always thinks about getting rich without any investment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲贈品都係唔使本嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 zang6 ban2 dou1 hai6 m4 sai2 bun2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些赠品都是免费的。
examples.english_sentence: These free gifts are free.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 用免費軟件，都算係唔使本嘅一種方法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jung6 min5 fai3 so2 gin2, dou1 syun3 hai6 m4 sai2 bun2 ge3 jat1 zung2 fong1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 使用免费软件，也算是一种不费成本的方法。
examples.english_sentence: Using free software is also considered a way to do something without any investment.

english_meaning: It's not a matter of life and death; It's not that serious; No big deal
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情没有想象中那么严重，不必过于担心或害怕。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is not as serious as it seems, and there's no need to worry or be afraid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 跌咗少少錢啫，唔使死嘅！
examples.jyutping_sentence: dit3 zo2 siu2 siu2 cin2 ze1, m4 sai2 sei2 ge3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 只是掉了点钱而已，没什么大不了的！
examples.english_sentence: It's just a little bit of money that you lost, it's not a matter of life and death!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試衰咗，都唔使死嘅，下次努力啲咪得囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 seoi1 zo2, dou1 m4 sai2 sei2 ge3, haa6 ci3 nu5 lik6 di1 mai1 dak1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试没考好，也没什么大不了的，下次努力点不就好了嘛。
examples.english_sentence: You failed this exam, but it's not the end of the world. Just work harder next time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 遲到咗幾分鐘，唔使死嘅，老闆唔會鬧你嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ci4 dou3 zo2 gei2 fan1 zung1, m4 sai2 sei2 ge3, lou5 baan2 m4 wui5 naau6 nei5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 迟到了几分钟，不要紧的，老板不会骂你的。
examples.english_sentence: You were just a few minutes late, it's not a big deal, the boss won't scold you.

synonyms: 唔使咁擔心 (m4 sai2 gam3 daam1 sam1)

english_meaning: No need to calculate; it's obvious; it's a certainty
explanation_mandarin: 表示不需要计算，通常用于形容结果非常明显，或者事情是必然发生的。
explanation_english: Indicates that there is no need to calculate, usually used to describe that the result is very obvious, or that something is bound to happen. It can also mean 'it's a given', 'no need to think about it'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁勤力，考試一定合格，唔使計啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 kan4 lik6, haau2 si5 jat1 ding6 hap6 gaak3, m4 sai2 gai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么努力，考试肯定会及格，不用算了。
examples.english_sentence: He is so hardworking, he will definitely pass the exam, no need to even calculate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋咁有錢，一定會幫手嘅，唔使計啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gam3 jau5 cin2, jat1 ding6 wui5 bong1 sau2 ge3, m4 sai2 gai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们这么有钱，一定会帮忙的，不用算了。
examples.english_sentence: They are so rich, they will definitely help, it's a given.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日落雨機會咁大，都唔使計都知要帶遮啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 lok6 jyu5 gei1 wui2 gam3 daai6, dou1 m4 sai2 gai3 dou1 zi1 jiu3 daai3 ze1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天下雨的几率这么大，不用算也知道要带伞啦。
examples.english_sentence: The chance of rain tomorrow is so high, it's obvious we need to bring an umbrella, no need to even think about it.

english_meaning: No need to think about it; Don't even have to think about it; It's a no-brainer
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情非常简单明了，不需要花费时间思考；或者表示事情已经决定，不需要再讨论。
explanation_english: Expresses that something is very simple and obvious, requiring no time to think about; or that a decision has already been made and requires no further discussion. It implies the answer is obvious or the choice is clear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買邊個牌子好？唔使諗，梗係買呢個啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 bin1 go3 paai4 zi2 hou2? m4 sai2 lam2, gang2 hai6 maai5 ni1 go3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 买哪个牌子好？ 不用想，当然是买这个了！
examples.english_sentence: Which brand should I buy? No need to think about it, definitely buy this one!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 去唔去飲？唔使諗，一定去啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: heoi3 m4 heoi3 yam2? m4 sai2 lam2, jat1 ding6 heoi3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去不去参加宴会？不用想，肯定去啦！
examples.english_sentence: Should I go to the banquet or not? No need to think about it, of course I'll go!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁錫你，結婚唔結婚？唔使諗啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 sek3 nei5, git3 fan1 m4 git3 fan1? m4 sai2 lam2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么疼你，结婚不结婚？不用想啦！
examples.english_sentence: He loves you so much, marry him or not? It's a no-brainer!

mandarin_meaning: 不用说，当然，那是肯定的
english_meaning: No need to say; obviously; of course; needless to say; it goes without saying
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情很明显，不需要再多作解释。语气强烈时，可以理解为“当然”，“那是肯定的”。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is obvious and requires no further explanation. When used with strong emphasis, it can be understood as "of course" or "that's for sure."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁錫你，唔使講都知佢會幫你啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 sek3 nei5, m4 sai2 gong2 dou1 zi1 keoi5 wui5 bong1 nei5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那么疼你，不用说也知道他会帮你啦。
examples.english_sentence: He loves you so much, it goes without saying that he will help you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 攞冠軍？唔使講㗎啦，梗係我哋贏㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lo2 gun3 gwan1? m4 sai2 gong2 gaa3 laa1, gang2 hai6 ngo5 dei6 wing4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 拿冠军？那是肯定的，当然是我们赢。
examples.english_sentence: Win the championship? Of course! We're going to win.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 靚成咁，唔使講一定好多人追啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: leng3 seng4 gam3, m4 sai2 gong2 jat1 ding6 hou2 do1 jan4 zeoi1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这么漂亮，不用说一定很多人追吧。
examples.english_sentence: So beautiful, it goes without saying that a lot of people are chasing after her.

english_meaning: not to be; is not; are not; am not; no
explanation_mandarin: 表示否定判断，相当于普通话的“不是”。
explanation_english: Indicates a negative judgment, equivalent to "is not" in Mandarin. Can also express disagreement or denial.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔係我嘅朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 hai6 ngo5 ge3 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不是我的朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He is not my friend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個唔係我嘅錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 m4 hai6 ngo5 ge3 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这不是我的错。
examples.english_sentence: This is not my fault.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘅唔係真嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 ge3 m4 hai6 zan1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说的不是真的。
examples.english_sentence: What you said is not true.

english_meaning: Not that type of person; not in that category
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人或某事不属于某种类别或风格，隐含贬义或轻蔑。
explanation_english: This phrase is used to indicate that someone or something doesn't belong to a certain category or style. It often carries a negative or dismissive connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔係讀書嗰皮嘅，成日掛住玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 hai6 duk6 syu1 go2 pei4 ge3, seng4 jat6 gwaa3 zyu6 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不是读书那一类人，整天只想着玩。
examples.english_sentence: He's not the studying type; he's always focused on playing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲戲唔係我嗰皮，我鍾意睇啲動作片。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 hei3 m4 hai6 ngo5 go2 pei4, ngo5 zung1 yi3 tai2 di1 dung6 zok3 pin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些电影不是我喜欢的那一类，我喜欢看动作片。
examples.english_sentence: These movies aren't my type; I prefer watching action movies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔係斯文嗰皮，講嘢好大聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 hai6 si1 man4 go2 pei4, gong2 je5 hou2 daai6 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她不是斯文那一类人，说话很大声。
examples.english_sentence: She's not the gentle type; she speaks very loudly.

english_meaning: To be light-fingered; to steal; to have sticky fingers; not trustworthy regarding money or valuables.
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人手脚不干净，喜欢偷东西。 通常用来暗示或委婉地说某人可能偷了东西，而不是直接指控。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is light-fingered, prone to stealing. It's often used as an indirect or euphemistic way of suggesting someone may have stolen something, rather than making a direct accusation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得佢好似唔係好手腳，啲嘢鎖好啲穩陣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 keoi5 hou2 ci5 m4 hai6 hou2 sau2 goek3, di1 je5 so2 hou2 di1 wan2 zin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得他好像手脚不太干净，东西锁好一点比较稳妥。
examples.english_sentence: I think he might be a bit light-fingered, better to lock things up properly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔係我講，但係佢個人真係唔係幾手腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hai6 ngo5 gong2, daan6 hai6 keoi5 go3 jan4 zan1 hai6 m4 hai6 gei2 sau2 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不是我说的，但是他这个人真的不太老实。
examples.english_sentence: Not that I'm saying anything, but he's really not very trustworthy.

mandarin_meaning: 不是人干的事；没品；不像人
english_meaning: Inhuman; beastly; to do something that is not befitting of a human being; to behave in a despicable manner; without principles; low class
explanation_mandarin: 形容人的行为卑劣，不符合道德标准，或者令人发指。通常用来表达强烈的厌恶或愤怒。
explanation_english: Describes someone's behavior as despicable, not meeting moral standards, or outrageous. It is usually used to express strong disgust or anger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢呃啲老人家啲錢，真係唔係人咁品！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aak1 di1 lou5 jan4 gaa1 di1 cin2, zan1 hai6 m4 hai6 jan4 gam2 ban2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他骗那些老人的钱，真不是人干的事！
examples.english_sentence: He cheated those elderly people out of their money, it's really inhuman!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你點可以咁樣對佢？你都唔係人咁品嘅！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dim2 ho2 ji5 gam2 joeng2 deoi3 keoi5? nei5 dou1 m4 hai6 jan4 gam2 ban2 ge3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你怎么可以这样对他？你太没品了吧！
examples.english_sentence: How can you treat him like that? You are such a beast!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做埋啲咁嘅嘢，簡直唔係人咁品！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 maai4 di1 gam3 ge3 je5, gaan2 zik6 m4 hai6 jan4 gam2 ban2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做了那些事，简直不是人能做出来的！
examples.english_sentence: Doing things like that, it's simply something no human would do!

english_meaning: not having human qualities; inhuman; behaving terribly
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人行为恶劣，缺乏人性，像禽兽一样。
explanation_english: Describes someone who behaves terribly, lacking human qualities, almost like a beast. Used to describe someone with very bad character or behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁樣對啲老人家，真係唔係人噉品！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 joeng2 deoi3 di1 lou5 jan4 gaa1, zan1 hai6 m4 hai6 jan4 gam2 ban2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这样对待老年人，真不是人品！
examples.english_sentence: The way he treats the elderly, it's truly inhuman!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你偷人哋啲錢，唔係人噉品㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tau1 jan4 dei6 di1 cin2, m4 hai6 jan4 gam2 ban2 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你偷别人的钱，不是人品啊！
examples.english_sentence: Stealing other people's money, that's not human!

synonyms: 狼心狗肺 (long4 sam1 gau2 fai3)

mandarin_meaning: 不是你想的那样; 事情并非如此简单
english_meaning: It's not what you think; It's not as simple as you think; You'd be wrong to assume that.
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情的真相或结果与对方的猜测或预想不符，带有一定的否定和纠正意味。
explanation_english: This phrase indicates that the reality or outcome of a situation is different from what someone might have guessed or expected. It carries a tone of negation and correction, suggesting that the listener's assumption is incorrect or an oversimplification.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份工唔係你估咁筍㗎，要做好多嘢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 gung1 m4 hai6 nei5 gu2 gam3 seon2 gaa3, jiu3 zou6 hou2 do1 je5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作可不是你想的那么轻松，要做很多事情的。
examples.english_sentence: This job isn't as easy as you think; there's a lot to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲樓價唔係你估咁易跌㗎，好多人等緊入市。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 lau2 gaa3 m4 hai6 nei5 gu2 gam3 ji6 dit3 gaa3, hou2 do1 jan4 dang2 gan2 jap6 si5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房价可不是你想的那么容易跌，很多人等着进场买呢。
examples.english_sentence: House prices aren't as easy to fall as you might think; a lot of people are waiting to buy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅關係唔係你估咁簡單，入面複雜好多㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 m4 hai6 nei5 gu2 gam3 gaan2 daan1, jap6 min6 fuk1 zaap6 hou2 do1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的关系可不是你想的那么简单，里面复杂很多呢。
examples.english_sentence: Their relationship isn't as simple as you think; it's much more complicated.

synonyms: 唔係咁簡單 (m4 hai6 gam3 gaan2 daan1)
冇咁簡單 (mou5 gam3 gaan2 daan1)

jyutping: m4 hai6 nei5 coi4 m4 jap6 nei5 doi2
mandarin_meaning: 不是你的钱财进不了你的口袋
english_meaning: What isn't meant for you won't come to you. / Money that isn't yours won't end up in your pocket.
explanation_mandarin: 指命中注定不属于你的东西，无论怎样努力也得不到。
explanation_english: This idiom means that what is not destined to be yours, you will not obtain, no matter how hard you try. It highlights the concept of fate and acceptance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 算啦，唔好再諗啦，都話唔係你財唔入你袋嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syun3 laa1, m4 hou2 zoi3 lam2 laa1, dou1 waa6 m4 hai6 nei5 coi4 m4 jap6 nei5 doi2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 算了吧，别再想了，都说了不是你的钱财进不了你的口袋。
examples.english_sentence: Forget it, don't think about it anymore. As they say, what isn't meant for you won't come to you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日諗住中六合彩，但係次次都買唔中，真係應咗句唔係你財唔入你袋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 lam2 zyu6 zung3 luk6 hap6 coi2, daan6 hai6 ci3 ci3 dou1 maai5 m4 zung3, zan1 hai6 jing3 zo2 geoi3 m4 hai6 nei5 coi4 m4 jap6 nei5 doi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想着中彩票，但是每次都买不中，真是应验了那句不是你的钱财进不了你的口袋。
examples.english_sentence: He always dreams of winning the lottery, but never wins. It really proves the saying, what isn't meant for you won't come to you.

jyutping: m4 hai6 nei5 coi4, m4 jap6 nei5 doi2
mandarin_meaning: 不是你的钱财，进不了你的口袋
english_meaning: What's not meant for you, won't come to you.
explanation_mandarin: 指如果某样东西注定不属于你，即使近在眼前也得不到。
explanation_english: This idiom means that if something is not destined to be yours, you won't get it, even if it's within your reach. It implies a sense of fate or inevitability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唉，呢次升職又冇我份，真係唔係你財，唔入你袋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aai1, ni1 ci3 sing1 zik1 jau6 mou5 ngo5 fan6, zan1 hai6 m4 hai6 nei5 coi4, m4 jap6 nei5 doi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 唉，这次升职又没有我的份，真是不是我的钱财，进不了我的口袋。
examples.english_sentence: Sigh, I didn't get the promotion this time either. What's not meant for you, won't come to you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買六合彩中咗頭獎，你唔使葡萄啦， 唔係你財，唔入你袋啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 luk6 hap6 coi2 zung3 zo2 tau4 zoeng2, nei5 m4 sai2 pou4 tou4 laa1, m4 hai6 nei5 coi4, m4 jap6 nei5 doi2 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买六合彩中了头奖，你不用嫉妒了，不是你的钱财，进不了你的口袋嘛。
examples.english_sentence: He won the lottery first prize, you don't have to be jealous, what's not meant for you, won't come to you.

english_meaning: It wasn't his doing; He wasn't involved
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事不是某人亲自参与或负责的。
explanation_english: This phrase indicates that someone was not directly involved in or responsible for something, often implying a lack of direct action or participation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 單嘢搞成咁衰，但係唔係佢手腳，佢只係聽order做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daan1 je5 gaau2 sing4 gam2 seoi1, daan6 hai6 m4 hai6 keoi5 sau2 geok3, keoi5 zi2 hai6 teng1 order zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 事情搞得这么糟糕，但不是他做的，他只是听命令做事。
examples.english_sentence: The matter turned out so badly, but it wasn't his doing. He was just following orders.

synonyms: 唔關佢事 (m4 gwaan1 keoi5 si6)
唔係佢搞嘅 (m4 hai6 keoi5 gaau2 ge3)

mandarin_meaning: 不是吧 / 不可能吧 / 真的吗
english_meaning: Really? / Is that so? / No way! / You're kidding!
explanation_mandarin: 表示惊讶、怀疑、不相信、难以置信等情绪，语气词“呀”加强语气。
explanation_english: Expresses surprise, doubt, disbelief, or incredulity. The particle "呀" (aa3) emphasizes the tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話佢攞咗第一名？唔係呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 keoi5 lo2 zo2 dai6 jat1 ming4? m4 hai6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说他得了第一名？不是吧？
examples.english_sentence: You're saying he got first place? Really?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢聽日結婚，唔係呀？咁快？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 ting1 jat6 git3 fan1, m4 hai6 aa3? gam3 faai3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他明天结婚，真的吗？这么快？
examples.english_sentence: He said he's getting married tomorrow, no way? So soon?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你中咗六合彩頭獎？唔係呀！恭喜你呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung3 zo2 luk6 hap6 coi2 tau4 zoeng2? m4 hai6 aa3! gung1 hei2 nei5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你中了六合彩头奖？不是吧！恭喜你啊！
examples.english_sentence: You won the lottery jackpot? You're kidding! Congratulations!

english_meaning: Are you serious? / You're kidding! / No way!
explanation_mandarin: 表示惊讶、不相信、怀疑等情绪的反问句，语气强烈。
explanation_english: An interrogative phrase used to express surprise, disbelief, or doubt. It's often used in response to something unexpected or unbelievable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話你中咗六合彩頭獎？唔係呀嘛！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 nei5 zung3 zo2 luk6 hap6 coi2 tau4 zoeng2? m4 hai6 aa3 maa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说你中了六合彩头奖？不是吧！
examples.english_sentence: You're saying you won the first prize in the Mark Six lottery? Are you serious?!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢聽日結婚？唔係呀嘛，佢哋尋日先啱啱開始拍拖咋喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 ting1 jat6 git3 fan1? m4 hai6 aa3 maa3, keoi5 dei6 cam4 jat6 sin1 ngaam1 ngaam1 hoi1 ci2 paak3 to1 zaa3 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他明天结婚？不是吧，他们昨天才刚刚开始约会啊。
examples.english_sentence: He said he's getting married tomorrow? No way, they just started dating yesterday!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你考到第一名？唔係呀嘛！勁啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 haau2 dou2 dai6 jat1 ming4? m4 hai6 aa3 maa3! ging6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你考了第一名？不是吧！厉害啊！
examples.english_sentence: You got first place? You're kidding! Awesome!

mandarin_meaning: 不是这么说的 / 话不能这么说
english_meaning: That's not how you say it / That's not how it works / It's not quite like that / That's not the way to put it
explanation_mandarin: 表示不同意对方的说法，或者觉得对方的理解不正确，需要纠正或者补充。
explanation_english: Expresses disagreement with someone's statement or a feeling that their understanding is incorrect and needs correction or clarification. It often implies a more nuanced or accurate explanation is needed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話佢懶，唔係咁講喎，佢只係做嘢慢啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 keoi5 laan5, m4 hai6 gam2 gong2 wo3, keoi5 zi2 hai6 zou6 je5 maan6 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说他懒，话不能这么说，他只是做事慢而已。
examples.english_sentence: You say he's lazy, but that's not quite right, he's just slow at working.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁做一定係想害你？ 唔係咁講嘅，可能佢有苦衷呢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 zou6 jat1 ding6 hai6 soeng2 hoi6 nei5? m4 hai6 gam2 gong2 ge3, ho2 nang4 keoi5 jau5 fu2 cung1 ne1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这样做一定是想害你？话不能这么说，可能他有苦衷呢。
examples.english_sentence: He's doing this to harm you for sure? It's not quite like that, maybe he has his own reasons.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港樓價好貴，窮人一定買唔起？唔係咁講，有啲人好慳家，儲到首期嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 lau2 gaa3 hou2 gwai3, kung4 jan4 jat1 ding6 maai5 m4 hei2? m4 hai6 gam2 gong2, jau5 di1 jan4 hou2 haan1 gaa1, cou5 dou3 sau2 kei4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港房价很贵，穷人一定买不起？不是这么说的，有些人很节俭，能存到首付的。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong property prices are very expensive, so poor people definitely can't afford it? It's not quite like that, some people are very thrifty and can save up for a down payment.

mandarin_meaning: 不是吧 / 不会吧 / 真的吗？
english_meaning: Really? / Seriously? / You don't say! / No way!
explanation_mandarin: 表示惊讶、怀疑或不相信的语气。
explanation_english: Expresses surprise, doubt, or disbelief. Similar to "Really?", "Seriously?", or "You're kidding!".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話佢辭咗職？唔係啩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 keoi5 ci4 zo2 zik1? m4 hai6 gwaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说他辞职了？不是吧？
examples.english_sentence: You said he quit his job? Really?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日要返工？唔係啩！我以為放假㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 jiu3 faan1 gung1? m4 hai6 gwaa3! ngo5 ji5 wai4 fong3 gaa3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天要上班？不会吧！我以为放假呢。
examples.english_sentence: Have to work tomorrow? Seriously! I thought it was a holiday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢中咗六合彩頭獎？唔係啩！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung3 zo2 luk6 hap6 coi2 tau4 zoeng2? m4 hai6 gwaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他中了六合彩头奖？真的吗？
examples.english_sentence: He won the first prize in the Mark Six lottery? No way!

english_meaning: otherwise, or else, if not
explanation_mandarin: 表示假设情况不成立，会产生另一种结果。相当于“要不然”、“不然的话”。
explanation_english: Indicates an alternative or consequence if a preceding condition is not met. Equivalent to "otherwise", "or else", or "if not".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你快啲做晒啲功課，唔係嘅話聽日俾老師鬧㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 faai3 di1 zou6 saai3 di1 gung1 fo3, m4 hai6 ge3 waa2 ting1 jat6 bei2 lou5 si1 nau6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你快点把功课做完，不然的话明天会被老师骂的。
examples.english_sentence: Finish your homework quickly, or else you'll be scolded by the teacher tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得帶遮啊，唔係嘅話會淋濕㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 daai3 ze1 aa3, m4 hai6 ge3 waa2 wui5 lam4 sip3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记得带伞啊，不然的话会被淋湿的。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to bring an umbrella, otherwise you'll get wet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你最好準時到，唔係嘅話我哋就唔等你啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zeoi3 hou2 zeon2 si4 dou3, m4 hai6 ge3 waa2 ngo5 dei6 zau6 m4 dang2 nei5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好准时到，要不然我们就不等你了。
examples.english_sentence: You better be on time, or else we won't wait for you.

mandarin_meaning: 不是小事; 非同小可
english_meaning: No small matter; Serious matter; It's a big deal
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情的重要性，程度严重，不可轻视。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is important, serious, and should not be taken lightly. It emphasizes the significance of a situation or event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試肥佬，唔係嘢少㗎，要同屋企人交代。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 fei4 lou2, m4 hai6 je5 siu2 gaa3, jiu3 tung4 uk1 kei2 jan4 gaau1 dai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试不及格，不是小事啊，要跟家里人交代。
examples.english_sentence: Failing this exam is no small matter; I have to explain it to my family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 工程出咗咁大問題，唔係嘢少，一定要查清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 cing4 ceot1 zo2 gam3 daai6 man6 tai4, m4 hai6 je5 siu2, jat1 ding6 jiu3 caa4 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工程出了这么大的问题，非同小可，一定要查清楚。
examples.english_sentence: Such a big problem occurred in the project; it's a serious matter. We must investigate thoroughly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你撞到人架車，唔係嘢少，報警啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zong6 dou2 jan4 ge3 ce1, m4 hai6 je5 siu2, bou3 ging2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你撞到了别人的车，不是小事，报警吧！
examples.english_sentence: You hit someone else's car, it's no small matter. Call the police!

english_meaning: Not that I'm saying...
explanation_mandarin: 一种委婉的说法，通常用来引出一些带有批评或不同意见的观点，暗示接下来要说的话可能不中听，但又想表达出来。
explanation_english: A polite phrase used to introduce an opinion or criticism that might be considered controversial or disagreeable. It indicates that the speaker is aware their upcoming statement may be sensitive but still wishes to express it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔係噉話，你啲設計真係唔係幾掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hai6 gam2 waa6, nei5 di1 cit3 gai3 zan1 hai6 m4 hai6 gei2 dim1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不是我说，你的设计真的不太好。
examples.english_sentence: Not that I'm saying..., but your design really isn't very good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔係噉話，佢份人係幾好，但係做嘢就麻麻哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hai6 gam2 waa6, keoi5 fan6 jan4 hai6 gei2 hou2, daan6 hai6 zou6 je5 zau6 maa4 maa2 dei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不是我说，他这个人挺好的，但是工作就一般般。
examples.english_sentence: Not that I'm saying..., he's a nice person, but his work is just so-so.

english_meaning: It's not like that; That's not how it is; That's not the way to put it; That's not the point.
explanation_mandarin: 用于纠正或反驳对方的说法，表示事情不是如对方所描述的那样。也可以表示不同意对方的观点或表述方式。
explanation_english: Used to correct or refute someone's statement, indicating that things are not as they describe. It can also express disagreement with the other party's point of view or expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔係懶，唔係噉講，佢只係有啲嘢唔識啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 hai6 laan5, m4 hai6 gam2 gong2, keoi5 zi2 hai6 jau5 di1 je5 m4 sik1 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不是懒，不是那样说的，他只是有些东西不懂而已。
examples.english_sentence: He's not lazy, it's not like that. He just doesn't know some things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔係噉講，你咁樣做係會影響到其他人㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hai6 gam2 gong2, nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 hai6 wui5 jing2 hoeng2 dou3 kei4 taa1 jan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不是那样说的，你这样做是会影响到其他人的。
examples.english_sentence: That's not the point. The way you're doing things is going to affect other people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔係噉講，佢嘅原意唔係想傷害你嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hai6 gam2 gong2, keoi5 ge3 jyun4 ji3 m4 hai6 soeng2 soeng1 hoi6 nei5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不是那样说的，他的原意不是想伤害你的。
examples.english_sentence: It's not like that, his original intention wasn't to hurt you.

english_meaning: not very, not quite, not so
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度不高，相当于“不太”、“不怎么”。用于修饰形容词或动词，表达一种轻微的否定。
explanation_english: Indicates a degree that is not very high, equivalent to "not very", "not quite", or "not so". Used to modify adjectives or verbs, expressing a slight negation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日我唔係幾舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 ngo5 m4 hai6 gei2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天我不太舒服。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not feeling very well today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部戲唔係幾好睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 hei3 m4 hai6 gei2 hou2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影不太好看。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is not very good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢唔係幾熟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 m4 hai6 gei2 suk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他/她不怎么熟。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not very familiar with him/her.

english_meaning: That's not my area/responsibility; that's not my department; that's not my problem.
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事不在自己的职责范围之内，自己不负责处理或承担。
explanation_english: Expresses that something is not within one's area of responsibility and that one is not responsible for handling or taking care of it. It implies a lack of accountability or involvement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你搵錯人喇，呢單嘢唔係我嗰皮嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 wan2 co3 jan4 laa3, ni1 daan1 je5 m4 hai6 ngo5 go2 pei4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你找错人了，这件事不是我负责的。
examples.english_sentence: You've got the wrong person, this matter isn't my responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好問我，設計嗰部分唔係我嗰皮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 man6 ngo5, sai3 gai3 go2 bou6 fan6 m4 hai6 ngo5 go2 pei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别问我，设计的那部分不是我负责的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't ask me, the design part isn't my area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果係技術問題，就唔係我嗰皮啦，你要搵IT部。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 hai6 gei6 seot6 man6 tai4, zau6 m4 hai6 ngo5 go2 pei4 laa1, nei5 jiu3 wan2 IT bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果是技术问题，那就不是我负责的，你要找IT部门。
examples.english_sentence: If it's a technical issue, that's not my department, you need to find the IT department.

synonyms: 唔關我事 (m4 gwaan1 ngo5 si6)
唔係我負責 (m4 hai6 ngo5 fu3 zaak3)

mandarin_meaning: 不是我的菜 / 不喜欢
english_meaning: Not my cup of tea / not to my liking / not what I'm interested in
explanation_mandarin: 比喻某事物不符合自己的兴趣或喜好。
explanation_english: A metaphor meaning something is not to one's taste or liking, not something one is interested in or enjoys.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲唔係我杯茶，我鍾意睇啲動作片。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 m4 hai6 ngo5 bui1 caa4, ngo5 zung1 yi3 tai2 di1 dung6 zok3 pin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影不是我的菜，我喜欢看动作片。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is not my cup of tea, I prefer watching action movies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行山唔係我杯茶，我寧願留喺屋企睇電視。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 saan1 m4 hai6 ngo5 bui1 caa4, ngo5 ning4 jyun2 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2 tai2 din6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爬山不是我的菜，我宁愿待在家里看电视。
examples.english_sentence: Hiking is not my cup of tea, I'd rather stay home and watch TV.

synonyms: 唔啱我口味 (m4 ngaam1 ngo5 hau2 mei6)

jyutping: m4 hai6 maang5 lung4 m4 gwo3 gong1
english_meaning: Only a fierce dragon dares to cross the river; meaning only someone with exceptional ability or confidence undertakes a challenging task or ventures into new territory.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻只有本领高强的人才敢去冒险或挑战新的领域。也指一个人对自己非常有信心。
explanation_english: This idiom implies that only individuals with exceptional skills, strength, or confidence are willing to take risks, venture into new territories, or undertake difficult tasks. It suggests a strong belief in one's own abilities and a willingness to face challenges head-on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁後生就敢去外國創業，真係唔係猛龍唔過江。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 hau6 saang1 zau6 gam2 heoi3 ngoi6 gwok3 chong3 jip6, zan1 hai6 m4 hai6 maang5 lung4 m4 gwo3 gong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么年轻就敢去国外创业，真不是猛龙不过江。
examples.english_sentence: He's so young and already dares to start a business abroad, he truly is no ordinary person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次嘅計劃咁困難，唔係猛龍唔過江，好少人會接手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 chi3 ge3 gai3 waak6 gam3 kwan3 naan4, m4 hai6 maang5 lung4 m4 gwo3 gong1, hou2 siu2 jan4 wui5 zip3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的计划这么困难，不是猛龙不过江，很少人会接手。
examples.english_sentence: This project is so difficult, only a capable person would take it on; few people would accept it.

synonyms: 藝高人膽大 (ngai6 gou1 jan4 daam2 daai6)

english_meaning: not right, something's wrong, off track, not making sense
explanation_mandarin: 指事情或情况不正常，不对劲，或人的行为举止不合常理。
explanation_english: Refers to a situation or thing that is not right, strange, or a person's behavior that is not normal or reasonable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日嘅表現唔係路喎，平時好醒目嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 ge3 biu2 hin3 m4 hai6 lou6 wo3, ping4 si4 hou2 sing2 muk6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天的表现不太对劲，平时很聪明的。
examples.english_sentence: His performance today is off; he's usually very smart.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事越諗越覺得唔係路，我哋要查清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 yut6 lam2 yut6 gok3 dak1 m4 hai6 lou6, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 caa4 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事越想越觉得不对劲，我们要查清楚。
examples.english_sentence: The more I think about this, the more I feel something is wrong. We need to investigate thoroughly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁做嘢方法唔係路㗎，一定會出事。
