examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 zou6嘢 fong1 faat3 m4 hai6 lou6 gaa3, jat1 ding6 wui5 chut1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做事的方法不对，一定会出事。
examples.english_sentence: Your way of doing things is not right; something bad will definitely happen.

english_meaning: not a solution; not the way to go; not a feasible method
explanation_mandarin: 表示某種做法或方法行不通，無法解決問題。
explanation_english: Indicates that a certain approach or method is not working or is not a solution to a problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 齋坐喺度等都唔係辦法，不如諗下點樣解決佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zaai1 co5 hai2 dou6 dang2 dou1 m4 hai6 baan6 faat3, bat1 jyu4 lam2 haa5 dim2 joeng2 gaai2 kyut3 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 只是坐在这里等也不是办法，不如想想怎么解决它吧。
examples.english_sentence: Just sitting here and waiting isn't a solution, why don't we think about how to solve it?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成日發脾氣都唔係辦法，解決唔到問題㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seng4 jat6 faat3 pei4 hei3 dou1 m4 hai6 baan6 faat3, gaai2 kyut3 m4 dou2 man6 tai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老是发脾气也不是办法，解决不了问题的。
examples.english_sentence: Constantly throwing tantrums isn't a solution, it won't solve the problem.

english_meaning: not believe in evil spirits; not superstitious; defy conventional wisdom; not easily deterred; not afraid of bad luck
explanation_mandarin: 不相信邪恶的力量或迷信说法；形容一个人不畏惧任何阻碍或困难，敢于挑战传统或既定的规则。
explanation_english: To not believe in evil forces, spirits, or superstitions; describes a person who is not afraid of any obstacles or difficulties and dares to challenge traditions or established rules.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁後生就創業，真係唔信邪㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 hau6 saang1 zau6 cong3 jip6, zan1 hai6 m4 seon3 ce4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么年轻就创业，真是个不信邪的人。
examples.english_sentence: He started his own business at such a young age, he's really someone who doesn't believe in superstition and is willing to take risks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲人話唔好喺農曆七月搬屋，但我唔信邪，照搬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jan4 waa6 m4 hou2 hai2 nung4 lik6 cat1 jyut6 bun1 uk1, daan6 ngo5 m4 seon3 ce4, ziu3 bun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人们说不要在农历七月搬家，但我却不信邪，照样搬。
examples.english_sentence: People say you shouldn't move houses during the seventh month of the lunar calendar, but I don't believe in that superstition, so I moved anyway.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 就算所有人都反對，佢都唔信邪，堅持要做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zau6 syun3 so2 jau5 jan4 dou1 faan2 deoi3, keoi5 dou1 m4 seon3 ce4, gin1 ci4 jiu3 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 就算所有人都反对，他也不信邪，坚持要做。
examples.english_sentence: Even if everyone opposes it, he doesn't care and insists on doing it.

mandarin_meaning: 不相信镜子（引申为不相信自己的外貌）
english_meaning: Not trusting the mirror (implying not trusting one's own appearance); insecure about one's looks.
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是不相信镜子里的自己，引申为对自己外貌没有信心，或者觉得自己不如镜子里看到的那么好。
explanation_english: Literally means 'not trusting the mirror.' Figuratively, it means to be insecure about one's appearance, feeling that one doesn't look as good as they appear in the mirror.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日話自己唔信鏡，明明就好靚女。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 waa6 zi6 gei2 m4 seon3 geng3, ming4 ming4 geoi2 hou2 leng3 neoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是说她不相信镜子，明明就很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: She always says she doesn't trust the mirror, even though she's obviously very beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日唔信鏡啦，對自己有啲信心啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 m4 seon3 geng3 laa1, deoi3 zi6 gei2 jau5 di1 seon3 sam1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是不相信镜子啦，对自己有点信心吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't always be insecure about your looks, have some confidence in yourself!

mandarin_meaning: 不打理; 不修理; 不收拾
english_meaning: not to bother; not to maintain; not to repair; not to tidy up
explanation_mandarin: 表示不进行整理、修理或维护的行为。通常指放任不管，不付出努力去改善或修复某事物。
explanation_english: Indicates the act of not tidying up, repairing, or maintaining something. It usually refers to leaving something unattended, without making any effort to improve or fix it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間屋好耐都冇人住，所以好殘，又唔修葺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 uk1 hou2 noi6 dou1 mou5 jan4 zyu6, so2 ji5 hou2 caan4, jau6 m4 sau1 cip3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的房子很久没人住了，所以很破旧，又不修理。
examples.english_sentence: His house has been uninhabited for a long time, so it's very dilapidated and unrepaired.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部車撞到花晒，佢都費事唔修。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 ce1 zong6 dou3 faa1 saai3, keoi5 dou1 fai3 si6 m4 sau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车撞坏了，他都懒得不修理。
examples.english_sentence: The car was damaged in the accident, but he couldn't be bothered to repair it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲文件亂晒籠，都唔修埋佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 man4 gin2 lyun6 saai3 lung1, dou1 m4 sau1 maai4 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 文件乱七八糟的，都不收拾一下。
examples.english_sentence: The documents are all messed up; (you/he/she) don't even tidy them up.

cantonese: 唔做中唔做保，唔做媒人三代好
jyutping: m4 zou6 zung1 m4 zou6 bou2, m4 zou6 mui4 jan4 saam1 doi6 hou2
mandarin_meaning: 不做中间人，不做担保人，不做媒人，三代平安
english_meaning: Don't be a middleman, don't be a guarantor, don't be a matchmaker, and three generations will be blessed.
explanation_mandarin: 意思是劝人不要做中间人、担保人或媒人，因为这些角色都可能带来麻烦和风险，一旦出现问题，容易惹祸上身，甚至影响后代。
explanation_english: This proverb advises people not to be a middleman, guarantor, or matchmaker. These roles can bring trouble and risk, and problems can easily lead to trouble for oneself and even affect future generations. It highlights the potential pitfalls and long-term consequences of taking on these responsibilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做生意最緊要小心，唔好隨便幫人擔保，記住「唔做中唔做保，唔做媒人三代好」啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 seng1 ji3 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 siu2 sam1, m4 hou2 ceoi4 bin2 bong1 jan4 daam1 bou2, gei3 zyu6 "m4 zou6 zung1 m4 zou6 bou2, m4 zou6 mui4 jan4 saam1 doi6 hou2" aa!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做生意最重要的是小心，不要随便帮人担保，记住“不做中间人，不做担保人，不做媒人，三代平安”啊！
examples.english_sentence: The most important thing in business is to be careful and don't casually guarantee for others. Remember "Don't be a middleman, don't be a guarantor, don't be a matchmaker, and three generations will be blessed!"

cantonese: 唔做中，唔做保，唔做媒人三代好
jyutping: m4 zou6 zung1, m4 zou6 bou2, m4 zou6 mui4 jan4 saam1 doi6 hou2
mandarin_meaning: 不做中间人，不做担保人，不做媒人，三代都会好
english_meaning: Don't be a middleman, don't be a guarantor, and don't be a matchmaker, and your descendants will have three generations of good fortune.
explanation_mandarin: 告诫人们不要轻易做中间人、担保人或者媒人，因为这些角色往往容易卷入纠纷，可能会给自己和后代带来麻烦。
explanation_english: This idiom advises people not to easily act as middlemen, guarantors, or matchmakers, because these roles are prone to involvement in disputes, which may bring trouble to themselves and their descendants. It suggests these roles carry significant risk and potential for negative consequences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記住啊，唔做中，唔做保，唔做媒人三代好，啲人情債好難還㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 zyu6 aa3, m4 zou6 zung1, m4 zou6 bou2, m4 zou6 mui4 jan4 saam1 doi6 hou2, di1 jan4 cing4 zaai3 hou2 naan4 waan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记住啊，不做中间人，不做担保人，不做媒人，三代都会好，人情债很难还的。
examples.english_sentence: Remember, don't be a middleman, don't be a guarantor, and don't be a matchmaker, and your descendants will have three generations of good fortune, personal favors are difficult to repay.

english_meaning: Cannot do; Not allowed; Unacceptable
explanation_mandarin: 表示不能够做，不允许做，或者不适合做某件事情。
explanation_english: Indicates that something cannot be done, is not allowed, or is unsuitable for doing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度唔做得食煙㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 m4 zou6 dak1 sik6 hin1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里不可以抽烟。
examples.english_sentence: You're not allowed to smoke here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家太夜啦，唔做得嘈住其他人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 taai3 je6 laa1, m4 zou6 dak1 caau4 zyu6 kei4 taa1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在太晚了，不能吵到其他人。
examples.english_sentence: It's too late now, you can't disturb other people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份報告唔做得交得咁求其。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 bou3 gou3 m4 zou6 dak1 gaau1 dak1 gam3 kau4 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告不能交得这么随便。
examples.english_sentence: This report can't be handed in so sloppily.

english_meaning: to talk non-stop; to be unable to stop talking
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人话很多，一直说个不停，停不下来。通常带有一种稍微负面的意味，表示说话的人很啰嗦。
explanation_english: Describes someone who talks a lot and cannot stop talking. It usually carries a slightly negative connotation, implying that the speaker is long-winded or verbose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一講起佢啲仔女就唔停得口，真係好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 gong2 hei2 keoi5 di1 zai2 neoi5 zau6 m4 ting4 dak1 hau2, zan1 hai6 hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一说起他的子女就说个不停，真是很烦。
examples.english_sentence: Once he starts talking about his children, he can't stop. It's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆一見到我就唔停得口，問長問短。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 jat1 gin3 dou2 ngo5 zau6 m4 ting4 dak1 hau2, man6 coeng4 man6 dyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶一见到我就问这问那，说个不停。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as grandma sees me, she starts talking non-stop, asking all sorts of questions.

jyutping: m4 soeng1 sam1 zau6 m4 lau4 leoi6
english_meaning: You don't cry unless you're sad.
explanation_mandarin: 表示没有伤心的事情，就不会流泪。也比喻事情发生的原因和结果。
explanation_english: This idiom literally means 'If you're not sad, you won't cry.' It implies that there is a reason for a particular reaction or emotion. It expresses the natural cause and effect relationship between sadness and tears.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喊得咁慘，都係唔傷心就唔流淚啫，肯定有啲嘢發生咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haam3 dak1 gam3 caam2, dou1 hai6 m4 soeng1 sam1 zau6 m4 lau4 leoi6 ze1, hang2 ding6 jau5 di1 je5 faat3 sang1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她哭得这么惨，肯定是有什么事情发生了，不然不会这么伤心流泪。
examples.english_sentence: She's crying so hard; something must have happened. You don't cry unless you're sad, after all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿哥突然辭職，唔傷心就唔流淚，一定係公司發生咗啲問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 go1 dat6 jin4 ci4 zik1, m4 soeng1 sam1 zau6 m4 lau4 leoi6, jat1 ding6 hai6 gung1 si1 faat3 sang1 zo2 di1 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哥哥突然辞职，肯定是因为公司发生了一些问题，不然不会这样。
examples.english_sentence: My brother suddenly resigned. There must be problems at the company; you don't just do that for no reason.

english_meaning: not up to standard; not first-rate; low-class; not in the mainstream; not considered important or significant
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人或某事物水平低下，不够资格，或不被主流认可。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone that is not up to standard, unqualified, or not recognized by the mainstream. It implies a lack of quality, competence, or significance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲畫功真係唔入流，學多幾年先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 waa2 gung1 zan1 hai6 m4 jap6 lau4, hok6 do1 gei2 nin4 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的画功真是不入流，再学几年吧。
examples.english_sentence: His painting skills are really not up to standard; he should study for a few more years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅服務真係唔入流，以後都唔會再嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 fuk6 mou6 zan1 hai6 m4 jap6 lau4, ji5 hau6 dou1 m4 wui5 zoi3 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的服务真是不入流，以后都不会再来了。
examples.english_sentence: The service at this restaurant is really low-class; I won't come again in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講啲嘢咁唔入流，根本冇人會聽佢講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 di1 je5 gam3 m4 jap6 lau4, gan1 bun2 mou5 jan4 wui5 teng1 keoi5 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的东西这么不入流，根本没人会听他的。
examples.english_sentence: What he says is so insignificant, no one will listen to him at all.

mandarin_meaning: 不露面, 不出门, 躲藏
english_meaning: to not show one's face, to not leave the house, to hide away
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人长时间躲在家中，不与外界接触，不外出。
explanation_english: Describes a person who stays at home for a long time, avoiding contact with the outside world and not going out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近失戀，成日都唔出窟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 sat1 lyun2, seng4 jat6 dou1 m4 ceot1 fat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近失恋了，整天都不出门。
examples.english_sentence: He's been heartbroken recently and hasn't left the house at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打風落雨，最好都係唔出窟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 fung1 lok6 jyu5, zeoi3 hou2 dou1 hai6 m4 ceot1 fat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刮风下雨，最好还是别出门。
examples.english_sentence: When it's windy and rainy, it's best to not leave the house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排咁多病，我寧願唔出窟，喺屋企睇戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 gam3 do1 beng6, ngo5 ning4 jyun2 m4 ceot1 fat1, hai2 uk1 kei2 tai2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近这么多疾病，我宁愿不出门，在家里看电影。
examples.english_sentence: With so many illnesses lately, I'd rather stay at home and watch movies.

jyutping: m4 ceot1 seng1 mou5 jan4 dong3 nei5 aa2
mandarin_meaning: 不说话没人当你是哑巴
english_meaning: If you don't speak up, no one will assume you're mute; Speak up, or no one will acknowledge your presence.
explanation_mandarin: 指责或鼓励别人要主动表达自己的意见，不然会被忽略。也可能带有一点责怪的语气，暗示对方应该说话而没有说话。
explanation_english: This idiom is used to urge or encourage someone to express their opinions actively, otherwise they will be ignored. It can also carry a slightly accusatory tone, implying that the person should have spoken but didn't.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開會嗰陣你有嘢想講就講啦，唔出聲冇人當你啞㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 wui2 go2 zan6 nei5 jau5 je5 soeng2 gong2 zau6 gong2 laa1, m4 ceot1 seng1 mou5 jan4 dong3 nei5 aa2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开会的时候你想说什么就说吧，不说话没人当你是哑巴。
examples.english_sentence: If you have something to say during the meeting, just say it. If you don't speak up, no one will assume you're mute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔出聲冇人當你啞，有咩唔滿意咪直接講囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 ceot1 seng1 mou5 jan4 dong3 nei5 aa2, jau5 me1 m4 mun5 ji3 mai1 zik6 zip3 gong2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不说话没人当你是哑巴，有什么不满意就直接说啊。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't speak up, no one will assume you're mute, if you are not satisfied with something, just say it directly.

jyutping: m4 ceot1 seng1 mou5 jan4 waa6 nei5 aa2
mandarin_meaning: 不说话没人当你是哑巴
english_meaning: If you don't speak, nobody will call you dumb (or: It's better to remain silent if you have nothing to say; Silence is golden)
explanation_mandarin: 意思是如果没有必要说话，或者说了也没什么用，不如保持沉默。有时也用来讽刺那些喜欢乱说话的人，劝他们少说废话。
explanation_english: It means that if it's not necessary to speak, or if speaking won't be useful, it's better to remain silent. It can also be used to sarcastically tell someone who likes to talk nonsense to shut up and not say useless things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔識嘢就唔好亂咁講啦，唔出聲冇人話你啞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 sik1 je5 zau6 m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 gong2 laa1, m4 ceot1 seng1 mou5 jan4 waa6 nei5 aa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不懂就不要乱说，不说话没人当你是哑巴。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't understand, don't talk nonsense. If you don't speak, nobody will call you dumb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆成日喺度講埋啲無聊嘢，真係唔出聲冇人話你啞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 gong2 maai4 di1 mou4 liu4 je5, zan1 hai6 m4 ceot1 seng1 mou5 jan4 waa6 nei5 aa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个老妇人总是说一些无聊的事情，真是不说话没人当你是哑巴。
examples.english_sentence: That old woman is always saying some silly things, really, if she didn't speak, nobody would call her dumb.

synonyms: 少講兩句啦 (siu2 gong2 loeng5 geoi3 laa1)

cantonese: 唔出辛苦力，點得世間財
jyutping: m4 ceot1 san1 fu2 lik6, dim2 dak1 sai3 gaan1 coi4
mandarin_meaning: 不付出辛勤的努力，怎么能得到世间的财富
english_meaning: No pain, no gain; No effort, no reward; You can't get worldly wealth without hard work.
explanation_mandarin: 形容要得到财富，必须付出辛勤的劳动。
explanation_english: This idiom emphasizes that to acquire wealth and success, one must put in diligent and arduous effort. It highlights the correlation between hard work and financial rewards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你又唔肯做嘢，又想發達，真係唔出辛苦力，點得世間財㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau6 m4 hang2 zou6 je5, jau6 soeng2 faat3 daat6, zan1 hai6 m4 ceot1 san1 fu2 lik6, dim2 dak1 sai3 gaan1 coi4 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你又不肯工作，又想发达，真是不付出辛苦的努力，怎么能得到世间的财富呢？
examples.english_sentence: You don't want to work but you want to get rich. Really, you can't get worldly wealth without hard work, can you?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿強日日OT，就係因為佢信唔出辛苦力，點得世間財。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 koeng4 jat6 jat6 OT, zau6 hai6 jan1 wai6 keoi5 seon3 m4 ceot1 san1 fu2 lik6, dim2 dak1 sai3 gaan1 coi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿强每天都加班，就是因为他相信不付出辛苦的努力，怎么能得到世间的财富。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Keung works overtime every day because he believes that you can't get worldly wealth without hard work.

synonyms: 一分耕耘，一分收穫 (jat1 fan1 gang1 wan4, jat1 fan1 sau1 wok6)
沒有耕耘，哪有收穫 (mut6 jau5 gang1 wan4, naa5 jau5 sau1 wok6)

mandarin_meaning: 不分场合，不分轻重，不分尊卑
english_meaning: Not differentiating between formal and informal situations; not distinguishing between important and unimportant matters; not respecting hierarchy or social boundaries; indiscriminate
explanation_mandarin: 指不分场合、不分轻重缓急、不分尊卑长幼。形容一个人说话或做事不注意场合，没有礼貌，不懂得尊重不同的人或事情。
explanation_english: Describes someone who doesn't differentiate between formal and informal situations, trivial and important matters, or social hierarchies. It implies a lack of respect for social boundaries, etiquette, or the importance of different situations and people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺老闆面前講埋啲唔應該講嘅嘢，真係唔分莊閒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 lou5 baan2 min6 cin4 gong2 maai4 di1 m4 jing1 goi1 gong2 ge3 je5, zan1 hai6 m4 fan1 zong1 haan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在老板面前说一些不该说的话，真是不分场合。
examples.english_sentence: He always says things he shouldn't in front of the boss. He really doesn't know how to act properly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢可唔可以分下莊閒啊？呢件事咁重要，你都唔上心嘅？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 fan1 haa5 zong1 haan4 aa3? ni1 gin6 si6 gam3 zung6 jiu3, nei5 dou1 m4 soeng5 sam1 ge3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做事能不能分一下场合？这件事这么重要，你都不上心？
examples.english_sentence: Can't you tell the importance of things when you're working? This matter is so important, and you don't even care?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋屋企人之間唔需要咁多規矩，唔分莊閒都得嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei2 jan4 zi1 gaan1 m4 seoi1 jiu3 gam3 do1 kwai1 geoi2, m4 fan1 zong1 haan4 dou1 dak1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们家人之间不需要那么多规矩，不用分场合也可以的。
examples.english_sentence: Among family members, we don't need so many rules. It's okay if we don't differentiate between formal and informal.

english_meaning: too late; cannot make it in time; unable to cope
explanation_mandarin: 表示时间或能力上赶不上，无法及时完成或处理。
explanation_english: Indicates that one is unable to make it in time, unable to complete or handle something promptly, or that a situation is beyond one's ability to cope with.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我驚我趕唔切尾班車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 geng1 ngo5 gon2 m4 cit3 mei5 baan1 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我怕我赶不上末班车。
examples.english_sentence: I'm afraid I won't be able to catch the last bus.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 太多嘢做，我真係應付唔切呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: taai3 do1 je5 zou6, ngo5 zan1 hai6 ying3 fu6 m4 cit3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要做的事情太多了，我真的应付不过来啊！
examples.english_sentence: There's too much to do, I really can't cope!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果遲咗報名，就趕唔切參加個比賽喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yu4 gwo2 chi4 zo2 bou3 ming2, zau6 gon2 m4 cit3 caam1 gaa1 go3 bei2 coi3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果报名晚了，就赶不上参加那个比赛了。
examples.english_sentence: If you register late, you won't be able to participate in the competition.

english_meaning: cannot; unable to
explanation_mandarin: 表示能力或可能性不足，无法做到。
explanation_english: Indicates lack of ability or possibility to do something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我睇唔到佢嘅樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tai2 m4 dou3 keoi5 ge3 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我看不见他的样子。
examples.english_sentence: I can't see his face.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽唔到你講乜嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 teng1 m4 dou3 nei5 gong2 mat1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我听不见你说什么。
examples.english_sentence: I can't hear what you're saying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我忍唔到佢嘅態度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jan2 m4 dou3 keoi5 ge3 taai3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我忍受不了他的态度。
examples.english_sentence: I can't stand his attitude.

english_meaning: have no choice but to; must
explanation_mandarin: 表示没有选择，只能做某事。强调被迫性或必要性。
explanation_english: Expresses that there is no other choice but to do something. Emphasizes the forced nature or necessity of the action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日要交報告，唔到你唔做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 jiu3 gaau1 bou3 gou3, m4 dou3 nei5 m4 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天要交报告，你不得不做。
examples.english_sentence: The report is due tomorrow; you have no choice but to do it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢都病到咁，唔到你唔送佢去醫院。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou1 beng6 dou3 gam2, m4 dou3 nei5 m4 sung3 keoi5 heoi3 ji1 yun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他都病成这样了，你不得不送他去医院。
examples.english_sentence: He's so sick; you must take him to the hospital.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽話要我結婚，唔到你唔應承。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 waa6 jiu3 ngo5 git3 fan1, m4 dou3 nei5 m4 jing3 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈说要我结婚，你不得不答应。
examples.english_sentence: My mother said she wants me to get married, you have no choice but to agree.

english_meaning: refuse; disagree; not willing
explanation_mandarin: 表示不同意、不愿意、拒绝。
explanation_english: Expresses disagreement, unwillingness, or refusal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔制呀，點解要我做咁多嘢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zai3 aa3, dim2 gaai2 jiu3 ngo5 zou6 gam3 do1 je5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不同意，为什么要做这么多事情？
examples.english_sentence: I don't agree, why do I have to do so much?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話唔制結婚住，想遲啲先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 m4 zai3 git3 fan1 zyu6, soeng2 ci4 di1 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她说不同意现在结婚，想晚一点再说。
examples.english_sentence: She said she doesn't want to get married yet, she wants to wait a while.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔制咪算囉，唔好迫人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 zai3 mai1 syun3 lo3, m4 hou2 bik1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不同意就算了，不要勉强别人。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't agree, then forget about it, don't force others.

english_meaning: Worse than…; Extremely bad; Unacceptable
explanation_mandarin: 表示情况比某个基准更差，通常用来表达不满或否定。
explanation_english: Used to express that something is worse than something else, usually indicating dissatisfaction or disapproval. It implies the situation is exceptionally bad or unacceptable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試嘅成績唔制得過上次喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 ge3 sing4 zik1 m4 zai3 dak1 gwo3 soeng5 ci3 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试的成绩比上次更差。
examples.english_sentence: The result of this exam is worse than the last one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅態度真係唔制得過，一定要教訓下佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 taai3 dou6 zan1 hai6 m4 zai3 dak1 gwo3, jat1 ding6 jiu3 gaau3 fan3 haa5 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的态度真是糟透了，一定要教训他一下。
examples.english_sentence: His attitude is really unacceptable, he needs to be taught a lesson.

mandarin_meaning: 不开窍, 不识时务, 不懂变通
english_meaning: not adaptable, inflexible, unable to read the situation, lacking social grace or common sense
explanation_mandarin: 形容人反应迟钝，不理解情况，或者不善于交际，不懂得变通。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is slow to understand, doesn't read the situation well, or lacks social skills and the ability to adapt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢咁死板，真係唔化喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 gam3 sei2 baan2, zan1 hai6 m4 faa3 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做事这么死板，真是不开窍。
examples.english_sentence: You're so inflexible in your work, you really lack common sense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁講你都唔明，真係幾唔化下喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 gong2 nei5 dou1 m4 ming4, zan1 hai6 gei2 m4 faa3 haa5 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他都这么说了你还不明白，真是有点不开窍啊。
examples.english_sentence: He's said it like that and you still don't understand? You're really being obtuse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁唔化啦，人哋都俾晒提示你㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 m4 faa3 laa1, jan4 dei6 dou1 bei2 saai3 tai4 si6 nei5 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么不开窍了，人家都已经给了你提示了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so dense, they've already given you all the clues.

english_meaning: not worth it; not cost-effective; uneconomical
explanation_mandarin: 表示做某事不值得，成本高于收益，或者不合算。
explanation_english: Indicates that doing something is not worthwhile, the cost is higher than the benefits, or it's not economical.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買呢架車咁貴，真係唔化算。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 ni1 gaa3 ce1 gam3 gwai3, zan1 hai6 m4 faa3 syun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 买这辆车这么贵，真是不划算。
examples.english_sentence: Buying this car is so expensive, it's really not worth it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家先開始溫書，應該唔化算㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 sin1 hoi1 ci2 wan1 syu1, jing1 goi1 m4 faa3 syun3 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在才开始复习，应该不划算了。
examples.english_sentence: Starting to study now, it's probably not worth it anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搭的士返屋企太貴喇，唔化算，都係搭巴士好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daap3 dik1 si2 faan1 uk1 kei2 taai3 gwai3 laa3, m4 faa3 syun3, dou1 hai6 daap3 baa1 si2 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 坐出租车回家太贵了，不划算，还是坐巴士好些。
examples.english_sentence: Taking a taxi home is too expensive, it's not worth it. It's better to take the bus.

english_meaning: not as good as; not up to; inferior to
explanation_mandarin: 表示不及，比不上。用于比较两者之间的优劣。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is not as good as something else; inferior to. Used to compare the quality or performance of two things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅廣東話唔及你咁流利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gwong2 dung1 waa2 m4 gap6 nei5 gam3 lau4 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的粤语不如你那么流利。
examples.english_sentence: His Cantonese isn't as fluent as yours.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部新電話嘅相機功能都唔及舊嗰部咁好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 san1 din6 waa2 ge3 soeng3 gei1 gung1 nang4 dou1 m4 gap6 gau6 go2 bou6 gam3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部新手机的相机功能都不如旧的那部好。
examples.english_sentence: The camera function of this new phone isn't as good as the old one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嘅體力唔及後生嗰陣咁好喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ge3 tai2 lik6 m4 gap6 hau6 saang1 go2 zan6 gam3 hou2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的体力不如年轻的时候那么好了。
examples.english_sentence: My physical strength is not as good as when I was younger.

english_meaning: cannot tolerate; cannot stand; unbearable
explanation_mandarin: 表示无法忍受或无法接受某种事物或情况。
explanation_english: Indicates an inability to tolerate or accept something or a situation. It suggests that something is unbearable or too much to handle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我真係唔受得佢把聲，好刺耳呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zan1 hai6 m4 sau6 dak1 keoi5 baa2 seng1, hou2 ci3 ji5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我真的受不了他的声音，很刺耳啊！
examples.english_sentence: I really can't stand his voice, it's so piercing!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度嘅天氣濕熱到我唔受得囉！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 ge3 tin1 hei3 sap1 jit6 dou3 ngo5 m4 sau6 dak1 lo1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的天气湿热到我受不了啦！
examples.english_sentence: The weather here is so humid and hot that I can't stand it!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔受得佢咁樣對我講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 sau6 dak1 keoi5 gam2 joeng2 deoi3 ngo5 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我受不了他这样对我说话。
examples.english_sentence: I can't tolerate him talking to me like that.

english_meaning: not only; more than; not limited to; not just
explanation_mandarin: 表示超出某个数量或范围；不仅仅是。
explanation_english: Expresses exceeding a certain quantity or scope; not just.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔只叻，仲好勤力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 zi2 lek1, zung6 hou2 kan4 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不仅聪明，而且很努力。
examples.english_sentence: He is not only smart, but also very hardworking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔只識講廣東話，識講英文添呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zi2 sik1 gong2 gwong2 dung1 waa2, sik1 gong2 ying1 man2 tim1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不只会说广东话，还会说英语呢。
examples.english_sentence: I don't just know how to speak Cantonese, I also know how to speak English.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試唔只佢合格，我都合格呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 m4 zi2 keoi5 hap6 gaak3, ngo5 dou1 hap6 gaak3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试不仅他合格了，我也合格了。
examples.english_sentence: Not only did he pass the exam, I also passed.

english_meaning: not call; don't call; not shout; don't shout
explanation_mandarin: 表示不发出声音，不呼喊，或不打电话。
explanation_english: Indicates not to make a sound, not to shout, or not to call someone on the phone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔舒服，唔叫得咁大聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 syu1 fuk6, m4 giu3 dak1 gam3 daai6 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不舒服，不能叫那么大声。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not feeling well, I can't shout that loudly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔叫你幫手，你都唔好自己嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 giu3 nei5 bong1 sau2, nei5 dou1 m4 hou2 zi6 gei2 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我没叫你帮忙，你也不要自己来。
examples.english_sentence: If I don't ask you to help, don't come on your own.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔叫我，我點知要開會呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 giu3 ngo5, ngo5 dim2 zi1 jiu3 hoi1 wui2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不叫我，我怎么知道要开会呀？
examples.english_sentence: If you don't call me, how would I know there's a meeting?

english_meaning: different, not the same
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物之间存在差异，不相同。
explanation_english: Indicates that things are different, not the same.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嘅諗法同你唔同。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ge3 lam2 faat3 tung4 nei5 m4 tung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的想法和你不同。
examples.english_sentence: My thoughts are different from yours.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢兩件衫嘅顏色唔同。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 loeng5 gin6 saam1 ge3 ngaan4 sik1 m4 tung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这两件衣服的颜色不同。
examples.english_sentence: The colors of these two pieces of clothing are different.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日好似同平時唔同咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 hou2 ci5 tung4 ping4 si4 m4 tung4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天好像和平时不一样了。
examples.english_sentence: He seems different from usual today.

mandarin_meaning: 说法不一；有不同的说法
english_meaning: different versions; different accounts; varying opinions
explanation_mandarin: 指对于同一件事情，有不同的说法或解释。表示各方有不同的观点或立场。
explanation_english: Refers to different versions or interpretations of the same event. It indicates that different parties have different perspectives or stances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事咁多唔同講法，我都唔知信邊個好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 gam3 do1 m4 tung4 gong2 faat3, ngo5 dou1 m4 zi1 seon3 bin1 go3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事有这么多不同的说法，我都不知道该相信谁。
examples.english_sentence: There are so many different versions of this story, I don't know who to believe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 關於佢辭職嘅原因，有唔同講法，有人話佢俾人炒，有人話佢自己唔撈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwaan1 jyu1 keoi5 ci4 zik1 ge3 jyun4 yan1, jau5 m4 tung4 gong2 faat3, jau5 jan4 waa6 keoi5 bei2 jan4 caau2, jau5 jan4 waa6 keoi5 zi6 gei2 m4 lou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 关于他辞职的原因，有不同的说法，有人说他被炒了，有人说他自己不干了。
examples.english_sentence: Regarding the reason for his resignation, there are different accounts. Some say he was fired, and some say he quit on his own.

english_meaning: not here; absent
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人不在某个地方。
explanation_english: Indicates that someone is not at a certain location.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明唔響度，佢去咗買嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 m4 hoeng2 dou6, keoi5 heoi3 zo2 maai5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明不在，他去买东西了。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ming is not here; he went shopping.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我搵佢，但係佢唔響度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wan2 keoi5, daan6 hai6 keoi5 m4 hoeng2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我找他，但是他不在。
examples.english_sentence: I was looking for him, but he wasn't here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經理今日唔響度，有咩事聽日再講啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 lei5 gam1 jat6 m4 hoeng2 dou6, jau5 me1 si6 ting1 jat6 zoi3 gong2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经理今天不在，有什么事明天再说吧。
examples.english_sentence: The manager isn't here today. Let's talk about it tomorrow if there's anything.

english_meaning: Not at home; not in the place (specified); away
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人或某物不在某个地方或地点。
explanation_english: Indicates that someone or something is not in a particular place or location. Often implies they are out or absent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我頭先打電話俾佢，佢唔響處。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tau4 sin1 daa2 din6 waa2 bei2 keoi5, keoi5 m4 hoeng2 cyu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚才给他打电话，他不在家。
examples.english_sentence: I called him just now, he's not at home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明唔響處，要聽日先返。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 m4 hoeng2 cyu3, jiu3 ting1 jat6 sin1 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明不在，要明天才回来。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ming is not here, he will be back tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你搵佢都冇用㗎，佢成日都唔响處嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 wan2 keoi5 dou1 mou5 jung6 gaa3, keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 m4 hoeng2 cyu3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你找他也没用，他经常都不在的。
examples.english_sentence: It's no use looking for him, he's often not around.

mandarin_meaning: 嗯嗯; 唔; 语气词
english_meaning: Uh-huh; Mmm; An interjection indicating agreement, acknowledgment, or hesitation.
explanation_mandarin: 表示同意，认可，或者犹豫的语气词。 在粤语中，通常“唔”的发音是“m4”，重复使用表示轻微的同意或犹豫，也可以用作填补停顿。
explanation_english: An interjection used to indicate agreement, acknowledgment, or hesitation. In Cantonese, '唔' is usually pronounced 'm4'. Repeating it ('唔唔') signifies mild agreement, hesitation, or can be used as a filler word when speaking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘅嘢都幾啱，唔唔，都幾有道理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 ge3 je5 dou1 gei2 aam1, m4 m4, dou1 gei2 jau5 dou6 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说的东西挺对的，嗯嗯，挺有道理的。
examples.english_sentence: What you're saying is quite right, uh-huh, it makes a lot of sense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔唔，等我諗下先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 m4, dang2 ngo5 lam2 haa5 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 嗯嗯，让我想一下先。
examples.english_sentence: Mmm, let me think about it first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: A：你鍾唔鍾意食壽司啊？ B：唔唔，都OK嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: A: nei5 zung1 m4 zung1 ji3 sik6 sau6 si1 aa3? B: m4 m4, dou1 OK ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: A：你喜欢吃寿司吗？ B：嗯嗯，还可以吧。
examples.english_sentence: A: Do you like eating sushi? B: Uh-huh, it's alright.

english_meaning: unnecessary; not worth the effort; pointless; irrelevant
explanation_mandarin: 形容某件事情不重要，或者不需要去做，没有意义。
explanation_english: Describes something as unimportant, unnecessary to do, or meaningless. Suggests that the effort is not worthwhile.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家先嚟講呢啲嘢，都唔啦更啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 sin1 lai4 gong2 ni1 di1 je5, dou1 m4 laa1 gaang1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在才说这些，都无关紧要了。
examples.english_sentence: Talking about these things now is pointless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔鍾意咪唔好做囉，咁唔啦更嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 zung1 ji3 mai1 m4 hou2 zou6 lo1, gam3 m4 laa1 gaang1 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不喜欢就别做了，这么没必要的事情。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't like it, then don't do it. Such an unnecessary thing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 使唔使幫手呀？唔使啦，唔啦更嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai2 m4 sai2 bong1 sau2 aa3? m4 sai2 laa1, m4 laa1 gaang1 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要不要帮忙？不用了，无关紧要的事。
examples.english_sentence: Do you need help? No, it's not important.

mandarin_meaning: 不合適 / 不對 / 不合
english_meaning: unsuitable / not right / incorrect / incompatible / don't get along
explanation_mandarin: 表示不合適、不對、不合適、不相容或不喜歡。
explanation_english: Indicates something is unsuitable, incorrect, doesn't fit, incompatible, or that one dislikes something/someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫唔啱我著。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 m4 ngaam1 ngo5 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服不适合我穿。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt doesn't fit me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋性格唔啱，做唔到朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sing3 gaak3 m4 ngaam1, zou6 m4 dou2 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们性格不合，做不了朋友。
examples.english_sentence: We don't get along, we can't be friends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你計錯數，答案唔啱㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gai3 co3 sou3, daap3 on3 m4 ngaam1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你算错了，答案不对的。
examples.english_sentence: You calculated wrongly, the answer is incorrect.

english_meaning: not compatible, not on the same wavelength, unable to communicate effectively, not get along well (in conversation)
explanation_mandarin: 指两个人性格、观点、兴趣等方面不合拍，导致交流不畅，无法好好聊天。
explanation_english: Describes two people who are not compatible in terms of personality, views, or interests, leading to poor communication and inability to have a good conversation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢真係唔啱傾，講兩句就嘈交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 zan1 hai6 m4 ngaam1 king1, gong2 loeng5 geoi3 zau6 cou4 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我跟他真的不合拍，说两句就吵架。
examples.english_sentence: I really can't get along with him, we argue after just a few words.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅政治立場唔同，梗係唔啱傾啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 zing3 zi6 lap6 coeng4 m4 tung4, gang2 hai6 m4 ngaam1 king1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的政治立场不同，当然谈不来。
examples.english_sentence: Their political stances are different, of course they can't communicate effectively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得我同佢啲價值觀唔同，所以都唔啱傾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 ngo5 tung4 keoi5 di1 gaa3 zik6 gun1 m4 tung4, so2 ji5 dou1 m4 ngaam1 king1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得我和他的价值观不同，所以也谈不来。
examples.english_sentence: I feel like our values are different, so we can't really connect.

synonyms: 唔啱嘴型 (m4 ngaam1 zeoi2 jing4)

english_meaning: not up to standard; not meeting the requirements; not matching
explanation_mandarin: 形容某事物不符合既定的标准或要求，未能达到合格的程度。
explanation_english: Describes something that doesn't meet the required standard or specifications; not qualified or up to par.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫啲手工唔啱合尺，好多線頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 di1 hung1 gung1 m4 ngaam1 hap6 cek3, hou2 do1 sin3 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服的做工不合标准，有很多线头。
examples.english_sentence: The workmanship of this shirt is not up to standard, there are many loose threads.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嘅報告寫得唔啱合尺，要再改過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ge3 bou3 gou3 se2 dak1 m4 ngaam1 hap6 cek3, jiu3 zoi3 goi2 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的报告写得不符合标准，需要再修改。
examples.english_sentence: Your report doesn't meet the requirements, you need to revise it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間餐廳啲衛生唔啱合尺，好污糟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 wai6 sang1 m4 ngaam1 hap6 cek3, hou2 wu1 zou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那家餐厅的卫生不达标，很脏。
examples.english_sentence: The hygiene of his restaurant is not up to standard, it's very dirty.

english_meaning: To not be compatible; to not get along; to clash; to not be to one's liking (food or person)
explanation_mandarin: 形容食物不合口味，或者人与人之间性格、观点不合，难以相处。
explanation_english: Describes when food doesn't suit one's taste, or when people's personalities or views clash, making it difficult to get along.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得佢個人好難相處，同我哋唔啱牙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 keoi5 go3 yan4 hou2 naan4 soeng1 chu2, tung4 ngo5 dei6 m4 ngaam1 ngaa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得他这个人很难相处，和我们合不来。
examples.english_sentence: I think he's a difficult person to get along with; he's not compatible with us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅嘢食唔啱我牙，下次都係唔好嚟啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 ye5 sik6 m4 ngaam1 ngo5 ngaa4, haa6 ci3 dou1 hai6 m4 hou2 lai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物不合我的口味，下次还是不要来了。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is not to my liking; let's not come here next time.

english_meaning: Not compatible; not getting along; not agreeing; not suitable; not a good match
explanation_mandarin: 指两人或事物之间不相配，不协调，或是不合拍，无法顺利相处或合作。也可以指某件事不适合或不符合要求。
explanation_english: Refers to incompatibility, lack of harmony, or not being in sync between two people or things. It can also mean that something is not suitable or does not meet requirements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個性格唔啱蕎，成日嘈交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 sing3 gaak3 m4 ngaam1 kiu4, seng4 jat6 cou4 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个性格不合，经常吵架。
examples.english_sentence: Their personalities are not compatible, they argue all the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工唔啱蕎我，我想搵過份。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 m4 ngaam1 kiu4 ngo5, ngo5 soeng2 wan2 gwo3 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作不适合我，我想找另一份。
examples.english_sentence: This job is not suitable for me, I want to find another one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻色同你件衫唔啱蕎，換第二隻啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 sik1 tung4 nei5 gin6 saam1 m4 ngaam1 kiu4, wun6 dai6 ji6 zek3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个颜色和你的衣服不搭，换另一个颜色吧。
examples.english_sentence: This color doesn't match your clothes, change to another color.

english_meaning: To argue black into white; to twist the facts to make something wrong seem right.
explanation_mandarin: 指明明是错误的事情，硬要说成是对的，颠倒是非。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where someone tries to justify something that is clearly wrong, twisting the facts to make it appear correct. It implies a deliberate attempt to deceive or mislead.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明明撞到人，重要唔啱講到啱，真係好離譜！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 ming4 zong6 dou2 yan4, zung6 jiu3 m4 ngaam1 gong2 dou3 ngaam1, zan1 hai6 hou2 lei4 pu2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明明撞到人了，还要硬把错的说成对的，真是太离谱了！
examples.english_sentence: He clearly bumped into someone, yet he still tries to argue black into white. It's outrageous!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住可以唔啱講到啱，我哋唔會俾你蒙蔽㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 nam2 zyu6 ho2 ji5 m4 ngaam1 gong2 dou3 ngaam1, ngo5 dei6 m4 wui5 bei2 nei5 mung4 bai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别以为你可以硬把错的说成对的，我们不会被你蒙蔽的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can argue black into white; we won't be fooled by you.

mandarin_meaning: 不舒服; 不自在; 彆扭
english_meaning: uncomfortable; uneasy; awkward
explanation_mandarin: 形容身体或心理上感到不舒服、不自在，或感觉别扭。
explanation_english: Describes a feeling of physical or mental discomfort, unease, or awkwardness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 著住呢件衫好唔啹呀，我換返另一件先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoek3 zyu6 ni1 gin6 saam1 hou2 m4 geoi1 aa3, ngo5 wun6 faan1 ling6 jat1 gin6 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 穿着这件衣服很不舒服啊，我换回另一件先。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is very uncomfortable, I'll change back to another one first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 坐喺度講嘢好似唔啹咁，不如我哋出去行下？
examples.jyutping_sentence: co5 hai2 dou6 gong2 je5 hou2 ci5 m4 geoi1 gam2, bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 ceot1 heoi3 haang4 haa5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 坐在这里说话好像不太自在，不如我们出去走走？
examples.english_sentence: Sitting here talking feels a bit awkward, how about we go out for a walk?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日好似唔啹咁，係咪唔舒服呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 hou2 ci5 m4 geoi1 gam2, hai6 mai6 m4 syu1 fuk6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天好像很不舒服，是不是不舒服啊？
examples.english_sentence: He seems uncomfortable today, is he not feeling well?

english_meaning: not only, not just
explanation_mandarin: 表示递进关系，相当于普通话的“不仅，不止”。
explanation_english: Indicates an escalating relationship, similar to 'not only' or 'not just' in Mandarin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔單只聰明，重好勤力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 daan1 zi2 cung1 ming4, zung6 hou2 kan4 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不仅聪明，而且还很勤奋。
examples.english_sentence: He is not only smart, but also very hardworking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳唔單只嘢食好味，價錢又合理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 m4 daan1 zi2 je5 sik6 hou2 mei6, gaa3 cin2 jau6 hap6 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅不仅食物好吃，价格也很合理。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant not only has delicious food, but the prices are also reasonable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔單只識講廣東話，仲識講英文同埋普通話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 daan1 zi2 sik1 gong2 gwong2 dung1 waa2, zung6 sik1 gong2 ying1 man2 tung4 ma4 put3 tung1 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不仅会说广东话，还会说英语和普通话。
examples.english_sentence: He not only speaks Cantonese, but also speaks English and Mandarin.

mandarin_meaning: 不但, 不僅, 不止
english_meaning: not only, not just, more than that
explanation_mandarin: 表示遞進關係，意思是不僅僅是這樣，還有更進一步的情況。
explanation_english: Expresses an intensifying or progressive relationship. Means 'not only' but there's more to it or a more advanced situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔單止叻仔，仲好有禮貌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 daan1 zi2 lek1 zai2, zung6 hou2 jau5 lai5 maau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不但聪明，还很有礼貌。
examples.english_sentence: He is not only smart, but also very polite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳唔單止嘢食好味，價錢都好合理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 m4 daan1 zi2 je5 sik6 hou2 mei6, gaa3 cin2 dou1 hou2 hap6 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅不仅食物好吃，价格也很合理。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant not only has delicious food, but the prices are also very reasonable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔單止幫我搬屋，仲請我食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 daan1 zi2 bong1 ngo5 bun1 uk1, zung6 ceng2 ngo5 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不仅帮我搬家，还请我吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: He not only helped me move, but also treated me to a meal.

english_meaning: not only; not just
explanation_mandarin: 表示递进关系的连词，相当于“不仅”、“不只是”。
explanation_english: A conjunction expressing an additive relationship, equivalent to "not only" or "not just".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳唔單祇啲嘢好食，而且價錢都唔貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 m4 daan1 zi2 di1 je5 hou2 sik6, ji4 ce2 gaa3 cin2 dou1 m4 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅不仅菜好吃，而且价格也不贵。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant not only has delicious food, but the prices are also not expensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔單祇聰明，而且仲好勤力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 daan1 zi2 cung1 ming4, ji4 ce2 zung6 hou2 kan4 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不仅聪明，而且还很勤奋。
examples.english_sentence: He is not only smart but also very diligent.

english_meaning: not here; absent; not in (a place)
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人或某物不在某个地方。指人时，表示缺席或不在场。指物时，表示东西不在这里。
explanation_english: Indicates that someone or something is not in a particular place. When referring to a person, it means absent. When referring to an object, it means that the object is not here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經理唔喺度，我哋等陣再打嚟啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 lei5 m4 hai2 dou6, ngo5 dei6 dang2 zan6 zoi3 daa2 lai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经理不在，我们待会儿再打来吧。

explanation_mandarin: 指一个人精神状态不佳，注意力不集中，反应迟钝，或者心不在焉。
explanation_english: Refers to a person not being mentally present, lacking focus, being slow to react, or being absent-minded. Implies a lack of alertness or awareness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日好似唔喺處咁，做嘢都錯晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 hou2 ci5 m4 hai2 cyu3 gam2, zou6 je5 dou1 co3 saai3.

examples.english_sentence: You seem not with it today; you've made mistakes in all your work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢失戀之後，成日都唔喺處。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sat1 lyun2 zi1 hau6, sing4 jat6 dou1 m4 hai2 cyu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他失恋之后，整天都不在状态。
examples.english_sentence: Ever since he broke up, he's been not all there all the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飲咗咁多酒，佢而家有啲唔喺處。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 喝了这么多酒，他现在有点不在状态。
examples.english_sentence: Having drunk so much alcohol, he's a bit out of it now.

mandarin_meaning: 不沾人间烟火；不食人间烟火
english_meaning: out of touch with reality; impractical; living an unrealistic life; not connected to the common people/everyday struggles
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人不了解普通人的生活，脱离实际，不接地气。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is out of touch with the lives and struggles of ordinary people; detached from reality; impractical and idealistic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋屋企咁有錢，梗係唔嗅米氣㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 uk1 kei5 gam3 jau5 cin2, gang2 hai6 m4 cau3 mai5 hei3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们家这么有钱，肯定是不食人间烟火的。
examples.english_sentence: Their family is so rich, of course they are out of touch with reality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢咁離地，梗係俾人話你唔嗅米氣啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 gam3 lei4 dei6, gang2 hai6 bei2 jan4 waa6 nei5 m4 cau3 mai5 hei3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做事这么不切实际，肯定会被人说你不接地气。
examples.english_sentence: You are so impractical in your work; of course, people will say you're out of touch with reality.

mandarin_meaning: 不咸不淡, 不三不四
english_meaning: neither here nor there; wishy-washy; lukewarm; not serious; half-hearted
explanation_mandarin: 形容态度或做事方式不够认真，不上心，不痛不痒。
explanation_english: Describes an attitude or way of doing things that is not serious, half-hearted, lukewarm, or not quite right. It implies a lack of commitment or enthusiasm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢成日都唔嗲唔吊，難怪老細唔鍾意佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 seng4 jat6 dou1 m4 de1 m4 diu3, naan4 gwaai3 lou5 sai3 m4 zung1 ji3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事总是不咸不淡的，难怪老板不喜欢他。
examples.english_sentence: He always does things in a half-hearted way, no wonder the boss doesn't like him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁樣唔嗲唔吊，认真啲啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 joeng2 m4 de1 m4 diu3, jing6 zan1 di1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这样不认真，认真点吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so wishy-washy, be more serious!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份報告寫得唔嗲唔吊，要重做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dak1 m4 de1 m4 diu3, jiu3 cung4 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告写得马马虎虎，要重做。
examples.english_sentence: The report is not well-written, it needs to be redone.

english_meaning: not a small matter, no small thing, serious, significant
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情重要或严重，不能小看或轻视。
explanation_english: Describes a matter that is important, serious, or significant, and should not be underestimated or taken lightly. Often used sarcastically to imply the opposite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試肥佬， 唔嘢小㗎，要留班㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 fei4 lou2, m4 je5 siu2 gaa3, jiu3 lau4 baan1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试不及格，可不是小事，是要留级的。
examples.english_sentence: Failing this exam is no small matter; you'll have to repeat the year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司升咗做經理， 唔嘢小喎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 sing1 zo2 zou6 ging1 lei5, m4 je5 siu2 wo3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司升职当经理了，不得了啊！
examples.english_sentence: He got promoted to manager at the company, that's quite significant!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你撞爛咗人哋架車，唔嘢小啦，報警處理啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zong6 laan6 zo2 jan4 dei6 gaa3 ce1, m4 je5 siu2 laa1, bou3 ging2 cyu2 lei5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你撞坏了别人的车，可不是小事，报警处理吧。
examples.english_sentence: You crashed into someone's car, that's no small matter, report it to the police.

english_meaning: No small matter; serious; significant; not to be taken lightly
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情的严重性或重要性，不可轻视。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is serious, significant, or important and should not be taken lightly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次單嘢唔嘢少，搞唔掂就大鑊啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 daan1 je5 m4 je5 siu2, gaau2 m4 dim6 zau6 daai6 wok6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的事情非同小可，搞不好的话就麻烦大了。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is no small matter; if we can't handle it, we'll be in big trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日考試喎，溫書唔嘢少㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 haau2 si3 wo3, wan1 syu1 m4 je5 siu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天考试，复习可不是小事啊。
examples.english_sentence: There's an exam tomorrow, so revising is no small matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病得好嚴重，唔嘢少。

examples.english_sentence: He is very sick, it's no small matter.

synonyms: 好大件事 (hou2 daai6 gin2 si6)

english_meaning: Needless to say; of course; obviously
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情显而易见，无需多说，通常用来强调已知的事实。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is obvious and doesn't need to be said. It is often used to emphasize a known fact or a very obvious situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁錫你，唔在講啦，一定會幫你㗎。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那么疼爱你，不用说，肯定会帮你的。
examples.english_sentence: He loves you so much, needless to say, he will definitely help you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁貴嘅嘢，唔在講，一定係好嘢嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam3 gwai3 ge3 je5, m4 zoi6 gong2, jat1 ding6 hai6 hou2 je5 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这么贵的东西，不用说，肯定是好东西。
examples.english_sentence: Such an expensive thing, needless to say, must be good quality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 贏咗咁多錢，唔在講，梗係要請食飯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jeng4 zo2 gam3 do1 cin2, m4 zoi6 gong2, gang2 hai6 jiu3 ceng2 sik6 faan6 laa1.

examples.english_sentence: Won so much money, of course, you have to treat everyone to dinner.

english_meaning: Even if you get your nose close to it, you can't smell anything.
explanation_mandarin: 形容气味非常淡薄，几乎闻不到。也引申为某事非常微小，几乎可以忽略不计。
explanation_english: Describes a very faint smell, almost undetectable. By extension, it can also mean something is very insignificant and almost negligible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢煮嗰碗湯，淡到唔埋得個鼻㗎。

examples.english_sentence: The soup he cooked is so bland that you can't even smell any flavor if you put your nose to it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次佢贏嘅機會，唔埋得個鼻咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 keoi5 wing4 ge3 gei1 wui2, m4 maai4 dak1 go3 bei6 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次他赢的机会，几乎为零。
examples.english_sentence: His chances of winning this time are practically non-existent.

mandarin_meaning: 不近人情; 不给人面子; 不领情
english_meaning: unforgiving; unreasonable; doesn't give any leeway; shows no face; unappreciative; insensitive
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人不通情达理，不给人留面子，或者不领情，比较苛刻。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is unreasonable, doesn't give any leeway, shows no face, or is unappreciative. It implies being harsh or insensitive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人真係唔埋得鼻，遲到一分鐘都唔得！

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人真是不近人情，迟到一分钟都不行！
examples.english_sentence: He is really unforgiving; even being one minute late is not allowed!

examples.mandarin_sentence: 你都道歉这么多次了，他还是不领情，算了。
examples.english_sentence: You've apologized so many times already, but he is still being unappreciative. Just forget about it.

english_meaning: not much; not many; not a lot
explanation_mandarin: 表示数量较少，不多。
explanation_english: Indicates a small quantity or amount; not much or many.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 m4 do1 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天不太舒服。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not feeling very well today.

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 m4 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她话不多。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的游客不多。
examples.english_sentence: There aren't many tourists here.

english_meaning: More or less; just about right; a certain amount
explanation_mandarin: 表示数量或程度不多也不少，刚好合适。也表示有一定的量，但不是很多。
explanation_english: Indicates a quantity or degree that is neither too much nor too little, just right. It can also mean a certain amount, but not a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試，佢哋 唔多唔少 都攞到七十分。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3, keoi5 dei6 m4 do1 m4 siu2 dou1 lo2 dou3 cat1 sap6 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试，他们多多少少都考了七十分。
examples.english_sentence: For this exam, they all got around seventy marks, more or less.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔多唔少都幫咗佢啲忙㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 do1 m4 siu2 dou1 bong1 zo2 keoi5 di1 mong4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我或多或少地帮了他一些忙。
examples.english_sentence: I helped him out a little, more or less.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然我唔係好記得，但係 唔多唔少 都仲有啲印象嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 ngo5 m4 hai6 hou2 gei3 dak1, daan6 hai6 m4 do1 m4 siu2 dou1 zung1 jau5 di1 jan3 zoeng6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然我不是记得很清楚，但或多或少还有一些印象。
examples.english_sentence: Although I don't remember very clearly, I still have some impression, more or less.

english_meaning: not quite right; not well; something is wrong
explanation_mandarin: 表示情况不太好，身体不舒服，或者事情进展不顺利。
explanation_english: Indicates that the situation is not good, feeling unwell, or that things are not going smoothly. It implies that there is a problem or something is amiss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日個人唔多妥，唔想返工。

examples.english_sentence: I don't feel well today, I don't want to go to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦好似有啲唔多妥，成日hang機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 hou2 ci5 jau5 di1 m4 do1 to2, seng4 jat6 hang1 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台电脑好像有点问题，总是死机。
examples.english_sentence: There seems to be something wrong with this computer, it keeps crashing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事好似有啲唔多妥，我哋要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 hou2 ci5 jau5 di1 m4 do1 to2, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事好像有点不对劲，我们要小心一点。
examples.english_sentence: Something seems wrong with this matter, we need to be more careful.

english_meaning: not enough; insufficient; not adequate
explanation_mandarin: 表示数量、程度或能力不足，达不到要求的标准。
explanation_english: Indicates a lack of quantity, degree, or ability; not meeting the required standard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啲錢唔夠買呢部電話呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 di1 cin2 m4 gau3 maai5 ni1 bou6 din6 waa2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的钱不够买这部手机啊。
examples.english_sentence: I don't have enough money to buy this phone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅經驗仲係唔夠，需要多啲時間去學習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ging1 jim6 zung6 hai6 m4 gau3, seoi1 jiu3 do1 di1 si4 gaan3 heoi3 hok6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的经验还是不足，需要更多时间去学习。
examples.english_sentence: His experience is still insufficient; he needs more time to learn.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚嘅餸好似唔夠鹹喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ge3 sung3 hou2 ci5 m4 gau3 haam4 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚的菜好像不够咸。
examples.english_sentence: The dish tonight seems not salty enough.

english_meaning: Can't compete with him/her; Not as good as him/her; Not up to his/her level.
explanation_mandarin: 表示某方面不如对方。 意思是某人在某方面能力、技巧、或者优势不如另一个人。
explanation_english: This phrase means that someone is not as good as another person in a certain aspect, whether it be ability, skill, or advantage. It indicates an inability to compete effectively with the other person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢讀書好叻，我點都唔夠佢嚟㗎啦。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他学习很厉害，我怎么也比不上他的。
examples.english_sentence: He's very good at studying; I can't compete with him at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打波咁勁，我梗係唔夠佢嚟啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 bo1 gam3 ging6, ngo5 gang2 hai6 m4 gau3 keoi5 lai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他打球那么厉害，我肯定比不上他的。
examples.english_sentence: He's so good at playing ball; of course, I can't compete with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢經驗咁豐富，你唔夠佢嚟嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging1 gim6 gam3 fung1 fu3, nei5 m4 gau3 keoi5 lai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经验那么丰富，你比不上他的。
examples.english_sentence: He is so experienced; you can't compete with him.

synonyms: 冇佢咁掂 (mou5 keoi5 gam3 dim3)

english_meaning: not satisfying; not enough to satisfy a craving or desire

explanation_english: Describes something that is not enough to satisfy a need or desire, usually referring to food, entertainment, etc. It implies a lack of intensity or completeness in the experience.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 这盘咖喱鱼蛋不够过瘾，再来一串！
examples.english_sentence: This plate of curry fish balls is not satisfying enough, give me another skewer!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 套戲嘅動作場面雖然精彩，但係我覺得唔夠喉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou3 hei3 ge3 dung6 zok3 coeng4 min6 seoi1 jin4 zing1 coi2, daan6 hai6 ngo5 gok3 dak1 m4 gau3 hau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影的动作场面虽然精彩，但是我感觉不过瘾。
examples.english_sentence: Although the action scenes in this movie were spectacular, I didn't find them satisfying enough.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 淨係睇咗一集，真係唔夠喉，我要煲埋成套劇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing6 hai6 tai2 zo2 jat1 zaap6, zan1 hai6 m4 gau3 hau4, ngo5 jiu3 bou1 maai4 sing4 tou3 kek6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 只看了一集，真是不够过瘾，我要一口气看完整部剧！
examples.english_sentence: Having only watched one episode is really not enough, I want to binge-watch the whole series!

english_meaning: Not enough to fill the gap between the teeth; Insufficient; Paltry; Meager
explanation_mandarin: 形容数量、质量等非常少，不足以满足需求，连塞牙缝都不够。
explanation_english: Describes something as being extremely small or insignificant in quantity or quality, insufficient to satisfy a need; not even enough to fill the gap between your teeth (meaning it's barely anything). It implies the amount is so small it's almost worthless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰啲人工唔夠攝牙罅，點夠養家啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 di1 jan4 gung1 m4 gau3 sip3 ngaa4 laa3, dim2 gau3 joeng5 gaa1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那点工资不够塞牙缝，怎么够养家啊？
examples.english_sentence: That salary is not even enough to fill the gap between my teeth, how can it be enough to support a family?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀嗰啲錢，唔夠攝牙罅㗎，使乜同佢客氣呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 go2 di1 cin2, m4 gau3 sip3 ngaa4 laa3 gaa3, sai2 mat1 tung4 keoi5 hak3 hei3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他给的那些钱，不够塞牙缝的，为什么要跟他客气呢？
examples.english_sentence: The money he gave is barely enough to fill a tooth gap, why should we be polite to him?

english_meaning: short of breath; out of breath; not enough air; breathless
explanation_mandarin: 指呼吸困难，感觉空气不足，无法顺畅呼吸。
explanation_english: Refers to having difficulty breathing, feeling like there is not enough air, and being unable to breathe smoothly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 跑完步之後，我哋都覺得有啲唔夠氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: paau2 jyun4 bou6 zi1 hau6, ngo5 dei6 dou1 gok3 dak1 jau5 di1 m4 gau3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 跑步之后，我们都觉得有点气不足。
examples.english_sentence: After running, we all felt a bit short of breath.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢行咗幾層樓梯，已經唔夠氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haang4 zo2 gei2 cang4 lau4 tai1, ji5 ging1 m4 gau3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他走了几层楼梯，已经气喘吁吁。
examples.english_sentence: He walked up a few flights of stairs and was already out of breath.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話我唔夠氣，要多啲休息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 m4 gau3 hei3, jiu3 do1 di1 jau1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说我气不足，要多休息。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said I'm short of breath and need to rest more.

english_meaning: Not enough; insufficient; not having enough to get by; not enough investment/capital; not enough power/strength
explanation_mandarin: 指某件事物的数量、质量、力度等不足，无法满足需求或达到预期效果。
explanation_english: Refers to something lacking in quantity, quality, or intensity, insufficient to meet the needs or achieve the desired effect. Can refer to a lack of money, resources, effort, or any other necessary ingredient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日帶得一百蚊，唔夠皮買呢件衫喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 daai3 dak1 jat1 baak3 man1, m4 gau3 pei4 maai5 ni1 gin6 saam1 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天只带了一百块钱，不够买这件衣服的。
examples.english_sentence: I only brought one hundred dollars today, not enough to buy this shirt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你讀書唔夠皮，點考到大學啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 duk6 syu1 m4 gau3 pei4, dim2 haau2 dou3 daai6 hok6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你读书不够努力，怎么考得上大学啊？
examples.english_sentence: You don't study hard enough, how are you going to get into university?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部車嘅引擎唔夠皮，上唔到斜坡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 ce1 ge3 jing5 ging2 m4 gau3 pei4, soeng5 m4 dou2 ce4 po1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车的引擎动力不足，上不了坡。
examples.english_sentence: This car's engine isn't powerful enough to climb the hill.

english_meaning: not enough to watch, not worth watching, uninteresting
explanation_mandarin: 指某事物不值得观看，没有吸引力，令人觉得沉闷或无聊。
explanation_english: Describes something that is not worth watching, lacking appeal, and generally considered boring or uninteresting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 套戲真係好悶， 唔夠眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou3 hei3 zan1 hai6 hou2 mun6, m4 gau3 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影真无聊，不值得看。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is really boring, not worth watching.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個節目都唔夠眼嘅，轉台啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 zit3 muk6 dou1 m4 gau3 ngaan5 ge3, zyun2 toi4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个节目都没什么好看的，换台吧。
examples.english_sentence: That program is not very interesting, let's change the channel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲八卦新聞咁低俗，真係唔夠眼嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 baat3 gwaa3 san1 man2 gam3 dai1 suk6, zan1 hai6 m4 gau3 ngaan5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些八卦新闻这么低俗，真是不值得看。
examples.english_sentence: These gossip news are so vulgar, really not worth watching.

english_meaning: not enough sleep, sleep-deprived
explanation_mandarin: 指睡眠时间不足，导致身体疲劳或精神不振。
explanation_english: Refers to not getting enough sleep, resulting in physical fatigue or mental sluggishness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我尋晚唔夠瞓，今日返工好眼瞓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cam4 maan5 m4 gau3 fan3, gam1 jat6 faan1 gung1 hou2 ngaan5 fan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨晚睡眠不足，今天上班很困。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't get enough sleep last night, and I'm very sleepy at work today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你面色咁差，係咪唔夠瞓啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 min6 sik1 gam3 caa1, hai6 mai1 m4 gau3 fan3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你脸色这么差，是不是睡眠不足啊？
examples.english_sentence: Your complexion is so bad, are you not getting enough sleep?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 長期唔夠瞓對身體唔好㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 kei4 m4 gau3 fan3 deoi3 san1 tai2 m4 hou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 长期睡眠不足对身体不好。
examples.english_sentence: Not getting enough sleep in the long term is bad for your health.

mandarin_meaning: 不够分量; 不够资格; 不成熟
english_meaning: Not enough weight; not qualified; immature; not up to standard
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是重量不够，引申为经验不足，不够资格，或者（指人）不成熟。
explanation_english: Literally means 'not enough weight'. Figuratively, it means not having enough experience, not being qualified, or (referring to a person) being immature and lacking the necessary experience or qualifications.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢唔夠秤，仲要學多啲嘢先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6嘢 m4 gau3 ceng3, zung6 jiu3 hok6 do1 dik1嘢 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事不够资格，还需要多学点东西才行。
examples.english_sentence: He's not qualified enough to do the job; he needs to learn more things first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都仲係唔夠秤，唔好咁快諗住創業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 zung6 hai6 m4 gau3 ceng3, m4 hou2 gam3 faai3 lam2 zyu6 chong3 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你还不够成熟，不要这么快想着创业。
examples.english_sentence: You're still not mature enough; don't think about starting a business so soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅食物唔夠秤，啲份量好細。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 sik6 mat6 m4 gau3 ceng3, di1 fan6 leong6 hou2 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物不够量，份量很小。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is not up to standard, the portions are too small.

english_meaning: not generous enough; stingy; not up to par; subpar
explanation_mandarin: 指不够慷慨、吝啬，或者指不够好、未达到标准。
explanation_english: Refers to not being generous enough, stingy, or not being good enough, not meeting the standard; subpar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好孤寒，俾利是都係得廿蚊，真係唔夠算。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 gu1 hon4, bei2 lei6 si6 dou1 hai6 dak1 jaa6 sap6 man1, zan1 hai6 m4 gau3 syun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很小气，给红包才二十块钱，真是太吝啬了。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very stingy person, giving only twenty dollars in red envelopes, it's really not generous enough.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅服務唔夠算，下次都係去第二間好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 fuk6 mou6 m4 gau3 syun3, haa6 ci3 dou1 hai6 heoi3 dai6 ji6 gaan1 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的服务不够好，下次还是去另一家好一些。
examples.english_sentence: The service at this restaurant is subpar, next time it's better to go to another one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個價錢，老闆仲話要減多啲，真係唔夠算。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gaa3 cin2, lou5 baan2 zung6 waa6 jiu3 gaam2 do1 di1, zan1 hai6 m4 gau3 syun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个价钱，老板还说要再便宜点，真是太吝啬了。
examples.english_sentence: With this price, the boss still says he wants to reduce it more, it's really stingy.

english_meaning: Not enough people; short-staffed; lacking sufficient personnel
explanation_mandarin: 指人手不足，人数不够。通常指缺少足够的人来完成某项任务。
explanation_english: Refers to a lack of sufficient personnel. It usually means there aren't enough people to complete a task.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日要搬屋，但係而家仲係唔夠腳，要再搵多幾個人嚟幫手先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 jiu3 bun1 uk1, daan6 hai6 ji4 gaa1 zung6 hai6 m4 gau3 goek3, jiu3 zoi3 wan2 do1 gei2 go3 jan4 lai4 bong1 sau2 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天要搬家，但是现在还是不够人手，要再找多几个人来帮忙才行。
examples.english_sentence: We're moving house tomorrow, but we're still short-staffed, we need to find a few more people to help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳最近生意好好，成日都唔夠腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 zeoi3 gan6 sang1 ji3 hou2 hou2, seng4 jat6 dou1 m4 gau3 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅最近生意很好，经常人手不够。
examples.english_sentence: The restaurant has been doing really good business lately, and is often short-staffed.

english_meaning: not good; don't; not to
explanation_mandarin: 表示否定，可以表示不好，不要，不应该等意思。
explanation_english: Expresses negation. Can mean not good, don't, shouldn't, etc. depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，我遲到咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si3, ngo5 ci4 dou3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我迟到了。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I'm late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁做啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 zou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这样做了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't do that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日天氣唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 tin1 hei3 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天天气不好。
examples.english_sentence: The weather is not good today.

english_meaning: Don't go die / Don't kill yourself
explanation_mandarin: 劝阻某人自杀或放弃生命。
explanation_english: A phrase used to dissuade someone from committing suicide or giving up on life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 無論發生咩事都好， 唔好去死啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou4 leon6 faat3 sang1 me1 si6 dou1 hou2, m4 hou2 heoi3 sei2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 无论发生什么事都好，不要去死啊！
examples.english_sentence: No matter what happens, don't kill yourself!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嘅生命好寶貴㗎， 唔好去死啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ge3 sang1 ming6 hou2 bou2 gwai3 gaa3, m4 hou2 heoi3 sei2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的生命很宝贵，不要去死啦。
examples.english_sentence: Your life is precious, don't go and die.

english_meaning: uncomfortable, not feeling well, feeling bad, suffering
explanation_mandarin: 表示身体或精神上感到不舒服，难受，不好过。
explanation_english: Describes a feeling of physical or mental discomfort, suffering, or not feeling well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 病咗咁耐，真係唔好受。
examples.jyutping_sentence: beng6 zo2 gam3 noi6, zan1 hai6 m4 hou2 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 病了这么久，真是不好受。
examples.english_sentence: Having been sick for so long, it's really uncomfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭痛到爆炸，好唔好受呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 tung3 dou3 baau3 zaa3, hou2 m4 hou2 sau6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 头痛到爆炸，很难受啊！
examples.english_sentence: My head is throbbing, it's so uncomfortable!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 失戀嘅感覺真係唔好受。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sat1 lyun2 ge3 gam2 gok3 zan1 hai6 m4 hou2 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 失恋的感觉真是不好受。
examples.english_sentence: The feeling of heartbreak is really awful.

mandarin_meaning: 说话不留情面; 说话刻薄
english_meaning: To have a sharp tongue; to be foul-mouthed; to say unpleasant things
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人说话尖酸刻薄，不顾及别人的感受。
explanation_english: Describes someone who speaks sharply and unkindly, without considering the feelings of others; implies using hurtful or unpleasant language.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人真係唔好口，成日講啲嘢傷害人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 zan1 hai6 m4 hou2 hau2, seng4 jat6 gong2 di1 je5 soeng1 hoi6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人真的很说话不留情面，总是说些话伤害人。
examples.english_sentence: He really has a sharp tongue, always saying things that hurt people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁唔好口啦，講嘢温柔啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 m4 hou2 hau2 laa1, gong2 je5 wan1 jau1 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么说话刻薄了，说话温柔点吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so foul-mouthed, speak more gently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 就算你嬲，都唔使咁唔好口嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau6 syun3 nei5 nau1, dou1 m4 sai2 gam3 m4 hou2 hau2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 就算你生气，也不用这么说话刻薄吧。
examples.english_sentence: Even if you're angry, you don't have to be so harsh with your words.

english_meaning: You're welcome; Don't mention it; Please don't stand on ceremony; Help yourself.
explanation_mandarin: 表示不用客气，用于回应别人的感谢，或劝别人不要拘束。
explanation_english: An expression used to respond to someone's gratitude, or to encourage someone to relax and not stand on ceremony.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你幫我拎嘢，唔好客氣！
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 bong1 ngo5 ling1 je5, m4 hou2 hak3 hei3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢你帮我拿东西，不用客气！
examples.english_sentence: Thanks for helping me carry things, you're welcome!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你鍾意食就食多啲啦，唔好客氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung1 yi3 sik6 zau6 sik6 do1 di1 laa1, m4 hou2 hak3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你喜欢吃就多吃点吧，别客气。
examples.english_sentence: If you like it, eat more, please don't stand on ceremony.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使多謝，幫到你我都好開心，唔好客氣！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 do1 ze6, bong1 dou2 nei5 ngo5 dou1 hou2 hoi1 sam1, m4 hou2 hak3 hei3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用谢，帮到你我也很高兴，不用客气！
examples.english_sentence: No need to thank me, I'm happy to help you, you're welcome!

synonyms: 使乜客氣 (sai2 mat1 hak3 hei3)

english_meaning: excuse me; sorry; embarrassed; shy
explanation_mandarin: 表示抱歉、不好意思、害羞等多种含义，根据语境而定。
explanation_english: Expresses apology, embarrassment, shyness, or reluctance depending on the context. It can also be used to politely get someone's attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，借問聲廁所喺邊呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ze3 man6 seng1 ci3 so2 hai2 bin1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，请问厕所在哪里？
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, could you tell me where the restroom is?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思啊，我遲到咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1 aa3, ngo5 ci4 dou3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我迟到了。
examples.english_sentence: I'm sorry, I'm late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔好意思問佢攞錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 hou2 ji3 si1 man6 keoi5 lo2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不好意思问他要钱。
examples.english_sentence: I feel embarrassed to ask him for money.

english_meaning: inauspicious; unlucky; of ill omen
explanation_mandarin: 指事情或说话不吉利，会带来坏运气或不好的结果。
explanation_english: Refers to something said or done that is considered unlucky and may bring bad fortune or unfavorable outcomes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年流流，唔好講啲咁唔好意頭嘅嘢啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 lau4 lau4, m4 hou2 gong2 di1 gam3 m4 hou2 ji3 tau4 ge3 je5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年期间，不要说这么不吉利的话！
examples.english_sentence: It's Chinese New Year, don't say such unlucky things!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打破咗玻璃，真係唔好意頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 po3 zo2 bo1 lei1, zan1 hai6 m4 hou2 ji3 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 打碎了玻璃，真是不吉利。
examples.english_sentence: Breaking the glass is really bad luck.

english_meaning: Don't be slow; Hurry up; Don't dawdle
explanation_mandarin: 指动作慢，拖拉，需要加快速度。
explanation_english: Refers to being slow or sluggish in action, indicating the need to speed up. It's often used as a gentle chiding or encouragement to be faster.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 快啲啦，唔好手腳，我哋趕時間啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: faai3 di1 laa1, m4 hou2 sau2 goek3, ngo5 dei6 gaan2 si4 gaan3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 快点儿，别磨蹭，我们赶时间呢！
examples.english_sentence: Hurry up, don't be slow, we're in a rush!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好手腳啦，陣間就冇位坐㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sau2 goek3 laa1, zan6 gaan1 zau6 mou5 wai2 co5 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别慢吞吞的，一会儿就没座位了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't dawdle, or there won't be any seats left later.

english_meaning: Don't be angry; Don't be grumpy
explanation_mandarin: 表示劝告或请求对方不要发脾气，保持冷静。
explanation_english: A phrase used to advise or request someone not to lose their temper or be grumpy; to stay calm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日先搞啦，唔好老脾住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 sin1 gaau2 laa1, m4 hou2 lou5 pei4 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天再弄吧，不要生气了。
examples.english_sentence: Let's deal with it tomorrow, don't be angry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 使乜老脾啫，慢慢講咪得囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai2 mat1 lou5 pei4 ze1, maan6 maan2 gong2 mai1 dak1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 干嘛生气呢，慢慢说就好了。
examples.english_sentence: Why are you so grumpy? Just talk slowly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 知你唔開心，但係唔好老脾對住我呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi1 nei5 m4 hoi1 sam1, daan6 hai6 m4 hou2 lou5 pei4 deoi3 zyu6 ngo5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 知道你不开心，但是不要对我发脾气啊。
examples.english_sentence: I know you're not happy, but don't be grumpy with me.

english_meaning: Don't say; let alone; not to mention
explanation_mandarin: 表示一种递进或补充说明的语气，强调后面的内容更加突出或明显。
explanation_english: Indicates an intensifying or supplementary tone, emphasizing that the following content is even more prominent or obvious. Often used to introduce a point that is even more significant than the previous one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢連廣東話都唔識講，唔好話英文啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lin4 gwong2 dung1 waa2 dou1 m4 sik1 gong2, m4 hou2 waa6 ying1 man2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他连广东话都不会说，更别说英语了。
examples.english_sentence: He can't even speak Cantonese, let alone English.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度啲嘢咁貴，唔好話買衫，連食飯都成問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 di1 ye5 gam3 gwai3, m4 hou2 waa6 maai5 saam1, lin4 sik6 faan6 dou1 sing4 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的东西这么贵，别说买衣服，连吃饭都成问题。
examples.english_sentence: Things are so expensive here, not to mention buying clothes, even eating is a problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病到行都行唔到，唔好話做嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 dou3 haang4 dou1 haang4 m4 dou2, m4 hou2 waa6 zou6 ye5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病到走路都走不了，更别说工作了。
examples.english_sentence: He's so sick that he can't even walk, let alone work.

english_meaning: not having a good time; not doing well; having a hard time; miserable
explanation_mandarin: 表示生活境况不好，日子难过，不舒服。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone is not doing well, having a hard time, or is miserable. It can refer to financial difficulties, emotional distress, or general unhappiness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近經濟唔好，好多人都覺得唔好過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 gok3 dak1 m4 hou2 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近经济不好，很多人都觉得不好过。
examples.english_sentence: The economy hasn't been good lately, and a lot of people are having a hard time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 失業之後，佢嘅日子就唔好過咯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sat1 jip6 zi1 hau6, keoi5 ge3 jat6 zi2 zau6 m4 hou2 gwo3 lok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 失业之后，他的日子就不好过了。
examples.english_sentence: After losing his job, he had a hard time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試考得咁差，阿媽一定唔俾我好過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si5 haau2 dak1 gam3 caa1, aa3 maa1 jat1 ding6 m4 bei2 ngo5 hou2 gwo3.
