examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试考得这么差，妈妈一定不会让我好过。
examples.english_sentence: I did so badly on the exam, my mom definitely won't let me have it easy.

mandarin_meaning: 不舒服，不顺心，关系不好
english_meaning: not comfortable; not well; to have a bad relationship; to disapprove of
explanation_mandarin: 1. 形容身体不舒服，感到不适。2. 形容事情不顺利，让人感到不满意。3. 形容人际关系不好，存在矛盾或不和。
explanation_english: 1. To feel unwell or uncomfortable (physically). 2. To describe something not going smoothly or being unsatisfactory. 3. To describe a bad relationship between people, implying conflict or discord.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日覺得有啲唔妥，好似發燒咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 gok3 dak1 jau5 di1 m4 to2, hou2 ci5 faat3 siu1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天觉得有点不舒服，好像发烧了。
examples.english_sentence: I feel a bit unwell today, like I have a fever.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個好似唔妥，成日嘈交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hou2 ci5 m4 to2, seng4 jat6 cou4 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个好像关系不好，经常吵架。
examples.english_sentence: It seems like they have a bad relationship, they argue all the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事我睇唔妥，覺得唔合理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ngo5 tai2 m4 to2, gok3 dak1 m4 hap6 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事我看不过去，觉得不合理。
examples.english_sentence: I disapprove of this matter; I think it's unreasonable.

mandarin_meaning: 不生气才怪；要是不生气就奇怪了
english_meaning: It's strange not to be angry; of course I'm angry; I'd be surprised if I weren't angry.
explanation_mandarin: 表示理所当然应该生气，语气强烈，反语的意味。
explanation_english: Expresses that it is only natural to be angry in the situation. The tone is strong and often ironic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 俾人呃咗咁多錢，唔嬲就假啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 jan4 aak1 zo2 gam3 do1 cin2, m4 nau1 zau6 gaa2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 被别人骗了这么多钱，不生气才怪！
examples.english_sentence: Being cheated out of so much money, of course I'm angry!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明成日遲到，今次仲要放飛機，唔嬲就假。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 sing4 jat6 ci4 dou3, gam1 ci3 zung1 jiu3 fong3 fei1 gei1, m4 nau1 zau6 gaa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明总是迟到，这次还要放鸽子，不生气才怪。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ming is always late, and this time he stood me up. I'd be surprised if I weren't angry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁樣對你，你唔嬲就假㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 joeng2 deoi3 nei5, nei5 m4 nau1 zau6 gaa2 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那样对你，你不生气才怪呢。
examples.english_sentence: The way he treated you, of course you're angry.

english_meaning: uncertain; not sure; indefinite; not necessarily
explanation_mandarin: 表示不确定，没有肯定的答案或结果。
explanation_english: Indicates uncertainty, the lack of a definite answer or outcome; meaning 'not definite' or 'not necessarily'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日唔定有時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 m4 ding6 jau5 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天不一定有时间。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not sure if I'll have time tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢會唔會嚟，真係唔定㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wui5 m4 wui5 lai4, zan1 hai6 m4 ding6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他会不会来，真的不一定。
examples.english_sentence: Whether he will come or not, it's really uncertain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個方法一定work 㗎？唔定喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fong1 faat3 jat1 ding6 work gaa3? m4 ding6 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个方法一定有效吗？不一定啊。
examples.english_sentence: Is this method sure to work? Not necessarily.

english_meaning: You're welcome; Don't mention it; Not at all
explanation_mandarin: 表示不用客气，通常在别人感谢时使用。
explanation_english: A polite phrase used in response to someone thanking you, indicating that no thanks are necessary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你幫我，唔客氣！
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 bong1 ngo5, m4 hak3 hei3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢你帮助我，不客气！
examples.english_sentence: Thank you for helping me, you're welcome!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使客氣，舉手之勞啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 hak3 hei3, geoi2 sau2 zi1 lou4 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用客气，举手之劳而已。
examples.english_sentence: Don't mention it, it was just a small favor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁客氣啦，當自己屋企咁就得㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 hak3 hei3 laa1, dong3 zi6 gei2 uk1 kei2 gam2 zau6 dak1 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么客气啦，就当自己家一样就行了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so polite, just make yourself at home.

english_meaning: No road closure; road is not closed; the road is open
explanation_mandarin: 表示道路没有被封闭，可以通行。
explanation_english: Indicates that the road is not closed and is open to traffic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好彩呀，頭先以為封路，點知嚟到又唔封路喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 coi2 aa3, tau4 sin1 ji5 wai4 fung1 lou6, dim2 zi1 lai4 dou3 jau6 m4 fung1 lou6 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 幸运啊，刚才以为封路了，没想到到这里又不封路了。
examples.english_sentence: Lucky, I thought the road was closed earlier, but unexpectedly it's not closed when I got here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日馬拉松比賽，不過佢哋話主要幹道唔封路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 maa5 laai1 sung3 bei2 coi3, bat1 gwo3 keoi5 dei6 waa6 zyu2 jiu3 gon3 dou6 m4 fung1 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天有马拉松比赛，不过他们说主要干道不封路。
examples.english_sentence: There's a marathon race tomorrow, but they said the main roads will not be closed.

english_meaning: something's not right; fishy; off; amiss; suspicious
explanation_mandarin: 指事情或情况感觉不对劲，有异样，可能存在问题或危险。
explanation_english: Describes a situation or feeling that something is not right, amiss, or suspicious. It indicates that there might be a problem or danger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我睇佢個樣唔對路，好似有嘢瞞住我哋咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tai2 keoi5 go3 joeng2 m4 deoi3 lou6, hou2 ci5 jau5 je5 maan6 zyu6 ngo5 dei6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我看他的样子不对劲，好像有什么事情瞒着我们。
examples.english_sentence: I think he looks suspicious, as if he's hiding something from us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事越諗越唔對路，我哋要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 yut6 lam2 yut6 m4 deoi3 lou6, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事越想越不对劲，我们要小心点。
examples.english_sentence: The more I think about this, the more suspicious it seems. We need to be careful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司近排成日炒人，好唔對路喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 gan6 paai1 seng4 jat6 caau2 jan4, hou2 m4 deoi3 lou6 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司最近经常裁员，感觉很不对劲啊。
examples.english_sentence: This company has been firing people frequently lately; something seems off.

english_meaning: not few; quite a lot; many
explanation_mandarin: 表示数量较多，不是少数。
explanation_english: Indicates a considerable quantity; not a small amount; quite a few; many.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗唔少嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 m4 siu2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买了不少东西。
examples.english_sentence: He bought quite a lot of things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試唔少人都肥佬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 m4 siu2 dou1 jan4 dou1 fei4 lou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试不少人都没及格。
examples.english_sentence: Quite a few people failed the exam this time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋識咗唔少年啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sik1 zo2 m4 siu2 nin4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们认识不少年了。
examples.english_sentence: We have known each other for quite a few years.

english_meaning: indispensable; cannot be without; essential; must have
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事物是不可缺少或不可或缺的。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is indispensable or essential.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 去旅行，相機唔少得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: heoi3 leoi5 hang4, soeng3 gei1 m4 siu2 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去旅行，相机是少不了的。
examples.english_sentence: When traveling, a camera is indispensable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開派對，啤酒同零食唔少得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 paai3 deoi2, be1 zau2 tung4 ling4 sik6 m4 siu2 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开派对，啤酒和零食少不了。
examples.english_sentence: When hosting a party, beer and snacks are essential.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做粵菜，豉油唔少得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jyut6 coi3, si6 jau4 m4 siu2 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做粤菜，酱油是少不了的。
examples.english_sentence: When cooking Cantonese cuisine, soy sauce is indispensable.

mandarin_meaning: 不骂不听话; 不鞭策不进步
english_meaning: You won't get anywhere unless you're criticized; no progress without some pressure or reprimand; things won't improve unless you scold/criticize them.
explanation_mandarin: 指人或事物不施加压力就不会有进展，需要督促和批评才能有改进。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where things won't improve or people won't progress unless they are criticized or pressured. It implies that some degree of reprimand or forcing is necessary to achieve results.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好hea，真係要唔屌唔鬆化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 hea1, zan1 hai6 jiu3 m4 diu2 m4 sung1 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作很懒散，真的需要骂一下才行。
examples.english_sentence: He's very lazy at work, you really have to scold him to get anything done.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢班細路仔唔屌唔鬆化，日日都唔做功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baan1 sai3 lou2 zai2 m4 diu2 m4 sung1 faa3, jat1 jat1 dou1 m4 zou6 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这群小孩子不骂他们就不会听话，每天都不做功课。
examples.english_sentence: These kids won't listen unless you scold them; they don't do their homework every day.

mandarin_meaning: 不行, 不可以, 不能
english_meaning: cannot, not allowed, won't work, impossible
explanation_mandarin: 表示否定，指不允许、不能做、不可能等。可以表示拒绝或事情不可行。
explanation_english: Expresses negation, indicating that something is not allowed, impossible, or cannot be done. Can be used to refuse a request or indicate that something is not feasible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔得閒，唔可以同你出去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 dak1 haan4, m4 ho2 ji5 tung4 nei5 chut1 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我没空，不能和你出去。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not free, I can't go out with you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個方法唔得嘅，要諗過第二個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fong1 faat3 m4 dak1 ge3, jiu3 lam2 gwo3 dai6 ji6 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个方法行不通，要再想另一个。
examples.english_sentence: This method won't work, we need to think of another one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔得！你唔可以咁樣做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 dak1! nei5 m4 ho2 ji5 gam2 joeng2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不行！你不能这样做。
examples.english_sentence: No! You can't do that.

english_meaning: terrible; awful; disastrous; hopeless; very serious; extremely; terribly; unbelievably
explanation_mandarin: 表示情况非常糟糕，超出控制，严重到无法解决。也可以表示程度很高，达到惊人的地步。
explanation_english: Used to describe a situation that is very bad, out of control, or too serious to be solved. It can also express a high degree, reaching an astonishing level.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 發燒發到咁高，唔得了，快啲睇醫生啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 siu1 faat3 dou3 gam3 gou1, m4 dak1 liu5, faai3 di1 tai2 ji1 sang1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 发烧烧到这么高，不得了，快点去看医生吧！
examples.english_sentence: Your fever is so high, that's terrible! Go see a doctor quickly!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試考得咁差，真係唔得了。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 haau2 dak1 gam3 caa1, zan1 hai6 m4 dak1 liu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试考得这么差，真是不得了。
examples.english_sentence: I did so badly on this exam, it's hopeless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唱歌唱得好好聽，真係唔得了！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 coeng3 go1 coeng3 dak1 hou2 hou2 teng1, zan1 hai6 m4 dak1 liu5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他唱歌唱得很好听，真是不得了！
examples.english_sentence: He sings so well, it's unbelievably good!

english_meaning: too late; not in time; unable to make it in time
explanation_mandarin: 表示时间上来不及，赶不上，无法及时完成某事。
explanation_english: Indicates that there is not enough time; cannot make it in time; unable to complete something in time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋趕唔得切去睇戲喇，開咗場喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gon2 m4 dak1 cit3 heoi3 tai2 hei3 laa1, hoi1 zo2 coeng4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们来不及去看电影了，已经开场了。
examples.english_sentence: We won't make it to the movie in time, it's already started.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我再遲啲出門口，就趕唔得切返工喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 zoi3 ci4 di1 chut1 mun4 hau2, zau6 gon2 m4 dak1 cit3 faan1 gung1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我再晚点出门，就赶不上上班了。
examples.english_sentence: If I leave the house any later, I won't make it to work on time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 驚趕唔得切交功課，所以咪通宵做囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: geng1 gon2 m4 dak1 cit3 gaau1 gung1 fo3, so2 ji5 mai1 tung1 siu1 zou6 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 害怕来不及交作业，所以才通宵做。
examples.english_sentence: I was afraid I wouldn't be able to hand in my homework on time, so I worked all night.

mandarin_meaning: 不行, 不行了,搞不定, 不成功
english_meaning: Not working, not feasible, can't handle it, unsuccessful, not going to work out
explanation_mandarin: 表示某件事无法完成，行不通，或者某人无法处理、应付某事。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is not working, not feasible, or someone cannot handle or cope with something. Often implies a sense of inability or failure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個project實在太難，我驚我搞唔得掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 project sat6 zoi6 taai3 naan4, ngo5 ging1 ngo5 gaau2 m4 dak1 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目实在太难了，我怕我搞不定。
examples.english_sentence: This project is too difficult; I'm afraid I can't handle it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再唔努力啲，今次考試就唔得掂㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 m4 nou5 lik6 di1, gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 zau6 m4 dak1 dim6 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再不努力一点，这次考试就不行了。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't work harder, you won't pass this exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦壞咗，整極都唔得掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 waai6 zo2, zing2 gik1 dou1 m4 dak1 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电脑坏了，怎么修都不行。
examples.english_sentence: The computer is broken; I can't fix it no matter what I do.

english_meaning: not free; not available; busy
explanation_mandarin: 表示没有空闲时间，无法做某事。
explanation_english: Indicates a lack of free time, being unavailable to do something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日唔得閒，要返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 m4 dak1 haan4, jiu3 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天没空，要上班。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not free tomorrow, I have to go to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，我而家真係唔得閒覆你，晏啲先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 ji4 gaa1 zan1 hai6 m4 dak1 haan4 fuk1 nei5, aan3 di1 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我现在真的没空回复你，晚一点再说。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I'm really not free to reply to you right now, I'll do it later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都話自己唔得閒，唔知忙啲乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 waa6 zi6 gei2 m4 dak1 haan4, m4 zi1 mong4 di1 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说自己没空，不知道在忙些什么。
examples.english_sentence: He always says he's not free, I don't know what he's busy with.

english_meaning: not care, not mind, indifferent, nonchalant
explanation_mandarin: 表示对某事不在意、不关心、不放在心上。
explanation_english: Expresses indifference, lack of concern, or not caring about something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔志在佢點睇我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zi3 zoi6 keoi5 dim2 tai2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不在乎他怎么看我。
examples.english_sentence: I don't care what he thinks of me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好有錢，所以唔志在啲少少錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 jau5 cin2, so2 ji5 m4 zi3 zoi6 di1 siu2 siu2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很有钱，所以不在乎这点小钱。
examples.english_sentence: He is very rich, so he doesn't care about this little bit of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 就算失敗咗都唔緊要，我唔志在嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zau6 syun3 sat1 baai6 zo2 dou1 m4 gan2 jiu3, ngo5 m4 zi3 zoi6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 就算失败了也没关系，我不在乎的。
examples.english_sentence: Even if I fail, it's okay, I don't care.

english_meaning: dissatisfied, resentful, discontented
explanation_mandarin: 表示心里不舒服，对某事或某人感到不满、不高兴。
explanation_english: Expressing a feeling of discomfort or displeasure, indicating dissatisfaction or resentment towards something or someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾老細鬧完之後，一路都唔忿巢噉樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 lou5 sai3 naau6 jyun4 zi1 hau6, jat1 lou6 dou1 m4 fan5 caau4 gam2 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被老板骂完之后，一直都不满的样子。
examples.english_sentence: After being scolded by the boss, he was resentful the whole time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我考得咁差，梗係唔忿巢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haau2 dak1 gam3 caa1, gang2 hai6 m4 fan5 caau4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我考得这么差，当然不服气啦。
examples.english_sentence: I did so badly on the exam, of course I'm dissatisfied.

english_meaning: unreconciled, unwilling to accept (defeat, injustice, etc.), indignant, resentful
explanation_mandarin: 表示对某种情况感到不甘心、不服气、愤愤不平。
explanation_english: Expressing a feeling of unwillingness to accept a situation, especially when one feels it is unfair or unjust. It conveys a sense of resentment and indignation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試肥佬，覺得好唔忿氣，因為佢覺得自己溫咗好多書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si3 fei4 lou2, gok3 dak1 hou2 m4 fan5 hei3, jan1 wai6 keoi5 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 wan1 zo2 hou2 do1 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试不及格，觉得很不服气，因为他觉得自己复习了很多书。
examples.english_sentence: He failed the exam and felt very resentful because he felt he had studied a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我輸咗場比賽，真係好唔忿氣呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 syu1 zo2 coeng4 bei2 coi3, zan1 hai6 hou2 m4 fan5 hei3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我输了这场比赛，真的很不甘心啊！
examples.english_sentence: I lost the competition, I'm really unwilling to accept it!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 明明佢做錯嘢，點解要我孭鑊？我好唔忿氣囉！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ming4 ming4 keoi5 zou6 co3 je5, dim2 gaai2 jiu3 ngo5 be1 wok6? ngo5 hou2 m4 fan5 hei3 lo1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明明是他做错了事，为什么要我背黑锅？我很不服气！
examples.english_sentence: It's clearly his fault, why should I take the blame? I'm very resentful!

jyutping: m4 paa3 jat1 maan6, zi2 paa3 maan6 jat1
english_meaning: It's not about fearing the general case, but fearing the unlikely event; Better safe than sorry.
explanation_mandarin: 意思是说，不怕出现大概率的情况，而是要小心防范小概率事件的发生。强调预防意外的重要性。
explanation_english: This idiom expresses the importance of being cautious and prepared for even the most unlikely events. It emphasizes that while common occurrences might not be a cause for concern, rare possibilities should be considered and prevented if possible. It's similar to the English phrase 'Better safe than sorry'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買多份保險好啲，唔怕一萬，只怕萬一嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 do1 fan6 bou2 him2 hou2 di1, m4 paa3 jat1 maan6, zi2 paa3 maan6 jat1 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 多买一份保险比较好，不怕一万，就怕万一嘛。
examples.english_sentence: It's better to buy more insurance, better safe than sorry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然飛機好安全，但係我都會買旅遊保險， 唔怕一萬，只怕萬一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 fei1 gei1 hou2 on1 cyun4, daan6 hai6 ngo5 dou1 wui5 maai5 leoi5 jau4 bou2 him2, m4 paa3 jat1 maan6, zi2 paa3 maan6 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然飞机很安全，但是我还是会买旅游保险，不怕一万，就怕万一。
examples.english_sentence: Although airplanes are very safe, I still buy travel insurance, better safe than sorry.

jyutping: m4 paa3 jat1 maan6, zeoi3 paa3 maan6 jat1
english_meaning: Not afraid of ten thousand, but afraid of the one in ten thousand (case). Better safe than sorry; it's the unexpected that's worrisome.
explanation_mandarin: 不怕大多数情况是好的，最担心的是极小的概率发生的意外情况。强调要小心谨慎，做好预防措施。
explanation_english: Not afraid of the likely good outcome, but most worried about the unlikely, but possible, accident. Emphasizes the importance of being careful and taking preventive measures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行山要帶齊裝備，唔怕一萬，最怕萬一，如果發生意外就麻煩啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 saan1 jiu3 daai3 cai4 zong1 bei6, m4 paa3 jat1 maan6, zeoi3 paa3 maan6 jat1, jyu4 gwo2 faat3 sang1 ji3 ngoi6 zau6 maa4 faan4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爬山要带齐装备，不怕一万，就怕万一，如果发生意外就麻烦了。
examples.english_sentence: When hiking, you need to bring all the equipment. Better safe than sorry. It'll be troublesome if an accident happens.

cantonese: 唔怕生壞命，最怕改壞名
jyutping: m4 paa3 sang1 waai6 ming6, zeoi3 paa3 goi2 waai6 ming4
mandarin_meaning: 不怕命运不好，最怕取名不好
english_meaning: Not afraid of having a bad fate at birth, most afraid of choosing a bad name.
explanation_mandarin: 意思是说名字对人的一生影响很大，比天生的命运还要重要。如果命运不好，还可以通过后天努力改变，但是名字一旦取坏了，就很难更改，会影响人的一生。
explanation_english: This idiom means that a name has a great impact on a person's life, even more important than their innate destiny. If fate is bad, it can be changed through hard work after birth, but once a name is badly chosen, it is difficult to change and will affect a person's entire life. It emphasizes the importance of choosing a good name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幫仔女改名真係要小心啲，唔怕生壞命，最怕改壞名啊嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bong1 zai2 neoi5 goi2 ming4 zan1 hai6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1, m4 paa3 sang1 waai6 ming6, zeoi3 paa3 goi2 waai6 ming4 aa3 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 给子女取名字真的要小心一些，不怕命运不好，最怕取名不好嘛。
examples.english_sentence: You really have to be careful when naming your children. You're not afraid of a bad fate at birth, but you're most afraid of choosing a bad name.

english_meaning: not shy; not bashful; not embarrassed; to not be afraid of making a fool of oneself
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人不害羞，不胆怯，不怕出丑，敢于表达自己。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is not shy, not timid, not afraid of embarrassment, and dares to express themselves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人唔怕醜，成日喺人哋面前唱歌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 m4 paa3 cau2, seng4 jat6 hai2 jan4 dei6 min6 cin4 coeng3 go1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人不怕丑，经常在别人面前唱歌。
examples.english_sentence: He's not shy, he often sings in front of others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔怕醜嘅話，咪舉手問老師囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 paa3 cau2 ge3 waa2, mai5 geoi2 sau2 man6 lou5 si1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不怕丑的话，就举手问老师吧。
examples.english_sentence: If you're not shy, just raise your hand and ask the teacher.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做銷售最緊要就係唔怕醜，要主動同客人傾偈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 siu1 sau6 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 zau6 hai6 m4 paa3 cau2, jiu3 zyu2 dung6 tung4 haak3 jan4 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做销售最重要的就是不怕丑，要主动和客人聊天。
examples.english_sentence: The most important thing in sales is not being shy, you have to actively chat with customers.

english_meaning: no wonder, it's not surprising
explanation_mandarin: 表示恍然大悟，领悟到原因，相当于“难怪”。
explanation_english: Expresses sudden realization or understanding of a reason. Equivalent to "no wonder" or "it's not surprising". It implies that something previously puzzling now makes sense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴日冇瞓覺，唔怪之今日咁眼瞓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 mou5 fan3 gaau3, m4 gwaai3 zi1 gam1 jat6 gam3 ngaan5 fan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天没睡觉，难怪今天这么困。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't sleep yesterday, no wonder he's so sleepy today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺美國大，唔怪之講嘢咁鬼地道啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 mei5 gwok3 daai6, m4 gwaai3 zi1 gong2 je5 gam3 gwai2 dei6 dou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是在美国长大的，难怪说话这么地道。
examples.english_sentence: He grew up in the US, no wonder he speaks so fluently and authentically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 原來你病咗，唔怪之呢幾日都冇見你返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyun4 loi4 nei5 beng6 zo2, m4 gwaai3 zi1 ni1 gei2 jat6 dou1 mou5 gin3 nei5 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 原来你生病了，难怪这几天都没见你上班。
examples.english_sentence: So you were sick, no wonder I haven't seen you at work these past few days.

english_meaning: No wonder; it's no wonder; that explains why
explanation_mandarin: 表示恍然大悟，之前不明白的事情现在明白了。用于解释原因或理由。
explanation_english: Expressing sudden realization or understanding after something was previously unclear. Used to explain a reason or a cause.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴日冇瞓，唔怪之得今日咁眼瞓啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 mou5 fan3, m4 gwaai3 zi1 dak1 gam1 jat6 gam3 ngaan5 fan3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天没睡，怪不得今天这么困。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't sleep yesterday, no wonder he's so sleepy today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 原來你病咗，唔怪之得你冇返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyun4 loi4 nei5 beng6 zo2, m4 gwaai3 zi1 dak1 nei5 mou5 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 原来你生病了，怪不得你没上班。
examples.english_sentence: So you're sick, no wonder you didn't go to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日吵交，唔怪之得咁快就離婚啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 caau2 gaau1, m4 gwaai3 zi1 dak1 gam3 faai3 zau6 lei4 fan1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们经常吵架，怪不得这么快就离婚了。
examples.english_sentence: They often argued, no wonder they divorced so quickly.

english_meaning: no wonder; that explains it; it's no surprise
explanation_mandarin: 表示恍然大悟，原来是这样，难怪如此。
explanation_english: Expresses a sudden realization or understanding; it explains something that was previously confusing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日遲到，唔怪得俾老細鬧啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ci4 dou3, m4 gwaai3 dak1 bei2 lou5 sai3 nau6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常迟到，怪不得被老板骂。
examples.english_sentence: He's always late, no wonder he gets scolded by the boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁勤力讀書，唔怪得考試考得咁好啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 kan4 lik6 duk6 syu1, m4 gwaai3 dak1 haau2 si5 haau2 dak1 gam3 hou2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么努力学习，怪不得考试考得这么好。
examples.english_sentence: You study so hard, no wonder you did so well on the exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋日落咁大雨，唔怪得今日咁涼爽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 jat6 lok6 gam3 daai6 jyu5, m4 gwaai3 dak1 gam1 jat6 gam3 loeng4 song2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天下了那么大的雨，怪不得今天这么凉爽。
examples.english_sentence: It rained so heavily yesterday, no wonder it's so cool today.

english_meaning: No wonder; that's why; it's not surprising
explanation_mandarin: 表示恍然大悟，明白了某件事情的原因。
explanation_english: Expresses a realization or understanding of the reason behind something. It implies that something previously puzzling now makes sense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔怪得之你咁開心，原來中咗六合彩！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 gwaai3 dak1 zi1 nei5 gam3 hoi1 sam1, jyun4 lai4 zung3 zo2 luk6 hap6 coi2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 难怪你这么开心，原来中了六合彩！
examples.english_sentence: No wonder you're so happy; it turns out you won the lottery!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔怪得之佢今日冇返工，原來佢病咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 gwaai3 dak1 zi1 keoi5 gam1 jat6 mou5 faan1 gung1, jyun4 lai4 keoi5 beng6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 难怪他今天没上班，原来他病了。
examples.english_sentence: No wonder he didn't come to work today; it turns out he's sick.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔怪得之咁多人排隊，原來間餐廳咁出名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 gwaai3 dak1 zi1 gam3 do1 jan4 paai4 deoi2, jyun4 lai4 gaan1 caan1 teng1 gam3 ceot1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 难怪这么多人排队，原来这家餐厅这么有名。
examples.english_sentence: No wonder there are so many people queuing; it turns out this restaurant is so famous.

english_meaning: someone you can't afford to offend; someone powerful you should avoid provoking
explanation_mandarin: 指某人或某事物背景深厚、权势强大，最好不要招惹，免得给自己带来麻烦。带有警告或劝告的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to someone or something with a strong background or great power that you should avoid provoking, lest it brings trouble to yourself. It carries a warning or advisory tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋老闆好惡㗎，你都係唔惹小佢好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 lou5 baan2 hou2 ok3 gaa3, nei5 dou1 hai6 m4 ze2 siu2 keoi5 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的老板很凶的，你最好还是不要惹他。
examples.english_sentence: Their boss is very fierce, you better not offend him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間公司背景好勁，唔惹小㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 gung1 si1 bui3 ging2 hou2 ging6, m4 ze2 siu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那间公司的背景很强大，惹不起的。
examples.english_sentence: That company has a very strong background, you can't afford to offend them.

mandarin_meaning: 惹麻烦不少, 不是小事
english_meaning: not a small matter, quite a bit of trouble, a big deal
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情带来的麻烦或影响不小，不是简单的事情。带有负面含义，通常指造成了相当大的麻烦或困扰。
explanation_english: Indicates that the trouble or impact caused by something is significant, not a simple matter. It usually carries a negative connotation, referring to causing considerable trouble or distress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次單嘢唔惹少㗎，搞到成間公司都雞毛鴨血。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 daan1 je5 m4 ze2 siu2 gaa3, gaau2 dou3 sing4 gaan1 gung1 si1 dou1 gai1 mou4 aap2 hyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的事情可不是小事，搞得整个公司都鸡犬不宁。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is not a small matter at all; it's caused chaos throughout the entire company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢撞車撞到咁犀利，醫藥費都唔惹少。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zong6 ce1 zong6 dou3 gam3 sai1 lei6, yi1 yeok6 fai3 dou1 m4 ze2 siu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他撞车撞得这么厉害，医药费可不是小数目。
examples.english_sentence: He had such a severe car accident; the medical bills won't be cheap.

english_meaning: certainly not; definitely not; unlikely
explanation_mandarin: 表示对某种情况的否定，语气较强，相当于“肯定不”、“绝不”。
explanation_english: Expresses a strong negation about a certain situation. It means 'certainly not,' 'definitely not,' or 'unlikely'. It implies a high degree of confidence in the negative prediction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做，唔慌會成功嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6, m4 fong1 wui5 sing4 gung1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做，肯定不会成功的。
examples.english_sentence: If you do it this way, you're definitely not going to succeed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁懶，唔慌考到好成績。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 laan5, m4 fong1 haau2 dou2 hou2 sing1 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么懒，肯定考不到好成绩。
examples.english_sentence: He's so lazy, he's definitely not going to get good grades.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家落咁大雨，唔慌仲有巴士搭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 lok6 gam3 daai6 jyu5, m4 fong1 zung6 jau5 baa1 si2 daap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在下这么大的雨，肯定没有巴士可以搭了。
examples.english_sentence: It's raining so heavily now, there's definitely no bus to take.

synonyms: 實情唔會 (sat6 ching4 m4 wui5)

english_meaning: not worried, not concerned, to have no worries
explanation_mandarin: 表示没有忧虑，不用担心。通常指在某个方面条件很好，不必为之烦恼。
explanation_english: Indicates a state of not being worried or concerned. Usually means that someone is in a favorable situation in a specific area and doesn't need to worry about it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋屋企咁有錢，梗係唔憂食唔憂著啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 uk1 kei5 gam3 jau5 cin2, gang2 hai6 m4 yau1 sik6 m4 yau1 zoek3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们家那么有钱，当然不愁吃不愁穿了。
examples.english_sentence: Their family is so rich, of course they don't have to worry about food and clothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家搵到份人工咁高嘅工，以後都唔憂無錢使啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 wan2 dou2 fan6 jan4 gung1 gam3 gou1 ge3 gung1, ji5 hau6 dou1 m4 yau1 mou5 cin2 sai2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在找到一份工资这么高的工作，以后都不用担心没钱用了。
examples.english_sentence: Now that I've found a job with such a high salary, I don't have to worry about having no money to spend in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個仔咁叻，將來一定唔憂出路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 zai2 gam3 lek1, zoeng1 loi4 jat1 ding6 m4 yau1 ceot1 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的儿子那么聪明，将来一定不用担心前途。
examples.english_sentence: His son is so smart, he definitely doesn't have to worry about his future prospects.

english_meaning: Unable to get along, incompatible, not being able to fit in
explanation_mandarin: 形容人与人之间性格或处事方式不合拍，难以相处。
explanation_english: Describes people whose personalities or ways of doing things are incompatible, making it difficult for them to get along.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個性格唔打得埋，成日嘈交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 sing3 gaak3 m4 daa2 dak1 maai4, sing4 jat6 cou4 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个性格合不来，经常吵架。
examples.english_sentence: Those two don't get along, they argue all the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢價值觀唔打得埋，所以做唔成朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 gaa3 zik6 gun1 m4 daa2 dak1 maai4, so2 ji5 zou6 m4 sing4 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他价值观不合，所以做不成朋友。
examples.english_sentence: Our values are incompatible, so we can't be friends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅文化同我唔打得埋，我諗住辭職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 man4 faa3 tung4 ngo5 m4 daa2 dak1 maai4, ngo5 lam2 zyu6 ci4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的文化和我格格不入，我打算辞职。
examples.english_sentence: This company's culture doesn't suit me, I'm thinking of resigning.

english_meaning: It's okay, it doesn't matter, never mind
explanation_mandarin: 表示不重要，没关系，不用担心或在意。
explanation_english: Used to express that something is not important, it's okay, don't worry about it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔小心整爛咗，唔打緊嘅，遲啲再買過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 siu2 sam1 zeng2 laan6 zo2, m4 daa2 gan2 ge3, ci4 di1 zoi3 maai5 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不小心弄坏了，没关系，晚点再买一个。
examples.english_sentence: I accidentally broke it, it's okay, I'll buy another one later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 遲到咗五分鐘，唔打緊啦，入去啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ci4 dou3 zo2 ng5 fan1 zung1, m4 daa2 gan2 laa1, jap6 heoi3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 迟到了五分钟，没关系啦，进去吧。
examples.english_sentence: You're five minutes late, it's okay, go in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 跌咗啲錢落地，唔打緊，執返咪得囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dit3 zo2 di1 cin2 lok6 dei6, m4 daa2 gan2, zap1 faan1 mai1 dak1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 掉了一些钱在地上，没关系，捡回来就行了。
examples.english_sentence: Some money fell on the ground, it's okay, just pick it up.

english_meaning: not worth it; not deserving; unfair; a pity; a waste
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事物不值得去做、不值得拥有，或者某人受到的待遇不公平，令人感到可惜或不值。
explanation_english: Expressing that something is not worth doing, possessing, or that someone's treatment is unfair, causing a feeling of pity or being undeserving.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁貴嘅嘢，買嚟都唔抵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam3 gwai3 ge3 je5, maai5 lai4 dou1 m4 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这么贵的东西，买来也不划算。
examples.english_sentence: Such an expensive thing, it's not worth buying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁辛苦做嘢，但係人工咁低，真係唔抵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 san1 fu2 zou6 je5, daan6 hai6 yan4 gung1 gam3 dai1, zan1 hai6 m4 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么辛苦工作，但是工资这么低，真是不值得。
examples.english_sentence: He works so hard, but his salary is so low, it's really unfair.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁後生就走咗，真係唔抵囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam3 hau6 saang1 zau6 zau2 zo2, zan1 hai6 m4 dai2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这么年轻就走了，真是可惜。
examples.english_sentence: Passing away at such a young age, it's such a pity.

mandarin_meaning: 不服气; 眼红; 嫉妒
english_meaning: Jealous; envious; resentful (of someone else's good fortune or success)
explanation_mandarin: 表示对别人的好运或成功感到不服气或嫉妒。
explanation_english: Describes the feeling of being jealous or resentful of someone else's good fortune or success. It implies a sense of unfairness or that the person doesn't deserve what they have.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢升咗職，我真係唔抵得佢囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing1 zo2 zik1, ngo5 zan1 hai6 m4 dai2 dak1 keoi5 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他升职了，我真是不服气他。
examples.english_sentence: He got promoted, I'm really jealous of him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁唔抵得人哋啦，人哋都係努力過先有今日嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 m4 dai2 dak1 yan4 dei6 laa1, yan4 dei6 dou1 hai6 nu5 lik6 gwo3 sin1 jau5 gam1 jat6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么眼红别人了，人家也是努力过才有今天的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so envious of others, they worked hard to get where they are today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到佢咁風光，有啲唔抵得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 keoi5 gam3 fung1 gwong1, jau5 di1 m4 dai2 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到他这么风光，有点嫉妒。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing him so successful, I feel a bit envious.

synonyms: 葡萄 (pou4 tou4) - slang, meaning 'grape', used as slang for jealous

english_meaning: jealous, envious, resentful of someone's good fortune
explanation_mandarin: 形容看到别人比自己好而感到不高兴、嫉妒的心理状态。
explanation_english: Describes the feeling of being unhappy and envious when someone else is doing better than you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞到獎學金，我唔抵得頸囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 dou2 zo2 zoek3 hok6 gam1, ngo5 m4 dai2 dak1 geng2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿到奖学金，我眼红了。
examples.english_sentence: He got a scholarship, I'm jealous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁唔抵得頸啦，人哋付出咗好多努力㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 m4 dai2 dak1 geng2 laa1, yan4 dei6 fu3 ceot1 zo2 hou2 do1 nu5 lik6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么嫉妒了，人家付出了很多努力的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so envious, they put in a lot of effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢升職升得咁快，好多人都唔抵得頸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing1 zik1 sing1 dak1 gam3 faai3, hou2 do1 yan4 dou1 m4 dai2 dak1 geng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他升职升得这么快，很多人都眼红。
examples.english_sentence: He got promoted so quickly, many people are jealous.

english_meaning: not particular; not fussy; doesn't matter; any
explanation_mandarin: 表示对某种事物没有特别的要求，不挑剔，都可以接受。
explanation_english: Indicates that there are no specific requirements for something, not picky, anything is acceptable. It implies a flexible or open attitude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食乜嘢早餐都唔拘，有嘢食就得啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 mat1 je5 zou2 caan1 dou1 m4 keoi1, jau5 je5 sik6 zau6 dak1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃什么早餐都行，有东西吃就行了。
examples.english_sentence: Anything for breakfast is fine, as long as there's something to eat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 去邊度旅行都唔拘，最緊要係放鬆下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: heoi3 bin1 dou6 leoi5 hang4 dou1 m4 keoi1, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hai6 fong3 sung1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去哪里旅行都行，最重要的是放松一下。
examples.english_sentence: I don't mind where we travel, the most important thing is to relax.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幾點開會都唔拘，你哋決定啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei2 dim2 hoi1 wui2 dou1 m4 keoi1, nei5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 几点开会都可以，你们决定吧。
examples.english_sentence: I don't mind what time the meeting is, you guys decide.

english_meaning: impatient, intolerant
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人缺乏耐心，容易不耐烦。
explanation_english: Describes a person who lacks patience and is easily impatient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好唔挐更㗎，排耐少少隊都發脾氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 m4 naa4 gaang1 gaa3, paai4 noi6 siu2 siu2 deoi2 dou1 faat3 pei4 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很不耐烦，排队稍微久一点都会发脾气。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very impatient person, he gets angry even if he has to queue for a little longer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁唔挐更啦，件事急唔嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 m4 naa4 gaang1 laa1, gin6 si6 gap1 m4 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么不耐烦，事情是急不来的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so impatient, these things can't be rushed.

english_meaning: reluctant to part with; unwilling to give up; to hate to part with
explanation_mandarin: 表示不忍心放弃、离开或失去某事物或某人。
explanation_english: Expressing reluctance to give up, leave, or lose something or someone. It conveys a feeling of attachment and unwillingness to let go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我真係唔捨得你走啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zan1 hai6 m4 se2 dak1 nei5 zau2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我真的很捨不得你走啊！
examples.english_sentence: I really hate to see you go!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部舊電話雖然壞壞哋，但我都唔捨得丟咗佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 gau6 din6 waa2 seoi1 jin4 waai6 waai6 dei2, daan6 ngo5 dou1 m4 se2 dak1 diu1 zo2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然旧手机有点坏了，但是我也捨不得把它扔了。
examples.english_sentence: Even though the old phone is a bit broken, I'm still reluctant to throw it away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工做得幾開心，真係唔捨得辭職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 zou6 dak1 gei2 hoi1 sam1, zan1 hai6 m4 se2 dak1 ci4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作做得多开心，真是不捨得辞职。
examples.english_sentence: This job is so enjoyable, I really don't want to resign.

mandarin_meaning: 不行; 不好; 搞不定
english_meaning: not okay; not good; can't handle; unable to cope
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情进展不顺利，无法解决，或者状态不好，身体不适等。
explanation_english: Indicates that things are not going well, cannot be resolved, or that the state is not good, such as being unwell or unable to handle a situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試我諗住都唔掂喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ngo5 lam2 zyu6 dou1 m4 dim6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我觉得不行了。
examples.english_sentence: I think I failed this exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最近身體唔掂，成日都覺得好攰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 san1 tai2 m4 dim6, seng4 jat6 dou1 gok3 dak1 hou2 gui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近身体不好，总是觉得很累。
examples.english_sentence: I haven't been feeling well lately, I always feel tired.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事太難搞，我真係搞唔掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 taai3 naan4 gaau2, ngo5 zan1 hai6 gaau2 m4 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事太难了，我真的搞不定。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is too difficult, I really can't handle it.

mandarin_meaning: 不在乎; 无所谓; 不介意
english_meaning: to not care; to not mind; to not bother; it doesn't matter
explanation_mandarin: 表示对某事不重视，不在意，觉得无所谓。通常用于表明态度或建议。
explanation_english: Expresses a lack of concern, indifference, or nonchalance towards something. It's used to indicate that something doesn't matter or is not a big deal to the speaker.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔想去咪唔去囉，我唔掙在嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 soeng2 heoi3 mai6 m4 heoi3 lo1, ngo5 m4 zaang1 zoi6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不想去就不要去呗，我不在乎的。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't want to go, then don't. I don't mind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 遲到少少唔掙在嘅，最緊要係準時交功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ci4 dou3 siu2 siu2 m4 zaang1 zoi6 ge3, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hai6 zeon2 si4 gaau1 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 稍微迟到一点没关系的，最重要的是准时交功课。
examples.english_sentence: Being a little late doesn't matter. The most important thing is to submit your homework on time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 少少錢，唔掙在啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 siu2 cin2, m4 zaang1 zoi6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一点点钱，没关系的啦。
examples.english_sentence: It's just a little money, it doesn't matter.

english_meaning: not to look for; not to earn (money); not to work
explanation_mandarin: 表示不寻找某物，或不从事挣钱的工作。
explanation_english: Indicates not looking for something or not doing work to earn money. It can also imply not wanting to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢失業好耐，都唔揾嘢做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sat1 jip6 hou2 noi6, dou1 m4 wan2 je5 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他失业很久了，都不找工作。
examples.english_sentence: He's been unemployed for a long time and hasn't been looking for work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日唔揾錢，想休息下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 m4 wan2 cin2, soeng2 jau1 sik1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天不挣钱，想休息一下。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not earning money today, I want to rest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日匿喺屋企，出去揾下嘢做啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 nik1 hai2 uk1 kei2, ceot1 heoi3 wan2 haa5 je5 zou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是躲在家里，出去找点事情做吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always hide at home, go out and find something to do.

english_meaning: not to look for; not to find; not to seek; not to contact; not to bother
explanation_mandarin: 表示没有寻找、没有找到或没有联系。
explanation_english: Indicates not looking for something, not finding something, or not contacting someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔搵佢啦，佢好忙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 wan2 keoi5 laa1, keoi5 hou2 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不找他了，他很忙。
examples.english_sentence: I won't bother him anymore, he's very busy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份工咁辛苦，唔搵都罷啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 gung1 gam3 san1 fu2, m4 wan2 dou1 baa6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工作这么辛苦，不找也罢。
examples.english_sentence: The job is so tiring, better not even look for it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔搵到證據都唔好亂咁講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 wan2 dou3 zing3 geoi3 dou1 m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没有找到证据就不要乱说。
examples.english_sentence: Don't speak carelessly if you haven't found the evidence.

jyutping: m4 wan2*, m4 wan2 gwo3* (tone sandhi)
mandarin_meaning: 不找/不寻找/不理睬/不顾
english_meaning: Not to look for; not to search; not to bother with; not to deal with; to ignore (someone); not to find
explanation_mandarin: 不寻找、不理会、不顾。 星号 (*) 表示语气助词，可以省略，也可以根据语境加不同的语气助词。
explanation_english: Not to look for, not to search for something or someone. Can also mean not to bother with something or someone, or to ignore them. The asterisk (*) represents a final particle which can be omitted or replaced by other final particles to adjust the tone or emphasis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋已經唔搵佢好耐喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji5 ging1 m4 wan2 keoi5 hou2 noi6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们已经很久没有找他了。
examples.english_sentence: We haven't looked for him for a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再唔聽話，我就唔搵你㗎喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 m4 ting1 waa6, ngo5 zau6 m4 wan2 nei5 gaa3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再不听话，我就不理你了！
examples.english_sentence: If you don't listen, I won't bother with you anymore!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔搵佢算啦，佢都唔會幫手嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 wan2 keoi5 syun3 laa1, keoi5 dou1 m4 wui5 bong1 sau2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别找他了，他也不会帮忙的。
examples.english_sentence: Let's not bother with him, he won't help anyway.

synonyms: 唔搵人幫手 (m4 wan2 yan4 bong1 sau2) - specific to not asking for help

english_meaning: to quit (a job); to stop doing something; to not do anymore
explanation_mandarin: 指停止从事某项工作、职业或活动。常见于口语，表达放弃或辞职的意愿。
explanation_english: Refers to stopping or quitting a job, profession, or activity. Commonly used in spoken Cantonese to express the intention to give up or resign.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我頂唔順喇，我決定唔撈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ding2 m4 seon6 laa3, ngo5 kyut3 ding6 m4 lou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我受不了了，我决定不做了。
examples.english_sentence: I can't stand it anymore, I've decided to quit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢做得唔開心，所以唔撈喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 zou6 dak1 m4 hoi1 sam1, so2 ji5 m4 lou1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他工作得不开心，所以不做了。
examples.english_sentence: He said he wasn't happy at work, so he quit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都做咗咁耐，真係要唔撈呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 zou6 zo2 gam3 noi6, zan1 hai6 jiu3 m4 lou1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你都做了这么久，真的要不做了吗？
examples.english_sentence: You've been doing it for so long, are you really going to quit?

english_meaning: to reject; to not accept (something, often due to being unsatisfactory); to be dissatisfied with
explanation_mandarin: 表示不接受某事物，通常是因为对其不满意，认为其质量或结果不合格。
explanation_english: To reject or not accept something because it is not up to standard or unsatisfactory. It implies dissatisfaction with the quality, performance, or result of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告寫得咁差，老細一定唔收貨㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dak1 gam3 chaa1, lou5 sai3 jat1 ding6 m4 sau1 fo3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告写得这么差，老板一定不会接受的。
examples.english_sentence: This report is so badly written, the boss definitely won't accept it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲嘢咁貴，質量又唔好，梗係唔收貨啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 je5 gam3 gwai3, zik1 leong6 jau6 m4 hou2, gang2 hai6 m4 sau1 fo3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 东西这么贵，质量又不好，当然不接受啦。
examples.english_sentence: The stuff is so expensive, and the quality is bad, of course I won't accept it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢交嘅設計，我哋全部都唔收貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaau1 ge3 sat3 gai3, ngo5 dei6 cyun4 bou6 dou1 m4 sau1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他交的设计，我们全部都不接受。
examples.english_sentence: We didn't accept any of the designs he submitted.

english_meaning: I don't deserve it / I'm unworthy of such praise / You flatter me.
explanation_mandarin: 一种客套话，表示不敢接受别人的赞扬或称赞，通常是谦虚的回应。
explanation_english: A polite expression used to decline or deflect praise, compliments, or flattery. It conveys humility and indicates that one feels unworthy of the praise received.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你讚我叻，唔敢當，我都係撞彩啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zaan3 ngo5 lek1, m4 gam2 dong1, ngo5 dou1 hai6 zong6 coi2 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你夸我很棒，不敢当，我也只是碰运气罢了。
examples.english_sentence: You praise me for being capable, I don't deserve it, I just got lucky.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你咁樣讚我，唔敢當啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 gam2 joeng2 zaan3 ngo5, m4 gam2 dong1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢你这样夸我，不敢当啊。
examples.english_sentence: Thank you for praising me like that, I don't deserve it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話我幫咗佢好多，我話唔敢當。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 ngo5 bong1 zo2 keoi5 hou2 do1, ngo5 waa6 m4 gam2 dong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说我帮了他很多忙，我说不敢当。
examples.english_sentence: He said I helped him a lot, and I said I didn't deserve the credit.

english_meaning: impossible; unlikely; there's no way; it's out of the question
explanation_mandarin: 表示不大可能发生的事情，语气较强。
explanation_english: Used to express a strong degree of impossibility or unlikelihood. Indicates that something is definitely not going to happen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁懶，唔方會考到第一名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 laan5, m4 fong1 wui5 haau2 dou3 dai6 jat1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么懒，不可能考到第一名。
examples.english_sentence: You're so lazy, there's no way you'll get first place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都遲到，唔方會升職嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 ci4 dou3, m4 fong1 wui5 sing1 zik1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都迟到，不可能升职的。
examples.english_sentence: He's late every day, there's no way he's getting a promotion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁唔努力，唔方合格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 m4 nou5 lik6, m4 fong1 hap6 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么不努力，不可能及格。
examples.english_sentence: You're not working hard enough, there's no way you'll pass.

mandarin_meaning: 动不动, 时不时, 经常
english_meaning: frequently, often, at any time, at all hours, every now and then, always (in a negative context, implying unwanted frequency)
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情发生的频率很高，带有不希望或不耐烦的语气。
explanation_english: Indicates that something happens frequently, often with a negative connotation expressing annoyance or impatience. It implies the event happens at inappropriate or unpredictable times.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔時唔候都打嚟問我借錢，真係煩死人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 si4 m4 hau6 dou1 daa2 lai4 man6 ngo5 ze3 cin2, zan1 hai6 faan4 sei2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他动不动就打电话来问我借钱，真是烦死了。
examples.english_sentence: He calls me all the time to ask for money, it's so annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦唔時唔候就壞，搞到我做唔到嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 m4 si4 m4 hau6 zau6 waai6, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 zou6 m4 dou2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台电脑经常出问题，导致我没法工作。
examples.english_sentence: This computer breaks down all the time, preventing me from working.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋唔時唔候都喺度嘈交，都唔知搞乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 m4 si4 m4 hau6 dou1 hai2 dou6 caau2 gaau1, dou1 m4 zi1 gaau2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们总是吵架，也不知道在搞什么。
examples.english_sentence: They are constantly arguing, I don't know what's going on.

english_meaning: never, not ever, have not (done something)
explanation_mandarin: 表示过去未曾发生过某事，相当于“没有”或者“不曾”。
explanation_english: Indicates that something has never happened in the past, equivalent to "never" or "have not (done something)".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔曾去過日本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 cang4 heoi3 gwo3 jat6 bun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我没去过日本。
examples.english_sentence: I have never been to Japan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔曾講過大話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 cang4 gong2 gwo3 daai6 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他从来没说过谎。
examples.english_sentence: He has never told a lie.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔曾諗過會咁樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 cang4 lam2 gwo3 wui gam2 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我从未想过会这样。
examples.english_sentence: I never thought it would be like this.

english_meaning: won't go far; can't amount to much; can't get much better/worse
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情或情况不会有太大的变化或进展，通常带有轻蔑或不乐观的语气。
explanation_english: Indicates that something or a situation will not change much or progress significantly. It often carries a dismissive or pessimistic tone. It implies that the subject is unlikely to improve or deteriorate significantly from its current state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁懶，唔會讀書讀得去邊㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 laan5, m4 wui5 duk6 syu1 duk6 dak1 heoi3 bin1 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么懒，学习也不会学到哪里去的。
examples.english_sentence: He's so lazy, he won't get far with his studies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳啲嘢食咁難食，都唔會做得去邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 gam3 naan4 sik6, dou1 m4 wui5 zou6 dak1 heoi3 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物这么难吃，也不会经营到哪里去的。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is so bad, it won't last long.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你依家咁樣hea做，唔會升職升得去邊㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ji1 gaa1 gam2 joeng2 hea1 zou6, m4 wui5 sing1 jik1 sing1 dak1 heoi3 bin1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你现在这样敷衍了事，升职也升不到哪里的。
examples.english_sentence: If you keep slacking off like this, you won't get promoted anytime soon.

synonyms: 冇乜搞作 (mut6 mat1 gaau2 zok3)
都係咁上下 (dou1 hai6 gam2 soeng6 haa6)

english_meaning: not convinced; unconvinced; not reconciled; unwilling to accept defeat or criticism
explanation_mandarin: 表示不认同、不甘心、不接受某种结果或评价，带有不满或抗拒的情绪。
explanation_english: Expresses disagreement, unwillingness to accept a result or evaluation, or a feeling of discontent or resistance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢輸咗比賽，梗係唔服氣啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 syu1 zo2 bei2 coi3, gang2 hai6 m4 fuk6 hei3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他输了比赛，当然不服气啦。
examples.english_sentence: He lost the competition, of course he's not convinced.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆無啦啦鬧我，我梗係唔服氣啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 mou4 laa1 laa1 naau6 ngo5, ngo5 gang2 hai6 m4 fuk6 hei3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板无缘无故骂我，我当然不服气了。
examples.english_sentence: The boss scolded me for no reason, of course I'm not convinced.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔服氣佢嘅決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 fuk6 hei3 keoi5 ge3 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不服气他的决定。
examples.english_sentence: I don't accept his decision.

english_meaning: unconvinced; not accepting something; unwilling to accept defeat
explanation_mandarin: 源自粤语歇后语“蒸笼里啲烧卖——睇你点样走出来”。“唔服烧卖”形容一个人内心不服气，不甘心，即使身处困境也不愿意认输。
explanation_english: Originates from a Cantonese cryptic saying/pun "烧卖 in a steamer - let's see how you get out". "唔服烧卖" (m4 fuk6 siu1 maai2) describes someone who is unconvinced, unwilling to accept defeat, and refuses to give up even in a difficult situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢輸咗，但佢都仲係唔服燒賣噉款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 syu1 zo2, daan6 keoi5 dou1 zung1 hai6 m4 fuk6 siu1 maai2 gam2 kwan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他输了，但他仍然是一副不服气的样子。
examples.english_sentence: Although he lost, he still looks unconvinced.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使咁唔服燒賣嘅，下次再努力咪得囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 gam3 m4 fuk6 siu1 maai2 ge3, haa6 ci3 zoi3 nu5 lik6 mai1 dak1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用这么不服气，下次再努力就可以了。
examples.english_sentence: There's no need to be so unwilling to accept it, just try harder next time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日都唔服燒賣啦，接受現實啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 dou1 m4 fuk6 siu1 maai2 laa1, zip3 sau6 jin6 sat6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是这么不服气，接受现实吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always be so unwilling to accept things, face reality.

english_meaning: not only; more than; in addition to
explanation_mandarin: 表示超出某个数量、范围或程度，相当于“不仅”、“不止”。
explanation_english: Indicates exceeding a certain quantity, range, or degree; equivalent to "not only," "more than," or "in addition to".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔止叻仔，仲好生性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 zi2 lek1 zai2, zung6 hou2 sang1 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不止聪明，还很懂事。
examples.english_sentence: He is not only smart, but also very sensible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳唔止貴，嘢食仲唔好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 m4 zi2 gwai3, je5 sik6 zung6 m4 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅不仅贵，东西还不好吃。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant is not only expensive, but the food is also not good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔止買咗衫，仲買咗鞋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zi2 maai5 zo2 saam1, zung6 maai5 zo2 haai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不止买了衣服，还买了鞋子。
examples.english_sentence: I not only bought clothes, but also shoes.

english_meaning: To have a narrow escape but suffer some damage; to barely survive an ordeal and come out worse for wear.
explanation_mandarin: 形容虽然侥幸逃脱，但受到损伤或损失。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where someone narrowly escapes a dangerous or difficult situation but still suffers some negative consequences or losses as a result. It emphasizes the close call and the resulting damage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次炒股票蝕咗咁多錢，真係唔死一身潺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 caau2 gu2 piu3 sit6 zo2 gam3 do1 cin2, zan1 hai6 m4 sei2 jat1 san1 saan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次炒股亏了这么多钱，真是不死也脱层皮。
examples.english_sentence: He lost so much money in the stock market this time; he barely survived but came out much worse for wear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上次車禍佢好彩冇事，但架車就撞爛晒，都算係唔死一身潺啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng6 ci3 ce1 wo6 keoi5 hou2 coi2 mou5 si6, daan6 gaa3 ce1 zau6 zong6 laan6 saai3, dou1 syun3 hai6 m4 sei2 jat1 san1 saan4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上次车祸他很幸运没事，但车就撞坏了，也算是侥幸逃脱但受到损伤了。
examples.english_sentence: He was lucky to be okay in the car accident last time, but the car was completely wrecked. You could say he had a narrow escape but suffered some damage.

english_meaning: Better to die than to burden the whole family (with your care/problems).
explanation_mandarin: 意思是说与其活着给家人带来负担，不如死去。形容一种绝望的心情，认为自己的存在只会给家人带来麻烦和拖累。
explanation_english: This idiom expresses the sentiment that it is better to die than to burden one's entire family with the costs and difficulties of care, illness, or other significant problems. It reflects a feeling of hopelessness and a belief that one's existence is only a source of trouble and burden for their family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢長期病痛，又冇錢醫，覺得自己唔死累全家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 coeng4 kei4 beng6 tung3, jau6 mou5 cin2 ji1, gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 m4 sei2 leoi6 cyun4 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他长期生病，又没钱医治，觉得与其这样不如死了，免得拖累全家。
examples.english_sentence: He's been sick for a long time and has no money for treatment. He feels like he's just burdening his whole family by not dying.

mandarin_meaning: 不死连累街坊/不死害街坊
english_meaning: If (someone) doesn't die, he/she will bring trouble to the neighborhood; better off dead so as not to cause trouble for others.
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人活着只会给其他人带来麻烦，不如死了算了。（一种责备或诅咒的说法，带有负面情绪。）
explanation_english: A saying used to express that someone is more trouble than they are worth alive, and that their existence only brings problems to others. It's a critical and often harsh remark suggesting that the person would be better off dead to prevent further burdening or harming others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再搞事，真係唔死累街坊啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 gaau2 si6, zan1 hai6 m4 sei2 leoi5 gaai1 fong1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再惹事生非，真是不死害街坊啊！
examples.english_sentence: If you cause any more trouble, you'll really be bringing trouble to the whole neighborhood!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁嘅樣，唔死累街坊咯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 ge3 joeng2, m4 sei2 leoi5 gaai1 fong1 lok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这样子，活着也是害街坊。
examples.english_sentence: The way he is, he's just bringing trouble to everyone.

mandarin_meaning: 活着也没用；没用的东西
english_meaning: Might as well be dead; utterly useless; good for nothing
explanation_mandarin: 指某人或某事物毫无价值，即使活着也毫无意义。多用于贬义，表达强烈的厌恶或失望。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something as completely worthless, as if their existence is pointless. Usually used in a derogatory way, expressing strong dislike or disappointment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條廢柴咁懶，唔死都冇用㗎啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 fai3 caai1 gam3 laan5, m4 sei2 dou1 mou5 yung6 gaa3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个废物这么懒，活着也没用了！
examples.english_sentence: That good-for-nothing is so lazy, he might as well be dead!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦舊到咁，唔死都冇用，不如買部新嘅啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 gau6 dou3 gam3, m4 sei2 dou1 mou5 yung6, bat1 jyu4 maai5 bou6 san1 ge3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台电脑这么旧了，活着也没用了，不如买一台新的吧。
examples.english_sentence: This computer is so old, it's utterly useless, might as well buy a new one.

english_meaning: not only, not just
explanation_mandarin: 表示递进关系，相当于“不仅”、“不止”。
explanation_english: Expresses an escalating relationship; equivalent to 'not only', 'not just'. Indicates that what follows is in addition to what has already been stated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔淨只聰明，重好勤力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 zing6 zi2 cung1 ming4, zung6 hou2 kan4 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不仅聪明，还很勤奋。
examples.english_sentence: He is not only smart but also very diligent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅嘢食唔淨只好味，價錢重好抵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 je5 sik6 m4 zing6 zi2 hou2 mei6, gaa3 cin2 zung6 hou2 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物不仅好吃，价格还很划算。
examples.english_sentence: The food in this restaurant is not only delicious, but the price is also very reasonable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學廣東話唔淨只學發音，重要了解佢嘅文化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 gwong2 dung1 waa2 m4 zing6 zi2 hok6 faat3 jam1, zung6 jiu3 liu2 gaai2 keoi5 ge3 man4 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学粤语不仅仅是学发音，还要了解它的文化。
examples.english_sentence: Learning Cantonese is not just about learning pronunciation, it's also about understanding its culture.

english_meaning: not only; more than just; not limited to
explanation_mandarin: 表示不仅限于某个范围或程度，还有更多的意思。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is not limited to a certain scope or degree, but there is more to it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢唔淨止好食，仲好抵食㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 m4 zing6 zi2 hou2 sik6, zung6 hou2 dai2 sik6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西不只是好吃，还很划算。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is not only delicious, but also very affordable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔淨止識講英文，仲識講法文同埋日文。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 zing6 zi2 sik1 gong2 ying1 man2, zung6 sik1 gong2 faat3 man2 tung4 ma4 jat6 man2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不只是会说英语，还会说法语和日语。
examples.english_sentence: He not only knows how to speak English, but also French and Japanese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個問題唔淨止影響佢一個人，仲會影響成個團隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 man6 tai4 m4 zing6 zi2 ying2 hoeng2 keoi5 jat1 go3 jan4, zung6 wui5 ying2 hoeng2 sing4 go3 teoi1 dui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个问题不只是影响他一个人，还会影响整个团队。
examples.english_sentence: This problem doesn't only affect him, but also the whole team.

english_meaning: not only; not just; more than
explanation_mandarin: 表示在原有的基础上更进一步，通常用于补充说明。
explanation_english: Indicates something is more than or in addition to what was previously mentioned. It is used to provide further explanation or add an extra point.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢好食，唔淨祇平，而且環境都好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 hou2 sik6, m4 zing6 zi2 peng4, ji4 ce2 hwaan4 ging2 dou1 hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西好吃，不只是便宜，而且环境也很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: The food in this restaurant is delicious. It's not only cheap, but the environment is also very comfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔淨祇係一個醫生，仲係一個作家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 zing6 zi2 hai6 jat1 go3 ji1 sang1, zung6 hai6 jat1 go3 zaak3 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不只是一个医生，还是一个作家。
examples.english_sentence: He is not only a doctor, but also a writer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔淨祇鍾意食生果，我都鍾意食菜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zing6 zi2 zung1 ji3 sik6 saang1 gwo2, ngo5 dou1 zung1 ji3 sik6 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不只是喜欢吃水果，我也喜欢吃蔬菜。
examples.english_sentence: I don't only like eating fruit; I also like eating vegetables.

mandarin_meaning: 不清楚, 不明白, 含糊不清
english_meaning: unclear, vague, ambiguous, indistinct
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情、说话、表达等不清楚、不明白，让人难以理解。
explanation_english: Describes something (e.g., a situation, speech, expression) that is unclear, vague, or indistinct, making it difficult to understand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢唔清唔楚，聽唔明佢講乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 m4 cing1 m4 co2, teng1 m4 ming4 keoi5 gong2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话不清楚，听不明白他在说什么。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks unclearly, I can't understand what he's saying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份報告寫得唔清唔楚，要重新寫過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dak1 m4 cing1 m4 co2, jiu3 cung4 san1 se2 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告写得不清楚，需要重新写一遍。
examples.english_sentence: The report is written unclearly, it needs to be rewritten.

english_meaning: unlucky; jinx; inauspicious
explanation_mandarin: 指不吉利，带来霉运，通常用于评价某人或者某事。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone bringing bad luck or misfortune; inauspicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁講嘢好唔湊米氣㗎，新年流流！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 gong2 je5 hou2 m4 cau3 mai5 hei3 gaa3, san1 nin4 lau4 lau4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么说话很不吉利，新年期间！
examples.english_sentence: It's very unlucky to say things like that, especially during the New Year!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人成日都黑口黑面，真係好唔湊米氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 seng4 jat6 dou1 hak1 hau2 hak1 min6, zan1 hai6 hou2 m4 cau3 mai5 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是愁眉苦脸的，真的很不吉利。
examples.english_sentence: He always looks gloomy; he's really a jinx.

english_meaning: neither fish nor fowl; neither one thing nor another; ambiguous; nondescript; wishy-washy
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物性质不明，不像汤也不像水。比喻不清不楚，不上不下，不伦不类。
explanation_english: Describes something that is neither one thing nor another, like something that is neither soup nor water. It is used to describe something ambiguous, nondescript, or wishy-washy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你份報告寫到唔湯唔水，睇完都唔知你想表達乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dou3 m4 tong1 m4 seoi2, tai2 jyun4 dou1 m4 zi1 nei5 soeng2 biu2 daat6 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这份报告写得不清不楚，看完都不知道你想表达什么。
examples.english_sentence: Your report is written so ambiguously, after reading it I still don't know what you want to express.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嗰種風格，唔湯唔水，唔知係想扮藝術家定係點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go2 zung2 fung1 gaak3, m4 tong1 m4 seoi2, m4 zi1 hai6 soeng2 baan6 ngai6 seot1 gaa1 ding6 hai6 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的那种风格，不伦不类，不知道是想扮艺术家还是怎么的。
examples.english_sentence: His style is neither fish nor fowl, I don't know if he's trying to be an artist or what.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲嘢你攪到唔湯唔水，真係唔知點算。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 je5 nei5 gaau2 dou3 m4 tong1 m4 seoi2, zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你把这些东西搞得不清不楚，真不知道该怎么办。
examples.english_sentence: You've made a mess of things, I really don't know what to do.

english_meaning: not notice; not pay attention to; be unaware of
explanation_mandarin: 没有注意到，没留心。
explanation_english: To not notice something; to be unaware of something; to not pay attention to something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先唔為意撞到你，唔好意思啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 m4 wai4 ji3 zong6 dou2 nei5, m4 hou2 ji3 si1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才没注意到撞到你，不好意思啊！
examples.english_sentence: I didn't notice I bumped into you just now, I'm sorry!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔為意佢幾時走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 wai4 ji3 keoi5 gei2 si4 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我没注意到他什么时候走了。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't notice when he left.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢好細聲，我唔為意聽唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 sai3 seng1, ngo5 m4 wai4 ji3 teng1 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说得声音很小，我没注意听不到。
examples.english_sentence: He spoke very quietly, I didn't notice and couldn't hear him.

mandarin_meaning: 只和熟人做生意；非熟客不招待
english_meaning: Only do business with acquaintances; Only serve familiar customers; Not for strangers
explanation_mandarin: 形容只与熟悉的人进行交易或提供服务，不轻易与陌生人打交道。 多指商家只做熟客的生意，不服务陌生顾客，有时也指在非正当行业中，只与熟人合作。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where one only conducts business or provides services to people they know well, and avoids dealing with strangers. It often refers to businesses that only cater to regular customers and not unfamiliar ones. It can also refer to cooperating only with familiar individuals in illicit or unconventional trades.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間鋪頭好似「唔熟唔食」咁，次次去都見到佢哋淨係招呼啲老顧客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou1 tau2 hou2 ci5 "m4 suk6 m4 sik6" gam2, ci3 ci3 heoi3 dou1 gin3 dou2 keoi5 dei6 zing6 hai6 ziu1 fu3 di1 lou5 gu3 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店好像只做熟人生意，每次去都看到他们只招呼老顾客。
examples.english_sentence: This shop seems to only do business with acquaintances, every time I go I see them only serving regular customers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋做呢啲偏門嘢，梗係「唔熟唔食」㗎啦，唔會咁易信生保㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zou6 ni1 di1 pin1 mun4 je5, gang2 hai6 "m4 suk6 m4 sik6" gaa3 laa1, m4 wui5 gam3 ji6 sin3 sang1 bou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们做这些不正当的事情，肯定是只和熟人合作的，不会轻易相信陌生人的。
examples.english_sentence: Since they're doing these shady things, of course they only work with people they know, they won't easily trust strangers.

english_meaning: unfamiliar; not close; distant; standoffish; not knowing how to socialize well
explanation_mandarin: 形容人与人之间关系不亲近，或者不熟悉情况，不善于应酬交际。
explanation_english: Describes a person being unfamiliar with a situation or people, or not being good at socializing and interacting with others. Can also mean someone is standoffish or distant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人比較唔熟性，所以唔係好鍾意參加聚會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 bei2 gaau3 m4 suk6 sing3, so2 ji5 m4 hai6 hou2 zung1 ji3 caam1 gaa1 zeoi6 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人比较不善于交际，所以不太喜欢参加聚会。
examples.english_sentence: He is not very good at socializing, so he doesn't really like to attend gatherings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對呢個地方唔熟性，你可唔可以帶我行吓？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 go3 dei6 fong1 m4 suk6 sing3, nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 daai3 ngo5 haang4 haa5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对这个地方不熟悉，你可以带我走走吗？
examples.english_sentence: I'm not familiar with this place, can you show me around?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，我啱啱嚟到，對呢度嘅規矩唔熟性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 lai4 dou3, deoi3 ni1 dou6 ge3 kwai1 geoi2 m4 suk6 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我刚来到，对这里的规矩不熟悉。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I just arrived and I'm not familiar with the rules here.

mandarin_meaning: 不熟悉书本知识；不熟悉情况
english_meaning: not familiar with the material; not knowing the subject well; unprepared
explanation_mandarin: 指对书本上的知识不熟悉，或者对某件事的情况不了解。
explanation_english: Refers to not being familiar with the knowledge in books, or not understanding the situation of a certain matter. It often implies a lack of preparation or study.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日考試，我仲有好多嘢唔熟書呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 haau2 si3, ngo5 zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 je5 m4 suk6 syu1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天考试，我还有很多东西不熟悉。
examples.english_sentence: There's an exam tomorrow, and I'm still not familiar with a lot of things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對呢個項目唔熟書，唔好俾佢負責啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 m4 suk6 syu1, m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 fu6 zaak3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对这个项目不熟悉，别让他负责了。
examples.english_sentence: He's not familiar with this project, don't let him be responsible for it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好唔熟書就亂講嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 m4 suk6 syu1 zau6 lyun6 gong2 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要不熟悉情况就乱说话。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just talk nonsense when you're not familiar with the situation.

english_meaning: might as well; wouldn't hurt to; what's the harm in; it doesn't matter anyway
explanation_mandarin: 表示既然已经做了很多，再多做一点也没什么关系。通常用于表示增加少量成本或努力不会带来显著影响，所以不如做了。
explanation_english: Expressing that since a lot has already been done, doing a little more won't make much difference. Usually used to indicate that adding a small amount of cost or effort won't have a significant impact, so it's better to just do it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 都買咗咁多嘢，唔爭在買多盒啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dou1 maai5 zo2 gam3 do1 je5, m4 zaang1 zoi6 maai5 do1 hap6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 都买了这么多东西了，不在乎再买一盒。
examples.english_sentence: We've already bought so much stuff, might as well buy one more box.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 都等咗咁耐，唔爭在等多陣啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dou1 dang2 zo2 gam3 noi6, m4 zaang1 zoi6 dang2 do1 zan6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 都等了这么久了，不在乎再多等一会儿。
examples.english_sentence: We've already waited this long, might as well wait a little longer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 既然都洗咗頭，唔爭在沖埋涼啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 jin4 dou1 sai2 zo2 tau4, m4 zaang1 zoi6 cung1 maai4 loeng4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 既然都洗了头，不如顺便洗个澡吧。
examples.english_sentence: Since I've already washed my hair, might as well take a shower too.

english_meaning: not notice; not pay attention to; overlook
explanation_mandarin: 没有注意到，没留意到。
explanation_english: To not notice something; to not pay attention; to overlook or be unaware of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先唔為意，撞到你，唔好意思呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 m4 wai4 ji3, zong6 dou2 nei5, m4 hou2 ji3 si3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才没注意到，撞到你了，不好意思！
examples.english_sentence: I didn't notice just now and bumped into you, sorry!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢太專心做嘢，所以唔為意有人入咗嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 taai3 zyun1 sam1 zou6 je5, so2 ji5 m4 wai4 ji3 jau5 jan4 jap6 zo2 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他太专心工作了，所以没注意到有人进来了。
examples.english_sentence: He was so focused on his work that he didn't notice someone came in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔為意佢心情唔好，仲同佢講笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 wai4 ji3 keoi5 sam1 ching4 m4 hou2, zung6 tung4 keoi5 gong2 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我没注意到他心情不好，还跟他开玩笑。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't notice that he was in a bad mood, and I even joked with him.

english_meaning: to ignore, to not care, to not pay attention to, to disregard
explanation_mandarin: 表示不理睬、不在乎、不关心某人或某事。
explanation_english: Indicates not paying attention to, not caring about, or disregarding someone or something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔理佢講乜嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 lei5 keoi5 gong2 mat1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不管他说什么。
examples.english_sentence: I don't care what he says.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔理幾困難，我都要試吓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 lei5 gei2 kwan3 naan4, ngo5 dou1 jiu3 si3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不管多困难，我都要试一下。
examples.english_sentence: No matter how difficult it is, I will try.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔理吓佢嘅感受？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 lei5 haa5 keoi5 ge3 gam2 sau6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不顾虑一下他的感受吗？
examples.english_sentence: Don't you care about his feelings?

jyutping: m4 lei5 saam1 cat1 ji6 sap6 jat1
english_meaning: regardless of the consequences; no matter what; without considering the consequences
explanation_mandarin: 比喻不顾一切，不问是非情由，鲁莽行事。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to act without thinking, regardless of the consequences or considerations. It implies a disregard for rules, reasoning, or potential problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔理三七二十一，攞起把刀就衝出去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 lei5 saam1 cat1 ji6 sap6 jat1, lo2 hei2 baa2 dou1 zau6 cung1 chut1 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不顾三七二十一，拿起刀就冲了出去。
examples.english_sentence: He charged out with a knife, regardless of the consequences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗幫朋友，佢唔理三七二十一，借咗好多錢俾佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 bong1 pang4 jau5, keoi5 m4 lei5 saam1 cat1 ji6 sap6 jat1, ze3 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2 bei2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了帮助朋友，他不顾三七二十一，借了很多钱给他。
examples.english_sentence: In order to help his friend, he lent him a lot of money without considering the consequences.

jyutping: m4 lei5 saam1 cat1 jaa6 jat1
english_meaning: regardless of the consequences; heedless of the consequences; without thinking things through
explanation_mandarin: 表示不顾一切，不计后果，横下心来做某事。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to do something without considering the consequences or details; to act impulsively or recklessly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔理三七廿一，就辭咗份工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 lei5 saam1 cat1 jaa6 jat1, zau6 ci4 zo2 fan6 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不顾一切地辞掉了工作。
examples.english_sentence: He quit his job without thinking things through.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔理三七廿一，決定搏一搏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 lei5 saam1 cat1 jaa6 jat1, kyut3 ding6 bok3 jat1 bok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不管三七二十一，决定拼一次。
examples.english_sentence: I've decided to take a gamble regardless of the consequences.

english_meaning: Couldn't care less; Not going to worry about it; Not going to think about it so much; Forget about it
explanation_mandarin: 表示对某种情况不再关心或考虑，决定采取行动，不再顾虑太多。
explanation_english: Expresses a decision to not worry or overthink a situation and proceed with an action. It implies a lack of concern for potential consequences or details.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冇時間喇，唔理得咁多，衝咗出去先！
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou5 si4 gaan3 laa3, m4 lei5 dak1 gam3 do1, cung1 zo2 chut1 heoi3 sin1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没时间了，管不了那么多了，冲出去再说！
examples.english_sentence: There's no time, couldn't care less, let's just rush out!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢都唔聽我講，唔理得咁多，我自己做決定算數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou1 m4 ting1 ngo5 gong2, m4 lei5 dak1 gam3 do1, ngo5 zi6 gei2 zou6 kyut3 ding6 syun3 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他都不听我的，管不了那么多了，我自己做决定算了。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't listen to me anyway, couldn't care less, I'll just make the decision myself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆話要OT，唔理得咁多，我收工照走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 waa6 jiu3 OT, m4 lei5 dak1 gam3 do1, ngo5 sau1 gung1 ziu3 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板说要加班，管不了那么多了，我下班照走。
examples.english_sentence: The boss said we have to work overtime, couldn't care less, I'm going home after work anyway.

english_meaning: no matter what; regardless of how; in any case
explanation_mandarin: 表示无论发生什么情况，或者无论如何，都采取某种行动或保持某种态度。
explanation_english: Indicates that regardless of what happens or how something is done, a certain action will be taken or a certain attitude will be maintained.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔理點，我都要完成呢個 project。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 lei5 dim2, ngo5 dou1 jiu3 wun4 sing4 ni1 go3 project.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 无论如何，我都要完成这个项目。
examples.english_sentence: No matter what, I will finish this project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔理點，你都要準時返到屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 lei5 dim2, nei5 dou1 jiu3 zeon2 si4 faan1 dou3 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 无论如何，你都要准时回到家。
examples.english_sentence: In any case, you must return home on time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔理點，我都唔會放棄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 lei5 dim2, ngo5 dou1 m4 wui5 fong3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 无论如何，我都不会放弃。
examples.english_sentence: Regardless of how, I won't give up.

english_meaning: unpromising, good-for-nothing, not living up to expectations, hopeless
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人不努力，不思进取，让人失望。指无法达到应有的水平或未能实现预期目标。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is not motivated, does not strive for improvement, and is disappointing. It refers to someone who fails to reach the expected level or achieve anticipated goals.
