explanation_english: Describes a state of being unhappy, upset, annoyed, or feeling that things are not going well. It implies a mild form of anger or displeasure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日唔開氣，唔好搞佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 m4 hoi1 hei3, m4 hou2 gaau2 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天不高兴，别惹他了。
examples.english_sentence: He's not in a good mood today, so don't bother him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我考試考得唔好，所以有啲唔開氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haau2 si5 haau2 dak1 m4 hou2, so2 ji5 jau5 di1 m4 hoi1 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我考试考得不好，所以有点不高兴。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't do well on the exam, so I'm a bit upset.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁樣做啦，搞到我好唔開氣啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 joeng2 zou6 laa1, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 hou2 m4 hoi1 hei3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这样做，搞得我很不高兴啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't do that, it's making me very unhappy.

english_meaning: not having an appetite, lacking appetite
explanation_mandarin: 指没有食欲，不想吃东西。
explanation_english: Describes the state of not feeling hungry or interested in eating; lacking appetite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日唔知點解，我成日都唔開胃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 m4 zi1 dim2 gaai2, ngo5 sing4 jat6 dou1 m4 hoi1 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天不知道为什么，我整天都没胃口。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know why today, but I've had no appetite all day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗之後，食乜嘢都唔開胃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2 zi1 hau6, sik6 mat1 je5 dou1 m4 hoi1 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他生病之后，吃什么都没胃口。
examples.english_sentence: After he got sick, he had no appetite for anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣太熱，搞到我啲仔女都唔開胃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hei3 taai3 jit6, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 di1 zai2 neoi5 dou1 m4 hoi1 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天气太热，弄得我的孩子们都没胃口。
examples.english_sentence: The weather is too hot, causing my children to have no appetite.

english_meaning: not related; irrelevant; none of your business
explanation_mandarin: 表示某件事情与某人无关，或者与讨论的话题无关。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is not related to someone or something, or that it's irrelevant to the topic being discussed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事唔關你事，你唔使理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 m4 gwaan1 nei5 si6, nei5 m4 sai2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事和你没关系，你不用管。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is not related to you, you don't need to worry about it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅決定，其實唔關其他人事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 kyut3 ding6, kei4 sat6 m4 gwaan1 kei4 taa1 jan4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的决定，其实和其他人无关。
examples.english_sentence: His decision, in fact, is not related to other people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想講，因為呢件事唔關你事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 gong2, yan1 wai6 ni1 gin6 si6 m4 gwaan1 nei5 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想说，因为这件事和你无关。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to talk about it, because it's none of your business.

english_meaning: It's none of your business; It's not your concern
explanation_mandarin: 表示某件事情与对方无关，通常用于不想让对方干涉或知道某些信息的情况。
explanation_english: This phrase indicates that something is not someone else's business or concern. It is often used when you don't want someone to interfere or know certain information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好問咁多啦，唔關你事㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 man6 gam3 do1 laa1, m4 gwaan1 nei5 si6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要问那么多啦，不关你的事！
examples.english_sentence: Don't ask so much, it's none of your business!

synonyms: 唔使你理 (m4 sai2 nei5 lei5)
關你咩事 (gwaan1 nei5 me1 si6)

english_meaning: It's none of my business; It's not my problem; It doesn't concern me.
explanation_mandarin: 表示某件事情与说话者没有关系，责任或义务不在说话者身上。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is not the speaker's responsibility or concern. The speaker is not involved or liable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 單嘢搞成咁，唔關我事㗎，我一早走咗啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daan1 je5 gaau2 sing4 gam2, m4 gwaan1 ngo5 si6 gaa3, ngo5 jat1 zou2 zau2 zo2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 事情变成这样，和我没关系，我早就走了。
examples.english_sentence: The matter turned out like this, it's none of my business. I left a long time ago.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋啲感情事，唔關我事，你自己解決啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 di1 gam2 cing4 si6, m4 gwaan1 ngo5 si6, nei5 zi6 gei2 gaai2 kyut3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们的感情问题，与我无关，你自己解决吧。
examples.english_sentence: Your relationship issues are none of my business. Solve it yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司執笠，雖然我有份，但係唔關我事嘅，我只係一個小職員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 zap1 lap1, seoi1 jin4 ngo5 jau5 fan6, daan6 hai6 m4 gwaan1 ngo5 si6 ge3, ngo5 zi2 hai6 jat1 go3 siu2 zik1 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司倒闭，虽然我有一份，但是和我没关系的，我只是一个小职员。
examples.english_sentence: The company went bankrupt, although I'm part of it, it's not my responsibility. I'm just a small employee.

english_meaning: I won't bother you; Don't want to take up your time
explanation_mandarin: 表示不打扰对方，希望对方可以做自己的事情，常用在结束对话或者离开的时候。
explanation_english: Indicates that you don't want to bother the other person and want them to do their own thing. It's commonly used when ending a conversation or leaving.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好啦，唔阻你做嘢啦，拜拜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 laa1, m4 zo2 nei5 zou6 je5 laa1, baai1 baai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 好了，不打扰你工作了，拜拜。
examples.english_sentence: Okay, I won't bother you with your work. Bye.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔阻你慢慢揀，我行開一陣先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 zo2 nei5 maan6 maan2 gaan2, ngo5 haang4 hoi1 jat1 zan6 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不打扰你慢慢选，我先走开一会儿。
examples.english_sentence: I won't bother you while you take your time to choose. I'll step away for a bit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我知你好忙，唔阻你喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi1 nei5 hou2 mong4, m4 zo2 nei5 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我知道你很忙，不打扰你了。
examples.english_sentence: I know you are busy, I won't bother you.

english_meaning: not present, not here, absent
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人或某物不在原来的位置或应该在的位置。
explanation_english: Indicates that someone or something is not in the original or expected location. Used to describe absence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢老細今日唔響度，搵佢聽日再嚟啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lou5 sai3 gam1 jat6 m4 hoeng2 dou6, wan2 keoi5 ting1 jat6 zoi3 lai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老板今天不在，你明天再来找他吧。
examples.english_sentence: His boss isn't here today, come back to see him tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲文件唔響度，唔知擺咗去邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 man4 gin2 m4 hoeng2 dou6, m4 zi1 baai2 zo2 heoi3 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 文件不在，不知道放到哪里去了。
examples.english_sentence: The documents are not here, I don't know where they were put.

english_meaning: not around; not present; absent
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人不在某个地方。
explanation_english: Indicates that someone is not in a particular place; absent from a location.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日唔響處，你聽日再打嚟啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 m4 hoeng2 cyu3, nei5 ting1 jat6 zoi3 daa2 lai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天不在，你明天再打电话来吧。
examples.english_sentence: He's not around today, call again tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經理唔響處，有咩事我可以幫你?
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 lei5 m4 hoeng2 cyu3, jau5 me1 si6 ngo5 ho2 ji5 bong1 nei5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经理不在，有什么事我可以帮你吗？
examples.english_sentence: The manager isn't here, can I help you with anything?

english_meaning: not smooth; uncomfortable; not going well; not going smoothly
explanation_mandarin: 指事情进行得不顺利，不舒服，或者心情不好。也用于形容身体不适。
explanation_english: Refers to things not going smoothly, feeling uncomfortable, or being in a bad mood. Can also describe physical discomfort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日覺得條頸唔順。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 gok3 dak1 tiu4 geng2 m4 seon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天觉得脖子不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: I feel uncomfortable in my neck today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事搞咗好耐都唔順，唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 gaau2 zo2 hou2 noi6 dou1 m4 seon6, m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事搞了很久都不顺利，不知道怎么办好。
examples.english_sentence: This matter hasn't been going smoothly for a long time, I don't know what to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日心情唔順，唔好搞佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 sam1 ching4 m4 seon6, m4 hou2 gaau2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天心情不好，不要惹他。
examples.english_sentence: He's in a bad mood today, don't bother him.

mandarin_meaning: 不服气, 咽不下这口气
english_meaning: to be resentful; to feel aggrieved; to be unable to swallow (an insult or injustice); to feel wronged
explanation_mandarin: 形容对某事或某人感到不满，心里无法接受，感到委屈或气愤。
explanation_english: Describes feeling dissatisfied, unable to accept something, feeling wronged or angry about something or someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁樣屈我，我真係好唔順氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 joeng2 wat1 ngo5, ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 m4 seon6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这样冤枉我，我真的非常不服气。
examples.english_sentence: He's framing me like this, I'm really resentful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿哥無啦啦鬧我，我梗係唔順氣啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 go1 mou4 laa1 laa1 nau6 ngo5, ngo5 gang2 hai6 m4 seon6 hei3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哥哥无缘无故骂我，我当然不服气啦。
examples.english_sentence: My brother scolded me for no reason, of course I feel aggrieved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細無理取鬧，好多同事都唔順氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 mou4 lei5 ceoi2 naau6, hou2 do1 tung4 si6 dou1 m4 seon6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板无理取闹，很多同事都不服气。
examples.english_sentence: The boss is acting unreasonably, many colleagues feel resentful.

english_meaning: to not like the look of someone or something; to dislike; to find something displeasing or annoying
explanation_mandarin: 表示对某人或某事的外观、行为等感到不悦、反感。
explanation_english: Describes a feeling of dislike or displeasure towards the appearance, behavior, etc., of someone or something. It implies finding something unpleasant to look at or observe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅態度真係好乞人憎，我好唔順眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 taai3 dou6 zan1 hai6 hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1, ngo5 hou2 m4 seon6 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的态度真的很令人讨厌，我非常看不顺眼。
examples.english_sentence: His attitude is really annoying, I really dislike him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫嘅顏色我唔順眼，我覺得太鮮豔喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 ge3 ngaan4 sik1 ngo5 m4 seon6 ngaan5, ngo5 gok3 dak1 taai3 sin1 jim6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服的颜色我不喜欢，我觉得太鲜艳了。
examples.english_sentence: I don't like the color of this shirt, I think it's too bright.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔順眼佢扮晒嘢嘅樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 seon6 ngaan5 keoi5 baan3 saai3 je5 ge3 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不喜欢他装模作样的样子。
examples.english_sentence: I don't like the way he pretends to be something he's not.

english_meaning: not satisfied; displeased; not happy about something
explanation_mandarin: 表示对某事感到不满意，不舒服，心中有所不满。
explanation_english: Expressing dissatisfaction or displeasure about something; feeling uneasy or uncomfortable with a situation or outcome. It often implies a feeling of being slightly annoyed or resentful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試考得咁差，真係好唔順超。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 haau2 dak1 gam3 caa1, zan1 hai6 hou2 m4 seon6 ciu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试考得这么差，真的很不爽。
examples.english_sentence: I did so badly on the exam this time, I'm really displeased.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁樣對我，我梗係唔順超啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 joeng6 deoi3 ngo5, ngo5 gang2 hai6 m4 seon6 ciu1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这样对我，我当然不爽啦。
examples.english_sentence: He treats me like this, of course, I'm not happy about it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 明明係我贏，佢都話佢贏，梗係唔順超啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ming4 ming4 hai6 ngo5 wing4, keoi5 dou1 waa6 keoi5 wing4, gang2 hai6 m4 seon6 ciu1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明明是我赢了，他都说他赢了，肯定不爽啊！
examples.english_sentence: It was clearly me who won, and he's saying he won, of course, I'm displeased!

mandarin_meaning: 不顾自身安危; 不顾个人利益
english_meaning: to disregard one's own safety; selfless; to put others before oneself
explanation_mandarin: 形容为了帮助别人或完成某件事，而不考虑自己的安全或利益。
explanation_english: Describes putting others' needs or the completion of a task above one's own safety or personal gain; to be selfless or altruistic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 消防員衝入火場救人，真係唔顧身私。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu1 fong4 jyun4 cung1 jap6 fo2 coeng4 gau3 jan4, zan1 hai6 m4 gu3 san1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 消防员冲入火场救人，真是奋不顾身。
examples.english_sentence: The firefighter rushed into the fire to save people, truly disregarding his own safety.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗幫朋友還債，唔顧身私咁樣借錢俾佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 bong1 pang4 jau5 waan4 zaai3, m4 gu3 san1 si1 gam2 joeng2 ze3 cin2 bei2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了帮朋友还债，他不顾个人利益地借钱给他。
examples.english_sentence: In order to help his friend repay debts, he lent him money selflessly.

english_meaning: to not care about saving face; to be shameless; to not consider someone's feelings or dignity
explanation_mandarin: 指不给别人留情面，使人难堪，不在乎别人是否丢脸。
explanation_english: Refers to not saving face for others, causing them embarrassment, and not caring whether others lose face. It implies a lack of consideration for someone's feelings or dignity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢成日都唔顧面，好多人都唔鍾意佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 seng4 jat6 dou1 m4 gu3 min6, ho2 do1 jan4 dou1 m4 zung1 ji3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话总是很不顾面子，很多人都不喜欢他。
examples.english_sentence: He always speaks without considering anyone's feelings, so many people don't like him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁樣鬧佢啦，俾啲面佢啦，唔好咁唔顧面呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 joeng6 naau6 keoi5 laa1, bei2 di1 min6 keoi5 laa1, m4 hou2 gam3 m4 gu3 min6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这样骂他了，给他留点面子吧，别这么不顾面子啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't scold him like that, save some face for him, don't be so shameless!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗上位，可以去到好唔顧面嘅地步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 soeng5 wai2, ho2 ji5 heoi3 dou3 hou2 m4 gu3 min6 ge3 dei6 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了上位，他可以做到非常不顾面子的地步。
examples.english_sentence: In order to climb the social ladder, he can go to a point where he doesn't care about saving face at all.

jyutping: m4 sik6 jan4 gaan1 jin1 fo2
english_meaning: To not eat earthly food; to be aloof from worldly affairs; otherworldly; detached from reality
explanation_mandarin: 形容人脱俗，不食人间食物，或形容人的生活方式超脱凡尘，不关心世俗琐事。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is detached from the world, doesn't concern themselves with mundane things, or is living a lifestyle that is beyond the ordinary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都淨係諗住藝術，好似唔食人間煙火咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 zing6 hai6 nam2 zyu6 ngai6 seot1, hou2 ci5 m4 sik6 jan4 gaan1 jin1 fo2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天只想着艺术，好像不食人间烟火一样。
examples.english_sentence: He always thinks about art, like he's detached from the world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好高傲，好似唔食人間煙火咁，唔睬人哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 gou1 ngou6, hou2 ci5 m4 sik6 jan4 gaan1 jin1 fo2 gam2, m4 caai2 jan4 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为人很高傲，好像不食人间烟火一样，不理睬别人。
examples.english_sentence: He is very arrogant, as if he's detached from the world, ignoring others.

synonyms: 離群脫俗 (lei4 kwan4 tyut3 suk6)
超凡脫俗 (ciu1 faan4 tyut3 suk6)

jyutping: m4 sik6 joeng4 juk6 jat1 san1 sou3
mandarin_meaning: 没有吃羊肉，身上却有羊膻味
english_meaning: To be suspected or accused of something one didn't do; to be implicated even though innocent; to get the blame without having done anything wrong.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻没有做某事，却被人怀疑或牵连其中，无端遭受指责或冤枉。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where someone is suspected or implicated in something they didn't do. It implies that the person is unjustly accused or blamed, even though they are innocent. The smell of mutton (lamb) represents the suspicion or blame, even though the person didn't eat any (i.e., didn't do anything wrong).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我淨係幫佢手影咗張相，點知佢犯法，搞到我 唔食羊肉一身臊，俾差人拉埋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zing6 hai6 bong1 keoi5 sau2 ying2 zo2 zoeng1 soeng2, dim2 zi1 keoi5 faan6 faat3, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 m4 sik6 joeng4 juk6 jat1 san1 sou3, bei2 caai1 jan4 laai1 maai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是帮他拍了张照片，没想到他犯法了，害得我没吃羊肉一身臊，被警察一起抓了。
examples.english_sentence: I just helped him take a picture, but I didn't expect him to break the law. Now, I'm getting the blame without having done anything wrong, and the police arrested me too.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢冇參與個計劃，但係佢之前提過類似嘅嘢，搞到佢而家 唔食羊肉一身臊，俾人質疑佢嘅誠信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 mou5 caam1 jyu5 go3 gai3 waak6, daan6 hai6 keoi5 zi1 cin4 tai4 gwo3 leoi5 ci5 ge3 je5, gaau2 dou3 keoi5 ji4 gaa1 m4 sik6 joeng4 juk6 jat1 san1 sou3, bei2 jan4 zat1 ji4 keoi5 ge3 sing4 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他没有参与那个计划，但是他之前提过类似的东西，导致他现在没吃羊肉一身臊，被人质疑他的诚信。
examples.english_sentence: Although he didn't participate in that project, he had mentioned something similar before, which made him get the blame even though he didn't do anything wrong, and his integrity is being questioned.

mandarin_meaning: 不用问，当然了；显而易见
english_meaning: No need to ask; obviously; it goes without saying
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情非常明显，无需询问就能知道答案。 亚贵是一个虚拟人物，用来强调事情的确定性。
explanation_english: This idiom means that something is very obvious and there is no need to ask about it. '亞貴' (Aa Gwai) is a fictitious person, used to emphasize the certainty of the situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日落雨機會咁大，唔駛問亞貴都知要帶遮啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 lok6 jyu5 gei1 wui2 gam3 daai6, m4 sai2 man6 aa3 gwai3 dou1 zi1 jiu3 daai3 ze1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天下雨的几率这么大，不用问当然也知道要带伞了。
examples.english_sentence: With such a high chance of rain tomorrow, no need to ask, we obviously have to bring an umbrella.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個咁friend，唔駛問亞貴都知佢哋一定會一齊去旅行啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 gam3 friend, m4 sai2 man6 aa3 gwai3 dou1 zi1 keoi5 dei6 jat1 ding6 wui5 jat1 cai4 heoi3 leoi5 hang4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个那么要好，不用问也知道他们一定会一起去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: They are such good friends, it goes without saying that they will travel together.

english_meaning: You're welcome; Don't mention it; No problem
explanation_mandarin: 表示不用感谢或客气，是一种礼貌的回应。
explanation_english: A polite phrase used as a response to thank you, indicating that no thanks or formality is necessary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你幫我搬嘢呀！ 唔駛客氣，舉手之勞啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 bong1 ngo5 bun1 je5 aa3! m4 sai2 haak3 hei3, geoi2 sau2 zi1 lou4 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢你帮我搬东西！不用客气，举手之劳而已。
examples.english_sentence: Thank you for helping me move things! You're welcome, it was just a small favor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該曬！ 唔駛客氣，下次再嚟幫襯呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 saai3! m4 sai2 haak3 hei3, haa6 ci3 zoi3 lai4 bong1 can3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢！ 不用客气，下次再来光顾啊！
examples.english_sentence: Thank you! You're welcome, come again next time!

english_meaning: Don't even think about it; Forget about it; There's no way
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事不可能发生，劝人不要抱有幻想或期望。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is absolutely impossible and advises against hoping or expecting it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁懶，仲想升職？唔駛旨意啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 laan5, zung2 soeng2 sing1 zik1? m4 sai2 zi2 ji3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么懒，还想升职？别想了！
examples.english_sentence: You're so lazy, and you still want a promotion? Don't even think about it!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢都走咗咁耐，你仲想佢返嚟？唔駛旨意喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou1 zau2 zo2 gam3 noi6, nei5 zung2 soeng2 keoi5 faan1 lai4? m4 sai2 zi2 ji3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他都走了这么久，你还想他回来？别指望了。
examples.english_sentence: He's been gone for so long, and you still want him to come back? Forget about it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試你衰咗咁多科，想入大學？唔駛旨意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 nei5 seoi1 zo2 gam3 do1 fo1, soeng2 jap6 daai6 hok6? m4 sai2 zi2 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试你挂了这么多科，想上大学？ 别想了。
examples.english_sentence: You failed so many subjects this time, and you want to go to university? Forget about it.

english_meaning: neither salty nor bland; mediocre; half-baked; neither one thing nor another; ambiguous; so-so
explanation_mandarin: 形容味道、状态或性质不纯正，不彻底，不上不下，不伦不类。多指口音不标准，做事不彻底等。
explanation_english: Describes something that is neither one thing nor another, mediocre, half-baked, or ambiguous. It often refers to a non-standard accent or incomplete actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲廣東話講到唔鹹唔淡，唔似本地人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 gwong2 dung1 waa2 gong2 dou3 m4 haam4 m4 daam6, m4 ci5 bun2 dei6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说广东话不伦不类，不像本地人。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks Cantonese with a half-baked accent, not like a local.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢唔好咁唔鹹唔淡，要搞清楚先好做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 m4 hou2 gam2 m4 haam4 m4 daam6, jiu3 gaau2 cing1 chu2 sin1 hou2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做事不要这么不上不下，要搞清楚了再做。
examples.english_sentence: Don't do things in such a half-hearted way, make sure you understand it before you do it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食唔鹹唔淡，好難食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 m4 haam4 m4 daam6, hou2 naan4 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西不咸不淡，很难吃。
examples.english_sentence: The food in this restaurant is so-so, it's hard to eat.

mandarin_meaning: 不恋家; 不依赖家人
english_meaning: not clingy to family; independent from family; not homesick
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人比较独立，不喜欢依赖家人，或者不喜欢经常待在家里。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is independent, doesn't like to rely on family, or doesn't like to stay at home often. It implies a preference for independence and self-reliance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好細個就去咗外國讀書，真係好唔黐家㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sai3 go3 zau6 heoi3 zo2 ngoi6 gwok3 duk6 syu1, zan1 hai6 hou2 m4 ci1 gaa1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很小就去国外读书了，真的很不恋家。
examples.english_sentence: He went abroad to study at a very young age, he's really not clingy to family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個仔大個咗，越嚟越唔黐家，成日出街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 zai2 daai6 go3 zo2, yut6 lai4 yut6 m4 ci1 gaa1, seng4 jat6 ceot1 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我儿子长大了，越来越不恋家，总是出门。
examples.english_sentence: My son has grown up, he's becoming less and less clingy to family, always going out.

mandarin_meaning: 不专心工作; 不务正业
english_meaning: To not concentrate on work; to be lazy; to slack off; to be idle
explanation_mandarin: 形容人工作时不专心，偷懒或不务正业。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is not concentrating on their work, is lazy, slacks off, or does not do proper work. The character "𠸎" (on1) resembles the sound of someone snoring, implying sleepiness or inattentiveness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺公司唔𠸎經，難怪俾老細炒魷魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 gung1 si1 m4 on1 ging1, naan4 gwaai3 bei2 lou5 sai3 caau2 jau4 jyu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天在公司不专心工作，难怪被老板解雇。
examples.english_sentence: He's always slacking off at the office, no wonder the boss fired him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺上堂嗰陣唔𠸎經，要專心聽書啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 soeng5 tong4 go2 zan6 m4 on1 ging1, jiu3 zyun1 sam1 teng1 syu1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你上课的时候不要不专心，要专心听课啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't slack off during class, you need to concentrate on listening to the lecture.

mandarin_meaning: 不听劝告；不服从；不听使唤
english_meaning: disobedient; unmanageable; not listening to advice; stubborn
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或事物不听劝告，不服从指挥，难以控制。
explanation_english: Describes a person or thing that doesn't listen to advice, disobeys commands, and is difficult to control or manage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個細路真係唔𠸎耕，成日周圍搞搞震。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sai3 lou2 zan1 hai6 m4 teng1 gaang1, seng4 jat6 zau1 wai4 gaau2 gaau2 zan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个小孩真是不听话，整天到处捣乱。
examples.english_sentence: This child is really disobedient, always making trouble everywhere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦舊咗就開始唔𠸎耕，成日hang機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 gau6 zo2 zau6 hoi1 chi2 m4 teng1 gaang1, seng4 jat6 hang1 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台电脑旧了就开始不听使唤，老是死机。
examples.english_sentence: This computer started becoming unmanageable after it got old, always freezing.

english_meaning: to kiss; to smooch; to make out
explanation_mandarin: 粤语口语，表示亲吻。程度比一般的亲吻要深，更强调长时间和投入。
explanation_english: Cantonese colloquialism for 'to kiss'. It implies a more passionate and prolonged kiss than a simple peck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺公园度唚咗好耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 gung1 jyun2 dou6 zeon3 zo2 hou2 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在公园里亲了很久。
examples.english_sentence: They kissed for a long time in the park.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺公众场所度唚啦，核突。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 gung1 zung2 coeng4 so2 dou6 zeon3 laa1, hat6 dat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在公共场所亲吻啦，真恶心。
examples.english_sentence: Don't kiss in public, it's disgusting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋两个唚得好投入。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 zeon3 dak1 hou2 tau4 jap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个亲得很投入。
examples.english_sentence: The two of them kissed very passionately.

english_meaning: to feel discouraged; to lose enthusiasm; to feel deflated; to be a downer
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人感到灰心丧气，失去动力或热情，令人感到扫兴。
explanation_english: Describes a feeling of discouragement, loss of motivation, or enthusiasm. Can also describe something or someone that brings down the mood or is a 'downer'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日要返工，諗起就唚氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 jiu3 faan1 gung1, lam2 hei2 zau6 cam3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 想到明天要上班，就感到很泄气。
examples.english_sentence: Just thinking about having to go to work tomorrow makes me feel discouraged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢次次都輸，所以有啲唚氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci3 ci3 dou1 syu1, so2 ji5 jau5 di1 cam3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每次都输，所以有点气馁。
examples.english_sentence: He loses every time, so he's a bit discouraged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁唚氣啦，下次努力啲咪得囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 cam3 hei3 laa1, haa6 ci3 nu5 lik6 di1 mai1 dak1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么灰心啦，下次努力点不就好了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so discouraged, just try harder next time.

english_meaning: to rest, to take a break
explanation_mandarin: 休息，歇息。
explanation_english: To rest, to take a break, to relax.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我晏晝想唞吓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aan3 zau3 soeng2 tau2 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下午想休息一下。
examples.english_sentence: I want to take a break this afternoon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做完嘢，我哋去飲杯嘢唞吓啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jyun4 je5, ngo5 dei6 heoi3 yam2 bui1 je5 tau2 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工作完后，我们去喝一杯东西休息一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: After finishing work, let's go for a drink and relax.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行咗咁耐，不如搵個地方唞吓？
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 zo2 gam3 noi6, bat1 jyu4 wan2 go3 dei6 fong1 tau2 haa5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 走了这么久，不如找个地方休息一下？
examples.english_sentence: We've been walking for so long, how about finding a place to rest?

english_meaning: to take a deep breath; to catch one's breath; to take a breather
explanation_mandarin: 指深深地吸一口气，通常是为了缓解疲劳、紧张或者惊讶等情绪。
explanation_english: Refers to taking a deep breath, usually to relieve fatigue, tension, or surprise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 跑完步之後，要唞大氣，放鬆下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: paau2 jyun4 bou6 zi1 hau6, jiu3 tau2 daai6 hei3, fong3 sung1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 跑完步之后，要深呼吸，放松一下。
examples.english_sentence: After running, you need to take a deep breath and relax.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到個消息之後，佢忍唔住唞咗啖大氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou2 go3 siu1 sik1 zi1 hau6, keoi5 jan2 m4 zyu6 tau2 zo2 daam6 daai6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到这个消息之后，他忍不住深呼吸了一下。
examples.english_sentence: After hearing the news, he couldn't help but take a deep breath.

english_meaning: to escape the summer heat; to go away for the summer (to a cooler place)
explanation_mandarin: 指为了躲避夏季的炎热而到凉爽的地方去。
explanation_english: To escape the summer heat, typically by going to a cooler location for vacation or respite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年我哋一家人打算去加拿大唞暑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ngo5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 daa2 syun3 heoi3 gaa1 naa4 daai6 tau2 syu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年我们一家人打算去加拿大避暑。
examples.english_sentence: This year, my family plans to go to Canada to escape the summer heat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢年年暑假都返鄉下唞暑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nin4 nin4 syu2 gaa3 dou1 faan1 hoeng1 haa6 tau2 syu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每年暑假都回老家避暑。
examples.english_sentence: He goes back to his hometown to escape the summer heat every summer vacation.

english_meaning: to breathe, to catch one's breath, to rest, to take a break
explanation_mandarin: 指呼吸，休息一下，喘口气。
explanation_english: Refers to breathing or taking a rest; to catch one's breath.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行咗咁耐，不如我哋唞氣先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 zo2 gam3 noi6, bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 tau2 hei3 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 走了这么久，不如我们先休息一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: We've walked for so long, how about we take a break first?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做完運動要唞氣，唔好即刻坐低。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jyun4 wan6 dung6 jiu3 tau2 hei3, m4 hou2 zik1 hak1 co5 dai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 运动完要喘口气，不要立刻坐下。
examples.english_sentence: After exercising, you should catch your breath; don't sit down immediately.

english_meaning: to cool off; to relax in a cool place
explanation_mandarin: 指在凉快的地方休息，纳凉。
explanation_english: To relax and cool down, usually in a place with a breeze or shade.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚好熱呀，不如我哋落街唞涼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 hou2 jit6 aa3, bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 lok6 gaai1 tau2 loeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚很热，不如我们下楼乘凉。
examples.english_sentence: It's very hot tonight, how about we go downstairs to cool off?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆成日喺公園唞涼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 seng4 jat6 hai2 gung1 jyun2 tau2 loeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶经常在公园乘凉。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma often relaxes in the park to cool off.

english_meaning: to take a breather; to calm down; to catch one's breath
explanation_mandarin: 指深呼吸放松心情，平复情绪，或休息一下缓解疲劳。
explanation_english: To take a deep breath to relax and calm down one's emotions, or to take a break to relieve fatigue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做咗咁耐嘢，不如唞順條氣先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 zo2 gam3 noi6 je5, bat1 jyu4 tau2 seon6 tiu4 hei3 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工作这么久了，不如先喘口气吧。
examples.english_sentence: We've been working for so long, let's take a breather first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使咁激動，唞順條氣先，慢慢講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 gam3 gik1 dung6, tau2 seon6 tiu4 hei3 sin1, maan6 maan6 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用这么激动，先冷静一下，慢慢说。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so excited, calm down first and speak slowly.

english_meaning: entirely; completely; all
explanation_mandarin: 表示全部、完全的意思。 通常用于否定句，表示没有任何剩余。
explanation_english: Indicates entirety, completeness, or all. Often used in negative sentences, implying that nothing is left or remaining.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋食嗮啲嘢，一啲都冇剩低，真係食到唥口唥鼻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sik6晒di1嘢, jat1 di1 dou1 mou5 sing6 dai1, zan1 hai6 sik6 dou3 laang1 hau2 laang1 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们把东西都吃光了，一点都没剩下，真是吃得干干净净。
examples.english_sentence: They ate all the food, leaving nothing behind at all; they really ate it all up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我身上唥都冇錢，點請你食飯啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 san1 soeng5 laang1 dou1 mou5 cin2, dim2 ceng2 nei5 sik6 faan6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我身上一点钱都没有，怎么请你吃饭啊？
examples.english_sentence: I don't have any money on me at all. How can I treat you to dinner?

english_meaning: spot on; perfectly correct; absolutely right
explanation_mandarin: 形容完全正确，一点也没有错。通常用来肯定对方的答案或判断非常准确。
explanation_english: Describes something that is absolutely correct and without error. Commonly used to affirm that someone's answer or judgment is perfectly accurate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你估中咗，唥鐘!
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gu2 zung1 zo2, laang1 zung1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你猜对了，完全正确！
examples.english_sentence: You guessed right, spot on!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅答案唥鐘，一分都唔扣得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 daap3 aan3 laang1 zung1, jat1 fan1 dou1 m4 kau3 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的答案完全正确，一分都不能扣。
examples.english_sentence: His answer is perfectly correct, no marks can be deducted.

english_meaning: to squirt; to pump out; to murmur; to complain softly
explanation_mandarin: 表示挤压出某种东西，或小声抱怨。
explanation_english: Indicates squeezing out something or complaining in a low voice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唧啲牙膏出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jik1 di1 ngaa4 gou1 cheut1 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 挤点牙膏出来。
examples.english_sentence: Squeeze some toothpaste out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺度唧唧貢啦，有咩唔滿意咪直接講囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 jik1 jik1 gung3 laa1, jau5 me1 m4 mun5 ji3 mai6 zik6 zip3 gong2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在这里嘟嘟囔囔了，有什么不满意的就直接说嘛。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just murmur here, if you are dissatisfied with something, just say it directly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個樽壞咗，㩒極都唧唔到啲洗手液出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 jeun1 waai6 zo2, gam6 gik1 dou1 jik1 m4 dou2 di1 sai2 sau2 jik6 cheut1 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 瓶子坏了，怎么按都挤不出洗手液出来。
examples.english_sentence: The bottle is broken, no matter how hard I press, I can't squeeze out any hand sanitizer.

english_meaning: that is to say, in other words, so; the point is
explanation_mandarin: 表示解释或说明，相当于“也就是说”、“就是”；也可用作语气词，表示强调或确认。
explanation_english: Used to explain or clarify something, equivalent to "that is to say" or "in other words". Can also be used as a particle to emphasize or confirm something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日唔得閒，唧係話我唔可以同你行街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 m4 dak1 haan4, zik1 hai6 waa6 ngo5 m4 ho2 ji5 tung4 nei5 haang4 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天没空，也就是说我不能和你逛街。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not free tomorrow, which means I can't go shopping with you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔鍾意佢，唧係你唔愛佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 zung1 ji3 keoi5, zik1 hai6 nei5 m4 oi3 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不喜欢他，那就是说你不爱他了。
examples.english_sentence: You don't like him, so you don't love him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唧係咁，我決定辭職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zik1 hai6 gam2, ngo5 kyut3 ding6 ci4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 就是这样，我决定辞职。
examples.english_sentence: That's it, I've decided to resign.

english_meaning: That is to say; In other words; Which is to say
explanation_mandarin: 表示解释或总结前面所说内容，相当于“也就是说”、“换句话说”。
explanation_english: Used to explain or summarize what was said before; equivalent to "that is to say", "in other words", or "which is to say".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我琴日病咗，唧係話我今日返唔到工啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kam4 jat6 beng6 zo2, zik1 hai6 waa6 ngo5 gam1 jat6 faan1 m4 dou2 gung1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天生病了，也就是说我今天回不了公司上班了。
examples.english_sentence: I was sick yesterday, which means I can't go to work today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔應機，唧係話佢唔想同你傾偈囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 ying3 gei1, zik1 hai6 waa6 keoi5 m4 soeng2 tung4 nei5 king1 gai2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不接电话，也就是说他不想和你聊天啦。
examples.english_sentence: He's not answering the phone, which means he doesn't want to chat with you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想煮飯，唧係話我哋出去食飯囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 zyu2 faan6, zik1 hai6 waa6 ngo5 dei6 cheut1 heoi3 sik6 faan6 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想做饭，也就是说我们出去吃饭吧。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to cook, which means we'll eat out.

english_meaning: Crushed ice popsicle; tube ice
explanation_mandarin: 一种冷冻在塑料管里的冰棒，通常需要挤压出来食用。在香港常见。
explanation_english: A type of frozen popsicle that is typically contained in a plastic tube and needs to be squeezed out to be eaten. Commonly found in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣，我成日食唧唧冰㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6, ngo5 seng4 jat6 sik6 zik1 zik1 bing1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候，我经常吃碎冰冰。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, I often ate crushed ice popsicles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日咁熱，不如買支唧唧冰解下暑啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 gam3 jit6, bat1 jyu4 maai5 zi1 zik1 zik1 bing1 gaai2 haa5 syu2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天这么热，不如买一支碎冰冰解解暑吧。
examples.english_sentence: It's so hot today, how about buying a tube ice to cool down?

english_meaning: flip-flops, slippers
explanation_mandarin: 指一种后跟没有鞋带的、穿着方便的鞋子，通常在家里或者休闲场合穿。
explanation_english: Refers to a type of footwear without a back strap, easy to slip on, usually worn at home or in casual settings; flip-flops or slippers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落街買嘢，求其着對唧屐就得啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 gai1 maai5 je5, kau4 kei4 zoek3 deoi3 zik1 gek1 zau6 dak1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下楼买东西，随便穿双拖鞋就可以了。
examples.english_sentence: Going downstairs to buy something, just wear a pair of flip-flops.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日着住對唧屐周圍走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zoek3 zyu6 deoi3 zik1 gek1 zau1 wai4 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天穿着拖鞋到处走。
examples.english_sentence: He wears flip-flops and walks around all day.

english_meaning: to squeeze toothpaste (literal); to reveal information bit by bit; to give information reluctantly
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是挤牙膏。比喻一点一点地透露信息，或不情愿地提供信息。
explanation_english: Literally means to squeeze toothpaste. Figuratively, it refers to revealing information little by little, or providing information reluctantly, like squeezing the last bit of toothpaste out of a tube.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好唧牙膏啦，一次過講晒出嚟啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zik1 ngaa4 gou1 laa1, jat1 ci3 gwo3 gong2晒saai3 ceot1 lai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别挤牙膏了，一次性全说出来吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't reveal information bit by bit, tell me everything at once.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢次次問佢嘢，佢都好似唧牙膏咁，唔肯一次過講清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci3 ci3 man6 keoi5 je5, keoi5 dou1 hou2 ci5 zik1 ngaa4 gou1 gam2, m4 hang2 jat1 ci3 gwo3 gong2 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每次问他事情，他都好像挤牙膏一样，不愿意一次性说清楚。
examples.english_sentence: Every time I ask him something, he reveals the information like squeezing toothpaste, unwilling to explain everything clearly at once.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細好似唧牙膏咁放出啲風聲，搞到我哋心掛掛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 hou2 ci5 zik1 ngaa4 gou1 gam2 fong3 ceot1 di1 fung1 seng1, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 dei6 sam1 gwaa3 gwaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板好像挤牙膏一样放出一些消息，搞得我们提心吊胆。
examples.english_sentence: The boss is releasing information bit by bit like squeezing toothpaste, making us anxious.

mandarin_meaning: 打气筒; 吹捧; 奉承
english_meaning: Air pump; to flatter; to suck up to; to pump up
explanation_mandarin: 原指物理上的打气筒。引申义为吹捧，奉承别人，使其自我感觉良好。
explanation_english: Originally refers to an air pump.  The extended meaning refers to flattering or sucking up to someone, making them feel good about themselves. Can also refer to pumping air into something physically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好識得唧筒，所以老闆好鍾意佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sik1 dak1 zik1 tung2, so2 ji5 lou5 baan2 hou2 zung1 ji3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很会吹捧，所以老板很喜欢他。
examples.english_sentence: He is good at flattering, so the boss likes him a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我踩單車條呔冇氣，要用唧筒唧返啲氣入去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 caai2 daan1 ce1 tiu4 taai1 mou5 hei3, jiu3 yung6 zik1 tung2 zik1 faan1啲 hei3 jap6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的自行车轮胎没气了，要用打气筒打回点气进去。
examples.english_sentence: My bicycle tire is flat, I need to use an air pump to pump some air back into it.

english_meaning: Pallet jack; hand pallet truck
explanation_mandarin: 一种手动液压搬运车，用于搬运托盘货物。
explanation_english: A hand-operated pallet truck used for lifting and moving pallets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 用唧車搬啲貨去貨車度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jung6 zik1 ce1 bun1 di1 fo3 heoi3 fo3 ce1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 用手动液压搬运车把货物搬到货车那里。
examples.english_sentence: Use the pallet jack to move the goods to the truck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間倉好多貨，要用唧車先搞得掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 cong1 hou2 do1 fo3, jiu3 jung6 zik1 ce1 sin1 gaau2 dak1 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 仓库里有很多货物，要用手动液压搬运车才能搞定。
examples.english_sentence: There are a lot of goods in the warehouse; we need a pallet jack to handle it.

mandarin_meaning: 一点都不笑; 毫无笑容
english_meaning: not even crack a smile; not even budge (in terms of smiling); utterly humorless
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常严肃，无论发生什么有趣的事情，都不会露出笑容。表示这个人缺乏幽默感或心情非常不好。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is very serious and doesn't smile even when something funny happens. It indicates a lack of humor or a very bad mood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人真係唧都唔笑，成日繃住塊面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 zan1 hai6 zik1 dou1 m4 siu3, sing4 jat6 bang1 zyu6 faai3 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人真是毫无笑容，整天绷着脸。
examples.english_sentence: He's really the type who won't crack a smile, always wearing a serious face.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我讲咗咁多笑话，佢都唧都唔笑，真係冇癮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gong2 zo2 gam3 do1 siu3 waa6, keoi5 dou1 zik1 dou1 m4 siu3, zan1 hai6 mou5 jan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我讲了这么多笑话，他都不笑，真没劲。
examples.english_sentence: I told so many jokes, but he didn't even crack a smile. It's so boring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿Sir今日唧都唔笑，可能發生咗啲咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 sir1 gam1 jat6 zik1 dou1 m4 siu3, ho2 nang4 faat3 sang1 zo2 di1 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师今天一点都不笑，可能发生了什么事。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher didn't smile at all today, something might have happened.

mandarin_meaning: 用勺子或特殊工具将鱼肉浆制成丸子
english_meaning: To make fish balls by squeezing fish paste through a tool (usually a spoon or specialized device); specifically refers to the process of shaping the fish balls, not the finished product.
explanation_mandarin: 指用工具将鱼肉浆挤压成鱼丸的过程。 不是指已经做好的鱼蛋。
explanation_english: Refers to the process of making fish balls by squeezing fish paste, typically with a spoon or specialized tool, to form the ball shape. It describes the action of creating the fish ball, not the finished fish ball itself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆喺度唧魚蛋，準備賣俾街坊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 hai2 dou6 zik1 jyu2 daan2, zeon2 bei6 maai6 bei2 gaai1 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶在那里做鱼丸，准备卖给街坊。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma is making fish balls, preparing to sell them to the neighbors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嗰陣成日睇住阿媽唧魚蛋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 tai2 zyu6 aa3 maa1 zik1 jyu2 daan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候经常看着妈妈做鱼丸。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, I often watched my mom making fish balls.

english_meaning: To suck; to sip; to puff (on a cigarette)
explanation_mandarin: 用嘴唇吸取液体或气体。
explanation_english: To draw liquid or gas into the mouth by contracting the lips and making a partial vacuum; to inhale or exhale smoke from a cigarette.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唨啖煙先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk1 daam6 jin1 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 先抽口烟。
examples.english_sentence: Take a puff of the cigarette first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唨緊果汁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zuk1 gan2 gwo2 zap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在吸果汁。
examples.english_sentence: I'm sipping juice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣成日唨手指。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 sing4 jat6 zuk1 sau2 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候经常吸手指。
examples.english_sentence: I used to suck my thumb a lot when I was a child.

english_meaning: to hold in both hands; to offer with respect (especially something small and light)
explanation_mandarin: 用双手托着或拿着；恭敬地托起。
explanation_english: To hold or carry something with both hands, especially to offer it respectfully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唪住碗飯
examples.jyutping_sentence: fung2 zyu6 wun2 faan6
examples.mandarin_sentence: 捧着一碗饭
examples.english_sentence: Holding a bowl of rice in both hands.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嘅時候成日唪住啲玩具周圍走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 sing4 jat6 fung2 zyu6 di1 wun6 geoi6 zau1 wai4 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候经常捧着玩具到处走。
examples.english_sentence: When he was little, he often carried toys around in his hands.

english_meaning: to sell; to offer for sale
explanation_mandarin: 将物品以价格出售。相当于普通话的“售卖，出售”。
explanation_english: To offer something for sale; to sell.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間鋪頭淨係售賣新鮮嘅海鮮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau2 zing6 hai6 sau6 maai6 san1 sin1 ge3 hoi2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家商店只售卖新鲜的海鲜。
examples.english_sentence: This shop only sells fresh seafood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲戲飛已經售罄喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 hei3 fei1 ji5 ging1 sau6 hing3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电影票已经售罄了。
examples.english_sentence: The movie tickets are already sold out.

english_meaning: to sell to; sold to
explanation_mandarin: 将某物出售给某人。
explanation_english: To sell something to someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司將佢啲股份售予一間美國企業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 zoeng1 keoi5 di1 gu2 fan6 sau6 jyu5 jat1 gaan1 mei5 gwok3 kei5 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司把它的股份出售给一家美国企业。
examples.english_sentence: The company sold its shares to an American enterprise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間屋已經售予咗李先生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 uk1 ji5 ging1 sau6 jyu5 zo2 lei5 sin1 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间房子已经售予了李先生。
examples.english_sentence: This house has already been sold to Mr. Li.

english_meaning: selling price; price
explanation_mandarin: 商品出售的价格。
explanation_english: The price at which something is sold.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫嘅售價係幾多啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 ge3 sau6 gaa3 hai6 gei2 do1 aa3?

examples.english_sentence: This company's after-sales service is very good. You can call them if you have any questions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買電器最緊要睇售後服務，如果壞咗起碼有人整。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 din6 hei3 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 tai2 sau6 hau6 fuk6 mou6, jyu4 gwo2 waai6 zo2 hei2 maa5 jau5 jan4 zing2.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅售後服務差到不得了，買完嘢就唔理你。

english_meaning: sales brochure (for properties), property brochure

explanation_english: A brochure that provides detailed information about properties for sale, including floor plans, prices, location, amenities, and other relevant details.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋睇吓呢間發展商嘅售樓書先，了解吓啲樓盤資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 tai2 haa5 ni1 gaan1 faat3 zin2 soeng1 ge3 sau6 lau4 syu1 sin1, liu2 gaai2 haa5 di1 lau4 pun4 zi1 liu2.

examples.english_sentence: Let's take a look at this developer's sales brochure to understand the property information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份售樓書寫住呢度嘅會所設施好完善㗎。

examples.english_sentence: The sales brochure says that the clubhouse facilities here are very comprehensive.

english_meaning: to sell tickets; ticket sales

examples.english_sentence: Online ticket sales are very convenient.

english_meaning: ticket office, ticket booth

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份工係售貨，所以要成日企。

english_meaning: salesperson, shop assistant, sales clerk
explanation_mandarin: 在商店或商场中负责销售商品的人员。
explanation_english: A person who sells goods in a shop or department store.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個售貨員好有禮貌，介紹得好詳細。

examples.english_sentence: The salesperson was very polite and explained everything in detail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺間百貨公司做售貨員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gaan1 baak3 fo3 gung1 si1 zou6 sau6 fo3 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在一家百货公司做售货员。
examples.english_sentence: He works as a salesperson in a department store.

english_meaning: to sell, to offer for sale

explanation_english: To sell, to offer goods or services for sale.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在网上售卖二手衣服。
examples.english_sentence: They sell second-hand clothes online.

mandarin_meaning: 只有，仅仅，是，回答的声音
english_meaning: only; just; merely; yes (in response); to comply; to answer respectfully
explanation_mandarin: 表示只有、仅仅。也可作应答声，表示顺从、同意。文言色彩较重。
explanation_english: Indicates only, just, merely. Can also be used as a response indicating compliance or agreement. Has a strong classical Chinese feel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對阿媽講嘅嘢唯唯諾諾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 aa3 maa1 gong2 ge3 je5 wai4 wai4 nok6 nok6.

examples.english_sentence: I can only solve the problem by doing this.

explanation_english: Being the only one; unique; without any others of the same kind.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 这是我们唯一的机会。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 广东话是香港唯一的法定语言之一。
examples.english_sentence: Cantonese is one of the only official languages of Hong Kong.

english_meaning: to hold someone solely responsible; you will be held accountable
explanation_mandarin: 意思是只向你追究责任。表示某件事情出了问题，只会找你负责，其他人一概不问。
explanation_english: It means to hold only you responsible. It indicates that if something goes wrong, only you will be held accountable, and no one else will be questioned.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你搞唔掂呢件事，我就唯你是問！
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 gaau2 m4 dim6 ni1 gin6 si6, ngo5 zau6 wai4 nei5 si6 man6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你搞不定这件事，我就唯你是问！
examples.english_sentence: If you can't handle this matter, I will hold you solely responsible!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆話如果project出咗事，就唯我是問。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板说如果项目出了事，就唯我是问。
examples.english_sentence: The boss said if anything goes wrong with the project, I will be held solely responsible.

english_meaning: solely interested in profit; driven by profit; mercenary; money-grubbing

examples.english_sentence: This company is solely interested in profit; they won't consider the welfare of the employees.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了赚钱，他什么都做得出来，真是唯利是图。
examples.english_sentence: He would do anything for money, he's truly driven by profit.

english_meaning: to obey orders blindly; to be completely subservient; to follow orders implicitly
explanation_mandarin: 完全听从命令，不敢有任何违抗或质疑。
explanation_english: To obey orders unquestioningly and without any hesitation or doubt; to be completely compliant and subservient to someone's commands.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對佢老細唯命是從，完全唔敢反抗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 keoi5 lou5 sai3 wai4 ming6 si6 cung4, wun4 cyun4 m4 gam2 faan2 kong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对他的老板言听计从，完全不敢反抗。
examples.english_sentence: He obeys his boss blindly, not daring to resist at all.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想做一个言听计从的人，我想有自己的想法。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to be someone who obeys orders blindly; I want to have my own thoughts.

english_meaning: to say yes to everything; to be servile; to be obsequious; to be a yes-man
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人总是顺从别人的意见，不敢提出异议，表现得非常恭顺。
explanation_english: Describes someone who always agrees with others and is afraid to express their own opinions, appearing very submissive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺老闆面前成日都唯唯諾諾，乜都話好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 lou5 baan2 min6 cin4 sing4 jat6 dou1 wai4 wai4 nok6 nok6, mat1 dou1 waa6 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在老板面前总是唯唯诺诺，什么都说好。
examples.english_sentence: He's always a yes-man in front of the boss, agreeing to everything.

examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 wai4 wai4 nok6 nok6 laa1, jiu3 jau5 zi6 gei2 ge3 nam2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么唯唯诺诺了，要有自己的想法。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so obsequious, you need to have your own thoughts.

english_meaning: for fear that, lest, afraid that, worried that
explanation_mandarin: 表示担心某种不希望发生的情况出现。
explanation_english: Expressing worry or fear that an undesirable situation might occur.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他跑得很快，恐怕赶不上巴士。
examples.english_sentence: He runs very fast, for fear that he will miss the bus.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 媽媽成日提醒我帶遮，唯恐落雨。

examples.english_sentence: My mother always reminds me to bring an umbrella, for fear that it will rain.

english_meaning: to delight in creating chaos; to thrive on turmoil; to be a troublemaker
explanation_mandarin: 形容人喜欢制造混乱，唯恐天下太平。
explanation_english: Describes a person who enjoys creating chaos and doesn't want the world to be peaceful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢條友仔成日唯恐天下不亂，邊度有鑊氣佢就衝去邊度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tiu4 jau5 zai2 seng4 jat6 wai4 hung2 tin1 haa6 bat1 lyun6, bin1 dou6 jau5 wok6 hei3 keoi5 zau6 cung1 heoi3 bin1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人总是唯恐天下不乱，哪里有麻烦他就往哪里冲。
examples.english_sentence: That guy always thrives on turmoil; he rushes to where the trouble is.

english_meaning: to regard oneself as supreme; arrogance; conceited; hubris
explanation_mandarin: 形容自以为了不起，认为只有自己最了不起，目中无人。
explanation_english: Describes someone who regards themselves as the best and most important person, often arrogant and disregarding others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好唯我獨尊㗎，聽唔入其他人嘅意見嘅。

examples.english_sentence: Don't be so arrogant, we're all part of the team, we need to respect other people's ideas.
