examples.mandarin_sentence: 预计旅行团下个星期启程。
examples.english_sentence: The tour group is expected to depart next week.

english_meaning: to set sail, to embark, to set off (on a journey)
explanation_mandarin: 指船、飞机等开始航行。
explanation_english: Refers to ships, airplanes, etc., starting their voyage or journey.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋架船聽朝就啟航去日本喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gaa3 syun4 ting1 ziu1 zau6 kai2 hong4 heoi3 jat6 bun2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的船明天早上就要启航去日本了。
examples.english_sentence: Our ship will set sail for Japan tomorrow morning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新嘅一年，我哋要重新啟航，迎接挑戰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 ge3 jat1 nin4, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 cung4 san1 kai2 hong4, jing4 zip3 tiu1 zin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新的一年，我们要重新启航，迎接挑战。
examples.english_sentence: In the new year, we must set sail again and meet the challenges.

english_meaning: to set sail; to embark on a voyage; to launch (a project, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 开始航行；比喻开始一项新的事业或计划。
explanation_english: To begin a voyage by ship or airplane; metaphorically, to start a new undertaking or project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日啟航去日本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 kai2 hong4 heoi3 jat6 bun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天启航去日本。
examples.english_sentence: We are setting sail for Japan tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目終於可以啟航喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 zung1 jyu1 ho2 ji5 kai2 hong4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目终于可以启动了。
examples.english_sentence: This project can finally be launched.

english_meaning: to enlighten, to initiate, to instruct in rudimentary knowledge
explanation_mandarin: 指开始教授基本知识，使人初步懂得一些道理。
explanation_english: To enlighten someone; to initiate someone into a subject or area of knowledge; to instruct someone in basic or rudimentary knowledge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嗰陣，係佢阿爺啟蒙佢讀古文嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6, hai6 keoi5 aa3 je4 kai2 mung4 keoi5 duk6 gu2 man1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候，是他爷爷启蒙他读古文的。
examples.english_sentence: When he was young, his grandfather initiated him into reading classical Chinese texts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書係我嘅音樂啟蒙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 hai6 ngo5 ge3 jam1 ngok6 kai2 mung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书是我的音乐启蒙。
examples.english_sentence: This book was my introduction to music.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個課程旨在啟蒙學生嘅批判性思維。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fo3 ching4 zhi2 zoi6 kai2 mung4 hok6 sang1 ge3 pai1 pun3 sing3 si1 wai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个课程旨在启蒙学生的批判性思维。
examples.english_sentence: This course aims to enlighten students' critical thinking.

english_meaning: enlightenment, to enlighten, initiation, to initiate
explanation_mandarin: 指开始教育，使人对某一事物开始认识或了解。
explanation_english: To enlighten; to initiate; to provide basic education or knowledge to someone, especially at an early age. It can also refer to the enlightenment or initiation itself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嘅時候就已經接受咗音樂啟蒙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 zau6 ji5 ging1 zip3 sau6 zo2 jam1 ngok6 kai2 mung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候就已经接受了音乐启蒙。
examples.english_sentence: He received musical initiation when he was little.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書係我哲學思想嘅啟蒙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 hai6 ngo5 jit3 hok6 si1 soeng2 ge3 kai2 mung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书是我的哲学思想的启蒙。
examples.english_sentence: This book was the starting point of my philosophical thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好感謝佢啟蒙咗我對藝術嘅興趣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 gam2 ze6 keoi5 kai2 mung4 zo2 ngo5 deoi3 ngai6 seot1 ge3 hing3 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我非常感谢他启蒙了我对艺术的兴趣。
examples.english_sentence: I am very grateful that he initiated my interest in art.

english_meaning: to enlighten; to inspire; to awaken
explanation_mandarin: 启发，开导，使人有所领悟。
explanation_english: To enlighten, inspire, or awaken someone, causing them to gain understanding or insight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書嘅內容好有啟迪性，睇完之後令我覺得獲益良多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 ge3 noi6 yung6 hou2 jau5 kai2 dik1 sing3, tai2 yun4 zi1 hau6 ling6 ngo5 gok3 dak1 wok6 jik1 loeng4 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书的内容很有启发性，看完之后让我觉得受益匪浅。
examples.english_sentence: The content of this book is very enlightening. After reading it, I feel that I have benefited a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅演講好啟迪人心，令我哋反思好多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jin2 gong2 hou2 kai2 dik1 jan4 sam1, ling6 ngo5 dei6 faan2 si1 hou2 do1 ye5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的演讲很启发人心，让我们反思了很多事情。
examples.english_sentence: His speech was very inspiring and made us reflect on many things.

english_meaning: to enlighten, to inspire, enlightenment, inspiration
explanation_mandarin: 指启发别人的思维，使人有所领悟或觉醒。
explanation_english: To enlighten or inspire someone, causing them to understand or become aware of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書啟迪咗我哋去思考人生嘅意義。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 kai2 dik1 zo2 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 si1 haau2 jan4 sang1 ge3 ji3 ngai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书启发了我们去思考人生的意义。
examples.english_sentence: This book inspired us to think about the meaning of life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅演講充滿啟迪性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jin2 gong2 cung1 mun5 kai2 dik1 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的演讲充满启发性。
examples.english_sentence: His speech was very enlightening.

english_meaning: to open one's mouth (to speak); to broach a subject; to begin to speak
explanation_mandarin: 指开始说话，有时特指开始谈论某件比较难以开口的事情。
explanation_english: To open one's mouth to speak; often refers to starting to talk about something difficult or embarrassing to bring up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔知點啟齒同佢講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zi1 dim2 kai2 ci2 tung4 keoi5 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不知道怎么开口跟他说。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know how to broach the subject with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事好難啟齒講出口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 hou2 naan4/naan6 kai2 ci2 gong2 chut1 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事很难开口说出来。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is very difficult to talk about.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一直都唔啟齒問我借錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 zik6 dou1 m4 kai2 ci2 man6 ngo5 ze3 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一直都不开口问我借钱。
examples.english_sentence: He never broached the subject of borrowing money from me.

english_meaning: coffee
explanation_mandarin: 咖啡的简称，来自英文“coffee”的音译。
explanation_english: Short form for coffee, transliterated from the English word "coffee".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想飲杯啡啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 jam2 bui1 fe1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想喝杯咖啡啊。
examples.english_sentence: I want to drink a cup of coffee.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間鋪頭嘅啡好香。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau2 ge3 fe1 hou2 hoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店的咖啡很香。
examples.english_sentence: The coffee at this shop smells very good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你鍾唔鍾意飲齋啡？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung1 m4 zung1 ji3 jam2 zaai1 fe1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你喜不喜欢喝纯咖啡？
examples.english_sentence: Do you like to drink black coffee?

english_meaning: to fail, to screw up, to mess up
explanation_mandarin: 指事情没有成功，搞砸了，失败了。通常带有贬义色彩，表示做的不好或者出了问题。
explanation_english: To fail at something, to screw up, to mess up. It usually has a negative connotation, indicating that something was done poorly or went wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試我啡低咗啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ngo5 fe1 dai1 zo2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我考砸了！
examples.english_sentence: I screwed up the exam this time!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢成日都啡低，真係唔掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 seng4 jat6 dou1 fe1 dai1, zan1 hai6 m4 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作总是搞砸，真是不行。
examples.english_sentence: He always messes things up at work, he's really useless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想再啡低，所以要努力啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 zoi3 fe1 dai1, so2 ji5 jiu3 nou5 lik6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想再失败，所以要更努力一些。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to fail again, so I need to work harder.

english_meaning: Silly, foolish, dim-witted
explanation_mandarin: 形容人反应迟钝，有点傻气。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is slow to react, a bit silly or dim-witted. It implies a lack of intelligence or awareness, but not in a strongly offensive way; rather, it's often used playfully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁啡啡流啦，咁簡單嘅嘢都唔識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 fe1 fe1 lau4 laa1, gam3 gaan2 daan1 ge3 je5 dou1 m4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么傻啦，这么简单的东西都不会。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so silly, you can't even do something so simple.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都啡啡流，不過心地幾好嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 fe1 fe1 lau4, bat1 gwo3 sam1 dei6 gei2 hou2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是有点傻傻的，不过心地挺好的。
examples.english_sentence: He's always a bit silly, but he has a good heart.

english_meaning: brown
explanation_mandarin: 指一种颜色，类似于咖啡的颜色，也称为棕色或褐色。
explanation_english: Refers to a color similar to the color of coffee; also known as brown.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意着啡色嘅衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 yi3 zoek3 fe1 sik1 ge3 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢穿棕色的衣服。
examples.english_sentence: I like to wear brown clothes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個手袋係啡色嘅，幾靚喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sau2 doi2 hai6 fe1 sik1 ge3, gei2 leng3 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个手提包是棕色的，挺漂亮的。
examples.english_sentence: This handbag is brown, it's quite pretty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢隻狗係啡色嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zek3 gau2 hai6 fe1 sik1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的狗是棕色的。
examples.english_sentence: His dog is brown.

mandarin_meaning: 淡奶咖啡 (使用淡奶代替炼乳的咖啡)
english_meaning: Coffee with evaporated milk (instead of condensed milk)
explanation_mandarin: 香港茶餐厅常用的一种咖啡饮品，特色是用淡奶代替炼奶。淡奶比炼奶味道淡，甜度低。
explanation_english: A type of coffee commonly found in Hong Kong-style cafes (Cha Chaan Tengs), characterized by the use of evaporated milk instead of condensed milk. Evaporated milk is less sweet and has a milder flavor than condensed milk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該，一杯熱啡走，少甜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1, jat1 bui1 jit6 fe1 zau2, siu2 tim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请给我一杯热的淡奶咖啡，少糖。
examples.english_sentence: Please give me a hot coffee with evaporated milk, less sugar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都飲啡走當早餐㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 jam2 fe1 zau2 dong3 zou2 caan1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都喝淡奶咖啡当早餐。
examples.english_sentence: He drinks coffee with evaporated milk for breakfast every day.

english_meaning: to hold in the mouth, to keep in the mouth
explanation_mandarin: 用嘴巴含住东西。
explanation_english: To hold something in the mouth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都啣住枝煙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 haam4 zyu6 zi1 jin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是叼着烟。
examples.english_sentence: He always has a cigarette in his mouth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個細路啣住條奶嘴瞓覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sai3 lou6 haam4 zyu6 tiu4 naai5 zeoi2 fan3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个小孩含着奶嘴睡觉。
examples.english_sentence: The child is sleeping with a pacifier in his mouth.

english_meaning: beer
explanation_mandarin: 啤酒的粤语口语说法。来源于英文单词“beer”的音译。
explanation_english: Cantonese slang term for beer. It is a transliteration of the English word "beer".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚去飲啤啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 heoi3 jam2 be1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚去喝啤酒吗？
examples.english_sentence: Are we going for beers tonight?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想飲返支冰凍嘅啤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 jam2 faan1 zi1 bing1 dung3 ge3 be1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想喝一支冰冻的啤酒。
examples.english_sentence: I want to have a cold beer.

english_meaning: Bearing (mechanical)
explanation_mandarin: 一种机械部件，用于减少旋转或线性运动中的摩擦力，并支撑负载。
explanation_english: A machine element that constrains relative motion to only the desired motion, and reduces friction between moving parts. Commonly used in rotating machinery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架單車嘅啤令爛咗，踩起上嚟好費力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 daan1 ce1 ge3 be1 ling4 laan6 zo2, caai2 hei2 soeng5 lai4 hou2 fai3 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自行车的轴承坏了，骑起来很费力。
examples.english_sentence: The bearing on the bicycle is broken, it's very tiring to ride.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部機器個啤令老化，要換個新嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 gei1 hei3 go3 be1 ling4 lou5 faa3, jiu3 wun6 go3 san1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 机器的轴承老化了，需要换一个新的。
examples.english_sentence: The bearing in the machine is aging, we need to replace it with a new one.

english_meaning: to stare at; to glare at
explanation_mandarin: 用眼睛盯着，带有不友善或威胁的意味。
explanation_english: To stare at someone intensely, usually with an unfriendly or threatening look.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做咩咁啤住我呀？我冇得罪你喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 me1 gam2 be1 zyu6 ngo5 aa3? ngo5 mou5 dak1 zeoi6 nei5 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你干嘛这样瞪着我？我没得罪你啊。
examples.english_sentence: Why are you staring at me like that? I didn't offend you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日啤住個新同事，唔知想點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 be1 zyu6 go3 san1 tung4 si6, m4 zi1 soeng2 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是瞪着那个新同事，不知道想干什么。
examples.english_sentence: He always glares at the new colleague, I don't know what he wants.

english_meaning: ball bearing
explanation_mandarin: 啤呤是轴承的粤语口语说法。轴承是一种减少旋转摩擦并且支撑旋转轴的部件。
explanation_english: "啤呤" is the Cantonese colloquial term for a ball bearing. A ball bearing is a type of rolling-element bearing that uses balls to maintain the separation between the bearing races, reducing rotational friction and supporting radial and axial loads.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車啲啤呤壞咗，要換過啲新嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 di1 be1 ling2 waai6 zo2, jiu3 wun6 gwo3 di1 san1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车的轴承坏了，要换新的。
examples.english_sentence: The ball bearings in this car are broken, we need to replace them with new ones.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部機器啲啤呤好嘈，唔知發生咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 gei1 hei3 di1 be1 ling2 hou2 cou4, m4 zi1 faat3 sang1 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台机器的轴承很吵，不知道发生什么事了。
examples.english_sentence: The ball bearings in this machine are very noisy, I don't know what's happening.

english_meaning: Why are you staring at me?
explanation_mandarin: “啤”是瞪眼的意思。“啤咩呀”指对方在瞪你，表示质问对方为何要瞪着自己。
explanation_english: "啤" (be1) means to stare. "啤咩呀" (be1 me1 aa3) is used to ask someone why they are staring at you, expressing a confrontational inquiry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你啤咩呀？我唔識你㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 be1 me1 aa3? ngo5 m4 sik1 nei5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你干嘛瞪我？我不认识你。
examples.english_sentence: Why are you staring at me? I don't even know you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我行過咋，你啤咩呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haang4 gwo3 zaa3, nei5 be1 me1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是路过，你干嘛瞪我？
examples.english_sentence: I was just passing by, why are you staring at me?

english_meaning: beer
explanation_mandarin: 指啤酒，从英文单词 "beer" 音译而来。
explanation_english: Refers to beer. A transliteration from the English word "beer."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚收工去飲翻兩罐啤啤啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 sau1 gung1 heoi3 jam2 faan1 loeng5 gun3 be1 be1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚下班去喝两罐啤酒吧！
examples.english_sentence: Let's go drink a couple of beers after work tonight!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔飲啤啤㗎，我飲紅酒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 jam2 be1 be1 gaa3, ngo5 jam2 hung4 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不喝啤酒，我喝红酒。
examples.english_sentence: I don't drink beer, I drink red wine.

english_meaning: little boy; baby boy
explanation_mandarin: 指小男孩，通常是比较亲昵的称呼。也可能略带开玩笑的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to a little boy. It's often used affectionately. It can also be used playfully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你個啤啤仔幾歲呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 go3 be1 be1 zai2 gei2 seoi3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你家的小男孩几岁了？
examples.english_sentence: How old is your little boy?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇下個啤啤仔幾得意！
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 haa5 go3 be1 be1 zai2 gei2 dak1 ji3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看看那个小男孩多可爱！
examples.english_sentence: Look how cute that little boy is!

english_meaning: careless, indifferent, whatever
explanation_mandarin: 表示对某事毫不在意，随便，无所谓。
explanation_english: Describes a careless or indifferent attitude towards something; whatever, it doesn't matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你鍾意點咪點囉，我啤啤俘㗎咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung1 ji3 dim2 mai1 dim2 lo1, ngo5 be1 be1 fu1 gaa3 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想怎样就怎样吧，我无所谓的。
examples.english_sentence: Do whatever you want, I don't really care.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試肥佬都啤啤俘，佢都唔知諗乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 fei4 lou2 dou1 be1 be1 fu1, keoi5 dou1 m4 zi1 nam2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试不及格也满不在乎，真不知道他在想什么。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't care about failing the exam, I don't know what he's thinking.

english_meaning: beer belly; potbelly
explanation_mandarin: 指因长期饮用啤酒或其他原因导致腹部脂肪堆积形成的突出肚子。
explanation_english: Refers to a protruding abdomen caused by accumulated fat, often associated with excessive beer consumption or other factors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢飲咗咁多年啤酒，而家有個好大嘅啤啤夫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jam2 zo2 gam3 do1 nin4 be1 zau2, ji4 gaa1 jau5 go3 hou2 daai6 ge3 be1 be1 fu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喝了这么多年的啤酒，现在有个很大的啤酒肚。
examples.english_sentence: He's been drinking beer for so many years, now he has a big beer belly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢要開始做運動，唔想有啤啤夫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 jiu3 hoi1 chi2 zou6 wan6 dung6, m4 soeng2 jau5 be1 be1 fu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他要开始做运动，不想有啤酒肚。
examples.english_sentence: He said he's going to start exercising, he doesn't want a beer belly.

english_meaning: A young woman who enjoys drinking beer.
explanation_mandarin: 指喜欢喝啤酒的年轻女性，带有一种比较随和、豪爽的印象。 在香港，啤啤女通常形容个性比较外向开朗，不拘小节的年轻女性。
explanation_english: Refers to a young woman who enjoys drinking beer, often implying a laid-back, outgoing, and uninhibited personality. In Hong Kong, '啤啤女' usually describes young women who are extroverted, cheerful, and not overly concerned with minor details.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日同啲朋友去酒吧飲嘢，係個標準嘅啤啤女。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 tung4 di1 pang4 jau5 heoi3 baa1 geoi2 jam2嘢, hai6 go3 biu1 zeon2 ge3 be1 be1 neoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她经常和朋友去酒吧喝酒，是个标准的爱喝啤酒的年轻女性。
examples.english_sentence: She often goes to bars with her friends to drink, she's a typical 'beer girl'.

english_meaning: crib, baby cot
explanation_mandarin: 婴儿睡觉用的床，通常有栏杆。
explanation_english: A bed with high sides for a baby or small child.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋幫個BB買咗張新嘅啤啤床。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 bong1 go3 bi1 bi1 maai5 zo2 zoeng1 san1 ge3 be1 be1 cong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们帮宝宝买了一张新的婴儿床。
examples.english_sentence: We bought a new crib for the baby.

english_meaning: Teddy bear
explanation_mandarin: 一种玩具熊，通常指泰迪熊。
explanation_english: A toy bear, usually referring to a Teddy bear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嗰陣好鍾意攬住隻啤啤熊瞓覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 hou2 zung1 ji3 laam5 zyu6 zek3 be1 be1 hung4 fan3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候很喜欢抱着泰迪熊睡觉。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, I really liked hugging a Teddy bear to sleep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻啤啤熊好得意，我想買俾我個女。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 be1 be1 hung4 hou2 dak1 ji3, ngo5 soeng2 maai5 bei2 ngo5 go3 neoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这只泰迪熊很可爱，我想买给我女儿。
examples.english_sentence: This Teddy bear is very cute, I want to buy it for my daughter.

english_meaning: Polo shirt, collared short-sleeved shirt
explanation_mandarin: 指带有领子的短袖上衣，通常为针织或棉质，款式休闲。
explanation_english: Refers to a short-sleeved shirt with a collar, usually made of knit or cotton material, with a casual style.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日着咗件啤啤衫去打波。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 zo2 gin6 bi1 bi1 saam1 heoi3 daa2 bo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天穿了件POLO衫去打球。
examples.english_sentence: He wore a polo shirt to play ball today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件啤啤衫嘅質地好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 bi1 bi1 saam1 ge3 zat1 dei6 hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件POLO衫的质地很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: The material of this polo shirt is very comfortable.

english_meaning: baby carriage; stroller; pushchair
explanation_mandarin: 一种用于运载婴儿或幼儿的小型车辆，通常有四个轮子，可以推着行走。
explanation_english: A small vehicle with wheels, typically four, used for carrying a baby or young child. It is pushed along by a person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋帶咗啤啤車，方便帶個BB出去玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 daai3 zo2 be1 be1 ce1, fong1 bin6 daai3 go3 BB ceot1 heoi3 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们带了婴儿车，方便带宝宝出去玩。
examples.english_sentence: We brought the stroller to make it easier to take the baby out to play.

english_meaning: spareribs; pork ribs (often referring to BBQ spareribs)
explanation_mandarin: 通常指用烤或烧烤方式烹制的猪肋排，是一种常见的食物。
explanation_english: Typically refers to pork spareribs that are cooked using grilling or barbecue methods. It is a common food item.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我想食BBQ，特別想食啤啤骨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 soeng2 sik6 BBQ, dak6 bit3 soeng2 sik6 be1 be1 gwat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我想吃烧烤，特别想吃猪肋排。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight I want to eat BBQ, especially spareribs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅啤啤骨好好味，好多人排隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 be1 be1 gwat1 hou2 hou2 mei6, hou2 do1 jan4 paai4 deoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的猪肋排很好吃，很多人排队。
examples.english_sentence: The spareribs at this restaurant are very delicious, many people are queuing.

english_meaning: to slack off (at work), to goof off, to shirk work
explanation_mandarin: 指在工作时偷懒，不认真工作。
explanation_english: Refers to slacking off at work, not working diligently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日啤工啦，俾老細見到就唔好啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 be1 gung1 laa1, bei2 lou5 sai3 gin3 dou2 zau6 m4 hou2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是偷懒，被老板看到就不好了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always slack off, it's not good if the boss sees you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都喺度啤工，難怪升唔到職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 hai2 dou6 be1 gung1, naan4 gwaai3 sing1 m4 dou2 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在这里偷懒，难怪升不了职。
examples.english_sentence: He's always slacking off here, no wonder he can't get promoted.

english_meaning: Beer
explanation_mandarin: “啤把”是“啤酒”的粤语音译。
explanation_english: "啤把" (bi1 baa1) is a Cantonese transliteration of the word "beer."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚收工想飲返兩罐啤把。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 sau1 gung1 soeng2 jam2 faan1 loeng5 gun3 bi1 baa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚下班后想喝两罐啤酒。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight after work I want to have two cans of beer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間酒吧啲啤把好鬼貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 zeoi2 baa1 di1 bi1 baa1 hou2 gwai2 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那间酒吧的啤酒很贵。
examples.english_sentence: The beer at that bar is very expensive.

english_meaning: pear
explanation_mandarin: 一种水果，即梨。
explanation_english: A type of fruit, the pear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想買兩個啤梨食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 loeng5 go3 be1 lei2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想买两个梨吃。
examples.english_sentence: I want to buy two pears to eat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個啤梨好甜呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 be1 lei2 hou2 tim4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个梨好甜啊！
examples.english_sentence: This pear is so sweet!

english_meaning: to play arcade games; to play video games (specifically arcade or console games)
explanation_mandarin: 指玩游戏机，通常指街机或家用游戏机。
explanation_english: Refers to playing video games, typically arcade games or console games. The term originated from the sound of arcade game buttons and levers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個成日同啲朋友去機舖啤機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 sing4 jat6 tung4 di1 pang4 jau5 heoi3 gei1 pou2 be1 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候经常和朋友去游戏厅玩游戏机。
examples.english_sentence: When I was young, I often went to arcades to play video games with my friends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴晚喺屋企啤咗成晚機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 maan5 hai2 uk1 kei2 be1 zo2 sing4 maan5 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨晚在家玩了一整晚游戏机。
examples.english_sentence: He played video games at home all night last night.

mandarin_meaning: 外壳; 套子; 保护壳
english_meaning: Shell; case; cover; protective casing (especially for electronics like phones)
explanation_mandarin: 指手机、电脑等电子设备的外壳或保护套，通常由塑料、金属等材料制成，用于保护设备免受损坏。
explanation_english: Refers to the shell, case, or cover of electronic devices such as mobile phones or computers. It is usually made of materials such as plastic or metal and is used to protect the device from damage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗個新嘅啤殼畀我部電話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 go3 san1 ge3 be1 hok3 bei2 ngo5 bou6 din6 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我给我手机买了一个新的手机壳。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a new phone case for my phone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個啤殼可以保護部電話唔俾佢跌爛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 be1 hok3 ho2 ji5 bou2 wu6 bou6 din6 waa2 m4 bei2 keoi5 dit3 laan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 手机壳可以保护手机不让它摔坏。
examples.english_sentence: The phone case can protect the phone from breaking if it falls.

mandarin_meaning: 筹钱, 凑钱, 借钱
english_meaning: to raise money, to pool money, to borrow money
explanation_mandarin: 指为了某个目的而筹集资金，通常是临时性的。
explanation_english: Refers to raising funds, usually temporarily, for a specific purpose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚打牌，我冇帶咁多錢，要啤水先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 daa2 paai2, ngo5 mou5 daai3 gam3 do1 cin2, jiu3 be1 seoi2 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚打牌，我没带那么多钱，得先凑点钱才行。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't bring enough money to play cards tonight; I need to pool some money first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司週轉唔靈，要周圍啤水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 zau1 zyun2 m4 ling4, jiu3 zau1 wai4 be1 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司资金周转不灵，要到处筹钱。
examples.english_sentence: The company has cash flow problems and needs to raise funds everywhere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，啤啲水嚟幫手，我爭緊人錢呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, be1 di1 seoi2 lai4 bong1 sau2, ngo5 zaang1 gan2 jan4 cin2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，凑点钱来帮帮忙，我欠别人钱呢。
examples.english_sentence: Hey, chip in to help, I owe people money.

english_meaning: to plaster; to apply plaster; to render (a wall)
explanation_mandarin: 用石灰或水泥等材料涂抹墙壁表面，使其平整光滑。
explanation_english: To apply a layer of plaster or cement-based mortar to a wall or surface, typically to smooth it out or create a more even finish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日啲工人會嚟幫我啤灰㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 di1 gung1 jan4 wui5 lai4 bong1 ngo5 be1 fui1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天工人们会来帮我抹灰的。
examples.english_sentence: The workers will come tomorrow to help me plaster.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅牆啤得好唔平均，要重新啤過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 cheung4 be1 dak1 hou2 m4 pings4 gwan1, yiu3 chung4 san1 be1 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这面墙抹得不均匀，需要重新抹过。
examples.english_sentence: This wall is not plastered evenly, it needs to be plastered again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋請咗師傅嚟啤灰，整靚間屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keui5 dei6 ching2 zo2 si1 fu2 lai4 be1 fui1, jing2 leng3 gaan1 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们请了师傅来粉刷，把房子弄漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: They hired a craftsman to plaster the house and make it look nice.

english_meaning: playing cards
explanation_mandarin: 指用于玩扑克游戏的纸牌。
explanation_english: Refers to playing cards used for card games like poker, bridge, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋一齊打啤牌啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 daa2 be1 paai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们一起打扑克牌吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's play cards together tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意收藏唔同嘅啤牌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 sau1 cong4 m4 tung4 ge3 be1 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很喜欢收藏不同的扑克牌。
examples.english_sentence: He likes to collect different playing cards.

english_meaning: bearing (mechanical component)
explanation_mandarin: 指机械零件中的轴承，用于减少旋转摩擦。
explanation_english: Refers to a bearing, a mechanical component used to reduce rotational friction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車啲啤玲壞咗，要攞去整。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 di1 be1 ling4 waai6 zo2, jiu3 lo2 heoi3 zing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车的轴承坏了，需要拿去修理。
examples.english_sentence: The bearings of this car are broken, it needs to be taken for repair.

english_meaning: beer
explanation_mandarin: 一种酒精饮料，用麦芽、啤酒花等酿制而成。
explanation_english: An alcoholic beverage made from malt, hops, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚想飲幾罐啤酒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 soeng2 jam2 gei2 gun3 be1 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚想喝几罐啤酒。
examples.english_sentence: I want to drink a few cans of beer tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間酒吧嘅啤酒選擇好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 jau5 baa1 ge3 be1 jau4 syun2 zaak6 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家酒吧的啤酒选择很多。
examples.english_sentence: This bar has a lot of beer options.

english_meaning: Beer girl, beer promoter (usually female)
explanation_mandarin: 指在酒吧、餐厅等场所推销啤酒的年轻女性。通常穿着特定服装，向顾客推荐啤酒并提供促销活动信息。
explanation_english: Refers to a young woman who promotes beer in bars, restaurants, or other venues. They typically wear specific attire and recommend beer to customers, providing information about promotions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚條街好多啤酒妹呀，個個都好落力咁sell啤酒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 tiu4 gaai1 hou2 do1 be1 zau2 mui1 aa3, go3 go3 dou1 hou2 lok6 lik6 gam2 sell be1 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚这条街上有很多啤酒女郎啊，每个人都很卖力地推销啤酒。
examples.english_sentence: There are many beer girls on this street tonight, all of them are working hard to sell beer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以前做過啤酒妹，所以好清楚唔同牌子嘅啤酒有咩分別。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 cin4 zou6 gwo3 be1 zau2 mui1, so2 ji5 hou2 cing1 chu2 m4 tung4 paai4 zi2 ge3 be1 zau2 jau5 me1 fan1 bit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她以前做过啤酒女郎，所以很清楚不同牌子的啤酒有什么区别。
examples.english_sentence: She used to work as a beer girl, so she is very clear about the differences between different brands of beer.

english_meaning: Beer belly, potbelly
explanation_mandarin: 指因长期饮用啤酒或其他原因导致腹部脂肪堆积形成的突出腹部。
explanation_english: Refers to a protruding abdomen caused by the accumulation of abdominal fat, often attributed to frequent beer consumption or other lifestyle factors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢自從做咗經理之後，就開始有啤酒肚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi6 cung4 zou6 zo2 ging1 lei5 zi1 hau6, zau6 hoi1 chi2 jau5 be1 zau2 tou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从他当了经理之后，就开始有了啤酒肚。
examples.english_sentence: Since he became a manager, he started to develop a beer belly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話要開始做運動減啤酒肚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 jiu3 hoi1 chi2 zou6 wan6 dung6 gaam2 be1 zau2 tou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说要开始做运动减啤酒肚。
examples.english_sentence: He said he's going to start exercising to get rid of his beer belly.

english_meaning: Hops (ingredient used in beer)
explanation_mandarin: 酿造啤酒的一种原料，学名蛇麻草。
explanation_english: Hops, the flower of the hop plant (Humulus lupulus), used as a flavoring and stability agent in beer, to which it imparts a bitter, tangy flavor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啤酒花係啤酒嘅重要原料之一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: be1 zau2 faa1 hai6 be1 zau2 ge3 zung6 jiu3 jyun4 liu2 zi1 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 啤酒花是啤酒的重要原料之一。
examples.english_sentence: Hops are one of the important ingredients in beer.

english_meaning: what
explanation_mandarin: 相当于普通话的“什么”，表示疑问。
explanation_english: Equivalent to "what" in Mandarin, used to indicate a question.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講乜嘢？你講緊啲乜嘢呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 mat1 je5? nei5 gong2 gan2 di1 mat1 je5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说什么？你在说什么啊？
examples.english_sentence: What are you saying? What are you talking about?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇緊啲乜嘢書呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 gan2 di1 mat1 je5 syu1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在看什么书啊？
examples.english_sentence: What book are you reading?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做乜嘢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 mat1 je5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做什么？
examples.english_sentence: What are you doing?

english_meaning: particle indicating completion, change of state, suggestion, or agreement; (sentence-final particle similar to 'lah' in Malay or Singapore English)
explanation_mandarin: 表示语气，通常用于句尾，可以表示完成、变化、建议、同意等多种含义，具体含义需要根据语境判断。
explanation_english: A sentence-final particle used to indicate a variety of meanings depending on context. It can indicate completion of an action, a change of state, a suggestion, or agreement. It's a common and versatile particle in Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食飯啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 faan6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃饭啦！
examples.english_sentence: Let's eat!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我走啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我走了。
examples.english_sentence: I'm leaving now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好啦，就咁决定！
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 laa1, zau6 gam2 kyut3 ding6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 好啦，就这样决定了！
examples.english_sentence: Okay, let's decide on that!

english_meaning: To dawdle, to procrastinate, to drag one's feet
explanation_mandarin: 指做事拖拉，动作缓慢，效率低下。
explanation_english: Refers to being slow and inefficient in doing things, dragging one's feet, or procrastinating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再啦㨢喇，快啲做晒啲功課佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 laa1 zaat6 laa3, faai3 di1 zou6 saai3 di1 gung1 fo3 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再拖拉了，快点把功课做完吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't dawdle anymore, finish your homework quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好啦㨢，成日都做唔完。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 laa1 zaat6, seng4 jat6 dou1 zou6 m4 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作很拖拉，总是做不完。

english_meaning: chat, talk, gossip, chit-chat

explanation_mandarin: 指注射毒品。通常带有贬义。
explanation_english: Refers to injecting drugs, usually with a negative connotation. Slang term for drug injection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺後巷度啪針，真係好危險。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在后巷里注射毒品，真的很危险。
examples.english_sentence: They are shooting up drugs in the back alley, it's really dangerous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好掂毒品啊，千祈唔好啪針！

examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要碰毒品啊，千万不要注射！
examples.english_sentence: Don't touch drugs, never shoot up!

english_meaning: Snap fastener; to click (mentally); to suddenly understand something; to trigger; to set off
explanation_mandarin: 1. 指按扣子，即把衣服上的按扣扣起来。2. 比喻突然明白、领悟，如同按动开关一样。3. 比喻触发或启动某个事件或动作。
explanation_english: 1. Refers to fastening a snap button on clothing. 2. Figuratively, it means to suddenly understand or realize something, like flipping a switch. 3. Figuratively, it means to trigger or initiate an event or action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我幫你啪咗呢粒鈕啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bong1 nei5 paak1 zo2 ni1 lap1 nau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我帮你把这颗扣子按上吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let me fasten this snap button for you.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jyun4 keoi5 ge3 gaai2 sik1, ngo5 sin1 zi3 paak1 nau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听完他的解释，我才恍然大悟。
examples.english_sentence: After hearing his explanation, I finally clicked.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事就好似啪咗個鈕咁，所有嘢都開始運作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 zau6 hou2 ci5 paak1 zo2 go3 nau2 gam2, so2 jau5 je5 dou1 hoi1 chi2 wan6 jok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事就像按下了开关一样，所有事情都开始运作了。
examples.english_sentence: This event is like flipping a switch, and everything started working.

english_meaning: bone setting, chiropractic adjustment
explanation_mandarin: 通过推拿手法调整骨骼位置，通常指治疗或缓解颈椎、腰椎等问题。
explanation_english: To adjust bones through manipulation, typically referring to treatment or relief of neck, back, or spinal problems through chiropractic or osteopathic methods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我成日對住電腦，條頸好唔舒服，想去啪骨鬆吓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seng4 jat6 deoi3 zyu6 din6 nou5, tiu4 geng2 hou2 m4 syu1 fuk6, soeng2 heoi3 paak1 gwat1 sung1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我整天对着电脑，脖子很不舒服，想去推拿一下放松一下。
examples.english_sentence: I face the computer all day, and my neck is very uncomfortable. I want to go for a bone setting session to relax.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂咁幫人啪骨，整親就唔好啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 bong1 jan4 paak1 gwat1, zeng2 can1 zau6 m4 hou2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要随便帮别人推拿正骨，弄伤了就不好了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't randomly adjust bones for others; it's not good if you injure them.

english_meaning: only, merely, just
explanation_mandarin: 语气助词，表示轻微的转折或仅此而已，放在句末。
explanation_english: A sentence-final particle indicating a mild contrast, reassurance, or that something is 'just' or 'only' so.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我淨係想幫你啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zing6 hai6 soeng2 bong1 nei5 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是想帮你而已。
examples.english_sentence: I just wanted to help you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢遲到咗少少啫，唔使咁嬲嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci4 dou3 zo2 siu2 siu2 ze1, m4 sai2 gam3 nau1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只是迟到了一点点而已，不用那么生气。
examples.english_sentence: He's just a little late, no need to be so angry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗一杯奶茶啫，唔係好多錢嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 bui1 naai5 caa4 ze1, m4 hai6 hou2 do1 cin2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是买了一杯奶茶而已，不是很多钱的。
examples.english_sentence: I just bought a cup of milk tea, it's not a lot of money.

mandarin_meaning: 哄骗; 捉弄; 耍弄
english_meaning: to tease; to fool; to play a trick on; to kid
explanation_mandarin: 以玩笑的方式欺骗或戏弄对方，通常程度较轻，不带有恶意。
explanation_english: To tease or play a trick on someone in a playful or lighthearted manner, usually without malicious intent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好啫住佢啦，佢真係會嬲㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 ze1 zyu6 keoi5 laa1, keoi5 zan1 hai6 wui5 nau1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别再捉弄他了，他真的会生气的。
examples.english_sentence: Stop teasing him, he'll really get angry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日啫住我，話我講嘢好大聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ze1 zyu6 ngo5, waa6 ngo5 gong2 je5 hou2 daai6 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是取笑我，说我说话声音很大。
examples.english_sentence: He always teases me, saying I speak too loudly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你係咪啫住我㗎？我唔信你講嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai6 mai1 ze1 zyu6 ngo5 gaa3? ngo5 m4 seon3 nei5 gong2 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你是不是在耍我？我不相信你说的。
examples.english_sentence: Are you kidding me? I don't believe what you're saying.

mandarin_meaning: 就是说, 也就是说, 相当于
english_meaning: That is to say; meaning; it means; in other words; like
explanation_mandarin: 表示解释或说明，类似于“也就是说”、“即是说”的意思。也可用作语气词，表示肯定或强调。
explanation_english: Used to explain or clarify something. Similar to 'that is to say,' 'it means,' or 'in other words.' Can also be used as a particle to express agreement or emphasis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啫係咁，你聽日唔使返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ze1 hai6 gam2, nei5 ting1 jat6 m4 sai2 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 就是说，你明天不用上班。
examples.english_sentence: That is to say, you don't need to go to work tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啫係唔想見你啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ze1 hai6 m4 soeng2 gin3 nei5 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他就是不想见你而已。
examples.english_sentence: He just doesn't want to see you, that's all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啫係你覺得我講得唔啱囉？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ze1 hai6 nei5 gok3 dak1 ngo5 gong2 dak1 m4 aam1 lo1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 也就是说你觉得我说的不对吗？
examples.english_sentence: So you mean you think what I said is wrong?

english_meaning: jelly, gelatin dessert
explanation_mandarin: 一种甜点，用明胶或果胶制成，口感柔软有弹性。
explanation_english: A dessert made with gelatin or pectin, typically flavored and colored, with a soft and elastic texture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最鍾意食士多啤梨味嘅啫哩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 yi3 sik6 si6 do1 be1 lei2 mei6 ge3 ze1 lei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最喜欢吃草莓味的果冻。
examples.english_sentence: I like eating strawberry jelly the most.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個啫哩好彈牙呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ze1 lei2 hou2 taan4 ngaa4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个果冻很有弹性啊！
examples.english_sentence: This jelly is very chewy!

english_meaning: Sizzling (usually refers to a type of cooking in a clay pot or wok served sizzling)
explanation_mandarin: 一种粤菜烹饪方式，指在砂锅或铁锅中烹饪食物，上桌时仍然热气腾腾，发出滋滋声。
explanation_english: A Cantonese cooking style where ingredients are cooked and served in a clay pot or hot wok, typically arriving at the table sizzling and steaming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我想食啫啫雞煲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 soeng2 sik6 ze1 ze1 gai1 bou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我想吃砂锅鸡煲。
examples.english_sentence: I want to eat sizzling chicken pot tonight.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的砂锅空心菜很有名。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant is famous for its sizzling water spinach.

english_meaning: Sizzling pot, hot pot cooked in a clay pot
explanation_mandarin: 一种烹调方法，将食材放入烧热的砂锅中快速烹制，使其发出“啫啫”的声音。也指用这种方法烹制的菜肴。
explanation_english: A cooking method where ingredients are quickly cooked in a heated clay pot, creating a sizzling sound. It also refers to dishes prepared using this method.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚食啫啫煲啦，聽日凍凍哋啱曬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 sik6 ze1 ze1 bou1 laa1, ting1 jat6 dung3 dung3 dei2 ngaam1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚吃砂锅吧，明天冷冷的最适合。
examples.english_sentence: Let's have a sizzling pot tonight, it's perfect for the cold weather tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅啫啫雞煲好出名，好多人排隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 ze1 ze1 gai1 bou1 hou2 ceot1 ming4, hou2 do1 jan4 paai4 deoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的砂锅鸡非常有名，很多人排队。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant's sizzling chicken pot is very famous, many people queue up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你試下個啫啫通菜煲，好有鑊氣㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 si3 haa5 go3 ze1 ze1 tung1 coi3 bou1, hou2 jau5 wok6 hei3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你试试那个砂锅空心菜，很有锅气。
examples.english_sentence: Try the sizzling water spinach pot, it has a great wok hei (wok aroma).

english_meaning: Sizzling chicken pot (cooked in a clay pot)

explanation_english: A Cantonese dish where chicken pieces and other ingredients are cooked in a clay pot (煲 bou1) at high temperature, creating a sizzling sound, hence the name 'ze1 ze1'.

examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 sik6 ze1 ze1 gai1 bou1, hou2 m4 hou2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们去吃砂锅啫啫鸡，好不好啊？

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅啫啫雞煲做得好惹味。

examples.english_sentence: The sizzling chicken pot at this restaurant is very flavorful.

english_meaning: Sizzling chicken hot pot
explanation_mandarin: 一种粤菜，用砂锅烹制，特点是烹制过程中发出的“啫啫”声。
explanation_english: A Cantonese dish cooked in a clay pot. Its defining characteristic is the sizzling sound ('ze ze') it makes during the cooking process, often involving chicken and various other ingredients.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋去食啫啫雞煲吖，好耐冇食喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 sik6 ze1 ze1 gai1 bou1 aa1, hou2 noi6 mou5 sik6 laa3.

examples.english_sentence: Let's go eat sizzling chicken hot pot tonight, it's been a long time since we had it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅啫啫雞煲做得好惹味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 ze1 ze1 gai1 bou1 zou6 dak1 hou2 ye5 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的砂锅鸡做得非常美味。
examples.english_sentence: The sizzling chicken hot pot in this restaurant is very delicious.

english_meaning: Jelly, Jello
explanation_mandarin: 一种甜点，主要成分是明胶、糖和水，通常加入水果或调味剂。
explanation_english: A dessert made from gelatin, sugar, and water, often with fruit or flavorings added.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嗰陣最鍾意食啫喱。

examples.english_sentence: I liked eating jelly the most when I was a child.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天我想做果冻给你吃。
examples.english_sentence: I want to make jelly for you to eat today.

explanation_mandarin: 一种使用啫喱状墨水的笔，书写顺滑，颜色鲜艳。
explanation_english: A type of pen that uses gel-based ink. It writes smoothly and is available in vibrant colors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意用啫喱筆寫字，啲顏色好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 yung6 ze1 lei1 bat1 se2 zi6, di1 ngaan4 sik1 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢用啫喱笔写字，颜色很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: I like writing with gel pens; the colors are very pretty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢枝啫喱筆寫到冇墨喇。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 这支啫喱笔写到没墨水了。
examples.english_sentence: This gel pen is out of ink.

english_meaning: jelly candy, gummy candy
explanation_mandarin: 一种以明胶或果胶为主要原料制成的软糖，口感Q弹。
explanation_english: A type of soft candy made primarily from gelatin or pectin, with a chewy and springy texture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嘅時候好鍾意食啫喱糖㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 hou2 zung1 ji3 sik6 ze1 le1 tong2 gaa3.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店的果冻糖有很多不同的味道。
examples.english_sentence: This shop has many different flavors of jelly candy.

english_meaning: just, only, that's all
explanation_mandarin: 表示一种缓和的语气，解释或辩解，有“只是”、“而已”的意思。
explanation_english: A modal particle used at the end of a sentence to soften the tone, express an explanation or justification, meaning "just", "only", "that's all". It can also imply a sense of obviousness or expectation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我遲到啫嘛，使唔使咁大反應啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ci4 dou3 ze1 maa3, sai2 m4 sai2 gam3 daai6 faan2 jing3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是迟到了而已，需要这么大反应吗？
examples.english_sentence: I was just late, do you need to overreact like that?

examples.english_sentence: I already said it, don't be so nervous.

examples.english_sentence: He just wants to have fun, let him be.

mandarin_meaning: 趾高气扬; 炫耀; 自鸣得意
english_meaning: To be smug; to show off; to be cocky; to strut
explanation_mandarin: 形容人骄傲自满，得意洋洋，爱炫耀的样子。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is arrogant, smug, and loves to show off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢升咗職之後，成日都啫屐噉款。

examples.english_sentence: After he got promoted, he's been so smug all the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁啫屐啦，謙虛啲好啲。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么趾高气扬了，谦虚点好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so cocky, it's better to be humble.

english_meaning: correct; right; suitable; just right; fit; agree

explanation_english: Indicates correctness, suitability, or being just right. Commonly used in spoken Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講得啱啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 dak1 ngaam1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说得对啊！
examples.english_sentence: You're right!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫啱唔啱身啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 ngaam1 m4 ngaam1 san1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服合身吗？
examples.english_sentence: Does this shirt fit well?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋啱傾計，好投契。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ngaam1 king1 gai3, hou2 tau4 kai3.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚刚吃完饭。
examples.english_sentence: Just finished eating.

explanation_mandarin: 形容两个人性格，想法很相近，很容易相处，或者形容事物符合某人的喜好。
explanation_english: Describes two people who have similar personalities and ideas, making it easy to get along. It can also describe something that fits someone's preferences or interests.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢都好啱channel，成日一齊吹水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 dou1 hou2 ngaam1 cin1 nou4, seng4 jat6 jat1 cai4 cheui1 seui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他很合得来，经常一起聊天。
examples.english_sentence: He and I really click; we chat all the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲好啱我channel，我好鍾意睇。

examples.english_sentence: They don't click, so they argue all the time.

english_meaning: to be compatible, to click, to be on the same wavelength
explanation_mandarin: 形容两个人性格，兴趣等方面很合得来。也可以指事情对得上，吻合。
explanation_english: Describes two people who are compatible in personality, interests, etc. Can also refer to things that match or coincide.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢好啱key，成日一齊玩。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他很合拍，经常一起玩。

english_meaning: Perfectly suitable, a perfect fit, just right
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常合适、恰如其分，符合所有要求和标准。合尺指古代木匠使用的曲尺，用来衡量角度和尺寸是否精确，引申为非常合适的意思。
explanation_english: Describes something that is perfectly suitable, a perfect fit, or just right. It meets all the requirements and standards. 'Hap cek3' refers to a traditional carpenter's square used to measure angles and dimensions precisely, which is extended to mean perfectly suitable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫啱晒合尺，好似度身訂造咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 ngaam1 saai3 hap6 cek3, hou2 ci5 dou6 san1 deng6 zou6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服非常合适，就像量身定做的一样。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is a perfect fit, like it was tailor-made.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工啱晒合尺你，你一定要試下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 ngaam1 saai3 hap6 cek3 nei5, nei5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 si3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作非常适合你，你一定要试试。
examples.english_sentence: This job is a perfect fit for you, you must give it a try.

english_meaning: to click with someone; to be compatible; to get along well
explanation_mandarin: 形容两个人性格、兴趣等方面很相投，彼此合得来，相处愉快。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where two people are compatible in terms of personality, interests, etc., and get along well with each other, enjoying each other's company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢好啱牙，一齊傾偈好開心㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 hou2 ngaam1 ngaa4, jat1 cai4 king1 gai2 hou2 hoi1 sam1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他很投缘，一起聊天很开心。
examples.english_sentence: I click with him very well, it's very happy to chat together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋兩個都咁鍾意睇戲，應該好啱牙喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 leong5 go3 dou1 gam3 zung1 ji3 tai2 hei3, jing1 goi1 hou2 ngaam1 ngaa4 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们两个都那么喜欢看电影，应该很合得来吧。
examples.english_sentence: You two both like watching movies so much, you should get along well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋啱唔啱牙，試下咪知囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ngaam1 m4 ngaam1 ngaa4, si3 haa5 mai1 zi1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们合不合得来，试一下不就知道了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Whether we click or not, we'll know if we try.

mandarin_meaning: 适用, 合用, 好用
english_meaning: useful, suitable, fit for purpose, handy
explanation_mandarin: 表示适合使用，用得着，有帮助。
explanation_english: Describes something that is useful, suitable for a particular purpose, or handy to have. Implies that the item or skill is applicable and provides benefit in a given situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個工具好啱用，幫咗我好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gung1 geoi6 hou2 ngaam1 jung6, bong1 zo2 ngo5 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个工具很好用，帮了我很多。
examples.english_sentence: This tool is very useful; it has helped me a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個方法唔啱用喺所有情況。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fong1 faat3 m4 ngaam1 jung6 hai2 so2 jau5 ching4 fong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个方法不适用于所有情况。
examples.english_sentence: This method is not suitable for all situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電腦買得啱用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 nou5 maai5 dak1 ngaam1 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台电脑买得值，很实用。
examples.english_sentence: This computer was a worthwhile purchase; it's very useful.

english_meaning: to click (with someone), to be on the same wavelength, to get along well
explanation_mandarin: 指两个人或事物之间非常合得来，彼此理解和欣赏。
explanation_english: Refers to two people or things getting along very well, understanding and appreciating each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢好啱線，一齊傾偈好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 hou2 ngaam1 sin3, jat1 cai4 king1 gai2 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他很投缘，一起聊天很开心。
examples.english_sentence: I really click with him, it's great chatting with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅諗法好啱線，所以好快就成為咗好朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 lam2 faat3 hou2 ngaam1 sin3, so2 ji5 hou2 faai3 zau6 sing4 wai4 zo2 hou2 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的想法很合拍，所以很快就成为了好朋友。
examples.english_sentence: Their ideas are very much on the same wavelength, so they quickly became good friends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅文化同我好啱線，所以我覺得好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 man4 faa3 tung4 ngo5 hou2 ngaam1 sin3, so2 ji5 ngo5 gok3 dak1 hou2 syu1 fuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的文化和我非常对路，所以我感觉很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: This company's culture really resonates with me, so I feel very comfortable.

english_meaning: pleasant to hear, music to one's ears, agreeable, to one's liking (in terms of what's being said)
explanation_mandarin: 形容说话内容合乎心意，听起来舒服或赞同。表示说话的内容是听者想听到的，容易接受的，或者让人感到高兴。
explanation_english: Describes something that is pleasant or agreeable to hear. It implies that what is being said is what the listener wants to hear, is easy to accept, or makes them happy. It also means pleasing to the ears, in the sense of agreeing with someone's viewpoint or feeling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢真係啱聽，所以大家都支持佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3嘢 zeon1 hai6 ngaam1 teng1, so2 ji5 daai6 ga1 dou1 zi1 chi4 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话很顺耳，所以大家都支持他。
examples.english_sentence: What he said was really pleasant to hear, so everyone supports him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細成日讚我哋，聽落好啱聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 seng4 jat6 zaan3 ngo5 dei6, teng1 lok6 hou2 ngaam1 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板总是夸我们，听起来很中听。
examples.english_sentence: The boss is always praising us, it's very pleasing to hear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想聽啲唔啱聽嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 teng1 di1 m4 ngaam1 teng1 ge3 嘢.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想听那些不中听的话。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to hear things that are not pleasant to hear.

mandarin_meaning: 合适; 恰好; 凑巧
english_meaning: Suitable; just right; coincidentally; by chance; serendipitous
explanation_mandarin: 形容时间、地点、条件等正好合适；表示事情发生得恰好、凑巧。
explanation_english: Describes a time, place, or condition that is just right; indicates that something happens to be just right or by chance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱蕎喺附近，所以順便嚟探你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ngaam1 kiu4 hai2 fu6 gan6, so2 ji5 seon6 bin2 lai4 taam3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我正好在附近，所以顺便来看你。
examples.english_sentence: I happened to be nearby, so I came to visit you while I was at it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日天氣啱蕎好好，我哋去行山啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 tin1 hei3 ngaam1 kiu4 hou2 hou2, ngo5 dei6 heoi3 haang4 saan1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天天气正好很好，我们去爬山吧！
examples.english_sentence: The weather is just right today, let's go hiking!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你打電話嚟啱蕎，我都有嘢想問你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 daa2 din6 waa2 lei4 ngaam1 kiu4, ngo5 dou1 jau5 je5 soeng2 man6 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你打电话来正好，我也有事想问你。
examples.english_sentence: It's just as well you called, I also have something I wanted to ask you.

english_meaning: fitting well (of clothes); just right
explanation_mandarin: 指衣服的尺寸、大小非常合适；也可以引申为正好适合（某种情况）。
explanation_english: Describes clothing that fits well, in terms of size and shape. Can also be used figuratively to mean something is perfectly suited or appropriate for a situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫好啱身，著得好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 hou2 ngaam1 san1, zoek3 dak1 hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服很合身，穿起来很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt fits really well, and it's very comfortable to wear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工好啱身，因為我對呢方面嘅經驗好豐富。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 hou2 ngaam1 san1, yan1 wai6 ngo5 deoi3 ni1 fong1 min6 ge3 ging1 yim6 hou2 fung1 fu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作很适合我，因为我对这方面的经验很丰富。
examples.english_sentence: This job is perfect for me, because I have a lot of experience in this field.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢覺得呢間公司嘅文化唔啱身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gok3 dak1 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 man4 faa3 m4 ngaam1 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他觉得这家公司的文化不适合他。
examples.english_sentence: He feels that the company's culture doesn't suit him.

english_meaning: accurate pronunciation; to pronounce correctly; to be in tune (phonetically)
explanation_mandarin: 指发音准确，没有错误。也指音调或节奏符合规范。
explanation_english: Refers to accurate pronunciation, without errors. It can also refer to a tone or rhythm that conforms to standards, or a correct phonetic match.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講英文好啱音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 jing1 man2 hou2 ngaam1 jam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说英语发音很准确。
examples.english_sentence: He pronounces English very accurately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋學唱歌，要練好啱音先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hok6 cheung3 go1, yiu3 lin6 hou2 ngaam1 jam1 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们学唱歌，要练好发音才行。
examples.english_sentence: When we learn to sing, we need to practice the correct pronunciation first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個字嘅粵語發音你讀得唔係好啱音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zi6 ge3 jyut6 jyu5 faat3 jam1 nei5 duk6 dak1 m4 hai6 hou2 ngaam1 jam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个字的粤语发音你读得不是很准确。
examples.english_sentence: Your Cantonese pronunciation of this word isn't very accurate.

english_meaning: some, a little, a bit, plural marker
explanation_mandarin: 表示少量或不定量，相当于普通话的“一些”、“一点”。也可以表示复数，放在名词后。
explanation_english: Indicates a small or indefinite quantity, equivalent to "some" or "a little" in Mandarin. It can also be used as a plural marker after nouns.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想飲啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 jam2 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想喝点东西。
examples.english_sentence: I want to drink something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲係我嘅朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 hai6 ngo5 ge3 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些是我的朋友。
examples.english_sentence: These are my friends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 俾啲時間我諗下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 di1 si4 gaan3 ngo5 lam2 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 给我一些时间想想。
examples.english_sentence: Give me some time to think.

english_meaning: some friends; a few friends
explanation_mandarin: “啲”在粤语中表示“一些”，“fd”是英文“friend”的缩写，表示朋友。整个词组表示“一些朋友”。
explanation_english: "啲 (di1)" in Cantonese means "some". "fd (fd1)" is a transliteration and shortening of the English word "friend". Therefore, "啲fd (di1 fd1)" means "some friends" or "a few friends". It's an example of Cantonese slang using English.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我琴日同啲fd去咗行山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kam4 jat6 tung4 di1 fd1 heoi3 zo2 haang4 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天和一些朋友去爬山了。
examples.english_sentence: I went hiking with some friends yesterday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚同啲fd出去食飯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 tung4 di1 fd1 cheot1 heoi3 sik6 faan6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚和一些朋友出去吃饭吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go out for dinner with some friends tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 一些朋友; 朋友们 (口语化)
english_meaning: some friends; a few friends; friends (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: “啲”是“一些”的意思，在粤语中常用来修饰名词，表示数量不多。 “啲friend”就是指一些朋友，说法比较口语化。
explanation_english: "啲 (di1)" means "some" or "a few" in Cantonese and is often used to modify nouns to indicate a small quantity. "啲friend" refers to some friends or a few friends and is a colloquial expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我琴日同啲friend去咗行山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kam4 jat6 tung4 di1 fen1 heoi3 zo2 haang4 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天和一些朋友去爬山了。
examples.english_sentence: I went hiking with some friends yesterday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢請咗啲friend嚟屋企食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ceng2 zo2 di1 fen1 lai4 uk1 kei2 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他请了一些朋友来家里吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: He invited some friends to his home for dinner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 得閒約啲friend出嚟飲嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dak1 haan4 joek3 di1 fen1 chut1 lai4 jam2 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有空约一些朋友出来喝东西吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's hang out with some friends when we are free.

english_meaning: These people / Those people / Some people
explanation_mandarin: 表示一群人，具体指代取决于语境。可以指“这些人”，也可以指“那些人”，有时泛指“一些人”。
explanation_english: Refers to a group of people. The specific reference depends on the context. It can mean "these people", "those people", or sometimes generally "some people". The "啲 (di1)" acts as a pluralizer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲人成日遲到，真係唔掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jan4 sing4 jat6 ci4 dou3, zan1 hai6 m4 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些人总是迟到，真不行。
examples.english_sentence: These people are always late, it's really unacceptable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人就係咁架啦，你唔使太在意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 zau6 hai6 gam2 gaa3 laa1, nei5 m4 sai2 taai3 zoi3 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人就是这样的，你不用太在意。
examples.english_sentence: Some people are just like that, you don't have to care too much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋日見到啲人喺公園度跳舞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 jat6 gin3 dou2 di1 jan4 hai2 gung1 jyun4 dou6 tiu3 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天看到一些人在公园里跳舞。
examples.english_sentence: Yesterday I saw some people dancing in the park.

english_meaning: Just a little bit, such a tiny amount
explanation_mandarin: 形容数量非常少，带有轻视或不满的语气。
explanation_english: Describes a very small amount, often with a tone of disdain or dissatisfaction. Emphasizes the insignificance of the quantity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢淨係畀咗啲咁啄錢我，真係唔夠搭車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zing6 hai6 bei2 zo2 di1 gam2 doek3 cin2 ngo5, zan1 hai6 m4 gau3 daap3 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只给了我这么一点点钱，真是不够坐车。
examples.english_sentence: He only gave me such a tiny amount of money, it's not even enough for the bus fare.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢做咗啲咁啄，點搞得掂啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 zou6 zo2 di1 gam2 doek3, dim2 gaau2 dak1 dim6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你工作才做了这么一点点，怎么能完成啊？
examples.english_sentence: You've only done such a tiny bit of work, how can you possibly finish it?

english_meaning: Only this much; just a little bit; not a lot
explanation_mandarin: 表示数量很少，程度不高。相当于“就这么一点”。
explanation_english: Indicates a small quantity or degree. Similar to 'just this much' or 'not a lot'. Used to express dissatisfaction or surprise at a small amount.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細，加咗咁耐人工，點解都係得啲咁多嘅？
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3, gaa1 zo2 gam3 noi6 yan4 gung1, dim2 gai2 dou1 si6 dak1 di1 gam3 do1 ge3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板，加了这么久的工资，为什么还是只有这么一点啊？
examples.english_sentence: Boss, after such a long time of salary increases, why is there still only this much?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我溫咗咁耐書，都係記得啲咁多，點算啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wan1 zo2 gam3 noi6 syu1, dou1 hai6 gei3 dak1 di1 gam3 do1, dim2 syun3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我复习了这么久的书，还是只记得这么一点，怎么办啊？
examples.english_sentence: I studied for so long, and I still only remember this much, what should I do?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你俾得啲咁多，邊夠用啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bei2 dak1 di1 gam3 do1, bin1 gau3 yung6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你给的这么一点，哪里够用啊？
examples.english_sentence: You only gave this much, how is that enough?

english_meaning: to this extent; to such a degree; so much; such a thing
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度、数量或范围，带有轻蔑或不屑的语气。强调程度之低，不值一提。
explanation_english: Used to express a low degree, quantity or scope, often with a tone of contempt or disdain. It emphasizes that the degree is low and not worth mentioning. Can also imply disbelief or disapproval.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢都唔識做啲咁朵嘅嘢，仲想升職？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou1 m4 sik1 zou6 di1 gam3 do2 ge3 je5, zung6 soeng2 sing1 zik1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他连这么点事都不会做，还想升职？
examples.english_sentence: He can't even do such a small thing, and he wants a promotion?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你淨係識做啲咁朵嘢，都唔好意思收咁多錢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zing6 hai6 sik1 zou6 di1 gam3 do2 je5, dou1 m4 hou2 ji3 si1 sau1 gam3 do1 cin2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你只会做这么点事，都不好意思收这么多钱。
examples.english_sentence: You only know how to do such a small amount of work, you shouldn't be embarrassed to charge so much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲咁朵嘅學歷，都入到間咁好嘅公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 gam3 do2 ge3 hok6 lik6, dou1 jap6 dou2 gaan1 gam3 hou2 ge3 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那么低的学历，都能进那么好的公司。
examples.english_sentence: With such a low qualification, he can still get into such a good company.

english_meaning: a little, a bit, some
explanation_mandarin: 表示少量，一点点。通常用于口语。
explanation_english: Indicates a small amount or a little bit. Commonly used in spoken Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我淨係識講啲咑廣東話咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zing6 hai6 sik1 gong2 di1 daa1 gwong2 dung1 waa2 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只会说一点点广东话而已。
examples.english_sentence: I only know how to speak a little Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以俾啲咑時間我諗下？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bei2 di1 daa1 si4 gaan3 ngo5 lam2 haa5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以给我一点时间考虑一下吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can you give me a little time to think about it?

mandarin_meaning: 指不正经的男人; 花花公子
english_meaning: Playboy; womanizer; a man who likes to flirt or date many women.
explanation_mandarin: 指那些到处沾花惹草，对感情不认真，喜欢玩弄女性的男人。通常带有贬义。
explanation_english: Refers to a man who flirts with many women, is not serious about relationships, and likes to play with women's feelings. Usually carries a derogatory connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日溝女，擺明係個啲咑佬嚟㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gau1 neoi5, baai2 ming4 hai6 go3 di1 daa1 lou2 lai4 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天泡妞，摆明就是个花花公子。
examples.english_sentence: He's always hitting on girls, he's obviously a playboy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你小心啲，唔好俾啲咑佬呃咗你呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 siu2 sam1 di1, m4 hou2 bei2 di1 daa1 lou2 aak1 zo2 nei5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你小心点，不要被那些花花公子骗了啊！
examples.english_sentence: Be careful, don't get tricked by those playboys!

english_meaning: a little bit; a few drops; a slight amount; to dribble
explanation_mandarin: 表示少量，零星的量。通常指液体或粉末等。
explanation_english: Indicates a small amount, a scattering of quantity. Usually refers to liquids or powders etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落咗啲啄雨，快啲入屋啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 zo2 di1 doek3 jyu5, faai3 di1 jap6 uk1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下了一点点雨，快点进屋吧。
examples.english_sentence: It's drizzling a bit, let's get inside quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢跌咗啲啄盐落地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dit3 zo2 di1 doek3 jim4 lok6 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他掉了一点点盐在地上。
examples.english_sentence: He dropped a little bit of salt on the floor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你俾啲啄耐心啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bei2 di1 doek3 noi6 sam1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你给一点耐心吧。
examples.english_sentence: Please have a little patience.

english_meaning: a little bit; slightly; a few
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度轻微，数量不多，一点点。
explanation_english: Indicates a small amount, a slight degree, or a few of something. Can be used as an adjective or adverb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我識講啲啲廣東話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sik1 gong2 di1 di1 gwong2 dung1 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只会说一点点广东话。
examples.english_sentence: I only know how to speak a little Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個菜鹹咗啲啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 coi3 haam4 zo2 di1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这道菜咸了一点点。
examples.english_sentence: This dish is a little bit too salty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日嘅心情好咗啲啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 ge3 sam1 cing4 hou2 zo2 di1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天的心情好了一点点。
examples.english_sentence: His mood is a little better today.

mandarin_meaning: 一点一点; 马马虎虎; 不认真
english_meaning: A little bit; so-so; not serious; sloppy
explanation_mandarin: 形容做事或说话不认真，敷衍了事，或者形容数量非常少。
explanation_english: Describes doing things or speaking in a perfunctory, unserious manner, or describes a very small quantity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢啲啲咑咑，成日都出錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 di1 di1 daa1 daa1, seng4 jat6 dou1 ceot1 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事马马虎虎，经常出错。
examples.english_sentence: He's sloppy at work and makes mistakes all the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我淨係識啲啲咑咑嘅英文。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeng6 hai6 sik1 di1 di1 daa1 daa1 ge3 ying1 man2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只会一点点英语。
examples.english_sentence: I only know a little bit of English.

mandarin_meaning: 微微颤抖; 稍稍激动
english_meaning: To tremble slightly; To be slightly agitated or excited; To shiver a little
explanation_mandarin: 形容轻微的颤抖或兴奋的状态。
explanation_english: Describes a slight trembling or state of excitement. Often used to describe being slightly nervous or excited, but not to a strong degree.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日要見工，我而家都已經啲啲震喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 jiu3 gin3 gung1, ngo5 ji4 gaa1 dou1 ji5 ging1 di1 di1 zan3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天要面试，我现在都已经有点微微颤抖了。
examples.english_sentence: I have an interview tomorrow, and I'm already trembling a little.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽到偶像嚟咗香港，興奮到啲啲震。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ting1 dou2 ngau5 zoeng2 lai4 zo2 hoeng1 gong2, hing1 fan5 dou3 di1 di1 zan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她听到偶像来了香港，兴奋得有点微微激动。
examples.english_sentence: She was so excited to hear that her idol came to Hong Kong, she was slightly trembling with excitement.

english_meaning: a bit more; some more
explanation_mandarin: 表示数量上再增加一些。是“一点多”的口语化表达。
explanation_english: Indicates adding a little bit more in quantity. It's a colloquial way of saying 'a little bit more'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你食啲多飯啦，唔夠飽呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sik6 dī dō faan6 laa1, m4 gau3 baau2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再吃多点饭吧，不够饱吗？
examples.english_sentence: Eat some more rice, are you not full?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 畀啲多時間我考慮下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 dī dō si4 gaan3 ngo5 haau2 leoi6 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 再给我多点时间考虑一下。
examples.english_sentence: Give me a bit more time to consider.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落啲多油，會好食啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 dī dō jau4, wui5 hou2 sik6 dī.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 放多点油，会好吃一点。
examples.english_sentence: Put a bit more oil in, it will taste better.

english_meaning: taxi; to take a taxi
explanation_mandarin: 在香港的口语中，“啲打”指的是出租车。既可以作为名词，表示出租车，也可以作为动词，表示打出租车。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong colloquial speech, "啲打" refers to a taxi. It can be used as a noun, meaning taxi, or as a verb, meaning to take a taxi.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我趕時間，不如我哋啲打去啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gon2 si4 gaan3, bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 di1 daa1 heoi3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我赶时间，不如我们打的去吧。
examples.english_sentence: I'm in a hurry, why don't we take a taxi?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度好難啲打㗎，你最好預先call定車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 hou2 naan4 di1 daa1 gaa3, nei5 zeoi3 hou2 jyu6 sin1 call ding6 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里很难打到出租车的，你最好提前预约车。
examples.english_sentence: It's hard to get a taxi here, you better book one in advance.

english_meaning: Manual laborer, mover, porter, someone who does physical work
explanation_mandarin: 指从事体力劳动的人，尤指搬运重物的工作者。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who does physical labor, especially those who move heavy objects. It can also be used more generally to refer to someone who does unskilled manual work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋日日都做啲打佬，好辛苦㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat6 jat6 dou1 zou6 di1 daa2 lou2, hou2 san1 fu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们每天都做搬运工，很辛苦的。
examples.english_sentence: They work as manual laborers every day, it's very hard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工要成日搬嘢，請啲打佬返嚟做會好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 jiu3 sing4 jat6 bun1 je5, ceng2 di1 daa2 lou2 faan1 lai4 zou6 wui5 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作要经常搬东西，请搬运工来做会好一些。
examples.english_sentence: This job requires moving things all the time, it would be better to hire some movers to do it.

synonyms: 搬運工人 (bun1 wan6 gung1 jan4)

english_meaning: reputation; fame; name
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人的名声、名气。可以用来形容一个人在某个领域的声誉。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's reputation or fame. Can be used to describe someone's standing in a particular field.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺行內都幾有啲朵㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 hong4 noi6 dou1 gei2 jau5 di1 do2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在业内还是很有名气的。
examples.english_sentence: He has quite a reputation in the industry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢出咗咁多醜聞，啲朵都臭曬啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 chut1 zo2 gam3 do1 chau2 man4, di1 do2 dou1 chau3 saai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他出了这么多丑闻，名声都臭了。
examples.english_sentence: He has so many scandals, his reputation is ruined.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都要顧下啲朵，唔好亂咁做嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 jiu3 gu3 haa5 di1 do2, m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 zou6 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你也要顾及一下名声，不要乱来。
examples.english_sentence: You need to think about your reputation, don't mess around.

mandarin_meaning: 语气助词，表示商量、疑问、催促等语气
english_meaning: particle used at the end of a sentence, indicating suggestion, question, or urging
explanation_mandarin: 用在句末，表示一种商量、疑问、或催促的语气。 根据语境不同，可以表达不同的情感和含义。
explanation_english: A particle used at the end of a sentence to express a sense of suggestion, questioning, or urging. Its precise meaning varies depending on the context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不如我哋去食飯啵？
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 sik6 faan6 bo1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不如我们去吃饭吧？
examples.english_sentence: How about we go eat something?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你諗清楚未啵？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 nam2 cing1 co2 mei6 bo1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想清楚了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you thought about it clearly?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 快啲啦啵！
examples.jyutping_sentence: faai3 di1 laa1 bo1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 快点啦！
examples.english_sentence: Hurry up!

english_meaning: Sure; definitely; fixed; confirmed; for sure; alright
explanation_mandarin: 表示确定、肯定或完成的状态，相当于“当然”、“确定”、“一定”、“没错”。也可表示同意或接受。
explanation_english: Expresses certainty, confirmation, or a completed state, equivalent to "of course," "certainly," "definitely," "no mistake." Can also express agreement or acceptance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 噉咪啶囉！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam2 mai1 ding3 lo1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那样不就没问题了吗！
examples.english_sentence: Then that's alright! / Then there's no problem!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日三點見，啶喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 saam1 dim2 gin3, ding3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天三点见，确定了。
examples.english_sentence: See you tomorrow at 3, it's confirmed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話佢會嚟，咁佢啶會嚟㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 keoi5 wui5 lei4, gam2 keoi5 ding3 wui5 lei4 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说他会来，那他一定会来的。
examples.english_sentence: You said he would come, then he will definitely come.

english_meaning: to throw; to fling; to toss
explanation_mandarin: 表示投掷的动作，通常是比较随意的扔。
explanation_english: Indicates the action of throwing, usually in a casual manner, not necessarily with great force or precision.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 將個波啷過去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 go3 bo1 long1 gwo3 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把球扔过去。
examples.english_sentence: Throw the ball over there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂咁啷嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 long1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱扔东西。
examples.english_sentence: Don't throw things around randomly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啷咗啲垃圾落垃圾桶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 long1 zo2 di1 laap6 saap3 lok6 laap6 saap3 tung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我把一些垃圾扔到垃圾桶里。
examples.english_sentence: I tossed some trash into the trash can.

english_meaning: to rinse the mouth
explanation_mandarin: 用水或其他液体清洁口腔，漱去食物残渣。
explanation_english: To rinse the mouth with water or other liquid to clean the mouth and remove food particles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食完嘢記得啷口啊，唔係好易蛀牙嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 jyun4 je5 gei3 dak1 long1 hau2 aa3, m4 hai6 hou2 ji6 zyu3 ngaa4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃完东西记得漱口啊，不然很容易蛀牙的。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to rinse your mouth after eating, or you'll easily get cavities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你食完榴槤記得啷口先好同人講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sik6 jyun4 lau4 lin4 gei3 dak1 long1 hau2 sin1 hou2 tung4 jan4 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你吃完榴莲记得先漱口才能和别人说话。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to rinse your mouth after eating durian before talking to others.

english_meaning: chatting, talking
explanation_mandarin: 指闲聊，说话，通常带有轻松、随意的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to chatting, talking, usually with a relaxed and casual tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日喺度啷啷，唔知講乜咁開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 long1 long1, m4 zi1 gong2 mat1 gam3 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们整天都在那里聊天，不知道说什么那么开心。
examples.english_sentence: They are chatting there all day long, I wonder what they are talking about that makes them so happy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好阻住我做嘢，你哋去第二度啷啷啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zo2 zyu6 ngo5 zou6 je5, nei5 dei6 heoi3 dai6 ji6 dou6 long1 long1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要打扰我工作，你们去别的地方聊天吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't disturb me from working, go chat somewhere else.

english_meaning: Okay; alright; sure; agreed
explanation_mandarin: 表示同意或者接受提议。语气相对轻松，可以理解为“好吧”、“可以”、“没问题”。
explanation_english: Expresses agreement or acceptance of a proposal. The tone is relatively light and casual, similar to "okay", "alright", or "no problem".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日去行山，啹唔啹啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 heoi3 haang4 saan1, geoi1 m4 geoi1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天去爬山，好不好？
examples.english_sentence: Shall we go hiking tomorrow? Is that okay?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不如我請你食飯，啹？
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jyu4 ngo5 cheng2 nei5 sik6 faan6, geoi1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不如我请你吃饭，怎么样？
examples.english_sentence: How about I treat you to dinner, okay?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啹，就咁決定啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: geoi1, zau6 gam2 gei3 ding6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 好吧，就这么决定了！
examples.english_sentence: Okay, it's decided then!

english_meaning: Gurkha
explanation_mandarin: 指来自尼泊尔的廓尔喀族士兵。在香港，通常指香港警队中的廓尔喀籍警员。
explanation_english: Refers to Gurkha soldiers from Nepal. In Hong Kong, it usually refers to Gurkha police officers in the Hong Kong Police Force.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲啹喀差佬好鬼惡㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 gwaak1 kaa1 caai1 lou2 hou2 gwai2 ok3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的廓尔喀警察很凶的。
examples.english_sentence: The Gurkha policemen used to be very fierce.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啹喀兵打仗好勇猛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwaak1 kaa1 bing1 daa2 zoeng3 hou2 jung5 maang5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 廓尔喀士兵打仗很勇敢。
examples.english_sentence: Gurkha soldiers are very brave in battle.

english_meaning: Gurkha soldier
explanation_mandarin: 指来自尼泊尔的廓尔喀族士兵。在香港历史中，啹喀兵曾是英国驻港军队的重要组成部分，负责维持治安。
explanation_english: Refers to soldiers of the Gurkha ethnic group from Nepal. In Hong Kong's history, Gurkha soldiers were an important part of the British garrison, responsible for maintaining law and order.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前喺香港，成日見到啹喀兵巡邏。
