examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一被人问到关于那个计划的问题，他就转移话题，说要问他的上级。
examples.english_sentence: Whenever he's asked about the plan, he deflects and says he needs to ask his superiors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再單刀橫傳啦，正面回答我嘅問題好唔好？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 daan1 dou1 waang4 cyun4 laa1, zing3 min6 wui4 daap3 ngo5 ge3 man6 tai4 hou2 m4 hou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别再转移话题了，正面回答我的问题好不好？
examples.english_sentence: Stop deflecting and answer my question directly, okay?

english_meaning: to go straight to the point; to cut to the chase
explanation_mandarin: 比喻说话或写文章直接了当，不绕弯子。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone gets straight to the point without beating around the bush; direct and to the point.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以單刀直入講重點啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 daan1 dou1 zik6 jap6 gong2 zung1 dim2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可不可以单刀直入讲重点啊？
examples.english_sentence: Can you just get straight to the point?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋時間有限，不如單刀直入傾吓個合同嘅細節。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 si4 gaan3 jau5 haan6, bat1 jyu4 daan1 dou1 zik6 jap6 king1 haa5 go3 hap6 tung4 ge3 sai3 zit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们时间有限，不如单刀直入地谈一下合同的细节。
examples.english_sentence: We have limited time, so let's get straight to discussing the details of the contract.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢好單刀直入，有啲人唔係咁鍾意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 daan1 dou1 zik6 jap6, jau5 di1 jan4 m4 hai6 gam2 zung1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话很单刀直入，有些人不太喜欢。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks very directly, some people don't like that.

synonyms: 開門見山 (hoi1 mun4 gin3 saan1)
直截了當 (zik6 zit3 liu5 dong3)

english_meaning: to attend a meeting alone with only a sword; to go single-handedly to a meeting (implying bravery or recklessness)
explanation_mandarin: 比喻一个人冒险赴约，敢于面对危险的局面。源自《三国演义》中关羽单刀赴宴的故事，形容其胆识过人，英勇无畏。
explanation_english: An idiom referring to attending a meeting alone with only a sword. It describes someone bravely or recklessly facing a dangerous situation alone. It originates from the story of Guan Yu attending a banquet alone in the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, highlighting his courage and fearlessness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢知嗰次傾判好牙煙，但都決定單刀赴會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi1 go2 ci3 king1 pun3 hou2 ngaa4 jin1, daan6 dou1 kyut3 ding6 daan1 dou1 fu6 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他知道这次谈判很危险，但还是决定单刀赴会。
examples.english_sentence: He knew the negotiation would be dangerous, but he still decided to go single-handedly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 明知對方唔會咁易妥協，仲要單刀赴會，真係夠晒膽色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ming4 zi1 deoi3 fong1 m4 wui5 gam2 ji6 to5 hip3, zung6 jiu3 daan1 dou1 fu6 wui2, zan1 hai6 gau3晒 daam2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明知道对方不会那么容易妥协，还要单刀赴会，真是很有胆色。
examples.english_sentence: Knowing that the other party wouldn't easily compromise, and still going single-handedly to the meeting, is truly courageous.

english_meaning: DSLR camera (Digital Single-Lens Reflex camera)
explanation_mandarin: 指一种数码单镜头反光相机，通过反光镜和棱镜将光线反射到取景器中，方便摄影师取景和对焦。 相对于傻瓜相机，单反相机通常具有更高的图像质量和更强的可操作性。
explanation_english: Refers to a digital single-lens reflex camera (DSLR). It uses a mirror and prism system to direct light from the lens to the viewfinder, allowing the photographer to see the image that will be captured. Compared to point-and-shoot cameras, DSLRs generally offer higher image quality and greater manual control.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近買咗部新嘅單反，成日周圍去影相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 maai5 zo2 bou6 san1 ge3 daan1 faan2, seng4 jat6 zau1 wai4 heoi3 ying2 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近买了一部新的单反相机，经常到处去拍照。
examples.english_sentence: He recently bought a new DSLR camera and goes around taking photos all the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 用單反影出嚟嘅相，質素真係好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yung6 daan1 faan2 ying2 chut1 lei4 ge3 soeng2, zat1 seoi3 zan1 hai6 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 用单反相机拍出来的照片，质量真的好一些。
examples.english_sentence: The quality of photos taken with a DSLR is really better.

english_meaning: To go all-in; To bet everything on one last chance; To be in a desperate situation and relying on a single hope.
explanation_mandarin: 原为麻将术语，指只差一张牌就能胡牌，因此孤注一掷，希望靠这张牌赢。引申指在绝境中孤注一掷，把所有希望寄托于最后的机会。
explanation_english: Originally a Mahjong term, referring to being one card away from winning and betting everything on drawing that card. It is extended to mean going all-in in a desperate situation, relying on a single last chance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試肥佬咗咁多次，今次真係要單吊西，唔係就畢唔到業喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si3 fei4 lou2 zo2 gam3 do1 ci3, gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 jiu3 daan1 diu3 sai1, m4 hai6 zau6 bat1 m4 dou3 jip6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试挂科这么多次，这次真的要孤注一掷了，不然就毕不了业了。
examples.english_sentence: He has failed the exam so many times. This time he really needs to go all-in, or he won't be able to graduate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司就嚟執笠，老闆決定單吊西，將所有資金拎去投資一個新項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 zau6 lai4 zap1 lap1, lou5 baan2 kyut3 ding6 daan1 diu3 sai1, zoeng1 so2 jau5 zi1 gam1 ling1 heoi3 tau4 zi1 jat1 go3 san1 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司快要倒闭了，老板决定孤注一掷，将所有资金拿去投资一个新项目。
examples.english_sentence: The company is about to go bankrupt, so the boss decided to go all-in, using all the funds to invest in a new project.

english_meaning: one-way, unidirectional
explanation_mandarin: 只有一个方向的，只能朝一个方向进行的。
explanation_english: Having only one direction; allowing movement or transmission in only one direction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條路係單向嘅，唔可以逆線行車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 lou6 hai6 daan1 hoeng3 ge3, m4 ho2 ji5 jik6 sin3 haang4 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条路是单向的，不可以逆行。
examples.english_sentence: This road is one-way, you can't drive against the traffic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋之間嘅愛係單向嘅，佢根本唔愛我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zi1 gaan1 ge3 oi3 hai6 daan1 hoeng3 ge3, keoi5 gan1 bun2 m4 oi3 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们之间的爱是单向的，他根本不爱我。
examples.english_sentence: The love between us is one-way, he doesn't love me at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個係單向溝通，冇得討論。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 daan1 hoeng3 gau1 tung1, mou5 dak1 to2 leon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这是单向沟通，没有讨论的余地。
examples.english_sentence: This is one-way communication, there is no room for discussion.

english_meaning: only; merely; simply; just
explanation_mandarin: 表示范围很小，相当于“仅仅”、“只是”、“光”的意思。
explanation_english: Indicates a small scope, equivalent to "only", "merely", or "just".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 單單係呢個原因就唔夠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daan1 daan1 hai6 ni1 go3 jyun4 yan1 zau6 m4 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 仅仅是这个原因还不够。
examples.english_sentence: Just this reason is not enough.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢單單得十歲咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daan1 daan1 dak1 sap6 seoi3 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他才十岁。
examples.english_sentence: He's only ten years old.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好單單睇表面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 daan1 daan1 tai2 biu2 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要仅仅看表面。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just look at the surface.

english_meaning: to make sarcastic remarks, to mock, to needle, to snipe
explanation_mandarin: 指用含沙射影的方式说话，讽刺挖苦别人。
explanation_english: To make indirect, sarcastic, and often malicious remarks; to snipe at someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做咩單單打打呀？有咩唔滿意咪直接講囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 me1 daan1 daan1 daa2 daa2 aa3? jau5 me1 m4 mun5 ji3 mai5 zik6 zip3 gong2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你干嘛冷嘲热讽啊？有什么不满意的就直接说嘛。
examples.english_sentence: Why are you making sarcastic remarks? If you're dissatisfied with something, just say it directly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日單單打打，真係好乞人憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 daan1 daan1 daa2 daa2, zan1 hai6 hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是冷嘲热讽，真的很令人讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: He's always making sarcastic remarks, it's really annoying.

english_meaning: Unable to accomplish anything single-handedly; one person cannot accomplish much; it is difficult to achieve success alone.
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人难以支撑大局，力量薄弱，无法完成困难的任务。比喻单靠一个人的力量是很难成事的。
explanation_english: This idiom refers to the difficulty of one person carrying out a significant task. It implies that an individual's strength is limited, making it hard to succeed without help. It's analogous to 'one hand cannot clap'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你淨係靠自己一個人做曬呢啲嘢，根本就係單天保至尊，好難搞掂㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zing6 hai6 kaau3 zi6 gei2 jat1 go3 jan4 zou6晒 ne1 di1 je5, gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 daan1 tin1 bou2 zi3 zyun1, hou2 naan4 gaau2 dim6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你仅仅靠自己一个人做完这些事，根本就是孤掌难鸣，很难完成的。
examples.english_sentence: You're trying to do all this by yourself; it's like trying to accomplish something single-handedly; it's very difficult to manage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想一個人撐起成間公司，真係單天保至尊呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 jat1 go3 jan4 caang1 hei2 seng4 gaan1 gung1 si1, zan1 hai6 daan1 tin1 bou2 zi3 zyun1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想一个人支撑起整个公司，真是孤掌难鸣啊！
examples.english_sentence: He wants to support the entire company alone; it's really like trying to do the impossible single-handedly!

english_meaning: single-character surname; simple surname
explanation_mandarin: 指姓氏只有一个字。与复姓相对。
explanation_english: Refers to a surname that consists of only one character. It's the opposite of a double-character surname (复姓).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 李先生係單姓，而司徒先生就係複姓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lei5 sin1 saang1 hai6 daan1 sing3, ji4 si1 tou4 sin1 saang1 zau6 hai6 fuk1 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 李先生是单姓，而司徒先生是复姓。
examples.english_sentence: Mr. Li has a single-character surname, while Mr. Situ has a double-character surname.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺香港，單姓嘅人比較多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 hoeng1 gong2, daan1 sing3 ge3 jan4 bei2 gaau3 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在香港，单姓的人比较多。
examples.english_sentence: In Hong Kong, there are more people with single-character surnames.

english_meaning: Single word, vocabulary word
explanation_mandarin: 指单个的字，通常用于学习语言时的词汇。
explanation_english: Refers to a single word, usually in the context of vocabulary learning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日阿 Sir 教咗好多新單字。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 aa3 sir2 gaau3 zo2 hou2 do1 san1 daan1 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天老师教了很多新单词。
examples.english_sentence: Today the teacher taught a lot of new words.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個單字點解呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 daan1 zi6 dim2 gaai2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个单词什么意思？
examples.english_sentence: What does this word mean?

english_meaning: one-on-one
explanation_mandarin: 指双方单独进行，一对一的形式。
explanation_english: Refers to a situation where two individuals are interacting or competing directly, with no third party involved; one-on-one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋不如單對單傾掂佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 bat1 jyu4 daan1 deoi3 daan1 king1 dim6 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不如我们一对一谈妥这件事吧。
examples.english_sentence: Why don't we settle this one-on-one?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話要同我單對單隻揪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 jiu3 tung4 ngo5 daan1 deoi3 daan1 zek3 ciu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说要和我单挑。
examples.english_sentence: He said he wanted to fight me one-on-one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個老細鐘意單對單咁同員工傾計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 lou5 sai3 zung1 ji3 daan1 deoi3 daan1 gam2 tung4 wun4 gung1 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的老板喜欢和员工一对一地聊天。
examples.english_sentence: My boss likes to have one-on-one conversations with employees.

english_meaning: single-layer, one-story
explanation_mandarin: 指只有一层，没有多层结构。
explanation_english: Refers to having only one layer or level, without multiple layers or stories.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋間屋係單層嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gaan1 uk1 hai6 daan1 cang4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们家是单层的。
examples.english_sentence: Our house is one-story.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個蛋糕得單層忌廉咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 daan6 gou1 dak1 daan1 cang4 gei1 lim4 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个蛋糕只有单层奶油而已。
examples.english_sentence: This cake only has a single layer of cream.

english_meaning: Standalone building; Single-block building
explanation_mandarin: 指不属于大型屋苑，独立存在的大厦或住宅楼。通常这些楼的设施较少，管理也可能不如大型屋苑。
explanation_english: Refers to a building or residential block that stands alone, not belonging to a larger housing estate. These buildings typically have fewer amenities and may have less comprehensive management compared to large housing estates.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰度好多單幢樓，搵食都幾方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 dou6 hou2 do1 daan1 tung4 lau2, wan2 sik6 dou1 gei2 fong1便.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那里有很多独立大厦，找吃的也很方便。
examples.english_sentence: There are many standalone buildings there, and it's quite convenient to find food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我寧願住大型屋苑，好過住啲單幢樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ning4 jyun2 zyu6 daai6 hing4 uk1苑, hou2 gwo3 zyu6 di1 daan1 tung4 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我宁愿住大型屋苑，胜过住那些独立大厦。
examples.english_sentence: I'd rather live in a large housing estate than live in those standalone buildings.

english_meaning: single quotation mark
explanation_mandarin: 一种标点符号，用于引用、强调或表示特殊意义。
explanation_english: A punctuation mark used to denote quotations, emphasis, or special meanings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個字嘅意思唔係表面咁簡單，要加單引號強調吓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zi6 ge3 ji3 si1 m4 hai6 biu2 min6 gam3 gaan2 daan1, jiu3 gaa1 daan1 jan5 hou6 koeng4 diu6 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个字的意思不是表面那么简单，要加单引号强调一下。
examples.english_sentence: The meaning of this word is not as simple as it seems, we should use single quotation marks to emphasize it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢成日用啲『潮語』，我都唔知佢up乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 seng4 jat6 yung6 di1 'ciu4 jyu5', ngo5 dou1 m4 zi1 keoi5 ap1 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话总是用一些『流行语』，我都不知道他在说什么。
examples.english_sentence: He always uses some 'slang' when he speaks, I don't even know what he's talking about.

english_meaning: leaflet, flyer, pamphlet
explanation_mandarin: 一种小型的印刷品，通常用于宣传或广告。
explanation_english: A small, printed sheet of paper, typically used for advertising or promotion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺街邊收到好多單張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 gaai1 bin1 sau1 dou2 hou2 do1 daan1 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在街边收到了很多传单。
examples.english_sentence: We received a lot of leaflets on the street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳派緊單張宣傳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 paai3 gan2 daan1 zoeng1 syun1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家餐厅正在派发传单做宣传。
examples.english_sentence: That restaurant is handing out flyers for promotion.

english_meaning: unrequited love, one-sided love
explanation_mandarin: 指一方爱慕另一方，但没有得到对方的回应或爱意。
explanation_english: To be in love with someone who does not return your feelings; unrequited love; one-sided love.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我單思咗佢好耐，但係佢一直都唔知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daan1 si1 zo2 keoi5 hou2 noi6, daan6 hai6 keoi5 jat1 zik6 dou1 m4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我单恋她很久了，但是她一直都不知道。
examples.english_sentence: I've been in love with her for a long time, but she never knew.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 單思真係好辛苦㗎，你都係放低佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daan1 si1 zan1 hai6 hou2 san1 fu2 gaa3, nei5 dou1 hai6 fong3 dai1 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 单恋真的很辛苦啊，你还是放下她吧。
examples.english_sentence: Unrequited love is really painful, you should just let her go.

english_meaning: solely relying on; based solely on; only by
explanation_mandarin: 表示只依靠某种事物或条件，没有其他的辅助或依据。
explanation_english: Expressing reliance solely on something or a specific condition, without any additional support or basis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你單憑佢嘅片面之詞就信晒佢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 daan1 pang4 keoi5 ge3 pin3 min6 zi1 ci4 zau6 seon3 saai3 keoi5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你仅仅凭借他的一面之词就完全相信他？
examples.english_sentence: Are you believing him completely based solely on his one-sided story?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 單憑你嘅努力係唔夠㗎，仲要靠啲運氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daan1 pang4 nei5 ge3 nou5 lik6 hai6 m4 gau3 gaa3, zung6 jiu3 kaau3 di1 wan6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 仅仅凭借你的努力是不够的，还需要靠一些运气。
examples.english_sentence: Relying solely on your effort isn't enough; you still need some luck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔可以單憑外表嚟判斷一個人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 ho2 ji5 daan1 pang4 ngoi6 biu2 lai4 pun3 dyun3 jat1 go3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不可以仅仅凭借外表来判断一个人。
examples.english_sentence: We cannot judge a person solely based on their appearance.

english_meaning: unrequited love, one-sided love
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人单方面地爱慕另一个人，但对方没有同样的情感回应。
explanation_english: Refers to a situation where one person loves another, but the other person does not reciprocate the feelings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我單戀咗佢好耐，但係佢一直都唔知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daan1 lyun2 zo2 keoi5 hou2 noi6, daan6 hai6 keoi5 jat1 zik6 dou1 m4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我单恋他很久了，但是他一直都不知道。
examples.english_sentence: I've been in love with him for a long time, but he's never known.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅單戀最後都冇結果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 daan1 lyun2 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 mou5 git3 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的单恋最后也没有结果。
examples.english_sentence: His unrequited love ultimately led to nothing.

english_meaning: one-handed; single-handed
explanation_mandarin: 指用一只手。可以指用一只手做某事，也可以形容某人只有一只手。
explanation_english: Refers to using only one hand. It can describe doing something with one hand, or describe someone who only has one hand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢單手揸車，好牙煙㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daan1 sau2 zaa1 ce1, hou2 ngaa4 jin1 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他单手开车，很危险的！
examples.english_sentence: He's driving with one hand, it's very dangerous!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢單手都可以搞掂呢份工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daan1 sau2 dou1 ho2 ji5 gaau2 dim6 ni1 fan6 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他单手都可以完成这份工作。
examples.english_sentence: He can handle this job single-handedly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢單手拎起咗個行李箱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daan1 sau2 ling1 hei2 zo2 go3 hang4 lei5 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他单手提起了那个行李箱。
examples.english_sentence: He picked up the suitcase with one hand.

english_meaning: To single out, to fight one-on-one (physically or figuratively), to act alone, solo
explanation_mandarin: 指一对一的打斗；也指独自行动，不依靠他人。
explanation_english: Refers to a one-on-one fight or confrontation; also refers to acting alone, without relying on others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個因為啲小事，搞到要單打。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 jan1 wai4 di1 siu2 si6, gaau2 dou3 jiu3 daan1 daa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个人因为一些小事，搞到要单挑。
examples.english_sentence: Those two ended up having to fight one-on-one because of some trivial matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次嘅任務我要單打，唔需要人幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ge3 jam6 mou6 ngo5 jiu3 daan1 daa2, m4 seoi1 jiu3 jan4 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的任务我要单独行动，不需要人帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: I want to act alone for this mission; I don't need anyone's help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係識得喺背後講人，有本事就出嚟單打啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 hai2 bui3 hau6 gong2 jan4, jau5 bun2 si6 zau6 ceot1 lai4 daan1 daa2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只会背后说人，有本事就出来单挑啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't just know how to talk about people behind their backs. If you have the guts, come out and face me one-on-one!

english_meaning: to fight single-handedly, to go it alone, to act independently
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人没有依靠，独自奋斗。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone is working alone without any support, fighting a battle on their own.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 創業初期，佢乜都靠自己，真係單打獨鬥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cong3 jip6 co1 kei4, keoi5 mat1 dou1 kaau3 zi6 gei2, zan1 hai6 daan1 daa2 duk6 dau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 创业初期，他什么都靠自己，真是单枪匹马。
examples.english_sentence: In the early stages of his business, he relied on himself for everything, truly going it alone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢個行業，單打獨鬥好難成功㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 go3 hang4 jip6, daan1 daa2 duk6 dau3 hou2 naan4 sing4 gung1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这个行业里，单枪匹马很难成功的。
examples.english_sentence: In this industry, it's very difficult to succeed by going it alone.

mandarin_meaning: 独自一人; 单独行动
english_meaning: alone; by oneself; solo; to go alone
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人独自行动，没有其他人陪伴或参与。
explanation_english: Refers to acting alone, without any other companions or participants.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都單拖去睇戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 daan1 to1 heoi3 tai2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是独自去看电影。
examples.english_sentence: He always goes to the movies alone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我單拖出去食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 daan1 to1 cheot1 heoi3 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我一个人出去吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight, I'm going out to eat by myself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，今次我得單拖嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, gam1 ci3 ngo5 dak1 daan1 to1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，这次我只能自己一个人来。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I can only come alone this time.

english_meaning: one-on-one, to challenge someone to a duel/fight/contest
explanation_mandarin: 指一对一的挑战或对决，通常带有竞争或冲突的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to a one-on-one challenge or duel, often implying competition or conflict.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁多廢話，單挑啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 do1 fai3 waa6, daan1 tiu1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别说那么多废话，单挑吧！
examples.english_sentence: Stop talking nonsense, let's settle this one-on-one!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個因為爭女而單挑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 jan1 wai6 zaang1 neoi5 ji4 daan1 tiu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个因为争女人而单挑。
examples.english_sentence: The two of them fought one-on-one because they were fighting over a girl.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢喺籃球場單挑，睇下邊個勁啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 hai2 laam4 kau4 coeng4 daan1 tiu1, tai2 haa5 bin1 go3 ging6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他在篮球场单挑，看看谁更厉害。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to have a one-on-one basketball match with him to see who's better.

mandarin_meaning: 单独工作；自己做；独立经营
english_meaning: to work independently; to freelance; to run a solo business
explanation_mandarin: 指不依靠他人，独自进行某项工作或经营事业。多指个体户，自由职业者等。
explanation_english: Refers to working or running a business independently without relying on others. Often refers to freelancers, sole proprietors, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔想幫人打工，想自己單撈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 soeng2 bong1 jan4 daa2 gung1, soeng2 zi6 gei2 daan1 lou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不想替别人打工，想自己单干。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't want to work for others; he wants to work for himself (go freelance).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多人選擇單撈，時間自由啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 jan4 syun2 zaak6 daan1 lou1, si4 gaan3 zi6 jau4 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多人选择自己做，时间更自由一些。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, many people choose to freelance; the time is more flexible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗幾年嘢，儲咗啲錢，打算單撈開間鋪頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 gei2 nin4 je5, cou5 zo2 di1 cin2, daa2 syun3 daan1 lou1 hoi1 gaan1 pou3 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作了几年，存了一些钱，打算自己开一家店。
examples.english_sentence: He's worked for a few years and saved some money; he plans to open a shop and run it solo.

english_meaning: Pick and roll (basketball), screen, to block
explanation_mandarin: 在篮球运动中，指进攻方队员利用身体阻挡防守队员的移动，为队友创造进攻机会。 也可泛指挡住，阻挡。
explanation_english: In basketball, to set a screen or pick for a teammate, creating space for them to drive or shoot. More generally, to block or obstruct something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢幫我單擋咗一吓，我就入咗波啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bong1 ngo5 daan1 dong2 zo2 jat1 haa5, ngo5 zau6 jap6 zo2 bo1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他帮我挡了一下，我就进球了。
examples.english_sentence: He set a screen for me, and I scored.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你企埋去幫佢單擋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 kei5 maai4 heoi3 bong1 keoi5 daan1 dong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你靠近去帮他挡拆。
examples.english_sentence: Go over there and set a screen for him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想佢哋再喺度單擋住我嘅發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 keoi5 dei6 zoi3 hai2 dou6 daan1 dong2 zyu6 ngo5 ge3 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想他们再在这里阻碍我的发展。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want them to keep blocking my progress here.

english_meaning: Receipt; Invoice; Document
explanation_mandarin: 指记录交易或活动的凭证，通常用于报销、记账等。
explanation_english: Refers to a document that records a transaction or activity, typically used for reimbursement, bookkeeping, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得攞返張單據，到時可以報銷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 lo2 faan1 zoeng1 daan1 geoi3, dou3 si4 ho2 ji5 bou3 siu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记得拿回这张收据，到时候可以报销。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to get the receipt back, you can claim expenses later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張單據唔見咗，唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 daan1 geoi3 m4 gin3 zo2, m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 收据不见了，不知道怎么办才好。
examples.english_sentence: The receipt is lost, I don't know what to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你幫我釘好啲單據佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bong1 ngo5 ding1 hou2 di1 daan1 geoi3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你帮我把这些单据钉好。
examples.english_sentence: Please staple these receipts for me.

english_meaning: detached house, stand-alone building
explanation_mandarin: 指独立的，没有和别的建筑物连接的楼房。通常指别墅或独立屋。
explanation_english: Refers to a building that is detached and not connected to any other buildings. Usually refers to villas or detached houses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋住喺半山嘅單支樓，好有錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zyu6 hai2 bun3 saan1 ge3 daan1 zi1 lau2, hou2 jau5 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们住在半山的独立屋，很有钱。
examples.english_sentence: They live in a detached house on the Mid-Levels, they are very rich.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一直想買間有花園嘅單支樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 zik6 soeng2 maai5 gaan1 jau5 faa1 yun4 ge3 daan1 zi1 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一直想买一间有花园的独立屋。
examples.english_sentence: He has always wanted to buy a detached house with a garden.

english_meaning: odd number, single
explanation_mandarin: 指不能被2整除的整数。也指单个的，不成双的。
explanation_english: Refers to an integer that cannot be evenly divided by 2 (odd number). It can also mean single or individual, not in pairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個數係單數嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sou3 hai6 daan1 sou3 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个数是单数。
examples.english_sentence: This number is an odd number.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗一隻單數嘅襪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 zek3 daan1 sou3 ge3 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一只单只的袜子。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a single sock.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人數係單數，分組唔平均喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 sou3 hai6 daan1 sou3, fan1 zou2 m4 ping4 gwan1 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人数是单数，分组不平均啊。
examples.english_sentence: The number of people is odd, the groups won't be even.

english_meaning: Simple; Plain; Uncomplicated; Unsophisticated
explanation_mandarin: 指事物简单、单调，没有复杂的装饰或变化。
explanation_english: Describes something that is simple, plain, and without much complexity or variation. It can also imply that something is unsophisticated or lacking in depth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好單料，唔鍾意啲複雜嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 daan1 liu2, m4 zung1 yi3 di1 fuk1 zaap6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很简单，不喜欢复杂的东西。
examples.english_sentence: He is a simple person and doesn't like complicated things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅嘢食好單料，冇乜特別。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 je5 sik6 hou2 daan1 liu2, mou5 mat1 bit6 bit1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物很简单，没什么特别的。
examples.english_sentence: The food in this restaurant is very plain; nothing special.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢好單料，一聽就明。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 hou2 daan1 liu2, jat1 teng1 zau6 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他讲的东西很简单，一听就明白。
examples.english_sentence: What he said was very simple; easy to understand.

mandarin_meaning: 比喻某人能力不足，只会做简单的事情
english_meaning: A metaphor for someone who is only capable of doing simple things; lacks versatility or skills; a one-trick pony.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻一个人只会做简单的事情，缺乏多样化的技能或能力。 就像一个铜锅只能用来煮一种简单的食材一样。
explanation_english: It's a metaphor that describes someone who is only capable of doing simple tasks and lacks versatility or a wide range of skills. The imagery refers to a simple copper pot that can only cook one type of simple ingredient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢呢個人真係單料銅煲，除咗寫code之外，咩都唔識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ni1 go3 jan4 zan1 hai6 daan1 liu2 tung4 bou1, ceoi4 zo2 se2 code zhi1 ngoi6, me1 dou1 m4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个人真是只会做简单的事情，除了写代码之外，什么都不会。
examples.english_sentence: This person is really a one-trick pony; besides coding, he doesn't know anything else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好睇小佢，可能佢唔係單料銅煲，仲有好多嘢你未見過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tai2 siu2 keoi5, ho2 nang4 keoi5 m4 hai6 daan1 liu2 tung4 bou1, zung6 jau5 ho2 do1 je5 nei5 mei6 gin3 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要小看他，也许他不是只会做简单的事情，还有很多你没见过的本事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't underestimate him. Maybe he's not a one-trick pony and has other abilities you haven't seen.

synonyms: 一招半式 (yat1 ziu1 bun3 sik1)

cantonese: 單料銅煲 - 一滾就熟
jyutping: daan1 liu2 tung4 bou1 — jat1 gwan2 zau6 suk6
mandarin_meaning: 简单的事情很快就完成
english_meaning: Simple task, quickly accomplished; easily done.
explanation_mandarin: 单料铜煲指材料简单的铜锅。这句话比喻事情简单容易，很快就能完成。
explanation_english: "Single ingredient copper pot - cooks as soon as it boils." This idiom uses the analogy of a simple copper pot with minimal ingredients that cooks very quickly. It means a task or matter is simple and easily accomplished.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個project單料銅煲，一滾就熟，聽日就交到啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 pro1-jek6 daan1 liu2 tung4 bou1, jat1 gwan2 zau6 suk6, ting1 jat6 zau6 gaau1 dou3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目很简单，很快就能完成，明天就能交了。
examples.english_sentence: This project is a piece of cake, easily done, I can submit it tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅關係單料銅煲，一滾就熟，好快就結婚㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 daan1 liu2 tung4 bou1, jat1 gwan2 zau6 suk6, hou2 faai3 zau6 git3 fan1 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的关系发展很快，很快就要结婚了。
examples.english_sentence: Their relationship is progressing rapidly and they will probably get married soon.

english_meaning: unilateral; one-sided
explanation_mandarin: 指只涉及一方，没有得到对方的同意或参与。
explanation_english: Referring to something that is done by one party only, without the agreement or involvement of the other party; unilateral.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋單方面取消咗合約。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 daan1 fong1 min6 ceoi2 siu1 zo2 hap6 joek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们单方面取消了合同。
examples.english_sentence: They unilaterally cancelled the contract.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想聽你單方面嘅說法，我想聽埋佢嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 teng1 nei5 daan1 fong1 min6 ge3 syut3 faat3, ngo5 soeng2 teng1 maai4 keoi5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想听你单方面的说法，我想听听他的。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to hear your one-sided account; I want to hear his too.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔可以單方面決定，要同其他人商量。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 ho2 ji5 daan1 fong1 min6 kyut3 ding6, jiu3 tung4 kei4 taa1 jan4 soeng1 loeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不能单方面决定，要和其他人商量。
examples.english_sentence: You can't make a unilateral decision; you need to discuss it with others.

english_meaning: odd day (of the month)
explanation_mandarin: 指一个月中日期为单数的日子。
explanation_english: Refers to the days of the month that have odd numbers as dates.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋淨係喺單日先至可以洗車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zeng6 hai6 hai2 daan1 jat6 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 sai2 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们只能在单数日期洗车。
examples.english_sentence: We are only allowed to wash the car on odd-numbered days.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今個月嘅單日好少有假期。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 go3 jyut6 ge3 daan1 jat6 hou2 siu2 jau5 gaa3 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个月的单数日期很少有假期。
examples.english_sentence: There are very few holidays on the odd days of this month.

english_meaning: single (music)
explanation_mandarin: 指只有一首歌曲的音乐作品，通常从专辑中提取发行。
explanation_english: Refers to a music recording that features only one song. It is often released as a standalone track extracted from an album.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢出咗隻新嘅單曲，好好聽㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ceot1 zo2 zek3 san1 ge3 daan1 kuk1, hou2 hou2 teng1 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他出了一首新的单曲，很好听的！
examples.english_sentence: He released a new single, it's really good!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻單曲喺網上好hit㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 daan1 kuk1 hai2 mong5 soeng5 hou2 hit3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这首单曲在网上很火。
examples.english_sentence: This single is very popular online.

english_meaning: Standalone building, single-block building
explanation_mandarin: 指独立的，没有与其他建筑相连的楼宇。通常指没有公共走廊或与其他楼宇共享墙壁的住宅楼。
explanation_english: Refers to a standalone building, one that is not connected to other buildings. It usually refers to a residential building without shared corridors or walls with other buildings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰度啲樓都係單棟樓，好少有屋苑式嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 dou6 di1 lau2 dou1 hai6 daan1 dung6 lau2, hou2 siu2 jau5 uk1 yun2 sik1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那里的大楼都是独栋楼，很少有屋苑式的。
examples.english_sentence: The buildings there are all standalone buildings; there are very few estate-style buildings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 住單棟樓嘅好處就係夠晒寧靜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zyu6 daan1 dung6 lau2 ge3 hou2 chu3 zau6 hai6 gau3 saai3 ning4 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 住独栋楼的好处就是足够安静。
examples.english_sentence: The advantage of living in a standalone building is that it's quiet enough.

english_meaning: single-handed; alone and unaided; to do something alone
explanation_mandarin: 比喻单独行动，没有依靠。
explanation_english: Describes acting alone without any help or support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢單槍匹馬去咗傾嗰單生意，真係好犀利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daan1 coeng1 pat1 maa5 heoi3 zo2 king1 go2 daan1 saang1 ji3, zan1 hai6 hou2 sai1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他单枪匹马去谈成了那笔生意，真是太厉害了。
examples.english_sentence: He went alone to negotiate that business deal, he's really impressive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要完成呢個項目，唔可以單槍匹馬，需要團隊合作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 waan4 sing4 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6, m4 ho2 ji5 daan1 coeng1 pat1 maa5, seoi1 jiu3 teoi1 deoi2 hap6 jok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要完成这个项目，不可以单枪匹马，需要团队合作。
examples.english_sentence: To complete this project, you can't do it alone, you need teamwork.

english_meaning: horizontal bar, high bar (gymnastics)
explanation_mandarin: 一种体操器械，由一根横杠固定在两根立柱上组成，用于做引体向上、回环等动作。
explanation_english: A piece of gymnastic equipment consisting of a horizontal bar fixed to two upright supports, used for exercises such as pull-ups and giants.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣，我好鍾意玩單槓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6, ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 waan2 daan1 gong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候，我很喜欢玩单杠。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a kid, I really liked playing on the horizontal bar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺單槓上面做好多花式動作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 daan1 gong3 soeng6 min6 zou6 hou2 do1 faa1 sik1 dung6 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在单杠上做了很多花式动作。
examples.english_sentence: He performed many fancy moves on the horizontal bar.

mandarin_meaning: 单干；不理人；自己一个人玩
english_meaning: going solo; doing things alone; isolating oneself; playing a single-player game
explanation_mandarin: 原指玩单机游戏，引申为单独行动，不与他人合作，或者不理会别人，自己做自己的事情。也指一个人独处的状态。
explanation_english: Originally referring to playing single-player video games, it is now used metaphorically to mean acting alone, not cooperating with others, or ignoring others and doing one's own thing. It also refers to a state of being alone and isolated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日單機，都唔同我哋一齊玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 daan1 gei1, dou1 m4 tung4 ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是自己一个人玩，都不和我们一起玩。
examples.english_sentence: He always goes solo and doesn't play with us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁單機啦，一齊合作好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 daan1 gei1 laa1, jat1 cai4 hap6 jok3 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么单干了，一起合作好一些。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so solo, it's better to cooperate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放假我鍾意單機喺屋企睇戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 gaa3 ngo5 zung1 ji3 daan1 gei1 hai2 uk1 kei2 tai2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 放假我喜欢自己一个人在家看电影。
examples.english_sentence: During holidays, I like to be alone at home watching movies.

english_meaning: alone, by oneself, individually, separately
explanation_mandarin: 指不跟別人在一起，独自一人。
explanation_english: Refers to being alone, not with others; by oneself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想單獨同你傾下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 daan1 duk6 tung4 nei5 king1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想单独和你谈一下。
examples.english_sentence: I want to talk to you alone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢通常單獨一個人食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tung1 soeng4 daan1 duk6 jat1 go3 jan4 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他通常单独一个人吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: He usually eats alone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好單獨行夜路啊，危險㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 daan1 duk6 haang4 je6 lou6 aa3, ngai4 him2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要单独走夜路啊，很危险的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't walk alone at night, it's dangerous.

mandarin_meaning: 眨眼; 只有一隻眼睛
english_meaning: to wink; to have only one eye
explanation_mandarin: 指眨一隻眼睛的動作，也指只有一隻眼睛。
explanation_english: Refers to the action of winking one eye, or having only one eye.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對我單眼，好似想暗示啲嘢咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ngo5 daan1 ngaan5, hou2 ci5 soeng2 am3 si6 di1 je5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对我眨眼，好像想暗示一些事情。
examples.english_sentence: He winked at me, as if he wanted to imply something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻貓單眼，好得意呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 maau1 daan1 ngaan5, hou2 dak1 ji3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这只猫只有一只眼睛，很可爱啊。
examples.english_sentence: This cat has only one eye, it's so cute!

english_meaning: One-eyed person
explanation_mandarin: 指只有一只眼睛的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person with only one eye. It can sometimes be used informally or playfully, but in some contexts, it can be considered offensive depending on the situation and tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個單眼佬喺度賣魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 daan1 ngaan5 lou2 hai2 dou6 maai6 yu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个独眼人在卖鱼。
examples.english_sentence: That one-eyed man is selling fish.

cantonese: 單眼佬睇榜 - 一眼睇晒
jyutping: daan1 ngaan5 lou2 tai2 bong2 -- jat1 ngaan5 tai2 saai3
english_meaning: A one-eyed man reading the list - seeing everything at a glance; Seeing through everything at a glance; Understanding everything quickly.
explanation_mandarin: 单眼佬（独眼的人）看榜（榜单），因为只有一只眼睛，所以能快速地浏览和理解全部内容。比喻一眼就看穿事情的本质，理解得非常透彻。
explanation_english: A one-eyed man reading a list. Since he only has one eye, he can quickly browse and understand the entire contents. The idiom means to see through the essence of things at a glance, to understand something very thoroughly and quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好醒目，單眼佬睇榜——一眼睇晒，知道邊個係鬼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sing2 muk6, daan1 ngaan5 lou2 tai2 bong2 -- jat1 ngaan5 tai2 saai3, zi1 dou3 bin1 go3 hai6 gwai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很聪明，一眼就看穿了，知道谁是内鬼。
examples.english_sentence: He's very smart. He sees through everything at a glance. He knows who the mole is.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個騙局好明顯，單眼佬睇榜——一眼睇晒，呃唔到人嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 pin3 guk6 hou2 ming4 hin2, daan1 ngaan5 lou2 tai2 bong2 -- jat1 ngaan5 tai2 saai3, aak1 m4 dou3 jan4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个骗局很明显，一眼就能看穿，骗不了人的。
examples.english_sentence: This scam is obvious. It's easy to see through it at a glance, it can't fool anyone.

mandarin_meaning: 斜眼看人, 瞧不起人
english_meaning: To look down on someone (with a sideways glance); to look at someone with disdain; to look at someone with a single eye
explanation_mandarin: 用一只眼睛斜着看人，表示不屑或轻蔑的态度。
explanation_english: To look at someone sideways with one eye, expressing disdain or contempt. This suggests a dismissive and condescending attitude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日單眼簷人，好乞人憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 daan1 ngaan5 jim4 jan4, hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是斜眼看人，很讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: He always looks down on people, he's very annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁單眼簷佢啦，佢都好努力㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 daan1 ngaan5 jim4 keoi5 laa1, keoi5 dou1 hou2 nou5 lik6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这样瞧不起他，他也很努力的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't look down on him like that, he is working hard.

english_meaning: one-way (trip/ticket)
explanation_mandarin: 指只去不回的旅程或车票。
explanation_english: Refers to a trip or ticket for going only one way, without returning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗張去香港嘅單程機票。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 zoeng1 heoi3 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 daan1 cing4 gei1 piu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一张去香港的单程机票。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a one-way ticket to Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗張單程火車飛返鄉下，決定唔再返嚟呢度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 zoeng1 daan1 cing4 fo2 ce1 fei1 faan1 hoeng1 haa2, kyut3 ding6 m4 zoi3 faan1 lei4 ni1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买了一张单程火车票回老家，决定不再回来了。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a one-way train ticket back to his hometown, deciding not to come back here anymore.

english_meaning: One-way permit
explanation_mandarin: 由中国大陆签发给前往香港或澳门定居的人士的证件。
explanation_english: A permit issued by mainland China to people who wish to reside permanently in Hong Kong or Macau.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞咗單程証嚟香港住啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 zo2 daan1 cing4 zung3 lai4 hoeng1 gong2 zyu6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿了单程证来香港住了。
examples.english_sentence: He obtained a one-way permit and came to live in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 申請單程証嘅程序好複雜㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 cing2 daan1 cing4 zung3 ge3 cing4 zeoi6 hou2 fuk1 zaap6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 申请单程证的程序很复杂。
examples.english_sentence: The application procedure for a one-way permit is very complicated.

english_meaning: One-way Permit (to Hong Kong from Mainland China)
explanation_mandarin: 指由中国大陆居民申请前往香港定居的证件，持证人获准单程前往香港，并在香港取得永久居留权。
explanation_english: Refers to a document applied for by residents of Mainland China to settle in Hong Kong. The permit allows the holder to travel to Hong Kong one-way and obtain permanent residency there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢拎咗單程證嚟香港同屋企人團聚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ling1 zo2 daan1 cing4 zing3 lai4 hoeng1 gong2 tung4 uk1 kei2 jan4 tyun4 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿了单程证来香港和家人团聚。
examples.english_sentence: He obtained a One-way Permit to come to Hong Kong to reunite with his family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 攞到單程證唔代表即刻有錢，都要努力工作㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lo2 dou2 daan1 cing4 zing3 m4 doi6 biu2 zik1 hak1 jau5 cin2, dou1 jiu3 nu5 lik6 gung1 zok3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 拿到单程证不代表立刻有钱，也要努力工作啊。
examples.english_sentence: Obtaining a One-way Permit doesn't mean you'll immediately be rich; you still have to work hard.

english_meaning: One-way street; a path of no return
explanation_mandarin: 字面意义指只允许车辆单向行驶的道路。引申意义比喻一旦选择就无法回头的道路或境地。
explanation_english: Literally refers to a road that only allows vehicles to travel in one direction. Figuratively, it describes a path or situation that cannot be reversed once chosen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人生有好多單程路，行咗就冇得返轉頭㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yan4 sang1 yau5 hou2 do1 daan1 cing4 lou6, hang4 zo2 zau6 mou5 dak1 faan1 zyun2 tau4 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人生有很多单行道，走了就回不去了。
examples.english_sentence: Life has many paths of no return; once you've walked them, you can't turn back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 揀咗呢份工，就好似行咗單程路咁，想轉行都難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan2 zo2 ni1 fan6 gung1, zau6 hou2 ci5 hang4 zo2 daan1 cing4 lou6 gam2, soeng2 zyun2 hang4 dou1 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 选择了这份工作，就像走了单行道一样，想转行都难。
examples.english_sentence: Choosing this job is like walking a one-way street; it's hard to switch careers.

english_meaning: clarinet
explanation_mandarin: 一种管乐器，通过吹气振动簧片发声。
explanation_english: A single-reed woodwind instrument in the clarinet family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺樂團度吹單簧管。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ngok6 tyun4 dou6 cheui1 daan1 wong4 gun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在乐团里吹单簧管。
examples.english_sentence: He plays the clarinet in the orchestra.

english_meaning: simple; pure; innocent; naive
explanation_mandarin: 形容思想、行为或事物简单，不复杂，没有掺杂其他成分。
explanation_english: Describes something that is simple, not complicated, pure, and without ulterior motives. Can also describe a person who is innocent or naive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好單純，好容易信人㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 daan1 seon4, hou2 jung4 ji6 seon3 jan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很单纯，很容易相信别人。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very simple person and easily believes others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個故事嘅情節好單純，小朋友都睇得明。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gu3 si6 ge3 cing4 zit3 hou2 daan1 seon4, siu2 pang4 jau5 dou1 tai2 dak1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个故事的情节很简单，小朋友都能看明白。
examples.english_sentence: The plot of this story is very simple, even children can understand it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人會覺得單純係一種福氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 wui5 gok3 dak1 daan1 seon4 hai6 jat1 zung2 fuk1 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人会觉得单纯是一种福气。
examples.english_sentence: Some people think that being simple is a blessing.

mandarin_meaning: 知会一声; 打声招呼
english_meaning: to give someone a heads-up; to notify; to let someone know
explanation_mandarin: 指提前告知，打声招呼，让人知道情况。
explanation_english: To give someone a heads-up, to notify them, or to let them know about a situation beforehand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你聽日唔嚟，記得單聲我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 ting1 jat6 m4 lai4, gei3 dak1 daan1 seng1 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你明天不来，记得通知我一声。
examples.english_sentence: If you're not coming tomorrow, remember to let me know.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有咩消息記得單聲我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 me1 siu1 sik1 gei3 dak1 daan1 seng1 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有什么消息记得通知我们。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to let us know if there's any news.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢走咗都冇單聲我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zau2 zo2 dou1 mou5 daan1 seng1 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他走了都没有告诉我一声。
examples.english_sentence: He left without even letting me know.

english_meaning: thin; weak; frail; flimsy
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或物又薄又弱，不够结实或丰满。
explanation_english: Describing a person or thing that is thin and weak, lacking substance or fullness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好單薄，好似一陣風就吹得走咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 daan1 bok6, hou2 ci5 jat1 zan6 fung1 zau6 cheoi1 dak1 zau2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很瘦弱，好像一阵风就能吹走一样。
examples.english_sentence: He is so thin and weak, it's like a gust of wind could blow him away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫嘅布料太單薄，唔夠暖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 ge3 bou3 liu2 taai3 daan1 bok6, m4 gau3 nün5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服的布料太单薄，不够暖和。
examples.english_sentence: The fabric of this shirt is too thin, it's not warm enough.

english_meaning: one-way (trip, street, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指单程的，或者指单方向的，不返回的。
explanation_english: Refers to something that is one-way, not returning or going in both directions. Can be used to describe a trip, a street, or a flow of information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗張去香港嘅單行機票。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 zoeng1 heoi3 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 daan1 hang4 gei1 piu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一张去香港的单程机票。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a one-way ticket to Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條路係單行路，唔可以倒車㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 lou6 hai6 daan1 hang4 lou6, m4 ho2 ji5 dou2 ce1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条路是单行道，不可以倒车。
examples.english_sentence: This road is a one-way street, you can't reverse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋只係得單行嘅溝通，佢從來唔聽我講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zi2 hai6 dak1 daan1 hang4 ge3 gau1 tung1, keoi5 cung4 loi4 m4 teng1 ngo5 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们之间只有单方面的沟通，他从来不听我说话。
examples.english_sentence: There's only one-way communication between us; he never listens to me.

english_meaning: stingy; miserly; tight-fisted
explanation_mandarin: 形容人非常吝啬，舍不得花钱。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is very stingy and unwilling to spend money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好單襟，一蚊都唔捨得使。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 daan1 kam1, jat1 man1 dou1 m4 se2 dak1 sai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的很吝啬，一毛钱都不舍得花。
examples.english_sentence: He's really stingy, unwilling to spend even a dime.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁單襟啦，請你食餐飯啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 daan1 kam1 laa1, cheng2 nei5 sik6 caan1 faan6 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么小气啦，请你吃顿饭而已。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stingy, it's just treating you to a meal.

english_meaning: single parent
explanation_mandarin: 指只有一位父亲或母亲的家庭。
explanation_english: Referring to a family with only one parent (either father or mother).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個單親媽媽，湊大兩個小朋友好辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 daan1 can1 maa1 maa1, cou3 daai6 loeng5 go3 siu2 pang4 jau5 hou2 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她是一位单亲妈妈，带大两个小孩很辛苦。
examples.english_sentence: She is a single mother, it's very hard raising two children.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港越來越多單親家庭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 jyuet6 lai5 yuet6 do1 daan1 can1 gaa1 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港越来越多的单亲家庭。
examples.english_sentence: There are more and more single-parent families in Hong Kong.

english_meaning: Single-parent family
explanation_mandarin: 指只有一个父亲或母亲的家庭。
explanation_english: A family with only one parent, either a father or a mother.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺單親家庭長大，所以特別獨立。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 daan1 can1 gaa1 ting4 zoeng2 daai6, so2 ji5 dak6 bit1 duk6 laap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她在单亲家庭长大，所以特别独立。
examples.english_sentence: He/She grew up in a single-parent family, so he/she is particularly independent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家香港嘅單親家庭越來越多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 daan1 can1 gaa1 ting4 jyuet6 lai4 jyuet6 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在香港的单亲家庭越来越多。
examples.english_sentence: There are more and more single-parent families in Hong Kong nowadays.

english_meaning: word
explanation_mandarin: 语言中最小的、有意义的单位。
explanation_english: A single distinct meaningful element of speech or writing, used with others (or sometimes alone) to form a sentence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋今日學咗十個單詞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gam1 jat6 hok6 zo2 sap6 go3 daan1 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们今天学了十个单词。
examples.english_sentence: They learned ten words today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個單詞點解呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 daan1 ci4 dim2 gaai2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个单词是什么意思？
examples.english_sentence: What does this word mean?

english_meaning: monotonous, dull, boring
explanation_mandarin: 指事物缺乏变化，枯燥乏味。
explanation_english: Describes something lacking variety, being uninteresting and tedious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 日日都做同一份工，真係好單調。

mandarin_meaning: 表示惊讶、疑问、提醒等语气
english_meaning: Indicates surprise, doubt, reminder, etc. (exclamatory particle)
explanation_mandarin: 语气词，通常用于句末，表示惊讶、疑问、提醒、不满等语气。具体含义需要根据语境判断。
explanation_english: An exclamatory particle, usually used at the end of a sentence to express surprise, doubt, reminder, dissatisfaction, etc. The specific meaning depends on the context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嘩，你又買咁多嘢喲！
examples.jyutping_sentence: waa1, nei5 jau6 maai5 gam3 do1 je5 jo1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哇，你又买这么多东西呀！
examples.english_sentence: Wow, you bought so much stuff again!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔記得帶鎖匙喲？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 so2 si4 jo1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你忘记带钥匙了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Did you forget to bring the keys?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，快啲啦喲！
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, faai3 di1 laa1 jo1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，快点啦！
examples.english_sentence: Hey, hurry up!

english_meaning: Yes, Ok, Right (used as a response to an order or instruction)
explanation_mandarin: 表示答应或顺从，通常用于下级对上级的回复。
explanation_english: Indicates agreement or compliance, typically used by subordinates to superiors in response to an order or instruction. It implies a quick acknowledgment and willingness to obey.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿 Sir，喳！我即刻去做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 si4, zaa1! ngo5 zik1 hak1 heoi3 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师，是！我立刻去做。
examples.english_sentence: Yes Sir! I'll do it right away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你聽日交份報告俾我，喳？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ting1 jat6 gaau1 fan6 bou3 gou3 bei2 ngo5, zaa1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你明天把报告交给我，好吗？
examples.english_sentence: Hand in the report to me tomorrow, okay?

english_meaning: Che Chaan, a type of sweet dessert soup
explanation_mandarin: 一种港式甜品，主要材料包括西米、芋头、红豆、绿豆、椰奶等。
explanation_english: Che Chaan is a popular Hong Kong-style dessert soup. The main ingredients usually include sago, taro, red beans, mung beans, and coconut milk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想飲碗喳咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 jam2 wun2 caa1 zaa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想喝一碗喳咋。
examples.english_sentence: I want to have a bowl of Che Chaan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間糖水鋪嘅喳咋好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 tong2 seoi2 pou3 ge3 caa1 zaa2 hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家糖水店的喳咋很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The Che Chaan in this dessert shop is delicious.

english_meaning: to chatter, to be garrulous, to be nosy, talkative (often in an annoying way)
explanation_mandarin: 形容人说话多，而且内容琐碎，令人厌烦。
explanation_english: Describes someone who talks a lot, often about trivial things, in a way that is annoying to others. It can also imply being nosy or sticking one's nose into other people's business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁喳喳啦，靜啲得唔得啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 zaa1 zaa1 laa1, zing6 di1 dak1 m4 dak1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么啰嗦了，安静点行不行啊？
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so chatty, can you be quiet for a bit?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好喳喳，成日問埋晒啲唔關事嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 zaa1 zaa1, seng4 jat6 man6 maai4 saai3 di1 m4 gwaan1 si6 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很爱多嘴，整天问一些无关紧要的事情。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very nosy person, always asking about things that don't concern him.

english_meaning: dripping wet, soaking wet
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常潮湿，水淋淋的状态。
explanation_english: Describes a state of being extremely wet, dripping wet, or soaked.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先落咗場大雨，全身濕晒，真係喳喳淋呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 lok6 zo2 coeng4 daai6 jyu5, cyun4 san1 sap1 saai3, zan1 hai6 zaa1 zaa1 lam4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才下了一场大雨，全身都湿透了，真是湿淋淋的！
examples.english_sentence: It rained heavily just now, my whole body is wet, I'm really soaking wet!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 洗完頭唔吹乾，啲頭髮就喳喳淋，好易感冒嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai2 jyun4 tau4 m4 ceoi1 gon1, di1 tau4 faat3 zau6 zaa1 zaa1 lam4, hou2 ji6 gam2 mou6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 洗完头不吹干，头发就会湿淋淋的，很容易感冒的。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't dry your hair after washing it, it will be dripping wet, and you can easily catch a cold.

mandarin_meaning: 吱吱喳喳, 抱怨, 絮絮叨叨
english_meaning: To complain noisily and incessantly, to nag, to chatter loudly, to make a fuss
explanation_mandarin: 形容人不停地发出抱怨或不满的声音，类似于“吱吱喳喳”或“絮絮叨叨”。通常带有负面含义，表示厌烦或不满。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is constantly complaining or expressing dissatisfaction, similar to "chattering loudly" or "nagging". It usually carries a negative connotation, indicating annoyance or dissatisfaction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再喺度喳喳聲啦，好嘈呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 hai2 dou6 zaa1 zaa1 seng1 laa1, hou2 cou4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再在这里抱怨了，好吵啊！
examples.english_sentence: Stop complaining here, it's so noisy!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都喺度喳喳聲，真係好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai2 dou6 zaa1 zaa1 seng1, zan1 hai6 hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天都在那里抱怨，真是很烦。
examples.english_sentence: He's always complaining, it's so annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細一唔滿意就喺度喳喳聲，搞到個個都好大壓力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 jat1 m4 mun5 ji3 zau6 hai2 dou6 zaa1 zaa1 seng1, gaau2 dou3 go3 go3 dou1 hou2 daai6 aat3 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板一不满意就在那里抱怨，弄得每个人都压力很大。
examples.english_sentence: The boss complains whenever he's not satisfied, putting a lot of pressure on everyone.

english_meaning: Is that so? Really?
explanation_mandarin: 表示疑问或惊讶的语气词，通常用于回应别人的话语，表示不确定或者反问。
explanation_english: An interjection expressing doubt, surprise, or seeking confirmation. It's typically used in response to something someone says, indicating uncertainty or a question.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢中咗六合彩，喳嘛？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 zung1 zo2 luk6 hap6 coi2, zaa1 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他中了六合彩，是吗？
examples.english_sentence: He said he won the lottery, is that so?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話佢唔嚟？喳嘛？尋日先話嚟咋喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 keoi5 m4 lai4? zaa1 maa3? cam4 jat6 sin1 waa6 lai4 zaa3 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说他不来？真的吗？昨天才说要来啊。
examples.english_sentence: You said he's not coming? Really? He just said he would come yesterday.

english_meaning: To argue, to bicker, to quarrel, to dispute (often in a petty or childish way)
explanation_mandarin: 形容为了一些小事情而争吵，不停地争辩，通常带有轻微的贬义，指争吵得没有意义。
explanation_english: Describes arguing or bickering over trivial matters, often with a slightly negative connotation, implying that the argument is meaningless or childish. It emphasizes the repetitive and pointless nature of the dispute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩姊妹成日都為咗啲小事喳篤撐，好鬼嘈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 zi2 mui6 sing4 jat6 dou1 wai6 zo2 di1 siu2 si6 zaa1 duk1 caang1, hou2 gwai2 cou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她们两姐妹总是为了一些小事吵架，很吵。
examples.english_sentence: Those two sisters are always arguing over trivial things, it's very noisy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再喳篤撐啦，解決唔到問題㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 zaa1 duk1 caang1 laa1, gaai2 kyut3 m4 dou2 man6 tai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再争论了，解决不了问题的。
examples.english_sentence: Stop arguing, it won't solve the problem.

english_meaning: powerful, imposing, awesome, impressive
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人或事物具有令人敬畏的气势或力量。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something that has an awe-inspiring aura or power.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢揸住架跑車，真係好喴呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zaa1 zyu6 gaa3 paau2 ce1, zan1 hai6 hou2 wai1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他开着跑车，真是有气势啊！
examples.english_sentence: He's driving a sports car, he looks really impressive!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司好喴水，好多人都想入去做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 hou2 wai1 seoi2, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 soeng2 jap6 heoi3 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司很有实力，很多人都想进去工作。
examples.english_sentence: This company is very powerful/impressive, many people want to work there.

mandarin_meaning: 形容速度很快，风驰电掣
english_meaning: Describing something moving very fast; zooming; whizzing
explanation_mandarin: 形容动作或事情进行得非常迅速，带有快速移动的声响或形象感。
explanation_english: Describes something happening or moving very quickly, often implying a rushing sound or a vivid sense of speed. It suggests a sudden and rapid movement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢架車一嚟就喴𠴈𠴈咁飛走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaa3 ce1 jat1 lai4 zau6 wei1 ma1 ma1 gam2 fei1 zou2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的车一来就嗖的一声飞走了。
examples.english_sentence: His car came and zoomed away immediately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲風喴𠴈𠴈咁吹過，好鬼大風啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 fung1 wei1 ma1 ma1 gam2 cheui1 gwo3, hou2 gwai2 daai6 fung1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 风嗖嗖地吹过，风好大啊！
examples.english_sentence: The wind whizzed past, it's very windy!

english_meaning: Meow (onomatopoeia for cat sound)
explanation_mandarin: 模拟猫的叫声。
explanation_english: Imitates the sound a cat makes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻貓成日喺度喵喵叫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 maau1 seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 miu1 miu1 giu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那只猫总是在这里喵喵叫。
examples.english_sentence: That cat is always meowing here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢扮貓叫，喵一聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baan6 maau1 giu3, miu1 jat1 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他模仿猫叫，喵一声。
examples.english_sentence: He imitated a cat's meow, 'meow'.

english_meaning: Cat people, people from Cat Planet (referring to cats)
explanation_mandarin: 对猫咪的一种爱称，指猫咪来自别的星球，自带神秘感和萌属性。
explanation_english: A term of endearment for cats, suggesting that they come from another planet, possessing inherent mystery and cuteness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屋企嗰隻喵星人好嗲㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 uk1 kei2 go2 zek3 miu1 sing1 yan4 hou2 de2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我家的猫星人很会撒娇。
examples.english_sentence: My cat is very affectionate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇下，佢又喺度扮喵星人，瞓到四腳朝天。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 haa5, keoi5 jau6 hai2 dou6 baan6 miu1 sing1 yan4, fan3 dou3 sei3 goek3 ciu4 tin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看，它又在那里装猫星人，睡得四脚朝天。
examples.english_sentence: Look, it's pretending to be a cat person again, sleeping upside down.

english_meaning: at, in, on (location); to be at, to be in, to be on
explanation_mandarin: 表示位置或处所；表示存在。
explanation_english: Indicates location or place; indicates existence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在家。
examples.english_sentence: I am at home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 本書喺檯上面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun2 syu1 hai2 toi2 soeng6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 书在桌子上面。
examples.english_sentence: The book is on the table.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺度做緊嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 dou6 zou6 gan2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在那里工作。
examples.english_sentence: He is working there.

english_meaning: Alright then / Fine / Whatever
explanation_mandarin: 表示无奈，勉强同意，或者敷衍了事。
explanation_english: Expresses resignation, reluctant agreement, or dismissing something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺啦，由得佢啦，唔好理佢咁多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 laa1, jau4 dak1 keoi5 laa1, m4 hou2 lei5 keoi5 gam3 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 好吧，随他去吧，别管他那么多了。
examples.english_sentence: Alright then, let him do what he wants, don't bother with him so much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺啦喺啦，我知啦，唔使你再講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 laa1 hai2 laa1, ngo5 zi1 laa3, m4 sai2 nei5 zoi3 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 好了好了，我知道了，不用你再说了。
examples.english_sentence: Alright, alright, I know, you don't need to say it again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話乜就乜啦，喺啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 mat1 zau6 mat1 laa1, hai2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说什么就是什么吧，行了。
examples.english_sentence: Whatever you say, fine.

mandarin_meaning: 在这里; 在那里; 正在
english_meaning: here; there; at; in; present progressive aspect marker (similar to '-ing' in English)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 介词; 副词; 助词
explanation_mandarin: 指示方位，表示“在这里”或“在那里”；表示动作正在进行中，类似于“正在”；表示人或事物存在。
explanation_english: Indicates location, meaning 'here' or 'there'; indicates an action in progress, similar to '-ing' in English (present progressive aspect); indicates the existence of a person or thing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺度等你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 dou6 dang2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在这里等你。
examples.english_sentence: I'm here waiting for you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你喺度做緊乜嘢啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai2 dou6 zou6 gan2 mat1 je5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在这里做什么呢？
examples.english_sentence: What are you doing here?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺度㗎，唔使擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 dou6 gaa3, m4 sai2 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在那儿呢，不用担心。
examples.english_sentence: He is there, don't worry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺度睇緊電視。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 dou6 tai2 gan2 din6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我正在看电视。
examples.english_sentence: I am watching TV.

english_meaning: to eat here, to dine in
explanation_mandarin: 表示在某个地方吃东西，与“外卖”相对。
explanation_english: Indicates the act of eating food at a specific location, as opposed to taking it away (takeout/takeaway).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想喺度食，唔想拎走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 hai2 dou6 sik6, m4 soeng2 ling1 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想在这里吃，不想带走。
examples.english_sentence: I want to eat here, I don't want to take it away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日我哋喺度食啦，唔好煮飯咁麻煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 ngo5 dei6 hai2 dou6 sik6 laa1, m4 hou2 zyu2 faan6 gam3 maa4 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天我们在这里吃吧，不要煮饭那么麻烦。
examples.english_sentence: Let's eat here today, it's too much trouble to cook.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你喺度食定拎走啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai2 dou6 sik6 ding6 ling1 zau2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在这里吃还是带走啊？
examples.english_sentence: Are you eating here or taking it away?

english_meaning: at (a place); in (a place); there
explanation_mandarin: 表示位置，相当于“在...地方”。
explanation_english: Indicates location, equivalent to "at/in a place"; can also simply mean "there".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺處等緊你啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 cyu3 dang2 gan2 nei5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在那里等你啊。
examples.english_sentence: He's waiting for you there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你喺處做乜嘢啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai2 cyu3 zou6 mat1 je5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在那里做什么啊？
examples.english_sentence: What are you doing there?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺處住咗好耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 cyu3 zyu6 zo2 hou2 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在这里住了很久了。
examples.english_sentence: I've lived here for a long time.

english_meaning: Here; There; At this/that place
explanation_mandarin: 表示地点，相当于“在这里”或“在那里”，强调地点。
explanation_english: Indicates a location; equivalent to "here" or "there." It emphasizes the location.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺道等你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 dou6 dang2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在这里等你。
examples.english_sentence: I'll wait for you here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 本書喺道，你自己攞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun2 syu1 hai2 dou6, nei5 zi6 gei2 lo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 书就在这里，你自己拿。
examples.english_sentence: The book is here, take it yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔喺道，我唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hai2 dou6, ngo5 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不在，我不知道怎么办才好。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know what to do without you here.

english_meaning: to illustrate; to make an analogy; to compare; metaphor; analogy
explanation_mandarin: 用相似的事物打比方来说明道理。也可以指比喻本身。
explanation_english: To illustrate or explain something by comparing it to a similar thing; metaphor, analogy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日用啲好生動嘅例子去喻佢嘅意思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 yung6 di1 hou2 sang1 dung6 ge3 lai6 zi2 heoi3 jyu6 keoi5 ge3 yi3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是用一些很生动的例子来比喻他的意思。
examples.english_sentence: He always uses vivid examples to illustrate his meaning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個比喻好貼切，容易明白。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 bei2 jyu6 hou2 tip3 cit3, jung4 yi6 ming4 baak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个比喻很贴切，容易明白。
examples.english_sentence: This analogy is very apt and easy to understand.

english_meaning: to be regarded as; to be considered as; to be likened to
explanation_english: To regard something as something else; to consider something to be something else; to compare something to something else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅演技畀人喻為本地嘅羅拔迪尼路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jin2 gei6 bei2 jan4 jyu6 wai4 bun2 dei6 ge3 lo4 bat6 dik1 nei4 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的演技被人们誉为本地的罗伯特·德尼罗。
examples.english_sentence: His acting is regarded as the local Robert De Niro.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅食物質素畀人喻為城中最佳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 sik6 mat6 zat1 so3 bei2 jan4 jyu6 wai4 sing4 zung1 zeoi3 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物质量被誉为城中最佳。
examples.english_sentence: The food quality of this restaurant is regarded as the best in the city.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日唔講嘢，畀人喻為沉默嘅羔羊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 m4 gong2 je5, bei2 jan4 jyu6 wai4 cam4 mak6 ge3 gou1 joeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是沉默寡言，被人比作沉默的羔羊。
examples.english_sentence: He's always quiet, and is regarded as a silent lamb.

english_meaning: to regard as; to consider as; to be likened to
explanation_mandarin: 把A比作B；认为A是B。
explanation_english: To regard something (A) as another thing (B); to consider A to be B; to liken A to B.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅成就被喻為醫學界嘅奇蹟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing4 zau6 bei6 jyu6 wai4 ji1 hok6 gaai3 ge3 kei4 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的成就被视为医学界的奇迹。
examples.english_sentence: His achievements are regarded as a miracle in the medical field.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個發明可以喻為係廿一世紀嘅印刷術。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 faat3 ming4 ho2 ji5 jyu6 wai4 hai6 jaa6 jat1 sai3 gei2 ge3 yin3 caat3 seot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个发明可以被视为21世纪的印刷术。
examples.english_sentence: This invention can be regarded as the printing technology of the 21st century.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅作品俾人喻為現代藝術嘅典範。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zok3 ban2 bei2 jan4 jyu6 wai4 hiu3 doi6 ngai6 seot6 ge3 din2 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的作品被人们视为现代艺术的典范。
examples.english_sentence: His works are regarded as a model of modern art.

english_meaning: suitcase; trunk; luggage
explanation_mandarin: 粤语，指手提箱或行李箱。
explanation_english: Cantonese slang for suitcase or luggage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我執好晒啲嘢落喼度喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zaap1 hou2晒 di1 je5 lok6 gip1 dou6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已经把所有的东西都收拾好放进箱子里了。
examples.english_sentence: I've already packed everything into the suitcase.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個喼太重喇，我攞唔郁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 gip1 taai3 cung5 laa3, ngo5 lo2 m4 juk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个行李箱太重了，我拿不动。
examples.english_sentence: This suitcase is too heavy, I can't lift it.

english_meaning: Flat cap, newsboy cap, ivy cap
explanation_mandarin: 一种帽子，帽檐短而硬，向前突出，帽身较扁平。
explanation_english: A type of cap with a short, stiff peak (visor) and a rounded, flat body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日戴住頂喼帽，好有型。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 daai3 zyu6 ding2 gip1 mou2, hou2 jau5 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是戴着一顶鸭舌帽，很有型。
examples.english_sentence: He always wears a flat cap; he looks very stylish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢頂喼帽幾襯你嘅衫喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ding2 gip1 mou2 gei2 can3 nei5 ge3 saam1 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这顶鸭舌帽很配你的衣服哦。
examples.english_sentence: This flat cap matches your clothes well.

english_meaning: Fit (in good physical shape); muscular; well-toned
explanation_mandarin: 形容身体健康，肌肉结实，体态健美。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is in good physical shape, with well-defined muscles, and a healthy physique. Often used to compliment someone on their fitness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日去健身室，操到勁喼弗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 heoi3 gin6 san1 sat1, cou1 dou3 ging6 gip1 fat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都去健身房，练得非常健美。
examples.english_sentence: He goes to the gym every day and has worked out to be very fit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嘩，你最近好喼弗喎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: waa1, nei5 zeoi3 gan6 hou2 gip1 fat1 wo3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哇，你最近身材真好！
examples.english_sentence: Wow, you're looking very fit lately!

english_meaning: briefcase gun, suitcase gun
explanation_mandarin: 指藏在手提箱里的枪。
explanation_english: Refers to a gun hidden inside a briefcase or suitcase.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲電影成日都有人用喼槍㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 din6 jing2 seng4 jat6 dou1 jau5 jan4 yung6 gip1 coeng1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电影里经常有人用手提箱手枪。
examples.english_sentence: In movies, people often use briefcase guns.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打開個喼，裡面竟然係一支喼槍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 hoi1 go3 gip1, leoi5 min6 ging2 jin4 hai6 jat1 zi1 gip1 coeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他打开手提箱，里面竟然是一把手提箱手枪。
examples.english_sentence: He opened the briefcase, and surprisingly there was a briefcase gun inside.

english_meaning: Worcestershire sauce
explanation_mandarin: 香港人对Worcestershire sauce (伍斯特沙司) 的粤语口语称呼，来源于其英文发音。
explanation_english: Cantonese colloquial term for Worcestershire sauce, derived from its English pronunciation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食炸嘢點啲喼汁好好味㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 zaa3 je5 dim2 di1 gip1 zap1 hou2 hou2 mei6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 炸的东西蘸点伍斯特沙司很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: It's delicious to dip fried food in Worcestershire sauce.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋屋企成日都用喼汁嚟醃豬扒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei5 seng4 jat6 dou1 yung6 gip1 zap1 lai4 yim1 jyu1 paa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们家经常用伍斯特沙司来腌猪扒。
examples.english_sentence: My family often uses Worcestershire sauce to marinate pork chops.

english_meaning: cheat sheet, crib sheet
explanation_mandarin: 指考试时偷偷携带的，写有考试相关内容的纸条，通常藏在隐蔽的地方，用于作弊。
explanation_english: Refers to a piece of paper containing notes related to an exam, usually hidden and used for cheating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試千祈唔好帶喼紙啊，俾人捉到就弊傢伙啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si5 cin1 kei4 m4 hou2 daai3 gip1 zi2 aa3, bei2 jan4 zuk1 dou2 zau6 bai6 gaa1 fo3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试千万不要带小抄啊，被抓到就糟糕了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't ever bring a cheat sheet to the exam, it would be terrible if you got caught.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試嗰陣偷偷雞咁攞咗張喼紙出嚟睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 go2 zan6 tau1 tau1 gai1 gam2 lo2 zo2 zoeng1 gip1 zi2 chut1 lai4 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试的时候偷偷地拿出小抄来看。
examples.english_sentence: He secretly took out a cheat sheet to look at during the exam.

english_meaning: What? (asking for repetition)
explanation_mandarin: 表示没听清楚，要求对方再说一遍。
explanation_english: Used to indicate that you did not hear or understand something and are asking someone to repeat it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你頭先講乜嘢呀？嗄？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tau4 sin1 gong2 mat1 je5 aa3? aa4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你刚才说什么？ 嗄？
examples.english_sentence: What did you just say? What?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗄？我聽唔清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa4? ngo5 teng1 m4 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 什么？我没听清楚。
examples.english_sentence: What? I didn't hear you clearly.

english_meaning: to smell, to sniff
explanation_mandarin: 用鼻子辨别气味。
explanation_english: To perceive or detect odors by means of the olfactory sense; to sniff.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嗅到一陣燒焦味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cau3 dou2 jat1 zan6 siu1 ziu1 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我闻到一股烧焦的味道。
examples.english_sentence: I smell a burnt smell.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻狗喺度嗅嚟嗅去，好似搵緊嘢噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 gau2 hai2 dou6 cau3 lai4 cau3 heoi3, hou2 ci5 wan2 gan2 je5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那只狗在那里闻来闻去，好像在找东西。
examples.english_sentence: The dog is sniffing around, as if it's looking for something.

english_meaning: sense of smell
explanation_mandarin: 辨别气味的感觉能力。
explanation_english: The ability to perceive smells; the sense of smell.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅嗅覺好靈敏，一聞就聞到嗰陣味係咩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 cau3 gok3 hou2 ling4 man5, jat1 man4 zau6 man4 dou2 go2 zan6 mei6 hai6 me1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的嗅觉很灵敏，一闻就闻到那味道是什么。
examples.english_sentence: His sense of smell is very sensitive, he can smell what the scent is as soon as he smells it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 感冒嘅時候，我嘅嗅覺好似差咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam2 mou6 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 ge3 cau3 gok3 hou2 ci5 caa1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 感冒的时候，我的嗅觉好像变差了。
examples.english_sentence: When I have a cold, my sense of smell seems to get worse.

english_meaning: to choke; to irritate; to be pungent; to speak sharply; to retort; to confront
explanation_mandarin: 1. (动词)食物或液体进入气管引起咳嗽或呼吸困难。2. (动词)用言语顶撞或反驳。3. (形容词)味道刺激。
explanation_english: 1. (verb) To choke, usually due to food or liquid entering the trachea. 2. (verb) To retort or argue back sharply. 3. (adjective) Pungent, irritating (e.g., a smell or taste).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飲水飲到嗆親。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yam2 seoi2 yam2 dou3 coeng3 can1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喝水呛到了。
examples.english_sentence: I choked while drinking water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁嗆我啦，我知錯㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 coeng3 ngo5 laa1, ngo5 zi1 co3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这样呛我啦，我知道错了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk back to me like that, I know I was wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個辣椒好嗆鼻㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 laat6 ziu1 hou2 coeng3 bei6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个辣椒很呛鼻子。
examples.english_sentence: This chili is very pungent.

english_meaning: stingy, miserly, parsimonious
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常小气，不愿意花钱。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is very stingy and unwilling to spend money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好嗇，一蚊都唔捨得用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 sik1, jat1 man1 dou1 m4 se2 dak1 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很吝啬，一分钱都不舍得花。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very stingy person, unwilling to spend even a single dollar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁嗇啦，請我飲杯嘢啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 sik1 laa1, ceng2 ngo5 jam2 bui1 je5 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么吝啬啦，请我喝杯东西而已。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stingy, just buy me a drink.

english_meaning: so; like this; such
explanation_mandarin: 表示情况、状态，相当于“这样”、“如此”。
explanation_english: Indicates a situation or state, equivalent to "so", "like this", or "such". Often used in rhetorical questions or statements to express exasperation or disbelief.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你點解可以咁樣做㗎？你點解可以噉樣做㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dim2 gaai2 ho2 ji5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 gaa3? nei5 dim2 gaai2 ho2 ji5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你为什么可以这样做呢？
examples.english_sentence: Why could you do something like this?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你點解可以咁樣講嘢㗎？你点解可以噉样讲嘢㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dim2 gaai2 ho2 ji5 gam2 joeng2 gong2 je5 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你为什么可以这样说话呢？
examples.english_sentence: Why can you say something like that?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 點解咁樣都得㗎？点解噉样都得㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: dim2 gaai2 gam2 joeng2 dou1 dak1 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为什么这样都可以呢？
examples.english_sentence: How can that be acceptable?
