english_meaning: to shout, to yell, to call out, to order (food)
explanation_mandarin: 表示大声叫喊，呼叫。有时也指点餐。
explanation_english: Indicates to shout loudly, to yell. Sometimes also refers to ordering food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁大聲嗌啦，嘈到我喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 seng1 aai3 laa1, cou4 dou3 ngo5 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么大声叫喊了，吵到我了！
examples.english_sentence: Don't shout so loudly, you're disturbing me!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺餐廳嗌咗碟炒飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 caan1 teng1 aai3 zo2 dip6 caau2 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在餐厅点了一盘炒饭。
examples.english_sentence: I ordered a plate of fried rice at the restaurant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗌佢嚟幫手啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: aai3 keoi5 lai4 bong1 sau2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 叫他来帮忙吧！
examples.english_sentence: Call him to come and help!

english_meaning: to quarrel, to argue, to have a fight (verbal)
explanation_mandarin: 指因为意见不合而激烈争吵。
explanation_english: Refers to arguing vehemently due to disagreement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日都為咗啲小事嗌交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 jat6 dou1 wai6 zo2 di1 siu2 si6 aai3 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们总是因为一些小事吵架。
examples.english_sentence: They always quarrel over trivial matters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日同你女朋友嗌交啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 tung4 nei5 neoi5 pang4 jau5 aai3 gaau1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是跟你女朋友吵架了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always quarrel with your girlfriend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個嗌交嗌到好犀利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 aai3 gaau1 aai3 dou3 hou2 sai1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个吵架吵得很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: They were arguing fiercely.

mandarin_meaning: 叫人; 喊人; 招呼人
english_meaning: to call someone; to shout for someone; to invite someone
explanation_mandarin: 指呼唤某人，可以是叫喊，也可以是邀请。根据语境有不同的含义。
explanation_english: Refers to calling someone, which can be shouting or inviting. The meaning varies depending on the context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嗌人嚟幫手啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aai3 jan4 lai4 bong1 sau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我叫人来帮忙吧。
examples.english_sentence: I'll call someone to help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺度嗌人，唔知做乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 dou6 aai3 jan4, m4 zi1 dou1 zou6 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在那里喊人，不知道干什么。
examples.english_sentence: He's shouting for someone there, I don't know what he's doing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚嗌人一齐食饭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 aai3 jan4 jat1 cai4 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚叫人一起吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: Let's invite people to have dinner together tonight.

english_meaning: to call for a breakup, to threaten to break up
explanation_mandarin: 指情侣之间因为争吵或矛盾而提出分手，通常带有情绪化的成分，不一定是最终决定。
explanation_english: To call for a breakup (in a relationship), often during an argument or disagreement. It implies a heated exchange and may not necessarily mean a final decision to end the relationship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日嗌分手，但係又唔會真係分。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 aai3 fan1 sau2, daan6 hai6 jau6 m4 wui5 zan1 hai6 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们经常吵着要分手，但是又不会真的分。
examples.english_sentence: They often threaten to break up, but they never actually do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日嗌分手嚟威脅人啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 aai3 fan1 sau2 lai4 wai1 hip3 jan4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要老是吵着分手来威胁人啦。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always threaten to break up to manipulate people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次佢哋嗌分手，好似係認真嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 keoi5 dei6 aai3 fan1 sau2, hou2 ci5 hai6 jing6 zan1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次他们吵着分手，好像是认真的。
examples.english_sentence: This time when they threatened to break up, it seems serious.

mandarin_meaning: 用麦克风讲话 / 喊麦
english_meaning: to speak into a microphone / to shout into a microphone (often in a performing or promotional context)
explanation_mandarin: 指使用麦克风说话，有时特指在舞台上或街头表演时喊麦，进行宣传或其他表演。
explanation_english: Refers to speaking into a microphone. Sometimes, it specifically refers to shouting into a microphone during a stage performance or street performance, for promotion or other performances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺街頭度嗌咪宣傳新產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gaai1 tau4 dou6 aai3 mai1 syun1 cyun4 san1 caan2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在街头用麦克风宣传新产品。
examples.english_sentence: He's using a microphone on the street to promote new products.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 演唱會嗰陣，歌手經常要嗌咪同觀眾互動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin2 coeng3 wui2 go2 zan6, go1 sau2 ging1 seong4 jiu3 aai3 mai1 tung4 gun1 zung3 wu6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演唱会的时候，歌手经常要用麦克风和观众互动。
examples.english_sentence: During concerts, singers often have to use the microphone to interact with the audience.

synonyms: 咪高峰講嘢 (mai1 gaau1 fung1 gong2 je5)

english_meaning: to shout for help, to cry for help
explanation_mandarin: 遇到危险或紧急情况时大声呼喊求救。
explanation_english: To shout loudly for help when facing danger or an emergency.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢跌咗落海，即刻嗌救命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dit3 zo2 lok6 hoi2, zik1 hak1 aai3 gau3 ming6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他掉进海里，立刻喊救命。
examples.english_sentence: He fell into the sea and immediately cried for help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到有人嗌救命，我哋即刻跑過去睇下發生咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou2 jau5 jan4 aai3 gau3 ming6, ngo5 dei6 zik1 hak1 paau2 gwo3 heoi3 tai2 haa5 faat3 sang1 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到有人喊救命，我们立刻跑过去看看发生了什么事。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing someone cry for help, we immediately ran over to see what was happening.

english_meaning: to settle accounts; to tally up; to demand payment
explanation_mandarin: 指结算账目，或者催讨欠款。
explanation_english: Refers to settling accounts or demanding payment of debts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚食完飯就嗌數啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan1 sik6 jyun4 faan6 zau6 aai3 sou3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚吃完饭就结账吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's settle the bill after dinner tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都唔找數，我哋要嗌數先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 m4 zaau2 sou3, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 aai3 sou3 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是不还钱，我们得催他算账才行。
examples.english_sentence: He never pays back, we need to demand payment from him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆， 埋單 嗌數！
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2, maai4 daan1 aai3 sou3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板，结账！
examples.english_sentence: Boss, bill please! (Settle the account!)

english_meaning: to shout oneself hoarse; to scream until one's throat is sore
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常大声地呼喊，以至于嗓子都喊哑了。
explanation_english: Describes shouting very loudly, to the point of losing one's voice or making one's throat sore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我點嗌破喉嚨佢都聽唔到，佢戴住耳機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dim2 aai3 po3 hau4 lung4 keoi5 dou1 teng1 m4 dou2, keoi5 daai3 zyu6 ji5 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我怎么声嘶力竭地喊他都听不见，他戴着耳机。
examples.english_sentence: No matter how much I shout myself hoarse, he can't hear me. He's wearing headphones.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺演唱會上面，啲歌迷嗌破喉嚨咁支持佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 jin2 coeng3 wui2 soeng6 min6, di1 go1 mai4 aai3 po3 hau4 lung4 gam2 zi1 ci4 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在演唱会上，歌迷们声嘶力竭地支持他。
examples.english_sentence: At the concert, the fans shouted themselves hoarse in support of him.

english_meaning: to shout all over the street; to yell out loudly in public
explanation_mandarin: 形容人大声喊叫，声音传遍整个街道。 通常用于描述某人情绪激动或急切地呼喊。
explanation_english: Describes someone shouting loudly, with their voice echoing throughout the street. It usually refers to someone shouting in an agitated or urgent manner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試肥佬，喺條街度嗌通街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 fei4 lou2, hai2 tiu4 gaai1 dou6 aai3 tung1 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试不及格，在街上大声喊叫。
examples.english_sentence: He failed the exam and was shouting all over the street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁大聲嗌通街啦，好嘈㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 seng1 aai3 tung1 gaai1 laa1, hou2 cou4 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么大声在街上喊，很吵的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't shout so loudly in the street, it's very noisy!

english_meaning: to make a fuss, to create a scene, to quarrel noisily
explanation_mandarin: 指大声吵闹、争吵，制造混乱或不愉快的气氛。
explanation_english: Refers to making a loud noise or quarrel, creating chaos or an unpleasant atmosphere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺度嗌霎啦，阻住晒人！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 aai3 saap3 laa1, zo2 zyu6 saai3 jan4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要在这里吵闹了，挡着别人了！
examples.english_sentence: Don't make a fuss here, you're blocking everyone!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日都因為啲小事嗌霎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 dou1 jan1 wai6 di1 siu2 si6 aai3 saap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们经常因为一些小事争吵。
examples.english_sentence: They often quarrel over trivial matters.

english_meaning: to suck; to sip
explanation_mandarin: 用嘴唇和舌头吸取液体或固体。
explanation_english: To suck or sip something using the mouth, lips, and tongue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嗍緊支冰條。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sok3 gan2 zi1 bing1 tiu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他正在吮吸冰棍。
examples.english_sentence: He is sucking on an ice pop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁大聲嗍麵啦，好嘈呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 seng1 sok3 min6 laa1, hou2 cou4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么大声地吸面了，很吵啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't slurp the noodles so loudly, it's noisy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嗍咗啖湯，話好夠味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sok3 zo2 daam6 tong1, waa6 hou2 gau3 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他啜了一口汤，说很有味道。
examples.english_sentence: He sipped the soup and said it was flavorful.

english_meaning: To inhale sharply; to gasp (usually from shock or fear); to suck in air.
explanation_mandarin: 指快速地、突然地吸入空气。通常表示惊讶、恐惧或痛苦等情绪时产生的生理反应。
explanation_english: Refers to a quick and sudden inhalation of air. It usually indicates a physiological reaction caused by emotions like surprise, fear, or pain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽到個消息之後，即刻嗍咗啖氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teng1 dou2 go3 siu1 sik1 zi1 hau6, zik1 hak1 sok3 zo2 daam6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他听到消息后，立刻倒吸了一口气。
examples.english_sentence: After hearing the news, he immediately gasped.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇到咁恐怖嘅畫面，我忍唔住嗍氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 dou2 gam3 hung2 bou3 ge3 waa2 min6, ngo5 jan2 m4 zyu6 sok3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到这么恐怖的画面，我忍不住倒吸了一口气。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing such a horrifying scene, I couldn't help but gasp.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到佢哋離婚，我真係嗍咗啖氣，太突然喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 dou2 keoi5 dei6 lei4 fan1, ngo5 zan1 hai6 sok3 zo2 daam6 hei3, taai3 dat6 jin4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到他们离婚，我真是倒吸了一口气，太突然了。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing that they got divorced, I really gasped; it was so sudden.

english_meaning: To freeload; to sponge off someone; to take advantage of someone; to exploit.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻不劳而获，占别人的便宜。多指在工作或关系中，利用对方的资源或能力，自己却不付出相应的努力或代价。
explanation_english: A metaphor for gaining benefits without effort; to take advantage of others. It often refers to exploiting someone's resources or abilities in work or relationships without putting in the corresponding effort or cost.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺公司嗍水，咩都唔做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 gung1 si1 sok3 seoi2, me1 dou1 m4 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天在公司混日子，什么都不做。
examples.english_sentence: He freeloads at the company all day, doing nothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日嗍我水啦，自己搵份工做下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 sok3 ngo5 seoi2 laa1, zi6 gei2 wan2 fan6 gung1 zou6 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别老是占我便宜了，自己找份工作做吧。
examples.english_sentence: Stop sponging off me all the time; go and find a job yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗住可以一路嗍水，總有一日會俾人發現㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 nam2 zyu6 ho2 ji5 jat1 lou6 sok3 seoi2, zung2 jau5 jat1 jat6 wui5 bei2 jan4 faat3 yin6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要想着可以一直占便宜，总有一天会被人发现的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can get away with freeloading forever; one day you'll get caught.

english_meaning: To freeload; to sponge; to take advantage of someone's generosity; to get something for nothing.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻占别人的便宜，通常指不付出任何代价就得到好处。
explanation_english: A metaphor for taking advantage of someone's generosity, usually getting benefits without paying any price or making any effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都嚟我哋度食飯，根本就係嚟嗍油嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 lai4 ngo5 dei6 dou6 sik6 faan6, gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 lai4 sok3 jau4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是来我们这里吃饭，根本就是来占便宜的。
examples.english_sentence: He always comes to our place for dinner; he's basically freeloading.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日諗住嗍油啦，自己都要努力下㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 nim2 zyu6 sok3 jau4 laa1, zi6 gei2 dou1 jiu3 nu5 lik6 haa5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是想着占便宜，自己也要努力一下啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always think about freeloading; you need to work hard yourself.

english_meaning: a particle used to form a question
explanation_mandarin: 表示疑问的语气助词，用在句末，构成疑问句。
explanation_english: A question particle used at the end of a sentence to form a question.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你食咗飯嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sik6 zo2 faan6 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你吃饭了吗？ (Nǐ chī fàn le ma?)
examples.english_sentence: Have you eaten?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你係唔係香港人嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai6 m4 hai6 hoeng1 gong2 jan4 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你是香港人吗？(Nǐ shì Xiānggǎng rén ma?)
examples.english_sentence: Are you from Hong Kong?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好唔好嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 m4 hou2 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 好不好吗？(hǎo bù hǎo ma?)
examples.english_sentence: Is it okay?

english_meaning: Morphine
explanation_mandarin: 一种鸦片类止痛药，从鸦片中提取。
explanation_english: A powerful opiate pain medication derived from opium.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生開咗啲嗎啡俾佢止痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yi1 sang1 hoi1 zo2 di1 maa1 fei1 bei2 keoi5 zi2 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生给他开了一些吗啡止痛。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor prescribed him some morphine for pain relief.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為長期病痛，要靠嗎啡先至可以舒服啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yan1 wai6 coeng4 kei4 beng6 tung3, jiu3 kaau3 maa1 fei1 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 syu1 fuk6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为长期病痛，要靠吗啡才可以舒服一些。
examples.english_sentence: Because of his chronic illness, he needs morphine to feel more comfortable.

english_meaning: to knock, to strike, to bump (against)
explanation_mandarin: 碰撞，敲击。
explanation_english: To strike against something, to bump into or knock against.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好行咁快，小心嗑親個頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 haang4 gam3 faai3, siu2 sam1 hap6 can1 go3 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要走那么快，小心磕到头。
examples.english_sentence: Don't walk so fast, be careful not to bump your head.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張枱隻腳唔平，成日嗑住地下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 toi2 zek3 goek3 m4 ping4, seng4 jat6 hap6 zyu6 dei6 haa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张桌子的脚不平，总是磕着地面。
examples.english_sentence: The leg of this table is not level, and it keeps bumping against the floor.

english_meaning: to sip; to smack one's lips; to taste; to savour
explanation_mandarin: 小口品尝，发出咂嘴的声音。
explanation_english: To sip or taste something lightly, often accompanied by a smacking sound of the lips, indicating enjoyment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嗒一啖咖啡，話好香。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daap3 jat1 daam6 gaa3 fe1, waa6 hou2 hoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他抿了一口咖啡，说很香。
examples.english_sentence: He took a sip of the coffee and said it was very fragrant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細佬嗒晒成杯凍檸茶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou2 daap3 saai3 seng4 bui1 dung3 ning4 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 弟弟一口气喝完了整杯冰柠檬茶。
examples.english_sentence: The younger brother gulped down the entire glass of iced lemon tea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁大聲嗒啦，好冇禮貌㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 seng1 daap3 laa1, hou2 mou5 lai5 maau6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么大声地咂嘴，很没有礼貌的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't smack your lips so loudly, it's very impolite.

english_meaning: to get along well; to be compatible; to click
explanation_mandarin: 形容人与人之间关系融洽，相处得很好，性格、兴趣等方面比较合拍。
explanation_english: Describes a harmonious relationship between people, indicating that they get along well and are compatible in terms of personality, interests, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個好似好嗒得杯落咁喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hou2 ci5 hou2 daap3 dak1 bui1 lok6 gam2 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个好像很合得来。
examples.english_sentence: It seems like those two get along very well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢都唔係好嗒得杯落，傾唔埋兩句。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 dou1 m4 hai6 hou2 daap3 dak1 bui1 lok6, king1 m4 maai4 loeng5 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他不太合得来，说不到两句话。
examples.english_sentence: He and I don't really click; we can't even have a decent conversation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋兩個一見如故，好嗒得杯落咁，真係難得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 loeng5 go3 jat1 gin3 jyu4 gu3, hou2 daap3 dak1 bui1 lok6 gam2, zan1 hai6 naan4 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们两个一见如故，非常合得来，真是难得。
examples.english_sentence: You two hit it off immediately and get along so well; that's really rare.

english_meaning: to flirt; to court; to be in a romantic relationship; sweet-talking
explanation_mandarin: 指男女之间发展恋爱关系，或者进行一些调情行为。
explanation_english: Refers to the development of a romantic relationship between a man and a woman, or engaging in flirtatious behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋最近成日一齐食饭，唔通喺度嗒糖？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zeoi3 gan6 sing4 jat6 jat1 cai4 sik6 faan6, m4 tung1 hai2 dou6 daap3 tong2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们最近经常一起吃饭，难道在谈恋爱？
examples.english_sentence: They've been eating together a lot lately. Could they be dating?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗住嗒糖就唔使做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 daap3 tong2 zau6 m4 sai2 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别想着谈恋爱就可以不用工作。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think that just because you're dating, you don't have to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好識嗒糖，成日氹到啲女仔好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sik1 daap3 tong2, sing4 jat6 tong2 dou3 di1 neoi5 zai2 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很会调情，经常哄得女孩子们很开心。
examples.english_sentence: He's good at flirting and often makes the girls very happy.

english_meaning: To have a lasting aftertaste; to have a lingering pleasant feeling; to be memorable.
explanation_mandarin: 形容食物或经历一开始可能没有特别吸引人，但过后却令人回味无穷，留下深刻的印象。
explanation_english: Describes something, often food or an experience, that may not be particularly appealing at first, but leaves a pleasant and memorable aftertaste or feeling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食初頭覺得好普通，但係嗒落有味，會想再嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 co1 tau4 gok3 dak1 hou2 po2 tung1, daan6 hai6 daap3 lok6 jau5 mei6, wui5 soeng2 zoi3 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物开始觉得很普通，但是回味无穷，会想再来。
examples.english_sentence: The food in this restaurant seemed ordinary at first, but it has a lingering aftertaste that makes me want to come again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 套戲睇嘅時候覺得麻麻地，但係隔咗幾日諗返起，又覺得嗒落有味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou3 hei3 tai2 ge3 si4 hau6 gok3 dak1 maa4 maa4 dei2, daan6 hai6 gaak3 zo2 gei2 jat6 lam2 faan1 hei2, jau6 gok3 dak1 daap3 lok6 jau5 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影看的时候觉得一般般，但是过了几天回想起来，又觉得回味无穷。
examples.english_sentence: I thought the movie was just okay when I watched it, but after a few days, when I thought about it again, I found it had a lingering and pleasant feeling.

english_meaning: throat, voice
explanation_mandarin: 指喉咙，也指声音。
explanation_english: Refers to the throat, and also to the voice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我條嗓唔舒服，好似有啲痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tiu4 song2 m4 syu1 fuk6, hou2 ci5 jau5 di1 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的嗓子不舒服，好像有点痛。
examples.english_sentence: My throat doesn't feel good, it feels a bit sore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢把嗓好靚，好適合唱歌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baa2 song2 hou2 leng3, hou2 sik1 hap6 cheung3 go1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的嗓音很美，很适合唱歌。
examples.english_sentence: His voice is very beautiful, very suitable for singing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗌到聲都沙嗮，搞到把嗓都啞埋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aai3 dou3 seng1 dou1 saa1晒 saai3, gaau2 dou3 baa2 song2 dou1 aa2 maai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 叫到声音都沙哑了，导致嗓子都哑了。
examples.english_sentence: I shouted until my voice became hoarse, which made my throat go mute.

english_meaning: throat; voice
explanation_mandarin: 指喉咙；声音。
explanation_english: Refers to the throat; voice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我琴日凍親，依家條嗓子好唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kam4 jat6 dung3 can1, ji1 gaa1 tiu4 song2 zi2 hou2 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天着凉了，现在嗓子很不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: I caught a cold yesterday, and now my throat is very uncomfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢把嗓子好好聽，好適合做歌星。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baa2 song2 zi2 hou2 hou2 teng1, hou2 sik1 hap6 zou6 go1 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的嗓子很好听，很适合当歌星。
examples.english_sentence: Her voice is very pleasant to listen to, and she is very suitable to be a singer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飲多啲暖水潤下個嗓子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yam2 do1 di1 nuon5 seoi2 jeon6 haa5 go3 song2 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 多喝点热水润润嗓子。
examples.english_sentence: Drink more warm water to soothe your throat.

english_meaning: to scold, to blame, to reproach
explanation_mandarin: 表示责备、埋怨，带有责怪但不严重的意味。
explanation_english: To scold or blame in a mild way; to reproach someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日嗔我啦，我都唔係故意嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 can1 ngo5 laa1, ngo5 dou1 m4 hai6 gu3 ji3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是责怪我啦， 我也不是故意的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always blame me, I didn't do it on purpose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢只係嗔你兩句，唔使咁介意嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi2 hai6 can1 nei5 loeng5 geoi3, m4 sai2 gam3 gaai3 ji3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只是责怪你两句，不用那么介意的。
examples.english_sentence: He just scolded you a couple of times, you don't need to mind it so much.

english_meaning: bone
explanation_mandarin: 指动物的骨头。
explanation_english: Refers to the bones of an animal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度有條魚嗗，小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 jau5 tiu4 jyu2 gwat1, siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里有鱼骨，小心点。
examples.english_sentence: There's a fish bone here, be careful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 煲湯嘅時候，可以用豬嗗增加味道。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou1 tong1 ge3 si4 hau6, ho2 ji5 yung6 zyu1 gwat1 zang1 ga1 mei6 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 煲汤的时候，可以用猪骨增加味道。
examples.english_sentence: When making soup, you can use pork bones to enhance the flavor.

english_meaning: to weep; to sob; sound of weeping
explanation_mandarin: 表示哭泣的声音；也可以作动词，表示哭泣。
explanation_english: Represents the sound of weeping; can also be used as a verb meaning to weep or sob.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢覺得好委屈，嗚嗚噉喊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gok3 dak1 hou2 wai2 kwik1, wu1 wu1 gam2 haam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他觉得很委屈，呜呜地哭。
examples.english_sentence: He felt very wronged and cried with sobbing sounds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好嗚啦，我哋盡快解決件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 wu1 laa1, ngo5 dei6 zeon6 faai3 gaai2 kyut3 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别哭了，我们尽快解决这件事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't cry, let's resolve this matter as soon as possible.

synonyms: 喊苦喊忽 (haam3 fu2 haam3 fat1)

english_meaning: Wow; an exclamation of surprise, excitement, or dismay
explanation_mandarin: 表示惊讶、兴奋、或沮丧的感叹词。类似于“哇”。
explanation_english: An interjection expressing surprise, excitement, or dismay. Similar to 'Wow'. It can be used in various contexts depending on the tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗚呀！咁貴嘅？
examples.jyutping_sentence: wu1 aa1! gam3 gwai3 ge3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哇！这么贵？
examples.english_sentence: Wow! Is it that expensive?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗚呀！好靚呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: wu1 aa1! hou2 leng3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哇！好漂亮啊！
examples.english_sentence: Wow! It's so beautiful!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗚呀！唔好意思，撞到你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wu1 aa1! m4 hou2 ji3 si1, zong6 dou2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哇！不好意思，撞到你了。
examples.english_sentence: Oh! I'm sorry, I bumped into you.

english_meaning: Alas! Woe!
explanation_mandarin: 表示感叹、叹息或悲伤的语气词，通常带有惋惜、伤感的情绪。
explanation_english: An interjection expressing lament, sigh, or sorrow. It usually carries a sense of regret or sadness. More literary and less common in everyday spoken Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗚呼哀哉！咁後生就走咗，真係可惜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wu1 fu1 ai1 zai1! gam3 hau6 sang1 zau6 zau2 zo2, zan1 hai6 ho2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 呜呼哀哉！这么年轻就走了，真是可惜。
examples.english_sentence: Alas! He passed away so young, what a pity.

mandarin_meaning: 呜呼哀哉 (wū hū āi zāi)
english_meaning: Alas! Woe is me!
explanation_mandarin: 表示悲伤或叹息的感叹词，常用于表示极度的悲痛或惋惜。
explanation_english: An interjection expressing grief, sorrow, or lamentation. Often used to express extreme sorrow or regret.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 本書寫到主角最後死咗，真係嗚呼哀哉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun2 syu1 se2 dou3 zyu2 gok3 zeoi3 hau6 si2 zo2, zan1 hai6 wu1 fu1 oi1 zoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书写到主角最后死了，真是呜呼哀哉。
examples.english_sentence: The book wrote about the protagonist dying in the end, truly alas! Woe is me!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁好嘅機會都錯過埋，嗚呼哀哉！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam3 hou2 ge3 gei1 wui6 dou1 co3 gwo3 maai4, wu1 fu1 oi1 zoi1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这么好的机会都错过了，呜呼哀哉！
examples.english_sentence: Such a good opportunity was missed, alas! Woe is me!

english_meaning: to sob; sobbing
explanation_mandarin: 指压低声音哭泣，抽噎。
explanation_english: To sob; to weep softly and with difficulty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢睇完套戲之後，忍唔住嗚咽咗出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tai2 jyun4 tou3 hei3 zi1 hau6, jan2 m4 zyu6 wu1 jit3 zo2 chut1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她看完电影之后，忍不住呜咽起来。
examples.english_sentence: After watching the movie, she couldn't help but sob.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到佢嘅遭遇，我忍唔住嗚咽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou2 keoi5 ge3 zou1 geoi1, ngo5 jan2 m4 zyu6 wu1 jit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到他的遭遇，我忍不住呜咽。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing about his experiences, I couldn't help but sob.

english_meaning: Wow; Ooh; Expressing surprise, admiration, or pain
explanation_mandarin: 表示惊讶、赞叹、或者痛苦的语气词。
explanation_english: An interjection used to express surprise, admiration, pain, or other strong emotions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗚啊！咁靚嘅錶！
examples.jyutping_sentence: wu1 aa3! gam3 leng3 ge3 biu1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哇！这么漂亮的手表！
examples.english_sentence: Wow! Such a beautiful watch!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗚啊！好痛啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: wu1 aa3! hou2 tung3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哇！好痛啊！
examples.english_sentence: Ouch! It hurts!

english_meaning: to be fond of, to have a liking for, addiction, habit, hobby
explanation_mandarin: 喜爱，特别爱好。
explanation_english: To have a special fondness or liking for something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嗜賭如命，成日都去賭錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 si3 dou2 jyu4 ming6, seng4 jat6 dou1 heoi3 dou2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他嗜赌如命，整天都去赌钱。
examples.english_sentence: He is addicted to gambling, he gambles all day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嗜辣，所以好鍾意食麻辣火鍋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 si3 laat6, so2 ji5 hou2 zung1 ji3 sik6 maa4 laat6 fo2 wo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢吃辣，所以很喜欢吃麻辣火锅。
examples.english_sentence: I like spicy food, so I really enjoy mala hotpot.

english_meaning: hobby; interest; addiction; predilection
explanation_mandarin: 特别喜好的事物或活动。
explanation_english: A hobby or interest; something one particularly enjoys doing in their free time. Can also refer to an addiction or a strong liking for something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅嗜好係睇戲同埋打波。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 si3 hou3 hai6 tai2 hei3 tung4 ma4 daa2 bo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的爱好是看电影和打球。
examples.english_sentence: His hobbies are watching movies and playing ball.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 賭錢唔係嗜好，而係一種病。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dou2 cin2 m4 hai6 si3 hou3, ji4 hai6 jat1 zung2 beng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 赌钱不是爱好，而是一种病。
examples.english_sentence: Gambling is not a hobby, but a disease.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對古董有濃厚嘅嗜好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 gu2 dung2 jau5 nung4 hau5 ge3 si3 hou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对古董有浓厚的爱好。
examples.english_sentence: He has a strong interest in antiques.

english_meaning: bloodthirsty; bloodlust
explanation_mandarin: 形容喜欢鲜血或暴力，渴望流血事件。
explanation_english: Describes a person or entity that enjoys blood or violence; having a strong desire for bloodshed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套恐怖片入面嘅殺人犯好嗜血，好恐怖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hung2 bou3 pin2 jap6 min6 ge3 saat3 jan4 faan6 hou2 si3 hyut3, hou2 hung2 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部恐怖片里的杀人犯很嗜血，很恐怖。
examples.english_sentence: The murderer in this horror movie is very bloodthirsty and terrifying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好似有啲嗜血傾向，成日睇暴力新聞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 ci5 jau5 di1 si3 hyut3 king1 hoeng3, seng4 jat6 tai2 bou6 lik6 san1 man2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他好像有点嗜血倾向，总是看暴力新闻。
examples.english_sentence: He seems to have some bloodthirsty tendencies, always watching violent news.

english_meaning: hiccup; to hiccup
explanation_mandarin: 指身体因膈肌痉挛而发出的短促声音；也指打嗝的动作。
explanation_english: Refers to the short, involuntary sound produced by a spasm of the diaphragm; also refers to the act of hiccupping.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我食得太快，打咗幾個嗝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sik6 dak1 taai3 faai3, daa2 zo2 gei2 go3 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我吃得太快了，打了几个嗝。
examples.english_sentence: I ate too fast and hiccupped a few times.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飲啖水可能冇咁易打嗝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yam2 daam6 seoi2 ho2 nang4 mou5 gam3 ji6 daa2 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喝口水可能不容易打嗝。
examples.english_sentence: Drinking some water might make it less likely to hiccup.

english_meaning: to sigh; to lament; expressing regret or disapproval
explanation_mandarin: 表示叹息、惋惜或轻视。可用作动词，表示叹气；也可用作叹词，表示情感。
explanation_english: Expressing a sigh, regret, or disdain. Can be used as a verb to sigh, or as an interjection to express emotion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗟，咁樣都唔得嘅？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ce1, gam2 joeng2 dou1 m4 dak1 ge3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 唉，这样都不行吗？
examples.english_sentence: Sigh, it doesn't work even like this?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嗟咗一聲，表示唔同意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ce1 zo2 jat1 seng1, biu2 si6 m4 tung3 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他叹了一口气，表示不同意。
examples.english_sentence: He sighed, indicating his disagreement.

english_meaning: food offered in contempt; food accepted with a loss of self-respect; humiliatingly received food
explanation_mandarin: 原指带有侮辱性的施舍。现在泛指不接受带有侮辱的帮助。
explanation_english: Originally referring to food given as a contemptuous handout. Now generally refers to refusing help offered in a humiliating or condescending manner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我寧願挨餓都唔食嗟來之食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ning4 jyun2 aai1 ngo6 dou1 m4 sik6 ce1 loi4 zi1 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我宁愿饿着也不吃嗟来之食。
examples.english_sentence: I'd rather starve than accept charity offered in contempt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁有骨氣，一定唔會接受嗟來之食㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 jau5 gwat1 hei3, jat1 ding6 m4 wui5 zip3 sau6 ce1 loi4 zi1 sik6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么有骨气，一定不会接受嗟来之食的。
examples.english_sentence: He's so upright, he definitely won't accept humiliating charity.

english_meaning: to sigh; to lament; to bemoan
explanation_mandarin: 表示因失望、悲伤或遗憾而叹息。
explanation_english: To express disappointment, sadness, or regret with a sigh.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到佢咁慘嘅遭遇，大家都忍唔住嗟嘆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou2 keoi5 gam3 caam2 ge3 zaau1 geoi6, daai6 gaa1 dou1 jan2 m4 zyu6 ze1 taan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到他这么悲惨的遭遇，大家都忍不住叹息。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing about his tragic experience, everyone couldn't help but sigh.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日嗟嘆自己懷才不遇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ze1 taan3 zi6 gei2 waai4 coi4 bat1 jyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是叹息自己怀才不遇。
examples.english_sentence: He always laments his talent being unrecognized.

english_meaning: to complain, to grumble
explanation_mandarin: 表达不满或怨恨。
explanation_english: To express dissatisfaction, resentment, or complaint.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日嗟怨啦，解決咗問題先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 ce1 jyun3 laa1, gaai2 kyut3 zo2 man6 tai4 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是抱怨了，先解决问题吧。
examples.english_sentence: Stop complaining all the time, let's solve the problem first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日嗟怨份工人工低，但係又唔肯轉工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ce1 jyun3 fan6 gung1 jan4 gung1 dai1, daan6 hai6 jau6 m4 hang2 zyun2 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是抱怨工作工资低，但是又不肯换工作。
examples.english_sentence: He's always complaining about his low salary, but he refuses to change jobs.

english_meaning: to hum; to buzz; noisy; annoying
explanation_mandarin: 形容昆蟲發出嗡嗡的聲音，或者形容環境嘈雜。
explanation_english: Describes the humming sound of insects or the state of being noisy and bothersome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻蚊喺我耳仔邊嗡嗡嗡，好鬼煩啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 man1 hai2 ngo5 ji5 zai2 bin1 ung1 ung1 ung1, hou2 gwai2 faan4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 蚊子在我耳朵边嗡嗡嗡的，真烦人啊！
examples.english_sentence: The mosquito is buzzing near my ear, it's so annoying!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺度嗡啦，好嘈啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 ung1 laa1, hou2 cou4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在这里吵闹了，很吵啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be noisy here, it's too loud!

english_meaning: humming, buzzing
explanation_mandarin: 形容昆虫飞舞或机器运转时发出的声音，也可用来形容人说话声音低沉不清。
explanation_english: Describes the sound of insects flying or machines running. It can also describe a low, indistinct voice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲蜜蜂喺花叢度嗡嗡聲飛嚟飛去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 mat6 fung1 hai2 faa1 cung4 dou6 ung1 ung1 seng1 fei1 lei4 fei1 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 蜜蜂在花丛中嗡嗡地飞来飞去。
examples.english_sentence: The bees are humming and buzzing around the flowers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢嗡嗡聲，好難聽得清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 ung1 ung1 seng1, hou2 naan4 ting1 dak1 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话嗡嗡的，很难听清楚。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks in a low, indistinct voice, it's hard to hear clearly.

english_meaning: to succeed; to inherit; offspring; descendants
explanation_mandarin: 继承（王位、财产等）；后代，子孙。
explanation_english: To succeed (to a throne, property, etc.); offspring, descendants.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢冇仔女，冇人可以繼承佢嘅事業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mou5 zai2 neoi5, mou5 jan4 ho2 ji5 gai3 sing4 keoi5 ge3 si6 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他没有子女，没有人可以继承他的事业。
examples.english_sentence: He has no children, so no one can inherit his business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 皇帝希望有後嗣，延續皇朝嘅統治。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wong4 dai3 hei1 mong6 jau5 hau6 zi6, jin4 zuk6 wong4 ciu4 ge3 tung2 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 皇帝希望有后嗣，延续王朝的统治。
examples.english_sentence: The emperor hoped to have offspring to continue the dynasty's rule.

english_meaning: to sneer, to scoff, to show contempt
explanation_mandarin: 表示轻蔑或嘲笑，通常指发出鼻音表示不屑。
explanation_english: To express scorn or contempt, usually by making a snorting sound.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢，我嗤之以鼻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5, ngo5 ci1 zi1 ji5 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话，我嗤之以鼻。
examples.english_sentence: I sneer at what he says.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日嗤人哋嘅夢想啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 ci1 jan4 dei6 ge3 mung6 soeng2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是嘲笑别人的梦想啦。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always sneer at other people's dreams.

mandarin_meaning: 嗤之以鼻 (chī zhī yǐ bí)
english_meaning: to turn up one's nose at, to treat with contempt, to scorn
explanation_mandarin: 表示轻蔑或厌恶的态度。
explanation_english: To express contempt or disdain for something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對我嘅提議嗤之以鼻，覺得我嘅諗法好幼稚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ngo5 ge3 tai4 ji5 ci1 zi1 ji5 bei6, gok3 dak1 ngo5 ge3 lam2 faat3 hou2 jau3 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对我的提议嗤之以鼻，觉得我的想法很幼稚。
examples.english_sentence: He turned up his nose at my suggestion, thinking my idea was very naive.

synonyms: 不屑一顧 (bat1 sit3 jat1 gu3)

english_meaning: to howl, to wail
explanation_mandarin: 指发出高而长的哭喊声或叫声。
explanation_english: To emit a loud, prolonged, and mournful cry or sound; to howl or wail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻狗夜晚成日喺度嗥，嘈到我瞓唔著。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 gau2 je6 maan5 seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 hou4, cou4 dou3 ngo5 fan3 m4 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那只狗晚上总是在那里嚎叫，吵得我睡不着。
examples.english_sentence: That dog is always howling at night, it's so noisy I can't sleep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到呢個噩耗，佢忍唔住放聲嗥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 dou2 ni1 go3 ngok6 hou3, keoi5 jan2 m4住放聲嗥。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到这个噩耗，她忍不住放声嚎啕大哭。
examples.english_sentence: Upon hearing this terrible news, she couldn't help but burst into loud wails.

english_meaning: to slurp, to suck
explanation_mandarin: 指用嘴吸取食物或液体，发出声音。
explanation_english: To slurp or suck in food or liquid, often making a noise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意嗦麵嘅湯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 so1 min6 ge3 tong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我非常喜欢吸面条的汤。
examples.english_sentence: I really like slurping the soup with noodles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嗦咗一啖檸檬茶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 so1 zo2 jat1 daam6 ning4 mung1 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他吸了一口柠檬茶。
examples.english_sentence: He slurped a mouthful of lemon tea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁大聲嗦麵呀，失禮㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 seng1 so1 min6 aa3, sat1 lai5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么大声地吸面条啊，没礼貌的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't slurp your noodles so loudly, it's impolite.

mandarin_meaning: 嗖嗖声; 悉悉索索的声音
english_meaning: rustling sound; swishing sound; whispering sound; rustling noise
explanation_mandarin: 形容细微而连续的摩擦声，通常指风吹树叶、纸张摩擦等发出的声音。
explanation_english: Describes a faint and continuous rubbing sound, usually referring to the sound of wind blowing through leaves, paper rubbing, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到啲樹葉有嗦嗦聲，應該就嚟落雨喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou2 di1 syu6 jip6 jau5 sok3 sok3 seng1, jing1 goi1 zau6 lai4 lok6 jyu5 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到树叶有嗖嗖的声音，应该快要下雨了。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing the rustling of the leaves, it should be raining soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺度睇緊本書，一路都有啲紙張嘅嗦嗦聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 dou6 tai2 gan2 bun2 syu1, jat1 lou6 dou1 jau5 di1 zi2 zoeng1 ge3 sok3 sok3 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他正在看一本书，一直都有一些纸张的悉悉索索的声音。
examples.english_sentence: He's reading a book, and there's a constant rustling sound from the pages.

english_meaning: High; excited; hyper
explanation_mandarin: 形容人兴奋、精神亢奋的状态，也指吸毒后产生的快感。来源于英文词汇 "high"。
explanation_english: Describes a state of excitement, being hyper, or the feeling of euphoria induced by drugs. It originates from the English word "high".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢飲咗好多酒之後，個人嗨到不得了。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jam2 zo2 ho2 do1 zau2 zi1 hau6, go3 jan4 haai1 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喝了很多酒之后，整个人兴奋得不得了。
examples.english_sentence: After drinking a lot of alcohol, he was extremely high.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋晚去咗party，全晚都好嗨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 maan1 heoi3 zo2 party, cyun4 maan1 dou1 hou2 haai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨晚去了派对，整晚都很兴奋。
examples.english_sentence: Went to a party last night and was high all night.

english_meaning: lock; to lock
explanation_mandarin: 上锁，用锁关住。
explanation_english: To lock; to fasten or secure with a lock.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記住出門口要嗩埋門呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 zyu6 chut1 mun4 hau2 jiu3 so2 maai4 mun4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记住出门要锁好门啊。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to lock the door when you go out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嗩咗單車喺街邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 so2 zo2 daan1 ce1 hai2 gaai1 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我把自行车锁在路边了。
examples.english_sentence: I locked the bicycle on the side of the street.

english_meaning: suona (a Chinese double-reed horn)
explanation_mandarin: 一种中国传统的吹奏乐器，音色高亢、嘹亮。
explanation_english: A traditional Chinese wind instrument, characterized by its loud and penetrating sound.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 結婚嘅時候，成日都會聽到人吹嗩吶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: git3 fan1 ge3 si4 hau6, seng4 jat6 dou1 wui2 teng1 dou2 jan4 cheui1 so2 naa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 结婚的时候，经常都能听到有人吹唢呐。
examples.english_sentence: You can often hear people playing the suona at weddings.

english_meaning: An interjection expressing surprise, disdain, or disagreement
explanation_mandarin: 表示惊讶、不屑、不以为然等语气。通常语气较轻，多用于日常口语。
explanation_english: Expresses emotions like surprise, disdain, disagreement, or a dismissive attitude. It usually carries a light tone and is commonly used in everyday speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗬，你咁樣都得㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho1, nei5 gam2 joeng2 dou1 dak1 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 嗬，你这样也可以的吗？
examples.english_sentence: Huh, you can do it like that?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗬，原來係咁㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho1, jyun4 lai4 hai6 gam2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 嗬，原来是这样啊。
examples.english_sentence: Oh, so that's how it is.

mandarin_meaning: 浪费; 白费; 过分
english_meaning: to waste; to squander; to be excessive; to overdo
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 动词; 形容词; 副词
explanation_mandarin: 表示浪费、白费，也可表示程度过分，或完成全部。
explanation_english: Indicates wastefulness, futility, or excessive degree. It can also indicate complete action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲錢就咁樣嗮咗佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 cin2 zau6 gam2 joeng2 saai3 zo2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些钱就这样浪费掉了。
examples.english_sentence: This money was just wasted like that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁嗮氣啦，冇用㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 saai3 hei3 laa1, mou5 jung6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要浪费力气了，没用的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't waste your energy, it's useless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔使咁嗮時間喺呢件事上面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 sai2 gam3 saai3 si4 gaan3 hai2 ni1 gin6 si6 soeng6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不需要在这件事上花费这么多时间。
examples.english_sentence: You don't need to spend so much time on this matter.

english_meaning: Um, uh, hmm (a sound of agreement, acknowledgement, or hesitation)
explanation_mandarin: 表示同意、认可、明白或犹豫的语气词。在广东话中，用法和普通话相似，表示同意、了解、思考等。
explanation_english: An interjection used to express agreement, acknowledgement, understanding, hesitation, or thinking. Similar to its Mandarin counterpart, it indicates affirmation, comprehension, or contemplation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗯，我明㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ng4, ngo5 ming4 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 嗯，我明白了。
examples.english_sentence: Um, I understand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗯...等我諗諗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ng4... dang2 ngo5 lam2 lam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 嗯...让我想想。
examples.english_sentence: Hmm... let me think.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講得啱，嗯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 dak1 ngaam1, ng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说得对，嗯。
examples.english_sentence: You're right, um.

english_meaning: that, that one
explanation_mandarin: 指示代词，指代较远或不特定的事物。相当于“那”或“那个”。
explanation_english: Demonstrative pronoun, referring to something further away or not specific. Equivalent to "that" or "that one".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰本書好睇喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 bun2 syu1 hou2 tai2 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那本书很好看。
examples.english_sentence: That book is very interesting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我要嗰個，唔要呢個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jiu3 go2 go3, m4 jiu3 ni1 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我要那个，不要这个。
examples.english_sentence: I want that one, not this one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰啲嘢唔係我嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 di1 je5 m4 hai6 ngo5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些东西不是我的。
examples.english_sentence: Those things are not mine.

english_meaning: at that moment; then; at that instant
explanation_mandarin: 表示在某个特定的时刻，通常指过去发生的某个时间点。
explanation_english: Refers to a specific moment in time, usually referring to a past point in time. It often emphasizes a reaction or feeling experienced at that precise moment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽到佢咁講，嗰下真係呆咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 teng1 dou2 keoi5 gam2 gong2, go2 haa5 zan1 hai6 aai1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我听到他这么说，那一刻真的呆住了。
examples.english_sentence: When I heard him say that, I was really stunned at that moment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢贏咗比賽，嗰下開心到跳起！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wing4 zo2 bei2 coi3, go2 haa5 hoi1 sam1 dou3 tiu3 hei2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他赢了比赛，那一刻开心得跳起来！
examples.english_sentence: He won the competition, he was so happy at that moment that he jumped up!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 跌親嗰下好痛呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: dit3 can1 go2 haa5 hou2 tung3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 摔倒那一刻好痛啊！
examples.english_sentence: It hurt a lot at the moment I fell!

english_meaning: that side; over there
explanation_mandarin: 表示较远的地方，与「呢便」相对。
explanation_english: Refers to a place that is relatively far away; the opposite of "this side" or "here".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 本書喺嗰便嘅櫃上面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun2 syu1 hai2 go2 bin6 ge3 gwai6 soeng6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 书在那边的柜子上面。
examples.english_sentence: The book is on the shelf over there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你行去嗰便睇吓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hang4 heoi3 go2 bin6 tai2 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你走到那边看看。
examples.english_sentence: Go over there and take a look.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢住喺嗰便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyu6 hai2 go2 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他住在那边。
examples.english_sentence: He lives over there.

english_meaning: that one; that
explanation_mandarin: 指示代词，表示“那个”。用于指代较远或不明确的人或事物。
explanation_english: Demonstrative pronoun. Refers to 'that one' or 'that'. Used to point to a person or thing that is relatively distant or not clearly defined.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你見到嗰個男人未呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gin3 dou2 go2 go3 naam4 jan2 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看到那个男人了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you seen that man?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想要嗰個紅色嘅衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 go2 go3 hung4 sik1 ge3 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想要那件红色的衣服。
examples.english_sentence: I want that red shirt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個係我嘅朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 hai6 ngo5 ge3 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那是我的朋友。
examples.english_sentence: That is my friend.

english_meaning: That thing; that thingamajig; that whatchamacallit; that matter
explanation_mandarin: 指代不方便说出、忘记名字或不想明确指出的事物或事情。多用于口语。
explanation_english: Used to refer to a thing or matter whose name is unknown, forgotten, or that the speaker doesn't want to specify directly. Common in spoken Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，你攞咗嗰個嘢未啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, nei5 lo2 zo2 go2 go3 je5 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，你拿了那个东西没有啊？
examples.english_sentence: Hey, have you taken that thing?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日唔想搞嗰個嘢，聽日先算啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 m4 soeng2 gaau2 go2 go3 je5, ting1 jat6 sin1 syun3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天不想弄那件事，明天再说吧。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to deal with that matter today, let's talk about it tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔记得佢叫咩名喇，就系嗰個嘢嚟嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 gei3 dak1 keoi5 giu3 me1 meng2 laa3, zau6 hai6 go2 go3 je5 lai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不记得他叫什么名字了，就是那个什么来着。
examples.english_sentence: I can't remember his name, he's that whatchamacallit.

english_meaning: those; those ones; that kind of thing; and so on
explanation_mandarin: 指示代词，指代比较远的事物；也用来表示同类事物等等。
explanation_english: A demonstrative pronoun, referring to things that are relatively far away. It can also be used to indicate things of the same kind, and so on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你鍾意呢啲定係嗰啲啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung1 ji3 ni1 di1 ding6 hai6 go2 di1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你喜欢这些还是那些？
examples.english_sentence: Do you like these or those?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講嗰啲無聊嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gong2 go2 di1 mou4 liu4 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说那些无聊的事。
examples.english_sentence: He always says those silly things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想再聽嗰啲藉口啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 zoi3 teng1 go2 di1 jik3 hau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想再听那些借口了。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to hear those excuses anymore.

english_meaning: Those things; that stuff; and so on; etc.
explanation_mandarin: 指代一些不太具体或不想明确说明的事物或事情。语气可以比较随意。
explanation_english: Refers to things or matters that are not very specific or that the speaker does not want to specify clearly. The tone can be casual or vague.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好問咁多啦，總之嗰啲嘢你唔使理就得㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 man6 gam3 do1 laa1, zung2 zi1 go2 di1 je5 nei5 m4 sai2 lei5 zau6 dak1 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别问那么多了，总之那些事你不用管就行了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't ask so much, anyway, you don't need to worry about those things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都買埋晒嗰啲嘢，唔知做乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 maai5 maai4 saai3 go2 di1 je5, m4 zi1 zou6 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是买那些东西，不知道做什么。
examples.english_sentence: He always buys that stuff, I don't know what he's doing with it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搞掂晒嗰啲嘢未啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau2 dim6 saai3 go2 di1 je5 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些事情都处理完了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you finished dealing with those things?

english_meaning: that, you know; like that; that's how it is
explanation_mandarin: 表示语气缓和、解释或强调，通常用于口语中，可以表达一种“就是那样啊”、“事情就是这样”的意思。
explanation_english: A modal particle used to soften the tone, explain, or emphasize. Usually used in spoken language, it can express a sense of "that's how it is" or "that's the way things are". It often implies a sense of acceptance or resignation to a situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咪就係嗰個明星囉，嗰噃，成日喺電視見到嗰個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mi1 zau6 hai6 go2 go3 ming4 sing1 lo1, go2 bo3, seng4 jat6 hai2 din6 si6 gin3 dou2 go2 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不就是那个明星嘛，就是那个，经常在电视上看到的那个。
examples.english_sentence: Isn't he that celebrity, you know, the one you always see on TV?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份工辛苦係辛苦啲，但係人工高，嗰噃，你明唔明？
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 gung1 san1 fu2 hai6 san1 fu2 di1, daan6 hai6 jan4 gung1 gou1, go2 bo3, nei5 ming4 m4 ming4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作辛苦是辛苦一点，但是工资高，就是这样，你明白吗？
examples.english_sentence: The job is a bit tough, but the salary is high, that's how it is, do you understand?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔想嚟，嗰噃，無計㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 soeng2 lai4, go2 bo3, mou5 gai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不想来，那…没办法。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't want to come, well, there's nothing we can do.

synonyms: 咪就係囉 (mai1 zau6 hai6 lo1)
係噉㗎啦 (hai6 gam2 gaa3 laa1)

english_meaning: there / that place
explanation_mandarin: 指示代词，指较远的地方，相当于普通话的“那里/那儿”。
explanation_english: Demonstrative pronoun, referring to a place that is further away. Equivalent to "there" or "that place" in English.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢住喺嗰度㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyu6 hai2 go2 dou6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他住在那里。
examples.english_sentence: He lives there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰度啲嘢好貴㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 dou6 di1 je5 hou2 gwai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那里的东西很贵的。
examples.english_sentence: Things are very expensive there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好行咁埋嗰度啦，危險㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 haang4 gam3 maai5 go2 dou6 laa1, ngai4 him2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要走那么靠近那里，很危险的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't walk so close to there, it's dangerous.

english_meaning: that time, during that period, those days
explanation_mandarin: 指过去一段时间，通常指较短的一段时期，类似于“那阵子”或“那段时间”。
explanation_english: Refers to a period of time in the past, usually a relatively short period, similar to "that time" or "during that period."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰排我好忙，日日都要加班。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 paai4 ngo5 hou2 mong4, jat6 jat6 dou1 jiu3 gaa1 baan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那段时间我很忙，每天都要加班。
examples.english_sentence: I was very busy during that time, and I had to work overtime every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嗰排心情唔好，成日都唔出街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go2 paai4 sam1 ching4 m4 hou2, sing4 jat6 dou1 m4 ceot1 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那段时间心情不好，经常都不出门。
examples.english_sentence: He was in a bad mood during that period, and he rarely went out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰排興緊呢隻歌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 paai4 hing3 gan2 ni1 zek3 go1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那阵子正流行这首歌。
examples.english_sentence: That song was popular during that time.

english_meaning: that day; the other day
explanation_mandarin: 指某一天，通常是过去的一天，但未必是很久以前。
explanation_english: Refers to a specific day, usually in the past, but not necessarily a long time ago.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰日落大雨，我冇帶遮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 jat6 lok6 daai6 jyu5, ngo5 mou5 daai3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那天下了大雨，我没带伞。
examples.english_sentence: It rained heavily that day, and I didn't bring an umbrella.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話嗰日會嚟，但係到而家都未見人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 go2 jat6 wui5 lai4, daan6 hai6 dou3 ji4 gaa1 dou1 mei6 gin3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说那天会来，但是到现在都没见到人。
examples.english_sentence: He said he would come that day, but I haven't seen him yet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔記得嗰日發生咩事啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 gei3 dak1 go2 jat6 faat3 sang1 me1 si6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不记得那天发生了什么事了。
examples.english_sentence: I don't remember what happened that day.

english_meaning: at that time, then, when
explanation_mandarin: 指过去某个特定的时间点或时期。
explanation_english: Refers to a specific point in time or period in the past.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰時我仲細，唔識嘢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 si4 ngo5 zung6 sai3, m4 sik1 je5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那时我还小，什么都不懂。
examples.english_sentence: I was still young at that time and didn't know anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰時佢哋成日一齊玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 si4 keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 jat1 cai4 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 当时他们经常一起玩。
examples.english_sentence: They often played together at that time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話嗰時佢好忙，所以冇覆我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 go2 si4 keoi5 hou2 mong4, so2 ji5 mou5 fuk1 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说那时他很忙，所以没有回复我。
examples.english_sentence: He said he was very busy at that time, so he didn't reply to me.

mandarin_meaning: 那块豆腐 (字面意思)，形容人呆板，迟钝，不灵活
english_meaning: That slab of tofu (literal meaning), used to describe someone who is dull, slow-witted, inflexible, or unresponsive.
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是“那块豆腐”。引申为形容人反应迟钝，不灵活，像豆腐一样。
explanation_english: Literally means "that slab of tofu." Figuratively, it's used to describe someone who is slow, dull, inflexible, or unresponsive, like a block of tofu.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢反應慢到好似嗰板豆腐咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faan2 jing3 maan6 dou3 hou2 ci5 go2 baan2 dau6 fu6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他反应慢得像一块豆腐一样。
examples.english_sentence: He is so slow to react, like a slab of tofu.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁嗰板豆腐啦，醒醒定定啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 go2 baan2 dau6 fu6 laa1, sing2 sing2 ding6 ding6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别那么迟钝了，清醒一点吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so unresponsive, wake up and be more alert.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁嗰板豆腐啦，俾啲創意啦!
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 go2 baan2 dau6 fu6 laa1, bei2 di1 chong3 yi3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么死板，有点创意!
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so inflexible, be more creative!

english_meaning: That thing, that stuff, that whatchamacallit
explanation_mandarin: 指代不太确定或不想明确提及的某样东西。
explanation_english: Refers to something that is not clearly defined or that the speaker doesn't want to specify.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔記得咗條鎖匙喺邊，但係肯定喺嗰槓嘢度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 gei3 dak1 zo2 tiu4 so2 si4 hai2 bin1, daan6 hai6 hang2 ding6 hai2 go2 gong3 je5 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不记得钥匙在哪了，但肯定在那东西那里。
examples.english_sentence: I forgot where the key is, but it's definitely somewhere near that thing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好掂嗰槓嘢呀，好污糟㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 dim6 go2 gong3 je5 aa3, hou2 wu1 zou1 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要碰那个东西，很脏的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't touch that stuff, it's very dirty!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嗱嗱臨搞掂佢啦，我仲有其他嘢做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 naa4 naa4 lam4 gaau2 dim6 keoi5 laa1, ngo5 zung6 jau5 kei4 taa1 je5 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你赶紧把他搞定吧，我还有其他事情要做。
examples.english_sentence: You finish dealing with him quickly, I have other things to do.

english_meaning: Quickly; immediately; hastily; hurriedly
explanation_mandarin: 表示动作迅速，立刻行动。
explanation_english: Indicates that an action should be done quickly and immediately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗱林做埋佢啦，陣間冇時間㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: naa4 lam4 zou6 maai4 keoi5 laa1, zan6 gaan1 mou5 si4 gaan3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 赶紧做完吧，一会儿就没时间了。
examples.english_sentence: Do it quickly, there won't be time later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嗱林返屋企啦，聽日要返工㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 naa4 lam4 faan1 uk1 kei2 laa1, ting1 jat6 jiu3 faan1 gung1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你快点回家吧，明天要上班的。
examples.english_sentence: You should go home quickly, you have work tomorrow.

english_meaning: To act coquettishly, to act in a spoiled manner, to be coy and flirtatious
explanation_mandarin: 指用娇媚的姿态或语言讨人喜欢，博取同情或满足某种要求。
explanation_english: To act in a way that is considered coy, flirtatious, or spoiled, often in order to get what one wants by appealing to someone's affection or sympathy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺男朋友面前嗲聲嗲氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 naam4 pang4 jau5 min6 cin4 de2 seng1 de2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是在男朋友面前撒娇。
examples.english_sentence: She always acts coquettishly in front of her boyfriend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁嗲啦，自己搞掂佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 de2 laa1, zi6 gei2 gaau2 dim6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别撒娇了，自己搞定它。
examples.english_sentence: Don't act so spoiled, handle it yourself.

english_meaning: Acting coquettishly and hanging around someone, being clingy in a spoiled way
explanation_mandarin: 形容人娇声娇气，喜欢黏着别人，通常带有负面含义，指对方像个小孩子一样。
explanation_english: Describes someone acting in a coquettish and clingy way, often with negative connotations, implying they are acting like a child and excessively dependent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日嗲嗲吊住佢男朋友，真係好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 de2 de2 diu3 zyu6 keoi5 naam4 pang4 jau5, zan1 hai6 hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她整天娇声娇气地黏着她男朋友，真的很烦人。
examples.english_sentence: She's always being coquettish and clinging to her boyfriend, it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再嗲嗲吊啦，自己搞掂佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 de2 de2 diu3 laa1, zi6 gei2 gaau2 dim6 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别再娇声娇气了，你自己搞定它吧。
examples.english_sentence: Stop being so clingy, sort it out yourself.

english_meaning: affectedly sweet; acting coy; saccharine; clinging
explanation_mandarin: 形容人说话或行为非常娇气，带着撒娇的语气和动作，通常带有一些负面含义，指责对方过于做作。
explanation_english: Describes someone who speaks or acts in an affectively sweet, coy, or clinging manner, often with a negative connotation implying that the person is being overly artificial and annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢成日都嗲嗲渧，聽到都起雞皮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 seng4 jat6 dou1 de2 de2 di1, teng1 dou2 dou1 hei2 gai1 pei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她说话总是娇声娇气的，听得我直起鸡皮疙瘩。
examples.english_sentence: She always speaks in an excessively sweet and coy way, it gives me goosebumps.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁嗲嗲渧啦，自己搞掂佢！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 de2 de2 di1 laa1, zi6 gei2 gaau2 dim6 keoi5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么娇气了，自己搞定它！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so clingy and saccharine, sort it out yourself!

english_meaning: To sweet-talk; to act coquettishly (and say a few things); to try to persuade (by acting in a charming or flirty way)
explanation_mandarin: 指用娇媚的语气说几句话，通常带有一些讨好或撒娇的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to saying a few words in a coquettish or charming manner, usually with the intention of pleasing or persuading someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嗲幾句，阿爸就乜都應承你㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 de2 gei2 geoi3, aa3 baa1 zau6 mat1 dou1 jing3 sing4 nei5 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你撒娇几句，爸爸什么都会答应你的。
examples.english_sentence: If you sweet-talk a bit, your dad will agree to everything you ask.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日嗲幾句就攞到想要嘅嘢，真係叻女。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 de2 gei2 geoi3 zau6 lo2 dou2 soeng2 jiu3 ge3 je5, zan1 hai6 lek1 neoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是撒娇几句就拿到想要的东西，真是个聪明的女孩。
examples.english_sentence: She always gets what she wants by sweet-talking a little, she's really a clever girl.

english_meaning: To sweet-talk someone into doing something; to coax or cajole someone into agreement through charm and/or flattery; to get someone to agree by being affectionate or seductive.
explanation_mandarin: 指通过撒娇、示好等方式，使对方同意或答应自己的要求。带有一定程度上利用个人魅力或亲昵关系达到目的的含义。
explanation_english: Refers to persuading someone to agree to your request by acting cute, being affectionate, or flattering them. It implies using personal charm or a close relationship to achieve a goal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都嗲掂佢男朋友買嘢俾佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 de2 dim3 keoi5 naam4 pang4 jau5 maai5 je5 bei2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是撒娇让她的男朋友买东西给她。
examples.english_sentence: She always sweet-talks her boyfriend into buying her things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗住可以嗲掂我，我唔會俾你過㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 ho2 ji5 de2 dim3 ngo5, ngo5 m4 wui5 bei2 nei5 gwo3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别想撒娇来搞定我，我不会让你过的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can sweet-talk me, I won't let you pass.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用把聲嗲掂咗個老闆，成功攞到個合約。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 baa2 seng1 de2 dim3 zo2 go3 lou5 baan2, sing4 gung1 lo2 dou2 go3 hap6 joek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她用声音撒娇搞定了老板，成功拿到了合同。
examples.english_sentence: She used her voice to sweet-talk the boss and successfully got the contract.

english_meaning: talking in a coquettish voice; speaking in a spoiled or overly sweet manner
explanation_mandarin: 形容说话声音娇柔做作，带有撒娇的意味。多指女性说话时的姿态。
explanation_english: Describes a voice that is deliberately sweet and affected, often in a coquettish or spoiled way. Usually used to describe the way women speak.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日嗲聲嗲氣咁同男朋友講嘢，聽到我都起雞皮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 de2 seng1 de2 hei3 gam2 tung4 naam4 pang4 jau5 gong2 je5, ting1 dou3 ngo5 dou1 hei2 gai1 pei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是娇声娇气地跟男朋友说话，听得我都起鸡皮疙瘩。
examples.english_sentence: She always talks to her boyfriend in a coquettish voice, it gives me goosebumps.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好嗲聲嗲氣啦，有咩事咪直接講囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 de2 seng1 de2 hei3 laa1, jau5 me1 si6 mai6 zik6 zip3 gong2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别娇声娇气了，有什么事就直接说吧。
examples.english_sentence: Stop talking in that spoiled voice, just say what you want.

english_meaning: bleep, beep
explanation_mandarin: 形容电子设备发出的短暂的尖锐声音。
explanation_english: Describes a short, sharp sound emitted by electronic devices.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦啱啱嗶咗一聲，唔知發生咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 aam1 aam1 bit1 zo2 jat1 seng1, m4 zi1 faat3 sang1 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电脑刚刚哔了一声，不知道发生了什么事。
examples.english_sentence: The computer just beeped, I don't know what happened.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢部手機成日都嗶嗶聲，好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bou6 sau2 gei1 seng4 jat6 dou1 bit1 bit1 seng1, hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的手机总是发出哔哔的声音，很烦人。
examples.english_sentence: His phone is always beeping, it's annoying.

english_meaning: onomatopoeia for a series of quick, light sounds (e.g., rain, typing, small talk); a string of incoherent or unimportant chatter
explanation_mandarin: 1. 象聲詞，形容快速、連續的細小聲音，如雨點聲、打字聲等。2. 形容說話喋喋不休，說了很多不重要或聽不懂的話。
explanation_english: 1. Onomatopoeia describing a rapid series of light sounds, such as raindrops, typing, or the babbling of a stream. 2. Describes someone talking incessantly or saying a lot of unimportant or unintelligible things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落緊雨呀，聽到啲雨點喺度嗶哩叭啦噉響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 ging2 jyu5 aa3, ting1 dou2 di1 jyu5 dim2 hai2 dou6 bit1 li1 baa1 laa1 gam2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下着雨呢，听到雨点在噼里啪啦地响。
examples.english_sentence: It's raining, and I can hear the raindrops making a 'bit li baa laa' sound.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺度嗶哩叭啦噉講，都唔知佢噏乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 bit1 li1 baa1 laa1 gam2 gong2, dou1 m4 zi1 keoi5 ap1 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是噼里啪啦地说个不停，都不知道他在说什么。
examples.english_sentence: He's always chattering away 'bit li baa laa', I don't even know what he's talking about.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦打字嘅聲嗶哩叭啦噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 daa2 zi6 ge3 seng1 bit1 li1 baa1 laa1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电脑打字的声音噼里啪啦的。
examples.english_sentence: The sound of the computer typing is 'bit li baa laa'.

synonyms: 喋喋不休 (dip6 dip6 bat1 jau1)
嘮嘮叨叨 (lou4 lou4 dou1 dou1)

mandarin_meaning: 表示疼痛、惊讶、或抱怨的声音
english_meaning: Ouch; ow; to express pain, surprise, or complaint
explanation_mandarin: 表示突然受到疼痛、惊吓或感到不满而发出的声音。
explanation_english: An interjection used to express sudden pain, surprise, or dissatisfaction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗷！咁辣嘅？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngou1! gam3 laat6 ge3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 嗷！这么辣？
examples.english_sentence: Ouch! Is it that spicy?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗷！整親隻手指！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngou1! zing2 can1 zek3 sau2 zi2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 嗷！弄伤了手指！
examples.english_sentence: Ouch! I hurt my finger!

english_meaning: crying loudly for food (used to describe someone desperately awaiting help or support)
explanation_mandarin: 形容婴儿饥饿时哭叫着等待喂食的样子。比喻迫切地等待援助或帮助。
explanation_english: Describes the sound of babies crying loudly for food, indicating extreme hunger. Metaphorically, it describes someone desperately awaiting help or support, highlighting their urgent need.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司經濟拮据，啲員工全部嗷嗷待哺，等住出糧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ging1 gai3 gat6 geoi1, di1 jyun4 gung1 cyun4 bou6 ngou4 ngou4 doi6 bou6, dang2 zyu6 ceot1 loeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司经济拮据，员工们都嗷嗷待哺，等着发工资。
examples.english_sentence: The company is in financial straits, and all the employees are crying out for food, waiting to get paid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 災區啲災民嗷嗷待哺，急需救援物資。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoi1 keoi1 di1 zoi1 man4 ngou4 ngou4 doi6 bou6, gap1 seoi1 gau3 wun4 mat6 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 灾区的灾民嗷嗷待哺，急需救援物资。
examples.english_sentence: The disaster victims in the affected area are desperately awaiting food and supplies, urgently needing relief materials.

english_meaning: Yes; indicating agreement or compliance (archaic)
explanation_mandarin: 表示应答，同意或顺从，通常用于旧时上下级之间，或长辈对晚辈。
explanation_english: Indicates agreement, compliance, or acknowledgment, often used in the past between superiors and subordinates or between elders and younger generations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 皇上，奴才會好好辦事嘅，嗻！
examples.jyutping_sentence: wong4 soeng6, nou4 caai2 wui5 hou2 hou2 baan6 si6 ge3, ze1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 皇上，奴才一定会好好办事的，是！
examples.english_sentence: Your Majesty, this servant will certainly do the job well, yes!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 係，阿爸，我會聽你話嘅，嗻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai6, aa3 baa1, ngo5 wui5 ting1 nei5 waa6 ge3, ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 是，爸爸，我会听你的话的，是。
examples.english_sentence: Yes, Dad, I will listen to you, yes.

english_meaning: to cough
explanation_mandarin: 指由于喉咙或呼吸道受到刺激而发出的声音，以清除异物或分泌物。
explanation_english: To expel air from the lungs with a sudden sharp sound, typically to clear the throat or airways.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴日開始就一路嗽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 hoi1 chi2 zau6 jat1 lou6 sau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天开始就一直在咳嗽。
examples.english_sentence: He's been coughing since yesterday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嗽得好犀利喎，睇醫生未啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sau3 dak1 hou2 sai1 lai6 wo3, tai2 ji1 sang1 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你咳嗽得很厉害，看过医生了吗？
examples.english_sentence: You're coughing really badly, have you seen a doctor?

english_meaning: To drip; to complain (informal)
explanation_mandarin: 表示液体一点一点地落下；也指小声地抱怨。
explanation_english: To drip (liquids); colloquially refers to complaining in a low voice or murmuring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲水一路嘀落嚟，好煩呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 seoi2 jat1 lou6 dik1 lok6 lai4, hou2 faan4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 水一直滴下来，好烦人啊！
examples.english_sentence: The water keeps dripping, it's so annoying!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢又喺度嘀嘀咕咕，唔知講乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau6 hai2 dou6 dik1 dik1 gu1 gu1, m4 zi1 gong2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他又在那里嘀嘀咕咕，不知道在说什么。
examples.english_sentence: He's muttering again, I don't know what he's saying.

english_meaning: to chatter incessantly; to nag repeatedly; to complain constantly; to be fussy; nitpicking
explanation_mandarin: 形容人说话琐碎，不停地抱怨或唠叨。也形容人做事挑剔。
explanation_english: Describes someone who talks incessantly and about trivial matters, often complaining or nagging. It can also describe someone who is fussy and nitpicking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再喺度嘀嘀嘚嘚啦，好鬼煩呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 hai2 dou6 dik1 dik1 dak1 dak1 laa1, hou2 gwai2 faan4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别再在这里唠唠叨叨的了，真烦人！
examples.english_sentence: Stop chattering on and on here, it's so annoying!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆成日都喺度嘀嘀嘚嘚，話啲嘢唔乾淨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 sing4 jat6 dou1 hai2 dou6 dik1 dik1 dak1 dak1, waa6 di1 je5 m4 gon1 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶总是唠唠叨叨的，说东西不干净。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma is always nagging, saying things are not clean.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好嘀嘀嘚嘚，咩都彈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 dik1 dik1 dak1 dak1, me1 dou1 taan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很挑剔，什么都抱怨。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very fussy person and complains about everything.

english_meaning: 's, of, (particle indicating possession, modification, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 相当于普通话的“的”，表示所属关系、修饰等。
explanation_english: A particle equivalent to Mandarin Chinese 的 (de), indicating possession, modification, or other relationships. It's a crucial grammatical element in Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書係我嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 hai6 ngo5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书是我的。
examples.english_sentence: This book is mine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我最好嘅朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 zeoi3 hou2 ge3 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她是我的最好的朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is my best friend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日做緊啲乜嘢嘅嘢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 zou6 gan2 di1 mat1 je5 ge3 je5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天在做什么呢？
examples.english_sentence: What are you doing today?

english_meaning: That's all, nothing more, just; used at the end of a sentence to indicate a simple statement of fact or a dismissive tone.
explanation_mandarin: 语气助词，表示仅仅如此，没什么大不了的意思，语气比较轻描淡写或不屑。
explanation_english: A particle used at the end of a sentence to indicate that something is just that and nothing more. It can convey a dismissive or nonchalant attitude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我淨係想瞓覺嘅唧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zing6 hai6 soeng2 fan3 gaau3 ge3 zek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是想睡觉而已。
examples.english_sentence: I just want to sleep, that's all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢都係得個講字嘅唧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou1 hai6 dak1 go3 gong2 zi6 ge3 zek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只是说说而已。
examples.english_sentence: He's just talking, nothing more.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔係好叻嘅唧，普通人一個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 hai6 hou2 lek1 ge3 zek1, pou2 tung1 jan4 jat1 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不是很好，只是一个普通人罢了。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not that great, just an average person.

english_meaning: just, only, that's all, simply
explanation_mandarin: 语气助词，表示事情的程度很轻微，或者用作解释或安慰。
explanation_english: A particle used at the end of a sentence to soften the tone, indicating that something is not a big deal, or used for explanation or reassurance. It indicates a sense of 'just', 'only', or 'that's all'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我遲到少少嘅啫，唔使咁緊張嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ci4 dou3 siu2 siu2 ge3 ze1, m4 sai2 gam3 gan2 zoeng1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是迟到了一点点而已，不用那么紧张。
examples.english_sentence: I'm just a little bit late, no need to be so nervous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咪講吓笑嘅啫，唔好咁認真啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mai1 gong2 haa5 siu3 ge3 ze1, m4 hou2 gam3 jing6 zan1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只是开玩笑而已，不要那么认真啦。
examples.english_sentence: He was just joking, don't take it so seriously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我淨係想幫吓你嘅啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zing6 hai6 soeng2 bong1 haa5 nei5 ge3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是想帮你一下而已。
examples.english_sentence: I just wanted to help you.

english_meaning: things; stuff; matters
