examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好信佢嘅說話，佢條脷好嘴滑㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 ge3 syut3 waa6, keoi5 tiu4 lei6 hou2 zeoi2 waat6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要相信他的话，他口才很油嘴滑舌的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust what he says, he's very smooth-tongued.

english_meaning: Trash talk; big talk with no action; all talk and no substance
explanation_mandarin: 指只会口头说说，却没有实际行动的人或行为。通常带有贬义，表示只会夸夸其谈，而没有实际能力或行动力。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who only talks big but doesn't take action. It usually has a negative connotation, indicating that someone is all talk and no substance, lacking the ability or willingness to follow through.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日淨係識得嘴炮，乜嘢都做唔到嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 zeoi2 paau3, mat1 je5 dou1 zou6 m4 dou2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天只会嘴炮，什么都做不到。
examples.english_sentence: He only knows how to trash talk all day long, and can't do anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係嘴炮啦，不如做啲實際嘢好過啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 zeoi2 paau3 laa1, bat1 jyu4 zou6 di1 sat6 zai3 je5 hou2 gwo3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别光说不做，不如做点实际的事情更好。
examples.english_sentence: Stop the trash talk and do something practical instead.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好信佢嘅，佢條友仔最叻就係嘴炮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 ge3, keoi5 tiu4 jau5 zai2 zeoi3 lek1 zau6 hai6 zeoi2 paau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别相信他，那家伙最厉害的就是嘴炮。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust him, that guy is best at talking big and doing nothing.

mandarin_meaning: 嘴炮 / 空谈 / 光说不做
english_meaning: Trash talk / Empty words / All talk, no action / Hot air
explanation_mandarin: 指光说不做，只会夸夸其谈，没有实际行动。也指言语上的攻击或挑衅。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who talks a lot but doesn't take action; all talk and no action. It can also refer to verbal attacks or provocations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺度嘴砲，但係乜嘢都冇做過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 zeoi2 paau3, daan6 hai6 mat1 je5 dou1 mou5 zou6 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天在那里嘴炮，但是什么都没做过。
examples.english_sentence: He's always just trash-talking, but he's never done anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係識得嘴砲，做啲實際嘢啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 zeoi2 paau3, zou6 di1 sat6 zai3 je5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只是会嘴炮，做一些实际的事情吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't just talk, do something practical!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好理佢嘅嘴砲，佢講嘢冇句真。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lei5 keoi5 ge3 zeoi2 paau3, keoi5 gong2 je5 mou5 geoi3 zan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别理他的嘴炮，他说话没一句真话。
examples.english_sentence: Don't mind his trash talk, nothing he says is true.

synonyms: 講就天下無敵，做就有心無力 (gong2 zau6 tin1 haa6 mou4 dik6, zou6 zau6 jau5 sam1 mou4 lik6)

english_meaning: lip
explanation_mandarin: 指口部的边缘部分，主要作用是帮助说话和饮食。
explanation_english: The fleshy folds that surround the mouth, primarily used for speech and eating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅嘴脣好紅潤呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zeoi2 seon4 hou2 hung4 jeon6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的嘴唇很红润啊。
examples.english_sentence: Her lips are very rosy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣乾燥，嘴脣好易裂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hei3 gon1 cou3, zeoi2 seon4 hou2 ji6 lit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天气干燥，嘴唇很容易裂。
examples.english_sentence: The weather is dry, lips crack easily.

english_meaning: countenance; face; expression; (fig.) true colors; ugly face; obnoxious behaviour
explanation_mandarin: 指人的面部表情，多含贬义，指人丑恶、虚伪或令人厌恶的神情。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's facial expression, often with a derogatory connotation, indicating an ugly, hypocritical, or disgusting expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇到佢嗰種勢利嘅嘴臉，真係令人反感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 dou2 keoi5 go2 zung2 sai3 lei6 ge3 zeoi2 lim5, zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 faan2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到他那种势利的嘴脸，真是令人反感。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing his snobbish face is really disgusting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一攞到權就露出真面目，嗰副嘴臉真係好難睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 lo2 dou2 kuyen4 zau6 lau6 ceot1 zan1 min6 muk6, go2 fu3 zeoi2 lim5 zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一拿到权力就露出真面目，那副嘴脸真是很难看。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as he got power, he showed his true colors; that face was really ugly.

english_meaning: To pout; to turn up one's nose; to look disdainful with pursed lips
explanation_mandarin: 形容嘴巴微微翘起，通常表示不高兴、不屑、不满或者傲慢的态度。
explanation_english: Describes the action of slightly pursing the lips, usually indicating unhappiness, disdain, dissatisfaction, or arrogance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都嘴藐藐，好似對乜嘢都唔滿意咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 zeoi2 miu5 miu5, hou2 ci5 deoi3 mat1 je5 dou1 m4 mun5 ji3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是撅着嘴，好像对什么都不满意。
examples.english_sentence: He's always pouting, as if he's dissatisfied with everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁嘴藐藐啦，我知你唔鍾意，但係都要試下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 zeoi2 miu5 miu5 laa1, ngo5 zi1 nei5 m4 zung1 ji3, daan6 hai6 dou1 jiu3 si3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这样撅着嘴啦，我知道你不喜欢，但是也要试一下。
examples.english_sentence: Don't pout like that, I know you don't like it, but you still have to try it.

english_meaning: corner of the mouth
explanation_mandarin: 嘴的两端。
explanation_english: The corner of the mouth; the point where the upper and lower lips meet on either side.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘴角上面有啲飯粒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi2 gok3 soeng6 min6 jau5 di1 faan6 lap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的嘴角上有一些饭粒。
examples.english_sentence: He has some rice grains on the corner of his mouth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘴角向上彎，好似笑緊噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi2 gok3 hoeng3 soeng5 waan1, hou2 ci5 siu3 gan2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的嘴角向上翘，好像在笑。
examples.english_sentence: The corners of his mouth turned upwards, as if he was smiling.

english_meaning: talkative, garrulous, chatty (often in an annoying or bothersome way)
explanation_mandarin: 形容人说话很多，不停地说话，有时让人觉得很烦。
explanation_english: Describes someone who talks a lot, non-stop, sometimes to the point of being annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人嘴𠴕𠴕，講嘢講成日都唔停。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 zeoi2 gap3 gap3, gong2 je5 gong2 sing4 jat1 jat6 dou1 m4 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个人很唠叨，说话说一天都不停。
examples.english_sentence: That person is very talkative; they talk all day without stopping.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好嘴𠴕𠴕啦，我好攰呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zeoi2 gap3 gap3 laa1, ngo5 hou2 gui6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再唠叨了，我很累啊。
examples.english_sentence: Stop being so talkative, I'm very tired.

synonyms: 口水多過茶 (hau2 seoi2 do1 gwo3 caa4)

english_meaning: To nag; to keep complaining or grumbling; to mutter repeatedly
explanation_mandarin: 指不停地小声抱怨、埋怨或唠叨。
explanation_english: Refers to constantly complaining, grumbling, or nagging in a low voice, often repetitively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺度嘴𡁻𡁻啦，好嘈呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 zeoi2 gap1 gap1 laa1, hou2 cou4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要在这里碎碎念了，很吵！
examples.english_sentence: Stop nagging here, it's so noisy!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆成日喺度嘴𡁻𡁻，唔知講乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 zeoi2 gap1 gap1, m4 zi1 gong2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶整天在那里碎碎念，不知道说什么。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma is always muttering, I don't know what she's saying.

synonyms: 喃喃自語 (naam4 naam4 zi6 jyu5)

english_meaning: to know, to understand, to be aware
explanation_mandarin: 明白，知道。多用于书面语或文言文中。
explanation_english: To understand, to know. Often used in written or classical Chinese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嘵唔嘵得發生咗咩事呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hiu1 m4 hiu1 dak1 faat3 sang1 zo2 me1 si6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你知道发生了什么事吗？
examples.english_sentence: Do you know what happened?

english_meaning: hissing sound; hoarse
explanation_mandarin: 形容声音嘶哑或发出嘶嘶的声音。作为拟声词，模仿嘶嘶声；作为形容词，描述声音嘶哑。
explanation_english: Describes a hoarse sound or a hissing sound. As an onomatopoeia, it imitates a hissing sound; as an adjective, it describes a hoarse voice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢把聲好嘶，可能感冒喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baa2 seng1 hou2 si1, ho2 nang4 gam2 mou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的声音很嘶哑，可能感冒了。
examples.english_sentence: His voice is very hoarse, he might have a cold.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲蛇嘶一聲，嚇死我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 se4 si1 yat1 seng1, haak3 sei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 蛇嘶了一声，吓死我了。
examples.english_sentence: The snake hissed, scaring me to death.

mandarin_meaning: 嘶叫; 尖叫; 喊叫
english_meaning: to scream; to yell; to shriek; to shout hoarsely
explanation_mandarin: 大声叫喊，通常指声音嘶哑或尖锐的叫喊。
explanation_english: To shout or scream loudly, often with a hoarse or shrill voice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嚇到嘶叫一聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haak3 dou3 sai1 giu3 jat1 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他吓得嘶叫了一声。
examples.english_sentence: He screamed in fright.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 班球迷興奮到嘶叫起嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baan1 fu1 mi4 hing1 fan5 dou3 sai1 giu3 hei2 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 球迷们兴奋地嘶叫起来。
examples.english_sentence: The fans were so excited that they started screaming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個細路仔發脾氣，喺度又喊又嘶叫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sai3 lou2 zai2 faat3 pei4 hei3, hai2 dou6 jau6 haam3 jau6 sai1 giu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个小孩发脾气，在那里又哭又尖叫。
examples.english_sentence: The child was having a tantrum, crying and screaming there.

english_meaning: to wail; to howl; to cry loudly
explanation_mandarin: 表示大声哭或叫，通常带有一种痛苦或悲伤的情绪。
explanation_english: To cry or shout loudly, usually expressing grief, pain, or sadness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個細路跌親，嘷到拆天咁滯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sai3 lou2 dit3 can1, hou4 dou3 caak3 tin1 gam3 zai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个小孩摔倒了，哭得天都要塌下来一样。
examples.english_sentence: The child fell and cried so loudly it felt like the sky was falling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到阿婆過身嘅消息，佢即刻嘷出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou2 aa3 po4 gwo3 san1 ge3 siu1 sik1, keoi5 zik1 hak1 hou4 chut1 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到奶奶去世的消息，她立刻嚎啕大哭。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing the news of her grandmother's passing, she immediately burst into wails.

english_meaning: no; not
explanation_mandarin: 表示否定，相当于“没有”、“不”。
explanation_english: A negative particle meaning 'no' or 'not'. It is a colloquial and sometimes dialectal word used to express negation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嘸知呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zi1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不知道啊。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘸係度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 hai6 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不在。
examples.english_sentence: He's not here.

english_meaning: clear and loud, resonant, ringing
explanation_mandarin: 形容声音清晰响亮，通常用来形容歌声、鸟鸣等声音。
explanation_english: Describes a sound that is clear, loud, and resonant, often used to describe singing, birdsong, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢把聲好嘹㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baa2 seng1 hou2 liu1 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的声音很洪亮！
examples.english_sentence: Her voice is very loud and clear!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唱歌把聲嘹到呢！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 coeng3 go1 baa2 seng1 liu1 dou3 ne1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她唱歌声音真清脆！
examples.english_sentence: Her singing voice is so clear and resonant!

english_meaning: loud and clear; resonant; sonorous
explanation_mandarin: 形容声音清晰响亮。
explanation_english: Describes a sound that is clear, loud, and resonant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢把聲好嘹亮，喺人群度都聽得好清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baa2 seng1 hou2 liu4 loeng6, hai2 yan4 kwan4 dou6 dou1 teng1 dak1 hou2 ching1 chu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的声音很响亮，在人群中也能听得很清楚。
examples.english_sentence: His voice is very loud and clear, you can hear it clearly even in a crowd.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲歌聲好嘹亮，充滿咗成個禮堂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 go1 seng1 hou2 liu4 loeng6, chung1 mun5 zo2 sing4 go3 lai5 tong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 歌声非常嘹亮，充满了整个礼堂。
examples.english_sentence: The singing was very loud and clear, filling the entire hall.

english_meaning: smug; conceited; pretentious; showing off
explanation_mandarin: 形容一個人自以為是，得意洋洋，或者裝模作樣，刻意表現自己。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is self-satisfied, smug, or putting on airs; deliberately showing off to attract attention or admiration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢贏咗比賽之後就成日都嘺嘺哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wing4 zo2 bei2 coi3 zi1 hau6 zau6 seng4 jat6 dou1 kiu4 kiu4 dei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他赢了比赛之后就总是得意洋洋的。
examples.english_sentence: He's been smug ever since he won the competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺度嘺啦，大家都知你係撞彩㗎啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 kiu4 laa1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 zi1 nei5 hai6 zong6 coi2 gaa3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要在这里装模作样了，大家都知道你是侥幸。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be pretentious here, everyone knows you got lucky.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好嘺，成日扮晒嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 kiu4, seng4 jat6 baan2 saai3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很爱炫耀，整天装模作样。
examples.english_sentence: He is a show-off and always acts pretentiously.

english_meaning: to laugh, to giggle, to joke
explanation_mandarin: 表示笑的声音，或用在句尾表示轻快的语气。
explanation_english: Represents the sound of laughter or is used at the end of a sentence to indicate a light and cheerful tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嘻嘻，你講嘢真係好搞笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 hei1, nei5 gong2 je5 zan1 hai6 hou2 gaau2 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 嘻嘻，你说的话真好笑。
examples.english_sentence: Hehe, what you said is really funny.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嘻，算啦，唔好咁計較啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1, syun3 laa1, m4 hou2 gam3 gai3 gaau3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 嘻，算了，别太计较了。
examples.english_sentence: Heh, forget it, don't be so picky.

english_meaning: laughing and joking; joking around; carefree and jovial
explanation_mandarin: 形容欢笑嬉闹的样子，表示轻松快乐的心情。
explanation_english: Describes a state of lighthearted laughter and playfulness, indicating a relaxed and happy mood. Can also imply a lack of seriousness depending on the context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日都喺度嘻嘻哈哈，好開心咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai2 dou6 hei1 hei1 haa1 haa1, hou2 hoi1 sam1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们整天都在那里嘻嘻哈哈的，非常开心。
examples.english_sentence: They are always laughing and joking around there, very happy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好嘻嘻哈哈啦，認真做嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hei1 hei1 haa1 haa1 laa1, jing6 zan1 zou6 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要嘻嘻哈哈了，认真工作吧。
examples.english_sentence: Stop joking around and get to work.

english_meaning: to scare; to threaten; to intimidate
explanation_mandarin: 表示用言语或行动使人感到害怕或不安。有恐吓、威胁的意思。
explanation_english: To scare, threaten, or intimidate someone through words or actions. It implies causing fear or unease.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日想住嘿人啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 soeng2 zyu6 haak1 jan4 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是想着吓唬别人了！
examples.english_sentence: Don't always think about scaring people!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想嘿我，但我唔驚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 haak1 ngo5, daan6 ngo5 m4 geng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想吓唬我，但我不怕。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to scare me, but I'm not afraid.

english_meaning: disgusting; nauseating; sickening
explanation_mandarin: 表示令人感到恶心、想吐。
explanation_english: Expressing a feeling of disgust, nausea, or wanting to vomit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢陣味好噁心，聞到想嘔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zan6 mei6 hou2 aak3 sam1, man4 dou2 soeng2 au2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这味道真恶心，闻到想吐。
examples.english_sentence: This smell is disgusting, it makes me want to vomit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲嘢食擺咗咁耐，都發晒霉，好噁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 je5 sik6 bai2 zo2 gam3 noi6, dou1 faat3 saai3 mui1, hou2 aak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些食物放了这么久，都发霉了，很恶心。
examples.english_sentence: Those foods have been left for so long, they're all moldy, so disgusting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 套戲啲情節好血腥，好噁心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou3 hei3 di1 cing4 zit3 hou2 hyut3 sing1, hou2 aak3 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影的情节很血腥，很恶心。
examples.english_sentence: The plot of this movie is very gory, it's disgusting.

english_meaning: disgusting; nauseating; sickening; to feel nauseous
explanation_mandarin: 形容令人厌恶、不舒服或想呕吐的感觉。也指令人不快或令人反感的事物。
explanation_english: Describes something that is disgusting, unpleasant, or makes one feel like vomiting. It can also refer to something unpleasant or offensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲嘢食好噁心呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 je5 sik6 hou2 aak3 sam1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些东西真恶心！
examples.english_sentence: These things are so disgusting!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聞到陣味好噁心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 man4 dou2 zan6 mei6 hou2 aak3 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我闻到这个味道觉得很恶心。
examples.english_sentence: I feel nauseous when I smell this scent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘅嘢真係令人覺得好噁心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 ge3 je5 zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 gok3 dak1 hou2 aak3 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做的事情真让人觉得很恶心。
examples.english_sentence: What he did is really disgusting.

mandarin_meaning: 语气助词，表示提醒，劝告，或舒缓语气。
english_meaning: particle used at the end of a sentence to express mild warning, reminder, confirmation, or to soften the tone
explanation_mandarin: 语气助词，通常放在句尾，表示提醒，劝告，或表示一种舒缓的语气。可以理解为“嘛”，“啦”。
explanation_english: A particle, usually placed at the end of a sentence, to express a mild warning, reminder, confirmation, or to soften the tone. Similar to "ma" or "la" in Mandarin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你記得聽日交功課噃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gei3 dak1 ting1 jat6 gaau1 gung1 fo3 bo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你记得明天交作业啊。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to hand in your homework tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小心啲行噃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 sam1 di1 haang4 bo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心走路啊。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful when you walk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 係咁噃，我明啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai6 gam2 bo3, ngo5 ming4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 原来是这样，我明白了。
examples.english_sentence: Oh, I see now.

english_meaning: to sip; to suck; to nibble
explanation_mandarin: 小口地吸饮或咬食。
explanation_english: To sip or suck in small amounts; to nibble at food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 噆啖茶先啦，唔使咁急嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zaam1 daam6 caa4 sin1 laa1, m4 sai2 gam3 gap1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 先喝口茶吧，不用这么着急。
examples.english_sentence: Sip some tea first, no need to rush.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢慢慢噆緊支雪條。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maan6 maan2 zaam1 gan2 zi1 syut3 tiu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她慢慢地吸着冰棒。
examples.english_sentence: She is slowly sucking on the popsicle.

english_meaning: to sigh; to gasp; to pant
explanation_mandarin: 表示叹息或喘气，通常是因为疲惫、失望或无奈。
explanation_english: To sigh or gasp, usually due to exhaustion, disappointment, or helplessness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做完運動之後，不停咁噆氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 jyun4 wan6 dung6 zi1 hau6, bat1 ting4 gam2 zaam1 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他运动完之后，不停地喘气。
examples.english_sentence: After finishing exercising, he was constantly panting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽完個壞消息，佢忍唔住噆咗啖氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jyun4 go3 waai6 siu1 sik1, keoi5 jan2 m4 zyu6 zaam1 zo2 daam6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听完这个坏消息，他忍不住叹了口气。
examples.english_sentence: After hearing the bad news, he couldn't help but sigh.

english_meaning: to sip, to drink in small mouthfuls
explanation_mandarin: 指小口地喝或啜飲。
explanation_english: Refers to drinking or sipping in small mouthfuls.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢噈咗啖茶，然後慢慢嘆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cau3 zo2 daam6 caa4, jin4 hau6 maan6 maan2 taan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小口喝了口茶，然后慢慢享受。
examples.english_sentence: He sipped a mouthful of tea, then savored it slowly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁大啖飲呀，噈住飲好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 daam6 jam2 aa3, cau3 zyu6 jam2 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要喝那么大口，小口喝好一点。
examples.english_sentence: Don't drink in such big gulps, it's better to sip it.

mandarin_meaning: 湊巧, 剛好, 正好
english_meaning: Just in time, coincidentally, luckily, to arrive just at the right moment
explanation_mandarin: 表示時間或情況剛好，碰巧。
explanation_english: Indicates that the time or situation is just right, coincidental, or lucky. It emphasizes arriving or happening at the perfect moment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋噈到趕得切睇最後一場戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 cuk1 dou3 gaan2 dak1 cit3 tai2 zeoi3 hau6 jat1 coeng4 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们刚好赶得上看最后一场电影。
examples.english_sentence: We just made it in time to catch the last showing of the movie.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我噈到喺街撞到佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cuk1 dou3 hai2 gaai1 zong6 dou2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我碰巧在街上遇到他。
examples.english_sentence: I happened to run into him on the street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢噈到喺我走之前嚟咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cuk1 dou3 hai2 ngo5 zau2 zi1 cin4 lai4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他正好在我离开之前来了。
examples.english_sentence: He arrived just before I left.

english_meaning: to kiss (on the lips); to peck
explanation_mandarin: 指嘴对嘴的亲吻，通常指快速或轻轻地亲吻。
explanation_english: Refers to kissing on the lips, usually quickly or lightly; a peck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺街度噈親咗一下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 gaai1 dou6 cuk1 can1 zo2 jat1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在街上亲了一下嘴。
examples.english_sentence: They kissed each other quickly on the street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 临瞓前，我都会噈親我个女。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lam4 seoi6 cin4, ngo5 dou1 wui5 cuk1 can1 ngo5 go3 neoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 睡觉前，我都会亲我的女儿一下。
examples.english_sentence: Before going to sleep, I always give my daughter a kiss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋淨係噈親咗，乜嘢都冇做過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zing6 hai6 cuk1 can1 zo2, mat1 je5 dou1 mou5 zou6 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们只是亲了嘴，什么都没做过。
examples.english_sentence: We just kissed, nothing else happened.

english_meaning: so; like this; such; then; in that case
explanation_mandarin: 指示代词，表示“这样”、“那样”；也可作连词，表示“那么”、“就”。
explanation_english: A demonstrative pronoun meaning 'like this', 'in this way', 'such'. It can also function as a conjunction, meaning 'then', 'in that case', 'so'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢噉做係唔啱㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 zou6 hai6 m4 ngaam1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这样做是不对的。
examples.english_sentence: It's not right for him to do it like this.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 噉樣都得？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam2 joeng2 dou1 dak1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这样也可以？
examples.english_sentence: Is it okay even like this?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 噉你話點算好？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam2 nei5 waa6 dim2 syun3 hou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那么你说怎么办好？
examples.english_sentence: So, what do you suggest we do?

mandarin_meaning: 那也可以; 也行; 这样也可以
english_meaning: That works; That's acceptable; That's okay; That's also an option
explanation_mandarin: 表示对某提议或行动表示认可或接受，语气较为随意。有时也带有无奈或妥协的意味。
explanation_english: Expresses acceptance or agreement to a suggestion or action, often with a casual tone. It can sometimes imply a sense of resignation or compromise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想食飯定係食麵？噉又得，是但啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 sik6 faan6 ding6 hai6 sik6 min6? gam2 jau6 dak1, si6 daan6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想吃饭还是吃面？那也可以，随便啦。
examples.english_sentence: Do you want rice or noodles? That works, anything is fine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話聽日晏啲先交報告？噉又得，不過唔好遲過五點啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 ting1 jat6 aan3 di1 sin1 gaau1 bou3 gou3? gam2 jau6 dak1, bat1 gwo3 m4 hou2 ci4 gwo3 ng5 dim2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说明天晚一点再交报告？那也可以，不过不要迟过五点啊。
examples.english_sentence: You said you'll submit the report later tomorrow? That's okay, but don't be later than 5 o'clock.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔想去睇戲？噉又得，不如我哋去行街啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 soeng2 heoi3 tai2 hei3? gam2 jau6 dak1, bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 haang4 gaai1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不想去看电影？那也可以，不如我们去逛街吧。
examples.english_sentence: You don't want to go see a movie? That's okay, how about we go shopping?

mandarin_meaning: 那不是吗？ / 难道不是吗？ / 岂不是？
english_meaning: Isn't it? / Isn't that so? / Doesn't that mean...?
explanation_mandarin: 表示反问或推断，语气较强。表示难道不是这样吗？或者如果这样，岂不是...?
explanation_english: Used as a rhetorical question to express agreement or to draw a logical conclusion. It implies "Isn't it obvious?" or "If that's the case, doesn't that mean...?"

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都遲到，噉唔係擺明想炒魷魚咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 ci4 dou3, gam2 m4 hai6 baai2 ming4 soeng2 caau2 jau4 jyu2 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都迟到，那不是摆明了想被炒鱿鱼吗？
examples.english_sentence: He's late every day, isn't it obvious he wants to get fired?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁辛苦做埋人哋嗰份，噉唔係蝕底咗俾人咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 san1 fu2 zou6 maai4 jan4 dei6 go2 fan6, gam2 m4 hai6 sit6 dai2 zo2 bei2 jan4 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么辛苦做别人的那份，那不是亏大了吗？
examples.english_sentence: You're working so hard doing other people's share, doesn't that mean you're being taken advantage of?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢都講到咁白，噉唔係暗示緊佢鍾意你咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou1 gong2 dou3 gam3 baak6, gam2 m4 hai6 am3 si6 gan2 keoi5 zung1 ji3 nei5 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她都说得这么明白了，难道不是在暗示她喜欢你吗？
examples.english_sentence: She's made it so obvious, isn't she implying she likes you?

mandarin_meaning: 那就; 这样就; 既然如此
english_meaning: then; in that case; that's it; that's all; so; if so
explanation_mandarin: 表示承接关系，相当于“那就”、“这样就”、“既然如此”。根据语境可以有不同的含义，表示结果、决定或让步等。
explanation_english: Expresses a consequential relationship, similar to "then," "in that case," "that's it," or "so." Depending on the context, it can express a result, decision, concession, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 噉就聽日見啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam2 zau6 ting1 jat6 gin3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那就明天见吧。
examples.english_sentence: Then I'll see you tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔想去，噉就唔好去囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 soeng2 heoi3, gam2 zau6 m4 hou2 heoi3 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不想去，那就别去了。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't want to go, then don't go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 噉就搞掂曬啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam2 zau6 gaau2 dim6 saai3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那就都搞定了！
examples.english_sentence: That's it, everything's done!

english_meaning: That's about right; that's pretty much it; almost there; close enough
explanation_mandarin: 表示情况接近或达到某种程度，表示认可或接受。
explanation_english: Indicates that a situation is close to or has reached a certain level, expressing approval or acceptance. It implies a satisfactory outcome or agreement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再加少少鹽，噉就差唔多啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 gaa1 siu2 siu2 jim4, gam2 zau6 caa1 m4 do1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再加一点盐，那就差不多了。
examples.english_sentence: Add a little more salt, and that's about right.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋準備咗咁耐，噉就差唔多可以開始喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zeon2 bei6 zo2 gam3 noi6, gam2 zau6 caa1 m4 do1 ho2 ji5 hoi1 chi2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们准备了这么久，那就差不多可以开始了。
examples.english_sentence: We've prepared for so long, we're pretty much ready to start.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅廣東話講得噉，噉就差唔多本地人喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gwong2 dung1 waa2 gong2 dak1 gam2, gam2 zau6 caa1 m4 do1 bun2 dei6 jan4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的广东话说成这样，那就差不多是本地人了。
examples.english_sentence: The way he speaks Cantonese, he's almost a local.

english_meaning: like this, in this way, so, such
explanation_mandarin: 指示代词，表示“这样”、“如此”的意思。也可以用作副词，表示“这样地”。
explanation_english: Demonstrative pronoun meaning "like this", "in this way". It can also be used as an adverb meaning "so", "such".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔應該噉樣做㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 jing1 goi1 gam2 joeng2 zou6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不应该这样做。
examples.english_sentence: You shouldn't do it like this.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔知點解會噉樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zi1 dim2 gaai2 wui5 gam2 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不知道为什么会这样。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know why it's like this.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 噉樣呀？我明喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam2 joeng2 aa3? ngo5 ming4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这样啊？我明白了。
examples.english_sentence: Like this? I understand now.

english_meaning: like this; this kind of way; in this manner
explanation_mandarin: 表示“像这样”，强调一种状态或方式。
explanation_english: Indicates 'like this,' emphasizing a state or manner. Similar to 'this way' or 'like so'. Often used to describe or demonstrate something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好噉樣樣搞啦，好危險㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 joeng2 joeng2 gaau2 laa1, hou2 ngai4 him2 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这样弄了，很危险的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't do it like this, it's very dangerous!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都噉樣樣，唔聽人講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 gam2 joeng2 joeng2, m4 teng1 jan4 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是这个样子，不听别人说话。
examples.english_sentence: He's always like this, not listening to what others say.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係識得噉樣樣抄功課，要自己諗先得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 gam2 joeng2 joeng2 caau1 gung1 fo3, jiu3 zi6 gei2 nam2 sin1 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只会这样抄作业，要自己想才行。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just copy homework like this, you need to think for yourself.

mandarin_meaning: 这样说来; 这么说; 这么解释
english_meaning: So; In that case; That's why; That's how it is explained; To interpret in that way.
explanation_mandarin: 表示对前面所说的话的总结或疑问，类似于“这么说来”、“这么解释”或“为什么”。
explanation_english: Indicates a conclusion or question based on what was previously said. Similar to "so," "in that case," "that's why," or "why is that the case?" It can also mean to interpret something in a particular way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁遲先嚟，噉解佢唔想嚟啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 ci4 sin1 lei4, gam2 gaai2 keoi5 m4 soeng2 lei4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么晚才来，这么说他不想来吧。
examples.english_sentence: He's only arriving so late, so I guess he doesn't want to come.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你噉解啫係唔信我啦？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 gaai2 ze1 hai6 m4 seon3 ngo5 laa1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么说就是不相信我咯？
examples.english_sentence: So you're saying you don't trust me?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢唔舒服，噉解佢唔會嚟啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 m4 syu1 fuk6, gam2 gaai2 keoi5 m4 wui5 lei4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他不舒服，这样说来他不会来了。
examples.english_sentence: He said he doesn't feel well, so in that case, he won't come.

english_meaning: Is that even possible? / Can that even be allowed? / I can't believe that!
explanation_mandarin: 表示惊讶、难以置信或不满的情绪，通常指某件事情出乎意料地被允许或发生。
explanation_english: Expresses surprise, disbelief, or dissatisfaction that something is allowed or has happened, often implying it's unexpected or unreasonable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試唔溫書都合格，噉都得㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 m4 wan1 syu1 dou1 hap6 gaak3, gam2 dou1 dak1 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试不复习都及格了，这样也行吗？
examples.english_sentence: He passed the exam without even studying, is that even allowed?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁求其嘅嘢都可以賣咁貴，噉都得？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam3 kau4 gei4 ge3 je5 dou1 ho2 ji5 maai6 gam3 gwai3, gam2 dou1 dak1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这么随便的东西也可以卖这么贵，这样也行？
examples.english_sentence: Such shoddy stuff can be sold so expensively, is that even possible?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 遲到成個鐘都唔扣人工，噉都得？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ci4 dou3 sing4 go3 zung1 dou1 m4 hau3 jan4 gung1, gam2 dou1 dak1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 迟到一整个小时都不扣工资，这样也行？
examples.english_sentence: Being an hour late and not getting your salary docked, I can't believe that!

english_meaning: suddenly; quickly; with a rush
explanation_mandarin: 表示动作发生得很突然、很快，通常伴随响声。
explanation_english: Indicates that an action happens suddenly and quickly, often accompanied by a sound.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢噌一聲企起身，嚇我一跳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cang1 jat1 seng1 kei5 hei2 san1, haak3 ngo5 jat1 tiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他噌地一声站起来，吓了我一跳。
examples.english_sentence: He suddenly stood up with a rush, giving me a fright.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 杯嘢一跌落地，噌一聲就爛咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bui1 je5 jat1 dit3 lok6 dei6, cang1 jat1 seng1 zau6 laan6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 杯子一掉在地上，噌的一声就碎了。
examples.english_sentence: The cup fell to the ground and broke with a crash.

english_meaning: to chew
explanation_mandarin: 用牙齿咬碎食物。
explanation_english: To chew food with the teeth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你慢慢噍啦，唔使咁快嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 maan6 maan2 ziu3 laa1, m4 sai2 gam3 faai3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你慢慢嚼吧，不用那么快。
examples.english_sentence: Chew slowly, there's no need to rush.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢食嘢唔噍爛就吞，對腸胃唔好㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sik6 je5 m4 ziu3 laan6 zau6 tan1, deoi3 coeng2 wai2 m4 hou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他吃东西不嚼烂就吞，对肠胃不好。
examples.english_sentence: He swallows food without chewing it properly, which is bad for his stomach.

english_meaning: to leave behind (uneaten food); to have leftovers; to remain
explanation_mandarin: 指食物吃剩，留下来的部分。
explanation_english: Refers to the portion of food that is left uneaten.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁多嘢噍低，係咪唔好食啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 do1 je5 ciu3 dai1, hai6 mai6 m4 hou2 sik6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你剩下这么多，是不好吃吗？
examples.english_sentence: You left so much food behind, is it not tasty?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好噍低咁多飯，要珍惜食物呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ciu3 dai1 gam3 do1 faan6, jiu3 zan1 sik1 sik6 mat6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要剩下这么多饭，要珍惜食物啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't leave so much rice behind, you should cherish food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我驚噍低，所以叫少咗嘢食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 geng1 ciu3 dai1, so2 ji5 giu3 siu2 zo2 je5 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我怕剩下，所以少点了食物。
examples.english_sentence: I was afraid of leaving leftovers, so I ordered less food.

english_meaning: To use and then discard; to exploit someone and then abandon them.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻利用完别人后就抛弃，过河拆桥的意思。
explanation_english: A metaphor for using someone and then discarding them, like kicking someone to the curb after they've served their purpose. Similar to 'using and abusing'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢升咗職之後就唔理我哋，真係噍完唱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing1 zo2 zik1 zi1 hau6 zau6 m4 lei5 ngo5 dei6, zan1 hai6 ziu1 jyun4 coeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他升职之后就不理我们了，真是利用完就丢弃。
examples.english_sentence: After he got promoted, he ignored us, truly using and discarding us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁噍完唱啦，以後仲要見面㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 ziu1 jyun4 coeng3 laa1, ji5 hau6 zung6 jiu3 gin3 min6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么利用完就丢弃，以后还要见面的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so exploitative and discard people after using them, we will still see each other in the future.

synonyms: 過橋抽板 (gwo3 kiu2 cau1 baan2)

english_meaning: To use and discard; to be used and then dumped (immediately after)
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人在利用完他人之后，立刻抛弃对方，毫无感情可言。比喻过河拆桥，卸磨杀驴。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone is used and then immediately discarded or abandoned after they are no longer needed. Implies a lack of loyalty, gratitude or respect for the person used.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢擺明係噍完鬆啦，一有利用價值就埋你身，冇用就唔睬你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baai2 ming4 hai6 ziu1 jyun4 sung1 laa1, jat1 jau5 lei6 jung6 gaa3 zik6 zau6 maai4 nei5 san1, mou5 jung6 zau6 m4 caai2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他摆明是利用完就丢弃，一旦有利用价值就靠近你，没用就不理你。
examples.english_sentence: He is obviously using and discarding people. He will get close to you when you are useful, and ignore you when you are not.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁噍完鬆啦，人哋幫咗你咁多，點解要咁對佢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 ziu1 jyun4 sung1 laa1, jan4 dei6 bong1 zo2 nei5 gam3 do1, dim2 gaai2 jiu3 gam3 deoi3 keoi5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么用完就丢，人家帮了你这么多，为什么这样对他？
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so quick to use and discard people. They helped you so much, why treat them like this?

english_meaning: to choke; to be choked; to be suffocated
explanation_mandarin: 食物或液体进入气管，导致呼吸困难。
explanation_english: To choke on something, usually food or liquid, that goes down the wrong way (into the trachea) and causes difficulty in breathing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我食飯食得太快，噎親。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sik6 faan6 sik6 dak1 taai3 faai3, at1 can1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我吃饭吃得太快，噎着了。
examples.english_sentence: I ate too fast and choked.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔食嘢要小心啲，唔好噎親。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou2 zai2 sik6 je5 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1, m4 hou2 at1 can1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子吃东西要小心点，不要噎着。
examples.english_sentence: Children need to be careful when eating, don't choke.

english_meaning: to talk nonsense, to blabber, to spout rubbish
explanation_mandarin: 指没有根据或缺乏逻辑的说话；乱说；胡说八道。
explanation_english: To speak without thinking, to talk nonsense, or to blabber about something without any real knowledge or understanding. Often implies the speaker is talking rubbish or spouting unfounded opinions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺度亂噏啦，根本唔係咁樣嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 lyun6 ap1 laa1, gan1 bun2 m4 hai6 gam2 joeng2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要在这里胡说八道了，根本不是这样的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk nonsense here, it's not like that at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都喺度噏三噏四，唔知佢講乜嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai2 dou6 ap1 saam1 ap1 sei3, m4 zi1 keoi5 gong2 mat1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天都在那里胡说八道，不知道他在说什么。
examples.english_sentence: He's always blabbering nonsense, I don't know what he's talking about.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你又喺度噏乜嘢呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau6 hai2 dou6 ap1 mat1 je5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你又在胡说些什么啊？
examples.english_sentence: What are you talking nonsense about again?

english_meaning: to talk nonsense; to babble incoherently; to ramble
explanation_mandarin: 指说话没有条理，乱说一通，通常带有贬义。
explanation_english: Refers to speaking incoherently, rambling, or talking nonsense, usually with a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺度噏三噏四啦，根本冇呢件事嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 ap1 saam1 ap1 sei3 laa1, gan1 bun2 mou5 ni1 gin6 si6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别在这胡说八道了，根本没有这件事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk nonsense here, this thing didn't even happen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢飲醉咗，開始噏三噏四。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yam2 zeoi3 zo2, hoi1 chi2 ap1 saam1 ap1 sei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喝醉了，开始胡说八道。
examples.english_sentence: He's drunk and starting to talk nonsense.

english_meaning: On the tip of one's tongue; about to say something; almost slipped out.
explanation_mandarin: 形容话语几乎要说出口，但最终没有说出。表示原本想说的话到了嘴边，但因为某些原因而忍住了没说。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where words are almost spoken but ultimately not uttered. It indicates that something was on the verge of being said but was held back for some reason.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱差啲噏到口唇邊，講咗佢嘅秘密出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 caa1 di1 ap1 dou3 hau2 seon4 bin1, gong2 zo2 keoi5 ge3 bei3 mat6 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚才差点说漏嘴了，把他的秘密说出来了。
examples.english_sentence: I almost slipped and told his secret just now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲衰嘢都噏到口唇邊㗎喇，好彩我醒水收返埋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 seoi1 je5 dou1 ap1 dou3 hau2 seon4 bin1 gaa3 laa3, hou2 coi2 ngo5 sing2 seoi2 sau1 faan1 maai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些不好的话都差点说出口了，幸好我反应快收了回去。
examples.english_sentence: Those nasty words were almost on the tip of my tongue, luckily I was quick-witted and swallowed them back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想問佢去邊，但係又怕佢唔鍾意，所以噏到口唇邊都無講出口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 man6 keoi5 heoi3 bin1, daan6 hai6 jau6 paa3 keoi5 m4 zung1 ji3, so2 ji5 ap1 dou3 hau2 seon4 bin1 dou1 mou5 gong2 ceot1 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想问他去哪里，但是又怕他不高兴，所以话到嘴边也没说出口。
examples.english_sentence: I wanted to ask him where he was going, but I was afraid he wouldn't like it, so even though the words were on the tip of my tongue, I didn't say them.

mandarin_meaning: 脱口而出; 话到嘴边
english_meaning: On the tip of the tongue; about to say it
explanation_mandarin: 形容话语即将说出口，但一时想不起来或者因为某种原因没有说出来。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where words are about to be spoken but are either momentarily forgotten or withheld for some reason. Meaning it's on the tip of your tongue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋個project嘅負責人係邊個嚟㗎？唉，噏到咀唇邊，但係又唔記得咗佢個名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 go3 project ge3 fu6 zaak3 jan4 hai6 bin1 go3 lai4 gaa3? aai1, ap1 dou3 zeoi2 seon4 bin1, daan6 hai6 jau6 m4 gei3 dak1 zo2 keoi5 go3 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们项目的负责人是谁来着？唉，话到嘴边了，但是又忘记他的名字了。
examples.english_sentence: Who is in charge of our project? Ah, it's on the tip of my tongue, but I forgot his name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我本來想同佢講多謝㗎，但係見到佢嘅時候，啲說話就噏到咀唇邊都講唔出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bun2 lai4 soeng2 tung4 keoi5 gong2 do1 ze6 gaa3, daan6 hai6 gin3 dou3 keoi5 ge3 si4 hau6, di1 syut3 waa2 zau6 ap1 dou3 zeoi2 seon4 bin1 dou1 gong2 m4 chut1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我本来想和他说谢谢的，但是见到他的时候，那些话都到嘴边了也说不出来。
examples.english_sentence: I originally wanted to thank him, but when I saw him, the words were on the tip of my tongue and I couldn't say them.

english_meaning: On the tip of the tongue; about to say it
explanation_mandarin: 形容话语就在嘴边，即将说出口，但一时想不起来或说不出口。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where something is on the tip of your tongue, you're about to say it, but you can't quite remember or bring yourself to say it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗咗好耐，但係個名都係噏到咀脣邊，就係講唔出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 zo2 hou2 noi6, daan6 hai6 go3 ming4 dou1 hai6 ap1 dou3 zeoi2 seon4 bin1, zau6 hai6 gong2 m4 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想了很久，但是名字就在嘴边，就是说不出来。
examples.english_sentence: I've been thinking for a long time, but the name is on the tip of my tongue; I just can't say it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事噏到咀脣邊，唔好意思講出口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 ap1 dou3 zeoi2 seon4 bin1, m4 hou2 ji3 si1 gong2 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事就在嘴边，不好意思说出口。
examples.english_sentence: The matter is on the tip of my tongue, but I'm too embarrassed to say it.

english_meaning: On the tip of my tongue
explanation_mandarin: 形容想说的话语已经到了嘴边，却一时想不起来。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where a word or phrase is on the verge of being spoken but cannot be immediately recalled; on the tip of the tongue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，我記得佢個名嘅，但係一時之間噏到嘴唇邊，都係諗唔起。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, ngo5 gei3 dak1 keoi5 go3 meng2 ge3, daan6 hai6 jat1 si4 zi1 gaan1 ap1 dou3 zeoi2 seon4 bin1, dou1 hai6 nim2 m4 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，我记得他的名字的，但是一时之间就在嘴边，就是想不起来。
examples.english_sentence: Hey, I remember his name, but it's on the tip of my tongue, I just can't recall it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條歌詞明明噏到嘴唇邊，點解會唔記得㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 go1 ci4 ming4 ming4 ap1 dou3 zeoi2 seon4 bin1, dim2 gaai2 wui m4 gei3 dak1 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 歌词明明就在嘴边，为什么会不记得呢？
examples.english_sentence: The lyrics are right on the tip of my tongue, why can't I remember them?

mandarin_meaning: 就要说出来了; 话到嘴边
english_meaning: On the tip of my tongue; about to say it
explanation_mandarin: 形容话已经到了嘴边，马上就要说出口了，但有时又忘记了或者犹豫没说出来。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where the words are right on the tip of your tongue, about to be spoken, but sometimes forgotten or hesitated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我噏到嘴脣邊，就係唔記得佢叫乜嘢名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ap1 dou3 zeoi2 seon4 bin1, zau6 hai6 m4 gei3 dak1 keoi5 giu3 mat1 je5 ming2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我话都到嘴边了，就是不记得他叫什么名字。
examples.english_sentence: It's on the tip of my tongue, I just can't remember his name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個答案我噏到嘴脣邊，你俾多啲提示我啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 daap3 aan3 ngo5 ap1 dou3 zeoi2 seon4 bin1, nei5 bei2 do1 di1 tai4 si6 ngo5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 答案我都要说出来了，你多给我一些提示吧！
examples.english_sentence: I'm about to guess the answer, give me some more hints!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一直想講，但係噏到嘴脣邊又唔敢講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 zik6 soeng2 gong2, daan6 hai6 ap1 dou3 zeoi2 seon4 bin1 jau6 m4 gam2 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一直想说，但是话到嘴边又不敢说。
examples.english_sentence: I've been wanting to say it, but it's on the tip of my tongue and I don't dare to say it.

english_meaning: To talk nonsense, to blabber whatever comes to mind without thinking
explanation_mandarin: 指说话不负责任，想到什么就说什么，通常带有贬义。
explanation_english: Refers to speaking irresponsibly, saying whatever comes to mind without thinking or considering the consequences. Usually carries a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日噏得就噏，你唔好信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ap1 dak1 zau6 ap1, nei5 m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是信口开河，你不要相信他。
examples.english_sentence: He always talks nonsense, don't believe him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好噏得就噏，講嘢要有根據。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ap1 dak1 zau6 ap1, gong2 je5 jiu3 jau5 gan1 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要胡说八道，说话要有依据。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just talk nonsense, your words should have basis.

english_meaning: To talk nonsense; to spout rubbish; to blather; to talk drivel.
explanation_mandarin: 指说话没有根据，内容荒谬，没有逻辑。
explanation_english: Refers to speaking without basis, with absurd content and lacking logic. It often implies the speaker is talking rubbish or not making any sense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再喺度噏撈啦，冇人信你㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 hai2 dou6 ap1 lou1 laa1, mou5 jan4 seon3 nei5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再在这里胡说八道了，没有人相信你的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk nonsense here anymore, nobody believes you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢飲醉酒之後，就開始噏撈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jam2 zeoi3 zau2 zi1 hau6, zau6 hoi1 chi2 ap1 lou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喝醉酒之后，就开始胡说八道。
examples.english_sentence: After he got drunk, he started talking nonsense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好信佢噏撈，佢講嘅嘢都係假嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 ap1 lou1, keoi5 gong2 ge3 ye5 dou1 hai6 gaa2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要相信他胡说八道，他说的东西都是假的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't believe his nonsense, everything he says is false.

synonyms: 亂噏廿四 (luan6 ap1 jaa6 sei3)

english_meaning: to talk nonsense, to ramble incoherently, to speak gibberish
explanation_mandarin: 指说话没有条理，内容荒谬，像精神失常的人说的话。
explanation_english: Refers to speaking without coherence or logical sense, with nonsensical content, like someone who is mentally disturbed. Implies speaking rubbish or talking crazy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺度噏瘋啦，我聽唔明你講乜嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 ap1 fung1 laa1, ngo5 teng1 m4 ming4 nei5 gong2 mat1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别在这里胡说八道了，我听不明白你在说什么。
examples.english_sentence: Stop talking nonsense here, I can't understand what you're saying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢飲醉咗，開始喺度噏瘋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yam2 zeoi3 zo2, hoi1 chi2 hai2 dou6 ap1 fung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喝醉了，开始在那里胡说八道。
examples.english_sentence: He got drunk and started talking nonsense.

mandarin_meaning: 垂头丧气, 没精打采
english_meaning: listless, dejected, downcast, dispirited
explanation_mandarin: 形容精神状态不好，情绪低落，没有活力。
explanation_english: Describes a state of low spirits, dejection, and lack of energy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試唔合格，成日都噏耷噉嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 m4 gok3 gaak3, seng4 jat6 dou1 ap1 dap1 gam2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试没及格，整天都垂头丧气的。
examples.english_sentence: He failed the exam and has been listless all day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁噏耷啦，打起精神！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 ap1 dap1 laa1, daa2 hei2 jing1 san4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么没精打采了，打起精神来！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so downcast, cheer up!

english_meaning: to talk nonsense; to boast; to lie; to exaggerate
explanation_mandarin: 指说话没有根据，信口开河，胡说八道，或者夸大其词。
explanation_english: Refers to speaking without basis, talking nonsense, or exaggerating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日噏風啦，邊有人信你啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 ap1 fung1 laa1, bin1 jau5 jan4 seon3 nei5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是吹牛了，没有人会相信你的。
examples.english_sentence: Stop talking nonsense all the time, no one will believe you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢全部都係噏風，唔好信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 ap1 fung1, m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话全部都是胡说八道，不要相信他。
examples.english_sentence: Everything he says is nonsense, don't believe him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪聽佢噏風啦，佢根本唔識㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 ting1 keoi5 ap1 fung1 laa1, keoi5 gan1 bun2 m4 sik1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别听他胡说八道了，他根本不懂的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't listen to his nonsense, he doesn't understand at all.

english_meaning: to lick, to suck
explanation_mandarin: 用舌头接触或吸取。
explanation_english: To lick or suck something, especially to eat or taste it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢噒晒啲雪條，搞到成手都係。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lin1 saai3 di1 syut3 tiu2, gaau2 dou3 seng4 sau2 dou1 hai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把冰棍都舔完了，弄得满手都是。
examples.english_sentence: He licked the whole popsicle, making his hands all sticky.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻貓仔好鍾意噒自己嘅毛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 maau1 zai2 hou2 zung1 ji3 lin1 zi6 gei2 ge3 mou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小猫很喜欢舔自己的毛。
examples.english_sentence: The kitten likes to lick its fur.

english_meaning: long-winded; verbose; to nag
explanation_mandarin: 形容人说话很啰嗦，重复地说个不停，让人觉得厌烦。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is long-winded, repeats themselves constantly, and is annoying to others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁噒諄啦，我都明㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 lin1 zeon1 laa1, ngo5 dou1 ming4 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么啰嗦了，我都明白了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so long-winded, I understand already.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆成日喺度噒諄，講啲舊時嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 lin1 zeon1, gong2 di1 gau6 si4 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老奶奶整天在那里唠叨，说一些过去的事情。
examples.english_sentence: The grandmother is always nagging there, talking about things from the past.

examples.english_sentence: Are you not embarrassed that you're always here freeloading off others?

explanation_mandarin: 关心问候别人的冷暖，多指对病人或体弱者的关怀。

explanation_mandarin: 指闲谈、聊天。多用于描述轻松、非正式的谈话。

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生用啲器械幫病人做手術。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 yung6 di1 hei3 haai6 bong1 beng6 yan2 zou6 sau2 seot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生用一些器械帮助病人做手术。
examples.english_sentence: Doctors use some instruments to help patients perform surgery.

english_meaning: utensil; container; implement; ware
explanation_mandarin: 盛放物品的用具，如碗、盘、杯子等。
explanation_english: A utensil or container used for holding or serving something, such as bowls, plates, cups, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廚房有好多唔同嘅器皿，好似碗、碟、煲咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyu4 fong4 jau5 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 ge3 hei3 ming5, hou2 ci5 wun2, dip2, bou1 gam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 厨房有很多不同的器皿，比如碗、碟、锅等。
examples.english_sentence: There are many different utensils in the kitchen, such as bowls, plates, and pots.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個器皿好精緻，唔捨得用佢嚟裝嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hei3 ming5 hou2 zing1 zi3, m4 se2 dak1 yung6 keoi5 lai4 zong1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个器皿很精致，舍不得用它来装东西。
examples.english_sentence: This utensil is very delicate, I don't want to use it to hold things.

english_meaning: to value highly; to think highly of; to esteem
explanation_mandarin: 重视，看重。指认为某人有才能或值得信赖而给予重视。
explanation_english: To value highly; to think highly of; to esteem. It refers to valuing someone highly because they are considered talented or trustworthy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好俾老細器重㗎，升職好快嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 bei2 lou5 sai3 hei3 zung6 gaa3, sing1 zik1 hou2 faai3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很受老板器重，升职很快的。
examples.english_sentence: He is highly valued by the boss, so he gets promoted quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好感激你器重我，畀機會我負責呢個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 gam2 gik1 nei5 hei3 zung6 ngo5, bei2 gei1 wui2 ngo5 fu6 zaak3 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很感激你器重我，给我机会负责这个项目。
examples.english_sentence: I am very grateful that you think highly of me and give me the opportunity to be responsible for this project.

english_meaning: tolerance; magnanimity; capacity; breadth of mind
explanation_mandarin: 指人的胸襟、气度和度量。形容一个人能容忍、宽恕他人的过错或不同意见。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's magnanimity, tolerance, and capacity. Describes someone who can tolerate and forgive the mistakes or different opinions of others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅器量好大，乜嘢都唔會計較。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hei3 loeng6 hou2 daai6, mat1 je5 dou1 m4 wui5 gai3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的气量很大，什么都不会计较。
examples.english_sentence: He has great tolerance and doesn't hold grudges about anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做大事嘅人要有器量先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 daai6 si6 ge3 jan4 jiu3 jau5 hei3 loeng6 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做大事的人要有气量才行。
examples.english_sentence: People who do great things must have magnanimity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你器量細，咁小事都嬲咁耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hei3 loeng6 sai3, gam3 siu2 si6 dou1 nau1 gam3 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你气量小，这么小的事都生气这么久。
examples.english_sentence: You are narrow-minded, you're still angry about such a small thing for so long.

mandarin_meaning: 凶恶; 坏的; 凶兆; 坏事
english_meaning: ominous; inauspicious; bad; evil omen; bad news
explanation_mandarin: 表示凶险、不吉利。 通常指不好的事情或预兆。
explanation_english: Indicates something ominous, inauspicious, or unlucky. Usually refers to bad events or omens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好彩嘅事就叫做「噩耗」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 coi2 ge3 si6 zau6 giu3 zou6 "ngok6 hou3".
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不幸的消息就叫做“噩耗”。
examples.english_sentence: Unfortunate news is called "bad news".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排發生咁多噩夢，真係唔知發生咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 faat3 sang1 gam3 do1 ngok6 mung6, zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 faat3 sang1 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近做了这么多噩梦，真不知道发生了什么事。
examples.english_sentence: I've been having so many nightmares lately, I really don't know what's going on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到佢過身嘅消息，簡直係一個噩耗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 dou2 keoi5 gwo3 san1 ge3 siu1 sik1, gaan2 zik6 hai6 jat1 go3 ngok6 hou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到他去世的消息，简直是一个噩耗。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing the news of his passing was simply devastating.

english_meaning: nightmare
explanation_mandarin: 指可怕的梦境，令人感到不安和恐惧的梦。
explanation_english: A very unpleasant dream that causes strong feelings of fear, horror, or distress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 琴晚發咗個好恐怖嘅噩夢，嚇到我成晚都瞓唔著。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kam4 maan5 faat3 zo2 go3 hou2 hung2 bou3 ge3 ngok6 mung6, haak3 dou3 ngo5 seng4 maan5 dou1 fan3 m4 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨晚做了一个很恐怖的噩梦，吓得我整晚都没睡着。
examples.english_sentence: I had a terrible nightmare last night, it scared me so much I couldn't sleep all night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事簡直係我嘅噩夢，唔想再經歷多次。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 gaan2 zik6 hai6 ngo5 ge3 ngok6 mung6, m4 soeng2 zoi3 ging1 lik6 do1 ci3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事简直是我的噩梦，不想再经历一次。
examples.english_sentence: This event is simply a nightmare for me, I don't want to experience it again.

english_meaning: bad news; sad news; a death knell
explanation_mandarin: 指令人悲痛或震惊的坏消息，通常指死亡或灾难。
explanation_english: Refers to devastating or shocking bad news, often concerning death or disaster.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 琴日收到個噩耗，佢阿爺過咗身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kam4 jat6 sau1 dou2 go3 ngok6 hou3, keoi5 aa3 je4 gwo3 zo2 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天收到一个噩耗，他爷爷去世了。
examples.english_sentence: I received some bad news yesterday, his grandfather passed away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 地震之後，不斷傳嚟嘅都係噩耗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dei6 zan3 zi1 hau6, bat1 dyun6 cyun4 lai4 ge3 dou1 hai6 ngok6 hou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 地震之后，不断传来的都是噩耗。
examples.english_sentence: After the earthquake, it was just a stream of bad news coming in.

english_meaning: bad luck, misfortune
explanation_mandarin: 指不幸的遭遇，倒霉的运气。
explanation_english: Refers to unfortunate experiences or bad luck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從佢失業之後，就開始行噩運，乜嘢衰嘢都俾佢撞到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 keoi5 sat1 jip6 zi1 hau6, zau6 hoi1 chi2 haang4 ngok6 wan6, mat1 je5 seoi1 je5 dou1 bei2 keoi5 zong6 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从他失业之后，就开始走厄运，什么倒霉事都被他碰到。
examples.english_sentence: Ever since he lost his job, he's been having bad luck; he's encountering all sorts of misfortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁迷信啦，邊有咁多噩運㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 mai4 seon3 laa1, bin1 jau5 gam3 do1 ngok6 wan6 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么迷信啦，哪有那么多厄运啊？
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so superstitious, how can there be so much bad luck?

english_meaning: noisy; clamorous; to make a noise; to be noisy
explanation_mandarin: 形容声音嘈杂，令人烦躁不安；或指发出嘈杂的声音。
explanation_english: Describes a loud and annoying sound; to make a racket; to be loud and disruptive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嘈到死呀！你哋班細路唔好咁噪啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: cou3 dou3 sei2 aa3! nei5 dei6 baan1 sai3 lou6 m4 hou2 gam3 cou3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吵死了！你们这群小孩不要这么吵啦！
examples.english_sentence: It's so noisy! You kids, don't be so loud!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部冷氣機好噪，瞓唔著。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 laang5 hei3 gei1 hou2 cou3, fan3 m4 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台空调很吵，睡不着。
examples.english_sentence: This air conditioner is so noisy, I can't sleep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺圖書館度咁噪啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 tou4 syu1 gun2 dou6 gam3 cou3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在图书馆里这么吵。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so noisy in the library.

english_meaning: noise, racket
explanation_mandarin: 令人感到厌烦或刺耳的声音。
explanation_english: Unpleasant or unwanted sound.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度日日都咁嘈，好多噪音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 jat6 jat6 dou1 gam3 cou4, hou2 do1 cou3 jam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里每天都这么吵，很多噪音。
examples.english_sentence: It's so noisy here every day, there's a lot of noise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: D地盤嘅噪音真係好擾人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: D dei6 paan2 ge3 cou3 jam1 zan1 hai6 hou2 jiu2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工地的噪音真的很扰人。
examples.english_sentence: The noise from the construction site is really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 長期暴露喺噪音嘅環境之下，會影響聽力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 kei4 bou6 lou6 hai2 cou3 jam1 ge3 waan4 ging2 zi1 haa6, wui5 jing2 hoeng2 teng1 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 长期暴露在噪音的环境下，会影响听力。
examples.english_sentence: Prolonged exposure to noisy environments can affect hearing.

english_meaning: expressing surprise, sigh, or other emotions
explanation_mandarin: 表示轻微的惊讶、怀疑、或不确定的语气。
explanation_english: Used to express a slight surprise, doubt, or uncertain tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 噫？點解會咁樣㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: yi1? dim2 gaai2 wui5 gam2 joeng2 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 咦？为什么会这样呢？
examples.english_sentence: Huh? Why is it like this?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 噫...唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yi1... m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 唉...不知道怎么办好。
examples.english_sentence: Sigh... I don't know what to do.

english_meaning: to bite; to devour
explanation_mandarin: 用牙齿咬，吞噬。
explanation_english: To bite; to devour; to eat with teeth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾隻狗噬咗一啖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 zek3 gau2 sai6 zo2 jat1 daam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被狗咬了一口。
examples.english_sentence: He was bitten by the dog.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲蟲噬緊啲樹葉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 cung4 sai6 gan2 di1 syu6 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虫子正在吞噬树叶。
examples.english_sentence: Insects are devouring the leaves.

english_meaning: sigh; an interjection expressing regret, disappointment, or resignation.
explanation_mandarin: 表示叹息，遗憾，失望等情绪的语气词。
explanation_english: An interjection used to express a sigh, regret, disappointment, or resignation. It's similar to the English "sigh" or "alas."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 噯，今次考試又衰咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ai2, gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 jau6 seoi1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 唉，这次考试又没考好。
examples.english_sentence: Sigh, I failed the exam again this time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 噯，都係冇辦法嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ai2, dou1 hai6 mou5 baan6 faat3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 唉，也是没办法的。
examples.english_sentence: Alas, there's nothing we can do.

english_meaning: gimmick, stunt, publicity stunt, trick, feature (designed to attract attention)
explanation_mandarin: 指吸引人注意的奇特手法、花招、卖点等。通常带有为了宣传或推广的目的。
explanation_english: Refers to a gimmick, stunt, or trick designed to attract attention, often for promotional or publicity purposes. It implies something unusual or sensational.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳成日諗埋啲新噱頭嚟吸引客人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 seng4 jat6 lam2 maai4 di1 san1 gek3 tau4 lai4 kap1 jan5 go3 hak3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅总是想出一些新的噱头来吸引客人。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant always comes up with new gimmicks to attract customers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢呢套戲嘅最大噱頭就係請咗個荷里活明星嚟客串。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ni1 tou3 hei3 ge3 zeoi3 daai6 gek3 tau4 zau6 hai6 ceng2 zo2 go3 ho4 lei4 wut6 ming4 sing1 lai4 hak3 cyun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影最大的噱头就是请了一位好莱坞明星来客串。
examples.english_sentence: The biggest gimmick of this movie is that they invited a Hollywood star for a cameo.

english_meaning: Gimmick, trick, stunt, hype
explanation_mandarin: 指为了吸引顾客或观众而采取的花招、手段或宣传方式。通常带有一种哗众取宠或不实宣传的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to a gimmick, trick, stunt, or form of hype used to attract customers or audiences. Often carries a connotation of being sensationalistic or misleading.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食好普通，全部都係靠啲噱頭嚟吸引人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 hou2 pou2 tung1, cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 kaau3 di1 gok3 tau4 lai4 kap1 jan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西很普通，全都是靠噱头来吸引人。
examples.english_sentence: The food in this restaurant is very ordinary; it relies entirely on gimmicks to attract people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個電影嘅劇情好差，啲特效只係噱頭嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 din6 ying2 ge3 kek6 ching4 hou2 caa1, di1 dak6 haau6 zi2 hai6 gok3 tau4 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影的剧情很差，那些特效只是噱头而已。
examples.english_sentence: The plot of this movie is terrible; the special effects are just a gimmick.

english_meaning: to spray, to spout, to erupt, to criticize vehemently
explanation_mandarin: 指液体或气体从孔中快速射出。也指猛烈地批评。
explanation_english: To emit a liquid or gas in a stream. Also used to describe vehement criticism or scolding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢成日噴口水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 seng4 jat6 pan3 hau2 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话总是喷口水。
examples.english_sentence: He sprays saliva when he speaks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂咁噴消毒劑呀，小心噴到人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 pan3 siu1 duk6 zai1 aa3, siu2 sam1 pan3 dou3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱喷消毒剂啊，小心喷到人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't spray disinfectant randomly, be careful not to spray people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾老細噴到狗血淋頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 lou5 sai3 pan3 dou3 gau2 hyut3 lam4 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被老板骂得狗血淋头。
examples.english_sentence: He was severely scolded by his boss.

english_meaning: talking nonsense; spouting hot air; talking rubbish
explanation_mandarin: 形容人说话不负责任，胡说八道，夸大其词，没有实际内容。
explanation_english: Describes someone who speaks irresponsibly, talks nonsense, exaggerates, and has no real content to their speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪聽佢噴一面屁啦，佢講嘢冇句真。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 ting1 keoi5 pan3 jat1 min6 pei3 laa1, keoi5 gong2 je5 mou5 geoi3 zan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别听他胡说八道，他说的话没有一句是真的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't listen to his nonsense, nothing he says is true.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日噴一面屁，冇人信佢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 pan3 jat1 min6 pei3, mou5 jan4 seon3 keoi5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天胡说八道，没人相信他。
examples.english_sentence: He's always spouting hot air, nobody believes him.

english_meaning: spray (medical, cleaning, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指通过喷雾方式使用的药物、清洁剂或其他液体。
explanation_english: Refers to a medication, cleaning agent, or other liquid that is applied through spraying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我用咗啲鼻敏感噴劑，舒服好多喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 yung6 zo2 di1 bei6 man5 gam2 pan3 zai1, syu1 fuk6 hou2 do1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我用了些鼻炎喷雾剂，舒服多了。
examples.english_sentence: I used some nasal allergy spray and feel much better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇帶蚊怕水噴劑呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 daai3 man1 paa3 seui2 pan3 zai1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有没有带驱蚊水喷雾剂啊？
examples.english_sentence: Did you bring insect repellent spray?

english_meaning: sneeze
explanation_mandarin: 一种生理反应，指鼻腔突然喷出空气。
explanation_english: A physiological reflex involving a sudden, forceful expulsion of air through the nose and mouth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我打咗個大噴嚏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daa2 zo2 go3 daai6 pan3 tai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打了个大喷嚏。
examples.english_sentence: I sneezed loudly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你係咪感冒呀？成日打噴嚏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai6 mai1 gam2 mou6 aa3? seng4 jat6 daa2 pan3 tai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你是不是感冒了？老是打喷嚏。
examples.english_sentence: Do you have a cold? You keep sneezing.

english_meaning: Inkjet (style/type)
explanation_mandarin: 形容词，指像墨水喷射打印机一样的工作方式或者状态，通常表示快速、大量、不精确。
explanation_english: Adjective. Refers to a style or method that resembles an inkjet printer, often implying rapid, large-scale, and sometimes imprecise execution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢噴墨式咁，快就好快，但係就唔夠仔細。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 pan3 mak6 sik1 gam2, faai3 zau6 hou2 faai3, daan6 hai6 zau6 m4 gau3 zi2 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事像喷墨式一样，快是很快，但是不够仔细。
examples.english_sentence: He works in an inkjet style, it's fast but not very detailed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司啲宣傳攻勢好似噴墨式咁，周圍都見到佢哋嘅廣告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 di1 syun1 cyun4 gung1 sai3 hou2 ci5 pan3 mak6 sik1 gam2, zau1 wai4 dou1 gin3 dou2 keoi5 dei6 ge3 gwong2 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的宣传攻势好像墨水喷射式一样，到处都能看到他们的广告。
examples.english_sentence: This company's advertising campaign is like an inkjet, you can see their ads everywhere.

english_meaning: to spray, to eject, to jet
explanation_mandarin: 指液体或气体从一个狭小的出口快速射出。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of liquid or gas being ejected or sprayed out quickly from a narrow opening.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架飛機噴射緊燃料，可能出咗事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 fei1 gei1 pan3 se6 gan2 jyun4 liu2, ho2 nang4 chut1 zo2 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那架飞机正在喷射燃料，可能出事了。
examples.english_sentence: That airplane is spraying fuel, there might be something wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋噴射啲消毒液喺條街度。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在街道上喷射消毒液。

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗支消毒噴霧返嚟清潔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 zi1 siu1 duk6 pan3 mou6 faan1 lai4 cing1 git3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一瓶消毒喷雾回来清洁。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a bottle of disinfectant spray to clean.

examples.english_sentence: He uses a nebulizer to relieve the symptoms of asthma.

english_meaning: to burst out laughing; hilarious; to be extremely funny
explanation_mandarin: 形容某事物非常搞笑，令人忍不住大笑，甚至将口中的饭喷出来。通常用来形容电影、节目或人的言行非常滑稽可笑。
explanation_english: Describes something extremely funny, causing one to burst out laughing, possibly even spitting out one's food. It is often used to describe a movie, program, or a person's words and actions that are highly comical and amusing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲真係噴飯，我由頭笑到尾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 zan1 hai6 pan3 faan6, ngo5 jau4 tau4 siu3 dou3 mei5.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话太搞笑了，忍不住笑出声。
examples.english_sentence: What he said was so funny, I couldn't help but laugh out loud.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺食飯嘅時候講咁噴飯嘅嘢啦，小心噴到周圍都係。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 sik6 faan6 ge3 si4 hau6 gong2 gam3 pan3 faan6 ge3 je5 laa1, siu2 sam1 pan3 dou3 zau1 wai4 dou1 hai6.

explanation_english: A spray used to hold hair in a particular style.

examples.english_sentence: Spray more hairspray, and your hair won't be messy.

examples.english_sentence: Don't suddenly jump out like that, you scared me!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽到巨響，嚇一跳。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 我听到巨响，吓了一跳。
examples.english_sentence: I was startled when I heard the loud noise.

explanation_mandarin: 形容非常害怕，恐惧到失去对大小便的控制。比喻吓到极点。

english_meaning: Scared shitless
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常害怕，吓得控制不住大小便。
explanation_english: An idiom used to describe someone being extremely scared, to the point of losing control of their bowels.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱睇咗套恐怖片，嚇到瀨屎咁滞。

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我頭先喺條巷仔度遇到隻大狗，真係嚇到瀨屎呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tau4 sin1 hai2 tiu4 haang2 zai2 dou6 jyu6 dou2 zek3 daai6 gau2, zan1 hai6 haak3 dou3 laai6 si2 aa3!

examples.english_sentence: I just encountered a big dog in the alley, I was really scared shitless!

jyutping: haak3 dou3 bei6 go1 lung1 dou1 mou5 juk6
english_meaning: So scared that the flesh around the nostrils disappears (indicating extreme fear)
