examples.cantonese_sentence: 琴日睇咗套鬼片，嚇到鼻哥窿都冇肉啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: kam4 jat6 tai2 zo2 tou3 gwai2 pin3, haak3 dou3 bei6 go1 lung1 dou1 mou5 juk6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天看了一部鬼片，吓得我脸色都发白了！
examples.english_sentence: I watched a horror movie yesterday; I was so scared that the flesh around my nostrils disappeared!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到老細發脾氣，嚇到鼻哥窿都冇肉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou2 lou5 sai3 faat3 pei4 hei3, haak3 dou3 bei6 go1 lung1 dou1 mou5 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到老板发脾气，吓得脸色发白。
examples.english_sentence: He was so scared seeing the boss losing his temper that his face turned pale.

english_meaning: to be easily frightened; to be raised being easily scared; to be easily intimidated
explanation_mandarin: 形容人胆小，容易受到惊吓。多指从小受到过度保护或过度惊吓而形成的性格特点。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is easily frightened or timid, often due to being overprotected or having been frequently scared during childhood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嗰陣成日俾人嚇，而家咪變咗個嚇大嘅囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 bei2 jan4 haak3, ji4 gaa1 mai1 bin3 zo2 go3 haak3 daai6 ge3 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候经常被人吓唬，现在不就变成了一个胆小的人了吗。
examples.english_sentence: He was often scared as a child, so now he's become someone who's easily frightened.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁大聲，阿仔嚇大嘅，會驚㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 seng1, aa3 zai2 haak3 daai6 ge3, wui5 geng1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么大声，儿子是吓大的，会害怕的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so loud, the son is easily scared, he will be afraid.

english_meaning: to be stunned speechless (out of fright); to be scared stiff
explanation_mandarin: 因受到惊吓而说不出话，呆住。
explanation_english: To be so shocked or frightened that one is unable to speak or move.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾個突發嘅消息嚇窒咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 go3 dat6 faat3 ge3 siu1 sik1 haak3 zat1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被这个突发的消息吓得说不出话。
examples.english_sentence: He was stunned speechless by the sudden news.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋俾佢嘅表現嚇窒咗，完全估唔到佢會咁勁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 bei2 keoi5 ge3 biu2 hin3 haak3 zat1 zo2, jyun4 cyun4 gu2 m4 dou3 keoi5 wui gam3 ging6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们被他的表现吓了一跳，完全没想到他会这么厉害。
examples.english_sentence: We were stunned by his performance, completely unexpected that he would be so good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個小朋友俾隻狗嚇窒咗，企喺度唔敢郁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 siu2 pang4 jau5 bei2 zek3 gau2 haak3 zat1 zo2, kei5 hai2 dou6 m4 gam2 juk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个小朋友被狗吓得说不出话，站在那里不敢动。
examples.english_sentence: The child was scared stiff by the dog and stood there afraid to move.

english_meaning: to be scared; to be frightened; to get a fright
explanation_mandarin: 表示受到惊吓，一般指突然或意外的惊吓。
explanation_english: To be frightened or scared, usually refers to a sudden or unexpected scare.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先差啲俾架車撞到，嚇親我呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 caa1 di1 bei2 gaa3 ce1 zong6 dou2, haak3 can1 ngo5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才差点被车撞到，吓死我了！
examples.english_sentence: I almost got hit by a car just now, it scared me so much!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思嚇親你，我唔係故意嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1 haak3 can1 nei5, ngo5 m4 hai6 gu3 ji3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思吓着你了，我不是故意的。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry for scaring you, I didn't do it on purpose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 套恐怖片好得人驚，嚇親好多人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou3 hung2 bou3 pin2 hou2 dak1 jan4 ging1, haak3 can1 hou2 do1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那部恐怖片很吓人，吓着了很多人。
examples.english_sentence: That horror movie is very scary, it frightened a lot of people.

english_meaning: to be frightened, to be startled, to get a fright
explanation_mandarin: 表示因为突然的惊吓而感到害怕或惊慌。
explanation_english: To describe the feeling of being scared or startled by something sudden and unexpected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先佢突然間喺我後面大叫，嚇驚我呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 keoi5 dat6 jin4 gaan1 hai2 ngo5 hau6 min6 daai6 giu3, haak3 ging1 ngo5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才他突然在我后面大叫，吓了我一跳！
examples.english_sentence: He suddenly shouted behind me just now, gave me a fright!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部車突然衝出嚟，嚇驚咗好多人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 ce1 dat6 jin4 cung1 chut1 lai4, haak3 ging1 zo2 hou2 do1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那辆车突然冲出来，吓到了很多人。
examples.english_sentence: That car suddenly rushed out, frightening a lot of people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好嚇驚小朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 haak3 ging1 siu2 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要吓唬小朋友。
examples.english_sentence: Don't frighten the children.

english_meaning: To scare someone; to be unbelievable; to pull someone's leg; to joke.
explanation_mandarin: 表示说话者认为某事难以置信，或怀疑对方在说谎。有“吓唬人呢吧？”，“别骗我！”的意思。
explanation_english: Expresses disbelief or skepticism. The speaker believes that what is being said is untrue, exaggerated, or unbelievable. Similar to saying "You're kidding me!" or "Don't pull my leg!"

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話你中咗六合彩頭獎？ 嚇鬼咩！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 nei5 zung3 zo2 luk6 hap6 coi2 tau4 zoeng2? haak3 gwai2 me1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说你中了彩票头奖？ 骗谁呢！
examples.english_sentence: You're saying you won the lottery jackpot? You're kidding me!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢識得李嘉誠，嚇鬼呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 sik1 dak1 lei5 ga1 sing4, haak3 gwai2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他认识李嘉诚，鬼才信啊！
examples.english_sentence: He said he knows Li Ka-shing, no way!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁平嘅價錢？唔係嚇鬼呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam3 peng4 ge3 gaa3 cin2? m4 hai6 haak3 gwai2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这么便宜的价格？不是骗人的吧？
examples.english_sentence: Such a cheap price? Are you pulling my leg?

english_meaning: nag; be a nag; complain repetitively
explanation_mandarin: 指不停地抱怨、嘮叨，令人厭煩。
explanation_english: To nag; to constantly complain or find fault in an annoying way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都嚊我唔執嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 naau1 ngo5 m4 zap1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她每天都唠叨我不收拾东西。
examples.english_sentence: She nags me every day for not tidying up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再嚊啦，我知錯啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 naau1 laa1, ngo5 zi1 co3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再唠叨了，我知道错了！
examples.english_sentence: Stop nagging me, I know I was wrong!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個阿媽成日嚊個仔唔讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 a3 maa1 seng4 jat6 naau1 go3 zai2 m4 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个妈妈总是唠叨儿子不读书。
examples.english_sentence: That mother always nags her son for not studying.

english_meaning: to howl; to wail; to cry loudly
explanation_mandarin: 指大声哭叫，通常带有悲伤、痛苦或愤怒的情绪。
explanation_english: To cry loudly, often with strong emotions like sadness, pain, or anger. It can also refer to the howling sound of animals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個細路跌親，嚎到拆天咁滯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sai3 lou6 dit3 can1, hou4 dou3 caak3 tin1 gam2 zai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个小孩摔倒了，哭得快要把天拆了。
examples.english_sentence: The child fell down and cried so loudly as if the sky was falling apart.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺度嚎啦，靜啲得唔得呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 hou4 laa1, zing6 di1 dak1 m4 dak1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在这里嚎叫了，安静一点行不行？
examples.english_sentence: Don't wail here, can you be quiet?

english_meaning: to wail, to howl in tears
explanation_mandarin: 指放声大哭，哭得很响亮。
explanation_english: To cry loudly and unrestrainedly; to wail or howl in grief or pain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢知阿爺走咗，即刻嚎哭起嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi1 aa3 je4 zau2 zo2, zik1 hak1 hou4 huk1 hei2 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他知道爷爷走了，立刻嚎啕大哭起来。
examples.english_sentence: He knew that grandpa had passed away and immediately burst into wailing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到呢個壞消息，佢忍唔住嚎哭出聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou2 ni1 go3 waai6 siu1 sik1, keoi5 jan2 m4 zyu6 hou4 huk1 chut1 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到这个坏消息，他忍不住嚎啕大哭起来。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing this bad news, he couldn't help but burst into wailing.

synonyms: 大喊大叫 (daai6 haam3 daai6 giu3)

english_meaning: sneeze
explanation_mandarin: 指因鼻腔受到刺激而突然喷气。
explanation_english: To expel air forcibly from the nose and mouth in an involuntary or convulsive way as a result of irritation of the nasal mucous membrane.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我打咗個嚏，好似感冒咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daa2 zo2 go3 tai3, hou2 ci5 gam2 mou6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打了一个喷嚏，好像感冒了。
examples.english_sentence: I sneezed, it seems like I have a cold.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一入到間房就打咗幾個嚏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 jap6 dou3 gaan1 fong2 zau6 daa2 zo2 gei2 go3 tai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一进到房间就打了几个喷嚏。
examples.english_sentence: He sneezed a few times as soon as he entered the room.

english_meaning: to taste; to try; to experience
explanation_mandarin: 品尝味道；尝试体验。
explanation_english: To taste the flavor; to try and experience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嚐下呢個蛋糕好唔好味啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng4 haa5 ni1 go3 daan6 gou1 hou2 m4 hou2 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 尝尝这个蛋糕好不好吃？
examples.english_sentence: Try this cake, is it delicious?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想嚐試下跳傘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 soeng4 si3 haa5 tiu3 saan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想尝试一下跳伞。
examples.english_sentence: I want to try skydiving.

english_meaning: question particle (similar to 'ma' in Mandarin)
explanation_mandarin: 表示疑问的语气助词，相当于普通话的“吗”。
explanation_english: A question particle used at the end of a sentence to form a yes/no question, similar to "ma" in Mandarin Chinese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你食咗飯嚒？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sik6 zo2 faan6 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你吃饭了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you eaten?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日唔返工嚒？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 m4 faan1 gung1 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天不工作吗？
examples.english_sentence: Isn't he working today?

mandarin_meaning: 擦, 迅速地擦, 很快地做
english_meaning: To wipe, to rub quickly; quickly, swiftly; whoosh (sound of quick wiping)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 动词, 副词, 象声词
explanation_mandarin: 动作迅速地擦拭；表示动作迅速或状态快速变化；也可作象声词，形容快速擦过的声音。
explanation_english: To wipe or rub something quickly; indicates a swift action or a rapid change of state; can also be used as an onomatopoeia to describe the sound of something being wiped quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋好快噉「嚓」一「嚓」就搞掂咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hou2 faai3 gam2 "caat3" yat1 "caat3" zau6 gaau2 dim6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们很快地擦了一下就搞定了。
examples.english_sentence: They quickly wiped it once and it was done.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我「嚓」一聲就抹乾淨咗個檯面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 "caat3" yat1 seng1 zau6 mut3 gon1 zing6 zo2 go3 toi2 min2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我唰地一下就把桌面擦干净了。
examples.english_sentence: I wiped the table clean with a swish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車「嚓」一聲就飛走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 "caat3" yat1 seng1 zau6 fei1 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车嗖地一声就飞走了。
examples.english_sentence: The car whooshed away.

english_meaning: to nag, to be repetitive in speech, to drone on, to grumble
explanation_mandarin: 指不停地重复地说，通常带有抱怨或者不满的情绪。
explanation_english: Refers to repeatedly saying something, usually with complaint or dissatisfaction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再嚕啦，我知㗎啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 lou1 laa1, ngo5 zi1 gaa3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再唠叨了，我知道了！
examples.english_sentence: Stop nagging, I know already!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺度嚕，真係好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 lou1, zan1 hai6 hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天在那里唠叨，真是很烦人。
examples.english_sentence: He's always nagging there, it's really annoying.

english_meaning: to gnaw, to bite
explanation_mandarin: 用牙齿啃、咬。
explanation_english: To gnaw, nibble, or bite with the teeth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻老鼠喺度嚙緊啲木頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 lou5 syu2 hai2 dou6 ngit6 gan2 di1 muk6 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那只老鼠正在啃木头。
examples.english_sentence: The rat is gnawing at the wood.

english_meaning: cringeworthy; nauseatingly sentimental; cheesy; corny
explanation_mandarin: 形容言语、行为或事物过于甜腻、让人感到不舒服或尴尬。
explanation_english: Describes speech, behavior, or things that are excessively sweet or sentimental, making one feel uncomfortable or embarrassed. Often used to describe cheesy or corny expressions of affection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺條街度攬頭攬頸，真係嚙牙到死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 tiu4 gaai1 dou6 laam5 tau4 laam5 geng2, zan1 hai6 ngaa5 ngaa4 dou3 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在街上搂搂抱抱，真是肉麻死了。
examples.english_sentence: They were hugging and kissing in the street, it was so cringeworthy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 套戲啲情節好嚙牙，睇到我起晒雞皮疙瘩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou3 hei3 di1 cing4 zit3 hou2 ngaa5 ngaa4, tai2 dou3 ngo5 hei2晒 gai1 pei4 gat1 daap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影的情节很肉麻，看得我起鸡皮疙瘩。
examples.english_sentence: The plot of the movie was so cheesy, it gave me goosebumps.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好講埋啲咁嚙牙嘅嘢啦，我頂唔順呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gong2 maai4 di1 gam3 ngaa5 ngaa4 ge3 je5 laa1, ngo5 ding2 m4 seon6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要说那些肉麻的话了，我受不了啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't say such cheesy things, I can't stand it!

english_meaning: to come, to arrive
explanation_mandarin: 表示从别的地方到说话人所在的地方，或表示到达某地。
explanation_english: To come; to arrive; indicates movement towards the speaker or a specified location.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你幾時嚟香港呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gei2 si4 lai4 hoeng1 gong2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你什么时候来香港啊？
examples.english_sentence: When are you coming to Hong Kong?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日會嚟搵你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 wui5 lai4 wan2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天会来找你。
examples.english_sentence: I will come find you tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴日嚟咗我屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 lai4 zo2 ngo5 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天来我家了。
examples.english_sentence: He came to my house yesterday.

english_meaning: To have one's period, to menstruate
explanation_mandarin: 指女性月经来潮。
explanation_english: Refers to a woman's menstrual period starting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我尋日嚟M，痛到我死死吓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cam4 jat6 lai4 em1, tung3 dou3 ngo5 si2 si2 haa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天来月经了，痛得我死去活来。
examples.english_sentence: I got my period yesterday, and it was so painful that I almost died.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日話唔舒服，唔通係嚟M呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 waa6 m4 syu1 fuk6, m4 tung1 hai6 lai4 em1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是说不舒服，难道是来月经了吗？
examples.english_sentence: She keeps saying she doesn't feel well, could it be that she's having her period?

mandarin_meaning: 来的呀 / 是…来的 / 表解释说明语气
english_meaning: It's like this / It's because / Emphasizes the reason or explanation
explanation_mandarin: 语气助词，表示解释、说明或强调语气，说明原因。
explanation_english: A sentence-final particle used to explain, clarify, or emphasize a reason or fact. It indicates that the preceding statement is providing an explanation or the reason behind something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我遲到咗，塞車嚟㗎嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ci4 dou3 zo2, sak1 ce1 lai4 gaa3 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我迟到了，因为堵车嘛。
examples.english_sentence: I was late because there was a traffic jam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁開心，中咗六合彩嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 hoi1 sam1, zung3 zo2 luk6 hap6 coi2 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么开心，因为中了彩票。
examples.english_sentence: He's so happy because he won the lottery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個係我嘅，人哋送嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 ngo5 ge3, jan4 dei6 sung3 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这是我的，是别人送的。
examples.english_sentence: This is mine. It was given to me by someone else.

english_meaning: too late; not in time; unable to make it
explanation_mandarin: 指时间上已经来不及，无法赶上或完成。
explanation_english: Refers to being too late in terms of time, unable to catch up or complete something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我驚我嚟唔切返工喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 geng1 ngo5 lai4 m4 cit3 faan1 gung1 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我怕我来不及上班了！
examples.english_sentence: I'm afraid I won't make it to work on time!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車開咗，你嚟唔切㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 hoi1 zo2, nei5 lai4 m4 cit3 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车开了，你来不及了。
examples.english_sentence: The bus has left, you're too late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嚟唔切去送佢機啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lai4 m4 cit3 heoi3 sung3 keoi5 gei1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我来不及去送他/她去机场了。
examples.english_sentence: I won't be able to make it to see him/her off at the airport.

english_meaning: coming and going; back and forth; repeatedly
explanation_mandarin: 表示动作或状态反复进行，没有变化，或者指人经常来来往往。
explanation_english: Describes something happening repeatedly, without variation, or someone frequently coming and going. Can also imply a sense of routine or lack of progress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份工都係嚟嚟去去做同一啲嘢，好悶㗎。

examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 lai4 lai4 heoi3 heoi3 dou1 hai6 king1 gan2 go3 gaa3 cin2, king1 m4 dim6 sou3.

examples.english_sentence: We've been going back and forth discussing the price, but we can't reach an agreement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺機場嚟嚟去去接人，都唔知佢做乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gei1 coeng4 lai4 lai4 heoi3 heoi3 zip3 jan4, dou1 m4 zi1 keoi5 zou6 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是往返机场接人，不知道他做什么的。
examples.english_sentence: He's always going back and forth to the airport picking people up, I don't know what he does.

english_meaning: to be able to make it (in time)

explanation_english: Indicates that there is still enough time to arrive or complete something before a deadline or appointment; to be able to make it in time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家走都嚟得切睇埋套戲嘅尾。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在走也还来得及看完电影的结尾。
examples.english_sentence: If we leave now, we can still make it to see the end of the movie.

examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 gam3 gon2, ngo5 dei6 zung1 lai4 dak1 cit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用那么赶，我们还来得及。
examples.english_sentence: Don't rush so much, we still have time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你快啲出門口啦，如果唔係就嚟唔切㗎喇。

examples.english_sentence: Hurry up and leave, or you won't make it in time.

english_meaning: Something's up; Something's about to happen; Trouble is brewing; Here it comes; Get ready for something
explanation_mandarin: 表示将要发生一些事情，通常是不好的事情或比较重大的变化，需要做好准备。带有预警和提醒的意味。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is about to happen, usually something bad, significant, or unexpected, requiring preparation. It carries a sense of warning and alert.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日要考試，但係我乜都未溫，真係嚟料喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 jiu3 haau2 si3, daan6 hai6 ngo5 mat1 dou1 mei6 wan1, zan1 hai6 lai4 liu2 laa3.

examples.english_sentence: I have an exam tomorrow, but I haven't studied anything. I'm in trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到老細個樣咁黑，就知嚟料喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 lou5 sai3 go3 joeng2 gam3 hak1, zau6 zi1 lai4 liu2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到老板脸色那么黑，就知道要出事了。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing the boss's face so dark, I know something's up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋晚落咁大雨，聽日返工應該嚟料，好多地方會塞車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 maan1 lok6 gam3 daai6 jyu5, ting1 jat6 faan1 gung1 jing1 goi1 lai4 liu2, hou2 do1 dei6 fong1 wui5 sak1 che1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨晚下了这么大的雨，明天上班应该有情况，很多地方会堵车。
examples.english_sentence: It rained so heavily last night, there's bound to be trouble getting to work tomorrow. Many places will be congested.

english_meaning: to be serious; to be for real; to actually do something (often previously joked about); to mean it
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人并非开玩笑，而是认真的，或者真的采取了行动。通常指原本以为是玩笑的事情变成了现实。
explanation_english: Indicates that someone is not joking but is serious, or that they have actually taken action. It often refers to a situation where something that was initially thought to be a joke has become a reality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話辭職唔係嚟眞㗎嘛？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 ci4 zik1 m4 hai6 lai4 zan1 gaa3 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说辞职不是来真的吧？
examples.english_sentence: You're not actually serious about quitting your job, are you?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話要減肥，點知真係嚟眞，日日都跑步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 jiu3 gaam2 fei4, dim2 zi1 zan1 hai6 lai4 zan1, jat1 jat6 dou1 paau2 bou6.

examples.english_sentence: He said he wanted to lose weight, and he actually meant it! He runs every day.

examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hak3 ngo5 laa1, nei5 m4 wui5 lai4 zan1 gaa3 maa3?

examples.english_sentence: Don't scare me, you wouldn't actually be serious, would you?

english_meaning: to be serious, to get real, to do for real
explanation_mandarin: 指事情不是开玩笑，而是认真进行或采取实际行动。
explanation_english: Refers to doing something seriously, not as a joke or in a playful way. Implies taking real action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你估我同你講笑咩，我嚟真㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gu2 ngo5 tung4 nei5 gong2 siu3 me1, ngo5 lai4 zan1 gaa3!

examples.english_sentence: This time the boss said he's getting serious, we can't do a bad job!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話要辭職，唔知係咪嚟真呢？

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说要辞职，不知道是不是真的？
examples.english_sentence: He said he's going to resign, I wonder if he's serious?

english_meaning: to have one's period, to menstruate
explanation_mandarin: 指女性开始月经期，即俗称的“来月经”。
explanation_english: Refers to a woman starting her menstrual period; commonly known as 'having one's period'.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 她说她来月经了，不想出门。
examples.english_sentence: She said she has her period and doesn't want to go out.

english_meaning: coming, upcoming, next, soon

explanation_english: Indicates something that will happen soon, approaching the future.

examples.jyutping_sentence: lai4 gan2 go3 sing1 kei4 ngo5 wui5 heoi3 hoeng1 gong2.

examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Hong Kong next week.

english_meaning: about to start; coming up; soon; in the near future

explanation_english: Refers to something that is about to happen or begin, indicating a close timeframe in the future.

english_meaning: to approach; to arrive; to be imminent; to come

examples.english_sentence: The storm is about to arrive; everyone needs to take precautions against the wind.

examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 lai4 lam4, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 gan2 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试临近，大家都非常紧张。

examples.english_sentence: Speaking for myself, the food at this restaurant is quite delicious.

english_meaning: to have come (before)

examples.english_sentence: The surface of this stone is rough and slightly shiny, very coarse.

english_meaning: rough, coarse, not smooth
explanation_mandarin: 形容表面不光滑，摸起来感觉粗糙。
explanation_english: Describes a surface that is not smooth, and feels rough to the touch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢塊砂紙摸落去嚡霎霎嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 faai3 saa1 zi2 mok1 lok6 heoi3 haai4 sap1 sap1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张砂纸摸起来很粗糙。
examples.english_sentence: This sandpaper feels rough to the touch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對手洗完碗之後變得嚡霎霎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 sau2 sai2 jyun4 wun2 zi1 hau6 bin3 dak1 haai4 sap1 sap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我洗完碗后，手变得很粗糙。
examples.english_sentence: My hands became rough after washing the dishes.

english_meaning: to deceive; to cheat; to trick; to swindle
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语中，表示欺骗，蒙骗。相当于普通话的“骗”。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, it means to deceive, to cheat, or to swindle someone. Equivalent to "骗" in Mandarin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁容易俾人嚢啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 jung4 ji6 bei2 jan4 long1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么容易被人骗啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so easily deceived by others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日嚢人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 long1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常骗人。
examples.english_sentence: He often deceives people.

english_meaning: fashionable, trendy, stylish
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人或者事物很时髦，很流行。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something as being fashionable, trendy, or stylish. Often used to describe something that is up-to-date with the latest trends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢着衫好嚤架，成日跟潮流。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 saam1 hou2 mo1 gaa3, seng4 jat6 gan1 ciu4 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她穿着很时髦，总是追赶潮流。
examples.english_sentence: She dresses very fashionably and always follows the trends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳裝修好嚤，好啱打卡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 zong1 sau1 hou2 mo1, hou2 ngaam1 daa2 kaat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅装修很时髦，很适合拍照打卡。
examples.english_sentence: The decoration of this restaurant is very trendy, it's perfect for taking photos.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你部電話好嚤喎，新款嚟嘅？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bou6 din6 waa2 hou2 mo1 wo3, san1 fun2 lai4 ge3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的手机很时髦啊，是新款的吗？
examples.english_sentence: Your phone is very stylish, is it a new model?

english_meaning: slow, sluggish, lethargic
explanation_mandarin: 形容人动作或事物进展缓慢。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something that is slow-moving or progressing slowly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好嚤佗，成日都交唔到貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 mo1 to4, seng4 jat6 dou1 gaau1 m4 dou2 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很慢吞吞，总是交不了货。
examples.english_sentence: He's so slow at work, he can never deliver on time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電腦好嚤佗，開機要等好耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 nou5 hou2 mo1 to4, hoi1 gei1 jiu3 dang2 hou2 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台电脑很慢，开机要等很久。
examples.english_sentence: This computer is very slow, it takes a long time to boot up.

mandarin_meaning: 马马虎虎, 不认真, 粗心大意
english_meaning: Careless, sloppy, slapdash, not serious, perfunctory
explanation_mandarin: 形容做事不认真，草率，马虎。也指态度不认真。
explanation_english: Describes being careless, sloppy, or perfunctory in one's work or attitude. It implies a lack of seriousness and attention to detail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份功課做得咁嚤囉差，點交畀人呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 gung1 fo3 zou6 dak1 gam3 mo1 lo1 caa1, dim2 gaau1 bei2 jan4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份作业做得这么马虎，怎么能交给别人呢？
examples.english_sentence: This assignment is done so sloppily, how can you submit it to someone?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁嚤囉差啦，認真啲做嘢啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 mo1 lo1 caa1 laa1, jing6 zan1 di1 zou6 je5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么马虎啦，认真工作吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so careless, please work more seriously!

synonyms: 是是但但 (si6 si6 daan6 daan6)

jyutping: mo1 lo1 caa1 waan2 jam1 ngok6
mandarin_meaning: 不务正业; 外行人装内行
english_meaning: To engage in frivolous or improper activities; An amateur dabbling in something they don't understand; Playing music poorly (as a metaphor)
explanation_mandarin: “嚤囉差”指外国人或不懂本地文化的人，带贬义。整体意思是指外国人或外行人不务正业地玩音乐，引申为不专业的人做不专业的事，带有讽刺意味。
explanation_english: "Moo lo chaa" refers to foreigners or those who don't understand local culture, often with a derogatory connotation. The idiom literally means a foreigner playing music, implying someone unprofessional or unskilled doing something beyond their abilities. It's used to describe someone engaging in frivolous or inappropriate activities, or someone dabbling in something they don't understand, often in a dismissive or sarcastic way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢又唔係專業嘅，走去搞電影，咪即係嚤囉差玩音樂囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau6 m4 hai6 zyun1 jip6 ge3, zau2 heoi3 gaau2 din6 ying2, mai1 zik1 hai6 mo1 lo1 caa1 waan2 jam1 ngok6 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他又不是专业的，跑去搞电影，不就是外行人装内行吗。
examples.english_sentence: He's not a professional, yet he's trying to make a movie. Isn't that just an amateur dabbling?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔識整電腦，咪鬼搞啦，唔好嚤囉差玩音樂啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 sik1 zing2 din6 nou5, mai1 gwai2 gaau2 laa1, m4 hou2 mo1 lo1 caa1 waan2 jam1 ngok6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不会修电脑，别碰了，别不懂装懂了。
examples.english_sentence: You don't know how to fix computers, don't touch it! Don't pretend you know what you're doing.

jyutping: mo1 lo1 caa1 dou1 jau5 zik6 man4 dei6
mandarin_meaning: 再差的地方也有其可取之处；各有千秋
english_meaning: Even the worst place has its good points; every place has its own merits.
explanation_mandarin: 这句话的意思是说，即使是条件很差、很糟糕的地方，也有其独特的优点和价值。强调任何事物都有其存在的意义，不应一概否定。
explanation_english: This idiom means that even the worst or most undesirable place has its own unique merits and value. It emphasizes that everything has its purpose and should not be completely dismissed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然呢度環境唔好，但係嚤囉差都有殖民地，佢哋嘅人情味好濃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 ni1 dou6 waan4 ging2 m4 hou2, daan6 hai6 mo1 lo1 caa1 dou1 jau5 zik6 man4 dei6, keoi5 dei6 ge3 jan4 cing4 mei6 hou2 nung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然这里环境不好，但是再差的地方也有殖民地，他们的人情味很浓。
examples.english_sentence: Although the environment here is not good, even the worst place has its good points, and the people here are very friendly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好睇小嗰條村，嚤囉差都有殖民地，佢哋啲手工藝品好出名㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 tai2 siu2 go2 tiu4 cyun1, mo1 lo1 caa1 dou1 jau5 zik6 man4 dei6, keoi5 dei6 di1 sau2 gung1 ngai6 ban2 hou2 ceot1 ming4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要小看那个村子，再差的地方也有殖民地，他们的手工艺品很出名的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't underestimate that village, even the worst place has its good points, their handicrafts are very famous.

english_meaning: Internet; the online world; cyberspace
explanation_mandarin: 指互联网，网络世界。源自英文“online”的谐音。
explanation_english: Refers to the Internet, the online world, or cyberspace. It's a Cantonese transliteration of the English word "online".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲資訊咁發達，喺嚤囉網乜都搵到㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 zi1 seon3 gam3 faat3 daat6, hai2 mo1 lo1 mong5 mat1 dou1 wan2 dou2 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在资讯这么发达，在互联网上什么都能找到。
examples.english_sentence: Information is so readily available now; you can find anything on the internet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日掛住喺嚤囉網度流連，都唔理屋企人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gwaa3 zyu6 hai2 mo1 lo1 mong5 dou6 lau4 lin4, dou1 m4 lei5 uk1 kei2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天只顾着在网络上游荡，都不理家人。
examples.english_sentence: He spends all his time loitering on the internet and doesn't care about his family.

english_meaning: to swallow
explanation_mandarin: 使食物或其他东西通过喉咙进入食道和胃。
explanation_english: To pass food or other things through the throat and into the esophagus and stomach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我食得太快，差啲嚥唔落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sik6 dak1 taai3 faai3, caa1 di1 jin1 m4 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我吃得太快，差点咽不下去。
examples.english_sentence: I ate too fast and almost couldn't swallow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔舒服，嚥嘢都覺得痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 syu1 fuk6, jin1 je5 dou1 gok3 dak1 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不舒服，吞咽东西都觉得痛。
examples.english_sentence: He's not feeling well; it hurts to swallow anything.

mandarin_meaning: 清脆的；响亮的 (形容声音)
english_meaning: crisp; clear; ringing (describes sound)
explanation_mandarin: 形容声音清脆响亮，通常用来形容小鸟的叫声。
explanation_english: Describes a crisp and clear sound, often used to describe the chirping of small birds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲雀仔嚦嚦噉叫，好得意呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 zoek3 zai2 lik1 lik1 gam2 giu3, hou2 dak1 ji3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小鸟叽叽喳喳地叫，好可爱啊！
examples.english_sentence: The little birds are chirping crisply, so cute!

english_meaning: throat; voice
explanation_mandarin: 指喉嚨，嗓子。
explanation_english: Refers to the throat, the passage for air and food; voice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我條嚨唔舒服呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tiu4 lung4 m4 syu1 fuk6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的嗓子不舒服呀。
examples.english_sentence: My throat feels uncomfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唱到聲都沙曬，嚨都痛埋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 coeng3 dou3 seng1 dou1 saa1 saai3, lung4 dou1 tung3 maai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他唱得声音都哑了，喉咙也疼了。
examples.english_sentence: He sang until his voice became hoarse and his throat started to hurt.

english_meaning: to give; to reward; to tip; to donate alms
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语中，“嚫”通常指给予，尤其是给予小费或打赏，也指布施钱财。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "嚫" typically refers to giving, especially tipping or rewarding someone. It can also refer to donating money as alms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嚫返啲錢俾你飲茶啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: can1 faan1 di1 cin2 bei2 nei5 jam2 caa4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 赏你点钱喝茶吧。
examples.english_sentence: Here's some money for you to have tea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺廟度嚫咗好多香油錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 miu2 dou6 can1 zo2 hou2 do1 hoeng1 jau4 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在庙里捐了很多香油钱。
examples.english_sentence: He donated a lot of money to the temple.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 表演得咁好，咪嚫多啲囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: biu2 jin2 dak1 gam3 hou2, mai1 can1 do1 di1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 表演得这么好，多给点小费吧。
examples.english_sentence: You performed so well, give a bigger tip!

english_meaning: towards; to; facing; in the direction of; formerly; before; all along
explanation_mandarin: 表示方向，朝著；表示过去，以前；一直，始终。
explanation_english: Indicates direction, towards; indicates the past, formerly; all along, consistently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嚮北行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hoeng2 bak1 haang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们向北走。
examples.english_sentence: We are walking north.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嚮我借錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hoeng2 ngo5 ze3 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他向我借钱。
examples.english_sentence: He borrowed money from me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嚮細個嗰陣就好叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hoeng2 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 zau6 hou2 lek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他从小就很聪明。
examples.english_sentence: He has been clever since he was young.

english_meaning: guide
explanation_mandarin: 指引方向的人或事物；引导，带领。
explanation_english: A person or thing that guides someone; to guide or lead.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個經驗豐富嘅嚮導，帶我哋行山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 ging1 jim6 fung1 fu3 ge3 hoeng3 dou6, daai3 ngo5 dei6 haang4 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是个经验丰富的向导，带我们爬山。
examples.english_sentence: He is an experienced guide who took us hiking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要一個嚮導嚟幫我哋搵路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 jat1 go3 hoeng3 dou6 lai4 bong1 ngo5 dei6 wan2 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要一个向导来帮我们找路。
examples.english_sentence: We need a guide to help us find the way.

english_meaning: to yearn for, to aspire to, to long for
explanation_mandarin: 心里想望；渴望。
explanation_english: To long for, yearn for, or aspire to something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好嚮往去歐洲旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 hoeng3 wong5 heoi3 au1 zau1 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很向往去欧洲旅行。
examples.english_sentence: He really yearns to travel to Europe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多年輕人都嚮往自由嘅生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 nin4 hing1 yan4 dou1 hoeng3 wong5 zi6 jau4 ge3 sang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多年轻人都向往自由的生活。
examples.english_sentence: Many young people aspire to a free life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嚮往和平嘅世界。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hoeng3 wong5 wo4 ping4 ge3 sai3 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们向往和平的世界。
examples.english_sentence: We long for a peaceful world.

english_meaning: to admire, to yearn for, to long for
explanation_mandarin: 心裡羨慕並希望達到某種境界或擁有某種事物。
explanation_english: To admire and long for something; to aspire to a certain state or to possess something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好嚮慕啲成功人士嘅生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 hoeng3 mou6 di1 sing4 gung1 jan4 si6 ge3 sang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很嚮往成功人士的生活。
examples.english_sentence: He admires the lives of successful people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多人都嚮慕外國嘅自由生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 hoeng3 mou6 ngoi6 gwok3 ge3 zi6 jau4 sang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多人都嚮往外国的自由生活。
examples.english_sentence: Many people yearn for the free life in foreign countries.

english_meaning: exclamatory particle indicating surprise, admiration, or disbelief; Wow!
explanation_mandarin: 语气词，通常表示惊讶、赞叹、难以置信等情绪。语气较重。
explanation_english: An exclamatory particle, often used to express surprise, admiration, disbelief, etc. The tone is relatively strong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嚱！咁貴嘅！
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1! gam3 gwai3 ge3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哇！这么贵！
examples.english_sentence: Wow! That's so expensive!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嚱！你咁犀利嘅！
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1! nei5 gam3 sai1 lei6 ge3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哇！你这么厉害！
examples.english_sentence: Wow! You're so amazing!

english_meaning: strict, severe, rigorous
explanation_mandarin: 表示要求高、标准严格，不轻易放宽。
explanation_english: Describes being strict, severe, or rigorous, not easily lenient or forgiving.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋個老細好嚴㗎，成日都捉住啲錯處唔放。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 go3 lou5 sai3 hou2 jim4 gaa3, sing4 jat6 dou1 zuk1 zyu6 di1 co3 cyu3 m4 fong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的老板很严格，总是抓住错误不放。
examples.english_sentence: Our boss is very strict, always catching mistakes and not letting them go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋屋企管教好嚴，唔俾啲細路咁夜返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 uk1 kei5 gun2 gaau3 hou2 jim4, m4 bei2 di1 sai3 lou2 gam3 je2 faan1 uk1 kei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们家管教很严，不让孩子们那么晚回家。
examples.english_sentence: Their family is very strict with discipline, not allowing the children to come home so late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間學校嘅校規好嚴格，學生唔可以隨便染頭髮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 hok6 haau6 ge3 haau3 gwai1 hou2 jim4 gaak3, hok6 sang1 m4 ho2 ji5 ceoi4 bin2 jim5 tau4 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间学校的校规很严格，学生不可以随便染头发。
examples.english_sentence: This school's rules are very strict, students cannot dye their hair casually.

english_meaning: severe winter, harsh winter
explanation_mandarin: 指非常寒冷的冬天。
explanation_english: Refers to a very cold and harsh winter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅嚴冬特別凍，記得著多件衫啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ge3 jim4 dung1 dak6 bit1 dung3, gei3 dak1 zoek3 do1 gin6 saam1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的严冬特别冷，记得多穿一件衣服啊！
examples.english_sentence: This year's severe winter is especially cold, remember to wear an extra layer of clothes!

english_meaning: severe punishment; harsh penalty
explanation_mandarin: 指严厉的刑罚。
explanation_english: Refers to severe and harsh punishment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古代啲統治者好鍾意用嚴刑嚟管治人民。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 doi6 di1 tung2 zi6 ze2 hou2 zung1 yi3 yung6 yim4 ying4 lai4 gun2 zi6 yan4 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古代的统治者很喜欢用严刑来管治人民。
examples.english_sentence: Ancient rulers liked to use severe punishments to govern the people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 法律唔應該用嚴刑去恐嚇市民。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 leot6 m4 ying1 goi1 yung6 yim4 ying4 heoi3 hung2 haak3 si5 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 法律不应该用严刑去恐吓市民。
examples.english_sentence: The law should not use harsh punishments to intimidate citizens.

english_meaning: severe laws and harsh punishments
explanation_mandarin: 指严厉的刑罚和严峻的法律，通常用于形容统治者为了维护统治而采取的高压政策。
explanation_english: Strict laws and severe punishments; used to describe harsh policies implemented by rulers to maintain power and order.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋個政府用嚴刑峻法嚟管治人民，搞到民不聊生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 go3 zing3 fu2 yung6 yim4 ying4 zeon3 faat3 lai4 gun2 zi6 yan4 man4, gaau2 dou3 man4 bat1 liu4 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的政府用严刑峻法来统治人民，搞得民不聊生。
examples.english_sentence: Their government uses severe laws and harsh punishments to rule the people, causing widespread suffering.

english_meaning: to extract a confession through torture; to coerce a confession under torture; to force a confession by cruel means
explanation_mandarin: 指用残酷的刑罚来逼迫人招供。

examples.english_sentence: They suspected him of stealing something, so they used torture to extract a confession, trying to wrongly accuse him.

examples.english_sentence: You must strictly adhere to your promise and not go back on your word.

examples.jyutping_sentence: gwan1 jan4 bit1 seoi1 jim4 sau2 gei2 leut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 军人必须严格遵守纪律。
examples.english_sentence: Soldiers must strictly observe discipline.

english_meaning: strict, tight, rigorous, closely-knit
explanation_mandarin: 指周密、严谨、没有漏洞。
explanation_english: Describes something that is meticulous, rigorous, and without loopholes; closely-knit and difficult to penetrate or circumvent.

english_meaning: to punish severely, to severely punish

examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次交通事故很严重，很多人受伤。
examples.english_sentence: This traffic accident was very serious, many people were injured.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病得好嚴重，入咗醫院。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 dak1 hou2 jim4 zung6, jap6 zo2 ji1 jyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病得很严重，住院了。
examples.english_sentence: He's very seriously ill and has been hospitalized.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個問題好嚴重，我哋一定要解決。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 man6 tai4 hou2 jim4 zung6, ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 gaai2 kyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个问题很严重，我们一定要解决。
examples.english_sentence: This problem is very serious, we must solve it.

english_meaning: to stand in battle array; to await in full battle readiness; to be fully prepared for a challenge or threat
explanation_mandarin: 形容摆好严整的阵势，等待敌人来犯；比喻做好充分的准备，等待事态的发展。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where one is in full battle array, waiting for the enemy to attack; also used figuratively to mean being fully prepared and waiting for events to unfold.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日打風，我哋要嚴陣以待，準備定晒啲物資。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 daa2 fung1, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 yim4 zan6 ji5 doi6, zeon2 bei6 ding6晒啲 mat6 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天要刮台风了，我们要严阵以待，准备好所有的物资。
examples.english_sentence: A typhoon is coming tomorrow, we need to be fully prepared and have all the supplies ready.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對住咁大嘅挑戰，公司上下都要嚴陣以待。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 zyu6 gam3 daai6 ge3 tiu1 zin3, gung1 si1 soeng5 haa6 dou1 jiu3 yim4 zan6 ji5 doi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面对这么大的挑战，公司上下都要严阵以待。
examples.english_sentence: Faced with such a big challenge, the whole company needs to be fully prepared.

english_meaning: whining, whimpering, acting coy or spoiled, cooing
explanation_mandarin: 形容人撒娇，发出哼哼唧唧的声音，通常用于形容小孩子或情侣之间。也指小声嘟囔。
explanation_english: Describes someone acting coy, spoiled, or whining with soft, murmuring sounds, often used for children or between lovers. It can also refer to muttering quietly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再嚶啦，我知你想要嗰樣嘢㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 aang1 laa1, ngo5 zi1 nei5 soeng2 jiu3 go2 joeng2 je5 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别再撒娇了，我知道你想要那个东西了。
examples.english_sentence: Stop whining, I know you want that thing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個BB喺度嚶嚶嚶，好似想瞓覺噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 bi1 bi1 hai2 dou6 aang1 aang1 aang1, hou2 ci5 soeng2 fan3 gaau3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个宝宝在哼哼唧唧，好像想睡觉一样。
examples.english_sentence: The baby is whimpering, seems like he wants to sleep.

english_meaning: to yell, to shout, to clamor
explanation_mandarin: 大声叫喊，吵闹。
explanation_english: To yell, shout, or clamor loudly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺度嚷啦，好嘈啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 joeng6 laa1, hou2 cou4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别在这里嚷嚷了，好吵啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't yell here, it's too noisy!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一路行一路嚷住要食雪糕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 lou6 haang4 jat1 lou6 joeng6 zyu6 jiu3 sik6 syut3 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一路走一路嚷着要吃冰淇淋。
examples.english_sentence: He kept clamoring for ice cream as he walked.

english_meaning: a sentence-final particle indicating obviousness, confirmation, or concession; (similar to 'lah' in Singlish/Malay)
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情显而易见，肯定，或者让步的语气助词，类似于普通话的“啦”。
explanation_english: A sentence-final particle indicating obviousness, confirmation, concession, or agreement. It often softens the tone of the sentence. Similar in function to 'lah' used in Singlish/Malay.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 係嚹，我知啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai6 laa1, ngo5 zi1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 是啦，我知道啦。
examples.english_sentence: Yeah, I know.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好嚹，我聽你講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 laa1, ngo5 teng1 nei5 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 好吧，我听你的。
examples.english_sentence: Okay, I'll listen to you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冇計嚹，唯有咁做啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou5 gai3 laa1, wai4 jau5 gam2 zou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没办法啦，只有这么做了。
examples.english_sentence: There's no other way, we can only do it like this.

english_meaning: to chew, to masticate
explanation_mandarin: 用牙齿磨碎食物。
explanation_english: To grind food with teeth; to masticate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日嚼住香口膠啦，對牙唔好嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 zoek3 zyu6 hoeng1 hau2 gaau1 laa1, deoi3 ngaa4 m4 hou2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是嚼口香糖，对牙齿不好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always chew gum, it's not good for your teeth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嚼爛啲嘢畀個BB食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 laan6 di1 je5 bei2 go3 bou2 bui1 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把食物嚼烂了喂给宝宝吃。
examples.english_sentence: He chewed the food soft and fed it to the baby.

english_meaning: lump, chunk, piece (usually of something substantial or bulky)
explanation_mandarin: 表示一块较大的、形状不规则的东西。也可用作名词，指块状物。
explanation_english: Classifier for a lump, chunk, or piece of something, usually something substantial or bulky. Can also be used as a noun to refer to a lump or chunk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢嚿石頭好重啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gau6 sek6 tau4 hou2 cung5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这块石头很重啊！
examples.english_sentence: This chunk of stone is very heavy!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食多嚿叉燒吖！
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 do1 gau6 caa1 siu1 a1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 多吃一块叉烧吧！
examples.english_sentence: Eat one more piece of char siu!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋攞咗一嚿钱走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 lo2 zo2 jat1 gau6 cin2 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们拿了一大笔钱走了。
examples.english_sentence: They took a lump sum of money and left.

english_meaning: lump sum of money; a sum of money
explanation_mandarin: 指一笔数量可观的钱。通常用于非正式场合。
explanation_english: Refers to a sizable sum of money. Usually used in informal contexts. Literally means 'lump of water'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢中咗六合彩，攞咗一大嚿水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung3 zo2 luk6 hap6 caai2, lo2 zo2 jat1 daai6 gau6 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他中了彩票，得到了一大笔钱。
examples.english_sentence: He won the lottery and got a large sum of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住儲翻一嚿水，去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 zyu6 cou5 faan1 jat1 gau6 seoi2, heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想攒一笔钱，去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I'm planning to save up some money to go travelling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工雖然辛苦，但係可以賺到幾嚿水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 seoi1 jin4 san1 fu2, daan6 hai6 ho2 ji5 zaan6 dou2 gei2 gau6 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作虽然辛苦，但是可以赚到一些钱。
examples.english_sentence: Although this job is tough, you can earn some good money.

english_meaning: to whisper; to murmur; to speak in a low voice
explanation_mandarin: 指小声地说话，通常是不想让别人听见。
explanation_english: Refers to speaking in a low voice, usually in a way that one doesn't want others to hear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺度囁囁耳語，唔知講緊乜嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 dou6 nip6 nip6 ji5 jyu5, m4 zhi1 dou3 gong2 geng2 mat1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在那里窃窃私语，不知道在说什么。
examples.english_sentence: They are whispering to each other, I don't know what they are talking about.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺課堂上面囁聲細語，會影響到其他人嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 fo3 tong4 soeng6 min6 nip6 seng1 sai3 jyu5, wui5 ying2 hoeng2 dou3 kei4 ta1 yan4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在课堂上窃窃私语，会影响到其他人的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't whisper in class, it will affect others.

english_meaning: arrogant, haughty; noisy, clamorous
explanation_mandarin: 形容人態度傲慢自大，或形容聲音嘈雜喧鬧。
explanation_english: Describes a person's attitude as arrogant and conceited, or describes a sound as noisy and clamorous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好囂張，成日以為自己好叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 hiu1 zoeng1, seng4 jat6 ji5 wai4 zi6 gei2 hou2 lek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很嚣张，整天以为自己很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very arrogant person, always thinking he is very capable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間房入面啲人傾偈傾到好囂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 fong2 jap6 min6 di1 jan4 king1 gai2 king1 dou3 hou2 hiu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房间里面的人聊天聊得很喧闹。
examples.english_sentence: The people in the room are chatting very loudly.

english_meaning: to show off excessively; to be cocky; to be arrogant; to brag
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常得意，炫耀自己的成就或财富，态度傲慢自大。是一种比较贬义的说法。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is overly proud and shows off their achievements or wealth, displaying an arrogant and conceited attitude. It's a derogatory term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢中咗六合彩，囂屎咁款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung3 zo2 luk6 hap6 coi2, hiu1 si2 gam2 kwan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他中了六合彩，得意忘形的样子。
examples.english_sentence: He won the lottery and is showing off like crazy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁囂屎啦，低調啲好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 hiu1 si2 laa1, dai1 diu6 di1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么炫耀了，低调一点好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so cocky, it's better to be more low-profile.

english_meaning: arrogant, bossy, high-handed, overbearing
explanation_mandarin: 形容人态度傲慢，自以为是，目中无人。
explanation_english: Describes a person's attitude as arrogant, self-righteous, and conceited; looking down on others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有少少成就就囂張到呢個樣，真係唔掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 siu2 siu2 sing4 zau6 zau6 hiu1 zoeng1 dou3 ni1 go3 joeng2, zan1 hai6 m4 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他取得一点成就就嚣张成这样，真是太不像样了。
examples.english_sentence: He's become so arrogant after achieving a little success, it's really unacceptable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁囂張啦，謙虛啲好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 hiu1 zoeng1 laa1, him1 heoi1 di1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么嚣张啦，谦虚一点比较好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so arrogant, it's better to be more humble.

mandarin_meaning: 嚣张跋扈 (xiāo zhāng bá hù)
english_meaning: arrogant and domineering; overbearing; imperious
explanation_mandarin: 形容人非常骄横放肆，专横跋扈，目中无人，为所欲为。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is extremely arrogant, domineering, and disregards others, doing whatever they please without restraint.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢靠住老豆係老細，成日都咁囂張跋扈嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kaau3 zyu6 lou5 dau2 hai6 lou5 sai3, sing4 jat6 dou1 gam3 hiu1 zoeng1 bat6 wu6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他仗着爸爸是老板，整天都这么嚣张跋扈。
examples.english_sentence: He relies on his father being the boss, and he's always so arrogant and domineering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為自己好叻就囂張跋扈，謙虛啲好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 zi6 gei2 hou2 lek1 zau6 hiu1 zoeng1 bat6 wu6, him1 heoi1 di1 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为自己很厉害就嚣张跋扈，谦虚点好些。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be arrogant and domineering just because you think you're capable; it's better to be humble.

synonyms: 不可一世 (bat1 ho2 jat1 sai3)
橫行霸道 (waang4 hang4 baa3 dou6)

english_meaning: to talk in one's sleep, to speak deliriously
explanation_mandarin: 指人在睡梦中说出的话，也指神志不清时说的话。
explanation_english: Refers to talking in one's sleep or speaking deliriously when one is not fully conscious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢瞓覺成日講囈語，唔知講乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan3 gaau3 seng4 jat6 gong2 ngai6 jyu5, m4 zi1 dou3 gong2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他睡觉总是说梦话，不知道说什么。
examples.english_sentence: He often talks in his sleep, I don't know what he's saying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病到講晒囈語，都唔知佢有冇事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 dou3 gong2 saai3 ngai6 jyu5, dou1 m4 zi1 dou3 keoi5 jau5 mou5 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病得都说胡话了，不知道他有没有事。
examples.english_sentence: He's so sick that he's delirious, I don't know if he's alright.

english_meaning: To ramble on and on; to be long-winded; to chatter incessantly; to nag repeatedly.
explanation_mandarin: 形容人说话没完没了，啰嗦，重复。
explanation_english: Describes someone who talks endlessly and repetitively, often in a nagging or rambling way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁囈囈篩篩啦，我都明㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 ngai6 ngai6 sai1 sai1 laa1, ngo5 dou1 ming4 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么唠唠叨叨了，我都明白了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't ramble on so much, I understand already.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆成日喺度囈囈篩篩，講返以前嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 ngai6 ngai6 sai1 sai1, gong2 faan1 ji5 cin4 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶总是喋喋不休地唠叨，说以前的事情。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma is always rambling on and on, talking about things from the past.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一飲醉酒就囈囈篩篩，講埋啲唔知乜嘢嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 jam2 zeoi3 zau2 zau6 ngai6 ngai6 sai1 sai1, gong2 maai4 di1 m4 zi1 mat1 je5 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一喝醉酒就絮絮叨叨，说一些不知道是什么的东西。
examples.english_sentence: Once he's drunk, he starts rambling on and on, saying things that don't make sense.

mandarin_meaning: 笨蛋, 傻瓜, 混蛋
english_meaning: idiot, fool, bastard (vulgar)
explanation_mandarin: 非常粗俗的粤语骂人用语，指愚蠢、无用的人。具有侮辱性，应避免使用。
explanation_english: A very vulgar Cantonese curse word used to call someone stupid, useless, or a bastard. It is highly offensive and should be avoided.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁都唔識，真係囈契弟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 dou1 m4 sik1, zan1 hai6 lai6 kai3 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这个都不知道，真是个笨蛋。
examples.english_sentence: You don't even know this, you're such an idiot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪咁囈契弟啦，做嘢醒醒定定啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 gam2 lai6 kai3 dai2 laa1, zou6 je5 sing2 sing2 ding6 ding6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么笨了，做事机灵点。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stupid, be more clever when you do things.

english_meaning: to babble; to talk incoherently; delirious talk
explanation_mandarin: 指人在神志不清时说胡话；梦话，谵语。
explanation_english: Refers to speaking nonsense when a person is delirious or unconscious; talking in one's sleep, delirium.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢發緊高燒，成日都喺度囈求。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faat3 gan2 gou1 siu1, seng4 jat6 dou1 hai2 dou6 ngaai6 kau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他正在发高烧，整天都在说胡话。
examples.english_sentence: He has a high fever and is constantly babbling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好理佢，佢飲醉咗，喺度囈求啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 ho2 lei5 keoi5, keoi5 yam2 zeoi3 zo2, hai2 dou6 ngaai6 kau4 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别理他，他喝醉了，只是在胡说八道而已。
examples.english_sentence: Ignore him, he's drunk and just babbling.

synonyms: [講夢話 (gong2 mung6 waa6) - talk in sleep]

english_meaning: particle indicating obviousness, agreement, or mild complaint; final particle used to soften the tone of a sentence or express confirmation.
explanation_mandarin: 语气助词，通常放在句尾，表示一种理所当然、既定事实、请求或让步的语气。有时也表示不耐烦或轻微的抱怨。
explanation_english: A particle usually placed at the end of a sentence, indicating obviousness, agreement, confirmation, suggestion, or mild complaint. Can also soften the tone of a sentence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 係咁囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai6 gam2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 就是这样了。
examples.english_sentence: That's how it is.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪係囉！
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai6 hai6 lo1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 就是嘛！
examples.english_sentence: Exactly! I agree!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁樣做囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam2 joeng2 zou6 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 就这样做吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's do it this way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 去就去囉，使乜咁大聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: heoi3 zau6 heoi3 lo1, sai2 mat1 gam3 daai6 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去就去呗，干嘛那么大声。
examples.english_sentence: Fine, I'll go, no need to shout.

english_meaning: sloppy, messy, untidy, scruffy
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或事物不整洁、不干净。
explanation_english: Describes a person or thing as untidy, unclean, or sloppy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你間房咁囉pat，執執佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gaan1 fong2 gam3 lo1 pat1, zap1 zap1 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的房间这么邋遢，收拾一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: Your room is so messy, tidy it up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好囉pat，成日唔換衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 lo1 pat1, seng4 jat6 m4 wun6 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很邋遢，经常不换衣服。
examples.english_sentence: He is a sloppy person, often doesn't change his clothes.

english_meaning: long-winded, verbose, naggy, fussy
explanation_mandarin: 形容说话絮絮叨叨，啰里啰嗦，也形容做事繁琐。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is long-winded, verbose, or constantly nagging. Can also describe something that is overly complicated or fussy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁囉唆，真係頂唔順。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 lo1 so1, zan1 hai6 ding2 m4 seon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么啰嗦，真是受不了。
examples.english_sentence: You're so naggy, I can't stand it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁囉唆啦，快啲做嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 lo1 so1 laa1, faai3 di1 zou6 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么啰嗦了，快点工作吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so long-winded, get to work already.

english_meaning: to imprison; to confine; prisoner
explanation_mandarin: 把犯人关在监狱里，失去自由。
explanation_english: To confine someone in prison; to deprive of liberty; also refers to a prisoner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人囚咗十年，而家終於放返出嚟啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 chau4 zo2 sap6 nin4, ji4 gaa1 zung1 jyu1 fong3 faan1 chut1 lai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人囚禁了十年，现在终于放出来了。
examples.english_sentence: He was imprisoned for ten years, and now he's finally been released.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個賊仔俾警察囚咗喺監倉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 caak6 zai2 bei2 ging2 caat3 chau4 zo2 hai2 gaam1 chong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个小偷被警察囚禁在监狱里。
examples.english_sentence: That thief was imprisoned in jail by the police.

english_meaning: Prison mate, fellow inmate
explanation_mandarin: 指在监狱里一起服刑的人。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who is serving time in prison together with another person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢同個囚友喺監獄入面一齊策劃咗一場逃獄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tung4 go3 chau4 jau5 hai2 gaam1 yuk6 jap6 min6 jat1 cai4 chak3 waak6 zo2 jat1 cheung4 tou4 yuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他和狱友在监狱里一起策划了一场越狱。
examples.english_sentence: He and his prison mate plotted an escape together inside the prison.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅囚友話佢好照顧人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 chau4 jau5 waa6 keoi5 hou2 jiu3 gu3 yan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的狱友说他很照顾人。
examples.english_sentence: His fellow inmate said he was very caring.

english_meaning: Prisoner's rights
explanation_mandarin: 指被囚禁的人所应享有的基本权利，例如医疗、卫生、通讯等。
explanation_english: Refers to the basic rights that prisoners should enjoy, such as medical care, hygiene, communication, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一直都爭取緊囚權，希望監獄嘅待遇可以好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 zik6 dou1 zaang1 ceoi2 gan2 chau4 kyun4, hei1 mong6 gaam1 juk6 ge3 dai6 yu6 ho2 ji5 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一直在争取囚犯的权利，希望监狱的待遇可以好一点。
examples.english_sentence: They have been fighting for prisoner's rights, hoping that the treatment in prison can be better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人認為囚犯唔應該有咁多權利，因為佢哋犯咗法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 jing6 wai4 chau4 faan6 m4 jing1 goi1 jau5 gam3 do1 kyun4 lei6, jan1 wai6 keoi5 dei6 faan6 zo2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人认为囚犯不应该有这么多权利，因为他们犯了法。
examples.english_sentence: Some people think that prisoners shouldn't have so many rights because they broke the law.

english_meaning: prisoner, convict
explanation_mandarin: 被判刑关押在监狱里的人。
explanation_english: A person imprisoned as a punishment for committing a crime.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個囚犯成功逃獄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 cau4 faan6 sing4 gung1 tou4 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个囚犯成功越狱了。
examples.english_sentence: That prisoner successfully escaped from prison.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋將啲囚犯鎖喺監倉入面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zoeng1 di1 cau4 faan6 so2 hai2 gaam1 cong1 jap6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们把囚犯锁在牢房里。
examples.english_sentence: They locked the prisoners in their cells.

english_meaning: imprison, confine, put in jail
explanation_mandarin: 拘禁, 限制人身自由。
explanation_english: To imprison; to confine; to deprive someone of their freedom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋將嗰個政治家囚禁咗五年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zoeng1 go2 go3 zing3 zi6 gaa1 cau4 gam3 zo2 ng5 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们把那个政治家囚禁了五年。
examples.english_sentence: They imprisoned that politician for five years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢被囚禁喺一間黑房入面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei6 cau4 gam3 hai2 jat1 gaan1 hak1 fong2 jap6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被囚禁在一间黑屋里。
examples.english_sentence: He was imprisoned in a dark room.

english_meaning: Prison van, paddy wagon
explanation_mandarin: 运送囚犯的车辆。
explanation_english: A vehicle used for transporting prisoners.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 差佬押送啲犯人上囚車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caa1 lou2 aap3 sung3 di1 faan2 jan4 soeng5 cau4 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察押送犯人上囚车。
examples.english_sentence: The police escorted the criminals onto the prison van.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人拉咗，仲要坐囚車去警署。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 laai1 zo2, zung6 jiu3 co5 cau4 ce1 heoi3 ging2 cyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人逮捕了，还要坐囚车去警察局。
examples.english_sentence: He was arrested and had to ride in a paddy wagon to the police station.

english_meaning: four
explanation_mandarin: 数字，三之后的数字。
explanation_english: The number four, the number that comes after three.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屋企有四個人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 uk1 kei2 jau5 sei3 go3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我家有四个人。
examples.english_sentence: There are four people in my family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家四點半。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 sei3 dim2 bun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在四点半。
examples.english_sentence: It's half past four now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考到四級鋼琴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 dou2 sei3 gap1 gong3 kam4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考到了钢琴四级。
examples.english_sentence: He passed Grade 4 piano.

english_meaning: The 28th day after a person's death (four weeks after death, following the traditional Chinese belief that the soul returns home every seventh day for seven weeks)
explanation_mandarin: 指人死后第二十八天，按照传统习俗，人死后每七天为一个祭奠日，共有七个七天，'四七'就是第四个七天。
explanation_english: Refers to the 28th day after a person's death. According to traditional customs, every seventh day after death is a day of remembrance, with a total of seven such days. '四七' (sei3 cat1) is the fourth of these seven days.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日要做四七，記得早啲嚟幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 jiu3 zou6 sei3 cat1, gei3 dak1 zou2 di1 lai4 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天要做四七，记得早点来帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: We are holding the memorial service for the 28th day tomorrow, remember to come early to help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 四七嘅時候，屋企人會準備好多祭品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sei3 cat1 ge3 si4 hau6, uk1 kei2 jan4 wui5 zeon2 bei6 hou2 do1 zai3 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 四七的时候，家人会准备很多祭品。
examples.english_sentence: During the 28th day after death, the family will prepare a lot of offerings.

english_meaning: Idiot, fool, stupid person
explanation_mandarin: 用来形容人愚蠢，笨拙，反应慢。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone who is foolish, clumsy, or slow to react. It's an insult.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁都唔明，真係四三八㗎你！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 dou1 m4 ming4, zan1 hai6 sei3 saam1 baat3 gaa3 nei5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样都不明白，你真是个傻瓜！
examples.english_sentence: You don't understand even this, you're really an idiot!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪咁四三八啦，快啲諗辦法啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 gam3 sei3 saam1 baat3 laa1, faai3 di1 nam2 baan6 faat3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么笨了，快点想办法吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stupid, hurry up and think of a solution.

english_meaning: nobody around; no one in sight
explanation_mandarin: 指周围没有任何人。
explanation_english: Indicates that there is nobody around.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我見四下無人，就偷偷地將啲垃圾掉咗喺後巷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gin3 sei3 haa6 mou4 jan4, zau6 tau1 tau1 dei2 zoeng1 di1 laap6 saap3 diu6 zo2 hai2 hau6 hong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我看到四下无人，就偷偷地把垃圾扔在了后巷。
examples.english_sentence: I saw that nobody was around, so I secretly threw the trash in the back alley.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以為四下無人，就開始唱歌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 wai4 sei3 haa6 mou4 jan4, zau6 hoi1 chi2 cheung3 go1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以为四下无人，就开始唱歌。
examples.english_sentence: He thought that nobody was around, so he started singing.

english_meaning: To use a small force to move a great weight; to achieve a great result with little effort; to overcome a strong opponent with finesse.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻用小的力量去拨动大的重量，指技巧高超，以柔克刚，以弱胜强。也比喻用小力量去办成大事。
explanation_english: This idiom describes using a small amount of force or leverage to move or overcome something much larger or heavier. It emphasizes skill, technique, and leverage over brute strength. It implies overcoming a stronger opponent or achieving a significant result with minimal effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用啲談判技巧，真係四両撥千斤，解決咗間公司嘅大問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 di1 taam4 paan3 gei2 haau2, zan1 hai6 sei3 loeng2 but6 cin1 gan1, gaai2 kyut3 zo2 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 daai6 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他运用一些谈判技巧，真是四两拨千斤，解决了公司的大问题。
examples.english_sentence: He used some negotiation skills, truly a case of using a small force to move a great weight, and solved the company's big problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個設計睇落簡單，但係用咗四両撥千斤嘅原理，好有效率。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sai3 gai3 tai2 lok6 gaan2 daan1, daan6 hai6 yung6 zo2 sei3 loeng2 but6 cin1 gan1 ge3 yun4 lei5, hou2 yau5 haau6 leut2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个设计看起来简单，但是用了四两拨千斤的原理，非常有效率。
examples.english_sentence: This design looks simple, but it utilizes the principle of using a small force to move a great weight and is very efficient.

synonyms: 以柔克剛 (yi5 yau4 hak1 gong1)

english_meaning: unlucky; unfortunate; trouble; a difficult or problematic situation
explanation_mandarin: 粤语俚语，指不顺利，倒霉，遭遇麻烦的情况。
explanation_english: Cantonese slang referring to being unlucky, unfortunate, or encountering trouble. Often used to describe a situation or circumstance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排真係四九，做乜都唔順利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 zan1 hai6 sei3 gau2, zou6 mat1 dou1 m4 seon6 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近真是倒霉，做什么都不顺利。
examples.english_sentence: I've really been unlucky lately, nothing goes smoothly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁擔心啦，可能只係一時四九啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 daam1 sam1 laa1, ho2 nang4 zi2 hai6 jat1 si4 sei3 gau2 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要太担心了，可能只是一时倒霉而已。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry so much, it might just be a temporary stroke of bad luck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢撞車之後，真係覺得自己好四九。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zong6 ce1 zi1 hau6, zan1 hai6 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 hou2 sei3 gau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他撞车之后，真的觉得自己很倒霉。
examples.english_sentence: After the car accident, he really felt like he was very unlucky.

mandarin_meaning: 黑社会的小喽啰，小成员
english_meaning: Low-ranking triad member; Triad foot soldier
explanation_mandarin: 指香港黑社会组织中级别较低的成员。 "四九" 在黑社会中代表普通成员， "仔" 是指小的，表示更低的级别。
explanation_english: Refers to a low-ranking member of a Hong Kong triad society. "49" (四九) represents a regular member in triads, and "zai (仔)" means small or junior, indicating an even lower rank.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢入咗社團冇幾耐，都係個四九仔嚟啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jap6 zo2 se5 tyun4 mou5 gei2 noi6, dou1 hai6 go3 sei3 gau2 zai2 lai4 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他加入社团没多久，也只是个小喽啰而已。
examples.english_sentence: He hasn't been in the triad for long, he's just a foot soldier.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好睇少啲四九仔，佢哋都係跟大佬搵食㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tai2 siu2 di1 sei3 gau2 zai2, keoi5 dei6 dou1 hai6 gan1 daai6 lou2 wan2 sik6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要小看那些小喽啰，他们也是跟着大哥混饭吃的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't underestimate those foot soldiers, they are also following the boss to make a living.

english_meaning: fool; idiot; stupid person
explanation_mandarin: 粤语俚语，指愚蠢、笨拙的人。带有贬义。
explanation_english: Cantonese slang referring to a foolish, clumsy, or stupid person. It has a derogatory connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪咁四二六啦，呢啲嘢都唔識做？
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 gam3 sei3 ji6 luk6 laa1, ni1 di1 je5 dou1 m4 sik1 zou6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么傻，这些东西都不会做？
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stupid, you don't even know how to do these things?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好四二六，成日撞板。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 sei3 ji6 luk6, seng4 jat6 zong6 baan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的很笨，总是碰钉子。
examples.english_sentence: He's really a fool, always running into obstacles.

english_meaning: pornography, pornographic films
explanation_mandarin: 指色情电影或录像。
explanation_english: Refers to pornographic movies or videos.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日睇四仔啦，對身體唔好㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 tai2 sei3 zai2 laa1, deoi3 san1 tai2 m4 hou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是看色情片，对身体不好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't watch porn so often, it's not good for your health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間房入面好多四仔碟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 fong2 jap6 min6 hou2 do1 sei3 zai2 dip2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的房间里有很多色情光盘。
examples.english_sentence: There are many pornographic DVDs in his room.

english_meaning: Convenient; easy; handy
explanation_mandarin: 粤语口语，表示方便、容易、顺手。和普通话的“方便”用法接近，但语气更口语化。
explanation_english: Cantonese colloquialism meaning convenient, easy, or handy. Similar in usage to the Mandarin word "方便 (fāng biàn)", but more colloquial.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度搭車好四便㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 daap3 ce1 hou2 sei3 bin6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里坐车很方便。
examples.english_sentence: It's very convenient to take the bus here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳好四便，行幾步就到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 hou2 sei3 bin6, haang4 gei2 bou6 zau6 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅很方便，走几步就到了。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant is very convenient, it's just a few steps away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間鋪頭位置都幾四便嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 pou3 tau2 wai6 zi3 dou1 gei2 sei3 bin6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家店的位置挺方便的。
examples.english_sentence: That shop's location is quite convenient.

english_meaning: Four wheels; car
explanation_mandarin: 指汽车。字面意思是“四个轮子”。
explanation_english: Refers to a car. Literally means 'four wheels'. It's a common way to refer to a car in Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日揸四個轆返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 zaa1 sei3 go3 luk1 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天开车上班。
examples.english_sentence: I drove to work today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港地養四個轆好貴㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 dei6 joeng5 sei3 go3 luk1 hou2 gwai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在香港养车很贵的。
examples.english_sentence: It's very expensive to own a car in Hong Kong.

english_meaning: To use a small force to overcome a large force; leverage; to achieve a great effect with minimal effort.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻以小力量胜过大力量，或以巧妙的手法处理困难的问题。
explanation_english: This idiom describes the principle of using a small amount of force or leverage to overcome a much larger force. It can also be used metaphorically to describe solving a difficult problem with a clever or efficient approach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用個策略真係四兩撥千斤，成功解決咗個大危機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 go3 caak3 leok6 zan1 hai6 sei3 loeng2 but6 cin1 gan1, sing4 gung1 gaai2 kyut3 zo2 go3 daai6 ngai4 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用的策略真是四两拨千斤，成功解决了那个大危机。
examples.english_sentence: The strategy he used was truly leveraging a small force to overcome a big one, successfully resolving the major crisis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好硬碰硬，試下用四兩撥千斤嘅方法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ngaang6 pung3 ngaang6, si3 haa5 yung6 sei3 loeng2 but6 cin1 gan1 ge3 fong1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要硬碰硬，试着用四两拨千斤的方法。
examples.english_sentence: Don't go head-to-head, try using the method of leveraging a small force to overcome a large one.

english_meaning: Something useless; a burden; excess baggage
explanation_mandarin: 比喻没有价值、没有用处的东西或人。 就像四两重的铁，既轻又没有实际用途。
explanation_english: A metaphor for something or someone worthless or useless. Like a small amount of iron (four taels), it is both light and lacking practical use.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個舊電腦對我嚟講，簡直係四兩鐵，掉咗都唔可惜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gau6 din6 nou5 deoi3 ngo5 lai4 gong2, gaan2 zik6 hai6 sei3 loeng2 tit3, diu6 zo2 dou1 m4 ho2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台旧电脑对我来说，简直是没用的东西，丢了也不可惜。
examples.english_sentence: This old computer is just a burden to me, it's not a pity to throw it away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司度成日游手好閒，簡直係四兩鐵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 dou6 seng4 jat6 jau4 sau2 hou2 haan4, gaan2 zik6 hai6 sei3 loeng2 tit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司里整天游手好闲，简直是个没用的人。
examples.english_sentence: He idles around at the company all day, he's practically useless.

english_meaning: Idiot, fool, dimwit
explanation_mandarin: 粤语俚语，用来骂人愚笨，迟钝。 源自香港黑社会用语，比喻低级成员。现在多用于朋友间的玩笑或者轻微的责备。
explanation_english: Cantonese slang used to scold someone for being stupid, foolish, or slow-witted. It originated from Hong Kong triad slang, referring to low-ranking members. Now it's often used in friendly banter or mild reproof.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做乜嘢咁蠢呀？真係四八九！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 mat1 je5 gam3 ceon2 aa3? zan1 hai6 sei3 baat3 gau2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你怎么这么笨啊？真是个笨蛋！
examples.english_sentence: Why are you so stupid? You're such an idiot!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，你唔好咁四八九啦，幫手諗下計啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 sei3 baat3 gau2 laa1, bong1 sau2 lim2 haa5 gai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，你别那么笨嘛，帮忙想想办法啦。
examples.english_sentence: Hey, don't be such a dimwit, help me think of a solution.

mandarin_meaning: 不正经，不老实；马马虎虎，凑合
english_meaning: not serious, unreliable; so-so, passable, just acceptable; flirting (between male and female)
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人做事不认真，不可靠；或者形容东西质量一般，凑合能用；也指男女之间不正经的调情。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is not serious or reliable in their work; can also describe something of mediocre quality, just passable; also refers to improper flirting between a man and a woman.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢咁四六，點搞得掂㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 gam3 sei3 luk6, dim2 gaau2 dak1 dim6 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做事这么不认真，怎么能做好呢？
examples.english_sentence: You're so unreliable in your work, how can you possibly get it done?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條裙啲手工好四六，唔係幾靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 kwan4 di1 hung1 gau2 hou2 sei3 luk6, m4 hai6 gei2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条裙子的手工很马虎，不太漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: The workmanship on this skirt is so-so; it's not very pretty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個成日喺度四六，都唔知係咪拍緊拖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 sei3 luk6, dou1 m4 zi1 hai6 mai1 paak3 gan2 to1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个整天在那儿调情，都不知道是不是在谈恋爱。
examples.english_sentence: Those two are always flirting around there; I don't even know if they are dating.

english_meaning: everywhere, all over, in all directions
explanation_mandarin: 表示在各个方向或各个地方。
explanation_english: Indicates in all directions or in all places.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗搵返隻狗，四出咁樣搵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 wan2 faan1 jek3 gau2, sei3 cheut1 gam2 yeung2 wan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为了找回那只狗，到处那样找。
examples.english_sentence: He was looking for the dog everywhere like that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察四出搜捕犯人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 chaat3 sei3 cheut1 sau1 bou6 faan6 yan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察到处搜捕犯人。
examples.english_sentence: The police are searching everywhere for the criminals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟唔好，啲人四出搵工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 jai3 m4 hou2, di1 yan4 sei3 cheut1 wan2 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济不好，人们到处找工作。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is bad, people are looking for jobs everywhere.

english_meaning: to be split apart, to fall apart, to be disunited, to be fragmented
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物分裂、分散、不成整体。也可用来形容组织、团体等解体。
explanation_english: Describes something being split apart, dispersed, and not forming a whole. Can also be used to describe the disintegration of an organization or group.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司因為內部矛盾而四分五裂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 jan1 wai6 noi6 bou6 maau4 teon5 ji4 sei3 fan1 ng5 lit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司因为内部矛盾而四分五裂。
examples.english_sentence: The company fell apart due to internal conflicts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個國家打完仗之後，四分五裂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 gwok3 gaa1 daa2 jyun4 zo2 zau3 hau6, sei3 fan1 ng5 lit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个国家打完仗之后，四分五裂。
examples.english_sentence: The country was fragmented after the war.

english_meaning: four arithmetic operations
explanation_mandarin: 指加、减、乘、除四种基本的算术运算。
explanation_english: Refers to the four basic arithmetic operations: addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路哥學識四則運算，對佢哋將來學數學好有幫助。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 go1 hok6 sik1 sei3 zak1 wan6 syun3, deoi3 keoi5 dei6 zoeng1 loi4 hok6 sou3 hok6 hou2 jau5 bong1 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子学会四则运算，对他们将来学数学很有帮助。
examples.english_sentence: Children learning the four arithmetic operations will greatly help them in studying mathematics in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你計數機識唔識做四則混合運算㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gai3 sou3 gei1 sik1 m4 sik1 zou6 sei3 zak1 wan6 hap6 wan6 syun3 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的计算器会不会做四则混合运算啊？
examples.english_sentence: Does your calculator know how to perform mixed four arithmetic operations?

english_meaning: four arithmetic operations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division)
explanation_mandarin: 指加法、减法、乘法、除法这四种基本的算术运算。
explanation_english: Refers to the four basic arithmetic operations: addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺數學測驗入面，計四則運算錯咗幾題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 sou3 hok6 cak1 jim6 jap6 min6, gai3 sei3 zak1 wan6 syun3 co3 zo2 gei2 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在数学测验里，计算四则运算错了几个题。
examples.english_sentence: He got a few questions wrong involving the four arithmetic operations in the math quiz.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友應該早啲學識四則運算嘅基本概念。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 ying1 goi1 zou2 di1 hok6 sik1 sei3 zak1 wan6 syun3 ge3 gei1 bun2 gaai3 nim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友应该早点学会四则运算的基本概念。
examples.english_sentence: Children should learn the basic concepts of the four arithmetic operations earlier.
