english_meaning: Siheyuan (courtyard house)
explanation_mandarin: 一种中国传统建筑形式，由四面房屋合围成一个院子。
explanation_english: A traditional Chinese architectural style featuring a courtyard surrounded by buildings on all four sides.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 北京好多四合院都俾人改建咗做酒店或者餐廳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bak1 ging1 hou2 do1 sei3 hap6 jyun2 dou1 bei2 jan4 goi2 gin3 zo2 zou6 zau2 dim3 waak6 ze2 caan1 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 北京很多四合院都被人改建成了酒店或者餐厅。
examples.english_sentence: Many Siheyuan in Beijing have been renovated into hotels or restaurants.

english_meaning: all around; on all sides; surroundings
explanation_mandarin: 周围；四面八方。
explanation_english: All around; on all sides; in every direction; the surroundings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢四周望下，睇下有冇人跟蹤佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 si3 zau1 mong6 haa5, tai2 haa5 jau5 mou5 jan4 gan1 zung1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他四周看看，看看有没有人跟踪他。
examples.english_sentence: He looked around to see if anyone was following him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋四周都係樹林。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 si3 zau1 dou1 hai6 syu3 lam4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房子的四周都是树林。
examples.english_sentence: The house is surrounded by woods.

english_meaning: around, surrounding, all around
explanation_mandarin: 指某个事物的四周，周围的环境或空间。
explanation_english: Refers to the area surrounding something, the environment or space around it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺間房四周圍咁望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gaan1 fong2 si3 zau1 wai4 gam2 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在房间里四周看看。
examples.english_sentence: He looked around the room.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間屋四周圍都係樹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 uk1 si3 zau1 wai4 dou1 hai6 syu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间房子四周都是树。
examples.english_sentence: This house is surrounded by trees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我四周圍搵都搵唔到佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 si3 zau1 wai4 wan2 dou1 wan2 m4 dou2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我到处找都找不到他。
examples.english_sentence: I looked everywhere for him but couldn't find him.

english_meaning: Four joys; usually refers to a dish with four ingredients representing four joys
explanation_mandarin: 通常指一道菜，包含四种食材，象征人生中的四大喜事：久旱逢甘霖，他乡遇故知，洞房花烛夜，金榜题名时。
explanation_english: Usually refers to a dish, often including four ingredients, symbolizing the four great joys in life: rain after a long drought, meeting an old friend in a foreign land, wedding night, and passing the imperial examination.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋食四喜丸子好唔好？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 sik6 sei3 hei2 jyun4 zi2 hou2 m4 hou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们吃四喜丸子好不好？
examples.english_sentence: How about we have Four Joy Meatballs for dinner tonight?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅四喜豆腐做得好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 sei3 hei2 dau6 fu6 zou6 dak1 hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的四喜豆腐做得很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The Four Joy Tofu at this restaurant is very delicious.

english_meaning: Double happiness; a succession of good things happening one after another
explanation_mandarin: 形容接连发生的好事。 多用于庆祝场合，例如婚礼、新年等，祝福对方好事不断。
explanation_english: An idiom used to describe a string of happy events occurring in succession. Often used in celebratory occasions like weddings and New Year, to wish someone a continuous flow of good fortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講你升職又結婚，真係四喜臨門呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 nei5 sing1 zik1 jau6 git3 fan1, zan1 hai6 sei3 hei2 lam4 mun4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说你升职又结婚了，真是喜事连连啊！
examples.english_sentence: I heard you got promoted and are getting married, that's really a double happiness!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年公司生意好咗好多，又攞到幾個大project，簡直係四喜臨門！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 gung1 si1 seng1 ji3 hou2 zo2 hou2 do1, jau6 lo2 dou2 gei2 go3 daai6 project, gaan2 zik6 hai6 sei3 hei2 lam4 mun4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年公司生意好了很多，又拿到了几个大项目，简直是喜事连连！
examples.english_sentence: The company's business is much better this year and we've also secured several big projects. It's simply a string of happy events!

english_meaning: Careless, sloppy, not serious, so-so
explanation_mandarin: 形容做事态度马虎，敷衍了事，不认真对待。
explanation_english: Describes an attitude of being careless, perfunctory, and not taking things seriously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢唔好咁四四二四啦，要認真啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 m4 hou2 gam3 sei3 sei3 ji6 sei3 laa1, jiu3 jing6 zan1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做事不要这么马马虎虎，要认真一点。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so sloppy in your work, you need to be more serious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份報告寫得四四二四，好多錯漏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dak1 sei3 sei3 ji6 sei3, hou2 do1 co3 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他写的报告马马虎虎，有很多错误遗漏。
examples.english_sentence: The report he wrote was sloppy, with many mistakes and omissions.

mandarin_meaning: 清楚明白; 清清楚楚; 條理分明
english_meaning: Clearly and distinctly; in an orderly and methodical manner; systematically; clearly and logically.
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情或說話清楚明白，有條理，有系統。
explanation_english: Describes things or speech that is clear, distinct, orderly, and systematic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢四四六六咁解釋成件事嘅來龍去脈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sei3 sei3 luk6 luk6 gam2 gaai2 sik1 sing4 gin6 si6 ge3 loi4 lung4 heoi3 mai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他清清楚楚地解释了整件事的来龙去脉。
examples.english_sentence: He explained the whole story clearly and distinctly from beginning to end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以四四六六咁講一次？我聽唔明啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 sei3 sei3 luk6 luk6 gam2 gong2 jat1 ci3? ngo5 teng1 m4 ming4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以不可以清楚地说一遍？我听不明白啊。
examples.english_sentence: Could you please explain it clearly? I don't understand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份報告要寫得四四六六，唔好含糊不清。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 bou3 gou3 jiu3 se2 dak1 sei3 sei3 luk6 luk6, m4 hou2 ham4 wu4 bat1 cing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告要写得清清楚楚，不要含糊不清。
examples.english_sentence: The report should be written clearly and distinctly, not vaguely.

synonyms: 井井有條 (zing2 zing2 jau5 tiu4)
一清二楚 (jat1 cing1 ji6 co2)

english_meaning: square; neat and tidy; proper; well-behaved; orderly
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物或人形态端正，规矩。也指做事稳妥、认真。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone that is square, neat, tidy, proper, well-behaved, or orderly. It can also describe someone who does things properly and seriously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間房執到四四正正咁，睇落舒服好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 fong2 zap1 dou3 sei3 sei3 zeng3 zeng3 gam2, tai2 lok6 syu1 fuk6 ho2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房间整理得方方正正的，看起来舒服多了。
examples.english_sentence: The room is tidied up neatly, it looks much more comfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢四四正正，老闆好欣賞佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 sei3 sei3 zeng3 zeng3, lou5 baan2 hou2 jan1 soeng2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事规规矩矩的，老板很欣赏他。
examples.english_sentence: He works properly and seriously, the boss appreciates him very much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張檯嘅四隻腳唔係四四正正，有啲歪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 toi2 ge3 sei3 zek3 goek3 m4 hai6 sei3 sei3 zeng3 zeng3, jau5 di1 waai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张桌子的四只脚不是方方正正的，有点歪。
examples.english_sentence: The four legs of this table are not square, they are a bit crooked.

english_meaning: Androgynous; hermaphrodite; transgender (derogatory, especially referring to someone who is not clearly male or female)
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人的性别特征模糊，不明显，既不像男的，也不像女的。通常带有贬义。
explanation_english: Describes a person whose gender characteristics are ambiguous and unclear, appearing neither distinctly male nor distinctly female. Often used in a derogatory manner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打扮到四四聲咁，真係唔知佢係男定女。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 baan6 dou3 sei3 sei3 seng1 gam2, zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 keoi5 hai6 naam4 ding6 neoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他打扮得不男不女的，真不知道他是男的还是女的。
examples.english_sentence: They dressed in such an androgynous way, it's really hard to tell if they are male or female.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁講人哋啦，咁樣好唔尊重，四四聲都係人嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 gong2 jan4 dei6 laa1, gam2 joeng2 hou2 m4 zyun1 zung6, sei3 sei3 seng1 dou1 hai6 jan4 lei4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这样说别人啦，这样很不尊重，人妖也是人啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't say that about others, it's disrespectful. Transgender people are people too.

mandarin_meaning: 麻将牌的一种胡牌牌型：清一色四归一
english_meaning: A winning hand in Mahjong: Pure Suit with a specific tile having four of a kind.
explanation_mandarin: 麻将术语，指清一色牌型中，有一种牌有四张一样的（四归一），可以作为特殊的胡牌方式。在某些麻将规则中，需要满足这种牌型才能胡牌。
explanation_english: In Mahjong, it refers to a winning hand in a pure suit (all tiles of the same suit) where there is a set of four identical tiles (four of a kind). In some Mahjong variations, having this specific tile arrangement is a requirement for going out (winning).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日打麻雀，希望可以食到四國啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 daa2 maa4 zoek3, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 sik6 dou2 sei3 gwok3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天打麻将，希望可以和到四归一！
examples.english_sentence: I'm playing Mahjong tomorrow, hopefully, I can win with a hand of Pure Suit with a four-of-a-kind!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日話自己好叻，但係打咗成日都冇食過四國。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 waa6 zi6 gei2 hou2 lek1, daan6 hai6 daa2 zo2 sing4 jat6 dou1 mou5 sik6 gwo3 sei3 gwok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说自己很厉害，但是打了一整天都没有和过四归一。
examples.english_sentence: He always says he's great, but he didn't win with a Pure Suit with a four-of-a-kind all day.

english_meaning: around; all around; everywhere
explanation_mandarin: 表示在某处或某范围的周围，或者指所有的方向。
explanation_english: Refers to the surrounding area of something, or in all directions; everywhere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你喺度四圍望乜嘢啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai2 dou6 sei3 wai4 mong6 mat1 je5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在这里四处看什么呢？
examples.english_sentence: What are you looking around for here?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我四圍搵都搵唔到我嘅銀包。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sei3 wai4 wan2 dou1 wan2 m4 dou2 ngo5 ge3 ngan4 baau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我到处找都找不到我的钱包。
examples.english_sentence: I've looked everywhere but I can't find my wallet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋四圍都係蜘蛛網。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 sei3 wai4 dou1 hai6 zi1 zyu1 mong5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房子周围都是蜘蛛网。
examples.english_sentence: There are cobwebs all around the house.

english_meaning: to run around everywhere; to scurry about
explanation_mandarin: 形容到处跑动，忙碌的样子，通常带有随意性或无目的性。
explanation_english: Describes the act of running around everywhere, often in a hurried, scattered, or aimless manner. It implies a lack of focus or a sense of being overwhelmed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 臨近考試，啲學生喺學校四圍捐，好似冇頭蒼蠅咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lam4 gan6 haau2 si5, di1 hok6 sang1 hai2 hok6 haau6 sei3 wai4 gyun1, hou2 ci5 mou5 tau4 cong1 jing1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 临近考试，学生们在学校里到处乱跑，像无头苍蝇一样。
examples.english_sentence: As the exam approaches, the students are running around everywhere in the school, like headless flies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先落大雨，啲人喺街上面四圍捐搵地方避雨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 lok6 daai6 jyu5, di1 jan4 hai2 gaai1 soeng6 min6 sei3 wai4 gyun1 wan2 dei6 fong1 bei6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才下大雨，人们在街上到处乱跑找地方避雨。
examples.english_sentence: It rained heavily just now, and people were scurrying around on the street looking for shelter.

english_meaning: to wander around; to roam; to walk around everywhere
explanation_mandarin: 指没有特定目的地，到处行走或活动。
explanation_english: Describes the act of walking or moving around everywhere without a specific destination; to roam or wander.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放假嘅時候，我鍾意四圍走，探索唔同嘅地方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 gaa3 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 zung1 ji3 sei3 wai4 zau2, taam3 sok3 m4 tung4 ge3 dei6 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 放假的时候，我喜欢到处走，探索不同的地方。
examples.english_sentence: During holidays, I like to wander around and explore different places.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺條街度四圍走，好危險㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 tiu4 gaai1 dou6 sei3 wai4 zau2, hou2 ngai4 him2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在街上到处走，很危险的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't wander around in the street, it's very dangerous.

english_meaning: Cheap, inexpensive, a good deal
explanation_mandarin: 形容价格便宜，物超所值。
explanation_english: Describes something that is cheap, inexpensive, or a good deal. Implies that the price is low relative to the value or quality of the item.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫四塊半，好抵買㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 sei3 faai3 bun3, hou2 dai2 maai5 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服很便宜，很值得买！
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is cheap, it's a good buy!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳啲嘢食都幾四塊半，成日都好多人排隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 dou1 gei2 sei3 faai3 bun3, seng4 jat6 dou1 hou2 do1 jan4 paai4 deoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西都挺划算的，每天都有很多人排队。
examples.english_sentence: The food in this restaurant is quite cheap, there are always many people queuing.

english_meaning: Four Heavenly Kings; Four Kings of Pop
explanation_mandarin: 最初指佛教护法神中的四位天王。在香港，通常指20世纪90年代香港乐坛最受欢迎的四位男歌手：张学友、刘德华、黎明、郭富城。
explanation_english: Originally referring to the Four Heavenly Kings, deities in Buddhism who protect the world. In Hong Kong, it usually refers to the "Four Heavenly Kings" of Cantopop in the 1990s: Jacky Cheung, Andy Lau, Leon Lai, and Aaron Kwok.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 九十年代嘅四大天王真係好紅啊，個個都識佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau2 sap6 nin4 doi6 ge3 sei3 daai6 tin1 wong4 zan1 hai6 hou2 hung4 aa3, go3 go3 dou1 sik1 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 九十年代的四大天王真的很红啊，每个人都认识他们。
examples.english_sentence: The Four Heavenly Kings of the 90s were really popular, everyone knew them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲人成日話想捧新嘅四大天王出嚟，但係好難㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 jan4 seng4 jat6 waa6 soeng2 pung2 san1 ge3 sei3 daai6 tin1 wong4 ceot1 lai4, daan6 hai6 hou2 naan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的人总是说想捧新的四大天王出来，但是很难的。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, people always say they want to create a new set of Four Heavenly Kings, but it's very difficult.

english_meaning: all is vanity; complete emptiness of the four elements (earth, water, fire, and wind); seeing through worldly illusions
explanation_mandarin: 佛教用语，指世间一切都是虚幻的，包括组成物质世界的地、水、火、风四种元素。形容看破红尘，对一切都不在意。
explanation_english: A Buddhist term referring to the illusory nature of everything in the world, including the four elements (earth, water, fire, and wind) that constitute the physical world. It describes a state of having seen through worldly illusions and being indifferent to everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢經歷咗咁多嘢之後，好似四大皆空噉，乜嘢都唔在乎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging1 lik6 zo2 gam3 do1 je5 zi1 hau6, hou2 ci5 sei3 daai6 gaai1 hung1 gam2, mat1 je5 dou1 m4 zoi6 fu4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经历了这么多事情之后，好像四大皆空一样，什么都不在乎了。
examples.english_sentence: After experiencing so much, he seems to have seen through worldly illusions and doesn't care about anything anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁四大皆空啦，人生仲有好多嘢值得追求㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 sei3 daai6 gaai1 hung1 laa1, jan4 sang1 zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 je5 zik6 dak1 zeoi1 kau4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么四大皆空了，人生还有很多东西值得追求的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so indifferent to everything, there are still many things in life worth pursuing.

mandarin_meaning: 四大元老; 指在某团体或组织中资历最老、权力最大、影响力最广的四个人。
english_meaning: The Four Elders; Refers to the four most senior, powerful, and influential people in a group or organization.
explanation_mandarin: 指在一个团体或组织中地位最高、最有权势的四位资深人士。通常带有调侃或讽刺的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to the four most senior and powerful people in a group or organization. Often used in a humorous or satirical way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司啲嘢都係四大長老話事嘅，我哋啲後生仔冇say嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 di1 je5 dou1 hai6 sei3 daai6 zoeng2 lou5 waa6 si6 ge3, ngo5 dei6 di1 hau6 saang1 zai2 mou5 say ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的事情都是四大元老说了算的，我们这些年轻人没有发言权。
examples.english_sentence: In this company, everything is decided by the Four Elders; we young people have no say.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嗰間社團，四大長老權力大到不得了，連大佬都要聽佢哋話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 go2 gaan1 se5 tyun4, sei3 daai6 zoeng2 lou5 kuen4 lik6 daai6 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5, lin4 daai6 lou2 dou1 jiu3 teng1 keoi5 dei6 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们那个社团，四大元老的权力大得不得了，连老大都要听他们的话。
examples.english_sentence: In their society, the Four Elders have immense power, even the boss has to listen to them.

english_meaning: four seasons
explanation_mandarin: 一年中的春夏秋冬四个季节。
explanation_english: The four seasons of the year: spring, summer, autumn, and winter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港四季都咁潮濕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 sei3 gwai3 dou1 gam3 zo1 sap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港四季都很潮湿。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong is humid in all four seasons.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意畫四季嘅風景。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 waak6 sei3 gwai3 ge3 fung1 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很喜欢画四季的风景。
examples.english_sentence: He likes to paint the scenery of the four seasons.

english_meaning: Kumquat
explanation_mandarin: 一种柑橘类的水果，果实小而圆，颜色金黄，可食用。
explanation_english: A small, round, orange-colored citrus fruit with a sweet rind and slightly sour pulp. It is edible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意食四季桔，酸酸甜甜好開胃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 sei3 gwai3 gat1, syun1 syun1 tim4 tim4 hou2 hoi1 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢吃金桔，酸酸甜甜很开胃。
examples.english_sentence: I like eating kumquats, they are sour and sweet and very appetizing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年嗰陣，好多人會買盆四季桔返屋企擺，話可以攞個好意頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 go2 zan6, hou2 do1 jan4 wui5 maai5 pun4 sei3 gwai3 gat1 faan1 uk1 kei2 baai2, waa6 ho2 ji5 lo2 go3 hou2 ji3 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年的时候，很多人会买一盆金桔回家摆放，说可以讨个好彩头。
examples.english_sentence: During Chinese New Year, many people buy a pot of kumquat and bring it home to display, saying it brings good luck.

english_meaning: green beans, string beans
explanation_mandarin: 一种常见的蔬菜，豆荚呈绿色，细长。
explanation_english: A common vegetable with long, green pods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日買咗啲四季豆，夜晚炒嚟食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 maai5 zo2 di1 sei3 gwai3 dau2, je6 maan1 caau2 lai4 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天买了一些四季豆，晚上炒来吃。
examples.english_sentence: I bought some green beans today, I'll stir-fry them for dinner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你鍾唔鍾意食蒜蓉炒四季豆呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung1 m4 zung1 ji3 sik6 syun3 yung4 caau2 sei3 gwai3 dau2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你喜欢吃蒜蓉炒四季豆吗？
examples.english_sentence: Do you like stir-fried green beans with garlic?

english_meaning: Sichuan (province)
explanation_mandarin: 中国西南部的一个省份。
explanation_english: A province in southwestern China.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意食四川菜，又麻又辣，好惹味㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 sik6 si3 cyun1 coi3, jau6 maa4 jau6 laat6, hou2 je5 mei6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很喜欢吃四川菜，又麻又辣，很入味！
examples.english_sentence: I really like Sichuan cuisine, it's both numbing and spicy, and very flavorful!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢去咗四川旅行，話啲風景好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 heoi3 zo2 si3 cyun1 leoi5 hang4, waa6 di1 fung1 ging2 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他去了四川旅行，说风景很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: He went to Sichuan for travel, and said the scenery is very beautiful.

english_meaning: upright; square; proper; well-behaved; (of handwriting) neat and regular
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物端正、规矩，也形容人品行端正。
explanation_english: Describes something upright, square, and proper; can also describe a person's character as upright and well-behaved. It can also refer to handwriting that is neat and regular.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢寫啲字四平八正，好整齊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 se2 di1 zi6 sei3 ping4 baat3 zing3, hou2 zing2 cai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他写的字端端正正，很整齐。
examples.english_sentence: He writes neatly and regularly, it's very tidy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爺教我哋做人要四平八正。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 je4 gaau3 ngo5 dei6 zou6 jan4 jiu3 sei3 ping4 baat3 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爷爷教导我们做人要规规矩矩。
examples.english_sentence: Grandfather taught us that we should be upright and well-behaved in our lives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間屋起得四平八正，望落好穩陣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 uk1 hei2 dak1 sei3 ping4 baat3 zing3, mong6 lok6 hou2 wan2 zan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间房子盖得很方正，看起来很稳固。
examples.english_sentence: This house is built square and upright, it looks very stable.

english_meaning: steady; stable; well-balanced; secure; safe and sound
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常稳固，没有风险，也形容做事非常稳重，不冒险。
explanation_english: Describes something as very stable, secure, and without risk. It can also describe someone who is very steady in their actions and doesn't take risks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢四平八穩，老闆好放心交俾佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 sei3 ping4 baat3 wan2, lou5 baan2 hou2 fong3 sam1 gaau1 bei2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事稳稳当当的，老板很放心交给他。
examples.english_sentence: He works very steadily and reliably, so the boss is comfortable entrusting tasks to him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃四平八穩，應該唔會有咩問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 sei3 ping4 baat3 wan2, ying1 goi1 m4 wui5 jau5 me1 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划稳稳当当的，应该不会有什么问题。
examples.english_sentence: This plan is very stable and secure, there shouldn't be any problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅發展四平八穩，唔會突然間有咩大起大落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 faat3 zin2 sei3 ping4 baat3 wan2, m4 wui5 dat6 jin4 gaan1 jau5 me1 daai6 hei2 daai6 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的发展稳扎稳打，不会突然间有大的起伏。
examples.english_sentence: This company's development is steady and stable; it won't suddenly have any major ups and downs.

english_meaning: Multiple choice question
explanation_mandarin: 一种题型，提供四个选项，让学生选择一个正确的答案。
explanation_english: A type of question, typically in an exam or test, that presents four options from which the student must choose the correct answer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試好多都係四式判斷題，好容易撞彩㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 hou2 do1 dou1 hai6 sei3 sik1 pun3 dyun3 tai4, hou2 jung4 yi6 zong6 coi2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试很多都是选择题，很容易蒙对的。
examples.english_sentence: There were a lot of multiple choice questions in this exam, it's easy to guess the right answer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得四式判斷題，只要識得排除，就容易啲揀啱答案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 sei3 sik1 pun3 dyun3 tai4, ziu2 jiu3 sik1 dak1 paai4 ceoi5, zau6 jung4 yi6 di1 gaan2 ngaam1 daap3 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得选择题，只要懂得排除法，就比较容易选对答案。
examples.english_sentence: I think with multiple choice questions, if you know how to eliminate options, it's easier to pick the right answer.

english_meaning: Top four, semi-finalists
explanation_mandarin: 指比赛中进入前四名的队伍或选手。
explanation_english: Refers to the top four teams or players in a competition; semi-finalists.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋隊波打入咗四強，真係好叻啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 deoi2 bo1 daa2 jap6 zo2 sei3 koeng4, zan1 hai6 hou2 lek1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的球队进入了四强，真了不起！
examples.english_sentence: Our team made it to the top four, that's amazing!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今屆世界盃嘅四強隊伍都好強勁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 gai3 sai3 gaai3 bui1 ge3 sei3 koeng4 deoi2 ng5 dou1 hou2 koeng4 ging6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这届世界杯的四强队伍都很强劲。
examples.english_sentence: The top four teams in this year's World Cup are all very strong.

english_meaning: Four-hand piano duet
explanation_mandarin: 指两人合奏一架钢琴，通常是演奏事先安排好的曲目。
explanation_english: Refers to two people playing a single piano together, typically performing a pre-arranged piece of music.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩姊妹琴技都好叻，成日一齊四手聯彈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 zi2 mui6 kam4 gei6 dou1 hou2 lek1, seng4 jat6 jat1 cai4 sei3 sau2 lyun4 daan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她们两姐妹钢琴技术都很好，经常一起四手联弹。
examples.english_sentence: The two sisters are both very skilled pianists and often play four-hand duets together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋學校嘅音樂會，有兩個學生會表演四手聯彈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hok6 haau6 ge3 jam1 ngok6 wui2, jau5 loeng5 go3 hok6 sang1 wui5 biu2 jin2 sei3 sau2 lyun4 daan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们学校的音乐会，有两个学生会表演四手联弹。
examples.english_sentence: At our school's concert, two students will perform a four-hand duet.

english_meaning: round off (numbers)
explanation_mandarin: 一种数值近似方法，当需要保留特定位数时，舍去不保留的位数，使结果更简洁。如果舍去的最高位数字小于5，则舍去；如果大于等于5，则进一位。
explanation_english: A method of approximating a number. When rounding to a specific place value, discard the digits to the right of that place. If the discarded digit is less than 5, round down; if it's 5 or greater, round up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我要將個數四捨五入到小數點後兩個位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jiu3 zoeng1 go3 sou3 si3 se2 ng5 jap6 dou3 siu2 sou3 dim2 hau6 loeng5 go3 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我要把这个数四舍五入到小数点后两位。
examples.english_sentence: I need to round this number to two decimal places.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆話條數要四捨五入，唔好計到咁仔細。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 waa6 tiu4 sou3 jiu3 si3 se2 ng5 jap6, m4 hou2 gai3 dou3 gam3 zai2 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板说账目要四舍五入，不要算得那么仔细。
examples.english_sentence: The boss said to round off the figures, don't calculate so precisely.

english_meaning: scattered in all directions; to disperse; to break up
explanation_mandarin: 指向不同方向分散开去。形容人员或物体分散到不同的地方。
explanation_english: To scatter in different directions. Describes people or objects dispersing to different places.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 差人嚟捉人，啲人即刻四散走佬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caai1 jan4 lai4 zuk1 jan4, di1 jan4 zik1 hak1 sei3 saan3 zau2 lou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察来抓人，人们立刻四处逃跑。
examples.english_sentence: The police came to arrest people, and everyone immediately scattered and ran away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到爆炸聲，啲雀仔嚇到四散飛走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou2 baau3 zaa3 seng1, di1 zoek3 zai2 haak3 dou3 sei3 saan3 fei1 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到爆炸声，鸟儿吓得四处飞散。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing the explosion, the birds were frightened and scattered in all directions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一嗌交，成個團隊就四散。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 aai3 gaau1, seng4 go3 teoi4 deoi2 zau6 sei3 saan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一吵架，整个团队就解散了。
examples.english_sentence: Once they had a fight, the whole team broke up.

english_meaning: all directions; square; steady; reliable
explanation_mandarin: 1. 指各个方向。2. 形容东西是正方形的。3. 形容人稳重，靠谱。
explanation_english: 1. Refers to all directions. 2. Describes something that is square. 3. Describes a person as steady, reliable, and trustworthy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間屋四四方方，幾好擺傢俬喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 uk1 sei3 sei3 fong1 fong1, gei2 hou2 baai2 gaa1 si1 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间房子方方正正的，挺好摆放家具的。
examples.english_sentence: This house is square and regular, it's good for placing furniture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人四方，好靠得住嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 sei3 fong1, hou2 kaau3 dak1 zyu6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很可靠，很值得信赖。
examples.english_sentence: He is a reliable person, very trustworthy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢周圍四方咁去搵工，都搵唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zau1 wai4 sei3 fong1 gam2 heoi3 wan2 gung1, dou1 wan2 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他四处去求职，都没有找到。
examples.english_sentence: He looked for a job everywhere, but couldn't find one.

english_meaning: from all directions; from all sides; all around
explanation_mandarin: 指各个方向，所有方面。形容范围广，涉及面广。
explanation_english: Refers to all directions or aspects. Describes a wide scope or coverage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新聞一出，佢受到四方八面嘅壓力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 man4 jat1 ceot1, keoi5 sau6 dou3 sei3 fong1 baat3 min6 ge3 aat3 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新闻一出，他受到四面八方的压力。
examples.english_sentence: Once the news came out, he received pressure from all sides.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢四方八面都好識做人，所以人緣好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sei3 fong1 baat3 min6 dou1 hou2 sik1 zou6 jan4, so2 ji5 jan4 jyun4 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他四面八方都很会做人，所以人缘很好。
examples.english_sentence: He knows how to handle people from all sides, so he has great interpersonal relationships.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅業務發展到四方八面，好成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 jip6 mou6 faat3 zin2 dou3 sei3 fong1 baat3 min6, hou2 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的业务发展到四面八方，很成功。
examples.english_sentence: This company's business has expanded to all directions, it's very successful.

english_meaning: mortarboard (graduation cap)
explanation_mandarin: 指毕业典礼上学生戴的方形帽子，象征着知识和学术成就。
explanation_english: Refers to the square academic cap worn by students at graduation ceremonies, symbolizing knowledge and academic achievement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽日畢業喇，著袍戴四方帽好威水啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ting1 jat6 bat1 jip6 laa3, zoek3 pou4 daai3 sei3 fong1 mou2 hou2 wai1 seoi2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明天毕业了，穿袍子戴四方帽很威风啊！
examples.english_sentence: He's graduating tomorrow, wearing a gown and mortarboard looks so impressive!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 戴住四方帽影相係畢業嘅指定動作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai3 zyu6 sei3 fong1 mou2 ying2 seung2 hai6 bat1 jip6 ge3 zi2 ding6 dung6 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 戴着方帽子拍照是毕业的指定动作。
examples.english_sentence: Taking photos wearing a mortarboard is a must-do for graduation.

mandarin_meaning: 正方形; 长方形; 四边形
english_meaning: square; rectangle; quadrilateral
explanation_mandarin: 指四边形的形状，可以是正方形或长方形。
explanation_english: Refers to a four-sided shape, which can be a square or a rectangle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個盒係四方形嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hap6 hai6 sei3 fong1 ying4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个盒子是四方形的。
examples.english_sentence: This box is square/rectangular.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張枱係四方形嘅，好啱擺喺客廳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 toi2 hai6 sei3 fong1 ying4 ge3, hou2 ngaam1 baai2 hai2 hak3 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 桌子是四方形的，很适合放在客厅。
examples.english_sentence: The table is rectangular, it's perfect for placing in the living room.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幅牆上面掛住一幅四方形嘅畫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fuk1 coeng4 soeng6 min6 gwaa3 zyu6 jat1 fuk1 sei3 fong1 ying4 ge3 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 墙上挂着一幅四方形的画。
examples.english_sentence: There's a rectangular painting hanging on the wall.

english_meaning: inflexible; rigid; inflexible person; square
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人思想僵化，不懂得灵活变通，就像四四方方的木头一样。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is inflexible, rigid, and doesn't know how to adapt or think outside the box, like a square piece of wood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人真係四方木，講極都唔明。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 zan1 hai6 sei3 fong1 muk6, gong2 gik1 dou1 m4 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人真是太死板了，怎么说都不明白。
examples.english_sentence: He's such an inflexible person, he doesn't understand no matter how much you explain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁四方木啦，試下新嘅方法啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 sei3 fong1 muk6 laa1, si3 haa5 san1 ge3 fong1 faat3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么死板啦，试试新的方法吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so rigid, try a new method.

mandarin_meaning: 一种竹子，竹竿是方形的
english_meaning: Square bamboo (a type of bamboo with square culms)
explanation_mandarin: 指一种竹子的品种，其竹竿的形状不是圆的，而是方形的。
explanation_english: Refers to a type of bamboo species where the culm (stem) is square rather than round.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度啲四方竹好靚呀，真係四方形㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 di1 sei3 fong1 zuk1 hou2 leng3 aa3, zan1 hai6 sei3 fong1 ying4 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的四方竹很漂亮啊，真的是方形的！
examples.english_sentence: The square bamboo here is beautiful, it's really square!

english_meaning: idiot, blockhead, stupid person
explanation_mandarin: 用来形容人笨，头脑不灵活。字面意思是四方的鸭蛋，因为鸭蛋通常是椭圆形的，四方是不正常的，所以引申为愚笨。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone as foolish, dull, or unintelligent. Literally means 'square duck egg,' because duck eggs are typically oval. Being square is abnormal, therefore it's used to mean stupid or foolish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁蠢啦，成日都好似嚿四方鴨蛋咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 ceon2 laa1, seng4 jat6 dou1 hou2 ci5 gau6 sei3 fong1 aap3 daan2 gam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么笨了，整天都好像个傻瓜一样。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stupid, you're always like an idiot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢成日甩漏，真係一嚿四方鴨蛋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 seng4 jat6 lat1 lau6, zan1 hai6 jat1 gau6 sei3 fong1 aap3 daan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作总是出错，真是一个笨蛋。
examples.english_sentence: He always makes mistakes at work, he's such an idiot.

mandarin_meaning: 笨拙，不灵活，不擅长交际
english_meaning: awkward, clumsy, socially inept
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人举止笨拙，不灵活，或者不善于与人打交道，不太会处理人际关系。也指做事不得要领，效率不高。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is awkward, clumsy, and socially inept. It can also refer to someone who is inefficient and doesn't get to the heart of the matter when doing things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人四方𡃈𡃈噉，唔係好識同人溝通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 sei3 fong1 guat1 guat1 gam2, m4 hai6 hou2 sik1 tung4 jan4 kau1 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人笨手笨脚的，不太会和人沟通。
examples.english_sentence: He is an awkward person and doesn't know how to communicate with others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好怪佢，佢只係四方𡃈啫，做嘢慢啲，但都好落力嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gwaai3 keoi5, keoi5 zek3 hai6 sei3 fong1 guat1 ze1, zou6 je5 maan6 di1, daan6 dou1 hou2 lok6 lik6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要怪他，他只是笨手笨脚而已，做事慢一点，但是也很努力的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't blame him, he's just clumsy, he's slow but he works hard.

synonyms: 笨手笨腳 (ban6 sau2 ban6 goek3)

english_meaning: the four seasons
explanation_mandarin: 指春夏秋冬四个季节。
explanation_english: Refers to the four seasons: spring, summer, autumn, and winter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅四時都好潮濕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 sei3 si4 dou1 hou2 ciu4 sap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的四季都很潮湿。
examples.english_sentence: The four seasons in Hong Kong are all very humid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鐘意四時都去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 sei3 si4 dou1 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喜欢一年四季都去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: He likes to travel in all four seasons.

english_meaning: The Four Books and Five Classics (of Confucianism)
explanation_mandarin: 四书五经是儒家经典著作的合称。“四书”指《大学》、《中庸》、《论语》、《孟子》；“五经”指《诗经》、《尚书》、《礼记》、《易经》、《春秋》。
explanation_english: "The Four Books and Five Classics" is a collective term for the classic works of Confucianism. The Four Books are "The Great Learning," "The Doctrine of the Mean," "The Analects of Confucius," and "Mencius"; The Five Classics are "The Book of Poetry," "The Book of Documents," "The Book of Rites," "The Book of Changes," and "The Spring and Autumn Annals."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前嘅人一定要讀四書五經㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yi5 cin4 ge3 yan4 yat1 ding6 yiu3 duk6 sei3 syu1 ng5 ging1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的人一定要读四书五经的。
examples.english_sentence: People in the past had to study the Four Books and Five Classics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嗰陣已經開始接觸四書五經啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 ji5 ging1 hoi1 chi2 zip3 juk1 sei3 syu1 ng5 ging1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候就已经开始接触四书五经了。
examples.english_sentence: He started getting exposed to the Four Books and Five Classics when he was young.

english_meaning: April
explanation_mandarin: 公历的第四个月份。
explanation_english: The fourth month of the Gregorian calendar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋四月去日本賞櫻花。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sei3 yut6 heoi3 jat6 bun2 soeng2 ying1 faa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们四月去日本赏樱花。
examples.english_sentence: We are going to Japan in April to see the cherry blossoms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 四月一號係愚人節。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sei3 yut6 jat1 hou6 hai6 jyu4 jan4 jit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 四月一日是愚人节。
examples.english_sentence: April 1st is April Fool's Day.

english_meaning: Four-panel comic strip
explanation_mandarin: 一种由四个小格子组成的漫画形式，通常带有简洁的故事或笑话。
explanation_english: A comic strip format consisting of four panels, often used to tell a short story or joke.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嗰陣好鍾意睇四格漫畫㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 hou2 zung1 ji3 tai2 sei3 gaak3 maan6 waa2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候很喜欢看四格漫画的。
examples.english_sentence: I really liked reading four-panel comics when I was a kid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本雜誌有好多唔同類型嘅四格漫畫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 zaap6 zi3 jau5 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 leoi6 jing4 ge3 sei3 gaak3 maan6 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本杂志有很多不同类型的四格漫画。
examples.english_sentence: This magazine has many different types of four-panel comics.

english_meaning: Four
explanation_mandarin: 表示数量，四个。
explanation_english: Means the number four.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗四條魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 sei3 tiu4 jyu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了四条鱼。
examples.english_sentence: I bought four fish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢有四條仔女。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 jau5 sei3 tiu4 zai2 neoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他有四个子女。
examples.english_sentence: He said he has four children.

mandarin_meaning: 端正, 正式, 规矩
english_meaning: Proper, decent, neat, well-behaved, presentable, respectable, standard
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物端正、正式、规矩。也可以形容人品行端正，或者外貌整洁。
explanation_english: Describes something as proper, decent, neat, well-behaved, presentable, or respectable. It can also describe a person's character as being upright or their appearance as being tidy and well-groomed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好四正，唔會搞搞震嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 sei3 zing3, m4 wui5 gaau2 gaau2 zan3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很正派，不会搞破坏的。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very decent person and wouldn't cause trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司啲文件全部都好四正。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 di1 man4 gin2 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hou2 sei3 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的文件都很规范。
examples.english_sentence: All the documents in this company are very standard and well-organized.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日着到好四正，唔知去邊度呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 dou3 hou2 sei3 zing3, m4 zi1 heoi3 bin1 dou6 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天穿得很整齐，不知道去哪里呢？
examples.english_sentence: He is dressed very neatly today, I wonder where he is going?

english_meaning: The whole world; all corners of the earth; everywhere
explanation_mandarin: 指天下各处，形容范围极广。
explanation_english: Refers to all parts of the world, describing a very wide range or scope.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 朋友滿四海，知己有幾人？
examples.jyutping_sentence: pang4 jau5 mun5 sei3 hoi2, zi1 gei2 jau5 gei2 yan4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 朋友遍天下，知己有几人？
examples.english_sentence: Friends are all over the world, but how many are true friends?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋四海為家，邊度都可以住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sei3 hoi2 wai4 ga1, bin1 dou6 dou1 ho2 yi5 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们四海为家，哪里都可以住。
examples.english_sentence: We wander all over the world; we can live anywhere.

jyutping: sei3 hoi2 zi1 noi6 gaai1 hing1 dai6
mandarin_meaning: 四海之内皆兄弟 (sì hǎi zhī nèi jiē xiōng dì)
english_meaning: All men are brothers; Everyone within the four seas is a brother.
explanation_mandarin: 形容天下的人都像兄弟一样，强调友爱与和平，无论来自哪里都应该互相尊重和帮助。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning that all people in the world are like brothers; it emphasizes universal brotherhood, love, and peace, and promotes mutual respect and help regardless of origin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該抱住四海之內皆兄弟嘅精神，互相幫助。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 pou5 zyu6 sei3 hoi2 zi1 noi6 gaai1 hing1 dai6 ge3 zing1 san4, wu6 seung1 bong1 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该抱着四海之内皆兄弟的精神，互相帮助。
examples.english_sentence: We should embrace the spirit of 'all men are brothers' and help each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然我哋唔識大家，但係四海之內皆兄弟，有咩幫到手嘅，出聲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seui1 yin4 ngo5 dei6 m4 sik1 daai6 ga1, daan6 hai6 sei3 hoi2 zi1 noi6 gaai1 hing1 dai6, yau5 me1 bong1 dou2 sau2 ge3, chut1 seng1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然我们不认识大家，但是四海之内皆兄弟，有什么需要帮忙的，说一声。
examples.english_sentence: Although we don't know each other, 'all men are brothers', if you need any help, just ask.

english_meaning: to regard the four corners of the world as one's home; to feel at home anywhere
explanation_mandarin: 形容志在四方，到处都可以安家。也形容一个人经常在外奔波，生活不安定。
explanation_english: Describes someone who aspires to travel widely and can settle down anywhere. It can also describe someone who travels frequently and whose life is unstable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩公婆成日周圍去旅行，真係四海為家咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gung1 po4 sing4 jat6 zau1 wai4 heoi3 leoi5 hang4, zan1 hai6 sei3 hoi2 wai4 gaa1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两口子整天到处去旅行，真是四海为家。
examples.english_sentence: The two of them travel around all the time, truly regarding the four corners of the world as their home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個就跟住阿爸周圍搬屋，可以話係四海為家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 zau6 gan1 zyu6 aa3 baa1 zau1 wai4 bun1 uk1, ho2 ji5 waa6 hai6 sei3 hoi2 wai4 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他从小就跟着爸爸到处搬家，可以说是四海为家。
examples.english_sentence: He moved around with his father everywhere since he was little; you could say he regards the four corners of the world as his home.

english_meaning: To make one's home wherever one is; to live a vagrant life; to roam the world
explanation_mandarin: 形容志在四方，不留恋家乡或固定住所。也指生活漂泊不定。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is ambitious and does not yearn for their hometown or a fixed residence. It can also refer to a nomadic and unsettled lifestyle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢後生嘅時候四海爲家，周圍去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau6 saang1 ge3 si4 hau6 si3 hoi2 wai4 gaa1, zau1 wai4 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他年轻的时候四海为家，到处去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: When he was young, he made his home wherever he went and traveled everywhere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做水手嘅生活就係四海爲家，好少可以留喺同一個地方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 seoi2 sau2 ge3 saang1 wut6 zau6 hai6 si3 hoi2 wai4 gaa1, hou2 siu2 ho2 ji5 lau4 hai2 tung4 jat1 go3 dei6 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做水手的生活就是四海为家，很少可以留在同一个地方。
examples.english_sentence: The life of a sailor is making one's home wherever one goes, rarely staying in the same place.

mandarin_meaning: 香港早期城市规划的区域划分
english_meaning: Four Districts and Nine Suburbs (historical administrative divisions of early Hong Kong Island)
explanation_mandarin: 指香港开埠初期对香港岛的早期行政区域划分。四环指的是香港岛最早发展的四个区域，大约是中环、上环、西环、湾仔一带。九约指的是在四环以外的九个郊区，主要集中在香港岛南边和东边。
explanation_english: Refers to the early administrative division of Hong Kong Island in the early days of its establishment. The 'Four Districts' (四環) refer to the four earliest developed areas of Hong Kong Island, roughly Central, Sheung Wan, Sai Wan, and Wan Chai. The 'Nine Suburbs' (九約) refer to the nine suburban areas outside the Four Districts, mainly concentrated in the south and east of Hong Kong Island.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋間公司喺四環九約入面嘅一個舊區。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaan1 gung1 si1 hai2 sei3 waan4 gau2 yoek3 jap6 min6 ge3 jat1 go3 gau6 keoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的公司位于四环九约里的一个老区。
examples.english_sentence: Their company is located in an old district within the Four Districts and Nine Suburbs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅歷史好耐㗎，你要了解多啲四環九約嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 lik6 si2 hou2 noi6 gaa3, nei5 jiu3 liu2 gaai2 do1 di1 sei3 waan4 gau2 yoek3 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的历史很悠久，你需要多了解一些关于四环九约的事情。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong has a long history, you need to learn more about the Four Districts and Nine Suburbs.

english_meaning: to look at each other, to gaze into each other's eyes
explanation_mandarin: 形容两人目光相遇，互相注视。通常带有深情的意味。
explanation_english: Describes two people looking at each other, gazing into each other's eyes. Usually implies a deep emotional connection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺舞池入面，四目交投，好似全世界得返佢哋兩個噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 mou5 ci4 jap6 min6, sei3 muk6 gaau1 tau4, hou2 ci5 cyun4 sai3 gaai3 dak1 faan1 keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在舞池里，四目相对，好像全世界只剩下他们两个人一样。
examples.english_sentence: They were in the dance floor, gazing into each other's eyes, as if they were the only two people left in the world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋第一次見面，四目交投嘅一刻，大家都覺得好似識咗好耐噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 dai6 jat1 ci3 gin3 min6, sei3 muk6 gaau1 tau4 ge3 jat1 hak1, daai6 ga1 dou1 gok3 dak1 hou2 ci5 sik1 zo2 hou2 noi6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们第一次见面，四目相对的那一刻，大家都觉得好像认识了很久一样。
examples.english_sentence: When they met for the first time, at the moment their eyes met, everyone felt as if they had known each other for a long time.

english_meaning: Four eyes (a derogatory term for someone who wears glasses)
explanation_mandarin: 对戴眼镜的人的蔑称。因为戴眼镜看起来像是多了两只眼睛。
explanation_english: A derogatory term for someone who wears glasses. It's called 'four eyes' because wearing glasses makes it seem like they have four eyes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪叫我四眼啦，好唔尊重㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 giu3 ngo5 sei3 ngaan5 laa1, hou2 m4 zyun1 zung6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别叫我四眼啦，很不尊重人的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't call me four eyes, it's very disrespectful!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢帶咗副新嘅眼鏡，但係佢啲朋友都係叫佢做四眼仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daai3 zo2 fu3 san1 ge3 ngaan5 geng2, daan6 hai6 keoi5 di1 pang4 jau5 dou1 hai6 giu3 keoi5 zou6 sei3 ngaan5 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他戴了一副新的眼镜，但是他的朋友还是叫他四眼仔。
examples.english_sentence: He's wearing a new pair of glasses, but his friends still call him 'four eyes'.

english_meaning: Four-eyes (term for someone who wears glasses)
explanation_mandarin: 对戴眼镜的人的称呼，略带贬义，不礼貌。字面意思是“四个眼睛的孩子”。
explanation_english: A term used to refer to someone who wears glasses, often with a slightly derogatory or impolite connotation. Literally means "four-eyed child."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好叫佢做四眼仔，好唔尊重人嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 giu3 keoi5 zou6 sei3 ngaan5 zai2, hou2 m4 zyun1 zung6 jan4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要叫他四眼仔，很不尊重人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't call him four-eyes, it's very disrespectful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個就開始戴眼鏡，成日畀人叫做四眼仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 zau6 hoi1 chi2 daai3 ngaan5 geng2, seng4 jat6 bei2 jan4 giu3 zou6 sei3 ngaan5 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他从小就开始戴眼镜，总是被人叫做四眼仔。
examples.english_sentence: He started wearing glasses since he was little and was often called four-eyes.

english_meaning: Four-eyes (offensive term for someone who wears glasses)
explanation_mandarin: 对戴眼镜的人的一种带有贬义的称呼。强调对方戴着眼镜，通常含有不尊重或嘲笑的意味。
explanation_english: A derogatory term for someone who wears glasses, emphasizing the fact that they wear glasses. It often carries disrespectful or mocking undertones.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好叫佢四眼佬，好冇禮貌㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 giu3 keoi5 sei3 ngaan5 lou2, hou2 mou5 lai5 maau6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要叫他四眼仔，很不礼貌的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't call him 'four-eyes', it's very impolite.

mandarin_meaning: 四眼老太婆, 眼镜婆婆
english_meaning: Four-eyed old woman, woman with glasses (derogatory)
explanation_mandarin: 对戴眼镜的年长女性的贬称。带有不尊重和嘲笑的意味。
explanation_english: A derogatory term for an older woman who wears glasses. It carries a disrespectful and mocking connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺度笑嗰個四眼婆，真係冇禮貌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 dou6 siu3 go2 go3 sei3 ngaan5 po4, zan1 hai6 mou5 lai5 maau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在嘲笑那个戴眼镜的老太太，真没礼貌。
examples.english_sentence: They are laughing at that four-eyed old woman, so rude.

mandarin_meaning: 四眼田雞 (sì yǎn tián jī)
english_meaning: Four-eyes (derogatory term for someone who wears glasses)
explanation_mandarin: 带有贬义的称呼，指戴眼镜的人。因为眼镜在脸上看起来像四只眼睛，所以用“四眼”来形容。 “龟”是一种比喻，通常带有负面含义。
explanation_english: A derogatory term for someone who wears glasses. 'Four eyes' refers to the appearance of having four eyes because of the glasses. 'Turtle' (龜) is often used with a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪叫人四眼龜啦，好冇禮貌㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 giu3 jan4 sei3 ngaan5 gwai1 laa1, hou2 mou5 lai5 maau6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别叫别人四眼田鸡了，很不礼貌的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't call people 'four-eyes', it's very rude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日笑我係四眼龜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 jat6 siu3 ngo5 hai6 sei3 ngaan5 gwai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们总是笑我是四眼田鸡。
examples.english_sentence: They always laugh at me, calling me 'four-eyes'.

english_meaning: Four beginnings; the four beginnings of morality (benevolence, righteousness, propriety, and wisdom) according to Mencius
explanation_mandarin: 指孟子提出的仁、义、礼、智的四种萌芽状态，认为人天生具有这四种道德观念的端绪。
explanation_english: Refers to the four beginnings of morality (benevolence, righteousness, propriety, and wisdom) proposed by Mencius. It is believed that humans are born with the seeds of these four moral concepts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 孟子講嘅四端係仁、義、禮、智。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maang6 zi2 gong2 ge3 sei3 dyun1 hai6 yan4, ji6, lai5, zi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 孟子说的四端是仁、义、礼、智。
examples.english_sentence: The four beginnings Mencius spoke of are benevolence, righteousness, propriety, and wisdom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個就已經展現出四端嘅萌芽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 zau6 ji5 ging1 zin2 hin3 cheut1 sei3 dyun1 ge3 mang4 ngaa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他从小就展现出四端的萌芽。
examples.english_sentence: He showed the beginnings of the four virtues from a young age.

mandarin_meaning: 麻将中的一种和牌牌型
english_meaning: A winning hand in Mahjong consisting of four red dragon tiles and one white dragon tile.
explanation_mandarin: 麻将中的一种特殊和牌牌型，由四张红中和一张白板组成。
explanation_english: A specific winning hand in Mahjong composed of four red dragon tiles (red middle, 紅中) and one white dragon tile (white board, 白板).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢聽日要打四紅一白，希望贏錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 daa2 sei3 hung4 jat1 baak6, hei1 mong6 wing4 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他明天要打四红一白，希望赢钱。
examples.english_sentence: He said he's going for a 'four reds and one white' Mahjong hand tomorrow, hoping to win money.

english_meaning: Terrible; awful; substandard; rubbish
explanation_mandarin: 形容某事物质量很差，水平很低劣。常用作贬义词，表示不满或鄙视。
explanation_english: Describes something of very poor quality or of a low standard. Often used as a derogatory term to express dissatisfaction or contempt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳啲嘢食四級，以後都唔會再去啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 sei3 kap1, ji5 hau6 dou1 m4 wui5 zoi3 heoi3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西太差了，以后再也不会去了！
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is terrible, I won't go there again!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢齣戲拍得真係四級，劇情又悶，演員又唔掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ceot1 hei3 paak3 dak1 zan1 hai6 sei3 kap1, kek6 cing4 jau6 mun6, jin2 yun4 jau6 m4 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影拍得真是太差了，剧情又无聊，演员又不行。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is absolutely rubbish, the plot is boring, and the actors are terrible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲英文真係四級，完全唔知佢講乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 jing1 man2 zan1 hai6 sei3 kap1, wun4 cyun4 m4 zi1 keoi5 gong2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的英语真是太差了，完全不知道他在说什么。
examples.english_sentence: His English is so awful, I have no idea what he's saying.

english_meaning: four tones (of Cantonese)
explanation_mandarin: 指粤语的四个主要声调。粤语实际上有六个声调，但传统上口语中常说“四声”，指的是阴平、阴上、阴去和阳平四个常用声调，不包含两个入声。
explanation_english: Refers to the four main tones of Cantonese. While Cantonese actually has six tones, it's common to refer to "four tones" in casual speech, referring to the high level (陰平), rising (陰上), going (陰去), and low level (陽平) tones, excluding the two entering tones.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學粵語最緊要係學好四聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 jyut6 jyu5 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hai6 hok6 hou2 sei3 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学粤语最重要的是学好四种声调。
examples.english_sentence: The most important thing when learning Cantonese is to learn the four tones well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲四聲都唔正，聽落好怪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 sei3 seng1 dou1 m4 zeng3, teng1 lok6 hou2 gwaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的四声都不准，听起来很奇怪。
examples.english_sentence: His four tones are not accurate, it sounds weird.

english_meaning: limbs (arms and legs)
explanation_mandarin: 指人的两只手臂和两只腿。
explanation_english: Refers to the four limbs of a person: two arms and two legs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢交通意外搞到四肢癱瘓咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaau1 tung1 ji3 ngoi6 gaau2 dou3 sei3 zi1 taan2 waai6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为交通事故导致四肢瘫痪了。
examples.english_sentence: He became quadriplegic due to a traffic accident.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做運動可以鍛鍊四肢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 wan6 dung6 ho2 ji5 dyun3 lin6 sei3 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做运动可以锻炼四肢。
examples.english_sentence: Exercising can strengthen the limbs.

english_meaning: able-bodied; having all four limbs intact and functioning
explanation_mandarin: 指四肢完整，功能正常。形容身体健康，没有肢体残疾。
explanation_english: Refers to having all four limbs complete and functioning normally. Describes a person who is healthy and does not have any limb disabilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢雖然年紀大，但係四肢健全，仲可以自己行路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seoi1 jin4 nin4 gei2 daai6, daan6 hai6 sei3 zi1 kin6 cyun4, zung6 ho2 ji5 zi6 gei2 haang4 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他虽然年纪大了，但是四肢健全，还可以自己走路。
examples.english_sentence: Although he is old, he is able-bodied and can still walk on his own.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有手有腳，四肢健全嘅人應該更加努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 sau2 jau5 goek3, sei3 zi1 kin6 cyun4 ge3 jan4 ying1 goi1 gang3 gaa1 nu5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有手有脚，四肢健全的人应该更加努力。
examples.english_sentence: People who are able-bodied should work even harder.

english_meaning: lying on one's back with limbs in the air; upside down; flat on one's back
explanation_mandarin: 形容摔倒或仰面朝上的样子，四肢向上伸展。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something falling or lying on their back with limbs pointing upwards. Often implies a sudden or clumsy fall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢踩親塊蕉皮，成個人四腳朝天噉跌落地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 caai2 can1 faai3 ziu1 pei4, seng4 go3 jan4 sei3 goek3 ciu4 tin1 gam2 dit3 lok6 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他踩到香蕉皮，整个人四脚朝天地摔倒在地。
examples.english_sentence: He stepped on a banana peel and fell flat on his back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻烏龜反轉咗，四腳朝天，郁都郁唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 wu1 gwai1 faan2 zyun3 zo2, sei3 goek3 ciu4 tin1, juk1 dou1 juk1 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 乌龟翻过身了，四脚朝天，动都动不了。
examples.english_sentence: The turtle flipped over, lying on its back and unable to move.

english_meaning: to crawl on all fours
explanation_mandarin: 形容用四肢在地上爬行，通常指小孩或者动物的爬行姿势。
explanation_english: Describes crawling on all fours, typically referring to the way a baby or animal crawls.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個細路仔啱啱學識四腳爬爬，周圍都去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sai3 lou2 zai2 ngaam1 ngaam1 hok6 sik1 sei3 goek3 paa4 paa4, zau1 wai4 dou1 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个小孩刚学会四脚爬，到处都去。
examples.english_sentence: This child just learned to crawl on all fours and goes everywhere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇吓隻狗仔四腳爬爬咁，幾得意呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 haa5 zek3 gau2 zai2 sei3 goek3 paa4 paa4 gam2, gei2 dak1 yi3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看看这只小狗四脚爬的样子，真可爱啊！
examples.english_sentence: Look at the puppy crawling on all fours, it's so cute!

mandarin_meaning: 动物；指动物，尤指哺乳动物
english_meaning: Four-legged animal; beast; derogatory term for an animal (especially mammal); sometimes jokingly used to refer to pets.
explanation_mandarin: 字面意义是四条腿的动物。通常指动物，多指哺乳动物。有时也带戏谑语气地指宠物。
explanation_english: Literal meaning is four-legged animal. Usually refers to animals, mostly mammals. Sometimes used jokingly to refer to pets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企養咗隻四腳獸，成日搞搞震。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei2 joeng5 zo2 zek3 sei3 goek3 sau3, seng4 jat6 gaau2 gaau2 zan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家里养了一只四脚兽，整天捣蛋。
examples.english_sentence: We have a four-legged creature at home that's always making trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢當佢隻狗仔係寶咁，成日話佢係最乖嘅四腳獸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dong3 keoi5 zek3 gau2 zai2 hai6 bou2 gam3, seng4 jat6 waa6 keoi5 hai6 zeoi3 gwaai1 ge3 sei3 goek3 sau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把他的小狗当成宝贝一样，总是说它是最乖的四脚兽。
examples.english_sentence: He treasures his puppy like a treasure, always saying it's the best-behaved four-legged creature.

english_meaning: Lizard
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，指蜥蜴，尤其指壁虎。
explanation_english: Cantonese colloquial term for a lizard, especially a gecko.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇下，有隻四腳蛇喺度爬緊呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 haa5, jau5 zek3 sei3 goek3 se4 hai2 dou6 paa4 gan2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看，有一只壁虎在那里爬！
examples.english_sentence: Look, there's a lizard crawling there!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好驚四腳蛇呀，佢哋唔咬人㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 geng1 sei3 goek3 se4 aa3, keoi5 dei6 m4 ngaau5 jan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要害怕壁虎啊，它们不会咬人的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be afraid of lizards, they don't bite.

mandarin_meaning: 随便; 不认真; 马虎
english_meaning: Careless; sloppy; perfunctory; not taking seriously; to do something without proper effort
explanation_mandarin: 形容人做事马马虎虎，不认真，敷衍了事。也表示随便，不拘小节。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is careless, sloppy, and perfunctory in their work. It also implies doing something without proper effort or attention to detail. Can also mean being casual or not fussy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁四萬九啦，呢份報告好重要㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 sei3 maan6 gau2 laa1, ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 hou2 cung4 jiu3 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么马虎，这份报告很重要！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so careless, this report is very important!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢成日都四萬九，所以老闆唔鍾意佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 seng4 jat6 dou1 sei3 maan6 gau2, so2 ji5 lou5 baan2 m4 zung1 ji3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事总是马马虎虎，所以老板不喜欢他。
examples.english_sentence: He always does things carelessly, so the boss doesn't like him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事唔可以四萬九咁做，一定要小心處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 m4 ho2 ji5 sei3 maan6 gau2 gam2 zou6, jat1 ding6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 cyu2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事不可以马马虎虎地做，一定要小心处理。
examples.english_sentence: This matter cannot be done carelessly, it must be handled carefully.

english_meaning: Grinning from ear to ear; smiling broadly
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常高兴，笑得嘴巴张得很大，像“四万”这个数字的形状。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is extremely happy and smiling so broadly that their mouth resembles the shape of the number '四万' (forty thousand), suggesting a very wide grin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢中咗六合彩，開心到四萬咁口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung3 zo2 luk6 hap6 coi2, hoi1 sam1 dou3 sei3 maan6 gam2 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他中了六合彩，开心得合不拢嘴。
examples.english_sentence: He won the lottery and was grinning from ear to ear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿仔考試攞到第一，阿媽笑到四萬咁口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 zai2 haau2 si5 lo2 dou2 dai6 jat1, aa3 maa1 siu3 dou3 sei3 maan6 gam2 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 儿子考试得了第一名，妈妈笑得合不拢嘴。
examples.english_sentence: The son got first place in the exam, and the mother was grinning from ear to ear.

english_meaning: grinning from ear to ear; beaming with joy; smiling widely
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常开心，笑容满面，嘴巴咧得很大，像“四萬”字一样。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is extremely happy and smiling broadly, with their mouth stretched wide like the Chinese character '四萬' (four ten thousand), which resembles a wide grin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢中咗六合彩，開心到四萬噉口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung3 zo2 luk6 hap6 caai2, hoi1 sam1 dou3 sei3 maan6 gam2 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他中了彩票，开心地合不拢嘴。
examples.english_sentence: He won the lottery and was grinning from ear to ear with happiness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到個仔攞到獎，佢四萬噉口咁同人講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 go3 zai2 lo2 dou2 zo2 zoeng2, keoi5 sei3 maan6 gam2 hau2 gam2 tung4 jan4 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到儿子得了奖，他高兴得合不拢嘴地和别人说。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing his son receive an award, he was smiling broadly while telling everyone about it.

english_meaning: Four-leaf clover; lucky charm
explanation_mandarin: 一种罕见的变异三叶草，因其四片叶子而被认为是幸运的象征。
explanation_english: A rare variation of the common three-leaf clover, believed to bring good luck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話搵到四葉草就會有好運。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 wan2 dou2 sei3 jip6 cou2 zau6 wui jau5 hou2 wan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说找到四叶草就会有好运。
examples.english_sentence: He said that finding a four-leaf clover would bring good luck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 送四葉草俾人，希望佢哋可以心想事成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sung3 sei3 jip6 cou2 bei2 jan4, hei1 mong6 keoi5 dei6 ho2 ji5 sam1 soeng2 si6 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 送四叶草给人，希望他们可以心想事成。
examples.english_sentence: Giving someone a four-leaf clover, hoping their wishes come true.

english_meaning: everywhere; all over; in all directions; all around
explanation_mandarin: 指各个地方，到处。
explanation_english: Refers to every place; everywhere; in all directions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢四處搵緊佢唔見咗嘅鎖匙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sei3 cyu3 wan2 gan2 keoi5 m4 gin3 zo2 ge3 so2 si4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他到处在找他不见了的钥匙。
examples.english_sentence: He's looking everywhere for his lost key.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度四處都係垃圾，好污糟呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 sei3 cyu3 dou1 hai6 laap6 saap3, hou2 wu1 zou1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里到处都是垃圾，好脏啊！
examples.english_sentence: There's rubbish everywhere here, it's so dirty!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋四處去旅行，睇吓唔同嘅風景。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sei3 cyu3 heoi3 leoi5 hang4, tai2 haa5 m4 tung4 ge3 fung1 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们到处去旅行，看看不同的风景。
examples.english_sentence: We travel everywhere to see different scenery.

english_meaning: quadrilateral, four-sided shape
explanation_mandarin: 具有四条边和四个角的几何图形。
explanation_english: A geometrical figure with four sides and four angles; a quadrilateral.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個窗係四角形嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 coeng1 hai6 sei3 gok3 jing4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个窗户是四边形的。
examples.english_sentence: That window is a quadrilateral.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畫咗一個四角形喺張紙上面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waak6 zo2 jat1 go3 sei3 gok3 jing4 hai2 zoeng1 zi2 soeng6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在纸上画了一个四边形。
examples.english_sentence: He drew a quadrilateral on the paper.

english_meaning: to arise on all sides; to break out everywhere; to happen everywhere
explanation_mandarin: 指在不同的地方同时或相继发生，多指不好的事情或现象。
explanation_english: Describes something occurring simultaneously or successively in different places, often referring to negative events or phenomena.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從經濟衰退之後，失業率就四起。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 ging1 zai3 seoi1 teoi3 zi1 hau6, sat1 jip6 leot2 zau6 sei3 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从经济衰退之后，失业率就到处发生。
examples.english_sentence: Since the economic recession, unemployment has been rampant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近好多地方都詐騙案四起，大家要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 hou2 do1 dei6 fong1 dou1 zaa3 pin3 on3 sei3 hei2, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近很多地方都诈骗案到处发生，大家要小心点。
examples.english_sentence: Recently, fraud cases have been occurring everywhere, so everyone needs to be more careful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 傳聞公司內部嘅人事鬥爭四起。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyun4 man4 gung1 si1 noi6 bou6 ge3 jan4 si6 dau3 zaang1 sei3 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 传闻公司内部的人事斗争到处发生。
examples.english_sentence: Rumor has it that internal power struggles within the company are breaking out everywhere.

english_meaning: Car, vehicle (literally: four wheels)
explanation_mandarin: 指有四个轮子的汽车。
explanation_english: Refers to a car, literally meaning 'four wheels'. It is a common and informal way to call a car in Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日揸四轆車你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 zaa1 sei3 luk1 ce1 lai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天开车接你。
examples.english_sentence: I'll pick you up in the car tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗部新嘅四轆，好靚㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 bou6 san1 ge3 sei3 luk1, hou2 leng3 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买了一辆新车，很漂亮！
examples.english_sentence: He bought a new car, it's very beautiful!

english_meaning: to extend in all directions; accessible from all sides; (of roads) leading everywhere
explanation_mandarin: 形容交通十分便利，道路向各方延伸。
explanation_english: Describes a place that is easily accessible and has roads extending in all directions; well-connected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅公共交通系統真係四通八達，去邊都好方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 gung1 gung1 gaau1 tung1 hai6 tung2 zan1 hai6 sei3 tung1 baat3 daat6, heoi3 bin1 dou1 hou2 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的公共交通系统真是四通八达，去哪里都很方便。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's public transportation system is really well-connected, it's very convenient to go anywhere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條新起嘅隧道令到呢個區嘅交通四通八達。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 san1 hei2 ge3 seoi6 dou6 ling6 dou3 ni1 go3 keoi1 ge3 gaau1 tung1 sei3 tung1 baat3 daat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条新建的隧道使得这个区的交通四通八达。
examples.english_sentence: This newly built tunnel has made the transportation in this area well-connected.

english_meaning: around; surrounding; all around
explanation_mandarin: 指周围的区域或范围。
explanation_english: Refers to the surrounding area or range.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋四週圍搵咗好耐，都搵唔到佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sei3 zau1 wai4 wan2 zo2 hou2 noi6, dou1 wan2 m4 dou2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们周围找了很久，都没找到他。
examples.english_sentence: We searched around for a long time, but we still couldn't find him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間屋四週圍都係樹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 uk1 sei3 zau1 wai4 dou1 hai6 syu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间房子周围都是树。
examples.english_sentence: This house is surrounded by trees.

english_meaning: all around; everywhere; on all sides
explanation_mandarin: 指四周的各个地方，各个方向。
explanation_english: Refers to all directions or places surrounding a certain point or area; everywhere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋四邊都係樹，好清靜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 sei3 bin1 dou1 hai6 syu6, hou2 cing1 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房子的四周都是树，很安静。
examples.english_sentence: The house is surrounded by trees, very quiet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我四邊搵都搵唔到佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sei3 bin1 wan2 dou1 wan2 m4 dou2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我到处找都找不到他。
examples.english_sentence: I looked everywhere but couldn't find him.

english_meaning: Convenient; to do something conveniently anywhere; haphazardly
explanation_mandarin: 形容某事或行为不拘小节，随意，方便。也指随地大小便（较为粗俗，需谨慎使用）。
explanation_english: Describes something done casually, conveniently, and without much regard for formality. Can also (more crudely) refer to relieving oneself anywhere (use with caution).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺街四邊四便呀，好唔衛生㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 gaai1 sei3 bin1 sei3 bin2 aa3, hou2 m4 wai6 sang1 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在街上随地大小便啊，很不卫生的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't relieve yourself anywhere in the street, it's very unhygienic!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢四邊四便，成日都甩甩漏漏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 sei3 bin1 sei3 bin2, seng4 jat6 dou1 lat1 lat1 lau6 lau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很随便，总是丢三落四的。
examples.english_sentence: He does things haphazardly, always leaving things unfinished or missing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔可以四邊四便咁處理啲文件㗎，要跟足程序。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 ho2 ji5 sei3 bin1 sei3 bin2 gam2 cyu2 lei5 di1 man4 gin2 gaa3, jiu3 gan1 zuk1 cing4 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不能随意地处理这些文件，要完全按照程序。
examples.english_sentence: You can't just handle these documents haphazardly; you need to follow the procedures.

english_meaning: quadrilateral
explanation_mandarin: 一个有四条边和四个角的几何图形。
explanation_english: A two-dimensional geometric shape that has four sides and four angles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個花園嘅形狀係一個四邊形。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 faa1 jyun4 ge3 ying4 zong6 hai6 jat1 go3 sei3 bin1 ying4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个花园的形状是一个四边形。
examples.english_sentence: The shape of this garden is a quadrilateral.

english_meaning: Sze Yup (the Four Counties)
explanation_mandarin: 指广东省台山、新会、开平、恩平四个县，是传统的华侨主要来源地。
explanation_english: Refers to the four counties in Guangdong Province: Taishan (Toishan), Xinhui (Sunwui), Kaiping (Hoiping), and Enping (Yanping). These areas have been historically a major source of overseas Chinese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啊爺係四邑人嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 je4 hai6 sei3 jap1 jan4 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我爷爷是四邑人。
examples.english_sentence: My grandfather is from Sze Yup.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多早期嘅移民都係嚟自四邑地區。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 zou2 kei4 ge3 ji4 man4 dou1 hai6 lai4 zi6 sei3 jap1 dei6 keoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多早期的移民都来自四邑地区。
examples.english_sentence: Many early immigrants came from the Sze Yup region.

english_meaning: quartet
explanation_mandarin: 指由四种乐器或声音组成的乐曲或组合。
explanation_english: A musical composition or group arrangement consisting of four instruments or voices.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋去睇四重奏表演。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 tai2 sei3 cung4 zau3 biu2 jin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们去看四重奏表演。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to see a quartet performance tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 四周; 周围; 四面八方
english_meaning: all around; everywhere; the whole area
explanation_mandarin: 指周围的整个区域或环境。
explanation_english: Refers to the surrounding area or environment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺四野放煙花，好靚呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 sei3 je5 fong3 jin1 faa1, hou2 leng3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在四周放烟花，很漂亮啊！
examples.english_sentence: They are setting off fireworks all around, it's so beautiful!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行到四野都冇人，我開始驚喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 dou3 sei3 je5 dou1 mou5 jan4, ngo5 hoi1 chi2 geng1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 走到周围都没人，我开始害怕了。
examples.english_sentence: I'm starting to get scared as there's nobody around.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 四野靜晒，得返啲蟬叫聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sei3 je5 zing6晒, dak1 faan1 di1 sim4 giu3 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 周围静悄悄的，只剩下蝉叫声。
examples.english_sentence: It's quiet all around, only the sound of cicadas remains.

english_meaning: something with four legs (often referring to furniture, or an animal, sometimes metaphorically for a precarious situation)
explanation_mandarin: 字面上指有四条腿的东西，通常指动物或者家具。也可用作比喻，指情况不稳固，摇摇欲坠。
explanation_english: Literally means "four legs." It typically refers to animals or furniture that have four legs. Metaphorically, it can describe a situation that is unstable or precarious, like something about to fall over.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張檯四隻腳唔穩陣，好似就嚟冧咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 toi2 sei3 zek3 goek3 m4 wan2 zan6, hou2 ci5 zau6 lai4 lam1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张桌子四条腿不稳，好像要倒了一样。
examples.english_sentence: The four legs of this table are not stable; it seems like it's about to collapse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司而家四隻腳都落地，你小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ji4 gaa1 sei3 zek3 goek3 dou1 lok6 dei2, nei5 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司现在情况很危急，你小心点。
examples.english_sentence: This company is in a precarious situation now; be careful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻狗仔四隻腳都好壯健。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 gau2 zai2 sei3 zek3 goek3 dou1 hou2 zong3 gin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这只小狗四条腿都很强壮。
examples.english_sentence: This puppy's four legs are very strong.

english_meaning: four sides; all sides; all directions; everywhere
explanation_mandarin: 指四个方向或各个方面。
explanation_english: Refers to the four directions or all aspects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢四面受敵，好難應付。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sei3 min6 sau6 dik6, hou2 naan4 ying3 fu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他四面受敌，很难应付。
examples.english_sentence: He's besieged on all sides; it's hard for him to cope.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋四面都係落地玻璃，風景一流。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 sei3 min6 dou1 hai6 lok6 dei6 bo1 lei1, fung1 ging2 yat1 lau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间屋子的四面都是落地玻璃，风景一流。
examples.english_sentence: This house has floor-to-ceiling windows on all four sides, the scenery is excellent.

english_meaning: Four-Faced Buddha (Erawan Shrine)
explanation_mandarin: 指位于泰国曼谷的爱侣湾神坛中的四面神。虽然被称为「佛」，实际上并非佛教神祇，而是印度教的创造神梵天。
explanation_english: Refers to the Four-Faced Buddha, specifically the Brahma statue located at the Erawan Shrine in Bangkok, Thailand. Despite being called "Buddha", it is not a Buddhist deity but rather the Hindu god Brahma, the god of creation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講去拜四面佛好靈㗎，好多人去求願。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 heoi3 baai3 sei3 min6 fat6 hou2 ling4 gaa3, hou2 do1 jan4 heoi3 kau4 jyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说拜四面佛很灵验，很多人去祈求愿望。
examples.english_sentence: I heard praying to the Four-Faced Buddha is very effective; many people go there to make wishes.

english_meaning: all directions; from all sides; all around
explanation_mandarin: 指各个方向、各个方面。
explanation_english: Refers to all directions, all aspects, or from everywhere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新聞一出，記者就四面八方湧過嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 man4 jat1 ceot1, gei3 ze2 zau6 sei3 min6 baat3 fong1 jung2 gwo3 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新闻一出，记者就从四面八方涌过来。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as the news came out, reporters rushed in from all directions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢收到好多四面八方嘅祝福。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sau1 dou2 hou2 do1 sei3 min6 baat3 fong1 ge3 zuk1 fuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他收到了很多来自四面八方的祝福。
examples.english_sentence: He received many blessings from all directions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新商場開幕，四面八方嘅人都嚟湊熱鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 soeng1 coeng4 hoi1 muk6, sei3 min6 baat3 fong1 ge3 jan4 dou1 lai4 cau3 jit6 naau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新商场开幕，四面八方的人都来凑热闹。
examples.english_sentence: When the new shopping mall opened, people came from all directions to join in the fun.

english_meaning: stage with audience on all four sides
explanation_mandarin: 指观众从舞台的四个方向都能看到的舞台。
explanation_english: A stage where the audience can see the performance from all four sides.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最鍾意睇四面台嘅演唱會，因為覺得同個歌手好近。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 tai2 sei3 min6 toi4 ge3 jin2 coeng3 wui2, jan1 wai6 gok3 dak1 tung4 go3 go1 sau2 hou2 gan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最喜欢看四面舞台的演唱会，因为觉得和歌手很近。
examples.english_sentence: I like watching concerts on a four-sided stage the most because I feel very close to the singer.

mandarin_meaning: 四面楚歌 (sì miàn chǔ gē)
english_meaning: surrounded by enemies on all sides; besieged (lit. Chu songs from all sides); in a desperate situation
explanation_mandarin: 比喻四面受敌，陷于孤立危急的困境。
explanation_english: An idiom referring to being surrounded by enemies on all sides, or being in a desperate and isolated situation. It originates from the story of Xiang Yu (項羽), the king of Chu, who was defeated by Liu Bang (劉邦) and trapped. Liu Bang's army sang Chu songs to demoralize Xiang Yu's troops, causing them to desert.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司而家四面楚歌，隨時都會執笠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ji4 gaa1 sei3 min6 co2 go1, ceoi4 si4 dou1 wui5 zaap1 laap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司现在四面楚歌，随时都会倒闭。
examples.english_sentence: This company is surrounded by enemies now and might close down anytime.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅政綱不得民心，搞到佢喺議會裏面四面楚歌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zing3 gong1 bat1 dak1 man4 sam1, gaau2 dou3 keoi5 hai2 ji5 wui2 leoi5 min6 sei3 min6 co2 go1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的政纲不得民心，导致他在议会里四面楚歌。
examples.english_sentence: His political platform is unpopular, which caused him to be surrounded by enemies in the parliament.

english_meaning: Four-wheel drive vehicle, 4WD car
explanation_mandarin: 一种四个轮子都有驱动力的汽车。
explanation_english: A vehicle in which all four wheels receive power from the engine simultaneously, providing increased traction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋部四驅車好勁，乜嘢爛路都去到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 bou6 sei3 keoi1 che1 hou2 ging6, mat1 je5 laan6 lou6 dou1 heoi3 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的四轮驱动车很厉害，什么样的烂路都能去。
examples.english_sentence: Their four-wheel drive is very capable, it can go on any kind of rough road.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港啲路咁窄，揸四驅車好似冇乜用咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 di1 lou6 gam3 zaak3, zaa1 sei3 keoi1 che1 hou2 ci5 mou5 mat1 jung6 gam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的路那么窄，开四轮驱动车好像没什么用。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong roads are so narrow, driving a four-wheel drive doesn't seem very useful.

english_meaning: son; child (often used affectionately)
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语中，囝指的是儿子或小孩，通常带有亲切的感情。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, 囝 refers to a son or child, often used with affection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個囝好乖㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 zai2 hou2 gwaai1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的儿子很乖的。
examples.english_sentence: My son is very well-behaved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好錫佢個囝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sek3 keoi5 go3 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很疼爱他的儿子。
examples.english_sentence: He loves his son very much.

english_meaning: son; little boy
explanation_mandarin: 指儿子，多用于称呼自己的儿子，带有亲昵的意味。
explanation_english: A term of endearment for one's son; little boy. Usually used to refer to one's own son.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 囝囝，你今日乖唔乖呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: zaai2 zaai2, nei5 gam1 jat6 gwaai1 m4 gwaai1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 儿子，你今天乖不乖呀？
examples.english_sentence: Son, have you been a good boy today?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個囝囝今年五歲喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 zaai2 zaai2 gam1 nin4 ng5 seoi3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的儿子今年五岁了。
examples.english_sentence: My son is five years old this year.

english_meaning: to return, to go back; to answer; to reply; measure word for times or occurrences
explanation_mandarin: 返回；答复；量词，表示次数。
explanation_english: To return, go back; to reply, answer; measure word for occurrences or times.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日會回香港。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 wui4 wui4 hoeng1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天会回香港。
examples.english_sentence: I will return to Hong Kong tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請你回覆我嘅電郵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 nei5 wui4 fuk1 ngo5 ge3 din6 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请你回复我的邮件。
examples.english_sentence: Please reply to my email.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我去咗三次回。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 heoi3 zo2 saam1 ci3 wui4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我去了三次。
examples.english_sentence: I went three times.

english_meaning: kickback, commission rebate, rebate
explanation_mandarin: 指卖方将一部分销售收入以佣金的形式返还给买方或中间人，通常是不公开或不正当的。
explanation_english: A portion of sales revenue that is returned as a commission or rebate to the buyer or intermediary, often secretly or improperly.
