examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司买了很多地皮，准备发展。
examples.english_sentence: Their company bought a lot of land, preparing for development.

english_meaning: Construction site; territory; sphere of influence
explanation_mandarin: 1. 指建筑工地。2. 比喻势力范围或管辖范围。
explanation_english: 1. Refers to a construction site. 2. Metaphor for territory, sphere of influence, or area of jurisdiction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺地盤做嘢，好辛苦㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 dei6 pun4 zou6 je5, hou2 san1 fu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在工地上工作，很辛苦的。
examples.english_sentence: He works at a construction site, it's very tough.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度係我哋嘅地盤，唔歡迎你哋嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 dei6 pun4, m4 wun1 jing4 nei5 dei6 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里是我们的地盘，不欢迎你们来。
examples.english_sentence: This is our territory, you are not welcome here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢響個地盤度揸住曬，冇人敢唔聽佢話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hoeng2 go3 dei6 pun4 dou6 zaa1 zyu6 saai3, mou5 jan4 gam2 m4 ting1 keoi5 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在那个地盘里说了算，没人敢不听他的话。
examples.english_sentence: He's in charge at that construction site, nobody dares to disobey him.

english_meaning: Construction worker
explanation_mandarin: 指在建筑工地工作的工人。通常指体力劳动者，有时带有一定的贬义或刻板印象。
explanation_english: Refers to construction workers, typically those who perform manual labor on a construction site. Sometimes carries a slightly derogatory connotation or stereotype, especially regarding their appearance or mannerisms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日着住件背心喺度行嚟行去，成個地盤佬咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zoek3 zyu6 gin6 bui3 sam1 hai2 dou6 haang4 lai4 haang4 heoi3, seng4 go3 dei6 pun4 lou2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天穿着背心走来走去，像个工地工人一样。
examples.english_sentence: He's always walking around in a vest, like a construction worker.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好睇少啲地盤佬，佢哋都好專業㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tai2 siu2 di1 dei6 pun4 lou2, keoi5 dei6 dou1 hou2 chuyên1 jip6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要小看那些工地工人，他们都很专业的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't look down on construction workers, they're all very professional.

english_meaning: geomagnetism; terrestrial magnetism
explanation_mandarin: 地球本身所具有的磁性，又称地球磁场。
explanation_english: The magnetism of the Earth itself; terrestrial magnetism; the Earth's magnetic field.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 指南針就係利用咗地磁嘅原理嚟運作嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi2 naam4 zam1 zau6 hai6 lei6 yung6 zo2 dei6 ci4 ge3 jyun5 lei5 lai4 wan6 zok3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 指南针就是利用了地磁的原理来运作的。
examples.english_sentence: A compass works based on the principle of geomagnetism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 地磁變化對導航系統會有影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dei6 ci4 bin3 faa3 deoi3 dou6 hong4 hai6 tung2 wui5 jau5 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 地磁变化会对导航系统有影响。
examples.english_sentence: Changes in geomagnetism can affect navigation systems.

english_meaning: floor tile
explanation_mandarin: 铺在地板上的砖块。
explanation_english: A tile used to cover a floor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間屋啲地磚好靚呀，咩質地嚟㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 uk1 di1 dei6 zyun1 hou2 leng3 aa3, me1 zat1 dei6 lai4 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间屋子的地砖很漂亮啊，是什么材质的？
examples.english_sentence: The floor tiles in this house are very beautiful. What material are they?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 裝修嘅時候，要揀啲防滑嘅地磚，費事跣親。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zong1 sau1 ge3 si4 hau6, jiu3 gaan2 di1 fong4 waat6 ge3 dei6 zyun1, fai3 si6 sin2 can1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 装修的时候，要选一些防滑的地砖，免得滑倒。
examples.english_sentence: When renovating, you should choose non-slip floor tiles to avoid slipping.

english_meaning: ground rent, land rent
explanation_mandarin: 土地的租金。
explanation_english: Rent paid for the use of land.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅地租好貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 dei6 zou1 hou2 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的地租很贵。
examples.english_sentence: The ground rent in Hong Kong is very expensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋間公司要交好多地租。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaan1 gung1 si1 jiu3 gaau1 hou2 do1 dei6 zou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的公司要交很多地租。
examples.english_sentence: Their company has to pay a lot of ground rent.

english_meaning: ground rent, land rent
explanation_mandarin: 指向土地所有者支付的租金，通常是定期支付的费用，用于在土地上建造或使用土地。
explanation_english: Rent paid for the right to occupy and use land. It is typically a recurring payment made to the landowner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間鋪頭嘅地稅好貴，搞到佢蝕本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 pou3 tau2 ge3 dei6 seoi3 hou2 gwai3, gaau2 dou3 keoi5 sit6 bun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店铺的地租很贵，搞得他亏本。
examples.english_sentence: The ground rent for this shop is very expensive, causing him to lose money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港啲地稅不斷升，好多小商戶都頂唔順。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 di1 dei6 seoi3 bat1 dyun6 sing1, hou2 do1 siu2 seong1 wu6 dou1 ding2 m4 seon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的地租不断上涨，很多小商户都承受不住。
examples.english_sentence: The ground rent in Hong Kong keeps rising, and many small businesses can't handle it.

english_meaning: Ground rent; Property tax (more broadly)
explanation_mandarin: 香港对土地或房产征收的税项，通常指地租或房产税。
explanation_english: A tax levied on land or property in Hong Kong, typically referring to ground rent or property tax.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅地稅貴咗好多喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ge3 dei6 seoi3 gwai3 zo2 hou2 do1 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的地租贵了很多啊。
examples.english_sentence: This year's ground rent is much more expensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要交地稅俾政府。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gaau1 dei6 seoi3 bei2 zing3 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要交地租给政府。
examples.english_sentence: We have to pay ground rent to the government.

english_meaning: property tax, rates
explanation_mandarin: 指地方政府征收的房产税，通常根据房屋的价值来计算。
explanation_english: Property tax levied by local governments, usually calculated based on the value of the property.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港啲地稅好貴㗎，好多人都供唔起。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 di1 dei6 seoi3 hou2 gwai3 gaa3, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 gung1 m4 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的房产税很贵，很多人都供不起。
examples.english_sentence: Property tax in Hong Kong is very expensive, many people can't afford it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今年交咗地稅未啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 nin4 gaau1 zo2 dei6 seoi3 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今年交房产税了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you paid your property tax this year?

english_meaning: plot ratio, floor area ratio (FAR)
explanation_mandarin: 建筑物的总建筑面积与建筑用地面积的比率。是衡量土地利用强度的一项指标。
explanation_english: The ratio of the total floor area of a building to the area of the land on which it is built. It is an indicator for measuring the intensity of land use.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個地盤嘅地積比係五。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dei6 pun4 ge3 dei6 zik1 bei2 hai6 ng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这块地的容积率是五。
examples.english_sentence: The plot ratio of this site is five.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 發展商想申請提高地積比，但係俾政府拒絕咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 zin2 soeng1 soeng2 san1 cing2 tai4 gou1 dei6 zik1 bei2, daan6 hai6 bei2 zing3 fu2 keoi5 zyut6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开发商想申请提高容积率，但是被政府拒绝了。
examples.english_sentence: The developer wanted to apply for a higher plot ratio, but it was rejected by the government.

english_meaning: plot ratio, floor area ratio (FAR)
explanation_mandarin: 指一个地块上总建筑面积与地块面积的比率。它反映了土地利用强度，是衡量土地开发强度的重要指标。
explanation_english: The ratio of the total floor area of buildings on a plot of land to the area of the plot itself. It reflects the intensity of land use and is an important indicator for measuring land development intensity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個地盤嘅地積比率係五，即係可以起嘅樓面面積係地盤面積嘅五倍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dei6 pun4 ge3 dei6 zik1 bei2 leut6 hai6 ng5, zik1 hai6 ho2 ji5 hei2 ge3 lau2 min6 zik1 hai6 dei6 pun4 min6 zik1 ge3 ng5 pui5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这块土地的容积率是五，也就是说可以建的楼面面积是土地面积的五倍。
examples.english_sentence: The plot ratio of this site is five, meaning the floor area that can be built is five times the area of the plot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府會根據唔同嘅地區調整地積比率，以控制人口密度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 wui5 gan1 geui3 m4 tung4 ge3 dei6 keoi1 tiu4 zing2 dei6 zik1 bei2 leut6, ji5 hung3 zai3 jan4 hau2 mat6 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府会根据不同的地区调整容积率，以控制人口密度。
examples.english_sentence: The government will adjust the plot ratio according to different areas to control population density.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 發展商都想爭取高地積比率嘅地，咁樣先可以起多啲樓嚟賣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 zin2 soeng1 dou1 soeng2 zaang1 ceoi2 gou1 dei6 zik1 bei2 leut6 ge3 dei6, gam2 joeng2 sin1 ho2 ji5 hei2 do1 di1 lau2 lai4 maai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开发商都想争取高容积率的土地，这样才可以建更多的楼来卖。
examples.english_sentence: Developers want to acquire land with a high plot ratio so they can build more apartments to sell.

english_meaning: cellar; underground storage room
explanation_mandarin: 通常建在地下的储藏室，用于储存食物、酒等物品。
explanation_english: An underground room or cellar, typically used for storing food, wine, or other items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋將啲紅酒擺晒入地窖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zoeng1 di1 hung4 zau2 baai2 saai3 jap6 dei6 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们把所有的红酒都放进地窖里了。
examples.english_sentence: They put all the red wine into the cellar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間屋以前有個地窖，但係而家已經封咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 uk1 ji5 cin4 jau5 go3 dei6 gaau3, daan6 hai6 ji4 gaa1 ji5 ging1 fung1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间屋子以前有个地窖，但是现在已经封住了。
examples.english_sentence: This house used to have a cellar, but it's been sealed off now.

english_meaning: Winning (in Mahjong) with the first draw of tiles, also known as "Earthly Hand"
explanation_mandarin: 麻将术语，指庄家摸完牌后，闲家在第一次摸牌后就胡牌。属于比较罕见且运气极佳的情况。
explanation_english: In Mahjong, it refers to a situation where a player (non-dealer) wins by completing their hand with the very first tile they draw. This is a rare and extremely lucky occurrence, also referred to as "Earthly Hand" or "Heavenly Hand" equivalent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱開始打就地糊，真係好彩！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaam1 ngaam1 hoi1 chi2 daa2 zau6 dei6 wu2, zan1 hai6 hou2 coi2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他刚开始打麻将就自摸了，真是幸运！
examples.english_sentence: He won with the Earthly Hand right at the beginning, so lucky!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我一定要摸到一次地糊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 ngo5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 mo2 dou2 jat1 chi3 dei6 wu2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我一定要摸到一次自摸！
examples.english_sentence: I must win with the Earthly Hand at least once tonight!

english_meaning: ground wire, earth wire
explanation_mandarin: 接地线，连接电器外壳与大地的电线，用于防止漏电触电。
explanation_english: A ground wire or earth wire; a wire connecting the chassis of an electrical appliance to the earth, used to prevent electric shock in case of electrical leakage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得幫部洗衣機駁埋地線呀，安全啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 bong1 bou6 sai2 ji1 gei1 bok3 maai4 dei6 sin3 aa3, on1 cyun4 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记得帮洗衣机接上地线啊，安全一点。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to connect the ground wire to the washing machine, it's safer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果地線鬆咗，好易會觸電㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 dei6 sin3 sung1 zo2, hou2 ji6 wui5 zuk1 din6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果地线松了，很容易触电的。
examples.english_sentence: If the ground wire is loose, it's easy to get an electric shock.

english_meaning: geopolitics
explanation_mandarin: 指地理因素对国家政治、经济、军事等方面的影响，以及由此产生的国际关系。
explanation_english: The study of the influence of geography (human and physical) on politics and international relations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近嘅國際新聞都離唔開地緣政治嘅影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 ge3 gwok3 zai3 san1 man4 dou1 lei4 m4 hoi1 dei6 jyun4 zing3 zi6 ge3 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近的国际新闻都离不开地缘政治的影响。
examples.english_sentence: Recent international news is inseparable from the influence of geopolitics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日討論地緣政治，但係我都唔係好明。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 jat6 to2 leon6 dei6 jyun4 zing3 zi6, daan6 hai6 ngo5 dou1 m4 hai6 hou2 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们经常讨论地缘政治，但是我不太明白。
examples.english_sentence: They often discuss geopolitics, but I don't really understand it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個地區嘅地緣政治局勢非常複雜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dei6 keoi1 ge3 dei6 jyun4 zing3 zi6 guk6 sai3 fei1 soeng4 fuk1 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个地区的地缘政治局势非常复杂。
examples.english_sentence: The geopolitical situation in this region is very complex.

english_meaning: until the end of time; forever; for eternity
explanation_mandarin: 形容时间非常久远，直到天地都荒芜衰老。比喻经历的时间极长，也指感情永恒不变。
explanation_english: Describes a very long time, until the earth and sky become barren and old.  It is used to describe something that lasts for a very long time, or unchanging, eternal love or commitment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅愛會地老天荒㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 oi3 wui5 dei6 lou5 tin1 fong1 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的爱会天长地久的！
examples.english_sentence: Our love will last forever!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋話佢哋嘅友情會地老天荒，永不改變。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 waa6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 jau5 ching4 wui5 dei6 lou5 tin1 fong1, wing5 bat1 goi2 bin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们说他们的友谊会天长地久，永不改变。
examples.english_sentence: They said their friendship would last forever, never changing.

english_meaning: local expert; someone who knows a particular area well; a local
explanation_mandarin: 指熟悉当地情况、对当地非常了解的人。常用于描述对某个地方的地理、风俗、习惯等非常熟悉的人。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who is very familiar with a local area, including its geography, customs, and habits. Often used to describe a local expert.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺呢度住咗幾十年，係正宗嘅地膽嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ni1 dou6 zyu6 zo2 gei2 sap6 nin4, hai6 zeng3 zung1 ge3 dei6 daam2 lai4 ga3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在这里住了几十年，是真正的本地人。
examples.english_sentence: He has lived here for decades, he's a real local expert.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你想搵好嘢食，問佢就啱喇，佢係呢區嘅地膽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 soeng2 wan2 hou2 je5 sik6, man6 keoi5 zau6 aam1 laa1, keoi5 hai6 ni1 ku1 ge3 dei6 daam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你想找好吃的，问他就对了，他是这区的地头蛇。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to find good food, ask him, he's the local expert in this area.

mandarin_meaning: 地基; 脚步; 基础
english_meaning: Foundation; footing; base; roots; (of a person) background; social standing
explanation_mandarin: 1. 建筑物的基础。2. 比喻事物的基础、根基。3. （口语）指人的出身、背景、社会地位。
explanation_english: 1. The foundation of a building. 2. Figuratively, the foundation or base of something. 3. (Colloquial) A person's origin, background, or social standing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢棟樓嘅地腳好穩固。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dung6 lau2 ge3 dei6 goek3 hou2 wan2 gu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这栋楼的地基很稳固。
examples.english_sentence: The foundation of this building is very solid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢地腳硬，唔好惹佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 goek3 ngaang6, m4 hou2 je5 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他背景很硬，不要招惹他。
examples.english_sentence: He has a strong background; don't mess with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做人要打好地腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jan4 jiu3 daa2 hou2 dei6 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做人要打好基础。
examples.english_sentence: You need to build a good foundation in life.

english_meaning: baseboard, skirting board
explanation_mandarin: 沿着墙壁底部安装的装饰性线条。
explanation_english: A decorative moulding covering the joint between the wall and the floor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋裝修嗰陣，記得要裝地腳線呀，咁樣會靚啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 zong1 sau1 go2 zan2, gei3 dak1 jiu3 zong1 dei6 goek3 sin3 aa3, gam2 joeng2 wui5 leng3 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 装修房子的时候，记得要安装踢脚线呀，这样会好看一些。
examples.english_sentence: When renovating the house, remember to install baseboards, it will look nicer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅地腳線用咗白色嘅油漆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 dei6 goek3 sin3 yung6 zo2 baak6 sik1 ge3 jau4 cat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的踢脚线用了白色的油漆。
examples.english_sentence: Their baseboards are painted with white paint.

mandarin_meaning: 地头蛇, 向导, 对当地情况很熟悉的人
english_meaning: Local expert, someone who knows a place very well, local guide
explanation_mandarin: 指对某个地方非常熟悉，像当地的蛇一样。比喻对该地方情况了如指掌，非常熟悉当地情况的人，通常可以作为向导。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who is very familiar with a certain place, like a snake in that territory. It's an analogy for someone who knows the ins and outs of a place very well and can usually act as a guide.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋第一次嚟香港，搵個地膽帶路好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 dai1 jat1 ci3 lai4 hoeng1 gong2, wan2 go3 dei6 daam2 daai3 lou6 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们第一次来香港，找个当地人带路比较好。
examples.english_sentence: It's our first time in Hong Kong, it's better to find a local expert to show us around.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺呢區住咗幾十年，係個真正嘅地膽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ni1 keoi1 zyu6 zo2 gei2 sap6 nin4, hai6 go3 zan1 zeng3 ge3 dei6 daam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在这区住了几十年，是个真正的当地人。
examples.english_sentence: He has lived in this district for decades, he's a true local expert.

english_meaning: platform; raised floor; dais
explanation_mandarin: 指房间或建筑物内稍微升高的平台或地板。
explanation_english: Refers to a slightly raised platform or floor within a room or building.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺屋企整咗個地臺，用嚟擺嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 uk1 kei2 zing2 zo2 go3 dei6 toi4, yung6 lai4 baai2 ye5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在家里做了一个地台，用来放东西。
examples.english_sentence: I built a platform in my house to store things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個舞台係一個大地臺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 mou5 toi4 hai6 jat1 go3 daai6 dei6 toi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个舞台是一个大地台。
examples.english_sentence: The stage is a large platform.

english_meaning: Ground floor shop, storefront
explanation_mandarin: 指位于建筑物底层，直接面向街道的商铺。
explanation_english: Refers to a shop located on the ground floor of a building that directly faces the street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想喺旺角租間地舖開間餐廳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 hai2 wong6 gok3 zu1 gaan1 dei6 pou3 hoi1 gaan1 caan1 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想在旺角租一间临街店铺开一家餐厅。
examples.english_sentence: I want to rent a ground floor shop in Mong Kok to open a restaurant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條街啲地舖租金好貴㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 gaai1 di1 dei6 pou3 zu1 gam1 hou2 gwai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条街的临街店铺租金很贵的。
examples.english_sentence: The rent for ground floor shops on this street is very expensive.

mandarin_meaning: 地主优势; 主场优势
english_meaning: home-court advantage; advantage of being the host
explanation_mandarin: 指在自己地盘上的优势，通常指主办方或所在地的人所享有的优势，例如熟悉环境、得到更多支持等。
explanation_english: Refers to the advantage of being on one's own territory, usually referring to the advantages enjoyed by the host or people in the locality, such as familiarity with the environment, more support, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次比賽香港有地莊，應該有優勢嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 bei2 coi3 hoeng1 gong2 jau5 dei6 zong1, jing1 goi1 jau5 jau1 seoi3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次比赛香港有主场优势，应该有优势的。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong has home-court advantage in this competition, so they should have an advantage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺呢間公司做咗咁耐，有晒地莊，邊個鬥得過佢呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zou6 zo2 gam3 noi6, jau5晒dei6 zong1, bin1 go3 dau3 dak1 gwo3 keoi5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在这家公司工作这么久了，完全占据了主场优势，谁能和他竞争呢？
examples.english_sentence: He's worked in this company for so long, he has complete home-court advantage, who can compete with him?

english_meaning: ground sheet, mat, floor mat
explanation_mandarin: 铺在地上的一种垫子，通常用于野餐或户外活动。
explanation_english: A type of mat spread on the ground, often used for picnics or outdoor activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去沙灘野餐，記得帶埋地蓆啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 saa1 taan1 je5 caan1, gei3 dak1 daai3 maai4 dei6 zik6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们去沙滩野餐，记得带上地席啊。
examples.english_sentence: We're going for a picnic on the beach, remember to bring the ground sheet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張地蓆好舒服，瞓喺上面好正。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 dei6 zik6 hou2 syu1 fuk6, fan3 hai2 soeng6 min6 hou2 zeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张地席很舒服，睡在上面很棒。
examples.english_sentence: This ground sheet is very comfortable, it's great to lie on.

english_meaning: Ksitigarbha (Bodhisattva)
explanation_mandarin: 佛教中的一位菩萨，以“地狱不空，誓不成佛”的宏愿而闻名。
explanation_english: Ksitigarbha is a bodhisattva primarily revered in East Asian Buddhism. He is known for his vow to take responsibility for the instruction of all beings in the six worlds between the death of Gautama Buddha and the rise of Maitreya, as well as his vow not to achieve Buddhahood until all hells are emptied.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆日日都喺屋企唸經，求地藏菩薩保佑一家人平安。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 jat6 jat6 dou1 hai2 uk1 kei2 nim6 ging1, kau4 dei6 zong6 pou4 saat3 bou2 jau6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 ping4 on1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶每天都在家里念经，求地藏菩萨保佑一家人平安。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma chants scriptures at home every day, praying to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva to protect the family's safety.

english_meaning: floor wax
explanation_mandarin: 用于地板上的一种蜡，可以保护地板并增加光泽。
explanation_english: A wax used on floors to protect them and give them a shine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽今日買咗樽新嘅地蠟返嚟，準備聽日打蠟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 gam1 jat6 maai5 zo2 zeon1 san1 ge3 dei6 laap6 faan1 lai4, zeon2 bei6 ting1 jat6 daa2 laap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈今天买了一瓶新的地板蜡回来，准备明天打蜡。
examples.english_sentence: Mom bought a new bottle of floor wax today, and she's preparing to wax the floor tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小心啲，地下打咗地蠟好滑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 sam1 di1, dei6 haa6 daa2 zo2 dei6 laap6 hou2 waat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心点，地上打了地板蜡很滑。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful, the floor has been waxed and it's very slippery.

english_meaning: The surface; used as a slang to mean the most or the best; ultimate
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是地球表面。在网络用语中，引申为“最”、“极致”、“最强”等意思，用于形容某事物达到顶峰。
explanation_english: Literally means the Earth's surface. In internet slang, it's extended to mean 'the most', 'ultimate', 'the best', used to describe something that has reached its peak.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係地表最強嘅男人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 dei6 biu2 zeoi3 koeng4 ge3 naam4 jan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是地表最强的男人。
examples.english_sentence: He is the ultimate strongest man.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅嘢食真係地表最好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 je5 sik6 zan1 hai6 dei6 biu2 zeoi3 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物真是地表最好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is truly the best in the world.

english_meaning: geology; geological features
explanation_mandarin: 地球的构造、组成、历史和变化的研究；某地区的地理和地质特征。
explanation_english: The study of the Earth's physical structure and substance, its history, and the processes that act on it. The geological features of an area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個地方嘅地質好特別，有好多奇形怪狀嘅石頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dei6 fong1 ge3 dei6 zat1 hou2 dak6 bit6, jau5 hou2 do1 kei4 ying4 gwaai3 zong6 ge3 sek6 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个地方的地质很特别，有很多奇形怪状的石头。
examples.english_sentence: The geology of this place is very special, with many strangely shaped rocks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺大學讀地質學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 daai6 hok6 duk6 dei6 zat1 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在大学读地质学。
examples.english_sentence: I'm studying geology at university.

english_meaning: squatting on the ground; low-class; unsophisticated
explanation_mandarin: 原指蹲在地上，引申为形容低级、不入流、简陋。也指出身低微。
explanation_english: Originally, it literally means squatting on the ground. Figuratively, it describes something as low-class, unsophisticated, or rudimentary. It can also refer to someone from a humble background.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日喺街邊地踎食嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 hai2 gaai1 bin1 dei6 mau1 sik6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们经常在路边蹲着吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: They often squat on the roadside to eat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳裝修好地踎，不過啲嘢都幾好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 zong1 sau1 hou2 dei6 mau1, bat1 gwo3 di1 je5 dou1 gei2 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅装修很简陋，但是东西挺好吃的。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant's decor is quite unsophisticated, but the food is pretty good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好睇佢地踎，佢其實好有錢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tai2 keoi5 dei6 mau1, keoi5 kei4 sat6 hou2 jau5 cin2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别看他出身低微，他其实很有钱的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't underestimate him just because of his humble origins, he's actually very rich.

english_meaning: Cheap and unpretentious restaurant; hole-in-the-wall eatery
explanation_mandarin: 形容环境简陋、价格低廉的餐馆。 通常指在街边或巷弄里的小餐馆，卫生条件和装修可能不太好，但食物价格实惠。
explanation_english: Describes a cheap and unpretentious restaurant, usually small eateries located on the street or in alleys. The sanitary conditions and decor may not be great, but the food is affordable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去食地踎館啦，平啲嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 sik6 dei6 mau1 gun2 laa1, peng4 di1 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们去吃便宜的餐馆吧，便宜点嘛。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to a cheap restaurant, it's cheaper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然係地踎館，但係佢嘅叉燒飯好好食㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: seui1 jin4 hai6 dei6 mau1 gun2, daan6 hai6 keoi5 ge3 caa1 siu1 faan6 hou2 hou2 sik6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然是家廉价餐馆，但是他的叉烧饭很好吃！
examples.english_sentence: Although it's a hole-in-the-wall eatery, their char siu rice is delicious!

english_meaning: feng shui of a place; geographical luck; geomantic fortune
explanation_mandarin: 指某个地方的风水气运，认为地理环境的好坏会影响到居住在那里的人们的命运和发展。
explanation_english: Refers to the feng shui or geomantic fortune of a place. It is believed that the quality of the geographical environment affects the fate and development of the people living there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講呢度地運好旺，所以好多人都搬嚟住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 ni1 dou6 dei6 wan6 hou2 wong6, so2 ji5 hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 bun1 lai4 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 据说这里地运很旺，所以很多人都搬来住。
examples.english_sentence: It is said that the feng shui of this place is very prosperous, so many people are moving here to live.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話呢個鋪頭嘅地運唔好，所以盤咗出去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 ni1 go3 pou3 tau2 ge3 dei6 wan6 m4 hou2, so2 ji5 pun4 zo2 ceot1 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说这个店铺的地运不好，所以转盘出去了。
examples.english_sentence: He said the feng shui of this shop was not good, so he sold the business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 風水師傅話香港嘅地運會越嚟越好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fung1 seoi2 si1 fu6 waa6 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 dei6 wan6 wui5 yut6 lai4 yut6 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 风水师傅说香港的地运会越来越好。
examples.english_sentence: The feng shui master said that the feng shui of Hong Kong will get better and better.

mandarin_meaning: 地道, 正宗, 道地
english_meaning: authentic, genuine, typical, pure, original
explanation_mandarin: 形容某事物纯正、地道的，符合当地的特点和风俗习惯。
explanation_english: Describes something that is authentic, genuine, typical, and in accordance with the local characteristics and customs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲點心好地道㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 dim2 sam1 hou2 dei6 dou6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的点心很正宗。
examples.english_sentence: The dim sum in this restaurant is very authentic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅廣東話好地道，聽唔出佢喺外國大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 gwong2 dung1 waa2 hou2 dei6 dou6, teng1 m4 ceot1 keoi5 hai2 ngoi6 gwok3 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的广东话很地道，听不出他在国外长大。
examples.english_sentence: His Cantonese is very authentic; you can't tell that he grew up abroad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想食啲地道嘅香港嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 sik6 di1 dei6 dou6 ge3 hoeng1 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想吃一些地道的香港东西。
examples.english_sentence: I want to eat some authentic Hong Kong food.

english_meaning: subway, metro, underground railway
explanation_mandarin: 一种城市轨道交通系统，通常在地下运行。
explanation_english: An urban rail transit system, usually running underground.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我日日都搭地鐵返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat6 jat6 dou1 daap3 dei6 tit3 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每天都坐地铁上班。
examples.english_sentence: I take the subway to work every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 地鐵站喺邊度呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: dei6 tit3 zaam6 hai2 bin1 dou6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 地铁站在哪里啊？
examples.english_sentence: Where is the subway station?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 繁忙時間搭地鐵好逼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faan4 gung1 si4 gaan3搭地鐵好逼。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 高峰时间坐地铁很挤。
examples.english_sentence: Taking the subway during rush hour is very crowded.

english_meaning: Property (usually residential or commercial) built directly above a subway station or on top of the subway infrastructure.
explanation_mandarin: 指建在地铁站上或地铁线路之上的房地产项目，通常是住宅或商业物业。
explanation_english: Refers to real estate developments (usually residential or commercial properties) built directly above a subway station or on top of the subway infrastructure. These properties are often highly desirable due to their convenient access to public transportation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 住地鐵上蓋真係好方便，落樓就搭到地鐵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zyu6 dei6 tit3 soeng6 goi3 zan1 hai6 hou2 fong1 bin6, lok6 lau2 zau6 daap3 dou3 dei6 tit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 住在地铁上盖真的很方便，下楼就能坐地铁。
examples.english_sentence: Living in a property above a subway station is really convenient; you can take the subway as soon as you go downstairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 地鐵上蓋嘅樓通常都比較貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dei6 tit3 soeng6 goi3 ge3 lau2 tung1 soeng4 dou1 bei2 gaau3 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 地铁上盖的楼通常都比较贵。
examples.english_sentence: Properties above subway stations are usually more expensive.

english_meaning: MTR station, subway station
explanation_mandarin: 香港的地铁车站。
explanation_english: A station on the Mass Transit Railway (MTR) system in Hong Kong; a subway station.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺地鐵站等你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 dei6 tit3 zaam6 dang2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在地铁站等你。
examples.english_sentence: I'll wait for you at the MTR station.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近嘅地鐵站喺邊度啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 ge3 dei6 tit3 zaam6 hai2 bin1 dou6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近的地铁站在哪里？
examples.english_sentence: Where is the nearest MTR station?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個地鐵站好迫呀，好多人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 dei6 tit3 zaam6 hou2 bik1 aa3, hou2 do1 yan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个地铁站很挤，很多人。
examples.english_sentence: This MTR station is very crowded, there are so many people.

english_meaning: to sweep the floor, to clean the floor
explanation_mandarin: 用扫帚等工具清理地面上的垃圾或灰尘。
explanation_english: To clean the floor by sweeping or other methods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你地除咗地未啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 ceoi4 zo2 dei6 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你扫地了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you swept the floor yet?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿妈叫我地除干净啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 giu3 ngo5 dei6 ceoi4 gon1 zing6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈叫我把地扫干净点。
examples.english_sentence: Mom told me to sweep the floor cleaner.

english_meaning: Landmine; Trigger point; Thing to avoid
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是埋在地下的爆炸装置。在粤语中，引申为需要避免的话题，潜在的麻烦或陷阱。指某事/某人很容易引发冲突或负面情绪，类似于“引爆点”。
explanation_english: Literally means a landmine, an explosive device buried in the ground. In Cantonese, it metaphorically refers to a topic to avoid, potential trouble, or a pitfall. It indicates something/someone that easily triggers conflict or negative emotions, similar to a 'trigger point'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺阿媽面前講佢減肥嘅事，呢個係地雷嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 aa3 maa1 min6 cin4 gong2 keoi5 gaam2 fei4 ge3 si6, ni1 go3 hai6 dei6 leoi4 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别在你妈面前说她减肥的事，这是个地雷。
examples.english_sentence: Don't mention her dieting in front of Mom; that's a landmine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政治話題喺家庭聚會度係一個大地雷，好容易就會鬧交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 zi6 waa6 tai4 hai2 gaa1 ting4 zeoi6 wui2 dou6 hai6 jat1 go3 daai6 dei6 leoi4, hou2 jung4 ji6 zau6 wui5 naau6 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政治话题在家庭聚会上是个大地雷，很容易就会吵架。
examples.english_sentence: Political topics are a major landmine at family gatherings; it's easy to start a fight.

synonyms: 敏感話題 (man5 gam2 waa6 tai4)

english_meaning: earthquake
explanation_mandarin: 地球内部发生的剧烈震动，导致地壳快速释放能量，产生地震波，引起地面震动。
explanation_english: A sudden and violent shaking of the ground, typically caused by movements within the earth's crust or volcanic action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋日香港冇地震喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 jat6 hoeng1 gong2 mou5 dei6 zan3 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天香港没有地震啊。
examples.english_sentence: There wasn't an earthquake in Hong Kong yesterday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 日本成日地震，好危險㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat6 bun2 sing4 jat6 dei6 zan3, hou2 ngai4 him2 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 日本经常地震，很危险的！
examples.english_sentence: Japan has earthquakes all the time, it's very dangerous!

english_meaning: A place produces outstanding people because of its auspicious land.
explanation_mandarin: 形容某个地方山川秀丽，因而产生许多杰出的人物。
explanation_english: Describes a place with beautiful scenery that produces many outstanding people. It emphasizes the connection between the environment and the quality of its inhabitants.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度真係地靈人傑，出咗好多叻人㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 zan1 hai6 dei6 ling4 jan4 git6, ceot1 zo2 hou2 do1 lek1 jan4 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里真是人杰地灵，出了很多能人啊！
examples.english_sentence: This place is truly auspicious, producing many talented people!

english_meaning: ground; floor; territory; sphere of influence
explanation_mandarin: 指地球的表面，地板，或势力范围。
explanation_english: Refers to the surface of the earth, floor, or sphere of influence/territory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 地下濕濕地，地面都係水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dei6 haa6 sap1 sap1 dei2, dei6 min6-2 dou1 hai6 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 地下湿湿的，地面都是水。
examples.english_sentence: The ground is wet, and the floor is all water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺呢行好有地面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ni1 hang4 hou2 jau5 dei6 min6-2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在这一行很有势力。
examples.english_sentence: He has a lot of influence in this industry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 執拾下地面啦，好污糟呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zaap1 sap1 haa5 dei6 min6-2 laa1, hou2 wu1 zou1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 收拾一下地面啦，好脏啊！
examples.english_sentence: Clean up the floor, it's very dirty!

english_meaning: territory; turf; local area; home ground
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人或一个团体所占据或管辖的区域；也可指熟悉的地点。
explanation_english: Refers to a territory or area occupied or governed by a person or group; can also refer to a familiar place or home ground.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度係我嘅地頭，有咩事我罩住你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 hai6 ngo5 ge3 dei6 tau4, jau5 me1 si6 ngo5 zaau3 zyu6 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里是我的地盘，有什么事我罩着你。
examples.english_sentence: This is my territory, I'll protect you if anything happens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺呢個地頭好熟路，問佢就啱晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ni1 go3 dei6 tau4 hou2 suk6 lou6, man6 keoi5 zau6 ngaam1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对这个地方很熟悉，问他就对了。
examples.english_sentence: He is very familiar with this area, asking him is the right thing to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺人哋地頭搞事，費事惹麻煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 jan4 dei6 dei6 tau4 gaau2 si6, fai3 si6 ze2 maa4 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在别人的地盘闹事，免得惹麻烦。
examples.english_sentence: Don't cause trouble in someone else's territory, in order to avoid trouble.

english_meaning: local bully; local tyrant; king of the hill; local strongman; a person with power and influence in their locality
explanation_mandarin: 指在当地有势力、横行霸道的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person with power and influence in a particular locality, often behaving like a bully or tyrant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺呢度係地頭蛇，咩都佢話事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ni1 dou6 hai6 dei6 tau4 se4, me1 dou1 keoi5 waa6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在这里是地头蛇，什么都他说了算。
examples.english_sentence: He's the local strongman here, he calls all the shots.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你最好唔好得罪佢，佢係呢區嘅地頭蛇嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zeoi3 hou2 m4 hou2 dak1 zeoi6 keoi5, keoi5 hai6 ni1 khu1 ge3 dei6 tau4 se4 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好不要得罪他，他是这个区的地头蛇。
examples.english_sentence: You'd better not offend him, he's the local king of the hill in this area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲地頭蛇最鍾意蝦啲外來人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 dei6 tau4 se4 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 haa1 di1 ngoi6 loi4 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些地头蛇最喜欢欺负外地人。
examples.english_sentence: These local bullies love to prey on outsiders.

english_meaning: Local tyrant; someone who dominates a particular area; a local bully; a big fish in a small pond
explanation_mandarin: 指在某个地方势力很大，很霸道的人，类似“地头蛇”。通常指在某个地方长时间居住或工作，熟悉当地情况，并以此为资本，排斥外来者或欺压他人的人。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who has a lot of power in a certain place and is very domineering, similar to "local snake." It usually refers to someone who has lived or worked in a certain place for a long time, is familiar with the local situation, and uses this as capital to exclude outsiders or oppress others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺呢度做咗咁耐，都變咗地頭蟲喇，冇人敢得罪佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ni1 dou6 zou6 zo2 gam3 noi6, dou1 bin3 zo2 dei6 tau4 cung4 laa3, mou5 jan4 gam2 dak1 zeoi6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在这里做了这么久，都变成地头蛇了，没人敢得罪他。
examples.english_sentence: He has been working here for so long that he has become a local tyrant. No one dares to offend him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 想喺呢條街做生意，最好搞好同個地頭蟲嘅關係。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng2 hai2 ni1 tiu4 gaai1 zou6 saang1 ji3, zeoi3 hou2 gaau2 hou2 tung4 go3 dei6 tau4 cung4 ge3 gwaan1 hai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 想在这条街做生意，最好搞好和当地恶霸的关系。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to do business on this street, it's best to get on good terms with the local tyrant.

english_meaning: Local tyrant; big fish in a small pond; local strongman
explanation_mandarin: 指在当地势力很大，有权有势的人，有时带有贬义。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who holds significant power and influence in a particular local area, often with negative connotations, suggesting they may be abusing their power.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺呢頭係地頭龍，乜嘢都要問過佢先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ni1 tau4 hai6 dei6 tau4 lung4, mat1 je5 dou1 jiu3 man6 gwo3 keoi5 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是这一带的地头蛇，什么事都要先问过他才行。
examples.english_sentence: He's the local strongman in this area, everything needs to be consulted with him first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你初嚟乍到，最好唔好得罪啲地頭龍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 co1 lai4 zaa3 dou3, zeoi3 hou2 m4 hou2 dak1 zeoi2 di1 dei6 tau4 lung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你刚来乍到，最好不要得罪当地的势力。
examples.english_sentence: You're new here, it's best not to offend the local power holders.

english_meaning: outdated, unfashionable, old-fashioned, uncool
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物或人过时，不流行，缺乏时尚感。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone that is outdated, unfashionable, or lacks a sense of trendiness. Often used to describe things that are behind the times or uncool.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你仲著緊呢啲衫？好地黃喎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung6 zoek3 gan2 ni1 di1 saam1? hou2 dei6 wong4 wo3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你还在穿这些衣服？很老土啊！
examples.english_sentence: You're still wearing these clothes? They're so outdated!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好搞啲咁地黃嘅髮型啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gaau2 di1 gam3 dei6 wong4 ge3 faat3 ying4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要弄那么老土的发型了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't get such an old-fashioned hairstyle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅品味有啲地黃，唔係好識得襯衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ban2 mei6 jau5 di1 dei6 wong4, m4 hai6 hou2 sik1 dak1 can3 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的品味有点老土，不太懂得搭配衣服。
examples.english_sentence: His taste is a bit old-fashioned, he doesn't really know how to coordinate clothes.

english_meaning: location; place; site
explanation_mandarin: 处所，位置。
explanation_english: A particular place or position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要揀返個好啲嘅地點搞活動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gaan2 faan1 go3 hou2 di1 ge3 dei6 dim2 gaau2 wut6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要选一个更好的地点搞活动。
examples.english_sentence: We need to choose a better location for the event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個地點好方便，近地鐵站。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dei6 dim2 hou2 fong1 bin6, gan6 dei6 tit3 zaam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个地点很方便，靠近地铁站。
examples.english_sentence: This location is very convenient, close to the subway station.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔知確實嘅地點喺邊度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zi1 kok3 sat6 ge3 dei6 dim2 hai2 bin1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不知道确切的地点在哪里。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know the exact location.

english_meaning: earthworm
explanation_mandarin: 指蚯蚓。
explanation_english: Refers to an earthworm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落完雨之後，地下好多地龍爬出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 jyun4 jyu5 zi1 hau6, dei6 haa2 hou2 do1 dei6 lung4 paa4 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下完雨之后，地上很多蚯蚓爬出来。
examples.english_sentence: After the rain, many earthworms crawled out onto the ground.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用嚟釣魚嘅餌係地龍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 lai4 diu3 yu2 ge3 er6 hai6 dei6 lung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用来钓鱼的饵是蚯蚓。
examples.english_sentence: The bait he uses for fishing is earthworms.

english_meaning: irrigation ditch; channel; furrow
explanation_mandarin: 指用于灌溉农田的引水沟渠。
explanation_english: Refers to a ditch or channel used for irrigation of farmland.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋起咗條圳嚟灌溉啲田。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hei2 zo2 tiu4 zeon3 lai4 gun3 gaai3 di1 tin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们修了一条水渠来灌溉田地。
examples.english_sentence: They built an irrigation ditch to irrigate the fields.

mandarin_meaning: 场地; 量词 (用于文艺演出、体育比赛等); 次
english_meaning: field; place; ground; a measure word (for theatrical performances, sports events, etc.); a session
explanation_mandarin: 指一块空地，或者可以进行活动的地方；也用作量词，表示文艺演出、体育比赛等活动的次数。
explanation_english: Refers to an open space or a place where activities can be carried out; also used as a measure word to indicate the number of times of cultural performances, sports competitions, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 个足球场好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 zuk1 kau4 coeng4 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个足球场很大。
examples.english_sentence: This football field is very big.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚有场戏睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 jau5 coeng4 hei3 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚有一场戏看。
examples.english_sentence: There is a play to watch tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 琴日去咗睇场波。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kam4 jat6 heoi3 zo2 tai2 coeng4 bo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天去看了一场球赛。
examples.english_sentence: Yesterday, I went to watch a ball game.

english_meaning: rubbish; garbage; trash
explanation_mandarin: 指废弃物、无用的东西。
explanation_english: Refers to waste material or useless items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂咁掉垃圾啦，唔環保㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 diu6 laap6 sap1 laa1, m4 waan4 bou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱扔垃圾，不环保。
examples.english_sentence: Don't litter, it's not environmentally friendly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度啲垃圾好臭呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 di1 laap6 sap1 hou2 cau3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的垃圾很臭啊！
examples.english_sentence: The rubbish here is so smelly!

english_meaning: address, location, site
explanation_mandarin: 地点，地方，场所。多用于指地址或场所。
explanation_english: A location, place, or site. Often refers to an address or a location.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以畀個地址我呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bei2 go3 dei6 zi2 ngo5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以把地址给我吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can you give me the address?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個係新廠址。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 san1 cong2 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这是新的厂址。
examples.english_sentence: This is the new factory site.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔記得咗公司嘅地址。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 gei3 dak1 zo2 gung1 si1 ge3 dei6 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我忘记了公司的地址。
examples.english_sentence: I forgot the company address.

english_meaning: slope; incline; hillside
explanation_mandarin: 指倾斜的地面，山坡。
explanation_english: Refers to a sloping ground, hillside.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行上條坂好攰㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 soeng5 tiu4 baan2 hou2 gui6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 走上这个斜坡很累的。
examples.english_sentence: It's tiring walking up this slope.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺山坂上面踩單車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 saan1 baan2 soeng6 min6 caai2 daan1 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在山坡上骑自行车。
examples.english_sentence: He's riding a bicycle on the hillside.

english_meaning: even; equal; all; uniformly; average
explanation_mandarin: 表示平均，一致，全部的意思。
explanation_english: Indicates evenness, uniformity, or all inclusiveness; refers to things being equal or equally distributed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 將啲餅乾均分畀大家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 di1 beng2 gon1 kwan1 fan1 bei2 daai6 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把饼干平均分给大家。
examples.english_sentence: Divide the cookies evenly among everyone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅能力均等。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 nang4 lik6 kwan1 dang2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的能力均等。
examples.english_sentence: Their abilities are equal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日天氣均陰天。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 tin1 hei3 kwan1 yam1 tin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天天气都是阴天。
examples.english_sentence: The weather today is all cloudy.

english_meaning: uniform; even; consistent; same
explanation_mandarin: 表示分布或性质一样，没有差别。
explanation_english: Describes something that is distributed or has properties that are the same throughout; without variation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舖啲嘢全部均一價，十蚊一件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 di1 je5 cyun4 bou6 gwan1 jat1 gaa3, sap6 man1 jat1 gin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店的东西全部统一价格，十块钱一件。
examples.english_sentence: Everything in this shop is the same price, ten dollars each.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個蛋糕嘅厚度要均一啲先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 daan6 gou1 ge3 hau5 dou6 jiu3 gwan1 jat1 di1 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个蛋糕的厚度要均匀一点才行。
examples.english_sentence: The thickness of this cake needs to be more even.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要確保所有學生嘅學習機會係均一嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 kok3 bou2 so2 jau5 hok6 sang1 ge3 hok6 zaap6 gei1 wui2 hai6 gwan1 jat1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要确保所有学生的学习机会是均等的。
examples.english_sentence: We need to ensure that learning opportunities are equal for all students.

english_meaning: to divide equally; to distribute evenly; to share equally
explanation_mandarin: 指将某物平均地分配给多个对象。
explanation_english: To divide something equally among several recipients.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋將啲糖均分畀小朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zoeng1 di1 tong2 gwan1 fan1 bei2 siu2 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们把糖平均分给小朋友。
examples.english_sentence: We'll divide the candies equally among the children.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲錢要均分畀你哋三個人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 cin2 jiu3 gwan1 fan1 bei2 nei5 dei6 saam1 go3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些钱要平均分给你们三个人。
examples.english_sentence: This money needs to be divided equally among the three of you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果冇特別講明，股東嘅利潤通常都係均分嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 mou5 dak6 bit3 gong2 ming4, gu2 dung1 ge3 lei6 jeun6 tung1 soeng4 dou1 hai6 gwan1 fan1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果没有特别说明，股东的利润通常都是平均分配的。
examples.english_sentence: Unless otherwise specified, the shareholders' profits are usually divided equally.

english_meaning: balance of power; equilibrium
explanation_mandarin: 指双方或多方在力量或影响力上达到相对平衡的状态。
explanation_english: A state of equilibrium or balance of power between two or more parties, where no single party has a decisive advantage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家兩隊波打到均勢，睇嚟要踢加時先分到勝負。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 loeng5 deui2 bo1 daa2 dou3 gwan1 sai3, tai2 lai4 jiu3 tek3 gaa1 si4 sin1 fan1 dou3 sing3 fu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在两队球队打成了均势，看来要踢加时赛才能分出胜负。
examples.english_sentence: The two teams are playing to a stalemate, it looks like they'll need extra time to decide the winner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個政策嘅目的係要維持各國之間嘅均勢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zing3 caak3 ge3 muk6 dik1 hai6 jiu3 wai4 ci4 gok3 gwok3 zi1 gaan1 ge3 gwan1 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个政策的目的是要维持各国之间的均势。
examples.english_sentence: The purpose of this policy is to maintain the balance of power between countries.

english_meaning: even; well-distributed; uniform; homogeneous
explanation_mandarin: 指分布或分配得没有轻重或多少之分。
explanation_english: Describes something that is distributed or allocated without significant variations or differences in amount or intensity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搽防曬嘅時候，要搽得均勻啲，唔係好容易曬傷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caa4 fong4 saai3 ge3 si4 hau6, jiu3 caa4 dak1 gwan1 wan4 di1, m4 hai6 hou2 jung4 ji6 saai3 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 涂防晒霜的时候，要涂得均匀一些，不然很容易晒伤。
examples.english_sentence: When applying sunscreen, you need to apply it evenly, otherwise you'll get sunburned easily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲粉底液搽上面好均勻，唔會浮粉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 fan2 dai2 jik6 caa4 soeng5 min6 hou2 gwan1 wan4, m4 wui5 fau4 fan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这款粉底液涂在脸上很均匀，不会浮粉。
examples.english_sentence: This foundation spreads evenly on the face and doesn't cake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 運動完之後，呼吸要均勻啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wan6 dung6 jyun4 zi1 hau6, fu1 kap1 jiu3 gwan1 wan4 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 运动完之后，呼吸要均匀一些。
examples.english_sentence: After exercising, your breathing should be more even.

english_meaning: even, uniform, well-distributed
explanation_mandarin: 分布或分配没有轻重、厚薄之分。
explanation_english: Evenly distributed, uniform, without variation in thickness or density.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你搽防曬要搽均匀啲，如果唔係好容易曬到一撻撻㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 caa4 fong4 saai3 jiu3 caa4 wan4 gwan1 di1, jyu4 gwo2 m4 hai6 hou2 jung4 yi6 saai3 dou3 jat1 taat3 taat3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你涂防晒要涂均匀一点，不然很容易晒成一块一块的。
examples.english_sentence: You need to apply sunscreen more evenly, otherwise you'll easily get uneven patches of sunburn.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個蛋糕要切得均匀啲，每個人先分到一樣咁多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 daan6 gou1 jiu3 cit3 dak1 wan4 gwan1 di1, mui5 go3 jan4 sin1 fan1 dou3 jat1 joeng6 gam3 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个蛋糕要切得均匀一点，每个人才能分到一样多。
examples.english_sentence: The cake needs to be cut more evenly so that everyone gets the same amount.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將啲顏料均匀咁舖喺幅畫上面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 di1 ngaan4 liu2 wan4 gwan1 gam2 pou3 hai2 fuk1 waa2 soeng6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把颜料均匀地铺在画上。
examples.english_sentence: He spread the paint evenly on the painting.

english_meaning: very real; genuine; authentic
explanation_mandarin: 表示非常真实，没有虚假成分。
explanation_english: Describes something that is very real and authentic, without any falsity or pretense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個古董真係均眞，唔係假嘢嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gu2 dung2 zan1 hai6 gwan1 zan1, m4 hai6 gaa2 je5 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个古董是真的，不是假的。
examples.english_sentence: This antique is genuine, it's not a fake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對你嘅感情係均眞嘅，你唔好懷疑佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 nei5 ge3 gam2 cing4 hai6 gwan1 zan1 ge3, nei5 m4 hou2 waai4 ji4 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对你的感情是真的，你不要怀疑他了。
examples.english_sentence: His feelings for you are genuine, don't doubt him.

english_meaning: genuine, honest, truthful, real
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或事物真实可靠，没有虚假成分。
explanation_english: Describes a person or thing that is genuine, honest, and reliable, without any falsehood or insincerity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舖頭賣嘅嘢都幾均真㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau2 maai6 ge3 je5 dou1 gei2 kwan1 zan1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店卖的东西还挺实在的。
examples.english_sentence: The things sold in this shop are quite genuine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好均真，唔會呃人嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 kwan1 zan1, m4 wui5 aak1 jan4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很诚实，不会骗人的。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very honest person, he wouldn't deceive anyone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要搵啲均真嘅材料嚟做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 wan2 di1 kwan1 zan1 ge3 coi4 liu2 lai4 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要找一些真实的材料来做事。
examples.english_sentence: We need to find some genuine materials to work with.

english_meaning: equal, even, equitable
explanation_mandarin: 表示数量、价值或机会相同或接近。
explanation_english: Describes the state of being equal in quantity, value, or opportunity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要確保每個人都有均等嘅機會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 kok3 bou2 mui5 go3 jan4 dou1 jau5 gwan1 dang2 ge3 gei1 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要确保每个人都有均等的机会。
examples.english_sentence: We need to ensure that everyone has equal opportunities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個比賽嘅獎金分配得好均等。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 bei2 coi3 ge3 zoeng2 gam1 fan1 pui3 dak1 hou2 gwan1 dang2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个比赛的奖金分配得很均等。
examples.english_sentence: The prize money in this competition is distributed very equally.

english_meaning: balanced, proportionate, even
explanation_mandarin: 指各方面的数量、比例或力量分布适当、协调。
explanation_english: Refers to the state where different aspects, quantities, proportions, or forces are appropriately distributed and coordinated to achieve equilibrium or stability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飲食要均衡，唔好偏食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jam2 sik6 jiu3 gwan1 hang4, m4 hou2 pin1 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 饮食要均衡，不要偏食。
examples.english_sentence: Your diet needs to be balanced; don't be a picky eater.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一份均衡嘅工作同生活，對個人發展好重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 fan6 gwan1 hang4 ge3 gung1 zok3 tung4 sang1 wut6, deoi3 go3 jan4 faat3 zin2 hou2 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一份均衡的工作和生活，对个人发展很重要。
examples.english_sentence: A balanced work and life is very important for personal development.

english_meaning: average speed; constant speed
explanation_mandarin: 指物体在某段时间内运动的平均速度，或指以恒定速度运动。
explanation_english: Refers to the average speed of an object moving over a period of time, or movement at a constant speed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一路都用緊均速行車，所以好慳油。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 lou6 dou1 jung6 gan2 gwan1 suk1 haang4 ce1, so2 ji5 hou2 haan1 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一直都在用平均速度开车，所以很省油。
examples.english_sentence: He's been driving at a constant speed all the way, so he's saving a lot of fuel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部火車要保持均速先可以準時到達目的地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 fo2 ce1 jiu3 bou2 ci4 gwan1 suk1 sin1 ho2 ji5 zeon2 si4 dou3 daat6 muk6 dik1 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这列火车要保持平均速度才能准时到达目的地。
examples.english_sentence: The train needs to maintain an average speed to arrive at the destination on time.

mandarin_meaning: 地方, 里弄, 牌坊
english_meaning: neighbourhood, ward, lane, archway (as in memorial archway)
explanation_mandarin: 指街道或里弄，也指牌坊。
explanation_english: Refers to a neighbourhood, ward, or lane. Can also refer to a memorial archway.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢住喺邊條坊啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyu6 hai2 bin1 tiu4 fong1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他住在哪个里弄啊？
examples.english_sentence: Which neighbourhood does he live in?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條坊好多老字號嘅鋪頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 fong1 hou2 do1 lou5 zi3 hou6 ge3 pou3 tau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条街有很多老字号的店铺。
examples.english_sentence: There are many old established shops on this street.

english_meaning: local residents; neighborhood people
explanation_mandarin: 指居住在同一社区的居民，街坊邻里，一般用于比较正式的场合。
explanation_english: Refers to the residents living in the same community or neighborhood, often used in more formal settings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋社區中心舉辦咗個活動，好多坊眾都嚟參加。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 se5 keoi1 zung1 sam1 geui2 baan6 zo2 go3 wut6 dung6, hou2 do1 fong1 zung3 dou1 lai4 caam1 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的社区中心举办了一个活动，很多街坊都来参加了。
examples.english_sentence: Our community center held an event, and many local residents came to participate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 區議員成日落區探訪坊眾，了解佢哋嘅需要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi1 wui5 jyun4 seng4 jat6 lok6 keoi1 taam3 fong2 fong1 zung3, liu2 gaai2 keoi5 dei6 ge3 seoi1 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 区议员经常下区探访街坊，了解他们的需要。
examples.english_sentence: The district councilor often visits the neighborhood to understand the needs of the local residents.

english_meaning: unofficial; among the public; in society; popular
explanation_mandarin: 指社会上、民间流传的，非官方的说法或事物。
explanation_english: Refers to information, opinions, or things that are circulating in society or among the public, but are not official or authoritative.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 坊間有好多關於佢嘅傳聞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong1 gaan1 jau5 hou2 do1 gwaan1 jyu1 keoi5 ge3 cyun4 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 社会上有很多关于他的传闻。
examples.english_sentence: There are many rumors about him circulating among the public.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 坊間一直都有呢隻藥可以醫好呢個病嘅講法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong1 gaan1 jat1 zik6 dou1 jau5 ni1 zek3 joek6 ho2 ji5 ji1 hou2 ni1 go3 beng6 ge3 gong2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 社会上一直有这种药可以治好这个病的说法。
examples.english_sentence: There has always been a popular belief that this medicine can cure this disease.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好輕易相信坊間嘅偏方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hing1 ji6 soeng1 seon3 fong1 gaan1 ge3 pin1 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要轻易相信民间的偏方。
examples.english_sentence: Don't easily believe unofficial remedies circulating among the public.

english_meaning: pit; bump; obstacle; hurdle; setback
explanation_mandarin: 指地面的坑洼不平之处，也比喻人生道路上的障碍或挫折。
explanation_english: Refers to a pit or uneven surface on the ground, also used metaphorically to describe obstacles or setbacks in life's journey.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條路好多坎，行路要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 lou6 hou2 do1 ham2, haang4 lou6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条路有很多坑洼，走路要小心一些。
examples.english_sentence: There are many pits on this road, walk carefully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人生總有高低坎坷，唔好咁灰心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 sang1 zung2 jau5 gou1 dai1 ham2 ko2, m4 hou2 gam3 fui1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人生总有高低起伏，不要这么灰心。
examples.english_sentence: Life always has ups and downs, don't be so discouraged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過咁多坎坷，佢終於成功咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 gam3 do1 ham2 ko2, keoi5 zung1 jyu1 sing4 gung1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过这么多坎坷，他终于成功了。
examples.english_sentence: After so many setbacks, he finally succeeded.

english_meaning: Just enough; barely make it; scrape by
explanation_mandarin: 形容数量、程度等刚刚达到标准，非常勉强。也指在困难的情况下勉强维持。
explanation_english: Describes something that barely meets the standard, just enough, or is very close to failing. It can also refer to barely managing to maintain something in a difficult situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試坎坎糊合格，下次要努力啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ham3 ham3 wu2 hap6 gaak3, haa6 ci3 jiu3 nu5 lik6 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试刚刚及格，下次要努力一些了。
examples.english_sentence: I barely passed the exam this time; I need to work harder next time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋坎坎糊趕得切班飛機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ham3 ham3 wu2 gaam2 dak1 cit3 baan1 fei1 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们勉强赶上了那班飞机。
examples.english_sentence: We just barely made it to catch that flight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間公司坎坎糊維持到收支平衡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 gung1 si1 ham3 ham3 wu2 wai4 chi4 dou3 sau1 zi1 ping4 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的公司勉强维持到收支平衡。
examples.english_sentence: His company is barely maintaining a balance between income and expenditure.

mandarin_meaning: 命运不顺, 道路崎岖
english_meaning: rough, bumpy, full of hardship; having an unfortunate fate; adversity
explanation_mandarin: 比喻人生道路艰难，不顺利。指遭遇很多挫折、困难。
explanation_english: Describes a life path filled with difficulty and hardship. Refers to encountering many setbacks and obstacles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一生都好坎坷，經歷咗好多困難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 sang1 dou1 hou2 ham2 ko2, ging1 lik6 zo2 hou2 do1 kwan3 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一生都很坎坷，经历了很多困难。
examples.english_sentence: His life has been very rough, and he's experienced many hardships.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅事業路途好坎坷，成日遇到阻滯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 si6 jip6 lou6 tou4 hou2 ham2 ko2, sing4 jat6 jyu6 dou6 zo2 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的事业道路很坎坷，经常遇到阻碍。
examples.english_sentence: His career path has been very bumpy, he often encounters obstacles.

english_meaning: Canberra (capital of Australia)
explanation_mandarin: 澳大利亚的首都。
explanation_english: Canberra is the capital city of Australia.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要去坎培拉開會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 ham2 pui4 laai1 hoi1 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要去堪培拉开会。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Canberra for a meeting tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 坎培拉嘅天氣點呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ham2 pui4 laai1 ge3 tin1 hei3 dim2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 堪培拉的天气怎么样？
examples.english_sentence: How's the weather in Canberra?

english_meaning: To hit a wall; to be in a dead end; to be at a loss
explanation_mandarin: 比喻遇到困难，走不通，没有出路。
explanation_english: A metaphor describing a situation where one encounters difficulties, cannot proceed, and has no way out; hitting a dead end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次投資失敗，真係坎頭埋牆啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 tau4 zi1 sat1 baai6, zan1 hai6 ham2 tau4 maai4 cheung4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次投资失败，真是走投无路了。
examples.english_sentence: His investment failed this time, he really hit a dead end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再唔努力，到時考試肥佬，就真係坎頭埋牆㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 m4 nu5 lik6, dou3 si4 haau2 si3 fei4 lou2, zau6 zan1 hai6 ham2 tau4 maai4 cheung4 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再不努力，到时候考试不及格，就真是走投无路了。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't work harder, you'll fail the exam, and then you'll really be in a dead end.

english_meaning: to sit
explanation_mandarin: 身体靠在物体上，重心由臀部承受。
explanation_english: To rest one's weight on the buttocks, typically on a chair or other support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺度坐低休息吓啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 dou6 co5 dai1 hiu1 sik1 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在这里坐下休息一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's sit down and take a rest here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，呢個位有人坐㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ni1 go3 wai2 jau5 jan4 co5 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，这个位子有人坐了。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, this seat is taken.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 坐車
examples.jyutping_sentence: co5 ce1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 坐车
examples.english_sentence: To take a vehicle (car, bus, train etc.)

english_meaning: To be in a VIP box (usually in a karaoke or nightclub)
explanation_mandarin: 指在卡拉OK或夜总会等娱乐场所的包厢里消费、玩乐。 "Box"指包厢。
explanation_english: Refers to spending time and entertaining oneself in a VIP box, usually in entertainment venues like karaoke (KTV) or nightclubs. "Box" refers to the VIP room or private room.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋去坐box唱K啦，點啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 co5 bok1 cheung3 K laa1, dim2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们去KTV包厢唱歌吧，怎么样？
examples.english_sentence: Let's go sing karaoke in a VIP box tonight, how does that sound?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日去坐box，真係有錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 heoi3 co5 bok1, zan1 hai6 jau5 chin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常去夜总会包厢，真是有钱。
examples.english_sentence: He often goes to VIP boxes, he's really rich.

english_meaning: to have a narrow view of the world; to be limited by one's experience
explanation_mandarin: 坐在井里看天。比喻眼界狭小，见识有限。
explanation_english: Literally, to sit in a well and look at the sky. Figuratively, it means to have a narrow view of the world; to be limited by one's experience and knowledge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁坐井觀天啦，出面嘅世界大好多㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 co5 zing2 gun1 tin1 laa1, ceot1 min6 ge3 sai3 gaai3 daai6 hou2 do1 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么坐井观天了，外面的世界大很多啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so narrow-minded, the outside world is much bigger!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日以為自己嘅諗法啱晒，真係坐井觀天。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ji5 wai4 zi6 gei2 ge3 lam2 faat3 ngaam1晒 saai3, zan1 hai6 co5 zing2 gun1 tin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是认为自己的想法全是对的，真是坐井观天。
examples.english_sentence: He always thinks his ideas are correct, he's really narrow-minded.

english_meaning: Sitting in second place, hoping to win the championship; Being a runner-up with hopes of becoming the champion.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻某人或某队在比赛或竞争中排名第二，但有实力和希望赢得第一名。
explanation_english: An idiom describing someone or a team currently in second place with the potential and desire to win first place in a competition or contest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋隊波今屆表現好好，依家坐亞望冠，好有機會攞冠軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 deoi2 bo1 gam1 gai3 biu2 hin2 hou2 hou2, ji1 gaa1 co5 aa3 mong6 gun1, hou2 jau5 gei1 wui2 lo2 gun1 gwaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们队这届表现很好，现在位居第二，有望夺冠，很有机会拿到冠军。
examples.english_sentence: Their team has performed very well this year. They are now in second place with a good chance of winning the championship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢今次考試考第二，但係佢一直好努力，下一次坐亞望冠都唔出奇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 haau2 dai6 ji6, daan6 hai6 keoi5 jat1 zik6 hou2 nu5 lik6, haa6 jat1 ci3 co5 aa3 mong6 gun1 dou1 m4 ceot1 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他这次考试考了第二名，但是他一直很努力，下一次位居第二，有望夺冠也不奇怪。
examples.english_sentence: Although he got second place in the exam this time, he has been working hard, so it wouldn't be surprising if he wins the championship next time.

english_meaning: to reap where one has not sown; to enjoy the fruits of others' labor
explanation_mandarin: 自己不出力，享受别人努力的成果。
explanation_english: To benefit from others' work without contributing oneself; to reap the benefits of someone else's efforts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咩都唔做，就想坐享其成，邊有咁筍嘅事啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 me1 dou1 m4 zou6, zau6 soeng2 zo6 hoeng2 kei4 sing4, bin1 jau5 gam3 seon2 ge3 si6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他什么都不做，就想坐享其成，哪有这么好的事啊？
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't do anything but wants to enjoy the fruits of others' labor. How could there be such a good thing?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做人唔應該淨係諗住坐享其成，要靠自己努力先得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jan4 m4 jing1 goi1 zing6 hai6 nam2 zyu6 zo6 hoeng2 kei4 sing4, jiu3 kaau3 zi6 gei2 nu5 lik6 sin1 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做人不应该只想着坐享其成，要靠自己努力才行。
examples.english_sentence: One shouldn't only think about reaping where one has not sown, but should rely on their own efforts.

english_meaning: to sit and wait for death; to await one's doom; to resign oneself to destruction; to sit still and wait for death
explanation_mandarin: 形容在困境中，不采取任何行动，只是坐着等待死亡或失败。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone is in a difficult or dangerous situation but does nothing to improve it, simply waiting for death or failure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔可以坐以待斃，一定要諗辦法解決呢個問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 ho2 ji5 co5 ji5 doi6 bai6, jat1 ding6 jiu3 nam2 baan6 faat3 gaai2 kyut3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不能坐以待毙，一定要想办法解决这个问题。
examples.english_sentence: We can't just sit around and wait for our doom, we must find a way to solve this problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對咁多挑戰，如果我哋乜都唔做，咪即係坐以待斃囉？
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 gam3 do1 tiu1 zin3, jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 mat1 dou1 m4 zou6, mi1 zik1 hai6 co5 ji5 doi6 bai6 lo1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面对这么多挑战，如果我们什么都不做，那不就是坐以待毙吗？
examples.english_sentence: Facing so many challenges, if we do nothing, isn't that just waiting for our doom?

english_meaning: sit down
explanation_mandarin: 表示从站立或蹲下的姿势变为坐姿。
explanation_english: To take a seat; to sit down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，坐低啦，唔駛咁客氣嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, co5 dai1 laa1, m4 sai2 gam3 haak3 hei3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，坐下吧，不用这么客气。
examples.english_sentence: Hey, sit down, you don't have to be so polite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋坐低傾下偈啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 co5 dai1 king1 haa5 gai2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们坐下聊聊天吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's sit down and have a chat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆，你坐低休息下先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4, nei5 co5 dai1 yau1 sik1 haa5 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿婆，你坐下休息一下先。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma, you sit down and rest for a while first.

mandarin_meaning: 事与愿违；适得其反；白费力气
english_meaning: To take a return trip immediately; to do something that backfires; to act against one's own interests; to be counterproductive
explanation_mandarin: 形容做了某事，结果与预期相反，反而造成了负面的效果。就像坐上了开往反方向的车，白费力气。
explanation_english: Describes doing something that has the opposite of the intended effect, resulting in a negative outcome. Similar to taking a bus going in the wrong direction, wasting effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住幫佢，點知坐倒頭車，反而害咗佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 nam2 zyu6 bong1 keoi5, dim2 zi1 co5 dou2 tau4 ce1, faan2 hai6 zo2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我本想帮他，结果适得其反，反而害了他。
examples.english_sentence: I intended to help him, but it backfired, and I ended up hurting him instead.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做，肯定會坐倒頭車㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6, hak1 ding6 wui5 co5 dou2 tau4 ce1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做，肯定会适得其反的。
examples.english_sentence: Doing it this way will definitely backfire.

synonyms: 適得其反 (sik1 dak1 kei4 faan2)
弄巧反拙 (lung6 haau2 faan2 zyut3)

english_meaning: to be sidelined, to be benched, to be left out in the cold
explanation_mandarin: 比喻受到冷落，担任不重要的职位，或者暂时没有机会发挥作用。
explanation_english: A metaphor for being sidelined, neglected, holding an unimportant position, or temporarily not having the opportunity to perform.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢得罪咗老細，而家坐緊冷板凳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dak1 zeoi6 zo2 lou5 sai3, ji4 gaa1 co5 gan2 laang5 baan2 dang3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他得罪了老板，现在在坐冷板凳。
examples.english_sentence: He offended the boss and is now being sidelined.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋後生仔，經驗唔夠，咪俾佢哋坐住冷板凳先囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hau6 saang1 zai2, ging1 jim6 m4 gau3, mai1 bei2 keoi5 dei6 co5 zyu6 laang5 baan2 dang3 sin1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是年轻人，经验不足，就先让他们坐坐冷板凳吧。
examples.english_sentence: They are young and lack experience, so let them be sidelined for now.

english_meaning: to be sidelined, to be put on the bench, to be out of favor
explanation_mandarin: 比喻受到冷落，没有被重用。
explanation_english: Figuratively, to be neglected, not to be given important tasks, to be put on the sidelines or in a position where one is not utilized effectively. It originally refers to literally sitting on a cold bench, implying a lack of activity or importance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢得罪咗老細，依家坐緊冷板櫈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dak1 zeoi2 zo2 lou5 sai3, ji1 gaa1 co5 gan2 laang5 baan2 dang3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他得罪了老板，现在正在坐冷板凳。
examples.english_sentence: He offended the boss, so he's being sidelined now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從新經理嚟咗之後，佢就好似坐緊冷板櫈咁，乜嘢都唔使做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 san1 ging1 lei5 lai4 zo2 zi1 hau6, keoi5 hau2 ci5 co5 gan2 laang5 baan2 dang3 gam2, mat1 je5 dou1 m4 sai2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从新经理来了之后，他就好像在坐冷板凳一样，什么都不用做。
examples.english_sentence: Since the new manager came, he seems to be sidelined, not required to do anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋唔努力，好快就會坐冷板櫈㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 m4 nu5 lik6, hou2 faai3 zau6 wui5 co5 laang5 baan2 dang3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们不努力，很快就会坐冷板凳的。
examples.english_sentence: If we don't work hard, we'll quickly be sidelined.

synonyms: 被投閒置散 (bei6 tau4 haan4 zi3 saan3)

english_meaning: to sit in a private room/booth
explanation_mandarin: 指在餐馆、卡拉OK等场所坐在包间里。
explanation_english: Refers to sitting in a private room or booth in a restaurant, karaoke bar, or similar establishment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去唱K坐包廂啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 heoi3 coeng3 kei1 co5 baau1 soeng1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚去唱K，坐包间吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to karaoke tonight and sit in a private room.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳好嘈，我哋不如坐包廂傾偈啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 hou2 cou4, ngo5 dei6 bat1 jyu4 co5 baau1 soeng1 king1 gai2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅太吵了，我们不如坐包间聊天吧。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant is too noisy, why don't we sit in a private room and chat?

english_meaning: orientation, facing direction
explanation_mandarin: 指建筑物或房间朝向的方向，通常用于风水或描述房屋的方位。
explanation_english: Refers to the direction a building or room faces, often used in feng shui or to describe the orientation of a house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間屋嘅坐向好好，向南，冬天夠暖，夏天又通風。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 uk1 ge3 zo6 hoeng3 hou2 hou2, hoeng3 naam4, dung1 tin1 gau3 nuon5, haa6 tin1 jau6 tung1 fung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间房子的朝向很好，朝南，冬天够暖和，夏天又通风。
examples.english_sentence: This house has a good orientation, facing south, it's warm enough in winter and breezy in summer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買樓要睇埋坐向，唔好買到坐北向南嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 lau2 jiu3 tai2 maai4 zo6 hoeng3, m4 hou2 maai5 dou3 zo6 bak1 hoeng3 naam4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 买房子也要看朝向，不要买到坐北朝南的。
examples.english_sentence: When buying a house, you also need to check the orientation, don't buy one that faces south but sits to the north.

english_meaning: on the spot; right there and then; extortion (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意义是“坐在地上”，引申为“就地”、“当场”。口语中也指漫天要价，敲竹杠。
explanation_english: Literally means "sitting on the ground." Figuratively, it means "on the spot" or "right there and then." In colloquial usage, it can also mean to overcharge or rip someone off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢坐地加咗五百蚊，簡直係搶錢！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 co5 dei6 gaa1 zo2 ng5 baak3 man1, gaan2 zik6 hai6 coeng2 cin2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他当场加了五百块钱，简直是抢钱！
examples.english_sentence: He increased the price by five hundred dollars on the spot, it's practically robbery!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好信佢哋，小心佢哋坐地起價。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 dei6, siu2 sam1 keoi5 dei6 co5 dei6 hei2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要相信他们，小心他们漫天要价。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust them, be careful they overcharge you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份合約我喺香港坐地簽嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 hap6 joek3 ngo5 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 co5 dei6 cim1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份合同我是直接在香港签的。
examples.english_sentence: I signed this contract directly in Hong Kong.

mandarin_meaning: 坐地涨价 / 漫天要价
english_meaning: to raise the price on the spot; to arbitrarily inflate prices; gouging
explanation_mandarin: 原指坐着就地抬高价格。比喻趁机抬高价格或要价过高。
explanation_english: Originally refers to raising the price while remaining seated. It describes taking advantage of an opportunity to raise prices arbitrarily or asking for an exorbitant price.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋見我哋咁趕時間，就坐地起價，真係好過份！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gin3 ngo5 dei6 gam3 gon2 si4 gaan3, zau6 co5 dei6 hei2 gaa3, zan1 hai6 hou2 gwo3 fan6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们看我们这么赶时间，就坐地涨价，真是太过分了！
examples.english_sentence: They saw that we were in a hurry, so they raised the price on the spot, it's really outrageous!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲黑心商人成日都坐地起價，揾笨實！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 hak1 sam1 seung1 yan4 sing4 jat6 dou1 co5 dei6 hei2 gaa3, wan2 ban6 sat1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些黑心商人总是坐地涨价，真会骗人！
examples.english_sentence: These unscrupulous merchants always inflate prices on the spot, they're really con artists!

synonyms: 獅子開大口 (si1 zi2 hoi1 daai6 hau2)
漫天開價 (maan6 tin1 hoi1 gaa3)

english_meaning: To be in the same boat (idiomatically); to be in the same situation or predicament
explanation_mandarin: 比喻处境相同，利害一致。
explanation_english: An idiom that describes being in the same situation or predicament as someone else, sharing the same fate or risks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次間公司咁嘅情況，我哋真係坐埋一條船，要一齊捱落去。

mandarin_meaning: 指那些什么也不做、只会享受和依赖别人的人
