english_meaning: Definitely, certainly, for sure
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事一定会发生，非常肯定。
explanation_english: Indicates that something will definitely happen; expressing certainty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試我坐梗肥佬啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ngo5 co5 gang2 fei4 lou2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我肯定要不及格了。
examples.english_sentence: I'm definitely going to fail this exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁勤力，坐梗成功嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 kan4 lik6, co5 gang2 sing4 gung1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么努力，肯定会成功的。
examples.english_sentence: He's so hardworking, he's definitely going to succeed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果佢咁做，坐梗俾人鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 keoi5 gam3 zou6, co5 gang2 bei2 jan4 naau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果他这样做，肯定会被人骂。
examples.english_sentence: If he does that, he's definitely going to get scolded.

english_meaning: To sit with customers (usually refers to hostesses in bars or clubs)
explanation_mandarin: 指在娱乐场所（如酒吧、夜总会）中的女性服务员陪伴顾客，提供服务，例如聊天、喝酒等。
explanation_english: Refers to female service staff in entertainment venues (such as bars or nightclubs) sitting with customers, providing services such as chatting and drinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺夜總會做坐檯嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 je6 zung2 wui2 zou6 co5 toi2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她在夜总会做陪侍的。
examples.english_sentence: She works as a hostess in a nightclub.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日去啲有坐檯嘅地方啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 heoi3 di1 jau5 co5 toi2 ge3 dei6 fong1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是去那些有陪侍的地方。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always go to places with hostesses.

english_meaning: to officially take office; to formally assume a position; to be officially recognized as the leader
explanation_mandarin: 原指在组织或团队中，某人从代理或临时职务转为正式职务。引申为正式掌权，坐上领导位置。
explanation_english: Originally, it referred to someone in an organization or team transitioning from an acting or temporary role to a formal one. It is now used to mean officially taking power or assuming a leadership position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗代理經理咁耐，今次終於可以坐正啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 daai6 lei5 ging1 lei5 gam3 noi6, gam1 ci3 chung1 jyu1 ho2 ji5 co5 zeng3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了代理经理这么久，这次终于可以正式上任了。
examples.english_sentence: He's been the acting manager for so long, he can finally officially take the position this time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一路都想坐正，但係啲人唔係好服佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 lou6 dou1 soeng2 co5 zeng3, daan6 hai6 di1 jan4 m4 hai6 hou2 fuk6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一直都想正式当上领导，但是大家不太服他。
examples.english_sentence: He has always wanted to formally take the leadership position, but people aren't very convinced by him.

english_meaning: to be sent off (in football/soccer)
explanation_mandarin: 指在足球比赛中，球员因犯规而被裁判罚下场，不能继续参与比赛，只能坐在观众席上。引申义指因犯错而受到惩罚，失去参与的机会。
explanation_english: Literally, "to sit in the stadium jail." In football/soccer, it refers to a player being sent off the field by the referee due to a foul, and being forced to sit in the stands (like being in jail), unable to participate further. By extension, it means being punished for making a mistake and losing the opportunity to participate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢頭先踢到人哋隻腳，依家要坐波監啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tau4 sin1 tek3 dou2 jan4 dei6 zoek3 goek3, ji1 gaa1 jiu3 co5 bo1 gaam1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他刚才踢到别人的脚了，现在要被罚下场了。
examples.english_sentence: He kicked someone's leg just now, so he has to be sent off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為遲到，佢俾老細罰咗坐波監，唔准佢參與今次嘅項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 ci4 dou3, keoi5 bei2 lou5 sai3 phạt1 zo2 co5 bo1 gaam1, m4 zeon2 keoi5 caam1 jyu5 gam1 ci3 ge3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为迟到，他被老板罚了，不准他参与这次的项目。
examples.english_sentence: Because he was late, the boss punished him by not allowing him to participate in this project.

synonyms: [被罰出場 (bei6 phạt1 ceot1 coeng4) - being sent off]

mandarin_meaning: 装模作样，假装没事，站着却看起来像坐着。
english_meaning: To pretend to be alright; to put on a brave face; to act like nothing's wrong; to feign composure when feeling uncomfortable or distressed; literally: to sit on an invisible stool.
explanation_mandarin: 形容人强忍不适，故作镇定，装出没事的样子。通常指身体不适或精神压力大却硬撑着。字面意思是“坐在没有影子的凳子上”，暗示了没有实际支撑却装作有支撑。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is forcing themselves to appear calm and composed despite feeling uncomfortable, unwell, or under pressure. The literal meaning is "sitting on an invisible stool", suggesting the lack of actual support while pretending to be supported.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢頭先俾老闆鬧完，依家仲要坐無影凳咁繼續做嘢，真係慘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tau4 sin1 bei2 lou5 baan2 nau6 jyun4, ji1 gaa1 zung6 jiu3 co5 mou4 jeng2 dang3 gam2 gai3 zuk6 zou6 je5, zan1 hai6 caam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他刚才被老板骂完，现在还要装作没事继续工作，真可怜。
examples.english_sentence: He was just scolded by the boss, and now he has to pretend everything's fine and continue working. It's really pitiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 明明佢隻腳扭親咗，但係佢為咗唔想大家擔心，唯有坐無影凳咁撐住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ming4 ming4 keoi5 zek3 goek3 nau2 can1 zo2, daan6 hai6 keoi5 wai6 zo2 m4 soeng2 daai6 gaa1 daam1 sam1, wai4 jau5 co5 mou4 jeng2 dang3 gam2 caang1 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明明他的脚扭伤了，但是为了不让大家担心，只好装作没事撑着。
examples.english_sentence: His foot is clearly twisted, but to avoid worrying everyone, he has no choice but to pretend everything's alright and keep going.

english_meaning: To sit on an imaginary chair; to squat
explanation_mandarin: 指蹲着，好像坐在一张看不见的凳子上。形容长时间保持蹲姿。
explanation_english: Describes the act of squatting for an extended period, as if sitting on an invisible chair. It emphasizes the prolonged squatting position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺街邊度坐無影櫈，等佢朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gaai1 bin1 dou6 co5 mou4 jing2 dang3, dang2 keoi5 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在街边蹲着等他的朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He was squatting on the street side, waiting for his friend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做嘢做得耐，攰到要坐無影櫈抖下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 je5 zou6 dak1 noi6, gui6 dou3 jiu3 co5 mou4 jing2 dang3 dau2 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工作太久了，累得要蹲下来休息一下。
examples.english_sentence: I've been working for too long, I'm so tired that I need to squat down for a rest.

english_meaning: to be in prison, to serve a sentence
explanation_mandarin: 因犯罪被判刑而关在监狱里。
explanation_english: To be imprisoned, to serve a prison sentence as a result of committing a crime.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打劫銀行，俾人捉咗去坐牢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 gip3 ngan4 hong4, bei2 jan4 zuk1 zo2 heoi3 co5 lou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他抢劫银行，被人抓去坐牢了。
examples.english_sentence: He robbed a bank and was caught and sent to prison.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果犯法就要坐牢㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 faan6 faat3 zau6 jiu3 co5 lou4 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果犯法就要坐牢的啦。
examples.english_sentence: If you break the law, you'll have to go to prison.

english_meaning: to be in prison; to be incarcerated; to serve time
explanation_mandarin: 指因犯罪被判刑而入狱服刑。
explanation_english: Refers to being imprisoned to serve a sentence due to a crime.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢搶嘢俾人捉咗，依家要坐監。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 coeng2 je5 bei2 jan4 zuk1 zo2, ji1 gaa1 jiu3 co5 gaam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他抢东西被人抓了，现在要坐牢。
examples.english_sentence: He robbed something and got caught, now he has to go to prison.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 貪污係犯法嘅，一旦俾人捉到就要坐監㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taam1 wu1 hai6 faan6 faat3 ge3, jat1 daan6 bei2 jan4 zuk1 dou2 zau6 jiu3 co5 gaam1 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 贪污是犯法的，一旦被人抓到就要坐牢的。
examples.english_sentence: Corruption is illegal, once you get caught you have to go to prison.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢衰咗，要坐十年監。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seoi1 zo2, jiu3 co5 sap6 nin4 gaam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他倒霉了，要坐十年牢。
examples.english_sentence: He messed up, he has to serve ten years in prison.

english_meaning: To be the dealer (in gambling); to be the bookmaker; to be the one in charge (informal)
explanation_mandarin: 指在赌博游戏中做庄家。引申为负责、主持某项事务。
explanation_english: Literally, to sit at the 'board' or 'game'. Primarily used to describe the person who acts as the dealer or bookmaker in gambling. Figuratively, it means to be in charge of something, to take responsibility for it, or to manage it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚打麻雀，邊個坐盤啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 daa2 maa4 zoek3, bin1 go3 co5 pun4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚打麻将，谁坐庄啊？
examples.english_sentence: Who's going to be the dealer tonight for mahjong?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目由你坐盤，有咩問題可以搵我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 jau4 nei5 co5 pun4, jau5 me1 man6 tai4 ho2 ji5 wan2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目由你负责，有什么问题可以找我。
examples.english_sentence: You're in charge of this project. If you have any problems, you can find me.

english_meaning: meditate, sit in meditation
explanation_mandarin: 通过特定的姿势（通常是盘腿而坐）和呼吸方法，集中注意力，以达到精神上的平静和觉悟。
explanation_english: To meditate, typically by sitting in a specific posture (often cross-legged) and using breathing techniques to focus the mind and achieve mental calmness and enlightenment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢每日朝早都會花半個鐘頭坐禪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mui5 jat6 ziu1 zou2 dou1 wui5 faa1 bun3 go3 zung1 tau4 zo6 sim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天早上都会花半个小时打坐。
examples.english_sentence: He spends half an hour meditating every morning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 坐禪可以幫助你減輕壓力，保持平靜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zo6 sim4 ho2 ji5 bong1 zo6 nei5 gaam2 hing1 aat3 lik6, bou2 ci4 ping4 ging6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 打坐可以帮助你减轻压力，保持平静。
examples.english_sentence: Meditating can help you reduce stress and stay calm.

mandarin_meaning: 为了满足移民居住要求而长期居住
english_meaning: To serve time as an immigration prisoner; to live in a country primarily to fulfill residency requirements for immigration purposes.
explanation_mandarin: 形容为了达到移民目的，不得不长期居住在移民国家，满足移民局规定的居住时间要求，如同坐牢一样，感到不自由。
explanation_english: Describes the situation where someone has to live in an immigration country for an extended period to meet the residency requirements stipulated by the immigration authorities. It implies a feeling of confinement or lack of freedom, similar to being in prison.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一家为咗攞外國護照，焗住要喺加拿大坐移民監。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 wai6 zo2 lo2 ngoi6 gwok3 wu6 ziu3, guk6 zyu6 jiu3 hai2 gaa1 naa4 daai6 co5 ji4 man4 gaam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一家为了获得外国护照，不得不被迫在加拿大坐移民监。
examples.english_sentence: In order to get a foreign passport, the family is forced to serve immigration time in Canada.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲人成日話要走，但係又唔捨得香港，諗住兩邊走，咁咪即係坐移民監囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 jan4 seng4 jat6 waa6 jiu3 zau2, daan6 hai6 jau6 m4 se2 dak1 hoeng1 gong2, nam2 zyu6 loeng5 bin1 zau2, gam2 mai1 zik1 hai6 co5 ji4 man4 gaam1 lo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的人总是说要走，但是又不舍得香港，想着两边跑，那不就是坐移民监吗？
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, people always say they want to leave, but they are reluctant to leave Hong Kong and intend to shuttle back and forth. Isn't that just serving immigration time?

mandarin_meaning: 站稳脚跟；保持现状；稳坐钓鱼台
english_meaning: Hold on tight; Keep the status quo; To be secure in one's position
explanation_mandarin: 比喻在某个位置或状态上保持稳定，不易被动摇。 可以指保持既得利益，也指在不稳定或困难的情况下坚持下去。
explanation_english: A metaphor for maintaining stability in a position or state, not easily shaken. Can refer to maintaining vested interests or persevering in unstable or difficult situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟唔好，最緊要係坐穩船，唔好亂咁轉工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hai6 co5 wan2 syun4, m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 zyun2 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济不好，最重要的是站稳脚跟，不要随便换工作。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is not good, the most important thing is to hold on tight and don't switch jobs rashly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司坐穩船，所以咩都唔使驚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 co5 wan2 syun4, so2 ji5 me1 dou1 m4 sai2 geng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司稳坐钓鱼台，所以什么都不用怕。
examples.english_sentence: He is secure in his position in the company, so he doesn't need to worry about anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對咁多競爭，要努力坐穩船先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 gam3 do1 ging6 zang1, jiu3 nu5 lik6 co5 wan2 syun4 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面对这么多竞争，要努力站稳脚跟才行。
examples.english_sentence: Facing so much competition, we have to work hard to maintain our position.

english_meaning: Hold on tight; Get ready for a wild ride (literally and figuratively)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是「坐稳车子」，比喻要做好准备，迎接即将到来的挑战或者变化，通常带有提醒对方做好心理准备的含义。
explanation_english: Literally means "sit tight on the car/vehicle." Figuratively, it means to hold on tight or get ready for a challenge, change, or a potentially unstable situation. It serves as a reminder to brace oneself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先聽講公司就嚟執笠，你坐穩車喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 teng1 gong2 gung1 si1 zau6 lai4 zap1 lap1, nei5 co5 wan2 ce1 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才听说公司快要倒闭了，你坐稳了！
examples.english_sentence: I just heard the company is about to close down, so hold on tight!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細話下個月要大裁員，大家坐穩車啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 waa6 haa6 go3 jyut6 jiu3 daai6 coi4 jyun4, daai6 gaa1 co5 wan2 ce1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板说下个月要大规模裁员，大家坐稳了。
examples.english_sentence: The boss said there will be massive layoffs next month, everyone hold on tight.

synonyms: 捉緊扶手 (zuk1 gan2 fu4 sau2)

english_meaning: restless; fidgety; uneasy
explanation_mandarin: 形容心情焦急，烦躁，无法安静地坐着或站着。
explanation_english: Describes a state of anxiety, restlessness, and fidgetiness, making it difficult to sit or stand still.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日就放榜喇，我緊張到坐立不安呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 zau6 fong3 bong2 laa3, ngo5 gan2 zoeng1 dou3 co5 laap6 bat1 on1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天就要公布榜单了，我紧张得坐立不安啊！
examples.english_sentence: The results are coming out tomorrow, I'm so nervous I can't sit still!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢等咗好耐都未見到佢女朋友，開始坐立不安。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dang2 zo2 hou2 noi6 dou1 mei6 gin3 dou2 keoi5 neoi5 pang4 jau5, hoi1 ci2 co5 laap6 bat1 on1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他等了很久都没见到他女朋友，开始坐立不安。
examples.english_sentence: He waited a long time and still hadn't seen his girlfriend, he started to get restless.

english_meaning: To be trapped (in a stock or investment); to be stuck (with losses)
explanation_mandarin: 指投资失利，股票价格下跌后无法卖出，被资金套牢。也泛指陷入困境，难以脱身。
explanation_english: Refers to being trapped in a stock or investment due to a significant price drop, making it impossible to sell without incurring substantial losses. It can also generally mean being in a difficult or trapped situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺呢隻股票坐咗艇，蝕咗好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 ni1 zek3 gu2 piu3 zo6 zo2 teng5, sit3 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在这支股票里被套牢了，亏了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: I'm trapped in this stock and have lost a lot of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔聽人勸，買咗啲垃圾股，依家坐晒艇啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 teng1 jan4 hyun3, maai5 zo2 di1 laap6 saap3 gu2, ji1 gaa1 zo6 saai3 teng5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不听劝告，买了一些垃圾股，现在都被套牢了。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't listen to advice and bought some trash stocks, and now he's completely trapped.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟唔好，好多公司都坐緊艇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, hou2 do1 gung1 si1 dou1 zo6 gan2 teng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济不好，很多公司都处境艰难。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is bad, many companies are struggling (being stuck).

mandarin_meaning: 比喻受冷落，不受重视; 像坐在接待客人的房间里一样
english_meaning: To be left out in the cold; to be sidelined; to be ignored; to be treated like a guest in one's own space.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻受到冷落，不受重视，像客人一样被晾在一边。花厅指旧时富贵人家会客的客厅。
explanation_english: An idiom that describes a situation where someone is left out, not valued, or treated as an outsider, like a guest in one's own home. '花廳 (faa1 teng1)' refers to the reception room in a wealthy family's house where guests were entertained.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從佢升咗做經理之後，我就好似坐花廳咁，咩都唔知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 keoi5 sing1 zo2 zou6 ging1 lei5 zi1 hau6, ngo5 zau6 hou2 ci5 co5 faa1 teng1 gam2, me1 dou1 m4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从他升为经理之后，我就好像被晾在一边一样，什么都不知道。
examples.english_sentence: Since he was promoted to manager, I've been left out in the cold; I don't know anything anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司坐花廳好耐，都冇人理佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 co5 faa1 teng1 hou2 noi6, dou1 mou5 jan4 lei5 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司里受冷落很久了，都没有人理他。
examples.english_sentence: He's been sidelined at the company for a long time, and no one pays attention to him.

english_meaning: To sit idly in a restaurant or cafe for a long time, often without ordering much; to loiter in a cafe; to 'nurse' a drink for an extended period.
explanation_mandarin: 指长时间在茶餐厅或咖啡店闲坐，通常消费不多或只点一杯饮料耗时间。
explanation_english: This phrase refers to the act of sitting in a cafe or restaurant for a long period of time, often with minimal consumption. It implies lingering and occupying a seat for an extended duration, sometimes even just ordering a single drink to justify staying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁坐茶監啦，人哋做生意都要翻枱㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 co5 caa4 gaam1 laa1, yan4 dei6 zou6 seng1 yi3 dou1 jiu3 faan1 toi2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这样一直坐着了，人家做生意也是要翻桌的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't sit here so long, they need to turn over the tables for business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺茶餐廳坐茶監，睇報紙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 caa4 caan1 teng1 co5 caa4 gaam1, tai2 bou3 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天在茶餐厅闲坐，看报纸。
examples.english_sentence: He spends all day sitting in the cafe, reading the newspaper.

english_meaning: to be located at; to be situated in
explanation_mandarin: 指建筑物、地方等位于某个地点。
explanation_english: Refers to the location of a building, place, or other entity at a specific spot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間大學坐落喺山上面，環境好清幽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 daai6 hok6 co5 lok6 hai2 saan1 soeng6 min6, waan4 ging2 hou2 cing1 jau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这所大学坐落在山上，环境很清幽。
examples.english_sentence: This university is located on the mountain, the environment is very peaceful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間屋坐落喺海邊，可以望到日落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 uk1 co5 lok6 hai2 hoi2 bin1, ho2 ji5 mong6 dou3 jat6 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的房子坐落在海边，可以看到日落。
examples.english_sentence: His house is located by the sea, and you can see the sunset.

mandarin_meaning: 莲花坐姿; 比喻女性两腿盘坐
english_meaning: Lotus position; (slang) to sit with legs crossed, especially referring to a woman sitting in that position in a potentially seductive way.
explanation_mandarin: 原指佛教中的莲花坐姿。在粤语俚语中，有时指女性两腿盘坐的姿势，带有一定的性暗示或挑逗意味，需要根据语境判断。
explanation_english: Originally refers to the lotus position in Buddhism. In Cantonese slang, it sometimes refers to a woman sitting cross-legged, often with a suggestive or teasing connotation. Interpretation depends on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁樣坐蓮啦，好核突呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 joeng2 co5 lin4 laa1, hou2 hat6 dat1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那样坐莲，很难看。
examples.english_sentence: Don't sit in the lotus position like that, it looks awful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺屋企坐蓮睇電視。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 uk1 kei2 co5 lin4 tai2 din6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是在家坐着莲花坐姿看电视。
examples.english_sentence: She always sits in the lotus position at home watching TV.

english_meaning: to sit idly by and do nothing; to turn a blind eye; to stand idly by
explanation_mandarin: 眼看著事情發生而不加以理會。形容對事物漠不關心。
explanation_english: To watch something happen without intervening; to be indifferent and do nothing to help or prevent something from happening.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到有人俾人蝦，唔可以坐視不理㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 jau5 jan4 bei2 jan4 haa1, m4 ho2 ji5 co5 si6 bat1 lei5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到有人被欺负，不可以袖手旁观的。
examples.english_sentence: If you see someone being bullied, you can't just stand by and do nothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府唔可以對貧富懸殊坐視不理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 m4 ho2 ji5 deoi3 pan4 fu3 hyun4 syu1 co5 si6 bat1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府不能对贫富差距袖手旁观。
examples.english_sentence: The government cannot turn a blind eye to the wealth gap.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔可以坐視不理你咁樣落去，我一定要幫你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 ho2 ji5 co5 si6 bat1 lei5 nei5 gam2 joeng2 lok6 heoi3, ngo5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 bong1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不能袖手旁观看着你这样下去，我一定要帮你。
examples.english_sentence: I can't just stand by and watch you continue like this, I must help you.

english_meaning: To match words with actions; to practice what one preaches; to walk the talk.
explanation_mandarin: 指人说话和行动一致，说了就要做到，言行一致。
explanation_english: Refers to someone whose words and actions are consistent. They do what they say they will do. Their actions align with their words.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要坐言起行，唔好淨係得個講字。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 co5 jin4 hei2 hang4, m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 dak1 go3 gong2 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要说到做到，不要只是说说而已。
examples.english_sentence: We need to walk the talk; don't just talk about it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一個好嘅領袖應該坐言起行，先至可以令人信服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 go3 hou2 ge3 ling5 zeoi2 ying1 goi1 co5 jin4 hei2 hang4, sin1 zai3 ho2 ji5 ling6 jan4 seon3 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一个好的领导者应该说到做到，这样才能令人信服。
examples.english_sentence: A good leader should practice what they preach in order to be convincing.

english_meaning: to take a vehicle, to ride in a vehicle
explanation_mandarin: 乘坐交通工具，例如巴士、的士、地铁等。
explanation_english: To travel by a vehicle, such as a bus, taxi, or subway.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日坐車去香港。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 co5 ce1 heoi3 hoeng1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天坐车去香港。
examples.english_sentence: We will take a vehicle (e.g., bus, train) to Hong Kong tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你坐咩車返屋企啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 co5 me1 ce1 faan1 uk1 kei2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你坐什么车回家啊？
examples.english_sentence: What kind of vehicle are you taking home?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 坐的士好貴㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: co5 dik1 si2 hou2 gwai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 坐出租车很贵的。
examples.english_sentence: Taking a taxi is expensive.

english_meaning: Sitting with a silver medal in hand, aiming for the gold; settling for silver but aspiring for gold.
explanation_mandarin: 形容目标远大，在已经取得较好成绩的基础上，继续努力争取更好的成绩。即使已经获得了第二名（银牌），仍然希望获得第一名（金牌）。
explanation_english: Describes having ambitious goals and striving for even better results after already achieving a good outcome. It implies being content with a silver medal but still aiming for the gold medal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試佢攞到第二，但係佢唔滿足，話要坐銀望金，下次一定要攞第一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 keoi5 lo2 dou3 dai6 ji6, daan6 hai6 keoi5 m4 mun5 zuk1, waa6 jiu3 co5 ngan4 mong6 gam1, haa6 ci3 jat1 ding6 jiu3 lo2 dai6 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试他得了第二，但是他不满足，说要稳拿银牌，力争金牌，下次一定要得第一。
examples.english_sentence: He got second place in the exam this time, but he's not satisfied. He said he's settling for silver but aspiring for gold, and he must get first place next time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司今年盈利已經好好，但係都要坐銀望金，希望可以再創高峰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 gam1 nin4 wing4 lei6 ji5 ging1 hou2 hou2, daan6 hai6 dou1 jiu3 co5 ngan4 mong6 gam1, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 zoi3 cong3 gou1 fung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司今年盈利已经很好，但是也要稳拿银牌，力争金牌，希望可以再创新高。
examples.english_sentence: Our company's profits are already very good this year, but we still want to settle for silver and aspire for gold, hoping to reach new heights.

english_meaning: to be stationed at; to oversee; to hold the fort; to be in charge at a location, often a headquarters
explanation_mandarin: 指在某个地方坐着镇守、指挥，通常是重要地点或总部。
explanation_english: To be stationed at a location, typically a headquarters or a crucial place, to oversee operations and maintain control. It implies a sense of authority and responsibility in managing affairs at that location.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋老闆親自坐鎭公司，睇住盤生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 lou5 baan2 can1 zi6 co5 zan3 gung1 si1, tai2 zyu6 pun4 saang1 yi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的老板亲自坐镇公司，盯着这笔生意。
examples.english_sentence: Their boss is personally overseeing operations at the company, keeping a close watch on this business deal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日打風，佢要喺控制中心坐鎭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 daa2 fung1, keoi5 jiu3 hai2 hung3 zai3 zung1 sam1 co5 zan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天有台风，他需要在控制中心坐镇。
examples.english_sentence: There's a typhoon tomorrow, he needs to be stationed at the control center.

english_meaning: to be in charge; to oversee; to be stationed at a key position to command or supervise
explanation_mandarin: 指在一个重要的位置负责指挥、监督工作，通常带有威慑、镇定的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to being in charge of and supervising work at an important position, often with a sense of deterrence and stability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋老細今次親自嚟坐鎮，睇嚟件事好重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 lou5 sai3 gam1 ci3 can1 zi6 lai4 zo6 zan3, tai2 lai4 gin6 si6 hou2 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的老板这次亲自来坐镇，看来这件事很重要。
examples.english_sentence: Their boss has come to oversee things personally this time, it seems the matter is very important.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚波士坐鎮酒吧，實行大懲罰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 bo1 si2 zo6 zan3 je5 baa1, sat6 hang4 daai6 cing4 fat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚老板坐镇酒吧，实行大惩罚（活动）。
examples.english_sentence: The boss will be at the bar tonight, implementing major penalties (activities/promotions).

english_meaning: to ride without paying (transportation fare)
explanation_mandarin: 指乘坐交通工具（如巴士、火车等）而不支付车费的行为。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of riding a means of transportation (e.g., bus, train) without paying the fare.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁窮，成日坐霸王車，真係唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 kung4, seng4 jat6 co5 baa3 wong4 ce1, zan1 hai6 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么穷，总是逃票乘车，真是不好。
examples.english_sentence: He's so poor, he's always riding without paying, it's really not good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住坐霸王車呀，捉到要罰錢㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 co5 baa3 wong4 ce1 aa3, zuk1 dou2 jiu3 fat6 cin2 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要想着逃票乘车，被抓到要罚钱的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't even think about riding without paying, you'll be fined if you get caught!

mandarin_meaning: 坐飞机; 被解雇; 迅速升迁
english_meaning: To take a plane; to be fired; to be rapidly promoted (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是乘坐飞机。引申义有多种，包括被解雇（尤指突然被解雇），以及指人迅速升迁（有讽刺意味）。
explanation_english: Literally means 'to take a plane'. Extended meanings include: 1. To be fired (especially suddenly). 2. To be rapidly promoted (often used sarcastically).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要坐飛機去北京。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 co5 fei1 gei1 heoi3 bak1 ging1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要坐飞机去北京。
examples.english_sentence: I need to take a plane to Beijing tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔做得嘢，俾老細炒咗，坐咗飛機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 dak1 zou6 je5, bei2 lou5 sai3 caau2 zo2, co5 zo2 fei1 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作做不好，被老板炒了，被解雇了。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't do his job well and got fired by the boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁快就升職，真係坐火箭呀，定坐飛機呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 faai3 zau6 sing1 zik1, zan1 hai6 co5 fo2 zin3 aa3, ding6 hai6 co5 fei1 gei1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么快就升职了，真的是坐火箭啊，还是坐飞机啊？
examples.english_sentence: He got promoted so fast, is he on a rocket or a plane?

synonyms: 炒魷魚 (caau2 jau4 jyu4) - to be fired (for the meaning of being fired)
升得好快 (sing1 dak1 hou2 faai3) - to be promoted quickly (for the meaning of rapid promotion)

mandarin_meaning: 享有特权的位置，高人一等的位置
english_meaning: To be in a privileged or advantageous position, to be favored, to have an unfair advantage
explanation_mandarin: 比喻占据有利地位，享受特权，或通过不正当手段获得优势。
explanation_english: A metaphor for being in a privileged or advantageous position, often implying unfair advantage or favoritism. Literally translates to "sitting in an airplane seat."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢靠關係坐咗飛機位，好快就升咗職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kaau3 gwaan1 hai6 co5 zo2 fei1 gei1 wai2, hou2 faai3 zau6 sing1 zo2 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他靠关系坐到了飞机的座位，很快就升职了。
examples.english_sentence: He got a privileged position through connections and was promoted very quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為你阿爸係老細，你就可以坐飛機位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 nei5 aa3 baa1 hai6 lou5 sai3, nei5 zau6 ho2 ji5 co5 fei1 gei1 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为你爸爸是老板，你就可以享有特权。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think that just because your dad is the boss, you can get preferential treatment.

english_meaning: To sit and eat away a mountain; to eat through one's fortune; living off one's capital
explanation_mandarin: 比喻只消费而不生产，即使家产堆积如山，也会耗尽。
explanation_english: An idiom that describes the situation where one only consumes without producing or replenishing. It means that even a large fortune will eventually be depleted if one only spends and does not work to earn money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都唔做嘢，坐食山崩，遲早都會冇錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 m4 zou6 je5, co5 sik6 saan1 bang1, ci4 zou2 dou1 wui5 mou5 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天都不工作，坐吃山空，迟早都会没钱。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't work all day, he's just eating away his fortune. Sooner or later, he'll be broke.

synonyms: 好吃懶做 (hou2 hek3 laan5 zou6)

english_meaning: To be the head of a triad society; to be in charge; to sit as the boss
explanation_mandarin: 指黑社会组织的首领或负责人。也泛指掌管权力，负责某个事物的人。
explanation_english: Refers to the leader or person in charge of a triad society. It can also broadly refer to someone who holds power and is responsible for something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今年坐館，應該會好忙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 nin4 zo6 gun2, jing1 goi1 wui5 hou2 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今年当家，应该会很忙。
examples.english_sentence: He is the head of the triad this year, he should be very busy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講佢哋幫派最近換咗人坐館。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 keoi5 dei6 bong1 paai3 zeoi3 gan6 waan6 zo2 jan4 zo6 gun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说他们帮派最近换了当家的人。
examples.english_sentence: I heard their triad recently changed its leader.

english_meaning: mount, vehicle, ride (often used for cars, bikes, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指代交通工具，通常是汽车或摩托车等。 也可指古代的坐骑，如马。
explanation_english: Refers to a vehicle, usually a car or motorcycle. Can also refer to a mount in ancient times, such as a horse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢架新嘅坐騎好靚啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaa3 san1 ge3 zo6 ke3 hou2 leng3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的新座驾真漂亮啊！
examples.english_sentence: His new ride is so beautiful!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日揸咩坐騎返工呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 zaa1 me1 zo6 ke3 faan1 gung1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天开什么车上班啊？
examples.english_sentence: What vehicle are you driving to work today?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋揸架靚坐騎去兜風。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zaa1 gaa3 leng3 zo6 ke3 heoi3 dau1 fung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们开着一辆漂亮的座驾去兜风。
examples.english_sentence: They drove a nice ride for a spin.

english_meaning: sciatic nerve; sciatica (sometimes used colloquially)
explanation_mandarin: 人体内的一条神经，起于腰骶部，经过臀部，到达下肢，支配下肢的感觉和运动。也指坐骨神经痛，即坐骨神经受到刺激或压迫而引起的疼痛。
explanation_english: The sciatic nerve, a major nerve extending from the lower spine down the back of the leg. It is also used to refer to sciatica, the pain caused by irritation or compression of the sciatic nerve.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日坐喺電腦前面，搞到坐骨神經痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 co5 hai2 din6 nou5 min6 cin4, gaau2 dou3 co5 gwat1 san4 ging1 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天坐在电脑前，搞得坐骨神经痛。
examples.english_sentence: He sits in front of the computer all day, causing him to have sciatica.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話我坐骨神經發炎，要休息多啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 co5 gwat1 san4 ging1 faat3 jim4, jiu3 jau1 sik1 do1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说我的坐骨神经发炎了，要多休息。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said that my sciatic nerve is inflamed, and I need to rest more.

english_meaning: pit; hole; trap; to swindle; to cheat; to deceive
explanation_mandarin: 1. 名词：地面上的洼地，坑洞。 2. 动词：欺骗，诈骗。
explanation_english: 1. Noun: A pit or hole in the ground. 2. Verb: To swindle, cheat, or deceive someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 前面有個坑，小心啲!
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin4 min6 jau5 go3 haang1, siu2 sam1 di1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 前面有个坑，小心点儿！
examples.english_sentence: There's a pit ahead, be careful!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人坑咗一筆錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 haang1 zo2 jat1 bat1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人骗了一笔钱。
examples.english_sentence: He was swindled out of a sum of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 千祈唔好信佢，佢專登坑人嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin1 kei4 m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5, keoi5 zyun1 dang3 haang1 jan4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 千万不要相信他，他专门坑人的。
examples.english_sentence: Definitely don't trust him, he specializes in swindling people.

mandarin_meaning: 陷阱；坑；地铁站名（坑口站）
english_meaning: Trap; Pit; Hang Hau (MTR station name)
explanation_mandarin: 1. 指陷阱、坑洞。2. 香港地铁站名，位于西贡区将军澳。
explanation_english: 1. Refers to a trap or pit. 2. Name of an MTR station in Hong Kong, located in Tseung Kwan O, Sai Kung District.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 千祈唔好信佢哋，小心有坑口啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin1 kei4 m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 dei6, siu2 sam1 jau5 haang1 hau2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 千万不要相信他们，小心有陷阱啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust them, be careful there might be a trap!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺坑口站等你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 haang1 hau2 zaam6 dang2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在坑口站等你。
examples.english_sentence: We will wait for you at Hang Hau station.

mandarin_meaning: 阴沟；下水道；引申为不体面、肮脏的地方或境地
english_meaning: ditch; gutter; drain; sewer; figuratively: a low, undesirable place or situation
explanation_mandarin: 指用于排水的沟渠，也常用于比喻肮脏、不体面的地方或境地。
explanation_english: Refers to a ditch or drain used for drainage. It's often used metaphorically to describe a dirty, undesirable place or situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 跌咗落坑渠，真係污糟到爆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dit3 zo2 lok6 haang1 keoi4, zan1 hai6 wu1 zou1 dou3 baau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 掉进下水道了，真的脏死了。
examples.english_sentence: Fell into the drain, so incredibly dirty.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 to4 faan6 dou1 dung3 saai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这团饭都凉透了。
examples.english_sentence: This lump of rice is completely cold.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢跌咗一坨屎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dit3 zo2 jat1 to4 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拉了一坨屎。
examples.english_sentence: He dropped a lump of poop.

english_meaning: square meter; square foot
explanation_mandarin: 面积单位，源于英语的“ping”，香港习惯用于表示房屋面积，近似于平方米或平方英尺。 具体数值根据香港的测量习惯而定。
explanation_english: A unit of area, derived from the English word "ping". It is commonly used in Hong Kong to measure the area of apartments or land. It is approximately equal to a square meter or square foot, although the exact equivalent can vary depending on the specific context in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間屋有三百幾坪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 uk1 jau5 saam1 baak3 gei2 ping4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间房子有三百多平方英尺。
examples.english_sentence: This apartment has over 300 square feet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港地寸金尺土，一坪都好貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 dei6 cyun3 gam1 cek3 tou2, jat1 ping4 dou1 hou2 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港寸土寸金，一平方英尺都很贵。
examples.english_sentence: Land is very expensive in Hong Kong; even one square foot is costly.

english_meaning: Peng Chau (an island in Hong Kong)
explanation_mandarin: 香港的一个离岛，位于香港岛的西北方。
explanation_english: An outlying island in Hong Kong, located northwest of Hong Kong Island.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我放假嘅時候成日去坪洲行山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 fong3 gaa3 ge3 si4 hau6 seng4 jat6 heoi3 ping4 zau1 haang4 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我放假的时候经常去坪洲爬山。
examples.english_sentence: I often go hiking on Peng Chau during my holidays.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 坪洲嘅海鮮幾新鮮㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ping4 zau1 ge3 hoi2 sin1 gei2 san1 sin1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 坪洲的海鲜挺新鲜的。
examples.english_sentence: The seafood in Peng Chau is quite fresh.

mandarin_meaning: 山坳; 两山之间低凹的地方
english_meaning: mountain pass; saddle (between two hills)
explanation_mandarin: 指两座山峰之间低凹的地方，像一个马鞍的形状。
explanation_english: Refers to a low-lying area between two mountain peaks, shaped like a saddle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋行過條坳就到㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haang4 gwo3 tiu4 aau3 zau6 dou3 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们穿过那个山坳就到了。
examples.english_sentence: We'll be there once we cross that mountain pass.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個坳風好大，小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 aau3 fung1 hou2 daai6, siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个山坳风很大，小心点。
examples.english_sentence: The wind is very strong in that mountain pass, be careful.

mandarin_meaning: 语气助词，表示感叹或停顿
english_meaning: particle indicating exclamation or a pause; uh, well (filler word)
explanation_mandarin: 语气助词，常用在句首或句中，没有实际意义，主要起舒缓语气或停顿的作用，类似于普通话的“呵”、“嗯”。
explanation_english: A particle used at the beginning or in the middle of a sentence, with no actual meaning. It mainly functions to soften the tone or create a pause, similar to "uh" or "well" in English.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 坷，你諗下先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho1, nei5 nam2 haa5 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 嗯，你先考虑一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: Well, think about it first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 坷，其實我都唔係好清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho1, kei4 sat6 ngo5 dou1 m4 hai6 hou2 ching1 chu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 嗯，其实我也不是很清楚。
examples.english_sentence: Well, actually I'm not very sure either.

english_meaning: lump; clod; chunk
explanation_mandarin: 量词，用于块状物。
explanation_english: A measure word, used for lumpy or chunky things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有坺牛油喺度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 bat6 ngau4 jau2 hai2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里有一块黄油。
examples.english_sentence: There's a lump of butter here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢跌咗一坺泥喺地下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dit3 zo2 jat1 bat6 nai4 hai2 dei6 haa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他掉了一块泥在地上。
examples.english_sentence: He dropped a clod of dirt on the ground.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢坺猪肉好肥呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bat6 zyu1 juk6 hou2 fei4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这块猪肉很肥啊。
examples.english_sentence: This chunk of pork is very fatty.

english_meaning: to crack; to split; a crack; fissure
explanation_mandarin: 指物体因干燥或外力作用而产生裂缝。
explanation_english: Refers to the appearance of cracks in an object due to dryness or external force.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲泥咁耐冇落雨，乾到坼晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 nai4 gam3 noi6 mou5 lok6 jyu5, gon1 dou3 caak3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些泥土很久没下雨，干裂了。
examples.english_sentence: This soil hasn't rained for a long time, it's all cracked.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度啲地磚坼開晒，行路要小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 di1 dei6 zyun1 caak3 hoi1 saai3, haang4 lou6 jiu3 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的地砖都裂开了，走路要小心。
examples.english_sentence: The floor tiles here are all cracked, be careful when walking.

english_meaning: to drool; to covet
explanation_mandarin: （口语，贬义）指贪图、羡慕别人的东西或成就，以至于垂涎欲滴。带有负面含义。
explanation_english: (Colloquial, derogatory) To covet or envy other people's belongings or achievements to the point of drooling. Carries a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都垂人哋啲嘢，好乞人憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 seoi4 jan4 dei6 di1 je5, hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是垂涎别人的东西，很令人讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: He always covets other people's things, which is annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日垂人哋嘅成功，自己努力先至係最重要嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 seoi4 jan4 dei6 ge3 sing4 gung1, zi6 gei2 nu5 lik6 sin1 zai3 hai6 zeoi3 zung6 jiu3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是羡慕别人的成功，自己努力才是最重要的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always envy other people's success; your own efforts are the most important.

english_meaning: critically ill, on the verge of death, endangered
explanation_mandarin: 指病情非常严重，生命处于危险状态；也指物种数量极少，面临灭绝的危险。
explanation_english: Refers to a situation where someone is critically ill and their life is in danger; it can also refer to a species being endangered and on the verge of extinction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢情況垂危，醫生話要做好心理準備。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cing4 fong3 seoi4 ngai4, ji1 sang1 waa6 jiu3 zou6 hou2 sam1 lei5 zeon2 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的情况危急，医生说要做好心理准备。
examples.english_sentence: His condition is critical; the doctor said we should prepare ourselves mentally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢種雀仔因為棲息地減少，已經瀕臨垂危。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zung2 zoek3 zai2 jan1 wai6 cai1 sik1 dei6 gam2 siu2, ji5 ging1 ban1 lam4 seoi4 ngai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种鸟类因为栖息地减少，已经濒临垂危。
examples.english_sentence: This type of bird is already endangered due to habitat loss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔及時搶救，病人隨時會垂危。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 kap6 si4 coeng2 gau3, beng6 yan2 ceoi4 si4 wui5 seoi4 ngai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不及时抢救，病人随时会病危。
examples.english_sentence: If we don't provide timely treatment, the patient's condition could become critical at any time.

english_meaning: easily obtainable; within easy reach; readily available
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常容易得到，就像伸手就可以拿到一样。
explanation_english: Describes something that is very easy to obtain, as if it can be reached with one's hand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個獎對佢嚟講，簡直係垂手可得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zoeng2 deoi3 keoi5 lei4 gong2, gaan2 zik6 hai6 seoi4 sau2 ho2 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个奖对他来说，简直是唾手可得。
examples.english_sentence: This award is practically within easy reach for him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢個市場，要搵到平貨簡直係垂手可得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 go3 si5 coeng4, jiu3 wan2 dou2 peng4 fo3 gaan2 zik6 hai6 seoi4 sau2 ho2 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这个市场，要找到便宜货简直是垂手可得。
examples.english_sentence: It's very easy to find cheap goods in this market.

english_meaning: dying, on the verge of death, moribund
explanation_mandarin: 形容生命即将结束，濒临死亡的状态。
explanation_english: Describes a state of being close to death, on the verge of dying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢傷得好重，幾乎垂死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng1 dak1 hou2 cung5, gei1 fu2 seoi4 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他伤得很重，几乎垂死。
examples.english_sentence: He was badly injured and almost dying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢樖嘢睇落好似垂死噉，要唔要淋多啲水？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 po1 ye5 tai2 lok6 hou2 ci5 seoi4 si2 gam2, jiu3 m4 jiu3 lam4 do1 di1 seoi2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这棵植物看起来好像快要死了，要不要多浇点水？
examples.english_sentence: This plant looks like it's dying. Should we water it more?

synonyms: 奄奄一息 (jim2 jim2 jat1 sik1)

mandarin_meaning: 垂死挣扎 (chuí sǐ zhēng zhá)
english_meaning: to struggle on one's deathbed; to struggle desperately; last-ditch struggle; death throes
explanation_mandarin: 临近死亡时还在挣扎。比喻做最后的、没有希望的挣扎。
explanation_english: A final, desperate struggle before death; figuratively, a futile last-ditch effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司都就嚟執笠㗎啦，佢哋仲喺度垂死掙扎，都冇用㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 dou1 zau6 lai4 zap1 laap1 gaa3 laa1, keoi5 dei6 zung6 hai2 dou6 seoi4 si2 zaang1 zaat3, dou1 mou5 jung6 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司都快倒闭了，他们还在垂死挣扎，都没用了。
examples.english_sentence: The company is about to close down, they're still struggling desperately, but it's all in vain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再垂死掙扎啦，認輸啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 seoi4 si2 zaang1 zaat3 laa1, jing6 syu1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再垂死挣扎了，认输吧！
examples.english_sentence: Stop struggling in vain, just admit defeat!

synonyms: 苟延殘喘 (gau2 jin4 caan4 cyun2)

english_meaning: to drool over; to covet; to salivate (at the sight of something desirable)
explanation_mandarin: 看到或想到美好的事物而非常想要，几乎要流口水。
explanation_english: To greatly desire something, especially food or something attractive, to the point of salivating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我見到嗰件蛋糕，都忍唔住垂涎三尺啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gin3 dou2 go2 gin6 daan6 gou1, dou1 jan2 m4 zyu6 seoi4 jin4 saam1 cek3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我看到那个蛋糕，都忍不住垂涎三尺了！
examples.english_sentence: When I saw that cake, I couldn't help but drool!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲小朋友對櫥窗入面嘅玩具垂涎欲滴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 siu2 pang4 jau5 deoi3 cyu4 coeng1 jap6 min6 ge3 wan2 geoi6 seoi4 jin4 juk6 dik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 孩子们对橱窗里的玩具垂涎欲滴。
examples.english_sentence: The children were drooling over the toys in the shop window.

english_meaning: to drool with envy; to be extremely covetous
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常贪婪或十分羡慕。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is very greedy or extremely envious of something. Literally means 'to drool three feet (long)'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到人哋揸靚車，即刻垂涎三尺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou2 jan4 dei6 zaa1 leng3 che1, jik1 hak1 seoi4 jin4 saam1 chek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到别人开好车，立刻垂涎三尺。
examples.english_sentence: When he saw someone driving a fancy car, he immediately drooled with envy.

english_meaning: to drool with envy; to be extremely envious; mouth-watering
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常想得到或吃到东西，以至于口水都快要流下来了。
explanation_english: Describes being so eager to have or eat something that one's saliva is about to drip.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到隔離枱嗰份牛扒，垂涎欲滴咁款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou2 gaak3 lei4 toi1 go2 fan6 ngau4 paak3, seoi4 jin4 juk6 dik1 gam2 款.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到隔壁桌的那份牛排，看起来垂涎欲滴。
examples.english_sentence: He saw the steak on the next table and looked like he was drooling with envy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間鋪頭啲蛋糕實在太吸引，睇到我都垂涎欲滴啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 pou3 tau4 di1 daan6 gou1 sat6 zoi6 taai3 kap1 jan5, tai2 dou2 ngo5 dou1 seoi4 jin4 juk6 dik1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家店的蛋糕实在太吸引人，看得我都垂涎欲滴啊。
examples.english_sentence: The cakes in that shop are so attractive that they make me drool.

english_meaning: to shed tears, to weep
explanation_mandarin: 流下眼泪。表示悲伤或感动。
explanation_english: To shed tears, indicating sadness or emotion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇到呢幕悲劇，佢忍唔住垂淚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 dou3 ni1 mok6 bei1 kek6, keoi5 jan2 m4住 seoi4 leoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到这一幕悲剧，他忍不住垂泪。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing this tragedy, he couldn't help but shed tears.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽住感人嘅故事，唔少觀眾都垂淚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 zyu6 gam2 jan4 ge3 gu3 si6, m4 siu2 gun1 zung3 dou1 seoi4 leoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听着感人的故事，不少观众都垂泪。
examples.english_sentence: Listening to the touching story, many audience members were shedding tears.

english_meaning: vertical; perpendicular
explanation_mandarin: 指与水平面或基线成直角的状态。
explanation_english: Relating to or being at right angles (90°) to a horizontal plane or line; upright; perpendicular.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幅畫唔係垂直掛喺牆上面，睇起嚟好唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fuk1 waa2 m4 hai6 seoi4 zik6 gwaa3 hai2 coeng4 soeng6 min6, tai2 hei2 lai4 hou2 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这幅画没有垂直地挂在墙上，看起来很不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: This painting is not hanging vertically on the wall; it looks very uncomfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 確保支柱係垂直，先好繼續起嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kok3 bou2 zi1 cyu5 hai6 seoi4 zik6, sin1 hou2 gai3 zuk6 hei2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 确保支柱是垂直的，才能继续建造。
examples.english_sentence: Make sure the pillar is vertical before you continue building.

english_meaning: to listen respectfully (used when the speaker is in a lower position than the listener)
explanation_mandarin: 恭敬地听取，通常用于下级对上级，或者表示谦卑。
explanation_english: To listen respectfully; typically used by a subordinate to a superior or to express humility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一定會仔細垂聽你嘅意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 wui5 zai2 sai3 seoi4 ting1 nei5 ge3 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一定会仔细倾听您的意见。
examples.english_sentence: We will definitely listen to your opinions carefully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝各位撥冗垂聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 gok3 wai2 but6 yung2 seoi4 ting1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 感谢各位抽出时间倾听。
examples.english_sentence: Thank you all for taking the time to listen.

english_meaning: to inquire; to ask (formal)
explanation_mandarin: 敬辞，询问。用于书面语或正式场合，表示对方的询问是对自己的尊重。
explanation_english: A polite expression meaning 'to inquire' or 'to ask'. It is used in written or formal contexts to show respect to the person asking the question.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如有任何疑問，歡迎隨時垂詢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gu2 jau5 jam6 ho2 ji5 man6, fun1 jing4 ceoi4 si4 seoi4 seon1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如有任何疑问，欢迎随时垂询。
examples.english_sentence: If you have any questions, please feel free to inquire at any time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 歡迎致電垂詢詳情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fun1 jing4 zi3 din6 seoi4 seon1 coeng4 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 欢迎致电垂询详情。
examples.english_sentence: You are welcome to call to inquire about the details.

english_meaning: fishing, angling
explanation_mandarin: 用钓竿钓鱼。
explanation_english: To fish with a rod and line; angling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋星期日成日去海邊垂釣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing1 kei4 jat6 sing4 jat6 heoi3 hoi2 bin1 seoi4 diu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们星期日经常去海边钓鱼。
examples.english_sentence: They often go fishing at the seaside on Sundays.

english_meaning: to favour; to think highly of; to pay attention to (usually used of superiors showing appreciation to inferiors)
explanation_mandarin: 指上级对下级的重视或赏识。
explanation_english: Refers to a superior's attention to or appreciation of a subordinate. It implies the superior thinking highly of the inferior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多謝你哋公司垂青，畀機會我嚟面試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 ze6 nei5 dei6 gung1 si1 seoi4 cing1, bei2 gei1 wui2 ngo5 lai4 min6 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 非常感谢贵公司垂青，给我机会来面试。
examples.english_sentence: Thank you very much for your company's favour, giving me the opportunity to come for an interview.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 承蒙垂青，我會努力做好呢份工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 mung4 seoi4 cing1, ngo5 wui5 nu5 lik6 zou2 hou2 ni1 fan6 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 承蒙您的赏识，我会努力做好这份工作。
examples.english_sentence: Thank you for your favour, I will work hard to do this job well.

english_meaning: dejected, crestfallen, dispirited, downcast
explanation_mandarin: 形容因失败或不如意而情绪低落，精神不振的样子。
explanation_english: Describes a state of being dejected, dispirited, or downcast due to failure, disappointment, or something undesirable. It suggests a lack of energy and enthusiasm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試唔合格，成日都垂頭喪氣噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 m4 hap6 gaak3, seng4 jat6 dou1 seoi4 tau4 song3 hei3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试没及格，整天都垂头丧气的。
examples.english_sentence: He failed the exam and has been dejected all day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使咁垂頭喪氣嘅，下次努力啲咪得囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 gam3 seoi4 tau4 song3 hei3 ge3, haa6 ci3 nu5 lik6 di1 mai1 dak1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用那么垂头丧气的，下次努力点不就行了吗。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so downcast, just try harder next time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 球隊輸咗場波，個個都垂頭喪氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kau4 deoi2 syu1 zo2 coeng4 bo1, go3 go3 dou1 seoi4 tau4 song3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 球队输了比赛，每个人都垂头丧气的。
examples.english_sentence: The team lost the game, and everyone is dejected.
