examples.jyutping_sentence: waa1! ni1 fan6 gung1 gam3 seon2, zan1 hai6 zaap1 dou2 dou1 haam3 saam1 seng1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哇！这份工作这么好，真是捡到宝一样高兴啊！
examples.english_sentence: Wow! This job is so great, it's like winning the lottery!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 估唔到佢竟然肯咁平賣俾我，真係執到都喊三聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 m4 dou2 keoi5 ging2 jin4 hang2 gam3 peng4 maai6 bei2 ngo5, zan1 hai6 zaap1 dou2 dou1 haam3 saam1 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没想到他竟然肯这么便宜卖给我，真是捡到宝一样高兴。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't expect him to sell it to me so cheaply, I'm really thrilled.

english_meaning: to be on duty, to perform one's duty
explanation_mandarin: 指履行职责，执行任务，多用于警察、消防员等需要轮班工作的人。
explanation_english: Refers to performing one's duties, often used for professions like police officers, firefighters, etc., who work in shifts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今晚要執勤，唔可以同我哋食飯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 maan1 jiu3 zap1 kan4, m4 ho2 ji5 tung4 ngo5 dei6 sik6 faan6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今晚要值班，不能和我们吃饭了。
examples.english_sentence: He has to be on duty tonight, he can't have dinner with us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察執勤嘅時候要時刻保持警惕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 zap1 kan4 ge3 si4 hau6 jiu3 si4 hak1 bou2 ci4 ging2 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察值勤的时候要时刻保持警惕。
examples.english_sentence: Police officers must remain vigilant when on duty.

english_meaning: To pack one's bags; to pack up and leave (often implying being forced to leave a job or residence); to prepare for departure
explanation_mandarin: 原本指收拾行李准备离开，现在多引申为被解雇或被迫离开某个地方。
explanation_english: Originally meaning to pack one's bags in preparation for leaving, it now more often refers to being fired or forced to leave a place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢炒咗魷魚，要執包袱走人喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 caau2 zo2 jau4 jyu2, jiu3 zaap1 baau1 fu6 zau2 jan4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被解雇了，要收拾行李走人了。
examples.english_sentence: He got fired, he has to pack his bags and leave.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司執笠，我哋全部都要執包袱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 zaap1 laap1, ngo5 dei6 cyun4 bou6 dou1 jiu3 zaap1 baau1 fu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司倒闭了，我们全部都要收拾东西走人。
examples.english_sentence: The company went bankrupt, we all have to pack up and leave.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日就搬屋，我今日要開始執包袱啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 zau6 bun1 uk1, ngo5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 hoi1 ci2 zaap1 baau1 fu6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天就搬家了，我今天就要开始收拾东西了。
examples.english_sentence: I'm moving tomorrow, I have to start packing today.

english_meaning: to tidy up things, to pack up things
explanation_mandarin: 整理东西，收拾行李。
explanation_english: To tidy up, pack, or organize things. It can refer to general tidying or packing luggage for travel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要去旅行，要執嘢喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 leoi5 haang4, jiu3 zap1 je5 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要去旅行，要收拾东西了。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going on a trip tomorrow, so I need to pack.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 執嘢啦！唔好咁懶啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zap1 je5 laa3! m4 hou2 gam3 laan5 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 收拾东西啦！别这么懒！
examples.english_sentence: Tidy up! Don't be so lazy!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢執嘢好快手㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zap1 je5 hou2 faai3 sau2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他收拾东西很快的。
examples.english_sentence: He packs things up very quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 收拾东西; 收拾行李
english_meaning: to pack; to pack belongings; to tidy up belongings for moving
explanation_mandarin: 收拾东西准备离开。通常指收拾行李或整理个人物品。
explanation_english: To pack up belongings, especially for moving or leaving a place. Usually refers to packing luggage or tidying up personal items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日就搬走喇，而家要開始執地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 zau6 bun1 zau2 laa3, ji4 gaa1 jiu3 hoi1 chi2 zaap1 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天就搬走了，现在要开始收拾东西。
examples.english_sentence: I'm moving out tomorrow, so I need to start packing now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 執地嘅時候先發現原來咁多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zaap1 dei6 ge3 si4 hau6 sin1 faat3 yin6 jyun4 loi4 gam3 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 收拾东西的时候才发现原来这么多东西。
examples.english_sentence: Only when I started packing did I realize I have so much stuff.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽叫我執地，準備返鄉下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 giu3 ngo5 zaap1 dei6, zeon2 bei6 faan1 hoeng1 haa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈叫我收拾行李，准备回老家。
examples.english_sentence: Mom told me to pack my bags, preparing to go back to our hometown.

english_meaning: To pick up cheap things; to find a bargain; to scavenge for good deals
explanation_mandarin: 捡取一些价廉物美的物品，或者占一些小便宜。
explanation_english: To find and acquire items at a very low price; to scavenge or hunt for bargains.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都去深水埗執地仔，買啲平嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 heoi3 sam1 seoi2 bou2 zaap1 dei6 zai2, maai5 di1 peng4 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是去深水埗捡便宜货，买一些便宜的东西。
examples.english_sentence: He always goes to Sham Shui Po to find bargains and buy cheap things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺二手市場執到個好新淨嘅喇叭，真係執到寶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 ji5 sau2 si5 coeng4 zaap1 dou2 go3 hou2 san1 zeng6 ge3 laa3 baa1, zan1 hai6 zaap1 dou2 bou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在二手市场捡到一个很新的喇叭，真是捡到宝了。
examples.english_sentence: I found a very new speaker at the second-hand market, I really found a treasure.

english_meaning: Another serving; Another round (of something, often negative)
explanation_mandarin: 指再来一份，通常用于不好的事物，比如遇到倒霉事，或者被惩罚等。
explanation_english: To have another serving or round of something, often used in a negative context, implying more bad luck, punishment, or undesirable experiences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先畀老細鬧完，依家又要OT，真係執多劑呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 bei2 lou5 sai3 nau6 jyun4, ji1 gaa1 jau6 jiu3 OT, zan1 hai6 zaap1 do1 zai1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才被老板骂了，现在又要加班，真是雪上加霜！
examples.english_sentence: I just got scolded by the boss, and now I have to work overtime again. It's just another hit!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 衰咗一次唔夠，仲想執多劑？
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 zo2 jat1 ci3 m4 gau3, zung2 soeng2 zaap1 do1 zai1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 失败一次还不够，还想再来一次（失败）？
examples.english_sentence: One failure isn't enough? You want another go at it (and probably fail again)?

english_meaning: Executive Committee (EC)
explanation_mandarin: 执行委员会，负责执行机构的决策和日常运作。
explanation_english: Executive Committee, responsible for executing the decisions and daily operations of an organization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係學生會嘅執委。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 hok6 sang1 wui2 ge3 zap1 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是学生会的执行委员会成员。
examples.english_sentence: He is a member of the Executive Committee of the student union.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 執委會開咗個會嚟討論下年嘅計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zap1 wai2 wui2 hoi1 zo2 go3 wui2 lai4 tou2 leon6 haa6 nin4 ge3 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 执行委员会开了一个会来讨论明年的计划。
examples.english_sentence: The Executive Committee held a meeting to discuss next year's plan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住選執委，想服務大家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 zyu6 syun2 zap1 wai2, soeng2 fuk6 mou6 daai6 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想竞选执行委员会成员，想为大家服务。
examples.english_sentence: I'm planning to run for the Executive Committee, I want to serve everyone.

mandarin_meaning: 收拾东西的人；清洁工 (非正式)
english_meaning: Cleaner; Janitor; person who cleans up (informal)
explanation_mandarin: 非正式用语，指负责清洁、整理的人员。 通常指在公司，学校，或公共场所负责清洁的人。
explanation_english: Informal term for a person who is responsible for cleaning and tidying up. Usually refers to people who clean in companies, schools, or public places; cleaner; janitor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司個執媽好勤力㗎，日日都抹到乾乾淨淨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 go3 zaap1 maa1 hou2 kan4 lik6 gaa3, jat1 jat1 dou1 mut3 dou3 gon1 gon1 zing6 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司的清洁工很勤劳，每天都擦得干干净净。
examples.english_sentence: Our company's cleaner is very diligent, cleaning everything spotless every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放工之後，執媽會將啲枱櫈抹乾淨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 gung1 zi1 hau6, zaap1 maa1 wui5 zoeng1 di1 toi2 dang3 mut3 gon1 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下班之后，清洁工会把桌椅擦干净。
examples.english_sentence: After work, the cleaner will wipe the tables and chairs clean.

english_meaning: to proofread, to typeset
explanation_mandarin: 原指印刷工人捡起一个个铅字进行排版。现在泛指校对文字，查找并改正错误。
explanation_english: Originally, it referred to typesetters picking up individual lead letters for typesetting. Now, it generally refers to proofreading text, finding and correcting errors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幫我執下字粒，睇下有冇錯字。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bong1 ngo5 zap1 haa5 zi6 lap1, tai2 haa5 jau5 mou5 co3 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 帮我校对一下，看看有没有错别字。
examples.english_sentence: Help me proofread and see if there are any typos.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇文執完字粒之後，就可以攞去印啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 man1 zap1 jyun4 zi6 lap1 zi1 hau6, zau6 ho2 ji5 lo2 heoi3 jan3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这篇文章校对完之后，就可以拿去印刷了。
examples.english_sentence: After proofreading this article, we can take it to print.

english_meaning: to direct (a film, play, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指导拍摄电影、电视剧、戏剧等。
explanation_english: To direct a film, television series, play, etc.  It refers to the act of overseeing and guiding the production of a performance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係呢套戲嘅執導。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ni1 tou3 hei3 ge3 zaap1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是这部电影的导演。
examples.english_sentence: He is the director of this movie.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 邊個執導呢套電視劇呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: bin1 go3 zaap1 dou6 ni1 tou3 din6 si6 kek6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谁导演这部电视剧啊？
examples.english_sentence: Who directed this TV series?

english_meaning: to tidy up the house; to clean the house; to do housework
explanation_mandarin: 整理和清洁房屋，使之变得整洁。
explanation_english: To tidy up and clean the house, making it neat and organized. It involves putting things away and cleaning surfaces.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今個星期六要執屋呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 go3 sing1 kei4 luk6 jiu3 zaap1 uk1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们这个星期六要收拾房子啊。
examples.english_sentence: We have to tidy up the house this Saturday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 執屋好攰㗎，但係執完又好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zaap1 uk1 hou2 gui6 gaa3, daan6 hai6 zaap1 jyun4 jau6 hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 收拾房子很累的，但是收拾完又很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: Tidying up the house is tiring, but it feels good after finishing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋咁亂，快啲執屋啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 gam3 lyun6, faai3 di1 zaap1 uk1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房子这么乱，快点收拾房子啦！
examples.english_sentence: The house is so messy, hurry up and tidy it up!

english_meaning: to pick up (someone who is drunk or unconscious); to scavenge a drunk person (for sexual purposes); to salvage a corpse (less common, literal meaning)
explanation_mandarin: 指在夜店或其他娱乐场所，将喝醉或意识不清的人带走，通常带有性暗示。另一种较少见的含义是字面意义上的捡拾尸体。
explanation_english: This term primarily refers to picking up someone who is heavily intoxicated or unconscious, usually in nightclubs or other entertainment venues, often with sexual connotations. A less common meaning is literally to pick up a corpse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢尋晚喺蘭桂坊執咗條屍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cam4 maan1 hai2 laan4 gwai3 fong1 zaap1 zo2 tiu4 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨晚在兰桂坊捡了一个醉鬼。
examples.english_sentence: He picked up a drunk person in Lan Kwai Fong last night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好飲咁多啦，費事俾人執屍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 yam2 gam3 do1 laa1, fai3 si6 bei2 jan4 zaap1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要喝那么多，免得被人捡尸。
examples.english_sentence: Don't drink so much, or you might get picked up by someone (when you're drunk).

mandarin_meaning: 捡大便；比喻收拾烂摊子
english_meaning: To pick up poop; (figurative) to clean up a mess, to deal with the aftermath (of someone else's mistake)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思为捡拾粪便。引申义为收拾残局，处理别人留下的烂摊子。 多为贬义。
explanation_english: Literally means to pick up poop. Figuratively, it means to clean up a mess, especially a mess left by someone else. Often used in a negative or complaining tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唉，今次又要我執屎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ai1, gam1 ci3 jau6 jiu3 ngo5 zap1 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 唉，这次又要我收拾烂摊子。
examples.english_sentence: Sigh, I have to clean up the mess again this time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日搞搞震，次次都係我幫佢執屎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gaau2 gaau2 zan3, ci3 ci3 dou1 hai6 ngo5 bong1 keoi5 zap1 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是惹麻烦，每次都是我帮他收拾烂摊子。
examples.english_sentence: He's always causing trouble, and I'm always the one cleaning up his messes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆走咗之後，啲文件亂晒，我要執屎執到幾時啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: laau5 baan2 zau2 zo2 zi1 hau6, di1 man4 gin2 lyun6晒, ngo5 jiu3 zap1 si2 zap1 dou3 gei2 si4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板走了之后，文件都乱了，我要收拾到什么时候啊？
examples.english_sentence: After the boss left, all the documents are in a mess. How long will I have to clean up?

english_meaning: to hunt for bargains, to look for cheap deals
explanation_mandarin: 指寻找和购买价格低廉的商品。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of searching for and buying cheap goods or deals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日去咗女人街執平嘢，買咗好多衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 heoi3 zo2 neoi5 yan2 gaai1 zaap1 peng4 je5, maai5 zo2 ho2 do1 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天去了女人街捡便宜货，买了很多衣服。
examples.english_sentence: I went to Ladies' Market to hunt for bargains today and bought a lot of clothes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都執平嘢，屋企擺滿晒平嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 zaap1 peng4 je5, uk1 kei2 baai2 mun5 saai3 peng4 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是捡便宜货，家里摆满了便宜货。
examples.english_sentence: He always hunts for bargains, and his house is full of cheap things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家網上執平嘢都好方便，唔使出街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 mong5 soeng6 zaap1 peng4 je5 dou1 hou2 faan1 bin6, m4 sai2 ceot1 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在网上捡便宜货也很方便，不用出门。
examples.english_sentence: It's very convenient to hunt for bargains online nowadays, you don't even need to go out.

english_meaning: obsession, fixation, strong attachment
explanation_mandarin: 指对某件事或某个人过分迷恋，难以释怀，放不下。
explanation_english: Refers to an excessive obsession with something or someone, making it difficult to let go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對舊時嘅嘢有好深嘅執念，成日都掛住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 gau6 si4 ge3 je5 jau5 hou2 sam1 ge3 zap1 nim6, seng4 jat6 dou1 gwaa3 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对过去的事情有很深的执念，总是挂念着。
examples.english_sentence: He has a deep obsession with the past and is always thinking about it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁有執念啦，放下佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 jau5 zap1 nim6 laa1, fong3 haa5 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么执念了，放下他吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so obsessed, let him go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對贏呢場比賽好有執念。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 wing4 ni1 coeng4 bei2 coi3 hou2 jau5 zap1 nim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对于赢得这场比赛很有执念。
examples.english_sentence: He's obsessed with winning this competition.

english_meaning: To pick up a bargain; to take advantage of a situation; to scavenge; to be opportunistic
explanation_mandarin: 指捡拾便宜的东西，或利用机会占便宜。
explanation_english: Refers to picking up cheap or discounted items, or taking advantage of a situation to gain an advantage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日去街市執怪，買啲就嚟過期嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 heoi3 gaai1 si5 zaap1 gwaai3, maai5 di1 zau6 lai4 gwo3 kei5 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常去菜市场捡便宜，买一些快要过期的东西。
examples.english_sentence: He often goes to the market to pick up bargains, buying things that are about to expire.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗住可以執怪，人哋唔係傻嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 ho2 ji5 zaap1 gwaai3, jan4 dei6 m4 hai6 so2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要想着可以占便宜，别人也不是傻的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can take advantage of others; they're not stupid.

english_meaning: insist on; be determined to; persist in
explanation_mandarin: 坚持自己的意见或主张，不肯改变。
explanation_english: To stubbornly insist on one's own opinion or course of action; to be determined to do something despite advice or opposition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢執意要去嗰度，我哋點勸都冇用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zaap1 ji3 jiu3 heoi3 go2 dou6, ngo5 dei6 dim2 hyun3 dou1 mou5 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他执意要去那里，我们怎么劝都没用。
examples.english_sentence: He insists on going there, no matter how much we try to persuade him, it's no use.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽執意要我讀醫，但我對醫科冇興趣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 zaap1 ji3 jiu3 ngo5 duk6 yi1, daan6 ngo5 deoi3 yi1 fo1 mou5 hing3 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈执意要我学医，但是我对医学没有兴趣。
examples.english_sentence: My mother insists that I study medicine, but I have no interest in it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然大家都反對，佢都執意要做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 daai6 gaa1 dou1 faan2 deoi3, keoi5 dou1 zaap1 ji3 jiu3 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然大家都反对，他还是执意要做。
examples.english_sentence: Even though everyone is against it, he still insists on doing it.

mandarin_meaning: 整理房间, 打扫房间
english_meaning: to tidy up a room, to clean a room, to make a room neat
explanation_mandarin: 整理房间，使之变得整洁干净。
explanation_english: To tidy up a room, making it neat and clean.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽叫我執房，唔好咁邋遢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 giu3 ngo5 zaap1 fong2, m4 hou2 gam3 laat6 taat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈叫我整理房间，不要这么邋遢。
examples.english_sentence: Mom told me to tidy up my room, don't be so messy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我每個星期六都會執房。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mui5 go3 sing1 kei4 luk6 dou1 wui5 zaap1 fong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每个星期六都会整理房间。
examples.english_sentence: I tidy up my room every Saturday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 酒店嘅清潔阿姐幫我哋執房。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ziu2 dim3 ge3 cing1 git3 aa3 ze2 bong1 ngo5 dei6 zaap1 fong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 酒店的清洁阿姨帮我们整理房间。
examples.english_sentence: The hotel cleaning lady tidied up our room.

synonyms: 收拾房間 (sau1 sap6 fong4 gaan1)
整理房間 (zeng2 lei5 fong4 gaan1)

mandarin_meaning: 善后, 收尾, 处理烂摊子
english_meaning: To clean up after someone; to clear up a mess; to tidy up loose ends; to deal with the aftermath
explanation_mandarin: 指收拾残局，处理别人遗留下来的问题或麻烦。
explanation_english: Refers to cleaning up the mess, handling the problems or troubles left behind by others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都唔做嘢，要我幫佢執手尾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 m4 zou6 je5, jiu3 ngo5 bong1 keoi5 zaap1 sau2 mei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是不做事，要我帮他善后。
examples.english_sentence: He never does anything, I always have to clean up after him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次單嘢咁大鑊，唔知邊個要執手尾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 daan1 je5 gam3 daai6 wok6, m4 zi1 bin1 go3 jiu3 zaap1 sau2 mei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的事情这么严重，不知道谁要来收拾烂摊子。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is so serious, I wonder who will have to clean up the mess.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該你執手尾執乾淨啲，唔好留低手尾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 nei5 zaap1 sau2 mei1 zaap1 gon1 zing6 di1, m4 hou2 lau4 dai1 sau2 mei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦你把善后工作做好，不要留下后患。
examples.english_sentence: Please clean up the mess properly, don't leave any loose ends.

synonyms: 收拾殘局 (sau1 sip3 caan4 guk6)

mandarin_meaning: 固执; 倔强; 顽固
english_meaning: stubborn; obstinate; persistent
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人坚持己见，不听劝告，非常固执。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is stubborn, insistent on their own opinion, and unwilling to listen to advice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好執拗，講極都唔聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 zap1 ngaau6, gong2 gik1 dou1 m4 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很固执，怎么说都不听。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very stubborn person, he doesn't listen no matter what you say.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁執拗啦，聽下人哋嘅意見都好呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 zap1 ngaau6 laa1, teng1 haa5 jan4 dei6 ge3 ji3 gin3 dou1 hou2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么固执了，听听别人的意见也好啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stubborn, it's good to listen to other people's opinions too.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋拗唔過佢，佢真係太執拗喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 aau3 m4 gwo3 keoi5, keoi5 zan1 hai6 taai3 zap1 ngaau6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们说不过他，他真是太固执了。
examples.english_sentence: We can't argue with him, he's really too stubborn.

english_meaning: to tidy up; to pack up; to put away
explanation_mandarin: 整理、收拾物品。
explanation_english: To tidy up, organize, pack, or put away items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 執拾好啲嘢，我哋準備出門口啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zaap1 sap6 hou2 di1 je5, ngo5 dei6 zeon2 bei6 chut1 mun4 hau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 收拾好东西，我们准备出门了。
examples.english_sentence: Tidy up your things, we're getting ready to leave.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都執拾屋企，好乾淨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 jat1 dou1 zaap1 sap6 uk1 kei2, hou2 gon1 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都收拾家里，很干净。
examples.english_sentence: He tidies up the house every day, it's very clean.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要執拾行李去旅行啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zaap1 sap6 hang4 lei5 heoi3 leoi5 hang4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要收拾行李去旅行了。
examples.english_sentence: We need to pack our luggage to go on a trip.

english_meaning: to be in charge of, to manage, to administer, to control
explanation_mandarin: 管理，主管，负责某项事务或权力。
explanation_english: To be in charge of, manage, or administer a certain affair or power.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家執掌成間公司嘅運作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 zap1 zoeng2 sing4 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 wan6 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在掌管着整个公司的运作。
examples.english_sentence: He is now in charge of the entire company's operations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢被委任執掌新嘅部門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei6 wai2 jam3 zap1 zoeng2 san1 ge3 bou6 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被委任负责新的部门。
examples.english_sentence: He was appointed to manage the new department.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 邊個執掌呢個項目啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: bin1 go3 zap1 zoeng2 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谁负责这个项目啊？
examples.english_sentence: Who is in charge of this project?

english_meaning: to be in power, to rule, to govern, in office (of a government)
explanation_mandarin: 指掌握政权，管理国家事务。
explanation_english: Refers to holding political power and managing state affairs; to be the governing power.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家嗰個黨執政。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 go2 go3 dong2 zap1 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在是那个党执政。
examples.english_sentence: That party is in power now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 執政嘅時候，一定要為人民服務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zap1 zing3 ge3 si4 hau6, jat1 ding6 jiu3 wai6 jan4 man4 fuk6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 执政的时候，一定要为人民服务。
examples.english_sentence: When in power, one must serve the people.

mandarin_meaning: 执教, 从事教师职业
english_meaning: to teach, to hold the teaching whip (literally), to be a teacher
explanation_mandarin: “执教鞭”字面意思是拿起教鞭，引申意义为从事教师的职业，当老师。
explanation_english: "執教鞭" literally means to hold the teaching whip. It is an idiom meaning to teach or to be a teacher, engaging in the teaching profession.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 李先生執教鞭已經三十年，經驗好豐富㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lei5 sin1 saang1 zap1 gaau3 bin1 ji5 ging1 saam1 sap6 nin4, ging1 jim6 hou2 fung1 fu3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 李先生执教已经三十年了，经验非常丰富。
examples.english_sentence: Mr. Lee has been teaching for thirty years, he has a lot of experience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢大學畢業之後就決定執教鞭，想教化下一代。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daai6 hok6 bat1 jip6 zi1 hau6 zau6 kyut3 ding6 zap1 gaau3 bin1, soeng2 gaau3 faa3 haa6 jat1 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他大学毕业之后就决定当老师，想教育下一代。
examples.english_sentence: After graduating from university, he decided to become a teacher, wanting to educate the next generation.

english_meaning: to teach, to lecture; to be a teacher
explanation_mandarin: 从事教育工作，担任教师。
explanation_english: To engage in teaching work; to serve as a teacher.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 李老師喺呢間學校執教咗十年喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lei5 lou5 si1 hai2 ni1 gaan1 hok6 haau6 zap1 gaau3 zo2 sap6 nin4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 李老师在这间学校执教十年了。
examples.english_sentence: Mr. Li has been teaching at this school for ten years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將來嘅理想係做個好嘅老師，可以執教鞭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 loi4 ge3 lei5 soeng2 hai6 zou6 go3 hou2 ge3 lou5 si1, ho2 ji5 zap1 gaau3 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他将来的理想是做一个好老师，可以执教。
examples.english_sentence: His future ideal is to be a good teacher and be able to teach.

english_meaning: to teach, to be a teacher (literally: to hold the teaching whip)
explanation_mandarin: 指从事教师职业，担任教职。 比喻开始或继续教学工作。
explanation_english: Refers to engaging in the teaching profession, holding a teaching position. Figuratively, it means to start or continue teaching work. The term originates from the imagery of a teacher holding a pointer or disciplinary tool (though the 'whip' aspect is largely historical).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 李老師畢業之後就開始執教鞭啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lei5 lou5 si1 bat1 jip6 zi1 hau6 zau6 hoi1 chi2 zap1 gaau3 bin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 李老师毕业之后就开始执教了。
examples.english_sentence: After graduation, Teacher Li started teaching.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一直都好想執教鞭，培育下一代。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 zik6 dou1 hou2 soeng2 zap1 gaau3 bin1, pui4 juk6 haa6 jat1 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一直都很想执教，培育下一代。
examples.english_sentence: He has always wanted to teach and nurture the next generation.

jyutping: zap1 tiu4 mat6 daai2 leoi6 san1 gaa1
mandarin_meaning: 捡根袜子带，拖累全家；因小失大，贪小便宜吃大亏
english_meaning: Picking up a sock strap leads to the ruin of the whole family; penny-wise, pound-foolish; trying to save a small amount but losing a large amount.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻为了贪图小便宜，最终导致更大的损失，甚至倾家荡产。形容因小失大。
explanation_english: An idiom that describes the situation where someone tries to save a small amount of money or gain a small advantage but ends up losing a much larger amount as a result, potentially leading to financial ruin. It emphasizes the importance of considering the long-term consequences of actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 貪埋啲免費嘢，結果畀人呃咗成筆錢，真係執條襪帶累身家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taam1 maai4 di1 min5 fai3 je5, git3 gwo2 bei2 jan4 aak1 zo2 seng4 bat1 cin2, zan1 hai6 zap1 tiu4 mat6 daai2 leoi6 san1 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 贪图那些免费的东西，结果被人骗了一大笔钱，真是捡根袜子带，拖累全家。
examples.english_sentence: By being greedy for free things, he ended up being scammed out of a large sum of money. It's a classic case of picking up a sock strap and ruining the family fortune.

jyutping: zap1 tiu4 mat6 daai2, leoi6 fu3 san1 gaa1
mandarin_meaning: 因小失大，因小错铸成大错
english_meaning: Penny wise, pound foolish; to lose a fortune over a trifle; to jeopardize everything for a small thing.
explanation_mandarin: 为了捡起一根袜子带，结果损失了全部家当。比喻为了小利而招致巨大的损失。
explanation_english: Literally, to pick up a sock strap but lose the entire family fortune. This idiom describes a situation where someone focuses on saving a small amount of money or effort, only to suffer a much larger loss as a result.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗慳幾蚊泊車費，亂咁泊車俾人抄牌，真係執條襪帶，累副身家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 haan1 gei2 man1 paak3 ce1 fai3, lyun6 gam2 paak3 ce1 bei2 jan4 caau1 paai4, zan1 hai6 zap1 tiu4 mat6 daai2, leoi6 fu3 san1 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为了省几块钱的停车费，乱停车被开罚单，真是因小失大。
examples.english_sentence: He parked his car illegally to save a few dollars on parking fees and ended up getting a parking ticket. It's a classic case of penny wise, pound foolish.

english_meaning: to practice (a profession); to be in practice (of a profession)
explanation_mandarin: 开始从事某种专业性工作，如医生、律师等。
explanation_english: To engage in the practice of a profession, such as medicine, law, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺律師樓執業已經五年喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 leot6 si1 lau2 zap1 jip6 ji5 ging1 ng5 nin4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在律师事务所执业已经五年了。
examples.english_sentence: He has been practicing law at the law firm for five years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生執業前要考牌㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yi1 sang1 zap1 jip6 cin4 jiu3 haau2 paai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生执业前需要考取执照。
examples.english_sentence: Doctors need to pass an exam to get a license before practicing medicine.

english_meaning: to rectify; to correct; to take seriously; to be conscientious
explanation_mandarin: 纠正错误；认真执行；认真对待事情，避免出错。
explanation_english: To rectify an error or mistake; to carry out duties meticulously; to take things seriously to avoid errors; to be conscientious and do things properly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好執正㗎，唔會馬虎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 zap1 zeng3 gaa3, m4 wui5 maa5 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作很认真的，不会马虎。
examples.english_sentence: He is very conscientious at work and won't be careless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細叫我哋執正啲文件先交上去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 giu3 ngo5 dei6 zap1 zeng3 di1 man4 gin2 sin1 gaau1 soeng5 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板叫我们把文件整理好再交上去。
examples.english_sentence: The boss told us to rectify the documents before submitting them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你執正啲嚟做啦，唔好是是但但。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zap1 zeng3 di1 lai4 zou6 laa1, m4 hou2 si6 si6 daan6 daan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你认真点做吧，不要随便应付。
examples.english_sentence: Do it properly, don't be careless.

english_meaning: Be more serious; be more strict; do it properly; do it correctly; straighten up; pay attention to detail
explanation_mandarin: 要求对方更加认真、严格地执行某事，或改正错误，做得更规范。
explanation_english: Used to urge someone to be more serious, strict, or correct in their actions. It can also mean to rectify an error or to do something in a more proper or standard way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你份報告寫得太馬虎喇，執正啲先交啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dak1 taai3 maa5 fu2 laa3, zap1 zing3 di1 sin1 gaau1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的报告写得太马虎了，认真点再交吧。
examples.english_sentence: Your report is too sloppy; do it properly before submitting it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲貨擺到亂晒籠，執正啲佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 fo3 baai2 dou3 lyun6 saai3 lung4, zap1 zing3 di1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 货物摆得很乱，整理一下。
examples.english_sentence: The goods are all messed up; straighten them up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日老闆會嚟巡視，大家執正啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 lou5 baan2 wui5 lai4 ceon4 si3, daai6 gaa1 zap1 zing3 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天老板会来视察，大家认真点。
examples.english_sentence: The boss will be inspecting tomorrow, everyone be more serious.

mandarin_meaning: 捡便宜; 捡漏; 侥幸获得
english_meaning: To pick up an easy win; to benefit from someone else's misfortune or mistake; to get lucky; to profit from a loophole or opportunity.
explanation_mandarin: 原本指的是捡到死鸡，现在比喻不费力气，侥幸得到好处，或是因为别人出错而获得利益。
explanation_english: Originally referring to picking up a dead chicken, now it metaphorically means to gain an advantage or benefit easily, often due to someone else's mistake or misfortune, or by capitalizing on an unforeseen opportunity. It often implies a degree of luck and minimal effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋爭到你死我活，點知最後俾隔離部門執死雞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zaang1 dou3 nei5 sei2 ngo5 wut6, dim2 zi1 zeoi3 hau6 bei2 gaak3 lei4 bou6 mun4 zaap1 sei2 gai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们争得你死我活的，谁知最后被隔壁部门捡了便宜。
examples.english_sentence: They were fighting tooth and nail, but in the end, the department next door got an easy win.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試我差啲唔合格，好彩老師手鬆，執死雞合格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ngo5 caa1 di1 m4 hap6 gaak3, hou2 coi2 lou5 si1 sau2 sung1, zaap1 sei2 gai1 hap6 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我差点没及格，幸好老师手松，侥幸及格了。
examples.english_sentence: I almost failed this exam, but luckily the teacher was lenient, and I scraped through.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 股票跌到咁，佢就趁低吸納，執死雞賺一筆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 piu3 dit3 dou3 gam3, keoi5 zau6 can3 dai1 kap1 naap6, zaap1 sei2 gai1 zaan6 jat1 bat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 股票跌得这么厉害，他就趁低吸纳，捡了个便宜赚了一笔。
examples.english_sentence: The stock market crashed, so he bought in at a low price and made a killing.

english_meaning: To pick up the pieces; to capitalize on someone else's misfortune; to get something easily because someone else failed or gave up
explanation_mandarin: 比喻在别人失败或放弃后轻易得到好处或便宜。
explanation_english: An idiom that describes getting something easily or capitalizing on a situation where someone else has failed, given up, or made a mistake. It literally translates to 'picking up a dead chicken'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢放棄咗份合約，而家咪俾你執死雞仔囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fong3 hei3 zo2 fan6 hap6 joek3, ji4 gaa1 mai1 bei2 nei5 zaap1 sei2 gai1 zai2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他放弃了那份合同，现在不就是让你捡漏了吗？
examples.english_sentence: He gave up the contract, so now you're getting it easily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋唔做，咁咪俾我哋執死雞仔囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 m4 zou6, gam2 mai1 bei2 ngo5 dei6 zaap1 sei2 gai1 zai2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们不做，那不就给我们捡漏了吗？
examples.english_sentence: They're not doing it, so it's our chance to pick up the pieces.

synonyms: 搭順風車 (daap3 seon6 fung1 ce1)

english_meaning: To take advantage of a lucky situation; to win or succeed through sheer luck or someone else's misfortune; to profit from an unexpected opportunity.
explanation_mandarin: 原本是赌博术语，指在赌局中，已经不可能赢的情况下，由于其他人的失误，最后反而侥幸获胜。现在泛指抓住机会，在别人失败或犯错的情况下，自己获利或成功。
explanation_english: Originally a gambling term referring to winning in a situation where winning was practically impossible due to others' mistakes. Now, it generally refers to seizing an opportunity and profiting or succeeding because of someone else's failure or error.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次考試執死鷄，本身唔識㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 zap1 sei2 gai1, bun2 san1 m4 sik1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次考试捡了个便宜，他本来不会的。
examples.english_sentence: He got lucky on this exam; he didn't actually know the material.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司執死鷄，競爭對手破產，佢哋就攞到個大project。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 zap1 sei2 gai1, ging6 zang1 deoi3 sau2 po3 saan2, keoi5 dei6 zau6 lo2 dou2 go3 daai6 project.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司捡了个便宜，竞争对手破产了，他们就拿到了那个大项目。
examples.english_sentence: Their company got lucky; their competitor went bankrupt, and they got the big project.

english_meaning: to pick up a bargain; to get something for almost nothing; to take advantage of someone else's misfortune
explanation_mandarin: 比喻捡到便宜货，或占别人便宜。通常指别人付出代价后你没有付出代价就轻易得到好处，含有不劳而获，或趁人之危的意思。
explanation_english: It figuratively means to pick up a bargain or take advantage of someone else. It usually refers to getting an advantage without paying the price, after someone else has suffered a loss, implying unearned gains or taking advantage of someone's misfortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司執咗死鷄仔，用好低嘅價錢買到隔離棟樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 zaap1 zo2 sei2 gai1 zai2, yung6 hou2 dai1 ge3 gaa3 cin2 maai5 dou2 gaak3 lei4 dung6 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司捡了个大便宜，用很低的价格买到了隔壁栋楼。
examples.english_sentence: Their company picked up a bargain, buying the building next door at a very low price.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住可以喺我度執死鷄仔呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 nam2 zyu6 ho2 ji5 hai2 ngo5 dou6 zaap1 sei2 gai1 zai2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别想在我这儿占便宜啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can take advantage of me.

english_meaning: to enforce the law; law enforcement
explanation_mandarin: 执行法律，实施法律。
explanation_english: To enforce or implement the law; to carry out law enforcement duties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察嘅職責係執法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 ge3 zik1 zaak3 hai6 zaap1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察的职责是执法。
examples.english_sentence: The duty of the police is to enforce the law.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府需要嚴格執法，先可以維持社會秩序。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 seoi1 jiu3 jim4 gaak3 zaap1 faat3, sin1 ho2 ji5 wai4 ci4 se5 wui2 dit6 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府需要严格执法，才可以维持社会秩序。
examples.english_sentence: The government needs to strictly enforce the law in order to maintain social order.

english_meaning: Pick up the ball / Clean up a mess / Clean up (after someone)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是捡球。比喻收拾残局，处理烂摊子，或者单纯指打扫场地。
explanation_english: Literally means 'to pick up the ball'. Figuratively means to clean up a mess, deal with a difficult situation, or simply to tidy up a place, especially after an activity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 踢完波記得執波啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: tek3 jyun4 bo1 gei3 dak1 zap1 bo1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 踢完球记得捡球啊！
examples.english_sentence: Remember to pick up the ball after playing football!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿頭又唔做嘢，到最後咪又係我執波。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 tau4 jau6 m4 zou6 je5, dou3 zeoi3 hau6 mai1 jau6 hai6 ngo5 zap1 bo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 领导又不干活，到最后还不是我收拾残局。
examples.english_sentence: The boss doesn't do anything, so in the end, I have to clean up the mess.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日搞搞震，要人幫佢執波。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gaau2 gaau2 zan3, jiu3 jan4 bong1 keoi5 zap1 bo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是惹麻烦，要人帮他收拾烂摊子。
examples.english_sentence: He always makes trouble, and needs people to clean up after him.

english_meaning: to miss something when packing; to leave something behind; to overlook; to forget to include something
explanation_mandarin: 在收拾东西或处理事务时遗漏了某些物品或环节，没有完全、仔细地完成。
explanation_english: To miss something when packing or tidying up; to forget to include something or a step in a process; to overlook something due to negligence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我執漏咗護照，差啲上唔到飛機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zap1 lau6 zo2 wu6 ziu3, caa1 di1 soeng5 m4 dou2 fei1 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我收拾东西时漏掉了护照，差点没能登上飞机。
examples.english_sentence: I missed the passport when packing, and almost missed the flight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你執漏咗幾份文件，重新檢查一次啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zap1 lau6 zo2 gei2 fan6 man4 gin2, cung4 san1 gim2 caa4 jat1 ci3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你遗漏了几份文件，重新检查一次吧。
examples.english_sentence: You missed a few documents, please double-check again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該你幫我檢查下有冇執漏嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 nei5 bong1 ngo5 gim2 caa4 haa5 jau5 mou5 zap1 lau6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦你帮我检查一下有没有遗漏的东西。
examples.english_sentence: Please help me check if I have missed anything.

english_meaning: license, permit
explanation_mandarin: 官方颁发的允许从事某种活动的凭证。
explanation_english: An official document issued by a government or other authority that allows someone to do something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢冇執照就開餐廳，梗係俾人告啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mou5 zaap1 ziu3 zau6 hoi1 caan1 teng1, gang2 hai6 bei2 jan4 gou3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他没有执照就开餐厅，当然会被人告啦。
examples.english_sentence: He opened a restaurant without a license, of course he'll be sued.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你揸車一定要帶住駕駛執照。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zaa1 ce1 jat1 ding6 jiu3 daai3 zyu6 gaa3 si2 zaap1 ziu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你开车一定要带着驾驶执照。
examples.english_sentence: You must carry your driver's license when you drive.

english_meaning: To hold the ear of the ox (figuratively, to be the leader; to take the lead)
explanation_mandarin: 比喻在某一方面居领导地位，或居于首位。
explanation_english: Figuratively means to be in a leading position in a certain field or to be in the first place. It originates from ancient times when leading an alliance, the leader would hold the ear of an ox during the ceremony.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺呢個行業執牛耳好耐喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ni1 go3 hang4 jip6 zap1 ngau4 ji5 hou2 noi6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在这个行业执牛耳很久了。
examples.english_sentence: He has been the leader in this industry for a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家呢間公司喺市場上執牛耳，佔咗大部份嘅市場份額。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 hai2 si5 coeng4 soeng6 zap1 ngau4 ji5, zim3 zo2 daai6 bou6 fan6 ge3 si5 coeng4 fan6 ngak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在这家公司在市场上执牛耳，占了大部分的市场份额。
examples.english_sentence: Now this company takes the lead in the market, occupying most of the market share.

english_meaning: to handle a situation as it arises; to improvise; to think on one's feet; to use one's initiative
explanation_mandarin: 指在情况突发或缺乏准备的情况下，根据实际情况灵活应变，采取适当的措施解决问题。
explanation_english: Refers to handling a situation flexibly and resourcefully as it arises, especially when unexpected or unprepared. It emphasizes the ability to use one's initiative and improvise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日老細唔喺度，有咩事你自己執生啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 lou5 sai3 m4 hai2 dou6, jau5 me1 si6 nei5 zi6 gei2 zap1 sang1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天老板不在，有什么事情你自己随机应变吧。
examples.english_sentence: The boss isn't here today, so handle anything that comes up yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試嘅時候唔記得咗條公式，唯有執生啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 ge3 si4 hau6 m4 gei3 dak1 zo2 tiu4 gung1 sik1, wai4 jau5 zap1 sang1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试的时候忘记了公式，只好随机应变了。
examples.english_sentence: I forgot the formula during the exam, so I'll just have to improvise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦壞咗，你執生整返好佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 waai6 zo2, nei5 zap1 sang1 zeng2 faan1 hou2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电脑坏了，你随机应变把它修好。
examples.english_sentence: The computer is broken, you'll have to figure out how to fix it.

mandarin_meaning: 再来一次, 重新再做
english_meaning: To do it again; to have another go; to repeat the process
explanation_mandarin: “执番劑”在粤语中指重新再做一次，通常用于需要重新准备或执行的事务。类似“再来一次”。
explanation_english: "執番劑" in Cantonese means to do something again, usually referring to a process that needs to be repeated or prepared anew. Similar to "try again" or "have another go".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試考得唔好，唯有執番劑啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si5 haau2 dak1 m4 hou2, wai4 jau5 zaap1 faan1 zai1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试考得不好，只好再考一次了。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't do well on the exam, so I have to take it again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份報告做得唔啱，要執番劑先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 bou3 gou3 zou6 dak1 m4 aam1, jiu3 zaap1 faan1 zai1 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告做得不对，需要重新做一遍才行。
examples.english_sentence: This report is not done correctly, it needs to be done again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個餸炒得唔夠味，要執番劑落多啲調味料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sung3 caau2 dak1 m4 gau3 mei6, jiu3 zaap1 faan1 zai1 lok6 do1 di1 tiu4 mei6 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这道菜炒得不够味道，要重新做一遍多放些调味料。
examples.english_sentence: This dish isn't flavorful enough, I need to cook it again and add more seasoning.

english_meaning: to escape death by a hair's breadth; to have a narrow escape
explanation_mandarin: 侥幸逃脱死亡，死里逃生。形容情况非常危险，但最终得以幸存。
explanation_english: To narrowly escape death; to have a close call. It describes a situation where one is in grave danger but manages to survive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啱啱架車差啲撞到佢，好彩佢反應快，執番條命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngaam1 ngaam1 gaa3 ce1 caa1 di1 zong6 dou2 keoi5, hou2 coi2 keoi5 faan2 jing3 faai3, zaap1 faan1 tiu4 meng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才那辆车差点撞到他，幸好他反应快，捡回了一条命。
examples.english_sentence: That car almost hit him just now. Luckily, he reacted quickly and had a narrow escape.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢入咗 ICU 咁耐，醫生都話無希望，估唔到最後執番條命，真係奇蹟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jap6 zo2 ICU gam3 noi6, yi1 sang1 dou1 waa6 mou5 hei1 mong6, gu2 m4 dou3 zeoi3 hau6 zaap1 faan1 tiu4 meng6, zan1 hai6 kei4 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他进了ICU那么久，医生都说没希望了，没想到最后捡回了一条命，真是奇迹。
examples.english_sentence: He was in the ICU for so long, and the doctors said there was no hope, but unexpectedly, he survived in the end. It's truly a miracle.

mandarin_meaning: 挽回面子, 找回面子
english_meaning: to save face, to recover some dignity after a setback or embarrassment
explanation_mandarin: 在遭遇失败或尴尬后，设法挽回一点面子或尊严。
explanation_english: To save face or recover some dignity after experiencing a setback, embarrassment, or loss of face. It implies making an effort to present oneself in a better light after a potentially humiliating situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然考試唔合格，但係佢喺課堂表現積極，都執番身彩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 haau2 si5 m4 gok3 gap3, daan6 hai6 keoi5 hai2 fo3 tong4 biu2 hin3 zik1 gik1, dou1 zaap1 faan1 san1 coi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然考试没及格，但是他在课堂上表现积极，也算挽回了一点面子。
examples.english_sentence: Although he failed the exam, he actively participated in class, which helped him save some face.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢比賽輸咗，但係佢好有風度咁恭喜對手，都執番身彩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 coi3 syu1 zo2, daan6 hai6 keoi5 hou2 jau5 fung1 dou6 gam2 gung1 hei2 deoi3 sau2, dou1 zaap1 faan1 san1 coi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他比赛输了，但是他很有风度地恭喜对手，也算挽回了一点面子。
examples.english_sentence: He lost the competition, but he congratulated his opponent with good grace, which helped him save some face.

synonyms: 挽回面子 (waan5 wui4 min6 zi2)
搵返啲面 (wan2 faan1 di1 min6)

english_meaning: to retouch a photo, to photoshop, to digitally enhance a photo
explanation_mandarin: 指使用软件对照片进行修改和美化，例如调整光线、颜色、去除瑕疵等。
explanation_english: Refers to the process of using software to modify and enhance a photo, such as adjusting lighting, colors, and removing blemishes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張相執靚啲佢啦，啲色水暗咗少少。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 soeng3 zaap1 leng3 di1 keoi5 laa1, di1 sik1 seoi2 am3 zo2 siu2 siu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张照片修得好看一点，颜色有点暗。
examples.english_sentence: Retouch this photo to make it look nicer, the colors are a bit dark.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都執相執到自己個樣都唔同晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 zaap1 soeng3 zaap1 dou3 zi6 gei2 go3 joeng2 dou1 m4 tung4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是修图修到自己的样子都不一样了。
examples.english_sentence: She always retouches photos so much that her face looks completely different.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲App執相真係好方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 App zaap1 soeng3 zan1 hai6 hou2 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的App修图真的很方便。
examples.english_sentence: Retouching photos with the current apps is really convenient.

english_meaning: to be attached to; to be persistent; to cling to; to be obsessed with
explanation_mandarin: 坚持不放，固执，放不下。
explanation_english: To be stubbornly attached to something, to be unable to let go, to be persistent even when it's not beneficial or logical.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對呢件事好執着，一定要搞清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ni1 gin6 si6 hou2 zap1 zoek6, jat1 ding6 jiu3 gaau2 ching1 chu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对这件事很执着，一定要搞清楚。
examples.english_sentence: He's very persistent about this matter, he has to figure it out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁執着啦，有啲嘢放低會好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 zap1 zoek6 laa1, jau5 di1 je5 fong3 dai1 wui5 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么执着了，有些东西放下会好些。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so obsessed, it's better to let go of some things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對愛情好執着，始終放唔低前度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 oi3 ching4 hou2 zap1 zoek6, chi2 chung1 fong3 m4 dai1 chin4 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对爱情很执着，始终放不下前任。
examples.english_sentence: He is very attached to love, he still can't let go of his ex.

english_meaning: To find a bargain / To pick up a good deal / To snag a discount
explanation_mandarin: 指购买或获得价格明显低于市场价的商品或服务，类似于“捡漏”或“捡便宜”。
explanation_english: Refers to buying or acquiring goods or services at a price significantly lower than the market price. Similar to finding a bargain or a good deal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日喺特賣場執到唔少碼喎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 hai2 dak6 maai6 coeng4 zaap1 dou2 m4 siu2 maa5 wo3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天在特卖场捡到不少便宜货呢！
examples.english_sentence: I found quite a few good deals at the outlet store today!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好識執碼㗎，成日買到啲抵嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sik1 zaap1 maa5 gaa3, sing4 jat6 maai5 dou2 di1 dai2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很会捡便宜，总是买到一些划算的东西。
examples.english_sentence: He's good at finding bargains, always buying things at a good price.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 趁減價執啲碼，買定下年着。
examples.jyutping_sentence: can3 gaam2 gaa3 zaap1 di1 maa5, maai5 ding6 haa6 nin4 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 趁着打折捡点便宜货，买着明年穿。
examples.english_sentence: Snag some bargains during the sale, and buy things for next year.

english_meaning: To get a bargain; to get a good deal; to benefit unexpectedly; to be lucky and obtain something advantageous
explanation_mandarin: 捡到便宜，占便宜。指意外地获得好处或得到划算的东西。
explanation_english: To get a bargain or advantage, often unexpectedly. Implies being lucky to obtain something at a favorable price or circumstance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日去街市執到平福，啲菜好平啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 heoi3 gaai1 si5 zaap1 dou2 peng4 fuk1, di1 coi3 hou2 peng4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天去菜市场捡到便宜，那些菜很便宜啊。
examples.english_sentence: I got a bargain at the market today, the vegetables were very cheap.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺二手鋪執到件靚嘢，真係執福啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ji5 sau2 pou2 zaap1 dou2 gin6 leng3 je5, zan1 hai6 zaap1 fuk1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她在二手店淘到一件好东西，真是捡到便宜了。
examples.english_sentence: She found a great item at the second-hand shop, she really got a bargain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次升職佢真係執福，因為阿頭好鍾意佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 sing1 zik1 keoi5 zan1 hai6 zaap1 fuk1, jan1 wai6 aa3 tau4 hou2 zung1 ji3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次他升职真是占了便宜，因为领导很喜欢他。
examples.english_sentence: He really got a break with this promotion, because the boss likes him a lot.

english_meaning: To do private work on the side; To earn money on the side; To moonlight; To feather one's own nest (idiomatic)
explanation_mandarin: 指利用工作之便或空閒時間，為自己賺取額外的收入。
explanation_english: Refers to earning extra income for oneself, often by taking advantage of one's job or free time to do private work on the side.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好鍾意執私，成日偷偷哋幫人整電腦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 zung1 ji3 zaap1 si1, sing4 jat6 tau1 tau1 dei2 bong1 jan4 zing2 din6 nou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很喜欢捞外快，总是偷偷地帮人修理电脑。
examples.english_sentence: He really likes to do private work on the side; he's always secretly helping people fix computers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細唔鍾意啲員工喺公司時間執私。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 m4 zung1 ji3 di1 jyun4 gung1 hai2 gung1 si1 si4 gaan3 zaap1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板不喜欢员工在公司时间赚私钱。
examples.english_sentence: The boss doesn't like employees doing private work during company time.

english_meaning: to close down (a business), to go bankrupt
explanation_mandarin: 指商店、公司等因经营不善而停止营业，倒闭关门。
explanation_english: Refers to a shop, company, etc. closing down due to poor management, going bankrupt and ceasing operations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳經營唔善，結果都係要執笠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 ging1 jing4 m4 sin6, git3 gwo2 dou1 hai6 jiu3 zaap1 laap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅经营不善，结果还是要倒闭。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant was poorly managed, and as a result, it had to close down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟唔好，好多細公司都頂唔順，要執笠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, hou2 do1 sai3 gung1 si1 dou1 ding2 m4 seon6, jiu3 zaap1 laap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济不好，很多小公司都顶不住，要倒闭。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is bad, many small companies can't withstand it and have to close down.

english_meaning: to take up the pen; to start writing; to write
explanation_mandarin: 拿起笔开始写作。泛指写作。
explanation_english: To pick up a pen and start writing; generally refers to writing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢執筆寫咗一本好受歡迎嘅小說。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zap1 bat1 se2 zo2 jat1 bun2 hou2 sau6 fun1 ying4 ge3 siu2 syut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他执笔写了一本很受欢迎的小说。
examples.english_sentence: He took up the pen and wrote a very popular novel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要盡快執筆寫報告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zeon6 faai3 zap1 bat1 se2 bou3 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要尽快执笔写报告。
examples.english_sentence: We need to start writing the report as soon as possible.

english_meaning: To take a number; to queue up
explanation_mandarin: 在香港，到某些地方（例如政府部门、餐厅）办事或用餐，需要先取号码牌，按号码顺序等待。这个动作称为“执筹”。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong, when going to certain places (such as government departments, restaurants), it is necessary to take a number first and wait in order. This action is called "zaap1 cau4".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 去醫院睇醫生要先執籌㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: heoi3 ji1 jyun2 tai2 ji1 sang1 jiu3 sin1 zaap1 cau4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去医院看医生要先拿号的。
examples.english_sentence: You need to take a number first when going to see a doctor at the hospital.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳咁多人，我哋都係執定籌先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 gam3 do1 jan4, ngo5 dei6 dou1 hai6 zaap1 ding6 cau4 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅这么多人，我们还是先排队拿号吧。
examples.english_sentence: There are so many people at this restaurant, let's take a number first.

english_meaning: to hold the rope of a coffin during a funeral procession; to be a pallbearer
explanation_mandarin: 在葬礼队伍中，拉着棺材的绳索。
explanation_english: To hold the ropes attached to a coffin during a funeral procession; to act as a pallbearer, specifically holding the rope.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋今次去幫阿伯執紼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gam1 ci3 heoi3 bong1 a3 bak3 zap1 fat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们这次去帮伯伯扶灵。
examples.english_sentence: They're going to help the uncle as pallbearers this time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 執紼嘅時候要好小心，唔可以鬆手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zap1 fat1 ge3 si4 hau6 jiu3 hou2 siu2 sam1, m4 ho2 ji5 sung1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 扶灵的时候要很小心，不可以松手。
examples.english_sentence: You need to be very careful when holding the ropes of the coffin, and you can't let go.

english_meaning: to narrowly escape death; to cheat death; to have a close call
explanation_mandarin: 指死里逃生，差一点失去生命，但最终幸存下来。
explanation_english: Refers to narrowly escaping death, almost losing one's life, but ultimately surviving.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 琴日揸車差啲撞到人，好彩我反應快，執翻條命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kam4 jat6 zaa1 ce1 caa1 di1 zong6 dou2 jan4, hou2 coi2 ngo5 faan2 jing3 faai3, zap1 faan1 tiu4 meng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天开车差点撞到人，幸好我反应快，捡回了一条命。
examples.english_sentence: Yesterday I almost hit someone while driving. Luckily I reacted quickly and narrowly escaped death.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋攀山嗰陣遇到山泥傾瀉，好彩及時走甩，先至執翻條命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 paan1 saan1 go2 zan6 jyu6 dou2 saan1 nai4 king1 se3, hou2 coi2 kap6 si4 zau2 lyut1, sin1 zai3 zap1 faan1 tiu4 meng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们登山的时候遇到山体滑坡，幸好及时逃脱，才捡回了一条命。
examples.english_sentence: They encountered a landslide while climbing the mountain. Luckily, they escaped in time, so they cheated death.

english_meaning: to narrowly escape death; to have a close call and survive
explanation_mandarin: 死里逃生，侥幸存活下来。
explanation_english: To narrowly escape death; to survive a dangerous situation by luck. Implies that one was very close to death.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次車禍真係執翻條命仔，差啲就無命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ce1 wo6 zan1 hai6 zaap1 faan1 tiu4 meng6 zai2, caa1 di1 zau6 mou5 meng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次车祸真是捡回一条命，差点就没命了。
examples.english_sentence: This car accident was really a close call, I almost died.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢跳樓自殺，好彩有人救返佢，執翻條命仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tiu3 lau4 zi6 saat3, hou2 coi2 jau5 jan4 gau3 faan1 keoi5, zaap1 faan1 tiu4 meng6 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他跳楼自杀，幸好有人救回他，捡回一条命。
examples.english_sentence: He attempted suicide by jumping off a building, luckily someone saved him, he narrowly escaped death.

synonyms: 死裡逃生 (sei2 lei5 tou4 sang1)

english_meaning: to prepare tea; to serve tea
explanation_mandarin: 准备并倒茶水。多用于招呼客人或为长辈准备茶水。
explanation_english: To prepare and serve tea. Often used when hosting guests or preparing tea for elders.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽，執茶俾客人飲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1, zap1 caa4 bei2 hak3 jan4 jam2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈，准备茶给客人喝吧。
examples.english_sentence: Mom, please prepare tea for the guests to drink.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該你幫手執茶，我嚟招呼啲朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 nei5 bong1 sau2 zap1 caa4, ngo5 lai4 ziu1 fu1 di1 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦你帮忙准备茶，我来招呼一下朋友。
examples.english_sentence: Please help me prepare the tea, I'll greet the friends.

english_meaning: To pack up; to tidy up; to clear away
explanation_mandarin: 收拾东西，整理物件。通常指离开一个地方前将自己的物品整理好。
explanation_english: To pack up or tidy up belongings. Often used when preparing to leave a place, ensuring belongings are organized and ready for transport.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要執葉走啦，唔好阻住人做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zaap1 jip6 zau2 laa1, m4 hou2 zo2 zyu6 yan4 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们得收拾东西走了，别妨碍别人工作。
examples.english_sentence: We need to pack up and leave now, don't get in the way of other people working.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 執葉執好啲嘢，唔好漏低任何嘢啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zaap1 jip6 zaap1 hou2 di1 je5, m4 hou2 lau6 dai1 jam6 ho4 je5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 好好收拾东西，别落下任何东西啊。
examples.english_sentence: Pack your things carefully, don't leave anything behind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 快啲執葉，唔係就趕唔切飛機啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faai3 di1 zaap1 jip6, m4 hai6 zau6 gon2 m4 cit3 fei1 gei1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 快点收拾东西，不然就赶不上飞机了。
examples.english_sentence: Hurry up and pack, otherwise we'll miss the plane.

english_meaning: persistent; stubborn; to cling to; to be attached to; to be hung up on
explanation_mandarin: 指坚持不放，固执地追求或坚守，难以改变自己的想法或行为。
explanation_english: Describes being persistent and clinging to something, stubbornly pursuing or adhering to something, and having difficulty changing one's thoughts or behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對呢件事好執著，唔肯放棄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ni1 gin6 si6 hou2 zap1 zoek6, m4 hang2 fong3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对这件事很执着，不肯放弃。
examples.english_sentence: He is very persistent with this matter and refuses to give up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁執著啦，放過自己啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 zap1 zoek6 laa1, fong3 gwo3 zi6 gei2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么执着了，放过自己吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so hung up on it, let it go and forgive yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好執著要考入嗰間大學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zap1 zoek6 jiu3 haau2 jap6 go2 gaan1 daai6 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很执着要考进那间大学。
examples.english_sentence: He is very determined to get into that university.

english_meaning: Executive Director
explanation_mandarin: 指在公司董事会中负责公司日常运营管理的董事。
explanation_english: An Executive Director is a member of a company's board of directors who also has executive responsibilities within the company, typically involved in the day-to-day management.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係公司嘅執董，好多嘢都要佢決定。

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要聽執董嘅指示去做嘢。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要听执行董事的指示去工作。
examples.english_sentence: We need to follow the instructions of the Executive Director to do our work.

english_meaning: to bury (the deceased), to hold a funeral
explanation_mandarin: 指为逝者办理丧事，包括安葬、祭拜等一系列活动。
explanation_english: To bury the deceased; to conduct funeral rites. It involves all activities related to arranging the burial and memorial services for the deceased.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢屋企人請咗個師傅嚟執葬。

examples.english_sentence: His family hired a master to conduct the funeral.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要幫佢執葬，送佢最後一程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 bong1 keoi5 zap1 zong3, sung3 keoi5 zeoi3 hau6 jat1 cheng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要帮他办丧事，送他最后一程。
examples.english_sentence: We need to hold a funeral for him, to bid him farewell.

english_meaning: to fill a prescription; to dispense medicine
explanation_mandarin: 按照医生开的处方配制药物。
explanation_english: To prepare and dispense medicine according to a doctor's prescription.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生開咗藥俾你，你去藥房執葯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 hoi1 zo2 joek6 bei2 nei5, nei5 heoi3 joek6 fong2 zap1 joek6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生给你开了药，你去药房配药吧。

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺醫院嘅藥房度幫病人執葯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ji1 jyun2 ge3 joek6 fong2 dou6 bong1 beng6 jan4 zap1 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在医院的药房帮病人配药。
examples.english_sentence: He dispenses medicine for patients in the hospital pharmacy.

english_meaning: to fill a prescription; to dispense medicine
explanation_mandarin: 按照医生的处方配制药物。
explanation_english: To prepare and dispense medicine according to a doctor's prescription.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生寫咗張藥單，我哋要去藥房執藥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 se2 zo2 zoeng1 joek6 daan1, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 heoi3 joek6 fong4 zaap1 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生开了一张药方，我们要去药房配药。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor wrote a prescription, we need to go to the pharmacy to fill it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆叫藥劑師幫佢執藥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 giu3 joek6 zai1 si1 bong1 keoi5 zaap1 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老奶奶叫药剂师帮她配药。
examples.english_sentence: The old woman asked the pharmacist to dispense her medicine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家好多藥房都可以網上執藥，方便好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 hou2 do1 joek6 fong4 dou1 ho2 ji5 mong5 soeng6 zaap1 joek6, fong1 bin6 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多药房都可以网上配药，方便了很多。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, many pharmacies offer online prescription filling, which is much more convenient.

english_meaning: to execute; to implement; to carry out; to enforce
explanation_mandarin: 实行；实施；履行。
explanation_english: To put into effect; to implement; to perform or carry out a task, plan, or order; to enforce a law or regulation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府執行咗新嘅政策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 zaap6 hang4 zo2 san1 ge3 zheng3 chaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府执行了新的政策。
examples.english_sentence: The government has implemented a new policy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要執行呢個計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 zaap6 hang4 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要执行这个计划。
examples.english_sentence: We need to execute this plan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察執行緊法律。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 chaat3 zaap6 hang4 gan2 faat3 leot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察正在执行法律。
examples.english_sentence: The police are enforcing the law.

english_meaning: to pack luggage; to pack one's bags
explanation_mandarin: 整理行李，准备出行。
explanation_english: To pack one's belongings into luggage in preparation for a trip.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要走喇，今晚要執行李。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 zau2 laa3, gam1 maan1 jiu3 zaap6 hang4 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要走了，今晚要收拾行李。
examples.english_sentence: I'm leaving tomorrow, I need to pack my luggage tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢執行李執咗成個鐘都未執完。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zaap6 hang4 lei5 zap1 zo2 seng4 go3 zung1 dou1 mei6 zap1 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他收拾行李收拾了一个小时都还没收拾完。
examples.english_sentence: He's been packing his luggage for an hour and still hasn't finished.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你快啲執行李啦，就嚟趕唔切飛機喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 faai3 di1 zaap6 hang4 lei5 laa1, zau6 lei4 gon2 m4 cit3 fei1 gei1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你快点收拾行李吧，就要赶不上飞机了。
examples.english_sentence: Hurry up and pack your luggage, you're going to miss your flight.

english_meaning: Executive Director
explanation_mandarin: 指在公司董事会中承担具体管理职责的董事，通常负责公司的日常运营和管理。
explanation_english: An Executive Director is a member of a company's board of directors who also has management responsibilities in the company. They are usually responsible for the day-to-day operations and management of the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢升咗做執行董事，前途一片光明啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing1 zo2 zou6 zaap6 hang4 dung2 si6, cin4 tou4 jat1 pin3 gwong1 ming4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他升任为执行董事，前途一片光明啊！
examples.english_sentence: He's been promoted to Executive Director, his future is bright!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 執行董事嘅責任好大，要對公司嘅盈利負責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zaap6 hang4 dung2 si6 ge3 zaak3 jam6 hou2 daai6, jiu3 deoi3 gung1 si1 ge3 ying4 lei6 fu6 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 执行董事的责任很大，要对公司的盈利负责。
examples.english_sentence: The Executive Director's responsibilities are great, they are responsible for the company's profits.

mandarin_meaning: 非常仔细地挑选；一丝不苟地整理
english_meaning: To pick or sort something meticulously; to be overly meticulous and picky; to nitpick.
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常仔细、挑剔地挑选或整理东西，像挑选豆子一样。也形容人非常挑剔、吹毛求疵。
explanation_english: Describes picking or sorting something with extreme meticulousness, like picking through beans. It can also describe a person who is overly picky, nitpicky, and fastidious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢執豆咁執，執咗成個鐘都未揀完啲菜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zap1 dau2 gam2 zap1, zap1 zo2 seng4 go3 zung1 dou1 mei6揀waan4 di1 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他挑菜挑得非常仔细，挑了一个小时还没挑完。
examples.english_sentence: He's picking the vegetables so meticulously that he hasn't finished after an hour.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好執豆咁執啦，邊有人會咁樣檢查份文件㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zap1 dau2 gam2 zap1 laa1, bin1 jau5 jan4 wui5 gam2 joeng2 gim2 caa4 fan6 man4 gin2 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么挑剔了，哪有人会这样检查文件啊？
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so nitpicky. Nobody checks documents like that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細執豆咁執，份報告改咗好多次都仲未approve。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 zap1 dau2 gam2 zap1, fan6 bou3 gou3 goi2 zo2 hou2 do1 ci3 dou1 zung1 mei6 approve.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板太挑剔了，这份报告改了很多次都还没批准。
examples.english_sentence: The boss is so nitpicky; the report has been revised many times, but it still hasn't been approved.

english_meaning: To be extremely picky; to nitpick
explanation_mandarin: 形容选择的时候非常挑剔，像挑豆子一样，仔细地挑选。
explanation_english: Describes being extremely selective or picky, like picking through beans to select only the best ones. It implies a high level of scrutiny and unwillingness to settle for anything less than perfect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢揀男朋友執豆噉執，唔怪之得而家都仲係單身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan2 naam4 pang4 jau5 zap1 dau6 gam2 zap1, m4 gwaai3 zi1 dak1 ji4 gaa1 dou1 zung1 hai6 daan1 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她挑男朋友的时候非常挑剔，难怪现在还是单身。
examples.english_sentence: She's so picky when choosing a boyfriend that it's no wonder she's still single.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽買生果執豆噉執，一定要揀啲靚嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 maai5 sang1 gwo2 zap1 dau6 gam2 zap1, jat1 ding6 jiu3 gaan2 di1 leng3 ge3.

examples.english_sentence: My mom is extremely picky when buying fruit, she always picks the prettiest ones.

english_meaning: to take advantage (of someone), to get away with something (undeservedly), to get a good deal (sometimes unfairly)
explanation_mandarin: 比喻占别人的便宜，或获得不应得的好处。带有贬义，指通过不公平或不正当的手段获利。
explanation_english: A metaphor for taking advantage of others or obtaining undeserved benefits. It has a negative connotation, referring to profiting through unfair or improper means.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住執我貓呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 zaap1 ngo5 maau1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别想占我便宜！
examples.english_sentence: Don't even think about taking advantage of me!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都想執人地貓，真係好乞人憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 soeng2 zaap1 jan4 dei6 maau1, zan1 hai6 hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想占别人的便宜，真的很令人讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: He always tries to take advantage of others, he's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司成日執員工貓，剋扣人工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 seng4 jat6 zaap1 jyun4 gung1 maau1, hak1 kau3 jan4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司经常占员工便宜，克扣工资。
examples.english_sentence: This company often takes advantage of its employees by deducting their salaries.

english_meaning: To gain an advantage, to get a bargain, to take advantage of a situation, to get the better of someone
explanation_mandarin: 指抓住机会，获得比别人更好的利益，通常带有一种不劳而获或者利用他人疏忽占便宜的含义。
explanation_english: To seize an opportunity to gain an advantage or benefit, often implying taking advantage of someone's oversight or getting something for less effort or cost than it's worth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都諗住執贏，但係通常都冇好結果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 nam2 zyu6 zaap1 wing4, daan6 hai6 tung1 soeng4 dou1 mou5 hou2 git3 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想着占便宜，但是通常都没有好结果。
examples.english_sentence: He's always trying to get an advantage, but it usually doesn't end well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗住可以喺佢身上執贏，佢好醒㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 nam2 zyu6 ho2 ji5 hai2 keoi5 san1 soeng6 zaap1 wing4, keoi5 hou2 seng2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别想着能在他身上占便宜，他很精明的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can get the better of him, he's very clever.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁想執贏啦，做人要老實啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 soeng2 zaap1 wing4 laa1, zou6 jan4 jiu3 lou5 sat6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是想着占便宜，做人要诚实一点。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always try to get an advantage, be more honest.

english_meaning: to save face; to redeem oneself; to regain some prestige
explanation_mandarin: 指挽回面子，使自己不至于太丢脸，或在不利的情况下找回一些优势或声誉。
explanation_english: To save face, preventing oneself from being too embarrassed. It means to regain some advantage or reputation in unfavorable circumstances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試衰咗，但係我決定下次要攞第一，執返啲身彩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 seoi1 zo2, daan6 hai6 ngo5 kyut3 ding6 haa6 ci3 jiu3 lo2 dai6 jat1, zap1 faan1 di1 san1 coi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试失败了，但是我决定下次要考第一名，挽回一些面子。
examples.english_sentence: I failed this exam, but I'm determined to get first place next time to save some face.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人踢爆咗講大話，依家想搵方法執身彩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 tek3 baau3 zo2 gong2 daai6 waa6, ji1 gaa1 soeng2 wan2 fong1 faat3 zap1 san1 coi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人揭穿了说谎，现在想找方法挽回面子。
examples.english_sentence: He was exposed for lying, and now he's trying to find a way to save face.

english_meaning: to lose out; to be at a disadvantage; to miss out on something; to be slow on the uptake
explanation_mandarin: 形容在行动或决策上慢了一步，导致失去机会或利益，最终吃了亏。
explanation_english: Describes the situation where someone is slow to act or make a decision, resulting in a missed opportunity or benefit, ultimately leading to a disadvantage or loss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔快啲買，陣間就執輸㗎啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 faai3 di1 maai5, zan6 gaan1 zau6 zap1 syu1 gaa3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再不快点买，一会儿就吃亏了！
examples.english_sentence: If you don't buy it quickly, you'll lose out later!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搶頭位梗係好啲，唔係嘅話就執輸啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng2 tau4 wai2 gang2 hai6 hou2 di1, m4 hai6 ge3 waa2 zau6 zap1 syu1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 抢到第一名当然好，不然的话就吃亏了。
examples.english_sentence: Getting the first spot is definitely better, otherwise you'll miss out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪咁慢啦，執輸行頭，慘過敗家！
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 gam3 maan6 laa1, zap1 syu1 hang4 tau4, caam2 gwo3 baai6 gaa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么慢了，慢人一步，比败家还惨！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so slow, missing out on the first opportunity is worse than being a spendthrift!

jyutping: zap1 syu1 haang4 tau4 caam2 gwo3 baai6 gaa1
mandarin_meaning: 输在起跑线上比败家还惨
english_meaning: Losing out at the start is worse than being a spendthrift (ruining the family fortune).
explanation_mandarin: 形容竞争激烈，开始时落后会造成难以弥补的损失。强调在机会出现时必须把握住，否则后果严重。比喻一开始的劣势比挥霍家产的损失还要大。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a highly competitive situation where falling behind at the beginning can cause irreparable losses. It emphasizes the importance of seizing opportunities as they arise, otherwise, the consequences will be severe. It illustrates that an initial disadvantage can be worse than wasting a family's fortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗱，呢啲限量版嘅嘢，一陣間冇晒㗎，執輸行頭慘過敗家，快啲搶啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: laa4, ni1 di1 haan6 loeng6 baan2 ge3 je5, jat1 zan6 gaan1 mou5晒 gaa3, zap1 syu1 haang4 tau4 caam2 gwo3 baai6 gaa1, faai3 di1 coeng2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看，这些限量版的东西，一会儿就卖完了，输在起跑线上比败家还惨，快点抢啊！
examples.english_sentence: Look, these limited edition items will be sold out soon. Losing out at the start is worse than being a spendthrift, so hurry up and grab them!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 升學唔可以拖㗎，執輸行頭慘過敗家，你哋要趁早規劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing1 hok6 m4 ho2 ji5 to1 gaa3, zap1 syu1 haang4 tau4 caam2 gwo3 baai6 gaa1, nei5 dei6 jiu3 can3 zou2 gwai1 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 升学不能拖延，输在起跑线上比败家还惨，你们要及早规划。
examples.english_sentence: You can't delay further education; losing out at the start is worse than being a spendthrift. You need to plan ahead early.

synonyms: 先下手為強 (sin1 haau6 sau2 wai4 koeng4)

jyutping: zaap1 syu1 haang4 tau4, caam2 gwo3 baai6 gaa1
mandarin_meaning: 输在起跑线上，比败家还惨
english_meaning: Losing at the starting line is worse than squandering a fortune; Being left behind is worse than losing everything.

explanation_english: This idiom describes the importance of being ahead of the curve and acting quickly. It emphasizes that being left behind or losing out on an opportunity is worse than losing all your wealth. It stresses the significance of being proactive and competitive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家樓價咁貴，唔快啲上車，執輸行頭，慘過敗家呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 lau2 gaa3 gam3 gwai3, m4 faai3 di1 soeng5 ce1, zaap1 syu1 haang4 tau4, caam2 gwo3 baai6 gaa1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在房价这么贵，不快点买房，输在起跑线上，比败家还惨啊！
examples.english_sentence: House prices are so expensive now. If you don't buy a home soon, you'll be left behind, and that's worse than losing everything!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個project咁多人爭，一定要快手，唔係執輸行頭，慘過敗家。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目这么多人竞争，一定要动作快，不然就输在起跑线上了，比败家还惨。
examples.english_sentence: So many people are competing for this project, you have to be quick, otherwise you'll be left behind, and that's worse than losing everything.

synonyms: 捷足先登 (zit6 zuk1 sin1 dang1)
先下手為強 (sin1 haau2 wai4 koeng4)

english_meaning: to save face; to regain some honor/respect; to salvage something from a bad situation
explanation_mandarin: 在不利的情况下，设法保住或挽回一点面子，不至于完全丢脸。
explanation_english: To manage to salvage some honor or respect from a bad situation, preventing complete humiliation or loss of face.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然比賽輸咗，但係佢哋盡咗力，都執返一身彩。
