examples.english_sentence: Although they lost the competition, they tried their best and managed to save some face.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試唔合格，但係老師讚佢進步咗好多，都執返一身彩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 m4 hap6 gaak3, daan6 hai6 lou5 si1 zaan3 keoi5 zeon3 bou6 zo2 hou2 do1, dou1 zaap1 faan1 jat1 san1 coi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试没及格，但是老师夸他进步了很多，也算挣回了一点面子。
examples.english_sentence: He failed the exam, but the teacher praised him for his progress, so he managed to salvage some honor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司差啲執笠，好彩佢哋推出咗新產品，執返一身彩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 caa1 di1 zaap1 laap1, hou2 coi2 keoi5 dei6 teoi1 ceot1 zo2 san1 caan2 ban2, zaap1 faan1 jat1 san1 coi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司差点倒闭，幸好他们推出了新产品，挽回了一点局面。
examples.english_sentence: The company was almost bankrupt, but fortunately, they launched a new product and managed to turn things around.

english_meaning: to remedy a situation; to fix things; to make up for something
explanation_mandarin: 指通过一些行动或方法来弥补之前的错误、失误或不足，使情况得到改善。
explanation_english: This phrase refers to taking actions or employing methods to compensate for previous mistakes, errors, or shortcomings in order to improve the situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試考得唔好，下次要努力啲執返劑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 haau2 dak1 m4 hou2, haa6 ci3 jiu3 nou5 lik6 di1 zaap1 faan1 zai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试考得不好，下次要努力一点来补救。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't do well in this exam. I need to work harder next time to make up for it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢知道自己講錯嘢，即刻道歉想執返劑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi1 dou3 zi6 gei2 gong2 co3 je5, zik1 hak1 dou6 hip3 soeng2 zaap1 faan1 zai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他知道自己说错话了，立刻道歉想补救。
examples.english_sentence: He knew he said something wrong, and immediately apologized to try to remedy the situation.

english_meaning: to save one's life, to barely survive, to escape death
explanation_mandarin: 从极度危险的情况中死里逃生，保住性命。
explanation_english: To survive a life-threatening situation; to escape death by a narrow margin; to save one's life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢撞車撞得好犀利，好彩執返條命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zong6 ce1 zong6 dak1 hou2 sai1 lei6, hou2 coi2 zaap1 faan1 tiu4 meng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他车祸撞得很严重，幸好捡回一条命。
examples.english_sentence: He had a very serious car accident, luckily he survived.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次真係執返條命，下次唔敢再咁做喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 zaap1 faan1 tiu4 meng6, haa6 ci3 m4 gam2 zoi3 gam2 zou6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次真是捡回一条命，下次不敢再这样做了。
examples.english_sentence: I really barely survived this time, I wouldn't dare to do that again next time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢情況危殆，但係經過搶救，總算執返條命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yi1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 cing4 fong3 ngai4 dai6, daan6 hai6 ging1 gwo3 coeng2 gau3, zung2 syun3 zaap1 faan1 tiu4 meng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说他的情况危急，但是经过抢救，总算捡回一条命。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said his condition was critical, but after rescue efforts, he managed to survive.

english_meaning: to narrowly escape death; to have a close call
explanation_mandarin: 指经历危险后侥幸活下来，死里逃生。
explanation_english: Refers to narrowly escaping death or surviving a dangerous situation by luck. It's like saying someone had a close call and barely made it out alive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱撞車撞到咁犀利，好彩執返條命仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaam1 ngaam1 zong6 ce1 zong6 dou3 gam3 sai1 lei6, hou2 coi2 zap1 faan1 tiu4 meng6 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他刚才出了很严重的车祸，幸好捡回了一条命。
examples.english_sentence: He was in a very serious car accident just now, thankfully he narrowly escaped death.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次真係執返條命仔，如果唔係戴咗安全帽，我諗我死咗喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 zap1 faan1 tiu4 meng6 zai2, jyu4 gwo2 m4 hai6 daai3 zo2 on1 cyun4 mou6, ngo5 lam2 ngo5 sei2 zo2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次真的是捡回了一条命，如果不是戴了安全帽，我想我已经死了。
examples.english_sentence: This time I really narrowly escaped death, if I hadn't worn a helmet, I think I would be dead.

synonyms: 死裡逃生 (sei2 lei5 tou4 sang1)
死過翻生 (sei2 gwo3 faan1 sang1)

mandarin_meaning: 挽回面子; 挣回面子
english_meaning: to save face; to regain some prestige; to salvage some pride
explanation_mandarin: 指在丢脸或失败后，通过某种方式挽回一些面子或尊严。
explanation_english: Refers to regaining some face, prestige, or pride after a loss of face or failure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先考試肥咗佬，好彩阿Sir畀多次機會我，執返身彩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 haau2 si3 fei4 zo2 lou2, hou2 coi2 aa3 Sir bei2 do1 ci3 gei1 wui2 ngo5, zap1 faan1 san1 coi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才考试不及格了，幸好老师给了我多一次机会，挽回了些面子。
examples.english_sentence: I failed the exam just now, but luckily the teacher gave me another chance, so I managed to save some face.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴日輸咗好多錢，今日買股票賺返啲，都算執返身彩啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 syu1 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2, gam1 jat6 maai5 gu2 piu3 zaan6 faan1 di1, dou1 syun3 zap1 faan1 san1 coi2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天输了很多钱，今天买股票赚回了一些，也算挽回了些面子了。
examples.english_sentence: He lost a lot of money yesterday, but he made some back by buying stocks today, so you could say he salvaged some pride.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然比賽輸咗，但係佢最後入咗一球，都執返少少身彩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 bei2 coi3 syu1 zo2, daan6 hai6 keoi5 zeoi3 hau6 jap6 zo2 jat1 kau4, dou1 zap1 faan1 siu2 siu2 san1 coi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然比赛输了，但是他最后进了一球，也算是挽回了一点面子。
examples.english_sentence: Although the game was lost, he scored a goal in the end, so he managed to regain a little prestige.

mandarin_meaning: 执迷不悟 (zhí mí bù wù)
english_meaning: stubbornly stick to a wrong course; refuse to come to one's senses; persist in error
explanation_mandarin: 坚持错误的想法或行为，不肯醒悟。
explanation_english: To stubbornly cling to a wrong idea or course of action and refuse to come to one's senses or realize the mistake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都錯晒啦，仲要執迷不悟，盞搞鑊甘啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 co3 saai3 laa3, zung6 jiu3 zap1 mai4 bat1 ng6, zaan2 gaau2 wok6 gam2 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你都完全错了，还要执迷不悟，只会把事情搞砸。
examples.english_sentence: You're completely wrong already, and you still stubbornly stick to your ways, you'll only make things worse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢投資失敗咗，但係仲執迷不悟，繼續借錢落注。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tau4 zi1 sat1 baai6 zo2, daan6 hai6 zung6 zap1 mai4 bat1 ng6, gai3 zuk6 ze3 cin2 lok6 zyu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他投资失败了，但是仍然执迷不悟，继续借钱下注。
examples.english_sentence: He failed in his investment, but he's still stubbornly sticking to his ways and continues to borrow money to bet.

synonyms: 一意孤行 (jat1 ji3 gu1 hang4)

english_meaning: Bailiff; Court enforcement officer; Sheriff's officer
explanation_mandarin: 指負責執行法院命令的官員，例如送達傳票、執行扣押等。
explanation_english: An officer of the court responsible for executing court orders, such as serving summonses, enforcing seizures, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋俾執達吏封咗，佢哋應該爭人好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 bei2 zap1 daat6 lei2 fung1 zo2, keoi5 dei6 jing1 goi1 zaang1 jan4 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房子被法警查封了，他们应该欠了很多人钱。
examples.english_sentence: The house was sealed by the bailiffs, they must owe a lot of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你收到執達吏嘅信，最好搵律師睇睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sau1 dou2 zap1 daat6 lei2 ge3 seon3, zeoi3 hou2 wan2 leot6 si1 tai2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你收到法警的信，最好找律师看看。
examples.english_sentence: If you received a letter from the bailiff, it's best to consult a lawyer.

english_meaning: to pick up money (off the street); windfall; unexpected gain
explanation_mandarin: 指在路上捡到钱，也指意外获得利益或好处。
explanation_english: Refers to picking up money on the street. It can also refer to unexpectedly gaining profit or benefit; a windfall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，阿婆，你執金呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, aa3 po4, nei5 zaap1 gam1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，老奶奶，你捡到钱了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Hey, Grandma, did you pick up money?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買股票賺咗好多錢，好似執金咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 gu2 piu3 zaan6 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2, hou2 ci5 zaap1 gam1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买股票赚了很多钱，好像捡到钱一样。
examples.english_sentence: He made a lot of money investing in stocks, it's like finding money.

mandarin_meaning: 收拾杂物; 收拾零碎东西
english_meaning: To tidy up; to clear up; to pack up miscellaneous items; to gather odds and ends.
explanation_mandarin: 收拾零碎杂物，使之整洁有序。
explanation_english: To tidy up, clear up, or pack miscellaneous items. It often implies dealing with small, scattered things to bring order to a space or prepare for a move.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要執雜搬屋喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zap1 zaap6 bun1 uk1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要收拾杂物搬家了。
examples.english_sentence: We need to pack up to move house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆成日喺街邊執雜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 sing4 jat6 hai2 gaai1 bin1 zap1 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老奶奶总是在街边捡拾杂物。
examples.english_sentence: The old woman is always picking up odds and ends on the street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你幫我執雜好唔好？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bong1 ngo5 zap1 zaap6 hou2 m4 hou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你帮我收拾一下好不好？
examples.english_sentence: Can you help me tidy up?

english_meaning: To pick up a bargain; to find something cheap and good; to get lucky with a cheap purchase; to scavenge (sometimes implying taking advantage of someone else's misfortune)
explanation_mandarin: 原意为捡鸡，引申为捡到便宜，通常指以低廉的价格买到好东西或捡到他人遗弃的物品。有时带有趁机占便宜的意味。
explanation_english: Originally meaning "to pick up a chicken," it's now a slang term meaning to pick up a bargain or find something cheap and good. It often implies getting lucky with a purchase or acquiring something that someone else has discarded at a low price. Sometimes, it can also carry a slightly negative connotation of taking advantage of a situation to benefit oneself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺二手市場執咗隻好新嘅相機，真係執雞啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 ji5 sau2 si5 cheung4 zaap1 zo2 jek3 hou2 san1 ge3 seung3 gei1, zan1 hai6 zaap1 gai1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在二手市场上捡到了一台很新的相机，真是捡到便宜了！
examples.english_sentence: I found a brand new camera at the second-hand market. It's a real bargain!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排好多商店都做特價，快啲去執雞啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 hou2 do1 seung1 dim3 dou1 jo6 dak6 ga3, faai3 di1 heui3 zaap1 gai1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近很多商店都在打折，快点去捡便宜吧！
examples.english_sentence: Many shops are having sales recently, go and grab some bargains!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到佢哋執雞咁開心，我都想去睇下有咩嘢好嘢執。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 keoi5 dei6 zaap1 gai1 gam3 hoi1 sam1, ngo5 dou1 seung2 heui3 tai2 haa5 jau5 mat1 je5 hou2 je5 zaap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到他们捡便宜捡得那么开心，我也想去看看有什么好东西可以捡。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing how happy they are with their bargains, I want to go and see if there's anything good to find.

english_meaning: To tidy up odds and ends; to take care of miscellaneous tasks; to wrap things up; to handle loose ends.
explanation_mandarin: 指处理一些琐碎的事情，例如收拾东西、整理细节等。通常用于事情接近尾声时。
explanation_english: Refers to handling small, miscellaneous tasks, such as tidying up belongings or organizing details. Often used when things are nearing completion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋執頭執尾，就可以走㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zap1 tau4 zap1 mei1, zau6 ho2 ji5 zau2 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们收拾一下零碎的东西，就可以走了。
examples.english_sentence: We just need to tidy up a few things, and then we can go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 臨瞓前執頭執尾，第二日就唔會咁趕啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lam4 fan3 cin4 zap1 tau4 zap1 mei1, dai6 ji6 jat6 zau6 m4 wui gam3 gan2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 睡前收拾一下，第二天就不会那么匆忙了。
examples.english_sentence: If we tidy up a bit before sleeping, we won't be so rushed the next day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個project就嚟完，仲有啲嘢要執頭執尾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 project zau6 lai4 jyun4, zung6 jau5 di1 je5 jiu3 zap1 tau4 zap1 mei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目快要完成了，还有一些事情需要收尾。
examples.english_sentence: This project is almost finished, there are still some things to wrap up.

english_meaning: To make do, to make it work, to patch things up, to scrape by
explanation_mandarin: 指勉强将就，凑合着使用或处理事情，尽量让情况能够继续维持下去。
explanation_english: Refers to making do with what you have, patching things up, or barely getting by. It implies using limited resources or suboptimal solutions to keep a situation afloat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦舊咗啲，但係都仲執頭碼用得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 gau6 zo2 di1, daan6 hai6 dou1 zung1 zaap1 tau4 maa5 yung6 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台电脑旧了点，但是还能凑合着用。
examples.english_sentence: The computer is a bit old, but we can still make do with it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冇錢嘅時候，咪執頭碼煮啲麵食囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou5 cin2 ge3 si4 hau6, mai1 zaap1 tau4 maa5 zyu2 di1 min6 sik6 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没钱的时候，就将就着煮点面条吃吧。
examples.english_sentence: When we're short on money, we'll just make do by cooking some noodles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份工唔係好理想，但係為咗生活都要執頭碼做住先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 m4 hai6 hou2 lei5 soeng2, daan6 hai6 wai6 zo2 sang1 wut6 dou1 jiu3 zaap1 tau4 maa5 zou6 zyu6 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工作不是很好，但是为了生活也要凑合着先做着。
examples.english_sentence: His job isn't ideal, but he has to make do and work it for the sake of living.

english_meaning: to collect bones (after cremation); to collect ashes
explanation_mandarin: 指火葬后，家属将逝者的骨灰从焚化炉中收集起来的动作。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of family members collecting the ashes of the deceased from the crematorium after cremation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋聽日會去火葬場執骨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ting1 jat6 wui5 heoi3 fo2 zong3 coeng4 zaap1 gwat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们明天会去火葬场捡骨灰。
examples.english_sentence: They will go to the crematorium to collect the ashes tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 執骨嘅時候，要小心唔好跌咗啲骨灰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zaap1 gwat1 ge3 si4 hau6, jiu3 siu2 sam1 m4 hou2 dit1 zo2 di1 gwat1 fui1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 捡骨灰的时候，要小心不要掉了骨灰。
examples.english_sentence: When collecting the ashes, be careful not to drop any.

english_meaning: To pick up a bargain; to scavenge for leftovers; to get a deal that others missed.
explanation_mandarin: 原指到菜市场捡拾别人丢弃的便宜的鸡肉。现比喻捡拾别人遗漏的便宜，或者获得意想不到的好处。
explanation_english: Originally refers to picking up cheap chicken scraps discarded by others in the market. Now it refers to picking up bargains that others have missed or obtaining unexpected benefits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日去特賣場執鷄，買到好多平嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 heoi3 dak6 maai6 coeng4 zaap1 gai1, maai5 dou2 ho2 do1 peng4 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常去特卖场捡便宜货，买到很多便宜的东西。
examples.english_sentence: He often goes to outlet stores to pick up bargains and buys a lot of cheap stuff.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 趁住減價，我哋去執下鷄啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: can3 zyu6 gaam2 gaa3, ngo5 dei6 heoi3 zaap1 haa5 gai1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 趁着打折，我们去捡点便宜吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go find some bargains while there's a sale.

english_meaning: To chip in, to contribute (money) to a group purchase or activity; potluck (dinner). Can also refer to a casual or cheap meal assembled from leftovers or readily available ingredients.
explanation_mandarin: 指大家凑份子购买东西或共同参与某项活动。也指用剩余的食材随便做的一餐。
explanation_english: Refers to chipping in money for a group purchase or participating in a group activity. It can also refer to a casual meal put together from leftovers or readily available ingredients (implying it's cheap and easy).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一齊執鷄買個蛋糕幫佢慶祝生日啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 zaap1 gai1 maai5 go3 daan6 gou1 bong1 keoi5 hing3 zuk1 saang1 jat6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一起凑份子买个蛋糕帮他庆祝生日吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's all chip in and buy a cake to celebrate his birthday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚冇乜餸，是但執鷄食下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 mou5 mat1 sung3, si6 daan6 zaap1 gai1 sik6 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚没什么菜，随便凑合吃点吧。
examples.english_sentence: There aren't many dishes tonight, let's just throw something together and eat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽晚搞個potluck party，大家執鷄帶啲嘢食嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 maan5 gaau2 go3 potluck party, daai6 gaa1 zaap1 gai1 daai3 di1 je5 sik6 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明晚办个百乐餐聚会，大家凑份子带点吃的来。
examples.english_sentence: We're having a potluck party tomorrow night, everyone chip in and bring some food.

english_meaning: area; field; arena; place
explanation_mandarin: 通常指用于特定活动的场地，例如赛场、表演场地等。
explanation_english: Refers to a space or field designated for a specific activity, such as a sports field, arena, or performance venue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 足球埸嘅草地好靚呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk1 kau4 coeng4 ge3 cou2 dei6 hou2 leng3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 足球场的草坪很漂亮啊。
examples.english_sentence: The lawn of the football field is very beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 演唱會嘅埸地好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin2 coeng3 wui2 ge3 coeng4 dei6 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演唱会的场地很大。
examples.english_sentence: The concert venue is very large.

english_meaning: to cultivate, to nurture, to foster, to train
explanation_mandarin: 培养；培育。
explanation_english: To cultivate, nurture, or foster something, especially talent or skills.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司好重視培訓員工嘅能力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 hou2 zung6 si6 pui4 fan3 jyun4 gung1 ge3 nang4 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司很重视培养员工的能力。
examples.english_sentence: The company values cultivating the skills of its employees.

english_meaning: Foundation; Base; Gay (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 本义指基础、地基。在香港俚语中，引申指男同性恋者，也可形容男性气质阴柔，或者带有同性恋倾向。
explanation_english: Literally means foundation or base. In Hong Kong slang, it refers to a gay man. It can also describe a man with effeminate qualities or homosexual tendencies.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dung3 lau4 ge3 gei1 daa2 dak1 hou2 wan2 zan6.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是和一些男孩子很亲密，有点gay里gay气的。
examples.english_sentence: He's always very close with some boys, a bit gayish.

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 hai6 gei1 gaa3, m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不是同性恋，不要乱说。

english_meaning: gay man, faggot (derogatory)

explanation_english: Refers to a gay man, often used in a derogatory or offensive way. It's a slang term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日俾人叫做基佬，好慘㗎。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是被人叫做男同性恋者，很可怜的。
examples.english_sentence: He is always called a faggot, it's really pitiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁樣叫人啦，基佬呢個字好唔尊重人㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 joeng2 giu3 jan4 laa1, gei1 lou2 ni1 go3 zi6 hou2 m4 zyun1 zung6 jan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这样叫别人了，基佬这个词很不尊重人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't call people that, the word 'gei lou' is very disrespectful.

explanation_english: Refers to a gay man. Sometimes it is used to refer to a close male friend, similar to 'bro' or 'buddy'. It can have a friendly, informal connotation, but usage depends on context and the speaker's intent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個係基友嚟㗎。

examples.english_sentence: They are gay.

english_meaning: gene

explanation_english: A unit of heredity that is transferred from a parent to offspring and is held to determine some characteristic of the offspring.

examples.english_sentence: His musical talent is hereditary. His family has strong musical genes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲係轉基因食品，你哋食之前要睇清楚啲標籤。

english_meaning: genetic modification, genetically modified

examples.english_sentence: Those viruses have become more difficult to deal with because of genetic mutation.

explanation_english: Shrimp that is farmed in artificial enclosures or ponds. It usually refers to whiteleg shrimp (Litopenaeus vannamei).

examples.english_sentence: Don't call people lesbians behind their backs, it's very rude.

english_meaning: grassroots; basic level; lower level
explanation_mandarin: 指社会或组织的最底层，也指基础性的、基本的层面。
explanation_english: Refers to the lowest level of society or an organization; also refers to the basic or fundamental level.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺基層做起，一路升上去。

examples.english_sentence: The government needs to pay more attention to the needs of grassroots citizens.

english_meaning: base, pedestal, foundation, mount

explanation_english: Refers to the basic physical and organizational structures and facilities (e.g., buildings, roads, power supplies) needed for the operation of a society or enterprise.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府计划加大力度投资基础设施。
examples.english_sentence: The government plans to increase investment in infrastructure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個地方嘅基建比較落後。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 dei6 fong1 ge3 gei1 gin3 bei2 gaau3 lok6 hau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个地方的基础设施比较落后。
examples.english_sentence: The infrastructure in that area is relatively underdeveloped.

examples.english_sentence: I heard that the situation in Kyiv is very unstable right now.

english_meaning: Kiribati
explanation_mandarin: 太平洋岛国，基里巴斯共和国。
explanation_english: A country in the central Pacific Ocean, officially the Republic of Kiribati.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 基里巴斯係一個位於太平洋嘅島國。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei1 lei5 baa1 si1 hai6 jat1 go3 wai6 jyu1 taai3 ping4 joeng4 ge3 dou2 gwok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 基里巴斯是一个位于太平洋的岛国。
examples.english_sentence: Kiribati is an island nation located in the Pacific Ocean.

english_meaning: fund; investment fund
explanation_mandarin: 一种集合投资方式，将投资者的资金集中起来，由专业的基金经理进行管理，投资于不同的金融工具，以实现资产增值。
explanation_english: A pooled investment fund managed by professional fund managers, investing in various financial instruments to achieve capital appreciation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗隻股票基金，希望可以賺多啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 zek3 guk1 piu3 gei1 gam1, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 zaan6 do1 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一只股票基金，希望可以赚多一些钱。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a stock fund, hoping to earn more money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司成立咗一個慈善基金去幫助有需要嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 sing4 laap6 zo2 jat1 go3 ci4 sin6 gei1 gam1 heoi3 bong1 zo6 jau5 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司成立了一个慈善基金去帮助有需要的人。
examples.english_sentence: This company established a charitable fund to help people in need.

english_meaning: Keelung (a city in Taiwan)
explanation_mandarin: 台灣北部的一个城市，是重要的港口。
explanation_english: A city in northern Taiwan, an important port city.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我上次去台灣嘅時候去咗基隆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng6 ci3 heoi3 toi4 waan1 ge3 si4 hau6 heoi3 zo2 gei1 lung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我上次去台湾的时候去了基隆。
examples.english_sentence: I went to Keelung last time I went to Taiwan.

mandarin_meaning: 偏僻的地方; 山脚下
english_meaning: Remote place; foot of a mountain; (used in place names)
explanation_mandarin: 指偏僻的地方，或者山脚下，多用于地名。
explanation_english: Refers to a remote place or the foot of a mountain, often used in place names.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度咁埼，乜都冇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 gam3 kui1, mat1 dou1 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里这么偏僻，什么都没有。
examples.english_sentence: This place is so remote, there's nothing here.

english_meaning: to dig, to excavate
explanation_mandarin: 指用工具或徒手挖土、挖洞等。
explanation_english: To dig, excavate, to use tools or hands to dig into the earth, make a hole, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺花園堀咗個窿種花。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 faa1 jyun2 fat6 zo2 go3 lung1 zung2 faa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在花园里挖了个洞种花。
examples.english_sentence: He dug a hole in the garden to plant flowers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺度堀爛啲草地呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 fat6 laan6 di1 cou2 dei6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在这里把草地挖烂了！
examples.english_sentence: Don't dig up the lawn here!

english_meaning: hall; classroom; session; measure word for lessons/sessions
explanation_mandarin: 1. 厅堂，正房。 2. 用作量词，表示上课的次数或会话的次数。
explanation_english: 1. Hall, main room of a house. 2. Used as a measure word to indicate the number of lessons or sessions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我琴日上咗三堂中文。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kam4 jat6 soeng5 zo2 saam1 tong4 zung1 man2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天上了三节中文课。
examples.english_sentence: I had three Chinese lessons yesterday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺禮堂等緊你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 lai5 tong4 dang2 gan2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在礼堂等你。
examples.english_sentence: He is waiting for you in the hall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日再上多堂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 zoi3 soeng5 do1 tong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天再上一节课。
examples.english_sentence: Let's have another lesson tomorrow.

english_meaning: Waiter, server (in a traditional restaurant)
explanation_mandarin: 旧时餐馆、茶楼里的服务人员。
explanation_english: A waiter or server in a traditional Chinese restaurant or tea house. This term is less common in modern settings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該，堂倌，埋單！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1, tong4 gun1, maai4 daan1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 服务员，结账！
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, waiter, the bill please!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間茶樓嘅堂倌都好有禮貌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caa4 lau2 ge3 tong4 gun1 dou1 hou2 jau5 lai5 maau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家茶楼的服务员都很有礼貌。
examples.english_sentence: The waiters in this teahouse are very polite.

english_meaning: male cousin (son of one's paternal uncle)
explanation_mandarin: 指与自己同姓的伯父、叔父的儿子，即父亲的亲兄弟的儿子。
explanation_english: Male cousin who is the son of one's father's brother (paternal uncle).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同我堂兄弟由細玩到大，感情好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 ngo5 tong4 hing1 dai6 jau4 sai3 waan2 dou3 daai6, gam2 ching4 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和我的堂兄弟从小玩到大，感情很好。
examples.english_sentence: My cousins and I grew up playing together, so we have a very good relationship.

english_meaning: parish (religious)
explanation_mandarin: 指基督教（主要是天主教和圣公会）教会组织的一个区域单位，通常由一位牧师或神父负责。
explanation_english: A territorial unit of a Christian church (primarily Roman Catholic and Anglican/Episcopal), typically under the care of a priest or pastor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋屋企屬於邊個堂區㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei2 suk6 jyu1 bin1 go3 tong4 kui1 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们家属于哪个堂区？
examples.english_sentence: Which parish does our family belong to?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺堂區嘅活動好積極。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 tong4 kui1 ge3 wut6 dung6 hou2 zik1 gik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在堂区的活动非常积极。
examples.english_sentence: He is very active in parish activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間教堂嘅堂區範圍好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gaau3 tong4 ge3 tong4 kui1 faan6 wai4 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个教堂的堂区范围很大。
examples.english_sentence: The parish boundary of this church is very large.

english_meaning: sub-branch of a triad society; turf; chapter (of a gang)
explanation_mandarin: 旧时指黑社会或帮会组织的分支机构或根据地。
explanation_english: Refers to a sub-branch or base of a triad or gang organization, particularly in the past. It can also refer to a specific turf or area controlled by such a group.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講佢喺油麻地有個堂口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 keoi5 hai2 jau4 maa4 dei2 jau5 go3 tong4 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说他在油麻地有个堂口。
examples.english_sentence: I heard he has a turf in Yau Ma Tei.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好惹佢哋，佢哋喺呢區有好多堂口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 je5 keoi5 dei6, keoi5 dei6 hai2 ni1 ku1 jau5 hou2 do1 tong4 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别惹他们，他们在这区有很多堂口。
examples.english_sentence: Don't mess with them, they have many territories in this area.

english_meaning: To eat in; to dine in (at a restaurant); opposite of 'take out'
explanation_mandarin: 在餐厅里面吃；不在餐厅外带食物。
explanation_english: To consume food at the restaurant where it was ordered. The opposite of taking food 'to go' or 'take out'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋想堂喫，唔想拎走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 ngo5 dei6 soeng2 tong4 hek3, m4 soeng2 ling1 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们想在店里吃，不想打包。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight, we want to eat in, we don't want to take out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多人都鍾意叫外賣，好少人會堂喫啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 zung1 ji3 giu3 ngoi6 maai6, hou2 siu2 jan4 wui5 tong4 hek3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多人都喜欢叫外卖，很少人会在店里吃啦。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, many people like to order takeout; few people eat in.

mandarin_meaning: 正正当当, 气派, 庄严
english_meaning: dignified, majestic, imposing, respectable
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或事物具有威严的气势，行为光明正大。
explanation_english: Describes a person or thing as having a majestic presence or acting in an upright and respectable manner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢堂堂一個大學教授，點會做啲咁嘅嘢啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tong4 tong4 jat1 go3 daai6 hok6 gaau3 sau6, dim2 wui5 zou6 di1 gam3 ge3 je5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他堂堂一个大学教授，怎么会做这种事情呢？
examples.english_sentence: He is a dignified university professor. How could he do such a thing?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間鋪頭裝修得堂堂正正，畀人一種好專業嘅感覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou1 tau2 zong1 sau1 dak1 tong4 tong4 zeng3 zeng3, bei2 jan4 jat1 zung2 hou2 zyun1 jip6 ge3 gam2 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店铺装修得堂堂正正，给人一种很专业的感觉。
examples.english_sentence: This shop is decorated in a dignified and proper manner, giving people a very professional feeling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋堂堂正正做人，唔怕人哋講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 tong4 tong4 zeng3 zeng3 zou6 jan4, m4 paa3 jan4 dei6 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们堂堂正正做人，不怕别人说。
examples.english_sentence: We live righteously and are not afraid of what others say.

mandarin_meaning: 光明正大, 正大光明
english_meaning: upright and honest; honorable; with dignity and integrity; fair and square
explanation_mandarin: 形容为人光明磊落，行为端正。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is upright, honest, and behaves with integrity; describes an action that is fair and just.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做人堂堂正正，唔會搞埋啲陰濕嘢嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 jan4 tong4 tong4 zing3 zing3, m4 wui5 gaau2 maai4 di1 jam1 sap1 je5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为人光明磊落，不会搞那些阴险的事情的。
examples.english_sentence: He is an upright and honest person and would never engage in shady dealings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事我哋要堂堂正正咁做，唔好偷雞摸狗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 tong4 tong4 zing3 zing3 gam2 zou6, m4 hou2 tau1 gai1 mok1 gau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事我们要光明正大地做，不要偷偷摸摸的。
examples.english_sentence: We must do this openly and honestly, not sneakily.

synonyms: 光明磊落 (gwong1 ming4 leoi5 lok3)
正人君子 (zing3 jan4 gwan1 zi2)

mandarin_meaning: 老大; 大哥 (在黑社会中)
english_meaning: Boss; Big Brother (in a triad/gang)
explanation_mandarin: 指黑社会或犯罪组织中的高级成员，通常是领导者或有影响力的人物。
explanation_english: Refers to a high-ranking member, usually a leader or influential figure, in a triad or criminal organization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係呢個社團嘅堂大佬，冇人敢惹佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ni1 go3 se5 tyun4 ge3 tong4 daai6 lou2, mou5 jan4 gam2 re2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是这个社团的老大，没人敢惹他。
examples.english_sentence: He is the boss of this triad, no one dares to mess with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講佢升咗做堂大佬，地位更加鞏固。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 keoi5 sing1 zo2 zou6 tong4 daai6 lou2, dei6 wai2 gang3 ga3 gung2 gu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说他升职成了老大，地位更加巩固。
examples.english_sentence: I heard he got promoted to boss, his position is more secure.

english_meaning: younger female cousin (father's brother's daughter)
explanation_mandarin: 指与自己同姓的叔叔或伯父的女儿，比自己年龄小。
explanation_english: Younger female cousin, specifically the daughter of your father's brother (older or younger).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個堂妹今年十歲，好得意㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 tong4 mui2 gam1 nin4 sap6 seoi3, hou2 dak1 ji3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的堂妹今年十岁，很可爱。
examples.english_sentence: My younger female cousin is ten years old this year, she's very cute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同堂妹自細一齊大，感情好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 tong4 mui2 zi6 sai3 jat1 cai4 daai6, gam2 cing4 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和堂妹从小一起长大，感情很好。
examples.english_sentence: My younger female cousin and I grew up together since we were little, we have a very good relationship.

english_meaning: Customer; guest
explanation_mandarin: 指光顾商店或饭馆的客人，也泛指客人。
explanation_english: Refers to customers who patronize shops or restaurants, also broadly refers to guests.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日好多堂客啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 hou2 do1 tong4 hak3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天好多顾客啊！
examples.english_sentence: There are a lot of customers today!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆，你對堂客好啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2, nei5 deoi3 tong4 hak3 hou2 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板，你对顾客好点吧。
examples.english_sentence: Boss, you should be nicer to the customers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嚟咗做堂客喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 lai4 zo2 zou6 tong4 hak3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们来做客人了。
examples.english_sentence: They came to be guests.

english_meaning: Older female cousin (father's side, same surname)
explanation_mandarin: 指父亲的兄弟的女儿，比自己年长的。
explanation_english: Refers to the daughter of one's father's brothers (paternal cousin), who is older than oneself. She shares the same surname as you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個堂家姐好叻女㗎，做嘢又快又好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 tong4 gaa1 ze1 hou2 lek1 neoi5 gaa3, zou6 je5 jau6 faai3 jau6 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的堂姐很能干，做事又快又好。
examples.english_sentence: My older female cousin is very capable, she works both fast and well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣成日同堂家姐一齊玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 tung4 tong4 gaa1 ze1 jat1 cai4 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候经常和堂姐一起玩。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, I often played with my older female cousin.

english_meaning: Formal seat; reserved seat; front seat (in a theatre/concert)
explanation_mandarin: 指正式场合或特定场所中的座位，尤指贵宾或重要人物的座位。例如戏院或宴会中的靠前或重要的座位。
explanation_english: Refers to a formal seat, especially a reserved or prime seat in a formal setting, such as a theatre, concert hall, or banquet. Often implies a VIP seat or a seat for someone of importance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚去睇戲，我哋訂咗堂座㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 heoi3 tai2 hei3, ngo5 dei6 ding3 zo2 tong4 zo6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚去看电影，我们订了前排座位。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to the movies tonight, and we reserved front seats.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係貴賓，安排佢坐堂座啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 gwai3 ban1, aan1 paai4 keoi5 co5 tong4 zo6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是贵宾，安排他坐在正式座位吧。
examples.english_sentence: He is a VIP, arrange for him to sit in the formal seat.

english_meaning: younger male cousin (on the father's side; same surname)
explanation_mandarin: 指与自己有相同祖父的弟弟，即伯父、叔父的儿子中比自己年龄小的男性。
explanation_english: Younger male cousin on the father's side of the family (same surname); the son of one's paternal uncle who is younger than oneself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個堂弟好鬼曳，成日搞搞震。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 tong4 dai6 hou2 gwai2 jai6, seng4 jat6 gaau2 gaau2 zan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的堂弟很顽皮，总是调皮捣蛋。
examples.english_sentence: My younger male cousin is very naughty and always gets up to mischief.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我嘅堂弟，細我五年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 tong4 dai6, sai3 ngo5 ng5 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我的堂弟，比我小五年。
examples.english_sentence: He is my younger male cousin, five years younger than me.

english_meaning: grand; magnificent; imposing; high-sounding (but often empty)
explanation_mandarin: 形容建筑物等气势宏伟、壮丽。也用来形容言辞动听，但内容空洞。
explanation_english: Describes something (like a building) as grand and magnificent. It can also be used to describe words that sound good, but are empty in content and lack substance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋間酒店起得好堂皇呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaan1 zau2 dim3 hei2 dak1 hou2 tong4 wong4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们那家酒店建得很堂皇啊！
examples.english_sentence: Their hotel is built so magnificently!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好聽佢講嘢咁堂皇，實際上咩都做唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 teng1 keoi5 gong2 je5 gam3 tong4 wong4, sat6 zeoi3 soeng6 me1 dou1 zou6 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要听他说得那么堂皇，实际上什么都做不到。
examples.english_sentence: Don't listen to his high-sounding words, he can't actually do anything.

english_meaning: younger male cousin (same surname and from the paternal side; son of father's brother)
explanation_mandarin: 指与自己同姓，父亲的兄弟的儿子中比自己年龄小的男性。
explanation_english: Refers to a younger male cousin who shares the same surname and is the son of one's father's brother.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個堂細佬今年考DSE。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 tong4 sai3 lou2 gam1 nin4 haau2 DSE.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的堂弟今年考DSE。
examples.english_sentence: My younger male cousin is taking the DSE exam this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日同佢個堂細佬一齊打機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 tung4 keoi5 go3 tong4 sai3 lou2 jat1 cai4 daa2 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是和他堂弟一起打游戏。
examples.english_sentence: He always plays video games with his younger male cousin.

english_meaning: in a grand and open manner; openly and brazenly; without any shame or secrecy
explanation_mandarin: 形容公开的、理直气壮的样子。指行为或言论公开而不加掩饰，带有贬义，表示不应该这样做而公然做了。
explanation_english: Describes something done openly and brazenly, often implying that it is wrong or inappropriate but is done without shame or concealment. It often carries a negative connotation, suggesting that the action shouldn't be done but is carried out publicly anyway.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋竟然可以堂而皇之咁喺街邊賣翻版貨，真係冇王管噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ging2 jin4 ho2 ji5 tong4 ji4 wong4 zi1 gam2 hai2 gaai1 bin1 maai6 faan1 baan2 fo3, zan1 hai6 mou5 wong4 gun2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们竟然可以堂而皇之地在街边卖盗版货，真是没人管一样。
examples.english_sentence: They can actually sell pirated goods on the street openly and brazenly; it's like no one is in charge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞咗人哋嘅錢，仲可以堂而皇之咁使，面皮真係厚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 zo2 jan4 dei6 ge3 cin2, zung6 ho2 ji5 tong4 ji4 wong4 zi1 gam2 sai2, min6 pei4 zan1 hai6 hau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿了别人的钱，还可以堂而皇之地花，脸皮真厚。
examples.english_sentence: He took other people's money and can spend it openly and without shame; he's really shameless.

english_meaning: Activity expenses; Management fee; Operational costs of an organization, especially illegal or shady ones.
explanation_mandarin: 指社团，帮派等组织的运作费用，尤其是指一些非法或不正当组织的活动经费，也指正规组织的管理费用。
explanation_english: Refers to the operational costs of an organization, particularly illicit or shady ones, like triads or gangs. Can also refer to the general management fees of a more legitimate organization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋靠收保護費嚟維持佢哋嘅堂費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 kaau3 sau1 bou2 wu6 fai3 lai4 wai4 ci4 keoi5 dei6 ge3 tong4 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们靠收保护费来维持他们的活动经费。
examples.english_sentence: They rely on collecting protection money to maintain their operational costs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司啲堂費好貴，好多嘢都要俾錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 di1 tong4 fai3 hou2 gwai3, hou2 do1 ye5 dou1 jiu3 bei2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的管理费用很贵，很多东西都要花钱。
examples.english_sentence: This company's management fees are very expensive; you have to pay for a lot of things.

english_meaning: dine-in, eat in (at a restaurant)
explanation_mandarin: 指在餐厅或食肆内用餐，而非外卖或自取。
explanation_english: Refers to eating at a restaurant or eatery, as opposed to takeaway or takeout.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家冇得堂食，淨係可以外賣咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 mou5 dak1 tong4 sik6, zing6 hai6 ho2 ji5 ngoi6 maai6 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在不能堂食，只能外卖。
examples.english_sentence: Now we can't dine in, only takeaway is available.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去邊度堂食好呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan1 heoi3 bin1 dou6 tong4 sik6 hou2 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚去哪里堂食好呢？
examples.english_sentence: Where should we dine in tonight?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 疫情期間，好多餐廳都暫停咗堂食服務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jik6 ching4 kei4 gaan1, hou2 do1 caan1 teng1 dou1 zaam6 ting4 zo2 tong4 sik6 fuk6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 疫情期间，很多餐厅都暂停了堂食服务。
examples.english_sentence: During the pandemic, many restaurants suspended dine-in services.

english_meaning: real, genuine, true, very, extremely
explanation_mandarin: 表示真实、可靠、程度很深。在粤语中，可以表示“真”、“真的”，也可以表示“非常”、“很”。
explanation_english: Indicates reality, authenticity, or a high degree. In Cantonese, it can mean 'real', 'true', or 'very', 'extremely'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢堅㗎，你信佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 gin1 gaa3, nei5 seon3 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的是真的，你相信他吧。
examples.english_sentence: What he said is true, you should believe him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食堅好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 gin1 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西真的很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is really delicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日份工堅係好忙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 fan6 gung1 gin1 hai6 hou2 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天的工作真是非常忙。
examples.english_sentence: Today's work is extremely busy.

english_meaning: really; truly; genuinely; definitely
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度很深，相当于“真的很”、“真是的”。语气比“係”更强烈，强调程度。
explanation_english: An intensifier used to express a high degree of certainty or truth. It's stronger than just saying "係 (hai6)" and emphasizes the reality or authenticity of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢堅係好食㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 gin1 hai6 hou2 sik6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西真是太好吃了！
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is really delicious!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢堅係好叻㗎，咩都識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin1 hai6 hou2 lek1 gaa3, me1 dou1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她真的很厉害，什么都会。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is really smart, knows everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日堅係好熱呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 gin1 hai6 hou2 jit6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天真是太热了！
examples.english_sentence: It's really hot today!

english_meaning: to firmly believe, to have unwavering faith
explanation_mandarin: 非常坚决地相信，毫不动摇。
explanation_english: To have a strong and unwavering belief in something; to be firmly convinced.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我堅信佢會成功嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gin1 seon3 keoi5 wui5 sing4 gung1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我坚信他会成功的。
examples.english_sentence: I firmly believe that he will succeed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢堅信自己嘅理念。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin1 seon3 zi6 gei2 ge3 lei5 nim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他坚信自己的理念。
examples.english_sentence: He firmly believes in his own principles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我堅信香港嘅未來會更加美好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gin1 seon3 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 mei6 loi4 wui5 gang3 gaa1 mei5 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我坚信香港的未来会更加美好。
examples.english_sentence: I firmly believe that Hong Kong's future will be even better.

english_meaning: genuine stuff, high-quality goods, the real deal
explanation_mandarin: 指质量好、货真价实的东西，也指能力强、靠谱的人。
explanation_english: Refers to something of high quality, genuine, or authentic. It can also refer to a reliable or capable person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲先至係堅嘢嚟㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 sin1 zi3 hai6 gin1 je5 lai4 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些才是真货啊！
examples.english_sentence: This is the real deal!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好掂，真係堅嘢嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 dim1, zan1 hai6 gin1 je5 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很棒，真是个靠谱的人。
examples.english_sentence: He does things very well; he's truly a reliable person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間鋪頭賣嘅全部都係堅嘢，唔會呃你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou1 tau2 maai6 ge3 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 gin1 je5, m4 wui5 aak1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店卖的全部都是真货，不会骗你。
examples.english_sentence: Everything this shop sells is genuine; they won't cheat you.

english_meaning: strong; firm; solid; durable; robust
explanation_mandarin: 形容物体结构牢固，不容易损坏。
explanation_english: Describing something that is strong, firm, and not easily damaged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個橋好堅固，唔使驚塌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 kiu4 hou2 gin1 gu3, m4 sai2 geng1 taap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这座桥很坚固，不用怕塌。
examples.english_sentence: This bridge is very strong, no need to worry about it collapsing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間屋嘅地基好堅固。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 uk1 ge3 dei6 gei1 hou2 gin1 gu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间房子的地基很坚固。
examples.english_sentence: The foundation of this house is very solid.

mandarin_meaning: 坚壁清野 (jiān bì qīng yě)
english_meaning: scorched earth policy; clear the fields and strengthen the walls (a military tactic)
explanation_mandarin: 一种军事策略，指将所有可能对敌军有用的资源（如食物、住所）摧毁或搬走，同时加固防御工事，使敌军无法获取补给，从而削弱敌军的战斗力。
explanation_english: A military tactic of destroying or removing any resources (such as food or shelter) that might be useful to an invading enemy, while simultaneously strengthening fortifications, depriving the enemy of supplies and weakening their fighting ability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗阻止敵人入侵，佢哋決定採取堅壁清野嘅策略。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai4 zo2 zo2 zi2 dik6 jan4 jam1 ceon1, keoi5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 coi2 ceoi2 gin1 bik1 ching1 je5 ge3 cak1 loek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了阻止敌人入侵，他们决定采取坚壁清野的策略。
examples.english_sentence: In order to prevent the enemy from invading, they decided to adopt a scorched earth policy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對噉樣嘅困境，有啲公司選擇堅壁清野，裁走晒啲員工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 gam2 joeng2 ge3 kwan3 ging2, jau5 di1 gung1 si1 syun2 zaak6 gin1 bik1 ching1 je5, caai4 zau2晒 saai3 di1 wun4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面对这样的困境，有些公司选择坚壁清野，裁掉所有员工。
examples.english_sentence: Faced with such difficulties, some companies choose to implement a scorched earth policy by laying off all their employees.

english_meaning: to stick to, to hold fast to, to adhere to, to defend resolutely
explanation_mandarin: 坚持守卫；坚决守住。
explanation_english: To maintain and defend resolutely; to stick to principles or a position firmly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要堅守信念，唔好俾困難打倒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gin1 sau2 seon3 nim6, m4 hou2 bei2 kwan3 naan4 daa2 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要坚守信念，不要被困难打倒。
examples.english_sentence: We must stick to our beliefs and not be defeated by difficulties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 班消防員喺火場入面堅守崗位，盡力救人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baan1消fong1 jyun4 hai2 fo2 coeng4 jap6 min6 gin1 sau2 gong1 wai2, zeon6 lik6 gau3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 消防员在火场里坚守岗位，尽力救人。
examples.english_sentence: The firefighters stuck to their posts in the fire and tried their best to save people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢堅守自己嘅原則，從來都唔會妥協。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin1 sau2 zi6 gei2 ge3 jyun1 zak1, cung4 loi4 dou1 m4 wui to2 hip3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他坚守自己的原则，从来都不会妥协。
examples.english_sentence: He sticks to his principles and never compromises.

english_meaning: firm, resolute, determined
explanation_mandarin: 形容意志、立场等非常确定，不轻易改变。
explanation_english: Describes a will, position, etc., that is very firm and not easily changed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅立場好堅定，唔會輕易改變主意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 lap6 coeng4 hou2 gin1 ding6, m4 wui5 hing1 ji6 goi2 bin3 zyu2 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的立场很坚定，不会轻易改变主意。
examples.english_sentence: His position is very firm and he won't easily change his mind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要堅定支持香港嘅發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gin1 ding6 zi1 ci4 Hoeng1 Gong2 ge3 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要坚定支持香港的发展。
examples.english_sentence: We must firmly support the development of Hong Kong.

english_meaning: firm and unshakeable; resolute; steadfast
explanation_mandarin: 形容立场、主张、决心等非常坚定，毫不动摇。
explanation_english: Describes a stance, proposition, or resolve that is firm and unwavering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 無論面對幾多困難，我哋都要堅定不移咁實現我哋嘅目標。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou4 leon6 min6 deoi3 gei2 do1 kwan3 naan4, ngo5 dei6 dou1 jiu3 gin1 ding6 bat1 ji4 gam2 sat6 hin6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 muk6 biu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 无论面对多少困难，我们都要坚定不移地实现我们的目标。
examples.english_sentence: No matter how many difficulties we face, we must resolutely achieve our goals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對佢嘅信念堅定不移，所以最後成功咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 keoi5 ge3 seon3 nim6 gin1 ding6 bat1 ji4, so2 ji5 zeoi3 hau6 sing4 gung1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对他的信念坚定不移，所以最后成功了。
examples.english_sentence: He was steadfast in his beliefs, so he finally succeeded.

english_meaning: True or false?
explanation_mandarin: 询问某件事是真是假，表示怀疑或不确定。
explanation_english: A phrase used to question the authenticity or truthfulness of something, expressing doubt or uncertainty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢中咗六合彩，堅定流呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 zung3 zo2 luk6 hap6 coi2, gin1 ding6 lau4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他中了六合彩，真的假的？
examples.english_sentence: He said he won the lottery, is it true or false?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食好好食，堅定流㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 hou2 hou2 sik6, gin1 ding6 lau4 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西很好吃，真的假的？
examples.english_sentence: The food in this restaurant is delicious, is it true?

english_meaning: solid; firm; substantial; sturdy
explanation_mandarin: 形容物体结构牢固，不易损坏。
explanation_english: Describing an object's structure as strong, firm, and not easily damaged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢棟大廈嘅地基好堅實，唔怕地震。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dung6 daai6 haa6 ge3 dei6 gei1 hou2 gin1 sat6, m4 paa3 dei6 zan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这栋大厦的地基很坚实，不怕地震。
examples.english_sentence: The foundation of this building is very solid, not afraid of earthquakes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅合作關係非常堅實，經得起考驗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 hap6 zok3 gwaan1 hai6 fei1 soeng4 gin1 sat6, ging1 dak1 hei2 haau2 jim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的合作关系非常坚实，经得起考验。
examples.english_sentence: Their partnership is very solid and can withstand tests.

english_meaning: Kennedy Town
explanation_mandarin: 香港岛西北部的一个地区，位于中西区。
explanation_english: Kennedy Town is a neighborhood located in the northwestern part of Hong Kong Island, in the Central and Western District.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我住喺堅尼地城，交通都幾方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zyu6 hai2 gin1 nei4 dei6 sing4, gaau1 tung1 dou1 gei2 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我住在坚尼地城，交通还挺方便的。
examples.english_sentence: I live in Kennedy Town, and the transportation is quite convenient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日我哋去堅尼地城食海鮮啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 gin1 nei4 dei6 sing4 sik6 hoi2 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天我们去坚尼地城吃海鲜吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to Kennedy Town for seafood tomorrow.

english_meaning: strong, firm, staunch, resilient
explanation_mandarin: 形容意志坚定，不可动摇。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is strong-willed and unwavering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢面對咁多困難都咁堅強，真係好令人佩服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 min6 deoi3 gam3 do1 kwan3 naan4 dou1 gam3 gin1 koeng4, zan1 hai6 hou2 ling6 jan4 pui3 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他面对这么多困难都这么坚强，真的很令人佩服。
examples.english_sentence: He is so strong in the face of so many difficulties. It's really admirable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做人要堅強啲，唔可以咁容易放棄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jan4 jiu3 gin1 koeng4 di1, m4 ho2 ji5 gam3 yung4 yi6 fong3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做人要坚强一点，不可以这么容易放弃。
examples.english_sentence: You need to be stronger in life; you can't give up so easily.

english_meaning: perseverance; fortitude; tenacity; resilience
explanation_mandarin: 形容意志坚定，能忍受困难和挫折。
explanation_english: Describing the quality of being steadfast and able to endure hardship and setbacks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅成功嚟自佢嘅堅忍精神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing4 gung1 lai4 zi6 keoi5 ge3 gin1 jan2 jing1 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的成功来自于他的坚韧精神。
examples.english_sentence: His success comes from his spirit of perseverance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對咁多困難，佢依然展現出令人敬佩嘅堅忍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 gam3 do1 kwan3 naan4, keoi5 ji1 jin4 zin2 hin3 ceot1 ling6 jan4 ging3 pui3 ge3 gin1 jan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面对这么多困难，他仍然展现出令人敬佩的坚韧。
examples.english_sentence: Despite so many difficulties, he still demonstrates admirable resilience.

english_meaning: resolute and indomitable; persevering; tenacious; steadfast; unwavering
explanation_mandarin: 形容意志坚定，毫不动摇。
explanation_english: Describes a strong and unwavering will, not easily shaken or deterred.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢靠住堅忍不拔嘅精神，終於成功完成咗個挑戰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kaau3 zyu6 gin1 jan2 bat1 bat6 ge3 zing1 san4, zung1 jyu1 sing4 gung1 waan4 sing4 zo2 go3 tiu1 zin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他靠着坚韧不拔的精神，终于成功完成了这个挑战。
examples.english_sentence: He finally completed the challenge successfully, relying on his resolute and indomitable spirit.

mandarin_meaning: 厉害; 强劲; 真材实料
english_meaning: powerful; strong; capable; genuine; the real deal
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或事物非常厉害、强劲，或者表示某事物是真材实料，质量上乘。
explanation_english: Describes a person or thing as being very powerful, strong, or capable. It can also indicate that something is genuine, of high quality, and the real deal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係堅抽，考試次次都攞第一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 gin1 cau1, haau2 si5 ci3 ci3 dou1 lo2 dai6 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的很厉害，每次考试都拿第一。
examples.english_sentence: He is really capable; he gets first place in every exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部車嘅引擎堅抽，上斜都冇問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 ce1 ge3 jing5 ching1 gin1 cau1, soeng5 ce3 dou1 mou5 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车的引擎很强劲，上坡都没问题。
examples.english_sentence: This car's engine is powerful, so it has no problem going uphill.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅用料堅抽，所以啲嘢食咁好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 yung6 liu2 gin1 cau1, so2 ji5 di1 je5 sik6 gam3 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的用料是真材实料，所以食物这么好吃。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant uses genuine ingredients, that's why the food is so delicious.

english_meaning: firmly refuse; strongly reject
explanation_mandarin: 表示态度非常坚决地拒绝。
explanation_english: Indicates a strong and firm refusal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢堅拒幫我哋手，唔肯提供任何協助。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin1 geoi6 bong1 ngo5 dei6 sau2, m4 hang2 tai4 cung4 jam6 ho4 hip3 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他坚决拒绝帮助我们，不肯提供任何协助。
examples.english_sentence: He firmly refused to help us and wouldn't provide any assistance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 無論點樣勸佢，佢都堅拒改變主意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou4 leon6 dim2 joeng2 hyun3 keoi5, keoi5 dou1 gin1 geoi6 goi2 bin3 zyu2 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 无论怎样劝说他，他都坚决拒绝改变主意。
examples.english_sentence: No matter how we persuade him, he firmly refuses to change his mind.

english_meaning: to persist; to persevere; to insist on; to stick to (a principle or course of action)
explanation_mandarin: 指坚持不懈，不轻易放弃。
explanation_english: To hold on firmly to something; to not give up easily, even when faced with difficulties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 無論幾咁辛苦，你都要堅持落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou4 leon4 gei2 gam3 san1 fu2, nei5 dou1 jiu3 gin1 ci4 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 无论多么辛苦，你都要坚持下去。
examples.english_sentence: No matter how hard it is, you have to persevere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢堅持自己嘅睇法，唔肯改變。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin1 ci4 zi6 gei2 ge3 tai2 faat3, m4 hang2 goi2 bin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他坚持自己的看法，不肯改变。
examples.english_sentence: He insists on his own point of view and is unwilling to change.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要堅持到底，先至可以成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gin1 ci4 dou3 dai2, sin1 zi3 ho2 ji3 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要坚持到底，才可以成功。
examples.english_sentence: We need to persevere to the end to succeed.

english_meaning: to persevere, to persist, to be persistent and unremitting
explanation_mandarin: 指坚持到底，毫不松懈。
explanation_english: Refers to persisting to the end, without any slackening.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢堅持不懈咁練習，最後終於成功咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin1 ci4 bat1 haai5 gam2 lin6 zaap6, zeoi3 hau6 zung1 jyu1 sing4 gung1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他坚持不懈地练习，最后终于成功了。
examples.english_sentence: He practiced persistently and finally succeeded.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 只要你堅持不懈，一定可以達到你嘅目標。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi2 jiu3 nei5 gin1 ci4 bat1 haai5, jat1 ding6 ho2 ji5 daat6 dou3 nei5 ge3 muk6 biu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 只要你坚持不懈，一定可以达到你的目标。
examples.english_sentence: As long as you persevere, you will definitely achieve your goals.

english_meaning: firm; steadfast; resilient; (of financial markets) strong
explanation_mandarin: 形容坚固挺拔，或指事物发展趋势强劲，不易动摇。
explanation_english: Describes something that is firm, upright, and resilient. In financial contexts, it refers to a strong and stable market trend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 樓市一直都好堅挺，冇跌過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lau4 si5 jat1 zik6 dou1 hou2 gin1 ting2, mou5 dit3 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房地产市场一直都很坚挺，没跌过。
examples.english_sentence: The real estate market has been very strong and has not fallen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢意志好堅挺，一定可以克服困難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji3 zi3 hou2 gin1 ting2, jat1 ding6 ho2 ji5 hak1 fuk6 kwan3 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的意志很坚定，一定可以克服困难。
examples.english_sentence: He has a strong will and will definitely overcome the difficulties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅業績喺經濟唔好嘅時候都咁堅挺，真係好犀利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 jip6 jik1 hai2 ging1 zai3 m4 hou2 ge3 si4 hau6 dou1 gam3 gin1 ting2, zan1 hai6 hou2 sai1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的业绩在经济不好的时候都这么坚挺，真的很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: This company's performance is so resilient even during a bad economy, it's really impressive.

mandarin_meaning: 厲害; 堅強; 扛得住
english_meaning: tough; awesome; capable; able to handle things; resilient
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人能力強，能幹，或者很厲害，經得起考驗，能扛住壓力。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is strong, capable, awesome, resilient, and able to handle difficult situations and pressure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好堅揪，乜嘢都頂得住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 gin1 ciu1, mat1 je5 dou1 ding2 dak1 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很厉害，什么都能顶住。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very tough person and can handle anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個project好難搞，好彩有佢先搞得掂，真係堅揪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 project hou2 naan4 gaau2, hou2 caai2 jau5 keoi5 sin1 gaau2 dak1 dim6, zan1 hai6 gin1 ciu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目很难搞，幸好有他才能完成，真是厉害。
examples.english_sentence: This project was very difficult. Luckily, he was able to complete it. He's really awesome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢參加毅行者，全程自己揹嘢，真係夠堅揪！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 caam1 gaa1 ngai6 hang4 ze2, cyun4 cing4 zi6 gei2 bei1 je5, zan1 hai6 gau3 gin1 ciu1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他参加毅行者，全程自己背东西，真够坚强！
examples.english_sentence: He participated in the Oxfam Trailwalker and carried his own supplies the entire way. He's truly resilient!

mandarin_meaning: 真材实料; 劲爆消息
english_meaning: genuine stuff; the real deal; bombshell news; reliable source
explanation_mandarin: （名词）指真实可靠的材料，高质量的东西。 （形容词）形容某事物是真的，可靠的，或者消息劲爆。
explanation_english: (Noun) Refers to genuine and reliable material, high-quality stuff. (Adjective) Describes something as being true, reliable, or news as being sensational.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食真係堅料，好足料㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 zan1 hai6 gin1 liu2, hou2 zuk1 liu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物真是真材实料，用料很足。
examples.english_sentence: The food in this restaurant is really the real deal; they use plenty of ingredients.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我收到堅料，聽日會加人工呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sau1 dou2 gin1 liu2, ting1 jat6 wui5 gaa1 jan4 gung1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我收到劲爆消息，明天会涨工资啊！
examples.english_sentence: I received bombshell news that we'll get a raise tomorrow!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢識好多堅料嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 sik1 hou2 do1 gin1 liu2 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他认识很多厉害的人。
examples.english_sentence: He said he knows a lot of influential/ capable people.

english_meaning: Nuts (edible seeds with a hard shell)
explanation_mandarin: 指外壳坚硬，富含油脂的可食用种子。
explanation_english: Refers to edible seeds with a hard shell and high oil content.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意食杏仁，因為佢係一種好好嘅堅果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 hang6 jan4, jan1 wai6 keoi5 hai6 jat1 zung2 hou2 hou2 ge3 gin1 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢吃杏仁，因为它是一种很好的坚果。
examples.english_sentence: I like to eat almonds because they are a good type of nut.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲混合堅果好啱送酒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 wan6 hap6 gin1 gwo2 hou2 ngaam1 sung3 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些混合坚果很适合配酒。
examples.english_sentence: These mixed nuts are perfect to go with wine.

english_meaning: determined, resolute, persistent, fortitude
explanation_mandarin: 形容意志坚定，有毅力。
explanation_english: Describing someone with a firm will and strong persistence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢憑住堅毅嘅精神，終於克服咗所有困難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 pang4 zyu6 gin1 ngai6 ge3 zing1 san4, zung1 jyu1 kok3 fuk1 zo2 so2 jau5 kwan3 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他凭借坚毅的精神，终于克服了所有困难。
examples.english_sentence: He finally overcame all difficulties with his determined spirit.

english_meaning: resolute, unyielding, steadfast, persevering
explanation_mandarin: 形容意志坚定，永不屈服。
explanation_english: Describes someone with a firm will who never gives in to adversity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺逆境入面都仍然堅毅不屈，真係好值得我哋學習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jik6 ging2 jap6 min6 dou1 jing4 jin4 gin1 ngai6 bat1 kwat1, zan1 hai6 hou2 dak1 zik6 ngo5 dei6 hok6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在逆境中仍然坚毅不屈，真的很值得我们学习。
examples.english_sentence: He remained resolute even in adversity, truly worth learning from.

english_meaning: resolute, firm, determined
explanation_mandarin: 形容态度、行动等坚定不移，毫不动摇。
explanation_english: Describes an attitude or action that is firm, unwavering, and resolute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢堅決唔肯認錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin1 kyut3 m4 hang2 jing6 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他坚决不肯认错。
examples.english_sentence: He resolutely refused to admit his mistake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要堅決反對暴力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gin1 kyut3 faan2 deoi3 bou6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要坚决反对暴力。
examples.english_sentence: We must firmly oppose violence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅態度好堅決，冇得改變。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 taai3 dou6 hou2 gin1 kyut3, mou5 dak1 goi2 bin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的态度很坚决，没有办法改变。
examples.english_sentence: His attitude is very resolute, and cannot be changed.

english_meaning: hard; solid; firm
explanation_mandarin: 形容物体质地硬而结实，不易变形或损坏。
explanation_english: Describing something as hard, solid, and not easily deformed or damaged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲石頭好堅硬，好難鑿開。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 sek6 tau4 hou2 gin1 ngaang6, hou2 naan4 zok6 hoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些石头很坚硬，很难凿开。
examples.english_sentence: These stones are very hard, it's difficult to chisel them open.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅意志好堅硬，遇到咩困難都唔會放棄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ji3 zi3 hou2 gin1 ngaang6, jyu6 dou2 me1 kwan3 naan4 dou1 m4 wui5 fong3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的意志很坚定，遇到什么困难都不会放弃。
examples.english_sentence: His will is very firm; he won't give up no matter what difficulties he encounters.

english_meaning: insist; maintain; assert strongly
explanation_mandarin: 坚持声称；坚决地说
explanation_english: To insist on; to maintain or assert something strongly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢堅稱自己係無辜㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin1 ching1 zi6 gei2 hai6 mou4 gu1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他坚称自己是无辜的。
examples.english_sentence: He insists that he is innocent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個犯堅稱佢冇去過案發現場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 faan2 gin1 ching1 keoi5 mou5 heoi3 gwo3 on3 faat3 sin6 cheung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 犯人坚称他没有去过案发现场。
examples.english_sentence: The criminal insisted that he had not been to the crime scene.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋堅稱呢個計劃係最好嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gin1 ching1 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 hai6 zeoi3 hou2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们坚称这个计划是最好的。
examples.english_sentence: They insisted that this plan was the best.

mandarin_meaning: 比石坚还坚硬; 非常坚固
english_meaning: Even tougher than Sek Kin; extremely tough; very durable; incredibly reliable
explanation_mandarin: 形容某物非常坚固、可靠，比著名演员石坚还要坚硬。石坚以饰演反派角色，尤其以奸角闻名，给人一种非常强硬的印象。所以以此作比喻。
explanation_english: Describes something that is extremely tough, durable, or reliable, even tougher than the famous actor Sek Kin. Sek Kin was known for playing villainous roles, giving him a strong and tough image, hence the comparison.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻錶堅過石堅，用咗十年都冇壞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 biu1 gin1 gwo3 sek6 gin1, yung6 zo2 sap6 nin4 dou1 mou5 waai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这只手表比石坚还坚硬，用了十年都没坏。
examples.english_sentence: This watch is as tough as Sek Kin, it hasn't broken down even after ten years of use.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅關係堅過石堅，經歷咗咁多嘢都冇分開。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 gin1 gwo3 sek6 gin1, ging1 lik6 zo2 gam3 do1 ye5 dou1 mou5 fan1 hoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的关系比石坚还坚硬，经历了这么多事都没有分开。
examples.english_sentence: Their relationship is as strong as Sek Kin, they haven't broken up despite going through so much.

english_meaning: Caine Road (a street name in Hong Kong)
explanation_mandarin: 坚道是香港岛中西区的一条街道。 以香港辅政司坚尼地命名。
explanation_english: Caine Road is a street in the Central and Western District of Hong Kong Island. It is named after Hong Kong Colonial Secretary William Caine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺堅道等。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 gin1 dou6 dang2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在坚道等。
examples.english_sentence: We'll wait at Caine Road.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢住喺堅道嗰頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyu6 hai2 gin1 dou6 go2 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他住在坚道那边。
examples.english_sentence: He lives around Caine Road.

english_meaning: Out of touch with reality; completely detached from real life; living in an ivory tower.
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人脱离实际，不了解普通人的生活和想法。通常指那些地位较高，生活优越的人，他们的观点和行为与大众脱节。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is out of touch with reality and unaware of the everyday lives and concerns of ordinary people. It often refers to people of high status or privileged backgrounds whose views and actions are disconnected from the general public.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋日日都搭的士返工，真係堅離地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 jat1 dou1 daap3 dik1 si2 faan1 gung1, zan1 hai6 gin1 lei4 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们每天都坐出租车上班，真是很不接地气。
examples.english_sentence: They take taxis to work every day, they're so out of touch with reality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嘅建議太離地喇，根本唔可行㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ge3 gin3 ji5 taai3 lei4 dei6 laa3, gan1 bun2 m4 ho2 hang4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的建议太不切实际了，根本不可行。
examples.english_sentence: Your suggestion is too unrealistic, it's simply not feasible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府啲政策成日都俾人話堅離地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 di1 zing3 caak3 sing4 jat1 dou1 bei2 jan4 waa6 gin1 lei4 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府的政策总是被人说不接地气。
examples.english_sentence: The government's policies are often criticized for being out of touch.

english_meaning: Resilient, tenacious, steadfast, tough
explanation_mandarin: 形容意志坚定，能经受住困难和挑战。
explanation_english: Describes the quality of being able to recover quickly from difficulties; toughness; the ability to withstand pressure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢性格好堅韌，遇到咩困難都唔會放棄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing3 gaak3 hou2 gin1 ngan6, jyu6 dou3 me1 kwan3 naan4 dou1 m4 wui5 fong3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的性格很坚韧，遇到什么困难都不会放弃。
examples.english_sentence: He has a very resilient personality; he won't give up no matter what difficulties he faces.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢種植物好堅韌，就算冇乜水都生得好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zung2植物 hou2 gin1 ngan6, zau6 syun3 mou5 me1 seoi2 dou1 saang1 dak1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种植物很坚韧，即使没什么水也能长得很好。
examples.english_sentence: This plant is very resilient; it can grow well even without much water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港人嘅堅韌精神令人敬佩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 jan4 ge3 gin1 ngan6 zing1 san4 ling6 jan4 ging3 pui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港人的坚韧精神令人敬佩。
examples.english_sentence: The resilience of Hongkongers is admirable.

english_meaning: pile, heap, stack; to pile up, to heap up
explanation_mandarin: 量词，表示成堆的东西。动词，表示堆积。名词，表示堆积起来的东西。
explanation_english: As a classifier, it measures things in piles or heaps. As a verb, it means to pile up. As a noun, it refers to a pile or heap of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 枱面有堆文件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: toi2 min6 jau5 deoi1 man4 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 桌子上有一堆文件。
examples.english_sentence: There is a pile of documents on the table.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂咁堆啲衫喺度啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 deoi1 di1 saam1 hai2 dou6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱堆衣服在这里！
examples.english_sentence: Don't just pile the clothes here randomly!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗成堆嘢返嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 seng4 deoi1 je5 faan1 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买了一堆东西回来。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a whole pile of things back.

english_meaning: to fill in (land), land reclamation, to reclaim land
explanation_mandarin: 指用泥土、石块等填满低洼的地方，或通过填海造地。
explanation_english: To fill in a low-lying area with earth, stone, etc., or to create land by reclaiming land from the sea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港好多土地都係靠堆塡返嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ho2 do1 tou2 dei6 dou1 hai6 kaau3 deoi1 tin4 faan1 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港很多土地都是靠填海得来的。
examples.english_sentence: A lot of land in Hong Kong was created through land reclamation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府計劃喺嗰度堆塡一個新嘅人工島。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 gai3 waak6 hai2 go2 dou6 deoi1 tin4 jat1 go3 san1 ge3 jan4 gung1 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府计划在那里填海造一个新的人工岛。
examples.english_sentence: The government plans to reclaim a new artificial island there.

english_meaning: Landfill
explanation_mandarin: 用于堆放和掩埋垃圾的区域。
explanation_english: An area of land where waste materials are buried.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅堆塡區差唔多飽和，要諗吓點樣處理啲垃圾先得啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 deoi1 tin4 keoi1 caa1 m4 do1 baau2 wo4, jiu3 nam2 haa5 dim2 joeng2 cyu2 lei5 di1 laap6 saap3 sin1 dak1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的垃圾填埋场差不多饱和了，要想想怎样处理这些垃圾才行。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's landfills are almost saturated. We need to think about how to deal with the waste.

english_meaning: landfill, to landfill
explanation_mandarin: 指用垃圾或其他废弃物填平低洼地区或海域，以扩大陆地面积或处理垃圾。
explanation_english: To fill low-lying land or coastal areas with garbage or other waste materials, either to expand land area or to dispose of waste.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅堆填區就嚟爆喇，要諗吓新方法處理垃圾先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 deoi1 tin4 ku1 zau6 lai4 baau3 laa3, jiu3 nam2 haa5 san1 fong1 faat3 cyu2 lei5 laap6 saap3 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的垃圾填埋场快要满了，需要想想新方法处理垃圾才行。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's landfills are almost full. We need to think of new ways to handle waste.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府計劃喺嗰度堆填，擴大個工業區。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 gai3 waak6 hai2 go2 dou6 deoi1 tin4, kwong3 daai6 go3 gung1 jip6 ku1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府计划在那里填埋，扩大工业区。
examples.english_sentence: The government plans to landfill there to expand the industrial zone.

english_meaning: Landfill
explanation_mandarin: 用于堆放垃圾的场所，通过填埋的方式处理垃圾。
explanation_english: A site for the disposal of waste materials by burial. A landfill.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港啲堆填區就嚟爆喇，要諗下其他方法處理垃圾先得。
