examples.english_sentence: A gentleman's revenge is never too late.

english_meaning: to report status / to update on the status
explanation_mandarin: “報status”是粤语中一个常用的口语表达，意思是汇报进度，报告情况，或更新状态。通常在工作场合或团队合作中用来了解事情的进展。
explanation_english: "報status" is a commonly used Cantonese colloquial expression that means to report progress, give updates, or report the status of something. It's often used in work settings or team collaborations to understand how things are going.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開會嘅時候，個個都要報status。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 wui2 ge3 si4 hau6, go3 go3 dou1 jiu3 bou3 si1 taat1 te2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开会的时候，每个人都要汇报进度。
examples.english_sentence: During the meeting, everyone has to report on their progress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你個project 報status未啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 go3 project bou3 si1 taat1 te2 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的项目汇报进度了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you updated the status of your project?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日先報status，依家仲未搞掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 sin1 bou3 si1 taat1 te2, ji1 gaa1 zung6 mei6 gaau2 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天再汇报情况，现在还没完成。
examples.english_sentence: I'll report the status tomorrow; it's not finished yet.

english_meaning: to snitch, to tattle, to inform on someone
explanation_mandarin: 指向他人告发某人的行为。通常带有负面含义，指背后告发，破坏关系的行为。
explanation_english: To snitch or tattle on someone; to inform on someone, usually in a negative context, implying backstabbing or betrayal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日報串啦，咁樣好乞人憎㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 bou3 cyun3 laa1, gam2 joeng2 hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是告密了，这样很惹人讨厌的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't always snitch! It's very annoying!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我驚佢會報串俾老師，所以唔敢講真相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 geng1 keoi5 wui5 bou3 cyun3 bei2 lou5 si1, so2 ji5 m4 gam2 gong2 zan1 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我怕他会向老师告密，所以不敢说真相。
examples.english_sentence: I'm afraid he'll snitch to the teacher, so I don't dare to tell the truth.

english_meaning: sticky note, Post-it note
explanation_mandarin: 一种带有粘性的纸张，用于记录信息或提醒，可以贴在各种表面上。
explanation_english: A small piece of paper with an adhesive strip on the back, used for writing notes and sticking them to surfaces.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我寫咗張報事貼提醒自己聽日要交功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 se2 zo2 zoeng1 bou3 si6 tip1 tai4 sing2 zi6 gei2 ting1 jat6 jiu3 gaau1 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我写了张便利贴提醒自己明天要交作业。
examples.english_sentence: I wrote a sticky note to remind myself to hand in my homework tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺個電腦mon貼滿咗報事貼，記住要做嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 go3 din6 nou5 mon1 tip3 mun5 zo2 bou3 si6 tip1, gei3 zyu6 jiu3 zou6 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在电脑显示器上贴满了便利贴，记住要做的事情。
examples.english_sentence: He stuck the computer monitor full of sticky notes to remember what to do.

english_meaning: journalist, reporter, press worker
explanation_mandarin: 指从事新闻行业的人员，包括记者、编辑等。
explanation_english: Refers to people working in the journalism industry, including reporters, editors, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個資深嘅報人，做咗好多年新聞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 zi1 san1 ge3 bou3 jan4, zou6 zo2 hou2 do1 nin4 san1 man2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一位资深的新闻从业员，做了很多年新闻。
examples.english_sentence: He is a senior journalist who has been working in journalism for many years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢位報人嘅報道好客觀公正。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wai2 bou3 jan4 ge3 bou3 dou6 hou2 hak1 gun1 gung1 zeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这位新闻从业员的报道很客观公正。
examples.english_sentence: This journalist's report is very objective and fair.

english_meaning: to take revenge; to avenge
explanation_mandarin: 指对伤害自己的人或事进行报复，以消除自己受到的损害。
explanation_english: To retaliate against someone who has harmed you; to seek vengeance for a wrong done to you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢發誓一定要報仇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faat3 sai6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 bou3 sau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他发誓一定要报仇。
examples.english_sentence: He swore that he would definitely take revenge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你千祈唔好諗住報仇，冤冤相報何時了？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 cin1 kei4 m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 bou3 sau4, jyun1 jyun1 soeng1 bou3 ho4 si4 liu5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你千万不要想着报仇，冤冤相报何时了？
examples.english_sentence: You must not think about taking revenge. When will this cycle of revenge end?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一直都諗住幫阿爸報仇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 zik6 dou1 lam2 zyu6 bong1 aa3 baa1 bou3 sau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一直都想着帮爸爸报仇。
examples.english_sentence: He has always been thinking about avenging his father.

english_meaning: To announce the good news (especially during Christmas); Caroling
explanation_mandarin: 原指在圣诞节期间挨家挨户唱歌，宣布耶稣诞生的喜讯。现也泛指传递好消息。
explanation_english: Originally, it refers to singing carols door-to-door during Christmas to announce the good news of Jesus' birth. Now, it generally refers to passing on good news.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋今晚會去報佳音，你諗唔諗住一齊去啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gam1 maan1 wui5 heoi3 bou3 gaai1 jam1, nei5 lam2 m4 lam2 zyu6 jat1 cai4 heoi3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们今晚会去报佳音，你考虑一起去吗？
examples.english_sentence: They're going caroling tonight, are you thinking of going together?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我收到大學嘅錄取通知，即刻報佳音俾屋企人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sau1 dou3 daai6 hok6 ge3 luk6 ceoi2 tung1 zi1, zik1 hak1 bou3 gaai1 jam1 bei2 uk1 kei2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我收到了大学的录取通知，立刻向家人报佳音。
examples.english_sentence: I received my university admission notice and immediately shared the good news with my family.

english_meaning: to report a false crime, to file a false police report
explanation_mandarin: 指向警方虚假报告犯罪事件。
explanation_english: To make a false report of a crime to the police; to falsely report an incident as a crime.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好亂咁報假案呀，係要負法律責任㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 bou3 gaa2 on3 aa3, hai6 jiu3 fu6 faat3 leot6 zaak3 jam3 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要随便报假案啊，是要负法律责任的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't just randomly report a false crime, you will be held legally responsible!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為報假案俾警察拉咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yan1 wai6 bou3 gaa2 on3 bei2 ging2 chaat3 laai1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为报假案被警察抓了。
examples.english_sentence: He was arrested by the police for filing a false report.

english_meaning: to report for the record; to inform; to register; to file a report
explanation_mandarin: 向上级或有关部门报告，以备查考。
explanation_english: To report something to a superior or relevant department for record-keeping purposes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去旅行之前要同公司報備。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4 zi1 cin4 jiu3 tung4 gung1 si1 bou3 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们去旅行之前要跟公司报备。
examples.english_sentence: We need to report to the company before we go on a trip.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做乜嘢重要嘅決定之前，最好同老闆報備聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 mat1 je5 cung5 jiu3 ge3 kyut3 ding6 zi1 cin4, zeoi3 hou2 tung4 lou5 baan2 bou3 bei6 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做任何重要的决定之前，最好跟老板报备一下。
examples.english_sentence: Before you make any important decisions, it's best to inform the boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗，所以要同學校報備請假。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2, so2 ji5 jiu3 tung4 hok6 haau6 bou3 bei6 ceng2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他生病了，所以要向学校报备请假。
examples.english_sentence: He's sick, so he needs to report to the school and ask for leave.

english_meaning: to quote a price; price quote; quotation
explanation_mandarin: 报出价格；给出价格的单据或信息。
explanation_english: To state or provide a price for goods or services; the act of providing a price, or the price itself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司幫我哋報價，睇下幾錢先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 bong1 ngo5 dei6 bou3 gaa3, tai2 haa5 gei2 cin2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司帮我们报价，看看多少钱再说。
examples.english_sentence: Let the company give us a quote and see how much it costs first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅報價好貴呀，可能要搵第二間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 bou3 gaa3 hou2 gwai3 aa3, ho2 nang4 jiu3 wan2 dai6 ji6 gaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的报价很贵啊，可能要找另一家。
examples.english_sentence: Their quotation is very expensive, we might need to find another one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要多幾間公司嘅報價嚟比較下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 do1 gei2 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 bou3 gaa3 lai4 bei2 gaau3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要几家公司的报价来比较一下。
examples.english_sentence: We need quotations from several companies to compare.

english_meaning: quotation, price list, quote
explanation_mandarin: 列明商品或服务的价格的单据。
explanation_english: A document listing the prices of goods or services.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想問你攞張報價單睇下，比較下唔同公司嘅價錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 man6 nei5 lo2 zoeng1 bou3 gaa3 daan1 tai2 haa5, bei2 gaau3 haa5 m4 tung4 gung1 si1 ge3 gaa3 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想问你拿一份报价单看看，比较一下不同公司的价格。
examples.english_sentence: I want to ask you for a quotation to see and compare the prices of different companies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋收到好多份報價單，而家要揀邊間公司好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sau1 dou2 hou2 do1 fan6 bou3 gaa3 daan1, ji4 gaa1 jiu3 gaan2 bin1 gaan1 gung1 si1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们收到了很多份报价单，现在要选择哪家公司好。
examples.english_sentence: We received many quotations, and now we need to choose which company is good.

english_meaning: newspapers and periodicals; the press
explanation_mandarin: 指报纸和期刊等出版物。
explanation_english: Refers to publications such as newspapers and periodicals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺圖書館睇好多唔同嘅報刊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 tou4 syu1 gun2 tai2 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 ge3 bou3 hon1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在图书馆看很多不同的报刊。
examples.english_sentence: He reads many different newspapers and periodicals in the library.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多人喺網上睇新聞，睇報刊嘅人少咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 jan4 hai2 mong5 soeng6 tai2 san1 man2, tai2 bou3 hon1 ge3 jan4 siu2 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多人在网上看新闻，看报刊的人少了很多。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, many people read news online, and fewer people read newspapers and periodicals.

english_meaning: to report for duty; to register; to check in
explanation_mandarin: 指在新的工作单位、学校等地方正式登记并开始工作或学习。也指到达某个地点后向有关人员报告。
explanation_english: To report for duty, register, or check in at a new workplace, school, or other location to officially begin work or study. It also refers to reporting to relevant personnel upon arrival at a certain location.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日第一日返工，要早啲去報到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 dai6 jat1 jat6 faan1 gung1, jiu3 zou2 di1 heoi3 bou3 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天第一天上班，要早点去报到。
examples.english_sentence: Tomorrow is my first day of work, I need to go and report for duty earlier.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去酒店報到先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 zau2 dim3 bou3 dou3 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们先去酒店报到吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's check in at the hotel first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學生開學前要返學校報到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 sang1 hoi1 hok6 cin4 jiu3 faan1 hok6 haau6 bou3 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学生开学前要回学校报到。
examples.english_sentence: Students need to return to school to register before the start of the semester.

english_meaning: to register, to sign up
explanation_mandarin: 登记姓名，参加某项活动或组织。
explanation_english: To register or sign up for an activity, event, or organization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想報名參加個烹飪班。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 bou3 ming4 caam1 gaa1 go3 paang1 jam6 baan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想报名参加烹饪班。
examples.english_sentence: I want to sign up for the cooking class.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你報咗名未呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bou3 zo2 ming4 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你报名了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you signed up yet?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 報名費幾多錢呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou3 ming4 fai3 gei2 do1 cin2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 报名费多少钱？
examples.english_sentence: How much is the registration fee?

english_meaning: Just letting you know, reporting to you
explanation_mandarin: 一种比较客气或调侃的表达方式，意思是向您汇报情况或通知您某事。常用在开始叙述某件事情之前。
explanation_english: A polite or playful way of saying "just letting you know" or "reporting to you." It is often used before starting to describe something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 報君知，我今晚唔返嚟食飯喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou3 gwan1 zi1, ngo5 gam1 maan5 m4 faan1 lai4 sik6 faan6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 告诉您，我今晚不回来吃饭了。
examples.english_sentence: Just letting you know, I won't be coming home for dinner tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 報君知，聽日會落雨，記得帶遮啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou3 gwan1 zi1, ting1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5, gei3 dak1 daai3 ze1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 告诉您，明天会下雨，记得带伞啊。
examples.english_sentence: Reporting to you, it will rain tomorrow, remember to bring an umbrella.

english_meaning: report; to report; to inform
explanation_mandarin: （名词）指向上级汇报情况的书面或口头材料；（动词）向上级汇报情况。
explanation_english: (noun) a written or oral account of something; (verb) to give an account of something to a superior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要向老細報告個項目嘅進度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 hoeng3 lou5 sai3 bou3 gou3 go3 hong6 muk6 ge3 zeon3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要向老板报告项目的进度。
examples.english_sentence: I need to report the progress of the project to the boss tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢遞交咗一份詳細嘅報告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dai6 gaau1 zo2 jat1 fan6 seon6 sai3 ge3 bou3 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他递交了一份详细的报告。
examples.english_sentence: He submitted a detailed report.

english_meaning: report; to report; to inform
explanation_mandarin: 汇报情况；呈报上去的文件或口头陈述
explanation_english: To give an account of something; to inform or notify; a formal account of an event or investigation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我要向老細報告今日嘅進度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jiu3 hoeng3 lou5 sai3 bou3 gok3 gam1 jat6 ge3 zeon3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我要向老板报告今天的进度。
examples.english_sentence: I need to report today's progress to the boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋要寫一份詳細嘅報告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jiu3 se2 jat1 fan6 cheung4 sai3 ge3 bou3 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们要写一份详细的报告。
examples.english_sentence: They need to write a detailed report.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請你報告發生咗咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ching2 nei5 bou3 gok3 faat3 sang1 zo2 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请你报告发生了什么事。
examples.english_sentence: Please report what happened.

english_meaning: to announce good news, to report a success
explanation_mandarin: 报告喜讯，告知好消息。
explanation_english: To announce or report good news, often used to express happiness about a success or achievement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考到大學喇，即刻打電話返屋企報喜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 dou2 daai6 hok6 laa3, zik1 hak1 daa2 din6 waa2 faan1 uk1 kei2 bou3 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考上大学了，立刻打电话回家报喜。
examples.english_sentence: He got into university and immediately called home to announce the good news.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司今年賺咗好多錢，老闆好開心噉樣報喜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 gam1 nin4 zaan6 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2, lou5 baan2 hou2 hoi1 sam1 gam2 joeng2 bou3 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司今年赚了很多钱，老板很高兴地报喜。
examples.english_sentence: The company made a lot of money this year, and the boss happily announced the good news.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅團隊贏咗比賽，要快啲報喜俾佢哋知！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 tyun4 deoi2 jeng4 zo2 bei2 coi3, jiu3 faai3 di1 bou3 hei2 bei2 keoi5 dei6 zi1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的团队赢了比赛，要快点报喜给他们知道！
examples.english_sentence: Our team won the competition, we need to quickly announce the good news to them!

synonyms: 宣告好消息 (syun1 gou3 hou2 siu1 sik1)

mandarin_meaning: 报喜不报忧 (bào xǐ bù bào yōu)
english_meaning: To report only the good news, not the bad; to present a rosy picture; to put a positive spin on things
explanation_mandarin: 只报告好的消息，不报告坏的消息。形容隐瞒坏消息，只说好听的，粉饰太平。
explanation_english: An idiom describing the act of only reporting good news and concealing bad news. It's used to describe someone who paints a rosy picture by hiding negative aspects or situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日報喜不報憂，搞到我哋以為佢生意做得好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 bou3 hei2 bat1 bou3 jau1, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 dei6 ji5 wai4 keoi5 saang1 ji3 zou6 dak1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是报喜不报忧，搞得我们以为他的生意做得很好。
examples.english_sentence: He always reports only good news, making us think his business is doing very well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲仔女通常都係報喜不報憂，唔想屋企人擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 zai2 neoi5 tung1 soeng4 dou1 hai6 bou3 hei2 bat1 bou3 jau1, m4 soeng2 uk1 kei2 jan4 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 孩子们通常都报喜不报忧，不想家里人担心。
examples.english_sentence: Children usually report only the good news, not wanting their families to worry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份報告報喜不報憂，完全睇唔到實際嘅問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 bou3 gou3 bou3 hei2 bat1 bou3 jau1, jyun4 cyun4 tai2 m4 dou3 sat6 zai3 ge3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的报告报喜不报忧，完全看不到实际的问题。
examples.english_sentence: His report only showed the good news and hid the bad, completely obscuring the real problems.

english_meaning: to announce a death; to inform (someone) of a bereavement
explanation_mandarin: 指将某人去世的消息告知亲友。
explanation_english: To announce the death of someone to relatives and friends. It typically involves formally informing people of a bereavement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆走咗，佢哋要報喪俾親戚朋友知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 zau2 zo2, keoi5 dei6 jiu3 bou3 song3 bei2 can1 cik1 pang4 jau5 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶去世了，他们要报丧给亲戚朋友。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma passed away, and they need to inform relatives and friends about the bereavement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 過身之後，仔女要盡快報喪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwo3 san1 zi1 hau6, zai2 neoi5 jiu3 zeon6 faai3 bou3 song3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去世之后，子女要尽快报丧。
examples.english_sentence: After someone passes away, the children must announce the death as soon as possible.

english_meaning: to serve one's country, to be devoted to one's country
explanation_mandarin: 指为国家尽力，贡献力量。
explanation_english: To serve one's country, dedicating one's efforts and strength to the nation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅一生都奉獻咗畀報國。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jat1 sang1 dou1 fung6 hin3 zo2 bei2 bou3 gwok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的一生都奉献给了报效国家。
examples.english_sentence: He dedicated his entire life to serving his country.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋希望將來可以報國為民。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hei1 mong6 zoeng1 loi4 ho2 ji5 bou3 gwok3 wai4 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们希望将来可以报效国家，为人民服务。
examples.english_sentence: They hope to serve their country and its people in the future.

english_meaning: to appear in someone's dream to deliver a message
explanation_mandarin: 指去世的人在活人的梦中出现，传递信息或请求。
explanation_english: Refers to a deceased person appearing in a living person's dream to deliver a message or make a request.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢過咗身之後，成日都報夢俾佢老婆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gwo3 zo2 san1 zi1 hau6, sing4 jat6 dou1 bou3 mung6 bei2 keoi5 lou5 po4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他去世之后，经常托梦给他老婆。
examples.english_sentence: After he passed away, he often appeared in his wife's dreams.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我噚晚發夢，阿爺報夢叫我買六合彩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cam4 maan5 faat3 mung6, aa3 je4 bou3 mung6 giu3 ngo5 maai5 luk6 hap6 coi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨晚做梦，爷爷托梦叫我买彩票。
examples.english_sentence: I had a dream last night, my grandfather appeared in my dream and told me to buy the lottery.

english_meaning: To exaggerate figures; to inflate numbers; to overreport
explanation_mandarin: 故意夸大实际的数目，通常是为了某种利益或掩盖问题。
explanation_english: To deliberately exaggerate actual figures, usually for personal gain or to cover up problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日報大數，搞到盤數錯晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 bou3 daai6 sou3, gaau2 dou3 pun4 sou3 co3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是虚报数字，搞得账目全错了。
examples.english_sentence: He always exaggerates the figures, causing all the accounts to be wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好報大數呀，真實啲好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 bou3 daai6 sou3 aa3, zan1 sat6 di1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要虚报数字啊，真实一点好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't exaggerate the figures, be more truthful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司為咗呃投資者，所以報大數，但係最終都係俾人發現咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 wai6 zo2 aak1 tau4 zi1 ze2, so2 ji5 bou3 daai6 sou3, daan6 hai6 zeoi3 chung1 dou1 hai6 bei2 jan4 faat3 hin1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那间公司为了欺骗投资者，所以虚报数字，但是最终还是被人发现了。
examples.english_sentence: That company inflated the numbers to deceive investors, but it was eventually discovered.

english_meaning: to report a loss; to report something missing
explanation_mandarin: 向有关部门报告遗失物品或证件等。
explanation_english: To report the loss of an item or document to the relevant authorities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我琴日喺街度唔見咗銀包，今日要去差館報失。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kam4 jat6 hai2 gaai1 dou6 m4 gin3 zo2 ngan4 baau1, gam1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 caai1 gun2 bou3 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天在街上丢了钱包，今天要去警察局报失。
examples.english_sentence: I lost my wallet on the street yesterday, I need to go to the police station to report the loss today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你應該即刻報失信用卡，費事俾人盜用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ying1 goi1 zik1 hak1 bou3 sat1 sin3 jung6 kaat1, fai3 si6 bei2 jan4 dou6 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你应该立刻报失信用卡，免得被人盗用。
examples.english_sentence: You should report the loss of your credit card immediately, to prevent it from being used fraudulently.

mandarin_meaning: 告状, 告密, 打小报告
english_meaning: to snitch, to tell on someone, to rat someone out
explanation_mandarin: 指向老师、领导或长辈报告某人的错误或不当行为。通常带贬义，指偷偷告发。
explanation_english: To inform a teacher, leader, or elder about someone's mistakes or misbehavior. Usually carries a negative connotation, implying secretly telling on someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日報寸啦，好乞人憎㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 bou3 cyun3 laa1, hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是告状了，很令人讨厌的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't always snitch, it's very annoying!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我驚佢會報寸，所以唔敢同佢講秘密。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 geng1 keoi5 wui5 bou3 cyun3, so2 ji5 m4 gam2 tung4 keoi5 gong2 bei3 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我怕他会告密，所以不敢跟他讲秘密。
examples.english_sentence: I'm afraid he will snitch, so I don't dare to tell him secrets.

english_meaning: report; broadcast; coverage
explanation_mandarin: 以书面或口头形式，对事件或情况进行叙述和介绍；指新闻报道。
explanation_english: To give a spoken or written account of something that one has observed, heard, done, or investigated; also refers to news coverage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 琴日啲新聞有報導單交通意外。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kam4 jat6 di1 san1 man4 jau5 bou3 dou6 daan1 gaau1 tung1 ji3 ngoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天的新闻报道了一起交通事故。
examples.english_sentence: Yesterday's news reported on a traffic accident.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇咗今朝嘅報導未啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 zo2 gam1 ziu1 ge3 bou3 dou6 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看了今天早上的报道了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you read this morning's report?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電視台報導咗呢件事，好多人都知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 si6 toi4 bou3 dou6 zo2 ni1 gin6 si6, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电视台报道了这件事，很多人都知道。
examples.english_sentence: The TV station reported this, so many people know about it.

synonyms: 報道 (Cantonese alternative spelling using same characters)

english_meaning: to report that one is safe; to let someone know you are safe
explanation_mandarin: 告知别人自己平安无事，通常是在遇到可能发生危险的情况下。
explanation_english: To inform someone that you are safe and well, usually after a potentially dangerous situation or event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打風嗰陣，記得打電話返屋企報平安呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 fung1 go2 zan6, gei3 dak1 daa2 din6 waa2 faan1 uk1 kei2 bou3 ping1 on1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 台风的时候，记得打电话回家报平安啊。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to call home and report that you're safe when the typhoon hits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行山之後，佢即刻send咗個message畀屋企人報平安。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 saan1 zi1 hau6, keoi5 zik1 hak1 send zo2 go3 message bei2 uk1 kei2 jan4 bou3 ping1 on1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爬山之后，他立刻发了个短信给家人报平安。
examples.english_sentence: After hiking, he immediately sent a message to his family to let them know he was safe.

english_meaning: to scrap; to discard as waste; to write off
explanation_mandarin: 指设备、物品等因损坏或老化而失去使用价值，需要注销登记并丢弃。
explanation_english: To officially declare something, typically machinery or equipment, as no longer serviceable and to be discarded or scrapped. It often involves removing it from official records.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車撞到咁爛，一定要報廢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 zong6 dou3 gam3 laan6, jat1 ding6 jiu3 bou3 fai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车撞得这么烂，一定要报废了。
examples.english_sentence: The car is so badly damaged; it definitely needs to be scrapped.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部舊電腦已經用咗十年，都差唔多要報廢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 gau6 din6 nou5 ji5 ging1 yung6 zo2 sap6 nin4, dou1 caa1 m4 do1 jiu3 bou3 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台旧电脑已经用了十年，也差不多要报废了。
examples.english_sentence: This old computer has been used for ten years; it's about to be scrapped.

english_meaning: revenge, retaliation
explanation_mandarin: 对他人施加的损害或伤害采取行动，以牙还牙。指对别人对自己造成的损害进行回击。
explanation_english: To take revenge or retaliate for harm or injury done to oneself; to inflict punishment or suffering on someone for an injury or wrong done.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想報復佢老闆炒佢魷魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 bou3 fuk6 keoi5 lou5 baan2 caau2 keoi5 jau4 jyu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想报复他老板炒了他鱿鱼。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to retaliate against his boss for firing him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想報復，只想放過自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 bou3 fuk6, zi2 soeng2 fong3 gwo3 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想报复，只想放过我自己。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want revenge, I just want to let myself go.

english_meaning: to repay kindness, to return a favor
explanation_mandarin: 报答别人给予的恩惠。
explanation_english: To repay someone's kindness or favor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嗰陣受過好多人嘅幫忙，大個咗就諗住要報恩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 sau6 gwo3 hou2 do1 jan4 ge3 bong1 mong4, daai6 go3 zo2 zau6 lam2 zyu6 jiu3 bou3 yan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候受到很多人的帮助，长大后就想着要报恩。
examples.english_sentence: He received a lot of help when he was young, and now that he's grown up, he wants to repay the kindness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一定要報恩，唔會辜負你嘅期望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 bou3 yan1, m4 wui5 gu1 fu6 nei5 ge3 kei4 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一定要报恩，不会辜负你的期望。
examples.english_sentence: I must repay your kindness, I won't let you down.

english_meaning: retribution, karma, divine justice, comeuppance
explanation_mandarin: 佛教或民间信仰中，认为做了坏事会受到相应的惩罚，做好事会得到相应的回报。
explanation_english: In Buddhist or folk beliefs, it refers to the concept that bad deeds will be punished accordingly, and good deeds will be rewarded accordingly; karma.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁衰，遲早會有報應嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 seoi1, ci4 zou2 wui5 jau5 bou3 jing3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么坏，迟早会有报应的。
examples.english_sentence: He's so bad, he'll get his retribution sooner or later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做咁多壞事，小心有報應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 gam3 do1 waai6 si6, siu2 sam1 jau5 bou3 jing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要做那么多坏事，小心报应。
examples.english_sentence: Don't do so many bad things, be careful of retribution.

english_meaning: to announce a victory; to report a success; to herald good news
explanation_mandarin: 报告胜利或取得成功的消息。表示取得好的成绩或进展后对外宣布。
explanation_english: To announce a victory or report a success. It signifies announcing good results or progress to the public.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺呢個項目入面成功報捷喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 jap6 min6 sing4 gung1 bou3 zit6 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在这个项目里成功报捷了！
examples.english_sentence: We have successfully announced our victory in this project!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司啱啱報捷，話今年嘅盈利創新高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ngaam1 ngaam1 bou3 zit6, waa6 gam1 nin4 ge3 ying4 lei6 cong3 san1 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司刚刚报捷，说今年的盈利创新高。
examples.english_sentence: The company just announced a victory, saying this year's profit has reached a new high.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 運動員喺奧運會上面為香港報捷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wan6 dung6 jyun4 hai2 ou3 wan6 wui2 soeng6 min6 wai4 hoeng1 gong2 bou3 zit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 运动员在奥运会上为香港报捷。
examples.english_sentence: The athlete announced a victory for Hong Kong at the Olympic Games.

english_meaning: Newspaper stand, newsstand
explanation_mandarin: 销售报纸、杂志等出版物的摊位。
explanation_english: A stand or stall that sells newspapers, magazines, and other publications.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺報攤買咗份報紙睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 bou3 taan1 maai5 zo2 fan6 bou3 zi2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在报摊买了一份报纸看。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a newspaper from the newspaper stand to read.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前好多地方都有報攤，而家少咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 hou2 do1 dei6 fong1 dou1 jau5 bou3 taan1, ji4 gaa1 siu2 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前很多地方都有报摊，现在少了很多。
examples.english_sentence: There used to be many newspaper stands everywhere, but there are much fewer now.

mandarin_meaning: 报数, 汇报数字, 报告数量
english_meaning: Report numbers, report the count, give a tally
explanation_mandarin: 汇报具体的数字或者数量，通常指上报统计结果或点名报数。
explanation_english: To report specific numbers or quantities, usually referring to reporting statistical results or calling out names to count the number of people present.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每個星期都要報數，好煩呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 go3 sing1 kei4 dou1 jiu3 bou3 sou3, hou2 faan4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每个星期都要报数，好烦啊！
examples.english_sentence: We have to report the numbers every week, it's so annoying!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日開會要你報數，記得準備定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 hoi1 wui2 jiu3 nei5 bou3 sou3, gei3 dak1 zeon2 bei6 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天开会要你报数，记得准备好。
examples.english_sentence: You need to report the figures at the meeting tomorrow, remember to be prepared.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 點名嘅時候，記得大聲啲報數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dim2 ming2 ge3 si4 hau6, gei3 dak1 daai6 seng1 di1 bou3 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 点名的时候，记得大声地报数。
examples.english_sentence: When roll is called, remember to report your number louder.

english_meaning: To provide information; to leak information; to tip off; to blow the whistle
explanation_mandarin: 指向媒体或有关部门提供不为人知的信息或内幕消息，通常涉及丑闻、内幕或秘密。
explanation_english: To provide previously unknown information, often regarding scandals, inside stories, or secrets, to the media or relevant authorities. It often implies revealing something that was meant to be kept private.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢向記者報料，揭發咗間公司嘅黑幕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hoeng3 gei3 ze2 bou3 liu2, kit3 faat3 zo2 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 hak1 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他向记者爆料，揭发了这家公司的内幕。
examples.english_sentence: He tipped off the reporter, revealing the company's shady dealings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇嘢報料？我哋想知道多啲內情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 je5 bou3 liu2? ngo5 dei6 soeng2 zi1 dou3 do1 di1 noi6 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有没有什么消息要提供？我们想知道更多内情。
examples.english_sentence: Do you have any information to provide? We want to know more about the inside story.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂咁報料，小心俾人告誹謗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 bou3 liu2, siu2 sam1 bei2 jan4 gou3 fei2 pong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱爆料，小心被人告诽谤。
examples.english_sentence: Don't leak information recklessly, be careful you don't get sued for defamation.

english_meaning: to tell the time; to announce the time
explanation_mandarin: 指告知或宣布时间。
explanation_english: To tell or announce the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個鐘頭好準確，可以幫你準確報時。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zung1 tau4 hou2 zeon2 kok3, ho2 ji5 bong1 nei5 zeon2 kok3 bou3 si4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个钟表很准确，可以帮你准确报时。
examples.english_sentence: This clock is very accurate and can tell you the time accurately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電台每小時都會報時。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 toi4 mui5 siu2 si4 dou1 wui5 bou3 si4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电台每小时都会报时。
examples.english_sentence: The radio station announces the time every hour.

english_meaning: to report for duty; to clock in (for a shift)
explanation_mandarin: 指工作人员向主管或相关部门报告自己开始上班或接替班次。
explanation_english: To report for duty or to clock in, typically referring to workers reporting to their supervisor or relevant department at the start of their shift.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日朝早八點要報更。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 ziu1 zou2 baat3 dim2 jiu3 bou3 gaang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天早上八点要报班。
examples.english_sentence: I have to report for duty at 8 am tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你報咗更未呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bou3 zo2 gaang1 mei6 a3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你报班了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you reported for duty yet?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴日唔舒服，所以無報更。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 m4 syu1 fuk6, so2 ji5 mou5 bou3 gaang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天不舒服，所以没有报班。
examples.english_sentence: He wasn't feeling well yesterday, so he didn't report for duty.

synonyms: 返工 (faan1 gung1 - to go to work)
上班 (soeng5 baan1 - to go to work)

english_meaning: quality; style; personality; integrity
explanation_mandarin: 指人的品质、风格或事物的格调。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's character, style, or the quality of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好有報格㗎，唔會呃人嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 jau5 bou3 gaak3 gaa3, m4 wui5 aak1 jan4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的为人很有品质，不会骗人的。
examples.english_sentence: He has good integrity; he wouldn't cheat people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅裝修幾有報格喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 zong1 sau1 gei2 jau5 bou3 gaak3 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的装修很有格调。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant's decoration has a good style.

english_meaning: to report a case (to the police)
explanation_mandarin: 向警察机关报告案件，请求处理。
explanation_english: To report a crime or incident to the police; to file a police report.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我琴日喺條街俾人打劫，今日要去報案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kam4 jat6 hai2 tiu4 gaai1 bei2 jan4 daa2 gip3, gam1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 bou3 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天在街上被人抢劫，今天要去报案。
examples.english_sentence: I was robbed on the street yesterday, and I have to report the case to the police today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你唔見咗銀包，應該盡快去警署報案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 m4 gin3 zo2 ngan4 baau1, ying1 goi1 zeon6 faai3 heoi3 ging2 syu2 bou3 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你丢了钱包，应该尽快去警局报案。
